bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: 7 Cups
providers.description: 7 Cups is an online emotional support and mental health platform founded in July 2013 by psychologist Glen Moriarty (Y Combinator S13) and based in Palo Alto, California. It connects people seeking help with trained volunteer "listeners" for free, anonymous, 24/7 one-to-one active-listening chat, and also offers community forums, group support chat rooms, self-help growth paths, and affordable online therapy with licensed therapists via messaging. The service reports reaching tens of millions of people across roughly 190 countries, supported by hundreds of thousands of trained volunteer listeners, and sells organizational solutions for schools, employers, and health plans. 7 Cups does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Arteria AI
providers.description: Arteria AI is an enterprise AI company for financial services that positions itself as the agentic backbone of financial services operations. Its platform automates document-intensive workflows across the institutional client lifecycle for tier-one global financial institutions: OTC derivatives and ISDA onboarding, prime brokerage, securities services and custody, corporate and commercial lending, trade confirmations, securities lending and repo, regulatory reporting, and post-transaction loan compliance. The platform spans four layers (data, component, agentic, and workflow), combining no-code configuration, automated document generation, intelligent extraction with zero-shot models, clause comparison and decisioning, and controlled agentic orchestration. Arteria AI is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified. It does not publish a public API or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity, domain-security posture, and published compliance certifications.

providers.name: Augmedix
providers.description: Augmedix is a San Francisco-based health technology company providing ambient AI medical documentation (AI scribe) services that capture patient-clinician conversations and generate clinical notes so that physicians can focus on patient care instead of EHR data entry. Founded in 2012, the company went public on Nasdaq in 2021 (AUGX) and was acquired by Commure in October 2024, becoming part of Commure's clinician-workflow platform alongside HCA Healthcare-aligned tooling. Augmedix's product line spans three service tiers — Augmedix Go (self-service AI scribe), Augmedix Assist (AI drafting with human editing, coding, and referral-letter support, notes ready within an hour), and Augmedix Live (full-service dedicated medical documentation specialist before, during, and after the visit) — plus specialty variants for Emergency Medicine, oncology, and other specialties. The platform integrates with major EHRs including Epic, Oracle Cerner, athenahealth, Meditech, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, and iKnowMed, and is HIPAA-compliant and HITRUST-certified. Augmedix's GitHub presence consists of internal QA, scribe-app base, and ambient API automation repositories; there is no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI specification — integration with Augmedix is handled through enterprise EHR partnerships and the Commure clinician platform rather than a self-service developer surface.

providers.name: Auquan
providers.description: Auquan builds production-grade, autonomous AI agents for institutional finance — agentic systems that convert messy, global, unstructured data (earnings calls, ESG disclosures, filings, news across 2M+ sources in 76 languages) into auditable, decision-ready intelligence and fully-formed deliverables such as credit memos, IC memos, portfolio-monitoring alerts, sustainability reports and LP reporting. Its RAG-powered agents cover 550,000+ companies and entities and complete end-to-end workflows autonomously for banks, asset managers, private credit, insurers and other institutional clients. Founded by Chandini Jain (CEO) and Shub Jain (CTO) with offices in New York and London, Auquan is used by 40% of the top 50 financial institutions (MetLife, T. Rowe Price, BC Partners) and was named a Gartner 2025 Cool Vendor in Agentic AI. The platform is demo/sales-gated and publishes no public self-service API or developer portal.

providers.name: Burbank
providers.description: Burbank is a Cardiff and London based payments technology company that builds card-present authentication for online and remote payments. Its flagship Card Present Over Internet (CPoI) technology lets consumers authenticate anywhere using the globally familiar "tap and PIN" gesture, alongside a SoftPOS product and an Issuer Toolkit for identity verification. Burbank ships a white-label SDK (mobile library plus containerized backend services) to issuers, acquirers, and payment service providers to reduce online fraud and improve conversion. Backed by Anthemis, Mouro Capital, and Portfolio Ventures.

providers.name: BuzzFeed
providers.description: BuzzFeed Inc. is a digital media company founded in 2006 and headquartered in New York City, best known for its viral entertainment, quizzes, pop-culture coverage, and commerce content. The company operates a portfolio of brands including the flagship BuzzFeed site, the news operation HuffPost, and the food brand Tasty, and produces video, podcasts, and shoppable content across web and social platforms. BuzzFeed is a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: BZFD) and monetizes through advertising, brand partnerships, and commerce. It does not publish a general-purpose public developer API program; its public machine-readable surface consists of content syndication (RSS feeds), an advertising/partnerships business, and a security.txt vulnerability-disclosure program via HackerOne. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from an a16z portfolio lead and enriched with the provider's real public surface.

providers.name: caimitech
providers.description: caimitech.com is the domain of Wacai (挖财, Hangzhou Wacai Network Technology Co.), a Chinese personal-finance and wealth-management company founded in 2009 that offers accounting/bookkeeping apps, personal financial management (PFM) tools, wealth-management services, and credit solutions. Its developer surface is the Wacai Open Platform (挖财开放平台) — an HMAC-signed API gateway addressed by (api_name, api_version) pairs rather than REST paths, with first-party client SDKs in Java (published to Maven Central under com.wacai), Node.js, PHP, Go, and C#, plus a separate topic-based message gateway (pull/ack). Access uses an app_key/app_secret credential with MAC or RSA request signing and an optional token service. No OpenAPI document is published; this profile was enriched from the provider's public GitHub SDKs and package registries.

providers.name: Citibank Canada
providers.description: Citibank Canada (Citi Canada) is the Canadian arm of Citigroup, chartered under Canada's Bank Act as a Schedule II (foreign bank subsidiary) deposit-taking institution, established in 1919 in Toronto and headquartered at Citigroup Place, 123 Front Street West. It is a member of the Canadian Bankers Association and the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation (CDIC). Citi Canada is an institutional and corporate bank only — securities trading, cash management, treasury, trade finance, custody, clearing, securities financing and private banking — having exited Canadian consumer retail banking years ago (its MasterCard portfolio was sold to CIBC in 2010 and CitiFinancial Canada, now Fairstone, was divested in 2017). It runs no Canada-specific developer portal; its corporate and institutional clients integrate through Citigroup's group-level Citi Developer Experience and CitiConnect API platform for payments, statements/reporting, balance inquiry and FX. Canada has no operational open-banking mandate — the federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (Budget 2024 / FES 2024, overseen by the FCAC) is legislated but not yet live — and because Citi Canada holds no retail consumer accounts here, consumer data-aggregation access is not applicable to this entity.

providers.name: Clone
providers.description: Clone Robotics develops musculoskeletal, intelligent humanoid androids and robotic hands built on Myofiber, its artificial-muscle technology pioneered in 2021, driven by water-based hydraulics and biomimetic joints. Its flagship Clone Alpha is a full-body biomimetic humanoid with synthetic organs; the Clone Hand is its foundational dexterous-manipulation platform. The developer surface is a first-party Python client (clone_client) exposing a high-level gRPC (proto3) API to directly control the Clone Robot over the local network — actuating muscles via impulses/pulses/pressures, driving pinch and hydra valves, managing the water-pump pressure source, streaming IMU/pose/joint telemetry, and configuring cameras. There is no public HTTP/REST API or hosted endpoint; control is LAN-scoped gRPC discovered over zeroconf/mDNS by robot name or IP. Co-founded 2021 by Dhanush Radhakrishna and Lukasz Kozlik.

providers.name: Delve Bio
providers.description: Delve Bio is a genomic diagnostics company commercializing clinical metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) for infectious disease diagnosis. Its flagship test, Delve Detect, analyzes all nucleic acids in a single cerebrospinal fluid sample to simultaneously detect bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites, screening against a curated database of more than 68,000 pathogen species to diagnose meningitis and encephalitis with results in roughly 48 hours. The company is the exclusive licensee of the University of California San Francisco (UCSF) mNGS technology developed at the Center for Next-Gen Precision Diagnostics, founded by Charles Chiu, Joe DeRisi, Michael Wilson, Pardis Sabeti, and Matthew Meyerson, and backed by investors including GV. Delve Bio operates as a CAP/CLIA-certified clinical laboratory serving labs and clinicians; it exposes no public developer API surface. Added to the API Evangelist network as a gv portfolio lead.

providers.name: Expedock
providers.description: Expedock is a digital business process outsourcing (BPO) and document-automation company for the logistics and freight-forwarding industry. It pairs AI-powered document automation products (FCL/LCL accounts-payable automation, monthly statement automation, and commercial invoice and packing-list data entry) with tech-enabled remote teams supported by operations managers and QA specialists. Freight forwarders, 3PLs, and supply-chain operators use Expedock to digitize shipping documents, automate back-office workflows, and scale operations without scaling headcount. Customers include Maersk, Gebrueder Weiss, and large shippers such as Nike, Adidas, Coca-Cola, and Shell. Expedock is backed by Insight Partners. The company operates a Digital BPO offering and document-automation product suite; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference documentation.

providers.name: Felix
providers.description: Félix (Félix Pago) is a US-based fintech building financial services for the Latino community in the United States. Its core product lets users send remittances to Latin America in seconds through a WhatsApp message, with no app download or physical-location visit required, covering 9+ countries including Mexico, Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Ecuador and Peru with real-time exchange rates, no hidden fees, over 40,000 cash pickup and deposit locations, and Spanish-language support. Félix is expanding beyond remittances into accounts, credit building, savings and investing for immigrants. Backed by General Catalyst and QED Investors. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Félix is a consumer-facing service and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation.

providers.name: Foundation Medicine
providers.description: Foundation Medicine is a molecular information and precision cancer diagnostics company that develops comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) tests for solid tumors, blood cancers, and sarcomas, including its FoundationOne family of assays. Its testing analyzes patient tumor and liquid-biopsy samples to identify genomic alterations that can inform targeted therapy, immunotherapy, and clinical-trial matching, and it partners with biopharma on companion diagnostics and clinical-trial enrollment. A Roche company, it has delivered more than 1.5 million patient CGP reports and supports 950+ clinical trials. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead (gv, kleiner-perkins) and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes no public developer API or portal, so this record captures its public web, legal, and security-disclosure surface.

providers.name: Globe Life
providers.description: Globe Life is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Globe Life API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Grabr
providers.description: Grabr is a peer-to-peer cross-border shopping marketplace, founded in 2015 in San Francisco, that connects shoppers wanting products unavailable or expensive in their home country with travelers who deliver those items during trips in exchange for a reward. Grabr handles secure online payments, calculates duties and fees upfront, and holds funds in escrow until delivery is confirmed, operating across 75+ countries. It is a consumer mobile-app marketplace (iOS and Android) with a sibling fintech product, GrabrFi (US banking for non-residents). Grabr does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity, support, legal, and domain-security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Gridware
providers.description: Gridware builds grid intelligence technology for electric utilities. Its Active Grid Response (AGR) platform pairs pole-mounted GridScope sensors with analytics to bring real-time visibility into the physical, electrical, and environmental condition of every span of the distribution grid, closing the "Hazard Awareness Delay" between when a fault or hazard occurs and when a utility detects it. Gridware supports fault prevention, faster power restoration, wildfire and hazard response, and grid asset management. Headquartered in San Francisco with an Applied Research Complex in Richmond, California, the company is backed by True Ventures. Gridware does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity, trust/compliance posture, and domain security.

providers.name: Hesai Technology
providers.description: Hesai Technology is a global leader in 3D LiDAR perception, designing and manufacturing high-performance lidar sensors for autonomous driving, advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), robotics, and industrial automation. Its sensors are deployed by major automotive OEMs and autonomous-vehicle companies across more than 40 countries. Hesai does not expose a public REST/HTTP API; its developer surface is source-distributed C++ SDKs, ROS and ROS2 drivers, and integration plugins (including an NVIDIA DriveWorks plugin) published on the HesaiTechnology GitHub organization, alongside a developer portal and downloadable firmware, manuals, and tools. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Hesai's public developer resources.

providers.name: HomeAway *
providers.description: HomeAway was an Austin, Texas vacation-rental marketplace that connected travelers with owners and property managers of holiday homes, cabins, condos, and beach houses worldwide. It published a first-party HomeAway API (OAuth 2.0) for listing management, availability and booking synchronization, pricing, and guest communication, along with a Ruby SDK and the hacurl command-line tool from its GitHub organization. HomeAway was acquired by Expedia Group in 2015 and the brand was retired into Vrbo: homeaway.com now redirects to Vrbo and the developer platform is no longer maintained. This profile captures the genuine historical first-party API surface (SDK, CLI, OAuth auth model) that remains publicly available.

providers.name: LEAP
providers.description: LEAP is cloud-based legal practice management software for law firms, covering matter and contact management, document automation and court forms, time recording, billing, and trust accounting, tightly integrated with Microsoft 365. LEAP operates a LEAP Developer Console and LEAP Marketplace (developer.leap.build / console.leap.build) through which approved third-party developers build REST-based integrations (an "API Reference" is versioned there, e.g. v1.0.4, v1.0.5), but the technical reference - endpoint paths, base URL, and authentication schema - sits behind developer registration and an app review process rather than a public, self-serve API reference. There is no publicly published OpenAPI document, public base URL, or anonymous API key signup. Existing Marketplace integrations (Xero, Zoom, InfoTrack, LawTap, and others) confirm the API surface is real and in production use, but its concrete shape is not publicly disclosed.

providers.name: Luminal
providers.description: Luminal is an AI inference-optimization company that compiles machine-learning models ahead-of-time into optimized native code for GPUs and ASICs, aiming to deliver the fastest, highest-throughput inference available. Its core product is an open-source, high-performance general-purpose inference compiler written in Rust (the "luminal" crate), built around static computation graphs, a compile-time-checked GraphTensor API, composable neural-network modules, and pluggable graph compilers. Luminal ships two deployment paths: Luminal Cloud, a managed serverless inference service with automatic scaling, and licensed on-prem deployment with dedicated support and custom optimization. The company is backed by Felicis.

providers.name: Modular Robotics
providers.description: Modular Robotics is a Boulder, Colorado hardware and educational-robotics company best known for Cubelets, magnetic modular robot construction blocks organized into SENSE, THINK, and ACT categories, and the MOSS building system. It also produces the Dexter Industries STEM product line, including the GoPiGo Raspberry Pi robot, BrickPi (LEGO Mindstorms plus Raspberry Pi), GrovePi, and the micro:bit GiggleBot. The company sells physical robotics kits and companion apps such as the browser-based Cubelets Console with Blockly and C coding rather than a public HTTP API; programmatic access is provided through first-party open-source Python driver libraries published on PyPI and maintained under the official DexterInd GitHub organization.

providers.name: Motorway
providers.description: Motorway is the UK's fastest-growing used car marketplace, connecting private sellers with a network of more than 8,000 verified car dealers through a daily online auction. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in London and Brighton, the platform provides instant AI-assisted vehicle valuations, a mobile app that builds a sale-ready car profile, nationwide home collection, same-day payment (Motorway Pay), transport (Motorway Move), and outstanding-finance handling. Over one million people have used Motorway to sell a car. It is a consumer and dealer (B2C/B2B) marketplace rather than a public API provider: no developer portal, OpenAPI, or public API surface is published as of this enrichment pass. Backed by Index Ventures, ICONIQ Growth, BMW i Ventures and LocalGlobe.

providers.name: Oosto
providers.description: Oosto (formerly AnyVision) is an enterprise vision-AI company providing real-time facial recognition, watchlist alerting, and video analytics for physical security, safety, and touchless access control. Its platform spans OnWatch real-time watchlist monitoring, OnAccess touchless facial-recognition access control, and Oosto Protect edge-to-cloud video analytics (person-of-interest detection, body/skeleton and pose/action recognition, and liveness detection), delivered via cloud, on-premises, and SDK deployments and integrating with existing VMS and camera systems. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. Oosto exposes no public self-serve developer API; its technical documentation lives in a login-gated partner knowledge base.

providers.name: SkySpecs
providers.description: SkySpecs is a renewable energy asset management company based in Ann Arbor, Michigan that combines autonomous drone inspections, condition-monitoring hardware, and its cloud-based Horizon software platform to help wind and solar operators manage the health and performance of their assets. Horizon consolidates blade inspection imagery, drivetrain and sensor data, SCADA-based performance analytics, repair-vendor coordination, and financial reporting into one hub, with third-party data ingestion and custom integrations for fleet owners. The company reports assets under contract across six countries and is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management. SkySpecs exposes no public developer API, SDK, or self-serve developer portal today; integrations are arranged directly with the Horizon team.

providers.name: Sparkles
providers.description: Sparkles (sparkles.dev) is a San Francisco developer-tools startup in Y Combinator's Winter 2026 batch building AI coding agents for a whole team, not just engineers. A technical owner connects the company's GitHub repositories and configures environment variables, after which any teammate on a company email address can describe a change and have an agent implement it inside an isolated sandbox and open a GitHub pull request for developer review. Positioned as "Lovable for existing projects," it lets marketers, designers, and operations staff ship safe code changes without needing to know Git or the command line. As of this profile Sparkles exposes only a marketing and product website plus legal pages; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, CLI, or OpenAPI, so this record captures verified company identity rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Stader Labs
providers.description: Stader Labs is a non-custodial, smart-contract-driven liquid staking platform for Proof-of-Stake networks. It lets retail users, exchanges, and custodians stake crypto and receive tokenized liquid staking tokens (ETHx, MaticX, BNBx, NEARx and others) that stay usable across 40+ DeFi protocols while earning auto-compounding rewards, with no lock-up and no minimum stake. Stader operates as multi-chain middleware infrastructure across Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Hedera, Fantom, and NEAR, and its contracts have been audited by Sigma Prime, Halborn, Peckshield, Code4rena, and OtterSec. The project is on-chain and open source rather than a REST/OpenAPI provider; developer surface area is Solidity/Go/Rust smart contracts, node software, and CLI tooling on GitHub.

providers.name: Stellapps
providers.description: Stellapps is an end-to-end dairy technology company from Bangalore, India (IIT Madras incubated, founded 2011) that digitizes milk production, milk procurement, and cold-chain management through its SmartMoo full-stack IoT platform. Sensors in milking systems, animal wearables, chilling equipment, and procurement peripherals stream data to the SmartMoo Big Data Cloud for analytics and machine learning serving dairy farmers, cooperatives, and processors, with applications including mooON herd management, smartAMCU and smartCC milk procurement, ConTrak cold-chain monitoring, mooFlow ERP, and mooPay financial services. Stellapps publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; the SmartMoo platform is accessed through hosted applications behind CAS single sign-on.

providers.name: True Anomaly
providers.description: True Anomaly is a defense-technology company building spacecraft, software, and payloads for space superiority. Its products include Jackal, a multirole space-superiority platform positioned as a tactical fighter-interceptor for contested orbital environments, and Mosaic, an autonomy software platform that transforms commander intent into autonomous action. The company serves U.S. government and allied defense customers from facilities in Centennial and Colorado Springs, Colorado; Long Beach, California; and Washington, DC. True Anomaly publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; its only machine-readable public surface is an RFC 9116 security.txt vulnerability-disclosure contact.

providers.name: Truex Media
providers.description: TrueX (stylized true[X]) is an interactive, opt-in video advertising company now operating as part of Infillion. Its technology delivers "attention-based" ad experiences — Choice Cards and interactive engagement units that let viewers opt in to a single, longer branded interaction in exchange for an ad-free content break — across connected TV (CTV), over-the-top (OTT), mobile, and web. The company originated as SocialVibe (a Redpoint Ventures portfolio company), was acquired by 21st Century Fox, and is now a video advertising product within Infillion alongside MediaMath, InStadium, Gimbal, and Catalina. TrueX's integration surface is the TruexAdRenderer (TAR) client SDK — published first-party from the "socialvibe" GitHub organization for iOS, tvOS, Android, Roku, and CTV/HTML5 web via Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods — rather than a public REST API. Publishers embed the renderer, typically alongside Google IMA (client- or server-side ad insertion), to serve and measure interactive ads.

providers.name: Turquoise Health
providers.description: Turquoise Health is a healthcare price transparency company (backed by a16z) that runs a platform aggregating and normalizing hospital and payer machine-readable price transparency files, negotiated contract rates, and out-of-network pricing into searchable, benchmarked rate data and analytics. Its products span rate analysis and benchmarking, contract management, clear rates and data assets, healthcare transactions, out-of-network pricing, patient cost estimates / Good Faith Estimates, and price-transparency compliance tooling, serving providers, payers, life sciences, and employers.

providers.name: Umony
providers.description: Umony is a London-based communications compliance platform, founded in 2017 and backed by Seedcamp, that captures, records, and archives employee voice calls, SMS, WhatsApp, and Microsoft Teams conversations at the telecom-network level for banks and other regulated financial institutions. Its platform spans the Umony App (BYOD softphone), Umony Mobile (eSIM carrier-level capture), and Umony Archive with AI risk scoring, and the company holds BSI-certified ISO 27001:2022, ISO 42001:2023, and ISO 22301:2019 certifications. Umony publishes no public developer API surface today.

providers.name: Vodafone
providers.description: Vodafone Group plc is a UK-headquartered (Newbury, England) multinational telecommunications company and one of the world's largest mobile and fixed network operators, with operations in 15 country markets and partner-market agreements covering 40+ additional countries across Europe and Africa. The group serves 279 million mobile customers, 5 million business customers, and manages 215+ million IoT connections through its Vodafone IoT platform. Beyond mobile and broadband connectivity, Vodafone operates one of the largest IoT/M2M businesses in the industry, invests in 70+ subsea cables, and runs financial services like M-PESA (Africa) and Vodapay. Through Vodafone Business it sells connectivity, cloud, security, and managed-mobility services to enterprises, and through the GSMA Open Gateway and CAMARA initiative it exposes a growing portfolio of standardised network APIs (Number Verify, SIM Swap, Quality on Demand, Device Location, Match, MVNO Discovery, and more) via the Vodafone Developer Marketplace (developer.vodafone.com), which publishes 27+ commercial and CAMARA APIs across Identity, Mobile, Analytics, Boost/QoS, and Partner categories. The Marketplace exposes sandbox and live endpoints under api-sandbox.vf-dmp.engineering.vodafone.com and api.vf-dmp.engineering.vodafone.com, with OAuth2 (Consumer Key / Consumer Secret) authentication and Postman collections for every product. Vodafone is a premier member of the CAMARA alliance hosted at the Linux Foundation, a founding participant in the GSMA Open Gateway, and one of the principal telco operators driving network-as-an-API adoption globally.

providers.name: Zmanda
providers.description: Zmanda is an enterprise backup and recovery software provider and the commercial steward of the open-source Amanda (Advanced Maryland Automatic Network Disk Archiver) project. Its products protect Linux, Windows and macOS systems, databases, and application data with agent-based and agentless backups that write to local disk, tape, and public-cloud object storage. The company maintains an active GitHub organization (github.com/zmanda) around the Amanda backup engine and related tooling, operates a customer-facing management portal at the Zmanda Network (network.zmanda.com), and publishes API documentation for programmatic backup and recovery management at api.zmanda.com. Zmanda was an early portfolio company of Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Zwift
providers.description: Zwift is a Long Beach, California online fitness company that operates a multiplayer indoor cycling and running platform combining stationary smart trainers and bikes with a 3D virtual-world game client. Riders and runners use a smart trainer, smart bike (such as the in-house Zwift Ride), treadmill, or pod to drive an avatar through fictional worlds (Watopia, Makuri Islands) and licensed real-world routes, joining structured workouts, group rides, races, training plans, and 24/7 events alongside a global community of more than a million members. The platform pairs with smart trainers and heart-rate monitors over Bluetooth and ANT+, and the Zwift Companion mobile app provides in-game messaging, ride control, and route discovery. Zwift does not operate a general public developer portal, OpenAPI reference, or open-source SDK. Its developer surface is limited to a private, application-only Structured Training API for approved training partners (TrainingPeaks, TrainerRoad, Wahoo SYSTM, JOIN Cycling and similar coaching platforms) that lets external workout builders push custom workouts into a rider's Zwift account, plus one-way activity-export connections to Strava, TrainingPeaks, Garmin Connect, MapMyRide, MapMyRun, Adidas Running, Technogym, Fitbit, Wahoo, Apple Health, and Withings. There is no public REST surface, OAuth client registration, or partner self-service available to general developers — third-party tools (community libraries, ZwiftPower, Sauce for Zwift) interact with Zwift via reverse-engineered private endpoints, not a sanctioned API. Zwift is a paid consumer subscription business; revenue comes from monthly memberships and hardware sales (Zwift Ride, Zwift Cog, Zwift Click, Zwift Play).

providers.name: Affinity Credit Union
providers.description: Affinity Credit Union is a member-owned financial cooperative headquartered in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada. Formed in 2005 through the amalgamation of several Saskatchewan credit unions, it is the largest credit union in Saskatchewan and among the ten largest in Canada, with roughly CAD 9.6 billion in managed assets and a province-wide branch and advice-centre network serving personal and business members. As a provincially regulated cooperative under its "Banking on Values" mandate, members democratically own and govern the institution. Affinity exposes NO first-party public developer API or developer portal; digital and core banking are delivered through banking-technology providers (the credit-union system's Central 1 rails), and third-party consumer data access today is aggregator/screen-scraping based. Affinity is a stated supporter of the credit-union-system "Open Banking Solution" delivered by Caspian One under the Large Credit Union Coalition, positioning it for Canada's legislated-but-not-yet-operational Consumer-Driven Banking framework (FCAC).

providers.name: Asimov
providers.description: Asimov is a synthetic biology company building an integrated platform for the intelligent design of living systems. Its Edge Systems (CHO for biologics, LV for cell therapies, AAV for gene therapies, and RNA for RNA medicines) combine engineered mammalian host cells, a library of more than 1,000 validated genetic parts, and cloud-based genetic design software so biopharma partners can design and manufacture advanced therapeutics at higher titers and on faster timelines. Backed by a16z, DCVC, Wing Venture Capital, and Y Combinator. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: ATOM
providers.description: Atom (atomchat.io) is a Panama-based conversational-commerce platform whose multimodal AI Agents combine text, voice, image, and CRM data to run human-like WhatsApp conversations that qualify leads and close sales for businesses across Latin America. Founded in 2019 by Erick Holmann and Rene Mouynes and backed by Techstars and Mucker Capital, Atom connects WhatsApp click-to-chat ads to an AI agent that engages and qualifies prospects, then hands sales-ready leads to human reps. It exposes a Customers API and a WhatsApp template-message API, both authenticated with an account API key configured from the Atom admin panel.

providers.name: Attralus
providers.description: Attralus is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Francisco, California, developing transformative medicines for patients with systemic amyloidosis. Its proprietary pan-amyloid removal (PAR) platform pairs a pan-amyloid binding peptide with a humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody so the resulting fusion protein binds amyloid deposits across every amyloidosis type and stage and recruits the immune system to clear them. The lead candidate, zamubafusp alfa (AT-02), is a pan-amyloid depleter in a Phase 1/2 open-label extension study and has received U.S. FDA Orphan Drug Designation for the treatment of AL amyloidosis; a next-generation PAR program (IV and subcutaneous) and a research-stage neurodegeneration program targeting Abeta, tau and alpha-synuclein aggregates follow behind it. Attralus' molecular imaging agents AT-01 (124-iodine evuzamitide) and AT-05 (99mTc-p5+14) were acquired by Bayer in January 2026. The company was launched in 2020 with a Series A from venBio Partners and has since raised additional rounds including a $56 million financing led by Alpha Wave Ventures with participation from Bristol Myers Squibb. Attralus is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable API contract of any kind (every OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP, A2A and /.well-known/ path probed on its hosts returns 404, and no api/developer/docs subdomain resolves).

providers.name: axiTrust
providers.description: axiTrust is a technology and consulting platform for the Indian surety-bond market, connecting IRDAI-licensed insurers, MSMEs, and government procurement bodies. Its platform unifies application processing, underwriting checks, and insurance surety bond issuance, with dashboards for tracking bonds, partners, and claims, plus integrations to financial, legal, banking, and ROC data sources. axiTrust also offers consulting services including discovery workshops, economic analysis comparing sureties to bank guarantees, and adoption support for enterprises and government departments. It is not an insurer or broker; all insurance surety bonds are issued by IRDAI-licensed insurance companies. axiTrust is a fintech backed by General Catalyst.

providers.name: Beazer Homes USA
providers.description: Beazer Homes USA, Inc. (NYSE: BZH) is an Atlanta, Georgia-headquartered national homebuilder founded in 1985 and publicly listed since 1994. The company designs, sells, and builds single-family and multi-family homes across approximately thirteen U.S. states under brand differentiators such as Choice Plans (customizable floorplans), Mortgage Choice (competitive lender program), Style Choice (interior personalization), and Livable Features (accessibility options). Beazer markets itself as "America's #1 Energy-Efficient Homebuilder," citing homes that are 44% more efficient than the average HERS-rated new home and shipping whole-house ERV ventilation in 100% of homes. As of the most recent public data point (FY2016 10-K), Beazer reported revenue of $1.822B, delivered 5,419 homes, operated 161 active communities, and employed approximately 1,100 people. The company has no public developer program or external APIs; its digital surface is a consumer-facing marketing/community-finder website plus an investor relations portal.

providers.name: Bukalapak
providers.description: Bukalapak is one of Indonesia's largest online marketplaces and all-commerce platforms, connecting millions of individual sellers, small warungs (kiosks), and buyers across the archipelago, alongside virtual products, financial services, and online-to-offline retail. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub (backed by 500 Global), this profile has been enriched from Bukalapak's real public developer surface: a public REST API at api.bukalapak.com secured with OAuth2 via accounts.bukalapak.com, a first-party JavaScript SDK (bukalapak.js), and a large public GitHub organization. No OpenAPI/Swagger specification is currently published by the provider, so the captured artifacts (authentication, packages, domain security) are sourced from first-party repositories and live domain probes rather than derived from a spec.

providers.name: Byteboard
providers.description: Byteboard is a technical interview platform for software engineering hiring. It replaces traditional whiteboard interviews with project-based, real-world assessments and live coding interviews that measure practical skills such as systems design, code quality, and communication across 20+ engineering competencies. Candidate work is anonymized and evaluated by trained human graders against calibrated rubrics to reduce bias and interviewer time while improving hire quality. Founded to fix the false positives, prep burden, and inequities of conventional coding interviews, Byteboard integrates with applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse) and is now part of Karat. Byteboard exposes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, web properties, domain security posture, and compliance program.

providers.name: Careem
providers.description: Careem is the everything app for the greater Middle East, a super-app operating across the MENAP region (Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan) and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Founded in 2012 and now owned by Uber, Careem combines mobility (rides, taxi, bike, car rental), food and grocery delivery (Careem Eat, Quik), courier and B2B logistics (Box, Express), and financial services (Careem Pay, remittance, donations) alongside the Careem Plus subscription. Careem does not currently operate a public developer API program or partner API portal; this profile captures its public identity, engineering surface, and domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cimulate
providers.description: Cimulate is an AI-native commerce experience platform for intelligent product discovery, delivering context-aware search, adaptive browse, real-time recommendations, a conversational AI shopping assistant, and Commerce AEO (answer/agent engine optimization for visibility inside LLM surfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude). The platform is architected API-first and headless-ready and advertises a proprietary Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for agentic commerce workflows. Cimulate became part of Salesforce in February 2026. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Sierra Ventures.

providers.name: Civica Digital
providers.description: Cívica Digital is a Mexican civic-technology company, founded in 2015 and backed by 500 Global, that helps governments, public institutions, and organizations design, build, and launch digital services for citizens. Its product portfolio includes Urbem, a platform for digitizing government procedures and citizen-facing services; Signum, a digital document and official-records management system with electronic signatures; and a suite of conversational AI agents that support citizens over WhatsApp, phone, and web. The company focuses on digital government transformation across Latin America. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface has been located; this profile captures the company's public web presence, legal pages, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: ClassPass
providers.description: ClassPass is a fitness and wellness marketplace that lets consumers book classes, gym visits, and spa/wellness experiences across a network of studios in a single app using a monthly credit subscription. On the supply side, ClassPass runs a partner integration platform - centered on a named "ClassPass Inventory API" - that lets studios and their scheduling/booking software (100+ platforms, including Mindbody, Vagaro, Zen Planner, and Eversports Manager) push live class schedules, availability, and pricing to ClassPass and receive bookings and cancellations back. The partner developer portal at developers.classpass.com requires an approved partner login (Auth0) to view the API specification document and run certification tests; ClassPass does not publish a public, unauthenticated API reference, OpenAPI file, or Postman collection. ClassPass is now part of Playlist, the group formed together with Mindbody and Booker.

providers.name: Converge Bio
providers.description: Converge Bio is a generative-AI platform for life sciences that accelerates drug development across discovery, molecular design, and manufacturing. It trains Bio-LLM foundation models directly on biological languages (DNA, RNA, and protein sequences) and delivers them through the Converge Computational Lab, whose applications include ConvergeAB (AI antibody design across IgG/VHH/bispecific formats), ConvergeGEO (protein gene-expression optimization across CHO/HEK293/E. coli and other cell systems), ConvergeCELL (virtual cell simulation for target and biomarker discovery), and a Patent Extractor for mining antibody sequences. The platform is delivered to biotech and pharmaceutical customers under a Request Access engagement model; there is no public developer API, SDK, or self-serve documentation surface today. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners ($25M Series A, January 2026); founded 2023.

providers.name: Cradle
providers.description: Cradle is a Dutch–Swiss biotechnology software company founded in 2021 with headquarters in Amsterdam and an office in Zurich, building an AI-powered protein engineering platform for industrial biotech and biopharma R&D teams. The platform combines proprietary generative AI models — trained on billions of natural protein sequences and on data produced in Cradle's own Amsterdam wet lab — with a web application and REST API/Python SDK so that scientists can design, simulate, and co-optimize amino-acid sequence variants across multiple measurable properties such as activity, binding affinity, stability, expression, and developability. Core platform capabilities include AI candidate generation, multi-property co-optimization, virtual plate design, experimental data management with full versioning and audit trails, task orchestration (analyze data, diversify, engineer, select, search, train) across modalities including antibodies/mAbs, enzymes, vaccines, therapeutic peptides, and food ingredients, plus a Custom Predictors framework letting customers plug in their own ML models. Cradle is sold as enterprise SaaS to R&D organizations — disclosed customers and partners include Johnson & Johnson Janssen, Bayer, Novozymes/Novonesis, and Twist Bioscience, with the platform serving six of the top 25 global pharma companies and over 50 active R&D programs. The company has raised approximately $115M to date across a seed round (Index Ventures, 2022), a $24M Series A (Index Ventures, 2023), and a $73M Series B (IVP, 2024). Co-founders are Stef van Grieken (CEO), Jelle Prins, Elise de Reus, Eli Bixby, and Harmen van Rossum.

providers.name: Darwin
providers.description: Darwin AI is an AI governance platform built exclusively for state, local, and education (SLED) government agencies, providing a centralized, secure hub for the public sector to safely adopt, manage, and govern AI tools while ensuring compliance, accountability, and public records requirements are met. The platform serves IT departments, innovation and digital services teams, city and county management, and data governance professionals across municipal and state government. Its core product surface includes the Control Center, which delivers cross-departmental visibility into AI usage along with records management and FOIA compliance tracking; the Policy Wizard, which helps agencies establish and refine AI policies aligned to regulatory requirements using 30+ policy frameworks and 15+ city and county regulation packs; Risk Management, which detects unauthorized or unvetted AI applications; the AI Navigator, which monitors departmental adoption patterns and surfaces actionable insights; and the Marketplace, an organization-wide hub of approved AI applications. Darwin AI was named to Government Technology's 2026 GovTech 100. The company also publishes a free public Policy Wizard tool. Darwin is backed by Insight Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a government-sector company profile. As of this enrichment pass Darwin publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Day One Biopharmaceuticals
providers.description: Day One Biopharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing targeted therapies for people of all ages living with life-threatening diseases, with an initial focus on pediatric and rare cancers. Its lead product OJEMDA (tovorafenib) is an FDA-approved treatment for relapsed or refractory pediatric low-grade glioma, and its pipeline includes DAY301 and the antibody-drug conjugate Emi-Le. Headquartered in Brisbane, California, the company was acquired by and is now part of the Servier Group as of March 2026. Day One was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it maintains a corporate and investor-relations web presence but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Diligent
providers.description: Diligent Corporation is a governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) software company best known for its board management portal (Diligent Boards / Boardbooks) and the broader Diligent One Platform, which unifies board management, enterprise risk, audit, compliance, entity management, and ESG. The board portal itself is a security-hardened product with no public developer API - it is integrated through SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning, and packaged connectors (Okta, Microsoft 365/Teams, Zoom, DocuSign). Diligent does, however, publish a real developer portal at developer.diligent.com covering the GRC side of the platform - the HighBond (Diligent One) REST API for audit/risk/compliance data, a GraphQL Entities API for legal-entity and subsidiary management, an ESG API for activity/usage data, and a Workflow API for jobs, tasks, and campaigns. API access is customer/partner-gated (a HighBond API key or SSO-scoped token is required) and pricing is quote-based via Diligent sales.

providers.name: Feesable
providers.description: Feesable is a fintech infrastructure company providing embedded finance and debt capital management (treasury) tooling that connects platforms, lenders, and capital markets. Its Embedded Finance product delivers white-labeled loan origination infrastructure — KYC/KYB verification, credit decisioning, dynamic pricing, fraud detection, and servicing/collections — exposed through APIs, SDKs, and embeddable widgets so SaaS platforms, marketplaces, and B2B lenders can launch embedded lending without building fintech from scratch. Its Debt Capital Management (DCM Engine) product provides institutional-grade treasury management — credit facility modeling, covenant monitoring, borrowing-base calculations, and automated lender/regulatory reporting connected to live portfolio data. Feesable targets GCC markets with Shariah-compliant options and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. The developer surface (APIs, SDKs, sandbox keys, documentation) is partner-gated behind a partnership onboarding process rather than publicly self-serve.

providers.name: Frost Bank
providers.description: Frost Bank is the banking subsidiary of Cullen/Frost Bankers, Inc. (NYSE: CFR), a San Antonio, Texas-based financial holding company and one of the largest Texas-headquartered banks. Founded in 1868, Frost operates as a Texas state-chartered commercial bank (regulated by the Texas Department of Banking and the Federal Reserve after converting from a national charter to a state charter in 2012), serving consumer, commercial, wealth-management, and insurance customers through financial centers across Texas. On open finance, Frost runs NO first-party public developer portal or documented public API: the host developer.frostbank.com does not resolve and no developers/API page exists on frostbank.com. Consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is made available only through third-party aggregators — Frost's own digital banking uses Plaid for account aggregation — rather than a direct API. Frost publishes no FDX (Financial Data Exchange) participation and no stated CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture. This is an honest identity-only record for a regional US bank whose external data access is aggregator-mediated.

providers.name: Global ID
providers.description: GlobaliD (global.id) is a decentralized digital-identity platform that lets people create a portable, self-sovereign identity and lets developers add "Sign in with GlobaliD" login, issue verifiable credentials, and verify identity claims (such as proof of being 18+) through server-side issuer and verifier toolkits built on Hyperledger Aries. Developers create apps in the invitation-based developer portal to obtain OAuth2 client credentials, then integrate using the official @globalid npm SDKs. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Grotto AI
providers.description: Grotto AI is an AI sales-coaching platform purpose-built for the multifamily apartment leasing industry. Founded by former EvolutionIQ leaders Nick Deveau (CEO) and Ben Epstein (CTO), Grotto delivers real-time call guidance, tour and call coaching, and prospect-lifecycle support across email and text that help leasing agents handle objections, book tours, and convert more leads to recover net operating income and asset value. The platform works alongside multifamily systems such as Entrata, Funnel, and Yardi and is used by operators including Weidner Apartment Homes and Hillpointe. Grotto is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27701 certified and Fair Housing compliant. It is backed by ICONIQ. Grotto does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; it is a demo-led enterprise SaaS product.

providers.name: Healthera
providers.description: Healthera is a United Kingdom digital-health and patient-engagement company, founded in 2015 by Cambridge University students and headquartered in Cambridge, England. It runs a patient-facing pharmacy app and website for ordering NHS prescriptions and medicines online and booking pharmacy services (Pharmacy First, treatments, vaccinations), alongside a pharmacy-facing SaaS "Patient Experience Platform" used by 1,700+ community pharmacies to manage repeat prescriptions, bookings, marketing, and delivery. In November 2022 Healthera became the first pharmacy app to integrate with the NHS Electronic Prescription Service (EPS), and it connects to NHS Digital / NHS England systems plus third-party platforms such as myGP, eConsult, Cegedim Rx Pharmacy Manager, Medpoint, Royal Mail, and Uber for same-hour delivery. Healthera markets custom integration APIs to pharmacy and brand partners, but as of this review it publishes no public developer portal, no self-serve API documentation, and no machine-readable contract; its api.healthera.co.uk "Healthera Core" host is a private backend and exposes no FHIR CapabilityStatement. Integration is partner-gated rather than self-serve.

providers.name: Hub
providers.description: Hub (Hub.xyz) is a distributed physical-AI data infrastructure company that creates, annotates, and curates custom real-world datasets — egocentric first-person video, image, video, and audio — used to train AI and robotics models. Data is sourced through a global network of 500,000+ retail contributors and verified small and medium businesses across 150+ countries and 100+ languages. Hub offers both off-the-shelf labeled datasets and bespoke, custom-scoped data collection projects quoted within hours, delivered through a fully managed pipeline that couples automation with human-in-the-loop validation for frontier AI labs and Fortune 500 companies.

providers.name: Intrinsic
providers.description: Intrinsic is a unified Trust & Safety platform that gives safety teams a single API and dashboard to detect, investigate, and enforce against abuse across user- and AI-generated content, fraud, and marketplace abuse. The platform surfaces machine-learning classifiers (for example text toxicity and IP trust scoring), account graph lineage for linkage analysis, geo enrichers, and global intelligence signals through a synchronous API, and lets teams author, version, deploy, and monitor real-time anti-abuse rules from a hosted dashboard. Founded in 2022 in San Francisco by Karine Mellata and Michael Lin (previously on Trust & Safety ML and data-engineering infrastructure at Apple and Discord), Intrinsic has since rebranded to Variance (variance.co); the Intrinsic-branded developer surfaces at docs.intrinsicapi.com and api.intrinsicapi.com remain in service.

providers.name: Invisible AI
providers.description: Invisible AI is a next-generation computer vision company delivering a Vision Execution System (VES) for manufacturing. NVIDIA Jetson-powered edge devices with Intel RealSense 3D depth cameras and on-device SSD storage mount to existing factory infrastructure and, within hours, encode and segment the production floor in real time. The no-code, edge-based platform captures 100% of production cycles across every station without wearables, operator disruption, or cloud integration, then analyzes human motion and objects to surface cycle-time variability, process drift, quality escapes, and safety/ergonomics risk. Founded in 2018 by autonomous-vehicle veterans and backed by Sierra Ventures, it serves automotive and aerospace OEMs including Toyota, Ford, General Motors, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Nissan. Invisible AI publishes no public API or developer platform today; this profile captures its company identity, security posture, and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Liquidia
providers.description: Liquidia Corporation (NASDAQ: LQDA) is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of inhaled therapies for cardiopulmonary disease, specifically pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD). Its proprietary PRINT technology produces drug particles of uniform size and shape engineered for deep-lung deposition, and underpins YUTREPIA, its inhaled treprostinil dry powder product. Liquidia is also developing L606, a sustained-release liposomal treprostinil inhalation suspension partnered with Pharmosa Biopharm. Liquidia publishes no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable interface; this profile is catalogued for network identity, corporate transparency, and domain-security coverage only.

providers.name: Lupin & Holmes
providers.description: Lupin & Holmes is an offensive-security and social-engineering research firm that blends adversarial creativity with rigorous logic to strengthen defensive security practices. Its flagship product, Depi, is a proactive cybersecurity dashboard for software supply-chain protection, giving security teams real-time visibility into dependency vulnerabilities, patch tracking, and risk response. The company also publishes hands-on security research covering supply-chain attacks, dependency confusion, and CI/CD exploitation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Mindful Health Solutions
providers.description: Mindful Health Solutions is a behavioral-health-care provider specializing in innovative, evidence-based psychiatric treatments for depression, anxiety, PTSD, OCD, and other treatment-resistant conditions. Founded in 2007 (originally as TMS Health Solutions) by Dr. Richard Bermudes, the company pioneered TMS-focused clinics in the United States and offers Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), SPRAVATO (esketamine) nasal spray, IV Ketamine infusion therapy, medication management, and psychiatric care across roughly 20 clinics in California, Texas, and Washington. Mindful Health Solutions maintains one of the world's largest TMS and esketamine patient-outcome repositories. It is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. As a clinical healthcare provider it publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, an AI-crawler llms.txt it publishes, and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Norm Ai
providers.description: Norm Ai (legal name Nomos AI, Inc.) is a legal and compliance AI company that embeds law and regulation directly into autonomous AI agents. Its platform spans Norm Law (an AI-native law firm), Norm Technology (domain-expert-built compliance agents), and Supervisory AI (systems that verify agent compliance), automating legal and regulatory workflows for financial institutions and enterprises. Backed by a $120M Series C round, it serves clients managing over $30 trillion in combined assets. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK is currently published; this profile captures the company's security, compliance, and identity surface.

providers.name: Nurix AI
providers.description: Nurix AI is an enterprise conversational-AI company that builds human-like voice and chat AI agents for sales, customer support, and internal operations. Founded by Mukesh Bansal and backed by Accel and General Catalyst, Nurix delivers custom AI agents across voice, chat, email, SMS, and social channels through its NuPlay conversational-AI platform, NuStack workflow engine, and NuPulse conversation-analytics product. It serves 30+ enterprises across retail, insurance, financial services, healthcare, and education, and offers enterprise-grade security controls (PII redaction, RBAC, SSO, audit trails, and regional data residency) with a HIPAA (BAA), DPA, and GDPR compliance posture. Nurix acquired the conversational-support platform Verloop.io. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Nuvocargo
providers.description: Nuvocargo is an AI-powered freight-management platform for North American truckload logistics, focused on the US-Mexico-Canada cross-border corridor. Its "Nuvo AI" system coordinates a network of specialized agents (quoting, negotiation, booking, dispatch, tracking, exception handling, audit, and payment) to automate the freight load lifecycle, and it pairs that software with licensed freight brokerage, managed transportation, and customs-brokerage services. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Homebrew and QED Investors. As of this enrichment pass Nuvocargo publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; onboarding is contact-gated ("zero-integration" pilots), so this profile captures the company identity, legal/resource surface, and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Phaidra
providers.description: Phaidra builds AI agents for autonomous data center and industrial operations, using reinforcement learning to control cooling, power, and workloads in mission-critical facilities. Its products include Phaidra Prism, an LLM for data center operations that helps technicians identify, prioritize, and resolve infrastructure issues, and Phaidra Factory, self-learning AI agents that continuously monitor and optimize thermal reliability, energy efficiency, and IT capacity to maximize tokens per watt across AI factories. Phaidra is an enterprise vendor with no public API or developer program; this profile captures its public security, compliance, and web posture. Backed by Index Ventures.

providers.name: Quizlet
providers.description: Quizlet is a San Francisco-based global learning platform offering flashcards, practice tests, and AI-powered study tools used by students, teachers, and lifelong learners. Core features include user-created and expert-verified study sets, Learn mode (adaptive practice), Test mode, Match game, Spaced Repetition, and an AI tutor (Q-Chat / Magic Notes) that generates flashcards, summaries, practice questions, and explanations from uploaded notes, PDFs, slides, and textbooks. Quizlet Plus is the company's consumer subscription, and Quizlet for Schools / Teachers provides licensed offerings for classrooms. The platform integrates with Google Classroom (share-as-assignment) and Canvas (embeddable widgets) but does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK — the legacy Developer API 2.0 (`quizlet.com/api/2.0`) was effectively wound down to partners-only and is not openly registrable. Quizlet's GitHub organization (`github.com/quizlet`) hosts internal tooling, GitHub Actions, and forks of OSS dependencies (HHVM/Hack, PHPUnit, Mockery, Stylus, etc.) rather than a developer-facing API platform.

providers.name: Solvo.ai
providers.description: Solvo.ai is a revenue-orchestration company building the decision layer for revenue management in container logistics. Its live pricing engine ingests market rates, capacity manifests, booking history, port congestion, customer behaviour and contract terms, then uses models trained on tens of millions of historical bookings to produce a ranked, capacity-aware rate recommendation per lane, equipment type and segment. Trade managers accept, adjust or override these recommendations on Solvo's Decision HUB, and every decision feeds back as training signal through a bidirectional integration with the carrier's commercial stack. Founded in 2021 and backed by Speedinvest, Solvo positions itself as the only proven, live pricing engine built specifically for container shipping, with one of the world's top carriers in production. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Speedinvest portfolio company; Solvo currently publishes a marketing and insights site only, with no public API, developer documentation, SDKs or specifications.

providers.name: StanCorp Financial Group
providers.description: StanCorp Financial Group, Inc. (doing business as The Standard) is an insurance and financial services company headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company since 2016. Founded in 1906, The Standard offers group and individual disability insurance, group life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance, group dental and group vision insurance, absence management services, retirement plans, individual annuities, and commercial mortgage loan origination. The Standard does not offer a public developer API. Employer and benefits administrator integrations are managed through EDI and proprietary data exchange channels.

providers.name: TechProcess Payment Services
providers.description: TechProcess Payment Services is an Indian digital-payments pioneer that has been building and operating cloud-based electronic-payment platforms since 2000, when it launched BillJunction.com, India's first electronic bill presentment and payment service. Its payment gateway supports card payments, Net-banking, NACH, NEFT/RTGS, IMPS, UPI and e-wallets for merchants across India. The business is now part of Worldline India (ePayments India), whose merchant checkout product is Paynimo, offering hosted and embeddable checkout, native mobile SDKs, and 20+ e-commerce platform plugins so developers can accept digital payments with a few lines of code. Originally a Battery Ventures portfolio company, it was acquired by Ingenico Group and folded into Worldline.

providers.name: Universal Music Group
providers.description: Universal Music Group N.V. (UMG) is the world's largest music company, headquartered in Hilversum, Netherlands with operational headquarters in Santa Monica, California. Spun off from Vivendi and listed on Euronext Amsterdam (ticker: UMG) on September 21, 2021 at a EUR 54 billion valuation, UMG operates Recorded Music, Music Publishing (Universal Music Publishing Group / UMPG), and Merchandising (Bravado), plus film and television production (PolyGram Entertainment) and the artist services and catalog arm Universal Music Enterprises. The company is led by Chairman and CEO Sir Lucian Grainge. Major label families include Republic Corps (Republic, Island, Def Jam), Interscope Capitol Labels Group (Interscope, Geffen, A&M, Capitol, Blue Note, Motown), Virgin Music Group, Verve Label Group (Verve, Decca, Deutsche Grammophon, Impulse!, Philips), UMG Nashville (MCA Nashville, Mercury Nashville, EMI Records Nashville, Capitol Records Nashville), Universal Music Latin Entertainment, and Universal Music UK. Catalog scale exceeds 3 million recordings and 4 million compositions. Ownership is split among Bolloré / Vivendi (~28%), Tencent Music (~11%), Pershing Square (~10%), and the public float. UMG operates no public developer portal: catalog and metadata reach developers only indirectly through downstream DSPs (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music) and through partner / aggregator programs (7digital exposed UMG catalog under a partner API; that integration is the only third-party developer-facing surface that has ever been openly documented). Royalty and publishing portals (UMG Royalty Portal, UMPG Window) exist for songwriters and rights holders behind authentication, not as APIs. AI is the active integration vector in 2025-2026: UMG has announced licensed generative-music partnerships with Udio, Splice, KLAY Vision, SoundLabs, ProRata, BandLab, YouTube, TikTok, Meta, and KDDI, and has filed 15+ AI patents with Liquidax Capital across collaboration, rights management, music & health, and AI threat protection. These integrations operate through bilateral commercial agreements, not a self-serve developer program. The official Universal-Music-Group GitHub organization (created May 15, 2024) has 0 public repositories.

providers.name: US Health Partners, LLC
providers.description: US Health Partners (USHP) is a physician-led national cardiovascular care network headquartered in Rockville, Maryland. USHP partners with independent cardiology practices across the country, providing management support, clinical governance, and technology while practices remain independent — reporting roughly 800 team members, 525K patients, and 30 locations. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Summit Partners, and Silversmith Capital Partners. USHP publishes no public developer portal or API surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Vivun
providers.description: Vivun is a B2B software company building AI teammates for revenue and sales teams using structured reasoning. Its flagship product, Hero, is an AI teammate built to help sellers win, and it pioneered the PreSales management category with tooling for sales engineering teams. Vivun also promotes a Sales Reasoning Model (SRM) and Agent Intelligence approach. The company is venture-backed by Accel and Menlo Ventures. As of this profile Vivun exposes a public product and trust surface (website, blog, resources, trust center) but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; this record captures its verified security, compliance, and web identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Xalts
providers.description: Xalts (operated by Tokuten Pte Ltd) is an Accel-backed fintech building an AI agent platform for corporate treasury and finance teams — a copilot that automates trade finance operations (guarantees, trade payments, documentary credit and collections), liquidity management, and revenue operations. Task-specific agents learn internal processes and policies and integrate with ERPs, accounting systems, payment processors, and banks through the company's Omni Connect Protocol, which provides multi-bank connectivity via a single API. Xalts does not currently publish a public developer portal or API documentation; its connectivity APIs are offered to enterprise customers.

providers.name: Xenex Disinfection Services
providers.description: Xenex Disinfection Services is a San Antonio, Texas-based medical technology company founded in 2008 by Johns Hopkins-trained epidemiologists Dr. Mark Stibich and Dr. Julie Stachowiak. Its LightStrike+ pulsed-xenon UV robot is the first FDA-authorized whole-room microbial reduction device, used by hospitals to destroy pathogens like C. difficile on surfaces; the portfolio also includes the LightStrike6 robot, the Deactivate handheld LED unit, and the TrackMate digital cleaning-event tracking system with a client portal at dms.xenex.com. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Battery Ventures portfolio company; enrichment probing found no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, but the company does publish an llms.txt company profile on its website.

providers.name: Zopper
providers.description: Zopper is an Indian insurtech platform that combines insurance and technology to deliver end-to-end, embedded insurance distribution for its partners. It builds APIs that let banks, consumer-electronics brands, retailers, e-commerce, travel and fintech platforms embed insurance into their customer journeys, and it manages policy issuance, servicing, claims and compliance across consumer-durables protection, life, health, bancassurance and embedded insurance. Zopper serves 2,500+ brands including Bank of Baroda, Axis Bank, IDFC First Bank, Apple, Samsung, Croma and Vijay Sales, and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: 01health
providers.description: 01Health is a UK-based health technology company building clinical infrastructure that lets specialist healthcare be delivered safely inside community and dental clinics rather than only in hospitals. Founded in 2022 by Dr Sonia Szamocki, its platform centralizes patient acquisition, clinical protocols, remote specialist oversight, treatment workflows, procurement, and financial management into a single system, currently spanning orthodontics (32Co) and sleep medicine (Aerox). 01Health is backed by Balderton Capital, Gresham House Ventures, Eka Ventures, and Wavemaker360. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal has been published to date; this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: 1hai
providers.description: eHi Car Rental (一嗨租车), operated by Shanghai eHi Information Technology Services Co., Ltd., is one of China's leading car rental and mobility companies. Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Shanghai, eHi offers self-drive car rentals, chauffeured car service, used-car sales, and corporate and government mobility programs across more than 500 cities nationwide, with cross-city return and airport pickup. eHi is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners, added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. The business operates consumer web and mobile (iOS, Android, HarmonyOS) booking channels; no public developer or API platform was found during enrichment.

providers.name: AlphaAI
providers.description: A REST API and agent-native platform for relevance-scored, ticker-linked financial news, built for trading bots, agent backends, and dashboards. Articles are enriched at ingest with relevance scores, categories, and per-ticker sentiment, plus structured SEC Form 4 insider data.

providers.name: Apiphani
providers.description: Apiphani is a technology-enabled application managed-services company dedicated to helping businesses minimize the effort and risk of running their tier-1, mission-critical applications. It combines decades of enterprise operations experience with intelligent automation and machine learning to drive efficiency and reliability across SAP environments (S/4HANA, Business Suite, Cloud ERP) running on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Services span application technical management (ABAP, SAP Basis, application security), application hosting (ALM/APM), application infrastructure (auto-scaling, HA/DR), security management, and cloud migration and optimization. Apiphani's Luumen platform is an AI-native observability product with "Deep Automation" that detects and resolves issues before users notice, unifying application telemetry, security, and self-healing. The company is certified SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and CSA STAR, and is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Assemble
providers.description: Assemble builds autonomous AI agents that help enterprise IT and business-systems teams automate development work inside core platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Workday, and NetSuite. The agents scope changes across integrated ERP, CRM, and HRIS systems, understand cross-system dependencies, implement and validate modifications, and keep a complete audit trail so teams can review agent work, approve modifications, and revert individual changes or restore a system to a prior state. Assemble is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) company targeting IT and business-systems teams managing complex enterprise transformations. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or OpenAPI, so only its verified public identity and website properties are captured.

providers.name: Asseta
providers.description: Asseta is a San Francisco-based online marketplace for the secondary market in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and parts. Founded in 2013, the platform lets fabs, refurbishers, and dealers list and discover used, refurbished, and new components, ranging from chamber assemblies and power supplies to smaller parts like o-rings, with more than 450,000 listings from suppliers around the world. Buyers request quotes from global suppliers with a single click and typically save 50-60% versus OEM pricing. Asseta is a portfolio company of a16z and Y Combinator. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its published web properties.

providers.name: AST SpaceMobile
providers.description: AST SpaceMobile (NASDAQ, ASTS) is a United States satellite operator building the SpaceMobile Network, a space-based cellular broadband constellation of BlueBird satellites carrying the largest commercial phased-array antennas in low Earth orbit, designed to deliver 4G and 5G directly to standard, unmodified smartphones. It sits upstream of the retail telecom market as a wholesale coverage layer, not a consumer brand, not a CPaaS: signals from a handset are relayed by satellite to a small number of in-country ground gateways, which compensate for Doppler and delay and then hand the traffic into a mobile network operator's core, where the operator completes the call and bills the subscriber. Distribution runs entirely through partner carriers, with agreements covering nearly 60 mobile network operators serving over 3 billion subscribers, including AT&T, Verizon, Vodafone, Rakuten, Bell, TELUS and stc, plus strategic investment from Google and American Tower. Its API posture is that of a satellite infrastructure company rather than a network-API publisher, honestly assessed as none: as of July 2026 AST SpaceMobile publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI, no SDKs and no public network-API surface. Probes of developer, developers, docs, api and opengateway subdomains and the corresponding site paths all fail to resolve or return 404, and no CAMARA, GSMA Open Gateway, TM Forum or 3GPP NEF exposure claim appears anywhere on ast-science.com or in its press releases. Any programmable access to SpaceMobile capacity reaches developers only indirectly, through the partner carrier that owns the subscriber relationship and the network APIs.

providers.name: Avec
providers.description: Avec is a free, AI-powered email application for Gmail, built by Nearly Extraterrestrial Technology, Inc. The iOS app prioritizes a user's inbox and surfaces important messages one at a time in a card-based interface, learning individual preferences over time so the most relevant email rises to the top. Users swipe to mark messages done or save them for later, compose replies by voice in their own writing style, receive smart notifications with email summaries, and search their mailbox with natural-language AI. Founded in 2024 by CEO Jonathan Unikowski and backed at seed stage by Bloomberg Beta and Lightspeed Venture Partners, Avec is a consumer productivity product rather than an API provider - it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Baania
providers.description: Baania (Baania (Thailand) Co., Ltd.) is a Thai proptech and real-estate marketplace that aggregates new and second-hand houses, condos, and townhomes for sale across Thailand. The consumer portal provides property listings, project data, reviews, and price comparison to help home buyers make decisions in one place, and connects them directly with property developers and real-estate agents. Backed by 500 Global. Baania is a consumer-facing web portal; no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bandana
providers.description: Bandana (operated by Workwise Solutions Inc.) is a two-sided marketplace and job-search platform for hourly and entry-level workers. Job seekers get free tools to find better-paying local jobs with benefits, generate resumes, auto-match to openings via Bandana Apply, and track applications; employers post jobs for free, reach local talent, promote listings across social platforms, and use a built-in ATS or integrate their existing hiring flow. Backed by Craft Ventures and General Catalyst, Bandana operates across California, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Chicago, and Washington, D.C.
