As of this profile Bandana publishes no public developer/API surface — no docs portal, OpenAPI, GitHub organization, or /.well-known discovery documents were found; this record captures its public identity and product links.

providers.name: Bank of Hawaii
providers.description: Bank of Hawaii is a state-chartered commercial bank organized under the laws of the State of Hawaii in 1897, a member of the Federal Reserve System and FDIC-insured. It is the principal banking subsidiary of Bank of Hawaii Corporation (NYSE: BOH), a Honolulu-headquartered regional financial services company serving Hawaii, Guam, and other Pacific islands with consumer, commercial, and wealth-management banking. As a regional US institution, Bank of Hawaii publishes no first-party public developer portal and exposes no documented public API surface; probes of developer.boh.com and developers.boh.com do not resolve. US open finance is voluntary and fragmented, and consumer-permissioned data access to Bank of Hawaii accounts is available in practice only through third-party aggregators (for example Plaid), not through a direct bank-operated API. No Financial Data Exchange (FDX) membership and no published CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture were found at the time of this record.

providers.name: Barakah
providers.description: Barakah is a Saudi foodtech company operating a consumer mobile marketplace that fights food waste by connecting restaurants, cafes, hotels, bakeries, and grocery retailers with consumers who buy their surplus, still-fresh meals and food products at discounts of up to 70 percent for pickup or delivery. Founded in Jeddah and backed by 500 Global, FoodLabs, and Salica Investments, Barakah has grown into one of the most downloaded food and drink apps in Saudi Arabia with partnerships across more than 800 merchants, including global brands. Barakah is a business-to-consumer mobile application and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK; this profile captures its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Baton Media
providers.description: Baton is a music collaboration and IP-management platform for unreleased music, built by Baton Media Inc. (New York, Techstars '23). It gives musicians, producers, managers, and talent scouts tools to securely upload, organize, version, and share unreleased tracks, beat packs, and sample libraries across iOS and web. A proprietary media player shows creators exactly who is listening to their material, while collaboration spaces (private, invite-only, or public), an in-app audio studio (looping, pitch shifting, EQ, effects, sample pairing), and a creator-to-fan marketplace support discovery, placement opportunities, and monetization. Baton is building collaboration protocols to track IP rights and automate crediting and compensation across the creator economy. As of this enrichment the company publishes a consumer product (iOS app + web) with no public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: Beeline Bikes
providers.description: Beeline Bikes (now operating as Beeline Connect) is a B2B software platform for the bicycle industry that links riders, retailers, and brands across North America, with roughly 3,300 participating retailers. The platform provides real-time service scheduling and 24/7 appointment booking, live market inventory management, test-ride booking, local bicycle assembly coordination, warranty submission and reimbursement tracking, an affiliate e-commerce sales channel with revenue sharing to local dealers, and a dynamic dealer locator. It supports both mobile and in-shop retail operations and serves established brands such as Aventon, Priority, Lectric, and Pedego. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, documentation, or integration surface has been found at this time.

providers.name: Bench IQ
providers.description: Bench IQ is a legal technology company building an AI-powered judicial intelligence platform that analyzes how individual judges reason and rule. Rather than limiting analysis to the roughly 3% of matters that produce written opinions, Bench IQ studies the reasoning behind all of a judge's rulings so litigators can anticipate decisions, craft stronger arguments, and shape case strategy. Founded by the team behind ROSS Intelligence — CEO Jimoh Ovbiagele and CTO Maxim Isakov — together with former Kirkland & Ellis restructuring partner Jeffrey Gettleman, the company says four of the top five AmLaw 100 firms rely on its analysis. It is backed by Battery Ventures, Inovia Capital, and Haystack, along with leading law firms including Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati, Fenwick & West, and Cooley.

providers.name: BillTrim
providers.description: BillTrim is a consumer bill-management and negotiation service that helps households lower, monitor, and pay their recurring bills. Its team negotiates with providers on the customer's behalf (up to twice a year), watches for price increases before autopay processes, and can pay bills automatically from a connected bank account. BillTrim advertises support for 20,000+ service providers across internet, cable, phone, insurance, and other recurring household expenses. Backed by 500 Global, it operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile application; no public developer API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Bindery
providers.description: Bindery (Bindery Books) is a community-driven, influencer-led book publishing platform and marketplace founded by Matt Kaye and Meg Harvey. It pairs established book "tastemakers" — social-media book reviewers and BookTok / Bookstagram creators — with emerging authors, letting each tastemaker run their own micro-imprint (Ezeekat Press, Boundless Press, Skies Press, and others), acquire titles, weigh in on creative decisions, and promote them to their communities in exchange for a share of net earnings. Often described as "Patreon meets publishing," Bindery combines traditional trade distribution and marketing with paid membership communities, a bookshop, exclusive reviews and author interviews, and iOS and Android apps. The company is backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Boldr
providers.description: Boldr is a Techstars-backed consumer hardware company building energy-saving smart home climate control devices. Its two products are Kelvin, a smart infrared heater, and Klima, a smart thermostat controller for mini-split air conditioners that also monitors appliance health so units last longer with fewer issues. Both devices are managed through the Boldr mobile app, which lets homeowners control climate settings remotely and track energy usage to lower utility bills. Boldr also runs Boldr Pro, a program for HVAC contractors. The company sells direct to consumers through a Shopify-hosted online store at shopboldr.com and does not currently publish a first-party developer API; its only public machine-readable surface is the Shopify Customer Account OIDC discovery served at the storefront host.

providers.name: BRICKS
providers.description: BRICKS is a no-code Platform-as-a-Service from BRICKS DAG, Inc. (Taipei, Taiwan) for building and managing interactive digital signage, kiosks, and multi-display stitched screens. A WYSIWYG editor lets designers and businesses create dynamic, data-driven displays — menu boards, wayfinding and crowd control, meeting-room panels, sports scoreboards, promotional posters, and NFT frames — deploy them to app-bound devices, control them remotely from mobile, and connect live data sources and APIs, all without writing code. BRICKS is a 500 Global Accelerator Taiwan (TTA 2022) company.

providers.name: Bridgewater Bank
providers.description: Bridgewater Bank is a Canadian Schedule I chartered bank, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Alberta Motor Association (AMA), headquartered in Calgary, Alberta and established in 1997. It is a member of the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation (CDIC) and operates a broker-distributed, deposit-and-lending model rather than a direct-to-consumer retail branch network — residential mortgages, Guaranteed Investment Certificates (GICs), and high-interest savings accounts sold through a select network of trusted mortgage and deposit brokers, with roughly $3.3 billion in mortgages and deposits across approximately 53,000 customer accounts nationwide. Bridgewater Bank exposes NO public first-party developer API or developer portal. Its only dedicated digital surface beyond the corporate site is a partner-gated broker information portal (bwbbrokerinfo.ca). Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking (open-banking) framework is legislated but not yet operational, so any consumer data access from a bank of this size is voluntary and today would be aggregator/screen-scraping based rather than through a documented first-party API. No Interac, Real-Time Rail (RTR), FDX, or consumer-driven-banking API participation is publicly documented by the institution.

providers.name: Briya
providers.description: Briya builds AIRE (AI Research Environment), a privacy-first AI platform for healthcare and clinical research that lets researchers analyze real-world medical data without writing code. AIRE trains AI models on real-world data and provides domain-specific agents for literature review, hypothesis testing, population and cohort analysis, study design, and manuscript-ready output with built-in validation. Data is accessed across multiple sources without centralizing it into a warehouse, with a compliance posture aimed at HIPAA, GDPR, and FDA/EMA regulatory standards. Briya serves emerging biotech, life sciences organizations, academic institutions, and healthcare systems, with offices in New York, Nashville, and Tel Aviv. The company is backed by Insight Partners. This API Evangelist profile is an enrichment pass on a portfolio lead; Briya publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Cantina AI
providers.description: Cantina is a social AI platform founded by Sean Parker (Cantina Labs, San Francisco) that lets people create AI-powered social characters that talk, perform, and interact, then turn them into short videos to share and go viral. The consumer product (cantina.com) centers on building characters with personality, chatting with friends and AI, and generating video in seconds across a public directory of trending bots and creators. Backed by a16z, Benchmark, Greycroft, and Salesforce Ventures. Cantina is a consumer social application and does not currently publish a public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its real public identity and link properties while no external API is available to enrich.

providers.name: Carreira Beauty
providers.description: Carreira Beauty (carreirabeauty.com) is a Brazilian online job marketplace connecting beauty, aesthetics, and wellness professionals with employment and freelance opportunities. The platform operates as a two-sided network that lets professionals — manicurists, hairdressers, estheticians, makeup artists, barbers, masotherapists, eyebrow designers, and salon receptionists — create a free professional profile and discover nearby openings, while salons, aesthetic clinics, spas, and studios post jobs and freelance ("freelas") shifts. It offers geographic filtering to match professionals with local roles, direct employer-to-professional communication over WhatsApp, and one free job posting per business with no credit card required. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Carreira Beauty is a consumer web application and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Casa
providers.description: Casa is a home management membership service that helps homeowners handle maintenance and everyday household tasks through a mix of digital home documentation and professional services. A $199/month membership bundles a concierge for project research, vendor negotiation and scheduling, monthly handyman hours, an Autopilot maintenance care plan, a 3D home inventory (appliances, paint colors, safety systems), utility and property-tax tracking, package handling, and recurring-vendor management. Casa is available in the San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, and Austin, and is backed by Forerunner Ventures and True Ventures. No public developer/API surface has been identified.

providers.name: Cheaf
providers.description: Cheaf is a mobile food-rescue marketplace that connects supermarkets, restaurants, bakeries, and food retailers holding surplus inventory with consumers who buy it as discounted "surprise packages" at pickup, cutting food waste while helping merchants recover value on stock that would otherwise be thrown away. Founded in Mexico in 2020, the consumer app operates across Mexico, Chile, and Argentina, has more than 3.5 million users, and reports millions of kilograms of food rescued and greenhouse-gas emissions avoided. Businesses list surplus through a merchant onboarding portal and pay a commission on sales; consumers browse and reserve packages through the mobile app. This API Evangelist profile tracks Cheaf's public web and developer surface; Cheaf is a consumer/merchant mobile platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: Cherrypick
providers.description: Cherrypick is a London-based food-tech company (backed by Speedinvest) behind an all-in-one meal-planning and grocery-shopping mobile app. The app helps home cooks discover personalized recipes tailored to their dietary preferences, automatically plan their weekly meals, and turn those plans into a supermarket basket at real supermarket prices for home delivery or in-store pickup. Positioned as a lower-cost alternative to recipe-box subscription services, Cherrypick combines recipe discovery, meal planning, and grocery ordering into a single consumer experience aimed at saving people time and money while reducing food waste. Cherrypick is a consumer mobile application with no public developer, API, or partner-integration surface at this time; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a network entity rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Clickable
providers.description: Clickable is a marketing analytics and digital advertising platform founded in 2006 that serves as an ads and analytics partner for businesses and agencies. The company builds award-winning pay-per-click (PPC) advertising tools for search and social campaigns and delivers customized reporting that cuts through data overload so marketers can focus on the metrics that matter. Clickable also offers VIN retention reporting purpose-built for automotive dealerships to improve customer retention. Backed by Union Square Ventures, the company focuses on relationship-driven managed advertising and analytics services rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Cooleaf
providers.description: Cooleaf is an employee engagement, recognition, and rewards platform built by ITA Group that helps HR and people leaders create lasting engagement across their organizations. The platform lets teams recognize peers, reward performance and KPIs, celebrate milestones and anniversaries, run pulse surveys and challenges, deliver training and programming, and surface engagement analytics through manager dashboards. Cooleaf meets employees where they already work by embedding recognition into Slack and Microsoft Teams and syncing people data through connectors like Zapier and Workday. Cooleaf is delivered as a closed SaaS product with a hosted web application and login; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference, so this API Evangelist profile captures its identity, domain-security posture, and the integration surface it exposes to customers rather than a developer program.

providers.name: Crowdplat
providers.description: CrowdPlat, Inc. is a Pleasanton, California company (backed by 500 Global) that operates two platforms combining human expertise with AI. Its crowdsourcing marketplace connects enterprises with vetted specialists across 50+ countries for consulting, software development, R&D, and innovation challenges, delivered with US-based project management and milestone-driven scopes. Its AI Hire platform is recruitment technology that automates candidate evaluation through resume scoring, AI-generated screening questions, video interviews, and LinkedIn job promotion with auto-targeted outreach. Customers include federal agencies and enterprises such as Airbus, PayPal, and EPRI. No public developer/API program is published at this time.

providers.name: Culdesac
providers.description: Culdesac is a post-car real estate development company building walkable, car-free neighborhoods in the United States. Its first project, Culdesac Tempe in Tempe, Arizona, broke ground in 2019 and welcomed its first residents in 2021 — a 16-acre, roughly $140 million development of 636 apartment units plus 24,000 square feet of restaurant and retail space, designed with no resident parking. Residents receive transportation benefits such as free light-rail rides and discounted rideshare and scooter access in place of car ownership. Culdesac operates leasing, tours, and resident services through its website and HubSpot-backed portals, and intends to replicate the car-free neighborhood model in other cities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Initialized Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Culdesac publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CUUP, Inc.
providers.description: CUUP, Inc. is a New York City-based direct-to-consumer intimates brand founded in 2018 by Abby Morgan and Kearnon O'Molony, offering precision-fit bras, underwear, loungewear, apparel, and swim across an extended range of cup and band sizes sold through its shopcuup.com online store. Backed by Insight Partners and Forerunner Ventures, CUUP was acquired by FULLBEAUTY Brands in July 2023 and now runs on the FULLBEAUTY commerce platform. As a consumer retail company it exposes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web presence, domain security posture, and commercial policy pages.

providers.name: Delek US
providers.description: Delek US is an alias for Delek US Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: DK), a diversified downstream energy company headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee with assets in petroleum refining, logistics, asphalt operations, renewable fuels, and convenience store retailing. Delek operates four refineries in Tyler and Big Spring (Texas), El Dorado (Arkansas), and Krotz Springs (Louisiana) with combined crude throughput capacity of roughly 302,000 barrels per day. The canonical profile for this company is maintained under aid delek-us-holdings; this entry exists as a name alias and references the corporate site. Delek does not publish a developer API; partner integrations occur through industry-standard EDI, terminal automation, and ticketing systems.

providers.name: Descartes Underwriting
providers.description: Descartes Underwriting is a Paris-headquartered insurtech, founded in 2019, specializing in parametric insurance for climate, natural-catastrophe, cyber, and emerging corporate risks. It operates two complementary entities — Descartes Underwriting, a global parametric managing general agent (MGA), and Descartes Insurance, an ACPR-licensed European full-stack carrier — using AI, satellite imagery, IoT sensor data, and scientific risk models to structure index-based covers that pay out automatically within days when a predefined trigger is met, without a traditional claims-adjustment process. Backed by Battery Ventures and other investors, the company serves 600+ large corporations and public entities through corporate brokers across 20+ offices worldwide. No public developer API or documentation is published; the company distributes coverage through brokers rather than a self-serve API surface.

providers.name: Dewu (POIZON)
providers.description: Dewu (POIZON) is a leading Chinese online marketplace for sneakers, streetwear, luxury goods, and collectibles, distinguished by its integrated product authentication (legit-check) service that verifies items before they ship to buyers. Operated by Shanghai-based Poizon and backed by Hongshan (formerly Sequoia China), it runs both the domestic Dewu (得物) app and the global POIZON marketplace. For developers it operates the POIZON / Dewu Open Platform (open.poizon.com and open.dewu.com), a partner program that lets sellers, ISVs, and ERP integrators connect to the marketplace over an app-key plus request-signature authenticated API covering product data, pricing, catalog search, delivery modes, and vendor information.

providers.name: Draxon
providers.description: Draxon is a Berlin-based company (founded 2025, backed by HV Capital and Point Nine) that provides IATA-certified virtual reality training for airport ground handling operations. The platform ships pre-configured Meta Quest VR headsets and an immersive training library covering ramp equipment such as belt loaders, tractors, pushback tugs, GPUs and towable stairs, plus safety procedures and hand signals for frontline ramp personnel. Its Trainer Hub delivers automated, IATA-compliant certification tracking with self-paced or instructor-led modules. Draxon operates as a B2B SaaS training provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: dwell
providers.description: Dwell is a digital publication and lifestyle brand focused on modern home design, architecture, and interior inspiration, published by Ziff Davis. It offers curated home tours, architectural features, renovation and before/after projects, design photography, real estate listings, shopping guides, and design news, plus a Dwell+ subscription for ad-free access and subscriber exclusives, a shop for furniture and decor, and a "Find a Pro" professional directory. Dwell was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent lead in the API Evangelist network; the public dwell.com property is a consumer media site with no developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so no API artifacts are captured for it.

providers.name: Ejen2u
providers.description: Ejen2u is a Malaysian reseller and agent-management technology company that operates one of the country's largest cloud-based reseller ecosystems for MSME brand owners, stockists, agents, dropshippers, and affiliates. Its platform spans EjenGO, a digital reseller and stockist management system; WEMAP, an entrepreneurial education program; and EjenVenture, custom reseller-network solutions for corporate brands, alongside fintech and logistics integrations (Pos Laju, Boost, Curlec, Delyva, J&T). Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Seri Kembangan, Ejen2u is backed by 500 Global, Gobi Partners, and Artem Ventures, and has facilitated hundreds of millions of ringgit in reseller commerce across a network of hundreds of thousands of agents. It exposes no public developer API today; this profile is an API Evangelist network entry enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Eloquii
providers.description: ELOQUII is a plus-size women's fashion retailer offering trend-driven, fashion-forward apparel and accessories in sizes 14 through 32, including dresses, workwear, outerwear, denim, and occasion wear with frequent seasonal collection refreshes. Known for its fit-obsessed design and inclusive sizing, the brand operates a direct-to-consumer ecommerce storefront at eloquii.com alongside select retail locations. ELOQUII was founded as a plus-size line, acquired by Walmart in 2018, and is now part of FullBeauty Brands. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a consumer ecommerce experience but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Emtethal
providers.description: Emtethal is a Riyadh, Saudi Arabia based smart compliance and inspection management platform for the food service and hospitality sectors, backed by 500 Global. The platform automates inspection scheduling and distribution, provides custom checklists per facility type, captures photo documentation with automatic timestamps and GPS location, detects and categorizes violations automatically, and pushes real-time alerts for critical issues. It layers analytics and compliance reporting on top of an offline-capable mobile field-inspection app (iOS and Android) and AI-powered camera and sensor monitoring. Emtethal serves both individual food facilities and consulting firms managing multiple client sites, offering a 14-day free trial. There is no public API, developer portal, or documented developer surface at this time; this profile is an API Evangelist company lead maintained for enrichment and monitoring.

providers.name: Eversettled
providers.description: EverSettled is a digital estate-settlement platform that guides families through the probate process after a death. Positioned between expensive probate attorneys and overwhelming do-it-yourself paperwork, it combines an adaptive, state-specific estate checklist, automated asset discovery across bank accounts, insurance policies and subscriptions, subscription cancellation and debt negotiation, secure document organization, a dedicated human estate-care specialist, and Sage, a 24/7 AI probate assistant. Available across all 50 U.S. states, EverSettled is not a law firm and does not provide legal services. Backed by a $5M seed round led by Emergence Capital with participation from Seedcamp.

providers.name: Execthread
providers.description: ExecThread is a selective, invitation-based network where successful executives discreetly share confidential, recruiter-led job opportunities with one another that are not posted on public job boards. The membership platform matches vetted senior professionals with unadvertised executive-level roles, offers executive branding services and resume review, and runs a points-based referral economy for members who contribute opportunities. Founded as a private career marketplace, it has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 and by the Financial Times. It is catalogued in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it exposes no public API or developer surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Fiture
providers.description: Fiture is a consumer smart-home fitness company that makes interactive AI-powered fitness mirrors for at-home workouts. Its hardware line includes the Fiture Core flagship mirror and the compact Fiture Mini, each pairing a wall-mounted display with a camera and on-device AI that delivers real-time motion tracking, gesture recognition, rep counting, and posture feedback across a library of live and on-demand fitness classes sold through a membership. The company was founded in China and is backed by venture investor Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). Fiture operates a direct-to-consumer commerce and membership website but does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or SDK; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company and its public web surface (support, legal, and account pages).

providers.name: Flow48
providers.description: Flow48 is an SME financing platform founded in March 2022 and backed by Speedinvest that provides non-dilutive, collateral-free capital to small and medium businesses across the GCC and wider MENA region, with a focus on the e-commerce and food & beverage sectors. Its two core products are revenue-based financing, which converts a business's future revenues into upfront capital repaid as a share of sales, and invoice financing, which accelerates cash locked in unpaid invoices. Flow48 markets funding decisions and disbursement within 24 to 48 hours with flexible repayment and no equity surrender. The company operates a self-service borrower onboarding portal but does not currently publish a public developer program, API reference, or SDKs.

providers.name: Forus (fka Tandem Health)
providers.description: Forus (formerly Tandem Health) is a US healthcare technology company building an AI-powered network that connects doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma to bring new therapies to patients. Its platform automates the medication-access workflow end to end: prior authorization submissions, appeal-letter generation, insurance enrollment forms, benefit verification, pharmacy routing, patient status communication, PA renewal tracking, and affordability-program enrollment. It integrates with major EHRs so prescribers can submit directly, covers any drug/plan/pharmacy across all 50 states, and is HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified. The company publishes an engineering blog at build.forus.com but does not currently expose a public developer API. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures.

providers.name: Generation Lab
providers.description: Generation Lab is a longevity science company founded in 2023 by Alina Su, UC Berkeley bioengineer Dr. Irina Conboy, and Michael Suswal, and backed by an $11M seed round led by Accel (Accel's first longevity bet). Its flagship SystemAge test measures biological age across roughly 460 biomarkers spanning 19 to 21 physiological systems and organs from an at-home, needle-free blood collection, returning a personalized aging report and science-backed action plan that ranges from lifestyle and supplement guidance to clinical interventions. The test is distributed through 300+ clinic partners across 18 countries and via a patient/provider portal. Generation Lab publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its public web, product, and legal surfaces.

providers.name: Glyf
providers.description: Glyf is an AI-powered creative tool for motion designers, studios, and creative teams, backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z Speedrun). It transforms 2D animations into stylized 3D with custom textures and effects, enhances live-action footage, and lets creators train bespoke AI models to match their own artistic direction, with exports into After Effects, Nuke, and other compositing pipelines. The product has since been rebranded and now ships as StyleFrame (www.styleframe.ai), a timeline-based, keyframe-driven video-generation platform where creators place keyframes and prompt tracks to control every frame of an animation. As of this enrichment pass, Glyf/StyleFrame is a consumer-facing creative application with no public API, developer documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or machine-readable discovery surface.

providers.name: GoAudience
providers.description: GoAudience is a customer-intelligence platform for Shopify ecommerce brands that turns first-party customer data into marketing decisions. It builds stable customer personas from real store data, surfaces findings and recommended actions ranked by impact, and syncs directly into Klaviyo, Meta, TikTok and other marketing tools. Features include a natural-language command surface for asking grounded questions about customers, a weekly "Monday Brief" digest of at-risk, lapsed and recovered customers with revenue impact, and a 90-day email audit. GoAudience is a Techstars-backed company; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: Grouper
providers.description: Grouper, operated by Element3 Health, Inc. (d/b/a Grouper) and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, is a healthy-aging benefit company that connects older adults to social clubs, group activities, and virtual community programming through health plans. Its consumer product, "Hello by Grouper," is a membership platform offering live and on-demand instructor-led virtual classes, research-based monthly brain-health challenges, and members-only online events, with the goal of keeping members active, socially connected, and healthier as they age. Grouper distributes primarily through Medicare Advantage and other health-plan partners rather than a direct developer channel; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface as of this profile, which was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture (a16z-associated) portfolio lead.

providers.name: Grover
providers.description: Grover is a Berlin-based consumer technology rental and subscription company that lets people rent smartphones, laptops, gaming consoles, cameras, smart home devices, and audio gear on flexible monthly plans ranging from one to twenty-four-plus months. With more than 500,000 active renters across the United States, Germany, Austria, Spain, and the Netherlands, Grover positions flexible tech access as a circular, subscription-based alternative to ownership, refurbishing and recirculating returned devices for resale. Grover is a consumer-facing service and does not currently publish a public developer portal or API; this profile captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Gustav
providers.description: Gustav is a vendor management platform (VMS) and sub-vendor marketplace for the staffing industry, enabling staffing firms to source talent from their trusted vendor network, share open jobs, collect and screen candidate submissions, run standardized hiring pipelines, schedule interviews, message vendors, and track performance in one place. Vendors organize into "Gustav Circles" with tiered job-release controls, and candidate submissions sync to applicant tracking systems including Bullhorn and JobDiva. Originally a Speedinvest-backed startup, Gustav is now operated by the member-owned Fuse Cooperative (a Colorado Limited Cooperative Association) and bills itself as the staffing industry's largest sub-vendor marketplace. Gustav is a SaaS web application; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs — integrations are delivered through the Bullhorn and JobDiva marketplaces.

providers.name: Hedvig
providers.description: Hedvig is a Swedish insurtech offering mobile-first digital insurance to consumers, with more than 200,000 customers managing policies and reporting claims through its app. Products span home and apartment (hemförsäkring), villa, car, pet (dog and cat), accident, student, and travel insurance, with in-app chat support and fast digital claims. Backed by Anthemis and Obvious Ventures, Hedvig operates a consumer app over internal APIs and publishes no public developer API surface; this network profile captures the company identity, public web properties, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Hemster
providers.description: Hemster is a fashion-technology company that modernizes tailoring and garment fit through a digital "Fit Profile" system. Customers create a personalized fit pattern once, then match any garment — new or from their existing closet — to that saved profile so it can be tailored to their perfect fit rather than to a standard size. The platform aims to reduce returns, extend the life of clothing people already own, and remove size-related hesitation at purchase, with a sustainability angle around keeping garments out of landfill. Hemster operates a consumer web app at my.hemster.co and a related returns/deadstock product ((re)vive / byrevive.com). It is backed by Bullpen Capital. As of this profile Hemster publishes no public developer, API, or integration surface; this record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: i-Brain Tech
providers.description: i-Brain Tech is a neuroscience company building a brain-controlled training platform for sports performance. Its core product is a video game driven exclusively by an athlete's brain impulses through motor-imagery and neurofeedback, requiring no physical movement. The platform is applied to three areas: post-injury neuromuscular recovery and return-to-play readiness, player development through cognitive and tactical training without physical strain, and cognitive assessment that surfaces mental resilience, attention, and endurance from real brain data. Elite football clubs including Real Sociedad, Juventus FC, CD Leganes, Olympique Lyonnais, S.L. Benfica, and Seattle Reign FC use the platform. i-Brain Tech is a Techstars portfolio company. It currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Indigov
providers.description: Indigov is a constituent relationship management (CRM) platform purpose-built for government — U.S. Congressional offices, state legislatures, and municipal agencies — that unifies inbound constituent communications from email, web forms, SMS, social media, phone, and scanned mail into a single cross-organizational inbox. It layers casework tracking, constituent routing, smart tagging, and mass-email triage with rapid response, plus a customer data platform for sentiment and engagement analytics and an award-winning mobile app for field staff. Indigov serves government offices across 35 states and 2 territories and was acquired by Granicus, joining its Government Experience Cloud (GXC). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: JobAdder
providers.description: JobAdder is a cloud-based recruitment and applicant tracking platform used by staffing agencies and in-house talent acquisition teams to manage jobs, candidates, placements, and client relationships. The platform offers a comprehensive REST API that exposes recruitment workflows including job posting, candidate search, application tracking, and analytics. The JobAdder API uses OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with region-specific base URLs returned in the token response.

providers.name: JobNimbus
providers.description: JobNimbus is a CRM and project management platform built for contractors, particularly in roofing, restoration, and home services industries. The platform enables lead tracking, job scheduling, estimating, invoicing, document management, and workflow automation. JobNimbus exposes a REST-like Open API supporting GET, PUT, and POST requests with JSON payloads, authenticated via API keys generated from the user dashboard.

providers.name: Jobvite
providers.description: Jobvite, part of Employ Inc., is an applicant tracking system (ATS) and recruiting platform that helps enterprises source, hire, and onboard talent. The platform combines candidate relationship management, recruitment marketing, branded career sites, and onboarding workflows. Jobvite provides REST APIs that facilitate real-time data exchange in JSON for candidate records, requisitions, applications, and the Onboard New Hire endpoint.

providers.name: Jolly
providers.description: Jolly is an AI-powered workforce engagement platform that uses a points-based rewards system, gamification, and performance-based incentives to drive engagement, utilization, compliance, and recruitment for frontline and part-time workforces. Employees earn points by completing work-related missions (taking shifts, arriving on time, hitting productivity goals) and redeem them for real-world rewards from partners such as Walmart, Amazon, and Visa. Employers use an AI campaign builder, programmatic employee referrals, an internal social recognition platform, real-time analytics (flight-risk detection, employee NPS, engagement metrics via ERP/EMR integrations), and white-label branding. Jolly serves healthcare, logistics, manufacturing, staffing, farming, retail, warehousing, construction, and military employers. Based at Cornell Tech in New York City, the company raised a $16.5M Series A and is backed by Bullpen Capital along with executives from Tesla, Coinbase, Stripe, PayPal, and Discord. Jolly does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Kartable
providers.description: Kartable is a French online education platform (edtech) delivering standards-aligned learning for students from primary through secondary school (CE1 to Terminale, ages 6-18). It provides more than 1,000 course summaries, thousands of corrected exercises, and quizzes across 16 subjects including mathematics, French, history, physics, and languages, authored by teachers from the French Education Ministry. Its "Alfa" AI tutor answers questions 24/7, generates custom quizzes from photos of coursework, and guides students through homework, while parents follow progress from a dedicated dashboard. Kartable is a consumer subscription product (from EUR 7.99/month) and does not publish a public developer API. Backed by Partech.

providers.name: Lola
providers.description: Lola is a consumer travel booking platform at lola.com that lets travelers discover, compare, and book flights, hotels, and trips in one place, built around insider access to the world's leading travel brands, competitive rates, and a simple "just ask" booking experience. The lola.com domain was previously the Boston-based corporate travel and expense-management startup founded by Kayak veterans Paul English and Bill O'Donnell (backed by Accel and GV, more than $80M raised) which wound down operations in 2021 with its technology acquired by Capital One; the domain now hosts this new consumer travel product. No public API or developer program is currently published — this profile captures the provider's public web and security posture.

providers.name: Material Bank
providers.description: Material Bank is a B2B digital marketplace that lets architects, interior designers, and other design professionals search, sample, and specify building and design materials from 650+ brands across hundreds of categories through a single platform, with free overnight sample delivery. The platform provides project boards, brand collections, sustainability filters (EPDs, CDPH), and a manufacturer portal for brands. Backed by bain-capital-ventures and general-catalyst. This profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer API surface was found.

providers.name: Materialbank
providers.description: Material Bank is an e-commerce marketplace that lets architecture and design professionals search and order free material samples from thousands of design and architectural product brands, delivered overnight in a single box. Founded by Adam Sandow, the platform consolidates supplier sample catalogs into one searchable storefront (built on Adobe Commerce) with free next-day sample fulfillment. Material Bank does not publish a public developer API program: the consumer storefront runs a standard Adobe Commerce GraphQL endpoint at /graphql (introspection disabled) and an api.materialbank.com host that is not publicly documented.

providers.name: MEAL PLANET HOLDING LTD
providers.description: MealPlanet (MEAL PLANET HOLDING LTD) is a UAE-based foodtech company, founded in 2024 by Khalid Baareh, that operates a meal-plan aggregation marketplace. Its consumer mobile app lets customers browse, compare, and subscribe to more than 500 personalised meal plans from 100+ trusted brands across the UAE, filtering by goal, calories, and dietary preferences, with flexible delivery and nutrition tracking. In 2024 the company closed a $6M seed round led by Middle East Venture Partners (MEVP) with participation from Sanabil 500 (the Sanabil Accelerator by 500 Global), AlTouq Group, Faith Capital, and Alturki Ventures, funding regional expansion beginning with Saudi Arabia. MealPlanet is a consumer-facing platform and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: MedAll
providers.description: MedAll is a UK-founded healthcare education platform on a mission to make medical education radically accessible. It hosts live and on-demand courses, conferences, workshops, webinars and training sessions for healthcare professionals, students and organisations, and provides event management tooling for registrations, feedback forms, certificates, abstracts, schedules and digital poster halls, alongside CME (continuing medical education), question banks and mobile apps for iOS and Android. The platform is used by clinicians and institutions worldwide. As of this enrichment pass MedAll publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or webhooks; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture. Backed by Seedcamp.

providers.name: Merchbar
providers.description: Merchbar, Inc. is the official merchandise retailer for top musicians, selling vinyl records, CDs, t-shirts, hoodies, posters, and other band merchandise across thousands of artist storefronts at merchbar.com. It runs a consumer shopping experience alongside a "Merchbar for Artists" program and official merchandise integrations with YouTube and Spotify. Merchbar is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital. As of this enrichment pass Merchbar publishes no public API, developer program, SDKs, or technical documentation — no developer/api/docs subdomain resolves and there is no /.well-known/security.txt — so this profile captures only its public web presence and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Mozi
providers.description: Mozi is a private social network mobile app founded by Twitter and Medium co-founder Ev Williams and Molly DeWolf Swenson, and backed by Obvious Ventures. Rather than public profiles or follower counts, Mozi privately matches your phone contacts so you learn when friends are in the same city, attending the same events, or checking in nearby — designed to spark in-person "social serendipity" and get people off their screens. Launched in December 2024 and available in 135+ countries, Mozi is a consumer iOS/Android application with no public developer program, API, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Mukuru
providers.description: Mukuru is a Cape Town-headquartered, pan-African fintech and one of the continent's largest formal remittance providers, serving over 16 million customers across Southern, Eastern and Western Africa, the United Kingdom, and the European Union. Founded in 2004 to make sending money home faster and more affordable for the African diaspora, Mukuru now operates a broader financial services platform spanning international and domestic money transfers, the Mukuru Card (a prepaid card product), Mukuru Wallet (a mobile money wallet available in markets such as Botswana for airtime, electricity, and bill payments), Mukuru Pay (cash-based online checkout at retail partners), and Mukuru Funeral Cover (life insurance with cross-border repatriation benefits underwritten by Guardrisk Life). The company is licensed as a South African Financial Services Provider (FSP 45517) and registered Credit Provider (NCRCP9244), and reaches customers through a hybrid network of branches, retail booths, USSD, WhatsApp, web, and native Android, iOS, and Huawei AppGallery apps, supported by more than 320,000 pay-in and pay-out locations. An enterprise arm — branded under the Mukuru Enterprise / MukuruPay umbrella — offers collections and disbursements rails to businesses sending funds into or paying out across Africa. Mukuru does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source client; its Mukuru GitHub organization contains only archived forks of upstream infrastructure tooling (Drone, Helm, Puppet, PHP Docker images) and no Mukuru-authored libraries. Integrations with the Mukuru Enterprise platform are arranged through direct commercial engagement rather than a self-service developer program.

providers.name: NICKL
providers.description: NICKL (Nicklpass) is a subscription management platform that bills itself as "the operating system for subscriptions." It helps organizations govern the digital tools, SaaS subscriptions, and data services their teams use by connecting identity, usage, and procurement data in one place. Capabilities include role-based governance and provisioning, usage intelligence to surface adoption and redundant spend, and coordinated procurement that aggregates demand to negotiate from real usage data. The platform integrates with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and Plaid, and applies AI models for insights and pricing optimization. NICKL participated in the Comcast NBCUniversal LIFT Labs Accelerator powered by Techstars. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing site and hosted control panel but no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or other machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Nobl9
providers.description: Nobl9 is a service-level objective (SLO) management platform that helps engineering and SRE teams define, measure, and act on reliability targets across cloud and observability tools. The platform aggregates data from Datadog, Prometheus, New Relic, Splunk, AWS CloudWatch, and other sources to compute error budgets and surface reliability insights. Nobl9 exposes a suite of REST APIs for managing SLOs, annotations, budget adjustments, audit logs, and reports using access token authentication.

providers.name: On Deck
providers.description: On Deck (now operating as the On Deck Founder Fellowship, ODF) is a founder fellowship and startup community program that helps aspiring entrepreneurs start companies through an intense, in-person cohort experience focused on meeting co-founders, exploring ideas, and gaining conviction. Backed by Canaan Partners, On Deck provides mentorship, a peer community, and startup perks. It is a program and community platform rather than a developer or API product: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: OpenDNS
providers.description: OpenDNS is a cloud-delivered recursive DNS and internet security service founded in 2005 and acquired by Cisco in 2015, where its enterprise capabilities now form the foundation of the Cisco Umbrella platform. OpenDNS continues to offer free consumer products - OpenDNS Home and OpenDNS Family Shield - providing recursive DNS resolution, phishing and malware blocking, and content filtering with parental controls across every device on a home network, all managed through the OpenDNS dashboard. Enterprise DNS-layer security, secure web gateway, and the Investigate threat-intelligence API have migrated to Cisco Umbrella (umbrella.cisco.com). Added to the API Evangelist network as a Greylock portfolio company in the cybersecurity sector.

providers.name: OpenVPN
providers.description: OpenVPN is a secure networking company providing VPN and Zero Trust network access solutions for over 20,000 organizations worldwide, offering both the self-hosted Access Server and the cloud-delivered CloudConnexa managed service. The platform supports encrypted tunnels, identity-based access policies, content filtering, IDS/IPS, and domain-based traffic rules across major cloud providers. OpenVPN exposes an XML-RPC management API for Access Server and an OAuth 2.0 protected REST API for CloudConnexa.

providers.name: Packmatic
providers.description: Packmatic is a Berlin-based packaging procurement platform that helps companies source flexible and paper-based packaging at lower cost. It combines a proprietary supplier database and a smart-matching engine spanning 350+ suppliers with expert packaging engineers and a cloud-based platform for managing quotes, orders, and supplier communication. Customers pay no upfront fees; Packmatic earns a commission when they source through its network, reporting average savings around 16% and reducing supplier search time by roughly 70%. Packmatic does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PawnHero
providers.description: PawnHero is the Philippines' first online pawnshop, offering instant collateral-based cash loans against jewelry, gold, luxury designer bags, watches, gadgets, and Apple devices. Customers create a pawn ticket online, an in-house courier ("Pawntrooper") collects the item for appraisal, and approved funds are disbursed within minutes via bank transfer or e-wallet, with loan terms up to 180 days and renewal options. The business is supervised by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP). PawnHero operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile service and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Picnic
providers.description: Picnic is a London-based, privacy-first photo-organization app for iOS that helps people declutter and organize their camera roll through a swipe-based, gamified experience — sorting photos into albums, comparing and removing duplicate shots, building streaks, and resurfacing "on this day" memories. All processing happens on-device, so photos never leave the user's phone: no cloud upload, no ads, and no tracking or selling of user data. Founded in 2019 and a certified B Corporation, Picnic grew to more than 1.5 million users and roughly €4M ARR before being acquired by Paris-based mobile app publisher MWM in April 2026. Picnic is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Pivotal Health
providers.description: Pivotal Health (formerly Radix Health) is a healthcare technology company and self-described "IDR Authority" that helps medical providers secure fair out-of-network reimbursement through the federal Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) process created by the No Surprises Act. Its platform combines automated eligibility screening, dispute submission software integrated with major revenue cycle management (RCM) systems, payer data, and white-glove managed services across emergency medicine, anesthesiology, radiology, surgery, pathology, air ambulance, and hospitals and health systems. Pivotal Health is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Pixyalbum
providers.description: Pixyalbum is a Mexican consumer photo-printing service that turns digital photos from a mobile device into physical printed products delivered across Mexico. Its catalog includes Fotolibros (soft- and hard-cover photo books of 40-100 pages), Imanes (packs of square photo magnets), and Pixycuadros (photographic prints with optional framing). Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. Pixyalbum is a direct-to-consumer product with no public API, developer portal, or documentation at the time of enrichment; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Plush
providers.description: Plush is an AI-powered fashion discovery and shopping platform at plush.shop that lets shoppers describe what they want in natural language and returns curated results from trusted and emerging brands. Rather than rigid keyword search, Plush matches on mood, aesthetic, and intent, layering image search, smart real-time filters, influencer edit collections, and wishlists on top of its proprietary AI curation. Founded by Chang Liu (CEO) and Ying Zhu (CTO) — who met through Y Combinator's co-founder matching — Plush is backed by the Anthemis Female Innovators Lab Fund and the Oxford Seed Fund. It is a consumer-facing web application; no public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: Pointee
providers.description: Pointee is an agentic automation platform for enterprise business process automation, guiding organizations through the full automation journey from discovery to running AI at scale. Its Process Discovery maps how work actually runs to surface automation potential and ROI, Workflow Automation orchestrates people, bots, and AI agents in unified workflows, and Guardian Agents continuously monitor automation to detect quality drops, automate incident response, and prevent cost overruns and security threats. Pointee also offers a dedicated offering to maximize existing RPA investments. The product is operated by Pointee Interactive s.r.o. (Liberec, Czech Republic) and is a portfolio company of Earlybird; customers include KBC, Intel, Deloitte, AXA, Microsoft, and Mutual of Omaha.

providers.name: Policygenius
providers.description: Policygenius is an independent online insurance marketplace and licensed brokerage founded in 2014 by Jennifer Fitzgerald and Francois de Lame and headquartered in New York City. The platform lets consumers compare quotes, get unbiased expert advice, and buy life, disability, homeowners, auto, and renters insurance across dozens of carriers, and it operates Policygenius Pro, a turnkey life-insurance fulfillment platform for financial advisors, agents, banks, and credit unions. Policygenius was acquired by Zinnia (an Eldridge company) in 2023. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass Policygenius publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDK; its GitHub organization hosts internal tooling and forks only.

providers.name: Prime Meridian
providers.description: Prime Meridian (Prime Meridian Labs) is an AI-powered consumer tax preparation and e-filing service that files federal and state income tax returns for free. Users upload their tax documents, answer a few clarifying questions, and the platform's AI generates a plain-language return covering W-2 employment, self-employment (Schedule C), K-1 partnership income, and multi-state situations, then e-files it with the IRS and state authorities in roughly fifteen minutes. The company is backed by General Catalyst and counts former IRS Commissioner Daniel Werfel among its strategic advisors. It is a consumer web application with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Ray Browser
providers.description: Ray Browser is an AI-powered web browser that learns a user's interests and browsing habits to personalize their internet experience. It ships a built-in agent that can run web searches and automate tasks, a curated daily Discover feed, and Ray Studio for building custom tools and dashboards without writing code. The product is currently in public beta with a free Starter plan that grants weekly credits for its AI features. Ray Browser is a consumer product; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network for tracking and enrichment.

providers.name: ReDEF
providers.description: REDEF is a media curation and newsletter company founded and led by Jason Hirschhorn (CEO + Chief Curator) that "DJs the internet" — surfacing daily remixes of the stories, people, and ideas that matter across Media, Fashion, Music, Sports, and Tech. Readers follow curated Mixes, Sets, Originals, Charts, and email Newsletters ("interest remixes for curious minds"), and can build and share their own mixes. ReDEF was surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found a public consumer content website (redef.com) but no public developer program, API, documentation, or machine-readable surface.

providers.name: Redwood Materials
providers.description: Redwood Materials is a Carson City, Nevada battery materials company founded in 2017 by former Tesla CTO JB Straubel. It operates a domestic circular supply chain for lithium-ion batteries: collecting and recycling end-of-life EV, consumer, micromobility and stationary-storage batteries, refining the recovered lithium, nickel, cobalt and copper, and remanufacturing anode copper foil and cathode active material for North American cell producers. Through Redwood Energy it also deploys second-life battery energy storage systems for data centers and the grid. Redwood runs the Tahoe Campus in Northern Nevada, the Carolina Campus outside Charleston, South Carolina, and an R&D center in San Francisco, and works with Panasonic, Toyota, GM, BMW, VW/Audi, Rivian, Caterpillar, Isuzu and Lime. Redwood publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK or MCP server; its only machine-facing surface is a gated AWS Cognito partner portal used by automotive dismantlers to price and sell end-of-life battery packs.

providers.name: Reflex Careers
providers.description: Reflex (Reflex Careers) is an on-demand labor platform for retail stores, connecting brands and store operators with vetted, background-checked associates for short-notice shift coverage. The platform handles employer-of-record responsibilities including payroll, tax withholding, and compliance, lets retailers post shifts with as little as two hours' notice, and uses a two-way review system to build worker track records and brand-specific training per shift. Reflex serves retail brands including Ariat, Faherty, Fossil, and Everlane and is backed by Canaan Partners. Added to the API Evangelist network from the Canaan Partners portfolio; as of this enrichment pass Reflex publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: River Health
providers.description: River Health is an employer-sponsored virtual-first health plan operated by Mountain (joinmountain.com) that gives employees comprehensive primary and behavioral care at no cost to them. Members get unlimited virtual primary care and in-person doctor visits, behavioral health and therapy, thousands of free medications with home delivery or pharmacy pickup, free preventive care and screenings, after-hours urgent care, no-cost specialty and chronic- condition care, and free lab testing through Quest Diagnostics. Employers from small businesses to the Fortune 500 sponsor the plan; members enroll and manage care through the River Health member app at app.helloriver.com. River Health is a portfolio company of Techstars. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal has been published.

providers.name: Roby
providers.description: Roby (Imageous, Inc.) is a Seattle-based building-management software company whose HVAC automation product connects room and space calendars with a building's BMS (building management system) to automatically switch HVAC to an unoccupied/energy-saving mode when spaces are not in use, delivering measured energy savings and extended equipment lifetime for K-12, higher-education, and office facilities without added staff effort. Roby is deployed through building system integrators (ATS, Climatec, Syserco, ABM Systems, Oprizon, NSF-E) and also offers Receptionist and Helpdesk workplace applications. The product uses Auth0-managed authentication with token-based, SSL-only API access, but does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rovi Health
providers.description: Rovi Health is a clinical navigation platform for employer health plans that puts "a clinician in every member's pocket." Members get text-based access to registered nurse care advisors who help them find high-quality, in-network doctors and specialists, navigate their insurance benefits and coverage, and coordinate care across every stage of treatment. The company also uses AI agents to search millions of pricing and quality data points to surface the best in-network providers for complex care and to handle appointment scheduling, aiming to help employers cut 10-20% of healthcare spend while improving employee outcomes. Rovi Health was a Y Combinator (Fall 2025) company operating in the digital health, health insurance navigation, and consumer health services space. As of this enrichment pass Rovi Health publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Ruma Care
providers.description: Ruma Care is a healthcare software company that streamlines the prior authorization process for biologic and infusion medications in infusion clinics. Its AI-powered platform pulls patient and insurance data from electronic health records (EHRs) to identify payer requirements, auto-populates payer-specific prior authorization forms with clinical data, flags missing documentation, and then manages insurer communication and follow-up until an authorization is approved. Built by former infusion clinic staff, Ruma Care consolidates the manual portal, fax, and paper workflows behind buy-and-bill and infusion services into a single platform to reduce denials and accelerate patient access to biologics. Ruma Care is a Y Combinator-backed company. As of this profile the company exposes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Sanctuary AI
providers.description: Sanctuary AI is a Vancouver, British Columbia humanoid robotics company on a mission to create and deploy industrial-grade general-purpose humanoid robots to help address growing labor challenges. Its flagship product is Phoenix, a bipedal humanoid robot designed for dull, dirty, and dangerous work in automotive, manufacturing, and logistics environments. Phoenix is driven by Carbon, Sanctuary AI's proprietary AI control system that mimics human cognitive subsystems — memory, sight, sound, and touch — to translate natural-language tasks into dexterous physical actions. The company is vertically integrated, designing everything from motors and actuators through to generative AI algorithms in-house. Co-founded by James Wells (CEO) and Olivia Norton (CTO/CPO), Sanctuary AI has a private GitHub organization with no public repositories, no developer portal, no public API, no SDK, and no published OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specifications. The commercial model is hardware sales and enterprise deployments; Carbon is a proprietary on-board system and there is no public developer surface.

providers.name: Second Home
providers.description: Second Home is a flexible workspace and cultural venue provider committed to supporting entrepreneurship, innovation, and community, with locations in London (Spitalfields and Holland Park) and Lisbon (Mercado da Ribeira). It offers coworking (resident and roaming desks), private offices, day passes, meeting-room and venue hire, and a program of cultural events. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable developer surface — this is a consumer/business workspace brand rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Shef
providers.description: Shef is a consumer marketplace for homemade food, connecting home cooks and chefs with nearby customers who order freshly prepared, culturally diverse meals delivered to their door. Cooks build a menu, take orders, and ship weekly; eaters browse local shefs, order meals, and reheat at home. The company operates a business-to-consumer web and mobile ordering experience and does not publish a public developer API, documentation portal, SDKs, or webhook surface. This API Evangelist profile was created as a lead from venture-capital portfolio data and enriched via live web and DNS/TLS probing; the honest result of that pass is that Shef exposes no public API artifacts, only a consumer storefront and standard company pages.

providers.name: Shweproperty
providers.description: Shweproperty (ShweProperty.com) is Myanmar's leading online real estate marketplace, founded in 2015, connecting buyers, renters, sellers, and agents across the country. The consumer-facing portal lists residential and commercial properties for sale and rent — apartments, condos, houses, land, shops, offices, and industrial zones — in Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, and beyond, alongside new-development project listings, home-loan assistance with Myanmar banking partners, property events and expos, and real estate news and buyer guides. The platform carries over 200,000 listings with 500+ added daily and handles tens of thousands of monthly sales inquiries. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this remains a consumer web and mobile property portal.

providers.name: Simplifeye
providers.description: Simplifeye is a dental practice management platform that helps practices grow and streamline front-office operations through integrated payments, online scheduling, live webchat, and patient-engagement campaigns. Its HIPAA-compliant payments product supports in-office transactions, invoicing, and customizable payment plans; its 24/7 real-time online scheduler lets patients self-book appointments; and its live webchat is staffed by real people who answer patient questions and qualify leads outside business hours. Simplifeye was acquired by Vyne Dental and integrates with the Vyne Trellis billing platform for claims, eligibility, and revenue acceleration. Simplifeye operates a private, authenticated backend (api.simplifeye.co) that powers its dashboard and patient-facing widgets, but publishes no public developer program, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Simplii Financial
providers.description: Simplii Financial is the no-fee direct banking brand of the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC), one of Canada's Big Six Schedule I domestic banks. Launched November 1, 2017, Simplii succeeded CIBC's two-decade President's Choice Financial (PC Financial) co-venture with Loblaws, migrating roughly two million accounts to the new brand. Simplii is not a separately chartered bank; it operates as a division and trade name of CIBC under CIBC's Schedule I federal charter, offering no-fee daily chequing and savings, mortgages, personal loans, lines of credit, GICs, mutual funds, and USD accounts through online, mobile, and telephone channels only (no branches), with CDIC deposit insurance provided through CIBC. On open finance, Simplii exposes no first-party public developer API or developer portal; consumer financial-data access today is aggregator- and screen-scraping-based via Plaid, Finicity, and MX (CIBC signed a data-access agreement with MX), consistent with Canada's voluntary, pre-mandate posture while the federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (Budget 2024 / FES 2024, overseen by the FCAC) is legislated but not yet operational.

providers.name: SmartShoot
providers.description: SmartShoot is a San Francisco-based (founded 2012) photography and video production platform that connects enterprises and marketing teams with a managed network of more than 200,000 professional photographers and videographers to produce custom, on-brand photo and video content at scale. The web-based platform coordinates shoot booking, project collaboration, editing, and cloud-based delivery across many locations, serving e-commerce, real estate, and multi-location brands such as Google, YouTube, Uber, Expedia, and Yelp. SmartShoot is a B2B managed-service marketplace with no publicly documented developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal as of this enrichment pass; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital.

providers.name: SmartSuite
providers.description: SmartSuite is a collaborative work management platform that helps teams plan, track, and manage workflows, projects, and everyday tasks using customizable solutions, tables, records, and automations. The platform combines spreadsheet, database, project management, and workflow automation capabilities into a unified workspace. SmartSuite's REST API provides programmatic access to Solutions, Tables, Records, and Fields using token-based authentication.

providers.name: Smol
providers.description: Smol is a UK-based direct-to-consumer home-care brand founded in 2018 by Paula Quazi and Nick Green, delivering concentrated, plant-based, cruelty-free cleaning products — laundry capsules, dishwasher tablets, fabric conditioner, surface sprays and personal-care bars — on a flexible subscription that ships refills through the letterbox. The company positions itself as a sustainability challenger to legacy home-care brands, emphasizing reduced plastic, carbon and chemical load, and became a certified B Corporation in July 2022. Backed by Balderton Capital and GV, Smol operates a consumer e-commerce and subscription business; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs or developer program.

providers.name: Sovryn
providers.description: Sovryn is a Bitcoin-native, non-custodial decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol built on Rootstock (RSK). It offers spot and margin trading, perpetual swaps, 0% interest Bitcoin-backed loans (Zero), the Sovryn Dollar (DLLR) Bitcoin-backed stablecoin, yield and liquidity pools, and SOV governance staking, operating as a DAO. Sovryn also incubated BitcoinOS, a zk-powered rollup and multi-VM execution stack for Bitcoin. Developers integrate through open-source smart contracts, a GraphQL subgraph, an indexer HTTP data API, and first-party JavaScript SDKs published under the @sovryn and @sovryn-zero npm scopes.

providers.name: Sprinter Health
providers.description: Sprinter Health is an in-home preventive and diagnostic healthcare company that pairs trained community health workers ("Sprinters") who visit patients at home with a virtual team of physicians, nurses, and care navigators. Its hybrid Sprinter Care+ model delivers vitals, blood draws, ECGs, cancer and diabetic screenings, wellness visits, medication reconciliation, care-gap closure, health risk assessments, and social-needs screening, and partners with health plans such as Humana, Molina Healthcare, and Anthem. Backed by a16z, Accel, General Catalyst, and GV. No public developer or API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's identity, security posture, and legal/trust properties.

providers.name: Svbtle
providers.description: Svbtle is a minimalist publishing and blogging platform designed to work the way your brain does, pairing a distraction-free Markdown editor with a simple dashboard for organizing drafts, developing ideas, and publishing to a clean reading experience. Created by Dustin Curtis and operated by Neutral Corporation, Svbtle emphasizes longevity through its "Forever Promise" that published writing remains permanently accessible online. Svbtle is a subscription-based writer's network rather than a developer platform: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, OAuth authorization server, or .well-known metadata, and each blog is exposed only as a human-readable site with an RSS feed.

providers.name: Tallyman
providers.description: Tallyman is Experian's collections and recoveries management software platform, acquired from Talgentra. It provides an end-to-end collections management system for financial services, utilities, telecommunications, and public sector organizations. The platform manages customer segmentation, contact strategies, decision automation, and analytics for debt collection operations. Tallyman integrates with Experian Decision Analytics, CRM systems, billing platforms, and external data sources via web services. It is available as a hosted service managed through Experian's data centres.

providers.name: Tass Vision
providers.description: Tass Vision is a venture-backed technology startup that operates a product website at tassvision.ai. It markets two named products, SITRAC and VITRAC, each with its own product page and pricing page, alongside About, How It Works, Blog, Calendar, and Contact sections. The public site is a Vue single-page web application with Zendesk-based customer support. The company is backed by 500 Global and Big Sky Capital among a cluster of Central Asian venture funds and accelerators (IT Park Uzbekistan, Astana Hub, National UzVC, and others). As of this profiling the company exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications; this profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Tellus
providers.description: Tellus is a consumer fintech company whose mobile app pairs high-yield savings tools with real-estate-backed lending and property management. Members earn competitive rates on cash held in Tellus accounts, funded by the company's portfolio of residential real-estate loans, with deposits held at FDIC-insured partner banks. The app also offers a mobile wallet, a business wallet, and property-management tooling for landlords and property owners. Tellus is a private, venture-backed startup (an a16z portfolio company); it operates as a direct-to-consumer mobile product and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Tiger New Energy
providers.description: Tiger New Energy is a Bangladesh-based clean-energy company building a battery-swapping network for electric vehicles, primarily electric rickshaws and motorcycles. Drivers swap depleted lithium batteries for fully charged ones at Tiger swapping stations in seconds instead of waiting to recharge, and a "battery passport" tracks each pack's health and lifecycle. The company operates consumer and partner mobile apps (Tiger Driver, Tiger Partner, Tiger Dealer) on iOS and Android. Tiger New Energy is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications; its mobile apps are backed by private, undocumented services.

providers.name: TOPdesk
providers.description: TOPdesk is a Netherlands-based service management vendor offering an ITSM and Enterprise Service Management platform used by IT, facilities, HR, and customer service teams for incident management, change management, asset management, self-service portals, and shared service workflows. The TOPdesk REST API uses application password authentication (basic auth) and exposes resources for incidents, changes, assets, persons, operators, and locations for building integrations against on-premises and SaaS TOPdesk environments.

providers.name: TT Labs
providers.description: TT Labs is the company behind VideoPixie, a freelance marketplace that connects clients with professional video creators — videographers, video editors, directors, animators, and motion designers — available for hire. Clients post a project brief in about five minutes and receive competitive bids from vetted creators, then choose a creator based on portfolio and price. VideoPixie serves crowdfunding and Kickstarter videos, product and explainer videos, game trailers, wedding videography, screencasts, and full production campaigns, with example budgets ranging from a few hundred to tens of thousands of dollars. Backed by 500 Global, VideoPixie is a customer-facing marketplace web application (AngularJS) and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or client SDKs.

providers.name: Turing Labs
providers.description: Turing Labs (turingsaas.com) is a product-led growth platform for consumer packaged goods companies. Its "Growth OS" helps CPG and consumer-product teams pressure-test which product bets will win before spending, perfect formulations, and fund launches from recovered margin, consolidating product development, formulation R&D, and go-to-market decisioning into a single engine rather than a stack of disconnected tools. The company is backed by Insight Partners and Menlo Ventures.
