No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; the product is delivered through a login-gated web application at app.turingsaas.com.

providers.name: UBS
providers.description: A Swiss multinational investment bank and financial services company and the world's largest wealth manager. UBS exposes a multi-ecosystem developer platform at developer.ubs.com covering retail banking, mortgages, QR billing, EU PSD2 open banking, Swiss TWINT payments, corporate bLink connectivity, and the enterprise UBS Partner / KeyPort offering.

providers.name: WE11DONE
providers.description: WE11DONE (pronounced "well done") is a Seoul-based fashion label founded in 2015 by Dami Kwon and Jessica Jung, the duo behind the Seoul concept boutique Rare Market. The brand fuses late-1990s and early-2000s streetwear and athleisure aesthetics into a globally distributed designer ready-to-wear line, sold through its own e-commerce storefront at we11-done.com and stockists worldwide. Surfaced as a consumer-sector portfolio company of hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-21 confirmed the company operates a direct-to-consumer retail website but publishes no developer API surface: no developer portal, API reference, well-known metadata, or llms.txt were found.

providers.name: Webster Bank
providers.description: Webster Bank, N.A. is a nationally chartered commercial bank (National Association) and the principal banking subsidiary of Webster Financial Corporation (NYSE: WBS), a Delaware-incorporated bank and financial holding company headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. A values-based super-regional institution with roughly $84 billion in assets, Webster serves businesses, individuals, and families across the Northeast from the New York City metro area through Connecticut, Rhode Island, and Massachusetts, and operates the HSA Bank division, a leading national provider of health savings accounts and consumer-directed benefit administration in all 50 states. Webster does not publish a first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specifications. Its open-finance posture is consumer- and commercial-permissioned data sharing delivered through aggregators rather than a direct API: in June 2026 Webster went live on Prolific Banking's FI-Streams Connector using Plaid's FDX-aligned Core Exchange specification to give commercial clients secure, tokenized connectivity to the Plaid network, and consumer account data is also reachable via Plaid and Finicity. There is no publicly documented first-party REST API, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, or self-serve developer program.

providers.name: Wiz
providers.description: Wiz is a cloud-native application protection platform (CNAPP) that provides agentless security across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and containers, covering CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, vulnerability management, DSPM, and threat detection in a unified security graph. The Wiz GraphQL API exposes inventory, issues, vulnerabilities, configurations, and reporting using OAuth 2.0 client credentials authentication.

providers.name: Z1
providers.description: Z1 is the API Evangelist network profile for the consumer social gaming app operated by Bunch Live, Inc., known publicly as Bunch and now rebranded as Mini Party (mini.party). The product lets friends hang out, play party games, and video chat together in real time on mobile, and connects with external services such as Discord. Bunch raised early venture funding (including a $3.8M round) and is tracked here as a 500 Global portfolio company. Bunch formerly operated a Bunch Developer Platform (the "Party Kit" voice/video SDK for iOS, Android, and Unity plus a Party Reservation API), but that developer program has been discontinued and the company currently publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal — this profile captures its identity, legal surface, and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Zageno
providers.description: ZAGENO is a multi-supplier e-commerce marketplace and procurement platform for pharma and life-science R&D labs. It lets scientists search, compare, and order more than 50 million SKUs from over 6,000 global suppliers through a single consolidated catalog and checkout, with real-time availability, spend visibility, and automated approval workflows. ZAGENO connects into enterprise procure-to-pay and ERP systems (Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, Procurify, NetSuite, QuickBooks and more) through a single PunchOut/cXML catalog integration rather than a public developer API. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, it is backed by General Catalyst, Grazia Equity, and Capnamic Ventures.

222 is a consumer social app that matches compatible strangers for curated, in-real-life group experiences — dinners, events, and pop-up hangouts — to help people meet new people, discover their city, and deepen relationships. There are no profiles, DMs, or swiping: members complete a personality/values survey that builds a curation profile, then receive invites to nearby experiences where the app seats them with the people they are most compatible with. Founded in Los Angeles and now operating in cities including Los Angeles and New York, 222 is backed by General Catalyst and Y Combinator. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; 222 is a consumer mobile application with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Abodu
providers.description: Abodu designs, manufactures, and installs prefabricated accessory dwelling units (ADUs) and backyard homes across California. It offers state-approved plans with fixed all-in pricing and installation as fast as one day, spanning seven models from the 385 sq ft Abodu Studio to the 1,195 sq ft Abodu Three+, plus an Abodu Office. The homes target homeowners seeking rental income, aging-in-place, home offices, and guest houses, as well as multifamily operators, and feature fire-resistant construction with an optional Net Zero solar package. Abodu is a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: AI Build
providers.description: AI Build (Aibuild) is a London and Silicon Valley based software company, founded in 2015, that is transforming additive manufacturing with agentic AI. Its flagship Aibuild OS is an autonomous engineering platform whose computer-use AI operates CAD, CAE, and CAM software the way a human engineer would, carrying work from design intent through to manufacturing-ready output. Aibuild CAM provides toolpathing for large-format and robotic 3D printing, CNC machining, mould design, and analysis, while Aibuild FETS delivers finite element thermomechanical simulation. The company is a portfolio company of Seedcamp and SuperSeed and appears in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it currently publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Air Company
providers.description: Air Company (AIRCO) is a carbon conversion technology company founded in 2017 by Gregory Constantine and Dr. Stafford Sheehan. Its patented Carbon Conversion Reactor mimics photosynthesis, combining captured CO2, water and green hydrogen with renewable energy to produce carbon-negative alcohols and fully formulated synthetic fuels. The company licenses its catalytic process technologies and designs deployable production systems, from the container-scale AIRCO MAD Fuel System to the AIRCO SAF Factory. Product lines are branded AIRMADE and span sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), ethanol, methanol, diesel and rocket fuel, with earlier consumer validation products including AIR Vodka and AIR Eau de Parfum. Partners and customers include the U.S. Department of Defense, U.S. Air Force, Department of Energy and NASA, alongside aviation partners such as Virgin, Air France-KLM, JetBlue and Air Canada; strategic investors include Alaska Airlines, Carbon Direct, In-Q-Tel and Toyota Ventures. Air Company publishes no public API, developer portal or machine-readable API contract as of the 2026-07-31 enrichment pass.

providers.name: Aktana (PharmaForceIQ)
providers.description: Aktana is an AI-driven commercial engagement platform for the pharmaceutical and life-sciences industry, now operating as PharmaForceIQ (aktana.com redirects in full to pharmaforceiq.com). The platform provides real-time orchestration that coordinates digital and field marketing across channels ("optichannel") to drive measurable script lift and HCP (healthcare provider) adoption, with NPI-level dashboards tying engagement to outcomes for HCP marketing, DTC marketing, medical affairs, omnichannel, sales, and commercial-leadership teams. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. It publishes no public developer/API surface; this profile captures corporate identity, compliance posture (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, CCPA, GDPR), and web properties.

providers.name: Alexi
providers.description: Alexi is a Toronto, Ontario, Canada based legal artificial intelligence company that operates a private AI platform purpose-built for law firms, unifying legal research, drafting, and analysis into a single, single-tenant environment. Founded in 2017 by Mark Doble and a team of lawyers and technologists, Alexi specializes in litigation workflows — generating research memos grounded in primary law, identifying controlling authority and jurisdiction-specific requirements, framing case strategy, and producing persuasive first drafts that reflect a firm's voice, citation style, and approved structures. The platform also supports transactional work, document review and comparison, knowledge management, and firm-specific playbook application. Alexi's architecture combines a retrieval-first approach grounded in cited authority with agentic reasoning, delivered through a private cloud deployment so that firms retain ownership and sovereignty over their data, models, and workflows. Coverage spans all 50 U.S. states, Washington D.C., federal law, and all Canadian provinces and territories (excluding Quebec). The platform integrates with 20+ tools including iManage, NetDocuments, SharePoint, Elite 3E, Aderant, Litify, Actionstep, Filevine, Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook, Zoom, DocuSign, Adobe Sign, Azure, AWS, Datasite, Intralinks, and Firmex. Alexi is SOC 2 certified, employs AES-256 encryption, and reports 99% uptime with customer firms including Dentons, Robins Appleby, Gluckstein Lawyers, MacLean Law, and Mongillo Law. The company's revenue model is SaaS subscription (Alexi Core and Alexi Advanced tiers); there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and integrations are delivered as turnkey enterprise connectors rather than a publicly documented integration platform.

providers.name: Amber Box
providers.description: AmberBox is an indoor gunshot detection company (San Francisco, CA) that builds sensor hardware and a response platform for schools, offices, and public buildings. Its patented tri-factor detection algorithm combines percussion, audio, and infrared signatures to identify a firearm discharge with a near-zero false-alarm rate, then automatically notifies on-site security and law enforcement to cut emergency response time by an average of five minutes. AmberBox integrates with existing physical-security estates (access control, IP video/VMS, PSIM, mass-notification, and fire-alarm-style life-safety systems) via closed-contact relay switches and TCP/IP relay input modules rather than a public developer API. Surfaced as an Uncork Capital portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company publishes no public REST/GraphQL API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Amedisys
providers.description: Amedisys is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Amedisys API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Applied Intuition
providers.description: Applied Intuition builds physical AI software and simulation infrastructure for autonomous systems across automotive, defense, trucking, mining, construction, and agriculture. Its end-to-end stack spans a Self-Driving System (SDS), a Vehicle OS, and tools for vehicle intelligence, letting teams develop, simulate, test, validate, and deploy autonomy at scale. Applied Intuition sells enterprise autonomy software to OEMs and defense programs; it does not publish a public developer REST/GraphQL API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile captures the company identity plus its public web, security, and open-source surfaces for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bevi
providers.description: Bevi is a smart beverage-dispenser company that manufactures connected, filtered-water machines for offices and commercial spaces. Its IoT-enabled Standup and Countertop dispensers deliver still and sparkling water plus dozens of fruit flavors and functional enhancements (vitamins, electrolytes, energy, focus), connect directly to a building's water supply, and track plastic bottles saved in real time. Bevi is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Techstars, and Trinity Ventures. No public developer API surface (OpenAPI, docs, or developer portal) was found during enrichment; this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Bevz
providers.description: Bevz is a delivery-management platform built for liquor stores and convenience retailers that consolidates multiple third-party delivery apps (DoorDash, Uber Eats, GrubHub) into a single dashboard. Its products cover menu management across platforms (Connect), AI-powered marketing and local promotion on Yelp, Google, and Facebook (Reach), cross-platform performance analytics (Reporting+), and a white-label direct-delivery storefront for restricted items (Shop.Bevz). Bevz bundles an iPad plus software, access to a 215,000+ product catalog, barcode scanning, onboarding, and training. Bevz is a Techstars-backed company; no public API, developer portal, or SDKs are currently published, so this profile is identity-only pending an API surface.

providers.name: BirdBuddy
providers.description: Bird Buddy (Buddy Bird Inc, backed by General Catalyst) makes the world's most recognized smart bird feeder and companion mobile app for discovering and learning about birds. An AI vision-and-sound model identifies bird species from the photos and audio captured by its camera feeders, notifies owners of feathered visitors, and organizes captures into a personal collection with postcards and monthly reports. Bird Buddy does not publish an official public API; the app is powered by a private, account- authenticated GraphQL backend hosted on AWS, which the community has reverse-engineered through the third-party pybirdbuddy Python library and a Home Assistant integration.

providers.name: BlackSwan Technologies
providers.description: BlackSwan Technologies is an enterprise AI software company founded in 2014 by Michael and Elinoar Ouliel, headquartered in London with engineering across Israel, Poland and India. Its flagship product, ELEMENT, is marketed as an Enterprise AI Operating System: a low/no-code platform-as-a-service combining a data fabric, knowledge graphs, machine learning and composite AI so banks and other regulated enterprises can assemble applications for KYC on demand, enhanced due diligence, financial crime, transaction intelligence, market intelligence and underwriting without first consolidating their data. Its software engineering unit, BST LABS, built and open-sourced CAIOS (Cloud AI Operating System) and a family of Python developer tools (DynaCLI, CLVM, PyJdict, PyComposite, AuthK). BlackSwan Technologies was acquired by HUB Cyber Security Ltd. (NASDAQ: HUBC) in a stock-for-stock transaction that closed on 27 January 2025, and its corporate domain blackswantechnologies.ai no longer resolves in DNS; the secured data fabric technology is now marketed under HUB Technologies. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API contract (OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI, MCP, A2A) was found for BlackSwan Technologies during enrichment.

providers.name: Boomerang
providers.description: Boomerang, from Baydin Inc, is a productivity software company founded in 2010 that builds email management and meeting scheduling tools. Its products include Boomerang for Gmail and Boomerang for Outlook browser extensions, Boomerang mobile apps for iOS and Android, and GQueues, a task manager for Google Workspace teams. Boomerang lets users schedule email to send later, snooze messages back to the inbox, track responses with read receipts and follow-up reminders, share availability and book meetings without back-and-forth, and use AI writing assistance. With over 2 million active customers, the platform has processed more than 500 million messages. Boomerang is a consumer and team-facing productivity suite delivered as browser extensions and apps rather than a developer API platform; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bridgestone
providers.description: Bridgestone Corporation is a Japanese global tire and rubber manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo. Bridgestone produces tires for passenger, commercial, off-road, and aircraft applications, plus diversified rubber and chemical products, and is one of the largest tire makers in the world.

providers.name: Brilliant
providers.description: Brilliant is a consumer-first interactive STEM learning platform that delivers bite-sized, problem-solving-driven courses in math, computer science, data science, and science to over 10 million learners on web, iOS, and Android. Brilliant for Educators offers free Premium access to K-12 teachers and students, with Google Classroom roster sync, COPPA/FERPA/GDPR compliance, and a teacher portal for class management. Brilliant does not publish a public developer API or partner SDK — the product is consumer- and classroom-facing, and integration with school ecosystems is limited to Google Classroom roster sync.

providers.name: Brilliant
providers.description: Brilliant is an online learning platform for interactive STEM education, covering mathematics, computer science, data, and science. Headquartered in San Francisco and used by over ten million learners worldwide, Brilliant pairs guided, problem-first lessons with adaptive practice that blends classic intelligent tutoring systems, machine-learning recommender systems, and natural-language conversations. The platform is delivered through brilliant.org and native iOS and Android apps, with a freemium model and a Brilliant Premium subscription that unlocks the full course catalog, including expanding AI-powered features such as personalized tutoring conversations and on-the-fly generation of interactive content. Brilliant operates as a direct-to-consumer subscription business with an educator program for classroom access; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner integration program, and the `github.com/brilliant` org on GitHub is an unrelated namespace of personal projects rather than an official Brilliant presence.

providers.name: Cajal Technologies
providers.description: Cajal Technologies (Cajal) is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (W26) company scaling formal verification to accelerate scientific discovery. Its multi-agent system, Tau, collaborates to discover and verify new mathematical proofs in Lean, deploying AI mathematicians across high-impact applied domains starting with quantum computing and finance. Tau verifies compiled binaries with mathematical certainty down to the machine level. Cajal also partners with frontier AI labs and research institutes to improve their systems through datasets, evals, and RL environments, and open-sources tooling such as Talos, a Wasm interpreter written in Lean designed for reasoning.

providers.name: Care GP
providers.description: Care GP is a Sydney-based healthcare technology company (Y Combinator Summer 2026) building a suite of AI agents that automate the administrative and operational work of Australian general practice clinics. Its products include Samantha (medical document allocation that files inbound emails, faxes, and scans), Veronica (24/7 inbound and outbound phone and booking management), and a Billing beta for billing and debt-collection automation. Care GP states it is ISO 27001 certified with onshore Australian data storage, multi-factor authentication, and encryption, and reports serving 400+ clinic operators. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a customer web application (agent.caregp.com.au) but no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: CentralComs
providers.description: CentralComs is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) proptech company building AI agents that automate maintenance coordination and leasing for residential and small-commercial property managers. Its agents field tenant, prospect, and owner messages 24/7, triage and dispatch maintenance work orders to ranked vendors, follow up until tickets close with verification photos, and answer lease/listing/HOA questions with the exact clause cited. A leasing agent captures multi-channel leads, scores qualification, matches units, analyzes documents, and runs background screening. CentralComs bills flat monthly per door with no per-message fees and keeps records aligned with AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, Rent Manager, and DoorLoop via CSV today, with native two-way PMS integrations on the roadmap. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company; the company does not yet publish a public API — it is an AI agent product with PMS integrations planned rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Citruslabs
providers.description: Citruslabs is a clinical research organization (CRO) that designs and runs clinical trials, consumer perception studies, and randomized controlled trials for consumer health brands across supplements, skincare, pet health, food and beverage, longevity, and women's health. It handles IRB approval, protocol design, participant recruitment, decentralized data collection, and statistical analysis, then turns results into regulator-reviewed, marketing-ready product claims for retailers, advertising, and packaging. Studies range from DIY consumer perception studies to full randomized controlled trials, typically completing in four to sixteen weeks.

providers.name: Crosschq
providers.description: Crosschq is a hiring intelligence platform that helps talent acquisition and people-analytics teams improve quality of hire. Its cloud product suite spans AI-powered interview agents, automated reference checks, candidate assessment and screening, identity and interview-fraud detection, and quality-of-hire analytics that tie hiring decisions back to on-the-job outcomes. Crosschq connects to major applicant tracking and HCM systems (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, iCIMS, Oracle, Lever, Ashby, Bullhorn, and others) through pre-built integrations rather than a public self-service API. Founded in Danville, California, the company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and GGV Capital.

providers.name: Cytovale
providers.description: Cytovale is a San Francisco-based medical diagnostics company that develops early-detection technology for sepsis. Its flagship product, IntelliSep, is the first and only FDA-cleared in vitro diagnostic test for sepsis: it uses microfluidics, high-speed video, and computer-vision algorithms to measure the biophysical rigidity of tens of thousands of white blood cells, detecting the immune activation that signals sepsis risk and returning a risk stratification in roughly eight minutes. The test runs on the Cytovale System medical device in emergency-department settings. Cytovale is venture-backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Sands Capital, and the Global Health Investment Corporation. The company operates as a clinical/diagnostics device maker and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Dealpad
providers.description: Dealpad is an AI-powered buyer-enablement and digital-sales-room platform for B2B sales teams. It centralizes the buyer and seller relationship into shared digital sales rooms, mutual action plans, and curated content, then layers "Sales Mind AI" predictive insight over each opportunity to help sellers progress complex, multi-stakeholder deals faster. Dealpad integrates with major CRMs including Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zoho, and targets sales leaders, account executives, and enterprise revenue teams. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Dealpad does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal.

providers.name: DeHaat
providers.description: DeHaat (Green Agrevolution Private Limited) is one of India's largest full-stack agritech platforms, connecting smallholder farmers from "seed to market" through a phygital network of 11,000+ DeHaat Centres and 503 Farmer Producer Organisations across 12+ agrarian states. Founded in 2012 by IIT/IIM alumni, the platform serves 1.8 million+ farmers with agri-inputs (seeds, fertilizers, crop protection), AI-enabled crop advisory in multiple regional languages for 30+ crops, soil analysis, crop-health monitoring, market linkage for harvested produce, and agri-financing. Backed by Prosus Ventures and others, DeHaat operates a franchisee micro-entrepreneur model that raises farmer net incomes 30-50% while making procurement more predictable for buyers. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of prosus-ventures; the company publishes no public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time, so enrichment is limited to identity, corporate link-properties, and security posture.

providers.name: Donnerstag Ai
providers.description: Donnerstag.ai (Donnerstag.ai Technologies GmbH) is a Frankfurt-based enterprise fintech building an AI Reconciliation Layer for enterprise finance. Its platform automates financial reconciliation at the line-item level across accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank, and intercompany flows, adapting to each customer's systems, data sources, workflows, and roles. The stated goal is 100% line-item coverage at T+0 so the financial close becomes a confirmation rather than a month-end scramble, with an immutable audit trail for GoBD, IFRS, SOX, and BEPS. The company serves logistics, payment service providers, retail and e-commerce, manufacturing, human resources, and construction, is EU-hosted in Frankfurt, and is founded by Barbaros Ozbugutu and Volkan Ozkan and backed by Speedinvest. As a solution-and-services provider it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or docs.

providers.name: Dream Games
providers.description: Dream Games is a mobile gaming company founded in 2019 with offices in Istanbul, Turkey and London, UK. It develops and publishes high-quality casual mobile games, most notably the match-three puzzle hit Royal Match and its follow-up Royal Kingdom. Royal Match became one of the top-grossing mobile games worldwide, and the company has raised multiple funding rounds reaching a multibillion-dollar valuation. Dream Games does not publish a public developer API or developer program; it is present in the API Evangelist network as a company profile enriched with its public identity, security, and domain artifacts.

providers.name: dreamgames
providers.description: Dream Games is a mobile gaming developer with offices in Istanbul and London that builds high-quality, long-lifecycle casual puzzle games, best known for Royal Match and Royal Kingdom. The company combines technology and creativity to produce polished match-3 titles played by tens of millions of players worldwide, and it was surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital. Dream Games operates as a consumer game publisher rather than an API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or programmatic API surface. This profile therefore captures the company's real public web, legal, and security surface (website, terms, privacy, careers, help center, and a published security.txt) rather than developer artifacts.

providers.name: Dtex Systems
providers.description: DTEX Systems (dtex.ai) is a risk-adaptive cybersecurity company delivering an enterprise Insider Risk Management platform that unifies human, data, and AI risk through behavioral intelligence. Its InTERCEPT platform combines lightweight endpoint telemetry, user activity monitoring, and data loss prevention with privacy-by-design pseudonymization to detect insider threats and prevent data breaches early. DTEX Platform v7 adds OCSF-aligned, cloud-to-cloud connectors and autonomous "agentic defender" AI agents (Triage Guardian, Threat Hunter) that investigate incidents, while the company's i3 investigative division provides expert insider-threat research. DTEX integrates with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, IdP, and productivity tools (Splunk, CrowdStrike, Microsoft 365, Netskope, Google Workspace) rather than exposing a public developer API. Backed by Wing Venture Capital.

providers.name: Embark
providers.description: Embark Veterinary is a dog genetics company that sells at-home canine DNA testing kits for breed identification, health condition and genetic-risk screening, trait analysis, and relative matching, alongside supplements and breeder/veterinary testing programs. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, the company operates a direct-to-consumer storefront, a help center, and a resources/blog library, but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced from VC-portfolio data; no machine-readable API surface (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, MCP) was found during enrichment.

providers.name: F.N.B. Corporation
providers.description: F.N.B. Corporation (NYSE: FNB) is a diversified financial services holding company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and the parent of First National Bank of Pennsylvania, an FDIC-insured, state-chartered commercial bank. With roughly $50 billion in total assets at year-end 2025, FNB is a regional super-community bank operating around 350 branches across seven states and Washington, D.C. (Pennsylvania, Ohio, Maryland, West Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina and Virginia), offering commercial banking, consumer banking and wealth management through its eStore digital platform. On open finance, FNB exposes NO first-party public developer portal or documented API: the developer/api subdomains of fnb-online.com redirect to the marketing homepage and no developer documentation is published. Consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is reachable only through third-party aggregators (notably Plaid), not a first-party FNB API. No direct Financial Data Exchange (FDX) membership or public CFPB Section 1033 posture is documented by the institution as of this profile.

providers.name: Fi Money
providers.description: Fi Money is a Bengaluru, India based money-management application and consumer fintech operated by Epifi Technologies, founded in 2019 by ex-Google Pay (Tez) executives Sujith Narayanan and Sumit Gwalani together with Neeraj Bhope and Prasanna Ranganathan. Fi is not a chartered bank; it delivers a millennial-focused mobile experience layered on top of partner RBI-licensed Federal Bank, providing zero-balance digital savings accounts, a Visa debit card, deposits, mutual funds, Indian and US stocks, EPF tracking, credit cards, personal loans, jump-style automated savings rules ("FIT Rules"), and an AI-powered money assistant. Fi has raised roughly US$169M across multiple rounds from investors including Sequoia Capital India (Peak XV), Ribbit Capital, Temasek, Alpha Wave, and B Capital, and serves Indian retail consumers via iOS and Android apps. There is no classic public REST developer API or partner banking-as-a-service surface; Fi's only developer-facing interface is the Fi MCP (Model Context Protocol) server — a JSON-RPC streaming endpoint at https://mcp.fi.money:8080/mcp/stream that lets users connect their own Fi account to LLM clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini, ChatGPT) and call read-only tools such as fetch_net_worth, fetch_credit_report, fetch_epf_details, fetch_bank_transactions, fetch_mf_transactions, and fetch_stock_transactions to expose their net worth, holdings, EPF balance, credit report, and transactions to AI assistants. A hackathon-friendly mock server (epiFi/fi-mcp-dev, Go) and developer documentation (epiFi/mcp-docs) are published publicly on GitHub.

providers.name: Geode
providers.description: Geode Finance is a decentralized, trustless staking infrastructure protocol on Ethereum (with an earlier Avalanche v1 deployment) that lets anyone create and operate permissionless, configurable liquid-staking pools without intermediaries. Through its Portal router, isolated storage, dual governance, staking derivatives (gETH / gAVAX), an operator marketplace, withdrawal contracts, bound liquidity pools, and the Telescope oracle system, entities can launch their own liquid staking derivatives, isolate risk profiles, run KYC/AML-segregated pools, and earn sustainable maintenance-fee revenue. Developers integrate via the geodefi Python SDK and geo-vue UI components.

providers.name: Goodfellow
providers.description: Goodfellow (Goodfellow Advanced Materials) is a global specialty-materials supplier founded in 1946 and headquartered in Cambridgeshire, United Kingdom, serving research, prototyping and specialized manufacturing markets in more than 111 countries. Its catalog spans over 70,000 stocked products drawn from 700+ different materials in many forms, including metals, alloys, ceramics, polymers, composites, compounds and glass, alongside custom fabrication and laboratory testing services. Customers include universities, government research facilities, laboratories and advanced manufacturers, served through subsidiaries in the United States, China, France and Germany. Goodfellow was acquired by Battery Ventures in 2021 to help digitize its operations and fund materials acquisitions. Goodfellow is a business-to-business e-commerce and catalog operation; it does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs or webhooks.

providers.name: Groover
providers.description: Groover is a music promotion platform that connects independent artists and their representatives with a network of more than 3,000 vetted music-industry professionals — playlist curators, bloggers, journalists, radio stations, record labels, and managers. Artists submit a track and spend credits ("Grooviz", roughly €2 each) to reach individual curators, and Groover guarantees personalized feedback within seven days or refunds the credit. Founded in Paris in 2018, the company also operates Temple by Groover, a fanbase-growth toolset. Groover runs a consumer web application on a credit-based, pay-per-submission model and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Harbor Global
providers.description: Harbor Global is a global professional-services firm delivering technology, operations, strategy, and intelligence consulting to law firms, corporate legal departments, and government legal teams. Its practice areas span legal-technology and operations (application management, process automation, AI enablement), strategic advisory, intelligence and research/library services, and vendor governance, delivered by a global team of specialists. Harbor has grown through acquisitions such as iTrain (UK legal-technology training and AI enablement) and CE Global Partners (HCM/HR and payroll transformation). It is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. Harbor Global is a services company and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company identity and discovery.

providers.name: Hidden Door
providers.description: Hidden Door is an interactive storytelling platform where roleplay meets fan fiction, letting players step into imaginative worlds and shape branching narratives through their choices. Players pick a pre-built world, add modifiers, create a character, and experience a unique story with a full cast of characters, where every playthrough differs. Creators can build playable worlds in as little as thirty minutes, then share, publish, and get paid when others play. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Homebrew and Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. Hidden Door ships a consumer web experience and publishes no developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. Sector: AI / entertainment.

providers.name: Hyperpad
providers.description: Hyperpad (hyperPad) is a no-code, visual game development platform for iPad, often described as "HyperCard for iPad." Founded in 2013 and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2014), the London, Ontario company lets non-programmers build media-rich 2D games and interactive apps using a drag-and-drop, node-based behavior system with a built-in physics engine, particle effects, animation and audio tools, and a bundled asset library, then publish them to the Apple App Store as native apps while keeping 100% of royalties. Products include the paid hyperPad app, a free hyperPad Starter edition, and hyperPad Hub, a community arcade for playing games made with the platform. hyperPad is a consumer-facing creation tool and does not currently publish a public web API or developer platform.

providers.name: Influenxio
providers.description: Influenxio is an Instagram influencer-marketing platform that connects brands with a database of more than 500,000 influencer profiles through an AI-powered matching system. Brands use its campaign-management tooling to search, invite, and collaborate with influencers at scale for brand awareness, website traffic, and affiliate marketing, including a pay-per-click affiliate model and content-authorization workflows for reusing user-generated content. It is a B2B SaaS product aimed at marketers and brands rather than developers, and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Invygo
providers.description: Invygo is a car subscription and flexible rental platform founded in 2018 in Dubai, offering an alternative to traditional car ownership across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar. Through its iOS and Android apps, customers subscribe to a car on a weekly or monthly basis, or enroll in a 36-month, Sharia-compliant "Subscribe to Own" plan, with insurance, maintenance, registration, and roadside assistance bundled into an all-inclusive fee and no deposit, salary certificate, or bank loan required. Invygo reports 20,000+ active subscriptions across 15+ cities in the GCC. There is no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its public web, legal, and security surface.

providers.name: IXL Learning
providers.description: IXL Learning is a K-12 personalized practice platform with 17,000+ skills across Math, Language Arts, Science, Social Studies, and Spanish, plus the IXL Real-Time Diagnostic and skill recommendations. IXL is sold primarily as a SaaS subscription to families, teachers, schools, and districts. Its integration surface is school-rostering and SSO, not a public developer API: IXL supports Clever (SSO + rostering), ClassLink (SSO + OneRoster auto-rostering), OneRoster CSV/REST, LTI, Google Classroom, and SAML SSO for district deployments. There is no public REST API portal, no published OpenAPI, and no partner developer program.

providers.name: Joy
providers.description: Joy (withjoy.com) is a consumer wedding and event planning platform that gives couples a free personalized wedding website, an all-in-one universal registry, guest list management, digital and printed save-the-dates and invitations, smart RSVP tools, hotel room blocks, and a companion mobile app. The company has since expanded into baby planning with Joy Baby. Joy is a business-to-consumer product and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI specification; this profile therefore carries identity and link-property metadata and live security probes rather than machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Klaim
providers.description: Klaim (Klaim Kapital Technologies Limited / Klaim Holdings Limited) is an Abu Dhabi-founded, UAE-based healthcare fintech that advances working capital against receivables. Healthcare providers, real estate brokers and SMEs submit unpaid insurance claims or invoices, Klaim's AI evaluates and prices the risk in real time, and Klaim advances up to 90% of face value within 24 hours, collecting only when the payer or client settles. Products span Klaim Health (insurance claim advances plus AI denial prediction), Klaim Flow (SME receivables purchasing with an escrow model), Klaim Estate (real estate commission advances) and Klaim Eligible (insurance eligibility verification). Founded in December 2019 by Karim Dakki and Ahmad Ghafour, backed by Techstars, and operating across the GCC, North Africa and Turkey. Klaim publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable API description at this time.

providers.name: Lila Sciences
providers.description: Lila Sciences is an AI company founded in 2023 that is building what it calls Scientific Superintelligence: an autonomous system that runs the scientific method end to end by generating hypotheses, designing experiments, executing them in physical AI Science Factories (autonomous robotic laboratory networks), and learning from the resulting experimental data. Rather than training on internet text, Lila trains a scientific reasoning model on experimental data, coupling it to scalable verifiers and instruments such as molecular dynamics simulators, protein structure predictors, quantum chemistry solvers, and gene editors, then optimizing the policy with reinforcement learning. The company packages this as two commercial offerings: Catalyst, positioned as an operating system for science that accelerates an organization's existing research, and Creation, a partnership model for generating new discoveries, launching products, and founding new companies. Lila works across therapeutics (mRNA, proteins, antibodies, cell therapies, small molecules), advanced materials, chemicals, energy and environment, oil and gas, aerospace and defense, and biotech. It has raised roughly $550M ($200M seed announced March 2025 and a $350M Series A closed in October 2025) from investors including General Catalyst and NVIDIA, at a reported valuation above $1.3B, and collaborates with NVIDIA on the BioNeMo Agent Toolkit. Lila operates from Cambridge MA, San Francisco CA, and London UK. As of this profile Lila publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts; this entry is a company identity record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Lovable
providers.description: Lovable is a Stockholm-based AI app builder ("vibe coding") platform that turns natural-language prompts into full-stack web applications. Founded in late 2023 by Anton Osika (CEO) and Fabian Hedin (CTO), Lovable grew out of the founders' open-source GPT Engineer project (originally a CLI codegen tool that crossed 50,000+ GitHub stars) and was relaunched as a commercial product targeting non-technical builders, product managers, designers, and founders. Users chat with Lovable's agent to scaffold React/Tailwind front-ends backed by a managed Postgres ("Lovable Cloud") and authentication layer; projects can sync to GitHub or GitLab, deploy to lovable.app subdomains or custom domains, and integrate with Supabase, Stripe/Paddle, Resend, Mailgun, AWS S3, BigQuery, and Snowflake. The platform's developer surface is intentionally small — there is no traditional REST/SDK developer API. Programmatic entry points are limited to the "Build with URL" pattern (passing a prompt via querystring/hash to https://lovable.dev/?autosubmit=true) and a hosted Model Context Protocol server at https://mcp.lovable.dev that lets AI clients (Claude, Cursor, Claude Code) create projects, message the building agent, inspect diffs, provision Postgres databases, and read analytics on behalf of an authenticated Lovable account. Lovable raised a $200M Series A (Accel) in July 2025 and a $330M Series B (CapitalG, Menlo Anthology) in December 2025 at a $6.6B valuation, with reported ARR growing from $100M (July 2025) to $400M+ (February 2026) and roughly 8 million users.

providers.name: Matsmart
providers.description: Matsmart (operating internationally as Motatos) is a Swedish e-commerce company that fights food waste by selling surplus, short-dated, and overstocked groceries and household goods at a discount, with average savings of up to 50%. Its catalog spans pantry staples, beverages, snacks, candy, baby food, health and beauty, cleaning supplies, pet food, and non-food surplus, sourced from manufacturers and retailers and shipped across Sweden and other European markets via partners including Bring, Airmee, and PostNord. The company runs a consumer web storefront and iOS/Android apps. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API or documentation, so this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: MemVerge
providers.description: MemVerge is a memory and AI-infrastructure software company whose Memory Machine and Memory Machine Cloud (MMCloud) platforms virtualize and orchestrate memory and compute for AI, high-performance computing, and life-sciences workloads. MMCloud is operated through the OpCenter control plane and the first-party "float" command-line interface, which submits, migrates, checkpoints, and monitors containerized jobs across cloud and on-prem infrastructure, with spot-instance resiliency (SpotSurfer / WaveRider). MemVerge integrates with Nextflow, Snakemake, and Flyte through open-source plugins and SDKs published on its GitHub organization. Originally surfaced as a Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio company, this profile is enriched from MemVerge's public documentation, CLI reference, and GitHub org.

providers.name: Minu Holdings Limited
providers.description: Minu Holdings Limited operates minu.mx, Mexico's leading employee benefits and financial wellness platform. Minu provides employers with more than fifty benefits designed to attract, retain, and engage talent, including on-demand salary access (earned wage access), savings accounts, food and gas vouchers, payroll-linked loans, telemedicine, insurance, discounts, and financial education programs. Backed by 500 Global, Minu delivers these services to employees through its mobile app and integrates with employer payroll and HR systems. No public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI specification was found during enrichment; the company operates a private/internal API surface (api.minu.mx responds but is not publicly documented).

providers.name: Modern Animal
providers.description: Modern Animal is a membership-based veterinary healthcare company operating physical primary and urgent care clinics across major U.S. metropolitan regions, combining in-clinic visits with 24/7 virtual veterinary consultations, pharmacy and prescription management, dental care, surgery, and preventive care. It runs a subscription membership model (All Access, Essential, and Pay As You Go tiers) with transparent, upfront pricing and a companion mobile app for booking and virtual care. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and susa-ventures. Modern Animal is a consumer veterinary brand and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: MOO
providers.description: MOO is a London-founded online print and design company that produces premium custom business cards, postcards, flyers, stickers, notebooks, packaging, and branded promotional merchandise for individuals and businesses. Backed by Index Ventures, MOO combines a browser-based design experience with commercial printing, and sells tiered business plans (Business, Advanced, Enterprise) with team management and design services. MOO does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; its developer-style subdomains resolve to the main storefront rather than an API surface. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Muuktest
providers.description: MuukTest (MuukLabs) is an AI-powered test automation and managed QA services company founded in 2019 that helps software teams reach high end-to-end test coverage in weeks rather than months. It blends an AI-driven automation platform with expert QA engineers to deliver end-to-end, functional, regression, API, and performance testing across web, mobile, and API surfaces, using self-healing scripts (Playwright, Selenium, Appium), CI/CD integration, and detailed bug reporting with repro steps, logs, recordings, and Slack alerts. MuukTest is a managed testing service delivered through a Chrome recorder and a dedicated team rather than a self-service public developer API; it is backed by Techstars, the NSF SBIR program, MassChallenge, and Google for Startups.

providers.name: NeoTaste
providers.description: NeoTaste is a restaurant discovery and dining-deals mobile app operated by NeoTaste GmbH (Osnabrück, Germany). Under the tagline "Discover more. Pay less." it surfaces curated local restaurants and exclusive member deals such as 2-for-1 main courses and a free starter with a main, letting diners try new places while saving money and helping restaurants attract new guests. The consumer product ships as native iOS and Android apps and currently operates across Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. NeoTaste is a venture-backed (Series A) company surfaced through the Earlybird portfolio. It exposes no public developer API — its api.neotaste.com backend is a private, authentication-gated service for the first-party mobile apps — so this API Evangelist profile captures company identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture rather than an integration surface.

providers.name: Newgen Software
providers.description: Newgen Software is a global provider of NewgenONE, a unified low-code digital transformation platform that orchestrates content services (enterprise content management), business process management (BPM/workflow), and customer communication management (CCM) for banks, insurers, government agencies, and healthcare organizations. Founded in 1992 and headquartered in New Delhi, India, the company is publicly listed (NSE/BSE) and serves enterprises worldwide with document management, intelligent document processing, case management, and process automation. Platform capabilities are exposed to customers and system integrators via REST APIs, but Newgen does not operate a public, self-service developer portal or publish OpenAPI/SDK artifacts on its marketing site.

providers.name: Nomad Homes
providers.description: Nomad Homes is a Partech-backed proptech company originally launched as a real-estate marketplace. It has since rebranded and pivoted to RemyAI (getremy.ai) — "the 24/7 intelligent assistant for real estate agents." RemyAI listens to agents' calls and texts, transcribes and summarizes them, auto-creates follow-up tasks and reminders, organizes buyer/seller contacts, and manages voicemail across iOS, Android, and desktop. The company's original domain nomadhomes.co now 301-redirects to getremy.ai. RemyAI publishes a public /.well-known/ai-plugin.json and an llms.txt describing the product, but it exposes NO public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or developer portal (its ai-plugin manifest explicitly declares api.type=none and auth.type=none).

providers.name: Nutmeg (J.P. Morgan Personal Investing)
providers.description: Nutmeg is a UK digital wealth manager and robo-advisor founded in 2011 and acquired by JPMorgan Chase in 2021, now operating as J.P. Morgan Personal Investing. It offers consumer investment accounts including Stocks and Shares ISAs, Lifetime ISAs, Junior ISAs, personal pensions, and general investment accounts, with fully managed, Smart Alpha, socially responsible, thematic, fixed allocation, and income portfolio strategies plus free financial guidance and paid advice. Nutmeg is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA register #552016). It is a consumer-facing wealth platform and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: OnDeck Capital
providers.description: OnDeck Capital (ODK Capital, LLC) is one of the largest online small business lenders in the United States, providing term loans and business lines of credit to small and medium-sized businesses. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in New York, OnDeck uses data-driven underwriting and cash-flow analytics to deliver fast funding decisions, and has delivered more than $13 billion in financing to over 100,000 businesses across the U.S. OnDeck operates as a subsidiary of Enova International and also markets under the Headway Capital brand. It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IVP; OnDeck publishes a public marketing site and an llms.txt resource index but does not currently expose a public developer or partner API.

providers.name: Oshi Health
providers.description: Oshi Health is a virtual, whole-person gastrointestinal (GI) care clinic delivering insurance-covered telehealth to patients with digestive conditions such as IBS, GERD, Crohn's disease, and ulcerative colitis. Care is provided by a coordinated team of GI providers, registered dietitians, and gut-brain behavioral health specialists, and is offered to members through major health plans and employers. Oshi Health is a patient-facing healthcare services company rather than an API producer; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or /.well-known/ discovery surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and enriched with the artifacts the company genuinely publishes.

providers.name: Outsite
providers.description: Outsite is a coliving and community platform for remote workers, digital nomads, and distributed teams. It operates a global network of fully-furnished coliving spaces, curated stays, and cowork cafes across more than twenty destinations including Lisbon, Barcelona, Bali, Oaxaca, and Costa Rica, pairing dedicated coworking areas and fast WiFi with a built-in community of remote professionals. Outsite sells yearly and lifetime memberships, curated month-long Outsite Trips, and team retreat and business membership offerings for companies. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; Outsite is a consumer hospitality and travel brand and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface at this time.

providers.name: Playabl
providers.description: Playabl is a no-code, conversational game creation platform that lets anyone build games and interactive experiences by chatting with AI. Operated by Replkt, Inc. and backed by Y Combinator, Playabl turns natural-language prompts into playable games across genres including sports, idle, brainrot, dopamine, and think/puzzle categories, with no coding required. The product is a consumer-facing web application (playabl.ai); as of this profile Playabl does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or technical documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from the company's public web presence.

providers.name: Playsome
providers.description: Playsome (Playsome Ltd. / Playsome Oy) is a Helsinki, Finland mobile game studio that builds free-to-play games combining deep gameplay with polished visuals under the philosophy of making "big games with a small team". Its flagship title is Friends & Dragons, a cooperative multiplayer puzzle-RPG for iOS and Android featuring 150+ collectible heroes and 700+ puzzles and dungeons. The company is backed by gaming-focused venture firms Play Ventures and EQT. Playsome does not publish a traditional developer API, but its Wix-hosted website exposes a live Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access, letting agents retrieve business details, search the site, and start bookings/purchases without scraping.

providers.name: Plumery
providers.description: Plumery is an Amsterdam, Netherlands-based fintech that provides a headless, mobile-first digital banking engagement platform it markets as the "Digital Success Fabric" — a "Digital Engagement Platform for Banks." It lets banks, credit unions, and financial institutions build and launch branded mobile and web banking experiences on top of their existing core banking systems, delivered to engineering teams as an API-first, composable platform with SDKs and developer documentation (built on the Stainless docs/SDK toolchain). Plumery maintains a public GitHub organization of supporting engineering tooling and publishes a security & compliance program (SOC 2, ISO 27001). The company is backed by QED Investors and Seedcamp.

providers.name: Plural Ai
providers.description: Plural is an AI platform built for private markets professionals across private debt, private equity, and banking. Its AI agents ingest and analyze complex financial documents and data-room sources (documents, SharePoint, data rooms) to generate auditable, fully-referenced outputs — deal screeners, investment committee (IC) memos, term-sheet drafts, portfolio reports, and compliance documentation. Plural emphasizes EU data residency, end-to-end encryption, ISO 27001-aligned controls, and GDPR/DORA readiness, with no training on customer data. The company is backed by Speedinvest, Creative Destruction Lab, AI SEED, Innovate UK, and the European Commission. As of this enrichment pass no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface is published; the product references MCP and agent integrations for private-markets workflows.

providers.name: Presso
providers.description: Presso is a garment-care automation company (operated by parent LaundrySucks.io Inc.) that builds robotic, AI-driven systems for dry cleaning and laundry businesses. Its flagship AirTouch product is a compact, plug-and-play unit that runs on a standard 110V outlet and combines automatic fabric recognition, built-in non-toxic cleaning formulas, and smart temperature control to deliver same-day wash, fold, and dry cleaning under one roof. Presso positions itself around faster, greener, and gentler garment care without compressors, boilers, or skilled labor. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass Presso publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface — it is a hardware/robotics and equipment business, not an API provider.

providers.name: Qiz Security
providers.description: QIZ Security is a cybersecurity company delivering a cryptography management platform for quantum-safe security. The platform helps organizations discover, prioritize, remediate, and govern their cryptographic assets across on-premises and cloud environments, making hidden cryptography visible and preparing them for post-quantum cryptography (PQC) adoption. Founded by experts in cybersecurity, networking, and post-quantum cryptography, QIZ Security is API-first and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, with offices in Lewes, Delaware (US) and Ra'anana, Israel.

providers.name: Quinto Andar
providers.description: QuintoAndar is a Brazilian proptech real-estate marketplace that lets people rent and buy homes online without a guarantor, with digital visit scheduling, digital contract signing, rent and sale pricing intelligence (QPreço), owner financial management, and a real-estate consortium financing program. It operates a two-sided marketplace across major Brazilian cities including São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre, Campinas, and Curitiba, earning revenue on rental and sales commissions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of ribbit-capital and enriched into the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found; the company does publish a security.txt with a Bugcrowd bug bounty program.

providers.name: Ragas
providers.description: Ragas is an open-source evaluation toolkit for Large Language Model applications, with particular depth on Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic systems. Originally created under the Exploding Gradients organization on GitHub and now maintained by Vibrant Labs AI, Ragas is a Python library distributed on PyPI under the Apache 2.0 license. It moves teams from informal "vibe checks" to systematic evaluation loops by providing objective LLM-based and traditional metrics, automated test dataset generation, experiment tracking, and integrations with the broader LLM ecosystem including LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Anthropic, and popular observability platforms. Ragas exposes a metrics library covering faithfulness, response relevancy, context precision and recall, factual correctness, semantic similarity, agent tool-use accuracy, SQL equivalence, Nvidia-defined RAG metrics, and general-purpose rubric scoring. The project ships a CLI (`ragas`) with quickstart templates such as `rag_eval`, and is consumed primarily as a `pip install ragas` library rather than as a hosted API service. Ragas is widely cited as a default evaluation harness for RAG applications and has grown a substantial community on GitHub and Discord.

providers.name: Refundid
providers.description: Refundid is an instant-refund platform for e-commerce returns in Australia/NZ. Provides instant cash refund at the point of return initiation.

providers.name: Res
providers.description: Res (ResQ) is an AI-powered operations platform for the service economy, connecting restaurants, hospitality groups, and facilities-management teams with vetted trades vendors to manage repair-and-maintenance work orders end to end. The platform covers work-order intake and dispatch, vendor sourcing and communication, invoicing and payments, and reporting across trades such as HVAC, plumbing, refrigeration, and electrical. Backed by Homebrew and surfaced through the API Evangelist network, ResQ operates a web and mobile SaaS product; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definitions, SDKs, or webhook surface at this time, so this profile captures company identity, website properties, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Rever Moto
providers.description: REVER (Rever Moto) is a motorcycle-focused navigation, ride-tracking, and social platform for riders. It offers a web-based route planner and mobile apps (iOS, Android, and Apple CarPlay) that let motorcyclists discover more than 3,000 curated routes worldwide, plan and sync trips, record rides with offline GPS tracking, and get turn-by-turn voice navigation. Social features include live friend tracking, ride sharing, challenges, and stories. REVER offers a free tier and a paid "Pro" subscription, and partners with brands including Honda, Cycle Gear, and Quad Lock. The company is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass REVER publishes no public developer API, documentation, or integration surface — it is a consumer mobile/web product.

providers.name: Robby
providers.description: Robby is an AI-powered growth and job-documentation platform for home-services businesses, focused on HVAC contractors. It automates job documentation and paperwork for technicians so they can focus on servicing equipment and talking to customers, combines customer and third-party data to surface new leads daily, equips technicians with talking points to increase sales, and gives management a dashboard to monitor the revenue opportunities captured from every visit. Robby is an early-stage Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup that currently publishes a marketing site, blog, and legal pages but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Rohirrim
providers.description: Rohirrim is an AI-native Unified Acquisition Platform that automates and accelerates government procurement for both agencies and contractors. Its UnifiedAcquire product helps government agencies manage procurements from market research through award by automating acquisition documents and centralizing institutional knowledge, while UnifiedRespond (RohanRFP) helps companies identify, match, and draft RFP responses faster and at lower cost. The company targets federal agencies, government contractors, Fortune 500 firms, and healthcare organizations, and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Insight Partners. Rohirrim publishes no public developer API surface today; this profile captures its public web, content, and security-posture footprint.

providers.name: Root Global
providers.description: Root Global is a Berlin-based climate technology company building decarbonization infrastructure for the food and beverage supply chain. Founded in 2022 and backed by Point Nine, its carbon operating system lets food processors, manufacturers, and retailers collect farm-level emissions data at scale, calculate corporate and product carbon footprints, and launch tailored reduction plans with their farming partners. Results are GUTcert certified and SBTi compliant, with the platform supporting operations across 11+ European countries. Root Global exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Rosebud AI
providers.description: Rosebud AI is an AI-powered game creation platform that lets anyone build and deploy playable 3D games and interactive worlds from natural-language prompts, a workflow the company calls "Vibe Coding" — you describe scenes, rules, and behaviors and an AI assistant named "Rosie" writes and applies the underlying JavaScript. The platform runs on a custom engine designed for AI-era game development, featuring deterministic WASM-based physics, native real-time multiplayer, instant link-based sharing, and a built-in "Juice API" for camera effects, particle systems, and spatial audio. Founded in 2019 in San Francisco by CEO Lisha Li (Ph.D. in machine learning, UC Berkeley), Rosebud AI is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company ships a hosted consumer product and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK packages, MCP server, or developer portal.

providers.name: Rylo
providers.description: Rylo (Nagish Inc. d/b/a Rylo) is a New York-based accessibility technology company building free communication tools for people who are Deaf, hard of hearing, or have a speech disability. Its consumer mobile app provides FCC-certified real-time phone-call captioning, in-person Live Transcribe, and Sign features, with automatic language detection across 50+ languages. Rylo raised $85M and is backed by Accel and General Catalyst. The company operates a consumer application only and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Secret Escapes
providers.description: Secret Escapes is a members-only luxury travel and holiday flash-sales platform that negotiates exclusive, time-limited discounts on hand-picked hotels, city breaks, and package holidays for its members, surfacing over 200 curated sales each week across the UK and international markets. Founded in London and backed by GV and Index Ventures, it operates on an invitation/membership model rather than a public developer platform; no public API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Shoelace
providers.description: Shoelace is an omni-channel growth marketing agency for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands, trusted by 300+ brands. The team plans, creates, and optimizes paid advertising, email, and creative work across both acquisition and retention channels to drive real, measurable revenue growth. Shoelace operates as a managed growth partner delivering marketing services rather than a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a 500 Global portfolio lead and captures its public web presence and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Showrunner
providers.description: Showrunner is an AI streaming and animation platform built by Fable Simulation (founded by Edward Saatchi) and billed as the "Netflix of AI." It lets users create and watch AI-generated serialized animated television shows across genres, acting as directors to write, produce, voice, and remix full episodes within simulated worlds such as Sim Francisco, alongside flagship series like Exit Valley. The platform is powered by Fable's proprietary SHOW-2 model and is delivered as a consumer iOS app and Discord community. Showrunner publishes no first-party developer API; its public site is a Wix-hosted marketing property that exposes the standard Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic access to public site content.

providers.name: Sol
providers.description: Sol Reader is a wearable e-reader — marketed as the world's first wearable e-reader — built by Sol and backed by Initialized Capital. The device is a lightweight (104g) headset with dual 1.3" 271ppi side-lit E Ink displays, adjustable diopter optics and IPD, a handheld remote, and 25+ hours of battery for a distraction-free reading experience. It reads a connected Kindle library and DRM-free EPUB uploads, offers the Sol Store with over one million titles, plus AI question-answering and an AutoPilot speed-reading mode. Sol is a consumer hardware company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Somnee
providers.description: Somnee is a consumer sleep-technology company behind a smart sleep headband that uses personalized neurostimulation to improve sleep. Developed over roughly eight years by a team of UC Berkeley neuroscientists (co-founders include sleep scientist Dr. Matthew Walker, Dr. Robert T. Knight, Dr. Rich Ivry, and CSTO Dr. Ram Gurumoorthy, with CEO Tim Rosa, former Fitbit CMO), the wearable pairs clinical-grade EEG+ sensors with a companion app and proprietary AI to deliver a 15-minute pre-bedtime session that the company says helps users fall asleep about 50% faster and cut nighttime wake-ups by roughly a third, without medication. Somnee sells the headband, accessories, and a sleep-service membership direct to consumers, and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Somnee publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: soona
providers.description: soona is an all-in-one creative platform for ecommerce brands that produces and manages product photography, video, and user-generated content (UGC). Brands can book virtual and in-studio photo and video shoots with vetted models, stylists, and photographers; generate on-brand content at scale with soona AI Studio; organize assets in a digital asset manager (DAM); and analyze listing performance and competitors with Listing Insights across Shopify, Amazon, Etsy, Walmart, Meta, and TikTok. soona is headquartered in Denver, Colorado. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures, techstars, and union-square-ventures; enrichment found no public developer API or documentation surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Spotlock
providers.description: Spotlock is a commodity risk management platform that helps organizations monitor, manage, and mitigate exposure to raw-material price volatility. It lets businesses track material exposures across inventory, customer contracts, and supplier commitments, set company-wide risk policies, and execute optimized hedging strategies — enabling fixed-price long-term contracts, profit margin protection, hedge accounting treatment, framework/agreement pricing, and global price intelligence for sectors such as construction and infrastructure, metal service centers and distribution, manufacturing and fabrication, automotive, energy, and transportation.

providers.name: Spotwise, Inc.
providers.description: Spotwise is an agentic operating system for broadcast media that detects advertising across radio, TV, podcasts, and streaming audio in real time, converts that ad-play data into qualified sales leads with decision-maker enrichment, and automates the outreach and CRM workflows that sell against it. Built by broadcasters and backed by 500 Global, the platform packages products including Spotwise aOS, the Spotty conversational copilot, Spotwise Intelligence, Lead-list, Contact Finder, Monitors & Signals, and Skills for ad-sales and commercial-leadership teams across 13 countries. Spotwise is a closed SaaS product accessed through app.spotwise.ai; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or specification at this time.

providers.name: StatusPRO
providers.description: StatusPRO is a sports technology and gaming company founded by former professional athletes, building extended reality (XR) products that pair competitive training tools for elite athletes with immersive gaming experiences for consumers. Its flagship product, NFL PRO ERA, is an officially NFL- and NFLPA-licensed virtual reality football game for Meta Quest headsets, and its StatusPRO Visualizer powers immersive broadcast perspectives used by ESPN on NFL Live. The company operates a live-services consumer game rather than a developer platform: it publishes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record; it carries no API surface at this time.

providers.name: Stel
providers.description: Stel Life provides cellular-connected remote patient monitoring (RPM) infrastructure for healthcare. Its cellular-enabled vitals hubs and connected medical devices — blood pressure monitors, pulse oximeters, glucometers, thermometers, and scales — let patients transmit vital-sign readings to electronic health record (EHR) systems without WiFi, broadband, a smartphone, or app setup, targeting elderly, low-income, rural, and low-tech-literacy populations. Health systems and digital health organizations use Stel across the care continuum, from wellness and chronic-care management to hospital-at-home. Stel is backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Taxfix
providers.description: Taxfix is a Berlin-based fintech that lets individuals and self-employed people in Germany prepare and file their annual income tax return from a mobile app or web browser. Users either answer a guided set of roughly 70 questions to self-file (Taxfix Basic) or hand the return to an independent tax expert via the Expert Service, with data transmitted to the tax authority over the official ELSTER interface. The company reports more than 10 million tax returns filed and over 5 billion euros in refunds. Taxfix is a consumer (B2C) product and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture. Backed by Creandum, Index Ventures and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Teamworks
providers.description: Teamworks is a sports technology company that builds "The Operating System for Sports" — an integrated software platform used by elite collegiate, professional, and national-team organizations to digitize the athlete lifecycle and consolidate their technology stack. The platform spans four product areas: Personnel (roster management, recruiting, scouting, player evaluation), Performance (strength & conditioning, nutrition, and a sports EMR / athlete-management system), Coaching (sport-specific game preparation and strategy for football, baseball, and hockey), and Operations (Hub communication, compliance, academics, inventory, camps, and influencer management), plus Wallet for athlete payments and Teamworks Intelligence for predictive analytics. Teamworks is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes customer-facing SaaS products and a public status page but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, or client SDKs.

providers.name: Teladoc Health
providers.description: Teladoc Health is a global leader in whole-person virtual care, providing on-demand healthcare, expert medical opinions, mental health services, chronic condition management, and integrated virtual care solutions to consumers, employers, health plans, hospitals, and clinicians. The company connects patients with clinicians via mobile, web, phone, and video to deliver 24/7 access to care across a wide range of conditions. Teladoc Health offers integration capabilities for partners and health systems, but does not publish a publicly accessible developer API portal with open documentation.

providers.name: This Is L.
providers.description: This Is L. (L. Inc.) is a personal-care company making certified-organic cotton menstrual products — tampons, pads, and liners — sold through major U.S. retailers including Target, Walmart, Walgreens, CVS, and Kroger as well as direct-to-consumer at thisisl.com. Founded as a social enterprise and public-benefit corporation with a one-for-one give-back model, L. was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global and is now a Procter & Gamble brand (its legal, privacy, and vulnerability-disclosure surfaces resolve to pg.com). This is a consumer packaged-goods e-commerce business with no public developer API, SDK, or technology platform; enrichment captured its identity, web link-properties, and security posture.

providers.name: Unacademy
providers.description: Unacademy is a Bangalore-based online learning platform — one of India's largest — offering live classes, courses, study material, and test preparation for competitive exams including UPSC Civil Services, IIT JEE, NEET-UG, SSC, CA Foundation, and CSIR UGC NET, delivered through its web platform and dedicated learner, educator, and parent mobile apps. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Unacademy runs a consumer platform on an internal API (api.unacademy.com) but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Understory
providers.description: Understory is an insurtech company headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin (founded 2012) that combines its own network of ground-truth Dot weather sensors with a proprietary weather risk model to underwrite parametric insurance against severe weather, including hail coverage for automotive dealership open lots and agricultural weather risk. Its UnderstoryOS platform covers broker management, pricing and quoting, and automated weather-triggered claims. Understory publishes no public API or developer portal; the platform is offered to insurance partners rather than as a self-service developer product.

providers.name: Unitree Robotics
providers.description: Unitree Robotics is a Hangzhou, China-based high-performance robot manufacturer founded in 2016 by Wang Xingxing. The company is a global pioneer in the commercial quadruped (robot dog) market and has expanded into bipedal humanoid robots.
