Its product line includes the Go1, Go2, and Go2-W quadrupeds for consumers, education, and research; the industrial-grade B1 and B2 quadrupeds for inspection, patrol, and logistics; the H1 full-size humanoid; the G1 humanoid for research and developer experimentation; the R1 humanoid; and the Z1 robotic arm. Unitree also produces in-house components including the L1/L2 LiDAR, hand-grade actuators, and dexterous hands (Dex1-1). Unitree's developer surface is SDK-centric — there is no public REST or gRPC cloud API. Robot control happens on-device over DDS (Data Distribution Service) via the unitree_sdk2 (C++) and unitree_sdk2_python libraries, with high-level message bindings published as unitree_ros and unitree_ros2. The company maintains an active GitHub presence at github.com/unitreerobotics with 46+ public repositories covering SDKs, ROS packages, MuJoCo and Isaac Lab simulation environments, reinforcement learning frameworks (unitree_rl_gym, unitree_rl_lab), teleoperation tooling (xr_teleoperate, kinect_teleoperate, televuer), imitation learning (unitree_lerobot), a vision-language-action model (unifolm-vla), and a Unitree App Store template repo. Documentation lives at support.unitree.com/home/en/developer. Unitree's revenue model is direct robot hardware sales via shop.unitree.com and partner distribution; there is no metered API service tier.

providers.name: Viz.ai
providers.description: Viz.ai is a healthcare AI company that builds an intelligent care coordination platform. Its FDA-cleared, AI-powered software analyzes medical imaging (CT, CTA, MRI, echocardiography) to detect suspected disease — stroke (large vessel occlusion, ICH), aneurysm, pulmonary embolism, and cardiovascular conditions — and automatically alerts and connects the multidisciplinary care team in real time to accelerate diagnosis and treatment. Backed by CRV, GV, Insight Partners, Scale Venture Partners, Seedcamp, Susa Ventures, and Threshold Ventures. Viz.ai exposes no public developer API; integration is delivered through clinical/enterprise deployment, and its governance-relevant public surface is a Drata-hosted Trust Center documenting a broad security and compliance program (SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and an extensive ISO family including ISO 42001 for AI management).

providers.name: Volter
providers.description: Volter (Get Volter Ltd) is a London-based energy platform that connects UK businesses with renewable generators to procure cheaper, greener electricity, and helps commercial real estate owners and generators deploy, optimize, and monetize rooftop solar and other onsite renewable assets. The platform spans renewable energy matching, solar optimization, and a forthcoming energy management suite with analytics, anomaly detection, flexible asset control, and battery storage. Backed by Transition and Seedcamp with a $3.2M pre-seed round in 2024. Volter does not currently publish a public API or developer documentation.

providers.name: Wag!
providers.description: Wag! is a US pet-care marketplace that connects dog and pet owners with local, background-checked caregivers for on-demand and scheduled dog walking, drop-in visits, pet sitting, boarding, daycare, and 24/7 vet chat. Operating across 5,300+ cities in all 50 states, the platform has completed more than 16 million services and is delivered primarily through its iOS and Android consumer apps. Wag! (Wag Labs, Inc.) is backed by Battery Ventures, Bullpen Capital, and General Catalyst. As of July 2026 Wag! exposes no public developer API or documented partner API; its production API hosts (prod-*-api.wagwalking.com) are internal mobile-app backends. This profile captures the company's public security and identity surface pending any future developer program.

providers.name: Walker & Co.
providers.description: Walker & Company Brands is a health and beauty products company founded in 2013 by Tristan Walker, best known for Bevel, an end-to-end shaving and grooming system designed for people of color, and for the Form hair-care line. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and others, the company was acquired by Procter & Gamble in 2018 and now operates as a consumer brand whose direct-to-consumer storefront runs on Shopify at getbevel.com. It is a consumer packaged goods company with no first-party developer API program; it was added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio lead. This profile captures its real public web surface (storefront, security.txt, well-known documents, P&G legal and vulnerability-disclosure programs) rather than an API product.

providers.name: Wooga
providers.description: Wooga is a Berlin-based mobile game developer founded in 2009 and a subsidiary of Playtika, specializing in story-driven casual games such as June's Journey, Ghost Detective and Pearl's Peril. Wooga publishes no public API or developer portal, but maintains an active open-source GitHub organization with its atlas Gradle plugin suite for Unity and mobile build automation, published to the Gradle Plugin Portal and RubyGems. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and hv-capital.

providers.name: Zeen
providers.description: Zeen is an AI-powered autonomous personal finance platform — a money copilot that connects to your financial accounts and uses background AI agents to manage money on your behalf. Its features include an interactive AI financial copilot that answers questions in real time, Guard (loss prevention that avoids overdraft fees and cancels unused subscriptions), Grow (yield optimization that moves idle balances to higher-interest accounts), and Guide (spending insights). As of mid-2026 Zeen is in pre-launch with a public waitlist. Zeen is backed by Cowboy Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Zoog
providers.description: Zoog is a consumer mobile app platform that lets families create and share personalized video books and songs for children. Users read classic kids' stories or sing popular kids' songs while the app adds filters, effects, and music to produce custom animated videos that connect loved ones across distances. Founded in 2021 by Yoav Oren and Matan Guttman and backed by Techstars, Zoog is used by families worldwide. It is a consumer product with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Zoog.A.I. Ltd.
providers.description: Zoog.A.I. Ltd. (Zoog) is a consumer application that lets families create personalized video books and songs for children. Parents and kids can read classic children's books, sing popular nursery rhymes, and turn them into personalized videos featuring their own family, then share those magical creations. Zoog is delivered as an iOS app (with an Android waitlist) and a companion website, and is backed by 500 Global. It has no public developer API surface, SDKs, or API documentation at this time; this profile captures its identity and web presence within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: AI Palette
providers.description: AI Palette is an AI-first consumer-insights and product-innovation platform for the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry. Founded in Singapore in 2018 and later acquired by GlobalData, it aggregates more than 61 billion data points across 24 countries and 18 languages to help food, beverage, and personal-care brands discover emerging trends, generate and screen new product concepts, and bring winning products to market faster. Its platform spans the Foresight Engine for real-time trend discovery, Concept Genie for generative-AI concept creation, Screen Winner for concept validation, and the FoodGPT / Arya agentic co-pilot. Customers include Nestle, Mondelez, Kellogg, Diageo, Cargill, ADM, and Symrise. This is an enterprise SaaS platform accessed by license; no public developer API, SDK, or specification is published.

providers.name: Alvee Health
providers.description: Alvee Health is an AI-powered care navigation platform for social determinants of health (SDOH) and whole-person care coordination. It surfaces unmet social and clinical needs from documentation, auto-codes Z-codes, automates patient outreach and benefits enrollment through an autonomous care navigator, generates compliant billing documentation, and tracks outcomes so providers can capture reimbursement for CHI, PIN, CCM, PCM, and G0136 care-coordination codes. The platform is HIPAA compliant and SMART on FHIR certified, integrating with EHRs to embed social drivers of health into clinical workflows. Alvee is a Techstars Iowa (2022) portfolio company.

providers.name: AstraZeneca
providers.description: AstraZeneca is a British-Swedish multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company focused on oncology, cardiovascular, renal, metabolism, and respiratory therapies. AstraZeneca does not publish a general developer portal or commercial public APIs; technology integration is delivered through enterprise partner programs, clinical trial data portals such as clinicaltrials.gov and the Vivli platform, and EDI/x12 channels used by distributors and pharmacy benefit managers.

providers.name: At-Home-Doc
providers.description: At-Home-Doc (now branded MetaDoc) is a Qatar-based healthcare SuperApp operated by Medihealth Solutions (MOPH Licence No. 2066) offering round-the-clock virtual and in-person medical care. Patients book on-demand video consultations, in-network clinic appointments, or home doctor visits through the app, alongside pharmacy delivery, lab-at-home services, family insurance packages, and a Med Coins loyalty rewards program. The platform bundles Meta Doc (virtual clinics for practitioners), Meta Patient (a patient community), and Medi Shop into a single consumer healthcare experience delivered over iOS and Android. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: Blackbird Labs Inc
providers.description: Blackbird Labs is the company behind Blackbird, a payments-and-loyalty app for the restaurant industry. Diners earn status, perks, points, and the $FLY rewards token by checking in and paying at partner restaurants, while restaurants gain a direct guest relationship and improved economics. Settlement runs on Flynet, a layer-three protocol built on Coinbase's Base blockchain. Founded by Resy and Eater co-founder Ben Leventhal, Blackbird is live across cities including New York, San Francisco, Charleston, Denver, and New Orleans, and raised $50 million in 2025. Backed by investors including QED Investors and Andreessen Horowitz (a16z crypto). Blackbird is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI description, or developer portal; this profile captures its public company and security posture surface.

providers.name: Cabal
providers.description: Cabal is an AI-powered relationship-intelligence and warm-introduction platform that turns an organization's professional relationships into warm introductions. It infers connections across millions of professional records without CSV uploads or calendar syncs, letting teams "ask who's connected to anyone." Cabal serves VC platform / deal-sourcing teams, sales organizations, and investor-relations and partnerships teams, and ships Cabal Mail for bulk personalized outreach (company updates, LP communications, strategic asks). The relationship graph is queryable through in-app chat, Claude and ChatGPT via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a Slack bot, or an API. Backed by Craft Ventures. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Cabal's public surface; the company advertises API and MCP access but does not publish a public OpenAPI spec or open developer reference (both are account-gated).

providers.name: Compass
providers.description: Compass is a leading real estate technology company headquartered in New York City that provides a tech-enabled brokerage platform connecting agents, buyers, and sellers across the United States. The company combines residential real estate services with proprietary software for agents, including marketing, client management, and listing tools. Compass does not currently publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: crownbio
providers.description: Crown Bioscience (CrownBio) is a global contract research organization (CRO) specializing in translational oncology and immuno-oncology drug discovery. It provides preclinical and translational services to biotech and pharmaceutical companies, including in vitro drug screening (cell lines, organoids, panels), in vivo studies (PDX, CDX, syngeneic and humanized models), DMPK/toxicology, preclinical imaging, and biomarker analysis spanning genomics (NGS, single-cell sequencing), proteomics, spatial biology, and flow cytometry. CrownBio also operates public web-browsable cancer-model databases — a PDX Model Database (2,500+ models), an Organoid Models Database (600+ models), an IO Murine Models Database, and a Cell Line / CDX Database — searchable through a Multi-Model Search interface. There is no public developer API or programmatic data access; the databases are web interfaces. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Daybreak
providers.description: Daybreak Health is a B2B mental health company that delivers teletherapy and mental health programs for K-12 students (ages 5-19) in partnership with school districts and health plans. Its services include one-on-one teletherapy, in-person and hybrid onsite programs, universal mental health screeners, and mental health classes, with programs tailored for BIPOC, LGBTQIA+, and low-income student populations. Daybreak is a care-delivery organization sold to schools and payers rather than a developer platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer or API surface. This APIs.json profile captures the company's public web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Equinox Holdings
providers.description: Equinox Holdings is a privately held luxury lifestyle and fitness company majority-owned by Related Companies. Its portfolio spans high-end fitness clubs (Equinox), boutique indoor cycling (SoulCycle), yoga (Pure Yoga), value-tier gyms (Blink Fitness), luxury hospitality (Equinox Hotels), and a consumer streaming fitness app (Equinox+). The group operates more than 300 club facilities across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom and is positioned around the tagline "It's not fitness. It's life." Equinox Holdings does not publish a public developer program, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a GitHub organization; all consumer experiences are delivered through its native iOS/Android apps and websites, with no documented partner or open API surface.

providers.name: First Nations Bank of Canada
providers.description: First Nations Bank of Canada (FNBC) is a Schedule I federally regulated chartered bank under the Bank Act, chartered on 19 November 1996 and headquartered in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. It is the first Canadian chartered bank to be independently controlled by Indigenous shareholders — roughly 88% Indigenous owned and controlled by 78 Indigenous shareholder groups from Nunavut, Northwest Territories, Yukon, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Alberta and Quebec — and focuses on serving the Indigenous marketplace, with over 90% of its loans going directly to Indigenous communities, many of its branches on reserve, and CDIC-insured deposits. On the open-finance and API front, FNBC runs no first-party developer portal and publishes no public API: probes of developer.fnbc.ca, api.fnbc.ca and developers.fnbc.ca all fail to resolve, and the fnbc.ca site exposes only retail online-banking and a mobile app, not a documented API surface. Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (legislated via Budget 2024 / Fall Economic Statement 2024, with FCAC as overseer) is not yet operational, so third-party access to FNBC account data today is voluntary and effectively aggregator-mediated (Flinks, Plaid and similar), not a first-party open-banking API.

providers.name: Future
providers.description: Future (Future Research, Inc., future.co) is a consumer fitness technology company that delivers custom, one-on-one personal training through a mobile app. Members are paired with a dedicated certified coach who builds an individualized workout program, provides real-time messaging and accountability check-ins, and adapts the plan over time. The product includes an exercise library with form-guidance videos, flexible scheduling, and Apple Watch integration for workout tracking. Future is a direct-to-consumer subscription service (first month $50, then $199/month with a 30-day money-back guarantee) and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Kleiner Perkins portfolio company.

providers.name: Ideaya Biosciences
providers.description: IDEAYA Biosciences is a clinical-stage precision medicine oncology company headquartered in South San Francisco, California (NASDAQ IDYA), focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing targeted therapeutics for genetically defined cancer patient populations. Its research spans PKC inhibition in uveal melanoma, antibody-drug conjugate and DNA-damage-response combinations, synthetic-lethal MTAP-pathway programs, and KAT6/7 epigenetic inhibition, led by the investigational candidate darovasertib in registrational uveal melanoma trials. The company maintains a corporate and investor-relations web presence and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Loft
providers.description: Loft is a Brazilian real estate technology (proptech) company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Sao Paulo. It operates a marketplace for buying, selling, and renting residential property alongside a broad platform of software and financial services for the real estate sector, including a CRM and property-management tools for agencies, digital proposals and e-signatures, lead generation, rental administration, and fintech products such as rental guarantees (Fianca Aluguel), home financing, credit with property collateral, and residential and commercial insurance. Backed by a16z, QED Investors, Fifth Wall, D1 Capital, Thrive Capital, and Baillie Gifford, Loft is a market leader in Brazil's real estate fintech space. Loft does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definitions, or client SDKs; its GitHub organization (loft-br) hosts internal engineering and data-science tooling.

providers.name: Melonn
providers.description: Melonn is a third-party logistics (3PL) and multichannel fulfillment operator for e-commerce businesses across Colombia and Mexico. Through its proprietary Órbita platform it centralizes inventory, processes and packs orders, manages returns, and offers same/next-day delivery, unifying multiple sales channels into a single operation. Melonn connects to platforms such as Shopify, VTEX, WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, MercadoLibre, Amazon, Walmart, Rappi, TikTok Shop, Liverpool, and Coppel, and exposes a REST API with real-time webhooks so any external platform can drive order management, inventory queries, shipment tracking, and returns. Melonn was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors. Public developer documentation and a sandbox are provided on request via the Melonn advisory/contact form rather than an open developer portal.

providers.name: Mend
providers.description: Mend is a HIPAA-compliant telehealth and patient engagement platform for mental and behavioral healthcare organizations, powering appointment scheduling, automated reminders, secure video visits, digital intake forms and consents, patient messaging, payments, and AI no-show prediction. Mend integrates with EHR and practice-management systems through a combination of HL7, SFTP, and an API served from api.mendfamily.com. That API exists and is used by Mend's own portal for session initialization and signaling, but its reference documentation is delivered through a login-gated customer knowledge base rather than a public developer portal, so Mend's programmatic surface is best characterized as partner- and customer-gated rather than openly self-serve.

providers.name: N26
providers.description: N26 is a European mobile-first neobank founded in 2013 and headquartered in Berlin, Germany, offering fully digital current accounts, debit and virtual cards, spending analytics, sub-accounts (Spaces), overdraft, savings, and investment products across the EU, delivered through iOS and Android apps and a web banking interface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Earlybird and Insight Partners in the fintech sector. As of this enrichment pass, N26 is a consumer bank that publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or /.well-known/ discovery surface; its integrations are handled through private business partnerships rather than self-service API access.

providers.name: Ohalo
providers.description: Ohalo is a data governance company whose Data X-Ray platform discovers, classifies, redacts, and governs unstructured data across enterprise file systems, databases, and cloud stores at petabyte scale. Using generative AI for content categorization and extraction, it helps organizations inventory sensitive data, audit access entitlements, automate redaction, and prepare their data estates for AI adoption while meeting regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI DSS. Ohalo is backed by 500 Global, Anthemis, and Craft Ventures.

providers.name: One Medical *
providers.description: One Medical (1Life Healthcare, Inc.) is a membership-based primary care organization delivering in-person and virtual healthcare across 25+ US cities. Members pay an annual fee for same/next-day appointments, 24/7 on-demand video visits, secure provider messaging, integrated lab services, and digital health records, with most major insurance plans accepted. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and is now owned by Amazon, which offers One Medical membership to Amazon Prime members. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; One Medical operates a consumer healthcare site and member app and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or /.well-known/ discovery surface.

providers.name: Outpost Bio
providers.description: Outpost Bio builds frontier AI foundation models for the human microbiome. Its "lab-in-the-loop" platform pairs high-throughput wet-lab experiments with machine learning in a continuous cycle to predict how drugs and ingredients interact with microbial ecosystems, helping de-risk drug and ingredient R&D decisions around metabolism, toxicity, and efficacy. The company's public developer surface is the open-source Waypoint Python library and CLI (published to PyPI as waypoint-bio) plus gated Waypoint model checkpoints, the Atlas pretraining dataset, and the Compass benchmark suite on the Hugging Face Hub. Outpost Bio is a Seedcamp portfolio company and does not currently publish a hosted web API.

providers.name: Planetary
providers.description: Planetary is a decentralized, peer-to-peer social networking company built on the Secure Scuttlebutt (SSB) protocol, offering an iOS app for algorithm-free social media where users own and store their data locally with no advertising and no data selling. The team has since migrated its design, app, and philosophy to the Nostr protocol under a new app, nos.social. The project is fully open source, developed in the open on GitHub, and is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. Planetary exposes no commercial REST/HTTP API; its developer surface is the underlying SSB/Nostr protocol documentation (RPC methods, replication, blobs) rather than a hosted web API.

providers.name: Remind
providers.description: Remind is a K-12 school-home communication platform that lets teachers, schools, and districts message students and families by text, app, email, and voice without exchanging personal phone numbers. The product line includes Remind Chat, a free two-way messaging service used by individual teachers and classrooms, and Remind Hub, a paid district-wide communications platform with administrative controls, SIS integration, delivery analytics, and translation into 90+ languages. Remind reports use in roughly 80% of US public schools and by a majority of US teachers. In November 2023, Santa Barbara-based ParentSquare acquired Remind, and the combined company now operates under the ParentSquare name with Remind Hub continuing for existing district customers and Remind Chat continuing for classroom-level use; Remind Tutoring was discontinued as part of the combination. Remind's only externally documented developer surface is the Share on Remind SDK (the "Remind Share SDK"), a partner program that lets approved third-party content providers embed the Remind composer into their own product, authenticate Remind users via OAuth 2.0, serve shareable content and previews via partner-hosted webhooks, and ship messages back through Remind. The Share SDK is accessed by application through partners@remind.com and the developer console at remind.com/integrations; there is no public self-serve REST API, no published OpenAPI specification, and no general-purpose messaging API for sending Remind messages from third-party systems.

providers.name: Sano
providers.description: Sano Genetics is a UK-based precision-medicine company operating a 360-degree platform that connects the workflows behind decentralized clinical trials and research studies. Its services span patient recruitment and outreach, protocol and study design, digital prescreening and consent, electronic medical record retrieval, at-home DNA testing with genetic counseling, participant engagement portals, and biomarker testing programs. The platform helps pharmaceutical sponsors and research teams find, engage, and retain the right participants for genetically-informed studies. Surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: Skout
providers.description: Skout is a location-based social discovery and dating mobile app that lets people meet, chat, and make connections with others nearby or worldwide. Operated by the ParshipMeet Group, Skout is distributed as consumer iOS and Android applications and an in-browser experience, and was an early a16z portfolio company. It is a consumer product with no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or API surface; this profile captures its public identity and published legal/support pages. Added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment.

providers.name: SwipeRx
providers.description: SwipeRx (operated by mClinica Pte. Ltd., formerly mClinica Pharmacy Solutions) is the leading community and B2B commerce platform for pharmacies across Southeast Asia. Delivered as a mobile application, it connects a network of more than 300,000 pharmacy professionals and 50,000 retail pharmacies in Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand and Cambodia. The platform combines professional networking, accredited continuing professional development (CPD) education, industry news, a drug directory, adverse-event reporting, and B2B medicine purchasing (the Belanja marketplace) into a single app that digitizes a historically fragmented pharmacy supply chain. SwipeRx publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; its api.swiperxapp.com host is an undocumented private backend serving the mobile app.

providers.name: Talkiatry
providers.description: Talkiatry is an online psychiatry (telepsychiatry) platform that connects patients with in-network, employed psychiatrists and therapists for virtual mental health care. Patients begin with a free online assessment that matches them to a psychiatrist, then attend video visits for evaluation, medication management, and talk therapy. Talkiatry treats conditions including ADHD, depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, PTSD, and OCD, works with major insurance plans, and operates as a HIPAA-compliant, LegitScript-certified telehealth provider. The company is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass Talkiatry publishes a consumer telehealth website but no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tamr
providers.description: An enterprise data management company that uses machine learning to automate the mastering, enrichment, and classification of messy data across disparate sources. Helps large organizations unify customer, supplier, and product data to power analytics and AI initiatives.

providers.name: The Atlas Marketplace
providers.description: The Atlas Marketplace (branded "The Atlas") is a free online community and knowledge marketplace for local government leaders. Officials and staff use it to learn from their peers about the smart, safe, and sustainable solutions working in their communities, browsing a searchable library of case studies, vendors, and civic-technology projects. The platform connects public-sector practitioners with the companies and partners behind proven municipal solutions across mobility, infrastructure, sustainability, and public safety. Backed by 500 Global, it operates as a content and community website rather than a developer/API product; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: Theom
providers.description: Theom is a cloud Data & AI Operations Center that governs and secures enterprise data estates, providing automated data security, compliance, and safe generative-AI data activation across multi-cloud environments. Founded in December 2020 by former Cisco, Google, and Yahoo security practitioners (creators of Tetration Analytics), Theom detects active data breaches, maps real-time data lineage, analyzes identity-aware data usage and insider threats, and enforces data-usage policy agentlessly. Its product spans Theom Core (data security and lineage), Theom AI (GenAI leak prevention), and Theom Trust (real-time data contracts). Theom is backed by Wing Venture Capital, Ridge Ventures, Snowflake Ventures, Databricks Ventures, SentinelOne Ventures, and M12, and was named a Leader in the 2026 Forrester Wave for Sensitive Data Discovery and Classification. Theom is delivered as an enterprise platform; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API docs.

providers.name: Tozuda
providers.description: Tozuda is a Philadelphia-based safety technology company that makes mechanical, non-electronic head impact indicators for helmets. The patented indicator changes from clear to red when a helmet sustains force exceeding a set G-force threshold, making hidden helmet damage visible to workers, athletes, and safety inspectors across ANSI, DOT, EN, CSA, CPSC, and SNELL helmet types. Tozuda is a Techstars portfolio company and does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Warbler Labs Incorporated
providers.description: Warbler Labs is the San Francisco-based software company founded in 2020 by former Coinbase engineers Blake West and Mike Sall that builds and maintains Goldfinch, a decentralized credit protocol on Ethereum for stablecoin lending to real-world borrowers without crypto collateral, and UID (Unique Identity), a KYC/KYB-compliant on-chain identity credential. Warbler Labs is the core development team behind the Goldfinch protocol, its smart contracts, oracles, and subgraph data layer, and publishes developer documentation for building on and integrating with the protocol. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Coinbase Ventures, IDEO CoLab, Kindred Ventures, and others, and was surfaced through the a16z portfolio. Its developer surface is primarily on-chain (Solidity smart contracts, The Graph subgraph for querying protocol data, and the UID credential) rather than a hosted REST API.

providers.name: A Place for Mom
providers.description: A Place for Mom is North America's largest senior living referral service, connecting families with assisted living, memory care, independent living, home care, and other senior care options through a network of Senior Living Advisors and a large marketplace of care communities. Families use the service at no cost to search, compare, and get matched to providers, while care communities and home care agencies partner with A Place for Mom to receive and manage referral leads, respond to and moderate consumer reviews, and track billing and performance through provider-facing portals. A Place for Mom was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The company operates consumer-facing web properties plus provider, community-partner, reputation, and home care portals, and publishes a support knowledge base (including an llms.txt documentation index) rather than a public developer API program.

providers.name: Airspace Intelligence
providers.description: Air Space Intelligence (ASI) builds AI software for mission-critical, geospatial operations across aviation, defense, logistics, and energy. Its Prescience platform fuses data, models operational domains, runs predictive simulations, and optimizes complex operations in real time — spanning airline operations, air traffic management, global logistics, defense (space, air, land, sea), and energy grids. ASI holds an $875M FAA contract to help modernize the U.S. National Airspace System and works with partners including Alaska Airlines, National Grid, and the U.S. Air Force. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: AiSensum
providers.description: AiSensum (AISensum) builds agentic AI "teammates" that work alongside front-line staff to drive revenue, improve quality, and reduce labour while keeping the human in the lead. Operating since 2017 with a presence across Southeast Asia, it deploys purpose-built AI teammates for enterprise front-line operations in retail, F&B, hospitality and entertainment, each specialising in one measurable outcome: Daniel (revenue teammate, personalised counter offers/upsell), Sasha (time and cost teammate, bulk product-photo editing and approval), and Nicole (progress teammate, conversation scoring and cashier coaching against brand SOPs). Deployments are scoped through a half-day IFA (Intelligent Front-line Automation) Workshop. AiSensum publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal; it is a portfolio company of 500 Global tracked in the API Evangelist network. This profile was enriched from the company's public web presence and an on-site llms.txt.

providers.name: Ali Tech
providers.description: Ali Tech (operating as Xaim) is an AI infrastructure platform that gives startups and AI-driven businesses affordable, predictable compute for running AI workloads. Instead of token-based pricing, Xaim sells reserved processing capacity so teams can reduce processing costs without modifying their existing AI models. The platform is delivered as APIs through an Azure API Management developer portal, and advertises three products - a Compute API for running existing AI models cost effectively, an Insights API for real-time performance-optimization signals, and an Automation API for automating and scaling AI processes. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: America First Credit Union
providers.description: America First Credit Union is a federally chartered, NCUA-insured credit union headquartered in Riverdale, Utah, founded in 1939. With roughly $19 billion in assets, more than one million members, and about 124 branches across seven western states (Utah, Idaho, Oregon, New Mexico, Arizona, Nevada, and California), it is one of the largest credit unions in the United States. Like the vast majority of US credit unions, America First operates no public first-party developer portal and publishes no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications. It provides no self-serve, publicly documented API surface; consumer-permissioned account data access is handled through third-party data aggregators and its core banking provider rather than a direct first-party API. No public FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is documented on its public website as of this bootstrap. This record is an honest identity profile with no fabricated API surface.

providers.name: Apar Infotech Corporation
providers.description: Apar Infotech Corporation, which operates publicly as Apar Technologies, is a Singapore-headquartered IT services and consulting group serving clients across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and the Americas. The firm delivers technology consulting and application services, data management and business intelligence, collaboration and content management, enterprise applications, managed services, staff augmentation and collaborative development centres, with practice areas spanning artificial intelligence, cloud, CRM, ServiceNow workflow, RPA/BPM hyperautomation, enterprise mobility and IoT. Apar also publishes a small set of its own products — the Otomeyt HR technology and technical-assessment platform, the Innoculate IoT monitoring platform, and the eLite SIS and eLite BAM applications. Apar is part of the Apar Group and is backed by Insight Partners. As of this enrichment pass Apar publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API specification or self-service sign-up; its API work is delivered inside client engagements rather than as a public product surface.

providers.name: Aramya
providers.description: Aramya is a direct-to-consumer (D2C) women's ethnic wear brand from India, operated by DSLR Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and based in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Founded by Ankush Goyal, Aramya sells premium cotton kurtas, kurta sets, bottoms, dresses, co-ord sets, and dupattas with a strong focus on inclusive sizing (XS to 10XL) and affordable, comfortable everyday, office, and occasion wear. The brand runs on a Shopify-based storefront at aramya.in with weekly launches, cash on delivery, and free returns, and has raised multiple rounds (seed, pre-Series A, and an ~INR 80 Cr Series A) co-led by Accel India and Z47 (formerly Matrix Partners India). Aramya is a consumer retail brand and does not publish a public developer API; it does publish an llms.txt describing its shopping surface for AI assistants.

providers.name: Brit + Co
providers.description: Brit + Co is a women-focused digital media and lifestyle company founded in 2011 by Brit Morin. It publishes daily content and how-to inspiration across fashion, food and recipes, beauty and self-care, DIY and creativity, home organization, health and wellness, money and work, and entertainment news, and is known for its DIY classes and creator/entrepreneurship programming. The brand reaches a large audience of predominantly women readers through its website, newsletters, and social channels. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures. Brit + Co is a consumer content company and does not publish a public developer API; it does publish a machine-readable llms.txt describing its content sections for AI agents.

providers.name: Casma Therapeutics
providers.description: Casma Therapeutics is a privately held clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2018 and headquartered at 201 Brookline Ave, Suite 1401, Boston, MA. Casma develops novel cellular degradation medicines built on the autophagy pathway — the conserved process cells use to clear damaged components. Its PHLYT (Phagosome-Lysosome Targeting) platform initiates target-specific autophagic degradation of disease targets independent of size or complexity, reaching beyond single proteins to organelles, protein aggregates and large signaling complexes, with programs spanning oncology, inflammation, neurodegeneration and metabolic disease. Casma was named to the Fierce 15 list in 2019. The company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable API contract; it is catalogued here as a company profile only.

providers.name: Choose Energy
providers.description: Choose Energy is a free online energy marketplace, founded in 2008 and operated by Red Ventures, that helps consumers and businesses in deregulated U.S. energy markets compare electricity and natural gas plans, view transparent all-inclusive pricing, and switch providers online in minutes. The platform serves customers across Texas, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Illinois, New Jersey, New York, Maryland, Massachusetts, Connecticut, and other deregulated states, and also offers solar cost estimation, business energy procurement, and educational energy resources. Choose Energy is a consumer-facing web marketplace and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: CIT Group
providers.description: CIT Group was a US financial holding company providing commercial financing, equipment leasing, factoring, and middle-market banking services. CIT was acquired by First Citizens BancShares in January 2022 and has been integrated into First Citizens Bank as the Commercial Banking division. CIT Group does not maintain a public developer portal and never published general-purpose REST APIs; legacy customer integrations were delivered through file-based ACH/wire feeds, the OneWest online banking platform, and partner-mediated treasury connectivity. New API-based integrations for the combined institution are now exposed through First Citizens Bank.

providers.name: City Therapeutics
providers.description: City Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at 399 Binney Street in Kendall Square, Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 2024 by pioneers of RNA interference including John Maraganore, Phillip Zamore, Kotaro Nakanishi, Yukihide Tomari and Mark Keating. The company engineers next-generation RNAi trigger molecules — including its proprietary cleavage-inducing tiny (city) RNAs — and pairs them with precision targeting ligands designed to deliver siRNAs beyond the liver into ocular, CNS and other extrahepatic tissues. Its pipeline includes CITY-FXI, a Factor XI-targeting candidate for thromboembolic disease, and CITY-RBP4 for Stargardt disease and geographic atrophy, alongside undisclosed hepatic, ocular and CNS programs. City Therapeutics raised a $135M Series A in October 2024 and a $99.5M Series B in June 2026, and holds research collaborations with Biogen and Bausch + Lomb. City Therapeutics publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface; it is catalogued here as a company profile only.

providers.name: Clubhouse
providers.description: Clubhouse (Alpha Exploration Co.) is a social audio application founded in 2020 by Paul Davison and Rohan Seth, backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Kindred Ventures. It popularized live "drop-in" audio chat rooms where people gather to talk, listen, and learn in real time across clubs, channels, and scheduled events. Clubhouse ships consumer iOS and Android apps and operates its service on the clubhouse.com / clubhouseapi.com domains. The company does not publish an official, documented public developer API or SDK; the only machine-readable interfaces are third-party, reverse-engineered clients maintained by the community and not endorsed by Alpha Exploration Co. This API Evangelist profile captures the provider's real public surface — website, legal, and support properties plus a live domain-security probe — with no fabricated API artifacts.

providers.name: Cobalt AI
providers.description: Cobalt AI (formerly Cobalt Robotics) is a San Francisco based physical security automation company whose Cobalt Monitoring Intelligence platform uses AI handlers to investigate security events across access control systems and video feeds, determine root cause, and trigger automated responses so security teams focus on genuine threats instead of alarm triage. Its offerings include the Cobalt Command Center remote monitoring service and an indoor autonomous security robot, with integrations spanning LenelS2, Genetec, Avigilon, Brivo, Eagle Eye Networks, Milestone, Okta, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and Slack. The company was founded in 2016, backed early by Bloomberg Beta and Sequoia, and acquired in 2024 by Dean Drako, who rebranded it to Cobalt AI.

providers.name: Current
providers.description: Current (Finco Services, Inc.) is a New York City-based U.S. financial technology company operating a mobile-first consumer banking platform serving over six million members. Through partner banks Choice Financial Group and Cross River Bank it offers fee-free spending accounts with early direct deposit (up to two days early), fee-free overdraft, and paycheck advances; Savings Pods earning competitive APY with automated Round-Ups; the Build Card for responsible credit building without a traditional credit check; fee-free cryptocurrency trading; and teen banking accounts with parental controls and automatic allowances. Current is a technology company, not a bank. It does NOT publish a first-party public developer API or developer portal — no developer.current.com (does not resolve), current.com/developers and current.com/api return 404, and api.current.com is an undocumented mobile-app backend. Programmatic access to member account data is available only through third-party open-finance aggregators (Plaid), on a consumer-permissioned basis. This profile captures the company's public web, legal, and security surface and its aggregator-only data-access posture.

providers.name: Elephant Healthcare
providers.description: Elephant Healthcare is a global health-technology company, headquartered in the UK, that partners with governments to digitise and strengthen public health systems across Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. Its flagship product, ElephantOS, is a mobile- and offline-first electronic health record (EHR) that streamlines clinical workflows for primary and secondary care facilities, serving over 19 million contracted patients across Nigeria, Kenya and Pakistan. The company also builds Elephant Nudge, a clinical co-pilot that guides and rewards quality of care, and Elephant Platform, an emerging AI-driven marketplace that connects clinicians to third-party healthcare software, medical devices and supply-chain partners. Elephant is backed by General Catalyst and Seedcamp. As of July 2026 the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Endowus
providers.description: Endowus is a Singapore- and Hong Kong-based digital wealth management platform founded in 2017 by Gregory Van and Samuel Rhee. It gives retail, accredited, and private-wealth clients access to low-fee institutional share-class funds, advised and self-directed portfolios, and private-market and alternatives strategies across Cash, CPF (Central Provident Fund), and SRS (Supplementary Retirement Scheme) accounts. Its conflict-free model rebates 100% of trailer fees and fund-manager commissions to clients. Endowus is licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (CMS License 101051), serves 300,000+ clients, and manages over US$10 billion in assets. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; the company operates consumer apps but publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: FanCraze
providers.description: FanCraze is an International Cricket Council (ICC) officially licensed platform for cricket collectibles, trading, and fantasy gaming, serving more than 500,000 cricket fans worldwide. Its flagship products are Grails, a digital collectibles experience where fans pull officially licensed ICC player cards (Common through Legendary), trade them with other fans, and complete themed sets; and Matchday, a free-to-play fantasy cricket game where fans build squads from their collectibles and compete on live challenges tied to real ICC tournaments including Men's and Women's Cricket World Cups, T20 World Cups, and U-19 World Cups. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and is backed by investors including Tiger Global, Sequoia, Coatue, Dapper Labs, and Coinbase Ventures. FanCraze operates as a consumer (B2C) mobile and web app and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Finoa
providers.description: Finoa is a Berlin-based, BaFin-regulated digital asset infrastructure provider serving institutional investors, asset managers, family offices, venture capital funds, and regulated crypto service providers. Its platform combines qualified custody, in-custody staking, and prime brokerage across 170+ digital assets and 12 Layer-1 networks, with security and governance controls built for institutional and regulatory requirements. Finoa exposes a gated institutional API surface (api.finoa.io) and a client platform (login.finoa.io / app.finoa.io) rather than a public self-serve developer program. Surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: General Intuition
providers.description: General Intuition is a frontier AI lab, founded in 2025 and spun out of Medal, building spatial-temporal world and action models that learn to perceive, anticipate, and act in space and time. Rather than training primarily on the archive of human language, its systems learn from gameplay data, teaching machines to play, dream within compressed simulacra of reality, and improvise within the unfolding dynamics of the world. The company is developing a commercial API for gaming, simulation, and robotics partners, with broader access planned through 2026. General Intuition is backed by Khosla Ventures, which led both its $133.7M seed round (October 2025) and its $320M Series A at a $2.3B valuation (2026).

providers.name: Gerson Lehrman Group (GLG)
providers.description: Gerson Lehrman Group (GLG) is the world's leading platform for trusted human expertise, connecting organizations with a network of senior-level subject-matter experts to inform strategic decision-making. For more than 25 years GLG has facilitated expert calls and meetings, on-demand expert content and transcripts, quantitative and qualitative research and surveys, in-person and virtual events, and advisory and placement engagements. Its myGLG platform layers AI-powered and agentic research tools over that expert network. GLG was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. GLG operates no public developer API or documented developer program; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and security surface.

providers.name: Herb
providers.description: Herb (herb.co) is a leading digital media and e-commerce platform dedicated to cannabis culture, education, and lifestyle. It publishes cannabis news, strain databases, product reviews, dispensary and brand guides, deals, recipes, and city-level legalization guides, and operates the "Herb Agency" offering branding and marketing services to cannabis companies. The consumer site is built on Gatsby (React) with a GraphQL data layer, Algolia search, and a Firebase/serverless backend hosted on Netlify. Herb is backed by Bullpen Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network from that portfolio; the company exposes no public developer API program at this time, so this profile captures its published web, content, and discovery surface (llms.txt, domain security posture, and identity/link properties) rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Hoptroff
providers.description: Hoptroff is a London-based precision timing company that delivers Traceable Time as a Service (TTaaS), providing enterprise-grade, traceable UTC time with guaranteed SLA accuracy to any data center or cloud environment. Founded in 2015 by Richard Hoptroff, the company operates a global network of atomic timing hubs in London, New York, and Tokyo, delivering microsecond-level precision over IEEE 1588 Precision Time Protocol (PTP) and NTP. Its Certified Time and Terrestrial Time Feed products let organizations timestamp and audit automated events without a satellite dependency, using resilient multi-source feeds (three satellite feeds plus a terrestrial feed from the RISE Institute of Sweden) that are hardened against GPS spoofing and network failure. Hoptroff is certified to ISO 27001 and ISO 9001, and its time synchronization is licensed as an API so a consistent, compliant timescale can be applied across an enterprise for use cases in financial services (MiFID II timestamping and high-frequency trading), content streaming, gaming, IoT, and distributed ledger technology.

providers.name: Howdy
providers.description: Howdy is a nearshore talent platform that connects US companies with senior software engineers, data, DevOps, design, and product professionals across Latin America. Operating as an employer of record (EOR), Howdy handles recruiting, vetting, payroll, benefits, equipment, compliance, and team performance coaching through physical "Howdy Houses" in cities across the region. Founded in 2018 in Austin, Texas by Jacqueline Samira and Frank Licea, the company went through Y Combinator (W21) and acquired the Brazilian recruiting platform GeekHunter in 2023. It is a services/staffing business with no public developer API; this profile captures its public web, agent-facing, and legal surface.

providers.name: Iontra
providers.description: Iontra Inc. is a Denver, Colorado battery technology company that develops proprietary Charge-Control technology for rechargeable lithium batteries. Founded in 2013 and publicly launched in 2022, Iontra applies electrodynamic sensing and signal processing during charging to suppress lithium plating, dendrite growth and SEI-layer expansion, claiming up to 4x cycle life, 2x faster charging, improved cold-weather charging and better safety without changing cell chemistry. The technology is chemistry agnostic across Li-ion, Li-metal, Li-S, solid-state and Na-ion cells, and is delivered to OEMs as custom charging algorithm "recipes" flashed onto an application-specific microcontroller, or as a software-only library. Iontra closed a $45M Series C led by Volta Energy Technologies to launch an integrated RISC-V charge-control and fuel-gauge MCU. Iontra is an embedded/silicon company: it publishes no public web API, no OpenAPI, and no public SDK packages — its SDK is firmware delivered to OEM customers through a login-gated Document Portal under commercial engagement.

providers.name: Julienne Bruno
providers.description: JULIENNE BRUNO is a London-based food company that creates, develops and produces naturally plant-based fresh cheeses. Its Collection 01 comprises Burrella, Superstraccia and Crematta - dairy-free, fermented products positioned as original foods in their own category rather than vegan imitations. Products are sold direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront and stocked at Ocado, Whole Foods, Planet Organic, Harrods and Selfridges, and featured on the menus of 800+ restaurants, pubs and cafes. Founded in 2020 and backed by Seedcamp, the brand and assets were later acquired by Harvey & Brockless (The Compleat Food Group). This is a consumer packaged goods company; it publishes no developer API - the profile is enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: Jumo
providers.description: JUMO is a Cape Town-based banking-as-a-service (BaaS) platform, founded in 2015, that uses artificial intelligence to power digital credit and savings products for banks, mobile network operators, and payments providers across emerging markets in Africa. Its infrastructure has two foundational capabilities: Core, an end-to-end next-generation banking platform that replaces legacy core banking with no build cost, and Unify, an AI processor that transforms alternative data (such as GSM records and mobile wallet transactions) to reduce the cost and risk of lending. JUMO delivers financial services through partners including Airtel, MTN Group, Orange Money Group, and Mukuru, and has disbursed over USD 8 billion to more than 31 million people across Ghana, Kenya, Tanzania, Zambia, Uganda, Cote d'Ivoire, South Africa, Benin, and Cameroon. It is a certified B Corporation backed by investors including Anthemis, LeapFrog Investments, Fidelity Management, and Visa. JUMO's APIs and integrations are provided privately to regulated financial-institution partners rather than through a public developer portal.

providers.name: Kilsar
providers.description: Kilsar is an AI-powered maintenance training and operations platform for the aviation, defense, and industrial sectors. Its flagship product, Orion, turns static technical manuals and maintenance procedures into intelligent, guided workflows so technicians learn faster and perform complex tasks correctly. The platform provides AI-assisted search across operational and maintenance manuals, dynamic data storage and library management, custom workflow and procedure building, real-time task tracking and work-log monitoring, and predictive maintenance and troubleshooting guidance. Kilsar promises measurable outcomes including reduced downtime, faster mean-time-to-repair, and increased equipment uptime. Kilsar is a Techstars-backed company. As of this profile it publishes a marketing site and a Secureframe-hosted trust center but no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: KoBold Metals
providers.description: KoBold Metals is a critical-minerals exploration and development company that applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to the search for the copper, lithium, nickel and cobalt deposits needed for electrification. The company combines three capabilities: novel sensor hardware and software that collect higher-quality subsurface data faster, centralized data systems that organize disparate geological information about the Earth's crust, and predictive models that rank and target exploration prospects. Its stated aim is to "turn exploration into a repeatable science." Its flagship project is Mingomba in Zambia, described by the company as one of the best copper deposits ever found and positioned to become one of the world's largest copper mines. KoBold is venture-backed (investors include a16z and Bond Capital) and operates as a private exploration company. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the public surface is a corporate marketing, science, careers and news site.

providers.name: Kodiak Robotics
providers.description: Kodiak Robotics, which now operates publicly as Kodiak AI, is an autonomous vehicle company founded in April 2018 by CEO Don Burnette and headquartered in California with a Texas operations center. Its flagship product is the Kodiak Driver, an AI-driven autonomy system that pairs onboard artificial intelligence with modular, swappable sensor hardware and offboard services so that a single driverless stack can be carried across different vehicle platforms. The company sells into three markets — long-haul trucking, defense, and industrial ground transportation — and positions driverless operation as a safety improvement, citing that more than 85% of U.S. truck crashes are caused by human error. Kodiak reports more than 2.6 million autonomous miles driven and over 7,000 loads delivered. Kodiak publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, or SDKs; enrichment probes of kodiak.ai found no /.well-known/ discovery documents and no api/docs/developer subdomains. It does publish an llms.txt, an RSS news feed, and a corporate safety report, so this profile is maintained as a company record rather than an API producer profile.

providers.name: KokkanLogis Co.,Ltd.
providers.description: KokkanLogis Co.,Ltd. (주식회사 곳간, branded KOKKAN / 도심창고 곳간) is a South Korean urban self-storage and logistics operator headquartered in Gangnam-gu, Seoul. It rents managed storage units in five sizes (S, M, L, XL, XXL, from 1.0m cubes up to 2.0 x 2.0 x 2.0m) across 22 branches in Seoul, Busan, Incheon, Gyeonggi and Chungbuk, serving households storing seasonal appliances, clothing, bedding and baby goods as well as businesses storing samples, inventory, documents and office equipment. Customers select a branch, choose a unit size, pay and manage their contract through the KOKKAN mobile apps for iOS and Android, with recurring monthly card billing through a Korean payment gateway, long-term and promotional discounting, an address-rental (주소지 임대) product, and an optional pickup service for moving stored goods. The company also runs a franchise and partnership program for operators who want to open a KOKKAN branch. It was surfaced through the 500 Global portfolio. As of this profile KokkanLogis publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or technical documentation — the product surface is a consumer website plus native mobile apps.

providers.name: Kouper Health
providers.description: Kouper Health (Kouper) is a healthcare technology company building an AI-agent orchestration layer for care navigation, deployed on top of a provider organization's existing EHR. The platform spans the full patient journey through three named agents: PRIMUS for patient access and inbound coordination (appointment scheduling, intake, insurance verification, missed-call recovery), ARCHIE for inpatient and post-acute navigation (discharge planning, home health attachment, LUPA risk), and CURA for ongoing care coordination and management (proactive outreach, reminders, check-ins, escalation). Kouper sells to health systems, independent and specialty provider groups, clinically integrated networks, risk-bearing entities, and payers, with multilingual patient engagement, human escalation, and HIPAA-compliant workflows. The company emerged from stealth in May 2025 with a $10M seed round led by General Catalyst with 25Madison and CVS Health Ventures, and operates out of New York, San Francisco, and Nashville. As of this profile Kouper publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, API reference, or machine-readable API artifacts — the product is delivered as a managed EHR-integrated service rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Kuli
providers.description: Kuli is an AI agent for influencer marketing, built for consumer brands. It runs the full creator marketing lifecycle end to end — discovery, vetting, outreach, and reporting — so a small marketing team ships like a much larger one. Unlike platforms that filter creators on metadata such as follower counts and engagement rates, Kuli's agent watches actual creator videos frame by frame across TikTok and Instagram, assessing brand safety, content style, audience signals, and brand fit, then drafts personalized outreach in the brand's own voice and reports campaign ROI on a schedule. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Levallois-Perret, Paris, Kuli is a Y Combinator company. As of this profile Kuli publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs — its only machine-readable surface is an llms.txt.

providers.name: La Solive
providers.description: La Solive is a French vocational training organization (organisme de formation) preparing career-changers and apprentices for the trades behind building energy renovation and the climate transition. It runs state-recognized, practice-based programs — chef de projet en rénovation énergétique, conducteur de travaux, plombier chauffagiste pompe à chaleur et gaz, technicien de maintenance CVC, installateur de panneaux photovoltaïques, QualiPAC and agent de maintenance du bâtiment — delivered across campuses in Paris, Lyon, Nantes, Marseille, Toulouse and Lille plus a distance-learning track, with Qualiopi certification and France Travail / Mon Compte Formation / Transitions Pro financing. La Solive reports 1,500+ students trained and 500+ recruiting partner companies. It is a Partech portfolio company in the Climate sector. As of this enrichment pass La Solive publishes no public API, developer portal, or /.well-known/ discovery surface; it does publish an /llms.txt agent-readable site index, captured in this repo.

providers.name: Lapse
providers.description: Lapse is a London-founded consumer photo company (Lapse Ltd) whose iOS app turns an iPhone into a disposable camera - a one-tap Lock Screen shutter, a film "developing" delay, and a friends-only photo journal built on a "Friends not followers" thesis of no ads, no data sales, and no public follower counts. The app is invite and friends-gated Early Access, free to use, iOS only, and screens uploads with AI moderation; contacts are hashed and encrypted on device. Lapse is backed by Greylock, GV and Speedinvest. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or documentation as of the July 2026 enrichment pass, so this profile captures company identity, the published policy and support surface, and probed security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: LARQ
providers.description: LARQ is a direct-to-consumer water technology company that designs self-cleaning and filtering drinkware and home water products. Its flagship Bottle PureVis uses UV-C light to neutralize up to 99.9999% of harmful, odor-causing bacteria in the bottle and on the water surface, and the range extends to filtered bottles, filtered pitchers, an under-sink water filter, and the cuva beverage flavor line. The company positions itself around sustainable hydration — reducing single-use plastic bottle consumption — and funds environmental nonprofits from a portion of each purchase. LARQ is a consumer hardware and e-commerce business: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification, and no /.well-known/ discovery documents. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures. Sector: consumer.

providers.name: Lil Snack
providers.description: Lil Snack is a Manhattan Beach, California games company, founded in 2024, that builds "snackable" daily games and party games — short pop-culture puzzle, word, and trivia titles that refresh every day. It runs its own consumer destination at lilsnack.com (Clue Daily, Scattergories Daily, Swap, DownWords, Pickle, Lite Brite Daily, Wheel of Fortune TODAY, Quiz Climb, Venn, Chain, and more) and also powers games embedded inside partner consumer platforms, citing BuzzFeed, FOX, Hasbro, the Los Angeles Times, Netflix, Peacock, Prime Gaming, Reddit, and Sony. The company reports 40M+ games played and 10M+ players all-time, and monetizes through platform partnerships, sponsorships, and brand licensing. As of this profile Lil Snack publishes NO public developer surface — no API, no documentation portal, no SDKs, no public GitHub organization, and no /.well-known documents; its partner game integrations are arranged through business development rather than self-serve APIs. This API Evangelist profile therefore captures verified company identity, web properties, and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: LVX (formerly LetsVenture)
providers.description: LVX — formerly LetsVenture — is an India-based private market investing platform founded in 2013 by Shanti Mohan and headquartered in Bengaluru, with teams in Delhi and Mumbai. The platform connects startup founders raising capital with angel investors, family offices and VCs, and has been a SEBI-regulated entity since its Angel AIF was approved in 2018. Its product surface spans LVX start (early-stage angel investing), LVX grow (growth-stage and co-investment deals), LVXschool (private market investor education), LVX Debt (non-dilutive debt financing for startups) and LVX Track (portfolio dashboards), alongside the sister platform trica. The company publicly reports 35K+ startups, 14K+ investors and over Rs 1500 Cr of AIF assets under management. LVX rebranded from LetsVenture in July 2025 and letsventure.com now redirects to lvxventures.com. LVX operates no public developer API program: no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition or SDKs were found, and the platform-backing API at api.lvxventures.com is a private token-authenticated service.

providers.name: Modern Meadow
providers.description: Modern Meadow is a bio-design and materials-science company founded in 2011 in Brooklyn by Andras Forgacs, Francoise Marga, Gabor Forgacs and Karoly Jakab, now headquartered in Nutley / Pine Brook, New Jersey, where it operates an innovation lab opened in 2017. The company applies synthetic biology and protein engineering to build animal-free, bio-fabricated alternatives to leather and other petrochemical-derived materials, through the Bio-Alloy technology platform (an alloy of engineered proteins and bio-based polymers), the BIO-VERA material launched in 2023, and its current flagship INNOVERA, a next-generation leather alternative made from plant proteins, biopolymers and recycled rubber with more than 80% renewable carbon content. It sells into interiors, fashion and accessories, footwear, and automotive, and has partnered with BASF, tannery HELLER-LEDER (a 2026 European joint venture) and Allbirds (the Terralux footwear line). Modern Meadow has raised roughly $236M. It is a materials manufacturer, not a software vendor: profiling on 2026-08-01 found no public API, no developer portal, no documentation, no OpenAPI/GraphQL/MCP surface, no /.well-known/ documents, and no GitHub organization. Its corporate site (modernmeadow.com, Craft CMS) largely redirects to the product site innovera-world.com.

providers.name: Numos
providers.description: Numos is an AI agent platform that automates accounting and financial planning & analysis (FP&A) workflows for finance teams. It layers above existing ERPs with "zero disruption to your current architecture" and learns a company's accounting policies and entity structures to run strategic FP&A and variance analysis, continuous month-end close, accounts payable orchestration, and accounts receivable / revenue recognition. Numos is headquartered in San Mateo, California and is backed by General Catalyst. Its product is delivered as a hosted web application (app.numosai.com); the company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time. This profile was surfaced from the General Catalyst portfolio and enriched from Numos's public web surface.

providers.name: Oboe
providers.description: Oboe is an AI-powered learning platform whose mission is to teach one billion people one trillion things. Positioned as "AI that won't make you stupid," it lets anyone learn virtually any subject through a conversational interface that generates personalized, on-demand courses and lessons ("magical courses made just for you"). Founded in New York and backed by Homebrew, Oboe is building what it calls the world's first completely generalized AI-powered learning platform, focused on making humans smarter rather than only making machines smarter. As a consumer web application, Oboe does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; api.oboe.com serves only an XML sitemap index for public course pages.

providers.name: Poker Skill
providers.description: Poker Skill is a mobile-first poker-training app for iOS and Android that turns learning poker into a daily habit. It teaches through interactive puzzles, bite-sized guided lessons, and daily practice reps that adapt to the player's skill level, from complete beginner to serious improver. At its core is "Showdown AI", a versioned game-theory engine that deals practice hands, plays the opponents, and grades every decision by its expected value — an approach the company says replicates the methods behind Pluribus, the first AI to beat top professionals at six-max no-limit hold'em. The product is subscription-funded with a free-to-start funnel, and is backed by Initialized Capital. Poker Skill is a consumer application and does not publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Prosimo
providers.description: Prosimo is a multi-cloud networking platform that gives enterprises a full-stack cloud transit, security, performance, observability, and cost-management layer across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud. Its Application eXperience Infrastructure (AXI) abstracts cloud-provider networking constructs and ties network transit, micro-segmentation, zero-trust policy, WAF, and observability into an autonomous, ML-driven control plane. Prosimo exposes that control plane programmatically through a first-party Terraform provider (prosimo-io/prosimo) for full lifecycle management of cloud gateways, network and application onboarding, policies, namespaces, and security profiles; a companion Pulumi bridge repository and reusable Terraform modules are published on GitHub. Prosimo was venture-backed by General Catalyst, WRVI Capital, and BlackRock; industry sources report it was subsequently acquired by Palo Alto Networks.

providers.name: RankScience
providers.description: RankScience is a San Francisco based SEO and AI-visibility agency (RankScience LLC) that helps startups, SaaS companies, and enterprises grow search traffic through foundational and technical SEO, strategic content, and link building, alongside next-generation AI-search optimization services (Generative Engine Optimization, Large Language Model Optimization, and Answer Engine Optimization) for platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. It began as a YC-backed SEO A/B testing platform and now operates as a services agency. RankScience does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public web and AI-discovery surface (a published /llms.txt and domain security posture).

providers.name: Servus Credit Union
providers.description: Servus Credit Union Ltd. is a member-owned cooperative financial institution headquartered in Edmonton, Alberta, founded in 1938. It is Alberta's largest credit union and, following its 2023 member-approved merger with connectFirst Credit Union, became Canada's largest credit union by total assets (roughly $30 billion CAD), serving more than 500,000 members through about 100 branches and distributing profits back to members via its Profit Share program rather than to outside shareholders. As a provincially regulated Alberta credit union, Servus operates within a cooperative charter and offers retail and business banking, mortgages, loans, investments, and digital/mobile banking. On the open-finance front its posture is aggregator-only and honest: Servus runs no public first-party developer portal or documented public API. External data access to member accounts today is provided through third-party financial-data aggregators (Mastercard Open Banking / Finicity and Plaid) via consumer-permissioned connections, consistent with Canada's voluntary, not-yet-operational Consumer-Driven Banking framework overseen by the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada (FCAC).

providers.name: Side
providers.description: Side is a technology-powered residential real estate brokerage platform that partners with top-producing agents, teams, and independent brokers to help them launch and grow their own branded brokerage companies without the time, cost, or risk of operating a traditional brokerage. Side provides back-office operations, compliance, transaction management, marketing, and a proprietary Side App that streamlines and automates real estate transactions. Founded in San Francisco, Side is backed by ICONIQ Capital, Matrix Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Trinity Ventures. Side runs a private, authenticated internal API (api.side.com/v1) that powers its app but publishes no public developer program, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Sidekick Data
providers.description: Sidekick is a professional AI assistant for real estate agents and brokerages, built on the same large language model technology that powers ChatGPT with custom integrations into real estate-specific data sources. From a chat-style interface it combines an agent's inputs with MLS data feeds, local market insights, and a brokerage's brand preferences to produce detailed, on-voice outputs - covering client relationship tracking, email and call interaction analysis, market trend monitoring, property comparisons, transaction document management, and compliance risk detection. Sidekick is directly integrated with MLS and association data feeds across the United States and is backed by investors including Socium Ventures, Swift Ventures, and Garuda Ventures. It is a consumer/professional SaaS product and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: SkenarioLabs
providers.description: SkenarioLabs is a Helsinki-based real estate finance data intelligence company (founded 2015) that turns fragmented building data into auditable, asset-level intelligence for European banks and financial institutions. From a single address it reconstructs complete building profiles covering automated valuation, climate and transition risk, energy performance, technical condition, and renovation potential — aligned with CRREM, EU Taxonomy, ECB, EBA, CRR3, MEPS, and SFDR frameworks. It serves 200+ institutional clients monitoring over 60 billion euros of collateral and scores more than one million assets monthly. SkenarioLabs delivers its intelligence ad hoc into loan origination, portfolio audit, and continuous risk-monitoring workflows rather than through a public self-serve developer API.

providers.name: Skeps
providers.description: Skeps is a business-to-business embedded finance and pay-over-time platform that lets merchants and lenders offer point-of-sale financing directly inside their own websites, retail stores, and one-to-one sales channels. Built as a microservices platform, Skeps embeds banking and lending services into the buyer journey: its patented technology securely and in real time matches a customer to the best financing offer from a multi-lender network of national banks, credit unions, and fintech lenders, powering pre-approval, offer testing, and checkout financing. Skeps serves verticals including home improvement, retail, telecom, travel and hospitality, health and wellness, automotive, veterinary, financial institutions, and cobrand card programs. It operates an enterprise, request-a-demo sales model and is backed by Accel; this API Evangelist profile was enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: Skip
providers.description: Skip (originally Skip Protocol, skip.money) is the interchain infrastructure company that rebranded to Cosmos Labs and is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Interchain Foundation, leading engineering and growth for the Cosmos blockchain stack. Its skip.money and skip.build domains now redirect to cosmos.network. The team maintains the open-source Cosmos SDK, the Inter-Blockchain Communication protocol (IBC), the CometBFT consensus engine, and Cosmos EVM — the most widely adopted Layer 1 blockchain toolkit, deployed across 200+ chains. There is no independent Skip-branded hosted API; the public developer surface is the Cosmos SDK node REST + gRPC interfaces documented at docs.cosmos.network, with source on the cosmos GitHub organization.
