providers.name: Standout
providers.description: Standout (standout.work) is an AI talent agent for tech professionals in the United States. Candidates run a CLI (`npx standout`) that assesses how they think, build, and debug to create a living, verified profile of capability rather than a resume. Standout matches candidates to hiring companies and brokers a direct introduction to the founder when a match looks right — no applications and no recruiter middle layer. It is free for candidates; companies pay only on a successful hire. Backed by Y Combinator.

providers.name: StoreDot
providers.description: StoreDot is an Israeli battery technology company founded in 2012 by Doron Myersdorf, Simon Litsyn and Gil Rosenman, headquartered in Herzliya with an advanced technology campus in Irvine, California. It develops extreme fast charging (XFC) lithium-ion cells built on proprietary silicon-dominant anode chemistry and synthesized organic and inorganic compounds optimized with machine-learning models, targeting the range and charging anxiety that gate mainstream electric-vehicle adoption. Its "100inX" product roadmap sets 100 miles of range charged in 5 minutes (100in5, 2024), 3 minutes (100in3, 2028) and 2 minutes (100in2, 2032); the company has demonstrated pouch and prismatic XFC cells sustaining more than 1,000 and later 2,000 extreme fast charging cycles while retaining over 80 percent of original capacity, and designs its chemistry to drop into existing Li-ion production lines. Strategic investors and partners include Daimler/Mercedes-Benz, BP, VinFast, Volvo, Polestar, Ola Electric, Samsung Ventures, TDK and manufacturing partner EVE Energy. In 2026 a planned SPAC merger with Andretti Acquisition Corp. II was terminated and the company returned to private fundraising. StoreDot is a hardware, materials and cell-manufacturing business: it publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server or machine-readable API contract, and no /.well-known/ discovery surface, llms.txt or developer subdomain resolves on store-dot.com.

providers.name: Sully AI
providers.description: Sully AI is a US-based healthcare AI company that ships a portfolio of "AI employees" for clinical and administrative work — including an AI Scribe that turns patient conversations into structured, HIPAA-compliant notes, an AI Receptionist for scheduling and front desk, an AI Triage Nurse for patient engagement, an AI Medical Coder for autonomous ICD-10 coding, an AI Pharmacist, and an AI Consultant for chart prep. The platform integrates with Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, Athenahealth, Allscripts, Veradigm, and 50+ other EHRs. Beyond the end-user products, Sully exposes a public REST API covering audio transcription (file upload and real-time WebSocket streaming), clinical note generation (SOAP and custom templates), medical coding extraction (ICD-10, CPT, SNOMED), note templates, and a medical consensus alpha feature, with asynchronous results delivered over webhooks. Official Apache-2.0 licensed TypeScript/Node and Python SDKs are published under the sullyai GitHub org, and an Odiggo-maintained sully-api-demo repo showcases end-to-end usage. Sully's revenue model is SaaS subscriptions to healthcare providers, hospitals, and digital health platforms.

providers.name: The Modern Milkman
providers.description: The Modern Milkman is a UK doorstep delivery service that brings farm-fresh milk, groceries and household essentials to customers in returnable and reusable glass bottles or recyclable packaging, with flexible ordering and early-morning delivery. Founded to modernise the traditional milkround, the company focuses on reducing food waste and single-use plastic through a return-and-reuse model, local sourcing, and a subscription-style ordering experience delivered through its website and mobile apps. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The company publishes no public developer API, but does maintain an llms.txt for AI agents, a customer help centre, and a blog. Sector: consumer / direct-to-consumer grocery delivery.

providers.name: Timeless
providers.description: Timeless (Timeless Investments GmbH) is a Berlin-based fintech that lets people invest in fractions of authenticated collectibles - luxury watches, classic cars, sneakers, fine wine, art, and memorabilia - starting at 50 EUR through its iOS and Android app. Assets are curated, authenticated, and securitized so users can buy, hold, and trade shares and exit when an asset sells. Backed by EQT Ventures. Timeless is a consumer mobile-app platform and publishes no public developer portal or API; its api.timeless.investments backend is private and authenticated.

providers.name: Total Attorneys (Internet Brands)
providers.description: Total Attorneys is a legal marketing and lead-generation brand owned by Internet Brands. Originally a legal practice-management and client-intake SaaS backed by Bain Capital Ventures, the service was folded into the Martindale-Avvo network, and as of April 1, 2019 its attorney lead-generation offering transitioned to the Martindale-Nolo Pay Per Lead program. The totalattorneys.com site today markets pay-per-lead attorney marketing across practice areas such as bankruptcy, criminal defense, DUI/DWI, divorce, and personal injury. No public developer program or API is currently published.

providers.name: Translucent AI
providers.description: Translucent AI provides an agentic AI platform that acts as a financial operating system for healthcare organizations, unifying claims, labor, clinical output, P&L, budget and forecast, and contract-economics data to deliver real-time financial visibility and automated root cause analysis for finance and clinical teams. The company raised a $27M Series A led by GV, backed by NEA, Virtue, FPV, and Redesign Health. Translucent AI publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: TRIDITIVE
providers.description: TRIDITIVE is an automated additive manufacturing company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Meres, Asturias, Spain, with offices in Hartford, Connecticut and London. It builds the AMCELL family of automated industrial 3D printing machines (Amcell 1300, 4300, 8300, Bulkam), the Traced traceability system, and the EVAM Software platform for additive manufacturing workflow management, digital warehousing, and on-demand production of polymer and metal parts. A Techstars portfolio company, TRIDITIVE publishes no public API, developer portal, or client SDKs as of July 2026.

providers.name: Triomics
providers.description: Triomics is an AI healthcare company focused on oncology workflows, using AI agents to transform unstructured electronic health records into structured, actionable datasets for cancer centers and life sciences organizations. Its products include PRISM (AI-powered clinical trial matching), Symphony (visit preparation), Harmony (registry data curation and abstraction), and OncoLLM, a language model that reads entire patient charts to answer oncology-specific questions. The platform ingests HL7, FHIR, CCDA, PDF, and image formats, integrates with Epic, OncoEMR, iKnowMed, and Cerner, and is approved on the Epic App Marketplace. Triomics is deployed at cancer centers including Memorial Sloan Kettering and Mount Sinai, and raised $22 million backed by Battery Ventures, Lightspeed, Nexus, Y Combinator, and Oncology Ventures. Triomics does not currently publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or client SDKs.

providers.name: Trupanion
providers.description: Trupanion is a pet medical insurance provider for cats and dogs, best known for its patented software that pays participating veterinary hospitals directly at checkout (VetDirectPay) rather than reimbursing pet owners after the fact. Trupanion operates a partner developer portal (Azure API Management) that exposes Partner APIs for Quotes, Enrollments, and Offers, plus a Vet Portal / VetDirectPay integration used by veterinary practice management systems such as ezyVet, IDEXX, and DaySmart Vet. API access is gated - partners must be approved through Trupanion's Partner Program and are issued OAuth client credentials (client ID and client secret) plus a subscription key; the endpoint reference is not publicly published. The APIs listed here are modeled from Trupanion's public partner and portal materials, not from an openly documented API reference.

providers.name: Tweezr
providers.description: Tweezr is a system-intelligence platform for safe legacy change, helping banks and insurers understand and incrementally evolve legacy core systems without risky big-bang modernization. The platform maps mainframe and heritage codebases (COBOL, PL/I, CICS, IMS, DB2 z/OS, VSAM, IBM i RPG, Adabas/Natural) into a deterministic, queryable, cited model that grounds engineering teams and AI tools in what the code actually does before anything is changed. Tweezr deploys on-premise by default, is a member of the Banking Industry Architecture Network (BIAN), partners with 10x Banking, is distributed through AWS Marketplace and Microsoft AppSource, and is a Techstars portfolio company. Tweezr publishes no public API or developer program as of July 2026.

providers.name: Udacity
providers.description: Udacity is an online tech-upskilling platform offering project-based Nanodegree programs, individual courses, and enterprise workforce development across Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Data Science, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Programming, Autonomous Systems, Product Management, and DevOps. Founded by Sebastian Thrun out of the Stanford CS221 free online AI course in 2011, Udacity pioneered the Nanodegree credential and partnered with industry leaders (AWS, Google, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Mercedes-Benz) to co-develop curriculum. In 2024 Accenture acquired Udacity for approximately $1B and folded the platform into LearnVantage, Accenture's enterprise learning and skilling business. Udacity reports 25M+ learners globally and remains best known for its Self-Driving Car, Deep Learning, and Generative AI Nanodegrees, with hands-on projects reviewed by human mentors and career services. Udacity does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal — enterprise customers integrate via Accenture LearnVantage sales channels rather than self-service APIs. Its public GitHub organization (github.com/udacity) hosts 1,100+ open-source classroom and course-content repositories (e.g. deep-learning-v2-pytorch, self-driving-car, cd13303-genai-c1-classroom) used as Nanodegree exercises, not as official platform APIs.

providers.name: UPSIDE Foods
providers.description: UPSIDE Foods is a cultivated meat company that grows real chicken directly from animal cells instead of raising and slaughtering animals. Starting from a master cell bank derived from a single heritage-breed chicken egg, cells are fed vitamins, minerals, and nutrients and grown in cultivator tanks, becoming cultivated chicken in about three weeks. The company supplies cultivated chicken to foodservice partners and is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and Threshold Ventures. UPSIDE Foods publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interfaces as of July 2026.

providers.name: Vay
providers.description: Vay is a Berlin-headquartered teledriving (remote driving) mobility company, founded in 2018 by Thomas von der Ohe, Fabrizio Scelsi, and Bogdan Djukic, that operates the first commercial remotely driven car service. Customers in Las Vegas rent cars by the minute that are delivered and parked driverless by professional remote drivers from a Remote Driving Center; the company runs a 175-vehicle fleet, has served 50,000+ trips, and raised a Series C from Grab in December 2025. Vay is a consumer mobility service and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Vaya
providers.description: Vaya is an AI-powered Vedic astrology platform from Anuvaya Labs Technologies Pvt Ltd (New Delhi, India) that connects users with classically trained Parashari astrologers for live chat consultations, alongside free tools for Kundli (birth chart), horoscope, dasha, kundli matching, marriage prediction, navamsa, and panchang. Founded by Maahin Puri and Nitesh Kumar Niranjan (previously co-founders of Atlys), Vaya is backed by Accel, Arkam Ventures, and Weekend Fund, and ships as iOS and Android apps with no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Vendavo
providers.description: Vendavo is an enterprise B2B commercial-excellence software company whose platform helps manufacturers and distributors optimize pricing, automate quoting and agreements, and manage rebate and incentive programs using AI-powered pricing intelligence and margin analytics. Vendavo has been named a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for B2B Pricing & Rebate Optimization Software and integrates with enterprise ERP, CRM, and eCommerce systems. As of this enrichment pass Vendavo publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition; its integration surface is delivered through partner and customer engagements. This profile was seeded as a portfolio lead of DCM Ventures and Sapphire Ventures.

providers.name: Web3 Foundation
providers.description: Web3 Foundation is a Swiss nonprofit founded in 2017 by Gavin Wood that funds research and development teams building the foundation of a decentralized web (Web3). It stewards and supports the Polkadot and Kusama networks, operates a research hub and an education/wiki program, and historically ran the Web3 Foundation Grants Program (now discontinued) to seed open-source software and protocol research. It is a funding and research organization rather than a traditional API provider: it publishes no public REST/OpenAPI surface, but does maintain an RFC 9116 security.txt and a coordinated vulnerability-disclosure program.

providers.name: Widgera, Inc.
providers.description: Widgera is an AI-native business platform that unifies a company's operations into what it calls "One Adaptive OS." Its AI assistants (branded Aiva) learn a business, automate workflows, build internal apps, and run customer interactions across a suite of modules that includes CRM, Chats, Drive, Analytics, and autonomous Agents. Widgera positions itself as the infrastructure layer powering operations for retail, automotive, hospitality, real estate, and service organizations, with a roster of customers across consumer electronics retail, car service, real estate, and wellness. The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this profile Widgera runs a private application backend (api.widgera.com) but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; its public surface is a marketing site plus Privacy and Terms pages and homepage-published compliance posture (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR).

providers.name: World Golf Tour
providers.description: World Golf Tour (WGT Golf), operated by World Golf Tour, LLC out of San Francisco, is a free-to-play online golf simulation launched in 2008 that recreates more than twenty real championship courses like Pebble Beach, St Andrews, and Bethpage Black using photorealistic imagery, played by over 15 million players on web, iOS, and Android, with virtual equipment from Callaway, Titleist, and TaylorMade and integrations with SkyTrak launch monitors. The company is a Battery Ventures portfolio company and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: World View
providers.description: World View (World View Enterprises) is a Tucson, Arizona-based stratospheric balloon company focused on remote sensing and persistent intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR). Its uncrewed high-altitude balloons carry EO/FMV, IR, SAR, and hyperspectral sensors for defense, government, and commercial missions. Acquired by Ondas Holdings in 2026, it now operates as part of the Ondas Sentinel multi-domain intelligence platform, with partnerships including Palantir and Sierra Nevada Corporation. World View publishes no public developer program or API.

providers.name: Worldview
providers.description: World View Enterprises (worldview.space) — incorporated in 2012 and headquartered in Tucson, Arizona — operates stratospheric balloons and high-altitude platforms for remote sensing, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), alongside a stratospheric space-tourism program. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, the company has completed more than 140 stratospheric flight operations for customers including NASA, NOAA, and the U.S. Department of Defense. World View was acquired by Ondas, Inc. in April 2026 and merged with DZYNE Technologies in July 2026 to form Ondas Sentinel. The company publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: XPO
providers.description: XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO) is a Fortune 500 transportation company and one of the largest providers of less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation in North America. Following the spin-offs of GXO Logistics (contract logistics, 2021) and RXO (brokerage, 2022), XPO is now a pure-play LTL trucking company operating a network of service centers across the United States and Mexico. XPO does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; customer integrations (rate quotes, shipment tracking, EDI) are arranged through enterprise account managers and standard EDI exchanges.

providers.name: XPO Logistics
providers.description: XPO Logistics, Inc. is a leading provider of less-than-truckload (LTL) transportation in North America. The company offers freight transportation through a proprietary network of service centers and uses technology to drive efficiency for more than 50,000 customers. XPO Logistics historically operated as part of XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO), the publicly traded company that spun off GXO Logistics (contract logistics) in 2021 and RXO (brokerage) in 2022, leaving XPO focused on LTL trucking. XPO Logistics does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are arranged through enterprise account managers.

providers.name: 42Maru
providers.description: 42Maru is a South Korean AI deep-tech company building a Deep Semantic TA (Text Analytics) and QA (Question Answering) platform that understands the true intent behind a user's question and returns a single answer drawn from large sets of unstructured documents. Its cognitive-search stack pairs document retrieval with Machine Reading Comprehension (MRC) and is delivered as enterprise chatbots (CHAT42), question-answering engines (QA42), natural-language processing (NL42), and the Platform42 SaaS. 42Maru ranked #1 on Stanford's SQuAD 2.0 machine-reading benchmark, won an AWS AI Challenge award, and is a Techstars London alumnus. It was added to the API Evangelist network from the Techstars portfolio and enriched from its public marketing site, GitHub organizations, and gitbook documentation; no public REST API, OpenAPI, first-party SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface was found — Platform42 API access appears to be provisioned per enterprise customer.

providers.name: A24
providers.description: A24 is an American independent entertainment company founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City that produces, finances, and distributes films and television, including award winners such as Everything Everywhere All at Once, Moonlight, and Hereditary. Beyond production, A24 runs a direct-to-consumer business spanning a merchandise shop, the AAA24 membership program, editorial "Notes," podcasts, and a mobile app. A24 is a portfolio company of Thrive Capital. A24 does not publish a public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Achronix Semiconductor
providers.description: Achronix Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in high-performance FPGA (field-programmable gate array) products and embedded FPGA (eFPGA) intellectual property. Its portfolio includes the Speedster7t family of standalone FPGAs, Speedcore eFPGA IP for system-on-chip integration, VectorPath PCIe accelerator cards, and the ACE design tools suite for synthesis, verification, and optimization. Achronix technology targets AI/ML inference, 5G/6G networking, data-center compute acceleration, automotive, SmartNICs, and test-and-measurement workloads. The company is privately held and backed by investors including Battery Ventures. It exposes no public web/REST API or developer API portal; its developer surface is a hardware support portal, product documentation, datasheets, and design tools.

providers.name: Acme Markets
providers.description: Acme Markets is a regional supermarket chain founded in 1891 and headquartered in the U.S. Northeast, operating approximately 164 stores across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, New York, Connecticut, and Maryland. Acme is a banner of Albertsons Companies, Inc., one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States. The brand has no publicly documented developer program or public API: digital surfaces (store locator, loyalty program "ACME for U", FreshPass subscription, DriveUp & Go, delivery, pharmacy) are delivered through Albertsons-shared web and mobile platforms. The Android package ID (`com.safeway.client.android.acme`) confirms that the Acme app is built on the shared Safeway/Albertsons banner application, suggesting a shared backend API surface across Albertsons banners that is not externally published.

providers.name: Agvend
providers.description: AgVend is an agricultural technology company founded in 2017 (Austin, TX) that provides digital engagement and commerce software to agricultural retailers, cooperatives, manufacturers, and distributors. Its white-labeled Grower Portal (web and mobile) gives ag retailers a branded storefront, CRM, sales enablement, digital billing, and integrated payments, while its Nexus product extends the platform to manufacturers and distributors across the ag supply chain. The platform integrates with major ag and energy ERPs, agronomy planning tools, and grain and financing systems, and exposes an API Access Driver that lets customers pull structured platform data into external reporting and BI tools such as Power BI. Backed by 8vc and Tidemark.

providers.name: alphin
providers.description: alphin is a Berlin-based marketing platform for local small businesses, giving restaurants, cafes, salons, and similar SMBs an all-in-one app to manage and automate their online presence. Its product suite spans review collection (alphin Reviews), Instagram and social management (alphin Socials), professional photography (alphin Photos), local influencer marketing (alphin Local Influencers), targeted Instagram advertising (alphin Local Ads), and multi-platform profile management across Google, TripAdvisor, and Yelp (alphin Portals), consolidated into one dashboard with daily reporting and analytics. Founded in 2016 (as Freachly GmbH), alphin serves 1,000+ local businesses across Germany, Austria, the UK, and Israel, and is backed by HV Capital, Partech, Scale Capital, and Wille Finance. alphin publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; the product is delivered through its web and mobile Business App.

providers.name: Alta
providers.description: Alta (Alta Daily) is a New York City-based consumer AI styling and agentic-shopping app built by Flagship AI, Inc. It digitizes a user's wardrobe into a searchable digital closet, generates daily outfit recommendations from natural-language prompts, weather, and occasion, lets users virtually try outfits on a personalized avatar, and surfaces shoppable recommendations across 4,000+ partner brands. Powered by more than a dozen proprietary in-house multimodal generative AI models, Alta was named a TIME Best Invention of 2025 and raised an $11M seed round led by Menlo Ventures. It is offered as a free iOS and Android mobile app; as of this profile there is no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: ams OSRAM
providers.description: ams OSRAM (ams-OSRAM AG) is a global leader in innovative optical solutions, designing and manufacturing intelligent sensors, emitters, and light-based semiconductors. Formed from the 2020 combination of ams AG (Austria) and OSRAM (Germany), the company builds LEDs, VCSEL and edge-emitting lasers, CMOS image sensors, ambient light and proximity sensors, direct time-of-flight (dToF) sensors, photodiodes, and LED/VCSEL driver ICs. Its sensing, illumination, and visualization technologies serve automotive and mobility (headlamps, interior lighting, ADAS), industrial automation and robotics, medical and healthcare devices, mobile and wearable devices, computing, and general lighting. Headquartered in Premstaetten, Austria and Munich, Germany, ams OSRAM employs roughly 18,500 people across 25 R&D sites and holds over 12,000 patents. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of iconiq-capital and enriched from ams OSRAM public web pages; the company exposes product/design support and a download center rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Anker Innovations
providers.description: Anker Innovations is a global consumer-electronics company headquartered in Shenzhen, China, known for its Anker charging and power products, Soundcore audio, eufy smart-home and security devices, Nebula projectors, and Anker SOLIX portable power and solar storage. Through the Anker Open Platform (developer.anker.com) the company exposes a developer surface that lets partners integrate and control Anker devices from their own applications via API and SDK, gated behind an Open Platform login. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and is being enriched with the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Anonym
providers.description: Anonym is a privacy-preserving advertising technology platform now operated by Mozilla, sitting between advertisers and major publishers to measure and optimize ad performance without exposing individual user data. It uses confidential computing and privacy-enhancing techniques to run performance measurement and campaign optimization across platforms including TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, and Reddit, replacing costly custom data-sharing systems with a single privacy-compliant setup. Anonym was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners; its public surface is a marketing site (anonymco.com, redirecting to mozilla.org/anonym) and a customer login portal (anonymportal.com). No public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Apeel
providers.description: Apeel (Apeel Sciences) is a food technology company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Goleta, California. It produces a plant-derived, edible coating, made from lipids and glycerolipids found in the peels, seeds and pulp of produce, that is applied to fresh fruit and vegetables at packing houses to slow water loss and oxidation, extending shelf life and reducing food waste across the supply chain. Apeel-treated produce is sold through grocery retailers in multiple countries. In 2021 Apeel acquired ImpactVision and added hyperspectral imaging to its supplier installations to grade interior quality, ripeness and freshness. Apeel is a materials-science and supply-chain operator: as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, or self-serve developer sign-up.

providers.name: Artifact
providers.description: Artifact is a consumer service that captures and preserves family stories through professional, guided interviews. The company conducts remote 30-minute interviews with a family member and edits each one into a studio-quality ~20-minute audio episode, hosted on a private webpage where relatives can add photos and share the recording. Episodes are priced per interview, positioning the product as a way to record a loved one's life story and memories. Backed by GV (Google Ventures) in the consumer sector. As of 2026 the company announced it is winding down: new Artifacts are no longer sold, and previously purchased interviews may be scheduled through October 31. The service exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Atypical AI
providers.description: Atypical AI is an artificial-intelligence and learning-science lab building generative-AI learning products for educators, learners, and content creators. Its flagship product, ExamJam, is an AI tutor that pairs adaptive, personalized tutoring with trusted exam content from major publishers (Pearson, McGraw Hill, Collins) to help students prepare for and revise toward their exams. Founded in 2023 and based in San Francisco, the woman-owned company builds personalized tutoring, exam preparation, content creation, collaboration, and student-success measurement tools grounded in learning science. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta; it publishes a consumer product surface (web + mobile) and no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Auditocity
providers.description: Auditocity is an HR compliance software platform that helps organizations of any size master regulatory requirements and best practices. It maintains a library of more than 14,000 questions spanning federal, state, and industry-specific HR compliance, automatically generating custom-built audits tailored to an organization's industry, size, and location. The platform produces actionable findings reports that identify compliance gaps, tracks requirements across all 50 states, and delivers real-time regulatory updates through an HR technology partner network. Auditocity is a Techstars portfolio company. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification has been published at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: AutoGrid
providers.description: AutoGrid Systems is a United States grid-technology company founded in 2011 by Amit Narayan in Redwood City, California, that built AI and machine-learning software for distributed energy resource management (DERMS), virtual power plants, and automated demand response under the AutoGrid Flex platform, selling to investor-owned utilities, retailers, and aggregators rather than to end consumers. It sits on the grid-tech / DERMS layer of the energy value chain - a buyer and orchestrator of utility and device data, not a data custodian - so no Green Button, Consumer Data Right, or smart-meter data-sharing obligation attaches to it. Schneider Electric took control of AutoGrid and then sold it to Uplight in a deal announced 14 December 2023 and closed in early 2024; auto-grid.com now serves only a 270-byte meta-refresh to uplight.com (on an expired TLS certificate as of 27 July 2026) and every developer, docs, api, and data subdomain fails to resolve. Its API posture is therefore honestly none-published - no public developer portal, no OpenAPI, no SDK, no consumer usage API, and no open market data. Its machine-readable contract is instead expressed as protocol conformance, and that is real and still published by the certifying bodies. AutoGrid is a certified OpenADR 2.0a and 2.0b VTN (server) - AutoGrid DROMS and OpenDR Server 2.0, Simple HTTP + XMPP, pull and push - and holds SunSpec Alliance certificate CS-000074 for AutoGrid Flex as an IEEE 2030.5-2018 / CSIP server, tested by Intertek on 12 December 2023 and awarded 22 January 2024. Both surfaces authenticate with mutual TLS x.509 client certificates and were reachable only under commercial contract. The successor surface at docs.uplight.com is real but fully login-gated, redirecting anonymous visitors to a ReadMe dashboard login, and api.uplight.com answers HTTP 401 with "Invalid or no token provided" - partner and customer access only.

providers.name: Avoice
providers.description: Avoice is an AI-native workspace for architects and engineers that automates the non-design work of running an architectural practice. Its AI agents understand drawings, specifications, schedules, materials, building codes, and research to generate specs, run automated QA/QC quality control on specs and drawings, auto-produce door/window/finish schedules and quantities, draft RFIs and submittals for construction administration, and manage a client portal alongside searchable detail and material libraries. A Y Combinator Winter 2026 company, Avoice positions itself as the operating system for architectural practice, with firms managing over $300 million in active projects using it across five countries. Avoice publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation at this time; this profile tracks the company as a network lead.

providers.name: birchbox
providers.description: Birchbox is a beauty and grooming subscription-box retailer that sends members a monthly assortment of personalized deluxe samples across skincare, makeup, haircare, and fragrance, then lets them purchase full-size versions of what they like in its online shop. Originally a New York startup and later acquired, the brand today runs a direct-to-consumer subscription and e-commerce storefront at birchbox.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer program, API, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Brite
providers.description: Brite is a white-label learning management system (LMS) platform for STEM education, giving educators, academies, and learning centers a single operational tool to run computer-science programs in game and web development. It bundles a ready-made curriculum, classroom and roster management, student progress reporting, and teacher accounts, replacing spreadsheets and disparate software with one branded platform. Brite is offered on free, per-student Professional, and custom school/district tiers. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Buncha
providers.description: Buncha is a scheduled neighborhood grocery delivery service operating across Minnesota and Michigan. Customers shop online from local partner retailers and receive their orders on set weekly routes, with a single refrigerated van consolidating multiple neighbors' orders into one trip for a $3.45 flat delivery fee. Professional personal shoppers hand-pick items into insulated bags, and the aggregated-route model is positioned to cut delivery CO2 emissions by up to 80% versus on-demand services. Buncha is offered through iOS and Android consumer apps and is backed by Foundry Group and Techstars. It is currently a consumer product with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Cenos
providers.description: CENOS is an engineering simulation software company founded in 2017 in Riga, Latvia, that packages academically proven open-source solvers (Salome, GetDP, and Elmer FEM) into focused, affordable desktop applications for practical engineers. Its products cover electromagnetic and thermal simulation use cases including induction heating, radio-frequency antenna design, wireless charging, electromagnetic stirring of liquid metals, and busbar heating, promising faster product development and lower cost than traditional CAE suites. CENOS is a subscription desktop product with CAD import, one-click PDF reports, and live expert support; it does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer platform. Backed by 500 Global, Startup Wise Guys, and Capitalia.

providers.name: Century 21 Canada
providers.description: CENTURY 21 Canada Limited Partnership is the Canadian master franchisor of the CENTURY 21® real estate brand, headquartered at 1285 West Pender Street in Vancouver, British Columbia. The master licence for Canada was secured in Vancouver in 1976 — the first international franchise of the CENTURY 21 System — and the network today spans roughly 400 independently owned and operated offices from coast to coast. Century 21 Canada sits in the brokerage/franchisor layer of the Canadian real estate value chain: it does not originate listing data, it consumes it. Canadian residential listings are consolidated nationally by the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA), which runs REALTOR.ca and the Data Distribution Facility (DDF®); franchisors and brokerages redistribute that member-owned MLS® content under CREA rules rather than publishing it themselves. Century 21 Canada's API posture is accordingly empty. As of a 2026-07-26 probe there is no developer portal, no API documentation, no published base URL, no SDK, no webhooks, no Postman collection and no machine-readable contract of any kind on century21.ca or c21.ca — both century21.ca and c21.ca resolve to the same WordPress consumer site whose terms of use name MoxiWorks LLC as the site operator, and whose property search is a hosted MoxiWorks Web Marketing System surface rather than a first-party API. Wildcard DNS on *.century21.ca and *.c21.ca returns HTTP 200 for every subdomain probed (developer., developers., api., docs.) by parking them all on eboat.moxiworks.com, so those 200s are a DNS artifact and not a developer portal. RESO is absent: no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData or $metadata endpoint, and no Universal Property Identifier reference appears anywhere in the public surface — consistent with Canada, where RESO certification is not the operative seam and CREA's DDF® is. The only genuinely public, anonymously callable machine-readable surface found is the incidental WordPress REST API route index at https://www.c21.ca/wp-json/, which is a CMS artifact, is undocumented by Century 21 Canada, and is deliberately not listed here as a product API. Agent- and franchisee-facing tools live behind the hub21.ca member login. This profile is therefore identity-only and honestly records a brokerage franchisor with no published developer surface.

providers.name: ClassAction
providers.description: ClassAction operates enjin (集団訴訟プラットフォーム enjin), a Japanese class-action / group-litigation platform that connects consumers who have suffered damages from the same party with registered attorneys to pursue collective lawsuits. Victims report their damages, registered lawyers volunteer to take on cases, and participants share legal costs and evidence so that even small-value claimants can afford to litigate. The service launched in May 2018 and is free for users. This is a consumer-facing legal-tech website with no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

providers.name: CoConstruct
providers.description: CoConstruct is a residential construction management software platform originally founded in 2005 in Charlottesville, Virginia by Donny Wyatt to help custom home builders and remodelers manage projects, budgets, selections, client communications, scheduling, and financial workflows in a single web and mobile application. The product served thousands of custom builders across the United States and was paired with CBUSA, a homebuilder group purchasing organization CoConstruct previously acquired. On February 24, 2021, CoConstruct was acquired by Buildertrend of Omaha, Nebraska, with growth funding from Bain Capital Tech Opportunities, HGGC, and Serent Capital, creating a combined company serving 23,000+ clients, 1.1M+ users, and $200B+ in annual construction project value. By 2022 Buildertrend had merged the two products into a single unified Buildertrend platform and migrated CoConstruct customers off the legacy product. CoConstruct historically operated a developer portal at developer.coconstruct.com exposing APIs for project, financial, and scheduling data, but as of the merger CoConstruct has paused new API development — "we are not establishing new API endpoints or connecting additional users to existing endpoints" — and the developer portal now redirects to a static notice page. Existing API connections are reportedly maintained but no public OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source release is published. Net-new integration work is directed to Buildertrend's own platform and partner program.

providers.name: CodeSecure
providers.description: CodeSecure is an application security testing company whose CodeSonar static application security testing (SAST) engine performs deep whole-program analysis of C, C++, Java, and other languages to find bugs, security vulnerabilities, and coding-standard violations, and whose CodeSentry binary software composition analysis (SCA) tool generates SBOMs and detects vulnerabilities in third-party and binary components. CodeSecure merged with AdaCore in 2025, combining SAST and SCA tooling with high-integrity software development for aerospace, automotive, defense, medical, and industrial customers. The tools support SARIF, CWE, MISRA, CERT, and OWASP as well as safety standards such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, EN 50128, and DO-178C, and integrate with CI/CD, IDE, and issue-tracking pipelines rather than exposing a public developer REST API.

providers.name: Cognichip
providers.description: Cognichip is an AI-first semiconductor company revolutionizing the way chips are designed. Its core technology, Artificial Chip Intelligence (ACI), is built on what the company describes as the world's first physics-informed foundation AI model tailored for chip design, positioning ACI as a new scaling factor for semiconductors. ACI aims to understand, learn, and solve chip design problems with designer-level cognitive abilities, reducing design effort by roughly 75% and cutting completion time in half to address the industry bottleneck where chip development can take three to five years. Founded by semiconductor and AI veterans including CEO Faraj Aalaei and CTO Ehsan Kamalinejad, the company is backed by Lux Capital, Mayfield, and Seligman Ventures, has Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan on its board, and was named to Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026. Added to the API Evangelist network and enriched by the pipeline; the company publishes a marketing and corporate presence today with no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Conduct AI
providers.description: Conduct AI (conduct.ai) is an enterprise "AI operating system" that helps IT teams understand, operate, and transform their business software, starting with SAP and expanding across the wider enterprise stack. Its platform analyzes custom code to reveal dependencies and system relationships (Understand), automates software-development workflows from planning through deployment (Operate), and accelerates system migrations such as S/4HANA with automated analysis and code refactoring (Transform). The company markets outcomes like faster S/4HANA migration planning, reduced manual system analysis, and shorter change-implementation cycles. Conduct raised a $60M Series A and is backed by ICONIQ Capital. It publishes a marketing site, blog, and case studies but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference documentation.

providers.name: Cuida Mi Mascota
providers.description: Cuida Mi Mascota (CuidaMiMascota SAPI de CV) is a Mexican pet-care marketplace that connects pet owners with vetted, trusted caregivers for boarding (hospedaje), daycare, in-home visits, and dog walking across cities in Mexico. Delivered primarily as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps, the platform has served more than 250,000 pet owners and lets caregivers register to offer services. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. The company exposes no public API, developer portal, or SDK today; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead with identity and domain-security signals captured for discovery.

providers.name: Cullen/Frost Bankers
providers.description: Cullen/Frost Bankers is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Cullen/Frost Bankers API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Cur8
providers.description: CUR8 is a carbon removal intelligence platform based in Oxford, United Kingdom, building the global market for high-quality carbon removals with a mission to remove one billion tonnes of carbon a year. Founded in 2021 by Mark Stevenson, Marta Krupinska and Gabrielle Walker, CUR8 combines financial and scientific expertise to source, evaluate and manage diversified carbon removal portfolios spanning nature restoration, biochar, direct air capture, enhanced weathering, superpollutant abatement and sustainable aviation fuel. Its platform surfaces (Discover for sourcing removal assets, Manage for tracking portfolio performance and risk, Finance for capital provision, and the Carbon Planner for strategy) help enterprises invest in carbon impact with confidence on the path to net zero. Clients include Microsoft, Coca-Cola HBC, Standard Chartered, Arup and UBS. CUR8 is backed by Google Ventures (GV) and Airbus Ventures. No public API, SDK or developer program is advertised as of this profile; access is via the CUR8 dashboard and platform.

providers.name: Dream11
providers.description: Dream11 is India's largest fantasy sports platform, operated by Sporta Technologies Private Limited and part of the Dream Sports group founded in 2008 by Harsh Jain and Bhavit Sheth and headquartered in Mumbai. Launched as a freemium fantasy game in 2012, it lets 140 million-plus users draft virtual teams and compete in free and paid contests across cricket, football, kabaddi, basketball and hockey, scoring on the real-world performance of the athletes they pick. Dream11 is a consumer, mobile-first product with no public consumer API program; its engineering organization does maintain public open-source infrastructure (Kong rate-limiter and circuit-breaker plugins, the Odin deployment tool) on GitHub and publishes an engineering blog.

providers.name: Dreambound
providers.description: Dreambound is a career and technical education marketplace that helps job seekers discover, compare, and enroll in vocational training programs across healthcare, technology, business, and the skilled trades. The platform aggregates thousands of schools and hundreds of programs, letting students filter by location, schedule, format (online, hybrid, or in person), and price, with enrollment coaches guiding them into certifications such as certified nursing assistant, medical billing, phlebotomy, and sterile processing. The service is free for students and monetizes through schools and workforce partners who list and advertise their programs. Backed by Union Square Ventures, Collaborative Fund, and 8VC, Dreambound is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Dusty Robotics
providers.description: Dusty Robotics is a construction-technology company building automated layout robotics for the building trades. Its flagship product, the FieldPrinter, is a mobile robot that prints digital BIM models and design drawings directly onto the jobsite floor at full scale, laying out walls, penetrations, and other design intent so field teams build to plan with far less manual measurement and rework. The FieldPrinter platform ingests drawings from tools like Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD via native plugins, translating the digital model into precise physical markings on the deck. Dusty Robotics is headquartered in Mountain View, California and is backed by investors including Canaan Partners. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its published surfaces are the product site, a partner program, a support center, and the Dusty Academy training resource.

providers.name: Englease Technologies SPV Ltd
providers.description: Englease is an online English language learning platform serving students across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, founded by Omar Shihan and headquartered in Dubai Internet City, UAE. The platform blends live classes running 16 hours a day across all seven days, self-paced on-demand courses, pronunciation and practice tools, and conversation clubs, with proficiency-based learning paths from beginner to advanced and UK-accredited certifications. Englease serves individuals, corporations, schools, and specific industries including hospitality, call centers, retail, banking, and healthcare. Englease Technologies SPV Ltd is a portfolio company of 500 Global, added to the API Evangelist network for tracking. The consumer product is delivered through a web/app experience; no public developer API surface has been identified.

providers.name: Formality
providers.description: Formality is a Paris-based AI platform for end-to-end asset and contract intelligence, aimed at businesses that need to centralize, understand, and track their legal, administrative, and asset-related documents. The product covers the full contract lifecycle: AI-assisted creation and collaborative negotiation, electronic signature, then post-signature data extraction, deadline and obligation alerts, and natural-language analysis of the resulting document estate. Its AI is trained on corporate legal documents, works across multiple languages, and runs inside a secure perimeter with full auditability and no use of customer data for model training. Formality integrates with tools including Google Drive, SharePoint, DocuWare, Docusign, Universign, Yousign, HubSpot, Salesforce, Outlook, Teams, Slack, and Gmail, and runs on compliant hosting with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certifications and GDPR compliance. It was founded in 2023 and is backed by Partech, Serena, and Bpifrance.

providers.name: FundMiner
providers.description: FundMiner is a fund management and donor stewardship platform for mission-driven organizations, giving universities, healthcare systems, and community foundations one place to manage the full fund lifecycle. It combines fund management with compliance monitoring, impact and donor reporting, and a branded donor portal that gives donors real-time visibility into how their gifts are used. The platform integrates with existing financial systems and offers role-based dashboards and access controls. FundMiner is a Techstars-backed company; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or API reference at this time, so this profile captures its public identity and web presence.

providers.name: Getsona
providers.description: Getsona (Sona) is an AI-powered workforce management platform that helps large, multi-site organizations make better workforce decisions across forecasting, scheduling, time and attendance, HR, and payroll. Marketed as "AI for better workforce decisions," Sona serves enterprises in hospitality, hotels, care, retail, and logistics, with customers including Popeyes UK, Paul Bakery, Salutem Healthcare, and Liaise. The platform pairs operational scheduling with an enterprise app builder (Sona Forge) and a catalog of integrations, but as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, SDKs, webhooks, or developer portal. Getsona is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Felicis.

providers.name: Gomultiply
providers.description: Multiply (gomultiply.com) is an AI-native paid media agency for B2B companies that combines proprietary self-learning advertising AI with human growth strategists. The platform plugs into a customer's sales calls and CRM data to learn why buyers actually convert, then uses 25+ specialized AI agents (customer insights, keyword, creative design, A/B testing, bidding, and attribution) to generate, launch, and continuously optimize hundreds of personalized ad experiments across Google and LinkedIn. Founded by Matt Jayson (formerly Google and Brex) and Ashish Warty (formerly SVP Engineering at HackerOne, Dropbox, and Airship), Multiply emerged from stealth with $9.5M led by Mayfield and reports 300-500% increases in sales meetings booked and pipeline generated for its B2B customers.

providers.name: Grove
providers.description: Grove (Grove Collaborative) is a direct-to-consumer retailer of everyday household essentials for a healthier home and planet, including eco-friendly cleaning products, bamboo paper products, personal care, and vitamins & supplements sourced from hundreds of vetted brands alongside its own private labels. Orders are held to strict ingredient standards, are carbon neutral, and support plastic-waste cleanup. The business runs as a subscription-friendly e-commerce storefront (hosted on Shopify). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; Grove operates a consumer retail storefront and publishes no public developer API, so this profile captures its identity and web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Guild
providers.description: Guild (formerly Guild Education) is an education benefits and career opportunity platform that partners with large employers to fund and administer workforce education, upskilling, and career-mobility programs for their frontline and hourly employees. Employers offer Guild as a benefit; employees access a curated marketplace of degrees, certificates, bootcamps, English-language, and professional-skilling programs from vetted learning providers, plus coaching and career navigation to move into higher-demand roles. Guild is a B2B/B2B2C SaaS platform sold to enterprise HR and talent-development teams to fill critical roles, improve retention, increase internal mobility, and prove measurable ROI. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Guild is a venture-backed company. This profile was surfaced from investor portfolios and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Guild publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Helio AI LLC
providers.description: Helio AI LLC operates Helio.AI, an AI-powered recruiting and applicant tracking (ATS) platform for HR and talent-acquisition teams. It automates the end-to-end hiring workflow — job posting and distribution, resume screening, candidate tracking, real-time analytics, and team collaboration — and pairs the ATS with a gamified personality test to evaluate candidates. The product is offered in multiple languages (English, Russian, Georgian, Armenian, Azerbaijani, and Uzbek) and targets markets across Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, and Uzbekistan. Helio AI is backed by 500 Global. The company runs its customer application at app.helio-ai.com and does not currently publish a public developer API program or documentation.

providers.name: Hobnob
providers.description: Hobnob is a consumer event and community-organizing platform (hobnob.app) for iOS, Android, and web. It lets people create custom video and photo invitations, deliver them by text message, track RSVPs, sell tickets, run sign-up lists, time polls, and announcements, and coordinate private group "Spaces" for chat and content sharing. Built on a Hawaii-inspired philosophy of real-world connection over engagement-maximizing social media, Hobnob reports 20 million invitations sent, roughly 35,000 events per month, 650,000 Spaces created, and 90,000+ five-star reviews. It is a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio company. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Identiq
providers.description: Identiq operates a privacy-preserving, peer-to-peer identity validation network that lets member companies confirm a customer is already known and trusted by other members without any party sharing, exposing, or centralizing personal data. Its patented anonymized protocol keeps identity data encrypted inside each member's own environment while answering cross-network trust queries in real time. Products include customer identification, sign-up validation, risk-based onboarding, payment optimization, and trust & safety, serving travel, e-commerce, ticketing, fintech, telco, and marketplace verticals. Identiq is a cybersecurity company backed by Insight Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; it publishes a public trust center but no public developer API.

providers.name: Instil
providers.description: Instil is a purpose-built fundraising CRM and revenue-intelligence platform for nonprofit organizations, built for major-gifts and development teams. It manages the full donor lifecycle across major gifts, capital campaigns, planned giving, grant tracking, and moves management, and layers AI on top with One-Click Briefings that assemble a constituent's giving history and contact record on demand and Voice AI Logging that transcribes calls and writes interactions back to Instil or Salesforce. Instil connects to the nonprofit tech stack through Salesforce, Stripe, Classy, Mailchimp, Constant Contact, Eventbrite, Google, Outlook, and Zapier. It is backed by Threshold Ventures. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published at this time; integrations are delivered through packaged connectors and Zapier.

providers.name: Instruct
providers.description: Instruct ("AI that works for you") is an AI automation platform that lets non-technical users delegate repetitive work across their connected applications. Users describe a task in natural language and Instruct's AI pulls context from one integrated app, acts on it in another, and can turn any successful one-off task into a recurring scheduled workflow, spanning use cases across education, recruiting, sales, and operations. It is a hosted end-user application with a free plan and Google/email sign-up. As of this profile Instruct does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. Instruct is backed by Creandum.

providers.name: iovation
providers.description: iovation is a device-intelligence and online fraud-prevention service acquired by TransUnion in 2018 and now delivered as TransUnion TruValidate Device Risk (the SDK was formerly branded "FraudForce"). It fingerprints web and mobile devices into an encrypted "blackbox," evaluates it against a shared reputation database of billions of devices plus configurable rulesets, and returns a transaction risk assessment. Device data is collected client-side with first-party JavaScript and native iOS/Android SDKs; server-side integration is a SOAP CheckTransactionDetails call over HTTPS. iovation is used for account takeover, new-account fraud, payment fraud, and bot detection.

providers.name: Juno Chat
providers.description: Juno (junocompanion.com), operated by SharedGenes, Inc., is a Y Combinator-backed (P26) consumer digital-health startup building an AI personal health assistant for the 1B+ people living with chronic illness. The Juno mobile app (iOS and Android) builds a longitudinal health profile through conversation, biometrics, and medical history to deliver personalized symptom guidance, automated symptom tracking by text or voice, trigger-pattern identification, and appointment-ready reports for clinicians. It supports conditions including fibromyalgia, long COVID, POTS, ME/CFS, EDS, endometriosis, lupus, and MS, and is informed by research from Oxford and UCL plus 1,000+ patient interviews. Founded in 2025 by Marshall Gould (CEO) and Isaac Tolley (CTO); HIPAA-aligned infrastructure with no health data sold. Juno is a consumer app and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Kidas
providers.description: Kidas is a Techstars-backed trust-and-safety company that builds white-label scam detection and online-protection solutions for enterprises and consumers. Its ProtectMe platform monitors PC gaming and Discord voice and text channels for cyberbullying, predators, phishing, and scams, and its broader suite adds SMS scam detection, email protection, a scam-screening chatbot, and deepfake/impersonation defense that integrate into existing customer channels. Kidas markets custom builds and lists Aura, Comcast, Overwolf, Razer, Walmart, Intel, and Best Buy among its customers. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Kingsware
providers.description: Kingsware (Zhuhai Kingsware Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd. / 珠海金智维人工智能股份有限公司) is a leading Chinese enterprise AI and RPA solutions provider that builds "AI digital employees" and enterprise-grade agent platforms by fusing large language models, AI algorithms, and robotic process automation with vertical industry workflows. Its core products are the K-APA intelligent process automation (RPA) platform and the Ki-Agent enterprise agent platform (built around a "Supervised Agent" model with task planning, tool calling, multi-agent collaboration, and result verification), exposed through the Kingsware AI Open Platform (ai.kingsware.cn). The company serves finance, government, manufacturing, energy, telecom, education, HR, and finance/operations use cases; it has been recognized by IDC as the number-one China RPA+AI solution vendor by market share, counts all six major state-owned banks and 1,300+ enterprise/government customers, has deployed over 1.8 million AI digital employees, and is a national-level "little giant" (专精特新) enterprise. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Layer
providers.description: Layer is a living digital art platform that curates code-based generative artwork and ultra-high-resolution video art for everyday display. Its developer surface is an artist-facing, first-party TypeScript SDK (a browser global, $layer) that lets creators declare customizable parameters, register a canvas for screenshot capture, and supply generated video previews back to Layer Studio, alongside published guidelines for generative and Ultra Res artwork. Layer is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Emergence Capital, added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from its public developer documentation. Layer exposes a client-side SDK rather than a public REST/HTTP API.

providers.name: Linc'well
providers.description: Linc'well, Inc. (株式会社Linc'well) is a Tokyo-based healthcare technology company founded in January 2018 whose stated mission is to take healthcare one step further through technology. It operates a healthcare platform that connects medical professionals with patients across online and offline care, organized into three business lines: a telehealth platform licensed to medical institutions, where patients complete everything from booking to consultation on web, smartphone, or tablet, pay by credit card or pay-later, and have medication delivered or dispensed at a local pharmacy; a Smart Clinic clinic-DX service that digitizes core primary-care operations including appointment booking, medical intake, payment, and medical record entry; and a healthcare e-commerce business covering cosmetics, contact lenses, over-the-counter medicines, online medication guidance, and prescription dispensing. Linc'well runs the CLINIC FOR clinic brand and the miteme commerce and pharmacy properties, and is backed by DCM Ventures. It publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; integration is a commercial arrangement with medical institutions.

providers.name: Luzia
providers.description: Luzia is a consumer-facing artificial intelligence assistant serving 85M+ users across web, iOS, Android, desktop, and WhatsApp, with a strong presence in Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking markets where it ranks as the #1 app in several countries. The free assistant offers AI chat, image generation, PDF understanding, web search, and an agentic "LuziClaw" task mode, with a Luzia+ premium subscription adding advanced reasoning, custom AI characters, and higher generation limits. Luzia is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures. As of this enrichment pass, Luzia publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Massive Bio
providers.description: Massive Bio is an AI-powered healthcare company that matches cancer patients with clinical trials. Its platform analyzes 500+ medical data elements — diagnosis, genomic profile, and clinical history — to deliver personalized trial-match reports within 24 hours, connecting patients, physicians, pharmaceutical sponsors, and research institutions. Products include a patient-facing matching service, the Trial Relay physician screening and referral tool, and iOS/Android mobile apps. The company reports 200,000+ registered patients and coverage of 19,000+ active oncology and hematology trials across multiple international markets. Massive Bio does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Matera
providers.description: Matera is a French proptech company providing a digital platform for condominium management (syndic de copropriété), rental property management (gestion locative), and real estate transactions. Founded in Paris, Matera lets co-owners self-manage their buildings with software backed by 200+ in-house accountants, lawyers, and works experts, plus embedded services such as building insurance, legal protection, and a Treezor-powered payment account. It serves 150,000+ co-owners across France and is a certified B Corporation.

providers.name: MaxLinear
providers.description: MaxLinear, Inc. (NASDAQ: MXL) is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Carlsbad, California that designs radio-frequency (RF), high-performance analog, and mixed-signal communications systems-on-chip (SoCs) for critical network infrastructure, the connected home, and industrial and multi-market applications. Its products integrate RF, analog, mixed-signal, digital signal processing, security engines, data compression, networking, and power management into single chips that power cable and fiber broadband modems, Wi-Fi 6/7 and wireline home routers, optical transceivers, 4G/5G base-station and backhaul infrastructure, and high-speed data-center interconnects. MaxLinear exposes developer surface primarily as hardware/firmware SDKs and C APIs (for example the Panther Storage Acceleration SDK and the MxL890x Raw Acceleration API) delivered with its silicon, along with design tools, simulation models, and a technical documentation library — it does not publish a public web/REST API. This profile was surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Minersai
providers.description: MinersAI applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to geoscience data for mineral exploration, mining operations, public geological authorities, and mining & minerals investors. Founded and run by geologists (CEO Tomi de Lophem, CTO Mason Dykstra) and backed by Speedinvest and the Creative Destruction Lab, MinersAI structures, cleans, QCs, feature-engineers, and standardizes geochemical, geophysical, and remote-sensing datasets, then applies anomaly detection, heatmap generation, dimensionality reduction, and geostatistical interpolation to surface high-potential exploration targets. Its "geologists-in-the-loop" approach keeps domain experts central rather than replacing their expertise. The platform is delivered as a gated web application (app.minersai.com); there is no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Mubit
providers.description: Mubit is a temporary storage and logistics service based in Guadalajara, Mexico, offering on-demand collection, climate-controlled warehousing, digital photo inventory, and delivery for both individuals and businesses. Customers pay only for the space they use, with free pickup and drop-off, optional professional packing, and 24/7 CCTV-monitored facilities across three warehouses (Colli, Tijera, and Casuarina). Backed by 500 Global and Techstars, the company reports 4,000+ customers and a 4.9-star Google rating, and operates a mobile/web customer portal at clientes.mubit.co for scheduling pickups and deliveries and viewing stored items. Mubit publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: NerdWallet
providers.description: NerdWallet is a personal finance company that helps consumers make smarter money decisions across credit cards, banking, investing, loans, mortgages, insurance, and taxes. Through its website and mobile apps it offers comparison tools, product marketplaces, educational content, and free credit-score monitoring. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Francisco, NerdWallet is publicly traded (NASDAQ: NRDS) and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of ivp. As of this enrichment pass NerdWallet publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or well-known API discovery surface; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nexus AI
providers.description: Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as "Nexus AI", a 500 Global portfolio lead, but its recorded domain conceptdrop.com now permanently redirects (301) to hiresource.io — the site of Source (formerly ConceptDrop), a freelance creative-talent management platform. Source lets teams find, vet, and manage freelance designers, writers, animators, and consultants through a single contract with a dedicated account manager, replacing traditional creative-agency procurement. The customer application lives at app.hiresource.io; the public site is a WordPress marketing property. During enrichment no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface was found — this remains a non-API company profile.

providers.name: Novus
providers.description: Novus (operating as SEI Novus) is a portfolio intelligence and investment analytics platform for institutional investors — endowments, foundations, sovereign wealth funds, family offices, pension funds, and asset managers. The platform provides manager monitoring, performance analysis, risk assessment, attribution, and reporting across public and private markets at the position, fund, and portfolio level, along with data integration and maintenance services. Originally venture-backed (Index Ventures among its investors), Novus was acquired by SEI and now operates as SEI Novus. It has been recognized as Best Portfolio Management Vendor (Family Wealth Report Awards) and Best Multi-Asset Class Portfolio Management System (PAM Awards). No public developer API is currently published on its website.

providers.name: Numan
providers.description: Numan (trading as Vir Health Limited) is a UK-based digital healthcare and telemedicine company offering convenient, clinician-led care direct to consumers. Its services span weight-loss programmes (including GLP-1 medications such as Mounjaro and Wegovy), men's health (erectile dysfunction, hair loss, testosterone), women's health (menopause support), at-home blood tests and diagnostics, supplements, and one-off doctor consultations, delivered through its website and iOS/Android app. Numan is regulated by the Care Quality Commission and operates a GPhC-licensed pharmacy. It is a portfolio company of Anthemis. As of this enrichment pass Numan publishes no public developer API, SDKs, MCP server, or partner integration surface.

providers.name: One Month
providers.description: One Month is an online coding education platform that teaches beginners practical software and web development skills through short, project-based video courses designed to be completed in about a month. Its catalog spans programming languages and frameworks such as Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, JavaScript, HTML & CSS, SQL, and WordPress, alongside professional skills like project management, using a "watch, do, repeat" methodology of hands-on lessons and follow-along projects. One Month markets itself to career changers and non-programmers looking to accelerate into technical roles, and publishes a supporting blog of programming tutorials and career guidance. It is a consumer-facing learning product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or webhooks. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Onefinestay
providers.description: Onefinestay is a British luxury hospitality company founded in 2009 that curates and manages a portfolio of upmarket private homes, villas, apartments and chalets for short-term and extended vacation rentals, pairing hand-picked properties with hotel-grade concierge service. AccorHotels acquired Onefinestay in 2016 for around $168 million; in 2025 Exclusive Resorts took a controlling operational stake while Accor retained a majority interest. Onefinestay operates as a consumer travel brand with a booking website and a technical/engineering organization on GitHub, but it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK program, or developer portal. This profile is maintained as a network company record.

providers.name: OneShield
providers.description: OneShield Software provides core insurance platform solutions for property and casualty (P&C) insurers, managing general agents (MGAs), program administrators, and insurance startups. Its two platforms — OneShield Enterprise, a comprehensive cloud/SaaS core suite, and OneShield Market Solutions (OMS), a preconfigured SaaS offering — cover policy administration, billing, claims, rating, product configuration, relationship management, business intelligence, and analytics across more than 90 lines of business. OneShield exposes RESTful and SOAP integration services (XML/JSON) through its Services Designer and OMS API integration suite, but publishes no public developer portal or OpenAPI; API access is provisioned to customers and implementation partners. Headquartered in Marlborough, Massachusetts with offices in India, OneShield is backed by investors including Bain Capital and Earlybird Venture Capital.

providers.name: Onze
providers.description: Onze is a Brazilian fintech (São Paulo) focused on corporate private pension (previdência privada) and financial health for companies and their employees. It offers digital management of employer-sponsored pension plans, access to more than 300 investment funds, one-on-one financial consultations with specialists, and financial-education seminars, all delivered as a B2B employee benefits platform. Onze positions itself as the first fintech centered on pension and financial wellness for a company's collaborators, and is backed by Ribbit Capital. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass Onze publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: OurCrowd
providers.description: OurCrowd is a global private-market investment platform that gives accredited and institutional investors access to curated venture and alternative-asset deals. Through a single online account, members can invest in pre-vetted startups, thematic and targeted venture funds, and a range of alternatives such as private equity and private credit. The platform handles deal sourcing, due diligence, syndication, and post-investment management. OurCrowd is a consumer-facing investment product and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public identity and web surface.

providers.name: Outtake
providers.description: Outtake is an AI-powered digital risk protection (DRP) platform that autonomously detects and dismantles digital threats — brand impersonation, executive impersonation, fake domains, fraudulent ads, and dark-web activity — across 100+ platforms. Its agentic system combines an Entity Registry, Agentic Search, a Digital Reservoir of contextual intelligence, threat graphing / narrative intelligence, and adaptive takedown workflows to remove threats in hours rather than weeks. The company reports a 99.4% takedown-confirmation rate and a 14.4-hour average resolution time. Backed by CRV and ICONIQ Capital.

providers.name: Overview
providers.description: Overview (overview.ai) builds AI-powered machine vision systems for manufacturing quality control. Its edge-computing platform runs vision transformer models directly on smart cameras with on-device NVIDIA GPUs to perform automated defect detection, assembly verification, and real-time inspection without cloud dependency. Overview serves connector, semiconductor, packaging, automotive, pharmaceutical, aerospace, renewable energy, food, and textile manufacturers, and integrates with factory-floor systems (PLCs, ERPs, SCADA) over MQTT and digital I/O rather than a public REST API. Backed by GV and Homebrew. Profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pallet
providers.description: Pallet builds an AI-powered logistics workforce: autonomous AI agents that automate supply chain operations for freight brokerages, freight forwarders, FTL and LTL carriers, warehouses, and shippers. Its agents handle end-to-end workflows from quoting through order entry, track-and-trace, billing, and customer service, integrating with existing TMS, WMS, email, and legacy applications. The Atlas product surfaces revenue opportunities across freight operations. Pallet is backed by Bain Capital Ventures and General Catalyst. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Pandai
providers.description: Pandai is a Malaysian education technology company founded in 2020 that operates a digital learning platform for primary and secondary school students. The app aligns to Malaysia's national curriculum (DSKP) across KSSR Years 1-6 and KSSM Forms 1-5, including SPM exam preparation, and helps learners improve their grades through interactive quizzes, tests, exams, topical practice, notes, flashcards, videos, and live tutoring. Features include personalized assessments, an AI-powered revision assistant (Ask Pbot), gamified learning with battles, leaderboards and rewards, and performance tracking via scorecards and report cards. Pandai is a consumer-facing learning app and does not publish a public developer API surface; this profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Phind
providers.description: Phind was an AI answer engine and coding assistant built for developers, offering conversational, multi-step technical search on the web and through a VS Code extension. Founded in 2022 by Michael Royzen and Justin Wei (Y Combinator S22), Phind trained its own code models and briefly held the top-ranked open-source coding model on Hugging Face. The phind.com product was a consumer/subscription service and never shipped an official public or partner developer API - the only genuinely public developer artifacts were its open-weight models on Hugging Face (Phind-CodeLlama-34B v1/v2, Python-v1, and later Phind-70B). Community "Phind API" projects on GitHub and RapidAPI are unofficial reverse-engineered wrappers, not an official interface. Phind shut down on January 16, 2026; Pro subscribers received prorated refunds and could export chat history through January 30, 2026 before servers were wiped. This entry is a historical record; API surfaces are modeled, not officially documented.

providers.name: Pi Health
