providers.description: Pi Health is an AI-native clinical trial technology company and contract research organization (CRO) building FICS, a unified operating system for oncology and global clinical trials. Its platform consolidates traditionally fragmented systems — Electronic Data Capture (EDC), Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), electronic Trial Master File (eTMF), electronic Investigator Site File (eISF), and an EMR-to-EDC Orchestrator — into a single AI-validated master record spanning study startup through closeout. Pi Health pairs the platform with CRO services and a global research network with oncology sites across the US, Brazil, Australia, and India. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this remains an identity profile in the API Evangelist network awaiting a public API.

providers.name: Primary
providers.description: Primary (Primary Kids, Inc.) is a direct-to-consumer children's apparel brand selling simple, slogan-free, mix-and-match clothing "in all colors, for all kids" — babies through age 14, plus adult sizes, swimwear, school uniforms and licensed Sesame Street collaborations. The company operates a Shopify-hosted online store at primary.com and is a portfolio company of Homebrew. Primary has no first-party developer API, but its storefront is agent-accessible: it serves a live hosted Shopify Storefront MCP server (catalog search, product lookup, cart, checkout, policy/FAQ lookup) and exposes Shopify's Customer Account API (OAuth2/OIDC) for customer-scoped operations, along with a published llms.txt agent-instructions document.

providers.name: Prisms VR
providers.description: Prisms VR (Prisms) is an educational technology company building what it calls the world's first spatial learning platform, where students learn core math, science, and other subjects by abstracting up from immersive, first-person physical experiences delivered in virtual reality. Founded by MIT engineer-turned-educator Anurupa Ganguly, the teacher-facing platform uses kinesthetic, embodied learning to help students grasp abstract concepts and aims to develop curious, resilient thinkers. Prisms is an a16z portfolio company; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead and profiled through the enrichment pipeline. As of this pass the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface.

providers.name: Qeen.AI
providers.description: Qeen.AI is an AI-powered digital marketing ecosystem for e-commerce brands across the GCC and wider MENA region. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in the UAE, the company pairs machine learning with human marketing expertise to run strategy, paid-media execution, creative production, and continuous optimization on a performance basis (no retainers, commission starting at 5% of generated revenue). Its founding team includes former Google and DeepMind researchers, and it has raised roughly $12M, including backing from Prosus Ventures. Qeen.AI operates a customer application at app.qeen.ai but does not currently publish a public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: RB2B
providers.description: RB2B is a US-focused B2B website visitor identification platform that resolves anonymous web traffic into person-level leads — names, LinkedIn profiles, hashed and plaintext business emails, mobile ad IDs, and full business profiles — and pushes them to sales, marketing, and ad-tech systems. The product is delivered as a JavaScript pixel plus a knowledge- base and pipeline of 50+ destination integrations (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, HubSpot, Clay, Zapier, Apollo, Customer.io, Demandbase, and others), with global company-level identification and US-only person- level resolution. RB2B operates a separate API Partner Program at api.rb2b.com that exposes credit-metered Identification endpoints (IP → HEM, IP → MAID, IP → Company Domain) and Enrichment endpoints (HEM → LinkedIn, HEM → Business Profile, HEM → MAID, LinkedIn → Email, LinkedIn → Phone, Email → LinkedIn, Email → MAID) for SaaS developers, GTM engineers, retailers, and ad-tech platforms that want to embed identity resolution into their own apps and identity graphs. The platform is SOC 2 Type II certified.

providers.name: Red Access
providers.description: Red Access (redaccess.io) is a cloud-based enterprise browsing and Secure Service Edge (SSE) security platform delivering agentless, browser-native protection — Zero Trust browsing, DLP, SWG, CASB, EDR-for-the-browser and GenAI security governance — without network rewrites or endpoint agents. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners and headquartered in New York, it was named a Leader in the 2025 GigaOm Radar for Secure Enterprise Browsing. As of this enrichment pass Red Access publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface; this profile carries the company identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Reiner.ai
providers.description: Reiner.ai (operated by AI Mapping GmbH of Cologne, Germany) is a construction- and planning-industry AI platform for architects, engineers, and planners. It combines leading LLMs with domain-specific "Reiner Knowledge" and "Reiner Logic" layers to deliver Reiner Chat, task-specific KI-Agenten (AI agents) for site protocols, explanatory reports and project applications, company-knowledge integration, and a library of 50+ prebuilt construction prompts. The product is delivered as a hosted web application (app.reiner.ai); as of this enrichment pass there is no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Repertoire Immune Medicines
providers.description: Repertoire Immune Medicines is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotechnology company (with a site in Schlieren, Switzerland) building immune medicines grounded in the human T cell repertoire. Its proprietary DECODE platform characterizes the immune synapse by identifying T cell receptor (TCR) and antigen (peptide-MHC) pairs together with T cell function and HLA presentation, and uses that map to rationally design treatments across oncology, autoimmune disease, and infectious disease. Backed by Flagship Pioneering and SoftBank Vision Fund, the company was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It publishes no public developer API; its only public technical surface is a small research GitHub organization.

providers.name: Robco
providers.description: RobCo is a Munich- and Austin-based industrial robotics company building software-defined, modular robotic automation delivered as Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) with zero upfront capital expenditure. Its modular robot arms (up to 8 axes, 40 kg payload, 2.5 m reach, 0.1 mm repeatability), the Alfie autonomous robot, the RobFlow no-code programming platform, RobCo Studio configuration and simulation tooling, and the RobVision AI vision system let manufacturers automate machine tending, palletizing, materials handling, and finishing tasks. RobCo serves manufacturing, food and beverage, logistics, automotive, wood, and defense customers, and is backed by Lightspeed, Sequoia Capital, Lingotto, Kindred Capital, and Promus Ventures.

providers.name: SambaTV
providers.description: Samba TV is a media and advertising intelligence company that measures television and streaming viewership across screens using data collected from millions of opted-in smart TVs and connected devices. Its platform gives advertisers, agencies, and publishers cross-screen audience targeting, campaign measurement, and content analytics built on privacy-first, deterministic viewing signals rather than cookies or traditional identifiers. Samba TV operates a gated partner portal (developer.samba.tv, which redirects to partner-portal.tvp.samba.tv) for licensed data partners; as of this enrichment pass it does not publish an open, public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: Scalarr
providers.description: Scalarr is an AI-powered cybersecurity company that builds machine-learning and neural-network detection systems to protect businesses from fraud and cyber threats in real time. Its Protection Suite detects and blocks mobile ad fraud on behalf of user-acquisition teams and mobile marketers, distinguishing fraudulent installs and in-app events from genuine ones, while its AI EdgeLabs product extends the same detection approach to edge and IoT cybersecurity. Scalarr is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing site, blog, and product pages but exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: SEI Investments
providers.description: SEI Investments Company (NASDAQ: SEIC) is a publicly traded financial services and technology provider founded in 1968 and headquartered in Oaks, Pennsylvania. SEI delivers end-to-end technology, operations, and asset management solutions to asset managers, banks and wealth managers, financial advisors, and institutional investors. Marquee platforms include the SEI Wealth Platform (front-to-back wealth management technology and outsourced operations), SEI Data Cloud (managed near-real-time data platform), SEI Sphere (managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud, and network operations), and SEI Novus (institutional portfolio analytics). SEI does not run a public developer portal — partner and client integrations are delivered through contractual onboarding to the SEI Wealth Platform, SEI Connect advisor channels, and managed-service engagements rather than self-serve OpenAPI or SDK distribution.

providers.name: Sensors Data
providers.description: Sensors Data (神策数据) is a customer data analytics and CDP (Customer Data Platform) company. Its platform unifies customer data across channels into real-time customer profiles and provides product analytics, user profiling, marketing and ad attribution, A/B testing, and smart-operations tooling. Sensors Data processes 250+ billion data points daily, ships 50+ data-collection SDKs across web, mobile, mini-program and server-side languages, and serves 2,000+ enterprise customers with both cloud and on-premise deployment. An OpenAPI is exposed for ecosystem integration.

providers.name: Sentisis Analytics
providers.description: Sentisis (Sentisis Intelligence) is a Spanish-language AI consumer-intelligence and sentiment-analysis platform that turns social media conversations, surveys, emails, and online reviews into actionable business insight using proprietary natural-language-processing built for Spanish and its regional variants. Products span Social Media listening, Customer Experience analytics, Reviews analysis, and sector consulting, serving brands such as Vodafone, Santander, Bancolombia, ALDI, Iberdrola, and Sony Pictures from offices in Madrid, Bogota, and Mexico City. The company was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and a domain security probe.

providers.name: Siolla
providers.description: Siolla is a Saudi financial-technology company offering a consumer investment-management mobile application. It provides professionally managed, fully Sharia-compliant investment portfolios, an in-app academy and educational resources covering financial fundamentals, budgeting and investment strategy, and simplified access to investing for modern investors. Siolla is licensed and regulated by the Saudi Capital Market Authority. The company presents a consumer app and website only; no public developer program, API, or developer documentation is published at this time.

providers.name: SiteAware
providers.description: SiteAware is the construction industry's first AI-powered Digital Construction Verification and Quality Management Platform for buildings. It verifies every installed element and flags real-time deviations across structure, envelope, and interior construction, giving field teams and business executives actionable data and analytics to catch issues before they lead to expensive rework. SiteAware is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Smart Bricks Holdings Limited
providers.description: Smart Bricks Holdings Limited operates Smart Bricks, an AI-powered real estate investment platform that uses proprietary foundational models and autonomous agents to help retail and institutional investors discover, underwrite, execute, and monitor property deals globally. Backed by a16z, Google, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Techstars, and 500 Global, the company automates deal sourcing, risk modeling across 1,000+ variables per opportunity, diligence, documentation, and portfolio intelligence. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; Smart Bricks currently publishes a consumer and institutional web application but no public API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Startup Buffer
providers.description: Startup Buffer is a community-driven directory and platform for discovering new startups, products, and innovations across various industries. The platform offers startup submission, browsing, and discovery features through web and mobile applications.

providers.name: Startup Ranking
providers.description: Startup Ranking is a platform that tracks, ranks, and indexes startups worldwide based on web presence, social metrics, and growth signals. It provides startup discovery, competitive benchmarking, and market intelligence for investors, entrepreneurs, and researchers.

providers.name: Statespace
providers.description: Statespace is the company behind Aimlabs (aimlabs.com, formerly statespace.gg), the leading AI-powered aim-training platform for FPS gamers. Aimlabs delivers personalized training tasks, real-time performance analytics, and game-specific tools, serving over 40 million players and operating as an official partner of Valorant and Rainbow Six Siege. Statespace is venture-backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lux Capital. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer web/desktop product but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: StatMuse
providers.description: StatMuse is a natural-language search engine that answers sports and financial questions in plain English, returning instant stats, tables, and visual answers. It covers MLB, NBA, NFL, NHL, WNBA, PGA, college football, and soccer, along with StatMuse Money for stock-market and finance data. Users ask questions conversationally ("How many points did LeBron score last night?") and get sourced answers with charts and shareable cards. Backed by Techstars, the company is consumer-facing and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or programmatic access surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: Stitch Fix
providers.description: Stitch Fix is an online personal styling service that pairs data science and machine learning with expert human stylists to send customers curated shipments ("Fixes") of apparel, footwear, and accessories selected to their size, budget, and style preferences. Founded in 2011 and publicly traded (NASDAQ: SFIX), the company operates a direct-to-consumer retail model across womens, mens, and kids categories. Stitch Fix does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its engineering team shares its data-science and platform work through the Multithreaded technology blog and open-source projects on GitHub. This profile captures the company's public web, security, and engineering surfaces.

providers.name: Sunday Robotics
providers.description: Sunday Robotics is a consumer robotics company building Memo, an autonomous home robot that handles household chores such as clearing dishes, loading the dishwasher, pulling espresso shots, and folding laundry. The robot is trained on human demonstrations captured with the company's proprietary Skill Capture Glove and runs on the ACT family of robot foundation models. Founded as a physical-AI company and backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Sunday is pre-launch with a beta program opening in late 2026. As of this profile the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation; this record captures its public web and security surface only.

providers.name: swivl
providers.description: swivl is an AI automation platform built specifically for the self-storage industry. It combines a unified CRM and contact center that consolidates calls, texts, emails, and chats with AI agents for sales, billing, support, and review management, plus a tenant mobile app (Spot) for access codes, payments, and referrals. Its self-storage natural-language model is trained on hundreds of thousands of customer conversations and serves 3,500+ locations. Founded in New York City and backed by Techstars, swivl advertises open APIs and integrations with major self-storage management systems, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: SylloTips
providers.description: SylloTips is an enterprise AI platform, founded in Italy and backed by Techstars, that adds a continuous-improvement and reliability layer on top of RAG chatbots and planning agents. It captures a company's undocumented, expert knowledge through human-in-the-loop validation, turns validated expert answers into governed, reusable memory, and monitors AI agents for silent failures — confidently wrong answers, outdated citations, and unadmitted knowledge gaps — routing issues to the right experts. The platform is optimized for Microsoft 365, Azure, and enterprise identity, ships native connectors to existing tools and data systems, and integrates with 200+ apps via Zapier, AWS, and Pabbly Connect. SylloTips publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; integration is delivered through those connectors and its Microsoft 365 / Teams application rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Teamshares Inc
providers.description: Teamshares is a tech-enabled acquirer of small businesses that offers a permanent home for companies whose owners are retiring. It programmatically buys profitable companies with $0.5-5 million of EBITDA from retiring owners, integrates them onto the Teamshares operating platform of financial products, software, and education, and helps employees earn company stock through employee ownership. Backed by QED Investors and other fintech investors, Teamshares runs a login-gated operating platform (os.teamshares.com) for its portfolio companies plus an investor portal. As of this profile Teamshares publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Tenex
providers.description: Tenex is a PropTech platform for real estate and hospitality operators across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region, offering an all-in-one suite that unifies property management, tenant and landlord experience, facility and asset management, real estate accounting, VR for off-plan developments, and a hospitality guest experience app. Trusted across 500+ buildings and communities, it advertises integrations with ZATCA, SAP, Oracle, and Microsoft Dynamics to automate compliance and unify operations. Tenex is backed by 500 Global and the Sanabil 500 MENA Seed Accelerator. As of this enrichment pass no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface is published.

providers.name: Time is Ltd
providers.description: Time is Ltd. is a collaboration analytics company that turns workplace communication and productivity data into actionable insights for HR, sales, and operations teams. Its platform connects to tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, Salesforce, Webex, and Tableau to measure meetings, focus time, and collaboration patterns, then reports on team performance, employee engagement, and revenue outcomes. Backed by Accel and profiled in the API Evangelist network, Time is Ltd. exposes no public developer API; integrations are configured through its hosted analytics application rather than a documented REST or GraphQL surface.

providers.name: Vise
providers.description: Vise is an SEC-registered investment adviser that provides an AI-powered wealth management platform for financial advisors, RIAs, enterprise wealth firms, and asset managers. The platform helps advisors build personalized, tax-aware portfolios and supports direct indexing, fixed income management, long/short strategies, tax-loss harvesting, portfolio rebalancing, and client reporting, managing over $100B in platform assets across 135K+ accounts. Vise publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its public company, legal, and domain-security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vital Lyfe
providers.description: Vital Lyfe is a Torrance, California hardware company building portable water purification technology designed to scale where infrastructure cannot reach. Its flagship product, Access, is a portable watermaker that converts naturally occurring water, including saltwater, into clean drinking water through a simple place-a-hose, press-start, hydrate workflow. The company sells the Access device and branded gear through a direct-to-consumer Shopify storefront and publishes a mission, team, careers, and journal. It was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Vital Lyfe is a consumer-hardware and e-commerce brand with no public API, SDK, or developer program surface.

providers.name: Volteum
providers.description: Volteum provides fleet electrification and EV fleet management software that helps companies plan, execute, and operate the transition of their vehicle fleets to electric. The platform covers electrification planning, charging optimisation, and live fleet management, connecting directly to vehicles through OEM APIs across 30+ brands with no hardware installation to track mileage, fault codes, charging sessions, maintenance intervals, and costs across electric, diesel, petrol, and hybrid fleets. Volteum is a Techstars portfolio company and publishes no public developer portal; its telematics and fleet-system API integrations are offered to customers directly.

providers.name: Whova
providers.description: Whova is an award-winning all-in-one event management platform built around a mobile event app that carries the agenda, speaker profiles, attendee networking, live polls, and session Q&A, plus registration, ticketing, name badges, surveys, abstract/speaker management, and exhibitor/sponsor tools. Whova does NOT publish an open, self-serve developer API - there is no public developer portal, no documented REST reference, no OpenAPI definition, and no SDKs. Its only programmatic surface for organizers is a partner/CRM integration layer exposed through Zapier (triggers for attendee, order, and registrant changes plus a create/update-attendee action), reached from the organizer dashboard under Attendees > Integrations > CRM Integration, alongside prebuilt connectors to Eventbrite, Cvent, Constant Contact, RegFox, OpenReview, SharePoint/OneDrive, MailChimp, Wild Apricot, and Google Drive. The API entries below are logical, HONESTLY MODELED views of that integration surface (see endpointsModeled) - they are not sourced from a public Whova API reference, and no base URL, auth scheme, or endpoint paths are published by Whova.

providers.name: Wideframe
providers.description: Wideframe is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building an AI agent for video production that automates the work editors do outside the editing timeline. It searches, labels, organizes, and sequences raw footage across local filesystems and cloud storage, indexing large media libraries by meaning and outputting native, editable Adobe Premiere Pro (.prproj) sequences rather than synthetic video. Delivered as an Apple Silicon (M1+) desktop application, it targets brands, agencies, and professional editors who spend far longer preparing footage than actually cutting it. Wideframe currently ships as a consumer/product application with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: WSFS Financial
providers.description: WSFS Financial Corporation is a multibillion-dollar financial services company headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware. Its primary subsidiary WSFS Bank has operated since 1832, making it one of the oldest banks in the United States. As of March 31, 2026 the company reported $22.1 billion in assets and $97.6 billion in assets under management and administration across 114 offices in six states. Business lines include personal banking, small business and commercial banking, treasury management, WSFS Mortgage, WSFS Wealth Management, Bryn Mawr Trust (acquired 2022), WSFS Institutional Services, and the Cash Connect ATM-as-a-service business that provides cash logistics and vault cash to independent ATM operators. WSFS does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, or SDKs; all APIs are bilateral treasury / cash management integrations delivered through Enhanced Business Online Banking, ACH/wire file feeds, and the Cash Connect partner portal.

providers.name: Zzish
providers.description: Zzish is an EdTech company (a Techstars-backed startup) building a K-12 learning product suite used by teachers and students across 180 countries. Its flagship product, Quizalize, is a classroom quiz and formative-assessment platform; the portfolio also includes Blockerzz (a 3D game engine with quiz games and coding tutorials), Marvely.ai (AI-powered, exam-aligned language tutoring), Quizalize Insights (leadership dashboards for tracking academic progress), and QUAT (a customer-analytics platform for schools and EdTech partners). Zzish reports 250k+ teachers onboarded in the last two years and 250m+ questions answered since launch. As of this enrichment pass, Zzish publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer-documentation surface.

providers.name: 1QBit
providers.description: 1QB Information Technologies Inc. (1QBit) is a quantum computing software company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. It builds hardware-agnostic algorithms and software for optimization, simulation, and machine learning that run across quantum, quantum-inspired, and classical high-performance computing hardware, with work spanning computational finance, life sciences and quantum chemistry, materials, and telecommunications. 1QBit has hardware and platform partnerships with D-Wave, Fujitsu, IBM, and Microsoft Azure Quantum, and participates in DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI) on automated design tools for utility-scale quantum computation. The company markets a 1Qloud optimization platform whose own marketing page cites Python SDK, gRPC, and REST API interfaces, but as of August 2026 1QBit publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API contract — the former portal.1qbit.com host no longer resolves and access is arranged through industry partnerships. Its only public developer surface is a small GitHub organization of research code plus two first-party Python libraries on PyPI.

providers.name: Acerta
providers.description: Acerta (Acerta Analytics Solutions Inc.) is a Canadian industrial-AI company whose LinePulse platform delivers AI-driven manufacturing quality analytics for discrete manufacturing. Founded in 2017 in Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario, Acerta helps Tier-1 automotive and powertrain manufacturers detect defects early, reduce scrap and rework, and root-cause complex production issues in real time. LinePulse replaces statistical process control software, spreadsheets, and custom querying tools with real-time SPC, predictive monitoring, and machine-learning root-cause analysis, and ingests production data through a proprietary secure ingestion API. The platform is built on Microsoft Azure, is SOC 2 Type 1 certified, and is proven across 300+ production lines in 12 countries with customers including BorgWarner, Dana, Linamar, Ford, ZF, Ballard, and BMW. Acerta is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. Acerta exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, self-serve sign-up, or SDKs; integration is delivered through enterprise deployment with the LinePulse ingestion API.

providers.name: Adams Resources & Energy
providers.description: Adams Resources & Energy is a diversified energy company engaged in the marketing, transportation, terminalling, and storage of crude oil and other related petroleum products in select markets across the United States. Through its subsidiaries GulfMark Energy, Firebird Bulk Carriers, Phoenix Oil, and Victoria Express Pipeline, the company purchases approximately 90,000 barrels per day at the wellhead and operates over 260 tractor-trailers and 112 pipeline inventory locations. Adams Resources & Energy serves multiple U.S. petroleum basins including the Gulf Coast, Eagle Ford Shale, Permian Basin, Bakken Shale, and Michigan, with over $1 billion in annual revenues and 400+ employees.

providers.name: Antheia
providers.description: Antheia, Inc. is a Menlo Park, California synthetic-biology company that manufactures biosynthetic key starting materials (KSMs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for essential medicines. Founded on Christina Smolke's Stanford research, Antheia engineers yeast strains that reconstruct long, complex plant biosynthetic pathways and ferment sugar into molecules previously obtainable only through agricultural cultivation, compressing production timelines from years to weeks. Commercial products include fermentation-derived thebaine, oripavine and scopolamine, with a development pipeline of 70+ KSMs and APIs spanning neurology, gastrointestinal and oncology programs. NOTE FOR THE CATALOG: Antheia's "APIs" are Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, not web APIs — the company publishes no developer API, SDK, or machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: Aspora
providers.description: Aspora is a cross-border fintech serving the Non-Resident Indian (NRI) diaspora, offering money transfers from the USA, UK, and UAE to India at near-mid-market ("Google") rates, NRE/NRO bank account opening, and digital gold investing, with multi-currency savings, bill payments, and EMI/SIP automation on its roadmap. The company reports over 1 million users moving more than $2 billion, with proactive fraud detection, 256-bit encryption, and funds held at regulated institutions. Formerly known as Vance, Aspora is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a Greylock portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Aspora's public web surface (identity, links, and probed domain security).

providers.name: Athos
providers.description: Athos is a sports performance technology company founded in 2012 and based in Redwood City, California, that builds athletic apparel with embedded surface electromyography (EMG) sensors. Its garments and snap-on Athos Core module capture muscle activity, effort, and motion data, streaming it over Bluetooth to a mobile app and coaching dashboard so athletes, trainers, and sports scientists can measure muscular exertion, fatigue, and return-to-play readiness in real time. Athos is a consumer and team hardware brand with no publicly documented developer API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Atom Bank
providers.description: Atom Bank plc is a UK app-only digital bank headquartered in Newcastle upon Tyne, and the first mobile-only bank in the United Kingdom (no branches, no web banking). Authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FS Register 661960), Atom offers fixed savings accounts, residential and commercial mortgages, and secured business lending, all delivered through its iOS and Android apps. Atom does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; it is a consumer of UK Open Banking, letting customers share a one-off snapshot of their bank data (via aggregators such as Plaid, Tink and TrueLayer) to speed lending decisions. Backed by Anthemis and others, Atom runs a Go/Python/Java/Kafka technology stack and operates a four-day working week.

providers.name: Aurascape
providers.description: Aurascape is an AI-native security company (Santa Clara, CA) that gives enterprises real-time visibility, intent-based controls, and data protection for every AI interaction. Its AI-native cloud proxy sits inline to discover and monitor thousands of generative, embedded, and agentic AI applications across browsers, SaaS, copilots, and IDEs; classify and protect multimodal data (text, code, voice, video) in real time; and secure AI agents from development through production, including testing for prompt injection and data leakage and enforcing runtime guardrails through its Zero-Bypass MCP Gateway. Aurascape is a Menlo Ventures portfolio company profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Avantos
providers.description: Avantos is an AI-native operating system for client management in financial services, built for wealth management and advisory firms. The platform unifies client data, products, teams, and workflows into a knowledge graph that powers agentic onboarding, relationship intelligence, and an AI-powered servicing workspace where agents anticipate client needs and streamline operations. It integrates with existing CRMs, custodians, and core systems, and is SOC 2 compliant with enterprise-grade architecture. Avantos raised a $35M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, announced February 2026.

providers.name: Avarra
providers.description: Avarra is an AI-powered sales training and enablement platform that helps revenue teams onboard, coach, and certify sales representatives at scale. The platform turns real sales conversations into AI-driven role-play simulations, delivers personalized coaching feedback, standardizes sales methodology across teams and regions, and reports certification and performance analytics. Its workflow moves through five stages: Capture, Train, Practice, Certify, and Performance Insights, with the stated goal of cutting new-hire ramp time in half. Avarra is a Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio company. As of this profile Avarra publishes a marketing and product site but no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Axiom Space
providers.description: Axiom Space, Inc. is a privately funded American space infrastructure developer headquartered in Houston, Texas, founded in 2016 by Kam Ghaffarian and former NASA International Space Station Program Manager Michael Suffredini. The company is building Axiom Station, the world's first commercial space station and planned successor to the ISS, and has flown private astronaut missions to the ISS (Ax-1 through Ax-4). Axiom Space also develops the Axiom Extravehicular Mobility Unit (AxEMU) spacesuit for NASA's return to the lunar surface, and sells human spaceflight, microgravity research, in-space manufacturing, and Orbital Data Center services (in-orbit cloud compute, with the ODC T1 node built alongside Kepler Communications and Skyloom Global). As of this enrichment pass Axiom Space publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable API contract — every offering is transacted through direct enterprise, agency, and government engagement, and its only public code presence is a two-repository GitHub organization holding forks of NASA simulation software (Trick and GUNNS).

providers.name: AZmed
providers.description: AZmed is a Paris-based medical-imaging AI company whose Rayvolve AI Suite assists radiologists by automatically analyzing X-rays and other studies. Its applications include AZtrauma (fracture detection), AZchest (chest imaging), AZmeasure (anatomical measurements), AZboneage (bone-age assessment) and AZnod (CT nodule detection). The software integrates into existing radiology workflows rather than being exposed as a public developer API, and is deployed across 2,500+ healthcare centers in 55+ countries, analyzing over 15 million X-rays annually, backed by 10+ peer-reviewed publications. As of this profile AZmed does not publish a public REST API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Bechtel
providers.description: Bechtel is one of the largest privately held engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) companies in the world. Bechtel does not publish a public developer portal; technology integration is delivered through project-specific data exchanges with owners, joint-venture partners, and subcontractors, the Bechtel supplier portal, and industry-standard construction data exchange formats (IFC, COBie, CDE) over secure project-management platforms.

providers.name: Bitculator
providers.description: Modern cryptocurrency REST API providing programmatic read access to crypto market data including coins, prices, markets, exchanges, wallets, global market data, sentiment, indicators, liquidations, conversions, calculators, editorial content, alarms, and webhooks. Version 1.0.0 with 70+ endpoints across 15 groups.

providers.name: Bolsai
providers.description: Brazilian financial-market data REST API serving equities, real-estate funds (FIIs), fundamentals, dividends, financial statements, and macroeconomic series sourced from official feeds (B3, CVM, BCB).

providers.name: Brain Corp
providers.description: Brain Corp builds BrainOS, an autonomy platform that powers commercial service robots for floor care, inventory scanning, and remote site management across retail, warehouses, education, airports, malls, healthcare, and hospitality. The product portfolio includes the BrainOS Sense Suite, Clean Suite, ShelfOptix scanning-as-a-service, RFID localization, and remote site management tools. Brain Corp integrates with OEM partners and operators rather than offering a public developer portal, and does not publish open APIs.

providers.name: Candid Co.
providers.description: Candid Co. (candidco.com), operating today as CandidPro, is a New York-based dental-technology company that delivers custom clear aligners for teeth straightening. Founded in 2017 as a direct-to-consumer brand backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Greycroft, and e.ventures, Candid pioneered at-home impression kits and remote monitoring, and has since pivoted to a dentist-directed model: aligners are prescribed and overseen by a licensed dentist with orthodontist support and convenient virtual visits (CandidMonitoring). Candid handles the clinical treatment plan, 3D-printed aligner manufacturing, and patient communication for crowding and common bite misalignments. This is a consumer/health brand with no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, domain security posture, and commercial link properties.

providers.name: Carbon Direct
providers.description: Carbon Direct is a science-first carbon management company that pairs an enterprise carbon management platform with a team of 70+ scientists. The platform helps organizations measure emissions, set science-based targets, reduce, and procure high-quality carbon dioxide removal (CDR), with monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV) capabilities expanded through its 2025 acquisition of Pachama. Carbon Direct is an enterprise SaaS and advisory offering and does not publish a public developer API as of this profile.

providers.name: CEEZER
providers.description: CEEZER (CEEZER Software GmbH) is a Berlin-based climate-tech enterprise platform for the procurement and portfolio management of carbon credits, Energy Attribute Certificates (EACs), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel Certificates (SAFc). The platform gives corporate sustainability teams access to a marketplace of more than 10,000 global carbon projects with transparent pricing and volume data, a proprietary risk-assessment engine ("Prism") that evaluates hundreds of validated data points per project, and audit-ready reporting for net-zero and decarbonization commitments. CEEZER combines expert climate advisory with enterprise-grade technology to help buyers plan, procure, and manage climate performance assets. Surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; the company operates a customer-facing web application but does not publish a public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Clear Labs
providers.description: Clear Labs builds automated next-generation sequencing (NGS) platforms that combine laboratory robotics, cloud software, and bioinformatics to deliver genomic data and actionable insights. Its product lines span oncology research (Clear Dx), infectious-disease and microbial genomics (Clear Ix), and food-safety pathogen testing (Clear Safety) for organisms such as Listeria and Salmonella. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV, Menlo Ventures, and Wing Venture Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Clear Labs publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation as of this profile; the record captures company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Cleo
providers.description: Cleo is an AI-powered personal finance assistant delivered through a chat interface in iOS and Android apps. The platform helps consumers budget, track spending across linked bank accounts, set savings goals, and access features such as Cleo Wallet (savings), Cleo Cover (cash advance), and Cleo Builder (credit-building). Cleo connects to user bank accounts using Plaid for read-only transaction access and does not currently publish a public, third-party developer API.

providers.name: Cogni
providers.description: Cogni is a non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet and digital-asset management app that consolidates cash, crypto, and NFTs in a single mobile experience. Users hold their own private keys, back up their seed phrase to iCloud, manage assets across multiple blockchains and Layer 2 networks, store and view NFTs, and connect to web3 dApps directly from the app. Backed by Techstars, Cogni is a consumer-facing mobile product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI at this time; this profile captures its public web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Command Zero
providers.description: Command Zero, Inc. is an autonomous and AI-assisted security operations center (SOC) platform for enterprise security investigations. Founded in 2023, it applies "Governed AI" and a question-based investigation method to run complete investigations across identity, endpoint, email, cloud, and SaaS data sources — from initial alert through verdict — with every agent step logged, visible, auditable, and reproducible. Rather than a SOAR, SIEM, or XDR, it connects read-only to existing data sources via a federated data model (no ingestion, no data migration) and runs Tier-1 through Tier-3 triage, breach, phishing, malware, identity, insider-threat, incident-response, and threat-hunting workflows. The company reports 500K+ investigations completed, a 90% reduction in Tier-1 escalations, and 40%+ efficiency gains, and holds SOC 2 Type II. Command Zero is a portfolio company of a16z and Insight Partners; this profile was enriched from the provider's public website and llms.txt.

providers.name: dino.markets
providers.description: Real-time cross-venue sports prediction-market data. Matches the same game across Kalshi and Polymarket, computes live cross-venue arbitrage sized to fillable depth, and streams it via REST, WebSocket, and a native MCP server. Operated by Nusantara Ventures LLC. Not a broker; not financial advice.

providers.name: DiscoverCloud
providers.description: Discover the best SaaS solutions and B2B services on the DiscoverCloud. Our B2B marketplace features an ever-growing number of SaaS solutions and outsourced services. Operated by Chekkt Limited, DiscoverCloud aggregates crowd-sourced ratings and reviews across software categories including CRM, Project Management, Marketing Automation, Business Intelligence, eCommerce, Invoicing, Help Desk, and Security.

providers.name: Eleanor Health
providers.description: Eleanor Health is a value-based, whole-person addiction and mental health care provider delivering virtual and in-person treatment for substance use disorders — including opioid, alcohol, stimulant, and prescription drug use — through medication for addiction treatment (MAT), therapy, peer recovery support, and health coaching. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, the company partners with health plans and Medicaid programs across multiple U.S. states to deliver measurement-based, outcomes-driven behavioral healthcare. Eleanor Health is backed by General Catalyst. It does not publish a public developer API program; member scheduling and clinical records run on athenahealth, and its public GitHub organization holds internal engineering tooling rather than a first-party API.

providers.name: Enjoei
providers.description: Enjoei is a Brazilian online marketplace (brechó) for buying and selling new and pre-owned fashion, shoes, accessories, electronics, furniture, home goods, and collectibles. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Sao Paulo, it operates a peer-to-peer resale platform and mobile app ("enjuapp") that connects individual sellers and buyers, handling listings, payments, shipping, and buyer/seller protection. Enjoei is publicly traded on Brazil's B3 exchange (ticker ENJU3). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. No public developer API, MCP server, or SDKs were found during enrichment; this profile carries the consumer-facing identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: First Circle
providers.description: First Circle is a Philippine fintech offering digital business banking and non-collateral financing to small and medium enterprises. Its products include free online business bank accounts, business credit lines up to PHP 20M, same/next-day express business loans, longer-term Business Credit Plus, future salary access for employees, and solar financing. The company is 100% online with five-minute account opening and no branch visits, serves over 5,000 Filipino businesses, and has disbursed roughly PHP 16 billion in loans. It is licensed by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), with banking delivered through partner rural banks regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP). It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Fundly
providers.description: Fundly is a Mumbai-based fintech platform purpose-built for India's pharmaceutical retail supply chain, offering embedded credit, B2B commerce, and payment solutions to pharma retailers and distributors. Its lending product provides unsecured working capital with interest charged only for the period funds are actually drawn, alongside B2B commerce tooling and payment rails tailored to the cash-flow cycles of the pharma industry. Backed by Accel, Fundly distributes primarily through native iOS and Android apps and works with RBI-regulated lending partners. No public API, developer portal, or technical documentation is currently published; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Gabit
providers.description: Gabit is a one-stop health and wellness platform on a mission to add more healthy years to people's lives. Headquartered in Gurugram, India and founded in 2022 by Gaurav Gupta (ex-Zomato cofounder) and Arpana Shahi, Gabit treats health as an interconnected system across four pillars — fitness, nutrition, sleep, and mindfulness. Its consumer ecosystem spans the titanium Gabit Smart Ring, a smart body-composition scale, at-home Blood Work diagnostics, a continuous glucose monitor (CGM), the Sweden-born Näck nutrition supplement line, all-good-no-harm skincare, and coached Fitness & Nutrition Plans — all unified in the Gabit app, which tracks 150+ biomarkers and includes the free PEP AI health coach. India is the primary market, with Ring-only storefronts in the UAE and UK and an informational US/global page.

providers.name: Glow
providers.description: Glow (glowing.com) is a women's health and reproductive-health technology company whose consumer mobile apps track periods, ovulation, fertility, pregnancy, and early baby development for a community of more than 25 million members. Its app suite spans Glow (ovulation and fertility), Eve by Glow (period tracking), Glow Nurture (pregnancy), and Glow Baby (infant development), and it layers AI-powered health insights through GlowGPT along with a Glow Premium subscription and a companion Glow Shop for hardware such as basal thermometers, test strips, and a smart breast pump. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network, Glow is a consumer app business with no public developer program: no API portal, developer documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface could be located during enrichment.

providers.name: Grail
providers.description: GRAIL, Inc. is a healthcare company headquartered in Menlo Park, California, focused on detecting cancer early, when it can be cured. Its flagship product, the Galleri multi-cancer early detection (MCED) test, uses a single blood draw and methylation-based genomic sequencing to screen for a signal shared across more than 50 types of cancer, many of which lack any recommended screening today. GRAIL runs large clinical programs including the PATHFINDER, PATHFINDER 2, and NHS-Galleri studies, and distributes Galleri through health plans, employers, and partners such as Quest Diagnostics and Junction. GRAIL is a portfolio company of investors including GV and SV Angel. It does not publish a first-party public developer API; programmatic access to Galleri ordering is offered through third-party diagnostic infrastructure partners.

providers.name: HD
providers.description: HD is an AI-native healthcare marketplace and patient-navigation platform for emerging Southeast Asia, headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Its consumer surface, HDmall, is a health, dental, aesthetics, and surgery marketplace that lets patients compare transparent pricing and book online across 30,000+ services from 3,000+ clinics and hospitals in Thailand (hdmall.co.th) and Indonesia (hdmall.id). AI-powered navigation turns patient symptoms into personalized, safety-checked care recommendations, and HDcare adds human-led, AI-assisted concierge support for complex surgical cases. The platform has navigated over 500,000 patients. HD is a consumer-facing healthtech operator with no public developer API or portal; the strongest machine-readable surface it publishes today is an llms.txt guiding LLMs to its canonical content. HD is a portfolio company of Partech, added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment tracking.

providers.name: Helu Io
providers.description: helu.io is a financial management, controlling, and reporting platform for startups and small-to-medium businesses. It connects directly to DATEV accounting data (via a certified DATEVconnect interface) to produce automated, real-time financial reports, customizable dashboards and KPIs, budget vs. actuals comparisons, multi-entity consolidation, and planning, so finance teams can analyze, plan, and collaborate without manual spreadsheet work. The company is a portfolio company of Speedinvest and hosts data on German servers in compliance with DSGVO/GDPR. helu.io is a SaaS product; it does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI — its integrations are product-level (DATEV, plus data upload from HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Sheets, Excel, and Personio).

providers.name: Internet Brands
providers.description: Internet Brands is a KKR-owned digital media and software company, founded in 1998 and headquartered in El Segundo, California, that operates a portfolio of vertical franchises across health, dental, legal, and auto/home/travel markets. Its brands include WebMD and Medscape (health), WebMD Ignite and PulsePoint (health engagement), Henry Schein One and Dentrix (dental SaaS), FindLaw and Avvo (legal), and CarsDirect and Fodor's (auto, home, and travel). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and Redpoint Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. The holding company does not publish a single unified public developer API; developer surfaces live with its individual operating brands.

providers.name: Juno
providers.description: Juno is a Brazilian B2B payments fintech, acquired by EBANX in October 2021, that provides a complete billing and payments platform for Brazilian companies. Founded in 2014 in Maringá, Paraná, Juno powers more than 35,000 small and medium businesses with online sales and collections via Pix, boleto bancário, boleto_pix, and credit cards, plus marketplace payment split, recurring subscriptions, and a digital business account (Conta Juno) with Banking-as-a-Service capabilities. Juno is a participant of the Brazilian Interbank Payments Chamber (CIP). The company exposes a public REST API v2 through the Juno Developer Academy at integracao.juno.com.br, secured with OAuth 2.0 client_credentials, plus HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks and native mobile Direct Checkout SDKs for Android and iOS for PCI-safe card data encryption.

providers.name: Junomedical
providers.description: Junomedical (now Qunomedical) is a Berlin-based digital health company founded in 2015 by Dr. Sophie Chung that connects patients with professionally-vetted doctors and clinics for high-quality medical treatments at home and abroad. The consumer platform (qunomedical.com) offers free assessments, price matching, 24/7 patient support, and personalized treatment matching across specialties including plastic surgery, hair transplants, dentistry, oncology, orthopedics, reproductive medicine, and weight-loss surgery, serving roughly 10,000 patients a month. The company also builds Qunosuite, a patient-relationship-management (PRM) SaaS for healthcare providers. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company operates a consumer marketplace and a provider SaaS but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Justlife
providers.description: Justlife is the Middle East's leading home-services super app, connecting customers with vetted professionals for on-demand cleaning, beauty and wellness, healthcare-at-home, laundry, and home maintenance. Founded in 2015 by Cagatay Ozcan and Kerem Kuyucu, the company operates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, and Bahrain through its consumer mobile apps and website. Justlife publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its public web, policy, security, and AI-agent (llms.txt) surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Konga
providers.description: Konga is a Lagos, Nigeria-based e-commerce company founded in July 2012 and now operating as Nigeria's leading online shopping marketplace, combining a first-party retail business with a third-party seller marketplace across consumer electronics, mobile phones, home appliances, fashion, groceries, beauty, and lifestyle categories. Konga runs a vertically integrated stack alongside its storefront: KongaPay, a Central Bank of Nigeria-licensed and NDIC-insured payments platform offering checkout, transfers, virtual accounts, multi-currency wallets, POS, bill payments, savings, and merchant payouts; Konga Travel & Tours, an IATA-certified travel agency providing flight bookings, hotels, and vacation packages; Konga Health (Medical Direct); Konga Foods/Groceries; KongaNow same-day delivery; and KXpress Logistics for nationwide fulfillment. Konga's revenue model spans marketplace commissions, first-party retail margin, KongaPay transaction fees, logistics fees, travel agency commissions, and seller advertising. Konga does not operate a unified public developer program: the marketplace exposes no documented public REST API for orders, products, or sellers; KongaPay published Android, iOS, and WooCommerce SDKs and SDK docs at kongapay.github.io, but that GitHub organization was archived on July 1, 2023, and the current KPay aggregator API documentation lives at kpayment-org.gitbook.io with limited public surface area focused on POS, Web Payment Gateway, Virtual Account, and Payment Link integrations for approved merchants. As a result, Konga is profiled here as a provider index rather than as an actively documented public-API company.

providers.name: Lilith Games
providers.description: Lilith Games (上海莉莉丝网络科技有限公司) is a Shanghai-headquartered video game developer and publisher founded in 2013, known for globally distributed mobile and PC titles including Rise of Kingdoms (万国觉醒), AFK Arena (剑与远征), AFK Journey (剑与远征：启程), Farlight 84 (远光84), Warpath (战火勋章), Art of Conquest (剑与家园) and a portfolio of indie games. The company operates as a consumer game publisher rather than an API platform: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or partner API program. Its public engineering surface is the LilithGames GitHub organization, which open-sources backend and build infrastructure (Go networking and reverse-proxy tooling, build caching, Perforce virtual file system work) rather than client SDKs for a Lilith API. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital.

providers.name: Local Holdings Limited
providers.description: Local (uselocal.co) is a Gulf Cooperation Council fintech and hospitality-technology company that replaces traditional card terminals with a single QR code guests scan to pay, order, and earn loyalty points instantly. Its pay-at-table, checkout, and remote payment-link flows serve 200+ restaurants, hotels, and hospitals across Bahrain, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia, capturing customer profiles from each transaction and feeding real-time revenue, table-turn, and staff-performance analytics back to venues. Local integrates with regional payment methods (BenefitPay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, all major cards) and POS platforms including Odoo, Oracle, Lightspeed, Square, and Invo. Local Holdings Limited was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Mercantile
providers.description: Mercantile is a branded business credit card platform operated by Onboard Partners LLC (Boston, MA) that helps fintechs, consumer brands, and trade associations launch and run custom affinity credit card programs. It delivers a turnkey card-as-a-service stack — card issuing (cards issued by Hatch Bank on the Mastercard network), tailored underwriting and flexible funding, a ready-made regulatory/compliance/banking framework, real-time fraud monitoring, rewards, cardholder support, and full-service marketing — plus a partner API that lets brands integrate card features into their own systems to automate and scale their program.

providers.name: Mira
providers.description: Mira is a San Francisco-based consumer hardware startup building AI-powered smart glasses positioned as an always-on "second brain." Founded in 2024 by Harvard builders AnhPhu Nguyen and Caine Ardayfio (rebranded from Halo), the camera-free glasses pair a dual-waveguide display, microphone, and iOS companion app to deliver live transcription, real-time translation across 60+ languages, hands-free AI assistance, and searchable memory of everyday conversations. Mira raised a $6.6M seed round led by General Catalyst and began shipping its first devices in January 2026. It is a privacy-first consumer wearable with an iOS companion app and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: MyStars FaaS — Fulfilment API
providers.description: A B2B Fragment-as-a-Service (FaaS) fulfilment REST API for programmatically buying and reselling Telegram Stars and Telegram Premium, delivered to any Telegram @username, paid on-chain in TON (GRAM) or USDT (TON). Non-custodial, no KYC. Offers versioned /v1 endpoints for pricing, recipient checks, product catalog, and order lifecycle, with signed webhooks and official TypeScript and Python SDKs.

providers.name: Nautilus Biotechnology
providers.description: Nautilus Biotechnology is a publicly traded (NASDAQ: NAUT) life-sciences company developing a single-molecule protein analysis platform aimed at unlocking the proteome for basic biology, medicine, and drug discovery. Its Voyager platform pairs a novel single-molecule proteomics instrument with reagents and software to quantify and map proteoforms at scale. The company partners with academic and pharmaceutical researchers on applications spanning biomarker discovery and the drug-development process. Nautilus operates as a research-tools and instrument company; it publishes a corporate site, blog, resource library, and investor relations pages, but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Neo Financial
providers.description: Neo Financial is a Calgary- and Winnipeg-based Canadian fintech (neobank) founded in 2019 by the founders of SkipTheDishes, offering credit cards, savings, money, investing, and mortgage products to consumers. Neo is not a chartered bank and holds no Canadian banking licence; it delivers CDIC-eligible deposits and card issuance through regulated partner institutions — Peoples Bank of Canada for everyday accounts, ATB Financial as Mastercard credit-card issuer, and formerly Concentra Bank (now part of Equitable Bank) for savings. Neo operates a consumer mobile and web platform only and publishes no first-party public developer API or developer portal; third-party access to Neo accounts today is available solely through data aggregators such as Flinks (a National Bank-owned Canadian aggregator) and Plaid via credential/screen-scraping access, not a documented first-party API. Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open banking) framework, legislated in Budget 2024 and overseen by the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada, is not yet operational, so no first-party FDX or CDB data API exists. Neo maintains a public GitHub organization of internal engineering tooling and an engineering blog, but ships no public API products.

providers.name: Newton Research
providers.description: Newton Research builds a team of specially trained AI agents for marketing analytics. Pre-built or custom agents connect to a customer's existing data infrastructure, write and execute code, and automate analytics workflows — data exploration and preparation, audience management, Customer 360, planning and activation, cross-channel measurement and attribution, anomaly detection, yield management, and automated reporting — with data remaining on the customer's own instance. Founded by John Hoctor, Matthew Emans, and Steven Bennett, the company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and is a member of the NVIDIA Inception program. Newton states SOC 2, GDPR, and CCPA compliance. No public developer API surface is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Nix
providers.description: Nix (Nix Biosensors) develops wearable biosensor technology that analyzes sweat to deliver real-time hydration and electrolyte data. Its lightweight single-use biosensor patch continuously measures fluid and electrolyte losses and provides personalized hydration guidance to athletes, service members, and laborers. The company ships two consumer/enterprise offerings: Nix Solo, an individual app for self-monitoring hydration, and Nix Pro, a group-monitoring platform that lets coaches and supervisors track multiple users. Nix is a Techstars portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it operates a direct-to-consumer commerce and mobile-app business with no public developer program, API documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Nurture
providers.description: Nurture is an EdTech company that turns children's screen time into skill-building experiences through an interactive storytelling app for kids aged 5-7. Built on the thesis that AI is mastering information while human skills — critical thinking, curiosity, empathy, creativity, and resilience — still need to be nurtured, the app delivers character-driven story adventures with practice-based learning, no in-app purchases, no ads, and no endless autoplay. It is COPPA-compliant and features licensed brands such as Care Bears, Crayola, and Pocoyo. Nurture is a consumer mobile product distributed on the iOS App Store, Google Play, and Amazon Appstore, sold as a $36/year subscription with a 7-day free trial. It is a Seedcamp portfolio company. As a consumer application, Nurture publishes no public developer API, SDK, or integration surface; api.nurture.is serves only an internal app backend.

providers.name: Old National Bank
providers.description: Old National Bank is a nationally chartered, FDIC-insured regional commercial bank and the primary subsidiary of Old National Bancorp (NASDAQ: ONB), headquartered in Evansville, Indiana and Chicago, Illinois. With roughly $73 billion in assets and nearly 200 retail branches across Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Michigan, Minnesota, Tennessee, and Wisconsin, it is one of the largest commercial banks headquartered in the U.S. Midwest, offering consumer, small business, commercial, treasury management, and wealth banking. Old National does not operate a first-party public developer portal or publish any downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications; probes of developer., api., and apis.oldnational.com do not resolve and /developers returns HTTP 404. Consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is instead reached through third-party financial data aggregators (Finicity by Mastercard is documented), which is the honest, aggregator-only open-finance posture typical of U.S. regional banks. No documented first-party FDX-conformant data-access API or published CFPB Section 1033 developer surface was found at review time.

providers.name: Onco.com
providers.description: Onco.com is a comprehensive cancer care platform operated by Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd that connects cancer patients across India with oncologists and treatment services. The platform offers priority expert oncology consultations, pan-India cancer medicine delivery at discounted rates, diagnostic testing and imaging, curated treatment packages with negotiated hospital rates, and the CanWin peer support group for survivors and caregivers. Onco.com reports a network of 400+ oncologists and 23+ treatment centers, having served more than 100,000 patients. It also publishes extensive patient-education content covering many cancer types (breast, lung, blood, prostate, colon, and others) through its About Cancer library and blog. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company; the platform is consumer/patient facing and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Oriient
providers.description: Oriient provides software-only, hardware-free indoor positioning ("indoor GPS") and navigation delivered as a SaaS SDK. Its geomagnetic technology reaches roughly 1-meter (3-foot) accuracy indoors without Wi-Fi, beacons, or installed infrastructure, powering product finding, order picking, visitor navigation, asset tracking, and in-store analytics for retail, grocery, and smart-building customers across thousands of locations. Oriient New Media Ltd is based in Tel Aviv and is a Techstars portfolio company. Oriient ships first-party mobile SDKs (including a React-Native Product Location AI package on npm) rather than a public REST API; integration is gated behind a customer dashboard and sales.

providers.name: Payall
providers.description: Payall Payment Systems provides purpose-built banking infrastructure that automates cross-border payments for regulated financial institutions. The platform orchestrates the full international money-movement lifecycle across originating banks, correspondent and clearing institutions, central banks, and payment channels, automating sanctions screening, KYC/AML compliance, fraud and risk management, FX, and settlement. Payall markets a lightweight, backward- compatible technical integration and business-friendly APIs (plus bulk/Excel upload) so banks, credit unions, EMIs, and other regulated institutions can offer safe, profitable international transfers. Public developer documentation and an open API specification are not published; the API surface at api.payall.com is authentication-gated.

providers.name: Payment24
providers.description: Payment24 is a white-label payment platform specializing in fuel and fleet payment solutions for oil companies, banks, and retailers, primarily across Africa. Its technology lets clients design and launch branded payment products under their own name — fuel payments and mobile payments, loyalty and rewards, POS terminals, electronic vouchers, B2B and B2C prepaid and store-account cards, EV charging payments, and wet-stock and fuel-in-tank management — alongside banking-grade issuing, acquiring, card management, and merchant management, plus fleet fuel management and telematics. Payment24 operates as a technology partner rather than a public self-serve API provider, so it publishes no open developer portal or API documentation.

providers.name: Peddlr
providers.description: Peddlr is a Philippine fintech startup offering free mobile point-of-sale (POS) and bookkeeping software for Filipino micro, small, and medium businesses (MSMEs). Its app spans sales recording, offline inventory management, expense tracking, cash and credit ledgers, bills payment, QRPH, e-loading and gaming pins, a payment ledger, and accounting reports, with over two million downloads across 1,400+ cities and municipalities. Peddlr is registered with the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas as an Operator of Payment Systems. The company publishes no public developer program or API at this time; this profile captures its identity, published web properties, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pedestal Health (formerly Target RWE)
providers.description: Pedestal Health, formerly Target RWE (and NoviSci), is a Durham, North Carolina real-world evidence and health-data company serving life sciences organizations and health systems. It generates regulatory-grade real-world evidence from large-scale observational data and longitudinal patient cohorts across hepatology, dermatology, and gastroenterology (including the TARGET-NASH, TARGET-Derm, and TARGET-Gastro registries), supporting clinical development, regulatory strategy, and care delivery. The company operates as a data, research, and services provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched from the company's public website (targetrwe.com now redirects to pedestalhealth.com).

providers.name: Pluro
providers.description: Pluro is India's fertility and IVF platform, built as a co-creation model with doctors for patients. It delivers personalised, evidence-based reproductive care through a growing network of 15+ clinics across India, combining advanced clinical science, AI-assisted embryology, standardised treatment protocols, and transparent pricing. Founded by Dr. Bhaskar Shah, Dr. Jaydeep Tank, and Dr. Parikshit Tank, Pluro raised a Rs 125 crore Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners in 2025. It offers IVF/ICSI, IUI, ovulation induction, and a range of diagnostic and surgical fertility treatments. Pluro publishes an llms.txt for AI agents but exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Qeepsake
providers.description: Qeepsake is a family memory-keeping and baby-journaling service that helps parents capture their children's milestones and everyday moments by responding to scheduled text prompts or free-journaling in the mobile app, then turning those entries into digital and printed family storybooks. Operated by Tinybeans USA Ltd, Qeepsake is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) with membership tiers; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched with an identity and domain-security pass.

providers.name: Recess
providers.description: Recess (Recess Academy, recess.gg) is an online school for gifted and neurodivergent students, including learners with ADHD, dyslexia, autism spectrum, and anxiety. It combines core academics, interest-led classes, small-group coworking sessions with an AI tutor, and a daily community hour, with personalized pacing and world-class mentors. Recess is backed by Bloomberg Beta. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a consumer education web application and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; the only machine-discoverable surface found is a valid RFC 9116 security.txt with a security contact.

providers.name: Republic Services
providers.description: Republic Services is one of the largest providers of non-hazardous solid waste disposal, recycling, and environmental services in the United States. As a Fortune 500 company, Republic Services serves millions of customers across residential, commercial, industrial, and environmental segments. The company offers waste collection, recycling processing, composting, landfill operations, and digital customer tools for account management, service scheduling, and environmental reporting.

providers.name: Scape
providers.description: Scape (Scape Wellness) is an on-demand wellness technology platform in Latin America that lets customers book professional spa experiences delivered to their home, apartment, hotel, Airbnb, office, or corporate event. Certified, identity-verified therapists arrive with all required equipment — professional massage table, towels, oils, and materials. The catalog spans relaxing, deep tissue, sports, prenatal, lymphatic drainage, reflexology, and couples massages; facials; body treatments; and combined facial-plus-massage experiences, alongside personal and corporate gift cards and workplace wellness programs. Scape operates in Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and the Dominican Republic via iOS and Android apps, with payments through MercadoPago and PayPal. It is a consumer booking platform and does not publish a public developer API or developer portal. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Scimplify
providers.description: Scimplify is a Bengaluru-based advanced specialty chemicals company that combines deep chemical expertise, software, and global manufacturing capacity to make complex chemical supply predictable at scale. Founded in 2023, it operates as a contract research (CRO) and contract manufacturing (CMO) organization across the specialty-chemicals lifecycle, serving pharmaceutical, agrochemical, flavors & fragrances, industrial, beauty & personal care, food & nutrition, dyes & pigments, oleochemicals, flame retardants, and critical-metals industries. Its integrated Scinode platform, IONS R&D and ATOMS manufacturing ecosystems, and Scira AI agentic layer coordinate discovery, sourcing, and production. Scimplify publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its web, content, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Second Nature
providers.description: Second Nature is a UK-based digital weight-loss programme that combines NHS-trusted, CQC-regulated clinical care with dietitian-led coaching and behaviour-change support. The service pairs weight-loss medication (including Wegovy, Mounjaro, oral semaglutide and Orlistat programmes) with personalised medication reviews, a mobile app for tracking, and a science-based content library of guides and member stories. It operates as a registered pharmacy, supports NHS referrals and partnerships, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Speedinvest. As of this enrichment pass Second Nature publishes a consumer marketing site and an llms.txt discovery file but exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Sensorum Health
providers.description: Sensorum Health is a healthcare technology company that provides home-based, fully passive sensor technology and integrated clinical services to identify and triage the earliest signs of health decline in older adults living with chronic conditions. The platform monitors patients 24/7 in their own homes without requiring wearables, smartphones, or WiFi, then coordinates clinical interventions when concerning health patterns emerge — with the goal of preventing avoidable hospital admissions. Backed by GV (Google Ventures). Added to the API Evangelist network as a company/provider record; no public API, specification, or developer program has been published as of this profile.

providers.name: Sirius
providers.description: beSirius is an Amsterdam-based AI platform for the critical minerals and metals value chain. It builds a continuously verified digital Twin of every supplier, mapping each company's data to the frameworks, questionnaires, and regulations its buyers, auditors, and regulators require - including CSDDD, CMRT/EMRT/AMRT conflict-minerals reporting, EcoVadis, CDP, S&P CSA, UN Global Compact, LME Passport, and the Consolidated Mining Standard Initiative (CMSI). The platform automates supplier due diligence, sustainability and ESG data collection and verification, certification readiness, customer KYC, and ratings improvement across mining, processing, and trading supply chains, reducing manual audit and disclosure effort. beSirius is backed by Techstars and other investors.

providers.name: Spacebase
providers.description: Spacebase is an online marketplace for booking meeting rooms, event venues, and flexible workspaces, connecting businesses and event planners with more than 18,000 unique spaces across 4,000+ venues in 12 countries and 550+ destinations. The platform offers self-service online booking with transparent pricing, instant confirmation, add-on extras such as WiFi and catering, and a Spacebase booking guarantee, alongside consultant support for complex bookings and business accounts with negotiated rates and monthly invoicing. Spacebase is a portfolio company of Point Nine. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company operates a consumer/business booking marketplace and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Spacetime Studios
providers.description: Spacetime Studios is an Austin, Texas mobile game developer and the creator of the free-to-play "Legends" series of cross-platform MMORPGs, including Arcane Legends, Pocket Legends, Star Legends, and Dark Legends. Founded by veteran game developers, the studio operates a consumer-facing community forum, an in-game item web store, and player support channels.
