The company also offers Journey, a mission simulation and design platform that matches simulated requirements to available satellite subsystems. Morpheus Space markets ITAR-free solutions and is backed by investors including Techstars, Alpine Space Ventures, Airbus Ventures, Lavrock Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. The company publishes no public developer API; its only machine-facing surface is a platform-hosted (Wix) site MCP endpoint and an auto-generated llms.txt for agent access to public marketing content.

providers.name: Nava Benefits
providers.description: Nava Benefits is a modern employee benefits brokerage that pairs expert human advisors with AI-driven technology to help HR teams manage health insurance renewals, audit billing, control benefits costs, and improve the employee experience. Its platform includes "HQ for HR" for benefits administration, renewals, and document management, and "HQ for Employees" for 24/7 benefits support, plan-decision tools, provider search, and digital ID cards, backed by consultants advising on self-funding and captive strategies. Surfaced as a gv portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; this enrichment pass found no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Raymond James Financial
providers.description: Raymond James Financial is a diversified financial services holding company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, providing investment banking, wealth management, capital markets, asset management, and banking services to individuals, corporations, and municipalities. With more than 7,100 financial advisors serving approximately 3 million client accounts and total client assets exceeding $637 billion, Raymond James is a Fortune 500 firm and one of the largest independent broker-dealers in the United States. The company offers client-facing portals and mobile apps for account management and reporting but does not publish a general-purpose public developer API or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: REST API
providers.description: Representational State Transfer (REST) is an architectural style for designing networked applications using standard HTTP methods and stateless communication between client and server. REST APIs define how client and server applications communicate over the web using GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and PATCH methods against resource-oriented URLs. REST is the dominant API paradigm, used by 89% of organisations as their primary API format. This index covers the REST API landscape including specifications, tools, frameworks, best practices, and educational resources.

providers.name: REST Services
providers.description: Representational State Transfer (REST) is an architectural style for designing networked applications using stateless communication and standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) to interact with resources identified by URLs. REST services underpin modern web APIs and support the full software development lifecycle from design through deployment and maintenance. This index covers REST service implementations, frameworks, best practices, patterns, tooling, and educational resources that guide how REST services are built, managed, and consumed.

providers.name: Sankun
providers.description: Sankun (산군) is a South Korean construction-industry big data platform based in Seoul that aggregates and sells access to eight integrated construction databases covering roughly 280,000 construction companies, some 820,000 project sites, government e-procurement bids, contract awards, professional reputation reviews, and construction news. Alongside its web application and a construction sales CRM (Sankun Sales), the company markets a Sankun API (data.sankun.com) for programmatic access to its construction data, though public developer documentation is gated behind sales and login. Sankun is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Seaboard
providers.description: Seaboard Corporation is a diverse global agribusiness and transportation company involved in pork, commodity merchandising, grain processing, sugar production, electric power generation, and ocean transportation.

providers.name: Shippingbo
providers.description: Shippingbo is a Toulouse, France-based e-commerce logistics SaaS founded in 2016 by Marc Hericher and Romain Parent. The platform unifies an Order Management System (OMS), Warehouse Management System (WMS), and Transport Management System (TMS) behind a single REST API so that merchants, DNVBs, 3PLs, wholesalers, manufacturers, and marketplaces can centralize multi-channel orders, pilot warehouse picking and packing, and execute multi-carrier shipments from one back office. Shippingbo claims 5,000+ active users, 80 million orders, and EUR 5 billion in merchandise handled in 2024, with 2,500+ warehouses equipped across France and Europe. The Shippingbo Developer Portal (powered by Stoplight) exposes a public REST/JSON API covering orders, products, stocks, shipments, customers, pickings, and source connectors, secured by OAuth 2.0 through the oauth.shippingbo.com authorization server. Shippingbo additionally offers a dedicated TMS API for multi-carrier label generation and a webhook channel for order state changes, stock changes, and shipment events. Reported developer-facing scale includes 500+ developers, 10+ million orders processed through the APIs, 500+ million webhook deliveries, and 40+ pre-integrated carriers. Shippingbo is a French Tech company backed by IRDI Capital Investissement and GSO Innovation.

providers.name: Skyworks Solutions
providers.description: Skyworks Solutions, Inc. is an American semiconductor company headquartered in Irvine, California that designs, develops, and markets proprietary semiconductor products for wireless communications, automotive, broadband, connected home, industrial, defense, and consumer electronics applications. Skyworks is a leading provider of analog and mixed-signal semiconductors, with dominant market share in 5G RF front-end modules (35% market share). Products span amplifiers, filters, front-end modules, isolators, switches, and power management ICs serving mobile, automotive, IoT, and infrastructure markets. The company does not publish a public developer API but provides datasheets, evaluation tools, and design resources for hardware engineers.

providers.name: State Employees' Credit Union
providers.description: State Employees' Credit Union (SECU / NCSECU) is a member-owned, not-for-profit financial cooperative headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. Founded in 1937 with 17 members and $437 in deposits, it is a state-chartered credit union regulated by the Credit Union Division of the North Carolina Department of Commerce and federally insured by the NCUA (NMLS #430055). SECU is the second-largest natural-person credit union in the United States by both assets and membership, serving nearly 2.9 million member-owners with roughly $56 billion in assets across 275 branches in all 100 North Carolina counties. Membership is primarily limited to North Carolina state employees and their families. On the open-finance front, SECU operates no public first-party developer portal and publishes no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications; its consumer digital banking (Member Access) supports connecting external accounts for aggregation, and outbound consumer-permissioned data sharing is handled through data aggregators rather than a documented first-party API. No public FDX-conformant data-access endpoint or CFPB Section 1033 data-rights posture is published as of July 2026.

providers.name: Valar Labs
providers.description: Valar Labs is an AI oncology company building diagnostics that interpret solid tumors from routine pathology slides to predict cancer treatment response. Its proprietary CHAI (Computational Histology Artificial Intelligence) platform analyzes digitized H&E-stained slides — trained on 500,000+ pathologist annotations of tumors and their microenvironment — to help physicians and patients make evidence-based therapy decisions. Products include Vesta Bladder (predicting BCG response in non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer), Vesta Prostate, and Vitara Pancreas ChemoPredict (guiding first-line chemotherapy selection in advanced pancreatic cancer). Founded at the intersection of AI and oncology and backed by a16z and DCVC, Valar Labs delivers results within days without requiring additional tissue. The company operates a physician ordering portal at portal.valarlabs.com and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API specification as of this profile.

providers.name: W. R. Berkley
providers.description: W. R. Berkley Corporation is one of the largest commercial lines property and casualty insurance holding companies in the United States, operating through more than 60 operating units in approximately 60 countries. The company operates across two business segments: Insurance and Reinsurance and Monoline. Subsidiaries include BerkleyNet (workers' compensation), Berkley Risk Administrators, and others. W. R. Berkley does not offer a public developer API, though subsidiary portals and agent portals provide limited policy, billing, and claims access.

providers.name: WebinarJam
providers.description: WebinarJam is a live webinar platform for marketing, training, and sales events, while its sibling product EverWebinar provides automated and evergreen webinar replays. Both products share a REST API that lets integrators retrieve webinars, register attendees, manage registrants, and drive marketing automations. The WebinarJam/EverWebinar API uses an API key (requiring approval) included in request payloads, with separate base paths for each product family.

providers.name: Abbott Laboratories
providers.description: Abbott Laboratories is a global healthcare company that develops, manufactures, and markets pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, and nutritional products. Abbott's digital health portfolio includes the FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring system, cardiac monitoring devices, and connected diagnostics platforms that enable data sharing between patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers.

providers.name: Adanos Market Sentiment API
providers.description: Key-authenticated REST/JSON API for financial market sentiment analytics across Reddit, X.com, news, and Polymarket, plus stock news and crypto sentiment. Provides Buzz Score, Trend Detection, and directional Sentiment signals for traders, fintech, quant/research teams, and AI agents.

providers.name: Aella Credit
providers.description: Aella (Aella Credit) is a technology-driven microfinance bank licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), building consumer and business financial infrastructure across Africa. Its consumer app offers savings, low-interest and same-day loans, bill payments, and high-yield savings accounts, while its Fintech-as-a-Service platform exposes that infrastructure to businesses through a developer-facing API gateway. Published API capabilities include wallet-as-a- service (create and manage digital wallets with real-time balances and full ledger support), KYC/identity verification via BVN and NIN, bank-account lookup and validation, sub-accounts and pooled fund structures for platforms and marketplaces, and direct-debit recurring collections. A live Aella Merchant API is hosted at api.aellaapp.com and a merchant dashboard at merchant.aellaapp.com, though the provider does not yet publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs. This profile was seeded as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Affirmed Networks
providers.description: Affirmed Networks is a cloud-native mobile core networking company, acquired by Microsoft in 2020 and now operating as part of the Azure for Operators initiative. It builds virtualized, fully software-based mobile network functions for telecommunications operators, including a Virtual Evolved Packet Core (vEPC), the Affirmed UnityCloud 5G Core, private network services, network slicing, and analytics. Its packet-core technology underpins Microsoft's Azure Operator Nexus and Azure Operator 5G Core platforms. Affirmed serves carriers and service providers modernizing their networks and does not expose a public developer API or SDK surface.

providers.name: Auxmoney
providers.description: Auxmoney (auxmoney GmbH) is a Düsseldorf-based German fintech operating one of Europe's largest online lending marketplaces, connecting consumer and small-business borrowers with private and institutional investors. Its fully digital platform handles personal-loan applications end to end — identity and credit checks, risk scoring, approval within seconds, and disbursement typically within 24 hours — funded by retail investors and institutional capital via its investment arm. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures. auxmoney publishes no public developer API or portal; its integration surface is a partner/affiliate program plus internal open-source tooling on GitHub. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Aviva
providers.description: Aviva (Aviva Financial, S.A. de C.V., SOFOM E.N.R.) is a Mexican fintech lender operating under the tagline "Tu historia importa." It offers quick, secured personal and business loans originated in person through a network of 100+ physical kiosks across central Mexico (Puebla, Hidalgo, Estado de Mexico, Morelos, Queretaro, Tlaxcala and Veracruz), using a video-call onboarding flow (the Aviva Onboarding System, AOS) with same-day or 24-hour direct-deposit disbursement. Products include Aviva Contigo (everyday expenses, up to $15,000), Aviva tu Negocio (business owners, up to $20,000), Aviva tu Compra (appliances at Bodega Aurrera), and Aviva tu Casa (construction materials via Construrama). Borrowers manage payments through the Aviva mobile app. Aviva was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Aviva publishes no public developer portal, API, SDKs, or OpenAPI - it exposes a consumer web/app and kiosk surface only.

providers.name: Azuqua
providers.description: Azuqua was a Seattle-based integration platform as a service (iPaaS) and no-code workflow-automation company, backed by Insight Partners and Techstars, that let business teams build integrations and automated workflows (FLOs) across SaaS applications such as Salesforce, Slack, Marketo and ServiceNow. Azuqua was acquired by Okta in 2019 and its workflow orchestration engine and connectors were folded into Okta Workflows (part of Okta Lifecycle Management). The standalone product is now end-of-life: azuqua.com serves an acquisition notice and the API is no longer available for purchase. This API Evangelist profile documents the surviving public developer surface (legacy ReadMe docs, changelog, llms.txt) and the product's lifecycle status.

providers.name: B612
providers.description: B612 is a consumer selfie and beauty camera application for iOS and Android, published globally by SNOW Corporation and operated in mainland China as B612咔叽 (B612 Kaji) by Yiruike Information Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. The app combines a real-time beauty camera, AR stickers and scene effects, user-created and creator-published filters, and photo and video editing tools, and has been distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play since 2014. B612 is a mobile end-user product rather than an API provider: as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer portal, no public API documentation, no SDKs, and no machine-readable API artifacts on any of its web properties.

providers.name: Backstartup
providers.description: Backstartup is a Colombian tech-enabled accounting and legal services firm for startups and small businesses (notably SAS entities). It automated company formation, bookkeeping, tax filing, payroll, and legal/DIAN compliance for founders in Latin America. Backstartup has since been integrated into Numbi (numbi.ai), a tech-enabled accounting firm that operates monthly bookkeeping, taxes, payroll, and DIAN compliance on top of the accounting systems companies already use (Siigo and Alegra), pairing expert accountants with automation and AI. Backstartup's legacy domain (backstartup.com) now redirects to numbi.ai and Backstartup operates as a sub-organization within Numbi's Colombia operation. This is a services-company profile: no public developer API or OpenAPI is published. It entered the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

providers.name: Barnes & Noble
providers.description: Barnes & Noble is the largest retail bookseller in the United States and the operator of the Nook digital reading platform. Barnes & Noble does not currently publish a public general-purpose developer portal. Trade and affiliate partners integrate through B&N's affiliate program, the B&N Press self-publishing platform for independent authors, EDI-based wholesale channels with publishers, and the Nook content distribution and reading ecosystem.

providers.name: Bayes Impact
providers.description: Bayes Impact is a nonprofit organization that builds open-source AI and data-science tools for public services, governments, and nonprofits, with a mission to empower people in need and those who help them. Surfaced through Y Combinator, it has served over 10 million beneficiaries across three continents. Its flagship open-source project, Bob (formerly Bob Emploi), delivers personalized, data-driven career and job-search advice to jobseekers through a Python/Flask RESTful JSON API whose data structures are defined in Protocol Buffers. Other projects include the Bayes Platform agent framework for public services, the Encompass geographic-access analysis tool, and a range of civic data-science tooling.

providers.name: BTC War Live Market Data API
providers.description: Public, read-only real-time crypto market-data API from btcwar.net, exposing live Binance Spot order-flow snapshots and single-market observations for nine USDT pairs as JSON and Schema.org JSON-LD. Ships a complete agent-native discovery stack: OpenAPI 3.1, Arazzo workflow, hosted MCP server, and llms.txt.

providers.name: Chegg
providers.description: Chegg is an American education technology company that provides direct-to-student learning services, including 24/7 homework and expert Q&A help, step-by-step textbook solutions, practice questions, and writing, grammar, and citation tools. Founded in 2005 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Chegg began as a textbook-rental marketplace and expanded into a subscription study-support platform (Chegg Study, Chegg Writing, Chegg Math Solver) plus tutoring and skills offerings. Chegg operates as a consumer web/mobile product rather than a developer platform: it exposes no public developer portal, published API, or SDKs at this time. Its public technical surface is limited to a coordinated vulnerability disclosure program on HackerOne and standard web security/policy pages. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Kleiner Perkins and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Chobani
providers.description: Chobani is an American food and beverage company founded in 2005 by Hamdi Ulukaya, best known for popularizing strained Greek yogurt in the United States and for operating what it describes as the world's largest yogurt facility in Twin Falls, Idaho. Its portfolio spans Greek yogurt, oat milk, plant-based yogurt, probiotic drinks, nutritional shakes, and — following the 2023 acquisition of La Colombe Coffee Roasters — ready-to-drink coffee. Chobani sells through retail grocery, an away-from-home foodservice channel, Chobani Cafe locations, and a direct-to-consumer shop. Chobani is a privately held consumer packaged goods manufacturer and does not operate a public developer program: it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, SDKs, or public webhook surface, and integrates with retail and distribution partners through EDI and private supply-chain connections rather than an open API.

providers.name: Clear Labs
providers.description: Clear Labs builds fully automated next-generation sequencing (NGS) platforms and software for genomic analysis across clinical and food-safety testing. Its products include Clear Dx for oncology research (solid tumor sequencing, liquid biopsy, and fusion detection), Clear Ix for infectious disease and microbial genomics research, and Clear Safety for NGS-based Salmonella serotyping and Listeria persistence monitoring in food safety. The company operates in the genomics, diagnostics, and biotechnology space and does not currently publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Conektto
providers.description: Conektto is an AI-assisted API design and lifecycle platform that helps teams design, simulate, generate, test, and deploy APIs. The platform bundles a Design Studio (NLP-driven contract design), an Autonomous Test Studio (mocking, test generation, test data, and performance testing), a Hybrid API Orchestrator, and an enterprise SDLC workspace. Conektto is delivered as a hosted SaaS workbench with a free Community Edition and a Pro Plan; it does not currently publish a public, self-service developer API for programmatic access to the Design Studio. Customer integrations are surfaced through the SaaS UI, GitHub workspace integrations, and custom enterprise engagements.

providers.name: Customer Analytics
providers.description: Customer Analytics (CA) is a data, analytics and AI consultancy headquartered in Middleton, Wisconsin with a delivery centre in Guindy, Chennai, India. The firm delivers AI/ML and data analytics, data engineering, business intelligence and reporting, business solutions design and software development, platform implementation and software management (Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Fabric, Salesforce), and quality assurance. Alongside these services it packages six productised offerings — DataWorks 360, BI Xpert 360, AI Assist 360, Retail AI Insights 360, PBILens 360 and Smart IoT Data Track 360 — and publishes case studies across healthcare, manufacturing, retail/B2B, education, agriculture, clinical research, warehouse operations, the art industry and government. Customer Analytics is a professional services company: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: David AI
providers.description: David AI is an audio data research company building high-quality speech and conversational datasets to bring AI into the real world through voice. Using a rigorous six-step research process (hypothesize, design, experiment, evaluate, productionize, release), the team produces datasets such as Converse (channel-separated two-speaker English conversations), Atlas (multilingual data spanning 15+ languages with dialect and accent metadata), Chorus (multi-speaker conversations for speaker separation and diarization), and Dialog (expert domain conversations). Its data is licensed to Fortune 100 companies and research labs working on speech recognition, translation, synthesis, and conversational AI. Access is arranged through samples, consultation, and a data license agreement rather than a self-serve API. David AI is backed by Amplify Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public web presence.

providers.name: Denta
providers.description: Denta is a San Francisco-based dental practice management and automation platform, founded by Jack Beecher (Jack Beecher LLC, dba Denta) and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026 batch). Positioned as "the dental practice that runs itself," Denta embeds AI into dental organizations to automate back-office operations: it ingests fragmented data from a practice's existing software, provides analytics so dentists can understand their business, and runs in the background to handle administrative work such as insurance payment posting. Its roadmap includes all-in-one native practice management software and an "autonomous dental practice." As of this profile Denta publishes a marketing site, a blog, and login and legal pages, but no public developer portal, API, or OpenAPI surface has been located.

providers.name: Detect Technologies
providers.description: Detect Technologies is an industrial AI company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Chennai, India, focused on transforming workplace safety, security, productivity, and asset inspections across asset-intensive industries such as oil and gas, steel, manufacturing, and energy. Its flagship platform, T-Pulse, is an AI-powered Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) management system that aggregates data from cameras, sensors, equipment, and processes to deliver near real-time risk and efficiency insights through computer vision and machine learning. The T-Pulse suite spans Workplace Safety, Workplace Operations, Workplace Inspections, and Workplace Security modules, complemented by predictive maintenance and turnaround (STO) orchestration capabilities. Detect Technologies is backed by Prosus Ventures.

providers.name: DietlyAPI
providers.description: Food & nutrition data REST API with 4.2M+ foods, calories, macros, 17 micronutrients, barcode lookup, and confidence-ranked full-text search. Data primarily from Open Food Facts (ODbL), EU-hosted, with key-optional read access.

providers.name: DIVE studios
providers.description: DIVE Studios is a global K-entertainment media platform that produces original shows, podcasts, and short-form social content, reaching over 135M Gen Z and Millennial fans and 5B+ lifetime views. The company operates two commercial arms: DIVE Media, which sells advertising and branded content across its podcast, video, and social network, and DIVE Agency (DIVE X), which builds creator, influencer, and celebrity marketing campaigns for global brands connecting with K-culture audiences. It publishes an llms.txt describing its pages but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or portal. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Duranta
providers.description: Duranta Labs is an applied AI laboratory building geospatial and computer-vision technology to understand the physical world. Its foundation vision model, Aidan, generates accurate, current 4D digital twins from optical imagery. That model powers a Landscapers solution that lets professionals measure, design, and bid any property directly from imagery without a site visit, a general-purpose World Model for spatial intelligence, and a forthcoming AEC (architecture, engineering, and construction) product that turns an address into a precise digital model. Duranta is backed by Fifth Wall.

providers.name: Easel AI
providers.description: Easel AI is a Los Angeles based generative AI company building a consumer app and a partner-facing image generation platform. Its models turn a single selfie into photorealistic single and multiplayer avatars without any per-user AI training, and the same technology is packaged for commercial use as Fashion Photoshoot (AI models of any race or body type wearing any outfit), Fashion Try-On (shoppers upload a picture and see themselves in an outfit instantly), Ad Creator (personalized ad creative from one selfie plus a context image), and Product Photoshoot (products placed in any scenario). Easel ships a consumer iOS app and markets a Try-On API and ad-generation API to fashion brands, ad platforms, messaging apps, dating and social apps, and talent agencies monetizing digital IP. As of this pass the API surface is partner-gated and contact-sales only - there is no public developer portal, documentation, API reference, machine-readable specification, or self-serve signup published on the website. Easel appears on the a16z investment list.

providers.name: Finbots.AI
providers.description: Finbots.AI (finbots.ai) is a Singapore-headquartered fintech offering CreditX, a no-code, AI-powered credit risk platform that lets banks and lenders build, validate, and deploy application, behavioural, and collection scorecards in hours instead of months. Its proprietary, explainable machine-learning models power real-time lending decisions in under 0.03 seconds, and the platform adds a Decision Engine (business rules), propensity modelling, and managed data services. Backed by Accel, finbots.ai serves retail banking, SME lending, and credit-card clients across APAC and MEA markets, and was among the first fintechs to complete Singapore's AI Verify AI-governance testing framework. No public self-service developer API is published; API integration is enterprise and sales-gated.

providers.name: Gametime
providers.description: Gametime is a mobile-first ticket marketplace for last-minute tickets to live sports, concerts, comedy, and theater across the United States and Canada. Founded in 2012 by Brad Griffith and headquartered in San Francisco, Gametime United, Inc. lets fans buy tickets up to roughly 90 minutes after an event begins, with all-in (fee-inclusive) pricing, a two-tap checkout, mobile ticket delivery, and buyer guarantees (Lowest Price Guarantee and lightning refunds). The company is backed by Accel, GV, and others. Gametime does not publish a public developer API; it runs a B2B "API Seller" program for professional point-of-sale sellers. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched with identity and domain-security data.

providers.name: Gebeya
providers.description: Gebeya is an Ethiopian talent-cloud and marketplace technology company headquartered in Addis Ababa, founded in 2016 by Amadou Daffe and Hiruy Amanuel. It trains, vets, and connects African tech talent with organizations, and provides a Marketplace-as-a-Service platform (Gebeya-Jenga) that lets entrepreneurs launch branded, multi-tenant service marketplaces with built-in payments and analytics. Its current products include Dala Studio and Jitume, applying LLMs and proprietary data to build AI agents and workforce-intelligence tools for the African digital economy. Gebeya is backed by Partech. As of this profiling it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK.

providers.name: Happy World
providers.description: Happy World operates SPICE (getspice.com), a premium lifestyle dining and rewards mobile application based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SPICE lets diners discover curated partner restaurants across the Kingdom, reserve or walk in, pay their bill in-app by entering the bill number, and earn instant cashback rewards (advertised as up to 20% cashback with no caps) on every visit. The product emphasizes intelligent personalization and a hand-picked selection of the best restaurants, food, and dining experiences. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. The company is a consumer mobile-app business with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documented developer surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence
providers.description: Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence is a division of Hexagon AB providing metrology, quality management, and manufacturing intelligence software and hardware. Products include PC-DMIS (CMM measurement software), WORKXPLORE (CAD viewer), SFx (smart factory platform), and HxGN Smart Quality. The division offers APIs and SDKs for automating CMM measurement programs, integrating quality data into MES and ERP systems, and building custom metrology applications.

providers.name: Holberton School
providers.description: Holberton School is a Silicon Valley-born technology education company that trains software and AI engineers through project-based, peer-driven learning rather than traditional lectures. Students build real applications from day one, using AI as a learning partner while developing the collaboration and problem-solving skills employers need, and the school reports a 92% employment rate among alumni. Holberton operates campuses and partner programs globally and delivers curriculum in software engineering, AI/machine learning, cybersecurity, and cloud. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Partech; the school publishes no public developer API, SDK, or well-known discovery surface at this time.

providers.name: Jingle Pay
providers.description: Jingle Pay is a DFSA-regulated (Dubai Financial Services Authority) digital financial services fintech headquartered in the UAE, offering an all-in-one mobile money account for cross-border remittances, peer-to-peer payments, real-time multi-currency exchange, and Mastercard-powered card payments. Founded and led by CEO Amir Fardghassemi, the company serves the UAE, Pakistan, Bahrain, and Canada, and reports having processed over $3.5 billion across 8M+ transactions to 150 countries for 1.5M+ unique senders. It is backed by strategic partners and investors including Bank Alfalah, MoneyGram, Mastercard, and 500 Global. Jingle Pay operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Koobz
providers.description: Koobz is a Ventura, California additive-manufacturing company rebuilding the footwear supply chain around on-demand 3D printing. Its "gigafactory" prints circular-ready, mono-material foamed-TPU shoes to order, so brands carry zero inventory and face no minimum order quantities: a consumer buys on the brand's own storefront, the order and personalization specs sync to the Koobz factory, the shoe is printed in Ventura and dropshipped direct to the customer in days. The company markets 10x faster concept-to-market cycles (4-6 weeks, no tooling), custom cushioning and foot-scanning personalization, and a KoobzWeave toolpath-as-textile upper pattern engine. Its mono-material architecture is positioned for Extended Producer Responsibility regimes such as California SB 707, since a single-polymer shoe yields premium TPU on take-back rather than mixed waste. Koobz has raised $7.2M and is backed by Uncork Capital. It describes its factory as API-driven and its order intake as an API sync from brand storefronts, but as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API definition; integration appears to run through its partner ("Partner With Us") channel.

providers.name: LAP Coffee
providers.description: LAP Coffee (Life Among People) is a Berlin-founded specialty coffee retail chain operated by Micro Retail Technologies MRT GmbH. It opened its first store in Berlin Mitte in August 2023 and has grown to a network of neighbourhood cafes across Berlin, with further locations and openings in Cologne, Frankfurt, Munich and Hamburg. LAP serves locally roasted specialty coffee at everyday prices from small, high-throughput stores, and runs a consumer mobile app (LAP: Everyday Coffee) for pre-ordering, in-store pickup, a stamps and rewards loyalty program, gifting and referrals, replacing an earlier Apple/Google Wallet stamp pass. LAP is backed by HV Capital. As of this enrichment pass LAP publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or developer documentation; its technology surface is the consumer app, the order.lap.coffee deep-link service and a Webflow marketing site.

providers.name: Leapmotor
providers.description: Leapmotor (Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co., Ltd., HKEX: 9863) is a Chinese intelligent electric vehicle manufacturer founded in 2015 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China, which sold its first vehicles in 2019. Leapmotor designs and builds battery-electric and range-extended (REEV) passenger vehicles — including the T03 city car and the B03X, B05, B10 and C10 SUVs — on its own vertically integrated LEAP platform, developing its electric drive, battery, and intelligent cockpit and driving systems in house. Stellantis took a stake in the company in 2023 and, through the Leapmotor International joint venture, distributes Leapmotor vehicles across Europe and other export markets via leapmotor.net. Leapmotor operates connected-vehicle services — the Leapmotor mobile app, OTA software updates, and the Leapmotor Connected Experience — but publishes no public developer API program, developer portal, or API documentation; the vehicle cloud interfaces used by its mobile app are private and only reached through unofficial, reverse-engineered community clients.

providers.name: LendUp
providers.description: LendUp was a San Francisco consumer-lending fintech founded in 2011 and backed by GV and QED Investors, offering single-payment and installment loans to subprime borrowers alongside a gamified "LendUp Ladder" program that promised cheaper credit and credit-bureau reporting as borrowers repaid. LendUp Loans LLC ceased lending operations in January 2022 following Consumer Financial Protection Bureau enforcement actions over misleading marketing and pricing claims. The lendup.com domain is now operated by an unrelated company, LendUp LLC of Dover, Delaware, which runs a consumer loan-matching and financial-education site connecting borrowers to licensed lenders for a referral fee; it states it has no corporate, ownership, or operational relationship to the former lender and no access to its customer data. Neither entity publishes a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or any machine-readable discovery surface.

providers.name: Luminai
providers.description: Luminai is an AI-powered automation platform for health system operations, marketed as "The AI Platform for Health System Operations." It automates complex, high-volume healthcare back-office workflows including referral intake and processing, provider inbox automation, patient registration, orders and referrals, pharmacy renewals, payor contract management, denial appeals, and underpayment recovery. The company reports over 12 million automations driven, an average 5.3x ROI, and a 48-day average time to value, with enterprise-grade security and flexible deployment options (on-premises, VPC, or fully managed). Luminai is SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. It is a venture-backed company in the General Catalyst portfolio. Luminai does not publish a public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Memorick
providers.description: Memorick is a 500 Global-backed company operating a live web application at memorick.com. Based on its observable application surface, it is a destination photography booking platform connecting customers with photographers across destinations, handling packages, orders, reviews, coupons, and messaging. The product is built on Laravel (Inertia.js single-page front end) and exposes an OAuth2 authorization server via Laravel Passport (authorize/token/clients/scopes plus personal access tokens), Sanctum first-party session auth, and optional two-factor authentication. It publishes no public API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal at this time; the /api/* routes back the first-party application and are authentication-gated. This profile was enriched from live probing of the public surface.

providers.name: Meridian Credit Union
providers.description: Meridian Credit Union is Ontario's largest credit union and one of the largest in Canada — a member-owned financial cooperative headquartered in St. Catharines and Toronto, serving more than 365,000 members with roughly CAD $31 billion in assets under management, over 2,200 employees, and more than 75 years of history. Formed in 2005 through the merger of Niagara Credit Union and HEPCOE Credit Union, Meridian offers personal, business, and wealth banking and owns Meridian OneCap Credit Corp. (commercial equipment leasing and financing); it previously operated the federally chartered digital bank motusbank, which was wound down in 2023. As a provincially regulated Ontario credit union — overseen by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario (FSRA), with member deposits insured under Ontario's credit-union deposit-insurance scheme — Meridian is a cooperative, not a Schedule I or Schedule II bank. It publishes no first-party public developer API and no downloadable OpenAPI specification. Consumer-permissioned account-data access today is aggregator-mediated rather than first-party: Plaid maintains a Meridian institution connector, and the Central 1 / Flinks Outbound seam provides API-based data sharing for member credit unions. Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (legislated in 2024 with the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada / FCAC as overseer) is not yet operational, so Meridian's open-finance participation remains voluntary and aggregator-based.

providers.name: Motorola
providers.description: Motorola (motorola.com) is the consumer mobile-device brand operated by Motorola Mobility, a Lenovo company, producing Android smartphones (moto g, moto edge, and razr foldable lines), tablets, and accessories sold worldwide. It was originally added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio stub. On review, the consumer brand publishes no open public REST/HTTP API developer portal: the historical developer.motorola.com Moto Mods hardware SDK (for the modular Moto Z) is no longer reachable, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or well-known discovery surface was found. Enterprise and public-safety APIs are offered separately by Motorola Solutions, Inc. (docs.motorolasolutions.com), a distinct company, under a gated partner Application Developer Program.

providers.name: Nagish
providers.description: Nagish (now operating as Rylo, following an $85M raise and rebrand) is a free phone-call captioning and live-transcription service for people who are Deaf, hard of hearing, or have a speech disability. Originally launched as the Nagish app (talknagish.com), the FCC-certified service delivers real-time captions on incoming and outgoing calls, in-person Live Transcribe, voicemail captioning, 50+ language support, and AI-powered quick replies, with transcripts kept private on-device. It is a consumer mobile/telecom product and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal. Backed by Canaan Partners and Techstars; profiled in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: National Bank of Canada
providers.description: National Bank of Canada (Banque Nationale du Canada, TSX: NA) is a Schedule I chartered bank headquartered in Montreal, Quebec, founded in 1859. It is the sixth-largest of Canada's Big Six banks and the leading bank in Quebec, serving personal, commercial, wealth-management, and financial-markets clients. On open finance, National Bank is a notable first-mover: it was the first major Canadian bank to launch a secure, consent-based data-sharing API for retail customers, but it does NOT operate a public self-serve first-party developer portal. Programmatic access to customer financial data is delivered through aggregators rather than a downloadable public API — principally Flinks, the Montreal aggregator in which National Bank holds an ~80% stake, via its Open Banking Environment (OBE), and also through Plaid. National Bank and Flinks are founding participants of the FDX Canada working group, aligning their data-sharing on the FDX technical standard, and the bank is positioning ahead of Canada's forthcoming, legislated-but-not-yet-operational Consumer-Driven Banking framework (Budget 2024 / FCAC oversight). Today access is voluntary and aggregator-mediated; there is no operational open-banking mandate and no public first-party API surface.

providers.name: Nelo
providers.description: Nelo is a Mexican fintech offering consumer credit that lets shoppers buy now and pay later in bi-weekly installments (quincenas). Its mobile app (iOS and Android) provides instant credit approval, an in-app marketplace (Tienda Nelo), bill payment for utilities such as CFE, water, gas and internet, phone recharges, cash withdrawals, and a premium Nelo VIP tier with a physical credit card. Backed by Homebrew, Nelo operates primarily as a consumer mobile product and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. Sector: fintech / buy-now-pay-later (BNPL).

providers.name: NG.Cash
providers.description: NG.CASH is a Brazilian digital banking platform built for the new generation (roughly ages 12 to 30), founded in 2021 and headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. Authorized by Brazil's Central Bank as a payment institution and electronic currency issuer, it offers a digital account with Pix instant payments, a personalized Mastercard prepaid and virtual card, bill payment, mobile top-ups, a savings feature ("Cofrinho"), allowance management, and a discount marketplace, plus credit products offered as a banking correspondent through partners such as BTG Pactual and QI SCD. NG.CASH is a consumer-facing mobile application (iOS and Android) with over three million active accounts; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and enriched by the API Evangelist network from public sources.

providers.name: Novi Connect
providers.description: Novi Connect (Novi) is an AI shopping optimization platform and data infrastructure for CPG and retail brands. It connects brands, certification bodies, and major retailers to verify, standardize, and distribute product data so products are accurately understood, ranked, and recommended by AI shopping systems and agentic search. Products include the AI Shopping Optimizer for SKU-level product-feed optimization and the Product Authority Builder for verified direct data distribution across retailers and marketplaces. Backed by Felicis. No public developer API surface is currently published; product docs are hosted on Notion and customer access is via login apps.

providers.name: ODAIA
providers.description: ODAIA is a commercial intelligence platform for the pharmaceutical industry, using AI to replace manual analysis and static annual segmentation with real-time, predictive insights. Its products (ODAIA Field, Marketing Intelligence, and Opportunity Analysis) help pharma field reps, brand marketers, and commercial operations teams identify the right healthcare professionals (HCPs), prioritize outreach, and surface untapped prescription opportunities. ODAIA integrates with Veeva CRM to deliver insights directly inside existing rep workflows. It is a Toronto-based, enterprise-focused SaaS vendor backed by Threshold Ventures; the product is sold via sales/discovery calls rather than a self-service public API.

providers.name: Onefootball
providers.description: Onefootball is a Berlin-based digital football (soccer) media platform that aggregates news, live scores, match coverage, video highlights, and streaming (OneFootball TV) for a global audience across iOS, Android, and the web. Backed by Earlybird and Union Square Ventures, the company partners with clubs, leagues, and publishers to distribute content and operates an official merchandise store and a Web3/club ecosystem. Onefootball does not publish a public developer API or partner developer portal; content ingestion for partners is handled via WordPress REST and private editorial integrations rather than an open, documented API surface.

providers.name: Owl Labs
providers.description: Owl Labs is a Boston-based video conferencing hardware and software company building smart devices for hybrid meetings. Its flagship Meeting Owl line is a 360-degree AI-powered camera, microphone, and speaker that automatically focuses on whoever is speaking, alongside accessories such as the Owl Bar, Whiteboard Owl, and Expansion Mic. The Nest is its cloud fleet-management platform for provisioning, updating, and monitoring deployed devices across an organization. Owl Labs sells to enterprises, schools, and distributed teams, and publishes an annual State of Hybrid Work report. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners and Playground Global. Owl Labs does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties.

providers.name: Polaron
providers.description: Polaron is a London-based AI software company that builds "the intelligence layer for materials science." Its platform applies machine learning to microscopy and image data to automate microstructure analysis, connecting process, structure, and performance so materials engineering teams can characterise, design, and manufacture materials faster and with less uncertainty. The platform centers on three core model families: Segmentation (identifying and measuring microstructural features), Reconstruction (converting 2D micrographs into 3D representations), and Design (optimising microstructural parameters). It is applied across batteries, metals and alloys, composites, ceramics, additive manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals, spanning R&D, quality and qualification, and modelling and simulation workflows. Polaron is backed by Speedinvest and research institutions including Imperial College London, Manchester, Oxford, and Cambridge.

providers.name: Prizeo
providers.description: Prizeo is a charity fundraising platform that runs celebrity-driven online sweepstakes: supporters donate as little as $10 to a participating cause to be entered for a chance to win once-in-a-lifetime experiences and prizes with well-known names in music, sports, and entertainment. Campaigns run on behalf of charities and celebrity partners, donations are processed online (Stripe and PayPal), and winners are selected by raffle under published official rules. Prizeo operates as part of the Charity Network family of fundraising brands (alongside Charitybuzz) and was backed by Battery Ventures. It is a consumer-facing web application; the /api/v1 and /api/v2 endpoints observed on the site are private backends for its own React frontend rather than a documented, public developer API — there is no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or public API program.

providers.name: Prosperity Bank
providers.description: Prosperity Bank is a Texas-chartered commercial bank (member FDIC, NMLS ID 466414) and the banking subsidiary of Prosperity Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: PB), a Houston, Texas based regional financial holding company with roughly $37-43 billion in total assets and 300-plus full-service branches across Texas and central Oklahoma. It offers consumer and commercial banking, treasury management, mortgage, and wealth services, and has grown largely through acquisitions (LegacyTexas, Lone Star State Bancshares, American Bank Holding, Southwest Bancshares, Stellar Bancorp). On open finance, Prosperity Bank operates no first-party public developer portal or documented API: developer. and api. subdomains do not resolve, and no /developers or /api pages exist. Consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is reachable only through third-party aggregators (Finicity/Mastercard Open Banking, Plaid, and similar), not a directly published bank API. No FDX-conformant data-access API or CFPB Section 1033 posture is publicly documented by the bank as of this review.

providers.name: Proximitty
providers.description: Proximitty is a Y Combinator-backed company building an AI operating system for commercial lending. Its platform deploys regulator-grade AI agents that ingest and parse borrower documents, spread financials, generate credit memos, automate loan operations, and continuously track covenants and closing obligations for FDIC-insured banks, credit unions, and non-bank lenders originating C&I, CRE, and SBA loans. The system is designed to align with SR 11-7 and OCC guidance on AI governance and third-party risk, and claims to compress underwriting from weeks to minutes while enabling loan closures in under ten days. Proximitty publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; it is delivered as a hosted SaaS product, and its public surface is limited to a marketing site, blog, security/compliance page, and a hosted Trust Center.

providers.name: QR Code Crafter APIs
providers.description: Public REST API and agent-native QR code generation platform by Brand Aspect Ltd, offering static QR generation across 27 payload types, six export formats, bounded bulk generation, and managed dynamic URL redirects with capability-token management.

providers.name: Rad AI
providers.description: Rad AI is a San Francisco based healthcare technology company that builds generative and machine-learning software for radiology. Its products help radiologists work faster and reduce burnout: Rad AI Reporting is a generative AI reporting platform, Rad AI Impressions automatically generates customized report impressions (reported to save radiologists 60+ minutes per shift), and Rad AI Continuity manages follow-up of incidental findings. The company is SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA certified and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Rad AI markets its clinical products directly to health systems and imaging groups and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and compliance program for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Replika
providers.description: Replika is an AI companion mobile and web application built by Luka, Inc. that lets people create a personalized conversational AI "friend" for chat, emotional support, roleplay, voice calls, and augmented-reality companionship. The product is a closed consumer experience delivered through iOS, Android, and a legacy web app; it retains conversational memory and adapts its personality over time. Replika does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specifications, webhooks, or an MCP server — all model behavior is applied server-side and surfaced only through the first-party apps. This API Evangelist profile therefore captures identity, legal, support, and domain-security signals rather than an API contract. Replika was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched here as a company profile.

providers.name: RetainIQ
providers.description: RetainIQ is a full-service retention-marketing agency for direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, delivering lifecycle email and SMS programs. Its work spans automated flows (welcome, cart abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, replenishment), weekly strategic campaign sends with design and copywriting, and deliverability/segmentation/list-hygiene infrastructure. A proprietary 1:1 personalization engine generates variant product blocks at scale. A Klaviyo Gold Master Partner and Omnisend partner, RetainIQ integrates with Shopify, Klaviyo, and Omnisend; plans start at $990/mo on month-to-month terms. It operates as a marketing-services agency and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: RethinkDB
providers.description: RethinkDB is an open source, distributed document-oriented NoSQL database designed for real-time applications, with push-based change feeds, native JSON storage, and an expressive query language called ReQL. Applications interact with RethinkDB through official client drivers (JavaScript, Python, Java, Ruby) that speak the native JSON driver protocol over TCP, rather than through an HTTP REST API. ReQL also includes an r.http command that lets queries pull data from external HTTP APIs directly.

providers.name: RightHand Robotics
providers.description: RightHand Robotics builds autonomous piece-picking robotic systems for order fulfillment. Its RightPick platform combines computer vision, machine learning, and adaptive grasping hardware to pick and place millions of SKUs at cycle times as fast as three seconds across e-commerce, pharmaceutical, apparel, health & beauty, and grocery operations. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV, Menlo Ventures, and SoftBank Vision Fund. RightHand Robotics does not publish a public web API; integration, deployment, and operator documentation is provided to authorized customers and partners through a login-gated partner portal (rhrdocs.com). The public GitHub organization hosts open-source ROS packages and C control libraries for the earlier ReFlex robotic hand hardware rather than web-API client SDKs.

providers.name: SeekingAlpha
providers.description: Seeking Alpha is a crowd-sourced investment research and analysis platform for stock-market investors, providing breaking financial news, analyst articles, earnings-call transcripts, dividend and quant ratings, stock and ETF screeners, portfolio tracking, and subscription research services (Premium, Pro, and Alpha Picks). Backed by Accel and headquartered in Israel, it serves individual investors worldwide. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public first-party developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Skool
providers.description: Skool is an all-in-one community platform that combines discussion communities, online courses, live calls, and gamification in a single product, founded by Sam Ovens and popularized in partnership with Alex Hormozi. As of this review, Skool does NOT publish an official public or partner developer REST API. The only official programmatic surface is a Zapier integration, gated to the paid Pro plan, that exposes a small set of triggers and actions via a per-group API key used solely to link a Skool group to Zapier - it is not a general-purpose developer API. All broader "Skool API" offerings found in the wild (Apify actors, docs.skoolapi.com, reverse-engineered clients, Chrome extensions) are unofficial third-party tools built on Skool's undocumented internal endpoints and are not endorsed or supported by Skool. This catalog entry is an honest gated stub: no public API surface is modeled because none is documented.

providers.name: Sonder
providers.description: Sonder is a hospitality company that designs, leases, and operates a global portfolio of boutique, design-forward apartment-style accommodations and hotels for short- and extended-stay travelers. Guests book directly through Sonder's website and mobile app, where a tech-enabled experience spans contactless check-in, in-app service requests, and 24/7 local support across cities in North America, Europe, and the Middle East. In 2024 Sonder entered a long-term licensing agreement with Marriott that lists its properties in the Marriott Bonvoy program. The company is publicly traded and was backed by venture investors including Greylock. Sonder publishes no public developer API; the only machine-facing surface documented here is its responsible security-disclosure program and the site's domain-security posture.

providers.name: SpectrumOutage API
providers.description: Community-powered REST API for live Spectrum internet, TV, and phone outage data across the US. Independent tracker, not affiliated with Charter Communications or Spectrum. Provides aggregate stats, outage reports, city/state/ZIP status, and map pin data.

providers.name: Stockly
providers.description: Stockly (Stockly SAS, headquartered in Vitry-sur-Seine, France) operates a global inventory network for e-commerce, positioning itself as "the first global inventory for Retail." It connects online retailers that are missing stock (Demanders) with brands and official retailers that hold surplus inventory (Suppliers), detecting out-of-stock variants and filling the gaps in real time so that e-shops never run out of stock. Stockly integrates directly with a retailer's e-commerce infrastructure via API, a CMS, or a marketplace, and is building toward a stock exchange for e-commerce inventory in compliance with brands' distribution policies. The company reports 300+ partnered retailers across Europe and 100M+ available items, and is backed by Techstars. Stockly is primarily a partner-onboarded platform rather than a broad self-serve public developer API.

providers.name: Stone Co
providers.description: Stone Co. (NASDAQ: STNE) is a Brazilian financial services and payment technology company headquartered in São Paulo. Stone provides card acquiring (POS), digital banking, business management software, and credit products to entrepreneurs and small-to-medium businesses across more than 5,500 Brazilian cities, and is the fourth-largest acquirer in Brazil following its acquisition of Elavon's Brazilian operations. Stone operates several developer-facing platforms: Connect Stone (a POS integration API for in-store payment automation and "infinite shelf" omnichannel inventory), Stone Open Banking (a RESTful banking API for account, balance, TED, PIX, and payment-link operations against Stone accounts and consented third-party accounts), the Stone SDK Android (for embedding card-present payments into Android apps and Pinpad/POS devices), AutoTEF (PIN-pad-based self-service TEF integration), the Conciliação Stone XML reconciliation feed, and Pagar.me (Stone's online/PSP gateway covering orders, charges, customers, subscriptions, split payments, recurring billing, tokenization, and 3DS). Authentication is OAuth2 / PEM-keyed JWT for Open Banking and API-key / credential-based for the other surfaces. Onboarding for Open Banking and Connect Stone partners is gated through Stone's partnerships team; Pagar.me and the Android SDK are self-service. Documentation is primarily in Portuguese and concentrated at docs.stone.com.br, docs.openbank.stone.com.br, connect-stone.stone.com.br, conciliacao.stone.com.br, and docs.pagar.me.

providers.name: ThredUp
providers.description: ThredUp (NASDAQ: TDUP) is one of the world's largest online resale and consignment platforms for secondhand women's and kids' clothing, shoes, and accessories. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Oakland, CA, it lets consumers buy and sell pre-owned fashion via mailed Clean Out Kits, and powers branded recommerce for 60+ retailers through its Resale-as-a-Service (RaaS) platform. ThredUp does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI; RaaS integrations are arranged through its partner sales team, so this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public web, engineering, and policy surface rather than a documented API program.

providers.name: Topline Pro
providers.description: Topline Pro is an AI-powered business management platform for local and home service professionals in the United States — contractors, landscapers, painters, roofers, cleaners, and other owner-operated service companies. It provides AI-generated websites, local marketing and online discovery, lead capture with automated follow-up, AI-assisted customer communication, appointment and job scheduling, and invoicing with automated payment collection. Topline Pro is backed by Forerunner Ventures and Northzone. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, SDK, gRPC, AsyncAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface; it does publish an llms.txt at its marketing domain that describes the platform for AI agents.

providers.name: Urbanic
providers.description: Urbanic is an online fast-fashion retailer selling women's apparel and accessories through app-first, localized storefronts, including in.urbanic.com for India and mx.urbanic.com for Mexico, with local payment methods such as Paytm, BHIM, RuPay, OXXO, SPEI, Pix, and Boleto. A portfolio company of D1 Capital, Urbanic is a consumer ecommerce business: its storefront runs on a first-party consumer API (api-shop-in.urbanic.com), but it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: VidCruiter
providers.description: VidCruiter is a Moncton, Canada based recruitment technology company that provides a modular hiring platform - pre-recorded and live video interviewing, automated interview scheduling, skills and pre-employment testing, automated reference checking, audio interviews, and video proctoring. VidCruiter does not publish a public, self-service developer API. Its programmatic surface is a partner and enterprise integration capability: pre-built connectors to major ATS/HCM, background-check, calendar, job-board, SSO, and video-conferencing providers, plus a bidirectional web-services integration in which an institution's unique, account-provisioned API endpoint is exchanged with a system of record (for example Slate) to push application records into VidCruiter and pull completed interview results back out. API access is gated behind a VidCruiter account representative; there is no public API reference, OpenAPI document, base URL, or self-serve key issuance.

providers.name: Volley
providers.description: Volley is a San Francisco voice-AI entertainment company, backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, that builds voice-controlled and connected-TV games. Its catalog includes hits such as Song Quiz, Yes Sire, and officially licensed titles like Jeopardy!, Wheel of Fortune, and Family Feud, playable on Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, Roku, Fire TV, LG, and Samsung TVs. The company is rebranding its consumer surface as "Weekend." Volley operates as a consumer entertainment product studio and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Withco
providers.description: Withco, now operating as With at with.us (the original with.co domain 301-redirects there), is rebuilding main street one share at a time. The company helps small business owners buy the commercial buildings they operate in, stacking the owner's investment, seller financing, and community investor capital to meet the deal price, grounding offers in comparable sales, and giving each business a public investor page to tell its story to potential backers. Withco is a consumer/community real-estate platform and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Yana
providers.description: Yana is an AI-powered emotional companion app (published by Yana App, S.A.P.I. de C.V., a 500 Global portfolio company) that gives millions of Spanish and English speakers a private space to talk through their feelings, reflect, and build daily emotional wellbeing. The product ships as consumer iOS and Android apps rather than a public API, and the company is currently rebuilding toward a new version of the companion.

providers.name: 1910 Genetics
providers.description: 1910 Genetics (now branded 1910) is an AI-native biotechnology company advancing small and large molecule drug discovery with a multimodal AI platform powered by high-throughput laboratory automation. Its ITO platform integrates computational data, wet-lab proxy biological data, and wet-lab ground-truth biological data to pursue "modality agnostic" drug discovery, alongside named AI models including PEGASUS (macrocyclic peptide discovery) and CANDID-CNS (CNS-penetration prediction). The company partners with pharma and technology organizations and offers co-engineering collaborations at the data, AI-model, compute, and interactive-tool levels. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Playground Global. As of this profile the company publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Aalo Atomics
providers.description: Aalo Atomics is an Austin, Texas-based advanced nuclear engineering company, founded in 2021, working to make reactor deployment fast, repeatable, and economical through factory manufacturing. It is developing the Aalo-1, a factory-fabricated sodium-cooled microreactor (~10 MWe class), and Aalo Pod power plants that combine five Aalo-1 reactors to deliver roughly 50 megawatts of electricity for data centers, industrial facilities, and communities. The company describes a new XMR ("extra modular reactor") category, has raised a $100M Series B, and is advancing through U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission pre-application activities and a U.S. Department of Energy experimental microreactor site in Idaho. This API Evangelist profile tracks Aalo Atomics as a company in the network; the company does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Actifio
providers.description: Actifio is an enterprise data management company that pioneered "copy data management" (CDM) built on its Virtual Data Pipeline (VDP) technology, letting organizations capture a single physical copy of production data and instantly provision virtual copies for backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, test/dev, and analytics. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, Actifio was acquired by Google Cloud in December 2020. Its technology now underpins the Google Cloud Backup and Disaster Recovery (Backup and DR) service and Actifio GO, delivering SaaS backup and DR for Google Cloud and hybrid workloads. Actifio VDP exposes automation via a RESTful API and CLI on the appliance, but there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger specification, or published client SDK.

providers.name: Adalo
providers.description: Adalo is a visual no-code app builder that lets users design, build, and publish native iOS, Android, and web applications without writing code, combining a drag-and-drop canvas with AI-assisted generation and hosted Postgres-backed collections. The platform supports external data sources, pre-built feature templates, and 2,000+ integrations via Zapier and Make, hosting over a million apps. The Adalo API provides REST access to app collections and push notifications, secured with a per-app Bearer API key.

providers.name: Akkari
providers.description: Akkari is an autonomous customer operations platform that runs the operational work across the entire customer lifecycle — from the first sales call through onboarding, success, and expansion. It captures every commitment, issue, request, and opportunity surfaced across customer channels like Slack, Discord, email, calls, and meetings, then executes the actual work to close each loop: drafting follow-ups, converting bug reports into tickets, scheduling meetings, and flagging expansion signals. Built for AI-native startups by 2x Y Combinator founders (OrderAhead, acquired by Square; and BLADE), Akkari integrates with tools including Slack, Linear, GitHub, Gmail, and PostHog.

providers.name: American Superconductor Corporation
providers.description: American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) is a Ayer, Massachusetts based power systems company that designs and deploys grid interconnection, power protection, and power supply solutions for the energy, renewables, industrial, utility, and military sectors. Its portfolio spans grid systems such as D-VAR dynamic reactive compensation and STATCOM, ship protection and degaussing systems for naval defense, wind turbine electrical control systems, and Amperium high-temperature superconductor wire. AMSC was surfaced as a portfolio company of kleiner-perkins and added to the API Evangelist network. This is a public-company / hardtech profile with no public developer API surface; the enrichment pass captured domain-security posture and corporate link properties only.

providers.name: Amogy
providers.description: Amogy is an energy-technology company decarbonizing hard-to-electrify sectors by converting energy-dense ammonia into dispatchable, zero-carbon electricity. Its AMMDrive power systems crack ammonia into hydrogen and nitrogen and convert the hydrogen to power for data centers, industrial facilities, microgrids, and maritime vessels, and it develops proprietary low-temperature ammonia-cracking catalysts. Backed by DCVC and other investors, Amogy has demonstrated the world's first carbon-free ammonia-powered maritime vessel and partners with firms such as Samsung Heavy Industries and Mitsubishi. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Amogy publishes no public developer API surface at this time, so this record captures its corporate identity and public web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: AMSC
providers.description: American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) is a power control systems company headquartered in Ayer, Massachusetts, and traded publicly on NASDAQ under the ticker AMSC. The company designs and delivers grid and power-electronics solutions across three specialties - power supply, power protection, and power innovation - serving the energy, renewables, utility, industrial, materials, and military sectors. Its offerings span grid capacity and resiliency systems, renewable generation integration, industrial process power control, and shipboard power protection for naval defense. AMSC is an early Battery Ventures portfolio investment. AMSC does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's corporate identity and domain security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Another
providers.description: Another is an AI-native software platform that modernizes off-channel and off-price inventory operations for fashion, beauty, and retail brands. Founded in 2024 by Corina Marshall, the platform connects to a retailer's existing systems - including returns management - to create a single source of truth for excess, returned, and pre-loved goods, then automates how brands identify, manage, and monetize that inventory across downstream channels. Teams can invite and connect with secondary merchandise recipients, send inventory proposals to buyers, request payment from partners, and let partners request inventory, replacing fragmented manual workflows spread across teams, buyers, channels, and partners. Another closed a $2.5M seed round in January 2026 co-led by Anthemis and Westbound. As of this profile the company operates a private, invite-based web application and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Approxima
providers.description: Approxima is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building AI agents that test every pull request. Approxima plugs into your CI/CD pipeline and runs autonomous agents on each PR: the agents build your application in an isolated sandbox, exercise it in a real browser, and report exactly what is broken, with screenshots. The company positions itself as a trust layer for AI-assisted software development, letting engineering teams catch regressions and validate fixes end to end before code merges to production. As of this profile Approxima operates a marketing site and private login at approxima.ai and does not yet publish a public API, developer documentation, or an OpenAPI definition; this repo captures its identity and domain-security posture pending a public API surface.

providers.name: Aura Finance
providers.description: Aura Finance is an employer-sponsored financial wellness platform that blends behavioral psychology with money management to help employees reach financial stability and peace of mind. The San Francisco fintech — a Techstars Economic Mobility 2023 company and an SEC-registered investment adviser (CRD 318940) — delivers goal-based automated investing, one-on-one financial coaching over chat, budgeting and saving tools, financial-literacy workshops, mindfulness exercises to reduce money stress, and a money-personality quiz, offered through a B2B2C model to organizations and their workforces. The company publishes no public developer program, API, or SDKs; its member application lives at web.aurafi.io.

providers.name: AVATOUR, Imeve
providers.description: AVATOUR (Imeve Inc.) is a 360-degree video collaboration platform that lets distributed teams conduct remote site visits, inspections, virtual tours, and location-based training without travel. It supports live real-time 360 streaming, synchronous shared sessions, and asynchronous on-demand recordings with annotations and reporting, serving manufacturing, construction, real estate, logistics, and retail. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during the enrichment pass.

providers.name: Avenue
providers.description: Avenue is an operations observability and workflow-automation platform that helps operations, RevOps, and support teams detect problems and act on them in real time. It connects to the tools and databases a business already runs on (Postgres, Google Sheets, Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack, Linear, Asana, Notion), watches for issues using custom rules and thresholds, and routes alerts into a shared task queue where teams triage and resolve them. A drag-and-drop playbook builder and an operational AI copilot automate routine responses, while metrics track resolution over time. Avenue is used by operations leaders at marketplaces, fintech, and healthcare companies. It was founded in 2021 and is backed by Y Combinator, Slack Fund, Accel, and Flexport.

providers.name: Basebuild
providers.description: Basebuild Labs, Inc. builds Beams, an AI project manager for construction and real estate teams. The product automatically transcribes project meetings, tracks decisions and action items, and assembles a searchable knowledge base from those discussions, capturing information without requiring a bot to join the call. It is aimed at giving construction and real estate project teams real-time visibility and control over teams, projects, budgets, and finances. Basebuild is an early-stage Canaan Partners portfolio company based in Santa Monica, California, and this API Evangelist profile tracks its public-facing surface. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing site and a product login only, with no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or documentation surface to catalog.

providers.name: BioInteractive Technologies
providers.description: BioInteractive Technologies operates Tenzr Health, a configurable digital care layer that helps health systems, rehabilitation programs, orthopedic groups, and therapy organizations extend care beyond the clinic. The platform gives patients structured guidance, education, tasks, check-ins, and recovery support while giving clinicians better visibility into patient progress, adherence, symptoms, and recovery signals across the episode of care. Tenzr supports musculoskeletal, orthopedic, and stroke rehabilitation, acquired brain injury recovery, outpatient therapy, Remote Therapeutic Monitoring, and hybrid or virtual care pathways. The company does not currently publish a public developer API or developer program.

providers.name: Bliq
providers.description: Bliq is a Berlin-based premium driverless-car subscription service rolling out across Europe. Instead of owning a car or paying per ride, members subscribe monthly to a private autonomous vehicle that Bliq charges, cleans, insures, maintains, and parks on their behalf. Cars are booked for time windows (hours or days) rather than single trips, every journey is remotely supervised by licensed local operators, and there is no surge pricing. Backed by Speedinvest, Bliq positions itself as "ownership without ownership." The company currently operates a consumer marketing site with early-access and waitlist flows and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Bloom Energy
