providers.description: Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE: BE) is a San Jose, California hardtech company that designs and manufactures solid-oxide fuel cell "Energy Server" platforms which generate electricity on-site from natural gas, biogas, or hydrogen through an electrochemical process rather than combustion. Its modular systems deliver resilient, always-on power for data centers, manufacturing, healthcare, utilities, and critical infrastructure, can be deployed in roughly 90 days, and scale from single units to hundreds of megawatts. Bloom also builds high-temperature solid-oxide electrolyzers for low-cost hydrogen production. The company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a hardtech portfolio company; it publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Bluma
providers.description: Bluma is a San Francisco-based AI company (Y Combinator Fall 2025) building a short-form AI content engine that lets creators, agencies, and brands produce social media video ads at scale. The platform "de-edits" existing reference videos into their individual scenes, captions, and overlays, then uses AI asset generation and a node-based canvas editor to recreate and remix shots into new ads, UGC, and template-based videos optimized for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Bluma also publishes a set of free, browser-based social tools (video downloading, carousel/slideshow extraction, TikTok/Instagram URL normalization, metadata inspection, transcript generation, audio extraction, thumbnail capture). Founded by Alisa Wu (formerly Zoox/Amazon) and Stephen Ni. No public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal has been published to date; this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: Bolt.Earth
providers.description: Bolt.Earth operates what it describes as India's largest EV charging network, with more than 100,000 charging points deployed across 2,100+ cities. The company sells EV charging hardware (3.3kW smart sockets for 2/3/4-wheelers, AC chargers from 7.4kW to 22kW, and DC fast chargers from 30kW to 240kW) alongside a Charging Management System (CMS) for operators and a consumer mobile app for locating, booking, and paying for charging sessions. Services span site assessment, installation, KYC onboarding, charger activation, remote firmware updates, and 24/7 support for individuals, RWAs, enterprises, fleet operators, hospitality venues, highways, and government agencies. Bolt.Earth is backed by Version One Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an energy-sector company profile. No public developer API portal or OpenAPI definition was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Brightwheel
providers.description: Brightwheel (mybrightwheel.com) is an all-in-one childcare and early education management platform used by childcare centers, preschools, and early-learning programs to run daily operations - attendance and check-in, digital daily sheets, tuition billing and payments, enrollment and admissions, staff/timecards, classroom (room) management, learning assessments, and real-time parent messaging and photo/video sharing. As of this catalog entry, Brightwheel does NOT publish a documented, self-serve public or partner developer API. There is no developer portal, API reference, API key signup, OpenAPI specification, or webhook documentation. The only Brightwheel API activity that is publicly acknowledged is bespoke, contract-scoped work built for individual government partners - for example a private API implemented to submit attendance and subsidy data to Iowa's childcare subsidy data system - and inbound integrations where Brightwheel pushes data into third-party products (e.g. staff timecards to Gusto for payroll). None of these expose a documented API surface that outside developers can build against. This entry is therefore an honest stub documenting the provider and its access model; no API definitions are asserted because none are publicly documented.

providers.name: Cabana
providers.description: Cabana Pools is a California pool-service company providing recurring maintenance, repair, and equipment installation for residential swimming pools across San Diego, Los Angeles, Orange County, and Sacramento. Services include weekly cleaning, filter maintenance, chemical balancing, algae removal, and repair of pumps, heaters, filters, and automation systems, delivered by CPO-certified technicians with photo documentation and chemical reports after each visit. The company offers an instant online pricing quote tool. No public API or developer surface is currently published; this profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network lead.

providers.name: Cadre
providers.description: Cadre is a New York-based, technology-driven investment platform that gives individual and institutional investors access to private-market alternatives, historically centered on institutional-quality commercial real estate. Founded in 2014 and backed by investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Thrive Capital, and Slow Ventures, Cadre now operates in partnership with Willow Wealth (Willow Wealth Markets LLC, a FINRA/SIPC broker-dealer formerly known as RealCadre LLC, and Willow Asset Management LLC, an SEC-registered investment adviser) to offer diversified private-market funds alongside traditional stocks and bonds. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Cadre does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Capstone Turbine
providers.description: Capstone Turbine Corporation, now operating as Capstone Green Energy (and its operating entity Capstone Energy+), is a California-based manufacturer of low-emission microturbine energy systems founded in 1988. The company designs and builds oil-free, air-bearing microturbines ranging from 65 kW to multi-megawatt configurations for on-site and on-demand power, combined heat and power (CHP), and combined cooling, heat and power (CCHP). Its systems power data centers, microgrids, ports, EV charging, oil and gas operations, critical power, and renewable energy applications. Capstone was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It is an industrial energy manufacturer with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Carbon
providers.description: Carbon is a digital manufacturing company that builds an integrated 3D printing platform combining Digital Light Synthesis (DLS) printing hardware, advanced photopolymer resins, and cloud-connected computational design software. Its technology enables production-scale additive manufacturing of end-use polymer parts across automotive, medical, dental, consumer goods, and industrial applications, with the Design Engine tool for lattice and part design and the Carbon Academy knowledge base for operational guidance. Carbon is a frontier-tech portfolio company backed by GV. As of this profile Carbon exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or event surface; enrichment is limited to verified company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Charta Health
providers.description: Charta Health is a healthcare AI company (founded 2023) that provides AI-powered medical chart review and autonomous coding for provider groups, FQHCs, MSOs, health systems, and payers. Its platform streams charts in from hundreds of EHR, clearinghouse, and billing integrations, then audits every patient encounter pre-billing to generate codes, surface missed revenue and E/M leveling issues, identify HCC risk-adjustment codes with supporting documentation citations, reduce payer audit risk, and deliver data-driven provider feedback. Charta reports outcomes such as an 11% revenue uplift from scaling pre-billing review across 100% of encounters. Integrations are built per customer against the customer's EHR (e.g. athenahealth Marketplace); Charta does not publish a public self-serve developer API or portal.

providers.name: Chief
providers.description: Chief is a private membership network built to connect and support senior women leaders, serving executives across more than 10,000 companies with roughly 44% of members in C-suite roles. Membership combines vetted peer Core Groups, one-on-one and group executive coaching, business training (including programming with partners such as The Wharton School), member Clubhouses, and ChiefX events, plus an enterprise offering for companies sponsoring their women leaders. Chief is a membership-and-community company rather than an API provider, so this profile is an identity record in the API Evangelist network with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Cleverdeck
providers.description: CleverDeck is a spaced-repetition flashcard application for iOS, built by an independent developer to help people learn and retain vocabulary and other material more efficiently. It ships hand-made premium decks covering roughly the 3,000 most common words in major foreign languages — Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Persian, Russian and advanced English — with translations, transliterations, images, native-speaker audio, and example sentences in both English and the target language. The app uses the SM-2 spaced-repetition algorithm (as popularized by SuperMemo and Anki) with a customizable learning schedule, cross-device sync, and full offline support. It is free to create and study your own content, with unlimited access to the premium decks for $3 per month. CleverDeck is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or agent-facing surface.

providers.name: Crew
providers.description: Crew is a digital workplace platform for frontline and deskless teams, connecting frontline staff to corporate leadership across distributed workforces. The product bundles real-time team communication and employee engagement, labor optimization and shift scheduling, task execution, culture and recognition, knowledge management, a Command Center for administration and analytics, a compliance and safety suite, and third-party integrations. Crew reports serving more than one million frontline workers across companies including Taco Bell, Wendy's, Planet Fitness, and Harps Foods. It is backed by Greylock and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Dianxiaomi
providers.description: Dianxiaomi (店小秘) is a free cross-border e-commerce ERP platform operated by Shenzhen Meiyunji Network Technology Co., Ltd., serving more than 1.8 million cross-border sellers worldwide. It unifies product listing and data collection, multi-platform order processing, warehouse and inventory management, procurement, financial and profit analytics, and customer service across 70+ marketplaces including AliExpress, Amazon, Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop, with integrations to 1,700+ logistics providers and 130+ overseas warehouses. The platform is user-facing SaaS; no public developer/API open platform is currently published.

providers.name: Discz
providers.description: Discz is a consumer mobile application that blends music discovery with social chat, styled as a modern, MySpace-inspired music community. Users discover songs, build music profiles, and chat with others around shared taste in music. The iOS app is developed by Discz, a Y Combinator-backed startup and a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. Discz publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its surface is the consumer iOS app distributed through the Apple App Store.

providers.name: Dwelly
providers.description: Dwelly (legal entity PROSPIRE TECHNOLOGIES LTD, also trading as Dwelly Group) is a UK-based, AI-first lettings and property-management company founded in 2023 by Ilya Drozdov (CEO), Dan Lifshits (CPO) and Dmitry Khanukov (CTO). Rather than selling software, Dwelly grows by acquiring independent UK lettings agencies and succession-planning their owners out, then running the acquired books on its own AI-powered operating platform. That platform automates tenant find (self-service enquiry chat, virtual viewings, verified offers), banking-grade tenant screening (KYC, Right to Rent, referencing), Direct Debit rent collection with automatic reconciliation and arrears handling, maintenance and property management workflows with centralised communications, and continuous lettings compliance. Dwelly is backed by General Catalyst, Begin Capital and S16VC. As of this profile Dwelly publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or technical documentation — the platform is operated internally for its own and its acquired agencies' portfolios.

providers.name: DZone
providers.description: DZone is one of the world's largest online communities and a leading publisher of knowledge resources for software engineering professionals. Founded in 1997 with roots in Javalobby, DZone reaches millions of developers each month with articles, tutorials, research guides, and Refcards covering topics including cloud architecture, Java, JavaScript, microservices, containers, data, DevOps, AI, and more.

providers.name: EarnBetter
providers.description: EarnBetter is a consumer job-search platform that gives workers free AI-powered tools to land better work, including an AI resume builder, cover letter generator, personalized job matching across more than five million listings, and a job-search tracker. The service is positioned as 100% free to job seekers and was acquired by EarnIn, the earned-wage / payroll-access company. EarnBetter surfaces as a portfolio company of a16z and was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. As of this pass EarnBetter publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile therefore captures company identity and public link properties only, with no API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: Eastman Chemical
providers.description: Driven by more than 100 years of continuous innovation, Eastman is a global Fortune 500 specialty materials company that produces a broad range of advanced materials, chemicals, and fibers used in everyday products. Eastman operates a customer-facing Customer Center for orders, documents, and Safety Data Sheets, but no public developer portal or REST API has been documented.

providers.name: EcomExperts
providers.description: EcomExperts is a Latin American ecommerce ERP and technology platform that helps online sellers manage, synchronize, and automate their stores from a single screen. It centralizes omnichannel operations across marketplaces and sales channels (including multi-account Mercado Libre management), synchronizes prices and stock in real time, and issues electronic invoices automatically in bulk. Delivered as a SaaS application with a hosted dashboard and a 7-day free trial, EcomExperts operates across Argentina, Chile, Mexico, Uruguay, Colombia, and Peru. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. EcomExperts does not currently publish a public developer platform, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures company identity and public-surface signals only.

providers.name: ElCoach
providers.description: ElCoach (الكوتش) is a Cairo, Egypt based fitness and nutrition technology company serving the Middle East and North Africa. Its bilingual Arabic/English mobile app delivers personalized workout routines and healthy meal plans tailored to each user, combining certified trainers and nutritionists with AI-driven personalization. The product is a consumer subscription app distributed on iOS and Android with in-app payments; it does not publish a public developer API program. ElCoach is backed by 500 Global (500 Startups), Endure Capital, Wise Capital, and the Misk 500 MENA and Google accelerators, and was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: enrich
providers.description: Enrich is a private, invite-only membership network for senior technology leaders — VPs, Directors, and CXOs from companies including Google, Slack, Anthropic, and OpenAI. It runs peer-led conversations with executive coaching, curated small-group and monthly in-person dinners, expert-led operator discussions, topic-based peer groups (organizational design, career transitions), and a private Slack community for real-time peer advice. Backed by Bloomberg Beta and Cowboy Ventures, and added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead. Enrich publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface — it is a community/membership product, not an API provider.

providers.name: Enter
providers.description: Enter is a Berlin-based residential energy-efficiency company that positions itself as Germany's largest energy advisor, combining on-site building analysis with installation of heat pumps, photovoltaic (solar) systems, battery storage, EV wallboxes, and home energy-management systems. It guides homeowners through energy consulting, subsidy (Foerderung) applications, and financing, and reports 37,000+ completed projects and 150M+ EUR in secured subsidies. Enter is a B2C service provider with no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs; it was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment.

providers.name: Fazla Gida
providers.description: Fazla (formerly Fazla Gida / Whole Surplus) is a Turkish technology-driven waste management and circular-economy company founded in 2017 in Istanbul. Its digital, decision-support platform helps B2B clients across the supply chain — manufacturers, retailers, e-commerce, distributors, HoReCa, food banks and municipalities — prevent waste at the source and recover value from surplus inventory through a food-recovery hierarchy of secondary-sales marketplace, donation, animal-feed conversion and recycling modules, backed by logistics support, a smart-scale IoT inventory system and an AI analysis tool that reports financial, CO2 and social impact. The company operates the Fazla Iyi surprise-box consumer app, is the first B Corp-certified waste-management organization in Turkey, and is backed by 500 Global among other investors.

providers.name: Fleetline
providers.description: Fleetline is an all-in-one AI dispatch and fleet-optimization platform for trucking fleets. Its AI-based dispatch engine ingests load, driver, and ELD data, simulates billions of scenarios, and recommends the best assignment plan so operators maximize revenue, productivity, and fleet utilization. The platform aggregates major load boards into a unified workspace, identifies schedule gaps and fills them with spot loads, composes complex trips with tradeoff analysis, forecasts delays, breakdowns, and HOS violations, and includes an AI assistant trained on fleet history and TMS data. Fleetline is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company; it exposes a marketing site, a customer login/auth portal, and an internal API host, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Flock Homes
providers.description: Flock Homes is a real estate investment platform, founded in 2020 and backed by a16z, that lets individual rental-property owners retire from active landlording by contributing their single-family and multifamily homes into a professionally managed, diversified residential real estate fund. Flock uses a 721 Exchange (an UPREIT contribution) so owners can trade appreciated rental property for fund shares on a tax-deferred basis, deferring capital gains and depreciation-recapture taxes while eliminating repair, vacancy, and eviction responsibilities. Fund investors receive quarterly cash-flow distributions and long-term appreciation across a nationwide portfolio, with Flock handling all property management, maintenance, and tenant operations. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface has been found; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: FT Cash
providers.description: FTCash (ftcash) is a Mumbai, India based financial services / fintech company focused on financial inclusion for micro-merchants and small and medium enterprises (SMEs). It provides digital payment acceptance and working-capital business loans to small offline retailers and merchants who are typically underserved by traditional banking, enabling them to accept digital payments and access short-term credit. FTCash was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global (500 Startups) and added to the API Evangelist network. At this time FTCash operates a public marketing website but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts, so this profile is limited to verified company identity plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Goomp Inc, Kalendar AI
providers.description: Kalendar AI (Goomp Inc / Kalendar Inc, a Delaware corporation operating from New York) is an autonomous AI sales-agent platform that automates B2B outbound prospecting end to end. It sources ideal-customer prospects from a database of hundreds of millions of professionals and companies, generates and sends personalized outreach through dedicated AI-managed mailbox infrastructure, qualifies replies, and books meetings directly onto the user's calendar. The product is sold as a self-serve, per-agent subscription and connects to common CRMs, calendars, and productivity tools. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Kalendar AI publishes a marketing site and product app behind Cloudflare, legal (terms/privacy) and sign-in pages, but no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or documented webhook surface.

providers.name: Ground AI
providers.description: Ground (joinground.com) is an AI-native revenue platform for consumer and e-commerce brands, delivering autonomous "AI revenue agents" that drive growth across the customer lifecycle. Its products include Greet AI for converting new visitors, ReBeat AI for repeat purchases and retention, and Terra, an AI-native revenue engine that orchestrates actions across the funnel. Ground positions itself as Growth-as-a-Service, plugging into a brand's existing stack (Shopify, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Recharge, Salesforce, Meta, Google Ads and 20+ platforms) with a fast, low-lift deployment. Headquartered in New York and Silicon Valley with a global team, Ground is a Techstars-backed company. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network via VC-portfolio discovery; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation at this time.

providers.name: HijUp
providers.description: HijUp is an Indonesia-based modest-fashion e-commerce marketplace selling Muslim women's clothing online — abayas, blouses, dresses, tunics, printed scarves, hijabs, mukena, khimar, and related accessories — aggregating a large catalog of local Indonesian modest-wear brands (over a hundred labels listed under its brands directory) into a single storefront with international shipping. The company operates a consumer-facing shopping site (product catalog, categories, cart, checkout, and customer accounts) rather than a public developer platform; it publishes no API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. HijUp is backed by 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. Public contact is customer@hijup.com and +6221-78-24-001.

providers.name: Humans Anonymous
providers.description: Humans Anonymous is a consumer mobile application offering anonymous audio spaces for mental health and peer support, built on the premise that "being a human is hard" and no one should face it alone. Distributed as an iOS app, it lets people join anonymous, real-time audio rooms to talk and listen around mental wellbeing. Surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes a consumer product website (humansanon.com) with privacy and terms pages but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: HYPERZ AI
providers.description: HYPERZ AI is a generative-AI company focused on professional photography and headshot generation, offering both consumer (B2C) and enterprise (B2B) products. Its consumer tool, Business Photo AI (businessphoto.ai), turns selfies into professional headshots with customizable poses, outfits, and backgrounds. Its enterprise product, HYPERTURE (hyperture.ai), delivers consistent, studio-grade headshots for teams with brand-consistency controls, member approval workflows, and C2PA provenance verification. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface — the products are end-user applications rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: iContact
providers.description: iContact is an email marketing and marketing automation platform (now part of Cision) that helps small and mid-market businesses build email campaigns, manage contacts and lists, automate drip sequences, and measure engagement. The iContact REST API v2.2 provides programmatic access to contacts, lists, segments, campaigns, messages, and reporting data using a combination of HTTP headers (API-AppId, API-Version, API-Username, API-Password) for authentication.

providers.name: Imagine Ai
providers.description: Imagine AI (YC F25) is a San Francisco B2B content platform, founded in 2025 by Neo Lee and Sky Yang, that reverse-engineers modern B2B growth starting with LinkedIn. It builds a persona-driven AI clone of a founder or executive by deeply analyzing their writing, speaking style, and market context, then uses that persona to plan content strategy, write LinkedIn posts, draft comments and DMs, and schedule coordinated distribution across an executive team (CEO, VP of Sales, Head of Marketing) from a single shared content calendar. Each client is paired with a dedicated content engineer, and the platform tracks engagement-quality analytics and inbound lead generation; early customers include MongoDB, Rippling, and Conduit. Imagine AI is a sales-led SaaS with no public self-serve developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI definition as of this catalog entry — this profile captures the company's identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Infervision
providers.description: Infervision is a medical artificial intelligence company that builds AI-powered medical imaging and clinical decision-support software for hospitals and healthcare providers. Its InferRead diagnostic suite assists radiologists with CT and DR reading across lung nodule detection, chest abnormality detection, coronary artery stenosis, stroke and hemorrhage triage, rib fracture identification, and pneumonia triage, while the InferOperate suite provides 3D reconstruction for thoracic, liver, and urological surgical planning. Additional platforms include InferCare for patient management and image follow-up, InferScholar for AI-enabled medical research, and the InferMatrix medical application platform. The company holds FDA 510(k) clearance for InferRead CT Lung, has filed 380+ patents and published 330+ peer-reviewed papers, and operates across 30+ countries. Infervision was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: innRoad
providers.description: innRoad is a cloud-based hotel property management system (PMS) that bundles PMS, a direct booking engine, and a channel manager (OTA distribution to Expedia, Booking.com, Airbnb, and others) into one platform, built for independent hotels, boutique properties, and small hotel management companies. innRoad also offers 40+ pre-built partner connections - point-of-sale (Lightspeed, Oracle Hospitality, Squirrel, Positouch, Uniwell), door locks (RemoteLock, Saflok, ONITY), guest messaging (Akia), accounting (M3, Inn-Flow), and in-house payment processing (innRoad Payments) - that are toggled on inside the application. innRoad does NOT publish a public, self-service developer API. There is no developer portal, no public API reference, no OpenAPI definition, and no documented WebSocket or webhook API as of this cataloging; every listed integration is a pre-built, partner-gated connection rather than an open surface a third-party developer can register for and call.

providers.name: Insurance Australia Group
providers.description: Insurance Australia Group (IAG, ASX: IAG) is the largest general insurance company in Australia and New Zealand, headquartered in Sydney and operating a portfolio of underwriting brands rather than a single consumer-facing label. In Australia it trades as NRMA Insurance, CGU, WFI, Swann Insurance and the digital-native ROLLiN'; in New Zealand as State, AMI, NZI and Lumley. Its lines of business are property and casualty — home and contents, motor, commercial, rural and farm, compulsory third party and specialty — split across a Direct Insurance Australia arm and an Intermediated Insurance Australia arm that sells through brokers and authorised representatives. IAG has no public, self-serve API surface. Probing every conventional developer hostname on iag.com.au, cgu.com.au and nrma.com.au found no developer portal and no published reference documentation; docs.iag.com.au exists but immediately redirects to a Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and is an internal wall, not a portal. What the probes did confirm is a real Apigee API gateway fronting three brand virtual hosts — api.iag.com.au, api.cgu.com.au and api.nrma.com.au — each returning an Apigee ApplicationNotFound fault at the root, meaning proxies exist but none is discoverable or documented to the public. A second round of probing added a fourth brand virtual host, api.wfi.com.au, and a publicly resolvable non-production Apigee organisation at test-api.iag.com.au. IAG has also deployed MuleSoft's Anypoint API Experience Hub and is migrating roughly 600 APIs onto it, with a stated intent to make them agent aware — a substantial API estate that is entirely internal. Broker and partner integration in this market runs through human-facing trading portals — CGU's PolicyPlace quote-and-bind platform, the Ebix Sunrise Exchange and the Steadfast Client Trading Platform — not through an open API programme. IAG does run a HackerOne vulnerability disclosure programme, and published an RFC 9116 security.txt across seven brand domains until it was withdrawn in mid-2025. Australia has the legal machinery for open insurance and no live obligation: the Consumer Data Right that opened banking and energy was flagged for general insurance and then paused, so nothing compels IAG to publish. This record is therefore an honest stub: a partner-gated carrier with a private gateway and zero public specifications.

providers.name: Intella, LTD
providers.description: Intella is an enterprise Arabic AI company founded in 2021, building proprietary Arabic speech intelligence from the ground up for banks, telecoms, and governments across the MENA region. Its product suite includes Ziila (an AI voice agent handling inbound/outbound conversations across 25+ Arabic dialects), intellaCX (call-center conversation analytics for sentiment and friction detection), intellaMX (media translation and dialect-aware subtitling), and intellaVX (a dialectal Arabic speech-to-text engine exposed through a REST API for high-throughput CCaaS, CRM, and developer-tool integration). Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Item
providers.description: Item is an AI-native customer relationship management (CRM) platform, part of Y Combinator's Fall 2025 batch. It replaces the traditional CRM with an AI Assistant that handles daily work in plain language and customizable Agents that autonomously execute business processes across sales, support, and account management. Item connects to 100+ customer tools, gathers and enriches context automatically, discovers leads that match an ideal customer profile, and becomes a company's single source of truth for people, companies, and deals.

providers.name: Its Good
providers.description: It's Good is a social dining recommendation app that reimagines how people discover restaurants and bars by surfacing recommendations from trusted friends rather than crowdsourced reviews from strangers. Founded in 2023 and co-founded by Mike Rosenthal (CEO) and musician John Legend, the iOS app lets people save the places they love, organize their lists, and share personalized recommendations within a curated community of people they know and admire. The company is backed by a seed investment from Lightspeed Venture Partners. It's Good is a consumer mobile product and does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: K Health
providers.description: K Health is a clinical AI and virtual primary care company founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City. Its platform pairs an AI-led symptom investigation and intake engine with a 24/7 team of credentialed clinicians to deliver primary care, urgent care, mental health, and medical weight management. K Health licenses its clinical AI to health systems — including Cedars-Sinai, Mayo Clinic, Hackensack Meridian Health, Hartford HealthCare, Mass General Brigham, and Northwell Health — where it triages patients, combines intake with EMR data (Epic/MyChart), and automates clinical documentation. The company has raised more than $380M and was valued at roughly $900M as of 2024. K Health is a B2B2C consumer health application with no public developer API; integrations are handled through partners such as Health Gorilla for lab ordering. This profile was surfaced as a ggv-capital portfolio lead and enriched with verified public identity, link, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Kickpay
providers.description: Kickpay is an intelligent finance platform for e-commerce and hardware brands that unlocks capital tied up in inventory. It plugs into a company's data sources — fulfillment centers, e-commerce sales channels, and bank accounts — to see historic sales, then finances the manufacturing cost of each SKU it estimates will sell within a reasonable window (typically around 16 weeks). Kickpay can fund the brand directly or pay the manufacturer to purchase more inventory, and the brand only pays Kickpay back as units ship: when a unit ships from the fulfillment center, Kickpay activates an ACH payment for the manufacturing price plus a fixed fee. It provides smart daily servicing and reporting, distinguishes customer shipments from internal stock movements, and uses prediction tooling to forecast future sales and cash flow so it can underwrite startups with as little as three months of sales history. Kickpay was backed by Canaan Partners and DCVC. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Kickpay publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs, and the enrichment pipeline found no machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Komodor
providers.description: Komodor is an autonomous AI SRE platform for Kubernetes observability, troubleshooting, and operations across multiple clusters. The platform surfaces cluster events, deployment timelines, dependency maps, and remediation runbooks to help platform and SRE teams diagnose incidents faster. Komodor exposes a REST API plus a Terraform provider for managing clusters, services, monitors, and policies, authenticated with API keys generated from the User Settings page.

providers.name: Laelaps AI
providers.description: Laelaps AI is a Zurich- and UK-based autonomous security company building what it calls "the brain behind security" — a hardware-agnostic, fail-safe autonomy layer that unifies aerial, ground, and stationary robots together with a site's existing fixed cameras into a single coordinated monitoring force. The platform pairs field foundational models and visual intelligence with multi-agent coordination so that critical infrastructure and commercial and defense sites can be watched continuously, incidents detected and triaged automatically, and robots dispatched to observe and deter without a human operator watching every screen. Founded by Dr. Sophia Belser (CEO), Dr. Maria "Mania" Stamatopoulou (CRO), and Rokas Bendikas (CTO), the company is backed by Speedinvest, Expeditions Fund, Florent Venture Partners, Fund F, ESA BIC Switzerland, and NVIDIA Inception. As of this profile Laelaps AI publishes a three-page corporate website and no public developer surface — no documentation, API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts were found.

providers.name: Lansweeper
providers.description: Lansweeper is an IT asset discovery and management platform that automatically scans and inventories hardware, software, users, and cloud resources across on-premises, cloud, and OT environments. It provides a unified technology asset intelligence platform used for IT asset management (ITAM), cybersecurity asset management (CAAM), software asset management, and compliance. The Lansweeper Data API is a GraphQL endpoint that exposes the technology asset intelligence stored in your Lansweeper sites using Bearer token authentication.

providers.name: Makrwatch
providers.description: Makrwatch is a creator representation and sponsorship management platform that sits between independent content creators and brands. It sources and filters brand-deal opportunities, negotiates terms and rates, protects creator IP and creative freedom, and handles the administrative work of briefs, timelines, revisions, invoicing, and payment tracking so creators can focus on producing content. Founded out of Y Combinator (W15) and based in New York City, the platform reports $27M+ distributed to creators across 34,000+ sponsorships for 7,400+ creators operating in 118 countries. Makrwatch does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Marker
providers.description: Marker is a writing tool for people who believe in writing — a calm, focused space for thinking and writing that acts as your partner and editor from first idea to final draft. Backed by Index Ventures, Marker sits in the future-of-work space and offers a distraction-free web application (my.marker.page) for drafting long-form writing. It is a consumer product web app: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, developer documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface, so this profile captures its identity and a live domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Mars Reel
providers.description: Mars Reel (Mars Reel Media Corp) is a Los Angeles-based youth sports media and streaming company producing original basketball and soccer documentary series, athlete training content, and original episodic shows (The Vault, Like Mike, Game City). Its Mars Club membership provides premium on-demand video, and its TFIOM (The Future Is On Mars) label runs a Shopify fashion storefront. Mars Reel is a 500 Global portfolio company operating consumer web and streaming products. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or technical documentation; this profile captures its public identity and consumer link surface only.

providers.name: Mazama Energy
providers.description: Mazama Energy is a geothermal energy company reinventing power generation with enhanced geothermal systems (EGS) that tap superhot rock to deliver universal, scalable, clean, and affordable electricity. Its Thermal Lattice sequential-stimulation technology improves connectivity between injectors and producers in super hot reservoirs (SHR). The company is developing the Newberry project in Oregon and runs the Mazama EMPOWER program, and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Headquartered in Frisco, Texas.

providers.name: Mentimeter
providers.description: Mentimeter is a Swedish audience-engagement and interactive-presentation platform used to run live polls, quizzes, word clouds, ranking, open-ended questions and Q&A during meetings, classrooms and events, with results updating in real time as participants respond from their phones. Founded in Stockholm in 2014, it is used across education and enterprise for interactive presentations and workshops. Mentimeter does not publish a public developer REST API; its extensibility surface is delivered through LMS integrations (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace via LTI), presentation add-ins (PowerPoint, Microsoft Teams, Zoom) and SSO, rather than a documented HTTP API. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline against its public developer, security and trust surface.

providers.name: Mesodyne
providers.description: Mesodyne is an MIT-founded engineering and manufacturing company (established 2018) that builds the LightCell, a patented thermophotovoltaic power generator which converts liquid and gaseous fuels — gasoline, diesel, propane, jet fuel, and hydrogen — directly into silent electricity with more than ten times the energy density of batteries. Designed for military, tactical, drone, and off-grid use, it operates day or night across extreme environments with low heat and emissions signatures and no routine maintenance. Mesodyne publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures the company identity and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Mob.ly
providers.description: Mob.ly (Mobly) is an AI-powered event marketing platform — "The Event Marketer's Operating System" — that helps B2B go-to-market teams plan events, capture and enrich leads in person, engage prospects, and measure pipeline across trade shows and in-real-life (IRL) marketing experiences. Its product suite spans lead Capture, event Host, Insights reporting, Pulse, and Scout, with native integrations into HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, and generic webhooks. As of this enrichment pass Mobly operates a customer-facing web application (hub.getmobly.com) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation. Backed by Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Moonhub
providers.description: Moonhub is an AI recruiting platform that deploys proprietary AI agents to source, qualify, engage, and vet candidates across millions of profiles, helping companies hire faster and more cost-effectively. Its agent products (Qualify AI, Engage AI, and Monitor AI) automatically identify qualified candidates, run outreach to convert them into interview-ready applicants, and analyze candidate intent to manage recruiter handoffs. Moonhub is backed by Khosla Ventures, GV, Greycroft, Time Ventures, and AIX Ventures; the Moonhub team joined Salesforce in 2026. The company ships a recruiter web application (recruiter.moonhub.ai) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface as of this profiling.

providers.name: Mozart AI
providers.description: Mozart AI is a generative audio workstation and AI music-creation platform (mozartai.com) that lets musicians compose, produce, and distribute songs using AI-assisted and agentic tools. Rather than generating finished tracks from a single prompt, it operates as a full digital audio workstation built around context-aware stem generation, real-time MIDI suggestions, synth and effects generation, and automated production tasks such as quantization and time-stretching, letting users work at the level of stems, instruments, or individual notes. Founded in 2025 and based in London, the company raised a $6M seed round led by Balderton Capital in February 2026 and reports more than 100,000 artists and over 1 million songs created. The product is delivered as a consumer web and mobile app (built on the ElevenLabs Eleven Music API) and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Mr. Cooper Group
providers.description: Mr. Cooper Group (formerly Nationstar Mortgage, NASDAQ: COOP) was a Coppell, Texas-based mortgage servicer with roughly $1.5T in unpaid principal balance under servicing and more than 4 million customers. It was acquired by Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT) in an all-stock transaction announced March 31, 2025 (initial value $9.4B) and closed October 1, 2025 (final value approximately $14.2B). Mr. Cooper now operates as a Rocket Companies subsidiary; the corporate site mrcoopergroup.com redirects to rocketcompanies.com and the COOP ticker has been delisted. The consumer brand Mr. Cooper continues at mrcooper.com as one of seven Rocket Companies operating businesses (Rocket Mortgage, Redfin, Mr. Cooper, Rocket Homes, Rocket Close, Rocket Money, Rocket Loans). Mr. Cooper does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Multiply
providers.description: Multiply is an AI-native media agency built specifically for B2B companies, pairing human paid-media strategists with a fleet of 25+ specialized AI agents to run and continuously optimize LinkedIn and Google Search advertising. Its "Self-Learning Advertising" platform plugs into a company's own data — sales call recordings (e.g. Gong), CRM closed-won outcomes, case studies, website content, competitive kill sheets and product documentation — and runs hundreds of structured ad experiments that refine audiences, copy and creative from real revenue signals. Multiply is a managed service (not a self-serve API product), founded by Matt Jayson (ex-Google, ex-Brex) and Ashish Warty (ex-HackerOne SVP Engineering, ex-Dropbox), and raised $9.5M led by Mayfield in March 2026. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Mayfield portfolio company; this pass confirmed it publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Omnifold
providers.description: Omnifold is an AI supply chain planning platform for physical product companies — CPGs, manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company trains a custom AI model for each supply chain to forecast demand, optimize inventory, and surface revenue, margin, and cash that traditional planning systems miss, positioning itself in the Forbes "Purpose-Built AI" tier and competing with Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, and o9. Omnifold was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Omnifold publishes marketing and product content but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or authentication surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: OnsiteIQ
providers.description: OnsiteIQ is a construction intelligence platform for real estate owners and developers that combines regular on-site 360-degree reality capture with AI-powered computer vision to monitor construction progress across trades and asset classes. The platform documents projects visually week over week, turns the imagery into searchable, measurable records, and surfaces analytics and actionable insights that teams use to verify progress, support payment applications, and make business-critical decisions on projects anywhere in the world. OnsiteIQ is a private company headquartered in New York City and backed by Anthemis and Bullpen Capital. As surfaced through the API Evangelist network, OnsiteIQ publishes a marketing and product website but does not expose a public developer API, documentation portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time; this profile records that honest state alongside the company's identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Ontora
providers.description: Ontora is an AI operational-intelligence platform that runs parallel, voice-based AI-agent interviews with every employee to map how work actually gets done across operations, sales, finance, and change management. It synthesizes the roughly 80% of undocumented, tacit process knowledge that lives only in employees' heads into prioritized automation and cost-reduction roadmaps, compressing a discovery effort that traditionally takes a consulting firm months into a matter of hours. Founded in 2026 and backed by Y Combinator, Ontora targets mid-market companies of roughly 200-2,000 employees undergoing AI transformation. As of this profile the company publishes a product and app but no public API, SDK, or developer platform.

providers.name: Paz Ai
providers.description: Paz.ai is an AI commerce platform that helps merchants win visibility and sales across AI shopping channels such as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Perplexity. It runs three autonomous agents — a Monitor agent that benchmarks catalog performance across AI channels, an Optimizer agent that enriches product titles, attributes, and structured data, and a Distributor agent that publishes AI-optimized feeds to agentic commerce endpoints — producing an AI-optimized copy of a product catalog without modifying the live store. It integrates with Shopify, Adobe Commerce, and Salesforce Commerce, plus CSV and a custom API on enterprise plans. Backed by Mayfield.

providers.name: Perfectly
providers.description: Perfectly is an AI-native recruiting platform (Y Combinator W2026) that automates the hiring process end to end, from candidate sourcing and outreach through screening and qualification. Its employer-facing AI recruiting agent, Paul, sources, engages, and qualifies candidates to help startups fill roles in days rather than weeks, delivered as an AI-native recruiting agency paired with a forward-deployed recruiter for onboarding and configuration. Its job-seeker agent, Parker, is an AI career super-connector on iMessage and WhatsApp that helps candidates find relevant industry contacts and craft personalized outreach before roles are publicly posted. Founded by former ML scientists and engineers from Meta and TikTok, Perfectly operates as a chat- and agent-delivered hiring service rather than a public developer API; no public API, developer portal, SDK, or specification surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Pic-Time
providers.description: Pic-Time is an online gallery, proofing, and print-sales delivery platform for professional photographers - client galleries, slideshows, an integrated print store, and studio-management integrations. Pic-Time does not publish a public developer API, API reference, or OpenAPI specification. Automation is limited to a Zapier integration (three triggers - New Gallery Visitor, New Order Placed, Main Client Gallery Invite Sent - and one action, Create New Gallery) plus private, bilaterally-arranged partner integrations (HoneyBook, Studio Ninja, Light Blue, StyleCloud, the Pic-Time Connect WordPress plugin) that are not documented for third-party developers. No API keys, endpoints, or SDKs are published for general developer use.

providers.name: PictorLabs.ai
providers.description: Pictor Labs develops AI-powered virtual staining technology for histopathology and digital pathology laboratories. Its platform generates diagnostic-quality tissue stains computationally in minutes rather than the hours or days required by traditional chemical staining, preserving precious tissue samples for additional downstream testing. Products include ClearStain for direct virtual H&E sequencing and DeepStain and ReStain for flexible, repeatable multi-stain tissue analysis. The technology integrates with existing whole-slide scanner platforms (partners include Hamamatsu and Proscia) and offers cloud or on-premise deployment. Virtual stains are currently labeled For Research Use Only. Pictor Labs is a venture-backed company in the Insight Partners portfolio. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Pimento
providers.description: Pimento is an AI ad-creative platform that helps marketing and advertising teams generate, analyze, and benchmark advertising creatives at scale. Its published product surface spans creative generation (Create), performance analysis (Analyze), competitive benchmarking (Benchmark), reusable brand kits, a Meta Score for predicting ad performance, multiformat output, and Meta Advantage+ support. Pimento is a venture-backed company in Partech's portfolio. As of this profile it publishes a marketing and product website with signup, login, and book-a-demo flows, but no public developer API, documentation, SDK, or MCP surface was found.

providers.name: Pop.in
providers.description: Pop.in is a consumer social gaming platform that connects people through real-time multiplayer games including Spades, Hearts, Dominoes, Liar's Dice, crosswords, Pop Quiz trivia, and Just Chatting. Delivered as iOS and Android apps plus a web play surface at play.pop.in, the service reports over 100M downloads and 20M active users with a 4.75+ average rating. The company is backed by 500 Global and was surfaced through its portfolio; it operates a purely consumer-facing product and publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Prisma Photonics
providers.description: Prisma Photonics is an infrastructure-monitoring company that turns existing optical fiber into a continuous sensing network using its Hyper-Scan Fiber-Sensing distributed acoustic sensing technology. The platform measures strain, temperature, pressure, and acoustic signatures at every point along hundreds of kilometers of fiber with sub-meter resolution, and applies AI-driven classification to detect and identify events in real time. It is used to protect and monitor power lines, oil and gas pipelines, perimeters, subsea assets, and smart rail and road infrastructure. Backed by Insight Partners, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Project Europe
providers.description: Project Europe (styled "Project Europe - LFG") is an initiative supporting the next generation of European founders. It runs an open application process for early-stage founders, backs and showcases a portfolio of companies started by that community, publishes an investor prospectus, and convenes a network of experienced European operators and investors. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of point-nine, Project Europe operates as a founder-community and early backing program rather than a public API or developer platform - its public web presence is a marketing site (apply, portfolio, legal pages) with no documented public API surface.

providers.name: Reach
providers.description: Reach Power (Reach Labs) is a Y Combinator-backed (S2015) wireless power company building long-range wireless energy distribution networks, aiming to "do for power what Wi-Fi did for data." Its patented, AI-driven power-beaming systems use adaptive metamaterial antennas to steer electromagnetic waves and deliver electricity through the air to multiple devices simultaneously, scaling from microwatts to kilowatts across both mobile and stationary transmitters. Reach serves defense and intelligence, manufacturing and logistics, and public safety markets, powering autonomous vehicles, industrial robotics, sensors, and drones. Partners and customers include the U.S. Department of Defense, NASA, DARPA, the U.S. Army and Air Force, Aisin/Toyota, and Panasonic. The company is headquartered in San Francisco. As of this profile, Reach publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this is a hardware and energy-infrastructure company rather than an API platform.

providers.name: Regbase
providers.description: Regbase is an AI-native regulatory intelligence platform that helps legal teams, compliance professionals, researchers, and government vendors monitor new and proposed laws worldwide. The platform uses AI agents to identify regulatory changes across 195 countries and 50 US states, surfacing draft bills, consultations, compliance requirements, and opportunities like grants from hard-to-find government sources, non-English publications, and informal channels that traditional tools miss. Regbase then analyzes those changes automatically and alerts users to updates relevant to their practice areas, spanning employment and labor, AI governance, healthcare, privacy, climate and sustainability, government contracting, and other regulated industries. Founded in 2026 and part of Y Combinator's Spring 2026 batch, Regbase is based in San Francisco. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist network; at the time of enrichment Regbase publishes a login-only web application and no public API, developer documentation, or SDK.

providers.name: Reken
providers.description: Reken is an AI security company building a trust layer for the Internet to combat generative-AI-enabled fraud, phishing, scams, deepfakes, and automated social engineering. Co-founded by Shuman Ghosemajumder (who founded Google's Trust & Safety group) and Rich Griffiths, both formerly of Shape Security, Reken centers on the on-device Reken Private Core: the Reken Model Zero detection ensemble, the Reken Trust Sensor for verifying human activity, and an embedded Reken API that lets applications connect to the core while keeping data on-device with local AI models and zero AI token cost. Protected applications form the Reken Network, a self-assembling zero-trust mesh. The company is pre-launch, offering an Early Access Program; it does not yet publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: Remedial Health
providers.description: Remedial Health is a Nigeria-based healthtech company digitizing pharmaceutical procurement and pharmacy operations across Africa. Its platform connects retail pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, health insurers/HMOs, and pharmaceutical manufacturers through a set of products: Remedial Store (a digital marketplace for pharmacies to procure inventory), Remedial RX (daily pharmacy operations and inventory tooling), Remedial Buy Now-Pay Later (inventory financing), the Remedial Benefits Manager (clinical pharmacy services and medication delivery for insurers), Remedial Market Access (distribution reach for manufacturers), and Remedial Intelligence (supply-chain data insights). The company is backed by QED Investors and reaches its customers primarily through Android and iOS mobile apps. As of this enrichment pass Remedial Health publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation host; this profile captures its identity, legal, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Rescripted
providers.description: Rescripted is a digital women's health platform dedicated to empowering women across the entire lifecycle, from first period to last. It combines an editorial content hub of expert-reviewed articles, videos, and clinical research with Clara, an AI-powered health companion built on thousands of real questions and reviewed by medical experts. The platform spans menstrual health, fertility, pregnancy, sexual health, general wellness, and condition management for PCOS, endometriosis, and related concerns, and works with 200+ health and wellness partners. Founded by Kristyn Hodgdon and Abby Mercado and backed by Techstars, Rescripted is a consumer-facing product with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Revnu
providers.description: Revnu is an AI-powered growth-automation platform for early-stage and technical founders, positioning itself as an "AI growth hire" that runs marketing work across channels so builders can stay in the codebase. The platform finds and qualifies leads from real signals, drafts cold outbound and partnership pitches, writes SEO content, runs paid ad experiments across Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, and TikTok, turns product wins into short-form video and social posts, and tests pricing and landing-page copy, sending approvals and weekly recaps through iMessage, Slack, and email. Founded in 2026 out of the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch and based in San Francisco, Revnu is a SaaS product with a dashboard/agent interface rather than an API-first platform; it currently publishes no public developer API, but does expose machine-readable llms.txt context files for AI agents.

providers.name: Robeaute
providers.description: Robeauté is a Paris-based medical technology company, founded in 2017 by Bertrand Duplat and Joana Cartocci, developing what it calls the world's first microrobotic platform for the brain. Its rice-grain-sized robots are designed to navigate brain tissue to diagnose, treat, and monitor neurological disease, aiming to make neurosurgery safer and less invasive. The device is pre-market — it has not received FDA clearance or CE marking and is not approved for clinical use or commercial sale. Robeauté has raised over €40M, including a $28M Series A led by Plural, Cherry Ventures, Kindred Ventures, and Brainlab, and operates from Paris with a San Francisco office opened in 2026. The company publishes no public API, developer platform, or SDK.

providers.name: Secondnature
providers.description: Second Nature Computing is an applied AI laboratory building Poppy, a proactive personal intelligence app for iOS. Poppy aggregates a user's calendar, email, messages, maps, music, fitness, HomeKit and 20-plus other apps and devices into a single unified surface that "knows what matters and surfaces it at the right moment," aiming to reduce screen time. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Second Nature ships a consumer mobile product only and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Shred Video
providers.description: Shred Video automates cinematic video and photo production for adventure tourism operators. Using LiDAR, GPS, smart camera technology, and proprietary algorithms, the platform automatically captures, edits, and delivers finished cinematic videos and photos to a customer's phone within seconds of an activity. It serves adventure tour operators such as skydiving centers, bungy jumping and giant swing operators, river rafting outfitters, and paragliding services, with documented clients including Skydive Utah and AJ Hackett locations in Australia and Singapore. Shred Video is a Y Combinator portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a marketing and demo-request website but publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: SIEMonster
providers.description: SIEMonster is a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) vendor whose flagship SIEMonster V5 platform ingests, correlates, and alerts on 2M+ security events per second for threat detection and response, deployed via AWS Marketplace or as a managed SaaS. Its EDG3 product is an autonomous AI SOC built on an edge-resident security lakehouse. Documentation covers platform deployment and agent installation, a knowledgebase, and FAQs; SIEMonster does not publish a public developer REST API, SDKs, or API reference at this time.

providers.name: SmarterDx
providers.description: SmarterDx builds clinical AI software that hospitals and health systems use to analyze the complete record of every patient and fully capture the value of care delivered. Its products span the revenue cycle — SmarterPrebill, SmarterCharges, SmarterDenials, SmarterNotes, and SmarterUtilization — surfacing missing diagnoses, validating charges, defending against payer denials, improving clinical documentation, and supporting utilization management decisions. The company serves 85+ health systems and operates as an enterprise B2B vendor: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or self-serve sign-up, and maintains HIPAA compliance to protect the privacy of its health-system partners.

providers.name: SOLS Energy
providers.description: SOLS Energy is Malaysia's leading residential and commercial solar energy company, on a mission to make green energy a basic human right. It has completed more than 8,900 solar installations across Malaysia spanning residential (Green Homes), commercial (Green Business), and off-grid indigenous community projects (Green Impact), and also offers EV charging (ChargeSingh) and a Solar Academy apprenticeship program. The company is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass SOLS Energy publishes a consumer marketing website (blog, FAQ, contact, privacy and terms pages) but no public developer platform, API, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Sonans
providers.description: Sonans is an AI software company building an intelligence layer for fashion merchandising. Its collaborative AI agents replace manual coordination with autonomous workflows that bridge buying decisions and cross-functional execution, turning raw design sketches and purchase orders into production-ready assets including photorealistic product imagery, marketing copy, and catalog data synchronized across ERPs, Shopify, and B2B commerce platforms. Sonans serves fashion brands and designers (streamlining design cycles, asset enrichment, and multi-channel product launches) as well as retailers and merchants (automating assortment planning, catalog enrichment, and inventory management). The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Sonans operates a web application at app.sonans.ai but publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Star Catcher
providers.description: Star Catcher is a space technology company building the first power grid in space. Its optical power beaming system, the Star Catcher Network, concentrates and transmits solar energy directly to satellites' existing solar arrays, delivering up to 10x more power without any hardware modifications. Founded in 2024 and backed by Initialized Capital, the company holds a world record for optical power beaming and is working to bring shared orbital power infrastructure to satellites supporting universal connectivity, advanced computing, and national security. Star Catcher raised $65 million in May 2026 and plans to bring its technology to orbit. Star Catcher operates physical space hardware and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: SuccessionMatching
providers.description: SuccessionMatching is an online community platform that connects business buyers, sellers, and succession planning professionals to facilitate ownership transitions of businesses and farms. The platform uses a compatibility matching algorithm to pair buyers and sellers, offers customizable privacy settings, commission-free sales for owners, educational resources on succession planning and business valuation, and a formal succession planning program that guides owners through selling their business. A Techstars-backed company operating a members-only web application, it currently exposes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Swift Charge
providers.description: Swift Charge is an electric vehicle charging company that provides turn-key, fully managed EV charging infrastructure to property owners across the hospitality, education, and multi-family residential sectors, pairing installed charging hardware with a payment application that lets EV drivers locate and pay for charging sessions. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Swift Charge publishes a public marketing and charger-map website but exposes no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or developer portal, so this profile is limited to company identity plus a domain-security probe of its website host.

providers.name: Swytchcode
providers.description: Deterministic API-execution layer for AI agents and developers that sits between an agent and production APIs, handling auth, retries, idempotency, and policy control across 2,000+ APIs. Consumable via a public npm-installable CLI and a local MCP server, with a published llms.txt.

providers.name: Syntiant
providers.description: Syntiant Corp is an Irvine, California edge-AI semiconductor company founded in 2017 that designs ultra-low-power Neural Decision Processors (NDPs) and the deep-learning models and tooling that run on them, bringing always-on speech, audio, sensor and vision inference to battery-powered devices without a cloud connection. Its silicon family spans the NDP100/NDP101, NDP102, NDP115, NDP120, NDP200 and NDP250, paired with a Training Development Kit (TDK) that maps TensorFlow models onto the NDP core and an embedded SDK for integration into customer firmware. In December 2024 Syntiant completed the USD 150 million acquisition of Knowles Corporation's Consumer MEMS Microphones business, taking the company from roughly 70 to nearly 1,700 employees and making microphones the majority of its revenue. Syntiant is a silicon, module and embedded-software supplier rather than an API provider - enrichment probing found no public web API, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, no developer portal, no first-party package-registry SDKs and no event surface; its SDK and TDK are distributed to customers through a private GitLab and under agreement.

providers.name: TAAI Labs, Inc
providers.description: TAAI Labs, Inc operates Sparkle (sparkle.security), an AI-first secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform, currently in beta, that aims to prevent vulnerabilities across the entire SDLC by embedding AI-powered security analysis into existing engineering workflows. Sparkle works across five phases — contextualize, design, build, validate, and govern — and deploys "Secure Agents" that surface risks, gather evidence, and track security decisions to give product security, AppSec, platform engineering, and engineering leadership teams audit-ready visibility across the secure SDLC. The company markets outcomes such as increased security-team productivity, reduced AI-generated risk, and full visibility, and is backed by 500 Global. The product is pre-general-availability and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation as of this profile.

providers.name: The Atavist
providers.description: The Atavist is a pioneering digital longform-storytelling brand founded in 2009 by Evan Ratliff, Jefferson Rabb, and Nicholas Thompson. It comprises The Atavist Magazine, which publishes one immersive work of narrative nonfiction each month and has earned National Magazine Award and Emmy recognition, and the Atavist multimedia publishing platform for building rich, media-driven stories. Automattic (the company behind WordPress.com) acquired both the magazine and the platform in 2018; the platform's storytelling features were folded into WordPress.com and the magazine now runs on Newspack by Automattic. The Atavist exposes no public developer API or documented developer program — it is a reader-facing publication at magazine.atavist.com.

providers.name: TrademarkNow
providers.description: TrademarkNow is an AI-native trademark clearance, screening, and watching platform, now part of Corsearch. It helps brand owners and legal teams create, launch, and defend trademarks globally using neural-network models that analyze phonetics, spelling, meaning, and visuals to surface conflicts across trademark registries. Its modules include ExaMatch for preliminary screening across 190+ registries with phonetic matching, NameCheck for instant trademark risk assessment, LogoCheck for deep-learning image-based logo conflict clearance, and Portfolio Analyzer for portfolio-strength benchmarking and coverage-gap analysis. TrademarkNow is delivered as a SaaS web platform (login at tm.corsearch.com) and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Transbnk
providers.description: TransBnk — rebranded as TBX — is an Indian open-finance and transaction-banking infrastructure company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Mumbai. It gives banks, enterprises, fintechs, corporates, and NBFCs the platforms, APIs, and connected workflows behind corporate banking: mandate management, escrow flows, virtual accounts, reconciliation, lending acceleration, and cash and treasury management. TransBnk reports partnerships with 25+ banks, 200+ APIs extended, 100+ BFSI clients, and 50M+ transactions processed. Products include TxB Hub (transaction banking), TrustHub (core banking and escrow), and the API Hub integration surface. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, 8i Ventures, and Accion Venture Lab.

providers.name: Una Brands
providers.description: Una Brands is a Singapore-headquartered, digital-age e-commerce house of brands that acquires and operates consumer e-commerce businesses across the APAC region, accelerating their growth with operational expertise and AI-led innovation from teams in Singapore, China, and Indonesia. The company publishes no public developer API, but its website ships an llms.txt and a live Wix Site MCP endpoint that lets AI agents retrieve business details, search products and services, book appointments, and start purchases.

providers.name: Visual Studio
providers.description: Microsoft Visual Studio is an integrated development environment (IDE) for building applications across .NET, C++, web, mobile, cloud, and game platforms on Windows and macOS. While the Visual Studio IDE itself is not exposed as a SaaS REST API, Microsoft provides developer-facing APIs for Live Share real-time collaboration (consumed via the vsls extension SDK) and the Visual Studio Marketplace REST API for discovering and distributing extensions, themes, and tools.

providers.name: VOYGR
providers.description: VOYGR provides real-world place intelligence for AI apps and agents, delivering continuous location and point-of-interest (POI) data validation and enrichment. Its Location Freshness Validation confirms historical existence and current operating status, detecting relocations, rebrands, and closures across multiple attributes with up to 99.62% validation precision and configurable decision thresholds. Its Location Data Enrichment populates and continuously enriches place records from web, social, authoritative, and other sources, spanning foundational attributes (address, contacts, web presence), operating data (hours, menus, prices), and fresh context (articles, reviews, news, events). VOYGR is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) and SNR.VC backed seed-stage company based in San Francisco, founded by Vlad Baskakov (CEO, ex-Google Maps) and Yarik Markov (CTO, ex-Google/Meta/Apple ML). Its maps API goes beyond the 10-15 standard attributes of existing mapping providers. The developer surface is currently demo-gated and no public API documentation is published yet.

providers.name: Wabi
providers.description: Wabi is a consumer AI mini-app platform — billed as "the first personal software platform" and a "YouTube of apps" — where anyone can create, discover, share, and remix AI-generated mini-apps from a single natural-language prompt while Wabi handles the underlying infrastructure, UI, hosting, and data. Founded by Eugenia Kuyda (founder of the AI companion app Replika) and backed by a roughly $20M pre-seed round (investors include Naval Ravikant, Garry Tan, Justin Kan, and Forerunner Ventures), Wabi is an invite/beta consumer product. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer documentation — only the consumer web app and its Terms/Privacy pages.

providers.name: Watch Club
providers.description: Watch Club is a mobile streaming and social platform for young adults, built around original coming-of-age teen drama series that viewers watch and then discuss with other fans through polls, episode reactions, and community threads. Its first original series, RETURN OFFER, launches February 2026, with a slate of additional YA series in development. The app is available on iOS and is operated by Kino Technologies Inc. Watch Club is a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company in the consumer sector; it publishes no public developer API surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Wizard
providers.description: Wizard is an AI-powered personal shopping agent for consumers. Shoppers describe what they want in natural language and Wizard searches across retailer websites, customer reviews, trusted editorial, and social content to return a tightly curated set of product recommendations, with direct checkout from retailers such as Amazon, Best Buy, Apple, and Target. The company is backed by Accel. As of this enrichment pass Wizard is a consumer-facing web/app product and exposes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or well-known discovery surface (developer/docs/api subdomains and /.well-known/security.txt all return 404).

providers.name: X mart
providers.description: X mart is a 500 Global portfolio company whose website, dentacarts.com, operates DentaCarts, an online dental supplies marketplace positioned as a "Dentist Smart Partner." The storefront sells dental and medical products across categories including restorative materials, endodontics, orthodontics, implants, prosthetics, perio and surgery, instruments, equipment, consumables, dermatology, and dental lab supplies, with support offered over WhatsApp. No public developer API surface has been found.

providers.name: Zoho Meeting
providers.description: Zoho Meeting is an online meeting, video conferencing, and webinar platform from Zoho that lets teams host secure meetings, presentations, and recorded webinars from any device. The Zoho Meeting REST API enables programmatic scheduling, management, and reporting of meetings and webinars, including registrant handling and session lifecycle. Authentication uses Zoho's OAuth 2.0 (Zoho-oauthtoken) with domain-specific API endpoints.

providers.name: Zoomin
providers.description: Zoomin is a content and knowledge orchestration platform that unifies unstructured product content — documentation, in-product help, knowledge base and community answers — into personalized self-service and in-app experiences across customer support, success and experience teams. Founded in Tel Aviv, Zoomin was acquired by Salesforce on November 1, 2024 and now powers the Unified Knowledge and Agentforce/Data Cloud offerings. Its products include the Content Delivery Platform, Documentation Portal, In-Product Help, Zoomin for ServiceNow, Unified Knowledge and Zoomin Analytics. Zoomin does not publish a public, self-serve developer API surface; its integrations are delivered through customer implementations and the Salesforce platform. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company.

providers.name: Zscaler
providers.description: Zscaler is a cloud security platform delivering Zero Trust Exchange services including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX). Zscaler exposes REST APIs across its product suite for configuration, policy management, and reporting, authenticated via API keys, OAuth 2.0, or session-based authentication depending on the product and cloud (zsapi).

providers.name: 2NDNATURE
providers.description: 2NDNATURE is a Santa Cruz, California environmental technology company that builds cloud-based stormwater management and water-quality software.
