Its flagship product, 2NFORM, is GIS-powered MS4/NPDES compliance software that helps municipalities automate stormwater permit reporting, track assets and BMPs, detect illicit discharges, and run construction and post-construction programs. Rainsteward is its corporate water-stewardship platform for reducing costs and maximizing the value of stormwater investments. The company embeds peer-reviewed environmental science into an enterprise SaaS platform and is backed by Techstars. No public developer API program has been identified; the 2NFORM and Rainsteward applications are gated SaaS logins.

providers.name: Amerigroup
providers.description: Amerigroup is a US health insurance company specializing in publicly funded health care, offering Medicaid managed care coverage to low-income families, children, pregnant women, seniors, and people with disabilities. It operates today as Amerigroup Community Care in Georgia and is part of Elevance Health (formerly WellPoint/Anthem), which acquired the company in 2012 and has since rebranded most Amerigroup plans to Wellpoint. Amerigroup coordinates benefits, provider networks, and care management for state Medicaid and related government health programs. Members and health-care providers interact through the amerigroup.com member site and a separate provider portal; the company exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Amplication
providers.description: Amplication is an open-source backend development platform that generates production-ready microservices — REST APIs, GraphQL endpoints, data models, DTOs, and supporting infrastructure code — from a domain model, embedding organizational best practices and standards so teams avoid repetitive backend coding. The project is TypeScript-based, distributed as @amplication npm packages and an `amp` CLI, and remains actively maintained on GitHub (16k+ stars, v3.15.0). Originally offered a hosted product at app.amplication.com; the hosted service and docs subdomain have since been retired and the amplication.com root now redirects to overcut.ai (the founders' agentic-SDLC venture), while the open-source project, npm packages, and Discord community continue.

providers.name: Apiday
providers.description: Apiday is an ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) software platform built for private markets. It combines AI-powered automation with expert guidance so investors, fund managers, and portfolio companies can streamline sustainability reporting, comply with regulatory frameworks (SFDR, EU Taxonomy, EDCI, PRI, ILPA), automate ESG questionnaires and due-diligence requests, calculate GHG emissions against 3,000+ benchmarks, and turn ESG obligations into measurable value creation. The company reports that over 500 investors and 5,000 companies use the platform across private equity, venture capital, private credit, institutional LP, and infrastructure asset classes. Backed by Speedinvest. Apiday does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Apollo Agriculture
providers.description: Apollo Agriculture is an agricultural technology company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, that helps small-scale farmers across Africa maximize their profits. Apollo delivers a full-stack service bundling quality farm inputs (seed and fertilizer), flexible input financing and credit, satellite- and machine-learning-driven agronomic advice, crop insurance, and market access, distributed through a network of local agrodealers and mobile technology. The company serves smallholder farmers in markets including Kenya and Zambia and is backed by investors including Anthemis and the SoftBank Vision Fund. This profile tracks Apollo Agriculture as a company in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Beam Dental
providers.description: Beam Dental (Beam Benefits) is an employee benefits provider offering dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental health coverage (accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness) to brokers, employers, and members. The company streamlines benefits administration with digital quoting, self-service member, broker, and provider portals, and fast group implementation. Beam is backed by Kleiner Perkins. As of this enrichment pass Beam publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification; its digital surface is a set of login-gated member, broker/employer (Lighthouse), and provider web applications.

providers.name: Belvedir
providers.description: Belvedir is an autonomous private AI platform built by Fractal Machine Research, Inc. (a Y Combinator Summer 2026 company). It lets individuals and teams train custom AI models and memory systems, host them privately on single-tenant infrastructure, and continually improve them through use: it collects agent calls and production traces, converts those traces into training data, and fine-tunes models with reinforcement learning in a continuous loop before redeploying on private infrastructure. The stated aim is to let everyday individuals own their own artificial intelligence rather than rent it from a shared provider. The product is in closed alpha and access is currently granted by request; there is no public API or developer documentation yet, so this profile captures the company's public identity and will be enriched as a developer surface appears.

providers.name: Braavos
providers.description: Braavos is a self-custody smart-contract wallet for Bitcoin and Starknet, available as a browser extension and mobile app. Built on Starknet account abstraction, it adds hardware-backed two-factor signing (mobile secure element and passkeys), session keys for dApps, gas abstraction, in-wallet swaps, staking, and fiat on-ramp. Its developer surface is the injected Starknet wallet API (get-starknet), the Braavos Cairo account contracts, and first-party JavaScript libraries (session keys, deeplinks, StarkNet URLs, dApp metadata) published under the myBraavos GitHub organization. Braavos does not publish a hosted REST API or OpenAPI. Sector: crypto. Backed by Pantera Capital.

providers.name: Buildertrend
providers.description: Buildertrend is an Omaha, Nebraska-based cloud construction-management platform serving residential home builders, remodelers, and specialty trade contractors. The product consolidates sales (CRM, leads, proposals, contracts, email marketing), project management (schedule, daily logs, selections, change orders, warranties, sub portal, client updates), and financial management (estimates, bids, takeoff, job-costing budgets, bills, purchase orders, invoices, online payments) into a single web and mobile application used by 20,000+ builders. Pricing is custom-quoted by sales rather than published self-serve tiers, with unlimited users and projects on every plan, and the platform integrates with QuickBooks, Xero, and other accounting and trade tools through a partner integrations marketplace. The company exposes a REST API at api.buildertrend.com that is gated by partner agreement — endpoints return 401 Unauthorized to the public and there is no open developer portal, public OpenAPI specification, or self-serve API key signup. As a result Buildertrend is profiled here as a non-public (partner-only) API provider; the public surface documented is limited to marketing, support, integrations marketplace, mobile apps, and corporate resources.

providers.name: Camfer
providers.description: Camfer is a Y Combinator-backed startup (S24) building an AI mechanical engineer — an AI-powered CAD tool that plugs into SolidWorks and lets engineers generate parametric designs from natural language prompts and images. Its camfy text-to-CAD model produces editable feature-tree geometry, automates repetitive modeling tasks, answers questions about a model without manual feature-tree navigation, and gives real-time design feedback. The product is a downloadable desktop application (currently in invite-only beta), not a public API; the company is backed by Y Combinator, Next47, Bloomberg Beta, Octave Fund, and the founders of Dropbox, Airtable, and Clari.

providers.name: ClaimSorted
providers.description: ClaimSorted is a tech-enabled third-party administrator (TPA) for insurance claims, combining human claims-handling expertise with proprietary technology to process claims faster while lowering operating costs and fraud leakage for MGAs and insurance carriers. It offers a white-label electronic Notice of Loss (eNOL) intake system, a policyholder Claims Portal for status tracking and document upload, automated assessment workflows, and fraud-detection algorithms, with reporting delivered daily, weekly, or monthly and as live data feeds over SFTP/API. ClaimSorted supports commercial and personal property, auto, small commercial, general liability, accident & health, travel, and warranty lines of business, serving 30+ clients including Axis and Lloyd's.

providers.name: Classiq
providers.description: Classiq Technologies is a Tel Aviv, Israel headquartered enterprise quantum software company founded in 2020 by Nir Minerbi (CEO), Amir Naveh (CPO), and Dr. Yehuda Naveh (CTO), positioning itself as a high-level quantum algorithm design platform that lets organizations build, scale, and deploy quantum algorithms across any hardware or simulator without writing low-level gate code. Its flagship offering centers on Qmod, an intuitive quantum modeling language, and a hardware-aware synthesis engine that compiles functional quantum models into optimized circuits with constraint-driven optimization, transpilation, and execution session management across cloud quantum providers including AWS Braket, Azure Quantum, GCP, IBM Quantum, IonQ, OQC, Alice and Bob, and C12. The platform is delivered through the Classiq Studio web IDE at platform.classiq.io, a public Python SDK (`pip install classiq`) currently at version 1.14.0 covering synthesis, execution, analysis, and application libraries for chemistry (QSP), finance (IQAE), and quantum machine learning (QSVM, QML), plus an AI-assisted natural language interface for algorithm design. Classiq publishes the largest open quantum algorithm library on GitHub at github.com/Classiq/classiq-library (2,000+ stars, Jupyter Notebook, MIT license) with reference implementations across optimization, linear solvers, quantum machine learning, chemistry, finance, logistics, cybersecurity, and physical systems. Customers include Microsoft, AWS, NVIDIA, HSBC, Citibank, BMW, and Rolls-Royce; the company is SOC 2 and GDPR compliant. Classiq has raised over $200M including a $110M Series C in May 2025 with backers such as AMD Ventures, Qualcomm Ventures, IonQ, Bank Leumi, Mirae Asset Capital, and SoftBank. Classiq's developer surface is the Python SDK and Qmod language — there is no public REST API or OpenAPI specification; the Mintlify-hosted `docs.classiq.io/api-reference/openapi.json` endpoint currently returns the default Mintlify Plant Store placeholder rather than a real API contract.

providers.name: Cuponomia
providers.description: Cuponomia is a Brazilian coupons and cashback platform that helps consumers save money on online purchases from more than 2,000 partner retailers. A pioneer in popularizing free discount coupons in Brazil, the company expanded into cashback in 2019 and now operates a website, a browser extension, and mobile apps alongside a Prime membership tier. It is backed by 500 Global. Cuponomia does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: DistroKid
providers.description: DistroKid is a Brooklyn, New York based digital music distribution service founded in 2013 by Philip Kaplan that lets independent musicians and labels upload an unlimited number of songs and albums to Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, TikTok, Instagram, Pandora, Tidal, Deezer, and dozens of other streaming and download stores for a flat annual subscription fee while keeping 100% of their royalties. By 2020 the platform was distributing roughly a third of all new music released worldwide and serving more than two million artists; Spotify and Insight Partners both hold equity stakes following a 2021 valuation around $1.3B. Around the core distribution product DistroKid has built out a suite of artist services including Teams for automated royalty splits, cover-song mechanical licensing, YouTube Content ID monetization, DistroVid music-video distribution, Upstream label matching, Mixea AI mastering, and DistroKid Direct for fan merchandising and pre-orders. The company has historically operated without a public developer API — integrations with stores, DSPs, rights organizations, and partners are handled through private B2B arrangements, and the only public web endpoints exposed under distrokid.com/api are unauthenticated pre-save widgets used to drive Spotify follow/save campaigns. DistroKid is actively hiring API engineers to scale partner and AI-facing integrations, suggesting a more formal developer surface may emerge, but as of 2026 there is no published OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, sandbox, or developer portal. Third-party reverse-engineered wrappers such as the unofficial Golang `distrogo` library exist but are not endorsed.

providers.name: Electric Hydrogen
providers.description: Electric Hydrogen (EH2) is a Massachusetts-based clean-energy company that designs, manufactures, and commissions the world's most powerful PEM electrolyzers, packaged into a fully-integrated 100MW HYPRPlant that turns water and renewable electricity into the lowest-cost green hydrogen. The complete plant solution bundles power conversion, gas processing, water treatment, and thermal management so heavy industry can decarbonize ammonia, e-fuels, steel, and refining at gigawatt scale. Founded in 2020 and led by CEO Raffi Garabedian, EH2 operates a 1.2GW gigafactory in Devens, Massachusetts, became green hydrogen's first unicorn with a $380M Series C, and is backed by Fifth Wall, Fortescue, Energy Impact Partners, bp Ventures, Temasek, and Microsoft's Climate Innovation Fund. This profile enriches the API Evangelist network stub with the company's real public web surface.

providers.name: FlyteDesk
providers.description: flytedesk is the campus advertising platform that connects national brands with college media across the United States. Founded in 2015 in Boulder, Colorado, it operates the largest network of campus media in the US, letting advertisers create, book, manage, and measure national campaigns across print, digital, email newsletters, social, influencer, radio, and out-of-home channels reaching millions of college students. For college publishers and campus media organizations, its self-serve platform provides tools to build, manage, and monetize their media ecosystem, along with an Audience Builder for targeting. flytedesk is backed by Techstars. The company exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its public web presence and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Freshop
providers.description: Freshop is an eCommerce platform purpose-built for grocery and specialty retail, now part of NCR Voyix. It powers branded online storefronts, mobile shopping, order fulfillment, pickup, and delivery for independent and regional grocers, and integrates third-party services for loyalty, coupons, email, SMS, and fulfillment. Freshop exposes a live REST API at api.freshop.com that serves store and product data to Freshop-powered storefronts and apps, authenticated with an application key (app_key) query-string parameter and versioned by a numeric path segment.

providers.name: Groundspeed
providers.description: Groundspeed is an insurance data and analytics company that pioneered AI-powered extraction and standardization of unstructured commercial property and casualty (P&C) insurance documents — loss runs, schedules of values, ACORD forms, and broker submissions — turning them into structured, analytics-ready data for underwriters, brokers, and carriers. Founded in Ann Arbor, Michigan and backed by Insight Partners, Groundspeed was acquired by Insurance Quantified, where its technology now powers the Intake, Workflow, and Intelligence products of an AI-driven underwriting platform serving commercial P&C carriers and MGAs. Groundspeed does not currently publish a public developer program, API reference, or self-service onboarding surface; this profile tracks its identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Gut Wellness Club
providers.description: Gut Wellness Club is an India-based consumer wellness brand offering a "Gut Reset" program that promises to resolve digestive issues in 15-20 days using natural traditional foods, yoga, Ayurveda, and Naturopathy as an alternative to medication. The site is Wix-hosted and, notably for a consumer brand, exposes agent-native surfaces: a published /llms.txt and a live, hosted Wix Site MCP endpoint that lets AI agents retrieve business details, search the site, and access Wix REST APIs without scraping. It has no first-party developer API, OpenAPI, or SDKs. Surfaced via Accel portfolio mining and enriched from its real public agent surfaces.

providers.name: Infilla
providers.description: Infilla is a permitting software platform that modernizes housing approvals for cities and municipal planning departments. Its product suite—a fee Calculator, a guided Application Form for permit intake, and digital Plan Check checklists—cuts response times, eliminates repetitive administrative work, and accelerates housing production. Founded and led by CEO Jenny Song after research with 300+ planners across 50+ jurisdictions, Infilla targets permitting as a major barrier to housing development by equipping government staff to work faster and better serve their communities. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification is published at this time.

providers.name: insitro
providers.description: insitro is a machine-learning-driven drug discovery and development company founded in 2018 by Daphne Koller and headquartered in South San Francisco, California. It combines large-scale in vitro cellular data generated in its own automated labs with human clinical and genetic data to build predictive models of biology, aiming to bring better drugs faster to the patients most likely to benefit. Its therapeutic focus spans metabolism, oncology, and neuroscience, and its interdisciplinary teams pair life scientists, data scientists, and engineers. insitro operates no public developer API; it maintains open-source research and infrastructure tooling (such as the redun workflow engine) on its GitHub organization. Backed by a16z, GV, and the SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: Jaspersoft
providers.description: Jaspersoft is a business intelligence and embedded analytics platform, now part of Cloud Software Group (formerly TIBCO). Its flagship products are the open-source JasperReports Library — a Java reporting engine (net.sf.jasperreports) — and JasperReports Server, a reporting and analytics server that exposes a REST API (rest_v2) for managing the repository, running and scheduling reports, executing queries, and administering users, roles, and organizations. Developers embed Jaspersoft content into their own applications with Visualize.js and the js-visualize component library, and interact with the server programmatically through official Java and PHP REST clients. Sector: data analytics / business intelligence. Backed by Sapphire Ventures; surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company.

providers.name: Jefferies Financial Group
providers.description: Jefferies Financial Group is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm providing advisory, capital raising, sales, trading, research, wealth management, and alternative asset management services to clients across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific.

providers.name: Karnott
providers.description: Karnott is a French agricultural technology company based in Lille that builds connected tracking devices and a digital management platform for farms, equipment cooperatives (CUMA), agricultural contractors (ETA), and wine growers. Its beacon automatically records equipment usage and field interventions without manual data entry, enabling real-time fleet and equipment monitoring, fuel-cost tracking, parcel mapping, and precise billing and regulatory documentation. Karnott is a portfolio company of Partech. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found on the provider's public surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Kema
providers.description: Kema (Kema FZ-LLC) is a UAE-based B2B fintech providing cash-flow and accounts-receivable tools for SMEs across the MENA region. Its platform combines invoice financing that advances up to 95% of invoice value, accounts-receivable automation with automated reminders, invoice tracking and reconciliation, and branded payment links delivered over email, WhatsApp and SMS that accept cards and wire transfers. Additional capabilities include practice-management tooling for accounting firms, recurring-payment automation, credit assessment and a real-time AR dashboard and analytics. Kema is backed by Speedinvest and reports 4,000+ companies transacting on its network.

providers.name: Kik
providers.description: Kik is a freeware instant-messaging mobile app for iOS and Android, known for letting users register with only a username rather than a phone number. Founded in 2009 by University of Waterloo students and released in 2010, Kik grew to hundreds of millions of registered users and was especially popular with teens. It has been owned by MediaLab AI since 2019. Kik formerly operated a developer surface — the Kik Bot Platform at dev.kik.com — and the Kin cryptocurrency, but that developer/bot API platform is no longer online and Kik currently publishes no public API.

providers.name: Levelset
providers.description: Levelset is a New Orleans-based construction payment software company that helps contractors, subcontractors, material suppliers, and equipment rental firms manage mechanics lien rights, preliminary notices, lien waivers, and payment compliance across all 50 U.S. states. The platform automates preliminary notice delivery, lien filing and release, conditional and unconditional lien waiver exchange, job and stakeholder research, and contractor payment-history monitoring, with deep state-by-state lien-law templates and deadline tracking. Founded as zlien in 2011 and rebranded to Levelset in 2018, the company was acquired by Procore Technologies for approximately $500 million in November 2021 and now operates as part of Procore's invoicing and payments suite. Customer-facing integrations exist with Procore, Sage, Viewpoint, Foundation, Acumatica, QuickBooks and other construction ERP and accounting platforms, but Levelset does not currently publish a self-serve public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal — integrations are delivered through partner-built connectors, the Procore Marketplace, and direct enterprise engagements with the Levelset integrations team. The Levelset GitHub organization is empty and developers.levelset.com / developer.levelset.com are not publicly reachable as of this profile date.

providers.name: Lilium
providers.description: Lilium was a German eVTOL aircraft developer building the Lilium Jet, a seven-seat (including pilot) ducted-fan electric jet designed for regional air mobility with target cruise speeds around 175 mph and ranges in excess of 100 nautical miles. Lilium pursued concurrent EASA and FAA Type Certification and signed pre-orders with operators across Europe, the Middle East, the United States, Brazil, and Saudi Arabia. In October 2024 Lilium's board approved self-administration for its German subsidiaries after failing to secure a guarantee for a EUR 50 million Bavarian government loan, and in December 2024 the company ceased operations and laid off approximately 1,000 employees. A consortium called Mobile Uplift Corporation GmbH announced a partial asset acquisition in late December 2024, but in February 2025 Lilium's German entities filed a second insolvency after the promised takeover financing failed to materialize. As of this profile (May 2026) Lilium remains non-operational and the website and social channels may be intermittently available; this profile is preserved for historical and archival reference.

providers.name: Loftia
providers.description: Loftia is a cozy, solarpunk massively-multiplayer online (MMO) game developed by Qloud Games Pty Ltd, a remote-first indie studio founded in 2022 and headquartered in Sydney, Australia. Set across floating islands in a warm, sustainable world, players farm, craft, decorate, socialize, and build a life in the sky alongside friends in a shared world that grows over time. The studio (founded by Eric Mallon, Martina Qin, and Michael Su) raised a $5M seed round led by BITKRAFT Ventures and GFR Fund with participation from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), and took part in a16z's SPEEDRUN gaming accelerator. Loftia is a consumer game company with no public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: LTSE
providers.description: The Long-Term Stock Exchange (LTSE) is a U.S. national securities exchange, approved by the SEC, built to help companies and investors focus on long-term value creation over short-term results. LTSE operates a stock exchange and trading platform with listing standards organized around five long-term principles covering stakeholders, strategy, executive compensation, board governance, and investor engagement. The company also publishes market and governance insights and produces The Eric Ries Show podcast. LTSE previously offered a cap-table management product (LTSE Equity, formerly Captable.io) which has since been sunset and transitioned to Astrella. LTSE exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: OneConnect
providers.description: OneConnect Financial Technology (NYSE: OCFT; HKEX: 6638) is a technology-as-a-service platform for financial institutions, incorporated in 2015 as an associate of China's Ping An Group to externalize its banking and insurance technology. Its cloud-native, microservices platform spans digital banking, digital insurance, and the Gamma platform (AI voice, computer vision, blockchain and big-data analytics), serving hundreds of banks and insurers across China and Southeast Asia with ready-to-integrate financial technology components exposed through Open APIs. OneConnect raised a US$650M Series A in 2018 from investors including the SoftBank Vision Fund and SBI Group. Its APIs are delivered as enterprise B2B integrations rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Onsitego
providers.description: Onsitego is a Mumbai-based Indian consumer device-protection company that sells extended warranty, accidental and liquid damage protection, and repair and maintenance (AMC) plans for consumer electronics and home appliances including mobile phones, laptops, televisions, refrigerators, washing machines and air conditioners. Sold at point of sale through 10,000+ retail stores and serviced via 3,300+ service centers, the company reports 2.5+ crore (25M+) customers and lets buyers activate coverage, manage devices and plans, and request service online. Onsitego is a portfolio company of Accel. No public developer API, documentation, or programmatic surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: Payna
providers.description: Payna is a compliance operating system for financial licensing that automates applications, renewals, maintenance, and monitoring across all 50 US states and jurisdictions. It tracks state statutes, NMLS procedures, and FinCEN requirements in real time, calculates filing deadlines backward from due dates, scores compliance posture against state examiner playbooks, automates document pre-fill and e-signature, and maintains a timestamped, queryable audit trail for examinations. Payna serves regulated financial sectors including money transmission, lending, mortgage, cryptocurrency/VASP, debt collection, loan origination, and insurance. It is a Y Combinator (W26) company; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: PenFed Credit Union
providers.description: PenFed Credit Union (Pentagon Federal Credit Union), founded in 1935 and headquartered in McLean, Virginia, is a federally chartered credit union regulated by the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA) and one of the largest credit unions in the United States, with roughly 2.9 million members and tens of billions of dollars in assets. It is a not-for-profit, member-owned financial cooperative that originally served the U.S. military and defense community and now offers open membership, providing mortgages, auto loans, credit cards, personal loans, and deposit accounts. On the open-finance front, PenFed runs an internal API-management practice — MuleSoft/Anypoint is the backbone of its digital-banking platform and an Apigee-backed developer portal host exists at developer.penfed.org (with an api.penfed.org gateway) — but neither surface is publicly documented or openly reachable: there is no public developer program, no published OpenAPI, and consumer account data is made available to members through permissioned third-party aggregators such as Plaid rather than a directly documented FDX or CFPB Section 1033 data-access API.

providers.name: Pinoffer
providers.description: Pinoffer is the API Evangelist network profile for Converted (convertedin.com), a MENA-focused adtech and martech "unified growth platform" operating across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE. Founded by Mohamed Fergany, Mohamed Atef, and Mustafa Raslan, and backed by 500 Global, Converted helps 10,000+ businesses in emerging markets manage marketing data, ad payments, lead generation, and order intelligence across Google, Meta, TikTok, and other channels through a single interface. Its products include Converted Pay (ad credit, local invoicing, and spend policies), Flyerz, Leads, and Orders. Converted is a Google Premier Partner and a Deloitte Fast 50 company. As of this enrichment pass Converted publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDK program; this profile is identity-and-domain-security only.

providers.name: Policy Bazaar
providers.description: Policybazaar is India's largest online insurance aggregator and marketplace, operated by PB Fintech Limited (publicly listed on the NSE and BSE) and headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana. Founded in 2008 by Yashish Dahiya, Alok Bansal, and Avaneesh Nirjar, it is an IRDAI-licensed insurance web aggregator and broker that lets consumers compare, buy, and manage policies across life, term, health, motor (car and bike), travel, and investment (ULIP and guaranteed-return) products from more than fifty partner insurers. The platform provides quote comparison, online purchase, claims assistance, and renewal management, and is a portfolio company of Ribbit Capital. Policybazaar does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and domain-security posture surfaced by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: PROOF
providers.description: PROOF is a digital art and NFT platform built on the belief that "art is proof of our collective humanity." It is the company behind Moonbirds (its flagship profile-picture collection), the 1,000-member PROOF Collective, and collections including Oddities, Mythics, and the Grails art-collector experience, alongside the Lunar Society community-governance program, a research arm, live events, and a podcast. PROOF is backed by a16z and Kindred Ventures. Its public surface is a consumer/collector documentation site (docs.proof.xyz) and marketing site; PROOF does not currently publish a programmatic developer API, OpenAPI spec, SDKs, or webhooks.

providers.name: Sensefinity
providers.description: Sensefinity is a supply-chain IoT company ("The IoT Transformation Company") delivering real-time tracking, monitoring, and analytics for global cargo and logistics operations. Its platform combines GPS/NB-IoT tracking devices for maritime containers, pallets, and vehicles with temperature and condition (cold-chain) sensors, indoor location tracking, a cloud analytics and machine learning layer, and digital product passport / blockchain integrations. The operational platform is delivered as a hosted web application (uiadmin.sensefinity.com) and mobile asset-management apps, serving enterprise customers across food, pharma, automotive, and manufacturing supply chains. No public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface is published as of this profile; a private API host (api.sensefinity.com) backs the platform.

providers.name: sherpa
providers.description: sherpa is an AI operating system for External Workforce Management (EWM) that runs an enterprise's contingent-labor program end to end with autonomous agents, replacing the work traditionally done by a VMS (Vendor Management System) and MSP (Managed Service Provider). Its agents cover every phase of an external engagement: autonomous intake and classification from Slack, email, Teams or voice; collaborative scope, role and budget drafting; autonomous sourcing with market-benchmarked rates and ranked candidates and suppliers; coordinated screening interviews scored against a weighted rubric; autonomous hiring and onboarding (documents, background and compliance checks, contracts, provisioning, hardware and badges); and active management and payment with a dedicated PM agent, live spend visibility and flexible payouts once outcomes are verified. One platform spans every worker type — contingent labor, freelancers / independent contractors (with a built-in Agent of Record), SOW / services engagements, and, coming soon, AI agents as a managed worker type — with rate intelligence, compliance management and analytics built in. sherpa launched out of stealth with a $2.2M pre-seed round and is backed by Seedcamp and Y Combinator.

providers.name: So Sure
providers.description: So Sure (wearesosure.com), operated by Open Insurance Services UK Limited, was a UK app-based social insurance provider offering mobile phone and home contents insurance, known for a social/peer insurance model that rewarded claim-free groups. It was an early portfolio company of 500 Global. The company has stopped selling new policies and has transitioned its mobile phone cover to the Huddle Insurance brand while continuing to service existing customers. So Sure publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Souqalmal
providers.description: Souqalmal was a UAE-based personal-finance comparison marketplace that let consumers across the GCC compare and apply for credit cards, personal loans, bank accounts, and insurance products online. The brand has since transitioned to Yabi (yabimoney.com), an AI-powered financial coaching application offering personalized guidance, budgeting tools, spending tracking, credit checks, and financial-education content on iOS and Android. Backed by 500 Global. The souqalmal.com domain now permanently redirects to yabimoney.com. No public developer, API, or partner-integration surface is currently published.

providers.name: Togal.AI
providers.description: Togal.AI is a Miami, Florida construction-technology company building AI-powered takeoff and estimating software for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry. Founded by former U.S. Congressman Patrick Murphy out of his family's multi-generational construction business, the cloud-based platform applies computer-vision and deep-learning models to architectural drawings and blueprints to automatically detect, measure, count, label, and compare project spaces and features — reporting up to 98% accuracy against AIA measurement standards and reducing manual estimating effort by roughly 80%. Signature capabilities include the Togal Button (one-click automated takeoff), AI-powered image, text, and pattern search across plan sets, drawing-set comparison for change quantification, real- time multi-user cloud collaboration, and Togal.CHAT, a natural-language assistant that lets estimators query plans, verify quantities, identify errors, and draft RFPs. The product serves drywall, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, glazing, landscaping, painting, FF&E, and general-contracting trades, with documented case studies (e.g., Coastal Construction) showing multi-hour-per-plan-set savings and seven-figure annual ROI. Togal.AI's revenue model is SaaS subscriptions sold to estimators, subcontractors, and general contractors; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and the only known third-party integration is Service Titan plus data export to Excel and downstream estimating tools.

providers.name: Tomo
providers.description: Tomo is a consumer "personal AI" application that lives in your text messages: users tell Tomo about their life, goals, problems, and aspirations over SMS, and the AI assistant learns those goals and guides them toward achieving them through ongoing text-based conversation. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Ribbit Capital, Tomo operates in the AI-apps sector as a mobile-first consumer product rather than a developer platform. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing site (tomo.ai) with About, Careers, Privacy, Terms, and Login pages but no public developer program: no API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, CLI, MCP server, llms.txt, or .well-known discovery endpoints were found. This profile is maintained for API Evangelist network completeness.

providers.name: User Stories
providers.description: A curated collection of API user stories following agile methodology formats. User stories capture software requirements from the end-user perspective using the format "As a [user], I want [goal], so that [benefit]". This repository indexes user story patterns for API consumers and producers across product management, developer experience, integration design, and platform engineering contexts. Teams use these to align stakeholders, prioritize API features, track progress, and adapt to evolving requirements throughout the API lifecycle.

providers.name: Vestwell
providers.description: Vestwell is a New York City-based digital savings and retirement platform (founded 2016) that powers workplace savings programs for employers, financial advisors, financial institutions, TPAs, PEOs, payroll and benefit partners, and government agencies. Its recordkeeping and administration engine supports traditional and Safe Harbor 401(k), Solo-k, Starter-k, pooled/PEP plans, 403(b), 529 education savings, ABLE, emergency savings, student-loan repayment, and tuition reimbursement, as well as state-facilitated ("government savings") retirement programs. Vestwell emphasizes payroll and HR integrations (auto-sync across 190+ payroll providers) rather than a public developer API; onboarding, servicing, and saver access run through its web platform. Surfaced as a Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio company and profiled here for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Zanskar
providers.description: Zanskar (Zanskar Geothermal & Minerals, Inc.) is a Salt Lake City-based geothermal energy company founded in 2021 by Carl Hoiland and Joel Edwards. It uses custom artificial intelligence, machine learning, and subsurface geoscience to discover and develop conventional geothermal resources, with a mission to make geothermal the most affordable form of widely-deployable, 24/7 carbon-free power. The company raised a $115M Series C and is backed by Obvious Ventures and Union Square Ventures. Zanskar publishes public geothermal datasets on the Snowflake Marketplace; it does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: 10percenthappier
providers.description: 10percenthappier (now branded Happier Meditation) is a personalized meditation and mindfulness company offering a consumer mobile app with over 500 guided meditations, multi-day courses, and daily mindfulness practices led by expert teachers. The app adapts to the user with monthly check-ins and daily recommendations, and is available on iOS and Android. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. The company operates a consumer product and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: AbelZeta Pharma
providers.description: AbelZeta Pharma is a global clinical-stage cell therapy company discovering, developing, and manufacturing T-cell-based immunotherapeutics for cancer and immunological diseases. Its pipeline centers on Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR)-T cell technology across hematologic malignancies, solid tumors, and inflammatory and immunological conditions. Backed by Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China), AbelZeta develops personalized immune cell therapies that empower patients' own immune systems to address unmet medical needs, with operations in the United States (Maryland) and China. AbelZeta does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's corporate web presence and identity within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Abogen Biosciences
providers.description: Abogen Biosciences (Suzhou Abogen Biosciences, 苏州艾博生物科技有限公司) is an industry-leading clinical-stage biotech company founded in January 2019 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, dedicated to developing transformative medicines through messenger RNA (mRNA) innovation. The company has built full-scale in-house capabilities spanning the entire mRNA drug-development cycle — protein engineering, mRNA sequence design and synthesis, lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery, formulation, and commercial-scale manufacturing — underpinned by proprietary mRNA and nano-delivery technology platforms. Its pipeline covers infectious-disease prevention and tumor immunology, including an EUA-authorized product and multiple clinical-stage candidates. Abogen is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced through the API Evangelist VC-portfolio enrichment pipeline; the company publishes a corporate website but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Acclinate
providers.description: Acclinate is a health-equity technology company that improves clinical trial diversity by building trust with historically underrepresented communities. Its NOWINCLUDED community platform engages 250,000+ members with culturally relevant content and in-person events, while its proprietary e-DICT AI/ML engine transforms community trust signals into predictive enrollment intelligence — participation-probability scoring, demographic forecasting, and real-time dashboards for pharmaceutical sponsors and CROs. Acclinate operates as a managed service across a three-stage trust model (Access, Engage, Mobilize) rather than a self-service developer platform; no public API, developer portal, or API documentation is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Affinia Therapeutics
providers.description: Affinia Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company in Waltham, Massachusetts pioneering next-generation adeno-associated virus (AAV) gene therapies. Using AI and structural modeling to rationally design novel capsids that better target tissues for improved safety and effectiveness, Affinia develops therapeutic cargoes for devastating rare and prevalent diseases of the heart and the nervous system. Its lead program, AFTX-201, targets BAG3-associated dilated cardiomyopathy and is being evaluated in the UPBEAT trial. Affinia Therapeutics is a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). This company profile carries no public API surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network for identity and demand signal.

providers.name: AgFunder
providers.description: AgFunder is a global agrifood-tech venture capital firm investing in deeptech and foundational technologies across AI, biology, robotics, and climate to advance food, agriculture, and human and planetary health. Founded roughly a decade ago by Michael Dean and Rob Leclerc and headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices in London and Singapore, the firm manages over $300M in assets and has backed more than 100 portfolio companies across four continents. AgFunder also operates AgFunderNews (AFN), the leading agtech and foodtech news and research publication, and publishes market research for the agrifoodtech ecosystem. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched with the firm's public identity and site properties; AgFunder publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Alcresta Therapeutics
providers.description: Alcresta Therapeutics is a specialty pharmaceutical company developing enzyme-based products that improve fat absorption and digestive health for people with rare and chronic conditions. Its lead product, the RELiZORB (immobilized lipase) cartridge, uses the company's patented iLipase microbead technology to mimic pancreatic lipase and hydrolyze fats in enteral (tube) feeding formulas, helping patients with exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, cystic fibrosis, short bowel syndrome, and critical-care nutrition needs absorb fatty acids they otherwise could not. Alcresta is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. The company operates a corporate and product marketing website but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Alector
providers.description: Alector is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing immuno-neurology therapies for neurodegenerative diseases, including frontotemporal dementia (FTD), Alzheimer's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Combining human genetics, neuroscience, and immunology, the company designs potential first- and best-in-class medicines that remove toxic proteins, replace deficient proteins, and restore immune and nerve cell function. Alector was added to the API Evangelist network as a GV portfolio company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile captures corporate and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: All City Communications
providers.description: All City Communications is a Wisconsin-based telephone answering and call center service provider offering 24/7 live answering for businesses across many industries. Founded in 1979 (originally as a paging service), the company operates from Green Bay and Milwaukee and delivers custom call scripting, message delivery by text, email or live call patching, call recording with secure storage, a customer web portal for real-time call data, and detailed call reporting. It serves property management, home restoration, electrical / plumbing / HVAC trades, municipalities, home health and hospice, healthcare, legal, landscaping, and travel and hospitality clients. All City Communications is a service business and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Alloy Therapeutics
providers.description: Alloy Therapeutics is a biotechnology ecosystem company operating as a Product Development Organization that partners across discovery, preclinical, and clinical development. It combines proprietary AI/ML, real-world data, and tech-enabled scientific services across multiple therapeutic modalities, including monoclonal and bispecific antibodies, TCR mimics, genetic medicines (cyclic RNA and oligonucleotide design), and cell-therapy pharmacology. Alloy is known for its transgenic antibody-discovery platforms (the ATX-Gx mouse series) and licenses reagents, platforms, and services to pharmaceutical and biotech partners rather than exposing a public developer API. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Alpha-9 Oncology
providers.description: Alpha-9 Oncology is a clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company that spun out of the University of British Columbia and BC Cancer in 2019 to develop a portfolio of targeted cancer therapies. Alpha-9 engineers bespoke radiopharmaceutical molecules — optimizing the binder, linker, chelator, and radioisotope — to deliver radiation directly to tumor cells while limiting exposure to healthy tissue. The company operates purpose-built research facilities in Vancouver, BC and Boston, MA, and in October 2024 raised an oversubscribed $175M Series C led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Ascenta Capital to advance its clinical pipeline. Alpha-9 is a drug developer and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity and public-web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: AltspaceVR
providers.description: AltspaceVR was a social virtual reality platform founded in 2013 where people gathered in shared 3D spaces for live events, meetups, classes, comedy shows and conferences. Google Ventures (GV) was an early investor. Microsoft acquired the company in 2017 and folded it into its Mixed Reality division, then announced in January 2023 that the platform would close, shutting it down permanently on 2023-03-10 in favor of Microsoft Mesh. AltspaceVR published no hosted HTTP API; its developer surface was the Mixed Reality Extension (MRE) SDK for building server-hosted 3D world extensions in Node.js, plus the earlier web-based AltspaceSDK. Every SDK repository is now archived and altvr.com redirects to microsoft.com. This profile is retained as a historical record of a terminated platform, not as a live integration target.

providers.name: Ansible Health
providers.description: AnsibleHealth is a virtual-first, doctor-led telemedicine practice specializing in the management of COPD, congestive heart failure, and other chronic pulmonary and cardiac conditions from home. Serving patients across 50+ states, it combines virtual diagnosis and personalized treatment plans, remote patient monitoring of vitals like heart rate and blood oxygen, virtual physical therapy, smoking-cessation coaching, and medication and durable-medical-equipment ordering to reduce hospitalizations and emergency-room use. The practice accepts Medicare, Medicaid, and most major commercial insurance plans. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a patient-facing website but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Apollomics, Inc.
providers.description: Apollomics, Inc. (Nasdaq: APLM) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Foster City, California, focused on the discovery and development of oncology therapies designed to be combined with other treatments to harness the immune system and target specific molecular pathways that inhibit cancer. Operating since 2016, Apollomics has a pipeline of nine drug candidates spanning small-molecule targeted drugs and biologics, including late-stage programs such as vebreltinib (Phase 2, NSCLC and solid tumors with cMet dysregulation) and uproleselan (Phase 3 in China for relapsed/refractory AML). The company became publicly traded via a business combination with Maxpro Capital Acquisition Corp. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network; as a biopharmaceutical company it publishes no public developer API surface — this profile carries its corporate identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: asieris
providers.description: Asieris Pharmaceuticals is a China-based biopharmaceutical company developing innovative therapies in genitourinary tumors and women's health. Its focus areas span urologic oncology (bladder cancer diagnosis and treatment), women's health, and breast and gynecologic oncology, with marquee assets Vesique (APL-1202) for bladder cancer and Cevira (APL-1702), a non-invasive photodynamic therapy for cervical precancerous lesions. The company runs three proprietary R&D platforms (TIMN, TAIDD, DDC). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network; as a biopharma company it publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Aumio
providers.description: Aumio (Aumio GmbH) is a Berlin-based children's digital-health company behind a freemium sleep, meditation, and mindfulness mobile app for kids aged roughly 0-10 and their families. The app offers 200+ audio experiences - bedtime stories, soundscapes, white noise, sleep music, and guided meditations - added to weekly, with parts of the subscription reimbursed by German statutory health-insurance providers as a certified prevention course. Founded in 2020 and backed by Partech, Aumio operates as a consumer B2C product (iOS, Android, and web) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web and domain footprint.

providers.name: Auto Finance
providers.description: Auto Finance is a decentralized finance (DeFi) liquidity-management protocol built by Tokemak. Its core product, Autopools, are automated onchain vaults that autonomously optimize, rebalance, and auto-compound liquidity-provider yield across major DeFi venues (Curve, Fluid, Inverse, Morpho, AAVE) and networks (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base), abstracting away the complexity of manual LP management. The protocol is governed and secured through AUTO token staking, and its onchain surface is a public set of audited Solidity smart contracts rather than a REST API. Documentation is published via GitBook with an agent-readable llms.txt index.

providers.name: Bank OZK
providers.description: Bank OZK is a regional bank headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas, tracing its charter to 1903 and today operating roughly 265 offices across Arkansas, Georgia, Florida, North Carolina, Texas, and New York. It is a state-chartered commercial bank and the wholly owned subsidiary of Bank OZK holding company, publicly traded on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol OZK, with about $40.8 billion in total assets as of year-end 2025 and a national reputation in commercial real estate lending. Bank OZK runs no first-party public developer portal and publishes no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications; it is not a documented Financial Data Exchange (FDX) participant and has not published a specific CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture. Consumer-permissioned account data is reached only indirectly through third-party aggregators, with Plaid documented as the supporting aggregator. This is an honest identity-only profile with no public API surface.

providers.name: Barclays US
providers.description: Barclays US is the United States consumer banking arm of Barclays PLC, operated through Barclays Bank Delaware, a Delaware state-chartered bank headquartered in Wilmington. Doing business as Barclays US (barclaysus.com redirects to cards.barclaycardus.com), it is one of the largest co-branded credit card issuers in the country, running highly customized card programs for major travel, airline, retail, and affinity partners (JetBlue, American Airlines, Wyndham, AARP, Gap, and others), alongside small-business cards, installment loans, point-of-sale financing, and a direct-to-consumer online savings and CD franchise. Unlike Barclays UK — which operates a mandated PSD2 Open Banking API Exchange at developer.barclays.com — the US consumer entity publishes no first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specification. US open finance is voluntary and fragmented, so consumer- permissioned account and card data from Barclays US is reached in practice through third-party data aggregators rather than a documented first-party API. No FDX-conformant data-access endpoint or formally stated CFPB Section 1033 posture is published on the US site as of this profile.

providers.name: Baton Systems
providers.description: Baton Systems is a post-trade settlement and payments technology provider founded in 2016, headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices in London, New York, and Chennai. Its CORE platform (Core-FX, Core-Payments, Core-Liquidity, and Core-Collateral) uses distributed ledger technology (DLT) and payment-versus-payment (PvP) settlement to orchestrate real-time FX settlement, intraday liquidity management, collateral optimization, and post-trade payment control for global banks and financial institutions. Baton operates a live FX PvP settlement service and processes roughly USD 30 billion daily for seven of the nine largest Western global systemically important banks, having settled trillions in aggregate value. Data flows integrate over APIs and standard financial formats including ISO 20022, SWIFT MT, FIXML, and XML.

providers.name: Bikky
providers.description: Bikky is a New York-based Customer Data Platform (CDP) built exclusively for large, multi-unit restaurant brands, serving thousands of locations for companies such as Bojangles, MOD Pizza, Dave's Hot Chicken, and Long John Silver's. By integrating with point-of-sale, online ordering, payment, and loyalty systems, Bikky builds a single source of truth on guests, cleaning, standardizing, and de-duplicating data to reveal behavior, frequency, lifetime value, and menu performance across channels. Bikky offers push-button API integrations with leading ordering, loyalty, and marketing providers, plus Snowflake data shares, SFTP, and CSV import for data exchange. It does not appear to publish a public, self-service developer API or documentation; integration and data access are arranged directly with Bikky.

providers.name: Breathwrk
providers.description: Breathwrk is a consumer health and performance app offering guided breathing exercises to reduce stress, improve sleep, boost energy, and enhance athletic and social performance. It packages more than 50 science-backed breathing techniques with music, haptics, coach-led classes, and progress tracking across calming, sleep, energizing, performance, and social categories. Breathwrk is available on iOS and Android with free and Pro subscription tiers plus a Breathwrk for Business program for organizations, and the company is now part of Peloton. Breathwrk publishes no public API, SDK, or developer program; this profile is maintained by API Evangelist and reflects the company's live web presence and security posture.

providers.name: Bright
providers.description: Bright is Mexico's leading residential and commercial solar energy provider, founded in 2014 (Y Combinator W15) by Jonah Greenberger. Often described as "Sunrun for the developing world," Bright combines financing and software to let homeowners and businesses adopt rooftop solar and battery energy storage (BESS) at no upfront cost. The company operates a marketplace connecting a network of local installers, distributors, and retail promoters with customers, and offers financing models such as solar PPAs and leasing schemes. Bright's public web presence is a Wix-hosted marketing site (thinkbright.mx) covering its industrial, commercial, and home solutions, success cases, and 24/7 energy monitoring technology. It exposes an agent-facing surface via an llms.txt and a hosted Wix Site MCP endpoint, but publishes no first-party developer/REST API.

providers.name: Bumame
providers.description: Bumame is an Indonesian healthcare provider ("Elevating Indonesian Healthcare") delivering global-standard health screening and preventive-care services to Indonesian families. It operates a network of clinics and offers medical check-up packages, laboratory testing, vaccination and boosters, maternal and child health services, early cancer screening and genetic DNA testing, vitamin infusions, home care, doctor consultations, and corporate health programs, with online appointment booking. Backed by 500 Global. Surfaced as a portfolio-company lead in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: Carbon Health
providers.description: Carbon Health is a technology-enabled healthcare provider offering primary, urgent, virtual, and pediatric care through in-person clinics and telemedicine across the United States. It operates on its own clinical technology platform (CarbyOS) and offers services including same-day appointments, cold/flu/COVID testing, STI/STD testing, sports physicals, occupational and workplace health, and clinical research for sponsors. Carbon Health was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or FHIR patient-access surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Cardurion Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Cardurion Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on transforming the treatment of cardiovascular disease and heart failure. Its research and development pipeline centers on novel small-molecule programs including PDE9 inhibition for chronic heart failure (HFrEF and HFpEF) and CaMKII inhibition for cardiac diseases such as catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT). Cardurion combines target discovery, adaptive clinical trial design, and precision-medicine approaches, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). The company publishes a corporate and R&D website but does not expose a public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Cartwheel Care
providers.description: Cartwheel (Cartwheel Care) is a school-based youth mental health provider that partners with K-12 school districts to deliver rapid-access, evidence-based therapy and psychiatric care to students. Through licensed clinicians it offers individual and group therapy, medication management, and parent guidance, with Care Coordinators contacting families within 24 hours of a school referral and initial appointments typically available within 7-10 days; a course of care generally lasts two to six months. The company is backed by General Catalyst and operates across 25+ school districts in multiple states. Cartwheel publishes no public API or developer surface; its software footprint is a school- and family-facing web application at app.cartwheel.org, hosted on the HIPAA-compliant Aptible platform.

providers.name: Cerevance
providers.description: Cerevance is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapeutics for central nervous system (CNS) disorders. Its proprietary NETSseq platform profiles gene expression across specific human brain cell types from post-mortem tissue to identify previously undiscovered, cell-type-specific drug targets, powering a pipeline of small-molecule candidates for Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, epilepsy, and other neurodegenerative and psychiatric conditions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV; profiled in the API Evangelist network. Cerevance publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK.

providers.name: Cirsium Biosciences
providers.description: Cirsium Biosciences is a biotechnology company democratizing gene therapy through transformative manufacturing methods. It develops viral vector production systems that use whole plants as bioreactors, offering a highly scalable, linear scale-out platform for producing recombinant AAV (adeno-associated virus) vectors. The plant-based, controlled-environment agriculture approach targets the industry's core production bottlenecks - inadequate global capacity, poor scalability, high clinical-grade manufacturing costs, and standardization challenges - claiming up to a 70% reduction in manufacturing lead times. Cirsium is a private, venture-backed therapeutics-manufacturing firm and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Clay
providers.description: Clay is a go-to-market platform that combines people and company data enrichment from 150+ premium providers, AI research agents (Claygents), intent signals, and workflow automation for sales, marketing, and revenue operations teams. Clay exposes inbound HTTP API endpoints and webhooks so external systems can push records into Clay tables, trigger enrichments, and receive enriched data for CRM sync, lead scoring, and outbound workflows.

providers.name: CMR Surgical
providers.description: CMR Surgical is a British medical-device company headquartered in Cambridge, UK, founded in 2014 (as Cambridge Medical Robotics). It develops Versius, a small, modular and portable robot-assisted surgical system used across urology, general, gynaecological and thoracic surgery, and Versius Plus, its next-generation platform cleared by the US FDA in December 2025. More than 45,000 patients have been treated globally, making Versius one of the most widely used soft-tissue robotic surgery platforms. CMR reached unicorn status in 2019 and raised a $600M Series D at a $3B valuation in 2021, backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, GE Healthcare, ABB Technology Ventures and others. Its digital ecosystem (Versius Connect, Versius Team, Versius Clinical Insights) is a login-gated clinical surface; CMR publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs or developer portal.

providers.name: Coffee Meets Bagel
providers.description: Coffee Meets Bagel (CMB) is a consumer dating application built for people seeking serious, committed relationships rather than casual swiping. Founded by three sisters, the app uses a curated daily-match model and reports over 150 million matches, with the large majority of its daters looking for a long-term partner. The company operates a mobile-first product for iOS and Android across the US, Canada, and worldwide markets, supported by a premium subscription tier. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. Coffee Meets Bagel publishes no public developer or partner API, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specifications, and no /.well-known discovery surface; this profile therefore carries company identity, verified public web properties, and a domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Condorsoftware
providers.description: Condor Software builds AI-powered financial intelligence software for life sciences R&D organizations, unifying clinical, operational, and financial data to manage complex clinical trial finances. The platform connects data from existing systems (CROs, ERP, CTMS, EDC, procurement), automates AI-powered accruals, invoice reconciliation, and financial close, and delivers board-ready forecasts, scenario planning, and portfolio dashboards for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies. Condor advertises 90%+ forecast accuracy, faster month-end close versus spreadsheets, and a compliance-by-design architecture co-developed with Big 4 accounting firms. No public API, developer portal, or SDKs are published at this time; integrations with systems such as Veeva, Medidata, SAP, and Oracle NetSuite are delivered through the product. Backed by Felicis; raised a $24M Series A.

providers.name: ContinuumCloud
providers.description: ContinuumCloud is a Tampa, Florida-based provider of cloud software purpose-built for behavioral health and human services organizations. Its integrated suite spans three products: Welligent, an electronic health record (EHR) platform for caseload management, scheduling, clinical documentation and revenue-cycle management; DATIS e3, a unified human capital management (HCM) and payroll system covering recruiting, onboarding, timekeeping, talent management and workforce analytics; and CaredFor, a patient-engagement platform that builds online communities connecting clients, alumni and families. Formerly known as Behavioral Holdings and founded in 2020, the company draws on 25+ years of domain focus and is backed by Battery Ventures. ContinuumCloud does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or MCP server at this time; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Crystal Dynamics
providers.description: Crystal Dynamics is a AAA video game development studio, best known as the home of the Tomb Raider franchise and its Lara Croft character, and part of the Embracer Group. The studio publishes a consumer-facing marketing website, careers portal, player support center, and news/community hub, but exposes no public developer API program, API documentation, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio stub lead; enrichment confirms there is no public API surface to catalog at this time.

providers.name: CubeSmart
providers.description: CubeSmart (NYSE CUBE) is a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust (REIT) and the third-largest owner and operator of self-storage properties in the United States. As of December 31, 2024 the company owns 631 self-storage properties across 25 states and Washington DC, containing approximately 45.8 million rentable square feet, and operates a third-party management platform that pushes the total managed network well past 1,300 properties. Headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, CubeSmart originated as U-Store-It Trust (founded July 2004, IPO October 2004) and rebranded to CubeSmart on September 14, 2011. The company is a component of the S&P 400. CubeSmart does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal — its public technology footprint is limited to the consumer cubesmart.com booking/account site and the CubeSmart mobile apps for iOS and Android.

providers.name: Curology
providers.description: Curology is a direct-to-consumer skincare and telehealth company founded in 2014 and based in San Francisco, California. It pairs online dermatology providers (dermatologists, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants) with custom-compounded prescription topical treatments for acne, anti-aging, and other skin concerns, delivered as a subscription. Care is delivered through a secure telemedicine platform where patients complete a skin assessment, upload photos, and receive a personalized formula plus ongoing provider messaging. Curology is a portfolio company of Forerunner Ventures and IVP. It operates as a consumer web and mobile product and does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company as part of the API Evangelist health/telehealth network.

providers.name: DCU (Digital Federal Credit Union)
providers.description: Digital Federal Credit Union (DCU) is a not-for-profit, member-owned federal credit union headquartered in Marlborough, Massachusetts and regulated by the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA), with roughly 1.18 million members, 23 branches across Massachusetts and New Hampshire, and nationwide access via the Co-Op shared-branch and surcharge-free ATM networks. It offers consumer and business banking, lending, mortgages, credit cards, and investment services, and has recently merged with First Technology Federal Credit Union. Like most US credit unions, DCU publishes NO public first-party developer API, developer portal, or downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications; consumer-permissioned account data is reached only indirectly through third-party aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) and its core banking provider, and there is no publicly documented FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access program. This is an honest identity-only record: no public API surface exists to catalog.

providers.name: Delfi Diagnostics
providers.description: DELFI Diagnostics is a precision oncology company, founded in 2019 and built on research from the Johns Hopkins Kimmel Cancer Center, that combines machine learning with genome-wide analysis of cell-free DNA fragmentation patterns (an approach it calls DNA fragmentomics, or "fragmentomes") to develop accessible, blood-based cancer screening and treatment-monitoring tests. Its first commercial product, FirstLook Lung, is a laboratory-developed liquid biopsy screening test for lung cancer that runs from a simple blood draw and reports a high negative predictive value; the company also offers DELFI-TF for treatment monitoring and partners with health systems and pharmaceutical researchers. DELFI operates a CLIA laboratory and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California. This profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network; DELFI publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: DESERT FARMS INC.
providers.description: Desert Farms Inc. is a direct-to-consumer camel milk brand founded in 2013 by Walid Abdul-Wahab and headquartered in Santa Monica, California. The company sources 100% pure camel milk from a network of small family-owned camel dairies across the United States and sells raw and pasteurized camel milk, frozen and powdered camel milk, plus camel-milk-based soaps and skincare, direct to consumers through its Shopify storefront at desertfarms.com and through select retail grocers. Backed by 500 Global, Desert Farms is a consumer packaged goods and e-commerce company rather than an API provider; it exposes no first-party developer API. Its public web surface runs on Shopify, whose Customer Account API OpenID Connect discovery documents are served on the storefront domain for customer login. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched with the domain-security, well-known, and site link-property signals that are genuinely present.

providers.name: Drahim Holdings
providers.description: Drahim (دراهم) is a Saudi personal-finance and automated-investment fintech, founded in Riyadh in 2021 by Sultan Alkhayal and Yasser Alshurihi. Its mobile app uses open banking to aggregate a user's bank accounts into one view, enriches and auto-categorizes transactions (2.5B+ processed), and offers auto-savings, Zakat calculation, and Sharia-compliant robo-advisory portfolios spanning 40+ funds across Saudi and global equities, real estate, and commodities. Drahim is licensed by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) for open-banking/payment services and by the Capital Market Authority (CMA) for investment management; it was backed by Y Combinator and 500 Global, and Al Rajhi Bank acquired a 65% majority stake in 2024. Drahim is a consumer application and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; this profile captures its corporate and product identity plus live domain-security posture. Consumer surfaces include the iOS and Android apps and a business platform.

providers.name: Editas Medicine
providers.description: Editas Medicine is a clinical-stage genome editing company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing durable, precision CRISPR-based gene editing medicines for people with serious diseases. The company works across in vivo and ex vivo approaches and holds foundational CRISPR/Cas9 and Cas12a intellectual property, advancing a pipeline that has included programs in sickle cell disease, beta-thalassemia and inherited retinal disorders. Editas Medicine trades on Nasdaq under the ticker EDIT and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). As a life-sciences research and therapeutics organization it publishes a corporate and investor-relations web presence rather than a public developer API, so this profile captures its identity, web properties, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: EditorConfig
providers.description: EditorConfig helps maintain consistent coding styles for multiple developers working on the same project across various editors and IDEs. The EditorConfig project consists of a file format for defining coding styles and a collection of text editor plugins that enable editors to read the file format and adhere to defined styles. EditorConfig files are easily readable and work well with version control systems. The format uses an INI-style syntax compatible with the Python configparser library, with filepath glob patterns similar to gitignore.

providers.name: eGenesis
providers.description: eGenesis is a biotechnology company working at the intersection of genome engineering and transplantation to make organ transplants accessible to all. Using a multiplex CRISPR gene-editing and genome-engineering platform, eGenesis engineers porcine (pig) donor organs that are immunologically and molecularly compatible with human recipients and free of porcine endogenous retroviruses, aiming to end waitlist mortality by removing donor-organ scarcity as a barrier to transplantation. Its pipeline spans kidney, liver, and heart xenotransplantation programs; the U.S. FDA has cleared its IND for EGEN-2784, a genetically engineered porcine kidney, to begin a Phase 1/2/3 trial in patients with end-stage kidney disease. eGenesis is a private, venture-backed company (investors include Lux Capital). This API Evangelist profile tracks the company for network discovery; eGenesis publishes a corporate and scientific web presence but does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: eGenesis
providers.description: eGenesis is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing human-compatible, genetically engineered organs to address the global organ shortage. Using a proprietary CRISPR-based multiplex genome-editing platform, eGenesis modifies the porcine genome to inactivate endogenous retroviruses and add protective human transgenes, producing pig kidneys, livers, and hearts intended for xenotransplantation. Its lead program, EGEN-2784, is a genetically engineered porcine kidney being evaluated in an expanded-access study. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company; eGenesis publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: eHealth
providers.description: eHealth, Inc. (NASDAQ: EHTH) operates a licensed online health insurance marketplace where U.S. consumers can compare and enroll in health coverage from more than 180 insurance carriers across all 50 states and Washington, D.C. Founded in 1997, the company offers individual and family plans, Medicare products (Medicare Advantage, Medigap, and Part D prescription drug plans), small-business coverage, and Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangements (ICHRA). eHealth also provides a partner-facing developer API, documented at its gated developer portal, that lets affiliates and partners embed health-insurance shopping, quoting, and enrollment into their own applications.

providers.name: Emancro
providers.description: Emancro is an AI robotics company automating hospital logistics.
