Tigermed was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer, API, or technical platform surface.

providers.name: Tonik
providers.description: Tonik is the first digital-only neobank in the Philippines, operated by Tonik Digital Bank, Inc. under a digital banking license from the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP). Delivered entirely through a consumer mobile app, Tonik offers retail deposit accounts, high-interest savings "Stashes", time deposits, and consumer/quick loans, together with everyday payments and transfers for Filipino customers. The company positions itself around fast, easy, and secure mobile-first banking and is backed by investors including Prosus Ventures. As of this profile Tonik publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this record captures its public web presence and probed security posture and remains a lead awaiting a provider API surface.

providers.name: TreeHouse Foods
providers.description: TreeHouse Foods is one of the largest manufacturers of private label packaged foods and beverages in North America, producing snack and convenience foods for retail grocery and foodservice customers. The company is publicly traded on the NYSE (THS) and is headquartered in Oak Brook, Illinois. TreeHouse Foods produces over 1,600 SKUs across snacking, beverage, and meal preparation categories.

providers.name: TVbeat
providers.description: TVbeat is a London-based, Techstars-backed advertising technology company whose platform unifies linear television and streaming (CTV) advertising operations into a single system. It lets media owners and buyers forecast, plan, transact, optimize, and measure campaigns across audiences, yield, and operations, supporting multi-currency transacting (ratings, spots, impressions, and outcomes) and modern buying models — Direct, Programmatic, Self-Serve, and AI-driven — across both traditional linear spots and streaming inventory. TVbeat does not publish a public API, SDK, or open developer portal; its documentation portal at docs.tvbeat.com is private and requires credentials.

providers.name: Vibe Bio
providers.description: Vibe Bio is a biopharma AI company whose VibeOne platform provides AI decision infrastructure for business development and licensing teams, accelerating therapeutic asset diligence by turning unstructured scientific and clinical data into decision-ready outputs across a source, prioritize, evaluate, and decide workflow. The company also operates a venture fund backing founders developing cures for rare and overlooked diseases. VibeOne is offered as a demo-request enterprise SaaS product; no public API or developer platform is published at this time.

providers.name: Vilya
providers.description: Vilya is a computational drug-design biotechnology company pioneering the de novo design of macrocycles — entirely new therapeutic molecules that do not exist in nature. Spun out of the Institute for Protein Design and built on Nobel Prize-winning computational protein-design research from scientific founder Dr. David Baker, Vilya uses AI-driven generative models to generate, predict, and validate novel, chemically diverse macrocycles in silico. Its pipeline advances orally bioavailable macrocycles that aim to combine the target selectivity of biologics with the convenience of small- molecule pills, opening previously untreatable disease areas across oncology and immunology (including an integrin alpha4beta7 program for IBD). Vilya is a private therapeutics company; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Vivid
providers.description: Vivid Money is a European fintech company operating a mobile-first financial super-app for individuals and businesses across the EU. Through its regulated entities Vivid Money S.A. (payments/e-money) and Vivid Money B.V. (investments), it offers business and personal accounts, physical and virtual cards, SEPA and card payments, cashback rewards, savings/interest pockets, stock and ETF investing, and crypto services. For businesses it adds expense management, sub-accounts, and open-banking connectivity to accounting tools such as DATEV, sevDesk, Lexware Office, FastBill, and Agicap. Vivid is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this profile Vivid does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; its 'open banking' is consumer-consent connectivity to third-party financial apps rather than an outbound public API surface.

providers.name: VivorCare
providers.description: OncoveryCare (VivorCare) is the first virtual survivorship clinic for people living with and beyond cancer. Backed by Techstars, the company pairs survivorship-trained care teams with a virtual-first platform delivering physical and mental health support, personalized survivorship care planning, patient navigation to community resources and referrals, and survivor education. It partners with oncology providers such as New York Cancer & Blood Specialists (NYCBS) to extend post-treatment care. OncoveryCare operates a public website and blog but currently publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Vixtra
providers.description: Vixtra (VIXTRA Tecnologia e Serviços Financeiros LTDA., CNPJ 43.443.444/0001-04) is a Brazilian trade-finance fintech founded in July 2021 and headquartered in São Paulo, positioning itself as "the Trade Banking of the Brazilian importer." It pioneers financing for importers using in-transit maritime cargo as collateral, and delivers credit, foreign exchange, guarantees, and cash-flow management for foreign trade from a single digital platform. Its products include Crédito Flex (revolving working-capital credit), Crédito Pré (pre-shipment import financing), Câmbio Fácil (100% digital commercial FX), Trade Banking (the unified operations platform), and a Vixtra stablecoin for cross-border payments. Vixtra operates as a banking correspondent of BMP Money Plus SCD and an FX correspondent of Ebury Banco de Câmbio, has raised roughly US$36M (US$30M debt + US$6M seed extension) led by QED Investors with Valor Capital Group, Endeavor Promessas, NXTP Ventures, Actyus, and BluStone, and processes data in compliance with Brazil's LGPD. No public developer portal or API is currently published; the api.vixtra.com host backs the customer application and returns 403 to anonymous callers.

providers.name: Well
providers.description: Well is a personalized health engagement platform for employers and their workforce, marketed as "your personalized daily health partner." It pairs an AI-driven health engine that delivers tailored interventions and behavior-change nudges with human "Well Guides," across a mobile and web experience, and ties outcomes to a performance-based ROI guarantee for the sponsoring employer. Well powers wellness programs, health challenges, biometric screenings, premium reductions, and rewards for large employer and benefits clients including Bank of America, USAA, Sam's Club, UNC Health, MGM, Regions, Amentum, and Octapharma. The company is backed by General Catalyst and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; enrichment found a public WordPress marketing/campaign presence at well.co but no public developer API, SDKs, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Wenspiredata
providers.description: Wenspiredata is an enterprise cybersecurity vendor delivering all-in-one, zero-trust Privileged Remote Access Management (RPAM) for high-risk access. Its platform secures and governs remote privileged access for IT, OT, and third-party vendors, including air-gapped and industrial (OT) environments, and pairs with OsecT for OT-native intrusion detection and continuous visibility. Wenspiredata also offers security assessment services (external attack surface and internal vulnerability assessments) and helps organizations across manufacturing, telecom, finance, and healthcare meet regulatory compliance requirements. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment; the company markets a demo-led enterprise product and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: West Technology Group
providers.description: West Technology Group is a cloud-based global technology company providing customer experience and communications solutions through its WestCX platform. The company operates through two main brands: Mosaicx, which delivers AI-native conversational automation for enterprise customer engagement, and TeleVox, which provides digital patient engagement solutions for healthcare organizations including providers, payers, and life sciences companies.

providers.name: Whirl
providers.description: Whirl AI is an enterprise IT platform that uses AI agents to help IT teams understand, enhance, and transform business processes and core systems. It automates research and impact analysis, generates business requirements, epics and user stories, and accelerates configuration and code changes across applications and integrations, compressing enterprise system changes from weeks and months into days and hours. Whirl runs on dedicated single-tenant AWS infrastructure per customer with immutable, versioned, auditable pipelines (no SSH access), FIDO2 device-based access, and SOC 2 Type II compliance. Founded by former Snowflake CIO Sunny Bedi and backed by ICONIQ, with advisors from Okta, Splunk, and VMware.

providers.name: Zai Lab
providers.description: Zai Lab is an innovative, research-based, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company based in China and the United States, founded in 2014 with headquarters in Cambridge, Massachusetts and Shanghai. The company discovers, develops, and commercializes transformative medicines for conditions with significant unmet patient needs across oncology, immunology, neuroscience, and infectious disease. As a fully integrated biopharma, Zai Lab spans early-stage discovery through development, regulatory approval, manufacturing, and commercialization. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HongShan and Qiming Venture Partners. Zai Lab publishes a corporate and investor web presence but exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Zenyum
providers.description: Zenyum is a Singapore-founded, direct-to-consumer oral-care and dental company operating across Asia. Its flagship product is ZenyumClear invisible braces (clear aligners) delivered through a network of partner clinics, alongside a broader oral-care line that includes ZenyumSonic electric toothbrushes, ZenyumBright whitening strips, serums and pens, toothpastes, water flossers and floss. Zenyum sells online and through retail across Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam and Japan, and is backed by venture investors including Partech. As of this profile the company operates consumer e-commerce and clinic-partner surfaces but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or GitHub organization; this record captures its verifiable public web and domain security footprint.

providers.name: Zogo Finance
providers.description: Zogo Finance is a gamified financial education platform (founded 2018, a Techstars portfolio company) that helps banks, credit unions, and other financial institutions engage and educate their customers. Its library of 1,200+ bite-sized financial literacy modules is delivered to end users through an embeddable, white-label SDK that partners drop into their existing digital banking apps and websites, plus a standalone mobile app and desktop web experience. Users earn redeemable points for completing lessons. Zogo is a B2B/enterprise offering distributed via SDK embed and mobile-banking integrations (Q2, NCR, Jack Henry Banno) rather than a public developer API; as of this pass no public API documentation, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal is published.

providers.name: 24M
providers.description: 24M Technologies is a battery technology company founded in 2010 out of MIT laboratories and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Rather than manufacturing cells at scale itself, 24M licenses its battery materials, cell architecture and SemiSolid manufacturing platform to energy-storage system integrators, EV battery manufacturers and OEMs worldwide. Its product portfolio spans the Eternalyte electrolyte (ultra-fast charging and low-temperature performance), the Impervio separator (thermal-runaway prevention), the LiForever electrode, the 24M ETOP electrode-to-pack architecture, and 24M production equipment. Partners and corporate investors have included Volkswagen Group, Kyocera, Itochu and FREYR Battery. 24M is a hardware, materials and manufacturing company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: ABL Space Systems
providers.description: ABL Space Systems is an American launch vehicle company founded in 2017 by Harry O'Hanley and Dan Piemont, headquartered in El Segundo, California, with operations at the Port of Long Beach, Mojave and Kodiak, Alaska. ABL built RS1, a two-stage, kerosene/liquid-oxygen small satellite launch vehicle designed to deliver 1,350 kg to low Earth orbit and 1,000 kg to sun-synchronous orbit, powered by nine in-house additively manufactured E2 engines on the first stage and one on the second. Its companion GS0 ground system packages an entire orbital launch site into standard shipping containers so a pad can be activated anywhere with a flat concrete surface and moved by land, sea or air. RS1 attempted its first orbital flight from Pacific Spaceport Complex Kodiak in January 2023 and was lost shortly after liftoff; a second vehicle was destroyed during preflight static-fire testing in July 2024. In November 2024 the company announced its exit from the commercial orbital launch market, and in February 2025 it rebranded as Long Wall, refocusing on containerized missile defense — the Cyclops exoatmospheric interceptor, RSX low-cost liquid boosters for flight testing and threat replication, and the Ironwood ground support equipment line. ABL/Long Wall is an aerospace and defense hardware manufacturer: it publishes no public developer API, SDK, machine-readable API contract or developer portal.

providers.name: Alvarez & Marsal
providers.description: Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a leading global professional services firm, founded in 1983 by Tony Alvarez II and Bryan Marsal and headquartered in New York City. Privately held, the firm employs more than 10,000 people across six continents and is best known for turnaround and restructuring engagements (Lehman Brothers, HealthSouth, Tribune, FTX, Arthur Andersen) and for performance improvement, tax advisory, transaction advisory, disputes and investigations, valuation, and private equity performance improvement (PEPI) services. A&M does not operate a public developer portal; technology is delivered through client engagements, internal proprietary tools, A&M Capital Partners (the firm's investment arm), and a public Insights / thought-leadership surface published on alvarezandmarsal.com.

providers.name: Animoca Brands
providers.description: Animoca Brands is a Web3 company focused on advancing digital property rights and building the open metaverse through blockchain technology, gaming, and digital assets. Founded in Hong Kong, the company operates a portfolio of consumer products including The Sandbox, Moca Network (digital identity), Open Campus (education), and Anichess, alongside institutional offerings such as Anchorpoint Financial (stablecoins and real-world assets) and NUVA (treasury management). Animoca Brands is also one of the most active investors in Web3, backing 600+ builders across gaming, infrastructure, real-world assets, and digital-ownership platforms. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of the SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network; Animoca operates primarily as a holding and investment company and does not publish a first-party public developer API.

providers.name: ANYbotics
providers.description: ANYbotics is a Swiss deep-tech robotics company that builds ANYmal, an autonomous four-legged inspection robot used to automate routine and hazardous industrial inspections across power and utilities, oil and gas, mining, chemicals, and metals. Its platform pairs the legged robot with inspection-management software and analytics to increase plant uptime, cut costs, and remove workers from dangerous areas. ANYbotics is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. No public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface is exposed; this API Evangelist profile currently captures the company's published security and trust posture.

providers.name: AptDeco
providers.description: AptDeco is a full-service online marketplace for buying and selling used, new, and vintage furniture. Founded in 2014 in New York City by Reham Fagiri and Kalam Dennis, the company handles the entire resale transaction end to end: pickup, disassembly and assembly, delivery, payment, scheduling, and logistics are all carried out by its own trained delivery teams. AptDeco serves the New York City metro, New Jersey, Connecticut, Philadelphia, Delaware, and the San Francisco Bay Area, and has expanded to additional US metros with national shipping. Backed by Y Combinator and Initialized Capital. AptDeco does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, support, legal, and developer surfaces for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Armadin
providers.description: Armadin is an AI-native cybersecurity company building the "Ultimate Attacker" — an autonomous, agentic offensive security platform that continuously identifies, proves, and prioritizes exploitable risk across enterprise attack surfaces. Founded in 2025 and launched publicly in March 2026, Armadin is headquartered in San Francisco and was co-founded by Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant, former FireEye CEO) alongside former Mandiant and Google Cloud Security leaders. The company pairs agentic AI "attacker swarms" with elite human red teamers to deliver continuous, 24/7 red teaming and prioritized remediation, framed as a response to AI-driven machine-speed "Hyperattacks." Armadin raised $189.9M in combined Seed and Series A funding led by Accel, with Google Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Menlo Ventures, 8VC, Ballistic Ventures, and In-Q-Tel participating. It is currently a security services and platform company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Arzana
providers.description: Arzana is an AI-powered Office Execution System for US manufacturers and distributors, founded in 2025 in San Francisco and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026). Arzana trains custom models on a factory's historical data and deploys agents that automate back-office work — quoting, estimating, order entry, purchasing, prospecting, outreach, CRM, AP 3-way match, AR tracking, and customer service — alongside a customizable ERP/CRM/MES with every agent pre-installed. Forward-deployed engineers configure each agent per operation; Arzana reports going live in 120 days with 99%+ accuracy. Arzana currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; it does publish a /llms.txt for agent discovery.

providers.name: Aurascape Ai
providers.description: Aurascape is an enterprise AI-security company that builds an AI-native cloud proxy sitting inline to see and secure every AI interaction across an organization, from the browser to AI embedded in SaaS, websites, and IDE plug-ins. The platform gives security teams real-time visibility, policy enforcement, and data protection over prompts and responses across thousands of AI apps, discovers shadow AI use, and secures AI agents from development through production, including runtime guardrails and a Zero-Bypass MCP Gateway for governing agent tool use. Aurascape is backed by Mayfield and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead. The company is sales-led and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures verified company identity and web properties.

providers.name: BRND.ME
providers.description: BRND.ME (legally Mensa Brand Technologies Private Limited) is an India-based house-of-brands company that acquires, builds, and scales digital-first consumer brands across Health, Wellness, Lifestyle, Fashion, Party & Celebration, and Home Decor. Founded by Ananth Narayanan and backed by Accel, the company combines technology, data insight, and centralized operations to grow market-leading D2C brands from India for global customers. Its portfolio includes brands such as Majestic Pure, Botanic Hearth, Dennis Lingo, House of Ishin, and MyFitness. This is a company/provider profile in the API Evangelist network; BRND.ME operates a corporate marketing presence and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Chasi
providers.description: Chasi (Chasi AI) is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company building an AI revenue engine for the equipment industry — sales, rental, and service. Chasi deploys AI agents that plug into an equipment dealer or rental company's existing stack and work around the clock to handle lead intake, quoting, CRM updates, follow-ups, and booking coordination, so teams respond faster, sell more, and maximize fleet utilization without adding headcount. Founded in 2025 by Akash Pavan and Sarman Aulakh, the company targets an industry where fleet utilization often sits below 60% and reps lose hours each day to email, voicemail, and manual data entry. At the time of profiling Chasi is pre-product-public: it exposes a marketing site, a trust center, and a demo booking flow, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDKs yet.

providers.name: Cotool
providers.description: Cotool is an AI platform for the defensive security "blue team" — AI agents that scale detection, response, and threat hunting across an organization's security stack. Its three products, Detect, Respond, and Hunt, let teams author detections from natural-language descriptions, automate alert response and playbook execution with human-in-the-loop controls, and monitor threat intelligence for relevance and coverage gaps. Cotool's stated mission is to "scale defensive security with tokens," giving defenders machine-speed operational advantages instead of being limited by headcount, improving coverage and cutting mean-time-to-respond (MTTR). Cotool is a San Francisco company backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Y Combinator, WndrCo, and Homebrew. As of this profile it publishes a product and marketing site only — no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or MCP server was found.

providers.name: Florence Healthcare
providers.description: Florence Healthcare provides eRegulatory and clinical-trial site enablement software for research sites, sponsors, and CROs. Its eBinders product is an electronic investigator site file (eISF) and participant binder platform that replaces paper regulatory binders with structured, compliant, 21 CFR Part 11 workflows; eTMF manages the sponsor-side trial master file; and SiteLink connects a network of 10,000+ investigator sites across 44+ countries to sponsors and CROs for remote site access, monitoring, document exchange, and source data verification. Florence describes an "open API" for eBinders, eTMF, and SiteLink that supports connected management of roles and permissions, inbound and outbound document exchange, and document status reporting across regulatory and source documents. Access to the API is partner- and customer-gated - it is granted through Florence's integration and partnership programs rather than a self-service public developer portal, and no public API reference, OpenAPI description, or base URL is published as of this writing.

providers.name: Forge Nano
providers.description: Forge Nano is a materials-technology manufacturer headquartered in Thornton, Colorado that commercializes particle and wafer Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) under its Atomic Armor platform and patented ALDx architecture. The company applies atomic-scale nanocoatings to powders, electrodes and semiconductor wafers to improve energy density, cycle life, thermal stability and yield, and sells three lines of business: US-sourced lithium-ion cells from its Morrisville, North Carolina gigafactory, commercial semiconductor wafer-fabrication equipment including the TEPHRA cluster tool for 200mm wafers, and Powder ALD coating systems for batteries, catalysts and composites. Its markets are semiconductors, energy storage, defense and aerospace, AI hardware and quantum devices. Forge Nano is a hardware and advanced-materials company: as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Gangkhar
providers.description: Gangkhar is an AI-native embedded protection infrastructure platform that lets digital platforms, insurers, MGAs, and brokers configure, launch, and continuously optimize embedded insurance products globally through a single infrastructure layer and API. Its Sherpa+ engine provides full-stack embedded protection rails covering onboarding, pricing, underwriting, and claims across multiple carriers and markets, while Sherpa+Lens applies real-time AI optimization to pricing, messaging, and product versions. The platform enables sectors like mobility, delivery, fintech, e-commerce, travel, health, and vertical SaaS to embed compliant protection directly into their customer experiences without becoming insurers themselves. Founded in 2025 and led by former Chubb executive Federico Spagnoli, Gangkhar closed a $4.25M seed round in March 2026 led by Anthemis. Surfaced as an Anthemis portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Goat Group
providers.description: Goat Group is the parent company behind a family of global marketplaces for sneakers, apparel, and luxury goods, operating the GOAT marketplace and app (goat.com), the Flight Club consignment stores and site, the Grailed peer-to-peer menswear and streetwear community, and the alias B2B platform. Founded in 2015 by Eddy Lu and Daishin Sugano and headquartered in Los Angeles (Culver City), California, the company began as a sneaker marketplace that pioneered ship-to-verify authentication and grew into one of the largest platforms for buying and selling new and pre-owned style. Goat Group went through Y Combinator (Winter 2015) and has raised capital from investors including D1 Capital Partners, Park West Asset Management, Foot Locker, Index Ventures, and others. The company does not currently publish a public developer API program; this profile is a network identity record.

providers.name: Grace
providers.description: Grace (Grâce) is a Paris-based insurtech that lets luxury maisons offer their clients complimentary, embedded protection against theft, loss, and damage for high-value goods such as watches, jewelry, and accessories. Founded in 2022 and backed by Speedinvest and FinTech Collective, Grace pairs a top-tier underwriter with a technology platform that handles instant coverage, fraud detection, claims processing, and logistics through the Grace app, and integrates into a brand's existing purchase journeys via a customizable API. The company raised a €5.9M seed round in 2025 and operates across Europe and beyond. Grace publishes no public developer portal or API specification; its API is a private, partner-facing integration offered to luxury brands.

providers.name: Hadrian
providers.description: Hadrian (Hadrian Automation) is a Los Angeles-area precision-manufacturing company founded in 2020 by Chris Power, building software-driven, AI-powered factories that produce high-tolerance machined components for the aerospace and defense industrial base — including parts for rockets, satellites, jets, drones, and missiles. The company's core software stack is Opus, described as a full-stack, AI-powered Factory Autonomy platform that interprets legacy engineering designs, automates CNC machining, inspection, tool-path optimization, adaptive programming, scheduling, and quality assurance, and enables new operators to be productive in 30 days or less. Hadrian operates multiple factories — Factory 2 (F2) and Factory X (FX) in Torrance, California, and Factory 3 (F3) in Mesa, Arizona — and offers three commercial models: precision component manufacturing, Manufacturing-as-a-Service (dedicated automation cells for a single customer), and Factories-as-a-Service (turnkey factory design and operation). Customers and partners include major aerospace and defense primes such as Lockheed Martin. Hadrian has also launched an additive manufacturing division to expand U.S. defense production capacity. The Opus platform is internal-only — Hadrian sells finished precision parts and factory capacity, not software access — and there is no public developer API, SDK, GitHub organization, or open-source release for Opus or any Hadrian system.

providers.name: Jade Autism
providers.description: Jade (Jade ND) is a Brazil-, UAE-, and UK-based education technology company building inclusive digital solutions for neurodivergent children, including those on the autism spectrum (ASD). Its product family includes Jade Edu (personalized-learning software for schools and educators), the Jade App (cognitive-development games for children, with 185,000+ downloads across 179 countries), Jade Astea (eye-tracking technology that assists professionals in evaluating autism-spectrum diagnosis), and Jade Academy (professional-development courses on inclusive and diverse education). Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Keep Network
providers.description: Keep Network is a privacy-focused blockchain infrastructure project that merged with NuCypher in 2021 to form the Threshold Network. Its flagship product is tBTC, a decentralized, trust-minimized bridge that tokenizes Bitcoin as the TBTC ERC-20 token so it can be used across Ethereum DeFi without centralized custodians. Keep originally provided off-chain "keeps" — private data containers secured by a threshold ECDSA signing network and a random beacon — enabling confidential data to be used on public protocols. The developer surface is on-chain Solidity smart contracts plus first-party JavaScript/TypeScript client libraries published under the @keep-network npm scope; there is no hosted REST API. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio company and enriched from the project's public GitHub org, npm packages, blog, and security.txt.

providers.name: Kiki
providers.description: Kiki (Kikihub) is a location-based social networking and chat mobile app that connects people nearby for local friendships, dating, networking, and community conversations. Users join local chat rooms to discover people around them and start real conversations, meeting new friends and matches in their area. The app is available for iOS and Android. Kiki publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation; this profile tracks the company within the API Evangelist network as a venture-backed (500 Global, a16z) consumer social lead awaiting any future developer surface.

providers.name: Legendary Entertainment
providers.description: Legendary Entertainment is a Burbank, California based global media company that owns, produces, and delivers content to worldwide audiences through three divisions: Legendary Pictures (film), Legendary Television and Digital Media (television and digital content), and Legendary Comics. The company builds and licenses media properties aimed at the fandom demographic, with productions that have generated over $20 billion in worldwide box office, including the Dune, Godzilla and Kong Monsterverse, Pokemon Detective Pikachu, Minecraft, and Street Fighter franchises, plus the Monarch: Legacy of Monsters series. Legendary was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IDG Capital. It operates no public developer program: no developer portal, API documentation, or API reference is published, and developer.legendary.com, api.legendary.com, and docs.legendary.com do not resolve. Its only machine-readable public surfaces are an llms.txt link index, an RSS news feed, and an XML sitemap on the marketing site.

providers.name: Mahmee
providers.description: Mahmee is a wraparound maternal and infant healthcare platform that connects expectant and new parents with integrated, coordinated teams of nurses, doulas, lactation consultants (IBCLCs), mental health coaches, and nutritionists through virtual and in-person appointments. Founded by Melissa Hanna (CEO) and Linda Hanna (Director of Care), the platform delivers evidence-based pregnancy and postpartum care — including remote blood pressure monitoring, in-home newborn jaundice phototherapy, and lactation support — across all 50 U.S. states, with in-person clinics in California. Mahmee works with major insurers such as Aetna, Cigna, Kaiser Permanente, and United Healthcare, and focuses on reducing maternal health disparities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: MeetMe
providers.description: MeetMe is a consumer social-discovery and chat platform that helps people find and connect with new people nearby who share their interests, through profiles, feeds, live streaming, and real-time messaging on web and mobile. Operated by The Meet Group as part of the ParshipMeet Group, MeetMe grew out of the myYearbook social network and today runs as a location-aware social networking and dating-adjacent app. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass MeetMe publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or SDKs — this profile captures its identity, legal surface, and live domain-security posture only.

providers.name: MIDAS Technologies
providers.description: Midas (Midas Technologies / Midas Inc.) is a free consumer cash-rewards and loyalty app in Mexico, built around the slogan "Tu efectivo cuenta" (your cash counts). Shoppers earn points worth up to 5% back when paying at affiliated merchants, where one Midas point equals one Mexican peso and accumulated points can be spent to pay the full total of a bill at participating stores. The app lets users create an account in under three minutes with just a name and phone number, view their points balance, browse promotions and discounts, find nearby affiliated stores on an interactive map, and track a full history of transactions and purchase tickets. Merchants can affiliate their business ("Afilia tu negocio") to reward customers. The company is a consumer-facing mobile app and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Motorq
providers.description: Motorq is a connected vehicle intelligence platform that taps native OEM connectivity to deliver AI-powered insights across the automotive ecosystem. It aggregates and normalizes vehicle telematics data from 25+ automotive brands and third-party sources without plug-in hardware or dongles, so fleets, fleet management companies, dealerships, lenders, insuretechs, and mobility companies can drive maintenance, safety, utilization, and EV use cases. Motorq offers access through a cloud fleet management portal, bi-directional APIs and data streams (Get Location, Create Geofence, and more), and a Snowflake data lake integration. Its Motorq Fuse AI layer surfaces prioritized recommendations ranked by severity and cost impact. API access is gated to enterprise and OEM partners; there is no public self-serve developer portal or OpenAPI definition. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Nourish
providers.description: Nourish is a virtual nutrition-counseling telehealth platform that connects patients with Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs) through insurance-covered video appointments in all 50 states. Its network of more than 10,000 dietitians supports conditions including diabetes, eating disorders, heart health, and gut health, and a companion mobile app handles meal and goal tracking, secure messaging, lab-work review, and between-session support. Nourish verifies insurance and submits claims on the patient's behalf, with the company reporting that 94% of patients pay $0 out of pocket. Backed by Index Ventures, Menlo Ventures, and Susa Ventures, the company raised a $100M Series C. Nourish exposes a consumer marketing and patient-app surface only; no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: OnXMaps
providers.description: onX Maps (onXmaps) is a Montana-based GPS mapping technology company building offline-capable navigation apps for outdoor recreation. Its product line spans onX Hunt (hunting maps with public/private land boundaries, species and unit data), onX Offroad (650K+ miles of off-road and overland trails), onX Backcountry (hiking, backpacking, skiing and climbing, incorporating Mountain Project and MTB Project data), and onX Fish (lake maps and fishing). The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. onX does not publish a public developer API; this profile is a company record enriched from its public web, security, and trust surfaces rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Phare Health
providers.description: Phare Health builds AI tools for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), focused on medical coding and clinical documentation improvement (CDI). Its platform analyzes complete electronic health records to generate accurate, compliant medical codes and to catch coding errors before bills are submitted. Products include Phare Audit (a pre-bill safety net that screens encounters for errors), Phare Autonomous (automated coding of simpler cases with explainability), and Phare Analytics (coding workflow and financial monitoring). The UK-founded, General Catalyst-backed company has been acquired by R1 and integrated into its R37 lab division. Phare Health operates as a closed B2B product and publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDK, or status page at this time.

providers.name: Phasecraft
providers.description: Phasecraft is a quantum algorithms company building software that combines classical and quantum computing to solve real-world problems in materials discovery, advanced biochemistry, and optimization. Its algorithms are engineered to run efficiently across multiple quantum hardware platforms, and its published results include scalable approaches to the Fermi-Hubbard model and QAOA-based optimization. Founded by Profs. Ashley Montanaro (CEO) and Toby Cubitt (CTO), the company operates from London, Bristol, and Washington DC, and is backed by Playground Global. Phasecraft exposes no public developer API; its programmatic surface is limited to open research code on GitHub and two interactive web tools (a materials database and an optimization graph library).

providers.name: Pratilipi
providers.description: Pratilipi is India's largest digital storytelling platform, democratizing story creation and consumption across languages, formats, and boundaries. Built by Nasadiya Technologies Private Limited and headquartered in Bangalore, it lets more than 300,000 self-published writers reach roughly 25 million monthly readers across twelve Indian languages (Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali, English, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Urdu, and Odia). The ecosystem spans Pratilipi Literature, Pratilipi FM (audio books, podcasts, and folk songs), Pratilipi Comics (the largest Hindi online comic platform), Westland Publications, and IVM Podcasts, carrying a story "from someone's draft to someone's screen." Pratilipi does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's identity, web properties, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sallie Mae Bank
providers.description: Sallie Mae Bank is a Utah state-chartered industrial bank (industrial loan company) founded on November 28, 2005 and headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, operating as the FDIC-insured banking subsidiary (FDIC cert #58177) of SLM Corporation (NASDAQ SLM), the publicly traded, S&P 400 consumer-finance company best known as the largest originator of private student loans in the United States. Beyond student and education lending, the bank offers retail deposit products including high-yield savings accounts, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit through salliemae.com. Sallie Mae Bank does not operate a first-party public developer program - there is no developer.salliemae.com portal, no api.salliemae.com host, and no published OpenAPI/Swagger definitions. Consumer account and transaction data is reachable only on a permissioned basis through third-party data aggregators (historically Plaid), and no first-party FDX data-access API or published CFPB Section 1033 data-rights posture could be confirmed. This is an identity-only, aggregator-access record reflecting the honest reality that this institution exposes no public API surface.

providers.name: Sierra Space
providers.description: Sierra Space is a commercial space and defense technology company headquartered in Louisville, Colorado, spun out of Sierra Nevada Corporation as an independent entity in April 2021 and building on more than three decades of spaceflight heritage. The company designs and manufactures the Dream Chaser reusable lifting-body spaceplane and Shooting Star cargo module, the LIFE expandable space habitat and the Orbital Reef commercial space station developed with Blue Origin, Eclipse-class satellites for national security and on-orbit servicing missions, VORTEX rocket propulsion and hypersonics, space solar arrays and electrical power systems, environmental control and life support systems, and a broad spaceflight hardware catalog spanning valves, regulators, radiators, sensors, actuators, docking and berthing systems, deployable structures and launch adapters. Sierra Space states it has delivered more than 4,000 space systems, subsystems and components across more than 500 space missions. It is a hardware and mission-systems manufacturer rather than a software platform: as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: SlashNext
providers.description: SlashNext is an AI-native phishing and social-engineering threat detection company founded by Atif Mushtaq (an architect of FireEye's core malware sandbox). Its Real-Time Phishing Threat Intelligence is delivered through the SlashNext On-demand Threat Intelligence (OTI) REST API at oti.slashnext.cloud, which offers URL and host reputation lookups, real-time cloud SEER-engine URL scanning in both asynchronous and blocking modes, and forensic downloads (screenshot, HTML, and rendered text) keyed by scan id, plus per-tenant API quota status. Responses are available as JSON, CSV, or plaintext and every request authenticates with a per-tenant API key passed as the authkey parameter. SlashNext was acquired by Varonis Systems in August 2025 and its detection capabilities are being integrated into the Varonis Email Security and MDDR platform.

providers.name: Tejas Networks India
providers.description: Tejas Networks is a Bengaluru, India-based optical and data networking products company that designs, develops and manufactures telecom networking equipment for communications service providers, internet and cable operators, utilities, defence and government agencies worldwide. Its portfolio spans optical transport (DWDM/OTN), packet transport, broadband access (GPON/fiber) and wireless (4G/5G radio access) systems deployed across more than 75 countries. The company is publicly listed in India (NSE/BSE TEJASNET) and is majority owned by the Tata Group; Battery Ventures was an early institutional investor. Tejas Networks is a hardware and network-infrastructure vendor and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal or SDK program.

providers.name: Tempus
providers.description: Tempus AI, Inc. (formerly Tempus Labs) is an AI-enabled precision medicine and genomic diagnostics company founded in 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois (NASDAQ: TEM). Tempus has assembled one of the world's largest libraries of clinical and molecular data and runs a next-generation-sequencing lab offering oncology assays such as Tempus xT (solid-tumor DNA panel), xF (cell-free DNA liquid biopsy), xG (germline), and whole-transcriptome RNA, expanding from oncology into cardiology, neuropsychiatry, radiology, and infectious disease. For its United States home market its technical surface is delivered as partner and provider integrations rather than a public self-serve developer program: Tempus Hub (a provider portal to order tests and view genomic results), EHR integration via Tempus Edge (bidirectional HL7, FHIR, API, and PACS interfaces into Epic, Oracle Health / Cerner, OncoEMR, and other EHRs), the Tempus Lens agentic-AI platform for oncology drug development, Tempus One clinical assistant, and de-identified multimodal real-world-data collaborations for life sciences. As of this review no public developer portal, downloadable OpenAPI, or anonymously reachable FHIR CapabilityStatement was found; integration is gated behind partner and provider onboarding.

providers.name: Travelstop
providers.description: Travelstop (rebranded WegoPro) is a modern corporate travel and expense management platform founded in Singapore and backed by Accel. Companies use it to book flights and hotels from multiple supply partners, enforce travel policy and approval workflows, and automate expense reporting with receipt scanning (OCR), duplicate detection, and fraud prevention. Expense and accounting data syncs to Xero and QuickBooks, and native iOS and Android apps support travelers on the move. The product exposes prebuilt in-app accounting integrations rather than a public, self-serve developer API; this profile enriches its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: Tyffon
providers.description: Tyffon Inc. is a Japanese immersive entertainment company that combines creativity and technology to deliver memorable XR experiences. The studio builds VR, AR, and mixed-reality attractions - including Corridor, Kaiju Haven VR, Floria, and Island Mirrorge MR - operates the Tyffonium attraction brand, licenses its XR content to entertainment venues across Japan, and released the GARA AR platform app. A Techstars portfolio company, Tyffon publishes no public developer portal or API surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: UBQ Materials
providers.description: UBQ Materials is a climate-tech company founded in 2012 that converts unsorted mixed household waste, including organics and hard-to-recycle plastics, into UBQ, a climate-positive thermoplastic material that substitutes for oil-based plastics in manufacturing. A Certified B Corporation backed by Battery Ventures, the company operates a full-scale production facility in Bergen op Zoom, Netherlands (opened 2024) with 80,000 tons of annual capacity, plus an R&D center in Tze'elim, Israel. UBQ Materials publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Upscale AI
providers.description: Upscale AI is a pure-play AI networking infrastructure company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, founded by industry veterans from Palo Alto Networks, Marvell, Cisco, and Google and led by CEO Barun Kar. The company builds a full-stack, open-standards AI fabric spanning silicon, systems, and software — its SkyHammer scale-up ASIC architecture and NVIDIA Spectrum-X/SONiC-based scale-out Ethernet systems connect accelerators, memory, and storage for large-scale AI training and inference. Backed by Mayfield among others (Premji Invest, NVIDIA, Salesforce Ventures, Temasek, Tiger Global), it has raised $500M total at a $2B valuation. The company publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface surface beyond a Webflow-served llms.txt; it sells networking hardware and software evaluated by hyperscalers and neoclouds.

providers.name: Valence Discovery
providers.description: Valence Discovery is an AI-first drug discovery company, now operating as Valence Labs, the AI research engine of Recursion. Formed from the merger of Datamol and InVivo AI, the team builds machine-learning methods and foundation models for molecular design, cellular perturbation prediction, and biological discovery, trained on petabyte-scale phenomics and transcriptomics data. Rather than a public REST API, Valence's developer surface is a suite of first-party open-source Python libraries - datamol, molfeat, graphium, SAFE and OpenQDC - published under the datamol-io and valence-labs GitHub organizations for cheminformatics, molecular featurization, graph neural networks and ML-ready quantum datasets.

providers.name: VSORA
providers.description: VSORA is a French fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Meudon-La-Foret, France, that designs high-performance AI inference chips. Its Jotunn 8 data-center inference chip (3200 Tflops fp8, 288 GB HBM, built on TSMC 5nm) targets cost- and energy-efficient large-scale AI inference, and its Tyr family (Tyr 2, Tyr 4) targets edge AI and on-device processing. VSORA is a Partech portfolio company and publishes no public web API or developer portal as of July 2026.

providers.name: World 50 Group
providers.description: World 50 Group is an invitation-only membership community for CEOs, board directors, and C-suite executives from the world's largest and most respected companies. It runs highly curated peer communities organized by role (General Counsel 50, Procurement 50, Human Resource 50, President 50, Innovating 50, and more), the NEXT executive-development platform (Next Director, Next Leader, Next Generation Leadership), and publishes C-suite insights and impact research. Membership is by invitation; members access the community through the World 50 iOS/Android app. The company publishes no public developer program or API surface.

providers.name: AbbVie
providers.description: AbbVie is a research-based biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, manufactures, and markets advanced therapies in immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and other specialty areas. AbbVie's portfolio includes treatments for autoimmune diseases, various cancers, neurological disorders, and aesthetics through the Allergan Aesthetics portfolio.

providers.name: Akido Labs
providers.description: Akido Labs is a Los Angeles-based healthcare technology company re-engineering care delivery with artificial intelligence. Its flagship system, Scope AI, is a clinical decision support platform trained on large volumes of healthcare data using reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) to help physicians reach efficient diagnoses, order the right diagnostics, personalize treatment, and forecast health risks. Providers use Scope AI through the Akido Chart EMR to expand capacity for primary care and specialty visits. Akido also operates Akido Medical, a care network spanning dozens of locations and hundreds of providers serving hundreds of thousands of patients, with an emphasis on underserved and street-medicine populations. The company is venture-backed (including a Series B led by Oak HC/FT) and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Albemarle
providers.description: Albemarle Corporation is a global specialty chemicals company and leading provider of lithium, bromine, and other essential elements. Operating from its global headquarters in Charlotte, NC, Albemarle serves customers in approximately 70 countries with world-class hard-rock and brine lithium resources, state-of-the-art lithium conversion facilities, advanced lithium material and process development, bromine production facilities, and the US's only producing lithium resource in Silver Peak, NV. The company serves critical markets including electric vehicle batteries, energy storage, flame retardants, pharmaceutical ingredients, catalysts, and specialty chemicals, employing approximately 7,800 people and holding over 1,500 active patents worldwide.

providers.name: Alcoa
providers.description: Alcoa Corporation is a global industry leader in bauxite, alumina, and aluminum production. Founded in 1888, Alcoa operates mines, refineries, and smelters across Australia, Brazil, Canada, Iceland, Norway, Saudi Arabia, and the United States. The company is a Fortune 500 member and one of the world's largest aluminum producers, supplying lightweight, high-strength materials to automotive, aerospace, packaging, construction, and industrial markets. Alcoa is committed to sustainability through low-carbon aluminum production, responsible bauxite mining, and advancing aluminum recycling.

providers.name: Art19
providers.description: Art19 (ART19, Inc.) is a podcast hosting, distribution, and monetization platform, and an Amazon company. It provides publishers, networks, and enterprises with a content management system for audio, automated RSS feed generation, dynamic ad insertion and targeting through its WarpFeed feed technology, and an embeddable Web Player. The platform serves podcast delivery, analytics, and advertising workflows at scale. Art19 does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; its public presence consists of a marketing site, a contact page, a privacy policy, and a system status page tracking CMS, RSS, WarpFeed, and Web Player availability.

providers.name: Assort Health
providers.description: Assort Health builds an AI voice-agent platform purpose-built for healthcare practices, automating the full patient-access journey across the phone line and back office — 24/7 appointment scheduling and management, intelligent triage and call routing, patient intake and insurance verification, proactive outbound reminders and outreach, referral and fax automation, medication refill management, after-hours medical answering, and payment resolution. The agents are trained on 190M+ patient interactions spanning 23+ medical specialties and integrate with 15+ EHR/PMS platforms (with deep athenahealth support), personalizing each conversation with patient context, language preference, and care history. The company is venture-backed (Series C), with Lightspeed Venture Partners and Menlo Ventures among its investors. This API Evangelist profile was enriched from Assort Health's public web surface; the company publishes no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: Bacca.ai
providers.description: Bacca.ai is an AI-driven Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) platform that deploys an autonomous agent functioning as a Tier-1 on-call engineer. It ingests operational context from Slack, Jira, documentation, logs, traces, and metrics to build a proprietary Knowledge Graph of an organization's systems, then contextualizes and deduplicates alerts, identifies root causes with high accuracy, automates incident war rooms and post-mortem generation, and surfaces reports on system failures and hotspots. Bacca reports cutting Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) by roughly 40-60%. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, the company deploys on Google Cloud (cloud or on-prem) with single-tenant data isolation and SOC 2 Type I & II attestation. Backed by Homebrew.

providers.name: Blixt
providers.description: BL!XT (Blixt) is a Swedish deep-tech company building intelligent, programmable power infrastructure that turns electrical distribution from analog systems into digitally controlled, software-defined platforms. Its products include ZERO, a solid-state current-control switchgear for circuit-level protection, monitoring, and automation; X-VERTER, a software-defined voltage conversion system with integrated energy storage; and THE ZONE, an AI-driven software intelligence layer that coordinates connected distribution devices for real-time analysis, failure prediction, and load balancing. BL!XT serves data centers, industrial manufacturing, maritime vessels, grid providers, and defense. Headquartered in Kista, Sweden and backed by Union Square Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Blocto
providers.description: Blocto is a Web3 smart-contract wallet built by Portto that lets everyday users interact with decentralized applications without managing seed phrases, using a chain-agnostic account-abstraction architecture. For developers, Blocto ships a client-side integration surface — the JavaScript Blocto SDK, a Blocto-flavored Flow Client Library (FCL) fork, plus Go, Swift and Rust SDKs — to connect dApps to the Blocto wallet for authentication, transaction signing and account-proof verification across Flow, Ethereum, Solana, Aptos, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum and Optimism. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network from its public developer documentation and GitHub organization.

providers.name: Brooks Brothers
providers.description: Brooks Brothers is a historic American clothier founded in 1818 in New York City by Henry Sands Brooks, defining classic American tailored menswear, womenswear, and boyswear. After filing Chapter 11 bankruptcy on July 8, 2020 amid the COVID-19 pandemic, the brand was acquired in September 2020 by SPARC Group, a joint venture of Authentic Brands Group and Simon Property Group. SPARC subsequently merged with JCPenney in January 2025 to form Catalyst Brands, the brand's current operating parent. Brooks Brothers operates roughly 150 retail stores plus an e-commerce presence at brooksbrothers.com.

providers.name: CarServ
providers.description: CarServ was auto repair shop management software — marketed as "the operating system for auto repair" — used by single-site shops and multi-location repair groups to run repair orders, Digital Vehicle Inspections, technician and service advisor workflows, customer communication and payments. The company was backed by Techstars. It is no longer operating: carserv.com returned HTTP 410 Gone through late 2024 and now resolves to a registrar parking page delegated to Afternic name servers. CarServ shipped a read-only JSON:API v2 "Public API" covering repair orders, customers, vehicles, appointments, inspections, operations and their part, labor and sublet line items, authenticated by exchanging an API key and secret for a JWT bearer token. No OpenAPI definition, developer portal or documentation survives; this profile reconstructs the historical API contract from the company's own open-source Ruby client library, which remains public on GitHub.

providers.name: Chapter
providers.description: Chapter is a technology-driven Medicare advisory service (parent company Memoir, Inc.; insurance services via Chapter Advisory, LLC) that helps older Americans navigate retirement healthcare. Licensed advisors and self-service tools compare and enroll consumers across all major Medicare carriers nationwide, representing 50 organizations offering more than 15,000 products, and serving 500,000+ enrollees with a 4.9/5 rating across 6,700+ reviews. Chapter is HIPAA compliant, BBB accredited, and also ships a consumer OTC benefits app. Founded 2020 in New York City; backed by Addition. This is a consumer healthtech company with no public developer/API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: DaVita
providers.description: DaVita Inc. is a Fortune 500 kidney care company operating in-center hemodialysis, home hemodialysis, and peritoneal dialysis programs in the United States and abroad, alongside transplant support, integrated kidney care, hospital partnerships, and clinical research. DaVita does not publish a public developer API; integration with the company is handled through patient-facing portals, payer and provider partnerships, and electronic health record data exchange standards.

providers.name: Diligent Robotics
providers.description: Diligent Robotics is an Austin, Texas-based healthcare robotics company founded in 2017 by Andrea Thomaz (CEO) and Vivian Chu (CIO), both trained as roboticists at MIT, Georgia Tech, and the University of Texas at Austin. The company builds Moxi, a socially intelligent mobile manipulator that operates autonomously inside hospitals to handle non-clinical material transport — delivering medications, lab samples, supplies, PPE, and patient items so nurses and clinical staff can focus on patient care. Moxi combines mobile manipulation (grasping, opening doors, riding elevators), social navigation, and human-guided learning, and is deployed 24/7 with minimal facility infrastructure (existing Wi-Fi). Operationally, Moxi has logged 500,000+ deliveries and 100,000+ autonomous elevator rides across customer hospitals including UTMB, Shannon Health, ThedaCare, Carilion Giles Community Hospital, and Medical City Denton. The platform is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II audited, and TX-RAMP Level 2 certified. Diligent has raised roughly $100M across rounds led by Canaan, True Ventures, Tiger Global, DNX Ventures, Next Coast Ventures, and Northwestern Medicine Innovation. Diligent's revenue model is robot deployment/leasing and enterprise services; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for Moxi or its underlying robotics stack.

providers.name: Dynegy
providers.description: Dynegy is a retail electric service provider and part of the Vistra Corp family of companies, delivering simple, price-protected retail electricity plans for homes and businesses across the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, and Midwest, including Ohio, Illinois, and Pennsylvania. No public APIs have been documented for Dynegy.

providers.name: ecoplanet
providers.description: ecoplanet provides cloud-based, integrated energy management software for German mid-market companies. The platform combines three core functions: real-time consumption monitoring through meter integration with AI-powered anomaly detection and automated load-shifting on price signals; strategic energy procurement using algorithmic purchasing across spot markets, tranches, and power purchase agreements (PPAs); and automated ISO 50001 compliance documentation. The company reports customers achieve up to 15% consumption savings and ~13.9% average price advantages on energy purchases. Backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital. No public developer/API surface was found at the time of profiling.

providers.name: EFEX (Ventu)
providers.description: EFEX (efex.com, formerly efexpay.com) is a cross-border payments and treasury fintech serving businesses across the Americas. It enables international transfers to 140+ countries, bulk and mass payouts for payroll and multi-beneficiary disbursement, multi-currency business accounts (USD, MXN, EUR, GBP, CAD, JPY), international collections in local currency across 24+ countries, and FX and currency management for treasury optimization. Headquartered in Palo Alto, California with operations across Mexico (Mexico City, Monterrey, Tijuana, Queretaro, Guadalajara) and Colombia, EFEX is authorized by Mexico's CNBV as a money transmitter (registration 22469) and regulated by FinCEN in the United States. Backed by 500 Global. As of this profile the company exposes a business web/app product but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Enpal
providers.description: Enpal is a Berlin-based residential clean-energy company and one of Germany's market leaders in home solar. It sells and finances complete home energy systems — rooftop solar PV, battery storage, air-to-water heat pumps, EV wallbox chargers, and a dynamic electricity tariff — orchestrated by its Enpal.One+ smart energy-management platform, with flexible purchase and zero-down financing options. Enpal serves over 130,000 German households and operates business (business.enpal.de) and installer partner (enpal.pro) channels alongside its consumer offering. Backed by HV Capital and the SoftBank Vision Fund. This API Evangelist profile was created from a VC-portfolio lead; Enpal publishes a consumer website and customer portal but no public developer API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: FirstCry
providers.description: FirstCry (operated by Brainbees Solutions Ltd) is India's largest omnichannel retailer of baby, kids, and maternity products, founded in 2010 by Supam Maheshwari and Amitava Saha and headquartered in Pune, India. It sells apparel, footwear, toys, diapers, feeding and nursery gear, and personal-care products across its website, mobile apps, and a large network of physical stores, alongside in-house brands such as BabyHug. The company is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and listed publicly on the NSE and BSE in 2024. FirstCry publishes no public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web, policy, and security-disclosure surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fluxx
providers.description: Fluxx is a cloud grants management platform for foundations, government agencies, corporations, and nonprofits, covering the full grant lifecycle from funding announcement through pre-award applications, post-award payments, and measurement and evaluation. Fluxx Grantmaker includes a RESTful API (REST API v2) available to customers for building custom integrations with financial, CRM, and business-intelligence systems. The API is exposed per-client on each customer's own Fluxx instance under https://{client}.fluxx.io/api/rest/v2, is authenticated with OAuth 2.0 credentials created in that instance, and is driven by a dynamic, instance-specific data model whose reference documentation is generated at /api/rest/v2/doc for each deployment. Because the surface is per-instance and gated behind an authenticated customer deployment, the endpoints below are honestly modeled from Fluxx's documented REST v2 conventions rather than pulled from a single public reference.

providers.name: Flyzipline
providers.description: Flyzipline (Zipline International Inc., flyzipline.com / zipline.com) designs, manufactures, and operates autonomous delivery drones for food, groceries, and medicine. Its instant logistics platform flies vital shipments — blood products, vaccines, pharmaceuticals, prepared meals, and retail goods — on direct aerial routes at up to 70 mph, with temperature-controlled pods and real-time tracking. Zipline operates distribution centers across the United States, Rwanda, Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, Côte d'Ivoire, and Japan, partnering with health systems, retailers (Walmart, Chipotle), and restaurant technology providers (Olo) that submit delivery requests through Zipline's ordering system or software integrations. As of early 2026 the fleet has completed more than two million commercial deliveries across 120+ million autonomous miles. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars-adjacent portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Zipline publishes no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI at this time — partner integrations are bespoke.

providers.name: Ginkgo Bioworks
providers.description: Ginkgo Bioworks is a synthetic biology company founded in 2008 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, that builds a horizontal platform for programming biology. Through autonomous laboratories, foundry services, and AI-powered tools, Ginkgo automates the design-build-test cycle of biological engineering for customers across biopharma, agriculture, industrial biotech, and biosecurity. Its offerings include Build-Your-Own-Lab automation hardware and software, a remotely accessible Cloud Lab, Ginkgo Datapoints screening and data services, Foundry cell-engineering services, and the Catalyst autonomous lab agent. Ginkgo Bioworks (NYSE: DNA) does not currently publish a public self-service developer API; this profile tracks the company's identity and web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GuruHotel
providers.description: GuruHotel is AI-native direct-booking infrastructure for independent hotels: an AI-powered hotel website builder, a conversion-optimized direct booking engine, and a Stripe-powered payment-orchestration platform that turns a hotel's official website into a commission-free direct booking channel with real-time inventory, multi-currency checkout and a guest-first experience. Founded in 2019, GuruHotel is trusted by 1000+ hotels, serves 200,000+ guests a year and processes $15M+ in annual gross booking value across the United States, Mexico, the Caribbean and Europe. It connects to hotel PMS platforms directly (Cloudbeds) and through Channex (280+ PMS incl. Mews, apaleo, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Guesty, Hostaway), plus Google for Hotels. GuruHotel is a portfolio company of 500 Global and Anthemis.

providers.name: igloo
providers.description: Igloo is a full-stack insurtech firm headquartered in Singapore and operating across six Southeast Asian markets (Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam). It makes insurance simple, accessible, and affordable by embedding coverage into the platforms consumers already use, working with 100+ partners across e-commerce, telecommunications, banking, logistics, and lifestyle (including Shopee, Foodpanda, GCash, AIS, and Siam Commercial Bank). Its product line spans motor, mobile phone, travel, pet, personal accident, cyber, loan protection, e-commerce purchase protection, and blockchain-powered weather-index insurance. Igloo also ships technology platforms for the insurance value chain: Igloo Agent (agency management), Igloo Consumer (direct-to-consumer marketplace), Igloo Partner (affinity distribution), Ignite (digital agent platform), and the Turbo Core insurance operations system. Integration is offered through a partner-facing API program rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Infusionsoft (Keap)
providers.description: Infusionsoft, now branded as Keap, is a sales and marketing automation CRM built for small businesses that combines contact management, email marketing, e-commerce, pipeline automation, appointments, and invoicing in a single platform. Keap exposes REST APIs (v1 and v2) and a legacy XML-RPC API for managing contacts, companies, opportunities, orders, products, tags, emails, and campaigns, all authenticated via OAuth 2.0 authorization code and refresh token grants.

providers.name: Jack in the Box
providers.description: Jack in the Box Inc. (NASDAQ: JACK), founded in 1951 and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a quick-service restaurant company operating and franchising approximately 2,200 Jack in the Box hamburger restaurants across 21 U.S. states. In December 2021 the company acquired Del Taco for $575M; in August 2025 it announced a strategic review of Del Taco and on October 2025 agreed to divest Del Taco (~600 locations) to Yadav Enterprises for $115M, with the transaction closing December 22, 2025. Digital channels include the Jack in the Box mobile app, Jack Pack loyalty program, online ordering, and integrations with third-party delivery platforms (DoorDash, Grubhub, Uber Eats). The company does not publish a public developer API; all digital ordering, loyalty, and franchise systems are operated via internal platforms and partner integrations.

providers.name: Lifemote
providers.description: Lifemote Networks is an Istanbul-based provider of AI-driven home Wi-Fi analytics and experience management for broadband ISPs and network operators. A software agent running on the subscriber gateway or access point streams detailed in-home Wi-Fi performance telemetry to Lifemote's cloud, which scores quality of experience per household and per device and isolates root causes such as poor coverage, misplaced repeaters, congested or co-channel Wi-Fi, legacy client devices, and non-Wi-Fi interference. Operators consume the results through a web application for first-line support, proactive maintenance, churn detection and mesh/gateway upselling, plus quarterly expert-reviewed QoE reports. Lifemote markets a full-featured API for integrating this data with in-house OSS/BSS systems and support workflows, but that API is sold and provisioned through direct enterprise engagement — there is no public developer portal, documentation site, machine-readable specification, or self-service sign-up. Customers named publicly include A1, Community Fibre, Online.nl, and Tusass.

providers.name: Loop Health
providers.description: Loop Health is an India-based health assurance and group insurance company, founded in 2018 by Mayank Kale and Amrit Singh and headquartered in Pune. It combines traditional group hospitalization insurance with unlimited primary care, telemedicine, wellness programs, mental-health counseling, and an Employee Assistance Program, delivered to employers and their teams through asset-light clinics and a member app. Backed by General Catalyst, Elevation Capital and Y Combinator, Loop serves 1,250+ companies and 950,000+ members across India. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass Loop Health publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Medwing
providers.description: MEDWING is Germany's largest digital service platform for jobs and staffing in the healthcare sector, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Berlin. It operates a recruitment marketplace that matches hospitals, clinics and care facilities with nurses, caregivers, doctors, midwives, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals across Germany and the United Kingdom. Beyond permanent placement, MEDWING combines career brokerage with temporary-staffing (Zeitarbeit) operations and HR/workforce tooling, offering an end-to-end digital workflow that spans job search, matching, contracts, digital signatures and timesheets. The service is free for candidates, with employers paying on successful placement. MEDWING is backed by Northzone and other investors. This profile was enriched from public web sources; MEDWING does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: MPIRIQ
providers.description: MPIRIQ (MPiriQ Science Technologies GmbH) is a Munich-based healthcare software company that automates clinical documentation for medical practices and study centers. Its AI platform structures patient data directly inside existing EMR/PMS systems, runs quality and billing validation checks in the background, and connects real-world care data to clinical research through decentralized, GDPR-compliant pseudonymization. The platform helps practices participate in clinical trials via automated indication screening and patient recruitment, giving physicians time back while opening a research revenue stream. Founded in 2024 and backed by HV Capital and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Naviday Health
providers.description: Naviday Health is a Boston-based women's health technology company and Techstars portfolio company building clinical decision support that connects the continuous health data women generate every day from consumer wearables and patient-generated sources to the practitioners who need it most. Its LUCI Care platform surfaces actionable insights for clinicians between appointments, and the company partners with device manufacturers on wearable integration services. Naviday Health is HIPAA compliant and has been recognized by the Mayo Clinic Platform, StartUp Health, and MassChallenge. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDK, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Netskope
providers.description: Netskope is a security service edge (SSE) and SASE platform delivering cloud-native Secure Web Gateway, CASB, Zero Trust Network Access, data loss prevention, and threat protection from its NewEdge global network. The Netskope REST API v2 provides tenant-level programmatic access to events, alerts, incidents, policies, IoCs, SCIM provisioning, and configuration so SOC and platform teams can automate SOAR, SIEM, and IGA workflows using service-account bearer tokens in the Netskope-Api-Token header.

providers.name: Oligo
providers.description: Oligo Security is a runtime security platform built for the AI era, giving security teams real-time visibility and protection across applications, cloud infrastructure, and AI systems. Oligo combines Cloud Application Detection and Response (CADR), runtime software composition analysis (SCA) and SBOM generation, container scanning, and AI security posture management to detect and stop attacks at the application layer before they spread. By observing which vulnerable code actually executes at runtime, Oligo proves exploitability and reduces vulnerability noise by up to 90-99%, letting teams prioritize the small fraction of findings that are truly reachable. The platform covers apps, workloads, hosts, and cloud infrastructure, and adds runtime protection for AI agents and models. Oligo is a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and counts organizations such as Databricks, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Instacart, and Cresta among its customers. Its customer platform and API documentation are gated behind authentication; no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or MCP server is published on the open web at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Parlevel
providers.description: Parlevel Systems is a San Antonio-based vending technology company (founded 2012, now part of 365 Retail Markets) providing a Vending Management System (VMS) and related tools for unattended retail operators across vending, micro markets, and office coffee service. The platform covers real-time machine telemetry, dynamic route optimization, cashless payments (PayPlus), inventory and warehouse management, and cash accountability. No public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or documented webhook surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public identity and probed domain security only.

providers.name: Paycor
providers.description: Paycor is a cloud-based human capital management (HCM) platform that provides payroll, HR, benefits administration, talent management, time and attendance, and workforce analytics for small and mid-sized businesses. The platform serves HR and finance teams with a unified system of record for employees, pay, time, and benefits data. Paycor exposes a Public REST API authenticated via OAuth 2.0 with authorization at secure.paycor.com and resource endpoints at apis.paycor.com (production) and apis-sandbox.paycor.com (sandbox).

providers.name: Polymorph
providers.description: Polymorph is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building adaptive consumer internet infrastructure that personalizes user experiences with AI agents. Founded in San Francisco by Andrew Sy, the platform runs thousands of continuous product and lifecycle-engagement experiments for its customers, each carrying the craft of that product's direction and brand, so consumer teams can scale experimentation in product surfaces without being bottlenecked by headcount or design capacity.
