Its stated vision is to make the consumer internet polymorphic — one that adapts to each user and optimizes for delightful experiences. As of this profile the company operates a marketing site only; it publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Skello
providers.description: Skello is a European (French) workforce management SaaS for shift-based businesses in retail, hospitality, restaurants, and health. It provides employee scheduling and shift planning, time and attendance tracking, absence and leave management, labor-cost and legal-compliance controls, team communication, and payroll preparation exports. Skello is a Partech portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Skello publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or status page; integrations are delivered through its own partner program rather than a documented public API.

providers.name: SNMP
providers.description: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) is the foundational IETF standard for monitoring and managing network devices. SNMP defines a request/response protocol over UDP (ports 161 and 162) for retrieving and altering management variables exposed by agents on routers, switches, servers, UPSs, and other equipment, plus an asynchronous trap/notification channel for event delivery. The protocol family spans three major generations — SNMPv1 (RFC 1157), SNMPv2c (RFC 1901-1908), and the modular SNMPv3 architecture (RFC 3411-3418, extended by RFC 7860 for HMAC-SHA-2 authentication) — and is paired with the Structure of Management Information (SMI) and a vast catalog of MIB modules, most notably the IF-MIB (RFC 2863) for network interfaces. SNMP remains the lingua franca of network monitoring, consumed primarily by NMS platforms such as Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG, SolarWinds, LibreNMS, and Observium, and implemented in open source primarily by the Net-SNMP suite.

providers.name: Swell Energy
providers.description: Swell Energy is a residential clean-energy company that designs, finances, installs, and operates home solar, battery storage, and virtual power plant (VPP) systems for homeowners, businesses, and utilities. Its Swell Compass platform connects to home energy devices to monitor, report, and optimize energy use, and coordinates aggregated distributed batteries into grid services (GridRevenue programs) in partnership with utilities. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, the company operates a consumer web and mobile experience (Compass) rather than a public developer API; no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documented public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Tengo
providers.description: Tengo is an AI-powered public procurement platform that helps companies find, evaluate, and respond to public tenders in one place. Founded in 2023 in France by Hugues Renou and Yoann Gauthier, Tengo covers the full tender lifecycle — sourcing and targeting relevant opportunities, drafting and writing proposals with AI, and managing responses and performance analytics — serving SMEs, mid-sized companies, and large corporations. Tengo raised a €3M round led by Point Nine in 2024. It operates a business-user SaaS with a request-a-demo onboarding and no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Transfercar
providers.description: Transfercar is a free vehicle relocation marketplace that connects rental car and motorhome companies who need vehicles moved between their depots with travelers willing to drive those vehicles one-way. Rental operators list relocation deals for cars and campervans that need to be repositioned, and drivers book them to travel between cities at little or no rental cost, often with extras such as free days, fuel allowances, or ferry contributions. The service operates across New Zealand, Australia, and the United States as a consumer-facing web booking platform rather than a developer API provider. Transfercar was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; this profile has been enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: Trunk Tools
providers.description: Trunk Tools is a construction-technology company building an AI/ML platform that helps general contractors, specialty contractors, and owners make sense of project data buried in documents and automate repetitive, time-intensive workflows. Founded in 2021 with offices in New York, Austin, and Santa Barbara, its products include TrunkText (instant answers from project documents via a construction AI agent), TrunkSubmittal and an auto-generated Submittal Register, TrunkReview (drawing-revision change detection), TrunkRFI, and TrunkBid. The platform ingests structured and unstructured construction data (PDF, XER, MPP, CSV) and connects to major project and document management systems such as Procore, Autodesk, CMiC, SharePoint, Box, Dropbox, and Egnyte. Backed by Insight Partners and Redpoint Ventures.

providers.name: Westlake
providers.description: Westlake Corporation is a global Fortune 500 manufacturer and supplier of materials and innovative products that enhance life every day. The company produces chemical materials and building products across multiple sectors including packaging, healthcare, automotive, consumer goods, and construction. Westlake operates through two primary segments: Performance and Essential Materials (PEM) and Housing and Infrastructure Products (HIP), with net sales of approximately $11 billion annually.

providers.name: 3T Biosciences
providers.description: 3T Biosciences is a clinical-stage immunotherapy company based in South San Francisco, developing next-generation T-cell receptor (TCR) therapeutics for solid tumors and other immune-mediated diseases. Founded in 2017 on research from K. Christopher Garcia's lab at Stanford University, the company operates its proprietary 3T-TRACE (T-Cell Receptor Antigen and Cross-reactivity Evaluation) platform, which combines high-diversity yeast-display target libraries with active machine-learning to screen billions of protein fragments and identify novel shared TCR targets and specificities. 3T has raised a $40M Series A from Westlake Village BioPartners and Lightspeed Venture Partners and has struck cancer-immunotherapy collaborations with Boehringer Ingelheim worth up to $268M in milestones. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of CRV and enriched into the API Evangelist network; 3T publishes no public developer API, SDK, or specification surface.

providers.name: Accompany Health
providers.description: Accompany Health is a value-based healthcare company that delivers integrated in-home and virtual care to patients with complex, chronic conditions, primarily those covered by Medicaid and Medicare. Its multidisciplinary care teams combine primary care, behavioral health, and social care, wrapping medical treatment with support for the social drivers of health. The company operates in Massachusetts, Michigan (Detroit), and Colorado (Denver), works with health plans and providers, and is HIPAA compliant. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IVP and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a marketing and patient-education website but no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Age of Learning
providers.description: Age of Learning, Inc. is a Glendale, California educational technology company founded in 2007, best known for ABCmouse.com Early Learning Academy, a subscription digital curriculum for children ages 2-8, along with Adventure Academy (ages 8-13) and Mastery-branded school programs. It builds direct-to-consumer and school-facing learning products delivered through web and mobile apps (iOS and Android). Age of Learning does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a consumer edtech provider surfaced from the ICONIQ Capital portfolio, enriched with the public link surface (privacy, terms, support, press, careers) and a domain-security posture probed from public DNS/TLS records.

providers.name: Alpharank
providers.description: Alpharank is a no-code sales guidance and digital-origination analytics platform for banks and credit unions. It analyzes funded loan and deposit applications to reveal which marketing tactics, channels, and campaigns actually drive funded dollars, then guides institutions to optimize their online branch, curb funnel abandonment, and turn ad spend into higher-quality leads. Its products include Optimizer, AdSync, and CRMSync, and it serves roughly 200 financial institutions nationwide. Originally recognized for turning payment transaction data into customer influence graphs, Alpharank is a 500 Startups / 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Alpharank publishes a marketing and client-login presence but no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Andromeda
providers.description: Andromeda is a robotics company building personalised humanoid robot companions for aged care and assisted living. Its flagship robot, Abi, adapts to each resident's personality, ability, and language to provide social connection, conversation, and engagement that improves resident mood and wellbeing while extending care-team capacity. Founded by Grace Brown and backed by Forerunner Ventures and Paradigm, Andromeda has deployed Abi across aged-care providers in Australia and the United States (partners include mecwacare and Medical & Aged Care Group) and has been featured by the BBC, CNN, Forbes, and ABC Australia. The company currently publishes a public marketing and news site but no developer platform, API, or public technical documentation.

providers.name: Artemis Health
providers.description: Artemis Health (now Artemis by Nomi Health) is a healthcare data analytics platform that helps employers, benefits advisors, and health plans see every healthcare dollar clearly, cut waste, and improve care for their members. The platform unifies medical, pharmacy, and other benefits data to deliver cost analysis, program evaluation, automated reporting, custom analytics, and social-determinants-of-health insights for self-insured organizations. Artemis was acquired by Nomi Health in 2022. The product is a login-gated B2B SaaS application; no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface is published. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and enriched with the verifiable public identity, link, and domain-security signals available.

providers.name: Artofsport
providers.description: Art of Sport is a consumer personal-care brand offering a complete line of daily body and skin care products made for athletes, including aluminum-free deodorant, antiperspirant, charcoal shampoo and body wash, bar soap, sunscreen, and hair care. Products are formulated with high-performance skincare science, fresh scents, clean formulas, and natural botanical ingredients. The company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify-powered e-commerce storefront at artofsport.com as well as retail distribution. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. Art of Sport does not publish a first-party developer API; its only machine surface is the Shopify Customer Accounts OpenID Connect / OAuth authorization server exposed at the storefront host.

providers.name: ARX Robotics
providers.description: ARX Robotics is a European defense technology company building autonomous unmanned ground systems and the software that runs them. Its flagship Mithra OS is an AI-driven autonomy platform that turns legacy and modern military vehicles into software-defined, autonomous units, while its Gereon RCS line delivers scalable robotic ground vehicles for reconnaissance, firepower, clearance, surveillance, cargo, and casualty evacuation across defense and commercial missions. Headquartered in Munich with offices in Berlin, the UK, and Ukraine, ARX operates one of Europe's largest autonomous defense systems production facilities and has delivered unmanned ground systems to Ukraine. The company is venture-backed (a €31M Series A extended by €11M, with HV Capital among its investors) and partners with RENK, DEUTZ, Helsing, and Quantum Systems to strengthen Europe's technological resilience and defense sovereignty. ARX publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's public web presence and an llms.txt it publishes for AI agents.

providers.name: Atalanta
providers.description: Atalanta is a mathematical AI company building provably correct decision-making for the world's most important missions. Its flagship platform, Argo, is described as the first software understanding platform - it uses mathematical proof and formal verification to establish safety, security, and performance guarantees for software-defined and autonomous systems at operational speed, moving beyond the limits of traditional testing. Argo identifies failure modes before deployment and verifies compliance with critical constraints across energy (nuclear and grid control systems), space (satellite and communications networks), and defense (complex military systems and data isolation). Atalanta was founded by Anjana Rajan and Jonathan Ring, is headquartered in Washington, D.C., and is backed by Felicis and In-Q-Tel.

providers.name: Avidbots
providers.description: Avidbots is a robotics company that designs and manufactures fully autonomous commercial floor-cleaning robots, including the Neo, Neo 2W, and Kas scrubbers, powered by its proprietary Avidbots Autonomy AI, lidar, and 3D sensing for real-time mapping, dynamic route planning, and intervention-free cleaning. Its robots serve airports, warehouses, retail, manufacturing, education, and healthcare facilities, and are managed through the web-based Avidbots Command Center. Avidbots was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Ayar Labs
providers.description: Ayar Labs is a silicon-photonics company that develops co-packaged optics (CPO) and optical I/O technology to replace copper interconnects with light. Its products, including the TeraPHY optical engine and SuperNova external light source, connect thousands of GPUs across racks to deliver the bandwidth density and energy efficiency required by hyperscale AI infrastructure. Ayar Labs is backed by Insight Partners and Playground Global. It ships hardware and optical-interconnect technology rather than a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web properties and domain security posture.

providers.name: Azara Healthcare
providers.description: Azara Healthcare provides population health management, data analytics, and quality reporting solutions for community health centers, safety-net providers, and physician practices. Its flagship platform, Azara DRVS (Data Reporting and Visualization System), aggregates clinical, claims, and social determinants of health (SDOH) data into unified dashboards, quality measures, eCQM and UDS (Uniform Data System) reporting, patient registries, and care-gap analytics. Related products include Azara Cost & Utilization, Azara Patient Outreach, Azara Care Connect, and value-based care reporting. Azara is backed by Insight Partners and serves the safety-net and federally qualified health center (FQHC) market. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead; the provider publishes no public developer portal or API at this time.

providers.name: Banyansoftware
providers.description: Banyan Software is a global acquirer and permanent operator of vertical market software (VMS) businesses, headquartered in Toronto, Canada. Built as an "evergreen" alternative to private equity, Banyan buys profitable, growing enterprise software companies that hold dominant positions in niche markets (typically $2M-$30M in annual revenue) and holds them for the long term rather than reselling. It has acquired 100+ companies across sectors including healthcare IT, education, manufacturing, broadcast, public sector, and fintech, and supports them through a Growth Ops team spanning AI, talent, sales and marketing, payments, product, finance, cybersecurity, and legal. Banyan Software is a holding/operating company and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Bounce
providers.description: Bounce operates the world's largest luggage storage network, connecting travelers with more than 32,000 vetted partner locations across 4,000+ cities worldwide where they can securely drop off bags, luggage, and packages by the hour or day and explore hands-free. Founded by Cody Candee in 2018, the company runs a two-sided marketplace: travelers book storage in advance or on the spot through the Bounce web and mobile apps, while local shops, hotels, and businesses earn revenue as storage partners. Bounce also offers luggage-delivery between hotels, airports, and city locations, a hotel solutions program, and an affiliate program. It is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire. This profile currently tracks the company's public web surface; Bounce publishes an llms.txt but no public developer API.

providers.name: Branch8
providers.description: Branch8 is a digital solutions and managed contracting company headquartered in Hong Kong with operations across Asia (Singapore, Taiwan, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines). Founded in 2015, it provides managed technical squads and blended onshore/offshore teams that deliver e-commerce implementation (Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, and marketplace operations on Shopee, Lazada, and Amazon), CRM and CDP strategy (Salesforce, HubSpot, Segment, mParticle, Braze, Dynamics 365), digital product and mobile engineering, AI and workflow automation (n8n, Make, Windmill), and data engineering (Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, Fivetran). Branch8 serves mid-market to enterprise clients including Chow Tai Fook, Chow Sang Sang, Lacoste, Hong Kong International Airport, Hotai/Toyota, and HKBN. It is a services firm rather than an API producer and publishes no public developer API, but it does expose an agent-native llms.txt describing its services.

providers.name: Brightree
providers.description: Brightree is a ResMed company providing cloud-based business management software for post-acute care providers, including home medical equipment (HME), durable medical equipment (DME), home infusion and specialty pharmacy, orthotics and prosthetics, and home health and hospice organizations. Its platform automates the end-to-end operational workflow from intake, documentation and inventory through billing, delivery, resupply, and patient engagement. Brightree does not publish a public, self-service developer API; integrations are delivered through a partner-gated Integrated Vendor program, so this profile is limited to the company's public web presence rather than a developer portal or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: BTI Systems (Juniper)
providers.description: BTI Systems was an Ottawa, Ontario based supplier of cloud and metro packet-optical networking systems and software, best known for the BTI 7800 Series Packet Optical Transport platform, the BTI 800 Series, and the proNX family of management software (proNX Service Manager and proNX Optical Director). Juniper Networks acquired the remaining ownership interest in BTI Systems for approximately $25.8 million in cash, closing the acquisition on April 1, 2016, to accelerate open and automated packet-optical transport and SDN/NFV capabilities. BTI no longer operates as an independent company and publishes no independent developer portal or public API; the BTI Series and proNX product lines are documented and supported under Juniper Networks, whose proNX Optical Director exposes REST APIs northbound for OSS/BSS integration with NETCONF and telemetry southbound. This profile is retained as an acquired-company record in the API Evangelist network, with the live vendor surface tracked in the juniper-networks profile.

providers.name: Calastone
providers.description: Calastone operates the world's largest global funds network, connecting asset managers, distributors, custodians and platforms to automate and digitalize the investment funds marketplace. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in London, it provides order routing, settlements, share-class conversions, dividends, transfers, reporting, money market services and tokenized fund distribution. More than 4,500 clients across 58 countries and territories use the network, processing over £300 billion of investment value each month. API and messaging connectivity is delivered through client onboarding rather than a public self-service developer portal. Calastone is a wholly owned subsidiary of SS&C Technologies Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: SSNC).

providers.name: Canopy Aerospace & Defense
providers.description: Canopy Aerospace & Defense (Canopy A&D) is a vertically integrated advanced materials platform serving the aerospace, defense, space, maritime, and power-electronics industries. The company manufactures and delivers highly specialized materials with exceptional insulative, absorptive, and signal-reducing characteristics, including thermal protection systems (TPS), ultra-high-temperature ceramics, additive-manufactured ceramic components, multi-layer insulation and soft goods, and composite structures. Formed by Trive Capital through the combination of Canopy Aerospace, Hera Technologies, and MSM Industries, Canopy partners with OEMs from initial design and R&D through turnkey manufacturing and refurbishment of reusable platforms, operating facilities across the US, UK, and Netherlands. This is a physical materials manufacturer and publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its web and identity surface.

providers.name: Careport Health
providers.description: CarePort Health, powered by WellSky, is a healthcare technology company providing care coordination and patient transition management across the entire care continuum. Its platform connects hospitals, health systems, ACOs, physician groups, payers, and post-acute providers to manage discharge planning, referrals, transitions of care, emergency department optimization, utilization and authorization management, and value-based programs. Products include Guide, Connect, Insight, Care Management, Transition, Referral Management, Intake, and Discharge, with EHR integrations for Epic and Cerner. CarePort reports covering 14M lives across roughly 2,000 hospitals in 43 U.S. states. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead (500 Global, Techstars); no public developer API, developer portal, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: CelLink
providers.description: CelLink (CelLink Technologies / CelLink Corporation) manufactures large-format, high-conductance flexible circuits that consolidate power, data, and sensing into thin, lightweight layers, replacing traditional wire harnesses and busbars. Its product lines are Battery Pack Interconnect, Flex Harness, and Data Center power delivery, serving automotive, aerospace, industrial, data center, and grid-storage electrification markets. Founded by CEO Kevin Coakley and VP Engineering Malcolm Brown, the company is headquartered in San Carlos, California, with sites in Georgetown, Texas; Wixom, Michigan; Hamburg, Germany; and Shanghai, China. CelLink circuits have been in electric-vehicle production since 2020. CelLink is a hardware manufacturer and publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Circle Asia
providers.description: Circle Asia Technologies is a Singapore-headquartered consumer fintech (offices at 68 Circular Road, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam) behind the Circle app and the VPBank Circle PayLater credit card, a digital buy-now-pay-later card issued in partnership with Vietnam Prosperity Joint Stock Commercial Bank (VPBank). The product lets consumers onboard with only an ID and phone number, waives the lifetime annual fee, and pairs a physical and virtual card with AI-assisted expense management, spending limits, one-tap card lock, biometric (face/fingerprint) authentication, and real-time SMS/app transaction alerts. The company is PCI DSS v4.0.1 certified and Visa-compliant, ships native iOS and Android apps, and is backed by 500 Global. Circle Asia is a consumer application company with no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and compliance claims for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ConcertoCare
providers.description: ConcertoCare is a value-based healthcare provider delivering coordinated, in-home and virtual medical care to Medicare-eligible seniors and adults with complex, chronic, and behavioral health needs. Its interdisciplinary care teams of physicians, nurse practitioners, pharmacists, and social workers deliver house calls, medication management, behavioral and social health support, transportation and nutritional assistance, caregiver support, and advanced care and palliative planning, coordinating with a member's existing doctors and benefit plans. The company operates as a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST CSF certified organization and is a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures. It has no public API or developer program at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Dagangan
providers.description: Dagangan is an Indonesian tech-enabled wholesale e-commerce platform serving small and medium retailers (SMEs) in tier 3-4 cities and rural areas. Through a hub-and-spoke network of 50+ micro-warehouses across remote regions, it connects large suppliers to traditional local retailers, giving them affordable mobile access to daily necessities and groceries while reducing delivery costs and supply-chain friction. The company operates a consumer/retailer Android shopping application (Dagangan Mall), is backed by 500 Global, and is recognized as a Rural Digitalization Partner of Indonesia's Ministry of Villages, Disadvantaged Regions, and Transmigration. As of this profile, Dagangan publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Dil Mil
providers.description: Dil Mil is a South Asian dating and matchmaking platform built to help singles find meaningful, culturally-grounded connections. Its mobile app offers matching algorithms, interest-based community chat rooms, global matching that reaches beyond geography, and a VIP Elite membership tier with premium features such as unlimited likes, rewind, and advanced filtering. The company markets itself under the tagline "Find Something Real" and highlights thousands of documented success stories among South Asian singles worldwide. Dil Mil is a consumer mobile application with no public developer or API surface; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for tracking.

providers.name: Disconetwork
providers.description: Disco (disconetwork.com) is a commerce media network focused on the post-purchase moment. It helps ecommerce brands monetize their order-confirmation and thank-you pages by placing relevant partner offers in front of shoppers, and gives advertisers a channel to reach buyers at the point of purchase. Its products span offer placement, audience insights, and cross-brand advertising across the post-purchase experience and beyond. Backed by Felicis. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Donkey
providers.description: Donkey is an AI-native trading company (Y Combinator, Summer 2026) that buys directly from Chinese factories and sells delivered duty-paid to US importers. Donkey mines public US customs records to identify the factory that actually makes a product, returns a landed DDP quote within 72 hours, runs its own on-the-floor quality inspections before the factory is paid, clears customs, moves the money, and offers credit-insured net-45 terms to qualified buyers. Founded by Benjamin Martindale (CEO) and Minghao Tan (CTO), the company runs small teams in San Francisco and China. Donkey publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform today; this profile tracks its company identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Eclipse Foods
providers.description: Eclipse Foods is a Berkeley, California plant-based food company making non-dairy ice cream and soft-serve engineered from cassava, corn, rapeseed, and potato to replicate the taste and texture of traditional dairy. Marketed as chef-crafted (co-founder brings 16-Michelin-Star kitchen experience) and sold in gallon tubs and soft-serve mixes to consumers and foodservice operators. Backed by Initialized Capital. This is a consumer/CPG brand with a WordPress marketing storefront and no public developer API; the profile captures its web identity, published llms.txt, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: ECOVACS Robotics
providers.description: ECOVACS Robotics is a global home service robotics company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, that designs, manufactures, and sells AI-powered autonomous cleaning devices for consumer and commercial use. Its product families include DEEBOT robotic vacuum and mopping robots, WINBOT window-cleaning robots, GOAT robotic lawn mowers, ULTRAMARINE pool-cleaning robots, and the DEEBOT PRO commercial line, all managed through the ECOVACS HOME mobile app. The company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IDG Capital; as of this enrichment pass ECOVACS publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documented API surface — this profile captures its public web, support, and legal properties plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Eucalyptus
providers.description: Eucalyptus (eucalyptus.health) is a global digital healthcare company founded in 2019 and headquartered in Sydney, Australia, that builds and operates patient-first telehealth clinics. It runs four consumer digital-health brands — Juniper (women's weight management and menopause), Pilot (men's health, hair loss, sexual health and weight), Software (clinical-grade skincare and dermatology) and Kin (reproductive, fertility and postpartum care) — across Australia, the United Kingdom, Germany, Japan and Canada, pairing licensed practitioners with technology and connected-care tooling. Eucalyptus was acquired by Hims & Hers Health in June 2026. This profile is a consumer-facing healthtech company: it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time, so enrichment is limited to verified corporate identity, published website properties, a responsible-disclosure program, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Exporo
providers.description: Exporo is a Hamburg, Germany-based digital investment platform for real estate and renewable-energy infrastructure, operating as a regulated European Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP). The platform lets private investors participate in residential and commercial property development as well as clean-energy projects such as solar, with typical terms of 12-36 months. Exporo has mediated over EUR 1.17 billion of capital across more than 600 financed projects, and also offers Club Deals for larger qualified investors. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or developer portal is currently published; this profile is maintained as a company lead and will be enriched if a developer surface appears.

providers.name: Feetme
providers.description: FeetMe is a Paris-based medical device company, founded in 2013, that develops smart connected insoles and digital health software for real-time gait analysis and mobility care. Its CE-marked, ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 certified wearables embed plantar pressure sensors and a 6-axis inertial measurement unit to capture more than twenty gait and balance metrics per step, streaming them over Bluetooth Low Energy to the FeetMe Mobility dashboard used by clinicians for neurological, orthopedic and rehabilitation assessment. Product lines include FeetMe Evaluation, FeetMe Rehabilitation, FeetMe Monitor and FeetMe Stimulate. The company is backed by Partech. FeetMe does not currently expose a public developer API or OpenAPI-described web API; a partner SDK for raw-data integration is referenced in product materials but is not publicly documented.

providers.name: Field AI
providers.description: FieldAI builds general-purpose robot intelligence through its Field Foundation Models (FFMs) and EDGE brain — a new class of physics-first, risk-aware foundation models for embodied AI. FieldAI's embodiment-agnostic autonomy lets robots navigate dynamic, unstructured environments without maps, GPS, or predefined trajectories, and has been proven across quadrupeds, humanoids, wheeled robots, and passenger-scale vehicles. Founded in 2023 (formerly AI for Humanity) and based in Mission Viejo, California, the company is led by veterans from DeepMind, Google Brain, Tesla Autopilot, NASA JPL, and SpaceX, and serves construction, energy, mining, logistics, manufacturing, power and utility, agriculture, and federal applications. FieldAI has raised over $405M from investors including Bezos Expeditions, Canaan Partners, Khosla Ventures, Temasek, Intel Capital, Hyundai Motor Company, and Prysm Capital.

providers.name: FlyHomes
providers.description: Flyhomes is a Bellevue, Washington-based real estate and mortgage financial technology company whose Buy Before You Sell platform lets homebuyers purchase a new home before selling their existing one. Its products—Flyhomes Cash Offer, Instant Equity, and Guaranteed Backup Contract—turn financing into competitive cash-like offers, unlock home equity without requiring a prior sale, and reduce a buyer's debt-to-income ratio so they can qualify for larger loans and move only once. Flyhomes reaches homebuyers through a network of in-network loan officers and real estate agents and also operates an AI-powered home search portal. Flyhomes does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, discovery surface (llms.txt), and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Freed
providers.description: Freed is a San Francisco-based AI medical scribe and clinician assistant designed to reduce the documentation burden on healthcare providers. The product listens to patient visits and generates SOAP-style clinical notes, visit summaries, patient instructions, referral letters, and ICD-10 / CPT coding suggestions, then transfers the finalized note into the clinician's EHR via a browser-resident agent. Freed was founded in 2023 by former Facebook engineers Erez Druk (CEO) and Andrey Bannikov (CTO) after Druk's wife, a practicing family physician, experienced the daily toll of manual charting. The company is consumer self-serve: clinicians sign up for a 7-day free trial and then a monthly Starter, Core, Premier, or custom Groups plan with no enterprise sales required. As of 2025 Freed reported more than 20,000 paying clinician users and raised a $30M Series A led by Sequoia Capital, bringing total funding to $34M. The platform is HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and HITECH-ready; patient recordings are not stored. Rather than ship a traditional public REST API, Freed pursues an "anti-integration" model in which a Chrome-extension AI agent navigates any web-based EHR (Athena, Tebra, PracticeFusion, TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, Elation, AdvancedMD, Cerbo, and others) to place the finished note in the correct fields. There is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release.

providers.name: Fundamental Technologies
providers.description: Fundamental Technologies Inc. (Fundamental) is an AI company building foundation models for predictive decision-making across enterprises and governments. Its flagship product, NEXUS, is a large tabular model pre-trained on billions of real-world enterprise tables and designed to capture the complex, non-linear feature interactions in structured data that large language models handle poorly. NEXUS is positioned to be deployed "with just one line of code" with a deep AWS integration and confidential-computing privacy controls. Founded by DeepMind alumni and led by serial entrepreneurs, the company raised a $255M Series A in February 2026 and is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Battery Ventures portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a marketing and research presence at fundamental.tech but no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Gameto
providers.description: Gameto is a female-led clinical-stage biotechnology company redefining women's health across the reproductive lifespan. Using proprietary induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) engineering, Gameto develops ovarian cell lines that mimic the biology of the female reproductive system. Its lead product, Fertilo, is an engineered line of ovarian support cells that mature immature eggs outside the body to reduce the hormonal burden of IVF and egg freezing, and is in a Phase 3 clinical trial (FIRST). Additional programs include Deovo, an organoid of the female reproductive system for drug discovery, and Ameno, a cell-based therapeutic targeting menopause and primary ovarian insufficiency. Gameto is backed by Insight Partners. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Gameto publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Glorify
providers.description: Glorify is a Christian devotional and worship mobile application that helps people build a daily faith and wellbeing practice. The app delivers daily devotionals, Bible passages and inspirational quotes alongside guided meditations, prayer, sleep stories, worship music playlists, and audio courses led by theologians and authors, plus a community for connecting with other believers. Glorify also offers a physical wearable, the Glorify Ring. The company reports more than 20 million downloads and a 4.9-star average across over one million reviews, and is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). Glorify is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Gridwise
providers.description: Gridwise is an earnings-tracking and optimization platform for rideshare and delivery gig workers, aggregating mileage, trip, and income data across gig platforms such as Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Grubhub, Instacart, and Amazon Flex so drivers can see where they earn most and drive more strategically. Alongside the consumer app, Gridwise operates Gridwise Analytics, a B2B mobility-data business that turns millions of anonymized driver location, trip, and earnings records into industry benchmarking, KPI, and market-intelligence products for gig mobility platforms, financial services, retailers/merchants, and autonomous vehicle fleets. Data is delivered as aggregated weekly reports, record-level trip datasets, and consumer/driver surveys through commercial engagement. Gridwise does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its consumer, data-product, support, and policy surfaces.

providers.name: Heyclicky
providers.description: Heyclicky (product name Clicky) is a consumer macOS application from the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch that puts an AI assistant right next to your cursor. In Talk Mode a hotkey lets you ask about whatever is on screen and get spoken, on-screen guidance; in Agent Mode you can command autonomous agents to build, research, or perform tasks in the background, and it can connect to services like Notion, Gmail, and Calendar. The app is screen-aware, works across any application with no plugins, and ships as a notarized macOS binary distributed via a Sparkle appcast on GitHub. Heyclicky is a consumer desktop product; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: HomeLane
providers.description: HomeLane is an Indian end-to-end interior design company that delivers customized home interiors — modular kitchens, wardrobes, storage, bedroom, living room, bathroom, and home-office designs — pairing in-house digital design and 3D visualization tools with material selection and professional installation, backed by a 45-day delivery guarantee on end-to-end modular interiors. Founded in Bangalore and backed by Accel, HomeLane operates across major Indian cities through design studios, a franchise/partner network, and a customer mobile app. HomeLane currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its digital, security, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HumanQ
providers.description: HumanQ is an execution-capability and intelligence platform that helps organizations move critical work forward through structured, live execution sprints called QPods. Each QPod is a 60-minute facilitated session, led by trained "Catalysts," for small groups of up to six participants working through decision drag, unclear ownership, and cross-team stalls. HumanQ is offered as HumanQ Scale (an enterprise-wide program with weekly and monthly tracks, on-demand drop-ins, and deep customization) and HumanQ Teams (a manager-led tool for up to four groups, live in two weeks with no contract). Progress is tracked through the QStart, QImpact, and QSignal measurement framework, with delivery across 74 countries. HumanQ is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. It is a managed-services platform and does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Hungryroot
providers.description: Hungryroot is a personalized grocery and meal-planning service that blends meal-kit convenience with grocery-store variety. Its AI-driven personalization engine builds each customer's cart from dietary preferences, health goals, and budget, drawing on a catalog of 50,000+ recipes and curated grocery products that support high-protein, gluten-free, vegan, and other dietary needs. Hungryroot is a direct-to-consumer company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners; it operates a consumer web and mobile app experience rather than a public developer platform. This profile was surfaced through the venture portfolio graph and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline, which probed the provider's domain and public discovery surfaces (no public API, OpenAPI, SDKs, well-known catalog, security.txt, or llms.txt were found as of this pass).

providers.name: ilik
providers.description: Ilik (ilikhealth.com) is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company offering personalised prescription skincare designed and approved by dermatologists. Customers complete an online dermatology consultation, receive a custom AM/PM routine built from medical-grade, clinically proven ingredients, and have their prescription medication shipped free to their door — consulting with a dermatologist on their own time without the wait of an in-clinic appointment. The service is organised around skin concerns such as acne, anti-ageing, hyperpigmentation, and rosacea. Ilik is a consumer health / e-commerce brand and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment and monitoring.

providers.name: IMP Software
providers.description: IMP Software builds MAT-first financial management software for the UK education sector. Its flagship product, IMP Planner, is a single-database, trust-wide platform for budgeting, forecasting, reporting, Integrated Curriculum Financial Planning (ICFP) and purchasing, used by Multi-Academy Trusts (MATs) and their schools. Based in Exeter, UK, the company is trusted by more than 550 trusts across roughly 6,000 schools and secured a growth investment from Partech in September 2025. IMP Planner is a closed SaaS application for trust finance teams; IMP Software does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Irreverent Labs
providers.description: Irreverent Labs is a Bellevue, Washington startup founded in 2021 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Samsung Next, and Michael Ovitz. The company began by building MechaFightClub, a web3 gaming property, then pivoted to generative AI, developing video foundation models intended to let creators, game studios, and developers produce short-form video from natural-language prompts. Its current public product is Supermodel (supermodel.ai), an autonomous on-chain trading agent that watches top Hyperliquid wallets, scores their track records, and fuses crowd, technical, and prediction-market signals into trades. The company has publicly signaled intent to ship a developer API for its video generation models, but no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK has been released as of this profile.

providers.name: Juvo
providers.description: Juvo is a San Francisco based fintech company, founded in 2014, that provides Financial Identity as a Service (FiDaaS). In partnership with mobile network operators, Juvo uses data science, machine learning, and game mechanics to analyze anonymous prepaid mobile subscriber behavior and build proprietary Identity Scores for the roughly 68% of adults worldwide who lack a formal credit history. Its Identity Stack exposes an API for carriers to derive customer analytics and insights, and powers airtime lending and cash-loan products. Juvo has built over 150 million financial profiles and works with operators and partners including Mastercard, Claro, T-Mobile, Vivo, and TIM across Latin America and beyond. Developer documentation is published on a Stoplight-hosted portal at developers.juvo.com.

providers.name: Kampi
providers.description: Kampi is an aquaculture technology company headquartered in Samborondón, Ecuador, building an AI-powered mobile app and platform for real-time shrimp farm management. Created by the team behind XpertSea (KAMPI AQUA SOLUTIONS S.A. / XpertSea Solution Inc.), Kampi converts daily farm records into personalized guidance using machine learning, an approach it calls dynamic precision farming. The platform combines three integrated tools — Pond Vision (intelligent pond monitoring), FarmAI (predictive biomass analytics) and Farmbook (digital team integration) — to deliver biomass monitoring, biological parameter tracking, real-time alerts, harvest planning and FCR optimization from a smartphone, online or offline. Kampi is a marketing-and-mobile-app company with no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its published web presence and a verbatim llms.txt it serves.

providers.name: Kelvin
providers.description: Kelvin (kelvin°) is a Paris-based startup, founded in 2023 and backed by Seedcamp, building an AI-powered commercial platform for the home energy-renovation industry in France. Its tools help RGE-certified artisans, renovation contractors, general contractors, CEE delegatees and trade platforms find and qualify renovation prospects, generate leads through embeddable address-based simulators, automatically compute energy-efficiency scenarios and government aids (MaPrimeRenov / CEE) with remaining customer cost, and assemble complete financing packages. The AI is trained by thermal engineers and architects and uses open data plus computer vision to assess buildings without a recent DPE. More than 4,000 artisans and sales reps use Kelvin to prospect, prepare appointments and quote work.

providers.name: Kerys
providers.description: Kerys Software is a European (Palaiseau, France) cybersecurity company behind YS::Desktop, a Type 1 hypervisor that runs multiple fully isolated environments on a single workstation. By preallocating dedicated CPU cores to the hypervisor versus VM workloads and adding hypervisor-level encryption, YS::Desktop closes VM escape and cross-VM attack vectors while sustaining roughly 92% native performance. It replaces dedicated admin machines, air-gapped OT laptops, and traditional VDI for regulated organizations in aerospace and defense, energy, finance, construction, and the public sector, with a mandatory Security Domain model (no unmanaged VMs) administered through the YAC console. The company positions around NIS2, IEC 62443, and ANSSI multi-environment workstation guidance and sells 100% through resellers. Kerys does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or pricing; it was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and enriched here from its public site.

providers.name: Mint State Labs
providers.description: Mint State Labs (mintstatelabs.com, operating as Wildnet Edge) is an AI-first custom software development and IT outsourcing company delivering custom AI, machine learning, mobile, web, and cloud engineering services to enterprises and Fortune 500 clients. Its offerings span custom AI model and agent development, generative AI, ChatGPT app development, mobile and web app development, DevOps, data engineering, business intelligence, and staff augmentation ("build a team" / white-label) across a broad set of frameworks and platforms. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; the public presence is a marketing and services site with no first-party API product, developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: MosaicML
providers.description: MosaicML was a San Francisco-based foundation model training company founded in 2021 by Naveen Rao and Hanlin Tang to make large-scale model training faster and cheaper through algorithmic and systems efficiency. Databricks acquired MosaicML in July 2023 for approximately $1.3 billion and folded the team and platform into Databricks Mosaic AI Research. The MosaicML training platform is now delivered as Databricks Mosaic AI Training (pretraining and finetuning), and the original mosaicml.com domain redirects to the Databricks Mosaic Research microsite. MosaicML's surviving open-source artifacts include Composer (a PyTorch training library with built-in speedup recipes), Streaming (a cloud-native dataset format for efficient distributed training), LLM Foundry (the training code behind Databricks' DBRX foundation model), the Diffusion training stack, and the MCLI command line and Python SDK that orchestrate Pretraining and Finetuning jobs against the managed training service. The Mosaic AI Training service itself is accessed exclusively through the MCLI command line, the mosaicml-cli Python SDK, and Databricks workspace integrations — there is no publicly published REST OpenAPI surface for the training control plane. Commercial access requires a Databricks account; pricing is consumption-based via Databricks DBU billing rather than an independent MosaicML pricing page.

providers.name: Mytos
providers.description: Mytos is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for regenerative medicine and cell therapy. Its iDEM automation platform automates every unit operation of cell culture — coating, seeding, feeding, imaging, passaging and harvesting — in standard 2D T-flask formats, letting clinical-stage biotech companies transfer their manual protocols to automated GMP production at up to 50% lower batch cost, with 10x less labor and cleanroom footprint per batch. Mytos operates a CDMO facility within the Cell and Gene Therapy Catapult site and is backed by Wing Venture Capital. No public developer/API surface was found during enrichment; the profile captures the company's verified security posture (trust center, SOC 2/SOC 3/21 CFR Part 11, domain security, vulnerability disclosure).

providers.name: MyWear
providers.description: MyWear (operating as vPersonalize Inc.) is a Houston, Texas based, Accel-backed software company founded in 2014 that provides a cloud platform for on-demand apparel manufacturing and mass customization. Its integrated toolset spans the full production lifecycle: a 3D product customizer and 3D uniform builder for real-time design, an online pattern-making CAD with automated size grading, web-to-print and print-layout automation with color management (PANTONE, CMYK, custom SPOT), an automated catalog builder, e-commerce storefront integration, and order and factory management across multiple suppliers. The company holds six US patents covering its automation and pattern-generation technology and targets apparel brands, sportswear makers, and print-on-demand operators. The public surface is a marketing and product site (vpersonalize.com); no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: NetSuite Accounting
providers.description: NetSuite Accounting is the cloud financial management module of Oracle NetSuite that delivers general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, cash management, tax management, fixed assets, and real-time financial reporting and consolidation for growing businesses. NetSuite exposes its accounting records (invoices, bills, journal entries, payments, accounts, customers, vendors, and ledgers) through SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL queries, and RESTlets, secured with OAuth 2.0 and token-based authentication for ERP and finance integrations.

providers.name: Omnee
providers.description: Omnee (Omnee AI) is a Techstars-backed startup providing an AI-powered customer care platform built for residential homebuilders. It pairs a per-home digital "home twin" data record with a personalized, multilingual AI assistant that handles buyer support and warranty management 24/7, claiming to increase warranty-department capacity by over 60%. Products are sold per-home (Warranty Triage, AI Customer Care, and an Enterprise Partner tier with custom integrations). The company operates a marketing and product website but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile was enriched from its public site.

providers.name: Ooak Data
providers.description: Ooak Data is an applied AI research lab building the data infrastructure for frontier AI. It turns real company data into reinforcement-learning environments where AI agents learn to work in the real world — sourcing multimodal enterprise data, anonymizing it into digital twins of tools like Slack, Gmail, Notion and Jira, and generating expert-calibrated, multi-step, multi-tool workflow tasks calibrated on the latest frontier models. It serves frontier AI labs, enterprise AI teams, and AI startups that need real-world evaluation infrastructure rather than synthetic benchmarks. Backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026) and based in Paris, France. Ooak Data publishes research essays and an AI-friendly content surface (llms.txt + Markdown content negotiation) but does not currently expose a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Oportun
providers.description: Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company and U.S. Treasury-certified Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) that provides responsible, affordable personal loans, savings, and budgeting tools to people with limited or no credit history. Founded in 2006, Oportun has disbursed more than $20.8 billion across 7.7 million loans and established credit history for over 1.3 million people. Beyond its consumer app, Oportun runs an Enterprise Platform offering Lending-as-a-Service (LaaS) and embedded-finance partnerships, but publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or self-serve API; the LaaS integration API is available only through contact-gated enterprise partnerships.

providers.name: Passport
providers.description: Passport (Passport Labs) is a mobility management platform for cities, universities, and agencies, covering digital parking payments, enforcement, permits, and curbside management, and is used by 800+ agencies. Passport exposes a partner developer program at developer.passportinc.com whose REST APIs let parking apps, navigation apps, in-car infotainment, and mobility/POS systems create and stop parking sessions, quote and determine rates, bulk-export the parking environment (zones, spaces, rules), receive parking event schemas, and manage enforcement immobilizations. Rates and rules are configured once by Passport's customers and pushed to payment providers via API. Access is gated - partners register an application, are issued OAuth client credentials by Passport's identity provider, and only authenticated partner applications may call the public APIs. No SDK is required. Commercial terms are partnership / agency-contract based rather than publicly listed self-serve pricing.

providers.name: Pawfinity
providers.description: Pawfinity is pet service business management software for grooming salons, mobile groomers, kennels, dog daycares, pet sitting, training, and pet therapy businesses - handling online booking, client and pet records, scheduling, point of sale, and staff management. Pawfinity does not publish a public or partner developer API or developer portal. The product is a closed, single-tenant SaaS web application; the only outbound data integration is a built-in, one-way nightly QuickBooks Online sync bundled with the subscription, not a documented API a third party can call.

providers.name: Paynas
providers.description: Paynas is an Egyptian HR, payroll, and employee-benefits platform offering hassle-free, digitized human-resources management for businesses. Through a single web and mobile interface, Paynas handles attendance tracking, vacation and leave management, payroll processing, and reporting analytics, while extending financial services to employees through the Paynas Card — a Visa-powered payroll card issued in partnership with Banque Misr — and affordable medical-insurance packages provided in partnership with Libano-Suisse. Backed by 500 Global, the company serves employers across Egypt. Paynas publishes no public developer or API surface; this profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pocket Protector
providers.description: Pocket Protector is a consumer peer-to-peer trading application operated by Pocket Protector Inc. Under the tagline "Trade Better Together," it lets users trade items and assets with one another through an iOS app and an accompanying Telegram bot (@pocketprotectorbot). The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Electric Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass it publishes a marketing site with privacy and terms pages but no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Rank Science
providers.description: RankScience (RankScience LLC) is a San Francisco based SEO and AI-visibility agency that turns search rankings into revenue for startups, SaaS companies, and enterprises. Refined over 15+ years, its practice spans foundational and technical SEO, on-page and local SEO, strategic link building, and content strategy, plus a next-generation AI-visibility line covering generative engine optimization (GEO), large language model optimization, and answer engine optimization for platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. It serves technology, healthcare, legal, and specialized verticals with revenue-focused reporting. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; RankScience is an agency and publishes no public API, though it does publish an llms.txt for AI-agent discovery.

providers.name: Salasa
providers.description: Salasa is an end-to-end eCommerce logistics provider based in Saudi Arabia, offering 3PL fulfillment (warehouse storage, automated pick/pack/ship), hyperlocal dark stores with 2-hour delivery in Riyadh, domestic on-demand and scheduled shipping, cross-border shipping with customs clearance, and reverse logistics / return management. Its Operations Management System (OMS) provides real-time tracking, inventory management, and analytics, and it connects to major eCommerce platforms (Salla, Zid, Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Amazon, Trendyol) and offers custom API integrations for merchants automating fulfillment and order synchronization.

providers.name: SchoolsFirst FCU
providers.description: SchoolsFirst Federal Credit Union is a federally chartered, member-owned credit union headquartered in Tustin, California, serving educators and their families. Founded in 1934 as Orange County Teachers Credit Union, it is the largest credit union in California and one of the largest in the United States, with roughly $31.9 billion in assets, over 1.4 million members, and about 70 branches. It offers savings, checking, loans, mortgages, credit cards, and investment services. Like most US credit unions, SchoolsFirst runs no first-party public developer program: probes of developer.schoolsfirstfcu.org fail to resolve and /developers returns 404, and its api.schoolsfirstfcu.org host is the member online-banking login backend, not a documented API. Consumer-permissioned data access is available only through open-finance aggregators (Plaid, Finicity, MX, Akoya) rather than a direct API. No public FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is documented at this time.

providers.name: Scouter
providers.description: Scouter is a Mexican online marketplace, founded in 2021 in Guadalajara, for discovering and booking unique locations — houses, mansions, studios, terraces, haciendas, rooftops and more — for audiovisual productions, events, photo shoots and workshops across Mexico. It connects brands, agencies and production companies with the owners of over 1,500 spaces, handling quotes and reservations directly via WhatsApp (no public list prices, 8-hour minimum booking). Clients have included Netflix, HBO, Puma, Nike and Grupo Modelo. Backed by 500 Global (500 LatAm "Somos Lucha" Batch 16). The public product is a consumer/host web app at wearescouter.com; it exposes no public developer API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched.

providers.name: Spinny
providers.description: Spinny (Valuedrive Technologies Ltd.) is an India-based online marketplace for buying and selling used cars. Every Spinny Assured car undergoes a 200-point quality check and comes with a 1-year warranty, a 5-day money-back guarantee, and hassle-free RC ownership transfer. The platform also offers instant online car valuation, doorstep evaluation, used-car finance and EMI, car insurance, RC transfer, scrap-car service, e-Challan and RTO lookups, servicing, the Spinny Max luxury tier, and a Partners auction platform for dealers. Backed by Accel and General Catalyst. Spinny publishes a consumer web experience and an llms.txt for AI agents but does not expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Stage
providers.description: Stage is a code review tool that reorganizes local git changes and pull requests into logical, ordered "chapters" so engineers can review and merge changes far faster — a workflow built for teams shipping large volumes of AI-generated code. Stage ships an open-source (MIT) command-line tool, "stagereview", that runs entirely on the developer's machine and works with any AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, opencode): it diffs the current branch or a GitHub PR, clusters the hunks into narrated chapters with a prologue, and opens them in a local browser SPA for review. The full hosted Stage experience lives at stagereview.app. Stage is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company founded by Charles Pan and Dean Stratakos.

providers.name: Stanza Living
providers.description: Stanza Living is one of India's largest managed accommodation and co-living platforms, founded in 2017 by IIM-Ahmedabad alumni Anindya Dutta and Sandeep Dalmia and headquartered in Gurugram. It provides professionally managed, fully furnished, brokerage-free residences — student housing, co-living for working professionals, and managed apartments — across 24+ Indian cities, operating 450+ residences and more than 70,000 beds under the promise of "your second home in a new city." The company is backed by investors including Accel, Falcon Edge, Sequoia Capital and Matrix Partners. Stanza Living operates as a consumer web and mobile brand for discovering, booking and living in managed accommodation, and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Tenex AI
providers.description: TENEX.AI is an AI-native, human-led Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider that fuses agentic AI, automation, and elite human security analysts to run security operations at scale. Its platform triages every alert and investigates every threat, orchestrating workflows across 300+ security tools to deliver faster detection, high-fidelity triage, and autonomous response with human guardrails for Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Crosspoint Capital, and Shield Capital, TENEX.AI operates as a managed cybersecurity service rather than a public developer API platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: TimesTen
providers.description: TimesTen is an in-memory relational database company that spun out of Hewlett-Packard Labs in Palo Alto in 1996 as TimesTen Performance Software, taking venture backing that included Lightspeed Venture Partners, and was acquired by Oracle Corporation in 2005. The product lives on as Oracle TimesTen In-Memory Database, a persistent, ACID-compliant OLTP database with SQL support, replication, JSON support, and a Kubernetes operator, documented today under Oracle Help Center with releases 11.2.2, 18.1, 22.1, and 26.1. The company no longer operates independently and publishes no standalone web API; timesten.com redirects into oracle.com.

providers.name: Velotax
providers.description: Velotax is a Brazilian digital-credit fintech (mobile app plus velotax.com.br), operating 100% online, that offers unsecured personal loans and income-tax (IRPF) refund advances, disbursed via Pix within 30 minutes of approval — approving even "negativado" (poor-credit) customers because the anticipated tax refund secures repayment. Founded in 2020 by ex-J.P. Morgan bankers Eduardo Esmanhotto and Victor Savioli, it operates as a banking correspondent in partnership with VIA CAPITAL (a Brazilian Central Bank SCD), holds Reclame Aqui's top RA1000 reputation seal, has 3M+ app downloads, and raised a R$125M Series A in 2025 from QED Investors, Valor Capital and Picus Capital. Velotax is a consumer product and publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Wunder
providers.description: Wunder (formerly Wunder Capital, wewunder.com, now wunderpower.com) is a commercial clean-energy company that deploys solar, battery storage, and EV charging infrastructure across real estate portfolios with no-CapEx energy solutions, managing projects from design through operations in 40+ US states. Backed by Techstars and a $650M partnership with Blackstone, Wunder runs its project development on Astra, a proprietary internal platform for energy data analysis, forecasting, and automation. Wunder publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Zum
providers.description: Zum is a student transportation technology company that runs school bus operations for K-12 school districts through its Connected Mobility Experience (CMX) platform. Founded by Ritu Narayan and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Zum unifies parents, students, drivers, and district administrators with real-time ride tracking, route optimization, parent notification apps, driver tooling, fleet management dashboards, and an electrified bus program. The company serves roughly 6,500 schools and districts, has completed more than 159 million rides, and is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. Zum operates consumer-facing parent and driver mobile apps and district dashboards, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Zymbly
providers.description: Zymbly is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building a voice-first AI copilot for aircraft maintenance. Its AI agents automate the administrative half of a maintenance technician's day at airlines and MROs (maintenance, repair, and overhaul organizations): troubleshooting issues, looking up parts, retrieving technical documentation, and generating compliant paperwork so technicians can focus on the aircraft. Zymbly is a demo-led B2B product with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications at this time; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched from the company's public marketing site.

providers.name: Aer Therapeutics
providers.description: Aer Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in the Research Triangle Park / Raleigh area of North Carolina, developing novel treatments for muco-obstructive lung diseases such as COPD, asthma, cystic fibrosis, and non-CF bronchiectasis. A spinout from Dr. John Fahy's laboratory at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF), the company's lead candidate, AER-01 (fexlamose), is an inhaled small-molecule mucolytic designed to break down and liquefy the dense mucus plugs that obstruct airflow in the lungs. Aer closed a $36 million Series A backed by life-science investors including Canaan, OrbiMed, Hatteras Venture Partners, and Pappas Capital. Aer Therapeutics is a private, research-focused therapeutics company and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or SDKs; this profile captures its corporate identity within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Agile Robots
providers.description: Agile Robots SE is a Munich-based robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in 2018 as a spin-off from the German Aerospace Center (DLR) Institute of Robotics and Mechatronics. The company develops force-sensitive industrial and service robots, robotic arms (Diana series), grippers and hands (Agile Hand), mobile robotics, and the AgileCore / AgileAI software platform that lets system integrators and operators build and deploy AI-driven automation for the automotive, consumer electronics, healthcare, and service industries. Headquartered in Munich's Sendling district with manufacturing across Europe, China, and India, Agile Robots reached unicorn valuation in a 2021 Series C and is backed by investors including Hongshan (Sequoia Capital China). This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Agile Robots does not currently publish a public developer portal, REST API, or first-party SDKs.

providers.name: Aktis Oncology
providers.description: Aktis Oncology is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation precision radiopharmaceuticals for the treatment of cancer. The company has built a proprietary miniprotein radioconjugate platform that pairs tumor-targeting miniproteins with targeted alpha-particle emitters, aiming to reach solid-tumor types that have been difficult to address with existing radiopharmaceutical therapies. Aktis focuses on patient populations with significant unmet medical need, advancing a pipeline of targeted alpha-based therapeutic candidates. The company operates from Boston, Massachusetts, with an additional site in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina. Aktis Oncology was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a biotechnology company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Alodokter
providers.description: Alodokter is Indonesia's leading digital health and telemedicine platform, founded in 2014 and operated by PT Alodokter Teknologi Solusi. It connects tens of millions of monthly active users with tens of thousands of licensed doctors through chat-based consultations (Tanya Dokter), online and in-person doctor appointment booking, a large library of medically reviewed health articles and a symptom and disease encyclopedia, health protection and insurance products, and a health commerce surface for medicines and health products. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from the provider's own public web surface; Alodokter does not publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time, so this profile focuses on company identity, legal and support surfaces, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Alta VR
providers.description: Alta VR (legally Another Axiom LLC) is a virtual reality game studio behind Gorilla Tag, one of the most-played VR titles ever, and the newer social VR world Orion Drift. The studio builds imaginative, physics-driven multiplayer experiences centered on hand-based locomotion and social play across Meta Quest, Steam, and other VR platforms. It runs an Another Axiom Creator Program for community map-building and content creation, and publishes game code and Unity map-export tooling through its public GitHub organization. Alta VR is a portfolio company of a16z. As a VR consumer game studio it does not currently operate a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK program; its developer-facing surface is limited to open-source game code, custom map tooling, and creator resources.

providers.name: Altira Health
providers.description: Altira Health is a San Francisco-based healthcare technology company, founded in 2025, building AI-powered clinical follow-up for health systems. Its virtual clinical assistant, Lena, engages discharged and at-risk patients over voice and SMS, carries clinical context from the EMR across interactions, adapts across languages, escalates to human clinicians when needed, and documents findings directly back into the electronic medical record. The platform aims to recover clinician staff time and reduce hospital readmissions, and advertises API, webhook, dashboard, and analytics surfaces for connected EMR workflows (no public developer portal or API documentation is published as of this profile). Backed by Homebrew, Coalition, Focal, Stone Mountain Ventures, and Wireframe Ventures.

providers.name: Amex Bank of Canada
providers.description: Amex Bank of Canada is the Canadian banking subsidiary of the American Express Company (United States), incorporated in 1990 and headquartered in the Toronto area (Markham, Ontario). It is a Schedule II bank under Canada's Bank Act — a foreign-bank subsidiary regulated by the Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions (OSFI) and treated as a Category II small-and-medium-sized deposit-taking institution — and it issues American Express charge and credit cards to Canadian consumers and businesses. As a card-centric Schedule II bank, Amex Bank of Canada runs no first-party developer portal of its own; the global American Express developer platform at developer.americanexpress.com is operated by the U.S. parent (a separate profile), not by this Canadian entity. Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open-banking) framework, legislated in Budget 2024 and the 2024 Fall Economic Statement with the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada (FCAC) as overseer, is not yet operational, so consumer data access to Amex-Canada accounts today is voluntary and largely aggregator-based rather than served by a public first-party API. This is an identity/provider record; no public Canadian API surface is documented.

providers.name: Anchor Protocol
providers.description: Anchor Protocol is a Terra-based decentralized finance (DeFi) savings protocol that offered a low-volatility yield on Terra stablecoin (UST) deposits, borrowing against bonded-asset (bAsset) collateral such as bLUNA and bETH, and cross-chain access through EthAnchor and xAnchor. Its developer surface is a set of first-party JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs (Anchor.js and Anchor Earn) plus on-chain CosmWasm smart contracts rather than a REST or OpenAPI web API. The project is part of the Terra ecosystem and is backed by Pantera Capital; its main web application deployment is currently disabled, though its developer documentation and npm SDK packages remain published.

providers.name: Anthro Energy
providers.description: Anthro Energy is a battery materials company based in Alameda, California, developing next-generation electrolyte technology for lithium-ion and next-gen battery cells. Its flagship Proteus platform is a drop-in electrolyte that increases energy density, improves safety, and adds mechanical integrity without requiring changes to existing gigafactory manufacturing infrastructure, and is compatible with a wide range of anodes, separators, and cathodes. Spun out of research at Stanford, Anthro Energy is a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures and Ultratech Capital. It is a physical-materials company with no public API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company and market discovery.

providers.name: ArriVent
providers.description: ArriVent BioPharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the identification, development, and commercialization of differentiated medicines to address the unmet medical needs of patients with difficult-to-treat diseases, beginning with cancers. The company operates through three strategic pillars — Discover (identifying oncology programs with strong scientific rationale), Partner & Collaborate (licensing promising candidates and building partnerships), and Develop (designing development strategies leveraging regulatory expertise). Its lead candidate is firmonertinib, an EGFR inhibitor, alongside ARR-002, a tetravalent antibody-drug conjugate. ArriVent was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a corporate website and an investor relations site but exposes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings
providers.description: Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings is a global airfreight, charter, and aircraft leasing group headquartered in Purchase, New York and operating across more than 80 countries and 330+ airports. The holding company positions itself as the "Leader in Aviation Outsourcing" and runs three operating businesses: Atlas Air (ACMI, CMI, charter, and military/government cargo and passenger operations on Boeing 747-400F, 747-8F, 777F, 767, and 737-800BCF freighters), Polar Air Cargo (scheduled airport-to-airport cargo network, historically a joint venture with DHL), and Titan Aviation Leasing (commercial aircraft acquisition, leasing, and sale-leaseback services). Atlas is the largest operator of the Boeing 747 freighter, the Dreamlifter operator for Boeing, and one of the principal lift providers for Amazon Air's middle-mile network. In August 2022 a consortium led by Apollo Global Management with J.F. Lehman & Company and Hill City Capital agreed to take the company private in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately US$5.2 billion; the deal closed in March 2023, delisting the company (formerly Nasdaq: AAWW). As a freight carrier the group does not publish a public developer portal or open APIs — integrations with shippers, forwarders, and customers are delivered through private B2B channels (EDI, Cargo-IMP/XML messaging, airwaybill tracking on polaraircargo.com, and account-managed connectivity).
