A "Track Shipment" tool and a Special Loads request form (specialloads.atlasair.com) are the principal self-service surfaces; an internal-facing GitHub organization (Atlas-Air-Data-Platform) exists but publishes no public repos.

providers.name: Atmosfy
providers.description: Atmosfy is a live-video mapping platform that bills itself as the world's largest live video map, aggregating 500M+ geo-tagged short-form videos across 100M+ places in 20,000+ cities and 150+ countries. The consumer app lets people see what restaurants, bars, hotels, and events actually look like in real time, while its business side offers brand targeting, embedded local-video integrations for other platforms, and video corpora for AI training. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Atmosfy publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile captures company identity, legal/link surface, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: August Home
providers.description: August Home is a consumer smart-home and access-control brand best known for its retrofit August Smart Lock, Smart Lock Pro, Wi-Fi Smart Lock, Smart Keypad, Doorbell Cam, and the August Connect Wi-Fi Bridge. Founded in San Francisco and acquired by ASSA ABLOY, August products are now sold and supported alongside the Yale Home brand and operated through the shared Yale Access mobile app. August does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; programmatic access to August locks is reached through the private mobile/app API or via third-party universal-access platforms such as Seam, and integrations exist with Google Home, Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit, Airbnb, and Yale. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Avalynpharma
providers.description: Avalyn Pharma is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing inhaled therapies for rare and serious respiratory diseases, with a focus on idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and other interstitial lung diseases. Its inhaled-delivery pipeline includes AP01 (inhaled pirfenidone), AP02 (inhaled nintedanib), and AP03 (a fixed-dose combination), aiming to deliver antifibrotic medication directly to lung tissue to improve efficacy while reducing systemic side effects. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, the company is a therapeutics developer and publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: B2B Bank
providers.description: B2B Bank is a Schedule I Canadian bank, headquartered in Toronto and wholly owned by Laurentian Bank of Canada (Laurentian Bank Financial Group). It operates a business-to-business, intermediary-only model: rather than serving retail consumers directly, it manufactures and distributes banking products through a network of roughly 27,000 financial professionals — financial advisors and their dealerships, deposit and mortgage brokers and their firms, mutual fund and insurance manufacturers, and CIRO (formerly MFDA/IIROC) members. Its product lines include investment loans, RSP and TFSA loans, broker deposits (GICs and high-interest savings/investment accounts), broker mortgages, and investment and banking accounts. The bank became a Schedule I bank and adopted the B2B Bank name in 2012, consolidating predecessor trust businesses (North American Trust, Sun Life Trust), and its deposits are CDIC insured. On open finance, B2B Bank publishes no first-party developer portal or public API: developer.b2bbank.com and api.b2bbank.com do not resolve, and the public site exposes only gated advisor/broker applications (Advisor Access, EASE online loans, Group Access, Investor Access, online banking). Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking framework is legislated but not yet operational, and the bank documents no FDX participation, Interac data-sharing API, or aggregator program of its own — consistent with an intermediary bank whose digital surface is partner-gated rather than developer-facing.

providers.name: Bagel Labs
providers.description: Bagel Labs is an AI research lab building distributed diffusion training infrastructure for frontier diffusion workloads on commodity and heterogeneous GPU fleets. Its core method, Distributed Diffusion Models (DDM), replaces a single large diffusion model with an ensemble of smaller expert models trained independently on dataset partitions with no gradient synchronization, then ensembled at inference by a lightweight router (the Paris Inference Engine, PIE). Public releases include Paris-1 (image diffusion) and Paris 2.0 (video generation), with open weights on Hugging Face and papers on arXiv. Founded in 2023 by Bidhan Roy and backed by Polychain Capital, the lab targets image, video, world-model, and robotics / physical AI workloads.

providers.name: BandLab
providers.description: BandLab is a cloud-based music creation and social platform where musicians and fans make, collaborate on, publish, and discover music. It pairs a free browser- and mobile-based digital audio workstation (Mix Editor) with a social network for creators, plus sample packs, mastering, distribution, and community features. Part of BandLab Technologies (which also owns Cakewalk/SONAR and other music brands), it is backed by Prosus Ventures. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or official client SDK was found during enrichment; the GitHub organization publishes only internal engineering tooling (eslint/stylelint configs, audio libraries). This profile is a company identity record awaiting a documented API surface.

providers.name: Bankiom
providers.description: Bankiom is a Dubai-based consumer fintech founded in 2018 by Danny Abla. It began as a UAE/GCC lifestyle neobank offering free virtual prepaid Mastercard cards, multi-bank account aggregation, spending insights, and instant peer transfers through a mobile app across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Kuwait, and Oman. Bankiom has since repositioned as an autonomous AI money agent that securely connects to a user's bank, audits roughly 90 days of transactions, and surfaces the fees, interest, unused rewards, forgotten subscriptions, and expiring loyalty points a customer should not be paying, charging only a capped share of verified savings. It is a consumer-facing application and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: BARK (BarkBox)
providers.description: BARK, Inc. (operating as BarkBox) is a New York-based dog-focused consumer company founded in 2011 by Henrik Werdelin and Matt Meeker, serving over two million dogs monthly through its BarkBox and Super Chewer subscription boxes, the BARK Bright dental line, the BARK Air pet travel experience, and retail distribution. The company went public via a SPAC merger in 2021 (NYSE: BARK). BarkBox does not operate a public developer program or externally documented API portal; its engineering surface is a set of mostly-internal Ruby services and open-source libraries published under the github.com/barkbox organization (including the barkbox_client Ruby API client and cursor-pagination gems). This profile was surfaced as a Slow Ventures portfolio company and enriched with verified public identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Beam Therapeutics *
providers.description: Beam Therapeutics is a biotechnology company pioneering precision genetic medicines through base editing, a technology that makes precise, predictable, and efficient single-base changes to the genome without cutting the DNA double helix. The company is developing a portfolio of investigational base editing programs across hematology, hepatology, and other therapeutic areas, using multiple delivery modalities including electroporation, nonviral lipid nanoparticles, and viral vectors. Publicly traded on Nasdaq as BEAM, Beam was named a TIME100 Most Influential Company in 2026. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and hongshan; it is a life-sciences company with no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: Belts
providers.description: Belts covers the landscape of APIs, data standards, and digital resources related to conveyor belts and industrial belt systems. This topic encompasses conveyor belt monitoring and predictive maintenance APIs, industrial IoT sensor data for belt condition tracking, and the standards bodies that govern belt conveyor design and safety. Key organizations include CEMA (Conveyor Equipment Manufacturers Association) and ANSI, which define design, installation, and safety standards for belt conveyors used in mining, manufacturing, food processing, and bulk material handling industries.

providers.name: Betdex
providers.description: Betdex Labs is the team behind BetDEX, a decentralized sports betting exchange, and the Monaco Protocol — an open-source, permissionless liquidity and betting-exchange protocol built on the Solana blockchain. Rather than a traditional REST API, Betdex exposes an on-chain integration surface: Solana programs plus first-party TypeScript client libraries (@monaco-protocol/client and @monaco-protocol/admin-client on npm) that let developers create markets, place and match orders, and settle outcomes directly against the protocol. Developer resources are published at betdex.com/developers with source under the MonacoProtocol GitHub organization.

providers.name: Booko
providers.description: Booko is an Australian book, eBook, audiobook, DVD, music and collectibles price-comparison service operating since 2007. It aggregates new and used prices across many online retailers and regions, calculates shipping, and converts international prices to the shopper's local currency to surface the cheapest place to buy a title. Booko also offers shopping lists with bundled shipping calculations, barcode scanning, reading lists, price alerts and notifications. It is a consumer-facing comparison site rather than a retailer or a public API provider, earning referral fees from partner shops (including Amazon Associates) when shoppers buy through its links. Booko is a solo developer-run product surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio company.

providers.name: Carwow
providers.description: Carwow is a UK-based online automotive marketplace that helps consumers buy, sell, lease, and finance cars without haggling or hidden fees. Buyers browse new and used car deals, compare dealer quotes, arrange leasing (including salary sacrifice and fleet through Carwow Leasey), find electric-vehicle deals, and access vehicle financing and credit brokering. Sellers get free car valuations, part-exchange, and van sales. Carwow also publishes professional car reviews and ratings, runs a large YouTube channel, and offers comparison tools, EV charging maps, a car history checker, and insurance services. Founded in London and backed by Accel, Balderton Capital, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Carwow operates across the UK and Europe. It maintains a public GitHub organization of open-source engineering tooling but does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: CBS (Paramount Global)
providers.description: CBS is the flagship broadcast television network of Paramount Global (NASDAQ: PARA, PARAA). It encompasses CBS Entertainment, CBS News, CBS Sports, CBS Stations (owned and operated), and feeds Paramount+ streaming service. CBS does not publish a consumer developer portal. Partner, syndication, advertising, and distribution APIs are operated privately through Paramount Global's business development, ad sales, and affiliate operations teams.

providers.name: CD Baby
providers.description: CD Baby is an independent music distribution and publishing administration service for songwriters, performers, and independent record labels. Founded in 1998 and now part of Downtown Music Holdings under Virgin Music Group, CD Baby services over 50 million music assets from creators in hundreds of countries across six continents. The platform distributes music to 150+ digital service providers including Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Pandora, Tidal, TikTok, Amazon, Shazam, and Deezer, and is a flagship member of YouTube's Preferred Distributor Program plus a preferred partner with Apple and Spotify. Services include digital distribution, physical CD and vinyl manufacturing, publishing administration, cover song licensing, sync licensing through CDB Boost, YouTube and social monetization, performing rights organization (ASCAP, BMI, SOCAN) registration assistance, and promotion tools via SymphonyOS, HearNow, Show.co, Managed Ads, Groover, Laylo, and Internet Radio Airplay. Pricing is a one-time fee ($9.99 single, $14.99 album) with artists retaining over 90% of earnings. CD Baby has paid out more than $1 billion to artists. CD Baby has no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release; all distribution and reporting workflows are exposed only through the artist member portal at members.cdbaby.com.

providers.name: CesiumAstro
providers.description: CesiumAstro designs, manufactures, and tests full-stack communication systems and satellites for space, air, and ground missions. The Austin, Texas company, founded in 2017, builds active phased array payloads (Vireo), software-defined radios (SDR-1001/2051/2104/3104), reconfigurable processing units, SATCOM terminals (Skylark), tactical ISR/PNT payloads (Nightingale), and the integrated Element LEO satellite platform. Its hardware enables inter-satellite links, high-speed downlinks, lunar communications, and 5G non-terrestrial networks. CesiumAstro publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; this profile tracks the company as an aerospace hardware provider in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Chord
providers.description: Chord is a New York / Santa Barbara-based commerce data and AI platform founded in 2021 by Bryan Mahoney (CEO) and Henry Davis (President & Chairman), both former Glossier executives. Chord began as a headless commerce backbone built on top of Solidus — the open-source Spree Commerce fork written in Ruby on Rails — and has since evolved into an AI-native commerce data platform with three layers: a Data Foundation that unifies sources such as Shopify, ad platforms, and CDPs; a Context Stack that grounds AI in store-specific business context; and a set of Agents that take action across the commerce stack. Its current product surface includes Chord OMS (a Solidus-based order management system covering orders, products, promotions, subscriptions, affiliates, gift cards, returns, shipping, tax, and digital products documented at chord.stoplight.io), Chord CDP (customer data platform with identity resolution, RFM scoring, customer lifetime revenue, and destination activations), Chord Event Tracking (client- and server-side eventing with Shopify Web Pixel integration and consent management via OneTrust and Shopify Customer Privacy API), Chord Data Platform (analytics, predictive modeling, attribution, recommendations, Fivetran ingestion, GA4 compatibility), and Chord AI / Copilot Chat, powered by Anthropic Claude (Opus 4.5 for SQL generation, Haiku 4.5 for response generation and classification) with charts, monitors, context modeling, and natural-language data querying. Chord's GitHub org (github.com/chordcommerce) maintains a fleet of Solidus extensions (solidus_stripe, solidus_braintree, solidus_paypal_braintree, solidus_subscriptions, solidus_virtual_gift_card, solidus_importer, solidus_avatax_certified), a consent-manager TypeScript library, a Jitsu fork for event ingestion, and example repos for eventing and analytics. Notable customers include Sonos, Blue Bottle Coffee, Rodan + Fields, MrBeast, and Ritual. Funding has come from M13 Ventures, Equal Ventures, Act One Ventures, Chingona Ventures, and CEAS Investments, with an $18M Series A reported by TechCrunch in 2021. The commercial model is sales-led with custom enterprise pricing gated behind a demo request.

providers.name: CIBC Bank USA
providers.description: CIBC Bank USA is an Illinois state-chartered, FDIC-insured commercial bank (FDIC Cert #33306) headquartered at 120 South LaSalle Street in Chicago, Illinois. Formerly The PrivateBank and Trust Company, it was acquired in 2017 and rebranded, and today operates as a wholly owned US subsidiary of Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) through the intermediate holding company CIBC Bancorp USA Inc. The bank focuses on commercial banking, capital markets, wealth management, trust services, private banking, and cross-border services for clients with North American operations, rather than mass-market retail. As a US regional institution, CIBC Bank USA publishes no first-party public developer portal or open API program; consumer-permissioned account and balance data is reached only through third-party aggregators such as Plaid, and the CIBC group has a data-access agreement with MX. It is not a documented direct Financial Data Exchange (FDX) participant and has published no explicit CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture, making its honest API surface aggregator-mediated only.

providers.name: Close Brothers
providers.description: Close Brothers Group plc (LSE: CBG) is a UK merchant banking group founded in 1878 and a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index, headquartered at 10 Crown Place, London EC2A 4FT. The group provides specialist lending across motor, premium, asset, invoice, and property finance; takes personal and business deposits through Close Brothers Savings; manages wealth through Close Brothers Asset Management; and trades securities through Winterflood. Its banking entity, Close Brothers Limited, is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and the PRA. Close Brothers is not one of the CMA9 mandated banks; it offers savings and deposit products rather than online payment (current) accounts, and therefore carries no UK Open Banking (OBIE / PSD2) Read/Write or Open Data publishing obligation. As of this profile no public developer portal, Open Banking Open Data endpoint, or documented API surface could be confirmed for the group.

providers.name: Compass Therapeutics
providers.description: Compass Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing proprietary antibody-based therapeutics for the treatment of cancer. Its research is grounded in understanding the tumor microenvironment, designing candidates that optimize the components required for an effective anti-tumor immune response and bridge innate and adaptive immunity. Lead clinical programs include tovecimig and CTX-8371. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV, this is a life-sciences company profile in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a corporate and investor web presence but no public developer, API, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: CopilotIQ
providers.description: CopilotIQ is a Nashville, Tennessee remote patient monitoring and telehealth company, founded in 2021, that delivers AI-driven chronic-condition management to seniors and Medicare members living with type 2 diabetes and hypertension. Through connected in-home devices, predictive analytics, and clinical automation it captures daily biometric readings and pairs them with weekly nurse coaching to catch anomalies early, reduce hospitalizations, and lower costs for health plans and providers. In October 2024 CopilotIQ merged with in-home care company Biofourmis. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and the SoftBank Vision Fund. CopilotIQ operates as a clinical care service and does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: Corner Health
providers.description: Corner Health is a primary care provider network operating in Arizona and Washington that connects patients with independent nurse practitioners and advanced practice registered nurses (APRNs). The company offers everyday and preventative care, chronic condition management, women's health, weight management and metabolic health, and hormone management, with longer appointment times, acceptance of major insurance plans, same-day/evening/Saturday availability, and continuity with the same provider across visits. It is a patient-facing healthcare service that publishes no public developer program, API, or technical documentation; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of homebrew and enriched with verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: CRISPR Therapeutics
providers.description: CRISPR Therapeutics (NASDAQ: CRSP) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with US operations in Boston, Massachusetts. Co-founded by CRISPR/Cas9 pioneer Emmanuelle Charpentier, the company develops transformative gene-based medicines for serious human diseases. Its programs span hemoglobinopathies, immuno-oncology, regenerative medicine, and in-vivo editing; its lead therapy CASGEVY (exagamglogene autotemcel), developed with Vertex Pharmaceuticals, is the first approved CRISPR/Cas9 gene-editing treatment for sickle cell disease and transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia. This is a corporate/investor web presence with no public developer program or API surface.

providers.name: Curie.Bio
providers.description: Curie.Bio is a seed-stage biotech venture firm and drug-discovery co-pilot co-founded by Zach Weinberg (founder of Flatiron Health), Alexis Borisy, and Christoph Lengauer. It pairs seed investment — typically $5M-$7M initial checks, backed by a $380M pro-rata Series A follow-on fund — with hands-on scientific and operational support from a team of experienced drug hunters, helping therapeutics founders design their science and move programs into the clinic and toward a strong next round of financing. Curie.Bio has raised close to $1B and is backed by GV, a16z, and ARCH Venture Partners. It operates as a company/investor profile in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API or platform, so most technical API artifacts are not applicable to this provider.

providers.name: Data Sciences International
providers.description: Data Sciences International (DSI) is a preclinical research instrumentation and services company for in vivo physiology and translational research, operating as part of Harvard Bioscience. DSI builds implantable and external telemetry systems, respiratory measurement (plethysmography, airway mechanics, pulmonary function), inhalation and smoke-exposure systems, iPRECIO infusion pumps, and behavioral monitoring (VivaMARS), paired with analysis software (Ponemah, FinePointe, NeuroScore) and surgical, data-analysis, GLP-validation and training services. It is a laboratory-instrument and life-sciences vendor rather than an API provider; no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface is published. Surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: dForce
providers.description: dForce is a decentralized stablecoin protocol powered by an integrated DeFi matrix spanning assets, lending, trading, and an omni-chain bridge. It positions itself as an AI-native on-chain capital markets platform, unifying its USX USD-pegged stablecoin, permissionless lending markets, yield vaults, a real-world-asset (RWA) marketplace, a DEX, the InteNet launchpad, and DF-native cross-chain bridging under DAO governance driven by the DF token. dForce ships as smart contracts across multiple EVM chains rather than a hosted REST API; its developer surface is on-chain contracts, open documentation, and the dforce-network GitHub organization. Backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: Dishpatch
providers.description: Dishpatch is a UK-based meal delivery service that partners with renowned chefs and restaurants to deliver restaurant-quality, finish-at-home meals nationwide. Operated by Dishpatch Ltd (part of the Waitrose family), the service curates seasonal menus from chefs such as Michel Roux, Rick Stein, Sabrina Ghayour, Jose Pizarro and Paul Ainsworth. Orders are placed a la carte rather than by subscription, delivered on Fridays in insulated, recyclable packaging via DPD, and arrive pre-prepared for simple finishing steps at home. A paid "Supper Club" membership adds free shipping, exclusive menus, early sale access and spending credits. Dishpatch operates a consumer e-commerce storefront and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: Draftea
providers.description: Draftea is a Mexico-based daily fantasy sports and real-money sports gaming platform, billed as the first daily fantasy sports (DFS) product for the Spanish-speaking world. Fans draft lineups of real athletes across soccer, American football (via an NFL partnership), basketball, baseball, and Formula 1, enter paid contests, and compete against other users for cash prizes rather than against a bookmaker. The company operates in Mexico under regulatory approval (DGAJS/SCEVF/P-06/2005-TER), distributes through native iOS and Android apps, and is backed by Sequoia, Kaszek, Bullpen Capital, Stepstone Group, and Courtside Ventures, along with athlete investors. Draftea is a consumer product company and does not currently publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its public web, support, legal, and open-source engineering surface.

providers.name: Dyndrite
providers.description: Dyndrite develops GPU-accelerated software for digital and additive manufacturing, focused on laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) and other metal 3D-printing processes. Its platform streamlines build preparation, materials development, process qualification, and production automation for industrial manufacturers, machine builders (OEMs), and software vendors. Products include Dyndrite LPBF Pro for end users and the Application Development Kit (ADK) for machine makers, exposing low-level toolpathing control (Vector and Raster Toolpathing APIs) plus a scriptable Python geometry engine. Dyndrite is backed by Amplify Partners and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an AI/ML and manufacturing automation company. It does not currently publish a public web/REST API, OpenAPI definition, or self-service developer portal; its APIs are embedded scripting and integration interfaces delivered inside its desktop software and ADK.

providers.name: Easyhealth
providers.description: EasyHealth is a Los Angeles-based value-based care company that partners with health plans, provider groups, and risk-bearing entities to deliver proactive, in-home and virtual clinical care to Medicare, Medicaid, and Health Exchange members across 40+ states. Its Preventative Care Platform combines a hybrid visit model (in-home medical assistants paired with virtual nurse practitioners), Health Information Exchange integration, and real-time data dashboards for health plans to close HEDIS/care gaps, complete annual wellness visits, run preventive screenings, and manage chronic conditions such as cardiovascular, respiratory, diabetes, kidney, and behavioral health. EasyHealth emphasizes reaching underserved and hard-to-reach populations, claiming roughly 40% member engagement versus traditional sub-10% rates. The company is backed by Anthemis and QED Investors and is profiled here as an API Evangelist network company. EasyHealth publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Effectiv
providers.description: Effectiv is a real-time fraud and risk decisioning platform for banks and fintechs, founded in 2021 and acquired by Socure in 2024 for approximately $136M. Its AI-driven decisioning engine and orchestration layer let risk teams automate decisions across the customer lifecycle, integrating 50+ third-party data and solution providers behind one developer-friendly API. The platform spans identity verification (KYC and Know-Your-Business KYB), payment and identity fraud controls across card, ACH, wire, check, and real-time payment rails, AML transaction monitoring, and credit underwriting, backed by a unified case-management workspace and client-side Device Intelligence SDKs for iOS and React Native.

providers.name: Elroy Air
providers.description: Elroy Air develops autonomous vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) cargo aircraft for defense, commercial, and rapid-response logistics. Its flagship Chaparral is a hybrid-electric aircraft designed to carry up to 300 pounds of cargo across roughly 300 miles with no crew onboard, taking off and landing vertically and cruising autonomously between points. Founded in 2016 and based in San Francisco, the company works with partners including FedEx, NASA, the U.S. Air Force, and Lockheed Martin, and was selected for the U.S. Department of Transportation eVTOL Integration Pilot Program. Elroy Air is a hardware and autonomy company; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched with identity and domain-security data.

providers.name: EnduroSat
providers.description: EnduroSat is a Sofia, Bulgaria-based satellite manufacturer and space service provider working to make space universally accessible by lowering the cost and complexity of accessing space data. The company builds CubeSat and SmallSat platforms (FRAME Max, FRAME L, FRAME S buses and 8U/12U/16U CubeSats), avionics and communication modules (X-Band SDR, S-Band and UHF transceivers, EPS power modules, solar panels, and antennas), and delivers end-to-end Space Service, SpaceOps, and SpaceDev offerings that take customers from idea to orbit in roughly six months. EnduroSat has deployed 100+ satellites with 3,500+ modules in operation, downlinked 500+ TB of data, and serves ~450 customers including NASA, ESA, and IBM Space. It maintains an open-source GitHub organization publishing Cubesat Space Protocol (CSP) implementations and NextGen ground-station and onboard API frameworks. Backed by Founders Fund and GV.

providers.name: Epocrates
providers.description: Epocrates is a mobile clinical reference application, part of athenahealth, relied on by healthcare professionals for more than 25 years to support point-of-care decisions. It provides a drug reference database, a drug-drug interaction checker, a pill identifier, clinical practice guidelines, medical calculators, and a herbs and supplements reference, with the premium epocrates+ subscription adding expanded content. Epocrates does not publish a public developer API or SDK; this profile captures the company's public web identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network. Sector: healthcare.

providers.name: Esperion Therapeutics
providers.description: Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: ESPR) is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing innovative medicines that lower LDL cholesterol and reduce cardiovascular risk. Its lead products are NEXLETOL (bempedoic acid) and NEXLIZET (bempedoic acid and ezetimibe), oral, once-daily, non-statin therapies indicated to lower elevated LDL-C in adults. As a life-sciences company, Esperion operates a corporate and scientific marketing web presence rather than a developer program; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched with verifiable company identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: ethealthcare
providers.description: ET Healthcare (ethealthcare.com.cn) is an in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) company founded in 2008 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with operations in China. It develops immunodiagnostic systems built on its proprietary "lab-on-a-tip" technology, delivering central-lab-grade immunoassay performance in a near-patient setting. Its flagship Pylon platform (Pylon 3D automated immunoassay analyzers plus single-use Pylon Test Strips) runs cardiac, inflammation, fertility, infectious-disease, and tumor assays on whole blood, plasma, and serum. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners and other investors, ET Healthcare is a medical-device / clinical-laboratory instrument maker and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Flipp (Wishabi)
providers.description: Flipp (operated by Wishabi) is a Toronto-based retail media and digital merchandising company that connects retailers, brands, and consumers through shoppable digital experiences. Its consumer app aggregates weekly digital flyers, coupons, and shopping lists from more than 2,000 retailers including Walmart, Kroger, Home Depot, CVS, and Publix, helping shoppers find local deals and clip offers to loyalty cards. For businesses, Flipp runs a retail media platform - content collection, curation, and distribution of "full fidelity" shoppable merchandising experiences reaching over 100 million high-intent households - plus sponsored video and shoppable-item ad solutions built on 400B+ intent-based shopping signals. Flipp publishes no public developer API or portal; this profile captures the company's public web, merchant, and open-source (github.com/wishabi) surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Focal Systems
providers.description: Focal Systems is a San Francisco-based deep-learning company building the operating system for brick-and-mortar retail. Its platform combines proprietary shelf-mounted computer-vision cameras, real-time AI, and streaming data to digitize physical stores hourly — tracking on-shelf availability, out-of-stocks, planogram and price-tag compliance, shrink, and inventory. Products include Computer Vision cameras, Shelf AI, the Action Tool associate mobile app, and the Impact analytics dashboard, used by leading grocery and retail chains such as Walmart Canada to reduce waste, redeploy labor, and recover lost sales. Focal Systems is a Y Combinator and Uncork Capital-backed company and operates as an enterprise SaaS vendor; it does not publish a public self-serve developer API or SDK.

providers.name: Fractyl Health
providers.description: Fractyl Health, Inc. (Nasdaq: GUTS) is a clinical-stage metabolic therapeutics company developing treatments that target the root causes of type 2 diabetes and obesity rather than managing symptoms. Its lead product, Revita, is an outpatient endoscopic procedure that resurfaces the duodenal lining to address a driver of metabolic disease, and Rejuva is an early-stage pancreatic islet-cell gene therapy platform designed for durable, one-time metabolic remission. The company is headquartered in Massachusetts and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and General Catalyst. Fractyl publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks its corporate, product, and investor web presence.

providers.name: Freeform
providers.description: Freeform is an AI-native advanced manufacturing company founded by former SpaceX engineers, building a network of autonomous factories that sense, learn, predict, and control metal formation for high-performance metal additive manufacturing (metal 3D printing). Freeform integrates hardware, sensors, controls, and software to move parts from prototype to full-scale production for aerospace, defense, aviation, advanced energy, consumer electronics, and automotive customers. It is a physical-AI / advanced-manufacturing business rather than a software API platform, so as of this profile it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: FreshPlanet
providers.description: FreshPlanet Inc. is a New York City based mobile game developer, headquartered at 200 Hudson St, New York, NY 10013, best known for the music trivia franchise SongPop. The studio builds free-to-play mobile entertainment titles for iOS and Android, combining licensed music catalogs, social multiplayer play, and live events. FreshPlanet is a portfolio company of Uncork Capital. As a consumer game studio it does not operate a public developer program or API: it exposes only a marketing site, player support via a Zendesk help center, and standard legal surfaces (Terms of Use and Privacy Policy). This profile captures the studio's real public web and legal footprint for the API Evangelist network; there is no OpenAPI, SDK, or agent surface to enrich because the company publishes none.

providers.name: Funcom
providers.description: Funcom is a Norwegian video-game developer and publisher founded in 1993, headquartered in Oslo with additional studios in Raleigh (North Carolina), Lisbon, and Bucharest. It is best known for online, open-world, and survival titles including Dune: Awakening, Conan Exiles, Age of Conan, and The Secret World / Secret World Legends, alongside published titles such as Metal: Hellsinger, Aloft, Dune: Spice Wars, and Mutant Year Zero. Funcom is majority-owned by Tencent. It was surfaced as a Northzone portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer API surface, so this profile captures company identity, legal/support links, and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: FundersClub
providers.description: FundersClub is an online venture capital firm and investment platform based in San Francisco that lets accredited investors browse, evaluate, and invest in curated early-stage technology startups through professionally managed, single-purpose venture funds. Founders apply for funding and, once selected, gain access to capital, a partner network, and post-investment support. Backed by a16z, Felicis, and Y Combinator, FundersClub pioneered the online VC model. The company publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks its web, identity, and domain-security surface for the network.

providers.name: Futuredontics
providers.description: Futuredontics is the parent company of 1-800-DENTIST, a dental marketing and patient-acquisition business with more than 38 years serving dental practices across the United States. Its core offerings are PatientLeads, a pay-per-call program that routes live new-patient calls (with AI-powered call screening) to practices on month-to-month terms, and PatientActivator, patient-engagement software that automates appointment reminders, review requests, and reputation management. The company reports serving 5,000+ practices, handling roughly 70,000 calls per month, and scheduling over two million appointments through its platform. Futuredontics is a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Fuze Health
providers.description: Fuze Health is a technology-powered healthcare company delivering comprehensive, patient-focused care at scale across three business units: FuzeRx (digital pharmacy and prescription fulfillment with patient engagement tools), Fuze Services (diagnostics, screening, clinical and genomics programs), and Fuze Technologies (proprietary healthcare software and consulting for partners). The company operates a unified digital platform that simplifies access, strengthens engagement, and supports patients throughout their care journeys, and reports serving 22 million patients, delivering 31 million prescriptions, and reaching 90% payer coverage. Fuze Health is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. No public API or developer surface is published at this time.

providers.name: Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals (Shanghai Stock Exchange: 603087) is a Chinese biopharmaceutical company founded in 1998, specializing in the research, development, production, and commercialization of recombinant insulin analogs and injection devices for diabetes care, alongside a growing oncology pipeline and medical devices. Its products, including insulin glargine injections and prefilled pen injectors, are marketed across 23 countries with 19 products launched globally and clinical trials running in 10 countries. Gan & Lee does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: General Medicine
providers.description: General Medicine is a consumer digital-health company building a healthcare storefront for the age of AI, making it delightfully simple to access the best care in the world. Founded by PillPack alumni Elliot Cohen and TJ Parker with CEO Ashwin Muralidharan, the company operates as part telehealth provider, part medical concierge, and part marketplace for browsing and booking medical care, prescriptions, and diagnostic lab testing across more than 35 specialties with board-certified clinicians, transparent pricing, and no waitlists. It is backed by roughly $32M led by Matrix Partners, with BoxGroup, Founder Collective, VXI Capital, and JSL Health Capital participating. General Medicine runs a consumer web storefront (generalmedicine.co) and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Glyphic Biotechnologies
providers.description: Glyphic Biotechnologies is a Berkeley, California proteomics company founded in 2021 that is developing ProSE (Protein Sequencing by Expansion) — a de novo, high-throughput, single-molecule protein sequencing technology designed to discriminate all 20 amino acids and their post-translational modifications. The company aims to make massively parallel proteome sequencing broadly accessible for drug discovery and biological research, and is backed by Wing Venture Capital. Glyphic currently publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Goop
providers.description: Goop is a modern lifestyle and wellness brand founded in 2008 by Gwyneth Paltrow, launched from her kitchen as a weekly email newsletter and grown into a content-and-commerce company spanning editorial journalism, e-commerce, and its own product lines across beauty, skincare, supplements, food, fashion, home, and travel. Goop operates goop.com as a curated online shop and digital magazine, publishes wellness and beauty guidance, and sells goop-branded product lines (including goopglow and goop Beauty) alongside a curated marketplace of third-party brands. It is a privately held company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners (Series C, 2017) and other investors. Goop does not currently operate a public developer program or API; this profile captures its company identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GrowXCD
providers.description: GrowXCD (GrowXCD Finance Private Limited) is an RBI-registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) headquartered in Chennai, India, focused on accelerating business growth for the small businesses and self-employed customers that form the backbone of India's economy. Its lending products include Grow Shubam small-ticket mortgage loans, Loan Against Property (LAP) secured lending, and unsecured loans up to Rs 25 lakh with tenures of 12 to 60 months, delivered through a minimal-documentation digital process with swift approvals and repayment via eMandate or NACH auto-debit. GrowXCD is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures. It publishes a consumer website and statutory policy documents but does not currently expose a public developer portal, API, or SDKs.

providers.name: Hula Earth
providers.description: Hula Earth is a Munich-based environmental technology company providing real-time biodiversity monitoring. It combines solar-powered, maintenance-free Hula BioT IoT sensors with AI-powered species detection, satellite-based Earth Observation, and the Hula Platform dashboard so organizations can monitor, manage, and report on biodiversity at landscape scale. Hula Earth serves renewables (solar and wind), agriculture, nature conservation, and urban development, turning environmental uncertainty into operational confidence and compliance-ready reporting.

providers.name: HumanCo
providers.description: HumanCo is a mission-driven consumer packaged goods and wellness holding company that builds and acquires better-for-you food, beverage, and lifestyle brands made with real, clean ingredients and free of seed oils and highly processed inputs. Its portfolio spans brands and concepts such as Against the Grain (gluten-free foods), True Food Kitchen (health-focused restaurants), and Grove Collaborative (sustainable home and personal care). Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. HumanCo operates a marketing and e-commerce web presence but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or technical developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Ibotta
providers.description: Ibotta is a Denver-based consumer technology company (NYSE: IBTA) that operates a cash-back rewards platform and the Ibotta Performance Network (IPN), a digital promotions and retail-media network. Consumers earn real cash back on everyday purchases in-store and online through the Ibotta mobile app, browser extension, and connected retailer loyalty accounts. For brands, agencies, and retailers, the Ibotta Performance Network distributes digital rebates and promotions to more than 200 million shoppers across Ibotta's owned properties and a network of partner retailers and publishers (including Walmart, Dollar General, Family Dollar, and others). Ibotta was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GGV Capital. It does not currently publish a public, self-serve developer API or OpenAPI specification; its integrations are managed B2B partner onboarding into the Ibotta Performance Network.

providers.name: IDEXX
providers.description: IDEXX Laboratories is a global leader in veterinary diagnostics, offering reference laboratory testing, in-house analyzers (IDEXX VetLab Station), diagnostic imaging (IDEXX Web PACS), and practice management software (Cornerstone, Neo, and ezyVet, which IDEXX acquired in 2021). IDEXX connects the practice to its diagnostic ecosystem through VetConnect PLUS - a diagnostic results and ordering platform - and through partner integration APIs for Web PACS imaging and reference/in-house lab results. These developer integrations are partner-gated - the developer portal at developer.vetconnectplus.com requires an authenticated login, and partner access is granted only after an approved IDEXX integration request. Web PACS API Partner integrations authenticate with OAuth 2.0-style credentials (Client ID, Client Secret, and Grant Type) issued by IDEXX customer support. IDEXX does not publish an open, unauthenticated API reference, OpenAPI description, or pricing; the logical APIs below are modeled from IDEXX's public product and integration pages, not from a public endpoint reference.

providers.name: Ike Robotics (Nuro)
providers.description: Nuro is an autonomous-vehicle technology company that builds the Nuro Driver, an AI-first self-driving system it now licenses to automakers and mobility providers rather than operating its own delivery fleet. Nuro acquired the assets and team of Ike Robotics, an autonomous-trucking startup, folding that self-driving expertise into its Level 4 autonomy platform. The company partners with firms such as Uber and Lucid to deploy robotaxis and other autonomous applications, and pairs the Nuro Driver with the Nuro Toolkit for validation and deployment. Nuro operates a B2B licensing model and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures.

providers.name: Indrive
providers.description: inDrive is a global ride-hailing, delivery, and urban-services platform built around a peer-to-peer, name-your-price model in which passengers propose a fare and nearby drivers accept, counter, or decline it directly. Founded in 2012 by Arsen Tomsky in Yakutsk, Russia and now headquartered in Mountain View, California, the company operates across roughly 48 countries and more than 1,000 cities, with over 400 million app downloads. Beyond city rides it offers intercity transport, courier and freight delivery, on-demand task services, and driver lending. inDrive was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bond Capital and General Catalyst. inDrive does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal; its GitHub organization hosts internal engineering frameworks and an engineering handbook rather than external API definitions.

providers.name: InfiniGods
providers.description: InfiniGods is a gaming studio building fun, free-to-play, Web3-powered mobile games centered around ancient mythologies. Its titles — Immortal Siege, King of Destiny, and InfiniMerge — share interoperable gaming assets, items, power-ups, and currencies that span the InfiniGods Universe (IGU). Players collect blockchain assets such as the Elder Gods (a 4,488-piece Gen 0 NFT collection that unlocks abilities and boosts scoring across all titles) and the InfiniPass VIP membership (early access, bonus play, exclusive NFT drops, and in-game boosts). The company is backed by Pantera Capital. InfiniGods is a consumer game studio with no public developer/API program; this profile captures its public web, legal, community, and code-org surface.

providers.name: Inofab
providers.description: Inofab Health (a Clario company) is a digital respiratory health company headquartered in Ankara, Turkey, building connected spirometry and inhaler devices with cloud software for the home-based and clinical management of chronic respiratory conditions including asthma, COPD, and cystic fibrosis. Its product line spans the SpiroHome Personal portable ultrasonic spirometer, the SpiroClinic Pro and SpiroClinic Compact clinical-grade spirometers with EHR integration, the SpiroCloud web dashboard that collects and analyzes data from all connected SpiroHome and SpiroClinic devices, and the SpiroHaler smart inhaler attachments for medication adherence. Inofab was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it does not currently publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Insmed
providers.description: Insmed Incorporated is a NASDAQ-listed (INSM) global biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing therapies for people with serious and rare diseases. Its approved medicines include ARIKAYCE (amikacin liposome inhalation suspension) for refractory Mycobacterium avium complex lung disease and BRINSUPRI (brensocatib) for bronchiectasis. The company advances a pipeline across pulmonary, inflammatory, and rare-disease indications and runs early-innovation science platforms in gene therapy with targeted delivery, protein deimmunization, RNA end-joining, and synthetic rescue. Insmed operates patient-facing surfaces such as a clinical-trials portal and an investigator-initiated-research program, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio lead and enriched with identity and domain-security data only.

providers.name: Isar Aerospace
providers.description: Isar Aerospace is a European space launch service provider founded in 2018 and headquartered in Ottobrunn near Munich, Germany. The company designs and manufactures Spectrum, a two-stage orbital small-lift launch vehicle capable of carrying up to 1,000 kg to low Earth orbit or up to 700 kg to Sun-synchronous orbit, using liquid oxygen and propane propulsion. Spectrum is fully developed and produced in-house with automated, scalable manufacturing including additive manufacturing and carbon-composite structures. Isar Aerospace offers dedicated, lead, and rideshare launch services for small and medium satellites and constellations. Backed by more than EUR 500 million in private capital from investors including Earlybird and HV Capital, the company employs over 400 people from nearly 50 nations and conducted the inaugural Spectrum test flight from Andoya Spaceport, Norway, on 30 March 2025.

providers.name: Iterative Health
providers.description: Iterative Health is a Boston-based clinical research and healthcare technology company operating a global network of community-based clinical research sites that connect trial sponsors with providers to accelerate enrollment and expand patient access to investigational therapies. Its therapeutic focus spans gastroenterology, hepatology, obesity, and cardiology, and its SKOUT AI tooling (rooted in the company's computer-vision work in GI endoscopy) helps sites and sponsors run research more efficiently. Backed by GV and Obvious Ventures and funded through a $77M Series C, the company partners with provider networks including GI Alliance, One GI, and US Heart & Vascular. As of this enrichment pass Iterative Health publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this profile captures its public company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Joblocal
providers.description: Joblocal GmbH is a Munich-based German recruiting technology company and a part of the Funke Mediengruppe. With more than fifteen years of experience it operates a network of 41 regional job portals across Germany and, together with the Funke network, runs data-driven, hyper-regional recruiting campaigns tailored to position, location and budget for over 1,000 client companies. Its "Talent.KI" product applies artificial intelligence to candidate sourcing and regional labor-market analysis, surfacing employers where job seekers actually search. Joblocal was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable API artifacts at this time.

providers.name: Juleb
providers.description: Juleb is a Saudi Arabia-based pharma-tech and retail software company providing an integrated cloud platform for the health, retail, and distribution sectors. Its suite spans accounting and financial management, inventory and warehouse management, sales force automation (SFA), point of sale (POS), Rx e-prescription, e-commerce, and DSCSA regulatory compliance. Juleb connects to Saudi compliance systems (ZATCA/Fatoora, RSD, GS1, Wasfaty), e-commerce channels (Salla, Shopify, HungerStation), payment providers (Geidea, Alhamrani), and ERPs (Microsoft Dynamics). Founded by Yousuf Jamjoom and backed by 500 Global, Juleb exposes a REST API (documented at docs.juleb.com) covering inventory, point of sale, prescriptions, and partner/company resources.

providers.name: Junglee Games
providers.description: Junglee Games is a skill-based online gaming company founded in 2012 by Ankush Gera, operating as an independent subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, which acquired a majority stake in 2021 in a deal valuing the company at more than $440 million. Headquartered in Gurugram with a studio in Bengaluru, the company builds and operates consumer real-money and casual gaming apps for a base of over 150 million users, with flagship titles including Junglee Rummy, the Howzat fantasy cricket and football platform, Carrom Stars, and Junglee Poker. The company positions trust, safety, and fairness as engineering priorities. Junglee Games is a consumer gaming provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documented API program; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and probed security posture for the API Evangelist network. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: KiddoWear
providers.description: KiddoWear (now operating as Kiddo Health) is a pediatric healthcare technology company that offers a connected care platform for capturing and sharing health data for children with physical and behavioral health challenges. The platform combines biometric tracking of 12+ biomarkers (respiration, heart rate, stress scores, and sleep), family journaling of behavior and health status between visits, educational family resources, care navigation that integrates with medical records and clinical workflows, and a provider dashboard that surfaces insights and real-time health trends. Kiddo Health serves behavioral health conditions such as ADHD and autism spectrum disorder and metabolic conditions such as childhood obesity and diabetes, bridging gaps between families, providers, and care teams across health plans, health systems, and employers. A Techstars-backed portfolio company added to the API Evangelist network. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Leucine
providers.description: Leucine is an AI-powered software platform for pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality, and laboratory operations, helping drug manufacturers plan, execute, and optimize every batch. The platform spans a Manufacturing Execution System (batch execution, batch intelligence, production logbooks, batch release, shop floor monitor, material management), a Quality Management System (AI Investigator, FDA Tracker, cleaning validation, market complaints, change control, CAPA, supplier quality, audit and deviation management), and a Laboratory Execution System (environmental monitoring, instrument logbooks, QC planning). Leucine also publishes FDA compliance research including 483 analysis and investigator profiles. As of 2026 the company is migrating its web presence from leucinetech.com and leucine.io to leucine.ai. Leucine is an enterprise SaaS vendor and does not publish a public developer API program, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Loctax
providers.description: Loctax is a collaborative tax compliance, risk, and governance platform built for global in-house tax teams. Founded in 2020 and based in Gent, Belgium, its Global Tax Intelligence Platform lets teams ask any tax question grounded in their own company data and IBFD's authoritative tax content spanning 220+ jurisdictions, then act on the answer with workflow, compliance-monitoring, risk, and controversy-management tooling. Loctax is backed by Index Ventures, Cavalry Ventures, and Seedcamp, and in 2026 was acquired by Tax Systems to build a combined EMEA tax-technology platform. Loctax is a closed enterprise SaaS product with no public developer API, portal, or specification at the time of this profile.

providers.name: Lolli
providers.description: Lolli is a bitcoin and cash-back rewards company founded in 2018 by CEO Alex Adelman, on a mission to make bitcoin accessible to everyone. Through a browser extension, website, and mobile app, Lolli gives shoppers a percentage of their purchase back in bitcoin or cash when they shop online and in-store at 25,000+ merchants including Adidas, Microsoft, Ulta, and Kroger. Merchants pay Lolli for driving sales, and Lolli shares that commission with users as rewards paid into their Lolli wallet. The company reports having distributed over $10 million in bitcoin rewards and onboarded thousands of people into bitcoin for the first time. Lolli is a consumer product; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of version-one-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Microhealth
providers.description: Microhealth is a Y Combinator (S15) digital-health company building digital therapeutics and connected patient-provider networks for people living with rare bleeding disorders such as hemophilia and for sickle cell disease. Its products let patients track, manage, and share their treatment journey while giving clinicians real-time monitoring between visits, and it aggregates anonymized real-world evidence for life-science and pharmaceutical research. Products include Microhealth Bleeding Disorders (patient) and Rare Bleeding Disorders HCP (clinician dashboard), Microhealth SCD and SCD HCP for sickle cell disease, and life-science research tooling. The company validates interventions through clinical studies toward regulatory clearance as Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). Its hemophilia network is reported to cover roughly a third of US patients and providers in the specialty, with pharmaceutical clients including Sanofi, Bayer, Novo Nordisk, Biogen, and Roche. Microhealth is a patient- and clinician-facing application platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Modak
providers.description: Modak (Modak Makers) is a US consumer fintech that offers a family money-management app built around a free Visa debit card for kids and teens. Parents can assign chores and automate allowance, set savings goals with reward boosts, and use co-parenting tools, gift links, ATM access, bill splitting, and spending controls such as instant alerts, card freeze, and biometric security. Kids earn MBX reward points through daily steps and challenges that convert to pocket money, so they learn to spend, save, and manage money in real life. Modak is delivered as a mobile consumer application and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. Backed by GGV Capital.

providers.name: Modicus Prime
providers.description: Modicus Prime builds an AI Management System (AIMS) — enterprise software that gives pharmaceutical companies and CDMOs AI audit readiness through data, model, and control management. Just as a QMS manages quality and a LIMS manages laboratories, AIMS manages the AI lifecycle: AI inventory, validation evidence, datasets and model versions, risk guardrails, technical change history, decision records, traceability, and lifecycle performance monitoring. It integrates with existing QMS and data-science tooling to keep GxP AI systems compliant with FDA, EMA, and other health-authority expectations. Modicus Prime is Techstars-backed and is trusted by top-50 pharma companies.

providers.name: mojiworks
providers.description: Mojiworks is a UK-based social games studio, backed by Balderton Capital, that is pioneering a game genre it calls MuGC (Multi-User Generative Creation) — living, collaborative worlds that communities and AI systems build together. Its released titles include Ready Chef Go, Trivia Party, Chef Showdown and Hatch Cats, and it is building its first MuGC world as a persistent, community-shaped city. The company publishes a public AI Ethics Policy committing to licensed training data, environmental accountability, human oversight and content-safety controls. Mojiworks does not currently expose a public developer platform, API, or SDK; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record and enrichment lead.

providers.name: Much Better Adventures
providers.description: Much Better Adventures is a B Corp certified adventure travel company that runs 250+ solo-friendly, expert-led outdoor group trips across the world's trails, rivers, coasts and mountains, matching travellers with certified local guides and hosts. It is a consumer-facing booking platform with financial protection via ABTOT/ABTA/ATOL and contributes 5% of every booking to its foundation for conservation. Surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; an enrichment pass found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Nimbus Health
providers.description: Nimbus Health is a technology-enabled network of outpatient pulmonary care clinics treating chronic respiratory disease. Founded in 2022, it acquires and unifies established pulmonary practices onto a shared clinical and operational platform, operating eight clinics across Arizona, Georgia, and South Carolina and serving more than thirty thousand patients with care for COPD, asthma, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary fibrosis, bronchiectasis, sleep apnea, and chronic cough. It is backed by 8VC, 2048 Ventures, and General Catalyst. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Niramai
providers.description: NIRAMAI Health Analytix is a Bangalore, India based deep-tech healthcare company that develops AI-powered, radiation-free breast cancer screening solutions. Its core product, Thermalytix, uses machine learning and deep learning to analyze thermal images of the chest for early-stage tumor detection, complemented by the FDA-cleared SMILE-100 thermal imaging device and the Mythri mobile screening service for primary healthcare settings. The company reports 40+ patents, 55+ clinical publications, and 500,000+ women screened across 22+ countries. Backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass, Niramai publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nonnatech
providers.description: Nonnatech is a New York-based remote patient monitoring (RPM) and virtual health company that provides HIPAA-secured technology and clinical services for healthcare providers. Its platform integrates biometric sensors and passive home devices to deliver real-time analytics, chronic condition management, and population health programs across hospitals, health systems, physician practices, payers, ACOs, home care, long-term care, and senior living communities. Nonnatech offers turnkey device ordering, EHR data integration, and optional clinical monitoring, with no upfront costs to providers and roughly 30-day implementation. Nonnatech is a 500 Global portfolio company. It does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Opolskie Open Data
providers.description: Opolskie Open Data is a regional government open-data portal for Poland running DKAN.

providers.name: Overjet
providers.description: Overjet is a dental AI platform that applies FDA-cleared computer vision to dental radiographs (bitewings, periapicals, panoramics, and CBCT) to detect, outline, and quantify oral health conditions - caries, calculus, bone level and bone loss, periapical radiolucencies (PARLs), and anatomical structures - for dental providers, DSOs, and insurance payers. Overjet is not a self-serve public API. Its AI is delivered as OEM/partner integrations embedded into imaging systems and practice management software (Open Dental, Dentrix, Dentrix Ascend/Enterprise, Eaglesoft, Oryx, CareStack, and others) via connector software and DICOM image routing, plus payer-side products for insurance verification and claim review (ReviewPASS). Any programmatic access is arranged privately under a partner or enterprise agreement; there is no public developer portal or published API reference as of this catalog entry. The APIs listed below are logical, honestly-modeled surfaces (endpointsModeled) representing the capabilities Overjet exposes to integration partners, not documented public endpoints.

providers.name: Paraglide
providers.description: Paraglide is a British-Swedish AI company building autonomous agents that automate accounts receivable for high-volume B2B finance teams. Its agents handle two-way billing communication across the order-to-cash lifecycle: answering customer billing questions, chasing overdue invoices, resolving disputes and deductions, running collections, operating a supplier portal, and applying cash — integrating with ERPs, CRMs, and billing software to cut Days Sales Outstanding and improve cash flow. Founded in 2025 by Rasmus Areskoug and Andreas Astrom with offices in London and Malmo, Paraglide raised a $5M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and DN Capital in January 2026. As of this profile the company is a product/agent platform with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: PerfectStay
providers.description: PerfectStay is a French online travel company that sells curated flight-plus-hotel packages, all-inclusive stays, guided tours, city breaks and standalone flights, hotels, activities and transfers, marketed around a best-price guarantee (refunding twice any price difference), trip protection and 24/7 customer support, with installment payment options (2x/4x). Founded in Paris and backed by Partech, it also powers private, brand-operated travel-club sale sites. The company exposes no public developer platform, API, SDK or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web and security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Photoneo
providers.description: Photoneo is a Slovak (Bratislava, founded 2013) machine-vision company and a global pioneer of high-resolution structured-light 3D measurement. Its flagship products are the PhoXi 3D Scanner family and the MotionCam-3D, a parallel structured-light camera that captures moving scenes in real-time 3D, together with AI-enabled software such as Bin Picking Studio, Locator, and Palletizing for robotic automation. Rather than a hosted web/REST API, Photoneo exposes a developer surface through the PhoXi Control software and its official C++, C#, and Python device APIs, GenICam/GigE Vision standard connectivity, TCP/IP robot interfaces (UR, ABB, FANUC, Staubli, Mitsubishi, Kawasaki, Yaskawa), and a set of BSD-licensed example repositories on GitHub. Documentation lives in the Photoneo Knowledge Base (docs.photoneo.com) and the 3D scanning wiki. Photoneo (now part of the Brightpick Group) was acquired by Zebra Technologies.

providers.name: Popular (Banco Popular)
providers.description: Popular, Inc. (NASDAQ: BPOP), operating as Banco Popular, is a publicly traded financial holding company founded in 1893 and headquartered in Hato Rey, San Juan, Puerto Rico. It is the largest bank in Puerto Rico and operates through two chartered depository segments: Banco Popular de Puerto Rico (BPPR), serving Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Popular Bank (formerly Banco Popular North America), a New York state-chartered commercial bank serving mainland U.S. markets including New York, New Jersey, and Florida. Popular is FDIC-insured and regulated as a U.S. bank holding company. On its open-finance and API posture, Popular does not publish a first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specifications for its U.S. institutions (popular.com); consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is made available indirectly through third-party data aggregators such as Plaid, Tink, and Finicity rather than a direct bank API. This identity record reflects that honest reality — an aggregator-only access model with no documented first-party API surface, FDX membership, or published CFPB Section 1033 data-access program. (Note: the separate apiportal.popularenlinea.com open-banking portal belongs to Banco Popular Dominicano / Grupo Popular, a distinct Dominican Republic company, not to Popular, Inc.)

providers.name: Probably Genetic
providers.description: Probably Genetic is a healthcare company focused on rare disease diagnosis through genetic testing. It offers free targeted genetic testing programs for specific rare conditions (including alpha-mannosidosis, cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis, GRN-FTD, and SYNGAP1-related disorder), insurance-billed testing paired with genetic counselors, at-home saliva/cheek-swab collection kits, and physician-ordered genetic counseling. The platform has served more than 200,000 patients and partners with 50+ patient advocacy groups to advance rare disease research. This is a consumer-facing healthcare provider with no public API or developer program surface.

providers.name: Push Doctor
providers.description: Push Doctor is a UK telehealth company offering video consultations with licensed UK GPs via smartphone, describing itself as the UK's first platform to provide video doctor consultations on mobile. It serves both NHS patients and private paying customers, covering online GP appointments, digital prescriptions, referrals and follow-up care. Headquartered in Manchester and backed by Partech, Push Doctor operates as a consumer-facing telemedicine service; no public developer API, developer portal, or SDK surface was found during enrichment probes.

providers.name: Quero Educação
providers.description: Quero Educação is a Brazilian education-technology company that operates a marketplace connecting students with higher-education institutions across Brazil. Its flagship product Quero Bolsa lets students compare colleges, courses and schools with price transparency and enroll online at discounted tuition, while a suite of institution-facing products — Nota Quero (online entrance exams), Matrícula Digital (digital enrollment), Quero Pago (tuition payments) and Quero Analytics (data intelligence) — helps partner schools fill seats and manage admissions. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. It maintains a private GitHub organization and a public engineering blog on Medium, but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or published API documentation at this time; this profile captures its public identity, domain-security posture, and commercial/legal surfaces.

providers.name: Qvin
providers.description: Qvin is a women's health diagnostics company that develops the Q-Pad, described as the first and only FDA-cleared diagnostic menstrual pad, enabling non-invasive at-home health screening from menstrual blood. The company analyzes collected samples in its CLIA-certified laboratory to test biomarkers for conditions such as diabetes (A1c), and is researching screening for cervical cancer, endometriosis, sexually transmitted infections, and uterine fibroids. Qvin operates as a consumer and clinical diagnostics provider rather than a developer platform, and does not currently publish a public API, SDKs, or developer documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Version One Ventures.

providers.name: Rabbit
providers.description: Rabbit Inc. is a consumer technology company building AI-powered devices, best known for the Rabbit R1, a $199 handheld AI companion with industrial design by Teenage Engineering. The R1 runs rabbitOS and centers on a Large Action Model (LAM) that automates tasks across operating systems and applications (DLAM), alongside features like the Magic Camera, voice recording with transcription, and vibe-coded "creations." Rabbit is a portfolio company of a16z. As of this profile, Rabbit is a consumer hardware and device company with no publicly documented developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its public surface is a marketing site, support center, blog, and newsroom.

providers.name: Rentomojo
providers.description: Rentomojo is India's largest tech-driven, full-stack direct-to-consumer furniture and appliance rental platform, converting ownership into flexible monthly subscriptions. Customers rent beds, sofas, wardrobes, refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, water purifiers and other home essentials on plans from roughly three to thirty-six months, with delivery, installation, maintenance, relocation and upgrades handled in-house. Per its March 2026 draft red herring prospectus the company operates across 22 Indian cities with 227,511 live subscribers and 1,688 in-house technicians, carpenters and painters. Backed by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network from VC portfolio data; this pass found no public developer API, SDK or documentation surface.

providers.name: Ritual
providers.description: Ritual is a direct-to-consumer health and wellness brand that sells traceable, scientifically-formulated vitamins and nutritional supplements, best known for its Essential for Women multivitamin, prenatal and postnatal formulas, and protein products. The company emphasizes a "clean label" approach with a visible, traceable supply chain and university-backed clinical studies, sold primarily through a subscription model on ritual.com. As of this enrichment pass Ritual operates as a consumer e-commerce business and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rosebud
providers.description: Rosebud is an AI-powered journaling application for personal growth, combining journaling, habit-building, and emotional support in one experience. Users write or speak entries and receive conversational AI feedback, long-term pattern recognition, guided modes (including Internal Family Systems), automated weekly insight reports, and voice journaling, with end-to-end encryption for privacy. It is available on iOS, Android, and the web. Rosebud is a consumer product with no public API, SDK, or developer platform; it is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Initialized Capital, and Khosla Ventures.

providers.name: Saber
providers.description: Saber is a decentralized automated market maker (AMM) on the Solana blockchain, optimized for trading and providing liquidity between mean-reverting assets such as stablecoins and wrapped or pegged tokens. Its StableSwap program delivers low-slippage swaps and capital-efficient liquidity pools. Saber does not expose a REST/HTTP API; developers integrate through its on-chain StableSwap program using first-party TypeScript SDKs (the @saberhq/* packages on npm) and Rust crates (crates.io) that construct and submit Solana transactions. The project also maintains open-source Solana tooling, an asset/pool registry, and on-chain governance. Saber was surfaced as a portfolio company of Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: Sana Biotechnology *
providers.description: Sana Biotechnology is a clinical-stage biotechnology company (NASDAQ: SANA) focused on engineering cells as medicines. Its platforms repair or control genes inside cells and replace missing or damaged cells to address the underlying causes of disease, with drug candidates spanning type 1 diabetes, B-cell cancers, and B-cell-mediated autoimmune disorders. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass Sana publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation; this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Santander US
providers.description: Santander Bank, N.A. (santanderbank.com) is the US retail and commercial banking subsidiary of Spain's Banco Santander S.A., headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It is a nationally chartered bank (National Association, regulated by the OCC) operating a branch network across the Northeast US (Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Delaware), which positions it as a super-regional bank.
