Unlike UK and Australian institutions bound by mandated open-banking contracts, and unlike US banks such as Capital One or Chase that publish first-party developer portals, Santander Bank N.A. exposes no public, first-party developer API for its US retail franchise: developer.santanderbank.com does not resolve, and the site publishes no developers/API/open-banking pages. Consumer-permissioned data access in the US is available today through aggregators rather than a direct API — Plaid supports "Santander - Personal" (Assets, Auth, Balance and Transactions). Santander's UK developer portal (developer.santander.co.uk) and the group's Corporate & Investment Banking API marketplace (apimarket.santandercib.com) are operated by separate legal entities and are not the US retail bank's surface. This record is an honest identity profile of a super-regional bank whose US open-finance posture is aggregator-mediated, with no documented first-party developer program.

providers.name: Security Service Federal Credit Union
providers.description: Security Service Federal Credit Union (SSFCU), headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, is a member-owned, not-for-profit financial cooperative federally chartered and insured by the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA). It is one of the largest credit unions in the United States, serving members across Texas, Colorado, and Utah with consumer and business banking, deposit accounts, credit cards, auto and mortgage lending, and investment services through branches, online banking, and mobile apps. Its open-finance posture is the norm for a US credit union: there is no first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specification, and no public FDX or CFPB Section 1033 data-access API is documented. Consumer-permissioned account data is reachable only indirectly through third-party aggregators, and any API capability is delivered through its core banking provider rather than a self-serve developer program.

providers.name: Semperis
providers.description: Semperis provides identity-first cybersecurity and disaster recovery for hybrid Active Directory, Entra ID, and Okta environments. Its platform prevents, detects, and responds to identity-based attacks and enables rapid recovery to a trusted state. Products include Directory Services Protector (AD/Entra ID threat prevention, detection, and response), Active Directory Forest Recovery, Disaster Recovery for Entra Tenant, Recovery for Okta, Lightning Intelligence security posture assessment, Delegation Manager, Migrator for AD, and the Ready1 crisis-response platform, alongside the free community tools Purple Knight and Forest Druid. Backed by Insight Partners, Semperis serves enterprises defending the identity attack surface. This profile was enriched from public sources; Semperis publishes no public developer/REST API surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Skillshare
providers.description: Skillshare is a New York City–based online learning community for creators, founded in 2010 by Michael Karnjanaprakorn and Malcolm Ong. The platform hosts thousands of on-demand video classes across creative disciplines — illustration, design, photography, animation, lettering, film, productivity, writing, and business — taught by working creators and industry professionals. Skillshare operates on a paid subscription model (Premium membership) that grants members unlimited access to the class catalog, project-based learning, and a discussion community where students submit class projects for feedback. The company has a teacher revenue-share program in which class creators are paid based on watch time and student enrollments, and runs Skillshare for Teams as a B2B offering for organizations to give employees access to the catalog. Skillshare does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, partner API, or SDK. The platform's programmatic surface is limited to internal web/mobile clients and an affiliate/marketing referral program; there is no documented developer portal, public webhook system, or third-party integration API for the Skillshare catalog, enrollments, watch-time, or teacher-payout data.

providers.name: Sleep Number
providers.description: Sleep Number Corporation (NASDAQ: SNBR) designs, manufactures, and retails smart adjustable-firmness beds and sleep-wellness products, sold through an omnichannel US retail model. Its Sleep Number 360 smart beds run the proprietary SleepIQ operating system, which captures biometric sleep data each night and returns actionable insights to improve sleep health. Sleep Number does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; the SleepIQ platform is a closed, undocumented backend consumed only by the first-party mobile and web apps. The community has reverse-engineered unofficial SleepIQ client libraries (Python, Go, PHP), but these are not first-party and are not endorsed by Sleep Number. This profile was surfaced as a legacy portfolio lead of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: SouthState Bank
providers.description: SouthState Bank, National Association is an OCC-chartered national commercial bank headquartered in Winter Haven, Florida, and the principal subsidiary of SouthState Bank Corporation (NASDAQ: SSB). Formed through the 2020 merger of South State Corporation and CenterState Bank and redomiciled to Florida in 2025, it holds roughly $67 billion in assets and operates across the Southeast, Texas, Colorado, and Virginia. Like most US regional banks, SouthState runs no public first-party developer portal and publishes no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger definitions. Consumer-permissioned data access is delivered through third-party aggregators rather than a direct API: the Open Banking Tracker records SouthState reachable via Plaid only, with no documented Financial Data Exchange (FDX) endpoint and no published CFPB Section 1033 data-access surface. Its open-finance posture is therefore aggregator-mediated, not a self-serve developer program.

providers.name: STAND+
providers.description: STAND+ is a Techstars-backed footwear company making biomechanically engineered "energy-recovery" shoes for people who spend long hours standing or walking - healthcare workers, frontline and workforce professionals, athletes, and everyday movers. Its proprietary midsole is designed to dissipate and disperse impact energy outward rather than returning it into the joints, which the company markets for fatigue and pain reduction. The product lineup includes the AntiGrav1, AntiGrav2, and AG3 recovery shoes, the Gales Pro and Gales Frontline workforce and healthcare lines, and standalone recovery insoles. STAND+ is APMA (American Podiatric Medical Association) certified and HSA/FSA eligible through a Truemed partnership. This is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand (standshoes.com) with no public developer API, SDK, or integration surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Tezbor, Inc.
providers.description: Tezbor is a Tashkent, Uzbekistan based courier and last-mile logistics company that automates the delivery of documents, parcels, and cargo across Uzbekistan. Beyond its consumer and business courier service, Tezbor operates a technology platform that exposes delivery ordering and tracking through an integration API, ready-made e-commerce plugins (WooCommerce, OpenCart, Magento), mobile apps, dashboards, and Telegram bots, so that any online store can automatically generate a Tezbor delivery order from each purchase. The company is backed by 500 Global, Activat, and StartupBase, and counts brands such as Beeline, Ozon, and OQ among its delivery clients.

providers.name: Transposon Therapeutics
providers.description: Transposon Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing transformational therapies for neurodegenerative and aging-related diseases driven by LINE-1 retrotransposon activity. Its lead asset, TPN-101 (censavudine), is a potent oral inhibitor of LINE-1 reverse transcriptase in late-stage development for progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP), amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) / frontotemporal dementia (FTD), and Alzheimer's disease. The pipeline also includes follow-on novel nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors (NRTIs) and Protein Kinase R inhibitors (PKRi) targeting pathways activated by LINE-1 and implicated in cognitive impairment. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found a corporate marketing website only and no public API, developer, or machine-readable surface.

providers.name: TurbineOne
providers.description: TurbineOne builds a frontline AI/ML platform that turns raw sensor data into real-time detection, classification, and targeting at the edge for defense and national-security missions. Its product suite spans Frontline Perception (edge computer vision on live sensor feeds), Frontline Command, Frontline Autonomy, a Model Hub for managing and deploying ML models, and EdgeWorks, a program that brings warfighters, mission teams, and engineers together to develop and validate mission capabilities for contested, disconnected environments. The company was founded on expertise in artificial intelligence, mesh networking, and sensing technology, and positions its work as "Responsible AI for our nation's heroes." It is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. TurbineOne publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity, GitHub organization, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Tyra Biosciences
providers.description: Tyra Biosciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company (NASDAQ: TYRA) based in Carlsbad, California, focused on developing next-generation precision medicines that address the emergence of tumor resistance and other challenges in existing treatment options. Tyra's proprietary in-house SNAP discovery platform combines advanced protein crystallography with structure-based drug design, producing full structural "SNAPshots" of the real-world interaction between a drug and its target in as little as seven days rather than weeks to months. This rapid, sequential structural iteration lets the team refine molecular designs to angstrom-level precision and design selective inhibitors intended to deliver deeper, more durable responses for patients, including in cancers where resistance mutations block first-generation drugs. Tyra was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. It is a therapeutics company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Ulta Beauty
providers.description: Ulta Beauty is the largest beauty retailer in the United States, offering cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products, and salon services through retail stores and online. The company operates over 1,400 stores across all 50 states and an e-commerce platform. Ulta Beauty does not currently offer a public developer API, but provides an affiliate program through Impact for publishers and content creators.

providers.name: Verdant Robotics
providers.description: Verdant Robotics is an agricultural robotics company building precision farming systems for specialty crop growers. Its flagship SharpShooter uses "Aim & Apply" technology - machine learning and computer vision that identify crops and weeds in real time, build a three-dimensional map of the field, and deliver microliter-precise applications directly onto weeds without contacting the crop, doing over 240 targeted applications per second. The Robotics-as-a- Service platform reduces herbicide use by up to 99% and manual labor costs by up to 85% across carrots, leafy greens, cabbage, onions, and grass seed and sod production. Founded by leaders from the self-driving vehicle industry and commercial agriculture, Verdant is backed by DCVC. This profile was surfaced as a DCVC portfolio company; Verdant publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation - its GitHub organization hosts robotics tooling and forks (cbuf message serialization, Jetson build scripts, YOLO/ultralytics forks) rather than a product API.

providers.name: Virtuo
providers.description: Virtuo (govirtuo.com) is a Paris-based, next-generation car rental company founded in 2015 and backed by Balderton Capital. It replaces the traditional rental counter with a mobile app: customers book, unlock, and return premium connected vehicles (Mercedes, BMW, Audi, Peugeot, Renault, Toyota, Volkswagen and others) entirely from their phone, with delivery options, free cancellation, and 24/7 support across 100+ locations in Europe. Virtuo also runs a "Virtuo for Business" corporate program and has committed to offsetting 100% of trips and electrifying its fleet by 2030. Virtuo does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface; this profile captures the company's public web properties and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vongi Health (芝兰健康)
providers.description: Vongi Health (芝兰健康, Hangzhou Zhilan Health Co., Ltd., also branded Slan Health) is a Qiming Venture Partners-backed Chinese digital therapeutics company founded in Hangzhou in 2015. Its hepatitis B mother-to-child transmission prevention digital therapeutic (小贝壳) was the first digital therapeutic certified by China's NMPA, and it also operates a sleep specialty (CBT-I) digital therapeutics platform and a DTx CDMO business covering product R&D, clinical research, regulatory registration, and commercial operations. The company publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: W. R. Grace
providers.description: W. R. Grace & Co. is a global producer of specialty chemicals and specialty materials, providing catalysts and process technologies to refining, petrochemical, and other manufacturers. Grace operates in two segments: Catalysts Technologies (fluid catalytic cracking catalysts, additives, and process technologies) and Materials Technologies (silica-based engineered materials for pharmaceutical, food, coatings, and industrial applications). Grace's Fine Chemical Manufacturing Services division provides active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) development and manufacturing for the pharmaceutical industry. W. R. Grace does not offer a public developer API for software integration.

providers.name: Wanderu
providers.description: Wanderu is a ground-travel metasearch and booking platform - a Kayak-style aggregator that lets travelers search, compare, and book intercity bus and train tickets (plus flights and ferries) across hundreds of carriers in North America and Europe, including Amtrak, Greyhound, FlixBus, Megabus, Peter Pan, VIA Rail, and Deutsche Bahn. Its routing technology stitches together multi-operator bus-and-train itineraries, and bookings are completed in-platform with carriers paying a percentage of each fare. Wanderu operates a private booking/search API and publishes no public developer program, SDKs, or OpenAPI; its public open-source presence is internal engineering tooling on GitHub (the redis-backed "bamboo" queuing system). Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Wellframe
providers.description: Wellframe is a digital health management and member engagement company, now part of HealthEdge, serving health plans and payers. Its platform combines care management, member engagement, and advocacy tooling to help health plans build trusted relationships with members through a mobile app and a clinician-facing dashboard. Wellframe does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; its integrations are delivered as part of enterprise health-plan implementations rather than a self-serve API program.

providers.name: Welly
providers.description: Welly is a health and wellness brand and Certified B Corporation that designs first aid and personal care products, best known for its patterned Flex Fabric adhesive bandages, first aid kits, hydrocolloid blemish and bug-bite patches, and antiseptic wipes. Founded to make caring for everyday cuts, scrapes, and playtime injuries more joyful, Welly sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at getwelly.com and via national retail partners. As a consumer packaged-goods company it publishes no public developer API or documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: Wiser
providers.description: Wiser Solutions is a retail and commerce intelligence company that provides pricing, market, and MAP (minimum advertised price) intelligence to brands and retailers. Its platform collects online and in-store data, tracking billions of products daily across hundreds of thousands of stores, to power price optimization, competitive price monitoring, promotion and assortment tracking, review analytics, and unauthorized-seller enforcement. Wiser serves hundreds of brands and large retailers and integrates with major eCommerce platforms and marketplaces. As of this profile Wiser publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; integrations are delivered through its platform, dashboards, and partner connectors.

providers.name: Ziff Davis Enterprise
providers.description: Ziff Davis (Nasdaq: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands across technology, entertainment, shopping, health, cybersecurity, and marketing technology. Its brands include PCMag, Mashable, IGN, Lifehacker, RetailMeNot, Spiceworks, Everyday Health, IPVanish, Ookla (Speedtest), FullContact, and iContact, among others. The company operates a portfolio of advertising, subscription, and performance-marketing businesses rather than a single first-party public API product. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio lead; a public web crawl of the corporate site found an active investor-relations, newsroom, brands, privacy, and terms surface but no developer portal, API reference, or published API specification at the corporate (ziffdavis.com) level.

providers.name: Zurich Open Data
providers.description: Zurich Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Switzerland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 925 datasets.

providers.name: BlueNalu
providers.description: BlueNalu, Inc. is a San Diego, California cellular aquaculture company founded in 2017 by Lou Cooperhouse, Chris Somogyi and Chris Dammann that produces cell-cultivated seafood — real seafood grown directly from fish cells rather than harvested from the ocean. Its lead product is cell-cultivated bluefin tuna toro, marketed as "Seafood Without Compromise", targeted first at premium foodservice operators in the United States and then internationally. The company has raised approximately $84 million to date, including a Series B and a December 2025 insider-led convertible note and preferred stock financing led by Agronomics, Siddhi Capital and Lewis & Clark AgriFood, and was the first cell-cultivated seafood company admitted to the National Fisheries Institute. BlueNalu is a food and biotechnology producer; it publishes a marketing website and no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Deppon Express
providers.description: Deppon Express (德邦快递), operated by Deppon Logistics Co., Ltd., is a major Chinese express delivery and logistics provider specializing in large-parcel (heavy/bulky) express, less-than-truckload freight, full-truckload, air freight, warehousing, supply chain, and cross-border services. Founded from Cui's Freight Company (1996) and incorporated in 2009, it became part of the JD Logistics group in 2022 and ranks among China's largest express carriers by market share. For developers and enterprise partners, Deppon runs the Deppon Open Platform (德邦开放平台, established 2015) at dpopen.deppon.com, offering system-integration APIs for order creation, standard track/tracking queries, and electronic waybill (面单) printing, with access granted to contracted monthly-settlement customers.

providers.name: ELV8
providers.description: ELV8 Inc. operates Scout, a financial platform built for college athletes and athletic departments navigating Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) income. Scout provides NIL income tracking and management, financial education with one-on-one coaching, payment processing for schools (per diems, bonuses, and NIL payments), roster cap-management and compliance tooling, and business-setup assistance such as LLC formation and tax filing. ELV8 Inc. is an SEC-registered investment adviser and works with 30-plus college athletic programs serving thousands of athletes. It was surfaced as a Techstars-backed portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Scout is a consumer/institutional fintech product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Fintech
providers.description: Fin (fin.tech) is a crypto-native payments company that lets users and businesses move millions of dollars instantly — to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. It provides business-grade payment rails that feel like a consumer payment app rather than crypto: instant global settlement in seconds, native support to deposit and withdraw to bank accounts, and send/receive of USDT, USDC, ETH, and BTC, while Fin abstracts the underlying crypto settlement behind a clean fintech interface. Backed by Sequoia, Multicoin, and Pantera Capital, Fin operates a private, auth-gated production API surface (api.fin.tech) and publishes an llms.txt for agents; it does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Pantera Capital portfolio company (sector: crypto) and enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: Incentivio
providers.description: Incentivio is a Boston-based digital guest engagement platform for multi-unit restaurant brands, unifying online ordering, loyalty, marketing automation, and guest analytics into a single system. Its Incentivio Connect product is an AI-powered, API-first restaurant data platform that ingests data from POS, loyalty, mobile apps, web, and marketplaces, resolves it into a single persistent Guest ID, and scores guests for lifetime value, churn risk, visit frequency, journey stage, propensity-to-purchase, and offer sensitivity. The platform is BigQuery-native with a Star Schema data model, SOC 2 aligned with encryption at rest and in transit and RBAC, and pairs an API-first surface with reverse ETL to sync unified guest records back to existing CRM and ad platforms. Incentivio is built on modern APIs and offers deep partner integrations with POS, payments, delivery, and marketing systems such as Toast, Oracle Simphony, Square, SpotOn, and PAR Brink. Public, self-service developer API documentation does not appear to be available; integration and API access are handled through partnerships and enterprise onboarding (the Connect Enterprise tier markets dedicated API SLAs).

providers.name: InDrive (fka inDriver)
providers.description: InDrive (formerly inDriver) is a global mobility and urban-services platform operating in roughly 48 countries and more than 1,000 cities, with over 400 million app downloads. It is built on a distinctive peer-to-peer, user-proposed pricing model in which riders name a fare and nearby drivers accept, counter, or decline, rather than an algorithm setting the price. Beyond ride-hailing, InDrive spans intercity (city-to-city) rides, courier and freight delivery, and financial services, and is expanding into a "super app" for frontier markets. InDrive does not currently publish a public third-party developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its public company, engineering, and legal surface.

providers.name: Konn Technologies
providers.description: Konn Technologies is an Amman, Jordan based design and construction technology company, founded in 2020, that builds three integrated systems for a new model of homeownership - a composable architectural design language, an industrialized construction methodology using reinforced concrete and insulated sealed envelopes, and a software platform connecting the entire homeowner journey from first idea to keys in hand. Its consumer brand, Konn (konnhomes.com), sells that system directly to homeowners through a productized ladder - DesignFit, a 300 JOD ten-day land assessment producing 2D layouts, a site plan, and a budget and timeline; ArchDesign, a 4,000 JOD 3D design with a locked-in construction price; and Konnify, which adapts a design a homeowner already commissioned from an outside architect onto the Konn engineering system. Customer-facing software includes a Design Studio for browsing floor types, sizes, and styles with plans and pricing, and a Design Match tool that recommends a home design from stated requirements. The company reports 100+ homes designed and 35+ homes built, with typical permit-to-move-in timelines of three to six months. It publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Lanch
providers.description: LANCH GmbH is a Berlin-based food-tech startup that builds creator-led virtual restaurant brands for the delivery market. Founded by Nono Konopka and Jonas Meynert and headquartered at Schoenhauser Allee 180 in Berlin, LANCH develops food brands together with German influencers, musicians and athletes, then scales them through franchise partners and ghost-kitchen partners operating out of existing restaurant kitchens. Its two flagship brands are Loco Chicken (halal-certified wings, filets, burgers and chicken-and-waffle creations) and Happy Slice (hand-pulled pinsa-dough pizza, dips and cookies), both distributed through delivery marketplaces including Wolt, Lieferando and Uber Eats. The company is backed by HV Capital and Felix Capital alongside founders of FlixBus, Gorillas, Flaschenpost, Glovo, Foodspring, Foodora, Honest Food and Finleap. LANCH publishes a marketing and partner-recruitment website only; as of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API specification or SDK surface.

providers.name: Leadstate Incorporated
providers.description: Leadstate Incorporated is a New York City based real estate and design technology company, founded in 2021 and backed by 500 Global, that builds AI and AR tooling for how spaces are planned, developed, designed, and marketed. Its consumer-facing products are ReelProp, which turns static property photography and interior design sketches into marketing video reels, and RealMe In, which generates and manipulates 3D assets. The published product surface covers Photo-to-Video and Sketch-to-Video generation, CADgpt text-to-3D model generation, Image-to-3D asset conversion, and FloorPlan-to-3D visualization. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface of any kind, so this profile records verified company identity and web properties only.

providers.name: LearnVest
providers.description: LearnVest was a New York personal-finance company founded in 2009 by Alexa von Tobel and backed by Accel, selling subscription financial planning that paired consumers with CFP professionals alongside budgeting, spending-tracking and goal tools. Northwestern Mutual acquired LearnVest in 2015 for a reported $250 million and terminated the subscription planning service on June 5, 2018, closing all client accounts. The brand was relaunched as a consumer financial-education content site, and learnvest.com today is an archived article library on budgeting, saving, paying off debt and career growth, operated under the Northwestern Mutual brand. LearnVest never published a public API, developer portal, SDK or sandbox, and no developer surface exists today.

providers.name: Levocred AI
providers.description: Levocred AI builds an AI operating system for structured credit operations, serving both credit funds (lenders) and loan originators from a single platform. Its product, Levo, ingests loan tapes, credit agreements, servicer reports and bank feeds, then automates analytical work a credit team would otherwise do by hand: generating lender-ready borrowing base reports, monitoring covenants for breaches in real time rather than at month-end, drafting credit analyses and investment committee memos, assembling lender packages, consolidating treasury and cash visibility across facilities, and maintaining a centralized facility workspace as a single source of truth. The company is a Y Combinator Summer 2026 company based in San Francisco and reports monitoring $500M in capital across 10+ facilities. As of this profile Levocred publishes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation; the product is delivered as a hosted web application.

providers.name: Lightberry
providers.description: Lightberry is a San Francisco robotics software company (Y Combinator Fall 2025) that builds conversational AI "personality" software for humanoid and quadruped robots. Its platform lets a robot listen, speak, see its surroundings, and act on natural-language instruction without the owner writing any code, emphasizing emotional intelligence, contextual awareness, and autonomy rather than a simple speech-to-text voice pipeline. Lightberry ships pre-installed on robots sold through its partnership with Unitree, and the company runs a manufacturer-compatibility program with robot makers including Fourier, Booster Robotics, and High Torque. Its published documentation today covers device setup (power-on, WiFi provisioning, starting a conversation) plus an MCP architecture note describing a Model Context Protocol server that routes tool calls to individual Lightberry devices, which each expose a REST endpoint. There is no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or OpenAPI definition at this time.

providers.name: littlefish
providers.description: littlefish is a next generation merchant services platform positioned as a full-stack enterprise payments platform that extends a business's existing infrastructure instead of replacing it. Backed by Partech and operating in the Financial Services sector, littlefish covers merchant services, payments, finance, commerce, onboarding, operations, intelligence, and customer engagement, with a stated focus on financial inclusion. As of enrichment the company publishes a marketing site only (littlefishapp.com) with no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI surface discovered; this profile captures verified identity, legal, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: MathWallet
providers.description: MathWallet is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of multicoin-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: crypto-web3. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Mojo Vision
providers.description: Mojo Vision is a Saratoga, California semiconductor and display company building a "wafers-in, wafers-out" micro-LED platform. Founded in 2015, it originally developed the world's smallest, densest dynamic display for an AR smart contact lens, then pivoted in 2023 to commercializing micro-LED displays and optical interconnects. Its platform combines a 300mm silicon architecture with GaN-on-Silicon emitters, proprietary quantum dots and micro-lens arrays, and has demonstrated a monolithic RGB panel at 4µm pixel pitch (6,350 ppi). Target markets are XR and AI-enabled glasses, automotive heads-up displays, large-format displays, and high-density optical I/O for AI infrastructure. Partners include Marvell, DigiLens and CY Vision; investors include Khosla Ventures, NEA, Future Ventures, HP Tech Ventures, Amazon's Alexa Fund and Dolby Family Ventures. Mojo Vision is a hardware/silicon company and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Octave
providers.description: Octave (Octave Online Therapy) is a modern behavioral and mental health company providing personalized, evidence-based therapy — individual, couples, and family therapy, plus Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) and specialized Centers of Excellence for perinatal/postpartum mental health, LGBTQIA+ (queer resiliency), trauma, and women's emotional health. Care is delivered virtually and in-person across 20+ U.S. states, with in-network insurance coverage, a therapy cost calculator, therapist matching, and a secure client portal. Octave is a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures. Octave publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public web surface, a provider-published llms.txt, and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Percolata
providers.description: Percolata is a Palo Alto, California predictive-analytics company that applies machine learning to help retailers optimize labor scheduling and marketing spend. Its platform forecasts hourly sales, in-store traffic, and takeout demand to drive staffing optimization and marketing budget allocation, with published claims of 4x higher forecast accuracy, 10-20% same-store sales lift, and a forecast-accuracy guarantee. Named customers include 7-Eleven, Uniqlo, and Telefonica. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Google Ventures (GV). Percolata does not publish a public developer portal or REST API reference; its retail platform is delivered as a managed product with custom application integration. The percolata.com marketing site is now served by Wix, which provisions a live, first-party Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint and an llms.txt for agentic access to public site content.

providers.name: Reibus International
providers.description: Reibus International is an Atlanta, Georgia headquartered technology company operating a digital marketplace and open-deck freight logistics platform for the industrial metals industry. Reibus connects buyers and sellers of steel and other industrial metals with a curated network of international and domestic carriers, offering instant freight quotes, automated carrier assignment, and real-time shipment visibility tracking. The Reibus Logistics platform specializes in flatbed, dry van, and dray transportation across the contiguous United States, Canada, and Mexico, plus specialized services including oversized loads, team drivers, expedited shipping, cross-border logistics, high-value freight, and warehousing. Founded by CEO John Blount, Reibus operates across seven countries with business relationships spanning more than 25 nations and is backed by Battery Ventures. Reibus does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; customer-facing tools (instant quote, shipment visibility dashboard) are delivered through the app.reibus.com web application.

providers.name: Reshop
providers.description: Reshop (Reshop US, Inc.) is a fintech company that provides instant refunds for e-commerce returns. When a shopper initiates a return at a partner retailer, Reshop pays out the refund immediately rather than making the customer wait for the item to ship back and be processed, delivering funds to the original payment method, a debit card, or a bank account. Reshop partners with clothing and lifestyle brands such as Volcom, RVCA, Vince Camuto, and Roxy, operates in the United States, and offers iOS and Android mobile apps. The company is backed by Matrix Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; Reshop publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Town
providers.description: Town is a personal AI assistant that works across email, calendar, Slack, docs, WhatsApp, and the web. Users connect their accounts and Town — through a personal agent called a "Townie" — learns how they work, then suggests and runs automated "routines" (meeting briefs, email drafting, follow-ups, scheduling) on their behalf. Founded by Jean-Denis Greze (former Plaid CTO) and Tony Vincent (former Google product/AI lead), Town raised a $55M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz (June 2026) with Forerunner Ventures, First Round, Alt Capital, and Conviction participating. Town publishes no public developer program: the product is fully auth-gated, api.town.com is a Convex backend deployment rather than a public API, and its robots.txt carries explicit Content-Signal declarations restricting AI training on its content.

providers.name: Trace
providers.description: Trace (tracehq.com) is a workforce planning, headcount management, and procurement platform where companies plan and manage headcount as their most important investment, offering instant workforce analytics and headcount planning. Trace was backed by 500 Global and Uncork Capital, was acquired by Paylocity (now branded "TraceHQ, A Paylocity Company"), and the standalone Trace app is being sunset in early 2026 as the product folds into Paylocity for Finance headcount planning. Trace publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Trace Neuroscience
providers.description: Trace Neuroscience, Inc. is a biotechnology company developing genetic medicines for neurodegenerative diseases. Its lead investigational medicine, TRCN-1023, is designed to restore the function of the UNC13A protein, which is disrupted in most people living with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). The company sponsors the FUNCtion ALS Phase 1/2 trial (NCT07674667) evaluating TRCN-1023 delivered by intrathecal injection. Trace Neuroscience is backed by GV and does not currently publish a public developer portal or APIs.

providers.name: TransFS
providers.description: TransFS (Transparent Financial Services, LLC) is the Chicago fintech that operated FeeFighters, a marketplace helping small and medium-sized businesses compare credit-card processors and reduce merchant-account fees. It also built the Samurai payment gateway, a developer-facing API for tokenizing cards and processing payments. FeeFighters was acquired by Groupon in March 2012 and folded into Groupon Payments / the Merchant Operating System, after which the Samurai gateway API was retired. The feefighters.com domain today operates as a credit-card fee-negotiation and chargeback-management consultancy under the FeeFighters name, promising fee reductions without switching processors; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API definition.

providers.name: TreeX Robotics
providers.description: TreeX Robotics is an Israeli physical-AI company founded in 2024 that is bringing autonomous robotics to outdoor field operations at scale. TreeX replaces human field crews with fleets of physical AI-powered autonomous workers that perform high-skill field operations as an on-demand labor service, regardless of terrain or ground conditions. The company is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners (seed, 2024) and operates in Israel, the United States, and Italy. TreeX publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: TrustPoint
providers.description: TrustPoint, Inc. is a space technology company building a fully commercial, next-generation global navigation satellite system (GNSS) — a C-band LEO microsatellite constellation delivering secure positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) independent of GPS, with improved accuracy, faster time to first fix, and anti-jamming / anti-spoofing capabilities for automotive, aviation, critical infrastructure, and national security applications. Headquartered in Northern Virginia with an office in Mountain View, California, and backed by DCVC, TrustPoint does not currently publish a public API or developer portal.

providers.name: Voya
providers.description: Voya GmbH is a software development and consulting company based in Hamburg, Germany, with nearshore TechHubs in Bucharest and Cluj, Romania. Founded in 2015 as an AI-powered chat-based business-travel booking platform backed by 500 Global, it became a wholly-owned Volkswagen Group subsidiary and has been an independent, founder-led company again since November 2024. Today Voya delivers end-to-end software development, applied AI solutions, and engineering team building for automotive, mobility, and travel clients including Volkswagen, Audi, CARIAD, Deutsche Bahn, and Lufthansa City Center. TISAX certified. Voya publishes no public API or developer portal.

providers.name: Whitespace
providers.description: Whitespace is an AI operating system for wholesale distributors, based in London and part of Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch. The platform connects to a distributor's existing business systems (ERPs such as SAP, NetSuite, Epicor, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and Sage, plus Salesforce, HubSpot, QuickBooks, Gmail and Outlook) to build a model of operations, then deploys self-improving AI agents that automate demand forecasting, inventory replenishment, order entry, quote generation, customer query responses, and accounts payable and receivable. It targets sectors including industrial supplies, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, building materials, foodservice, consumer goods and textiles. Founded by Alex Tung and Leon Yao. As an early-stage company it currently ships a product but publishes no public API, developer documentation or SDK.

providers.name: WithAI
providers.description: WithAI is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company building Multiplier, a secure AI platform for institutional investors and independent equity hedge funds. Multiplier unifies structured data, unstructured data, AI agents, human work, and firm knowledge so investment teams can research stocks and manage portfolios more efficiently, with an integration ecosystem spanning Bloomberg, FactSet, Enfusion, Snowflake, and other market data and infrastructure platforms. WithAI does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: Woowa Brothers
providers.description: Woowa Brothers is the Seoul-based technology company behind Baedal Minjok (Baemin), South Korea's leading food delivery platform, alongside B-Mart quick commerce, Baemin Connect rider services, and robotics initiatives for serving and delivery robots. A subsidiary of Delivery Hero since 2021, the company runs a strong engineering culture through its Woowahan tech blog and first-party open-source libraries on GitHub (NestJS libraries, WoowahanJS, Redis tooling), but it does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Zhangmen
providers.description: Zhangmen (掌门1对1 / 掌门教育) is a Shanghai-based online education company offering premium one-on-one and small-group tutoring to K-12 students across China. Its platform pairs students with elite instructors and layers on data-driven, intelligent learning analysis: diagnostic assessment, personalized study plans, real-time classroom monitoring, automated learning reports, and parent progress tracking. Beyond core academic tutoring the company runs quality-education modules spanning public speaking, creative art, programming, and comprehensive/mathematical thinking, along with a piano accompaniment-practice product (zmpeilian.com). The business is a direct-to-consumer web and mobile app play delivered in Simplified Chinese; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: 1X Technologies
providers.description: 1X Technologies (formerly Halodi Robotics) is a Norwegian-American humanoid robotics company building general-purpose bipedal robots designed to live and work alongside people. Founded in 2014 in Norway by Bernt Øyvind Børnich, the company is now headquartered in Palo Alto, California with R&D and manufacturing presence in Moss, Norway and a new vertically integrated NEO factory in Hayward, California. 1X is backed by the OpenAI Startup Fund, EQT Ventures, Tiger Global, Samsung NEXT, and others through Series A2 ($23.5M, 2023), Series B ($100M, 2024), and a $1B raise reported in 2025. Its commercial robots are EVE — a wheeled upper-humanoid deployed in industrial and security settings since 2022 — and NEO, a bipedal home humanoid that began pre-orders October 28, 2025 at $20,000 (or $499/month) with consumer deliveries in 2026. 1X also acquired Kind Humanoid (Jan 2025) and announced a partnership to deploy up to 10,000 NEO robots into EQT portfolio company factories and warehouses between 2026 and 2030. Unlike most humanoid robotics vendors, 1X publishes meaningful open-source artifacts: the EVE ROS2 API (custom WholeBodyTrajectory and DrivingCommand message types) and the halodi-messages package on GitHub under Apache-2.0, plus the 1X World Model Challenge with 100+ hours of vector-quantized EVE observations and GENIE baseline models released on Hugging Face. There is no public REST/HTTP developer API or hosted developer portal — the developer surface is ROS2 messages, robot models in URDF, and the world-model dataset/model artifacts.

providers.name: A Security
providers.description: A Security (Ⓐ) is an Israeli-founded cybersecurity company building an autonomous offensive security and remediation platform. The product continuously discovers real attack paths inside an organization, validates whether they can actually be exploited by following each path until it proves what is truly exploitable, and then helps close those gaps before adversaries chain vulnerabilities into a breach. Positioned for organizations where failure is not an option, A Security is designed to operate at machine speed to keep pace with AI-enabled attackers. The company emerged from stealth in June 2026 with $37M in funding led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Cyberstarts, with participation from Cerca Partners and angel investors including Wiz CEO Assaf Rappaport and Cyera CEO Yotam Segev. It was founded by Yossi Torati (CEO), Omer Gull (CPO), and Yuval Itzchakov (CTO), veterans of Check Point, Hunters, Sygnia, and the IDF's Unit 8200. A Security maintains SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications.

providers.name: Aculys
providers.description: Aculys Pharma, Inc. is a Japanese clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on neurological and psychiatric diseases where there is high unmet medical need. The company works to eliminate Japan's drug lag and drug loss by bringing innovative medicines already approved in Western markets to Japanese patients as early as possible. Its lead product is Spydia (diazepam nasal spray), Japan's first domestically developed intranasal anti-seizure agent, approved in June 2025 and administrable outside medical facilities. Originally funded by SoftBank Vision Fund (Series C, March 2025), Aculys was acquired by and became part of the Viatris Group in October 2025. Aculys publishes no public developer program, API, or technical documentation surface; this profile is maintained for network completeness and identity.

providers.name: AGTools
providers.description: Agtools, Inc. is an agricultural technology (AgTech) company providing a real-time data analytics and market-intelligence SaaS platform for the global food supply chain. The platform aggregates and curates hundreds of official government, institutional, university, and weather data sources covering 450+ specialty crops and commodities across 189+ countries, exposing 70+ variables and 25+ years of historical records (pricing, supply, demand, exchange rates, weather, CO2 footprint, and transportation costs) through dashboards, daily commodity reports, and a price analyzer so growers, shippers, buyers, and retailers can forecast demand, manage purchase orders, and reduce food waste. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Irvine, California, Agtools is a Techstars Farm to Fork alumnus and Microsoft Machine Learning & AI award winner. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface has been published to date.

providers.name: Aora
providers.description: Aora (Aora Servicios) is a Mexico-based on-demand home and office services marketplace that connects households and businesses with vetted technicians and providers for repairs, installations, and maintenance. Its catalog spans home and office repairs, white-goods and appliance service, air conditioning and mini-split installation, water heaters, plumbing and drainage, waterproofing, and home-technology work. Consumers browse and book services through the Aora web app and the Aora mobile app, while a B2B program serves business customers. The company is backed by 500 Global. Aora publishes a consumer-facing website and blog but does not currently expose a public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; this profile captures its public web surface and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Atlas5D
providers.description: Atlas5D is a healthcare technology company that develops an Ambient Measurement System (AMS) for assessing health and wellness through motion in any environment. Its passive, privacy-preserving sensor platform recognizes specific individuals, characterizes and quantifies their movement, and interprets daily routines to predict trends and assess risk of adverse events such as falls, without wearables, without transmitting video, and without storing images. Atlas5D serves individuals monitoring aging loved ones, assisted-living and other institutional care settings, and healthcare and clinical-trial teams that need clinical-grade, real-world evidence of patient movement wherever people live. Backed by Techstars.

providers.name: BAE Systems
providers.description: BAE Systems is a British multinational defense, security, and aerospace company and one of the largest defense contractors globally. BAE Systems does not publish public developer APIs; technology integration is delivered through classified and ITAR-controlled customer programs, the Discover supplier portal, defense-program-specific data exchanges (e.g. F-35 ALIS / ODIN, Eurofighter), and FMS / government-to-government channels.

providers.name: Balance Re
providers.description: Balance Re is a fully licensed German life reinsurance company headquartered in Cologne, with an office in London, offering asset-liability management (ALM) reinsurance solutions to life insurers and pension funds. Its proprietary technology delivers real-time analytics that help clients manage capital and liquidity, price and transfer longevity, savings and retirement risk, and improve competitiveness through quantitative asset-liability management. Balance Re raised a $10M Series A in 2021 led by Anthemis Group, with participation from Global Brain, Roland Berger Industries and Talabot Finance. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; the company publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API, documentation, or machine-readable specifications as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Bedrock
providers.description: Bedrock (Bedrock Ocean Exploration) builds advanced autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and Mosaic, a cloud-native data platform that transforms how the world maps, monitors, and understands the seafloor. Its AUV fleet carries multibeam echosounder, side-scan sonar, magnetometer, and sub-bottom profiler payloads to deliver high-resolution geophysical survey data for offshore energy (wind, oil and gas, renewables), ports and harbors, submarine telecom infrastructure, defense, and scientific research. A Northzone portfolio company, Bedrock is an enterprise ocean-data provider; it publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Blau Corp
providers.description: Blau (Blau Corp) is a waste-management operating system for haulers (gestores), final-destination facilities, and government regulators across Mexico, Colombia, and Spain. The SaaS platform delivers AI-assisted route optimization, route-level profitability analysis, automated RP and RPBI hazardous- and biological-infectious-waste manifests, online collection booking, and end-to-end traceability, plus the Blau Driver mobile app for field crews. Founded in Guadalajara, Mexico in 2021 and backed by 500 Global (LatAm B17 batch), Blau integrates with SAT/CFDI, SEMARNAT, SAP/ERP, QuickBooks, WhatsApp, fleet GPS, and Power BI. Blau does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Bonum Coaching
providers.description: Bonum Coaching is an enterprise coaching platform based in Latin America that pairs personalized human coaching with technology to develop talent and improve organizational performance. Its offering spans one-to-one executive coaching, group and team coaching, structured mentoring programs, and CLARA, an AI coach-bot for practicing workplace conversations in a safe environment. The company positions itself around democratizing access to coaching, leadership development, talent retention, building a growth culture, and diversity, equity and inclusion, and counts enterprises such as Uber, Davivienda, Farmatodo, and Mi Banco among its clients. Backed by 500 Global, Bonum Coaching is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Cega
providers.description: Cega is a decentralized exotic derivatives protocol building on-chain structured products for investors: exotic options such as Fixed Coupon Notes (pure options and bond + options) and Dual Currency Swaps that generate yield with built-in downside protection. Cega is live on Ethereum Mainnet and Arbitrum One (EVM) and on Solana, and exposes its protocol to developers through first-party TypeScript SDKs on npm (@cega-fi) plus a GraphQL subgraph rather than a hosted REST API. Backed by Pantera Capital and surfaced into the API Evangelist network from its VC portfolio.

providers.name: Cera
providers.description: Cera is a United Kingdom-based digital-first home healthcare company, founded in 2016 and headquartered in London, that describes itself as Europe's largest provider of in-home care. Cera delivers home care, live-in care, nurse-led and complex care, extra-care housing, supported living, and specialist learning-disability and autism support, all wrapped around a proprietary digital platform that uses data analytics and machine learning so its network of carers can collect, monitor, and react to vital-sign and health-condition changes in real time. Cera positions this technology as a remote-monitoring and predictive layer that surfaces deterioration in health earlier and reduces hospitalisations across its United Kingdom home-care operations. As of this review Cera exposes no public developer portal, no self-serve REST API, and no HL7 FHIR endpoint or CapabilityStatement; its platform is an internal, operator-facing product delivered through consumer and carer mobile apps rather than a documented partner API. This profile is an honest identity-only stub recording the absence of a public API surface for a United Kingdom telehealth-adjacent home-care provider.

providers.name: Compt
providers.description: Compt is an employee benefits platform that automates flexible stipends and Lifestyle Spending Accounts (LSAs). HR teams define eligible categories across 30+ benefit types — wellness, childcare, professional development, and more — while employees submit receipts for reimbursement. The platform automatically handles taxable versus nontaxable treatment and delivers payments through existing payroll, alongside rewards and recognition, professional development management, employee discounts, a company swag store, and business expense tracking. Compt reports a 93% average participation rate and roughly 30 minutes of monthly admin time. It is a Battery Ventures portfolio company. No public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Corning
providers.description: Corning Incorporated is a Fortune 500 American technology company that specializes in glass science, ceramic science, and optical physics. Founded in 1851, Corning manufactures specialty glass, ceramics, and related materials and technologies for industrial and scientific applications. Corning's businesses include Optical Communications (fiber optic cable and hardware), Display Technologies (LCD and OLED glass substrates), Specialty Materials (Gorilla Glass for mobile devices), Environmental Technologies (ceramic substrates and filters for emissions control), and Life Sciences (laboratory glassware, cell culture, and bioprocess products). Corning does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Cyclone Robotics
providers.description: Cyclone Robotics is an enterprise Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and hyperautomation platform provider serving large organizations across Asia. Its product suite spans RPA Studio, RPA Robot and RPA Controller for building and orchestrating software robots; AI capabilities including AI Skill Studio, Task Intelligence, Process Intelligence, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) and chatbots; and delivery options such as Robot-as-a-Service and RPA Mobile. The platform lets business and technical users automate finance, government, manufacturing, banking, insurance, logistics, healthcare and customer-service processes, and can expose robot business functions as callable services (RaaS) for third-party integration. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: David Energy
providers.description: David Energy is a clean-energy technology company and licensed electricity retailer that installs free plug-in smart batteries for homes and businesses. Its software charges batteries when grid power is cheap and discharges them during peak-price periods to lower customers' monthly utility bills, alongside bill-monitoring and thermostat-management advisory tools. Backed by Union Square Ventures, David Energy operates in the New York City market with a stated mission of powering the grid on 100% clean energy and shifting the balance of energy control from institutions toward consumers.

providers.name: EduAdvisor
providers.description: EduAdvisor is a Malaysian education platform that helps students compare, plan and apply for tertiary education. It provides course and university comparison tools, scholarship matching, study-abroad guidance, and free education counseling, working directly with 100+ universities and colleges in Malaysia and abroad to streamline applications for prospective students. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. EduAdvisor currently operates as a consumer-facing WordPress web platform with no public developer program, API, or documentation surface at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Efreshli
providers.description: Efreshli is a Cairo, Egypt based online home-furnishing and interior-design commerce platform founded in 2018 by Heba El Gabaly. The company lets consumers design and shop their space online, pairing an e-commerce catalog of furniture, decor, lighting, rugs, bedding, and kitchen and dining goods with AI-assisted room design tools, curated collections, a gift registry, an Efreshli Pro membership, and a B2B / trade program that connects a network of vendors and brands. Efreshli is backed by 500 Global, Algebra Ventures, Marakez, and angel investor Tarek Sakr. This profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network; Efreshli operates a consumer e-commerce web storefront and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Endel
providers.description: Endel is a wellness technology company that generates personalized, adaptive soundscapes to help people focus, relax, sleep, and stay active. Its patented technology creates endless real-time audio that responds to inputs such as time of day, weather, circadian rhythm, heart rate, and location, delivered across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, web, Apple Watch, Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV, and Alexa. Endel is a consumer application; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface, so this repo captures its identity and public web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Enertiv
providers.description: Enertiv is a commercial real estate sustainability and decarbonization technology company serving owners and operators of large CRE portfolios. Its platform combines portfolio-scale utility data collection and ESG reporting (Report), asset-specific carbon planning that pairs AI recommendations with on-site equipment surveys (Decarbonize), and real-time monitoring with fault detection and operational optimization (Optimize). Additional workflow tools cover automated tenant utility billing and maintenance/work-order management, with integrations into property management systems such as Yardi and MRI. The company guarantees 100% utility data coverage — including tenant-controlled utilities — and has worked with 100+ large portfolios over more than fifteen years.

providers.name: Entrepreneur First
providers.description: Entrepreneur First (EF) is a talent investor that backs exceptional individuals before they have a company, pairing them into cofounding teams and providing pre-seed capital, mentorship, and a global network to build technology startups from scratch. Founded in London in 2011 by Matt Clifford and Alice Bentinck, EF runs cohort-based programs across Europe, Asia, and North America and has helped launch hundreds of venture-backed companies. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Greylock and added to the API Evangelist network; EF publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Essity
providers.description: Essity is a Swedish-headquartered global hygiene and health company operating across four business areas: Health & Medical, Personal Care, Consumer Tissue, and Professional Hygiene. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (ESSITY) and owns roughly 40 brands including TENA (incontinence care), Tork (professional hygiene), Libero (baby diapers), Libresse / Bodyform / Nana / Saba / Nuvenia / Libra (feminine care), Modibodi and Knix (period underwear), JOBST (compression hosiery), Leukoplast (adhesive bandages), Cutimed, Sorbact, Hydrofera and Actimove (wound care, sports medicine, orthopedic supports), Delta-Cast (casting), and consumer tissue brands Lotus, Zewa, Tempo, Cushelle, Plenty, Velvet, Regio, Sorbent and Purex. No public developer-facing APIs or developer portal have been identified for Essity; this repository tracks corporate, brand, sustainability, investor, and integration surfaces for ongoing API discovery. The company's Tork brand ships a connected washroom data platform — Tork Vision Cleaning — which is the closest thing to a public data surface in the portfolio.

providers.name: Exotic Markets
providers.description: Exotic Markets is a decentralized options and structured-products protocol on the Solana blockchain, describing itself as the #1 options protocol on Solana and backed by Multicoin Capital. The platform lets users earn yield or buy call/put options through flexible structured products, including baskets of tokens, accumulators, and capital-preservation strategies with customizable payoffs and maturities. Access is on-chain via a Solana wallet (Phantom, Solflare) and the $EXO token powers staking, points, and protocol utility. Exotic Markets is a smart-contract DeFi protocol rather than a REST/HTTP API provider: there is no public OpenAPI, gateway, or hosted developer API surface; developer materials are limited to GitBook documentation, a GitHub organization, and community channels.

providers.name: Exowatt
providers.description: Exowatt is a clean-energy technology company redefining power generation for the AI era. Its flagship Exowatt P3 is a modular, dispatchable solar-thermal energy platform that captures solar energy with proprietary Fresnel lenses and heat exchangers, stores it in a high-efficiency heat battery, and dispatches electricity on demand via a proprietary heat engine, delivering up to 24 hours of dispatchable baseload power. The systems are factory-built in the USA from abundant, low-cost materials without rare-earth minerals, and are aimed at energy-intensive customers such as AI data centers and utilities. Backed by a16z and Felicis, Exowatt is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it currently publishes no public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: FlagshipRTL
providers.description: FlagshipRTL (Flagship) is a SaaS company providing AI-powered inventory forecasting and merchandise planning software for retail brands, with a focus on apparel and direct-to-consumer (DTC) businesses. Its platform pairs demand forecasting at size-level granularity with multi-scenario planning, a purchase-order (PO) builder, and real-time inventory alerts to help retailers reduce stockouts and maximize full-price sell-through. Flagship reports optimizing over $2B in GMV for customers such as Bala, Mack Weldon, and Fresh Clean Threads, and integrates with systems including Shopify, NetSuite, Cin7, Snowflake, and Google Sheets. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Flovision (formerly FloWaste)
providers.description: Flovision Solutions (formerly FloWaste) builds AI-powered computer-vision systems for food production, using cameras and machine learning to measure product on the line for yield improvement, quality control, and staff-performance tracking. Its FloVision Nano (conveyor measurement, KPI reporting, and benchmarking) and FloVision Pro (real-time operator guidance at processing stations) products feed a hosted FloVision Analytics dashboard, and the company reports processing over 23 million kg of food and recovering up to 1.5% of production yield. Insight Partners portfolio company in the manufacturing / food-tech sector; no public developer API or documentation surface has been published to date.

providers.name: Focal Point Procurement Solutions
providers.description: Focal Point is an AI-powered procurement orchestration platform for enterprise procurement teams. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, the SaaS platform sits on top of a company's existing S2P and ERP systems to centralize procurement data, intake, and workflows across six core modules: Request Intake Management, Procurement Activity Management, Sourcing Event Management, Supplier Relationship Management, Third-Party Risk Management, and Contract Lifecycle Management. It connects existing systems and data via API integrations, automates tactical no-code workflows, and provides total spend visibility, intelligent intake, and smart routing so procurement teams can focus on strategic work. Focal Point does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; integrations are delivered through the platform. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fora
providers.description: Fora is a modern, tech-enabled host travel agency headquartered in New York City, founded in 2021 by Henley Vazquez, Evan Frank and Jake Peters. It equips independent travel advisors with a custom booking portal, 700+ training videos, live support, preferred supplier partnerships, an IATA number, E&O insurance and automated commission collection, powered by a Travelport-backed booking platform and integrations such as Tablet Hotels. Fora runs a consumer traveler app plus an advisor portal and is building agentic AI tooling (Via / Sidekick) to streamline advisor workflows. Backed by Forerunner Ventures and Insight Partners, Fora does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and web properties within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: FREE NOW
providers.description: FREE NOW is one of Europe's leading multi-mobility "super apps," letting riders book taxis and private-hire vehicles and, in many cities, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, carsharing and public-transport tickets from a single application. Founded in Hamburg in 2009 as mytaxi and rebranded FREE NOW in 2019, the company operates across nine European countries and 150+ cities. It ran as part of the YOUR NOW mobility joint venture between Mercedes-Benz and BMW and was acquired by Lyft. FREE NOW exposes a partner/business integration API (FREE NOW for Business) through a password-gated developer portal at developer.free-now.com, and maintains an active open-source presence — including the Wave design system — under the freenowtech GitHub organization.

providers.name: General Matter
providers.description: General Matter is a domestic nuclear-fuel company founded in 2024 and based in California, building United States uranium enrichment capacity to produce low-enriched uranium (LEU) and high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) for advanced commercial and government nuclear reactors. Co-founded by Scott Nolan and Lee Robinson and backed by Founders Fund, the company was awarded a $900M Department of Energy IDIQ contract and plans a $1.5B commercial enrichment facility at the former Paducah Gaseous Diffusion Plant in Kentucky, plus a lease on the Hanford Fuels and Materials Examination Facility in Washington. Its mission is to reduce American reliance on foreign nuclear fuel and strengthen energy independence. General Matter is an industrial energy manufacturer with no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, website properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: GetCraft
providers.description: GetCraft is a Southeast Asian creative and content-marketing marketplace, headquartered in Indonesia and backed by 500 Global, that brands itself as "The Creative Industry's Premium Directory." It connects brands and agencies with a vetted network of freelance creators and production partners ("Crafters") for content, video, design, advertising, and marketing work, spanning a talent Directory, a Jobs board, Managed project services, and a Community. Its companion publication, MarketingCraft, is a bilingual (English/Indonesian) content hub of articles, events, tutorials, jobs, and research for marketers and creators. GetCraft exposes no public developer or API surface; this record is an identity/enrichment profile.

providers.name: Go X
providers.description: Go X is an electric micromobility sharing company that lets riders rent scooters, e-bikes, and cars on demand, 24/7, through a consumer mobile app. Operating in cities such as New Orleans, Go X builds its own connected electric vehicles and manages fleet access, unlocking, ride sessions, and payments entirely in-app on iOS and Android. It is a consumer-facing mobility service rather than a public API provider: it exposes no developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or documented public API surface (its api.goxapp.com host is the private backend for the mobile apps).

providers.name: Green Fusion
providers.description: Green Fusion GmbH is a Berlin-based climate-energy software company that provides an intelligent 360-degree energy management platform for the residential real estate sector (Wohnungswirtschaft). Its software digitizes and optimizes building heating systems: "Der Energiespar-Pilot" delivers digital boiler-room management and optimized operation of conventional heat sources (gas, oil, district heating, CHP/BHKW), while its AI platform for sector coupling (Sektorkopplung) integrates heat pumps, PV systems, storage, and grid connectivity for intelligent monitoring and control. The platform is TUV-certified under GEG section 71a. Green Fusion is backed by HV Capital and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a climate-energy provider; it operates a customer control platform (control.green-fusion.de) but publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Happytal
providers.description: Happytal is a French healthtech and services company founded in 2013 and acquired by La Poste Group's health division (La Poste Santé) in 2022. It operates a hospital concierge service (conciergerie hospitalière) that combines a digital platform with on-site human concierges to simplify the administrative, medical and hotel journey of each patient. Services include in-room delivery, a comfort-products marketplace, private-room and admission paperwork assistance, and support for patients, their families and hospital staff across French healthcare establishments, alongside elder-care/EHPAD offerings and the careside.care business-to-business product for care facilities. Happytal exposes no public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Heron Power
providers.description: Heron Power is an industrial power-electronics company modernizing the electrical grid with solid-state transformers and integrated power conversion systems. Founded by former Tesla executive Drew Baglino, the company builds Heron Link products that combine a solid-state transformer with a power supply or inverter for two markets: data centers (AI and hyperscale power delivery, including 800 VDC datacenter architectures) and solar-and-storage renewable energy systems. Heron Power targets the grid infrastructure bottlenecks of the clean-energy transition, replacing century-old passive transformer technology with dense, controllable, software-defined power hardware. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Breakthrough Energy. Heron Power is a hardware and infrastructure company and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence.

providers.name: Hexafarms
providers.description: Hexafarms GmbH is a Berlin-based agricultural technology company that builds AI-powered greenhouse optimization software for commercial growers. Its platform combines computer vision, environmental sensors, and machine learning to help greenhouse and foil-tunnel operations forecast yield, register crops, and detect pests and disease early. Products include AI yield forecasting (claimed up to 20% more accurate than traditional methods), automated crop registration via fruit and flower counting, pest and disease monitoring, and environmental sensing across crops such as strawberries, tomatoes, bell peppers, blueberries, cucumbers, raspberries, and aubergine. The product is delivered as a login-gated web application at hexafarms.app; no public developer API or documentation surface has been identified. Hexafarms was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: High Mark Credit Information Services
providers.description: High Mark Credit Information Services (now operating as CRIF High Mark) is one of India's four RBI-licensed credit bureaus, headquartered in Mumbai. It maintains credit information on retail, microfinance, and commercial borrowers, and delivers credit reports, bureau scores, analytics, portfolio monitoring, fraud-detection, and origination-decisioning solutions to banks, NBFCs, microfinance institutions, insurers, and telecom providers. The bureau is best known for its microfinance credit information services and pan-India retail and commercial credit databases. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer portal or API specification, so this profile captures company identity and domain security posture only.

providers.name: Higharc
providers.description: Higharc is an AI-powered homebuilding software platform founded in 2018 by Marc Minor and headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, with team members across San Francisco and Atlanta. Its design-to-construction cloud platform lets residential builders design homes from scratch, configure market-proven plans, and turn every home into shoppable 3D visuals, plan-based estimating data, and permit-ready construction documents. The product surface spans Studio (design), Config (plan configuration), Showroom (3D visualization), Estimate (material takeoffs), Build (construction documents), Photoreal (renderings), and enterprise AI Estimating, unifying architecture, sales, and construction operations. Higharc is a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this profiling it publishes no public developer API, reference, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Idecsi
providers.description: IDECSI is a Microsoft 365 and on-premises data security platform focused on Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) and Data Access Governance (DAG). It helps mid-size and large enterprises eliminate access, permission, and sharing risks across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and file systems, with advanced monitoring, permission analysis, and user-driven security workflows. IDECSI serves large organizations such as L'Oreal, TotalEnergies, SNCF, Renault, and ADP, and aligns with regulatory frameworks including NIS2, DORA, and the EU AI Act. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes a marketing site, blog, and help center but no public developer API or specification at this time.

providers.name: Imajin
providers.description: Imajin is an Indonesian online manufacturing marketplace (the "Indonesia Manufacturing Hub") that connects buyers with vetted manufacturers and machine shops through a project-based workflow: post a project, receive quotes, and track production through to delivery. It brokers rapid 3D printing and prototyping, high-precision mold and die making, SPM and custom part fabrication, mass production (stamping, plastics, and fabrication), CNC milling and turning at machining centers, and broader manufacturing projects. The platform offers an instant-quote tool, real-time project notifications, integrated company profiles, team and project management, and up-front payment handling for suppliers. Imajin is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Intella
providers.description: Intella is an enterprise Arabic AI company founded in 2021 and headquartered in the MENA region, building voice and customer-experience technology that natively understands 25+ Arabic dialects and cultural nuances rather than adapting generic global models. Its product suite includes Ziila (an AI voice agent for inbound/outbound conversations), intellaCX (conversation analytics for sentiment and churn), intellaMX (media translation and dialectal subtitling), and intellaVX (Arabic speech-to-text). Intella raised a $12.5M Series A led by Prosus and is backed by 500 Global, Hala Ventures, and Hearst, with partnerships including Visa and Jumia Egypt. The company is currently a sales-led enterprise vendor with no public developer API or documentation surface; this profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network lead.

providers.name: Jar
providers.description: Jar is a Bengaluru-based fintech company operating India's first micro-savings app, enabling tens of millions of Indians to save in 24K digital gold from as little as ₹10. The app supports daily, weekly, monthly, and instant savings mechanisms, plus a round-up feature that automatically invests spare change from everyday transactions into 99.5%+ pure digital gold held in insured vaults.
