Founded in 2021 by Nishchay AG (CEO) and Misbah Ashraf (CPO) under Changejar Technologies Private Limited, Jar has grown to 50+ million registered users across 12,000+ Indian zip codes. The company recently vertically integrated its gold operations, moving away from a third-party distribution model to purchase, store, and manage gold directly. Jar partners with Brink's for global custody, ICICI Lombard for insurance, Vistra as independent trustee, and BDO as statutory auditor. Adjacent products include Nek, a direct-to-consumer gold and silver jewellery brand sold via shopnek.com. Jar reached profitability in 2025 after backing from Tiger Global, Arkam Ventures, Rainfall Ventures, Yes VC, and others at a $300M+ valuation, and is preparing for an IPO. There is no public developer API, SDK, or partner integration program — Jar is a B2C consumer mobile app distributed exclusively through Apple App Store and Google Play.

providers.name: Jingle
providers.description: Jingle is a consumer marketplace mobile app for fast, direct local deliveries from mobile stores and services — "shops-on-wheels" — operating in the San Francisco Bay Area. Users sign up with a phone number (no password) and enable push notifications to be alerted when their favorite mobile vendors are nearby — artisanal food trucks, farmers'-market sellers, and one-click services such as bike repair, car wash, manicures, pedicures, and knife sharpening — then request a "jingle" to summon them. Deliveries are handled directly by the businesses themselves, cutting out delivery middlemen. Merchants use the app at their discretion to broadcast their presence to nearby neighborhoods, and residential complexes can partner to bring vendors on-site. Jingle is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. The company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its public consumer and merchant surface.

providers.name: Junto Education
providers.description: Junto is a Berlin-based leadership-development company and a portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital. Junto delivers cohort-based, live and interactive online training led by certified coaches who previously held senior leadership roles at leading technology companies. Its programs combine the accountability and personal interaction of offline training with the scalability of online learning, and cover first-time managers, high-performance teams, and custom leadership tracks. Junto sells directly to organizations, who nominate high-potential employees for the programs. Junto operates a marketing site at junto.eu and a customer learning application at app.junto.eu. As of this profile, Junto publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Kiavi
providers.description: Kiavi (formerly LendingHome) is a technology-driven private lender for residential real estate investors, providing fix-and-flip bridge loans, new-construction financing, and DSCR rental loans across 49 states plus Washington, D.C. The company has originated more than $30 billion in loans and funded over 100,000 investment properties, pairing a digital application and portfolio-management experience with institutional capital. Kiavi is backed by Cowboy Ventures and Ribbit Capital. As of this enrichment pass Kiavi publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; its public surface is a marketing site, a real-estate-investing blog, legal/policy pages, and a HackerOne-based security vulnerability disclosure program.

providers.name: Kiko Labs
providers.description: Kiko Labs is a neuroscience-based early-learning company (a 500 Global portfolio company) that builds adaptive brain-training games for children ages 3-7. Its flagship product, Kiko's Thinking Time, is a voice-guided iOS app developed with Harvard and UC Berkeley neuroscientists with support from the US Department of Education and National Science Foundation. The program trains executive functions — working memory, inhibition, focus, and cognitive flexibility — through progressive games, and includes a parent and educator dashboard for tracking skill development. Kiko Labs is a consumer edtech company and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Kinetic
providers.description: Kinetic (Kinetic Automation) builds robotics-based automated collision repair for modern vehicles equipped with advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS). The company operates robotic repair facilities (Kinetic Hubs), automated imaging for collision damage assessment and repair estimates (Kinetic Vision), and AI-powered calibration identification software (Kinetic ID) that determines which ADAS sensors need recalibration after a repair. Backed by Menlo Ventures and Techstars, Kinetic was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and corporate site plus a login-only identity portal (id.kinetic.auto); it exposes no public developer program, API documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or webhooks surface.

providers.name: Kinside
providers.description: Kinside is a modern child care marketplace that connects families with licensed child care providers by surfacing real-time availability across thousands of providers, helping parents find care in minutes rather than months. Beyond the consumer marketplace, Kinside serves child care providers with enrollment and scheduling tools, employers with child care benefit programs, and government agencies seeking community child care supply-and-demand data. Backed by Initialized Capital and Techstars, the company operates alongside UrbanSitter in the family-care benefits space. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from venture-portfolio discovery; Kinside does not publish a public developer portal or API at this time, so this entry captures its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: Lane
providers.description: Lane is a workplace experience platform for commercial real estate, now operated as VTS Activate after VTS acquired the company. The product gives building tenants a single mobile and web app for keyless building, suite and room access, booking amenities and shared spaces such as meeting rooms, fitness studios and desks, inviting and checking in visitors, receiving building information, maintenance updates and alerts, and RSVPing to events or ordering and paying for retail and food service. Landlords and property managers use it as the tenant-facing layer over the VTS commercial real estate platform. The legal entity behind the apps is VTS LANE INC. and the joinlane.com application traffic is served by the VTS Activate platform at activate.vts.com. Lane publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition or SDKs; the product is delivered as a first-party mobile and web application backed by an internal GraphQL API.

providers.name: Marvel Fusion
providers.description: Marvel Fusion is a Munich-based deep-tech company founded in 2019 that is developing laser-based inertial confinement fusion energy. It combines a proprietary fast-ignition approach with innovations across lasers, fuel targets, and power-plant design to make commercial fusion power viable, building on the National Ignition Facility 2022 ignition breakthrough. The company operates in Germany and the United States, with a demonstration facility in Fort Collins, Colorado, and has raised over $400M from venture capital, industrial partners, and public funding. As a physics and energy-infrastructure company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or MCP surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and web/domain security posture.

providers.name: Medley
providers.description: Medley is a leadership development company that delivers group-based executive coaching at enterprise scale, pairing professional coaches with AI-enabled tooling to bring quality and a human touch to Fortune 500 organizations. Founded in 2020 by Edith Cooper and Jordan Taylor, the platform runs curated small-group coaching cohorts focused on trust, empathy, communication, and collaboration to drive organizational transformation. Medley raised a $3.7M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). It operates as a B2B services and coaching platform and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: ObserveIT (Proofpoint)
providers.description: ObserveIT was an insider threat management (ITM) vendor acquired by Proofpoint in 2019 and folded into the Proofpoint Insider Threat Management product line within Proofpoint's Information Protection portfolio. The platform provides endpoint visibility, user activity monitoring, session timelines, and data-loss detection across careless, malicious, and compromised users, correlating activity across endpoints, email, and cloud. Integration is delivered through webhooks that let SIEM and SOAR tools ingest alerts and automated exports to customer-owned AWS S3 storage; ObserveIT no longer operates as a standalone brand and publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or self-service API documentation.

providers.name: Olli Health
providers.description: Olli Health is an AI-powered managed service for home health agencies that automates medical coding and OASIS (clinical assessment) and Plan of Care quality review. It pairs clinical artificial intelligence with certified human coders to ingest patient documentation (faxes, handwritten notes, and digital records), produce ICD-10 coding and OASIS review, and push approvals back into existing EHR workflows. The company reports 98%+ accuracy, roughly 4x faster turnaround, and about half the cost of traditional coding vendors, serving 100+ agencies and 200,000+ patients. Olli Health is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 certified, and its OASIS/Plan of Care quality review service is CHAP Verified. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass Olli Health publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Open Port Technology
providers.description: Open Port Technology (OpenPort) is a pan-Asian logistics and supply chain technology company that digitizes trucking, freight, and supply chain operations across emerging markets through an open, neutral, AI-based platform. Headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan, its product suite spans transport management (OpenTM), a digital trucking marketplace (OpenMarket), customs clearance (OpenClear), warehouse picking operations (OpenPick), and FBR digital invoicing (Open Invoice). The company reports millions of completed shipments, 1,600+ transport partners, and integrations across 100+ ERP systems, offering ERP integration and custom API development to clients, though it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine readable API specification at this time.

providers.name: Optoscale
providers.description: Optoscale (OptoScale AS) is a Norwegian aquaculture technology company founded in 2015 in Trondheim that builds AI-powered, camera-based edge-computing monitoring for fish farming. Its Bioscope units capture real-time measurements of fish weight, biomass, sea-lice counts, welfare, behaviour and feeding, producing tens of thousands of validated measurements each day directly on the unit rather than on remote servers. Customers view trends, graphs and high-resolution imagery through the OptoScale web portal, export to Excel/CSV, and integrate the underlying data into their own analytics and farm-management systems via OptoScale's data API. OptoScale was acquired by Insight Partners in 2025.

providers.name: Plotlogic
providers.description: Plotlogic is a mining technology company that builds AI-driven sensing systems for real-time ore and material characterisation. Its flagship product, OreSense, scans rock in open-pit, stockpile, and underground mining operations and delivers decision-ready quantitative mineralogy in under 15 minutes, compared with more than an hour for traditional laboratory assay methods. The hardware is engineered for harsh mining environments and integrates into existing operational workflows so mines can reduce waste, improve grade control, and make faster material-routing decisions. Plotlogic is headquartered in Zillmere, Queensland, Australia, and is backed by the deep-tech venture firm DCVC. Customer access is delivered through an enterprise client platform rather than a public developer API; there is no published developer program, SDK, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Principly
providers.description: Principly, Inc. is an SEC-registered investment adviser that operates the consumer fintech product Backer (backer.com), a mobile-first platform for opening and managing 529 education savings plans. Backer lets parents open a 529 plan in minutes, automate contributions, and share custom gifting links so family and friends can contribute to a child's college fund. The service helps families choose among more than 100 U.S. 529 plans, reporting 250K+ users and $70M+ saved. It is a consumer-facing mobile and web application and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs. Principly is backed by 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company.

providers.name: Proxima Fusion
providers.description: Proxima Fusion is a Munich-based fusion energy company building the first generation of commercial fusion power plants using quasi-isodynamic (QI) stellarators. Spun out of the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics, the company is developing Stellaris, a stellarator power plant concept, with milestones that include a Stellarator Model Coil and an Alpha demonstration stellarator on the path to grid-scale fusion energy. Proxima Fusion is a privately held deep-tech startup and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Quantifind
providers.description: Quantifind is a financial crimes automation company founded in 2009 by physicists Ari Tuchman and John Stockton to extract meaningful risk signals from large, unstructured datasets. Its flagship SaaS platform, Graphyte, applies machine learning, natural language processing, and entity resolution to anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) compliance. Graphyte spans watchlist and sanctions screening, adverse media screening, enhanced due diligence, credit risk, and investigations, and is delivered through GraphyteSearch (an investigation application), GraphyteQueue (an AI-native case manager), GraphyteAPI (a synchronous REST risk-assessment API), and GraphyteBatch (batch screening). Quantifind serves Tier 1 and regional banks, digital banks, Fortune 50 companies, and federal and defense agencies, and integrates with case-management systems such as Oracle FCCM. Backed by a16z.

providers.name: rabot.energy
providers.description: rabot.energy (RABOT Energy DE GmbH) is a Hamburg-based German electricity supplier offering dynamic and fixed-rate power tariffs where consumers pay hourly rates that track the wholesale electricity market. The company provides 100% renewable energy certified by TÜV NORD, smart meter installation and management, EV charging optimization (Autostrom), and home battery storage (Rabot Flow), all managed through a consumer mobile app for consumption monitoring. It is a consumer-facing energy retailer; no public developer portal or API is currently published. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HV Capital.

providers.name: Recyda
providers.description: Recyda is a German software company offering an all-in-one platform for packaging sustainability and regulatory compliance. The platform centralizes packaging data, automates Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) fee calculation and declaration across 20+ countries, and assesses packaging recyclability against standards such as the ZSVR Minimum Standard and EN 18120. It supports EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) compliance, portfolio-wide assessments, and submission-ready reporting, turning weeks of manual compliance work into minutes. Recyda is trusted by global brands and is backed by venture firm Speedinvest.

providers.name: Remedio
providers.description: Remedio is an autonomous cybersecurity remediation platform that detects and automatically fixes misconfigurations, configuration drift, and emerging Shadow AI risks across hybrid IT environments at machine speed. Its platform spans five modules — Baseline (secure configuration baselines), AI Govern (discovery and governance of AI tools, agents, and connections), Fortify (autonomous vulnerability and misconfiguration remediation), Gate (application and software control), and Assure (continuous compliance monitoring) — with predictive impact preview, auditable rollback, and ROI measurement. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. Remedio publishes a marketing site and blog but no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Reserv
providers.description: Reserv is an insurance technology company and third-party administrator (TPA) that combines AI-powered automation with human claims expertise to handle property and casualty (P&C) claims for MGAs and carriers across North America, the UK, and the EU. Its platform pairs adjuster workflows with analytics dashboards, reporting, and structured claims data, positioning itself as the simplicity of a TPA with the benefits of an in-house team. Reserv is backed by 8VC, Anthemis, and Bain Capital Ventures. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs.

providers.name: Roche
providers.description: F. Hoffmann-La Roche is a Swiss multinational healthcare company with two divisions: Roche Pharma and Roche Diagnostics. Roche does not publish a general public developer API but exposes interoperability through the navify diagnostics platform, the cobas infinity laboratory software, and an open-source GitHub presence focused on data-science tooling such as pyreadstat, foxops, and OligoGym.

providers.name: Satellite
providers.description: Satellite IM builds privacy-focused, decentralized peer-to-peer communication software for crypto and web3 communities. Its core is Warp, a Rust interface-driven distributed data service providing end-to-end-encrypted chat, voice, video, and file sharing with data stored on IPFS. Uplink is a customizable decentralized chat application built on top of Warp. Satellite publishes no hosted REST or GraphQL API; the developer surface is the open-source Warp Rust crates and the first-party warp-wasm WebAssembly and TypeScript library. Satellite is backed by Multicoin Capital and its code is MIT licensed.

providers.name: ShardSecure
providers.description: ShardSecure is a data security company providing agentless, file-level data protection that keeps sensitive data private, resilient, and compliant across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid or multi-cloud environments. Its platform uses microsharding to cryptographically fragment and distribute data so exfiltrated fragments are unintelligible, adds ransomware detection with self-healing data integrity, and extends to securing AI inference data through an MCP Secure Gateway. ShardSecure is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API or developer portal as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Sketchpro
providers.description: SketchPro is an AI copilot for Autodesk Revit that helps architects and engineers automate construction documentation directly inside their live project models. Delivered as a native Revit plugin (not a public developer API), it executes natural-language instructions to handle dimensioning, tagging, view creation, sheet setup, and scheduling, while adapting to each firm's standards, naming conventions, and documentation logic through an admin-configured AI Knowledge Base. Founded in 2023 and used by architecture practices including SOM, 10 Design, and Little, SketchPro is backed by Khosla Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or event/webhook surface; API access is described as "contact vendor / not publicly documented."

providers.name: Slingshot AI
providers.description: Slingshot AI is a mental-health AI research lab building a foundation model for psychology. Its consumer product, Ash, is a voice- and text-based AI companion for mental health support, trained on behavioral-health approaches including CBT, DBT, ACT, psychodynamic therapy, and motivational interviewing, and shipped as a free iOS and Android app. Founded by Neil Parikh (co-founder of Casper) and Daniel Reid Cahn, the company has raised roughly $93M from investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Forerunner Ventures, Menlo Ventures, and Radical Ventures. As of this pass Slingshot AI publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; Ash is a consumer-facing application at talktoash.com.

providers.name: SocialSign.in
providers.description: SocialSign.in is a guest WiFi marketing platform that turns venue Wi-Fi login into a customer-acquisition and engagement channel. When guests connect to free Wi-Fi through branded splash pages, the platform captures opt-in contact data (email, phone, profile), measures visit frequency and dwell time, and syncs profiles to CRM and email/SMS marketing tools to trigger targeted campaigns across retail, hospitality, sports and entertainment, healthcare, and commercial real estate venues. The company exposes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or documentation surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Somos Internet
providers.description: Somos Internet is a Colombian residential and business fiber-optic internet service provider (ISP) delivering high-speed home and enterprise broadband across cities including Medellin, Bogota, Sabaneta, Rionegro, Caldas and Laureles. The company is building AI-ready digital infrastructure for Latin America and raised a $40M Series B backed by Ribbit Capital. It offers fiber internet plans, parental controls, TV channel line-ups, and Wi-Fi routers to homes, businesses, and property developers. No public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or other programmatic surface has been identified for Somos Internet; it is a consumer and enterprise connectivity provider rather than an API platform.

providers.name: SpareFoot
providers.description: SpareFoot is the largest online marketplace for finding and reserving self-storage units, owned by Storable (the same parent that owns the storEDGE and SiteLink property-management systems, cataloged separately at api-evangelist/storable). SpareFoot itself does not publish a developer portal, API reference, or self-serve API keys for third parties to call. Instead, storage facilities' pricing, unit availability, and promotions reach SpareFoot through one-way, partner-gated data-feed integrations built by property-management software vendors - Storable Edge (storEDGE), SiteLink Web Edition, Storable Easy, Self Storage Manager (E-SoftSys), eDOMICO, and DoorSwap - each of which pushes its own facilities' inventory into the marketplace and receives reservation/lead data back. No endpoint list, request/response schema, or authentication scheme for this feed mechanism is publicly documented; a facility operator or software vendor must go through SpareFoot/Storable's integrations team to be onboarded. This entry documents that access model honestly rather than fabricating an API surface.

providers.name: Spokn
providers.description: Spokn is an AI-powered short-form video creation platform built for internal communications, HR, and learning & development teams. It lets organizations collect selfie, full-screen, or screen-share clips from employees across desktop and mobile, then stitch, trim, caption, translate (15 languages), and brand them into polished employee videos in under 30 minutes without video-editing expertise. Finished videos distribute via intranet, LMS, Microsoft Teams, Slack, email, or MP4 export. Spokn integrates with common HRIS (BambooHR, Workday, Zenefits, ADP, Rippling), SSO (Okta, OneLogin, G Suite), and Slack, but does not currently publish a public developer API, API reference, or developer portal. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Stuck
providers.description: STUCK? is a content creation, translation, and localization platform based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia that pairs AI efficiency with human expertise. Customers can request work fully AI-powered, fully human-expert-led, or as a hybrid (AI drafting with human review) across translation, content writing, video subtitling, editing, and dialect localization. The platform matches requesters to vetted experts in under ten minutes, supports direct chat and document upload, and runs a quality-assurance review step. Pricing spans pay-as-you-go, monthly and annual subscriptions, and custom enterprise plans. Stuck is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes a web/app product but no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Sware (fka BTR)
providers.description: Sware (formerly BTR) is a life sciences software company providing AI-driven GxP validation for regulated life sciences and pharmaceutical organizations. Its Res_Q SaaS platform combines a decade of validation intelligence with a Data Cloud and AI agents that automate validation work, surface insights, and keep every decision explainable, traceable, and reversible. A companion product, GxPNext, delivers agentic validation built for software development so teams can embed GxP validation directly into their applications, ship faster, and simplify customer audits. Sware serves quality, regulatory, and engineering leaders across software validation, AI/ML validation, plant and equipment validation, and medical device / SaMD development, and publishes SOC 2 and ISO 9001 certifications. It is backed by Insight Partners. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI is available today (the Res_Q API page is password-gated), so this profile captures the company's public identity, compliance posture, and domain-security probe.

providers.name: Teesnap
providers.description: Teesnap is an all-in-one golf course management platform and point-of-sale system for golf operators, founded in 2013 and based in Las Vegas, Nevada. Its cloud software suite covers a tee sheet and tee-time booking engine, golf and food-and-beverage point of sale, customer and membership management, an online store, websites, payments, and a marketing and reporting system. Teesnap connects to the wider golf ecosystem through partner integrations - GolfNow (its official online tee-time distribution partner via NBC Sports Next), Priswing dynamic pricing, Golf Genius tournament management, QuickBooks Online accounting, Gallus mobile apps, Heartland payment processing, and range hardware from eRange and Select Pi. As of this catalog's review date Teesnap does not publish a public, self-service developer API or developer portal; integrations are delivered through partner-gated, business-development relationships. The APIs listed here are honestly modeled from Teesnap's public product surface and are not sourced from published API documentation.

providers.name: TIM
providers.description: TIM S.p.A. (formerly Telecom Italia) is the incumbent Italian telecommunications operator headquartered in Rome and one of the largest telcos in Europe. The group operates fixed and mobile networks across Italy under the TIM Consumer and TIM Enterprise brands, runs TIM Brasil (the second-largest mobile operator in Brazil), and owns a portfolio of technology subsidiaries including Sparkle (international connectivity and quantum-safe infrastructure), Noovle (cloud), Telsy (cybersecurity), and Olivetti (IT services). TIM exposes its mobile network as a programmable platform through the developer.tim.it portal in Italy and through TIM Open Gateway in Brazil, both implementing CAMARA-standard network APIs (SIM Swap, Number Verification, Know Your Customer, IP-to-MSISDN, IP-to- Number, Device Location) jointly defined by the Linux Foundation, TM Forum, and GSMA. These APIs let banks, fintechs, insurers, retailers, and online services authenticate users, detect SIM-swap fraud, verify customer identity, and locate devices using TIM's mobile network as the trust anchor. As of late 2025 TIM Brasil reported 50 million Open Gateway API queries across its catalog.

providers.name: TradeLink
providers.description: TradeLink is a Munich-based logistics SaaS company building the first collaboration platform for supply chain and inbound/outbound logistics. Its cloud software gives warehouses, suppliers, carriers, and dispatchers a shared system for time-slot (dock) booking, dock and yard management, load-carrier and empties management, driver check-in terminals, and analytics insights, replacing phone and email coordination with real-time, transparent workflows. TradeLink integrates with existing ERP and transport-management systems and serves production, retail, and contract-logistics companies across the DACH region and Europe, with customers including MAN, SPAR, Liebherr, and Emons. It is backed by Insight Partners and Point Nine.

providers.name: Venwiz
providers.description: Venwiz is a Bengaluru, India based B2B digital platform for the procurement of industrial and infrastructural project services, covering both CapEx and MRO requirements for the manufacturing sector. Founded in 2020 by Rajesh Reddy and Sandesh Paturi, it operates a marketplace that connects industrial buyers with a verified, pan-India database of service vendors, adding vendor discovery, order expediting, project management tooling and vendor intelligence on top. Backed by Accel and other investors (~$11.4M raised), Venwiz digitises what has traditionally been an offline, relationship-driven industrial services procurement process. No public developer API, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDK, or documentation surface is published as of this enrichment pass; the public presence is a marketing/content website plus a login-gated application.

providers.name: Vivere
providers.description: Vivere Partners is a technology-enabled Managing General Agent (MGA) that provides specialty property and management liability insurance solutions for complex risks. Founded and led by CEO Christopher McKechnie, who brings more than 25 years of insurance industry experience, Vivere combines deep underwriting expertise with advanced analytics and alternative data to deliver faster quotes, tailored coverage, and competitive terms for niche insurance lines, while giving carriers and capacity providers greater portfolio performance visibility. The company raised $7.5 million in seed funding led by General Catalyst, with participation from Pathlight Ventures and Greenlight Re.

providers.name: WhatsCookin'
providers.description: WhatsCookin' is a community cooperation platform — a "Cooperation Engine for Communities" — that helps people organize local and virtual gatherings and build healthy social connections. Members join or create Circles (community spaces for conversation and events), post Offers to gauge interest in potential events, and make Wishes that others can fulfill by hosting. Communities span wellness, community-building, language exchange, and food, with active circles in Tucson, Queens, San Francisco, and Oakland. It is available on the web and as native iOS and Android apps. Backed by Bloomberg Beta. There is no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: @Stake
providers.description: Stake (Stake Technologies, Inc., NMLS #2535498) operates the "Return on Rent" cash-back network for renters. Renters earn cash back on their rent payments, build credit history through on-time payments, unlock exclusive local deals, and access banking services including an FDIC-insured checking account and debit card provided through banking partner Midland States Bank. Co-founded by Rowland Hobbs and Jimmy Jacobson, the platform reports more than 550,000 homes in its network and over $50M in cash back earned by renters, averaging roughly $350 per renter annually. Stake is a consumer-facing fintech product; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead (surfaced under Battery Ventures).

providers.name: Afresh Technologies
providers.description: Afresh Technologies builds an AI platform for grocery retail that helps supermarkets and distributors manage fresh food, reducing shrink, improving in-stock rates, and cutting food waste across store ordering, inventory management, production planning, recipe management, and distribution-center buying. Its machine-learning decision engine forecasts demand for perishable, random-weight, and bulk items where operational data is inherently messy, and is also offered as a backend Replenishment API that plugs Afresh's forecasting and ordering logic into a retailer's existing front-end systems without changing in-store associate workflows. The company is based in San Francisco and is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: AppliedVR
providers.description: AppliedVR is a virtual reality therapeutics company that combines immersive technology with proven cognitive behavioral and behavioral-science techniques to treat medical conditions, with a focus on chronic pain. Its lead product, RelieVRx, is the first FDA-authorized prescription VR device for chronic lower back pain, delivering automated, self-administered cognitive behavioral therapy in the patient's home. AppliedVR also offers the SustainVR and ITx immersive therapeutics platform and the AVR Pathway patient-support system, and validates its products through clinical academic research. The company operates as a regulated digital-therapeutics / medical-device business rather than a developer-facing API platform, so it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Aspen RxHealth
providers.description: Aspen RxHealth is a healthcare technology company that transforms medication management by connecting healthcare organizations with a nationwide network of licensed clinical pharmacists who deliver remote, patient-facing consultations. Its web-based BeWell platform supports CMS-compliant clinical programs including medication therapy management (MTM), medication adherence, chronic disease management, medication reconciliation, and statin-therapy gap closure, using proprietary matching algorithms to pair pharmacists with patients by language, geography, and clinical condition. Aspen RxHealth was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners; it does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: Columbia Bank
providers.description: Columbia Bank is an Oregon state-chartered commercial bank and the principal banking subsidiary of Columbia Banking System, Inc. (NASDAQ: COLB), a West Coast regional bank holding company headquartered in Tacoma, Washington with more than $50 billion in assets. The bank took the legal name "Columbia Bank" effective July 1, 2025, having previously operated as Umpqua Bank following the 2023 merger of Columbia Banking System and Umpqua Holdings Corporation. On the open-finance front, Columbia is one of the relatively few US regional banks to run a first-party developer surface: Columbia API Banking, a commercial and treasury-management integration product exposing capabilities such as book transfers, ACH file imports, positive pay, stop-payment and NSF management, lockbox management, transaction and statement search, check images, and real-time account balances in JSON and XML, backed by a production-ready SDK and the gated Columbia API Portal. That surface is commercial/ERP-oriented rather than a self-serve public developer portal, and consumer-permissioned data access is instead delivered through the Plaid aggregator. No documented FDX participation or published CFPB Section 1033 posture was found.

providers.name: ComparaOnline
providers.description: ComparaOnline is a Latin American digital marketplace and licensed insurance broker that lets consumers compare and buy insurance and financial products in one place. Operating in Chile (comparaonline.cl), Brazil (comparaonline.com.br) and Colombia (comparaonline.com.co), it aggregates offers for auto insurance, mandatory SOAP accident insurance, travel, life, health and pet insurance alongside financial products such as mortgage, auto and consumer loans, credit cards and checking accounts. Its Chilean brokerage, Compara Online Corredora de Seguros SpA, is supervised by the Comision para el Mercado Financiero (CMF), and the company earns revenue as a broker collecting premiums and by referring users to partner banks and insurers. ComparaOnline is a fintech/insurtech portfolio company of Ribbit Capital. No public developer API or specification is currently published; this profile captures the company's public identity and web surface.

providers.name: Divebell
providers.description: Divebell is a cloud-native data privacy and security compliance platform that helps organizations discover, classify, and protect sensitive data and personally identifiable information (PII) across their data sources. The platform pairs continuous, intelligent data scanning with "Deep Automation" to deliver four capability areas: Data Discovery (data classification, data mapping, and access management), Compliance Automation (risk assessment, data retention, and regulatory compliance), DSR Fulfillment (data subject request workflows, subject mapping, and automated retrieval), and Risk Protection (a policy engine, "Risk Sonar," and remediation actions). Delivered as a lightweight modern SaaS with private data processing, Divebell protects customer data across sources such as Snowflake and AWS. Divebell was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and is now part of the Exterro family, operating as Exterro Data Discovery.

providers.name: Dronamics
providers.description: Dronamics is a European deep-tech company that designs, builds, and operates autonomous long-range cargo drones for middle-mile logistics. Its flagship aircraft, The Black Swan, is a remotely piloted UAV that carries up to 350 kg (770 lb) of cargo over distances up to 2,500 km (1,550 mi), enabling same-day, cross-border, point-to-point deliveries that are faster, cheaper, and lower in CO2 emissions than traditional air freight. Founded in 2014 in Sofia, Bulgaria by brothers Svilen and Konstantin Rangelov and operating as Dronamics Group Limited, the company is building the world's first cargo drone airline, operating a proprietary drone fleet from a network of low-cost droneports. The public dronamics.com marketing site is built on Wix and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic access; Dronamics does not publish a developer-facing logistics API, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Eve
providers.description: Eve (eve.legal) is a legal AI platform built by Butler Labs, Inc. for plaintiff law firms. Marketed as "the only legal AI that works your whole case with you," Eve 2.0 is positioned as a proactive AI workforce that spans the full plaintiff case lifecycle — intake and evaluation, pre-litigation drafting (medical chronologies, demand letters), litigation discovery (propounding and responding), and case auditing. The platform is organized around three product surfaces: Eve Agents (intake & evaluation, AI voice agent, medical overviews, demand letters, drafting, propounding discovery, responding to discovery), Eve Auditor (nightly audit of the active caseload for missed value drivers such as TBIs, MRIs ordered but not taken, and mass-tort eligibility), and Eve Analyst (announced as "coming soon"). Eve targets personal injury and labor & employment plaintiff firms and claims to be used by 1000+ firms with reported outcomes including a 250% year-over-year revenue increase, 2.5x case capacity, 90% faster demand letter generation, and a 4.9/5 G2 rating. Eve is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and HIPAA compliant, with case data encrypted, isolated per-firm, and never used to train shared models. The company is led by founder & CEO Jay Madheswaran (formerly Rubrik, Lightspeed Venture Partners), co-founder & CPO Matt Noe, and co-founder & Head of Engineering David Zeng, and has raised $164M+ from venture investors. Eve is a closed B2B SaaS application; as of this profile there is no public developer API, no public OpenAPI/AsyncAPI documentation, no `docs.eve.legal` developer portal, no SDKs, and no public repositories under the `eve-legal` GitHub organization (the org exists with zero public repos as of May 2026). All access is through the Eve web application following a sales-led "Schedule a call" / "Book a Demo" motion.

providers.name: EverySim Inc.
providers.description: EverySim Inc. (everysim.io) is a 500 Global-backed company that operates a private, authentication-gated web application. Every public path on everysim.io redirects unauthenticated visitors into a Keycloak-based OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 single-sign-on flow (realm "everysim", client "everysim-web", authorization-code with PKCE). As of this profile no public developer API, documentation, SDK, CLI, or developer portal surface was found; the only publicly reachable machine-readable endpoint is the realm's OpenID Connect discovery document on auth.everysim.io. This entry captures the provider's verifiable identity, authentication model, and domain-security posture pending a public API surface.

providers.name: eXp World Holdings
providers.description: eXp World Holdings is the holding company for a portfolio of cloud-based, agent-centric real estate and technology businesses including eXp Realty, eXp Commercial, SUCCESS magazine, Frame, Realty Connect, and LuxVT. The company operates a virtual brokerage model powered by an immersive cloud workspace for agents. eXp World Holdings does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Express Scripts Holding
providers.description: Express Scripts is a pharmacy benefit management (PBM) company, now part of Cigna's Evernorth Health Services, that processes prescription claims and provides home delivery and specialty pharmacy services for clients including health plans and employers. The Express Scripts Developer Portal exists for partner and client integrations, but its API catalog is not openly published; access is gated to authenticated partners.

providers.name: Fabrix
providers.description: Fabrix (Fabrix Security) is an AI-native identity and access management company building AI agents for identity security. Its platform centers on the Identity Knowledge Graph, which unifies fragmented human, machine, and AI-agent identities across providers, and a set of AI agents that automate identity visibility and intelligence, user access reviews, just-in-time privileged access, identity lifecycle management, identity security posture management (ISPM), and non-human / AI-agent governance. Deployed as an agentless solution, Fabrix uses cross-provider identity resolution (deterministic matching, heuristics, and AI) plus natural-language analysis to speed access reviews, risk scoring, and compliance. Founded as a venture-backed startup (Norwest Venture Partners, Merlin, Jibe) and ISO 27001 aligned, Fabrix announced it is joining Silverfort in 2026 to build a runtime identity security platform. This profile currently tracks the company and its public web surface; Fabrix does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or API reference.

providers.name: Forwardlane
providers.description: ForwardLane Technologies builds Signal Studio, a decision intelligence platform that transforms enterprise data into auditable actions rather than dashboards. Users ask questions in natural language and receive Next Best Actions with complete audit trails in seconds, powered by a semantic data layer, multi-agent AI orchestration, a no-code signal builder, and in-database processing so data never leaves the customer environment. Validated across eight years of Fortune 500 production, Signal Studio serves financial services, private credit and private equity, real estate, energy and oil and gas, and government, with BYOK support for any LLM, cloud, or inference provider. Led by CEO Nathan Stevenson. ForwardLane exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company's public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Harper
providers.description: Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage founded in 2024 and headquartered in San Francisco. Harper pairs licensed insurance experts with a proprietary AI tech stack that automates core brokerage workflows — reading applications, routing submissions, following up with underwriters, and managing client communications — to place excess & surplus (E&S) and specialty commercial coverage across industries from trucking and construction to technology, CPG, and professional services. Businesses can get bound coverage in 24-48 hours rather than weeks. The company is backed by Emergence Capital and Y Combinator and raised a $47M Series A and seed round in early 2026. Harper does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company's identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Home Trust
providers.description: Home Trust Company is a federally regulated Canadian trust company founded in 1977 and headquartered in Toronto, and the principal operating subsidiary of Home Capital Group. Home Capital was taken private by Smith Financial Corporation (Stephen Smith) in 2023, and the group now spans Home Trust, Home Bank (a Schedule I bank), Fairstone Bank, and the Oaken Financial deposit brand, positioning itself as one of Canada's leading alternative (non-prime) lenders. Its products include residential and commercial mortgages, reverse mortgages, Equityline, Preferred and Secured Visa credit cards, and Oaken GIC and high-interest savings deposits. Home Trust operates no public developer portal or first-party API: developer.hometrust.ca and api.hometrust.ca do not resolve (DNS NXDOMAIN), no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger is published, and no Interac e-Transfer or Payments Canada Real-Time Rail (RTR) API surface is documented. Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open-banking) framework is legislated (Budget 2024 / Fall Economic Statement 2024, FCAC as overseer) but not yet operational, and Home Trust publishes no stated CDB or FDX position; any consumer data access today would be via screen-scraping aggregators such as Flinks or Plaid rather than a first-party API. This is an identity-only record: no public API exists as of July 2026.

providers.name: Kobalt
providers.description: Kobalt Music Group is an independent music rights management and administrative publishing company founded in 2000 by Willard Ahdritz, operating from New York and London. Unlike traditional publishers it administers copyrights rather than owning them, running Kobalt Music Publishing, a neighbouring rights division, and AMRA, the digital-first collection society it acquired in 2014. Royalty and rights processing runs on KTech, the rights and content management platform built to independently serve both Kobalt Music Publishing and AMRA at the scale of billions of music micro-transactions, with songwriters and rightsholders viewing statements and analytics through the authenticated Kobalt Portal. Kobalt publishes no public developer program: a 2026-07-19 probe found no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or AsyncAPI description, and no API discovery documents under /.well-known/. Integration is arranged commercially through Kobalt or KTech rather than through a self-service API.

providers.name: Papa
providers.description: Papa is a companion care company that pairs older adults and families with vetted, trained companions called Papa Pals for social support, errands, transportation, technology help, check-ins, and everyday assistance. Papa sells to Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Special Needs, and commercial health plans and to employers as a tech-enabled social care benefit, serving millions of members across roughly 70-100 health plan and employer partners. Members are enrolled by phone or, for employer members, online, and use the Papa Care app to request and schedule visits; Papa Pals use the Papa Pal app to accept and complete visits. Papa does not publish a public or self-serve developer API. Health plan integration is handled through business agreements - eligibility file exchange to identify and onboard eligible members, and recurring reporting dashboards covering utilization, gaps, referrals, satisfaction, and outcomes - rather than through a documented public REST API, developer portal, or API keys.

providers.name: PharmaCCX
providers.description: PharmaCCX, operating as CCX (Contingent Commitment Exchange), is a digital market-access and pricing software company for the pharmaceutical industry, serving pharma manufacturers, payers, and health systems. Its enterprise platform provides a single source of truth for global pricing strategy and contract management through three products: CCX Planning (contract scenario planning, modeling, and analysis), Deal Admin (contract administration and pharma-payer coordination), and CCX Digital Negotiation (an invite-only deal negotiation tool). The platform is delivered as an invite-only enterprise SaaS terminal (marketaccess.ccxterminal.com) with Terminal and Sandbox environments; no public developer API, documentation, or portal is published as of this profiling.

providers.name: Puddle
providers.description: Puddle is a technical-interview platform for evaluating software-engineering candidates in real-world, AI-enabled conditions. Candidates work through live coding assessments inside a sandboxed environment with an integrated IDE and terminal, and are free to use modern AI tools (such as Claude Code) during the session. Puddle captures detailed signals about how a candidate approaches a problem across structured phases (problem discussion, architecture, implementation, and debrief) and produces an outcome report with confidence scores, focus and iteration-pace metrics, and hiring recommendations. It is sold as a B2B SaaS recruitment-assessment tool via demo and early-access waitlist. Puddle was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this pass Puddle publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or OpenAPI surface; the profile below captures its verifiable public web and security presence.

providers.name: Script Health
providers.description: Script Health (operating as "Scripted", scripted.co) is a healthcare technology company that lets community pharmacies deliver clinical services and prescribe for common conditions, so patients can skip the trip to the doctor and get same-day care at their local pharmacy. Its platform covers appointment booking and walk-in intake, clinical service administration, medical claims and pharmacy billing (CLIA waivers, collaborative practice agreements), and patient-record management across services including chronic conditions, general and urgent care, vaccines, testing, sexual and reproductive health, and skin and hair health. Scripted also builds native integrations into pharmacy management systems (its first with Liberty RXQ) so pharmacies can run clinical services inside their existing PMS. A Techstars-backed portfolio company; the original scripthealth.co domain now redirects to scripted.co. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is published at this time.

providers.name: SkySafe
providers.description: SkySafe is a San Diego-based drone-detection and airspace-intelligence company (founded 2015, backed by a16z) whose cloud SaaS platform lets airports, critical infrastructure, law enforcement, universities, correctional facilities, and government customers detect, track, analyze, and act on every drone in their airspace in real time. The platform surfaces precise drone location, altitude, velocity, flight status, launch point, and pilot location, receives and analyzes Remote ID, retains historical flight telemetry for forensic "Prosecutor-Ready" reporting, and pushes instant notifications via SMS, Microsoft Teams, Slack, or CommandCentral Aware. SkySafe advertises integration APIs that push detection, forensics, and analytics into third-party command centers and mitigation workflows, but its developer surface (app.skysafe.io, docs.skysafe.io, api.skysafe.io) sits entirely behind customer authentication — there is no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI specification to harvest.

providers.name: Spring Labs
providers.description: Spring Labs is an AI-native compliance and customer-experience platform for financial institutions, deploying autonomous AI agents that complete operational work rather than only surfacing insights. Its agents score customer-service calls, run 100% QA/QC review coverage, identify and file complaints, and (soon) automate the dispute lifecycle, alongside SummerGRC, an AI-driven governance, risk, and compliance product. Spring Labs targets sponsor banks, fintech lenders, enterprise banks, BaaS platforms, and debt-collection (ARM) organizations. Originally a blockchain-based data and identity company backed by Multicoin Capital, the firm has repositioned around applied AI for regulated financial operations. This profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes a marketing/product site but no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Sunoco LP
providers.description: Sunoco LP (NYSE: SUN) is a master limited partnership and the premier independent fuel distributor in the United States, distributing over 15 billion gallons of fuel annually to approximately 11,000 Sunoco and partner-branded retail locations and operating more than 160 terminals. Sunoco LP is affiliated with Energy Transfer (parent of Sunoco GP, the general partner). On November 3, 2025 Sunoco closed its $9.1 billion acquisition of Parkland Corporation (announced May 5, 2025), creating SunocoCorp LLC, which began trading on the NYSE under ticker "SUNC". The Parkland acquisition substantially expands Sunoco's footprint into Canada and additional international markets, adding Parkland's refining, retail, and commercial fuels businesses to Sunoco's North American distribution network.

providers.name: Supermaven
providers.description: Supermaven was an AI code completion tool founded by Jacob Jackson (previously co-founder of Tabnine) and known for shipping the first code completion product with a 1,000,000-token context window — over thirty times the context of contemporary copilots — backed by the in-house Babble model and roughly 250 ms response latency. Supermaven delivered plugins for VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, and Neovim, plus a chat surface that proxied GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and GPT-4 alongside inline completions, style adaptation, and codebase-aware suggestions. Anysphere — the company behind the Cursor AI code editor — acquired Supermaven on 12 November 2024 to power Cursor's next-generation Tab model, and on 21 November 2025 Supermaven was formally sunset: subscribers received prorated refunds, agent/chat features were retired, VS Code users were migrated to Cursor, and free autocomplete inference continues for existing JetBrains and Neovim users for the foreseeable future. There is no public developer API, OpenAPI spec, or SDK — Supermaven shipped as an IDE plugin product, and its long-context completion technology now lives inside Cursor.

providers.name: Tenstorrent
providers.description: Tenstorrent is an AI hardware company designing Tensix and Tensix++ based AI accelerators on the open RISC-V architecture, including the Wormhole and Blackhole generations of cards, the TT-QuietBox workstation, and the Galaxy Blackhole 6U server housing 32 Blackhole chips. The company is unusual in the AI silicon space for shipping a fully open-source software stack including TT-Metal (the low-level kernel and operator library), TT-Forge (an MLIR-based compiler for PyTorch, JAX, and ONNX), TT-MLIR, TT-XLA, the TT-Inference-Server, and RISC-V cores and toolchains. Pricing is published from 999 dollars for an entry card up to 440,000 dollars for a base Galaxy supercluster. Tenstorrent does not currently offer a public hosted-inference API, so this profile catalogs hardware, SDKs, compilers, and open-source repositories rather than an HTTP API surface.

providers.name: ThayerMahan
providers.description: ThayerMahan, Inc. is a U.S. maritime autonomy and ocean-intelligence company headquartered in Groton, Connecticut, founded in 2016 and led by former U.S. Navy Vice Admiral Michael Connor. It builds and operates uncrewed surface and subsurface sensing systems — Outpost, SeaPicket, SeaGuard (a non-kinetic counter-UUV defeat system) and the TransparenSea data platform — combining passive acoustic arrays, electronic sensors, edge processing, AI classification and human analysts to deliver persistent undersea surveillance, port and critical-infrastructure security, subsea infrastructure monitoring, passive acoustic marine-mammal monitoring and illegal-fishing (IUU) detection for defense, government and commercial offshore customers. ThayerMahan sells outcomes as a service rather than developer tooling: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable contract. The only public reference to programmatic access is on the TransparenSea page, which states that contact reports are delivered by application programming interface (API), voice report, or other means in near real-time — a customer-delivery integration negotiated per engagement, not a self-serve public API. Its GitHub organization holds two forks of third-party tools and no first-party libraries.

providers.name: Vaas
providers.description: Vaas is a Colombian fintech building debt infrastructure for Latin America, operating a platform that automates asset-backed debt facilities for originators, asset managers, and debt providers across industries. Vaas autonomously verifies asset documentation, reconciles cash flows end to end, and enforces collateral ownership in real time so assets cannot be pledged twice, bringing liquidity and transparency to private credit. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). Vaas does not currently publish a public API or developer portal.

providers.name: 2U
providers.description: 2U, Inc. is an education technology company, founded in 2008 and headquartered in Lanham, Maryland, that partners with the world's top universities and companies to develop and deliver online education programs — from free open courses to bootcamps, certificates, and credit-bearing master's degrees. In 2021 2U acquired edX, which it operates as its global online learning platform and primary consumer brand, offering thousands of courses across subjects such as artificial intelligence, data science, public health, and business. This profile was seeded from a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio-linked lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline. 2U publishes no first-party developer API on its corporate domain (2u.com); its programmatic and integration surfaces live under the edX / Open edX learning platform, and its engineering work is visible in the 2uinc GitHub organization.

providers.name: Accent Therapeutics
providers.description: Accent Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering a new class of small-molecule precision cancer therapies that target critical intracellular dependencies spanning multiple types of cancer. Its pipeline is led by ATX-295, a novel KIF18A inhibitor in clinical development, with data presented at AACR and ASCO. Backed by GV, Accent focuses on precision oncology drug discovery and development. The company does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its corporate and web identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Aerska
providers.description: Aerska is a biotechnology company developing RNA interference (RNAi) medicines to treat, delay, and prevent diseases of the brain and central nervous system. The company pairs next-generation RNAi therapeutics with receptor-mediated "brain shuttle" delivery technology engineered to cross the blood-brain barrier and silence disease-causing genes in the CNS. Founded in 2025 by Jack O'Meara, Stuart Milstein, and Dave Hardwicke, Aerska is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland with research operations in London. It emerged from stealth in 2026 having raised a Series A round led by the EQT Dementia Fund and age1, with additional backing from Speedinvest and Backed. Aerska is a pre-clinical drug-discovery company and does not currently publish a public developer API or platform.

providers.name: AgadoLive
providers.description: Agado Live is an AI-powered telerehabilitation platform built for physical therapy clinics, letting one therapist supervise many patients at once while capturing measurable outcomes. Its computer-vision engine extracts joint kinematics in real time from a single smartphone or webcam, with no wearables, markers, or proprietary hardware, then flags form issues live and directs the therapist's attention where it is needed most. The platform delivers Live Group Care, AI movement assessment, auto-generated SOAP notes, and specialized orthopedic, neurological, and geriatric protocols. Founded by Tzach Goren, Gili Yaron, Gil Shamai, and Vittaly Tavor, Agado Live operates from Tel Aviv and Boston and is backed by Techstars. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; the company publishes a marketing and clinical site but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Altius Labs
providers.description: Altius Labs builds customized, high-performance blockchain infrastructure for high-frequency onchain markets and trading applications. Founded by former Hudson River Trading engineers, Altius offers a VM-agnostic modular execution stack that decouples execution from consensus and storage to deliver parallel transaction processing, targeting 10,000+ TPS and sub-millisecond latency while remaining EVM-compatible through a hybrid architecture (Altius L1 for settlement plus a high-performance execution coprocessor). Applications retain gas fees, sequencing revenue, and governance rather than ceding them to a base layer. The stack integrates with existing L1, L2, and app chains and supports multiple virtual machines (EVM, MoveVM, CosmWasm, SolanaVM). Altius Labs is backed by Founders Fund, Pantera Capital, Archetype, and others, and positions itself as institutional-grade dedicated chain infrastructure deployable in weeks rather than years.

providers.name: AminoChain
providers.description: AminoChain operates a transparent, decentralized research ecosystem for patient-centric biomedical research. Its Specimen Center helps researchers discover and access legacy biospecimens through decentralized specimen discovery and collaboration, while its Donor Platform enables prospective participant registries and manages participant involvement in studies. The platform emphasizes privacy-preserving re-engagement, cryptographic tracking of biospecimens, auditable consent, and benefit-sharing models that return value to patients and donors. Backed by a16z. AminoChain currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: AmunCore
providers.description: AmunCore turns a database into a secure REST API without writing a backend. You connect a database, pick tables, and endpoints go live with routing, authentication, validation, pagination, joins, errors, logs and docs already handled — the layer between a database and HTTP that would otherwise be a two-to-six-week project. It supports SQL Server, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle and SQLite, with a visual builder that is the same regardless of the engine underneath. It is MCP-native by design: the endpoints you build become tools an AI assistant can call under the same keys, permissions and audit trail, and the MCP endpoint is live and token-gated. Full CRUD, a free plan, and Bearer API keys.

providers.name: Antech Diagnostics
providers.description: Antech Diagnostics operates North America's largest veterinary reference laboratory network, plus in-house diagnostic instruments, imaging, and the HealthTracks diagnostics platform. Antech is part of Mars Petcare (Mars Veterinary Health), acquired via Mars' 2017 purchase of VCA. Antech's programmatic surface is a partner-gated laboratory integration API - commonly configured in practice information management systems (PIMS) as "Antech V3" - that lets veterinary software submit lab requisitions to Antech and receive results back into the patient's medical record. There is no public, self-serve developer portal or published API reference; access requires an Antech account and a business / integration partner relationship, authenticated with an Account Number, Username, Password, and Clinic ID. The logical APIs below are modeled from documented PIMS integration behavior (Vetspire, Cornerstone, DaySmart Vet, NaVetor, ezyVet, NectarVet), not from an Antech-published specification.

providers.name: antengene
providers.description: Antengene Corporation is a commercial-stage, R&D-driven global biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing first-in-class and best-in-class therapies for the treatment of hematologic malignancies and solid tumors. Headquartered in Shanghai with a global footprint across the Asia Pacific region and beyond, Antengene's marketed product XPOVIO (selinexor) and a pipeline of oncology assets such as the Claudin 18.2 antibody-drug conjugate ATG-022 and the CD73 inhibitor ATG-037 target unmet needs in cancer care. Antengene operates in the life sciences sector and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and captured in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence and enrichment.

providers.name: Assort Health
providers.description: Assort Health builds agentic AI voice agents purpose-built for healthcare organizations, automating the full patient journey through natural voice interactions. The platform handles 24/7 appointment scheduling and management, intelligent patient triage and routing, patient intake, insurance eligibility verification, referral and fax automation, proactive outbound outreach, medication refill management, and payment resolution. It integrates with EHR and practice-management systems and is trained on more than 150M patient interactions across 5,000+ providers and 23+ medical specialties. Founded in 2023 by Jeff Liu and Jon Wang, the company is backed by Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, First Round Capital, Felicis, Chemistry, and others. This profile is maintained as part of the API Evangelist network; Assort Health does not currently publish a public developer program, API reference, or OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: Ayenda
providers.description: Ayenda is a hotel-technology platform operating across Colombia, Mexico, and Peru. It combines a property management system (PMS), a channel manager for distributing hotel inventory, and a booking engine; ayenda.com is its consumer reservations channel where travelers search, compare, and book budget hotels, hostels, and aparthotels by city, neighborhood, or landmark, with both traveler and corporate (Empresas) rates. Ayenda began as a budget hotel chain and since 2023 has focused on software, management, and distribution for independent hoteliers across Latin America. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Bailey44
providers.description: Bailey 44 (stylized Bailey/44) is a contemporary womenswear brand selling direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at bailey44.com. The label offers women's apparel — dresses, tops, knits, and separates — around a brand voice of optimism and self-expression ("The Future is Female"). Bailey44 was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. It does not publish a public developer API; its only machine-readable surfaces are the Shopify Customer Account API discovery documents (OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 authorization-server metadata, issuer shopify.com/authentication/8596750398) served at bailey44.com/.well-known/, a standard Shopify sitemap, and an RSS-backed news blog. This profile is a lead enriched by the pipeline; no first-party API artifacts were found.

providers.name: Belden
providers.description: Belden Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets networking, connectivity, and cable products and solutions for industrial automation, smart buildings, and broadcast markets. The company delivers end-to-end signal transmission solutions for mission-critical applications, including industrial Ethernet infrastructure, cybersecurity, and IIoT connectivity. Belden's Hirschmann brand is a leading provider of industrial network switches and management software with CLI, SNMP, and REST API interfaces for network device management.

providers.name: BHP
providers.description: BHP is one of the world's largest mining companies, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia. BHP does not publish a public developer portal; integration is delivered through enterprise procurement systems for tier-1 and tier-2 suppliers, charter and shipping data exchanges for commodity logistics, and standard commodity-trading and assay data exchange formats with customers and exchanges (LME, SHFE).

providers.name: BioNTech
providers.description: BioNTech is a Mainz-based biotechnology company that pioneered the use of messenger RNA (mRNA) technology in human therapeutics. Best known for co-developing Comirnaty, the COVID-19 mRNA vaccine with Pfizer, BioNTech is building a broad oncology pipeline across mRNA cancer immunotherapies, next-generation immunomodulators such as the bispecific antibody BNT327, and targeted therapies, as well as continuing infectious disease vaccine development. BioNTech does not currently expose a public developer API; this index captures the company's products, pipeline, clinical trials, and corporate resources as an API Evangelist profile.

providers.name: Bitterroot Bio
providers.description: Bitterroot Bio is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Palo Alto, California, pioneering the emerging field of cardio-immunology — the interplay between the immune system and cardiovascular disease. Its lead program, BRB-002, is a novel investigational immunomodulating protein therapy that targets CD47 to treat atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) by acting on atherosclerotic plaque through the immunomodulation of macrophages, an approach distinct from current standards of care. Founded in 2021, the company is advancing BRB-002 through its MATADOR Phase 2a proof-of-concept study. Bitterroot Bio is a therapeutics developer and publishes no public developer API or programmatic surface; this profile captures its public web identity within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Black Sheep Foods
providers.description: Black Sheep Foods is a San Francisco food-technology company making plant-based meat that targets the flavors and textures of premium and heritage animal proteins — starting with its signature meat-free lamb, plus steak bites, built on a proprietary pea-protein DualTexture blend. Originally launched as a restaurant and retail brand (served at Bay Area restaurants and sold as vegan ground lamb), the company has increasingly positioned itself as a B2B ingredient supplier, licensing its DualTexture protein platform for hybrid and fully plant-based meat products. It is venture-backed (investors include Bessemer Venture Partners and AgFunder) and pitches a sustainability story of far lower land, water, and greenhouse-gas footprint than conventionally raised lamb. This is a consumer/ ingredient food-tech business with no first-party public developer API; its web presence runs on Shopify.

providers.name: Book My Show
providers.description: BookMyShow (Bigtree Entertainment Pvt. Ltd.) is India's premier online entertainment ticketing platform, serving as a centralized hub for discovering and booking movies, live music festivals, comedy, theatre, sports, activities, and Video-on-Demand (VOD) streaming. For enterprise partners and event organizers it also provides venue management software, box-office point-of-sale solutions, corporate vouchers, gift cards, and end-to-end event production capabilities. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Accel; enriched by the enrichment pipeline. No public developer API or portal was found, but BookMyShow publishes an agent-facing llms.txt describing its consumer inventory hubs and B2B services.

providers.name: Bootc
providers.description: Bootc is an open source tool that enables transactional, in-place operating system updates using OCI/Docker container images as the source for OS updates. It applies the container layering model to bootable host systems, using standard OCI containers as a transport and delivery format for base operating system updates. The container image includes a Linux kernel, and when deployed the base userspace runs normally with systemd as PID 1. Bootc is a CNCF Sandbox project with a stable CLI and API.

providers.name: Boson Motors
providers.description: Boson Motors is an electric vehicle and robotics company founded in 2017, building a modular electric off-road utility vehicle (UTV) platform for agriculture, farm automation, and work applications. Its flagship LX40 is a user-serviceable, low-maintenance electric 4WD UTV that charges from a standard 110v outlet and accepts interchangeable work modules for spraying, hauling, and crew transport. The company operates engineering and production out of Tada, Andhra Pradesh, India, with a strategic base in Fremont, California, and maintains a robotics arm (Boson Robotics) focused on autonomous and agricultural automation. Boson Motors is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a consumer marketing and reservation site with no public developer program, API, SDK, or developer documentation; its public engineering footprint is a GitHub organization of ROS/robotics libraries. This profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network lead and enrichment target.

providers.name: BRINC
providers.description: BRINC builds a connected ecosystem of drones, software, and services purpose-built for public safety in the United States. Its Drone as First Responder (DFR) systems — the Guardian and Responder outdoor drones, the Lemur 2 indoor tactical drone, and the throwable BRINC Ball — pair with LiveOps teleoperations software (livestreaming, two-way comms, evidence management) to put a camera overhead within seconds of a 911 call. BRINC reports deployments across 900+ public safety agencies in all 50 states, sub-70-second average drone arrival times, and a recent $125M funding round. The company also runs its Safeguard upgrade-and-repair program and grant/DFR playbook services. BRINC exposes no public developer API, SDK, or MCP surface as of this profile; this entry is enriched from the company's public web presence.

providers.name: Brookdale Senior Living
providers.description: Brookdale Senior Living is one of the largest operators of senior living communities in the United States, offering independent living, assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing, continuing care retirement communities (CCRCs), and in-home care through Brookdale at Home. The company operates hundreds of communities across the US, serving tens of thousands of residents and their families.

providers.name: Careforce
providers.description: Careforce (Helpcare AI, Inc., d/b/a Careforce) provides an autonomous AI workforce platform for healthcare operations. Its AI agents — Angelica, a care coordinator handling preventive-care outreach, appointment scheduling, reminders, and referral management, and David, a data analyst that pulls and analyzes patient data across EHR and portal systems — integrate with 30+ healthcare platforms including Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth, and NextGen to close care gaps and reduce staff workload. Backed by CRV. Careforce consumes third-party healthcare APIs rather than publishing a public developer API; no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs were found.

providers.name: Cartography Biosciences
providers.description: Cartography Biosciences is a South San Francisco biotechnology company developing precision cancer immunotherapies designed around tumor-selective antigens. Using single-cell genomics, proteomics, and novel binder-discovery methods, the company profiles antigen expression across thousands of patient samples and millions of cells to build a comprehensive antigen atlas, classifying cancers by antigen expression rather than histology or genetic mutation. Its goal is to direct immunotherapies toward the safest and most effective targets. Backed by a16z, Cartography was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a corporate and careers website but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Cellares
providers.description: Cellares is an Integrated Development and Manufacturing Organization (IDMO) for cell therapies, operating a global network of automated "Smart Factories." Its FDA-recognized Cell Shuttle platform delivers high-throughput, end-to-end, cGMP industrial-scale cell therapy manufacturing, and its Cell Q platform automates quality-control testing of cell therapy products. Smart Factories operate in South San Francisco (CA), Bridgewater (NJ), Leiden (Netherlands), and Kashiwa (Japan). Cellares was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and profiled in the API Evangelist network; as a cell therapy manufacturing organization it publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Cityblock Health
providers.description: Cityblock Health is a value-based healthcare provider delivering relationship-based primary care, behavioral and mental health support, social care services, urgent care, and hospital-to-home transitions to underserved and Medicaid-eligible communities. Care is coordinated by Community Health Partners who connect members with medical providers, therapists, clinical pharmacists, and social resources. Cityblock operates clinics across nine states plus Washington, D.C., working in partnership with health insurance plans. Backed by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: COMSOL
providers.description: COMSOL is a Swedish-American engineering software company best known for COMSOL Multiphysics, a desktop platform for physics-based simulation.
