The platform exposes a unified COMSOL API that powers the GUI, the Application Builder (Java-based Method Editor), LiveLink for MATLAB, LiveLink for Excel, and the LiveLink family of CAD/CAE interfacing products (SOLIDWORKS, Inventor, AutoCAD, Revit, Solid Edge, CATIA V5, MATLAB, Simulink, Excel). COMSOL is primarily licensed desktop software with web deployment via COMSOL Server and standalone applications via COMSOL Compiler. There is no public web REST API and no public GitHub SDK organization; programmatic surfaces are the Java API, the MATLAB LiveLink interface, and the module-specific LiveLink integrations bundled with the licensed product.

providers.name: Consure Medical
providers.description: Consure Medical is a nurse-centric medical device company with Silicon Valley roots that develops incontinence and critical-care management solutions for hospitals. Its product line includes the QiVi family of truly external male and female urine management catheters, the Qora SMK manual stool management kit, and the Qoramatic automated stool management system, all designed to reduce catheter-associated urinary tract infections (CAUTI), incontinence-associated dermatitis (IAD), and hospital-acquired conditions while improving patient dignity. The company operates from San Diego, California and New Delhi, India, and markets its devices through partners such as Medline. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Consure Medical publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Course Hero
providers.description: Course Hero is an online learning platform where students and educators access more than 25 million course-specific study resources — practice problems, study guides, class notes, step-by-step explanations, essays, and lab reports — alongside 24/7 tutoring and AI-assisted study tools. Founded in 2006 by Andrew Grauer at Cornell University and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Course Hero is part of Learneo, a family of learning and productivity brands that also includes QuillBot, Symbolab, LitCharts, CliffsNotes, Scribbr, Bartleby, and LanguageTool. Course Hero exposes only internal, undocumented web APIs (under /api/) that power its consumer web and mobile apps; it publishes no public developer program, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or partner API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of D1 Capital, Sierra Ventures, and SV Angel.

providers.name: Covera Health
providers.description: Covera Health is a clinical intelligence company that delivers AI-powered quality insights across the healthcare ecosystem, beginning with diagnostic radiology. Its Connected Platform helps providers, health plans, and employers improve diagnostic accuracy and care coordination across high-cost conditions including musculoskeletal disorders, cancer, neurological disease, heart disease, chronic pain, and metabolic disease. Certified as a Patient Safety Organization by AHRQ, Covera focuses on reducing misdiagnosis, unnecessary cost, and patient harm from the point of diagnosis through care delivery, prior authorization, and claims administration. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Creyon Bio
providers.description: Creyon Bio (branded Creyon) is a San Diego drug-development company operating an AI-powered nucleic acid engineering platform, NucleIQ, that designs oligonucleotide and RNA therapies with tissue- and cell-specific delivery. Creyon uses aptamer-based delivery, lipid nanoparticles, and transferrin-receptor aptamers to cross the blood-brain barrier, targeting immunology, central nervous system (CNS), and neuromuscular indications including late-onset Pompe disease. The company is a venture-backed portfolio company of DCVC and currently advances three wholly-owned programs. This profile is a company/identity record in the API Evangelist network; Creyon publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Dyno
providers.description: Dyno Therapeutics is an AI and biotechnology company building high-performance gene delivery technologies to unlock the potential of next-generation genetic medicine. Using its CapsidMap platform, which combines machine learning with high-throughput in vivo measurement, Dyno designs novel adeno-associated virus (AAV) capsids with improved tissue targeting, immune evasion, manufacturability, and payload capacity. The company partners with leading gene therapy developers rather than exposing a public developer API; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an a16z Bio+Health portfolio company. Founded on research from George Church's lab at Harvard, Dyno is headquartered in Watertown, Massachusetts.

providers.name: Eisen
providers.description: Eisen is an AI-enabled compliance operations platform for financial institutions and digital asset companies, managing escheatment (unclaimed property), disbursement, customer outreach, and 1099 tax reporting across all account types. Its product suite includes an Escheatment Manager that tracks state compliance deadlines and dormancy rules, a Disbursement Manager that automates personalized customer payments, an Outreach Manager that re-engages dormant account holders, and a 1099 Reporting Manager for tax reporting. Eisen handles dormant accounts, stale checks, account wind-downs, and forced closures, and is backed by Cowboy Ventures, Homebrew, and Index Ventures. As of this profile Eisen exposes no public developer API, portal, or documentation; this record captures its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Finres
providers.description: Finres (finres SAS) is a French climate-risk analytics company building a decision platform for agriculture. It translates climate hazards into economic consequences for farms, agricultural value chains and territories, combining agronomic, pedological, climate and market data with AI models that are peer-reviewed and validated against published research. Two productized offerings sit on top of the platform - a farm-level economic and climate viability diagnostic (DPEC, currently in beta, seeded from a grower's TelePAC parcel file and reference datasets such as Agreste, IPPAP and RICA) and bespoke territorial or sector studies. Finres was founded by Florent Baarsch, previously with the World Bank, the United Nations and climate research institutes, and its customers include the French government, the World Bank, the Green Climate Fund, IFAD and the FAO. The company markets high-resolution data delivery into customer decision systems, but as of this enrichment pass publishes no public developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification or SDK - access is arranged through a sales demo.

providers.name: ForeVR
providers.description: ForeVR Games is a consumer virtual-reality game studio that brings classic social bar and backyard games into VR. Its catalog includes ForeVR Bowl, ForeVR Darts, ForeVR Pool, and ForeVR Cornhole, built for multiplayer play across Meta Quest, Steam VR, and PlayStation VR2. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. ForeVR is a consumer game publisher with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation program; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Forged Sports, Inc.
providers.description: Forged Sports, Inc. is a Palo Alto, California software company (founded May 2024) building a Venue Management System (VMS) for commercial indoor golf and golf-simulator venues. The platform consolidates bay operations, bookings, player profiles, waivers, leagues, business intelligence, and third-party integrations into a single command center — offering live bay monitoring, reservation and booking management, player-retention analytics, game-popularity insight, and bay-utilization reporting. Forged Sports also develops gamified indoor-golf experiences on top of launch-monitor technologies. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface is currently published.

providers.name: Gatherhealth
providers.description: Gather Health is a Boston-area primary care organization delivering team-based, community-centered medical care for seniors aged 65+ on Medicare. Operating neighborhood locations across Quincy, Lynn, Dorchester, and Brockton, each patient is supported by a care team of a primary care provider, a "Gather Guide," and a medical technician, with both in-office and home-based visits, care coordination with specialists and hospitals, and 24/7 urgent care support. Gather Health is a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures. As a care-delivery organization it does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; it uses athenahealth for its patient portal. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity record.

providers.name: Geopipe
providers.description: Geopipe uses AI and machine learning to build game-ready digital twins of real-world cities and environments. It ingests raw sensor data (imagery and laser scans) and reconstructs regions as semantically-modeled, multi-level-of- detail 3D models that developers stream or download into games, simulations, training, architecture, and metaverse applications without any manual 3D modeling. Delivery is through Cesium 3D Tiles streaming for Unity and Unreal Engine, downloadable 3D meshes in common file formats, ready-to-use Unity Asset Store packs, and a first-party Unity SDK, backed by an open-source geospatial and 3D-tiles toolchain on GitHub. Founded in New York City by Christopher Mitchell and Thomas Dickerson and backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Givers
providers.description: Givers is a healthcare technology platform that enrolls, supports, and pays family caregivers through state programs. Qualified family caregivers can earn up to $2,000 per month tax-free while caring for a loved one such as a parent, spouse, or child. Givers handles Medicaid and state program eligibility screening and enrollment, provides caregiver coaching and training, and manages ongoing payment processing on behalf of the caregiver. The company operates a consumer web platform rather than a public developer API. It is backed by CRV and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Good Eggs
providers.description: Good Eggs is an online grocery marketplace founded in 2011 that delivers "absurdly fresh" groceries, meal kits, and locally sourced food to homes across the West Coast of the United States, primarily the San Francisco Bay Area and Southern California. The company curates a marketplace of over 6,000 items from local farms, ranches, fisheries, and independent food makers, and operates its own fulfillment and same-day/next-day delivery logistics. Good Eggs is a consumer-facing e-commerce and delivery business; it maintains a verified public GitHub organization for its engineering open-source and internal tooling but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner integration program. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead (GV, Index Ventures, Obvious Ventures) and enriched with the company's real public web properties.

providers.name: Groups
providers.description: Groups (Groups Recover Together, joingroups.com) is a healthcare provider delivering outpatient opioid use disorder treatment that combines Suboxone (buprenorphine) medication-assisted treatment with weekly group therapy and individual care coordination. Founded in 2014 and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Groups operates in-person locations nationwide alongside a virtual/telehealth care option and a member mobile app, accepting most commercial insurance and Medicaid. It is CARF-accredited and focuses on accessible, non-judgmental, long-term recovery. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Groups is a direct-to-consumer clinical service and publishes no public developer API surface at the time of profiling.

providers.name: GymNadz
providers.description: GymNadz is a women-focused fitness application offering personalized workout programs, nutrition and meal plans, and community features. The platform provides a library of 300+ exercises with customizable workout and meal plans tailored to individual fitness goals, plus progress tracking and coach interaction. It is delivered as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps rather than as a developer platform. GymNadz is a portfolio company of 500 Global, tracked in the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Hermeus
providers.description: Hermeus is an American aerospace and defense company building rapidly reusable high-Mach and hypersonic aircraft for national-security missions in partnership with the U.S. Department of Defense. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, the company applies a hardware-rich, rapid design-build-test approach to move quickly from concept to flight. Its programs include Quarterhorse, a reusable high-speed flight-test aircraft; Darkhorse, a multi-mission reusable hypersonic uncrewed aerial system (UAS); and Chimera, a hybrid turbine-based combined-cycle engine that transitions from turbojet takeoff through supersonic flight into hypersonic acceleration. Hermeus is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile tracks the company's public web, security, and corporate properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HERP
providers.description: HERP Inc. (株式会社HERP) is a Japanese HR Tech company whose mission is "採用を変え、日本を強く。" (change recruiting, strengthen Japan). It builds HERP Hire, an AI-era applicant tracking and recruitment management system (ATS) known for "scrum recruiting", alongside ジョブミル (Jobmill) for recruiting agents and HERP Career, a startup-focused job-change service. HERP Hire integrates with job boards and tools such as Zoom, Google Calendar and Slack, and exposes the "HERP Hire API" (generally available from 2026-02-03 to paying customers) for member assignment and application management. HERP was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Impactyn B.V
providers.description: Impactyn B.V is an AI-powered crowd-marketing platform that turns authentic user-generated video reviews into brand marketing assets. Based in Cairo, Egypt, Impactyn connects brands with real customers who record genuine video testimonials, letting businesses leverage user-generated video content to increase visibility, credibility, and engagement. The platform is delivered primarily through consumer iOS and Android mobile apps plus a partner/brand web console, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public API or developer platform is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Included Health
providers.description: Included Health is a healthcare company that delivers personalized virtual care and healthcare navigation to members through their employers and health plans. The platform combines virtual primary, urgent, behavioral, and specialty care with a 24/7 Care Team that handles benefits navigation, provider matching, billing and claims advocacy, and expert medical opinions. Sold B2B to employers, health plans, labor and trust organizations, and the public sector, Included Health surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Greylock portfolio company; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or well-known discovery surface, so this profile captures company identity and live domain-security posture rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Inovia Bio
providers.description: Inovia Bio is a TechBio company delivering drug development strategy and evidence generation for biotech and pharmaceutical organizations, aiming to combine big-pharma impact with biotech speed. It pairs purpose-built platforms with advisory services to produce regulatory-grade evidence, covering clinical development planning and trial design, therapeutic product profiles (TPP), development, regulatory and commercial strategy, Integrated Evidence Plans (IEP/IEGP), Real World Evidence (RWE) for regulatory submissions, and clinical program rescue. Its Study Designer platform (diagity.inovia.bio) supports study design workflows. Inovia Bio is a Seedcamp portfolio company; no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: Inspiren
providers.description: Inspiren is a healthcare technology company providing an AI-powered ecosystem for senior living communities that combines hardware and software to improve resident safety, care planning, and staff efficiency. Its platform pairs devices such as the AUGi sensor, Sense, Help Button, Resident Pendant, and Staff Beacon with the Inspiren HQ software platform and mobile app to deliver emergency call, real-time fall prevention and safety monitoring, data-driven care insights, and staff workflow coordination. Inspiren reports outcomes including reductions in falls, faster alert response times, and improved occupancy for the communities it serves. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and Scale Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; Inspiren does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Jarmin
providers.description: Jarmin is a Y Combinator-backed company building autonomous "AI employees" for technical and operational roles — ML engineers, financial analysts, account executives, compliance analysts, data analysts, project managers, and paralegals. Rather than a single chatbot, Jarmin operates a system of proprietary agents, models, and automations that learn a role's responsibilities, connect to a company's internal systems and data sources, experiment with approaches, and run end-to-end workflows autonomously (with optional human approval at key decision points). For ML work this spans domain-specific feature engineering, model selection under constraints, hyperparameter optimization, and deploying production pipelines. Founded by engineers from Meta, Apple, AWS, Lockheed Martin, and JPMorgan Chase, Jarmin targets investment banking, fintech, and legal verticals. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio lead; at enrichment time Jarmin publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Karius
providers.description: Karius is an infectious disease diagnostics company that applies clinical metagenomics and machine learning to microbial cell-free DNA (mcfDNA) circulating in the bloodstream, detecting pathogens that conventional culture-based testing misses. Its CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited laboratory runs the Karius Spectrum blood test, which screens a single blood draw for more than 1,000 bacteria, fungi, DNA viruses, and parasites, and the Karius Focus BAL test, which detects more than 500 pathogens in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid for lung infections. Results are returned to clinicians managing complex, immunocompromised, and difficult-to-diagnose patients.

providers.name: Kodiak Networks
providers.description: Kodiak Networks built a carrier-grade Push-to-Talk over Cellular (PoC) platform that wireless operators deployed as their own branded push-to-talk service, competing with legacy land mobile radio for dispatch, field-service and public-safety workforces. Motorola Solutions acquired the company in 2017 and the technology now ships as Motorola Solutions' "Kodiak" mission-critical push-to-talk (MCPTT) offering for carriers, aligned to the 3GPP SA WG6 MCPTT specifications (TS 23.379, TS 24.382, TS 24.482, TS 22.582) and interoperable with land mobile radio through Critical Connect. Kodiak Networks no longer operates independently: its legacy domain serves only a static "Site under maintenance" placeholder over plain HTTP, and it publishes no OpenAPI, developer documentation, SDKs or public API surface of its own. Broadband push-to-talk APIs for third-party integration do exist, but access is gated behind the Motorola Solutions Application Developer Program.

providers.name: Lexyom
providers.description: Lexyom (Lexyom LLP) is a law firm operating at lexyom.com, which redirects to lexyomlaw.com. The firm markets legal services to financial-services companies: financial institution setup, company registration, broker licensing, proprietary-trading ("prop firm") licensing, trademark registration and IP protection, retainer representation, and contract drafting and review. Published offices are New York (450 Park Avenue) and Dubai (DIFC Gate Village), with stated emphasis on US and MENA cross-border regulation. The public web property is a client-rendered single-page application with a marketing site, a blog, a news section, a "Become a Client" intake flow, and an authenticated client portal (matters, contracts, documents, invoices, trademarks). Lexyom publishes no public API, developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Lottie
providers.description: Lottie is a UK-based later-life care marketplace that helps families and retirees find and fund the country's best care homes, home care providers, and retirement living communities. The free consumer service matches people with regulated care providers, publishes availability and pricing, and offers guidance from care experts alongside a large library of funding and care guides. Backed by Accel and General Catalyst, Lottie serves tens of thousands of families monthly across England, Scotland, and Wales. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a consumer-facing web platform only and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: MedArrive
providers.description: MedArrive is a healthcare technology company that provides a logistics and workforce platform for in-home care delivery. Its software gives health systems and in-home care providers smart scheduling, real-time provider routing, automated re-routing and patient reminders, and a live command-center dashboard for tracking every provider and visit, alongside a provider mobile app for field teams. The HIPAA-compliant platform is designed to reduce windshield time, cut scheduling effort, and increase daily visit capacity so care teams spend more time with patients and less on logistics. MedArrive is backed by Kleiner Perkins.

providers.name: Memora Health
providers.description: Memora Health is a healthcare technology company (now part of Commure) that provides an AI-powered platform for digitizing and automating complex care programs. Its intelligent care enablement platform combines clinical workflow automation, remote patient monitoring, symptom management, medication adherence, and patient education to reduce clinician inbox burden and keep enrolled patients engaged between visits. Memora serves health systems and provider organizations across maternal care, surgical care, gastrointestinal care, oncology, chronic care management, population health, and transitions of care. The company operates as an enterprise B2B solution and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; integrations are delivered through direct enterprise engagements. Backed by General Catalyst, Memora is migrating onto the Commure platform at commure.com/engage.

providers.name: Mendaera
providers.description: Mendaera is a healthcare robotics company building the Focalist handheld robotic system, which combines robotics, real-time ultrasound imaging, and software to guide needle-based medical procedures with greater precision and consistency. The FDA-cleared platform is preparing for broad commercial launch in 2026. Mendaera is backed by Lux Capital, Threshold Ventures, Founders Fund, PFM Health Sciences, and Puma Venture Capital. The company is focused on medical devices rather than a developer-facing platform; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Midi Health
providers.description: Midi Health is a virtual care platform for women in midlife, delivering insurance-covered telemedicine from clinicians who specialize in perimenopause, menopause, and related midlife health. Patients get personalized care plans spanning hormone therapy (HRT), GLP-1 and weight management, sexual wellness, mood, sleep, hair and skin, and cancer-survivorship care, plus prescriptions, compounded medications, and supplements, with coverage available across all 50 states. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), Midi operates as a direct-to-consumer and employer/health-plan telehealth service. No public API, developer portal, or technical developer surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Nectar Social
providers.description: Nectar Social is an AI "social operating system" for consumer brands — an AI-powered social teammate that manages online communities, performs real-time social listening and sentiment analysis, tracks influencers, and turns organic social engagement and DM conversations into measurable revenue across community, brand safety, commerce, influencer, social-selling, and analytics use cases. Founded in 2023 by Misbah and Farah Uraizee and based in Bellevue, Washington, the company raised $30M from Menlo Ventures, GV (Google Ventures), and True Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; as of this enrichment pass Nectar Social ships a SaaS web application (app.nectarsocial.com) but does not publish a public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs.

providers.name: Oceans
providers.description: Oceans Healthcare is a behavioral health system operating a network of psychiatric hospitals and outpatient programs across the southern United States. Founded in 2010 and backed by General Catalyst, the company delivers inpatient and outpatient mental health treatment for adolescents, adults, older adults, and veterans and first responders, spanning acute inpatient psychiatry, partial hospitalization, intensive outpatient, and virtual telehealth care. Oceans Healthcare is a care-delivery operator focused on safety, stability, and lasting healing; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition at this time.

providers.name: OpenLLMetry
providers.description: OpenLLMetry is an open-source observability framework for LLM and generative AI applications, built on top of OpenTelemetry. Maintained by Traceloop under the Apache 2.0 license, it provides drop-in instrumentation for 30+ LLM providers, vector databases, and agent frameworks, and emits standardized GenAI traces over OTLP to any observability backend (Datadog, Grafana, Honeycomb, New Relic, Splunk, Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust, and the Traceloop platform). Its semantic conventions for LLMs have been upstreamed into the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions.

providers.name: Osmind
providers.description: Osmind is an interventional psychiatry platform that powers what it describes as the largest network of interventional psychiatry practices in the United States. The company provides a purpose-built electronic health record (EHR), billing and revenue-cycle management (RCM), measurement-based care and outcomes tracking, and a patient mobile app for practices delivering treatments such as ketamine, Spravato (esketamine), TMS, and other novel and interventional mental-health therapies. Osmind reports serving 1,000+ practices and supporting more than one million treatments delivered. It is a private B2B healthcare SaaS company backed by General Catalyst and other investors. As of this profile, Osmind publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or webhook surface on its public site.

providers.name: Pack
providers.description: Pack is an AI-powered skill management platform for HR and People teams. The product helps organizations map skills into future-proof ontologies, assess proficiency across teams, identify strategic skill gaps, and build personalized development plans for employees. Additional capabilities include business impact analysis, a Return on Development Investment (RODI) calculator, and access to a network of 1,000+ certified trainers for mentoring and coaching. Pack integrates with existing HRIS and LMS systems. The company (Pack SRL) has raised approximately EUR 5.8M and is backed by Anthemis and Techstars. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass Pack publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Paperplane
providers.description: Paperplane is an AI sales-productivity tool (Y Combinator W23, backed by Bloomberg Beta) that automatically takes notes on sales calls and keeps a rep's CRM up to date. It connects to a team's calendar and to conversational intelligence and call-recording tools such as Gong and Chorus, transcribes and analyzes each call, then writes the results back to Salesforce — updating opportunity fields, notes, and action items so sales teams spend less time on manual CRM data entry and stay on top of their deals. The product is organized around opportunities, calls, and notes, with integrations for Google Calendar, Gong, Chorus, and Salesforce. Paperplane is a hosted SaaS application; as of this enrichment pass it exposes a product documentation site (GitBook, with an llms.txt index) but no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or SDK.

providers.name: Parabilis Medicines
providers.description: Parabilis Medicines (formerly FogPharma) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing a new class of ultra-tunable alpha-helical peptide therapeutics called Helicons to reach intracellular protein targets long considered undruggable. Its AI- and physics-based discovery platform underpins a pipeline led by zolucatetide, a candidate targeting the beta-catenin / TCF interaction in the Wnt signaling pathway across multiple cancers. Backed by more than $500M from leading life sciences investors and public since its June 2026 IPO (Nasdaq: PBLS), the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and GV. It publishes a public marketing and investor web presence and a science/data tech blog, but exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: PayRange
providers.description: PayRange is a fintech company providing cashless commerce and self-service retail technology for unattended machines. Its platform enables mobile payments, age and identity verification, and access control across laundromats, vending, car washes, campgrounds, hospitality, micro-markets, coffee, and transit ticketing. Hardware includes the BluKey family, BluCheck, and PayStation, paired with a consumer mobile app and an operator Business Management Suite. Backed by GV and Matrix Partners. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment; integrations appear to run through direct partner and licensing channels.

providers.name: Pearl Health
providers.description: Pearl Health is a healthcare technology company that provides value-based care intelligence for physicians, primary care practices, physician networks, and health systems. Its platform acts as an operating system for value-based care, ingesting Medicare claims data, ADT feeds, and EHR information to identify high-risk patients, prioritize care activities with actionable next steps and automated administrative workflows, and optimize financial performance under Traditional Medicare and Medicare Advantage risk arrangements. Pearl reports serving 5,000+ providers across 40+ states, managing roughly 250,000 beneficiaries. The company connects to existing EHR systems but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as an a16z and SV Angel portfolio company and enriched from the provider's public web surface.

providers.name: Pensando *
providers.description: AMD Pensando (formerly Pensando Systems, acquired by AMD in 2022) builds programmable Distributed Services Cards (DPUs) and the Policy and Services Manager (PSM) control plane that operates them across cloud, distributed services switch, and enterprise deployments. PSM exposes a REST API — surfaced through auto-generated, first-party Python bindings on PyPI (pensando-cloud, pensando-dss, pensando-ent) and a Terraform provider — for managing clusters, networks, security policy, and services on Pensando infrastructure. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Physics Wallah
providers.description: Physics Wallah (PW) is India's leading affordable education technology platform, offering live and recorded courses, test series, notes, and doubt-solving for competitive exams (IIT JEE, NEET, GATE, UPSC), government job preparation (SSC, Banking, Railways, Defence), school boards (CBSE, ICSE, and regional boards), and professional certifications (CA, CS, CFA, ACCA). Beyond its flagship pw.live learning app it operates PW Skills for professional upskilling, PW Store for books and study material, CuriousJr for younger grades, and 100+ offline Vidyapeeth and Pathshala centres across 175+ cities. Physics Wallah reached unicorn status in 2022 and serves tens of millions of students. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. Physics Wallah does not publish an official public developer portal or API program; the company's public technology footprint is a set of open-source infrastructure libraries under its tech-pw GitHub org.

providers.name: Portea
providers.description: Portea Medical is India's leading home healthcare provider, delivering clinical care to patients at home across 40+ cities. Services include physiotherapy, nursing care, doctor consultations, medical equipment rental, trained attendants, diagnostic and lab tests, counselling, and specialized programs for eldercare, mother and baby care, diabetes, critical care, and vaccination. Portea was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer home-healthcare operator it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Protagonist Therapeutics
providers.description: Protagonist Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Newark, California and founded in 2006. It discovers and develops peptide-based new chemical entities using a proprietary peptide discovery and engineering platform, targeting rare and prevalent diseases with significant unmet medical need. Lead programs include rusfertide, a hepcidin mimetic in Phase 3 for polycythemia vera, and icotrokinra (PN-235), an oral IL-23 receptor antagonist partnered with Johnson & Johnson. The company is publicly traded (Nasdaq: PTGX) following its 2016 IPO. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or agent surface.

providers.name: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers)
providers.description: PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is one of the Big Four professional services firms, with approximately 370,000 staff across a global network of member firms coordinated by PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited (PwCIL). PwC organizes delivery across three primary service lines — Assurance (audit), Tax (tax compliance, planning, and reporting), and Advisory (consulting, deals, and risk). The firm operates proprietary technology platforms including PwC Halo (a suite of data analytics tools used to support audit engagements), the Trusted AI initiative (PwC's responsible-AI governance and assurance framework), and ProEdge (a workforce upskilling platform). In April 2024 PwC announced a multi-year alliance with OpenAI positioning the firm as both OpenAI's largest customer and its first reseller of ChatGPT Enterprise, supporting PwC's broader generative-AI consulting practice. PwC's research and insights surface — pwc.com/insights, the annual Global CEO Survey, the Global Workforce Hopes and Fears Survey, the Money Tree report, and regional industry outlooks — is the firm's primary public-facing knowledge product. PwC does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, partner API documentation, or a GitHub organization at the corporate level. The github.com/pwc handle is held by an unrelated individual user (Patrick Clearwater). Any technical integrations with PwC platforms are arranged through engagement contracts and the PwC Technology Consulting practice rather than through self-service developer credentials. PwC's content distribution is reader-facing (newsletter subscriptions, the PwC US Newsroom, LinkedIn, YouTube) with no documented public RSS feed endpoint exposing news, press releases, or insights as a syndication contract.

providers.name: Qlaris Bio
providers.description: Qlaris Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing first-in-class therapies for ophthalmic diseases, with a mission to preserve vision and prevent blindness. Its lead candidate, QLS-111, uses a novel mechanism of action to lower intraocular pressure by targeting the distal outflow pathway, and is being evaluated for primary open-angle glaucoma, ocular hypertension, and elevated IOP associated with conditions such as Sturge-Weber Syndrome. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a clinical-stage drug developer, Qlaris Bio publishes a corporate website but no public developer, API, or product integration surface.

providers.name: Reibus
providers.description: Reibus is a technology-enabled B2B platform for the industrial metals industry, originally a digital marketplace for buying and selling steel and other metals and now focused on open-deck freight logistics for shipping steel and industrial metals. Operating as Reibus Logistics, the company connects shippers with a vast network of international and domestic carriers across flatbed, dry van, and drayage modes, offering instant quoting, shipment visibility, and cross-border logistics in the US, Canada, and Mexico. Founded by CEO John Blount, Reibus operates in 7 countries, does business in 25+ countries, and is backed by Canaan Partners, Initialized Capital, and the SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Roivant
providers.description: Roivant Sciences Ltd. (Nasdaq: ROIV) is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical holding company that accelerates the development and commercialization of medicines through its distinctive "Vant" model, a network of nimble, focused subsidiary companies such as Immunovant, Priovant, and Pulmovant. Founded in 2014, Roivant advances a pipeline spanning immunology, dermatology, and other therapeutic areas, and has delivered multiple FDA approvals and Phase 3 trial successes. Roivant is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; it operates a corporate and investor web presence but publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Second Measure
providers.description: Bloomberg Second Measure provides alternative data analytics for investors, turning billions of anonymized U.S. consumer card-transaction purchases into daily insights on the performance of thousands of public and private companies and brands. It is a Bloomberg product delivered primarily through the Bloomberg Terminal (ALTD and ECAN commands) and via aggregated and transaction-level data feeds, with 2-, 3-, and 7-day delivery lags that support intra-quarter earnings forecasting and investment monitoring. Second Measure was founded as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company and acquired by Bloomberg in 2020. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; access is gated through Bloomberg data products rather than a self-serve web API.

providers.name: Silk Labs
providers.description: Silk Labs was an on-device artificial intelligence startup founded in 2015 by former Mozilla CTO Andreas Gal together with Chris Jones and Michael Vines, a team drawn from Mozilla's Firefox OS effort. The company's open-source Silk platform layered a Node.js runtime on Android so developers could build Internet of Things applications entirely in JavaScript, and it later shipped work on the "Sense" AI home camera focused on running real-time visual and audio recognition directly on the device. Silk Labs was backed by investors including 500 Global and was acquired by Apple in November 2018, after which it ceased independent operations; the silklabs.com domain is now parked on Apple nameservers. Its open-source Silk code, GitHub organization, and npm packages remain publicly available and are captured in this profile.

providers.name: Sona
providers.description: Sona is an AI-powered workforce management platform for large, multi-site organizations in hospitality, hotels, care, retail, and logistics. It unifies labor demand forecasting, autonomous staff scheduling, core HR (onboarding, absence, training), and payroll automation, with a Raffy AI assistant that guides manager decisions plus real-time analytics across locations. Sona ships 95+ pre-built integrations (ATS, POS, LMS, tipping, earned-wage-access, and care-planning systems) and advertises a private API for building bespoke integrations, though it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead (Northzone, Polychain, Speedinvest) and enriched via the local pipeline.

providers.name: Sounding Board
providers.description: Sounding Board is a leadership development company offering tech-powered coaching and mentoring solutions that help organizations develop dynamic leaders at every level. Its platform pairs software products (Expand, Guide, and Transform) with a global network of ICF/EMCC/IAC/CCE-certified coaches to deliver 1:1 coaching, group coaching, mentoring, and on-demand leadership development. Sounding Board serves technology, professional services, government, education, healthcare, financial services, and retail organizations, and was acquired by BTS in March 2025 to extend end-to-end executive-to-frontline coaching. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Canaan Partners; no public developer or API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: Spero Therapeutics
providers.description: Spero Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company advancing innovative medicines for immune-mediated and infectious diseases. Its pipeline includes SP001, a third-generation anti-CD40L antibody targeting IgG4-related disease, alongside earlier programs in antibacterial and rare-disease therapeutics. Spero was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network. As a life-sciences drug developer, Spero publishes a corporate and investor-relations web presence but no public developer API, developer portal, or technical integration surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Switch Therapeutics
providers.description: Switch Therapeutics is a precision neuroscience biotechnology company founded in 2020 and based in San Francisco, California, developing biomarker-gated genetic medicines for central nervous system (CNS) diseases with high unmet need. Its Conditionally Activated siRNA (CASi) platform combines properties of single- and double-stranded RNAs in one molecule to enable efficient self-delivery, potent and durable gene knockdown, and cell-type/cell-state selectivity. Its lead development candidate is CASi-APOE, a liver-sparing APOE RNAi therapy. The company is backed by CRV and Insight Partners and is a therapeutics developer with no public developer API, SDK, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Synchron
providers.description: Synchron is a clinical-stage neurotechnology company developing an implantable brain-computer interface (BCI). Its flagship device, the Stentrode, is placed in a blood vessel near the motor cortex through a minimally invasive endovascular procedure (via the jugular vein) rather than open brain surgery, letting people with paralysis control digital devices with their thoughts. Synchron has co-developed a Bluetooth-based interface aligned with Apple's BCI-HID protocol, connecting brain signals to iPhone, iPad, and Vision Pro through Switch Control, and runs a Cognitive AI division decoding neural data in real time. The Stentrode is an investigational device under FDA and TGA clinical trials and is not yet commercially approved. Synchron publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Take2.ai
providers.description: Take2.ai builds autonomous AI agents purpose-built for healthcare recruiting, automating the end-to-end hiring workflow from candidate sourcing through screening, interviewing, credential verification, and scheduling. Its product suite includes an AI Interviewer that conducts 24/7 phone interviews and syncs scoring and transcripts back into the recruiter's system, an AI Sourcer that re-engages past applicants to build pipelines for hard-to-fill clinical roles, an AI Verifier for real-time credential and certification checks, and an AI Scheduler for interview coordination. The platform integrates with most ATS and HRIS systems, is hosted on AWS in the United States, and is SOC 2 Type II compliant. Take2.ai is a Techstars-backed company serving enterprise healthcare organizations. As of this profile the company exposes a customer-facing SaaS product and ATS/HRIS integrations but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tibles
providers.description: Tibles is a digital collectibles company building authentic, engaging collecting experiences on the Flow blockchain. Its Tibles Clubhouse platform hosts multiple consumer iOS and web apps built around licensed intellectual properties — including FuggClub (Fugglers), Sk8tibles (Skateboarding Hall of Fame), OneShots (Valiant Comics), Tibles Fraggle Rock and Seussibles (Jim Henson / Dr. Seuss), and Aggretsuko (Sanrio) — offering interactive digital trading cards and NFT collections with barter-style trading, chat, and community events. Tibles is a Certified Flow Developer and publishes open-source Cadence smart contracts and an IPFS desktop client, but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal. Backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: TrustArc
providers.description: TrustArc is a Walnut Creek, California enterprise privacy management platform that helps organizations operationalize global data privacy programs. Its product portfolio spans three suites. Privacy Studio covers consumer-facing consent and rights with Cookie Consent Manager, Consent & Preference Manager, Individual Rights Manager (DSR automation), and the Unified Trust Center. The Governance Suite covers internal privacy program operations with PrivacyCentral, Data Mapping & Risk Manager, Assessment Manager (PIA/DPIA/TIA), and Nymity Research for regulatory intelligence. Assurance Services delivers third-party attestations including Data Privacy Framework verification, GDPR and CCPA/CPRA validation, APEC CBPR/PRP, and TRUSTe Responsible AI Certification. TrustArc exposes a developer surface through gated APIs documented in the customer help center — including the Gateway API, Individual Rights Manager Rapid/Client APIs, Cookie Consent Manager Reporting API, Consent & Preference Manager Rapid/Standard APIs, and Assessment Manager Internal API — plus a Mobile Consent SDK (iOS), 300+ prebuilt connectors to platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, Microsoft Dynamics, Jira, and Google Workspace, and a Google Consent Mode v2 template published on GitHub. Founded over 28 years ago and serving 1,500+ enterprises including Abbott, ADP, GE, Nike, and Starbucks, TrustArc operates on a commercial SaaS model; complete API specifications are not publicly available.

providers.name: TutorABC
providers.description: TutorABC (formerly iTutorGroup) is a Taiwan-headquartered online language-learning platform offering live one-on-one and small-group English and Chinese instruction to learners worldwide. Courses span conversational and business English, Mandarin Chinese, certification-exam prep, and study-abroad advising, delivered through a proprietary web and mobile classroom with matched tutors and partnerships with institutions such as Oxford and Cambridge. The company runs consumer learning sites alongside separate portals for tutor recruitment, learning consultants, and interviewer/onboarding workflows. TutorABC is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company identity, its agent-facing llms.txt, and its domain-security posture surfaced by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Ulta Salon, Cosmetics & Fragrance
providers.description: Ulta Salon, Cosmetics & Fragrance (now operating as Ulta Beauty) is the largest beauty retailer in the United States, offering cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products, and salon services through retail stores and online. This entry tracks the legacy brand identity prior to the Ulta Beauty rebranding. No public developer API is currently available.

providers.name: Upsight
providers.description: Upsight was a mobile analytics and marketing platform for apps and games — positioning itself as a "user lifecycle management platform" combining omnichannel analytics, integrated web and mobile marketing, ad optimization, and a DataMine SQL analytics product behind a single SDK for iOS, Android, tvOS, Unity, and Web. A Battery Ventures portfolio company, the platform is now defunct - upsight.com no longer resolves, the help.upsight.com developer docs survive only in the Internet Archive, and the GitHub org has been dormant since 2020, though the UpsightKit CocoaPods SDK and the doctor PyPI package remain published.

providers.name: Wellster
providers.description: Wellster Healthtech Group is a German digital healthcare company founded in Munich in 2018 by Dr. Manuel Nothelfer and Nico Hribernik. It operates a digital health ecosystem that integrates a diverse range of direct-to-patient medical brands across Europe, combining synchronous and asynchronous telemedicine with value-based, evidence-driven care. Wellster emphasizes German-based medical supervision, data stored on German servers, and treatments aligned with established clinical standards, acting as a structured filter and patient-routing layer for the healthcare system. It is backed by HV Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. Wellster does not publish a public API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Within3
providers.description: Within3 is a life sciences engagement and insights-management platform used by pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies to run virtual advisory boards, engage key opinion leaders and healthcare professionals, and collect, structure, and analyze scientific and medical insights across the product lifecycle. The company emphasizes AI-assisted insights management and secure, compliant stakeholder engagement. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company; an enrichment pass found no public developer/API surface (no API, docs, or developer subdomains resolve and no /.well-known discovery documents are served).

providers.name: Yield Guild Games
providers.description: Yield Guild Games (YGG) is a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) and one of the world's first and largest web3 gaming guilds, founded in 2020 by Gabby Dizon, Beryl Li, and the pseudonymous "Owl of Moistness" out of the Philippines. YGG invests in NFTs and blockchain-game assets, lends them to players, and shares the resulting yield with its community and YGG token holders. Its onchain Guild Protocol (launched on Base) equips guilds with a modular library of smart-contract tooling for treasury wallets, programmable quests, and contribution tracking, while YGG Play acts as a publisher for casual crypto games. The company was backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), which led a $4.6M round in 2021. Note: this repository slug "yield-guide-games" preserves an upstream typo of the real company name, Yield Guild Games.

providers.name: YRC Worldwide
providers.description: YRC Worldwide (rebranded as Yellow Corporation in 2021) was a holding company whose subsidiaries — YRC Freight, Holland, Reddaway, New Penn, and HNRY Logistics — provided less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation, brokerage, and logistics services across North America. The company ceased operations on July 30, 2023 and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on August 6, 2023, ending nearly 100 years of operation. Bankruptcy asset sales redistributed terminals and equipment to Saia, XPO, Estes, and other carriers; no public developer APIs were ever published.

providers.name: Zebec Network
providers.description: Zebec Network is a blockchain infrastructure company (founded 2021, San Francisco; founder Sam Thapaliya) building real-time payroll, on-chain payments, multi-chain debit/crypto cards, and treasury management for web3 businesses and individuals. Its continuous-settlement streaming protocol began on Solana and now spans EVM chains, NEAR, and BNB via a Wormhole-based cross-chain bridge. Zebec exposes its capabilities to developers as a family of first-party TypeScript/JavaScript SDKs published on npm under the @zebec-network, @zebec-protocol, and @zebec-fintech scopes — covering payroll streaming, the vault, staking, the Silver/instant cards, the bridge, and the Solana DAO — documented at docs.zebec.io. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Zencore Biologics
providers.description: Zencore Biologics (zgbiotech.com) is a one-stop biologics CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization) technology service platform serving pharmaceutical clients globally. Its services span large-molecule biologics development and production, antibody-drug conjugates (ADC), cell culture media, analytical and quality testing, and regulatory registration support. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming; this profile is a corporate/biotech entity with no public developer API surface (no OpenAPI, well-known, or event/webhook interfaces were found).

providers.name: Zolvers
providers.description: Zolvers is a home-services marketplace that connects households with vetted, background-checked domestic and home-maintenance workers across Latin America, operating in Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, and Chile with a focus on Buenos Aires, Mexico City, Santiago, Bogotá, and Monterrey. The platform handles service requests, worker vetting, scheduling, and integrated payment processing for housekeeping and cleaning (one-time and live-in) plus home maintenance such as plumbing, electrical, gas, painting, air conditioning, general repairs, upholstery cleaning, and elder care. Backed by 500 Global, Zolvers is a consumer-facing platform with no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Affirmed Networks
providers.description: Affirmed Networks is a mobile networking company founded in 2010 (Andover, Massachusetts) that pioneered fully virtualized, cloud-native mobile core software for service providers. Its portfolio spanned a Virtualized Evolved Packet Core (vEPC), the UnityCloud 5G Core, Private Network Service, Network Slicing, and service-automation/analytics tooling, deployed by 100+ mobile operators including AT&T, Orange, Vodafone, and Telus. The company was acquired by Microsoft in March 2020 and folded into the Azure for Operators initiative; the affirmednetworks.com site now operates as a Microsoft company marketing presence with no independent public developer portal or API. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners.

providers.name: Altvia
providers.description: Altvia is fund management software purpose-built for private capital markets, serving private equity, venture capital, fund of funds, real estate, hedge funds, family offices, and placement agents. Built on the Salesforce platform, Altvia unifies a purpose-built CRM, a virtual data room (VDR) and LP investor portal, analytics and reporting, and an AI assistant (AIMe) into one system that spans the full fund lifecycle — capital raising, investor relations, and deal management. Founded in 2006 and based in Broomfield, Colorado, Altvia was acquired by Marlin Equity Partners in 2022. The company exposes no public developer/API portal; integrations are delivered through the platform and the Salesforce ecosystem.

providers.name: Augury
providers.description: Augury is a New York City-headquartered industrial AI company founded in 2011 by Gal Shaul and Saar Yoskovitz that profiles itself as the leader in Machine Health and Production Health for manufacturing. Its flagship offering pairs purpose-built IoT vibration, temperature, and magnetic sensors — most prominently the Halo Node and earlier Auguscope hardware — with a cloud platform that applies prescriptive AI diagnostics to rotating and electrical equipment, advertised as delivering 75% fewer false alarms than threshold-based vibration systems and trained on more than one billion hours of machine monitoring data. Augury's product portfolio spans Machine Health (predictive maintenance for assets such as motors, pumps, fans, compressors, and gearboxes), Process Health (process optimization software acquired with Seebo in 2022 for yield, waste, and energy improvements), and an Industrial AI Workforce of AI agents that act on combined machine and operational data. The company runs an integration ecosystem branded Augury Plus (CMMS/EAM connectors for SAP PM, IBM Maximo, Infor EAM, MaintainX, and cloud/industrial platforms including Microsoft Azure, PTC, and AVEVA Connect), Augury On (OEM-embedded Machine Health with partners such as Grundfos, Schneider Electric, Trane, Carrier, Bently Nevada, and Baker Hughes), and Augury By (service partners including Accenture, Deloitte, Bain, McKinsey, Sodexo, Aramark, and AECOM). Augury closed a $75M Series F in February 2025 at a $1B+ valuation led by Lightrock with Insight Partners, Eclipse, Qumra Capital, La Maison Partners, SE Ventures, and Qualcomm Ventures, reports a 5x revenue increase since 2021, and serves 170+ global manufacturers across 40+ countries including Heineken, PepsiCo (Frito-Lay), Colgate-Palmolive, Shell, and Hershey's. The company commercializes through hardware-plus-subscription contracts and embedded OEM agreements, references public APIs and certified system integrator partners for custom integrations into customer enterprise systems, and does not publish an open developer portal, OpenAPI description, SDK, or public-facing API reference for the Halo platform.

providers.name: Axamer
providers.description: Axamer is the company behind Menteo (menteo.ai), an AI-agent platform for restaurants and restaurant chains, focused on Latin America. Menteo deploys a team of specialized AI agents for marketing (WhatsApp and email campaigns), 24/7 WhatsApp order taking, loyalty and rewards programs, and customer service, integrating with existing POS systems, delivery platforms, and messaging channels to unify customer data and automate marketing, sales, and retention. Plans start from $149 USD/month with no long-term contract. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this pass Menteo publishes a public marketing site with Terms of Service and Privacy Policy but no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Bitcoin
providers.description: Bitcoin is the original decentralized peer-to-peer digital currency and open-source protocol, first described in the 2008 whitepaper by Satoshi Nakamoto. It is not a company or a hosted commercial API; the reference implementation, Bitcoin Core, exposes a local JSON-RPC interface for node operators and application developers to query the blockchain, manage wallets, build and broadcast transactions, and interact with the peer-to-peer network. bitcoin.org and the developer documentation site at developer.bitcoin.org publish developer guides, an extensive RPC API command reference, worked examples, and reference material for building Bitcoin applications. This profile was seeded as a Ribbit Capital portfolio-sector lead and enriched from Bitcoin's public developer surface.

providers.name: Boston Metal
providers.description: Boston Metal is an industrial metals and materials company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, with a wholly owned subsidiary and commercial plant in Brazil. The company commercializes Molten Oxide Electrolysis (MOE), a one-step electrochemical process that uses clean electricity rather than fossil fuels to reduce iron ore into liquid metal, producing steel with no direct CO2 emissions, and to recover high-value critical metals such as niobium and tantalum from low-grade ore and mining waste. Boston Metal commissioned a multi-inert-anode industrial MOE cell at its Woburn facility and has raised over $500 million from investors including Tata Steel. Boston Metal is a physical process-technology and manufacturing company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, or machine-readable contract of any kind. This profile captures its public web, corporate, and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: C2M
providers.description: C2M A.S. is the company behind Connected2.me, a consumer mobile messaging and social application that lets people create a profile, receive messages, and chat in real time with new contacts around the world. The app supports anonymous and identified conversations, following friends, and online-status notifications, and is distributed on both iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). Connected2.me is a consumer-facing product with no public developer program, API, or SDK surface at this time; its published surface is limited to the marketing site, the mobile apps, and its legal documents (Terms of Service and Privacy Policy). C2M was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: chatous
providers.description: Chatous is a consumer messaging application for random, anonymous chat with real people from around the world over text and video. It connects strangers by shared interests using topic hashtags, letting users make friends and start conversations across iOS and Android. Chatous is a mobile-first social product backed by Slow Ventures; it publishes a consumer website, privacy policy, and terms of service but does not expose a public developer API, SDK, or documented API program at this time.

providers.name: CHS Inc.
providers.description: CHS Inc. is a Fortune 500 diversified, integrated, global agricultural cooperative owned by farmers, ranchers, cooperatives, and individual producers. Headquartered in Inver Grove Heights, Minnesota, CHS describes itself as the largest farmer-owned cooperative in the United States, with more than 750 member cooperatives, 75,000+ individual producer-owners, and 20,000+ preferred stockholders. The cooperative serves customers in 65 countries through three primary business divisions: Agriculture (crop nutrients, crop protection, precision agriculture, seed, animal nutrition, and oilseed products), Energy (refined fuels, propane, lubricants, pipelines, terminals, and renewable fuels under the Cenex brand), and Services (hedging, payment solutions, transportation, and capital services). Major brands include Cenex, Allegiant (seed), Payback (animal nutrition), and N-Edge (crop nutrients). CHS does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are provided through digital platforms such as MyCHS (online portal for grain tickets, billing, and payments) and CHS Connect (digital self-service for crop protection and energy wholesale customers).

providers.name: Cimarex Energy
providers.description: Cimarex Energy was an independent oil and gas exploration and production company headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with operations focused in the Permian Basin and the Mid-Continent. In October 2021 Cimarex Energy combined with Cabot Oil & Gas Corporation to form Coterra Energy (NYSE: CTRA). No public Cimarex-branded developer APIs exist; all current digital channels and any future API offerings are part of Coterra Energy.

providers.name: CohnReznick
providers.description: CohnReznick is a top-25 US accounting, tax, and advisory firm formed in 2012 by the merger of J.H. Cohn LLP and Reznick Group, P.C. The firm serves clients across more than 30 industries from offices throughout the United States and four offshore subsidiaries, with its global reach extended through membership in the Nexia International network (operating in more than 128 countries). In May 2024 CohnReznick became the first US accounting firm of its scale to receive a strategic growth investment from a private equity sponsor when funds advised by Apax Partners acquired a majority stake. As part of that transaction the firm operates under an alternative-practice structure: audit and attest services are delivered by CohnReznick LLP (a licensed CPA firm) while tax and advisory services are delivered through CohnReznick Advisory LLC. Largest practice areas include Real Estate, Renewable Energy, Government Contracting, Asset Management (private equity, hedge funds, private credit, REITs), Financial Services, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Consumer & Industrial, Technology & Media, Public Sector, and Private Clients (family offices, high net worth individuals, professional sports). CohnReznick does not publish a public software developer API; this repository documents the firm's organizational profile, practice taxonomy, and linked-data context for API catalog purposes.

providers.name: Core & Main
providers.description: Core & Main is a leading specialty distributor of water, wastewater, storm drainage, and fire protection products and related services to municipalities, contractors, and engineers across the United States. As a Fortune 500 company, Core & Main operates more than 320 branch locations and provides products and services for water infrastructure, geosynthetics, fusible HDPE pipe, smart metering, fire protection, and erosion control.

providers.name: Corpay (formerly FLEETCOR)
providers.description: Corpay is a global S&P 500 corporate payments company (NYSE: CPAY) that resulted from the March 2024 rebrand of FLEETCOR Technologies. The company serves more than 800,000 business clients across 200+ countries in 140+ currencies and processed approximately $400 billion in payments in 2024 with reported revenue of about $4.0B. Corpay operates across five product lines built largely through acquisition — Commercial Cards (including Corpay Mastercard), AP Automation (extended by the 2024 acquisition of Paymerang), Cross-Border Payments (built on the 2017 acquisition of Cambridge Global Payments and the 2025 acquisition of Alpha Group International), Fuel & Fleet Cards (the original FLEETCOR business plus the 2014 acquisition of Comdata), and Workforce Lodging & Travel. Despite this scale, Corpay does not operate a public developer portal — there is no developer.corpay.com, no public OpenAPI catalog, no public GitHub presence, and no self-service API key issuance. All integration surfaces (ERP connectors for NetSuite, Sage, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks, Acumatica, CMiC, Deltek, Trimble; the former Cambridge cross-border payments API; AP-automation API hooks) are sales-led and gated behind enterprise contracts.

providers.name: Craftable
providers.description: Craftable is hospitality's back-office software platform for restaurants, bars, hotels, and resorts, originally known for its Bevager and Foodager products, that connects purchasing, inventory, recipes, and accounts payable with accounting and sales data. Its suite spans Intelligent Ordering (eProcurement), AP Automation with Invoice AI, Inventory and Recipe Management, and Daily Actionable Insights, plus AI features such as Operator AI and the Crafty in-app assistant. Craftable is SOC 2 compliant and SSO-capable, with more than 1,000 POS, EDI, and vendor/API integrations spanning systems such as Toast, Square, Lightspeed, Clover, SpotOn, TouchBistro, Aloha by NCR Voyix, Restaurant365, Sage Intacct, Oracle NetSuite, Acumatica, QuickBooks, and Xero. Craftable does not publish a public self-service developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; integrations are delivered through its implementation team during onboarding, and API access to a connected platform is provisioned by requesting a scoped API key from that platform's support team.

providers.name: Crown Castle
providers.description: Crown Castle is a leading United States provider of shared communications infrastructure including cell towers, small cells, and fiber. Crown Castle owns and operates more than 40,000 cell towers and approximately 90,000 route miles of fiber, supporting wireless carriers, enterprises, and government customers with managed connectivity, dark fiber, optical encryption, ultra-low-latency transport, and managed SD-WAN services. Crown Castle does not currently publish a public developer API program; technical integrations are handled through customer and channel partner agreements.

providers.name: Dialup
providers.description: Dialup is a voice-chat app that revives the magic of talking on the phone by pairing people for one-on-one calls based on shared interests. It automates recurring, scheduled calls so users connect serendipitously with friends, communities, or complete strangers around the world without any manual coordination. Callers opt in with custom caller IDs rather than random numbers, and the free service is available on iOS and Android. Dialup is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company; it operates as a consumer social/communication application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Elektrik App
providers.description: Elektrik is a medium voltage (MV) equipment procurement platform for electrical distributors, contractors, and Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) firms. Founded in 2020 by Mario Dealba out of the Techstars Alabama EnergyTech Accelerator, the company streamlines sourcing of medium- to high-voltage supplies (roughly 5kV-35kV / 600V-69kV) including MV cable, terminations, splices, deadbreak and loadbreak connectors, and transformers. Buyers build part lists and specifications in the web app and Elektrik surfaces matching products across leading manufacturers such as TE Connectivity, BURNDY, Richards Manufacturing, and PFISTERER, compressing a traditionally slow, quote-driven procurement cycle. Backed by Techstars and growth capital, Elektrik is added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI.

providers.name: EnviCore
providers.description: EnviCore is a Calgary, Alberta based sustainability and materials-technology company, backed by Techstars, that produces low-carbon supplementary cementitious materials for the mining and construction industries. Its low-temperature process repurposes industrial waste, mine tailings, clays, and pozzolans into valuable cement replacements, reducing CO2 emissions and supporting a circular economy. EnviCore does not publish a developer API, but its public website exposes an agentic surface: a published llms.txt and a live Wix Site MCP endpoint for AI-agent access to public site content.

providers.name: Exelon
providers.description: Exelon Corporation is one of the largest energy delivery companies in the United States, serving more than 10 million customers through its regulated electric and gas utility subsidiaries: Atlantic City Electric, BGE, ComEd, Delmarva Power, PECO, and Pepco. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, Exelon operates across multiple U.S. states. No public consumer-facing developer APIs have been identified for Exelon; customer self-service is conducted through utility portals.

providers.name: Flank
providers.description: Flank builds AI agents for enterprise legal teams that handle high-volume, routine legal work autonomously. Its supervised agents operate like paralegals, taking in requests via email or portals, executing contracting tasks against an organization's own templates and playbooks, and returning completed work for lawyer review. The platform covers drafting, contract review, negotiation, and triage, letting legal departments insource repetitive work while lawyers supervise finished output and high-risk items. Flank is backed by HV Capital, Insight Partners, and Speedinvest, and is SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 42001, GDPR, and CCPA compliant.

providers.name: Haber
providers.description: Haber (Elixa Technologies Private Limited), headquartered in Pune, India with a US presence in Chicago, is an industrial AI company delivering AI-led automation for smart manufacturing across heavy industries including pulp, paper, packaging and tissue, metals and mining, food and beverages, oil and gas, and water/utility institutions. Its product suite spans eLIXA, an IIoT-powered process intelligence platform; Mt. Fuji for historical data storage, visualizations, digital twins and predictive interventions; Kaiznn, an optimization engine for trim-loss reduction, inventory and production scheduling; plus Kensei and FiMorph. The platform emphasizes real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, and enterprise-grade security (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022). Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Indian Energy Exchange
providers.description: Indian Energy Exchange (IEX) is India's largest electricity trading platform, operating a nationwide automated exchange for the physical delivery of electricity, renewable energy, and certificates. IEX runs Day-Ahead, Real-Time, Term-Ahead, Renewable Energy Certificate and Energy Saving Certificate market segments, matching buy and sell bids across a member network of distribution utilities, industrial and commercial consumers, and power generators. For members with sophisticated trading needs IEX offers a members-only trading API (currently for the iDAM and RTM segments) supporting order placement, trade-data retrieval and real-time monitoring for automated and high-frequency trading; access is provisioned to registered members rather than published as a public developer portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Jarvie
providers.description: Jarvie is a consumer AI assistant from All Day Technologies, Inc. that lives inside iMessage and SMS group chats. Marketed as "your group chat sidekick," it helps people who text together plan events, learn things, and have fun, and can draft emails and create calendar events on a user's behalf. It offers memory features to personalize responses across conversations. Jarvie is a mobile-messaging consumer product surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners; as of this profile it does not publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface.

providers.name: KAYAK
providers.description: KAYAK is a global travel meta-search engine headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, owned by Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG). Founded in 2004 by Steve Hafner and Paul English, KAYAK aggregates results from hundreds of online travel agencies, airlines, hotel chains, car-rental companies, and cruise providers to help travelers compare prices for flights, hotels, cars, vacation packages, and cruises across a single interface. The company operates the KAYAK consumer brand, the HotelsCombined and Momondo meta-search brands, and KAYAK for Business, a corporate travel platform. KAYAK also runs a global Affiliate Network that lets publishers, content sites, and travel partners embed KAYAK search via co-branded search forms, iframes, deep links, and white-label search pages, with revenue share on redirected click traffic. KAYAK does not publish a self-serve public REST or GraphQL API for third-party developers; the consumer experience is delivered through its websites, native apps, voice integrations (Alexa, Google Assistant), and chat surfaces (Slack, Messenger). Programmatic access is limited to vetted partners under the KAYAK Affiliate Network and KAYAK Partner Network agreements, which typically expose XML/JSON feeds, deep-link builders, white-label search results pages, and conversion tracking — all gated behind a partner application process. There is no public OpenAPI specification, no published SDK, and no developer portal for KAYAK's underlying meta-search infrastructure.

providers.name: Kinder Morgan
providers.description: Kinder Morgan is one of the largest energy infrastructure companies in North America, owning and operating pipelines and terminals that transport natural gas, refined petroleum products, crude oil, carbon dioxide, and other commodities. Kinder Morgan publishes pipeline informational postings and capacity data through Electronic Bulletin Board (EBB) portals; no public REST API or developer program has been identified at this time.

providers.name: LIMRA
providers.description: LIMRA is a member-based research and trade association for the life insurance and financial services industry, operating alongside LOMA under the LL Global umbrella. It provides industry research, sales and market data, benchmarking, experience studies, and professional development to member companies - primarily life insurers, annuity providers, and workplace benefits carriers. LIMRA does not operate a public developer API or developer portal. Its research, benchmarking, and experience-study data are delivered through the member-gated LIMRA.com portal, reports, and consortium programs rather than a programmatic interface. LIMRA's most API-relevant offering is the LIMRA Data Exchange (LDEx) Standards - free, industry-developed data exchange standards for workplace benefits (benefits enrollment management, benefits configuration management, and evidence of insurability) that define payloads in XML and JSON and, in recent releases, REST endpoints specified in OpenAPI 3.1. LDEx is a specification that insurance carriers and benefits administration platforms implement between themselves; LIMRA publishes the standard (registration required to download, membership not required) but does not host any live endpoints.
