This entry is an honest documentation stub kept for catalog completeness; it will be updated if LIMRA ever ships a hosted public API.

providers.name: NGL Energy Partners
providers.description: NGL Energy Partners LP is a diversified midstream master limited partnership providing transportation, storage, blending, and marketing services for crude oil, natural gas liquids, refined products, and water solutions to producers and end-users across the energy industry. The company is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol NGL and operates three primary business units: Crude Oil Logistics, Water Solutions, and NGL Liquids.

providers.name: Parallel Finance
providers.description: Parallel Finance is a decentralized money-market protocol built on the Polkadot ecosystem, offering lending, staking, and borrowing where depositors can lend and stake simultaneously to earn combined yield and borrowers can post collateral to borrow. It runs as a Substrate/Polkadot parachain (Parallel mainnet and the Heiko canary network on Kusama). Rather than a REST API, developers integrate through a JSON-RPC node over WebSocket (wss://rpc.parallel.fi) using polkadot.js, aided by Parallel's first-party @parallel-finance TypeScript SDK packages on npm that supply the chain types, RPC definitions, and connection options. Source, chain specs, and the auction toolkit are published under the parallel-finance GitHub organization.

providers.name: Polycam
providers.description: Polycam is a cross-platform 3D scanning and capture company building consumer and professional tools for turning the physical world into high-fidelity 3D content. Its iOS, Android, and web apps support LiDAR-based space capture, photogrammetry, photosphere capture, AI-generated 3D models, and Gaussian Splat reconstructions, with export formats including glTF/GLB, OBJ, FBX, DAE, STL, USDZ, point clouds, and CAD-friendly files. Polycam serves freelancers, AEC and real-estate teams, VFX and game studios, e-commerce sellers, and enterprise operators with 2D/3D floor plans, measurement tools, shared team libraries, virtual walkthroughs, AI reports, custom branding, SSO, and TransformEngine for custom 3D file creation. Revenue is subscription based across Free, Basic ($30/mo or $150/yr), Business ($400/yr per user), and Enterprise tiers, with sales-led pricing for organizations at scale. Polycam exposes a developer mode in the iOS app that unlocks a raw-data export bundle (raw.glb mesh, keyframes, images, cameras, depth maps, confidence data, mesh_info.json) used by partners such as Vuforia, Immersal, and Unity/Unreal workflows, and ships an open-source Python toolkit (polyform) for converting raw captures to NeRF and other research formats. As of this profile there is no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal — integrations happen through raw exports, partner pipelines, and the Polycam app surface itself.

providers.name: Project Canary
providers.description: Project Canary is a Denver-based climate technology company that helps oil and gas operators and natural gas utilities turn methane emissions data into operational intelligence. Founded in 2019, its Canary SENSE platform unifies measurement data from sensors, satellites, aircraft, SCADA, and field teams into a single view that drives decisions, reduces costs, and supports regulatory reporting (OGMP 2.0 and other frameworks). The company builds high-precision methane detection hardware (Canary RECON, Aeris PICO) and a proprietary predictive emissions model (methaneML) trained on a multi-year, high-fidelity methane dataset, serving upstream and midstream operators as well as gas distribution utilities across the United States. Project Canary has raised $121M (Series B) and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and Techstars. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI is published at this time; this profile captures identity, a verbatim llms.txt, and security posture.

providers.name: Rakuten Mobile
providers.description: Rakuten Mobile is the Japanese mobile network operator (MNO) of Rakuten Group, headquartered in Setagaya, Tokyo, and Japan's fourth nationwide carrier alongside NTT Docomo, KDDI, and SoftBank. Commercially launched in April 2020 and surpassing 10 million subscribers in December 2025, Rakuten Mobile built and operates the world's first fully cloud-native, end-to-end virtualized mobile network on Open RAN, with 4G population coverage of 99.9% and expanding 5G plus 700 MHz Platinum Band rollout. The same engineering effort spun out into Rakuten Symphony, a B2B business that productizes the Rakuten Mobile playbook as the Symworld platform — a cloud-native operating platform for telcos covering Open RAN (CU/DU/RIC, Symware distributed unit appliance), Symworld Cloud (Kubernetes-based hyperconverged telco cloud / CNP), OSS/BSS, site management, and a marketplace of pre-integrated cloud-native network functions from 50+ vendor partners. Symphony also offers Rakuten CPaaS (carrier-grade SMS, Confirm/OTP, and Short URL APIs running on the Rakuten Mobile network with JWT-authenticated REST endpoints at api.cpaas.symphony.rakuten.net) and Rakuten Communications Platform (RCP) for enterprise private 5G. Public, developer-accessible APIs are concentrated in the CPaaS suite; the Symworld platform APIs themselves are TM Forum-aligned but exposed under commercial engagement rather than a public developer signup.

providers.name: Regard
providers.description: Regard is an AI-powered clinical diagnosis and documentation platform for hospitals and health systems. It reviews 100% of a patient's electronic health record (EHR) to surface and recommend evidence-supported diagnoses, then generates clinical documentation at the point of care. Regard positions itself around "earning revenue through better care, not queries," spanning clinical notes, mid-revenue-cycle denial prevention and revenue capture, HCC risk-adjustment capture, and screening for care gaps. The company reports 12.9M+ recommended diagnoses accepted by clinicians and $50M+ in revenue generated for health systems. Regard integrates directly with EHRs rather than exposing a public developer API; its Health IT Module is ONC 2015 Cures Update certified. Backed by Foundry Group and Techstars. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sentra
providers.description: Sentra is a cloud-native data security platform (DSPM) that discovers, classifies, and governs sensitive data at petabyte scale across cloud and SaaS environments, with a focus on AI-readiness and preventing sensitive data exposure. The platform gives security teams visibility into where data lives, reduces data sprawl, and monitors data access and posture. Sentra was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. It operates a public Trust Center but does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or open documentation; its product documentation is gated behind an authenticated application login.

providers.name: Slintel
providers.description: Slintel is a B2B sales and market intelligence platform that mines buyer and technographic signals — company firmographics, technology installs, psychographics, and buying-intent scores — to help revenue teams prioritize accounts and time outreach. Founded in 2016 and backed by Accel and Sequoia, Slintel was acquired by 6sense in 2021 and its data and API services are now consolidated into the 6sense Revenue AI platform. Slintel's programmatic surface (company identification, firmographics, lead scoring, and enrichment) is delivered through the 6sense API Portal rather than a standalone Slintel developer portal; this profile reflects that consolidation and captures the surviving public developer surface.

providers.name: SoftPro
providers.description: SoftPro is the market-leading provider of title, escrow, and real estate closing software, used by title agents, escrow officers, and closing attorneys to produce settlement documents, manage closing files, and disburse funds. SoftPro 360 is its integrated vendor marketplace, a business exchange built into the SoftPro desktop and hosted products that lets users order title, escrow, and closing products and services - e-recording, closing protection letters and policy jackets, remote online notarization, eClosings, lien releases, property records, tax certificates, identity verification, and wire-fraud protection - from 100+ integrated service providers without leaving their SoftPro file, with order data flowing automatically back into the file. Partner and vendor integration with SoftPro 360 is delivered through a partner-gated web-service integration secured with API keys; SoftPro does not publish an open, self-service developer API or public API reference.

providers.name: Spectra (Defunct / Merged into OVG360)
providers.description: Spectra (formerly Spectra Experiences, originally Comcast-Spectacor Ventures / Global Spectrum + Ovations Food Services + Paciolan + Front Row Marketing) was a North American venue management, food services & hospitality, and partnership-sales company headquartered in Philadelphia, PA. Owned jointly by Comcast Spectacor and Atairos, Spectra was acquired by Oak View Group (OVG) in a deal announced August 31, 2021 and closed on November 15, 2021 after receiving U.S. Department of Justice approval. On February 25, 2022, OVG formally consolidated Spectra and OVG Facilities into a single, rebranded division called OVG360. The Spectra and Spectra Experiences brands were retired as a result, and the spectraexperiences.com domain is no longer resolvable. This apis.yml is preserved as an historical record only — Spectra never published a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal. Operational successor: OVG360 (https://www.oakviewgroup.com/ovg360-2/). Ticketing platform Paciolan, which had been part of the Spectra portfolio, was divested before the OVG deal and is now an independent Learfield subsidiary.

providers.name: Sprouts Farmers Market
providers.description: Sprouts Farmers Market is a specialty grocery retailer focused on fresh, natural, and organic foods at affordable prices. Operating primarily in the western United States, Sprouts integrates with third-party platforms including Instacart, DoorDash, and Uber Eats for online grocery delivery. Sprouts uses EDI-based supply chain integrations and participates in Instacart's AI-powered Cart Assistant program. There is no public developer API; integrations are handled through EDI and third-party delivery platform partnerships.

providers.name: Striim
providers.description: Unified data integration and streaming platform offering change data capture (CDC), real-time streaming analytics, and data validation. Exposes a token-authenticated REST API (WActionStore queries, system health, Application Management) consumed against your own Striim instance or Striim Cloud service.

providers.name: Tejas Networks
providers.description: Tejas Networks is an India-based telecommunications networking products company (part of the Tata group) that designs and manufactures a wall-to-wall portfolio of wireline and wireless networking equipment for telecom carriers, internet service providers, utilities, defense, and governments. Its product lines span Radio Access Network (4G/5G RAN), fiber broadband access (FTTx/GPON), packet-optical and DWDM/OTN transport (TJ1600), converged broadband (TJ1400), switching and routing, mobile packet core, satcom, and Direct-to-Mobile broadcast, all managed through the TejNMS (TJ5500) network management system. Tejas exposes an EMS/NMS management API for its equipment, but that interface and its product documentation are delivered through a login-gated customer documentation library rather than a public developer program; there is no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open developer portal at this time. This profile was surfaced as a Mayfield portfolio company and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Tesoro
providers.description: Tesoro Corporation (later rebranded as Andeavor) was a Fortune 100 independent petroleum refiner and marketer headquartered in San Antonio, Texas. Founded in 1968, the company operated ten refineries in the Western United States with combined crude oil capacity of approximately 1.2 million barrels per day and approximately 3,000 branded retail gas stations. Tesoro rebranded as Andeavor in 2017 following its acquisition of Western Refining, and was acquired by Marathon Petroleum on October 1, 2018. No public developer API was offered.

providers.name: WESCO International
providers.description: WESCO International is a Fortune 500 leading provider of business-to-business distribution, logistics services, and supply chain solutions for electrical, industrial, communications, and utility customers worldwide. WESCO serves over 150,000 customers through a network of branches and distribution centers and provides comprehensive digital integration capabilities including EDI, punchout, cXML, and API connectivity for procurement automation.

providers.name: Worthington Industries
providers.description: Worthington Industries was a global diversified metals manufacturing company specializing in value-added steel processing and manufactured metal products. In December 2023, the company split into two publicly traded companies: Worthington Enterprises (consumer and building products) and Worthington Steel (flat-rolled steel processing, electrical steel laminations, and tailor-welded blanks). Worthington Industries does not offer a public developer API.

providers.name: 1001 AI
providers.description: 1001 (also known as 1001 AI) is a deeptech artificial intelligence company founded in 2025 by Bilal Abu-Ghazaleh, a former director of generative AI operations at Scale AI, and headquartered between London and Dubai. The company builds sovereign AI operating systems for critical infrastructure — live operational models that help operators across aviation and airports, ports and logistics, energy and grids, construction, and manufacturing predict issues, automate and optimize decisions, and improve operational efficiency, while retaining full local ownership and governance of their AI systems. Focused primarily on the GCC and wider MENA region, 1001 raised a $9 million seed round in October 2025 led by CIV, General Catalyst, and Lux Capital, followed by a $30 million Series A in June 2026 led by Lux Capital with Sanabil Investments, 9Yards, and Hanabi joining and existing backers General Catalyst, CIV, and Stanford AI researcher Chris Ré increasing their commitments. As of this profile, 1001 publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDK; this entry captures the company's public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Aaru
providers.description: Aaru is an AI synthetic-research and prediction company based in New York City, founded in 2024 by Cam Fink, Ned Koh, and John Kessler. Aaru builds multi-agent simulation software that generates thousands of AI agents from public and proprietary behavioral data to model how individuals, groups, and entire populations will respond to future events, products, policies, and messaging. Its platform (marketed as Lumen) replaces traditional survey-based market research and polling with measurable-outcome simulation, covering price-sensitivity analysis, voter-behavior prediction, and disaster-communication testing. Customers include Accenture, EY, Interpublic Group, and political campaigns; the company raised a Series A at a roughly $1B headline valuation in December 2025, with backing from General Catalyst, Redpoint Ventures, Felicis, Abstract Ventures, and others. Aaru currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and web surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Agrapp
providers.description: Agrapp is a Chilean agricultural technology (AgTech) company offering "el cuaderno de campo inteligente" (the intelligent field notebook) — a mobile and web SaaS platform that helps small and medium farmers record, track, and manage their field operations without complex spreadsheets. Founded in 2016 in Santiago and backed by 500 Global, Start-Up Chile, OpenBeauchef, and ChileGlobal Ventures, the platform provides labor and task tracking with per-task cost analysis, inventory and supply (bodega) control, a work calendar, worker attendance and performance monitoring, WhatsApp and email alerts, and agricultural plus financial reporting to support data-driven decisions. It runs on iOS and Android with an offline mode that syncs when connectivity returns. Agrapp does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web surface, commercial links, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Agrostar
providers.description: AgroStar (Ulink Agritech Private Ltd) is a leading Indian agri-tech company on a mission to help farmers grow more and earn more, sustainably. Founded in Pune, it operates India's largest digital farmer network and agri-inputs platform, serving millions of farmers across Gujarat, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh through its Kisan (AgriDoctor) mobile app. AgroStar builds a connected ecosystem across the agricultural value chain — farm advisory, quality agri-inputs, omnichannel retail access and global market linkages — backed by data and agronomy expertise, with a focus on climate-smart agriculture, water conservation and reducing food waste. It is a portfolio company of Accel. AgroStar's public corporate site is Wix-powered and exposes a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint plus an /llms.txt for agentic AI access to public site content; it does not publish a developer-facing product API.

providers.name: AlgoX2
providers.description: AlgoX2 is a data streaming operating system that unifies ingestion, ordering, fan-out, transformation, and durable storage into a single fault-tolerant engine, positioned as an alternative to assembling Kafka, Flink, and Redis. Built by veterans of NYSE Pillar's matching engine, the platform offers a partition-free API, compute-storage separation, a zero-copy runtime, and native multicast fan-out, with native support for Kafka, NATS, MQTT, Redis, HTTP, and WebSocket protocols and protocol bridging between them. Streams automatically materialize as Apache Iceberg, Delta, or Hudi tables in S3-compatible Parquet storage for lakehouse integration. AlgoX2 raised a $3.5M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and serves real-time use cases including exchange and matching-engine infrastructure, market-data distribution, risk and surveillance, backtesting, and AI feature streaming.

providers.name: Apparta
providers.description: Apparta is a Colombian hospitality technology company providing a reservation-management and guest-engagement platform for restaurants, bars, and dining venues across Latin America (Bogota, Medellin, Cali, Barranquilla). The SaaS product covers AI-assisted table assignment and floor-plan zoning, no-show prevention with prepayments and cancellation policies, a WhatsApp AI chatbot for automated bookings, CRM campaigns over SMS/email/WhatsApp, POS integration, branded booking pages and digital menus, and marketing connectors to Google, Google Maps, Instagram, TripAdvisor, and Facebook. Apparta is offered in tiered monthly plans (Basico, Standard, Plus) and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface is published as of this profiling; higher tiers expose a WhatsApp Business API integration on behalf of venues rather than a first-party Apparta API.

providers.name: Arc Simulations
providers.description: Arc Simulations is a London-based sports technology company, founded in 2022 by Henry Smith and Michael Armenakis and part of the Techstars London Spring 2024 accelerator cohort. Arc builds ball-tracking and simulation technology for cricket and other ball sports: professional-standard cricket balls carry embedded tracking tags that transmit position data to sensors up to 200 times per second, feeding a real-time simulation and analytics platform. The system predicts ball trajectory post-impact from velocity, angle and spin to deliver millimetre-accurate, autonomous feedback for every shot, with customisable field configurations that mirror live match scenarios. Arc serves players, coaches, scouts, analysts, broadcasters and fans through a hosted application (app.arcsim.io) and a player-facing app (player.arcsim.io) offering ball-by-ball 3D simulations. Arc's technology is built first for cricket but is designed to track nearly any sports ball. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is published at this time; this profile captures the company's identity and web/security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Authy
providers.description: Authy is a two-factor authentication (2FA) product originally built by Authy Inc. and acquired by Twilio in 2015. It provided a consumer authenticator app (TOTP soft tokens, encrypted cloud backup, and multi-device sync) alongside a developer-facing Authy API for one-time passwords over SMS and voice, soft tokens, and push authentication. Twilio has since folded the Authy developer API into the Twilio Verify API, deprecated and archived the first-party Authy client SDKs, and discontinued the Authy desktop applications in 2024. The consumer Authy mobile app remains available. New integrations are directed to Twilio Verify. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and is enriched here from Authy's remaining public surface (marketing site, archived GitHub organization, and deprecated SDK registries).

providers.name: Automax Ai
providers.description: Automax AI is a fintech company delivering AI-native residential property appraisals built for modern mortgage lending and the UAD 3.6 standard. Lenders order signed residential appraisals directly from their loan origination system (LOS) and get them back in days rather than weeks, combining AI-assisted market data analysis with licensed appraiser review. The platform pairs a hybrid appraisal workflow (automated mobile data capture of floor plans and photos plus human quality review) with an Appraisal Copilot report-writing and analysis suite, automated appraiser matching and assignment, nationwide licensed-appraiser coverage, and real-time order status tracking. Automax AI is a Y Combinator portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes web and mobile applications (an appraiser Copilot at copilot.automax.ai and an iOS app) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Axis 2
providers.description: Axis (axis.xyz) is a Y Combinator-backed (W2022) knowledge base platform for corporate affairs, government relations, and compliance teams that helps large companies understand their markets and regulatory obligations across the world. The platform delivers regulatory intelligence for international expansion - which laws to comply with and which officials to seek approvals from - spanning 40+ countries and 200+ industries across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This is a product SaaS company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Blitzy
providers.description: Blitzy is an autonomous software development platform for enterprises with large legacy codebases. It reverse-engineers existing code into a knowledge graph, then orchestrates thousands of AI agents to modernize software and build new applications at the scale of 1 million to over 100 million lines of code, autonomously completing roughly 80% of a project before human engineers review and approve the result. Rather than training its own foundation models, Blitzy composes leading third-party models (Gemini, GPT, Claude). Founded by Brian Elliott (CEO) and Sid Pardeshi (CTO), the company is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts with an office in Pune, India, and is backed by Northzone.

providers.name: BOK Financial
providers.description: BOK Financial Corporation (NASDAQ: BOKF) is a regional financial-services holding company headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, delivering banking under the Bank of Oklahoma, Bank of Texas, and BOK Financial brands across the Southwest and Midwest, along with wealth management and commercial treasury services. As of July 2026 it does not publish a first-party public developer portal or any documented API products — developer.bokfinancial.com does not resolve and /developer and /api return 404. Its public, machine-accessible surface is consumer-permissioned account data access delivered through third-party aggregators (Plaid coverage confirmed), while commercial treasury and ERP connectivity is offered privately to clients under contract rather than through a self-serve documented developer program.

providers.name: Check24
providers.description: CHECK24 is Germany's largest online comparison portal (Vergleichsportal), founded in 1999 and headquartered in Munich. It lets more than 20 million customers compare prices and switch providers across over 50 categories, including car, life and health insurance, loans and bank accounts, electricity and gas, DSL and mobile tariffs, travel, rental cars, and online shopping. CHECK24 runs its own comparison calculators and a licensed bank (CHECK24 Bank), and integrates partner providers such as Allianz Direct through API-based connections. Backed by Accel, it is profiled in the API Evangelist network as a consumer company. CHECK24 maintains a verified GitHub organization and a GenDev developer scholarship program but publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Come Bien
providers.description: Come Bien is a Mexican foodtech company operating a digital corporate cafeteria (comedor digital) that delivers fresh, home-style, nutritionally balanced meals to offices without requiring any on-site kitchen installation. Employees choose from a rotating seven-week cyclical menu each day, place their order through the Come Bien app, and receive individually bagged, ready-to-eat meals delivered to the workplace in 100% biodegradable packaging. A dedicated backoffice platform lets employers subsidize, administer, and gain full visibility into their team's food benefit. Backed by 500 Global, the company reports serving 100+ companies, 10,000+ employees, and more than 1.5M orders delivered.

providers.name: Daash
providers.description: DAASH is an AI-powered predictive commerce intelligence platform built specifically for the beauty and cosmetics industry. It combines consumer shopping panels covering 6M+ people with social and advertising trend data and enriched product attributes to estimate sales performance, market share, and emerging trends at the SKU level. DAASH delivers weekly competitive intelligence to beauty brands, manufacturers, and financial services firms so they can uncover category shifts, benchmark competitor performance, and spot growth opportunities. The company was founded at the intersection of predictive intelligence and consumer products by retail and data experts (Philip Smolin, CEO; Justin Stewart, CTO; Melissa Munnerlyn, CMO), and is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital. DAASH is delivered as a hosted SaaS application (my.daash.co); it currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: EcoG
providers.description: EcoG is a Munich-based technology company that builds the software and hardware platform powering electric-vehicle DC fast chargers. Its EcoG OS operating system, Universal Core platform, and controllers let charger manufacturers, charge point operators (CPOs), and EV businesses design, launch, and scale DC charging solutions with reduced complexity, claiming more than 15% market share in Europe with operations across India and North America. For developers, EcoG OS exposes an on-device programmatic surface (an OpenAPI-based application interface, a local web interface, and the LifeC remote management tool) so smart value-added charging applications can be built and run at the device level. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched from EcoG's public website; it publishes no public REST API developer portal or specification.

providers.name: ElevateBio
providers.description: ElevateBio is an advanced therapies technology company and contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for cell and gene therapies, headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. Through its BaseCamp cGMP manufacturing and process-development business and its centers of excellence, ElevateBio provides end-to-end capabilities spanning gene editing, viral vectors (AAV and lentivirus), mRNA and RNA therapeutics, induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), analytical and process development, and regulatory CMC support, helping partners advance genetic medicines from concept through commercialization. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the SoftBank Vision Fund and profiled in the API Evangelist network, ElevateBio operates as a science- and manufacturing-driven organization rather than a public API provider; this profile captures its identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Finch Legal
providers.description: Finch Legal (Finch) is an AI-powered pre-litigation platform built for personal injury law firms, combining US-based expert legal operators with AI agents to run cases on autopilot from intake through demand. Its services span 24/7 bilingual intake and client sign-up, insurance claim and police-report retrieval, treatment tracking with client check-ins, and expert-reviewed demand-letter generation, with beta capabilities for medical chronologies and litigation support. Finch writes updates directly into a firm's existing case-management system rather than adding a new tool, integrating with Filevine, Smokeball, Litify, Neos, SmartAdvocate, MyCase, Clio, Casepeer, and Cloudlex. The company is SOC 2 certified, headquartered in New York City, and backed by venture investors. Finch exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK at this time; this profile captures its identity and security posture.

providers.name: Hongene Biotech
providers.description: Hongene Biotech Corporation is a nucleic acid contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) founded in 1998, with nearly 30 years of RNA-focused expertise. It offers vertically integrated services spanning oligonucleotide API manufacturing (from preclinical to commercial, GMP up to tonne scale), mRNA CDMO services (raw materials through enzymes and lipids to GMP manufacture and fill-finish), custom chemical synthesis of nucleic acid building blocks, and chemoenzymatic ligation for siRNA and sgRNA. Hongene supplies premium nucleic acid raw materials worldwide and runs an online store for direct-purchase reagents. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and enriched from Hongene public web surfaces; the company publishes no developer API.

providers.name: Hudl
providers.description: Hudl is a Lincoln, Nebraska sports performance and analytics technology company founded in 2007. The company started as a video sharing and review platform for high school, college, and professional teams and has grown into a global provider of video capture hardware, performance analysis software, and sports data services. Hudl operates across basketball, baseball, football, ice hockey, rugby, soccer, softball, and volleyball, serving customers from youth clubs through professional leagues. The company's product portfolio spans the core Hudl video platform, Hudl Focus AI-powered capture cameras (Indoor, Outdoor, Flex, Point), Hudl Replay and Hudl Studio for live and tactical analysis, Hudl IQ for American football analytics, Volleymetrics, the Hudl TV livestreaming product, and Hudl Tickets digital ticketing. Through acquisitions Hudl has consolidated several leading performance analysis and football data brands under its umbrella, including Sportscode (performance analysis software), Wyscout (the largest soccer video and stats database), Statsbomb (advanced football analytics), Instat (video and scouting), WIMU and Titan (athlete tracking and wearables), and Signal and ADI. Hudl exposes commercial developer surfaces primarily through Hudl Wyscout (Wyscout Data API, documented as OpenAPI 3.0 at apidocs.wyscout.com, with Database, Stats, Events, and Physical Data packs) and Hudl Statsbomb (the Statsbomb Aggregated API for player-match, player-season, team-match, and team-season data, accessed via the Data Hub, plus the Raw X&Y Tracking Data API and a Wyscout/Statsbomb ID Mapping API). Core Hudl video and Hudl Focus do not publish a public developer API; B2B integrations are sales-mediated. Hudl maintains a public GitHub organization (github.com/hudl) with infrastructure, resilience, and media tooling open source projects (Mjolnir, Fargo, HudlFfmpeg, react-native components), but these are engineering libraries, not product SDKs. Hudl's revenue model is SaaS subscriptions for video, analytics, and data packages, plus camera hardware sales and data licensing.

providers.name: iControl
providers.description: iControl is a Swedish construction-technology company whose mobile application digitalizes documentation on construction sites, replacing paper-based protocols and inspection records with real-time digital capture. Field personnel create, share, and manage project documentation from the job site, with offline capture that syncs when connectivity returns, drawing and blueprint uploads, and team collaboration. Marketed under the promise "Skriv aldrig ett protokoll igen" (never write a protocol again), iControl is used by leading Nordic contractors including NCC, JM, Veidekke, ARCONA, and In3prenor across infrastructure, residential, commercial, and public-facility projects. The company is headquartered in Stockholm and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. iControl exposes a consumer-facing web and mobile application; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK was found during enrichment.

providers.name: IndieFlow
providers.description: IndieFlow is an all-in-one music management platform for independent artists and their managers, positioning itself as a "Shopify for musicians." Made by musicians, it centralizes the business side of an independent music career in one place: distributing releases to 30+ streaming services (Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, Deezer, TikTok and more), collecting and registering royalties and songwriter/publisher credits with performing rights organizations, managing creative projects and release schedules, promoting music, booking gigs, and handling payments and collaborations. Founded in 2020, the company raised a $4M round led by State of Mind Ventures with participation from Techstars and other investors, and its artist-facing distribution is delivered through a Revelator-powered back end. IndieFlow does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company's public web presence.

providers.name: Kaizntree Inc.
providers.description: Kaizntree is a New York-based operations platform for growth-stage consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands, giving multi-channel manufacturers and sellers a single system to run purchasing, inventory, sales, fulfillment, production, and lot-level traceability. Its two products are Kaizntree OS, a cloud ERP that centralizes stock across raw materials, intermediate goods, packaging, finished and bundled products with COGS, margin, multi-location, batch/expiry and audit-ready records, and JP, an ERP-agnostic AI operations assistant that automates high-volume workflows such as purchase-order processing, reporting, data synchronization, and OTIF tracking. Kaizntree integrates with sales channels (including Shopify), accounting, WMS, and fulfillment platforms. Backed by 500 Global (seed, 2022), it operates on usage-based pricing. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; Kaizntree publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Kissmetrics
providers.description: Kissmetrics is a product and behavioral analytics platform that tracks individual user activity across web and mobile, surfacing funnels, cohorts, retention, and revenue reports tied to identified people. The platform helps product, marketing, and growth teams understand user journeys and pinpoint conversion drop-off. Kissmetrics provides REST APIs for querying reports, exporting segments, and ingesting events, authenticated via HTTP Basic auth.

providers.name: LivingSocial
providers.description: LivingSocial is a consumer daily-deals and local-experiences marketplace that sells discounted vouchers and offers across travel, events, dining, activities, and products, alongside a coupon and promo-code section for major retailers. Originally a pioneering group-buying company, its brand and marketplace now operate as an affiliate deals and coupons destination. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the public site (livingsocial.com) exposes no developer program, API, or documentation surface: probes of common developer subdomains (developer/api/docs) and /.well-known/ discovery endpoints returned redirects to the consumer site or 404s.

providers.name: Makani *
providers.description: Makani was an Alphabet (Google X) moonshot developing airborne wind energy — "energy kites" that flew in crosswind loops to generate electricity and sent power to the grid down a tether. Backed within Alphabet and partnered with Shell, Makani wound down in 2020 after roughly 13 years of development. On closure the team open-sourced its full flight-simulation, autopilot controller, visualization, and avionics software stack under Apache-2.0 and published the Energy Kite Collection of technical reports, designs, and flight logs. Makani has no commercial or developer API surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company for network completeness.

providers.name: MEQ Solutions
providers.description: MEQ Solutions is an Australian agrifood technology company delivering what it calls the world's only end-to-end measurement of red meat quality and yield. Its integrated hardware-and-software suite — MEQ Probe, MEQ Camera, MEQ Live, and MEQ Insights — gives producers, feedlots, processors, brands, retailers, and food-service operators objective, real-time carcass and eating-quality data. Deployed across Australia, New Zealand, the United States, and Brazil, MEQ has completed over 10 million scans across 60+ deployments and reports a demonstrated 10x ROI. The company is backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API surface is currently published; the meqinsights.com portal is a customer login.

providers.name: Mindset
providers.description: Mindset is a mobile self-care and wellness application by DIVE Studios that pairs audio content from celebrity artists and musicians with expert-led mental health resources. Features include Celebrity Mindsets audio collections, a five-minute Daily Check-In routine, Daily Reflections community sharing, licensed-professional advice, and daily quotes, delivered on iOS and Android with a 50,000+ member Discord community. Mindset operates a private, login-gated mobile backend at api.getmindset.com behind Google OAuth; no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or well-known discovery surface is published.

providers.name: Miuros
providers.description: Miuros is a performance platform for customer service that provides AI-powered analytics, quality assurance (Review & Insights), and agent-assist automation (Assist) for international and scaling customer support teams. Founded as a standalone startup and backed by Techstars, Miuros was acquired by Dixa and is now offered as Miuros by Dixa. The Miuros product surface — Data sync, Review & Insights, Assist, and Miuros APIs — remains operational and is tracked on a dedicated Miuros status page, while platform developer documentation is served through the Dixa developer hub.

providers.name: MyARC Fitness
providers.description: MyARC (operated by Vert Analytics Limited) is an all-in-one platform that lets fitness creators and coaches scale their business without writing code. Coaches use MyARC to launch a branded mobile app, automate AI-personalized workout and meal plans for thousands of members at once, run challenges and 1-on-1 coaching, build community, and earn recurring subscription revenue. The consumer-facing MyARC Fitness app ships on iOS and Android with progress tracking and accountability features. As of this profile MyARC exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface — it is a creator-facing SaaS and mobile product, not an API provider. Offices in London, New York, Melbourne, and India.

providers.name: Myu
providers.description: Myu (MyU Interactive Learning) is an education-technology company offering an integrated learning management system (LMS) and school management platform that unifies class delivery, a student information system (SIS), grading and academic reporting, attendance and compliance tracking, and parent/teacher communication in a single interface. It serves early-childhood centers, K-12 schools, higher-education institutions, training institutes, and individual teachers across 1,000+ institutions worldwide, with a notable presence in the GCC region. Myu is delivered as web and mobile (iOS/Android) applications and, as of this profiling, exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Onramp Payments
providers.description: Onramp Payments, Inc. (ONRAMP) is a fintech company building modern payments infrastructure for the commercial trucking and fleet industry. Founded by logistics and payments veterans and backed by Canaan Partners, the company operates an enterprise-grade digital platform that replaces legacy card-based fleet payment systems. For carriers it offers cardless fuel payments at the pump, administrative spend controls, and maintenance payment solutions; for merchants it provides digital payment acceptance, pricing controls, and fraud prevention that work both in-store and at fuel pumps; and for partners it offers API integrations, broker solutions, and Transportation Management System (TMS) connections. The company markets itself as the easiest, most secure payments platform for carriers and merchants and has raised roughly $21M from investors including Canaan Partners, CEAS Investments, Contour Venture Partners, Javelin Venture Partners, and RedBlue Capital. As of this enrichment pass ONRAMP publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures verified company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Palmstreet
providers.description: Palmstreet is a live shopping marketplace where sellers host interactive live-stream sales and buyers browse more than a million listings across rare plants, handmade goods, vintage items, jewelry, crystals, coins, fashion, beauty, aquatics, reptiles, and designer toys. The platform pairs real-time video commerce with a traditional marketplace, free seller onboarding, and Seller Hub inventory tooling. Backed by Craft Ventures, Palmstreet operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS/Android) and web storefront. No public developer API, documentation portal, or partner API surface is published as of this enrichment pass; this profile captures the company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Pillar Technologies
providers.description: Pillar Technologies provides construction jobsite risk management through environmental monitoring and data analytics. Its wireless, rugged "Pod" sensors measure eight environmental metrics on the jobsite (temperature, humidity, carbon monoxide, VOCs, particulates, noise, light, and pressure) with cellular connectivity and a one-year battery life, feeding a real-time software platform with customizable dashboards, floorplan integration, and drill-down reporting by site, floor, or sensor. A configurable alert system notifies teams via text, email, or phone. Pillar serves data centers, hospitality and multi-family housing, and science and healthcare construction projects to improve safety and protect schedules and budgets. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal was found as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Poly
providers.description: Poly is an AI-powered intelligent cloud file browser that syncs a user's local files to the cloud and layers an AI agent over them, letting people search by image, concept, phrase, color or face and ask natural-language questions about their documents, images, video and audio to get summaries, transcriptions, tags and generated content such as podcasts and presentations. Founded by CEO Abhay Agarwal, Poly (formerly reached at withpoly.com, now poly.app) emerged from stealth in November 2025 with $8M in seed funding led by Felicis with participation from Bloomberg Beta, NextView, Figma Ventures, AI Grant, Wing Ventures and MVP Ventures. It is currently in waitlist/beta on web and Mac, with a Windows version planned, and as of this enrichment pass publishes no public developer API, SDKs, CLI, or MCP server.

providers.name: Porters
providers.description: Porters is an AI-native outsourcing partner for European banking operations. Its platform uses AI agents with human oversight to automate high-volume back-office banking processes — account seizure processing (private and public account seizures), insolvency case management from intake to resolution, and chargeback dispute data collection, triage, and resolution. Documents are ingested, extracted, and classified; decisions are made with a human in the loop; and banking actions plus audit reports are generated automatically. Porters hosts data in the EU in line with GDPR, maintains 24/7 audit trails, and does not use customer data for model training. It was founded by veterans of McKinsey, Qonto, Upvest, Solaris, and Roland Berger, and is backed by Earlybird and Seedcamp. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Presti
providers.description: Presti (operated by Teker AI SAS, France) is an AI agent platform for automated product image and video production at scale. eCommerce teams, retailers, and brands write plain-language briefs — attaching product images, packshots, CSVs, or inspiration URLs — and Presti generates studio-quality product staging, 360-degree spins, image-to-video, close-ups, variants, dimension overlays, and infographics, then routes them through a collaborative review-and-approval workspace. It orchestrates multiple third-party generative models (Google Gemini and Veo, OpenAI GPT Image, Flux, Kling, Seedance, Grok, Photoroom) and encodes visual identity via reusable Brand Skills. API access is offered on the Enterprise plan but is not publicly documented.

providers.name: Qardy
providers.description: Qardy is the first online lending aggregator marketplace in Egypt and the wider MENA region, connecting micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) with banks and financial institutions for debt financing. Its digital matchmaking platform collects and digitizes business and individual financial data, runs bank-statement and financial-statement analysis, produces credit ratings and predictive profiles, then matches eligible applicants to partner financial institutions by loan amount, industry, and risk rating. Qardy offers business loans (from EGP 50,000), micro-company financing (up to EGP 242,000), small and medium company financing (from EGP 250,000 to over EGP 10,000,000), supply chain / invoice financing, leasing, and factoring — free of charge to applicants through a fast, transparent three-step application process.

providers.name: QPLIX
providers.description: QPLIX GmbH is a Munich-based wealth management software company offering QPLIX-Q, an all-in-one SaaS platform for professional investors, family offices, asset managers, and banks to consolidate, manage, and report on multi-asset-class portfolios. The platform automates portfolio management, trading and rebalancing, accounting, tax, and client reporting, integrating direct data feeds from 150+ custodian banks (UBS, Julius Baer, Deutsche Bank, and others) and leading market-data providers (LSEG, Moody's, S&P Dow Jones Indices, ISS ESG). QPLIX runs a self-hosted, API-based infrastructure on ISO 27001-certified European data centers, holds an ISAE 3402 attestation, and is registered with Germany's BaFin as an account information service provider (AISP). The company does not publish a public developer API or portal; integrations are delivered as managed add-ons and there is no OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Raseedi
providers.description: Raseedi is an Egyptian financial technology platform that helps underbanked users manage their spending and save money. Through its mobile app it offers free and discounted calls, mobile top-ups and bill payments, cash loans, and a smart dialer, building a community for financial control and savings. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, Raseedi runs a Wix-hosted marketing site with no first-party developer API; its only machine-readable surface is a published llms.txt and the generic Wix Site MCP endpoint.

providers.name: Simple Legal
providers.description: SimpleLegal is an enterprise legal management (ELM) platform for corporate legal departments, providing legal spend management, e-billing, matter management, vendor management, accruals, and reporting and analytics. It helps in-house legal teams track outside counsel spend, review and approve invoices, manage matters, and report on legal operations. Founded as a venture-backed legal operations startup (backed by a16z) and now part of Onit's enterprise legal management product suite, SimpleLegal is delivered as a cloud application at app.simplelegal.com. The product exposes an authenticated REST API to customers for integration with financial and matter systems, but does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI description, or API reference; its only standalone public discovery surface is an RFC 9116 security.txt and a vulnerability disclosure program operated through Onit.

providers.name: Squadio
providers.description: Squadio is a Tech Teams as a Service (TaaS) platform, backed by 500 Global, that lets companies spin up dedicated squads of vetted software engineers and tech talent to build, scale, and digitally transform their projects. The platform covers hiring tech talent, payroll management, MVP development, and talent buyout, and pairs clients with talent through an assisted onboarding flow that includes its Lama AI assistant. Squadio operates primarily across the MENA region and connects businesses with remote engineering teams rather than exposing a public developer API.

providers.name: Study Edge
providers.description: Study Edge is an education technology company that builds online learning, tutoring, and test-preparation platforms for students. Its products deliver on-demand instructional video, live and scheduled study sessions, practice problems, and course-specific study resources, and the company is known for operating statewide math learning platforms such as Algebra Nation / Math Nation. Study Edge is a consumer- and institution-facing learning service rather than a developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company.

providers.name: Swing Education
providers.description: Swing Education is a technology-driven substitute teacher staffing marketplace for K-12 schools and districts across the United States. Its vetted platform connects schools and districts with qualified, background-checked substitute teachers and classified staff to cover daily absences, long-term leaves, special education classrooms, and paraprofessional roles. Schools request coverage through an online admin console while substitutes browse and claim assignments through a dedicated app. The company reports a 94% fill rate, an average five-minute fill time, and coverage of more than 6,000 schools. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; the public site exposes no developer/API surface, so this record carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Syscap
providers.description: Syscap is a Monterrey-based Mexican financial technology company that provides a private-credit and funding-management platform for non-bank financial intermediaries (SOFOMs and financieras). Its software helps loan originators manage funding lines, organize documentation, automate tax compliance, generate amortization tables and electronic signatures, and give funders a 24/7 transparency portal with balance reports and transaction tracking. More than 140 financial institutions across Mexico use Syscap to manage private debt. The company operates a web application and a mobile app; it does not publish a public API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Teserac
providers.description: Teserac is an AI-native infrastructure intelligence company building Neuron™, a unified platform for data center observability, intelligence, and workflow automation. Neuron ingests telemetry from every system in a facility and correlates it across existing DCIM, BMS, EPMS, and ITSM platforms into a single intelligence layer, surfacing anomalies before they become incidents to protect SLAs and shrink MTTR. Its proprietary Neuron Connect™ technology auto-discovers and configures devices and supports protocols including SNMP, OPC-UA, MQTT, Redfish, REST APIs, and Niagara/Tridium. Teserac is backed by Mayfield. As of this profile the company exposes a marketing site and an authenticated product demo (neuron.demo.teserac.ai) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Tiney
providers.description: Tiney is the UK's fastest-growing Ofsted-approved childminder agency, connecting parents with quality-assured home childminders and supporting educators through training, registration, and ongoing quality assurance. Operating as a government-regulated Childminder Agency (CMA), tiney runs a consumer marketplace plus a mobile app for finding local childcare and managing payments, communication, and children's learning updates. Tiney publishes no public developer API; its backend at api.tiney.co powers the parent and childminder apps and is access-restricted (HTTP 403) and undocumented.

providers.name: Universal Forest Products
providers.description: UFP Industries (formerly Universal Forest Products) is a leading global manufacturer and distributor of wood and wood-alternative products serving retail, industrial, and construction markets. UFP operates over 200 facilities globally supplying lumber, engineered wood products, packaging, and building materials. The company has integrated OnBase-based business system integration for document management and workflow automation across its supply chain operations.

providers.name: Verana Health
providers.description: Verana Health is a healthcare real-world data (RWD) and analytics company that transforms de-identified electronic health records from more than 90 million patients across 50+ EHR systems into curated, disease-specific datasets for life sciences and clinical research. Its VeraQ population health data engine harmonizes, tokenizes, and links structured and unstructured EHR data, claims, and medical images using clinician-directed curation, natural language processing, and machine learning, delivering Qdata modules across ophthalmology, urology, and neurology. Verana partners with medical specialty societies (including the AAO IRIS Registry) to power trial design, site and patient identification, real-world evidence studies, and quality-measure reporting. The company is HIPAA-compliant and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV. No public developer API or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Yoshi
providers.description: Yoshi Mobility is a mobile vehicle-care and fleet-services platform founded in 2015 (Y Combinator S16). It brings automotive services to the vehicle wherever it is parked: mobile maintenance and oil changes, car washes and detailing, tire and battery service, EV charging, and live-video vehicle inspections that produce API-ready, signed results for fleets and rideshare platforms. Yoshi originally pioneered on-demand fuel delivery (that division was acquired by EZFill Holdings in January 2025) and now concentrates on mobile auto care and inspection technology, backed by strategic investors including General Motors Ventures, Bridgestone, and ExxonMobil. Integrations and APIs are offered to partners through direct sales rather than a public self-service developer portal.

providers.name: zincfive
providers.description: ZincFive is a power solutions company that manufactures nickel-zinc (NiZn) battery technology for mission-critical and backup power applications, including data center UPS systems, AI dynamic power, and grid storage. Its product line covers BC Series UPS battery cabinets, NiZn retrofit kits, monobloc batteries, and cylindrical cells, positioned as non-flammable, high-power-density, and highly recyclable alternatives to lead-acid batteries. ZincFive publishes technical documents, papers, and industry insights reports, but does not expose a public developer API or SDK surface.

providers.name: Abbycare
providers.description: Abby Care (Wellspring Care Inc.) is a family caregiving platform that helps families deliver professional care at home and get paid for it. It provides no-cost caregiver certification and CNA training, employment, payroll and Medicaid enrollment support, and an AI-assisted care-management platform (AbbyOS / AbbyAid) for real-time care documentation and insights. Backed by Khosla Ventures. The company operates a public marketing website but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures the identity and domain-security posture that could be verified from public sources.

providers.name: Adagio Therapeutics
providers.description: Adagio Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2020 to discover, develop, and commercialize antibody-based therapies for serious infectious diseases, with an initial focus on SARS-CoV-2 and other respiratory viruses. Its lead programs centered on monoclonal antibody candidates engineered for high potency and broad, evolution-resistant neutralization. The company was renamed Invivyd, Inc. in 2023 (Nasdaq: IVVD) and now advances antibody medicines such as PEMGARDA and the VYD2311 candidate. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network. As a life-sciences therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures corporate identity and policy links only.

providers.name: Admission Table
providers.description: Admission Table (admissiontable.com) was a study-abroad and overseas-education counseling platform founded in 2013 by Manish Katyan and Duleep Deosthale, offering real-time student counseling, university admissions guidance, scholarships, financing, and online test preparation for the SAT, GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, and IELTS. It was backed by 500 Global, NYU, and Aarin Capital, and was subsequently acquired by Azent Overseas Education. The admissiontable.com domain now permanently redirects (HTTP 301) to azent.com. This entry was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment found no public API, developer program, or API documentation on either host, so no API artifacts were produced.

providers.name: Advano
providers.description: Advano is a New Orleans, Louisiana battery-materials company that develops silicon-based anode materials for lithium-ion batteries. Spun out of Tulane University in 2016 and backed by 25+ patents, its flagship REALSi silicon-carbon composite is engineered as a drop-in replacement for graphite anodes, delivering up to 9x the energy density of graphite for electric vehicles, consumer electronics, defense, and grid energy storage. Advano's process avoids hazardous silane gas, uses abundant metallurgical-grade silicon, and runs on existing manufacturing equipment. The company operates a pilot plant in New Orleans East and is scaling toward 3,000 tons of REALSi in 2026 and 20,000 tons by 2030. This is a physical deep-tech manufacturer with no public API or developer platform; it is catalogued in the API Evangelist network as a VC portfolio company profile.

providers.name: Advantive
providers.description: Advantive is an AI-enabled software company for specialty manufacturing and distribution operations, unifying ERP, MES, quality (SPC/SQC), PLM, WMS, and B2B commerce workflows into industry-specific systems. Built from a portfolio of brands including Advantzware, DDI System, Distribution One, InfinityQS (Enact and ProFicient), Kiwiplan, WinSPC, and VIA, Advantive serves more than 2,500 customers across eight countries in verticals such as food and beverage, packaging (corrugated, folding carton, plastics), automotive, aerospace and defense, electronics, and distribution of fasteners, bearings, HVAC, and janitorial supplies. The company is a private-equity-backed operations software provider; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public digital surface. No public developer API or OpenAPI has been found — integration is delivered through the products' own connectors and the Advantive support portal.

providers.name: Aera Therapeutics
providers.description: Aera Therapeutics is a genetic-medicines biotechnology company founded by a team of scientists, investors, and company builders to unlock the potential of genetic medicines through next-generation delivery technologies and precision payloads. Aera develops multiple proprietary delivery platforms — including Targeted Lipid Nanoparticles (tLNPs) and protein-nanoparticle systems — to broaden the application of genetic medicines across many disease areas, advancing a broad preclinical pipeline toward the clinic. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network. Aera is a therapeutics company and publishes no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain-security posture. Sector: life-sciences.

providers.name: Aestheticpartners
providers.description: Aesthetic Partners is a clinical-aesthetics practice-management company that partners with physician-led medical aesthetics, cosmetic dermatology, and plastic surgery clinics to help them grow through expansion rather than consolidation. It provides partner practices with capital, marketing, HR, recruiting, IT, accounting, and legal support, plus professional development and new-clinic launch help. Incubated at Harvard and distinguished as female- and minority-owned, the company operates a network of practices across California, Florida, North Carolina, and Virginia, is headquartered in Miami, FL, and is backed by a strategic investment from Norwest Venture Partners. Aesthetic Partners is a non-technical healthcare-services business and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Agtonomy
providers.description: Agtonomy is a physical-AI and automation software company, founded in 2021 by growers and technologists, that embeds machine vision, connectivity, and AI directly into agricultural and off-road equipment from manufacturers such as Bobcat, Kubota, and Clemens. Its platform combines GPS guidance, computer vision, and fleet intelligence so a single operator can plan, remotely monitor, and review autonomous tasks like mowing, hauling, spraying, and cultivation across 10+ tractors at once. The TeleFarmer product controls these field missions through an intuitive app, helping growers address labor shortages and rising operational costs. Backed by investors including GV and Allison Transmission, Agtonomy operates primarily across the western United States with expansion into the Southeast US and Australia. This profile was surfaced as a GV portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Agtonomy publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Ai Fabrik
providers.description: AI Fabrik is an infrastructure company building an edge inference delivery network for high-performance AI tokens. Incubated within Gruve and led by founder Tarun Raisoni alongside Swati Deshpande and Tanuj Mohan, the company has deconstructed the traditional data center model and rebuilt every layer for real-time AI, delivering distributed inference close to users and cloud providers with sub-20ms latency, cost efficiency, and built-in compliance. AI Fabrik is deploying five initial production sites with 6,000+ B300 GPUs launching in 2026, backed by Mayfield, Xora (Temasek), Acclimate Ventures, and Cisco Investments.

providers.name: AI Fund
providers.description: AI Fund is a venture studio founded by Andrew Ng that co-founds and scales AI-powered companies alongside entrepreneurs, venture funds, and corporate partners. Backed by more than $370 million from investors including Sequoia Capital, NEA, Nikkei, and AES, it validates, builds, and scales ventures that tackle real-world problems across emergency response, retail, supply chain, government services, and enterprise productivity. Portfolio companies include Workera, Factored, Workhelix, Profitmind, and IrisGo. AI Fund was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Greylock.

providers.name: Aiko Solar
providers.description: Aiko Solar (Zhejiang Aiko Solar Energy Co.) is a solar photovoltaic manufacturer specializing in high-efficiency solar cells and modules, best known for its ABC (All Back Contact) module technology for residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale applications. A BloombergNEF Tier 1 manufacturer, the company reports 200 GW+ accumulative cell and module shipments and mass-production cell efficiency around 25%. This is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer or API surface; the profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Akorda
providers.description: Akorda was a contract intelligence and contract lifecycle management (CLM) startup that applied artificial intelligence and natural language processing to accelerate contract negotiation, review, and management for legal and procurement teams. Backed by Bloomberg Beta, the company built machine-learning tooling to surface risky clauses, benchmark contract language against standards, and streamline the redlining and approval workflow. Akorda has since been acquired and absorbed into LegalSifter: its former domain (akorda.com) now redirects to legalsifter.com, and no independent Akorda product, developer portal, or public API remains. This profile is retained as a network lead and reflects the acquisition rather than a live, standalone API provider.

providers.name: Akulaku
providers.description: Akulaku is a Southeast Asian fintech and e-commerce platform serving Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, and Malaysia, combining an online shopping marketplace with buy-now-pay-later (PayLater / Akucicil) installment credit and digital banking services. For merchants and partners it runs the Akulaku Open Platform (developer.akulaku.com), a vendor/seller integration surface exposing e-commerce and fulfillment APIs such as Add Item, Get Order Detail, and Init, alongside a Competence Center API set, a developer Console, and testing accounts to accelerate integration.

providers.name: Alethea
providers.description: Alethea is an AI-powered risk intelligence company that operates a proactive narrative and disinformation risk management platform. Its flagship product, Artemis, is a threat intelligence and narrative-risk mitigation platform that detects coordinated inauthentic behavior, influence operations, and emerging online narratives before they escalate into reputational or operational crises. Complementary offerings include Risk Radar (a threat-visibility dashboard), an agentic AI takedown agent for automated mitigation, and Alethea Insights macro threat analysis. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and Multicoin Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Alethea is an enterprise, engagement-led platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a self-service developer portal.

providers.name: Alignable
providers.description: Alignable is a business networking platform that connects small business owners and entrepreneurs across North America. Its members build local referral relationships, join discussion groups and networking events, request and give business introductions, and use intelligent matching tools to find nearby partners, suppliers, and customers. The platform reports more than 10 million members and focuses on peer support and word-of-mouth growth for small businesses. Alignable does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web presence, policies, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: All City Network
providers.description: ALLCITY Network (All City Network) is a sports media and podcasting company built on the tagline "Sports Over Everything." It operates a set of city-based sports networks — DNVR (Denver), PHNX (Phoenix), CHGO (Chicago), PHLY (Philadelphia), and DLLS (Dallas) — that produce team-focused podcasts, video shows, and written coverage of local professional and collegiate sports, alongside network-wide shows and NBA/NFL programming. The company reaches fans through audio and video podcasts, memberships, and a merchandise store. It is a Bullpen Capital portfolio company and is not an API provider; it publishes no developer portal, documentation, or API, so the API-specific artifacts of the enrichment pipeline are not applicable.

providers.name: Allset
providers.description: Allset is a food pickup and rewards platform (now part of SoundHound AI) that lets consumers order ahead from local restaurants and coffee shops for grab-and-go, curbside, or dine-in service while earning up to 15% cash back. Positioned as an alternative to third-party delivery marketplaces, Allset connects diners directly with participating restaurants across 100+ U.S. cities, and also runs Allset for Teams for corporate meal ordering. It is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) with a restaurant partner program; it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Anaqua
providers.description: Anaqua provides intellectual property management (IPMS) software and services for corporations and law firms, unifying patent, trademark, and broader IP portfolio operations through process automation, business intelligence, and analytics. Its AQX platform (AQX Corporate, AQX Law Firm, AQX Pharma) is complemented by PATTSY WAVE portfolio analytics, AcclaimIP patent search, ideaPoint innovation management, and IP services such as annuity, renewal, foreign filing, and docketing. Clients include Adidas, ARM, TSMC, and GSK. Backed by Insight Partners and Bessemer Venture Partners, Anaqua does not currently publish a public developer API or portal; integration is handled via its SeeUnity application-integration technology.

providers.name: Anunta
providers.description: Anunta is an enterprise managed-services company specializing in Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS), Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), managed endpoints, and cloud services across private, public, and hybrid cloud environments. It delivers secure digital workspaces for large enterprises, with proprietary platforms including DesktopReady (off-the-shelf DaaS), CloudOptimal (cloud cost management and optimization), EuVantage (VDI environment visibility and management), and an AI Fabric operations-automation layer. Anunta reports over one million migrated users, 400,000+ active users, and 99.98% user uptime. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Anunta operates primarily as a services provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Anyfin
providers.description: Anyfin is a Swedish consumer-fintech company that helps people lower the cost of their existing debt. Through its mobile app, customers photograph or import a current loan, credit card, or installment plan and Anyfin offers to refinance and consolidate it at a lower interest rate into a single monthly payment. Products span personal loans, credit-card and installment refinancing, car loans, debt consolidation, credit-score checking (via UC) and optional payment-protection insurance (via AXA). Founded in 2018 and backed by Accel, EQT Ventures and Northzone, Anyfin operates primarily in the Swedish market. It exposes no public developer API or developer portal; its api.anyf.in backend serves the consumer app only.

providers.name: APAC Financial Services
providers.description: APAC Financial Services (Apacfin) is a Mumbai-based, Reserve Bank of India registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) that provides customized MSME business loans to underbanked and underserved micro, small, and medium enterprises across India. APAC offers tech-enabled, largely paperless digital onboarding, quick disbursal with minimal documentation, and a mobile app (APACM) for loan tracking, EMI payments, and service requests. The lender reports roughly Rs 2,479 Crore of assets under management across 226 branches in six states, serving more than 52,000 customers, and carries an ICRA A (Stable) credit rating. APAC is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal is published; customer and partner interaction is via the mobile app and hosted customer/complaint portals.

providers.name: Apartment List
providers.description: Apartment List is a virtual-first online rental marketplace that helps renters find apartments across all 50 U.S. states. Founded in September 2011 by John Kobs and Chris Erickson, the platform uses an AI-driven "Perfect Match" recommendation engine to pair renters with listings based on budget, location, amenities, and lifestyle preferences, and offers a Partner Portal for property managers and landlords to list and manage units. The company runs a consumer-facing search experience alongside a B2B property-management side. Apartment List does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, brand, and security surface.

providers.name: Apeel
providers.description: Apeel Sciences is a food technology company headquartered in Santa Barbara, California that develops plant-based protective coatings which extend the shelf life of fresh fruits and vegetables. The company uses food-grade ingredients derived from the peels, pulp, and seeds of plants to create a thin, edible layer that reinforces produce's natural peel, slowing water loss and oxidation. This extends peak taste, juiciness, and nutrient retention while reducing reliance on refrigeration, waxes, pesticides, and plastic packaging across the fresh-produce supply chain. Apeel positions itself as a sustainability and food-waste leader, reporting that since 2021 its technology has prevented millions of pieces of fruit from spoiling, avoided tens of thousands of metric tons of CO2-equivalent emissions, and conserved billions of liters of water. Its products have undergone regulatory review in the United States, European Union, and other markets. Apeel is a portfolio company of Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead. It publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification as of this profile.

providers.name: apusapps
providers.description: APUS (apusapps.com) is a global mobile internet company founded in July 2014, operating the APUS User System — an Android-based ecosystem of consumer utility apps including APUS Launcher, Browser, Booster+, Message Center, Camera, Security Elite, Flashlight, and Theme Store. APUS reaches over two billion users across more than 200 countries and regions and supports 25+ languages, and was named the "world's youngest unicorn" by the Wall Street Journal in 2015. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. APUS is a consumer mobile app developer and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Arivihan
providers.description: Arivihan is an Indian EdTech company operating an AI-based, fully automated online learning platform that gives each K-12 school student a personalized "tutor in their pocket." It targets low- and middle-income families and students in Tier 2+ cities, delivering interactive, personalized lectures and doubt resolution in vernacular languages at roughly 10% of typical coaching fees. Products include the DoubtBuzzter mobile app and the tutor-prod / InstantGuru doubt-resolution web platform. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and prosus-ventures. No public API or developer surface was found during enrichment; this remains a consumer-facing product profile.

providers.name: Arvinas
providers.description: Arvinas is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company (NASDAQ: ARVN) headquartered in New Haven, Connecticut, developing targeted protein degradation therapeutics using its proprietary PROTAC (proteolysis targeting chimera) Discovery Engine. PROTAC molecules are heterobifunctional protein degraders that harness the body's natural protein-disposal system to eliminate disease-causing proteins rather than merely inhibiting them, with a therapeutic focus on oncology and neurology. Arvinas developed the first FDA-approved PROTAC protein degrader, VEPPANU (vepdegestrant). The company was founded on research from Yale University and maintains research partnerships across the industry. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; Arvinas is a life-sciences company and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Arx Robotics
providers.description: ARX Robotics is a German defense-technology company building autonomous mobile robots and a software-defined digitalization platform for European armed forces and commercial operators. Its product line includes Gereon, a small tracked reconnaissance and casualty-evacuation robot; Hector, a larger autonomous all-terrain ground vehicle for scalable land operations; and Mithra OS, a digitalization platform that modernizes legacy vehicle fleets through software integration. ARX positions itself around strengthening Europe's technological resilience and sovereignty with mission-ready, software-defined unmanned ground systems.
