The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Asap Work
providers.description: Asap.work is a next-generation temporary staffing, permanent placement, and freelance recruitment platform for the French construction and skilled-trades sector (BTP - Batiment et Travaux Publics). It connects tradespeople with short-term missions, permanent roles, and freelance projects through a mobile app and a network of consultants, and layers on worker benefits such as housing assistance, medical consultations, training via asap.academy, and wage advances. The company is backed by speedinvest and is expanding toward the United States. Asap.work publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and, on enrichment, was confirmed to have no machine-readable API surface (searched 2026-07-18).

providers.name: Atticus
providers.description: Atticus is a consumer legal-technology law firm, launched in 2019 and backed by Forerunner Ventures, True Ventures, and GV, that helps Americans in crisis get the benefits and aid they deserve. It began with Social Security Disability and has expanded to workers' compensation, VA benefits, and other government-aid programs. Atticus combines a free online qualification quiz, on-staff lawyers and client advocates reachable by phone, text, or chat, and a matching engine that connects each client with vetted attorneys from a network of 100+ top firms who work on contingency. It has helped tens of thousands of people access billions of dollars in life-changing aid. Atticus is a consumer-facing service company and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Audible
providers.description: Audible is an Amazon-owned online audiobook, podcast, and spoken-word entertainment service. It sells and streams audiobooks, Audible Originals, and podcasts through membership plans and a la carte purchases, delivered via web, iOS, Android, Alexa, and Kindle apps. Audible does not operate a public developer program or documented API — its catalog, library, and playback endpoints are a private internal API consumed by its own first-party apps. Community projects (the mkb79/Audible Python library, audible-cli, and omarroth/audible.cr) reverse-engineer that internal API; none are first-party or officially supported. This profile catalogs Audible's public web, help, and legal surface plus the unofficial client ecosystem.

providers.name: Auron Therapeutics
providers.description: Auron Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts, developing therapies that target cell-state plasticity to address the underlying causes of disease across oncology and inflammatory disease indications. The company built the AURIGIN platform, which integrates multi-omic profiling and computational biology to map how cells change states and identify those states that can be therapeutically targeted. Auron was founded by Dr. Katharine Yen with co-founders Dr. Ross Levine, Dr. Eytan Stein, and Dr. Matthew Vander Heiden, a team drawing on experience from Agios Pharmaceuticals and its FDA-approved IDH inhibitor programs. It is backed by investors including Apollo, Arkin Bio, Casdin Capital, and DCVC Bio. As a therapeutics company Auron publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this profile captures its corporate and legal web presence only.

providers.name: autone
providers.description: autone is an AI-powered inventory management platform for retail brands, blending machine-driven recommendations with merchandising expertise and a brand's own data to optimize stock decisions across buying, reordering, replenishment, and rebalancing. Its modules — Buy, Reorder, Replenish, Rebalance, Assortment & Initial Allocation, and Insights — help fashion, beauty, furniture, and sports retailers reduce stockouts and overstock, redistribute inventory across locations, and improve margins. Founded by supply-chain operators from luxury fashion houses (Alexander McQueen, Victoria Beckham, Givenchy), autone is backed by General Catalyst, Seedcamp, and Speedinvest. No public developer API or documentation is published at this time; the platform is delivered as an enterprise SaaS. This profile originated as a VC-portfolio lead and has been enriched with verifiable company identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Avant-Garde Health
providers.description: Avant-Garde Health is a healthcare data analytics company that helps hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs), and physicians identify cost-reduction and quality-improvement opportunities in surgical care. Its CareMeasurement platform ingests electronic medical record (EMR), financial, and patient-reported outcomes data, combines it with claims data and proprietary algorithms, and applies time-driven activity-based costing (TDABC) so care teams can drill into clinical, financial, and operational detail, benchmark performance across departments and institutions, and drive value-based improvement. Products span surgical cost management, surgical coding optimization, surgical quality and outcomes optimization (ERAS), PACU and OR throughput, and CMS TEAM support. Surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface was found at enrichment time.

providers.name: Awa Studios
providers.description: AWA Studios (Artists, Writers & Artisans, Inc.) is a New York-based independent multimedia entertainment company founded in 2018 by comics-industry veterans, including former Marvel editor-in-chief Axel Alonso and former Marvel president Bill Jemas, with media executive Jon Miller as board chairman. AWA publishes original comic books and graphic novels across action, crime, horror, science fiction, and fantasy genres, built around a creator-owned business model that offers favorable terms to writers and artists. The company operates the "Upshot" imprint and a shared "Resistance Universe," runs a direct-to-consumer shop for print and digital titles, and develops film and television adaptations of its properties. AWA received seed-stage funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners in 2018. It is a media and entertainment company and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Bain & Company
providers.description: Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm and one of the prestigious Big Three strategy consultancies. Bain does not publish a commercial public developer portal; technology integration is delivered through client-specific advisory engagements, Bain proprietary tools (NPS Prism, Helix, Vector), and a Bain-published Insights / research surface that is consumed via the bain.com website and feeds rather than developer APIs.

providers.name: Bedrock Robotics
providers.description: Bedrock Robotics develops advanced autonomy for the built world, retrofitting existing heavy construction machinery with an autonomous kit the company calls the Bedrock Operator. The system adds machine intelligence to equipment such as excavators and dozers so jobsites can run around the clock with reduced human intervention, compressing project timelines, improving safety by removing operators from hazardous work, and enabling remote progress tracking. Backed by 8vc and Emergence Capital, the company raised a $270M Series B. Bedrock is a robotics and physical-autonomy company; it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time. This profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network and captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: Belong
providers.description: Belong is a residential property-management platform serving both homeowners and renters across 25+ major U.S. cities. For homeowners it handles end-to-end rental management — home inspection, marketing, resident screening, rent collection, and maintenance — while for renters it offers rental-home discovery, flexible viewings, streamlined applications, and resident support. The company pairs AI-powered operations with human customer service. Belong is backed by a16z, Fifth Wall, and GGV Capital, and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. No public developer API or documentation surface has been found at this time.

providers.name: BeReal
providers.description: BeReal is a French social media application that encourages authentic, unfiltered daily sharing through a two-minute random notification window in which users capture a moment using both the front and rear cameras simultaneously. Positioned as an alternative to curated, algorithmic social media, it emphasizes genuine connection over performance and explicitly excludes AI-generated content from the platform. Founded in France and acquired by mobile publisher Voodoo, BeReal operates a consumer mobile product with a help center and an advertising business, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced via a16z and Accel portfolio data and enriched with the provider's real public web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Bible Chat
providers.description: Bible Chat is a faith-focused consumer mobile application built by Soulstream, a Romanian startup founded in 2023 by Laurentiu Balasa and Marius Iordache, that pairs AI-guided conversation with Scripture to help people study the Bible and grow spiritually. Features include topical Bible verses, guided Bible lessons, a faith Q&A assistant, verse of the day, a Bible glossary, and podcast and blog content, delivered through iOS and Android apps. It is marketed as "the #1 Faith App in the World." This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of True Ventures and is maintained in the API Evangelist network; the company publishes a consumer product and does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Bloomscape
providers.description: Bloomscape is a direct-to-consumer houseplant company that grows plants in its own greenhouses and ships them fully grown directly to customers' doors, bypassing traditional retail and nursery supply chains. Alongside houseplants, it sells planters, plant-care accessories, and gifting options, and backs every order with its Grow-How team of horticultural experts plus a plant guarantee. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network. Bloomscape operates a consumer e-commerce storefront and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documented developer surface at this time; this profile captures its public web, support, and legal properties along with a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Blue Apron
providers.description: Blue Apron is a direct-to-consumer meal-kit and prepared-food delivery company that ships chef-designed recipes with pre-portioned fresh ingredients on a weekly, no-commitment basis. Its consumer-facing surface spans meal kits, assembly-and-bake meals, ready-to-eat prepared dishes, and family-style options ordered and managed through blueapron.com and its mobile apps. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners, Blue Apron operates a consumer e-commerce and subscription platform with no public developer program, API portal, or documented API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Blue Fever
providers.description: Blue Fever is a social and mental-health app for young people that pairs a judgment-free peer community with "Blue," an AI emotional-support companion, under the tagline "A place to feel seen, not be seen." Users share thoughts, moods, and creative expression and receive support from both community members and the AI companion, alongside curated wellness resources and crisis support. The app is available on iOS and Android, has been featured as an Apple App of the Day, and carries a 4.6 App Store rating. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a consumer application with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Blue Nile
providers.description: Blue Nile is an online retailer of diamonds and fine jewelry, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington. It pioneered the direct-to-consumer model for engagement rings and loose diamonds, letting shoppers search and compare certified diamonds by cut, color, clarity, and carat and build custom rings, wedding bands, and gifts online. The company is now part of Signet Jewelers. Blue Nile is included in the API Evangelist network as a consumer / e-commerce company profile; it was originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Trinity Ventures. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Blue Water Autonomy
providers.description: Blue Water Autonomy is a Boston-based defense technology company building autonomous warships for open-ocean operations, with the goal of revitalizing U.S. shipbuilding through scalable, reliable, uncrewed naval vessels. Founded in 2025 by Rylan Hamilton (ex-U.S. Navy officer and founder of 6 River Systems), Scott N. Miller (ocean engineer and early iRobot engineer), and Austin Gray (former Navy intelligence officer), the company unveiled its 190-foot Liberty Class autonomous ship platform for the U.S. Navy in February 2026. Backed by a $50M Series A led by GV, Blue Water Autonomy operates from offices in Boston MA, Washington DC, Morgan City LA, and San Diego CA. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Bluewhite (fka Blue White Robotics)
providers.description: Bluewhite (formerly Blue White Robotics) is an autonomy company that builds an AI-powered "Field Intelligence" physical-AI engine for operating vehicles in demanding, unstructured, real-world environments. Founded in Israel, the company first commercialized autonomous agriculture — retrofitting existing tractor fleets with an aftermarket autonomy kit for driverless spraying, mowing, and other field operations — and has since extended the same edge-processing autonomy stack to defense and security missions through OEM integrations and complete unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs). Bluewhite is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. The company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or technical documentation; this API Evangelist profile tracks its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Boom
providers.description: Boom Supersonic is a Colorado-based aerospace company building Overture, a Mach 1.7 supersonic airliner designed to carry 64-80 passengers on transoceanic routes, powered by the company's Symphony engine and assembled at its Superfactory in Greensboro, North Carolina. Its XB-1 demonstrator flew supersonic in early 2025. Boom was surfaced as a portfolio company of SV Angel and added to the API Evangelist network. Boom publishes a corporate and investor-facing web presence (newsroom, careers, privacy, terms) but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, well-known discovery, or MCP surface, so no API artifacts are available to enrich; this profile captures its verifiable web and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Boom Supersonic
providers.description: Boom Supersonic is a Denver-based aerospace company building supersonic commercial aircraft to make the world dramatically more accessible. Its flagship airliner, Overture, is designed to carry passengers at twice the speed of today's jets and has orders and pre-orders from United Airlines, American Airlines, and Japan Airlines. The company develops the Symphony medium-bypass turbofan engine purpose-built for supersonic flight, flew the XB-1 demonstrator past Mach 1, and is applying its propulsion technology to Superpower gas turbines for data-center energy. Boom is a deep-tech, hardware-first manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API surface; this profile tracks its identity and security posture in the API Evangelist network. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Electric Capital, and Homebrew.

providers.name: Brick&Bolt
providers.description: Brick&Bolt (bricknbolt.com) is a Bangalore-based, tech-enabled home and commercial construction marketplace that delivers end-to-end design-to-build services across major Indian cities including Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Delhi NCR, and Mysuru. The company connects homeowners with vetted contractors and manages projects through its QASCON quality system (470+ quality checks), an ESCROW-secured payment model that releases funds only as milestones complete, transparent quotations, and consumer and professional mobile apps for real-time project tracking. Backed by Accel, Brick&Bolt has delivered thousands of homes and was named to Forbes Asia's "100 to Watch" list. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Brick&Bolt operates a consumer construction platform and mobile apps but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Buglance
providers.description: Buglance is a crowdsourced software testing platform that connects companies with a global community of more than 50,000 professional bug hunters to find defects and quality issues in mobile apps, games, e-commerce sites, and web platforms before release. Testers can be targeted by country, age, gender, and device type across a fleet of 10,000+ real devices, and detailed, validated, severity-classified bug reports are typically delivered in under 24 hours through live analytics dashboards. Buglance is a 500 Global portfolio company and markets to mobile gaming, e-commerce and retail, and lifestyle and productivity teams. It is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Cake
providers.description: Cake (stylized CAKE) is a Stockholm, Sweden based maker of premium, lightweight, high-performance electric motorcycles and mopeds, built around a mission to accelerate the shift to a zero-emission society by combining excitement with responsibility. Its clean-mobility lineup spans commuter models (Makka, Osa), off-road bikes (Kalk, Bukk) and work-focused utility variants. Founded by Stefan Ytterborn and backed by Creandum, CAKE filed for bankruptcy in early 2024 and its brand and IP were acquired by Norway's Brages Holding AS, which relaunched the company. Cake sells direct to consumers and through dealers at ridecake.com; it is a hardware and e-commerce brand with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: California Forever
providers.description: California Forever is a real estate and urban development company founded by Jan Sramek in 2017, backed by prominent Silicon Valley investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Laurene Powell Jobs, Reid Hoffman, Marc Andreessen, and Stripe co-founders Patrick and John Collison. Through its subsidiary Flannery Associates the company assembled roughly 60,000-70,000 acres of land in southeastern Solano County, California, and is planning a new walkable city for up to 400,000 residents alongside the Solano Foundry advanced manufacturing park and the Solano Shipyard. The company describes the effort as a $215 billion private investment intended to create hundreds of thousands of jobs, 170,000+ new homes, and billions in annual tax revenue over 40 years. California Forever is a physical-development and land-use company; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable interfaces at this time.

providers.name: CareGuide
providers.description: CareGuide is a Canadian company operating a network of online marketplaces that connect families with caregivers across child care, home care, pet care, and elder care, alongside HeartPayroll household payroll services. Its consumer brands include CanadianNanny.ca, Sitter.com, PetSitter.com, ElderCare.com, HouseKeeper.com and a family of "Meet A" professional directories. Backed by 500 Global, CareGuide is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. The company does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CarOnSale
providers.description: CarOnSale is an AI-supported B2B marketplace for used-car trading across Europe, operated by Castle Tech GmbH. Licensed dealers, OEMs, fleet operators, and leasing companies buy and sell used vehicles through digital auctions built on standardized 110-point condition assessments, AI-based pricing and valuation, and integrated transport and financing services. The platform connects sellers (dealer groups, OEMs, leasing and rental companies) with a European network of professional buyers, handling procurement, price discovery, settlement, and logistics end to end. Added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Cartesi
providers.description: Cartesi is a Linux-based optimistic rollup protocol that lets developers build decentralized applications by running rich off-chain computation inside a sandboxed Linux virtual machine. The core of the stack is the Cartesi Machine, a deterministic RISC-V emulator that boots a real Linux userland so dApps can be written in any language (Rust, Go, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++) using familiar libraries, then settle results on Ethereum and other EVM chains through Cartesi Rollups smart contracts. Cartesi Rollups 2.0 is the current major version, packaging an application-specific rollup as the combination of the Cartesi Machine, the Cartesi Rollups Node middleware (Rust + Go), and a set of Solidity rollup contracts that handle settlement, consensus, and data availability. The DAVE permissionless fraud-proof system provides Stage-2 trust minimization, while the Cartesi CLI (the successor to Sunodo) packages scaffolding, build, and local devnet workflows. Cartesi is stewarded by The Cartesi Foundation and the CTSI token governs the network. Cartesi is fully open source under Apache-2.0 and LGPL-3.0 licenses on github.com/cartesi; there is no proprietary SaaS product, but the Rollups Node ships several developer-facing surfaces — the Rollup HTTP API used by application backends, the Inspect HTTP API for read-only queries from frontends, a GraphQL reader for advance-state inputs / outputs / vouchers / notices / reports, and a JSON-RPC node API for operations.

providers.name: Cashify
providers.description: Cashify is an Indian re-commerce platform for buying, selling, and repairing used and refurbished consumer electronics — smartphones, laptops, tablets, and other gadgets. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Gurugram, the company provides instant online price quotes, free doorstep pickup with on-the-spot payment for devices sold to it, and sells certified refurbished devices backed by warranty. Alongside its consumer website and mobile apps, Cashify operates a network of physical retail stores across India, runs device repair services, and offers a partner program for retailers. It is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners among other investors. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead and has been enriched with identity and domain-security artifacts.

providers.name: Castbox
providers.description: Castbox is a free cross-platform podcast and audio content platform that lets listeners discover, stream, download, and manage millions of podcasts, audiobooks, and radio shows across Apple iOS, Android, Amazon Alexa, Google Home, CarPlay, Android Auto, and the web. Alongside its consumer listening apps, Castbox offers a "For Podcasters" suite for creators to host, distribute, and monetize their shows. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, Castbox is a consumer audio company that publishes no public developer API portal; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and support surface.

providers.name: Ceibo
providers.description: Ceibo is a Chilean copper technology company accelerating access to copper supply through a proprietary leaching process that recovers copper from primary sulfide ores. Backed by Khosla Ventures and BHP Ventures, the company positions its on-site technology as faster than bioleaching, using less water than concentration and a fraction of the capital expenditure of concentrators, aiming to close the global copper supply-demand gap needed for the energy transition. Headquartered in Santiago, Chile, Ceibo was named a 2026 Fast Company World Changing Ideas winner. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Ceibo publishes no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: Charm Industrial
providers.description: Charm Industrial is a carbon removal technology company that permanently sequesters atmospheric CO2 by converting waste biomass (agricultural residues and other plant matter) into a stable, carbon-rich liquid called bio-oil through fast pyrolysis, then injecting that bio-oil into EPA-regulated underground wells where it solidifies and remains stored for millennia. Charm sells verified carbon dioxide removal (CDR) credits to enterprise buyers and publishes a public ledger of delivered tonnage. The company received a $53M advance market commitment from Frontier and is backed by investors including General Catalyst and Lowercarbon Capital. This API Evangelist profile tracks Charm Industrial as a company; the provider publishes a marketing and carbon-purchasing website but no public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Chegg.com
providers.description: Chegg, Inc. is a US-based education technology company that provides direct-to-student learning services on a subscription basis, including homework and expert Q&A help, step-by-step textbook and problem solutions, textbook rental and purchase, online tutoring, writing and citation tools, math and science solvers, and AI-assisted study support. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass Chegg publishes a consumer web and mobile product but no public developer portal, documented API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP server; this profile therefore captures its public web identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Chemify
providers.description: Chemify is a Glasgow-based programmable-chemistry company, spun out of the University of Glasgow in 2022 by chemist Lee Cronin, that digitizes the creation of molecules through what it calls "Chemputation." The platform fuses AI/ML-driven molecular design, a universal chemical programming language, and robotic synthesis so pharmaceutical, biotech, and industrial partners can move from a novel concept to a makeable compound end to end. In 2025 Chemify opened its first Chemifarm, a fully automated chemistry facility in Glasgow's Maryhill district that pairs its molecular-design engine with industrial-scale robotic synthesis, and closed a $50M Series B co-led by Wing Venture Capital and Insight Partners, with backing from DCVC. Chemify does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; engagement runs through its partner program.

providers.name: Chemify Limited
providers.description: Chemify Limited is a chemistry-automation company founded in 2022 by Professor Lee Cronin, building on two decades of research at the University of Glasgow and headquartered in Glasgow, Scotland. Chemify develops "Chemputation" — programmable chemistry — fusing chemistry, robotics, computation, machine learning, and its own universal chemical programming language (chi-DL / XDL) to digitize the discovery, design, and synthesis of molecules on hardware-agnostic robotic chemistry platforms. Its ASSEMBLER stack converts optimized reaction information into fully defined chemical code that automated synthesis machines can execute. The company is backed by Insight Partners and DCVC. Chemify does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record with domain-security posture and public site properties.

providers.name: Chipper Cash
providers.description: Chipper Cash is a pan-African fintech (legal entities Critical Ideas, Inc. and Voyse Technologies US, Inc.) operating a mobile-first cross-border money transfer, digital payments, crypto, and investing platform across Africa and the diaspora. Founded in 2018 by Ham Serunjogi (Uganda) and Maijid Moujaled (Ghana) after they met at Grinnell College in Iowa, Chipper became one of Africa's fintech unicorns in 2021 and has raised over $340M to date. The consumer app — available on iOS, Android, and web — supports peer-to-peer and cross-border transfers across 21+ African countries, virtual Visa cards (Chipper Card), bill pay and airtime top-ups, fractional US-stock investing (Chipper Stocks, 6,000+ public companies, from $1), and historically crypto trading (BTC/ETH). Reported scale includes 5M+ registered users, 1M+ Visa cards issued, and 250,000+ daily transactions. Direct consumer markets include Nigeria, Ghana, Uganda, Tanzania, South Africa, Rwanda, the UK, and the US. On the developer side, Chipper exposes the Chipper Network API ("Pay With Chipper") — a merchant-facing API that lets authorized businesses accept cross-border payments across 9 currencies, initiate payouts, issue refunds, and look up Chipper user accounts, authenticated with a Chipper User ID + Network API Key. Documentation is published as a Postman collection and access is gated by merchant onboarding; no public OpenAPI or open-source SDK is currently published. Adjacent products include Chipper ID (AI-led identity verification), Chipper Enterprise (bulk payments and collections), Business Accounts, and Zoona (agent-network remittances), plus an integration with TBD's tbDEX protocol for decentralized cross-border payments.

providers.name: Chipstack
providers.description: Chipstack is an AI-driven semiconductor verification company that uses agentic AI to automate chip design verification, one of the most time-consuming stages of building a complex chip (often 60% or more of total development effort). Its product suite is a set of specialized AI agents — a Mental Model AI Agent, a Formal AI Agent, a Unit Simulation AI Agent, and a UVM AI Agent — that read design intent and generate, run, and reason about verification tasks to shift that work earlier in the design cycle and cut the time and resources it takes to tape out. Founded and based across Seattle, WA and San Jose, CA, and backed by Khosla Ventures, Chipstack is an enterprise, demo-request product rather than a public developer platform: as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or developer portal. In 2026 the company announced it is joining Cadence. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: Citizen
providers.description: Citizen is a consumer public-safety mobile application that delivers real-time, location-based safety alerts and incident notifications to users about events happening in their communities. The app surfaces verified alerts, live video streamed by witnesses at the scene, incident search, and community broadcast features to help people connect and stay safe. Backed by 8vc, Citizen positions itself as the leading public-safety app in the United States. It is a consumer product with no public developer program, API documentation, SDK, or developer portal exposed on its website as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Clarify Health
providers.description: Clarify Health Solutions is a healthcare analytics and outcomes company that helps health systems, payers, and life sciences organizations understand cost, quality, and utilization across the care journey. Its flagship platform, Clarify Meridian, unifies referral intelligence, physician activation, consumer engagement, and outcomes attribution into a single analytics environment built on billions of longitudinal patient records and claims data. Clarify Health is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and, in 2026, acquired Loyal Health to expand its consumer engagement capabilities. The company operates a SaaS analytics product rather than a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and public web surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Clarium
providers.description: Clarium is a healthcare supply chain resiliency company founded in early 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic and headquartered in New York City. Its AI-powered platform, Astra OS, unifies real-time data from hospitals and their suppliers across systems of record, then layers data-enabled workflow apps on top: Disruption Monitoring to detect and resolve supply chain disruptions faster, Substitute Management to automate product approvals, and Procedure Card Optimization to standardize and cut cost. Clarium has raised $43M+ (including a $27M Series A led by General Catalyst, with Northzone among its backers) and works with leading health systems such as Mount Sinai, Ochsner Health, Allina Health, and Yale New Haven.

providers.name: Clikalia
providers.description: Clikalia is a Spanish proptech founded in 2018 by Alister Moreno and Pablo Fernandez that operates an iBuyer model for residential real estate: it makes homeowners an instant purchase offer, can close a sale within days, then renovates and returns properties to the market in turnkey condition. The company pairs proprietary technology with a large operations team to digitize a historically slow home buying and selling process, and also offers mortgage brokerage (hipotecas) and renovation services (Studio by Clikalia). Backed by Fifth Wall and SoftBank Vision Fund, Clikalia operates across Spain, Portugal, France and Mexico. Clikalia does not publish a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web, legal, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Coach
providers.description: Coach is a luxury leather goods and lifestyle brand offering handbags, accessories, footwear, ready-to-wear apparel, and fragrances. Coach is owned by Tapestry, Inc. (NYSE: TPR), the New York-based house of accessible luxury brands that also operates Kate Spade New York and Stuart Weitzman. Coach operates direct-to-consumer e-commerce at coach.com and a global network of retail and outlet stores. Coach does not publish a public-facing developer portal or API; integrations with retail partners, marketplaces, and ad tech platforms run through Tapestry's enterprise systems and approved partner channels rather than a self-service developer program.

providers.name: CodeMentor
providers.description: CodeMentor (codementor.io) is an on-demand marketplace that connects software developers with vetted expert mentors for live 1:1 coding help, code review, debugging, pair programming, and longer-term freelance engagements across dozens of programming languages and frameworks. Part of the Arc / CodeMentor group, it serves individual learners seeking real-time mentorship as well as companies hiring vetted remote developers. As of this profile CodeMentor exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; this record was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched with verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Concentric AI
providers.description: Concentric AI provides an AI-driven data security governance platform built on its proprietary Semantic Intelligence technology to autonomously discover, classify, monitor, and protect sensitive data across cloud and on-premises environments. The agentless platform spans Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), data loss prevention, data access governance, insider risk detection, and generative-AI data security (covering Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, and Perplexity), connecting to 40+ data platforms and business applications including Snowflake, Amazon S3, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Google Workspace. Backed by Homebrew, Concentric AI was recognized as a 2026 Gartner Peer Insights Customers' Choice for DSPM.

providers.name: Connect Biopharma
providers.description: Connect Biopharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, dedicated to transforming care for patients with inflammatory diseases such as asthma and COPD. Its lead drug candidate, rademikibart (CBP-201), is an antibody targeting IL-4Ra in Phase 2 clinical development for acute asthma and COPD exacerbations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network, the company operates in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector and publishes no public developer portal, API, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Conntour
providers.description: Conntour is an Israeli AI video-intelligence company building a natural-language search engine for security camera systems. Its vision and language models let operators search any camera feed in plain language to find any object, person, or situation in real time, raise automatic alerts, and investigate recorded footage in seconds — turning passive surveillance into active intelligence. Unlike legacy analytics that depend on preset object or motion definitions, Conntour's models scale to thousands of concurrent feeds (up to roughly 50 feeds per consumer GPU such as an Nvidia RTX 4090) and deploy fully on-premises, in the cloud, or in a hybrid mix, either augmenting existing VMS/security systems or serving as a standalone surveillance platform. Founded in 2024 by Matan Goldner and Tomer Kola, the company serves intelligence agencies, homeland security, law enforcement, military and defense, transportation, and enterprise customers. It raised a $7M seed round in March 2026 led by General Catalyst, with participation from Y Combinator, SV Angel, and Liquid 2 Ventures.

providers.name: conrizon
providers.description: conrizon AG is a German holding company, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Essen, that unites four of Europe's leading Enterprise Content Management (ECM) brands - easy software, PROXESS, HABEL, and Portal Systems (Shareflex), alongside the friendWorks professional-services unit - under one roof. The group provides legally compliant, audit-proof digital archiving (GDPR, GoBD, eIDAS), document management (DMS), invoice and procure-to-pay (P2P) processing, contract management, and HR/HCM software with automated workflows, plus AI services and connectors for SAP and Microsoft 365 / SharePoint. Solutions are offered cloud-native, in a private cloud, on-premises, or hybrid, and are relied on by more than 8,700 companies and organizations worldwide. conrizon is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. It publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: CoPlane
providers.description: CoPlane is a San Francisco-based enterprise software company building an AI-native intelligent operations layer for the back office of essential enterprises. The platform combines AI agents with deterministic business rules on a durable workflow engine to automate high-friction, exception-heavy processes across finance, procurement, and operations — including invoice intake, PO matching, vendor onboarding, cash application, billing, collections, bank and account reconciliation, close processes, and variance analysis. CoPlane runs inside the customer's own cloud environment and interoperates with existing enterprise systems (SAP, Workday, Coupa) across Source-to-Pay, Quote-to-Cash, and Record-to-Report workflows without a rip-and-replace migration. Founded in 2024, the company raised a $14M seed round in November 2025 led by Ribbit Capital with participation from Stripe, Optum Ventures, and Terrain. This profile was surfaced as a Ribbit Capital portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; CoPlane does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Couchsurfing
providers.description: Couchsurfing is a community-driven travel and hospitality-exchange platform that connects travelers with local hosts offering free accommodation, local meetups, and cultural exchange across more than 200,000 cities worldwide. Members build trust through verified profiles, references, and community events, and use the service to find places to stay, meet locals, and discover events while traveling. Couchsurfing publishes no official public developer API or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web, trust, and policy surface for discovery and monitoring, and was originally surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and Point Nine.

providers.name: CrownIT
providers.description: CrownIT (Crownit.in) is India's online market-research and consumer-insights platform, now acquired by Ipsos, the world's leading market research company. Operating as a full-stack agency, Crownit conducts online surveys and tracks purchase and consumption behavior via shopping bills and product photos submitted through its mobile app, applying machine learning and big-data analytics to deliver fast, accurate and comprehensive consumer insights to over 200 brands and enterprises across 40+ Indian cities. Backed by Accel and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio company profile; Crownit runs a consumer rewards and survey application rather than a public developer API, so this profile carries company identity only and has no OpenAPI, developer portal, or API artifacts.

providers.name: Curefoods
providers.description: Curefoods is a Bengaluru-based multi-brand cloud kitchen and quick-service restaurant company founded in 2020 that builds and operates iconic Indian food brands. As of March 2025 it runs roughly 502 outlets across India (about 281 cloud kitchens, 99 kiosks, and 122 restaurants) under a house-of-brands model including Kitchens of EatFit, Sharief Bhai, Olio Pizza, Nomad Pizza, Arambam, CakeZone, Frozen Bottle, and Krispy Kreme. Backed by Accel, Chiratae Ventures, and Iron Pillar, the company crossed roughly Rs 746 crore in FY25 revenue and has received SEBI approval for an IPO. Curefoods is a consumer food operator with no public developer API or documentation surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and carries only identity, domain-security, and public-property signals.

providers.name: Cycle
providers.description: CYCLE (operated by CM Invest B.V., Amsterdam) is a European electric-mobility subscription service that provides e-bikes and cargo bikes to professional delivery riders, couriers, and businesses. Its all-inclusive monthly subscriptions bundle maintenance, on-site repairs, bike swaps, GPS tracking, theft protection, and remote motor control across 100+ cities in Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Belgium, Poland, Italy, and the UK. CYCLE was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; the provider publishes a consumer/business marketing and operations site but exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Cylib
providers.description: Cylib is a German battery recycling company founded in 2022 as a spinoff from RWTH Aachen University, headquartered in Aachen, Germany. It transforms end-of-life lithium-ion batteries, production scrap, and black mass back into critical raw materials, recovering lithium, graphite, nickel, cobalt, and manganese through a proprietary, largely water-based hydrometallurgical process that the company reports achieves over 90% recycling efficiency with an ~80% reduced carbon footprint versus primary extraction, powered by 100% renewable electricity. The company is backed by Speedinvest and other investors. Cylib operates as an industrial cleantech / circular-economy materials business and does not currently publish a developer program, public API, developer portal, SDKs, or other software integration surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and carries only identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Datacor
providers.description: Datacor is an enterprise software company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Florham Park, New Jersey, that builds industry-specific business management and engineering software for process manufacturers, chemical distributors, and animal-nutrition producers. Its business-automation suite spans ERP, CRM, MES, WMS, formulation management, BLISS LIMS, regulatory and nutrition labeling, and TrackAbout asset tracking, while its engineering line delivers chemical process simulation and flow-modeling tools including CHEMCAD, Fathom, Arrow, Impulse, and xStream. Datacor serves the petrochemical, refinery, energy, feed, and specialty-chemical sectors, and has begun layering AI-driven capabilities across its products. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Datacor does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or API specifications; this profile captures its verified public identity while the API surface (if any) remains behind its customer support portal.

providers.name: DatologyAI
providers.description: DatologyAI is a data curation and optimization platform that automatically identifies, prioritizes, and curates training data at petabyte scale so teams can train machine learning and foundation models that are better, faster, and smaller. Founded on the principle that "models are what they eat," its research-driven pipeline improves model quality while cutting compute cost and training time, and is used by AI labs and enterprises building frontier open models. The company is venture-backed by Amplify Partners and Felicis. DatologyAI operates as an enterprise, contact-sales service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation portal.

providers.name: Dattch
providers.description: Dattch (now HER, weareher.com) is a dating and social community app for LGBTQ+ women, nonbinary, and queer people, founded by Robyn Exton. The platform pairs one-to-one matching with community spaces, events, and social feeds, and reports more than 15 million users across 114+ countries. It operates as a consumer mobile application on iOS and Android with no publicly documented developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and tracked in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Deako
providers.description: Deako is a whole-home smart lighting company that designs modular smart switches, dimmers, plugs, and simple switches (motion, timer, nightlight, and fan controls) for residential new construction and retrofit. Its Deako Intelligence platform layers adaptive lighting, follow-me sound, intercom, and parent-care features on top of the hardware, and the devices integrate with Amazon Alexa, Google Home, Control4, Clare, and the Matter smart-home standard. Deako sells directly and through a network of homebuilders, electricians, and integrators. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; this profile tracks the company's public web, support, blog, legal, and smart-home integration surface, awaiting any future developer program.

providers.name: Dedrone
providers.description: Dedrone is a counter-drone (counter-UAS) airspace security company that detects, tracks, identifies, and helps mitigate unauthorized drones and unmanned aerial systems. Its AI-powered sensor platform combines RF detection, radar, cameras, and mitigation technologies to protect airports, critical infrastructure, correctional facilities, stadiums, and government and military sites. Dedrone was acquired by Axon and operates as its counter-drone / airspace-security line. Surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Felicis and Menlo Ventures; no public developer API, portal, or specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Detect
providers.description: Detect Technologies is an IIT Madras-incubated industrial AI company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Chennai, India. Its 360-degree Workplace Intelligence Platform, T-Pulse, combines proprietary IoT sensors, drones, robotics and machine vision with industrial AI to deliver automated inspections, predictive maintenance, gas and oil leak detection, structural health monitoring, and real-time workplace safety, operations and security monitoring for enterprises such as Shell, Vedanta, Adani Group and Hindustan Zinc. Backed by Accel and Elevation Capital. The company does not publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its public identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Dia
providers.description: Dia & Co is a plus-size fashion and personal styling subscription service for women, operated by FullBeauty Brands. Customers complete an online style quiz, and stylists curate a monthly box of up to seven clothing items in sizes 10 to 32 from hundreds of brands to try on at home, with free shipping and free returns both ways. Dia & Co also runs an online shop and has been featured in Vogue, Forbes, and Glamour, and was an early portfolio company of Union Square Ventures. It operates as a consumer e-commerce brand and publishes no public developer API; this profile tracks its web and security surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Diem
providers.description: Diem is a consumer social search engine, delivered as an iOS and Android app, that surfaces community-driven answers to questions people are often reluctant to ask elsewhere - positioning itself as "a search engine that feels like you're asking questions in a girl's bathroom at 1am." The Diem experience centers on a women-focused community, a Gems rewards program redeemable for products and features, a weekly newsletter, a merch shop, and companion products such as the Twin Flame astrology-compatibility app. Diem is backed by a16z, Ribbit Capital, and Techstars. It is a consumer application with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: digitaleseiten
providers.description: Digitale Seiten is a German online marketing company that operates a network of 28+ industry-specific business directories for craftspeople and local service providers (for example Elektriker.org, Klempner.org, Maler.org and Dachdecker.org). The platform lets tradespeople create free business listings, distributes regional customer inquiries and job requests to registered companies as leads, improves their search-engine visibility, and provides review-collection tools. According to the company it lists 869,000+ registered businesses and has matched 765,000+ job assignments. It is a B2B directory and lead-generation service and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or developer portal. Backed by Point Nine.

providers.name: Dimensional
providers.description: Dimensional is a Toronto-based personality-science company whose consumer mobile app assesses more than 200 traits across 15 dimensions — including cognition, values, communication styles, interests, love styles, attachment style, conflict resolution, strengths, and political ideology — to build detailed personality profiles. Users compare results with friends and explore relationship compatibility, positioning the product against social-media highlight reels in favor of authentic connection. The app is available on iOS with an Android beta, and the company is backed by Bloomberg Beta. No public API, SDK, or developer platform is published at this time; this profile captures the company's public web and security surface.

providers.name: Dinii
providers.description: Dinii (株式会社ダイニー) is a Tokyo-based restaurant-technology SaaS company, founded in June 2018, offering an "All in One Restaurant Cloud" for food-service businesses. Its integrated modules span POS register, customer mobile ordering, mobile self-checkout payment, customer management/CRM (with LINE integration), staff attendance and scheduling, reservation ledger, and management analytics dashboards (daily P&L, labor-cost optimization, QSC monitoring). Dinii reports 3,000+ installed locations and 20 million+ end users, with offices in Tokyo, Osaka, Sapporo, and Nagoya. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Dinii publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Donut Media
providers.description: Donut Media is an American automotive entertainment brand and one of the largest automotive channels on YouTube, founded in 2015 by Matt Levin, Ben Conrad, and Nick Moceri. It is best known for original series such as Up to Speed, Money Pit, and HiLow, along with the Past Gas podcast, reaching millions of car enthusiasts through video, social, and audio. Donut monetizes through advertising, brand sponsorships, content licensing, and an extensive Shopify-powered online store selling apparel, hats, and collectibles. The company was acquired by Recurrent Ventures in November 2021. This profile documents Donut Media's public web and commerce surface; the company does not publish a developer API program.

providers.name: Dren Bio
providers.description: Dren Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Foster City, California, focused on the discovery and development of novel antibody therapeutics that selectively deplete pathogenic cells and other disease-causing agents. Its proprietary Targeted Myeloid Engager and Phagocytosis Platform is a multispecific, antibody-based technology designed to induce potent depletion of disease-causing agents by engaging a novel phagocytic receptor selectively expressed on myeloid cells. The pipeline spans two first-in-class clinical-stage programs (including DR-01 and DR-0202) plus multiple preclinical and discovery-stage programs across oncology, autoimmune disease, immunology, and neurology. Dren Bio has established strategic collaborations with Pfizer and Sanofi, the latter of which acquired its DR-0201 (SAR448501) bispecific myeloid cell engager program. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Drover AI
providers.description: Drover AI is a Los Angeles-based micromobility technology company that pioneers the use of computer vision, machine learning, and proprietary sensor fusion in shared light electric vehicles (LEVs) such as e-scooters and e-bikes. Its flagship PathPilot module is a plug-and-play IoT unit retrofit onto existing fleet vehicles that delivers granular infrastructure distinction (sidewalk, bike lane, crosswalk, street), real-time parking validation, and the ability to control vehicle behavior (speed reduction, throttle disable) based on rider location. The Drover Corral dashboard surfaces real-time compliance insights and validation to operators and cities in line with the MDS 2.0 standard, delivered via API and automated Slack alerts. Partners and customers include Spin, Voi, Bolt, Beam, Dott, and Felyx. Drover AI is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published; integration is handled directly with operators.

providers.name: Dualbird
providers.description: Dualbird is a data and AI infrastructure company building accelerated data processing systems that speed up Apache Spark and Amazon EMR workloads by 10x-30x at 50%-90% lower cost, without code changes or migration. Founded by Gilad Tal (CEO), Ohad Gamliel (Chief Engineer), and Ehud Eliaz (Chief Hardware Architect) - a team with deep ASIC, FPGA, and high-performance computing expertise - Dualbird optimizes enterprise data pipelines at the hardware and software level to remove processing bottlenecks and let organizations maximize data utilization beyond current GPU capabilities. The company raised a $25M round backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Uncork Capital. As of this enrichment pass Dualbird publishes a marketing and company site only - no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or GitHub organization were found.

providers.name: E-Peas
providers.description: e-peas is a Belgian fabless semiconductor company founded in 2014 in Louvain-la-Neuve that designs power management integrated circuits (PMICs) for energy harvesting, enabling battery-free and battery-assisted IoT devices to power themselves from ambient energy. Its flagship Ambient Energy Manager (AEM) family harvests from photovoltaic (light), thermal, vibration/piezoelectric, radio-frequency, and hybrid multi-source inputs, and the company also develops ultra-low-power microcontrollers for autonomous data acquisition. e-peas positions itself as a pioneer of the "Ambient IoT" concept serving smart buildings, industrial IoT, consumer electronics, and wearables, with an ecosystem of 30+ partners including Panasonic, TDK, Vishay, and Silicon Labs. This is a hardware/silicon company that does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: East Meet East
providers.description: East Meet East (now branded EME Hive) is a dating platform built specifically for Asian and Asian American singles across North America, founded by serial entrepreneur Mariko Tokioka. The service matches members using culture-aware criteria and is offered as consumer web and mobile apps. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer dating product it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties (about, mission, blog, help center, terms, and privacy pages).

providers.name: Ebbo
providers.description: Ebbo is an enterprise loyalty and promotional marketing technology company that helps brands build lasting customer relationships and grow revenue through engagement. Its platform powers paid, tiered, and engagement-based loyalty programs alongside promotional overlays such as sweepstakes, instant wins, contests, and user-generated-content campaigns, supported by real-time performance dashboards, purchase validation, and advanced privacy and security controls. Ebbo pairs this technology with full-service program design, creative, program management, data analytics, rewards sourcing, and customer service for brands including T-Mobile, Lowe's, and FULLBEAUTY Brands. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: EDUFI PTE. LTD
providers.description: EduFi (EDUFI PTE. LTD) is a Singapore-incorporated education-financing fintech operating Pakistan's first Study Now, Pay Later (SNPL) digital platform, with expansion into Saudi Arabia and Oman. The Shariah-approved platform lets parents and students finance private schooling, higher education, and international student loans through quick, collateral-free approvals with direct disbursement to educational institutes and convenient monthly installments. EduFi also provides partner educational institutes a free ERP system and subsidized SNPL for their students, and works with financial institutions to fund receivables. Backed by 500 Global. This profile is maintained by API Evangelist; EduFi publishes a consumer marketing and application surface but no public developer/API program.

providers.name: Elevarm
providers.description: Elevarm is an upstream-focused agritech company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Bandung, Indonesia, that elevates smallholder horticulture farmers across West Java, Central Java, and Yogyakarta. It aggregates and supports more than 15,000 farmers with high-quality inputs (premium greenhouse seedlings, bio-based fertilizers, and environmentally friendly pest control via its NextBio line), lab-based soil testing through Klinik Tani, an AI-powered farming productivity app for land monitoring and data-driven agronomy recommendations, pro-farmer financing, and the PasarAgri commodity trading platform that links supply to business buyers. Elevarm is backed by Intudo, Insignia Ventures Partners, and 500 Global.

providers.name: Elo Life
providers.description: Elo Life Systems is a next-generation food and agriculture company based in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, using molecular farming and gene-editing to turn high-yield crops into biofactories for natural food ingredients. Its lead product is a low-calorie, high-potency natural sweetener inspired by monk fruit that is designed to taste like sugar while replacing both sugar and artificial sweeteners at a lower cost. Elo also partners with Dole to develop a fungus-resistant (TR4/Fusarium wilt) Cavendish banana. Backed by DCVC Bio and Novo Holdings, the company raised an oversubscribed $20.5M Series A2 to scale its molecular-farming platform. Elo Life is a food-tech / agricultural-biotech company and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Endeavor Catalyst I
providers.description: Endeavor Catalyst is the rules-based, co-investment fund of Endeavor Global, the nonprofit that supports high-impact entrepreneurs worldwide. The fund invests exclusively in companies led by Endeavor Entrepreneurs across Series A through D+ rounds, recycling proceeds back into Endeavor's mission of building entrepreneurial ecosystems in emerging and underserved markets. Endeavor Catalyst I is the first vintage in this fund family; across all vintages the program manages $540M+ in assets with 405+ active investments spanning 35+ markets, including 71 companies valued at $1B+ and 37 realized exits. This profile tracks the firm as a venture-capital entity in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API.

providers.name: Endovascularengineering
providers.description: Endovascular Engineering is a medical-device company developing minimally invasive thrombectomy technology for the removal of blood clots. Its lead product, the Helo PE Thrombectomy System, targets pulmonary embolism, pairing a small catheter profile with large-bore clot engagement via a self-expanding funnel and dual-action high-speed agitation plus physician-controlled aspiration for single-pass navigation of complex vasculature. The Helo system is investigational only and not commercially available. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. The company publishes a marketing and clinical-overview website but no public developer, API, SDK, or technical-documentation surface.

providers.name: Engrail
providers.description: Engrail Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2019 and focused on precision neuroscience. The company develops innovative, precision-targeted small-molecule therapeutics aimed at the molecular mechanisms and neural circuits underlying nervous system disorders, combining internal discovery with strategic partnerships. Its pipeline includes candidates ENX-102, ENX-104, ENX-203, and ENX-205 for patients with devastating and life-limiting neurological conditions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Enlaza Therapeutics
providers.description: Enlaza Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in La Jolla, California developing first-in-class covalent protein biologics for cancer and other serious diseases. Its proprietary War-Lock technology uses engineered unnatural amino acids to enable protein drugs — including antibody-drug conjugates and T-cell engagers — to bind their disease targets irreversibly, aiming for sustained target occupancy and a prolonged biologic effect with minimal systemic exposure across oncology and immuno-oncology applications. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a corporate website but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Enough
providers.description: ENOUGH (brand name ABUNDA) is a food-technology company that produces mycoprotein through a zero-waste fermentation process, growing fungi on grain-derived sugars. Operating as a B2B ingredient supplier to retailers and food brands, ENOUGH makes nutrient-dense, sustainable meat and seafood alternatives — including burgers, chicken-style products, noodles, and snacks — that use dramatically less water and produce far less CO2 than conventional animal protein. The company operates one of the world's largest mycoprotein fermentation facilities and is backed by DCVC. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; ENOUGH is a food-ingredient business and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Everdrop
providers.description: Everdrop is a Munich-based direct-to-consumer sustainability brand, founded in 2019, that sells more sustainable everyday household products — cleaning tabs, laundry detergent, dishwasher tablets, washing-up liquid and natural body care — designed around a refill model of concentrated tabs/powders dissolved in reusable bottles to cut single-use plastic, unnecessary chemicals and CO2. The company operates an e-commerce storefront (Shopify/Next.js/Storyblok stack) with a subscription-based refill program, and reports certifications including B Corp, EU Ecolabel and Ecocert. It has no public developer or API program; this profile was surfaced as an HV Capital portfolio company and enriched from Everdrop's public web surface.

providers.name: EVERY Company
providers.description: The EVERY Company (formerly Clara Foods; site now at every.com, redirected from theeverycompany.com) is a foodtech ingredients company that produces animal-free, antibiotic-free egg proteins using precision fermentation. Its flagship OvoPro product replicates the functional properties of conventional eggs — binding, gelling, foaming, and whipping — for food manufacturers making baked goods, frozen foods, pasta, and protein bars, offering kosher, halal, and sustainable ingredients with more consistent pricing and availability than animal-derived eggs. Backed by Prosus Ventures. As a B2B ingredient supplier it publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile captures its identity and domain security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Evigence Sensors
providers.description: Evigence Sensors is a freshness-management technology company for the food industry, combining low-cost physical sensors with data analytics to monitor food quality in real time from production to consumption at the individual item level. Its time-temperature indicator technology powers both digital (QR-scan) and visual freshness indicators applied to retail units, serving food brands, retailers, foodservice operators, cold-chain logistics providers, and consumers across the supply chain. Evigence holds 27 granted patents and its indicators meet WHO time/temperature monitoring standards. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Evigence publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its verified public company properties only.

providers.name: Explomar
providers.description: ExploMar (Changshu, China) designs and manufactures high-power fully-electric outboard propulsion systems for boats, ranging from 70HP to 1200HP. Its product line spans lightweight axial-flux electric outboard motors, high-density marine batteries for long-range and wide-temperature operation, the Smart Captain integrated control system with 200+ diagnostic capabilities, and 5S energy/charging stations (7kW portable through 120kW dual-gun). ExploMar markets an eco-friendly, high-performance alternative to combustion marine propulsion and exhibits at international yachting festivals (Cannes, Monaco, Interboot, Polboat). Backed by DCM Ventures; surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. Note: ExploMar is a marine hardware manufacturer and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time — this profile carries identity and web-property signals only.

providers.name: Eyewa
providers.description: Eyewa is an online-first eyewear retailer serving the Middle East, selling prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, clear and colored contact lenses, eyewear accessories, and eye-health vitamins through its e-commerce storefront and a network of 260+ physical stores with click-and-collect. Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, Eyewa operates across the GCC and offers regional payment options such as Tabby, Tamara, and Apple Pay. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Eyewa publishes a consumer storefront, an educational vision-and-eyewear blog, and standard commercial policy pages, but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or documented API surface.

providers.name: FabFitFun
providers.description: FabFitFun is a members-only lifestyle subscription company that delivers curated seasonal boxes of full-size beauty, fashion, wellness, and home products from premium brands, plus a members' community, customization, and weekly flash-sale shopping. Founded in Los Angeles and backed by 500 Global, Bond Capital, and Kleiner Perkins, FabFitFun serves over one million members with seasonal boxes valued up to $350 for as low as $65 per season. The company operates a direct-to-consumer commerce website, a members' account and box-customization experience, a support/help center, and the FabFitFun Magazine content property. As of this profile FabFitFun publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or API reference; this entry captures its public web and legal surface plus a probed domain-security posture, and remains a portfolio-sourced lead for further enrichment.

providers.name: Fairlyne
providers.description: Fairlyne is a French travel-technology company offering a white-label Resale-as-a-Service platform that lets travel brands turn no-shows and low-yield bookings into new revenue by allowing passengers and guests to resell non-refundable tickets and reservations. Founded in 2021 by former Accor executives Gilles de Richemond and Michael d'Eboli, the platform serves airlines, railway and road-transport operators, and hospitality chains, and powers programs such as SNCF Ouigo's resale experience. Fairlyne raised a 3M EUR seed round from Speedinvest, Kima Ventures, Evolem, and FJ Labs. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Fairlyne. No public developer API or documentation portal has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Fibmold
providers.description: Fibmold is an eco-friendly molded-fiber packaging manufacturer building sustainable, plastic-free alternatives to rigid single-use plastic packaging. Its products are thermoformed from natural fibres such as bagasse, bamboo, and hard/soft wood pulp collected from farms, forests, and agro-processing units, then upcycled into compostable and recyclable packaging. Applications span food-service packaging, customised industrial solutions, fibre-based dosing scoops, aviation casseroles, cosmetic inserts, pharma injectable trays, chocolate trays, and noodle cups. Fibmold also runs the Primo by Fibmold retail storefront and builds manufacturing eco-systems and material-science innovation to scale sustainable packaging on the supply side. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Fidor Bank
providers.description: Fidor Bank was a German digital challenger bank founded in Munich in 2009 and an early pioneer of Banking-as-a-Service and open banking through its fidorOS / bankOS middleware platform and public REST API, which covered Customers, Accounts, Transfers, Transactions and Account Information over an OAuth2 authorization-code flow. Fidor was acquired by France's Groupe BPCE in 2016; following years of post-acquisition integration struggles the bank ceased business operations in mid-2023 and entered liquidation. Its developer portal (fidor.com) is now a parked domain and the sandbox and production API hosts are offline. The surviving first-party developer artifacts are the archived official Ruby client (RubyGems: fidor_api, by Fidor Solutions AG) and the github.com/fidor organization. This is a retired provider retained for historical reference.

providers.name: Field AI
providers.description: Field AI is a physical-AI robotics company founded in 2023 and based in Mission Viejo, California, building Field Foundation Models (FFMs) — a class of risk-aware, embodied AI that gives general-purpose robots a single "brain" (marketed as EDGE) that works across many robots, tasks, and unstructured real-world environments. Its Belief World Model reasons under uncertainty and runs entirely on the edge, without pre-built maps, GPS, or pre-programmed paths, integrating vision, LiDAR, and other multimodal sensor data. Field AI has production deployments across three continents and serves construction, urban operations, industrial and energy, federal/government, manufacturing, mining, power and utility, and agriculture, with partnerships including Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA (Omniverse), and Certis. The company is backed by Khosla Ventures. This API Evangelist profile tracks Field AI as a network company; the enrichment pipeline found no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Figure1
providers.description: Figure 1 is a Toronto-based social platform and mobile app for verified healthcare professionals to view, share, and discuss real-world, de-identified patient cases and medical images. Founded in 2013 by Dr. Joshua Landy, Richard Penner, and Gregory Levey, it has grown to more than one million healthcare professionals and one of the world's largest libraries of crowd-sourced medical cases, with trained specialists reviewing and de-identifying each image before publication. Figure 1 also produces the DDx medical podcast and a clinical blog, and in 2024 formed the parent company Formedics with Physician's Weekly to deepen healthcare-professional engagement. It is a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures. Figure 1 is a consumer/professional, mobile-first product with no publicly documented developer API.

providers.name: Finku
providers.description: Finku is an AI-based personal finance management (PFM) mobile app from Indonesia, recognized as the number-one Indonesia PFM app and a Google Play "Best of 2025" selection with more than one million users. It helps people track expenses, set budgets, and build better money habits through manual entry, receipt and bank e-statement scanning, and FinGPT, a chat-based AI financial assistant. The app connects multiple banks and e-wallets, generates real-time interactive dashboards and reports, and runs a freemium model with a Premium tier. Finku is registered with Indonesian regulators OJK, Kominfo, AFTECH, and AFPI, and secures user data with 256-bit AES encryption. Finku is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile originated as a VC-portfolio lead for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Finova Capital
providers.description: Finova Capital is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) licensed by the Reserve Bank of India, founded in 2015 by Mohit Sahney and Sunita Sahney and headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan. It provides secured lending to micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) and self-employed customers across India, including MSME business loans, home loans, working capital and machinery loans, and personal loans, all secured against immovable property. Operating across 17 states through 450+ branches, Finova Capital is backed by investors including Peak XV Partners, Norwest Venture Partners, Faering Capital, Maj Invest, Sofina Ventures, Avataar Ventures and Madison India Capital. The company holds a Certificate of Registration issued by the RBI under Section 45-IA of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934. This is a financial-services provider with a public marketing and investor-relations website; it does not currently expose a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Firefly
providers.description: Firefly Systems Inc. is a data-first moving out-of-home (mOOH) advertising network that turns taxis, rideshare vehicles, and other mobility assets into digital and static advertising surfaces across 15+ major North American markets and several countries. Its network of tens of thousands of GPS-connected screens delivers geo-targeted, contextual, and programmatic digital out-of-home (DOOH) campaigns with advanced tracking, attribution, and measurement. Firefly offers digital and static car tops, full and partial car wraps, in-car TaxiTV, around-car activations, and experiential LED and hologram truck formats, and supports programmatic buying through its VIOOH integration. The company is backed by investors including 500 Global, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), and GV (Google Ventures).

providers.name: Fitetv
providers.description: FITE (fite.tv) is a live sports and entertainment streaming platform that now operates as TrillerTV, run by Flipps Media Inc., a Triller Group Inc company. The service specializes in combat sports and alternative entertainment, streaming boxing, bare-knuckle fighting (BKFC), MMA, kickboxing, professional wrestling, cricket (via the Willow by Cricbuzz channel), soccer, cycling, and motorsports. It advertises thousands of hours of free video, more than a thousand live events per year, and a multi-million-strong fan community, with content delivered through free tiers, the TrillerTV+ subscription, and pay-per-view events across web, mobile, and connected-TV apps. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web surface; no public developer API or documentation program has been located.

providers.name: Flat
providers.description: Flat (now operating as Clau) is a Mexican proptech real-estate marketplace and financial-services platform backed by 500 Global and Anthemis. Clau lets people buy and rent apartments and houses across major Mexican cities including Mexico City, Guadalajara, Monterrey, and Queretaro, and originates mortgage credit (Cofinavit, construction, land-purchase, and liquidity loans). It also offers property valuations, a price-map database, renovation services, and seller listing tools, alongside "El Living", its real-estate education blog. The company is consumer-facing and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile was surfaced from the 500 Global and Anthemis portfolios and enriched with domain-security and identity signals.
