providers.name: FlyFin
providers.description: FlyFin is an AI-powered tax preparation and filing platform for freelancers, self-employed individuals, 1099 contractors, sole proprietorships, LLCs, S-Corps, C-Corps, partnerships, and W-2 employees. It pairs an A.I. deduction scanner that connects to 2,000+ financial institutions through Plaid with a team of certified CPAs who prepare and file federal and state returns. The product suite includes a quarterly tax calculator, a CPA-certified AI tax assistant for unlimited questions, audit insurance with IRS representation, and Excel tax-summary exports. FlyFin operates as a consumer mobile and web application (iOS and Android) and does not publish a public developer API. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Forterra
providers.description: Forterra is a defense autonomy company headquartered in Clarksburg, Maryland, that builds combat-proven autonomous mission systems for ground operations in contested, GPS-denied, off-road environments. Founded in 2002 as Robotic Research and rebranded as Forterra, it retrofits existing military and commercial vehicles with self-driving capability through its AutoDrive autonomous driving system, the TerraLink modular vehicle-management and command-and-control platform, and the OASIS open architecture that lets the government and third-party developers add sensors, effectors, and payloads without vendor lock-in. Additional offerings span resilient communications, sensing, and ruggedized edge-compute hardware. The company is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Enlightenment Capital and supplies autonomy to multiple active U.S. Department of Defense programs. Forterra does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or self-service developer portal; its systems are delivered as government and defense-integration programs.

providers.name: Forum Mobility
providers.description: Forum Mobility develops, owns, and operates zero-emission heavy-duty trucking infrastructure, bundling electric Class 8 truck leases with charging subscriptions for a single monthly price so freight carriers of every size can electrify without upfront capital. The company builds and runs a network of charging depots — anchored by its flagship FM Harbor site at the Port of Long Beach (44 ports, 360KW fast chargers, 9MW capacity) — with additional depots in development across California and Nevada. Forum Mobility was surfaced as a portfolio company of obvious-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a physical-infrastructure operator with no public developer/API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Forward Earth
providers.description: Forward Earth is a Berlin-based climate technology company building AI-automated carbon management software that helps businesses measure, track, and reduce their carbon footprint in line with environmental regulation. Its platform covers Corporate Carbon Footprint (CCF) accounting certified to the GHG Protocol, Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) calculation, and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) compliance reporting, with an emphasis on automating data collection and emissions calculation to save time and cost. Forward Earth also offers a white-label / partner offering that embeds its carbon management capabilities into GRC, ESG, supply-chain, and consultancy software, exposing environmental and partner-specific APIs plus single sign-on through a sandbox that partners access on request. The company is backed by Speedinvest and is moving toward agent-native product carbon footprinting.

providers.name: Four Pillars
providers.description: Four Pillars is a research-driven blockchain enterprise headquartered in Asia, operating through three divisions: FP Research publishes primary analysis of crypto protocols, markets, and policy with deep regional expertise across Korea and the broader Asian market; FP Validated runs validator and node infrastructure across proof-of-stake networks, pairing research with live operations; and FP Institution advises banks, financial institutions, and corporates on blockchain strategy. The firm serves founders, funds, and regulators, and is a portfolio company of Pantera Capital. It is a research and advisory business rather than a developer-facing API platform, and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Fractile
providers.description: Fractile is a UK-based semiconductor startup, founded in 2022 and headquartered in London with an engineering base in Bristol, designing a new class of AI inference processors. Its architecture physically interleaves memory and compute to overcome the memory-bandwidth bottleneck that limits large language model inference, targeting frontier model serving up to 25x faster and at roughly 1/10th the cost of existing hardware. The company takes a full-stack approach spanning transistor-level circuit design through cloud inference server logic, and in May 2026 raised $220M to build the next generation of inference hardware. Backers include Accel and Felicis. Led by founder and CEO Walter Goodwin, Fractile is a hardware/compute company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Freight Farms
providers.description: Freight Farms is a Boston-based vertical farming company that builds the Greenery container farm, a commercial-scale, modular, hydroponic farm assembled inside a shipping container so growers can produce hyper-local produce 365 days a year in any climate. Its Farmhand software platform provides remote farm control, farm data analytics and insights, crop planning, and pre-set growing recipes, backed by certified training, onboarding, logistics, and technical support. The company reports 800+ farms across 50 U.S. states and 3 territories and 2,100+ farmers in 42 countries. Freight Farms currently publishes no public developer API, portal, or OpenAPI surface; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web, brand, and legal properties plus a domain-security probe while a programmatic surface is monitored for.

providers.name: Fuchsia
providers.description: Fuchsia is an AI-native hardware certification and compliance platform ("Vanta for hardware") that helps hardware teams get products to market faster by streamlining regulatory testing and certification. The platform maps the applicable standards for a product (FCC, CE, UL, FDA 510(k), ISO, RF & EMC, environmental, and functional-safety categories), auto-generates the lab-ready technical documentation and test plans required for certification, connects teams with qualified testing labs specialized in their product category, and tracks compliance progress to surface blockers early. Fuchsia uses AI agents to manage the compliance workflow end to end — from design through testing and certification — including direct communication with testing labs, aiming to democratize regulatory compliance that has traditionally favored larger companies with dedicated compliance teams. Founded in 2025 and part of the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch, Fuchsia is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and targets robotics, medical-device, IoT, and consumer-hardware builders. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass Fuchsia publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Fundable
providers.description: Fundable is a software-as-a-service fundraising platform for startups, operated as part of the Startups.com family and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of 500 Global. Fundable helps founders start and manage a professional raise to attract accredited investors, providing a secure investor data room, investor browsing and discovery tools, and email outreach templates across Self-Managed and Funding Accelerator Premium tiers. The platform reports more than $700 million in funding commitments across 20,000+ accredited investors. Fundable is not a registered broker-dealer and does not execute securities transactions or offer investment advice. As of this enrichment pass Fundable publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specification, so this profile captures company identity, published policy/support surfaces, and a probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Fundamental
providers.description: Fundamental (Fundamental Technologies Inc.) is an AI company building foundation models for tabular data and enterprise decision-making. Its flagship product, NEXUS, is a Large Tabular Model pre-trained on billions of real-world enterprise tables that learns which patterns drive which outcomes and delivers predictions with a single line of code. Founded by DeepMind alumni and serial entrepreneurs, the company raised a $255M Series A in February 2026 and is backed by Kindred Ventures. It targets predictive analytics across financial services and other enterprise sectors. Fundamental publishes no public API or developer platform yet, so this profile is an identity record rather than a spec-bearing API.

providers.name: Geek+
providers.description: Geek+ (Geekplus, HKEX: 2590) is a global leader in AI-driven autonomous mobile robot (AMR) solutions for warehouse and logistics automation. Founded in 2015, it delivers end-to-end smart-warehouse systems spanning shelf-to-person (PopPick), tote-to-person (RoboShuttle), pallet-to-person (Skycube) storage and retrieval, robot-arm picking, sorting, and intralogistics transport. Its All-in-One Software Suite (Robot Management System, Warehouse Execution System, Intelligent Warehouse Management System, data and simulation platforms) exposes open REST APIs and SDKs so customers and partners can integrate robot fleets with major WMS, ERP, and MES platforms including SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Manhattan Associates, and Blue Yonder. Geek+ serves 3PL, retail, e-commerce, apparel, grocery, healthcare and pharma, manufacturing, automotive, electronics, and cold-chain logistics across 40+ countries, with 950+ deployed warehouses. In 2025 it became the world's first publicly listed AMR warehouse robotics company on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

providers.name: Gist
providers.description: Gist is an AI brand-visibility and discovery platform built by ProRata (founded 2024) that helps publishers and advertisers stay visible, measurable, and monetizable inside generative AI experiences. It offers three products: Gist GEO (generative engine optimization for consistent organic visibility in AI answers), Gist Ads (paid brand amplification placed directly in AI search surfaces and premium environments), and Gist Answers (an embeddable, publisher-backed AI answer engine for on-site engagement and monetization). Gist positions itself as turning AI from a black box into a measurable, actionable channel for brands and content owners. Surfaced as a Mayfield portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Glimpse
providers.description: Glimpse (legally Dime Campus, Inc.) is an AI-native retail finance platform that automates deductions management, revenue recovery, and cash application for consumer brands and CPG companies. Its AI agents are trained on billions of dollars in retail transactions to track, validate, and dispute invalid deductions, recover trapped cashflow, and match payments faster across retailer accounts. Glimpse reports a 91% dispute win rate, $200M+ in transactions processed, and 100+ hours saved monthly per finance team, and works alongside major retailers including Walmart, Target, Kroger, Walgreens, and Amazon. The San Francisco company serves 200+ consumer brands, raised a $35M Series A, and is backed by 8vc. It is currently an enterprise, contact- sales SaaS with no public self-service API or developer portal.

providers.name: Glydways
providers.description: Glydways is an autonomous urban-transit company building on-demand, high-capacity mobility networks that combine small self-driving electric vehicles (Glydcars), an AI fleet-orchestration layer, and dedicated narrow guideways separated from regular road traffic. The system is designed to move up to 10,000 people per hour while cutting construction cost by roughly 90% and operating cost to about 30% of conventional transit, with launch projects underway in Atlanta, Contra Costa County, California, and at San Jose Airport. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Glydways was surfaced through the venture portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network. As an autonomous-transit infrastructure company it publishes a corporate and news presence but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: GNC Holdings
providers.description: GNC Holdings, LLC (General Nutrition Centers) is an American specialty retailer of health, wellness, and performance products including vitamins, minerals, herbal supplements, sports nutrition, diet, and energy products. Founded in 1935 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, GNC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Harbin Pharmaceutical Group following its 2020 acquisition. The company operates owned and franchised retail locations, online stores, and retail partnerships across approximately 50 countries.

providers.name: GoOpti
providers.description: GoOpti is a European ground-transportation marketplace for affordable airport transfers and intercity rides, connecting travelers with a network of vetted, contractual transport partners. Founded in Slovenia, GoOpti offers both shared (door-to-door pooled) and private transfers across Central and Southern Europe, using dynamic pricing where earlier, more flexible bookings earn lower fares. The company operates as a platform intermediary rather than a fleet owner, and has served more than two million passengers. Alongside its consumer booking site it runs B2B partner programs for agencies and resellers, corporate business accounts, franchising, and affiliates. GoOpti is a portfolio company of Point Nine and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, SDK, or agent-facing surface has been identified at this time.

providers.name: GoStudent
providers.description: GoStudent is an online tutoring platform headquartered in Vienna, Austria, offering personalized one-on-one lessons across 30+ subjects for K-12 and university students. Founded in 2016, it matches learners with vetted tutors and delivers lessons through its own video-classroom apps for iOS, Android, and web, sold as a monthly subscription. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and Speedinvest, GoStudent grew into one of Europe's largest edtech companies and has acquired peers including Tus Media, Seneca Learning, and Studienkreis. GoStudent does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web properties and domain-security posture as a network lead.

providers.name: Gourmey
providers.description: Gourmey is a Paris-based cultivated meat company producing sustainable, cell-cultured meat delights — starting with cultivated foie gras — for an uncompromising and conscious generation. Founded in France and backed by Partech and Point Nine, Gourmey grows real meat directly from animal cells without raising or slaughtering animals, aiming for a lower environmental footprint across the food and agritech sectors. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company profile; Gourmey operates a consumer and corporate website but does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Greg
providers.description: Greg is a consumer mobile application for plant identification and care, available on iOS and Android. Users photograph a plant to identify it in seconds and receive smart, personalized care guidance — watering schedules, light and soil recommendations, and reminders — alongside a community of plant enthusiasts, care articles, and a plant directory. Greg is an Index Ventures portfolio company in the AI/ML space, applying computer-vision plant recognition. It is a consumer app and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Guild Education
providers.description: Guild is an education benefits platform that helps large employers turn workforce education into workforce strategy. Guild connects a company's frontline and hourly workers to a curated marketplace of debt-free education, upskilling, and career-development programs delivered through vetted learning partners (universities, bootcamps, and skilling providers), and pairs that access with coaching and analytics so HR leaders can fill critical roles, improve retention, increase internal mobility, and prove measurable ROI. Guild operates as a B2B2C platform: employers fund and administer the benefit, learning partners supply the programs, and members (employees) enroll and progress toward degrees, certificates, and new durable skills. Guild does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public company and web-property surface.

providers.name: Habi
providers.description: Habi is a Colombian real estate technology company (proptech) that operates as a direct home buyer and seller — an iBuyer model where Habi itself purchases apartments in cash, typically within 10 days, rather than acting as a traditional agency. It operates across Bogota, Medellin, Cali, Barranquilla and 20+ Colombian cities and is expanding into Mexico. Products include Habimetro (an online property valuation simulator), property listings and search, Habi Credit (mortgage financing), Habi Inmobiliaria (assisted longer-term sales), and an allied-agent partner network. The company reports 40,000+ families served, 4,000+ allied real estate agents, and 550+ real estate experts. Backed by Homebrew. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from Habi's public surface; the company publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: HAKEEM HOLDING LTD
providers.description: Hakeem X Technologies (HAKEEM HOLDING LTD) is a UAE-based healthcare technology company delivering AI-powered clinical decision support and medical education to hospitals, universities, and healthcare professionals across the UAE and KSA. Its flagship HakeemDx assistant turns medical research into instant, evidence-based answers at the point of care for physicians and pharmacists, alongside licensed clinical reference suites (Micromedex, EBSCO DynaMed, Isabel, GIDEON), medication-adherence and virtual pharmacy tooling, and medical/nursing education platforms (Lecturio, Healer case simulations, Simtics). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, SDK, or portal is published at this time.

providers.name: HelperGo
providers.description: HelperGo is a Hong Kong-based on-demand home services marketplace that connects households with more than 5,000 vetted local helpers for domestic cleaning, air-conditioning and window cleaning, cooking, childcare and babysitting, postnatal doula and confinement care, elderly and nursing care, and medical escort services. Customers book through the HelperGo iOS and Android apps or the website, with instant helper matching, ratings and reviews, and a satisfaction guarantee. HelperGo is a portfolio company of 500 Global and operates across Hong Kong and Singapore. The company is a consumer-facing service marketplace and publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: HER
providers.description: HER is a dating and community platform built exclusively for queer women, non-binary, and trans people, with more than 15 million users across 125+ countries. The app pairs sapphic dating with community spaces, events, and richly customizable profiles (pronouns, gender identity, sexual orientation, and Pride Pins). Core features are free, with optional HER Premium tiers. HER was surfaced as a portfolio company of Initialized Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a consumer mobile application and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: HomeFirst
providers.description: HomeFirst (Home First Finance Company India Limited) is an affordable-housing finance company headquartered in Mumbai, India, that provides home loans, self-construction and resale loans, loans against property, shop loans, and renovation/top-up loans to first-time and lower- to middle-income home buyers across India, marketing itself as "India's Home Loan Expert" with approval within 48 hours. It is a technology-led lender operating consumer-facing customer and connector portals and mobile apps, and is a publicly listed company backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. It was surfaced as a Bessemer portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts at this time, so this profile captures its public web/identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Honeylove
providers.description: Honeylove Sculptwear Inc. is a Los Angeles-based, venture-backed direct-to-consumer apparel brand founded in 2018 that designs and sells shapewear, bras, bodysuits, leggings, and intimates engineered with targeted "smart compression" panels that support the body without over-squeezing. Sold primarily through its Shopify-powered online store at honeylove.com, the company has grown to millions of customers, was named to the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Y Combinator. Honeylove operates as a consumer e-commerce retailer and does not currently publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its public web, policy, and support surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hopscotch
providers.description: Hopscotch Primary Care is a value-based healthcare provider bringing relationship-based primary care to rural communities, with a focus on seniors on Medicare and Medicare/Medicaid plans. Operating clinics across Western North Carolina and beyond, Hopscotch pairs longer appointments and multidisciplinary care teams with same-day access and help navigating insurance. Backed by 8VC, CVS Health Ventures, K2 HealthVentures, Town Hall Ventures and others, it is a patient-facing care company with no public developer API surface; patient records are handled through an athenahealth portal.

providers.name: HouseEazy
providers.description: HouseEazy is an Indian proptech startup, founded in 2021 by Tarun Sainani and Deepak Bhatia, that runs a full-stack platform for buying and selling ready-to-move, pre-owned residential homes across the Delhi NCR region (Noida, Ghaziabad, and Gurugram). It uses an AI/ML-based pricing algorithm built on over two million on-ground data points — registry records, market trends, and recent transactions — to price properties instantly, then pairs that with 3D walkthroughs, drone imagery, and virtual staging to make resale transactions fast, transparent, and secure. HouseEazy also offers LoanEazy home financing and a channel-partner program, and is backed by Accel, Antler, and DTU-IIF. It is a consumer-facing web application and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal.

providers.name: Hutch Games
providers.description: Hutch Games (Hutch) is a mobile game development studio founded in London with additional studios in Dundee, Scotland and Nova Scotia, Canada. Hutch specializes in free-to-play mobile driving and car games, developing and publishing titles including F1 Clash, Top Drives, and Matchcreek Motors. The studio was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer mobile game publisher, Hutch does not currently expose a public developer API or developer program; this profile captures the company identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Iconbuild
providers.description: ICON Technology, Inc. (iconbuild.com) is an Austin, Texas construction technologies company using large-scale robotics, advanced materials, and software to build homes and structures. ICON develops the Vulcan and Phoenix 3D-printing robots, proprietary Lavacrete and CarbonX building materials, and design/build tooling (including its CODEX architectural catalog and ICON Prime), and has printed communities across the US as well as researched off-world construction with NASA (Project Olympus). Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. This is a physical construction / building-technology company; as of this pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface, so no API artifacts were harvested.

providers.name: IKF Finance
providers.description: IKF Finance Limited is an India-based non-banking financial company (NBFC) that has provided asset financing for more than 35 years through a network of 300+ branches pan-India, serving over one lakh customers. Its lending products include commercial vehicle loans, construction equipment loans, tractor loans, car and MUV loans, and MSME and business loans, with home loans offered through the affiliated IKF Home Finance entity. Operating under the tagline "Powering Progress with Prompt Financing," the company focuses on prompt, accessible credit for transport operators, small businesses, and individuals across India. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio lead and enriched with public identity, legal, and domain-security signals; IKF Finance publishes no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: iMile
providers.description: iMile is a technology-driven last-mile delivery and e-commerce logistics company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Led by founder and CEO Rita Huang, iMile provides express parcel delivery, cash-on-delivery (COD), domestic and international express, dropshipping, order fulfillment, warehousing, storage, and reverse logistics / return management across more than 30 countries spanning the Middle East, China, Latin America, Africa, Europe, and Australia. The company operates its own routing, tracking, and delivery technology and employs over 20,000 people. iMile assigns each shipment a 13-digit tracking number; parcel tracking is available on imile.com and through major third-party tracking aggregators. iMile does not currently publish a first-party public developer API or open platform, so this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Improovy
providers.description: Improovy is a Chicago-based prop-tech startup and digitally-native managed marketplace that connects homeowners with vetted, professional painters and controls the end-to-end residential and commercial painting experience. Founded in 2019 by CEO Andre Kazimierski, a third-generation tradesman, the platform offers instant online quotes and covers interior and exterior house painting, cabinet painting, drywall and plaster repair, staining, power washing, and specialty finishes across markets in Illinois, Michigan, Colorado, Florida, and Wisconsin. Improovy is a consumer service brand with no public developer program or API; this profile captures its web presence and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: In Focus Systems
providers.description: In Focus Systems, Inc. (later InFocus Corporation, and today marketed as InFocus) is an audiovisual technology company founded in 1986 in Oregon by Steve Hix and Paul Gulick, both formerly of Tektronix. The company pioneered LCD projection panels and is credited with inventing the digital projector, going public on NASDAQ (ticker INFS) in December 1990. It grew into a leading maker of DLP and LCD projectors, interactive flat-panel displays, DVLED video walls, and collaboration hardware for business, education, installation, and home markets. In Focus Systems was an early Battery Ventures investment (since exited). The InFocus business was acquired by Image Holdings Corp. in 2009 and operates today as a privately held subsidiary headquartered in the Portland, Oregon area. It is a hardware and audiovisual solutions company and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal.

providers.name: INGU
providers.description: INGU is a pipeline integrity technology company delivering inline inspection for oil & gas and water/wastewater pipelines through its Pipers multi-sensor free-floating inspection system paired with AI analytics and GIS-based pipeline viewer software. The platform performs leak detection, deposit and wall-condition assessment, and detection of gas pockets, magnetic features, bends, and hot taps across pipelines of any diameter or material. INGU has inspected over 900 pipelines for operators including Chevron, Shell, TotalEnergies, SUEZ, and Vale. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; the company publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Iris.ai
providers.description: Iris.ai is a Norwegian AI company providing an AI knowledge foundation for regulated enterprises, turning complex enterprise and scientific data into trustworthy, compliant AI. Its platform spans three products — Axion (data organization for AI-ready intelligence), Neuralith (enterprise knowledge integration into AI engines), and RSpace, the Researcher Workspace that lets R&D teams, librarians, and academics search, filter, analyze, extract, summarize, and report across scientific literature. Iris.ai is backed by 500 Global. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture pending any future developer surface.

providers.name: Jackpocket
providers.description: Jackpocket is a third-party lottery courier and mobile app that lets users in supported US states order official state lottery tickets — Powerball, Mega Millions, and regional draw games — from their phone, with the physical tickets stored securely on their behalf and winnings paid out through the app. Founded in 2013 in New York City by Peter Sullivan, the company was acquired by DraftKings in 2024. Jackpocket is a consumer-facing gaming/lottery brand; it does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook surface. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a network entity with its public web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Jago Coffee
providers.description: Jago Coffee is an Indonesian mobile coffee company operating a fleet of electric-vehicle coffee carts ("Jagoans") that bring freshly brewed specialty coffee, tea, and seasonal drinks directly to neighborhoods across Indonesia. Billing itself as the "#1 Cafe on Wheels," Jago lets customers order through its mobile app with no delivery fees or order minimums, paying with GoPay or OVO digital wallets, using Arabica beans sourced directly from local Indonesian farmers. Backed by 500 Global, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a consumer coffee-delivery business; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK.

providers.name: Jellysmack
providers.description: Jellysmack is a content amplification and creator-growth platform that helps digital creators expand their audiences and earnings across multiple social platforms (YouTube, Facebook, Snapchat, TikTok, Instagram) using AI-driven optimization, first-party data, and multi-platform distribution expertise. Its offerings span the Creator Program (audience growth and monetization for 500+ creator partners), Jellysmack Originals (owned beauty, sports, gaming, and entertainment channels), media licensing, and brand partnerships. The company reports 10B+ monthly video views and 125M+ monthly U.S. unique viewers. It is a consumer/creator-facing media technology company and does not publish a public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio intelligence.

providers.name: Jiobit
providers.description: Jiobit is a real-time GPS tracking device company owned by Life360, based in San Mateo, California. Its lightweight (18g) wearable tracker is designed for kids, pets, seniors, and adults, combining LPWA CatM1 cellular, GPS, WiFi, and BLE for location accuracy of 1-50 feet, up to 30 days of battery life, geofence and SOS/911 emergency alerts, and tamper-proof, government-level encryption. Jiobit is a consumer hardware and mobile-app product sold direct-to-consumer with a monthly connectivity subscription; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: K4Connect
providers.description: K4Connect is a Morrisville, North Carolina technology company serving the senior living industry, backed by Sierra Ventures. Its patented FusionOS integration and data platform provides two-way ("One-to-Many") interoperability that shares the who, what and when of a community between every integrated system, connecting 50+ leading applications, devices and services. On top of FusionOS sits K4Community, an enterprise engagement suite of interconnected modules: Team Hub for staff, the Plus App for residents, Voice (Amazon Alexa), K4TV infotainment, Digital Signage, and smart-home Resident Check-In. K4Connect operates a partner-led integration model rather than a public self-serve developer API; integrations are built and coordinated through FusionOS.

providers.name: Kabam
providers.description: Kabam is a mobile game developer and publisher founded in 2006 and headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of Netmarble. The studio builds free-to-play multiplayer titles for iOS and Android, best known for Marvel Contest of Champions, alongside Shop Titans, Transformers Forged to Fight, King Arthur Legends, and past titles such as Disney Mirrorverse and Fast & Furious games. Kabam operates studios and offices across Vancouver, Montreal, Charlottetown, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Austin, and Seoul. Kabam publishes no public developer program, API reference, or SDK surface; this profile captures its public web, legal, and support properties plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Kandou
providers.description: Kandou (Kandou AI) is a fabless semiconductor company founded in 2011 by Amin Shokrollahi and headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland. It designs high-speed, energy-efficient chip-to-chip interconnect technology built on its proprietary Copper MIMO / Chord Signaling architecture, which turns noise in copper channels into usable bandwidth for massively scalable AI systems. Products include the Glasswing chiplet interconnect IP, the Regli PCIe retimer, the Matterhorn USB4 retimer, the Zetti PCIe switch, and AI Fabric memory/networking platforms. Chord signaling has been adopted into JEDEC and OIF industry specifications. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners across multiple rounds, Kandou raised a $225M round in March 2026 led by Maverick Silicon with strategic participation from SoftBank, Synopsys, Cadence, and Alchip. This is a hardware/semiconductor IP company with no public REST/GraphQL API, SDK, or developer platform surface.

providers.name: Kango
providers.description: Kango is an on-demand rides and childcare platform for families, connecting parents and schools with background-checked, fingerprinted drivers and sitters who transport and care for children from preschool through high school. Operated by Dolightful, Inc. and backed by 500 Global, Kango offers prescheduled and same-day rides, real-time ride tracking, in-app communication with drivers, provided car and booster seats, in-home sitter sessions, and a free carpool feature promoted by schools and camps. It runs on iOS and Android apps using a subscription plus per-ride and per-session fee model. Kango is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Kardome Technology
providers.description: Kardome develops Voice AI technology that lets voice-integrated products hear and understand speech with human-level accuracy in complex, real-world acoustic environments. Its two core technologies are Spatial Hearing AI, which understands the acoustic scene to localize sound sources and attribute speech to the correct speaker, and Cognition AI, which adds contextual awareness so devices understand what people mean in the moment. Kardome targets automotive in-car voice UI and smart-home voice interaction in noisy environments. The company is a Techstars portfolio company, tracked in the API Evangelist network; it licenses embedded voice technology to device makers rather than publishing a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Karma Science
providers.description: Karma (Karma Science, karmanow.com) is a consumer shopping-assistant platform delivered as a browser extension and mobile app that helps people shop smarter. Founded in 2015, it serves roughly 6.5 million users with automatic coupon finding at checkout, price-drop and back-in-stock tracking, cross-retailer wishlists, and cash-back rewards across major merchants including Amazon, Apple, Nike, Target, and Nordstrom. The company also offers an Embedded Loyalty and partnerships program for retailers. Karma is a Kleiner Perkins-backed consumer company; as surfaced through the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline it publishes consumer product surfaces (apps, help center, blog) but no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Kasa
providers.description: Kasa is a tech-enabled hospitality company operating a curated collection of furnished apartments and boutique hotels across dozens of U.S. cities. Its asset-light model partners with multifamily property owners and hotel operators to run flexible short-term, extended-stay, and corporate accommodations, layering a proprietary technology platform on top for contactless check-in, a virtual front desk, remote guest support, and unit operations. Kasa also serves corporate housing and corporate travel programs. Backed by Ribbit Capital, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a proptech/hospitality provider; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: KeyMe
providers.description: KeyMe is a nationwide locksmith and key-duplication company that pairs mobile locksmith technicians with a network of self-service key-copying kiosks located inside thousands of retail stores across the United States. Customers can copy residential, commercial, and automotive keys, RFID fobs and access cards at a kiosk, order duplicates online, or request 24/7 mobile locksmith help for home, auto, and business lockouts, transponder and ignition key programming, lock installation, re-keying, and access-control and master-key systems. KeyMe is backed by Battery Ventures. As of this profile the company operates as a consumer-facing locksmith and kiosk service and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this record captures its public web identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kindred Healthcare
providers.description: Kindred Healthcare operated a nationwide network of long-term acute care hospitals and inpatient rehabilitation facilities. The Kindred name was retired after the 2021 merger with LifePoint Health, with the acute care facilities operating under the ScionHealth brand and rehabilitation facilities continuing as Kindred Hospital Rehabilitation Services. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified for the legacy Kindred Healthcare or its successor entities.

providers.name: Klaimee
providers.description: Klaimee is a Y Combinator (Spring/P26 batch) startup building certification, financial guarantee, and liability insurance for AI agents running in production. The company evaluates an autonomous agent across risk dimensions such as scope, data exfiltration, unauthorized action, output integrity, adversarial manipulation, behavioral stability, model drift, and operational control, then issues a letter-graded certification report with remediation guidance and a Klaimee-Verified badge that AI vendors use to clear enterprise procurement. Certified agents are backed by a financial guarantee and by AI liability insurance priced against the certification score, covering the gap that traditional errors-and-omissions and cyber policies explicitly exclude — hallucinated outputs, unauthorized actions, data exposure, prompt injection, and wrongful commitments. Klaimee also runs a public adversarial-testing playground where teams can stress-test an agent with probes for prompt injection, jailbreak, decision drift, data leakage, and biased outputs. Klaimee currently sells a human-delivered certification and underwriting service; it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation as of this enrichment pass. Founded in 2026 by Ines Boutemadja (CEO) and Julien Catonnet (CTO), based in San Francisco.

providers.name: Kony
providers.description: Kony was a U.S. digital banking and low-code application platform company, best known for the Kony Quantum multiexperience development platform and the Kony DBX digital banking suite. Temenos acquired Kony and folded the digital banking business into Temenos Infinity and the Quantum platform into Temenos Quantum; non-banking Kony Quantum customers were transitioned to HCL Volt MX, managed by HCL Software. Kony no longer operates an independent developer program or public API. The kony.com apex and www hosts now redirect to the Temenos "Kony is now Temenos" announcement, docs.kony.com resolves to the Temenos Base Camp Quantum documentation, and only the authenticated Quantum Fabric Console at manage.kony.com is still served on the Kony domain. This profile is retained as an acquisition record pointing at its successors rather than as a live API provider.

providers.name: Kuda
providers.description: Kuda is a Nigerian digital-first retail bank — branded "the money app for Africans" and "the bank of the free" — founded in 2019 by Babs Ogundeyi and Musty Mustapha and headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria with operations in the United Kingdom. Kuda's Nigerian entity, Kuda Microfinance Bank, holds a national microfinance bank license from the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), and Kuda EMI Limited operates as an FCA-authorised electronic money institution in the UK. Kuda offers retail banking accounts with zero or low fees, debit cards, instant transfers, bill payments, savings ("Spend+Save"), investments, overdrafts, and personal loans through its iOS, Android, and web apps, plus a Business banking suite covering expense accounts and cards, payroll, invoicing, softPOS and physical POS terminals, business loans, and CAC business registration. Kuda also exposes an Open API ("Kuda Open API") aimed at fintechs, marketplaces, and businesses that want to embed Nigerian banking primitives — virtual accounts, name enquiry, intra- and inter-bank transfers, balance inquiry, transaction history, bill payments, and disbursements — directly into their own products, with sandbox and live environments, RSA-encrypted request payloads, and client libraries for Node.js, PHP, C#, Rust, and Kotlin hosted under the kudabank GitHub organization.

providers.name: LawnStarter
providers.description: LawnStarter is an on-demand lawn care and outdoor-services marketplace founded in 2013 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, that connects homeowners with vetted local lawn care professionals ("LawnTrepreneurs"). Beyond recurring lawn mowing, the platform books more than 30 services including landscaping, lawn treatments and fertilization, tree care, gutter cleaning, pressure washing, and leaf removal, with transparent online quoting, consistent crews, and a re-mow-or-refund quality guarantee. LawnStarter operates across 500+ cities, has served more than 500,000 customers through roughly 7,500 professionals, and reached profitability in 2021. LawnStarter runs a consumer web/mobile marketplace and a separate provider app (pros.lawnstarter.com); it does not publish a public developer platform, API, or SDKs.

providers.name: Little Freddie
providers.description: Little Freddie (Sunny Fields Enterprise Ltd) is a UK-based organic baby and toddler food brand producing nutritious weaning products for infants from six months, developed with a paediatric dietitian to meet UK and EU baby-food guidelines. Its ranges include Greek-style yoghurts, Simply Fruit purees, Full of Veg meals, dairy-free alternatives, home-style meals and omega-3 "Good for Brains" options, sold through major UK retailers including Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda, Morrisons, Co-op, Ocado, Booths and Spar. The company also runs a Parenting Hub with weaning, nutrition and parenting content. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hillhouse; this profile currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Lollipuff
providers.description: Lollipuff is a luxury goods authentication service that has been authenticating high-end designer apparel and accessories professionally since 2010. Led by CEO Fei Deyle, the company uses a patent-pending process combining human expert authenticators with software to determine the authenticity of pre-owned designer items from submitted photographs, issuing an online certificate with a unique, shareable URL that owners can post alongside listings on sites like eBay. Lollipuff (YC W13) originally operated as a peer-to-peer online auction marketplace that pre-screened every listing for authenticity; the marketplace closed in 2020 as payment-processor fee structures changed, and the company now focuses on its photo-based authentication and certificate-lookup service, which many consignment and resale businesses rely on for their most challenging authentications. It is a consumer-facing web service with no publicly documented developer API.

providers.name: Lovevery
providers.description: Lovevery is a direct-to-consumer children's brand that designs stage-based Play Kits, books, and learning products for infants and toddlers, grounded in child-development research. It operates a Shopify-backed e-commerce and subscription storefront at lovevery.com with a customer help center, blog, and careers site. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network, Lovevery publishes no public developer/API surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

providers.name: ltztherapeutics
providers.description: LTZ Therapeutics is a clinical-stage immunotherapy biotechnology company developing novel myeloid engager therapeutics for cancer treatment. Its platform focuses on the direct engagement of myeloid cells with target cells to boost anti-tumor immunity, with lead candidate LTZ-232 receiving FDA IND clearance in July 2026 for advanced metastatic colorectal cancer and other solid tumors. The company operates from Redwood City, USA and Shenzhen, China. It is a portfolio company of Qiming and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; it publishes no developer API surface.

providers.name: Lucky Cart
providers.description: Lucky Cart is a French MarTech company specializing in retail media and smart commerce for grocery and consumer-goods retailers. It combines first-party transactional data with e-retail media, machine learning, and AI to power personalized shopper engagement, gamified promotions, and the monetization of retailer audiences at scale. Lucky Cart works with major French grocery retailers and CPG brands to activate transactional data into targeted advertising, loyalty, and measurable campaigns. The company publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Lumeris
providers.description: Lumeris is a physician-founded healthcare technology company delivering AI-powered primary care transformation through Tom, its Primary Care as a Service platform. Founded more than fifteen years ago, Lumeris helps physicians, health systems, and payers operate value-based care by reducing physician administrative burden, coordinating proactive patient experiences, and scaling care efficiently. The company serves over 1.4M lives across commercial, Medicare Advantage, multi-payer ACO, and Medicaid arrangements, and reports more than $90B in claims ingested. Lumeris is headquartered in the United States with its Tomorrow Labs innovation group in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Lumeris was surfaced as a portfolio company of Kleiner Perkins. No public developer portal, API documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Marlin Equity Partners
providers.description: Marlin Equity Partners (marlinequity.com) is a global investment firm founded in 2005 and headquartered in Hermosa Beach, California, with an additional office in London. The firm acquires and builds software and technology businesses, partnering with management teams to create strategic value through operational support, organic growth, and add-on acquisitions, with particular focus on financial technology and e-commerce segments. Its portfolio has included companies such as Bazaarvoice, Medius, StarCompliance, Exegy, and Learning Pool. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-network lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; as a private equity investor rather than a technology service provider, Marlin publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Marshall
providers.description: Marshall is a Swedish-British consumer audio brand, part of Marshall Group AB, known for its iconic guitar amplifiers and a modern line of Bluetooth speakers, wireless headphones, and earbuds. Built on more than 60 years of live-music heritage, Marshall sells direct-to-consumer through marshall.com across amps, home and portable speakers, and personal audio. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer portfolio company of HongShan. Marshall publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Martie
providers.description: Martie is a woman-owned, San Francisco-based online discount grocery marketplace founded in 2021 to fight food waste and make quality goods accessible and affordable. Martie works directly with brands on their overstock, surplus, seasonal, and old-packaging inventory — pantry staples, beauty, and household goods — and resells it to consumers at up to 80% off retail with no membership or subscription required. Shoppers browse daily deals through the martie.com website or the Martie iOS and Android apps. The company reports having diverted over five million pounds of food from landfill since launch. Martie is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand (a Shopify-hosted storefront) and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or documentation surface; this profile was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and enriched with company identity plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Mast Reforestation
providers.description: Mast Reforestation (formerly DroneSeed) is North America's leading post-fire reforestation and carbon-removal company, restoring wildfire-damaged forests across the American West. It operates two nurseries, Cal Forest Nurseries and Silvaseed, manages the largest seed bank in the western United States, grows more than 30 million seedlings annually, and develops carbon-removal credits by burying post-wildfire biomass to finance reforestation for landowners and consulting foresters. Mast publishes no public developer program or API surface.

providers.name: Mate Security
providers.description: Mate Security operates an AI-powered Security Operations Center (SOC) platform built on a "Security Context Graph." It learns an organization's unique security environment, tools, and procedures within 24 hours of integration, then runs a continuous detection and response (CD/CR) framework: AI agents automatically investigate, triage, and respond to alerts using organizational context, generate new detections from closed investigations, and support human-in-the-loop threat hunting across disparate security tools and data sources. Mate Security is backed by Insight Partners. No public API, SDK, or developer documentation is published at this time; this profile captures the company's identity and security posture.

providers.name: Medivis
providers.description: Medivis is a medical technology company building AI-powered augmented reality solutions for surgery and medical education. Its flagship product, SurgicalAR, is an FDA 510(k)-cleared platform that runs on Microsoft HoloLens 2 and transforms 2D medical imaging (CT and MRI) into interactive 3D holographic visualizations for surgical planning and navigation, including FDA-cleared systems for spine and cranial procedures. Medivis also offers AnatomyX, an AR platform for anatomy and medical education. The company reports deployment across 40+ institutions and use in 2,000+ surgeries. Medivis is a Microsoft technology partner and a portfolio company of Initialized Capital. Medivis publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; its software surface is delivered as HoloLens and iOS applications for clinical and educational users.

providers.name: Mejuri
providers.description: Mejuri is a direct-to-consumer fine jewelry brand founded in Toronto that designs and sells everyday fine jewelry — rings, earrings, necklaces and bracelets — direct to consumers through its e-commerce site, mobile app, and a growing network of retail stores across North America, Australia, and the United Kingdom. The company also runs the Mejuri+ membership program, offers in-store ear piercing services, and hosts community events. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, this profile has been through the enrichment pipeline: Mejuri operates a consumer-facing commerce experience and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Mentor Collective
providers.description: Mentor Collective operates an AI Mentorship OS for higher education, powering peer mentoring, student success, and retention programs at colleges and universities. Its platform matches and onboards mentors and mentees, guides conversations with AI prompts, surfaces risk signals and belonging gaps, and turns connection data into real-time retention intelligence for institutions. Backed by Techstars, the company serves higher-education and workforce partners. As of this profile Mentor Collective publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications; this repo captures its public web, blog, legal, and domain-security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Meragi
providers.description: Meragi is an Indian wedding planning and execution platform for city and destination weddings, offering a plug-and-play alternative to bare-shell venues. It coordinates venue discovery, decor design (10,000+ options), catering, photography, vendor management, and multi-event logistics across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Goa, Delhi NCR, Jaipur, and Udaipur. Backed by Accel, the company runs a consumer-facing web presence with no public developer, API, or integration surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Metro Africa Xpress
providers.description: Metro Africa Xpress (MAX), operating as maxdrive.ai, is a Nigerian technology-driven mobility company on a mission to make transportation safe, affordable, accessible and sustainable across Africa. MAX finances and deploys vehicles — including electric two- and three-wheelers — to a vetted network of driver-partners ("champions"), and runs a drivers services platform, electric-vehicle assembly and charging infrastructure, enterprise last-mile logistics, and mobility gov-tech solutions. Emerging from the MIT and Techstars ecosystem, MAX is backed by Novastar Ventures, Goodwell, Shell Foundation, Breakthrough Energy, Capria and Yamaha, and operates across Nigeria, Cameroon and other West African markets. The company publishes a marketing and corporate website only; no public developer program, API, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Mochacare
providers.description: MochaCare is an AI-powered operations platform for home care agencies and care facilities, combining human virtual assistants with AI agents to run hiring, scheduling, and client-intake operations end-to-end. The company offers two products: Mocha Managed, a 24/7 managed service where its team handles hiring and scheduling, and Mocha Tools, an AI software platform featuring an applicant tracking system, automated shift scheduling, shift-coverage management, document collection, and growth analytics. MochaCare builds custom integrations with existing care-agency systems (WellSky, AxisCare, AlayaCare), plus hiring and communication tools (Indeed, RingCentral), but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. A Y Combinator portfolio company founded by Nick Walker and Pranav Uppiliappan.

providers.name: Moj.io
providers.description: Mojio (moj.io) is a connected-car and connected-mobility platform that collects, processes, and monetizes vehicle telematics data at scale for mobile network operators, automotive OEMs, insurers, and fleet/field-service businesses. Its "Mobility Studio" platform exposes REST endpoints for vehicle data, a PUSH API for real-time insights, mobile SDKs, and a vehicle simulator, alongside a white-label consumer app (Motion) and a services ecosystem (Alexa, Google Maps, Bosch, and others). Mojio has processed 15+ billion miles of driving data. As of this pass the API and SDK surface is partner-gated — there is no public developer portal, published OpenAPI specification, or self-serve API documentation. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Momox
providers.description: momox SE (formerly Momox AG / Momox GmbH) is a Berlin-based re-commerce company founded by Christian Wegner in 2004 — the name stands for "Moderner Medien Online Express-Ankauf" (Modern Media Online Express Purchase). Through momox.de it buys used books, CDs, DVDs/Blu-rays and games from private sellers at fixed prices in Germany, Austria, France, Belgium and the UK, reselling them via its Medimops shop and third-party marketplaces. Its momox fashion arm (formerly ubup.com, momoxfashion.com) does the same for second-hand clothing, shoes and accessories. momox runs large logistics centres in Berlin, Leipzig and Neuenhagen bei Berlin and has handled more than 350 million articles since founding. momox is a consumer-facing re-commerce operation; it publishes no official public developer program, API portal, or SDKs. The only machine surface is an internal, undocumented mobile-app pricing endpoint (api.momox.de / api.momox.fr) that is not offered as a first-party API.

providers.name: Moonscale
providers.description: Moonscale is an AI sales advisor platform that automates top-of-funnel sales conversations and lead qualification with AI-powered sales avatars. Its avatars pitch products, qualify inbound buyers, handle objections, book meetings, and follow up around the clock across websites, landing pages, emails, and apps, with support for 130+ languages and CRM connections to Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Slack, and Clay. Moonscale markets a no-code, "no dev work required" deployment and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface. Backed by EQT Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company profile.

providers.name: Movandi
providers.description: Movandi is an RF semiconductor company founded by former Broadcom executives (CEO Maryam Rofougaran and CTO Reza Rofougaran) that designs 5G mmWave chipsets, RF front ends, phased-array antenna modules, 5G smart repeaters, and beamforming software for terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks. Based in Irvine, California and backed by Sierra Ventures, the company holds 130+ patents covering millimeter wave semiconductor, system, and software technologies spanning 5G, fixed wireless, and satellite connectivity. Movandi is a hardware/semiconductor vendor and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface.

providers.name: nabfly
providers.description: nabfly, Inc., doing business as Bespoke Post, is a New York City-based direct-to-consumer e-commerce and subscription retailer founded in 2011 and backed by 500 Global. It sells rugged-meets-refined menswear and lifestyle gear, designing its own brands (including Line of Trade, Fieldworth, Halfday, Wren, Ash and Fir, and Marcellin) and curating products from small independent makers. Alongside a standard online store, it runs an optional membership offering member pricing, early access, and curated monthly boxes. The company operates as a consumer retail brand at bespokepost.com and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nanotronics
providers.description: Nanotronics (rebranded to CubeFabs in 2025) builds AI-driven inspection, process-control, and automation systems for advanced industrial manufacturing, with a focus on semiconductors, data centers, EV/automotive, and aerospace/defense. Its "AI factory" platform combines optical imaging, machine learning, and robotics to improve manufacturing precision, yields, and cost efficiency for customers including Hologic, Broadcom, Coherent, and Standard BioTools. Surfaced as a founders-fund portfolio company; no public developer/API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Napkin Math
providers.description: Napkin Math is a personalized AI food journal from Paper Star (a Y Combinator company, founded 2026 in San Francisco by Manuel Castro, Claire Nord, and Jynnie Tang). Marketed as "an AI nutrition coach in your pocket," it is a simple, beautiful food diary that helps people log meals and understand their eating habits over time. The product is a consumer mobile application rather than a developer platform: as of this profile Napkin Math publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, OpenAPI, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface. This entry is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile and enrichment lead; it will be upgraded to carry API artifacts if and when Napkin Math or Paper Star exposes a public API surface.

providers.name: Nawy
providers.description: Nawy is an Egyptian proptech real estate marketplace that lets users buy, sell, rent, and invest in premium property across Egypt, listing 15,000+ properties and 800+ compounds with search, virtual tours, mortgage financing, and its "Nawy Now" instant-purchase and part-exchange offerings. It operates a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace connecting buyers, sellers, and developers; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer program, API documentation, or partner integration surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: NCX
providers.description: NCX (Natural Capital Exchange), originally founded as SilviaTerra, is a forestry technology company that maps and measures every acre of U.S. forestland using satellite imagery and machine learning. NCX built the Natural Capital Exchange, a marketplace that paid landowners to defer timber harvests and generate forest carbon credits, and it now offers LandBook, a tool that helps landowners capture the story, plans, and practical knowledge behind their property so it can be passed on to the next steward. The company is backed by Union Square Ventures and Version One Ventures.

providers.name: Network Solutions
providers.description: Network Solutions is one of the original ICANN-accredited domain registrars, founded in 1979 and operator of the .com, .net and .org registries under the InterNIC/NSF cooperative agreement through the 1990s. Today it is a consumer and small-business web-services brand of Newfold Digital, selling domain registration and transfers, WHOIS lookup, shared and WordPress web hosting, SSL/TLS certificates, professional email, a website builder, and online marketing services. It operates a domain reseller program (via ResellerClub) and an affiliate program, but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI documentation for third-party integration; the reseller and affiliate channels are the only programmatic-adjacent surfaces.

providers.name: Neurala
providers.description: Neurala is a Boston-based edge AI company whose Lifelong Deep Neural Network (L-DNN) technology is delivered as an embeddable, customized software library for on-device computer vision and visual inspection. Its stack trains on minimal data and runs entirely at the edge without cloud dependency, keeping data private on the device. Neurala partners directly with hardware and software makers rather than publishing a public self-service API; no public developer API, SDK registry package, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Neuron Mobility
providers.description: Neuron Mobility is a rental e-scooter and e-bike operator and micromobility technology developer running shared micromobility fleets in cities across Australia, the United Kingdom, and Canada. The company designs its own vehicles (including the N3 e-scooter), safety systems such as its patented Helmet Lock and ScootSafe rider training program, and the backend fleet-management, IoT, and geofencing technology that powers its rider apps and city operations. Backed by 500 Global, Neuron was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no first-party developer API, GBFS data feed, or well-known discovery surface on its own domain; this profile captures its public web, legal, and support properties plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: NewDays
providers.description: NewDays is a cognitive health company backed by General Catalyst that delivers a clinically proven, Medicare-covered program for people living with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or dementia. The service pairs a dedicated licensed cognitive clinician with AI-guided brain-training exercises delivered remotely from home: a free consultation, ongoing telehealth sessions, and clinician-supervised AI exercises between visits. NewDays reports that 75% of participants showed improved cognitive function on ACE-III assessments and that dementia participants delayed symptom progression by more than a year versus an untreated baseline. NewDays is a direct-to-patient telehealth offering with no public developer program, API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures the company's identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Notti
providers.description: Notti (Notti Pet Food) is a Malaysian pet-nutrition startup selling premium slow-baked kibble, treats, and supplements for dogs (Wou Wou) and cats (Mau Mau) direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront. Formulations emphasise ">=80% fresh meat", low-temperature slow-baking to preserve nutrients, no meat meal or by-products, and AAFCO-compliant nutrition with no chemical preservatives. The company is seed-funded, has been covered by Malaysian business press (The Edge, The Star, Business Today, Free Malaysia Today), and is tracked here as a 500 Global portfolio company. Notti operates as a consumer e-commerce and retail brand and publishes no developer API, documentation, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Odyssey Interactive
providers.description: Odyssey Interactive is an independent game development studio focused on building free-to-play, cross-platform, competitive titles set in bright, hopeful, anime-inspired IP. The studio is best known for Omega Strikers, a free-to-play competitive arena game, and its mission is to "ignite the spark of competitiveness that lives within everyone" by creating community-driven games with longevity. Odyssey Interactive was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the studio publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal — its public surface is its marketing site, a Verified Creators program, downloadable game asset kits, and a Zendesk-hosted player support center. This profile captures the studio's identity and verified public links.

providers.name: OfferUp
providers.description: OfferUp is a mobile-first local marketplace where people buy and sell items in their community across categories including electronics, vehicles, furniture, clothing, and collectibles. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, OfferUp reports more than 40 million active users and around 30 million transactions annually, and merged with letgo in 2020 to become one of the largest recommerce platforms in the United States. The company operates consumer iOS and Android apps and a website but does not publish a public developer program, partner API, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a venture-capital portfolio company (a16z, GGV Capital) and enriched with an identity and domain-security pass; no public API surface was found.

providers.name: Ollin Bio
providers.description: Ollin Bio is a privately held biotechnology company developing novel therapeutics, organizing its work around defined therapeutic areas and a product pipeline of drug candidates in development. Backed by a16z, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead. As a research-stage therapeutics company, Ollin Bio publishes a marketing and corporate website but does not expose a public developer program, API, documentation, or SDKs at this time. This profile records the company's public identity and web properties; it will be re-enriched if a public API surface ever appears.

providers.name: Omnitron Sensors
providers.description: Omnitron Sensors designs advanced MEMS (micro electro mechanical systems) sensors using innovative 3D manufacturing techniques, aiming to deliver high-performance, low-cost sensing with major gains in precision and reliability. Its technology targets AI data centers, autonomous systems and vehicles, environmental and climate monitoring, and extended reality (XR) devices. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, the company is a hardware/semiconductor business with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: On
providers.description: On (On Holding AG) is a Swiss performance sportswear company founded in 2010, known for its CloudTec running shoes and athletic apparel. It designs and sells premium running footwear, clothing, and accessories worldwide through on.com and retail partners, and is publicly traded on the NYSE (ONON). On was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bond Capital. On does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and its domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: OnCorps AI
providers.description: OnCorps AI is an agentic AI platform for fund operations at financial institutions, automating complex middle- and back-office tasks through AI agents that predict root causes and reduce time and cost. Its products span NAV oversight, investment operations, reconciliation, financial report review, performance verification, security attribution, cash and positions validation, accounting controls, OTC confirmations, and FX/share-class hedging, plus Deep Industry Research Agents (DIRA) for financial transaction analysis. OnCorps serves asset managers and fund administrators including PIMCO and Natixis, and is SOC 1 and ISO 27001 certified. No public API or developer program is currently published; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: One Five
providers.description: One Five (styled one.five) is a sustainable packaging technology company based in Holm, Germany that pairs an AI-driven decision platform, Quartermaster, with ready-to-use recyclable and compostable packaging products. The Quartermaster platform embeds product-market-fit and material analysis into packaging development to accelerate material scouting and packing trials, helping consumer brands cut R&D spend, improve customer acquisition efficiency, and meet emerging packaging regulations while reducing environmental impact. One Five ships flexible sustainable packaging for categories such as dishwasher tablets and gummies through partners including Bluemorph and Glassleaf, and is backed by Speedinvest. The company offers no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: oneNav
providers.description: oneNav is a fabless GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) semiconductor company building the next generation of mobile positioning. Its L5-direct receiver acquires and tracks on the modern L5 satellite band without legacy L1 aiding, delivering higher location accuracy in urban canyons and far greater resilience to GPS jamming and spoofing, in half the RF size, power and cost of hybrid L1+L5 solutions. Founded in 2019 (Steve Poizner, Paul McBurney) with offices in Sunnyvale, CA and Tampere, Finland, oneNav targets smartphones, wearables, IoT trackers, defense and emergency services. It is backed by GV, Norwest Venture Partners and GSR Ventures. oneNav is a hardware/silicon company and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Onsitedental
providers.description: Onsite Dental is a mobile and on-site dental care provider that brings full-scope oral healthcare directly to employers and their employees at the workplace. It operates three delivery models: fixed-site practices built inside client buildings, mobile dental clinics deployed to larger corporate campuses, and pop-up practices set up temporarily in conference rooms or amenity centers. Services span cleanings, preventive and diagnostic care, and full treatment delivered by dentists, hygienists, and specialists, positioned as an employee benefit for large employers and their benefits consultants. Onsite Dental is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Oolka
providers.description: Oolka is a Bangalore-based consumer fintech that helps people in India check, monitor, and improve their credit scores. Its mobile app provides free bureau-integrated credit-score checks (Experian), a Credit Builder for users with no prior credit history, EMI and bill payments with cashback via Bharat Bill Pay (the RBI-NPCI initiative), AI-guided insights on credit utilization and payment timing, and assistance disputing incorrect credit-report entries. Oolka operates as a co-branded financial-product partner working with banks and financial institutions. It is a consumer-facing mobile application and does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK surface.

providers.name: Orchard Labs
providers.description: Orchard Labs Inc. is a Toronto-based e-commerce company, founded in 2013, that buys, refurbishes, and resells pre-owned and certified-refurbished smartphones, tablets, and accessories across North America. Through its consumer website and mobile app, Orchard lets people test, price, and sell their used iPhones and Android devices, and buy thoroughly tested refurbished devices backed by a 90-day no-questions-asked warranty and carbon-neutral shipping. It is a consumer retail brand with no public API, developer portal, or SDKs. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Osseus
providers.description: Osseus is a secure research intelligence platform - "the secure research brain for R&D" - that connects the tools teams already use, scattered documents, and the knowledge in people's heads into one permissioned research brain. Permission-aware AI agents surface relevant evidence, experts, and next actions; proactive watchers flag integration issues and repeated work before costly mistakes; and background automations run across connected systems. The company also exposes a memory API for connecting internal agents to a governed evidence layer. Osseus (Y Combinator S2026) was founded by Anish Mariathasan and Ayush Patel and serves R&D teams across aerospace, automotive, robotics, electronics, pharma, and biotech.

providers.name: Otrium
providers.description: Otrium is an online designer fashion outlet, headquartered in Amsterdam, that connects shoppers across Europe with end-of-season and overstock apparel, footwear, and accessories from designer and premium brands at reduced prices. A Certified B Corporation, Otrium operates a curated marketplace model with dedicated brand storefronts, native iOS and Android apps, and multi-market localization across the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, France, Italy, the United Kingdom, Spain, Poland, and the rest of Europe. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bond Capital and Index Ventures. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and its verified public web properties.

providers.name: Outpace Bio
providers.description: Outpace Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company applying AI-powered protein design to cell therapy, with the mission of curing solid tumors. The company engineers novel proteins that reprogram immune cells to overcome the limitations of current cancer immunotherapies, built on a set of proprietary platform technologies (OUTSPACER, OUTSMART, OUTLAST, OUTSAFE) and logic-gated cell targeting. Outpace Bio is a private, research-driven organization backed by Playground Global; it operates no public developer API, SDK, or third-party technical platform, so this API Evangelist profile captures company identity, web properties, and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Ovia Health
providers.description: Ovia Health (by Labcorp) is a digital women's and family health platform delivering evidence-based programs, personalized data insights, and Care Team support across reproductive health, fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, parenting, and menopause. It is offered to individuals through consumer mobile apps (Ovia, Ovia Pregnancy, Ovia Fertility) and to employers and health plans as a benefit, and its apps sync with consumer health platforms including Apple Health and Google Fit.
