Ovia Health does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API specification; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and reflects the honest result of an enrichment pass that found no public API surface, only a consumer/enterprise product.

providers.name: OWLR
providers.description: OWLR (OWLR Technologies) is a London- and Fort Lauderdale-based consumer IoT company that builds universal remote-monitoring apps for home IP cameras, letting users view and manage cameras from many brands through a single mobile application. Its products include the OWLR Multi-Brand Viewer and brand-specific viewers for Foscam and D-Link, plus motion-alert notifications. OWLR emphasizes a privacy-first design in which camera credentials stay on the user's phone and nothing is stored on OWLR's servers. The company reports over two million users and was backed by 500 Global. OWLR is a consumer mobile product and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Own Up
providers.description: Own Up is an AI-driven mortgage marketplace that helps borrowers shop for home loans by comparing personalized rate offers from a network of top-rated lenders without hard credit checks or sales pressure. It provides real-time rate comparisons, personalized recommendations, pre-approval letters, and educational resources for both home purchases and refinancing. Own Up is not a lender or bank; it arranges loans and is compensated by third-party lenders whose offers appear on the platform. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Paireyewear
providers.description: Pair Eyewear is a direct-to-consumer eyewear company known for its customizable glasses: a base frame paired with interchangeable magnetic Top Frames in a rotating range of patterns and colors. The company hand-assembles prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, and accessories in the USA, runs its own in-house lens lab, and sells through its website, iOS and Android apps, a Pair+ membership program, and a wholesale retail-partner program. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: pandas
providers.description: pandas is a fast, powerful, flexible, and easy to use open source data analysis and manipulation tool, built on top of the Python programming language. It is a Python library that provides DataFrame and Series data structures and analysis tools; pandas itself does not expose an HTTP API, but is widely used to build data APIs alongside frameworks like FastAPI and Flask.

providers.name: Partiful
providers.description: Partiful is a free consumer event-invitation and party-planning platform for creating customized digital invites, managing RSVPs, coordinating guests with polls and custom questions, sending text-blast updates, selling tickets or collecting payments via a Stripe integration, and sharing event photos across web, iOS, and Android. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bond Capital, Canaan Partners, GV, and Initialized Capital. Partiful publishes no official public developer API or developer portal; a community-maintained reverse-engineered client library exists on GitHub but is not first-party. This profile captures the provider identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: PathSpot
providers.description: PathSpot Technologies provides a health-and-safety operating system for restaurants, commercial kitchens, food manufacturers, cafeterias, and hospitality venues. Its flagship HandScanner uses light-based spectroscopy to detect harmful contaminants on employees' hands in about two seconds after washing and drying. Alongside the scanner, PathSpot's SafetySuite bundles real-time temperature monitoring (PowerTemp), digital task management (PowerTasks), and food labeling (PowerLabels), rolling the data up into the SafetySuite Hub dashboard with analytics, automated compliance reporting, email reports, text alerts, and optional API-based data integration. PathSpot markets API integration as a data-delivery feature of SafetySuite but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or SDKs as of this profile.

providers.name: Peak
providers.description: Peak is a consumer brain-training mobile application operated by Synaptic Labs (formerly Peak Labs) that offers cognitive exercise games and personalized workouts spanning memory, attention, problem-solving, mental agility, language, and emotion. Its games and Advanced Training Programmes are developed with researchers from institutions including Cambridge, Yale, UCL, and King's College London. Peak Pro is a subscription that unlocks 40+ games, personalized workouts, performance analytics, and an AI Coach. Peak is a mobile-only consumer product distributed via the App Store and Google Play and does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Pelage Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Pelage Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing regenerative medicines for hair loss based on hair follicle stem cell biology discovered by UCLA researchers. Its lead candidate, PP405, is a topically-applied small molecule that reactivates dormant hair follicle stem cells via a metabolic switch to stimulate regrowth, targeting androgenetic alopecia, drug-induced alopecia, and telogen effluvium; it is non-hormonal, non-invasive, and in Phase 2 clinical trials. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). It publishes a corporate site and a clinical-trials site but no public developer, API, or technical surface.

providers.name: Pic Collage
providers.description: Pic Collage (PicCollage) is a consumer photo and video editing mobile app built by Cardinal Blue Software that lets people create collages, greeting cards, and personalized designs from templates, stickers, backgrounds, GIFs, and AI-powered editing tools. It ships on iOS and Android and has been backed by 500 Global. PicCollage exposes no public developer API — its Terms of Service explicitly restrict access to a private, app-only API — so there is no developer portal, documentation, SDK, MCP server, or machine-readable API surface to catalog. This profile captures the company identity and its public web properties.

providers.name: PierSight Space
providers.description: PierSight Space is an India-based space technology company building a constellation of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Automatic Identification System (AIS) satellites for persistent, all-weather maritime surveillance of the world's oceans. Founded by former ISRO engineer Gaurav Seth, PierSight delivers near-real-time ocean monitoring (targeting ~30-minute data latency and 100% ocean coverage) to detect illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing, monitor oil spills, protect Exclusive Economic Zones, support maritime insurance risk assessment, and improve shipping operations. The company has raised roughly $8M from investors including Alpha Wave Ventures, Elevation Capital, and Techstars. As of this enrichment pass PierSight sells data solutions to enterprise and government clients and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Plate Iq
providers.description: Plate IQ (now operating as Ottimate) is an AI-powered accounts payable (AP) automation platform for restaurants, hospitality groups, and multi-location finance teams. It captures and codes vendor invoices with line-item accuracy, matches purchase orders, routes approvals, detects fraud and overpayments, and processes vendor payments, syncing bi-directionally with accounting and ERP systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Acumatica, and Microsoft Dynamics. The company was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Ottimate does not publish a public developer API, REST reference, or developer portal — its integrations are pre-built, managed connectors rather than a self-service API.

providers.name: Pluto Brand
providers.description: Pluto (Plutopillow) is a Los Angeles-based direct-to-consumer sleep wellness brand best known for the Pluto Pillow, a made-to-order pillow custom-built around each customer's unique sleep profile via an online sleep quiz. The company also sells the PUFF body pillow, the POD travel pillow, and temperature-regulating bedding, and offers a 125-night risk-free trial with free shipping and returns. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, Pluto is a consumer e-commerce brand with no public developer platform, API, SDKs, or partner-integration surface at this time; this profile captures its public web properties for discovery.

providers.name: Pokelabo
providers.description: Pokelabo (ポケラボ) is a Japanese mobile game development studio founded in 2007 and headquartered in Tokyo. Originally an independent social-game maker, it became a subsidiary of GREE and, as of January 1, 2025, was integrated into WFS (Wright Flyer Studios) under the GREE group. The studio develops and operates smartphone games built on licensed and original intellectual properties, including titles such as SINoALICE and Magia Exedra (Puella Magi Madoka Magica). Pokelabo is a consumer entertainment company and does not expose a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pollinate
providers.description: Pollinate is a London-headquartered financial technology company that builds a cloud-based, bank-grade digital experience platform helping banks and payment processors reinvent merchant acquiring and value-added services for their small and medium business (SMB) customers. The platform wraps around a bank's legacy payment systems to deliver dynamic merchant onboarding, a bank-branded Merchant Command Center dashboard (transaction reconciliation, dispute management, statements, service discovery), integrated merchant services inside online banking, and ISV enablement. Built on Microsoft Azure and open-banking ready, it powers live bank deployments including Tyl by NatWest (UK), NAB Hive (Australia), and Tyl by CIBC (Canada), with clients including Truist and partners including Fiserv, Endava, and Dun & Bradstreet. Pollinate's APIs are private and partner-facing; it does not publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI.

providers.name: PortalOne
providers.description: PortalOne is a hybrid gaming platform that blends mobile games with live, interactive television-style entertainment, letting players compete inside shows and classic titles such as Atari's Breakout. Operated by PortalOne AS (Norway) and PortalOne, Inc. (United States), the company delivers its experience through native iOS and Android apps rather than a public developer platform. It is a consumer-facing entertainment product backed by Seedcamp and other venture investors; as of this profile PortalOne publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: PostgreSQL
providers.description: PostgreSQL is a powerful, open-source object-relational database system with over 35 years of active development that has earned a strong reputation for reliability, feature robustness, and performance. It supports advanced SQL features, JSON, full-text search, custom data types, extensions, and transactional DDL. PostgreSQL does not expose a native HTTP REST API; client applications connect via the libpq C client library, JDBC, ODBC, or one of dozens of language-specific drivers using the PostgreSQL wire protocol (default port 5432).

providers.name: Preteckt
providers.description: Preteckt provides AI-powered predictive maintenance for transit buses, coach buses, and trucking fleets. Its platform ingests vehicle sensor telemetry and applies machine-learning algorithms to detect maintenance issues before they cause breakdowns, reducing diagnostic time by nearly 50 percent and preventing roughly 20 percent of failures. Preteckt processes more than one million sensor data points per day per vehicle across 20+ maintenance-focused algorithms. The company is part of Diesel Laptops. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Preteckt publishes no public developer, API, documentation, or sign-up surface.

providers.name: Prime Medicine
providers.description: Prime Medicine is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a new class of differentiated one-time curative genetic therapies built on Prime Editing, a versatile, precise, and efficient gene editing technology that can search and replace disease-causing genetic sequences at their precise location in the genome without causing double-strand DNA breaks. The company is advancing a pipeline of programs across a broad range of diseases and, per its public materials, believes Prime Editing could theoretically correct approximately 90% of known disease-causing genetic mutations. It is publicly traded and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). This is a corporate/life-sciences profile: the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Proclaim
providers.description: Proclaim, built by Fresh Health, Inc., makes a custom-jet oral health system that replaces traditional flossing with a 3D-scanned, custom-fitted mouthpiece that pulses water through up to 60 jets to clean between teeth and below the gumline in about seven seconds. The consumer device is clinically shown to reduce gum bleeding and plaque, and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Proclaim is a direct-to-consumer oral-care hardware and wellness brand; it publishes a marketing and e-commerce site, a dental-professional portal, a help/knowledge center, and a blog, but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specification. This profile was surfaced as a Khosla Ventures portfolio lead and enriched with the identity and web properties the company actually publishes plus a probed domain-security profile; there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: ProGrad
providers.description: ProGrad (prograd.uk) is a UK-based consumer mobile app that lets users earn money by playing games and completing online tasks such as surveys and offers, positioning itself as a leading "make money" app in the United Kingdom. Users choose from a large catalogue of games and micro-tasks, accumulate rewards, and withdraw earnings to PayPal or Visa once they pass a minimum threshold. The company also publishes Gen Z insights and research alongside a consumer blog. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, ProGrad is a consumer-facing product with no public developer program, API portal, or programmatic surface at this time.

providers.name: Proportunity
providers.description: Proportunity is a London-based proptech/fintech mortgage lender, founded in 2016 by Vadim Toader and Stefan Boronea, that helps first-time buyers get onto the property ladder with a shared-equity loan. The Proportunity Loan supplements a buyer's deposit and can boost purchasing power by up to GBP 150,000, letting buyers secure a home with as little as a 5% deposit on any property on the market (not just new-builds). The company uses machine-learning models to forecast house prices and identify fair-valued homes in high-growth areas to reduce financing risk. Proportunity is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FRN 716565). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public developer/API surface (consumer-facing product only).

providers.name: Prypco
providers.description: PRYPCO is a Dubai-based PropTech platform building an integrated real estate ecosystem for the United Arab Emirates. Its products include Blocks (fractional property investment starting from AED 500), Mint (blockchain-based tokenized real estate buying, selling, and trading, run in partnership with the Dubai Land Department), Mortgage (instant pre-approval and mortgage comparison), Golden Visa application assistance, a general property buy/sell/rent management service, and One (an agent platform with listing and commission tooling). PRYPCO Real Estate LLC is registered in Dubai, UAE. The company operates a consumer web and mobile product surface and publishes no public developer API; this profile is a company identity record in the API Evangelist network, surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and awaiting any future developer/API surface.

providers.name: Qraved
providers.description: Qraved is Indonesia's leading food discovery platform, self-described as the "No. 1 Food App for Indonesia," helping diners across Jakarta, Bali, Bandung, Surabaya, Medan and other cities explore restaurants, read reviews and dining guides, watch food videos, and connect with a community of food enthusiasts. Backed by 500 Global, Qraved operates a consumer web experience and iOS/Android mobile apps. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification surface.

providers.name: Quago Technologies LTD
providers.description: Quago Technologies is a gaming analytics and fraud-detection company that uses machine learning and mobile device sensor data to protect and optimize mobile games. Its platform analyzes in-game behavioral and device-sensor patterns - without collecting personally identifiable information - to detect and manage cheating, identify user-acquisition (CPA) fraud, predict player churn, and optimize monetization and lifetime value. Quago is delivered to mobile game studios as an embedded SDK plus a backend analytics service rather than a public developer API; it was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Quantum Circuits
providers.description: Quantum Circuits, Inc. is a quantum computing hardware company (a Yale University spinout) building superconducting quantum systems with built-in error detection. Its dual-rail cavity qubits pair Quantum Error Detection (QED), Real-Time Control Flow (RTCF), and Error Detection Handling (EDH), and its Aqumen Seeker QPU (introduced November 2024) targets stable, repeatable, fault-tolerant quantum computation. The company engages early users through a Strategic Quantum Release (SQR) program that includes a simulator and access to Aqumen Seeker systems, rather than a public self-serve API. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: QueroQuitar
providers.description: QueroQuitar is a Brazilian fintech platform that helps consumers and businesses renegotiate and settle overdue debts online. Through its web and mobile apps it connects users with 50+ creditors (including Santander, Claro, Sky, BV, Inter and Carrefour) to arrange discounted, installment-based payoffs, and participates in Brazil's Desenrola Brasil program. It also offers QueroCredito credit products and QueroSaude health services. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass QueroQuitar exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: QuSecure
providers.description: QuSecure is a post-quantum cybersecurity company whose QuProtect R3 platform helps enterprises and government agencies discover, remediate, and report on cryptographic risk ahead of the quantum-computing threat. The platform pairs Recon (automated inventory of cryptographic assets), Resilience (crypto-agile remediation of encryption without code changes or downtime), and Reporting (Cryptographic Bill of Materials / CBOM for NIST, FIPS, CNSA 2.0, and GDPR compliance). QuSecure serves telecom, defense, finance, and critical-infrastructure customers including Fortune 500 companies and U.S. federal agencies. This profile currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Rabbit Mobility
providers.description: Rabbit Mobility (Rabbit) is a clean-tech micro-mobility sharing company operating in Cairo and Giza, Egypt. Through its iOS and Android mobile apps, Rabbit offers shared standing electric scooters and electric bikes with two service models: on-demand "Unlock & Go" rides and multi-day "Day Rentals" that include delivery. The company reports covering more than one million kilometers and saving over 50 tons of CO2 emissions. Rabbit is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As a consumer mobile-app business, Rabbit publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: RadiantGraph
providers.description: RadiantGraph is a healthcare engagement platform that turns fragmented health data into personalized member connections to improve clinical outcomes and reduce wasted spend. Its "Intelligent Personalization" product suite includes a Health Data Engine that ingests and enriches member records with 80+ social determinants of health, Smart Cohorts for identifying high-risk member groups, and Smart Spend for scoring members on clinical risk. The platform integrates with CRMs, contact centers, campaign engines, portals, and care-management systems, connecting claims data warehouses, clinical data repositories, and member-demographics sources. Backed by True Ventures. No public developer platform, API documentation, or SDKs were found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Rapido
providers.description: Rapido is an Indian on-demand urban mobility platform that connects riders with independent driver-partners (called "Captains") for bike taxis, auto rickshaws, and cabs through its consumer and Captain mobile apps. Founded in Bengaluru and backed by Accel, Rapido operates across hundreds of Indian cities and has expanded into parcel delivery and corporate mobility. As of this enrichment pass Rapido exposes only a consumer-facing web and app surface — no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification was found. This profile captures the company identity, its published policy and content pages, and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Raus
providers.description: Raus (operated by StayRaus GmbH, Berlin) is a consumer platform for booking sustainable, design-forward tiny cabins in nature across Germany and Austria, giving city dwellers a quick escape "close to home." Guests browse and book fully-equipped smart cabins in forests, by lakes, and on farms, add culinary experiences and extras, buy gift cards, and can list their own land as a host. Raus was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a B2C hospitality/booking brand with a public consumer website but no publicly documented API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Re:Build
providers.description: Re:Build Manufacturing is a U.S.-based industrial engineering and manufacturing company that takes complex products from concept to full-rate production through integrated design, engineering, and scalable domestic manufacturing. Founded to rebuild American manufacturing capacity, the company operates a family of specialized engineering and production businesses across more than 14 U.S. locations, spanning aerospace and defense, electrification, energy and environment, medical devices, and robotics and automation. With 400+ engineers and roughly one million square feet of industrial footprint, Re:Build partners with startups and established manufacturers to develop, industrialize, and produce advanced physical products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment confirms it is an industrial/manufacturing company with no public API, developer, or machine surface at this time.

providers.name: Recycleye
providers.description: Recycleye is a London-based company building AI-powered sorting equipment and analytics for waste management and material recovery businesses worldwide. Its products include Recycleye QualiBot robotic sorting cells, Recycleye QuantiSort optical sorting technology, and Recycleye Insights, a data analytics platform that uses computer vision (WasteNet) to identify and categorize waste streams. The company sells hardware and software into recycling operations to improve purity, recovery rates, and profitability. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC. As of this enrichment pass Recycleye publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Renoster Systems
providers.description: Renoster Systems is a carbon-credit ratings agency bringing deep transparency to the nature-based voluntary carbon markets. Using remote sensing, LiDAR, satellite data, and machine learning, Renoster independently rates forestry and other nature-based carbon offset projects, quantifying how much CO2 per credit a project has actually sequestered, and publishes public tools such as its Mercury project database and Renoster/Mercury rubric for researchers, reserve managers, policymakers, and corporate buyers. Renoster is a Techstars-backed startup. As of this profile the company does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; this record captures its company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Resolution Games
providers.description: Resolution Games is a Stockholm-based studio building games for virtual, augmented, and mixed reality platforms including Meta Quest, Apple Vision Pro, and PlayStation VR. Its titles include Demeo, Spatial Ops, Blaston, Bait!, and Ultimechs. The company is venture-backed (Creandum, GV, Partech) and runs a consumer-facing games business. It publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public web properties (blog, support, legal pages) for discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: ResortPass
providers.description: ResortPass is a consumer travel and hospitality marketplace that lets people book hotel and resort day passes — pool access, spa treatments, cabanas, fitness centers, and day rooms — at over 2,000 hotels without an overnight stay, starting around $25. Guests search by city and date, book a pass, and enjoy resort amenities for the day, while partner hotels monetize otherwise-idle amenity capacity. Surfaced as a portfolio company of CRV and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal was found during enrichment; the company operates a consumer web/mobile booking product and a hotel partner program.

providers.name: ResourceWise
providers.description: ResourceWise is a market intelligence company for sustainable commodities, delivering data, analytics, pricing benchmarks, forecasts, and consulting across the forest products, pulp and paper, biofuels, and chemicals markets. It was formed by unifying established industry brands including Tecnon OrbiChem, Wood Resources International, Fisher International, Forest2Market, Prima Markets, and Chemical Intelligence under the ResourceWise name. Its subscription platforms include ChemEdge360, FisherSolve, Forestat Global, OrbiChem360, Prima CarbonZero, Recycled Fiber 360, SilvaStat360, and WoodMarket Prices. The company is backed by Battery Ventures. No public API or developer portal is currently published; access is delivered through its SaaS platform logins.

providers.name: Revalia Bio
providers.description: Revalia Bio transforms donated, non-transplantable human organs and tissues into high-fidelity biological datasets, using AI to accelerate drug and device development. The company has built "The Human Data Stack" — infrastructure spanning data generation, ingestion, integration, interpretation, and delivery of decision-ready clinical insights for pharma, biotech, healthcare, and regulatory customers. Applications include safety signal detection, dose and target selection, patient selection, and mechanism-of-action studies. Founded by Greg Tietjen (CEO) and Jenna DiRito (COO), it generated first revenue in 2023 and raised seed funding in 2024. Backed by Sierra Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Revalia Bio publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or technical surface — it is a B2B research-services company, not a developer platform.

providers.name: Revlon
providers.description: Revlon is a global beauty company whose portfolio spans color cosmetics, fragrance, skin care, hair color, hair care, beauty tools, and antiperspirants / deodorants. The company markets Revlon, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, Mitchum, Cutex, Charlie, SinfulColors, and Ultima II, along with a portfolio of licensed prestige and celebrity fragrance brands. Revlon Consumer Products Corporation filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the Southern District of New York on June 15, 2022 and emerged on May 2, 2023 as a privately held company controlled by its former lenders (including BrandCo noteholders such as King Street Capital, Glendon Capital, and Angelo Gordon), having cut roughly $2.7 billion of debt from its balance sheet. Today Revlon operates as a private company with reduced leverage, selling through mass-market retail and prestige channels worldwide. Revlon does not publish a public developer API; supplier, retailer, and partner integrations occur through private commercial channels (e-commerce platform integrations, EDI / GDSN feeds for retailers, and the corporate procurement portal).

providers.name: Rightway Healthcare
providers.description: Rightway Healthcare is a healthcare navigation and pharmacy benefits management (PBM) company that pairs a transparent, 100% pass-through PBM built by pharmacists with clinical care navigation that helps members understand their benefits, resolve billing questions, and connect with the right care. Rightway serves employers and their members through web and mobile apps rather than a public developer program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of khosla-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Rightway publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs, so the captured artifacts are limited to a domain-security probe and verified public web properties.

providers.name: Ripcord
providers.description: Ripcord is a document digitization and data-extraction company that uses proprietary robotics and AI to turn paper and digital records into structured, actionable business data. Its pipeline runs in three stages — robotic digitization (scanning paper to high-quality digital files), intelligence (AI classification, extraction, validation and enrichment), and action (accessing the resulting data through existing enterprise systems or Ripcord's Canopy cloud content-management platform). Ripcord serves manufacturing, financial services, insurance, real estate, energy, public sector, HR, food & beverage, and accounts-receivable management, with customers including Coca-Cola Bottlers, BP, UCLA, MUFG Bank, Agilent, and the IRS. Integration with enterprise systems (ERP, ECM, RPA, BI) is offered through direct engagement rather than a public developer API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV and Lux Capital.

providers.name: Ripple Foods
providers.description: Ripple Foods is a plant-based beverage company that manufactures dairy-free milk alternatives made from pea protein, along with protein shakes, kids' milk, barista and coffee creamers, and organic plant-based milk. It sells through retail grocery and a direct-to-consumer Shopify storefront. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) in the frontier-tech sector and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer packaged goods company, Ripple Foods publishes no public developer program, API, or technical documentation; this profile captures its public web and domain-security surface only.

providers.name: Robust.AI
providers.description: Robust.AI is a robotics company building Carter, an AI-powered collaborative mobile robot for warehouse fulfillment and manufacturing environments. Founded by Rodney Brooks (co-founder of iRobot and Rethink Robotics) and colleagues, the company designs human-centered autonomous material-handling robots that work alongside people with minimal infrastructure change, no capital expenditure, and rapid ROI. Robust.AI is backed by Playground Global and was recognized among Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026. This is a physical-robotics company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or GitHub surface.

providers.name: Roomi
providers.description: Roomi is a consumer roommate- and room-rental matching platform that connects verified renters looking for roommates with people posting available rooms, sublets, spare rooms, and monthly rentals across more than 200 cities. The service offers a searchable listing experience with filters for amenities, duration, and property type, roommate verification and ID/background checks, an in-app booking and messaging system, and a safety-check service. Roomi is delivered primarily through free iOS and Android mobile apps and a web experience built on Bubble.io, monetized through premium features such as background checks and listing boosts. It exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead of DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Rossignol
providers.description: Rossignol is a French outdoor sports equipment and apparel manufacturer (Rossignol Group), one of the world's best-known makers of alpine skis, cross-country skis, snowboards, bindings, boots, poles, helmets and goggles, alongside a growing range of apparel, footwear, mountain bikes and accessories. Founded in Voiron, France, the company sells direct-to-consumer through localized e-commerce storefronts across 40+ countries and regions. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; this pass enriched it as a consumer brand with a public e-commerce presence but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Sandbox VR
providers.description: Sandbox VR is a location-based virtual reality entertainment company operating full-body, free-roam VR experiences for groups of friends, families, and corporate teams across 60+ venues in North America, Europe, and Asia. Guests play social, multiplayer VR adventures — horror, action, sports, and family-friendly titles including licensed properties — using motion-tracked suits and headsets. The business spans company-owned and franchised locations, online booking, gift cards, parties/events, and an unlimited-pass subscription. Backed by a16z and Craft Ventures. Sandbox VR is a consumer entertainment operator and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this record captures the company identity and its public web/security posture.

providers.name: Sarla Aviation
providers.description: Sarla Aviation is an Indian advanced air mobility company building electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft for urban transportation. Its flagship flying taxi, Shunya, uses a hybrid-electric propulsion system (seven electric units, dual battery packs, and a sustainable aviation fuel tank) to reach up to 250 km/h with a range up to 800 km and 150 km fully electric, in cabin configurations spanning 6-seat, 4-seat, cargo, and ambulance variants. Founded by former Lilium engineers Rakesh Gaonkar and Adrian Schmidt, the company is a portfolio company of Accel. The public website exposes no developer, API, or technical integration surface as of this enrichment pass; this profile captures corporate identity, legal, and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Saturn
providers.description: Saturn is a mobile calendar and scheduling app built for high school students, designed around the complexities of the school day, built around your friends, and kept truly real-time. Students import their class schedule, see what their friends are doing, coordinate activities, and share their calendar socially. The company positions itself as "the next generation calendar, enabling time together for all." Saturn is a consumer iOS and Android application distributed through the App Store and Google Play; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. Backed by General Catalyst and Insight Partners, with notable individual investors including Jeff Bezos, Marc Benioff, and Dara Khosrowshahi.

providers.name: Saucey
providers.description: Saucey is an on-demand alcohol delivery service that brings beer, wine, and spirits from local retailers to customers' doors, often in under an hour, across a growing list of US markets. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Los Angeles, the company operates consumer iOS, Android, and web ordering experiences, a Saucey Club membership offering free delivery and perks, and a retailer/brand partnership program. Saucey is backed by 500 Global and Bullpen Capital. This profile tracks Saucey in the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Saucey publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Sav Technologies Limited
providers.description: Sav Technologies Limited operates Sav (sav.money), a UAE-based intelligent financial platform that lets users track, save, invest, and grow their wealth across accounts. Sav offers a suite of consumer products including Gold (physical gold investment from AED 10), MyMoney (financial management and savings), Card (a prepaid card with cashback), Wealth (investing), Sav Pro (premium membership), and an upcoming Credit product. Sav describes itself as extending the APIs and technology components of licensed financial services providers to its users. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass, Sav publishes a consumer app and marketing site but no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Scorpion
providers.description: Scorpion is an American marketing technology company that provides revenue-focused advertising, marketing, and software services to local and multi-location businesses in home services, legal, franchise, and healthcare verticals. Founded in 2001 by Rustin Kretz and headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah (with major operations in Valencia, California), Scorpion pairs done-for-you digital advertising and SEO with its own AI-driven platform. In 2024 it launched RevenueMAX, an AI marketing platform built on Scorpion AI that aligns marketing spend, intake, and long-term revenue, and in 2025 it introduced Scorpion Convert, an AI intake-and-conversion product that automates response, scheduling, and voice/messaging engagement for missed leads. Scorpion is a services-and-platform provider; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Seekho
providers.description: Seekho (operated by Keyaro Edutech Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru, India) is a consumer edutainment mobile application delivering short-form learning videos across 50+ categories including stock market investing, spoken English, YouTube monetization, business, cooking, and government-procedure (sarkari) guidance. The platform reports 10 crore+ downloads, 40+ lakh learners, 10,000+ videos, and 250+ verified mentors, and is distributed via the Apple App Store and Google Play. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass, Seekho publishes a consumer marketing site, a blog, and a creator program but exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or partner API surface.

providers.name: Senken
providers.description: Senken (Senken GmbH, Berlin) is a carbon credit procurement marketplace and advisory for European enterprises. It curates high-integrity carbon credits by scoring climate projects across 600+ data points with its Sustainability Integrity Index (SII), aligned to the Oxford Offsetting Principles and ICVCM Core Carbon Principles, rejecting roughly 95% of available credits. Products span advisory (CSRD, SBTi, CDP compliance), vetted procurement, audit-ready documentation (Champion's Kit), the SBTi 2035 Reserve carbon-removal supply, an OER portfolio, and free self-serve tools at tools.senken.io (checkout, portfolio calculator, OER calculator, EU greenwashing auditor). Clients include Vodafone, Deutsche Telekom, DZ Bank, and Union Investment. No public developer API is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Session AI
providers.description: Session AI is an ecommerce AI platform that uses agentic decisioning to optimize promotions and customer experiences in real time. Its Session Marketing Agent predicts in-session visitor intent and behavior, then delivers personalized offers, nudges, and messages to maximize revenue, conversions, and profit margins for retail, travel and hospitality, and telecom brands. The platform integrates via tag managers (Google Tag Manager, Tealium), an SDK, server-to-server calls, and prebuilt plugins/cartridges, advertising sub-50ms decision latency, no PII collection, and SOC 2 aligned controls. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners; no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI is currently published (integration is arranged during onboarding).

providers.name: Setpoint.io
providers.description: Setpoint is a capital markets operating system for asset-backed finance. It embeds with borrowers and lenders to manage debt facilities — warehouse facilities, forward flow agreements, securitization, and fund/leverage finance — automating collateral verification, data standardization, and reporting across ABS and ABF markets. The platform (Capital OS and Data OS, plus PledgeCheck collateral certification and Setpoint Analytics) manages over $50 billion in financed assets annually. Setpoint is not currently a public API provider; this profile captures the company's identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sharechat
providers.description: ShareChat (Mohalla Tech Pvt. Ltd.) is an Indian social media company that operates the regional-language social network ShareChat and the short-video entertainment app Moj. The platform lets users across 15+ Indian languages share posts, images, videos, shayari, quotes, and trending content through personalized feeds. ShareChat monetizes through a self-serve advertising platform (ShareChat Ads) offering campaign management, audience targeting, and brand partnerships across its social and short-video surfaces. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and other investors, the company is one of the largest homegrown social platforms in India. As of this profile, ShareChat exposes consumer apps and a self-serve ad manager but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or programmatic API surface.

providers.name: ShiftSouth
providers.description: ShiftSouth (Pty) Ltd operates SweepSouth, South Africa's first on-demand home services marketplace, launched in 2014. The platform connects roughly 250,000 customers with about 6,500 vetted home-services professionals ("SweepStars") across Cape Town, Johannesburg, Sandton, Centurion, Pretoria, Durban, Umhlanga, Stellenbosch, Paarl and other South African cities. Services span on-demand and express indoor cleaning, office and Airbnb turnover cleaning, laundry and ironing, elder care, Mom's Helper and childcare, dog walking, gardening and pool maintenance, plus full-time placements of housekeepers, nannies and carers and a MyHome Hub subscription for managing private domestic workers. Professionals are background-checked, reference-verified and insured. SweepSouth is a 500 Global portfolio company and has won the Forbes Africa Women Innovation Award (2020) and the World Economic Forum Breakthrough Female Innovators Award (2017). It is a consumer marketplace with mobile apps for iOS and Android and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Shohoz
providers.description: Shohoz (Shohoj Limited) is a Bangladeshi consumer technology platform and digital super-app, billed as Bangladesh's largest online ticket destination. Founded in 2014 as an online ticketing service, it lets users book bus, train, air, launch (ferry), event, and movie tickets from its website and mobile apps, and expanded into ride-hailing (car and motorbike), on-demand delivery, and other everyday services. The company reports 10M+ users, 250M+ tickets sold, and 1,000+ transport and merchant partners across 3,000+ routes. Shohoz is a technology-first business but does not publish a public developer program, API reference, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Shopeando
providers.description: Shopeando is a Mexican technology and logistics startup that manages the full international shipping process, enabling businesses and individuals to import and export merchandise between China, Europe, the United States and Mexico. Through its platform it coordinates cross-border logistics, customs handling and last-mile delivery, and provides dedicated import, export and e-commerce fulfillment services for online stores. Shopeando is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Siren
providers.description: Siren is a digital health company that makes temperature-monitoring smart socks to prevent diabetic foot ulcers. The seamless, machine-washable socks require no charging or smartphone; embedded sensors continuously track foot temperature to detect the early inflammation that precedes an ulcer, and licensed nurses review the data and alert the patient's healthcare provider. Siren pairs the hardware with a remote patient monitoring service billed through providers and payers, and operates as a HIPAA-regulated healthcare business rather than a developer platform. It is backed by 500 Global and DCM Ventures. As surveyed for the API Evangelist network, Siren publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Slik
providers.description: Slik is a Latin American employee experience (PX) platform that helps organizations measure, analyze, and activate employee engagement in real time. Its Engagement module runs collaborator-journey surveys with real-time reporting, AI-prioritized improvement opportunities, people analytics and prediction, and leader action plans across the selection, onboarding, climate, and wellbeing touchpoints; its Performance module tracks cascading OKRs and continuous feedback outside annual review cycles. Slik distributes surveys and reaches employees through messaging channels including Slack, Google, Microsoft Teams, Workplace, and WhatsApp. Founded in Buenos Aires, Argentina and backed by 500 Global/500 Latam, AVP Ventures, and Vulcano Fund, the platform serves large enterprises such as Burger King, AXA, DHL, Starbucks, and Dole. Slik does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: SmartAsset
providers.description: SmartAsset is a financial technology company that runs the largest online marketplace connecting consumers with fiduciary financial advisors. Its SmartAdvisor matching service pairs more than 50,000 retail investors each month with up to three vetted advisors based on geography, investable assets, and preferences, while the SmartAsset Advisor Marketing Platform (AMP) delivers advisors a subscription stream of qualified referrals plus lead automation that syncs into their CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Wealthbox, Redtail, Zoho, Pipedrive, SmartOffice). SmartAsset also publishes a large library of consumer personal-finance calculators and editorial content across taxes, retirement, mortgages, investing, and banking. Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, SmartAsset is a lead-generation and media business and does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: SolarCycle
providers.description: SolarCycle is a technology-driven solar recycling company founded in 2022 that provides certified end-of-life management for solar energy systems. It recovers up to 97% of panel materials (silver, copper, gold, aluminum, glass), recycles power electronics such as inverters and transformers, and handles logistics and field operations for large-scale solar projects, achieving 100% landfill diversion. SolarCycle operates seven facilities across Georgia, Illinois, Texas, Nevada, and Arizona and is building a domestic recycled-solar-glass manufacturing plant, serving major solar companies including Q Cells, AES, Orsted, and Sunrun. It is a portfolio company of Fifth Wall. This is a physical circular-economy operations business with no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Splash
providers.description: Splash is an AI music-creation platform building games and tools for a new generation of creators. Developed by the team formerly known as Popgun AI, it has built proprietary generative-audio technology and high-quality music datasets since 2017, powering features such as Text-to-Singing, Text-to-Rap, and Generative Text-to-Music. Splash's consumer products include the Splash beat-maker app for iOS and Android, SPLASH on Roblox, the WeMix collaborative music experience, and KAIMIX. The company is backed by Khosla Ventures, Techstars, the Alexa Fund, Bitkraft, King River Capital, and Mawson. Splash publishes no public developer API or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its public web identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Structure Therapeutics
providers.description: Structure Therapeutics (NASDAQ: GPCR) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in South San Francisco, California, developing novel oral small-molecule medicines for chronic diseases with significant unmet medical need. The company applies a structure-based drug discovery platform focused on G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) to design once-daily oral therapies, with lead programs centered on oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonists for obesity and metabolic disease. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Structure Therapeutics maintains a corporate and investor web presence, but no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Summoners Arena
providers.description: Summoners Arena is a blockchain-based, multi-genre play-to-earn game universe set in the antique lore of Summonia, where players summon, evolve, and battle NFT heroes across PvP modes (Arena, Battleground) and PvE content (Dungeon, Campaign), with an in-game NFT marketplace supporting hero renting, equipment collection, and forging. Backed by Pantera Capital, it operates in the Web3 / crypto gaming sector. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes a consumer game and community surface but no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or well-known discovery documents were found.

providers.name: Super Evil
providers.description: Super Evil (Super Evil Megacorp) is an award-winning independent video game studio building shared, cross-platform gaming experiences that push creative and technical boundaries. The studio is best known for the MOBA Vainglory and the shooter Catalyst Black, and has shipped licensed titles including TMNT: Splintered Fate and a Rebel Moon game (Blood Line). Surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the studio publishes only a consumer marketing website (Gatsby/Netlify) and social channels; it exposes no public developer API, documentation, SDK, OpenAPI, developer portal, or status page.

providers.name: Super Evil Megacorp
providers.description: Super Evil Megacorp is an award-winning independent video game studio building shared, cross-platform gaming experiences that push creative and technical boundaries. Founded in 2012, the studio is best known for the mobile MOBA Vainglory and has since shipped titles including Catalyst Black, TMNT Splintered Fate, and Blood Line - Rebel Moon, developed on its own in-house game engine. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and Index Ventures; it is a consumer games studio and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tactile Games
providers.description: Tactile Games is a Danish mobile game studio headquartered in Copenhagen, founded in 2014, that builds and publishes casual free-to-play puzzle titles for iOS and Android. Its portfolio includes Lily's Garden, Penny & Flo, Makeover Match, the Cookie Cats series (Cookie Cats, Cookie Cats Pop, Cookie Cats Blast), and the Simon's Cat games. Tactile is a portfolio company of Index Ventures. It is a consumer game publisher rather than an API producer: it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile captures the company identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture surfaced by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Taxdoo
providers.description: Taxdoo is a Hamburg-based fintech providing real-time e-commerce accounting software for online retailers and tax advisors. The platform automatically captures sales, fees, payments, invoices, and contracts across 50+ marketplaces, shop systems, and payment providers (Amazon, eBay, Kaufland, Shopify, JTL, PayPal, Stripe, Klarna, Mollie), reconciles them into GoBD-compliant, audit-ready financial data, performs AI-based invoice verification, and exports daily to DATEV. Integrations are delivered as managed no-code connectors; Taxdoo does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API reference. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Taylor & Hart
providers.description: Taylor & Hart is a luxury bespoke jewellery company specialising in custom engagement rings and wedding bands, crafted made-to-order in London with showrooms in London and New York. The company pairs an in-house design team with in-person and virtual consultations, ethical gemstone and diamond sourcing, and a customer-led custom design experience. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As a direct-to-consumer luxury retail business, Taylor & Hart publishes a public website, blog, and standard legal pages, but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook/event surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Tensordyne
providers.description: Tensordyne (formerly Recogni) builds next-generation AI inference systems from the foundation up — a proprietary logarithmic-math architecture cast into custom 3nm silicon, compute hardware, scale-up interconnect, and system software. Its flagship Napier platform targets the fastest, lowest-cost, most energy-efficient generative AI inference for hyperscaler and neocloud data centers, delivering 608 PFLOPS dense compute per rack in an air-cooled 30 kW pod and supporting MoE models, agentic workloads, and 4K video generation. The stack integrates with PyTorch, Triton, vLLM, and Kubernetes; a developer SDK is announced as coming soon. Backed by Mayfield, Bosch Ventures, Toyota Ventures, GreatPoint Ventures, and Plug and Play, the company has raised more than $211M and operates from Sunnyvale, California and Munich, Germany.

providers.name: The Estée Lauder Companies
providers.description: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. (NYSE: EL) is one of the world's leading manufacturers, marketers and sellers of quality prestige skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products. Founded in 1946 by Estée and Joseph Lauder, the family-controlled, New York-headquartered conglomerate operates a portfolio of more than 20 prestige brands sold in approximately 150 countries and territories, employs roughly 57,000 people worldwide, and reported fiscal 2025 net sales of approximately $14.32 billion. ELC's corporate website (elcompanies.com) does not expose any public developer APIs, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, sandboxes, or a developer portal — the EsteeLauder GitHub organization is empty of public repositories. The technology surface is instead expressed through enterprise partnerships: the AI Innovation Lab (announced 2023, expanded April 2024) jointly run with Microsoft on Azure OpenAI Service; the ConsumerIQ tool built on Microsoft Copilot Studio (2025); an Adobe Firefly Services generative AI collaboration for digital marketing assets (March 2025); a Google Gemini / Vertex AI–powered Jo Malone London Scent Advisor (December 2025); and a Shopify-based unified global direct-to-consumer commerce platform (announced October 2025, ~50% rolled out by calendar year-end 2026). ELC's strategic vision, "Beauty Reimagined" (announced February 2025), and the Profit Recovery and Growth Plan ($0.8–1.0B gross benefits; $1.2–1.6B restructuring charges) anchor the One ELC operating model now led by CEO Stéphane de La Faverie and Board Chair William P. Lauder.

providers.name: The Exploration Company
providers.description: The Exploration Company (TEC) is a European deep-tech space startup founded in July 2021 by Hélène Huby and a team of aerospace engineers from Airbus and ArianeGroup. Headquartered in Munich, Germany with sites in Bordeaux, Oberpfaffenhofen, Italy, France, Houston, and the MENA region, TEC develops Nyx, a family of modular, reusable, in-orbit refuelable spacecraft designed to carry cargo — and eventually humans — to low Earth orbit, lunar orbit, and the Moon, serving space stations and long-distance research missions. The company has raised a €40.5M Series A and a €150M Series B and is a certified B Corp. It exposes no public developer API; interfaces are provided to payload customers via a Payload User's Guide.

providers.name: Thrive Causemetics
providers.description: Thrive Causemetics is a direct-to-consumer, cause-driven beauty brand selling cosmetics (makeup) under the Thrive Causemetics label and skincare under its Bigger Than Beauty Skincare line. The company operates a Shopify-based e-commerce storefront with a loyalty/rewards program, subscriptions, and referral offers, and donates products and funds to charitable partners with every purchase. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Trinity Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Thrive Causemetics publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine discovery surface; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: TomoCredit
providers.description: TomoCredit is a consumer fintech that helps people build credit without requiring a credit score or prior credit history. Its flagship products are the Tomo Card, a credit-building card marketed as an all-new black card, and TomoBoost, an AI-powered credit-building tool. The company positions itself around fast approval (apply in minutes), no credit-history requirement, and cardmember benefits and coverage it values at over $1,300, aiming to help thin-file consumers such as newcomers and students establish and grow their credit. TomoCredit was surfaced through the Techstars portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Travelio
providers.description: Travelio is one of Indonesia's largest online property rental and management platforms, operated by PT Horizon Internusa Persada. It lists furnished and unfurnished apartments, houses, villas, guest houses, and hotel residences for daily, monthly, and yearly rental across 15+ Indonesian cities including Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya, Bali, and Yogyakarta, and offers hospitality-grade property management for owners. Backed by 500 Global, Travelio runs consumer web and mobile apps but publishes no public developer API, SDK, partner integration surface, or developer portal as of this profile.

providers.name: Truly Experiences
providers.description: Truly Experiences is a UK-based experiential gifting company that curates and sells memorable experiences as gifts rather than physical products. Its catalog spans dining, spa treatments, drinks tastings, activities, masterclasses, travel getaways, and premium "dreams come true" experiences, organized by recipient, occasion, price point, and UK location (London, Edinburgh, Birmingham, Manchester and beyond). After checkout customers receive an e-certificate with a unique code, and a concierge team arranges the booking date and time. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass it operates a consumer e-commerce storefront with no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: TrustIQ
providers.description: TrustIQ (operating as Trusting Social) is a Singapore-headquartered AI fintech that provides alternative-data credit scoring, fraud detection, and digital identity verification for lenders and consumer platforms across emerging Asian markets including India, Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Philippines. Its products — Trust Scores (AI credit and fraud scoring built from telco and alternative data), Trust Vision (facial-recognition digital onboarding and KYC), and Smart Customer Acquisition — help financial institutions extend credit to underbanked, new-to-credit consumers. Engagement is sales-led; the company publishes no public self-service API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: UPSIDE Foods
providers.description: UPSIDE Foods is an Emeryville, California-based cultivated meat company (The UPSIDE Group Inc.) that grows real meat directly from animal cells - no farm, no slaughter. Its flagship product is UPSIDE Chicken, cultivated chicken cleared for sale in the United States following FDA review, offered through foodservice partners, with public tours of its EPIC (Engineering, Production, and Innovation Center) facility. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio company; enrichment probing found no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, GitHub organization, or event surface.

providers.name: Vera Therapeutics
providers.description: Vera Therapeutics is a clinical- and commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Brisbane, California, developing treatments for serious immunological and inflammatory diseases of the kidney. Its lead program, atacicept (marketed as TRUTAKNA), is a dual BAFF/APRIL inhibitor for IgA nephropathy (IgAN). Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment, Vera Therapeutics publishes a corporate and patient-facing website (veratx.com) but exposes no public developer portal, API, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface. Sector: life-sciences.

providers.name: versatile.ai
providers.description: Versatile is a construction-technology company building AI-powered crane intelligence for jobsites, primarily serving steel erectors and general contractors. Its CraneView hardware device attaches to a crane's hook block and passively captures operational data, which the Control Center software turns into real-time insight on pace, progress, productivity, and delays without asking crews to change how they work. The company is backed by Insight Partners. As of this profile Versatile publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform; this record captures its identity, published web properties, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Vico
providers.description: Vico (getvico.com) is a Colombian marketplace for finding and renting furnished rooms, aparta-estudios, and apartments for shared, medium- to long-term stays across cities such as Bogotá and Medellín. Guests browse and book verified co-living spaces while hosts list and manage rooms, under the tagline "Ama donde vives" (Love where you live). It is a consumer-facing accommodation platform backed by 500 Global; it exposes no public developer API program, OpenAPI, GraphQL, or /.well-known discovery surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Viewlocity
providers.description: Viewlocity Technologies Pty Ltd is a supply chain management software company that provides supply chain visibility, control tower, and execution solutions for global manufacturers, distributors, and logistics providers. Its solution set spans supply chain design, inventory and asset management, supply chain management, logistics and transportation, planning and production, order lifecycle management, and supplier management, delivered as SaaS and managed services to industries including aerospace and defense, automotive and industrial, consumer goods, high tech and electronics, manufacturing, retail, and third-party logistics. Viewlocity publishes a corporate marketing and resource website but does not expose a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Vita Inclinata
providers.description: Vita Inclinata Technologies is a Colorado-based hardware company that builds physics-based load stabilization systems for helicopter hoists and construction cranes, eliminating the dangerous spin and sway of suspended loads. Its ecosystem spans Vita Aerospace (helicopter and rescue hoist stabilization), Vita Industrial (crane and construction load control), Air Rescue Systems (hoist training and products), and the Vita Rescue System used in military MEDEVAC operations. The company is Techstars-backed. It was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and added to the API Evangelist network; as a physical-hardware manufacturer it currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Vividion Therapeutics
providers.description: Vividion Therapeutics is a San Diego-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that discovers and develops precision small-molecule medicines for previously undruggable disease targets. Its proprietary chemoproteomics platform pairs covalent chemistry with proteome-wide screening to map druggable pockets across the human proteome, driving a pipeline in oncology and immunology (including VVD-214, a WRN helicase inhibitor for MSI-high cancers). Vividion was acquired by Bayer in 2021 and operates as an independent subsidiary. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund; this profile has been enriched and carries no public developer or API surface (a corporate/scientific website only).

providers.name: Voldex
providers.description: Voldex (Voldex Entertainment) is a game developer and publisher founded in 2015 that acquires, operates, and grows platform-leading games on Roblox, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football, collectively reaching over 140 million monthly players. Its stated mission is to "bring people together through fun," pursuing a focused strategy of selectively acquiring and stewarding enduring Roblox experiences rather than broad portfolio expansion. Voldex publishes no public developer API, SDK, CLI, or API documentation surface — it is a consumer games studio whose products run inside the Roblox platform. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company; it was reviewed by the enrichment pipeline and confirmed to have no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Wineaccess
providers.description: Wine Access is an online wine retailer that curates limited-production and hard-to-find wines from around the world, sourced and vetted by its team of sommeliers and wine experts. Beyond direct e-commerce, the company operates a portfolio of subscription wine clubs (Discovery, Connoisseurs, Champagne, Collector's, Decanter, and Sunset clubs), a wine podcast and editorial content platform at discover.wineaccess.com, corporate and personal gifting, gift cards, and climate-controlled shipping. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. As of this profile, Wine Access publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; it is a consumer e-commerce brand rather than an API provider.

providers.name: WINT
providers.description: WINT (also styled Wint) is an AI-powered water management and leak-detection platform for commercial and industrial facilities. Its IoT flow sensors, automated shut-off valves, and 24/7 staffed monitoring center use signal processing and anomaly detection to catch leaks in real time across main feeds, domestic cold and hot water, HVAC loops, cooling towers, and irrigation systems, reporting 20-25% average water-consumption reduction and up to 90% less water damage and insurance loss. WINT is backed by Insight Partners and carries NSF International, ISO, and USGBC affiliations. During enrichment no public developer API, documentation, well-known discovery surface, OpenAPI, or SDK was found; this profile captures the company's public web properties and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Zeitview
providers.description: Zeitview (formerly DroneBase) is an AI-powered aerial inspection and asset intelligence platform. It combines a managed network of drone and aircraft pilots with computer-vision analytics and lifecycle asset-management software to deliver inspection imagery, condition assessments, and actionable intelligence for wind energy, solar, utilities, oil & gas, construction, commercial real estate, and property management. As of this profile the company operates a customer web platform, support center, and blog but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDK; data access is arranged through direct customer engagement.

providers.name: Agilon Health
providers.description: Agilon Health is a healthcare services company that partners with primary care physicians to transform care for seniors through a value-based, total care model. The company supports physician groups with a platform that combines clinical, operational, and financial capabilities to manage Medicare populations. Agilon Health does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Alpha-9 Oncology
providers.description: Alpha-9 Oncology is a clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company developing targeted radioligand therapies and imaging agents to treat solid and hematologic cancers with high precision. Founded in 2019 and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, the company engineers each molecule — binder, linker, chelator, and radioisotope — through a bespoke, iterative optimization process, and is advancing a pipeline that includes the A9-3202 imaging agent and the Actinium-225-based therapeutic A9-3408 into clinical trials. Alpha-9 is a therapeutics company with no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; it was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead from Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Arden
providers.description: Arden (Arden AI, Inc.) is an AI-native platform for internal audit and SOX compliance teams, backed by Y Combinator and based in San Francisco. Arden builds AI agents that automatically pull evidence from a company's stack, run end-to-end SOX ITGC and business-process control (BPC) testing, follow up with control owners, and produce reviewer-ready workpapers that external auditors will accept - work that historically ran on spreadsheets and screenshots over weeks. The platform advertises read-only access by default with approval gates before any system writes, integrations across 20+ enterprise systems (Workday, Okta, NetSuite, and others), full-population or sample-based control testing with exception flagging, and full traceability from each conclusion back to the source evidence. Arden targets regulated, compliance-critical institutions performing automated SOX 404(a) testing. Arden does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network lead and will be enriched further as a public API surface emerges.

providers.name: Axiom Trust
providers.description: Axiom Trust Company is a vertically integrated trust company and technology platform serving investment advisors, attorneys, trustees, and private families. Founded in 2025 by David Meister and headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, Axiom pairs a regulated corporate trustee with a proprietary data-driven administration platform, using technology to remove the administrative bottleneck of traditional trust administration so named trust officers can focus on fiduciary judgment and family relationships. The company positions itself as infrastructure rather than a competitor for the client relationship: it acts as independent or directed trustee, handles bill pay, notices, distributions, approvals and principal & income accounting, and takes on complex mandates other institutions avoid — closely held entities, private investments, contested situations, and special needs trusts. Axiom raised $11.8M in pre-seed and seed funding led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with Wischoff Ventures, Runa Capital, SNR, Primetime Partners, and Mercury founder Immad Akhund participating. As of this profile Axiom Trust publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts; its client-facing application is a private authenticated web app.

providers.name: BETA Technologies
providers.description: BETA Technologies is a Vermont-based aerospace company that designs and manufactures all-electric aircraft and the supporting electric aviation charging network. BETA produces two variants of its ALIA platform: ALIA CTOL (conventional take-off and landing) and ALIA VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), each carrying a pilot plus five passengers or equivalent cargo, with demonstrated range of 336 nautical miles and sub-hour recharge. BETA's Charge Cube is an interoperable multimodal charger now deployed at sites across the U.S. covering more than 50 million people within 50 miles, and the company operates a 188,000-square-foot net-zero manufacturing facility in South Burlington, Vermont. Customers include UPS, United Therapeutics, the U.S. Air Force and U.S. Army (via AFWERX Agility Prime), Air New Zealand, Bristow, Surf Air Mobility, and other early operators; BETA was selected for seven of the eight FAA eVTOL Integration Pilot Program initiatives.

providers.name: Boardy
providers.description: Boardy is an AI networking agent — an "AI Superconnector" that facilitates meaningful professional introductions. Users message Boardy (via chat and voice) to describe who they want to meet, and it matches them with relevant people from its network, sharing contact details only after both parties explicitly opt in to connect. Boardy is a free consumer product backed by Creandum; it uses public LinkedIn profile information to facilitate introductions and documents its data handling in a GDPR-aligned privacy policy and terms of service. Boardy publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time — its public surface is a marketing site, legal pages, and an llms.txt for AI agents.

providers.name: Breezebio
providers.description: BreezeBio (formerly GenEdit) is a South San Francisco genetic-medicine company developing precision-delivered nucleic acid therapies for autoimmune disease and oncology. Its proprietary NanoGalaxy platform uses non-lipid, hydrophilic polymer nanoparticles of tunable size, charge, and composition to selectively deliver DNA, RNA, and ribonucleoprotein payloads to specific tissues and cell types beyond the liver — including immune cells and targets in the heart, lung, and central nervous system. The company is advancing an internal therapeutic pipeline led by BRZ-101, which aims to restore immune tolerance in type 1 diabetes, and in February 2026 closed a $60M Series B backed by DCVC Bio, Sequoia Capital, and other investors. BreezeBio is a research-stage biopharmaceutical company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile tracks its corporate and identity surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Chronicle Labs
providers.description: Chronicle Labs is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) company building infrastructure for teams running AI agents in production. The platform turns production data into staging environments: it reconstructs real end-to-end workflows from production data streams, generates test scenarios from those workflows, runs agents against replicated production environments (its Backtest Arena), and monitors live agents with autonomous fix and rollback. The pitch is to help engineering teams prove their AI agents work before they ship, replacing hand-built evals and "vibe-deploying" with backtesting against a team's actual operational reality. Typical customers run AI agents in customer service, payments, refunds, and other high-stakes workflows, and Chronicle Labs reports integrating with 100+ production tools. Founded in San Francisco by Ayman Saleh (CEO) and Rowan Zyadeh. At profiling time the product is accessed via a hosted web application behind sign-up; there is no public API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK, and the company publishes an llms.txt at its primary host.

providers.name: Circle K
providers.description: Circle K is a global convenience store and fuel station chain operating more than 14,800 stores worldwide including 9,799 locations in North America and 2,697 in Europe across 48 U.S. states and over 30 countries. A subsidiary of Alimentation Couche-Tard, Circle K operates the Inner Circle Rewards loyalty program, the Easy Pay fuel payment system, an EV charging network, and the Circle K PRO Business Fleet Card.

providers.name: Dewpoint Therapeutics
providers.description: Dewpoint Therapeutics is a biotechnology company applying the emerging science of biomolecular condensates to drug discovery. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, with an additional research site in Dresden, Germany, Dewpoint has built an AI-powered, end-to-end platform (ERSA, powered by ERSAi) spanning target discovery, condensate-modulating (c-mod) drug discovery, optimization, and development. Its pipeline targets previously undruggable diseases across oncology, neurodegeneration, cardiopulmonary, and virology, with collaborations including Bayer, Novo Nordisk, Evotec, and Chemify. Dewpoint is a General Catalyst portfolio company; it operates internal research platforms and the open CD-CODE condensate knowledge platform (condensates.com), but does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Equilibrium Energy
providers.description: Equilibrium Energy is a venture-backed clean energy technology company building PowerOS, an agentic AI platform for the power and energy sector. The platform is designed to solve the extreme data and systems fragmentation across the power tech stack, uniting enterprise data, models, and systems under a common ontology and code frameworks so that power companies can deploy power-specific AI with guardrails they control.
