PowerOS bundles enterprise agents (trader and research copilots, app co-developers, data ingestion and transformation), configurable application suites (portfolio management, portfolio construction, development workbenches, middle and back office), and reusable core services (optimization, forecasting, risk, grid and market fundamentals, trading). The company's Mission Control product is in invite-only beta. Equilibrium Energy is backed by DCVC and is headquartered in the United States. It currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its public web, news, and organization surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Erad
providers.description: Erad is a licensed, Sharia-compliant fintech lender providing fast, flexible working capital to small and medium-sized businesses across Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. Founded in 2022 (Y Combinator S22) and headquartered in Riyadh, Erad offers revenue-based financing, invoice financing (advancing up to 90% of B2B/B2G invoices in as little as 48 hours), and supplier financing to revenue-generating SMEs. The company embeds working-capital products into supplier networks and business platforms, and is backed by investors including Y Combinator, 500 Global, Nuwa Capital, Khwarizmi Ventures, Aljazira Capital, VentureSouq, Oraseya Capital and Joa Capital, alongside debt facilities from Stride Ventures and a $125M asset-backed facility led by Jefferies with Channel Capital.

providers.name: Formation Bio
providers.description: Formation Bio (formerly TrialSpark, rebranded in December 2023) is a New York-based, tech-driven, AI-native pharmaceutical company co-founded by Ben Liu and Linhao Zhang. Rather than discovering molecules, Formation Bio in-licenses and acquires clinical-stage drug assets and runs them through a proprietary, software- and AI-driven development engine that compresses clinical planning, trial execution and regulatory work. That engine is a suite of internal platforms — Delphi (probability-of-technical-success and value modeling), Atlas (clinical-stage asset screening), Forge (autonomous trial design and scenario evaluation), Apollo (trial execution, study startup, enrollment and closeout), ARK (an AI orchestration layer connecting 80+ internal systems behind one governed interface) and a unified Data Platform spanning trial data, real-world patient data, literature and standardized ontologies. The company raised a $372M Series D led by Andreessen Horowitz with participation from Sanofi, and built Muse, an AI patient-recruitment system, with Sanofi and OpenAI. Formation Bio's technology is internal-facing: as of this profile the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, or client SDKs.

providers.name: Frontier Medicines
providers.description: Frontier Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering the discovery and development of small-molecule covalent drugs against disease-causing proteins long considered undruggable. Its proprietary Frontier Platform pairs chemoproteomics with artificial intelligence and machine learning and a proprietary Druggability Atlas that maps thousands of novel covalent binding opportunities across the human proteome. Lead precision oncology candidates include FMC-376 (KRAS G12C), FMC-220 (a p53 Y220C reactivator), and FMC-242 (PI3Kalpha-RAS). Founded in 2018 with offices in Boston, Massachusetts and South San Francisco, California, the company is backed by DCVC and other life-science investors. Frontier Medicines was added to the API Evangelist network as a DCVC portfolio company; it publishes no public API or developer surface, so this profile captures company identity only.

providers.name: Humans&
providers.description: Humans& (humansand.ai) is a human-centric frontier AI lab, publicly announced January 20, 2026, that aims to reimagine artificial intelligence around people and their relationships with one another rather than autonomy alone. The team focuses on long-horizon and multi-agent reinforcement learning, memory, and user understanding, tightly integrating scientific research with product development. Its founding team has led major efforts across frontier industry and academic labs including xAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Meta, Reflection, AI2, Stanford, and MIT. The seed round is led by SV Angel and co-founder Georges Harik, with investors including NVIDIA, Jeff Bezos, GV (Google Ventures), Emerson Collective, Forerunner, S32, DCVC, Bloomberg Beta, and many others. As of this profile the company is in a pre-product announcement phase with no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; it publishes a research blog and intends to contribute back to open source and academic research.

providers.name: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd
providers.description: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd (JISL) is a global agri-industrial conglomerate headquartered in Jalgaon, Maharashtra, India, and is widely cited as the world's largest micro-irrigation company. Founded in 1963 by Padma Shri recipient Bhavarlal Jain under the slogan "More Crop Per Drop," the company manufactures drip and sprinkler irrigation systems, PVC/HDPE/PP and plumbing piping, rigid and foam plastic sheets, solar pumping and photovoltaic systems, tissue-culture planting material, greenhouses and protected cultivation, and processed foods. JISL operates 33 manufacturing bases across four continents, serves 126+ countries through 11,000+ dealers, is listed on the BSE and NSE, and reports turnover exceeding USD 1.2 billion. The company publishes a structured llms.txt for AI crawlers but exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: JMEM
providers.description: JMEM (Jmem Tek) is an upstream semiconductor company specializing in Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) solutions for quantum-resilient cybersecurity. The company designs hardware security intellectual property and provides IC design services, offering products such as JRoot, JPUF, JCrypt, and JShield, along with Zanker, described as the world's first PUF-based post-quantum cryptography (PQC) chip. Its NIST-aligned, quantum-safe encryption and hardware-anchored identity authentication protect chips against counterfeiting and unauthorized modification across UAV, automotive, surveillance, and fintech applications. JMEM is a portfolio company of 500 Global, added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from its public web presence; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Kepler Communications
providers.description: Kepler Communications operates a cloud-based infrastructure network in space, delivering real-time connectivity, on-orbit edge compute, and hosted payload services for satellite operators and space missions. Its offerings include the Kepler Network for space-based data relay and communications, Kepler Compute for on-orbit processing, and hosted payload services that reduce the cost and technical complexity of operating in orbit. Kepler is backed by Canaan Partners, Costanoa Ventures, and Techstars. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK has been identified; services are accessed through the Kepler customer portal and an Atlassian-hosted support service desk.

providers.name: Nimblerx
providers.description: NimbleRx (a Swoop company) is a digital pharmacy technology platform that modernizes the prescription experience for independent and regional pharmacies. Patients use the NimbleRx mobile app to manage prescriptions and schedule discreet delivery or in-store pickup, while pharmacies get digital ordering, mobile checkout, patient communications, marketing, and revenue-optimization tools. Pharmaceutical manufacturers run adherence, abandonment-reduction, and awareness programs on the platform. NimbleRx reports improving medication adherence by 26-40 percent while reducing pharmacist administrative burden. It operates a consumer patient app (patient.nimblerx.com) and a pharmacy admin console (admin.nimblerx.com); as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs. Backed by Y Combinator.

providers.name: nPlan
providers.description: nPlan applies machine learning to construction project schedules to forecast and de-risk large capital projects. Trained on a large corpus of historical project schedules, its products (nPlan Insights Pro and nPlan Portfolio) analyze programme risk, benchmark schedules against similar projects, and surface the interventions most likely to keep delivery on time and on budget, with a Power BI integration for portfolio-level project controls. nPlan is a private enterprise SaaS company backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Obsidian Therapeutics
providers.description: Obsidian Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing engineered cell and gene therapies built on its proprietary cytoDRiVE platform, which uses drug-responsive domains to regulate therapeutic protein function with an FDA-approved small molecule. Its lead program, OBX-115, is in Phase 2 trials for advanced melanoma. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a life-sciences company with no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: OurHealthMate
providers.description: OurHealthMate was an Indian digital health-tech startup (a 500 Global / 500 Startups portfolio company) that let non-resident Indians book medical appointments, health checkups, and lab tests at hospitals and clinics across India on behalf of family members. The ourhealthmate.com domain now permanently redirects (HTTP 301) to myfitnesswallet.com, a corporate wellness platform operating in India and Singapore that delivers employee wellness programs, telemedicine, health risk assessments, health screenings, and mental-wellness services to enterprise clients. No public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface could be found for either brand as of this enrichment pass; this remains an identity-only company profile in the API Evangelist network with no API artifacts to harvest.

providers.name: Phreesia
providers.description: Phreesia is a patient intake, registration, scheduling, payments, and engagement platform for healthcare organizations, powering more than 150 million patient visits annually. It delivers digital check-in, mobile intake and consent forms in 20+ languages, logic-driven patient interviews, real-time insurance eligibility verification, and patient payments, and pushes the resulting data back into the provider's systems of record. Phreesia is not a self-serve public API product - it is an enterprise platform whose integrations are delivered by a dedicated interoperability team using open healthcare standards (HL7v2, FHIR, CCD, CSV) alongside proprietary APIs and data extracts, with bidirectional interfaces into EHR/EMR, PM, HIE, data warehouse, and data lake systems (Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, Oracle Health/Cerner, Veradigm, Meditech, ModMed, and more). There is no publicly documented developer portal, API reference, or self-service key registration as of this writing; the API surface below is modeled from Phreesia's published product and integration capabilities, not from public reference documentation.

providers.name: Physicsx
providers.description: PhysicsX is an AI-native engineering software company, founded in 2020 and headquartered in London (Shoreditch) with an office in New York, building a platform that embeds physics AI directly into industrial engineering and manufacturing workflows. The platform unifies simulation, physics AI, data, and engineering applications into a single foundation, pairing fast AI-driven physics inference (Deep Physics Models) with numerical simulation to compress development cycles and expand the design space engineers can explore. It integrates with industry-standard CAE/CAD tooling (ANSYS, CATIA, Siemens NX, OpenFOAM, Siemens Star-CCM+), runs cloud-agnostically across AWS and Azure plus hybrid and on-premises deployments, and serves aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy and renewables. Born out of Formula One, PhysicsX has raised roughly $489M across five rounds from investors including General Catalyst, Atomico, Temasek, NVIDIA, Siemens, and Applied Materials. There is no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures the company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Pronto
providers.description: Pronto is an on-demand and subscription-based house-help marketplace operating across 11 Indian cities (including Mumbai, Bangalore, Delhi, Hyderabad, and Pune). It connects urban homes with trained, background-verified Pronto Professionals for everyday household chores such as cleaning, laundry, kitchen prep, bathroom care, ironing, dusting, and window cleaning. Customers book in the Pronto mobile app (iOS and Android) for instant (a Pro in ~15 minutes), scheduled, or recurring service, and pay in-app; the withpronto.com website is the marketing surface while the booking flow runs in the app. Pronto is backed by Bain Capital Ventures and General Catalyst. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; the only machine-readable surface is a provider-published llms.txt.

providers.name: Rallybio
providers.description: Rallybio Corporation (NASDAQ RLYB) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in New Haven, Connecticut, founded in 2018, developing and commercializing life-transforming therapies for patients with severe and rare diseases. Its pipeline spans maternal-fetal health, complement dysregulation, hematology, and metabolic disorders, led by RLYB116, a differentiated complement component 5 (C5) inhibitor, and RLYB332, a long-acting matriptase-2 (MTP-2) antibody for iron-overload disorders. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a pharmaceutical company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures corporate identity only.

providers.name: Reliable Robotics
providers.description: Reliable Robotics is a California-based aerospace company developing continuous autopilot and remote piloting systems that retrofit existing fixed-wing aircraft for automated and remotely supervised flight across all phases (taxi, take-off, cruise, landing). The company has flown automated Cessna 208 Caravan demonstrations including a fully uncrewed take-off and landing in 2023, and is pursuing FAA Part 23 supplemental type certification for its automation system. Reliable Robotics has contracts with the U.S. Air Force AFWERX program and the Defense Innovation Unit to evaluate automated cargo and ISR missions on platforms including the Cessna 208, and has partnered with Textron Aviation on certification work. The company's founders are alumni of SpaceX and Tesla autopilot teams. Reliable Robotics is partner- and government-gated and does not currently offer public consumer or developer APIs.

providers.name: ReqBin
providers.description: ReqBin is an online HTTP/REST API client for testing API requests directly from the browser without plugins or software installation. It supports all HTTP methods, custom headers, request bodies, authentication schemes, and code generation for multiple languages. ReqBin is widely used by developers to test REST APIs, debug HTTP requests, and generate code snippets for API integration.

providers.name: Sett AI
providers.description: Sett AI is a creative performance AI platform for mobile game user acquisition (UA), offering "agentic AI" that helps game studios and performance-marketing teams research, generate, analyze, and deploy video and playable ad creatives at scale to combat creative fatigue. Sett agents connect to ad networks (Meta, Google, AppLovin, Unity, Mintegral) and MMP data to ideate concepts, generate playables and videos, and analyze creative performance. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners; the company raised a Series B bringing total funding to $57M. Sett operates a marketing and product website but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface as of this profiling.

providers.name: Supernal
providers.description: Supernal is the Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) company of Hyundai Motor Group, headquartered in Washington, D.C. with engineering operations in California. Supernal is developing the SA-2, an all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft unveiled at CES 2024, designed for short urban and regional trips with a pilot and four passengers, targeting commercial entry later this decade pending FAA Type Certification. Supernal leverages Hyundai Motor Group capabilities in design, manufacturing, batteries, motors, and software, and envisions an integrated AAM ecosystem of vertiports, sky corridors, and last-mile connectivity through robotaxis and rideshare. Supernal is hardware- and ecosystem-focused with no public consumer or developer APIs at this stage.

providers.name: The Feed
providers.description: The Feed is an online sports nutrition store for endurance athletes, stocking products from more than 300 brands across fuel, hydration, supplements, and recovery. Founded by Matt Johnson while managing a Tour de France cycling team, it sells gels, chews, and drink mixes as single servings so athletes can test products without committing to full boxes, offers AutoShip subscriptions and a Feed First membership, and is the official nutrition partner of USA Triathlon. The company builds personalized fueling plans around before/during/after-workout nutrition, tested with input from over 200,000 athletes. It is a consumer e-commerce brand (Shopify storefront) with no public developer API; its machine-readable surfaces are a published llms.txt and a Google Merchant product feed.

providers.name: Thyme Care
providers.description: Thyme Care is a value-based oncology care-navigation and support company that partners with health plans, providers, and employers to guide people through a cancer diagnosis and treatment. Its virtual oncology care team and navigators help members access care, coordinate with treating physicians, manage symptoms and side effects, understand costs, and improve outcomes across the cancer journey. Thyme Care delivers this through partner programs (Thyme Care Connect, Thyme Care Signal, Thyme Box, and Enhanced Supportive Care) rather than a public developer platform. As of this enrichment pass, no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or /.well-known API-discovery surface were found for Thyme Care; it is profiled here as a company, not an API provider.

providers.name: TimeTrace Labs
providers.description: TimeTrace Labs is a London-based mathematics and artificial intelligence company building the measurement layer for healthcare, spun out of a decade of research at the University of Oxford and backed by Seedcamp and Fly Ventures. Its quantitative measurement platform separates signal from noise in multimodal physiological time-series (kinematics, EEG, ECG, actigraphy, glucose, voice), powering analytics for drug development, clinical trials, and public health that the company delivers to partners through secure APIs and a compliant analytics dashboard — though it publishes no public developer portal or API documentation yet.

providers.name: Totus Medicines
providers.description: Totus Medicines is a biopharmaceutical company developing precision oral medicines against historically "undruggable" disease targets. The company's OmniDEL discovery platform screens targets in their normal cellular environment to identify potent, selective covalent small molecules, drawing on precedents like penicillin and AZT. Totus is advancing a pipeline focused on oncology and immunology & inflammation (I&I), including TOS-358, a covalent PI3Ka inhibitor, and a first-in-class covalent IRF5 inhibitor in clinical development. Headquartered in Emeryville, California, Totus was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As a clinical-stage drug-discovery company, Totus publishes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate identity, web properties, and security posture.

providers.name: Unchained Labs
providers.description: Unchained Labs is a life-science tools company that designs, manufactures, and sells analytical instruments, automation, and consumables for biologics, gene therapy, cell therapy, nanoparticle, exosome, and genomics research. Its product line includes plate-based systems for protein characterization, concentration and quantification (Lunatic and Stunner), protein stability and formulation (Uncle), automated buffer exchange and sample prep (Big Tuna, Little Big Tuna), viscosity measurement, and lipid-nanoparticle synthesis and analysis. The company serves biopharma R&D, process development, and QC labs. Unchained Labs is primarily a hardware, reagent, and lab-software vendor; as of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, REST/GraphQL surface, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and enriched with verified company identity and link properties from its public website.

providers.name: Virtual Internship Partners
providers.description: Virtual Internships (Virtual Internship Partners) is a global EdTech platform that connects learners, universities, and host companies to deliver guaranteed remote internships across career fields including finance, legal, healthcare, media and communications, supply chain, hospitality, real estate, HR, and sustainability. Backed by 500 Global, it pairs students and graduates with mentored, project-based work experience at companies worldwide. Added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio and enriched by the pipeline; the company publishes a marketing website and a Rank Math llms.txt but exposes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Volocopter
providers.description: Volocopter is a German urban air mobility company developing electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft for passenger and cargo use. Its product portfolio includes VoloCity, a two-seat multicopter air taxi pursued under EASA SC-VTOL certification; VoloRegion, a longer-range fixed-wing transition design for inter-city flights; VoloDrone, a heavy-lift cargo drone; and VoloIQ, a digital operations platform built on Microsoft Azure for fleet, route, and vertiport management. Volocopter has demonstrated flights in numerous cities including Paris, Singapore, Seoul, and Dubai, and worked toward operations around the Paris 2024 Olympics. The company experienced significant financial restructuring in 2024-2025 and ownership changes affecting commercial timelines; current status should be verified against the latest newsroom updates.

providers.name: Zag Bio
providers.description: Zag Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing thymus-targeted therapies for autoimmune diseases. The company engineers bifunctional antibodies that deliver self-antigens to antigen-presenting cells in the thymus, harnessing the body's natural process of central immune tolerance so developing immune cells learn to recognize, tolerate, and protect the body's own tissues. Its pipeline includes ZAG-101, a candidate for Type 1 Diabetes. Founded and incubated by Polaris Partners, Zag Bio launched publicly in October 2025 with an $80M Series A. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio company; as a therapeutics developer it publishes no public API or developer platform at this time.

providers.name: 6K
providers.description: 6K Inc is a North Andover, Massachusetts advanced-materials company that produces engineered powders and battery materials with UniMelt, its patented microwave-based production-scale plasma system. Named for the roughly 6,000 K plasma temperature it operates at — the temperature of the surface of the sun — UniMelt uses tightly controlled thermal plasma beams to melt or vaporize precursor feedstock into particles with precise size distribution and crystalline phase, in seconds rather than the days conventional processes require, while cutting energy use and eliminating wastewater. The company operates through two divisions. 6K Additive, with production in Burgettstown, Pennsylvania, makes sustainably sourced metal powders for additive manufacturing — titanium Ti-6Al-4V, nickel superalloys Ni625 and Ni718, stainless SS316L, refractory tungsten, niobium C103, copper C18150 and the HEA1000 refractory alloy — reclaiming CNC scrap and revert metal into premium AM powder. 6K Energy produces domestically sourced lithium-ion battery cathode and solid-state materials including NMC, LFP, LLZO, LMO, LTO and LNMO. Additional applications span semiconductor CMP, specialty ceramics, advanced coatings, lighting and display materials, nano-engineered powders, and federal/defense programs; 6K has received US Department of Defense and Department of Energy awards for domestic critical-materials capacity. 6K is a privately held company whose shares trade on secondary markets. Enrichment probing on 2026-07-31 found no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, developer portal, SDK, MCP server, agent card, or event surface — 6K is a materials manufacturer, not an API provider.

providers.name: 99.co
providers.description: 99.co (99 Group) is a Singapore-headquartered real estate technology company and one of the largest property marketplaces in Southeast Asia. Founded in 2014 by Darius Cheung, Yan Phun and Conor McLaughlin, it operates consumer property portals across Singapore and Indonesia, including 99.co and SRX.com.sg in Singapore and 99.co/id and Rumah123.com in Indonesia. The platform lets buyers, renters and agents search HDB resale flats, executive condos, condominiums, landed homes and new-launch projects for sale and rent, with map-based search, transaction data, agent directories, mortgage tools and nearby-amenity insights (MRT, schools, commute times). 99 Group is backed by investors including Sequoia Capital, 500 Global, Golden Gate Ventures, Quest Ventures and East Ventures. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; 99.co exposes consumer web products but publishes no first-party public developer API or portal at this time.

providers.name: Abaxx
providers.description: Abaxx Technologies is a financial software and market infrastructure company whose principal operating business, Abaxx Exchange, is a centrally-cleared commodity futures and derivatives exchange headquartered in Singapore and focused on energy-transition commodities across four markets: Energy (LNG), Environmental (carbon credits), Battery Materials (nickel, lithium), and Precious Metals. Abaxx Clearing (Abaxx Singapore Clearing Corporation) centrally clears the contracts, and the group also develops SMX (smart data / consensus-formation) technology. Trading runs on the markets.abaxx.exchange platform; market data is distributed to third parties including TradingView (ABAXX: symbol prefix), ipushpull (Microsoft Excel add-in) and LSEG/Refinitiv. Abaxx Technologies is publicly listed (Cboe Canada: ABXX; OTCQX: ABXXF). Abaxx does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI/FIX specification, SDKs or an MCP server; connectivity is arranged through member/broker onboarding. This profile originated as an earlybird portfolio lead in the API Evangelist network and has been enriched with verified public identity and security-posture signals.

providers.name: Acts Retirement-Life Communities
providers.description: Acts Retirement-Life Communities is a not-for-profit operator of continuing care retirement communities (CCRCs) headquartered in West Point, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1972, Acts operates 28 senior living campuses across nine Mid-Atlantic and Southeastern U.S. states (Alabama, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, New Jersey, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, South Carolina) and serves approximately 10,000 residents. Its core service lines are independent living for adults 55+, assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing, short-term rehabilitation, and on-campus health services delivered under the Acts Life Care contract model. Acts publishes no public developer APIs, no OpenAPI specifications, no SDKs, and no developer portal — its digital surface consists of a marketing website, a community directory, an iCIMS-hosted careers portal at careers-actslife.icims.com, and a separate health-services marketing site at actshealthservices.org. This repository documents the organization and its likely senior-living IT vendor stack for ecosystem mapping purposes; it does not document a developer API surface because none is published.

providers.name: ATB Financial
providers.description: ATB Financial (formerly Alberta Treasury Branches) is a financial institution and Crown corporation wholly owned by the Government of Alberta, established in 1938 and operating under the provincial ATB Financial Act rather than the federal Bank Act. Headquartered in Edmonton, it is Alberta's largest home-grown financial institution and the largest public bank in North America, with roughly C$64 billion in assets, more than 800,000 customers, about 5,000 team members, and 300+ branches and agencies across the province; deposits are guaranteed by the Province of Alberta rather than covered by CDIC. On the open-finance front, ATB does NOT operate a public first-party developer portal or documented public API surface (developer.atb.com returns HTTP 404), and Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (legislated in Budget 2024 and the Fall Economic Statement 2024, with the FCAC as overseer) is not yet operational. Consumer financial-data access to ATB today is therefore voluntary and aggregator-mediated — reached through third-party aggregators such as Finicity (by Mastercard) and Flinks rather than a direct bank API.

providers.name: Bloom
providers.description: Bloom was a decentralized identity, credit-attestation and verifiable-credentials company backed by Pantera Capital, built on Ethereum and IPFS around three products: BloomID (identity attestation), BloomIQ (a credit registry) and BloomScore (credit risk scoring). Its stated aim was to let traditional and digital-currency lenders serve people who cannot obtain a bank account or a credit score, and it announced a TransUnion partnership in 2020 for consumer credit monitoring. Bloom is wound down. Its integration SDKs were archived on GitHub in 2021, its API, documentation and status hosts no longer resolve, bloom.co now redirects to a domain-broker sale listing, and Bloom HoldCo LLC filed a Form 15-12G on 2025-08-14 terminating Exchange Act registration of its BLT token with holders of record stated as "none". What survives is open source: 40 public repositories under github.com/hellobloom and 19 unmaintained but installable npm packages under the @bloomprotocol scope implementing the W3C and DIF decentralized-identity stack (Verifiable Credentials, DIDs, Presentation Exchange, Credential Manifest, WACI).

providers.name: Brown-Forman
providers.description: Brown-Forman Corporation is one of the largest American-owned spirits and wine companies in the world, established in 1870 and headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky. The company produces, bottles, imports, exports, markets, and sells a wide variety of alcoholic beverages under brands including Jack Daniel's, Woodford Reserve, Old Forester, Herradura, El Jimador, Slane Irish Whiskey, Benriach, Chambord, Diplomático, and Ford's Gin. Brown-Forman is traded on the NYSE under tickers BF.A and BF.B.

providers.name: Cargo X
providers.description: Cargo X (CargoX) is a Sao Paulo based Brazilian logistics technology and fintech company, founded in 2013, that operates one of Brazil's largest digital freight marketplaces - matching shippers (embarcadores) with carriers (transportadoras) and independent truck drivers. Beyond freight brokerage the platform provides dedicated freight desk operations, driver qualification and real-time cargo monitoring, automated issuance of Brazilian transport tax documents (CT-e and MDF-e), cargo insurance, receivables financing and working-capital credit for carriers, and green-freight / ESG programs that reduce empty return trips. The company reached unicorn status with a USD 200M Series F in October 2021 co-led by Tencent and SoftBank, with Valor Capital Group, Lightrock and Oikos participating.

providers.name: CargoWise
providers.description: CargoWise is WiseTech Global's logistics execution platform - a single-database ERP for international freight forwarding, customs, warehousing, transport, and landside logistics. Its integration surface is delivered primarily through eAdaptor, which pairs a RESTful XML inbound service (push, query, add, and update records) with a SOAP-based outbound service (a webhook equivalent that emits messages on milestones). Payloads use CargoWise's Universal XML schemas - Universal Shipment (XUS), Universal Event (XUE), and Universal Transaction - or the legacy Native XML format. Newer REST integration (eAdaptor Next / xHub) adds OAuth 2.0 authorization-code access. The integration API is real but heavily gated - the eAdaptor Developers Guide and endpoint details are released only after a customer purchases the eAdaptor modules, and partner access runs through WiseTech accreditation and certification. Endpoints below are modeled from public developer references; the authoritative specification is not publicly published.

providers.name: Cognizant Technology Solutions
providers.description: Cognizant Technology Solutions is a multinational information technology services and consulting company that provides digital, technology, consulting, and operations services to clients worldwide. Cognizant does not publish a general-purpose public REST API. Its developer-facing footprint is centered on the Cognizant Neuro AI platform family (Neuro AI Decisioning, Neuro AI Enterprise Core, Neuro AI Engineering, Neuro AI for IT Operations) and the open-source Neuro SAN multi-agent orchestration framework released by Cognizant AI Lab. Other delivered platforms (BigFrame for mainframe data migration, ADM accelerators, industry vertical solutions) are typically engaged via consulting engagements rather than self-service APIs.

providers.name: CommerceIQ
providers.description: CommerceIQ is an AI-powered ecommerce platform that helps consumer brands win in algorithmic retail across sales, digital shelf, retail media, and content execution. Its unified platform, Ally AI, packages four AI agents (Content, Shelf, Media, and Sales) that optimize product content and SEO, monitor digital-shelf availability and search rankings across 1,450+ retailers globally, manage and automate retail media bidding and spend, and forecast and execute sales strategy from Amazon and Walmart to Instacart and Criteo. Founded in 2019, CommerceIQ serves enterprise brands including PepsiCo, P&G, Coca-Cola, and Colgate-Palmolive, and is backed by Insight Partners, SoftBank Vision Fund, and Trinity Ventures. The company operates as a managed enterprise platform and does not publish a public self-service API or developer portal.

providers.name: Concentrix
providers.description: Concentrix is a global technology and services leader providing customer experience (CX) management, digital transformation, and technology consulting across approximately 2,000 brands worldwide. Its product suite spans the iX product line (including iX Hello and iX Hero agentic AI assistants) and the Catalyst experience transformation and technology consultancy. Concentrix does not publish a public developer API; the iX product suite and Catalyst services are delivered via managed engagements and enterprise integrations rather than a self-service developer portal.

providers.name: Conduct
providers.description: Conduct is an AI operating system for enterprise software that helps IT teams understand, modernise, and run their core systems, with a particular emphasis on SAP landscapes. The platform reads underlying code, configuration, business rules, and custom code to reveal dependencies and system architecture, automates development workflows from planning through deployment, and accelerates system migrations (including S/4HANA) with fit-gap analysis. Conduct integrates with systems of record such as SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Confluence, and Jira. Backed by Creandum and Index Ventures, it raised a $60M Series A in 2026 and was named an SAP Strategic AI Partner. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; Conduct sells through a demo-led, non-self-service model and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Curaleaf Holdings
providers.description: The largest cannabis company in the world by revenue operating cultivation, processing, and retail dispensary operations. Operates in multiple U.S. states and international markets producing cannabis flower, pre-rolls, edibles, and vape products under leading brands.

providers.name: Divine
providers.description: Divine Research Inc. is a fintech company building blockchain-based unsecured lending for underserved borrowers in emerging markets. Its flagship product, Credit, issues small stablecoin (USDC) loans that start small and can grow to $1,000 as borrowers build trust, with algorithmically set interest rates and default rates that have approached zero. Borrowers access loans through a World MiniApp, while liquidity providers supply capital and earn yield through the Credit Vault at credit.cash. As of late 2024 the platform had issued hundreds of thousands of loans to more than 500,000 borrowers. Divine is backed by Paradigm and was surfaced through its portfolio; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network. Divine currently publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Erudifi
providers.description: ErudiFi (ErudiFi Pte. Ltd., formerly Dana Cita Pte. Ltd., a Singapore-registered company) is an education-financing technology company on a mission to expand access to affordable financial services for students across Southeast Asia. It operates two consumer lending platforms: Bukas in the Philippines, which provides secure, integrated tuition installment plans in partnership with top colleges and universities, and Danacita in Indonesia, a peer-to-peer education-financing platform registered with the OJK that funds diploma, bachelor's, master's, and short-course programs. ErudiFi is backed by investors including 500 Global and Helicap. The company maintains a small public GitHub presence (internal tooling, a data-quality checker, and a Danacita UI kit) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or MCP server.

providers.name: Evermore
providers.description: Evermore (formerly Soda Health, rebranded in October 2025) is a Chicago-based healthcare technology company, founded in 2021, that administers "Smart Benefits" — supplemental benefit programs connecting Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial health-plan members to the products and services they need. Its Smart Benefits card restricts spending to eligible items at the point of sale (item-level adjudication) across categories such as healthy food, OTC medications, transportation, and utilities, and can hold separate funds per benefit type. Evermore partners with payers, health plans, and a retail network (including grocers such as Save A Lot) to deliver consumer-directed health (CDH) accounts, Medicare Advantage supplemental benefits, Medicaid value-added benefits, and ICHRA administration through an API-based platform. The company runs a HIPAA/CMS-compliant program and is backed by General Catalyst, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Qiming, Define Ventures, and SVB Capital.

providers.name: EZ Farming
providers.description: EZ Farming is an agriculture investment and farm-ownership platform that lets individuals start or co-own a working farm without doing the day-to-day work themselves. Members can buy land in the EZFarming farm estate, join a farmer cooperative to co-own a farm alongside other investors, buy produce directly from managed farms, or invest in agricultural projects for returns. Backed by 500 Global, the company packages land acquisition, farm management, and produce offtake into a single managed offering aimed at first-time farm owners and agriculture investors.

providers.name: Fetcherr
providers.description: Fetcherr is an Israel-based AI technology company (founded 2019, Netanya) building generative-AI decision systems for the aviation industry. Its core is the Large Market Model (LMM), a generative model trained on internal airline data plus external signals (competitor prices, demand, weather, events, economic indicators) to forecast markets and drive real-time business decisions. Fetcherr productizes the LMM as a Generative Pricing Engine (GPE) for dynamic airline pricing and as ALPHA, a cloud-based retailing and inventory-management platform that integrates with existing airline PSS and legacy infrastructure. Customers include Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Azul, and Viva Aerobus. Fetcherr is an enterprise B2B vendor and does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or self-serve credentials; integration is delivered directly to airline customers. Added to the API Evangelist network as a battery-ventures portfolio company.

providers.name: GetApp
providers.description: GetApp is a free online resource that helps small businesses find, compare, and choose the best business software for their needs across hundreds of categories.

providers.name: Instalily
providers.description: InstaLILY builds Lily, an AI "Forward Deployed Engineer" for the physical and regulated economy. Lily learns how an enterprise operates, builds custom software agents for high-friction operational work such as quoting, routing, field service, and approvals, and runs them inside the systems companies already use including SAP, NetSuite, Epicor, Salesforce, HubSpot, and Snowflake. InstaLILY serves industrial distribution and MRO, manufacturing and OEM, field service, healthcare and pharma, and private equity. The company is headquartered at 455 Broadway, New York, and is backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Jane (iHeartJane)
providers.description: Jane Technologies (iHeartJane) is a cannabis ecommerce and marketplace platform that powers real-time online menus, point-of-sale and kiosk checkout, order and reservation flows, and the Jane Universal Product Catalog for 2,500+ dispensaries and brands across the United States and Canada. Jane exposes a documented HTTP API (the Jane API, published as Swagger at api.iheartjane.com/jane-api-docs) for retrieving live store menu products and generating access tokens, and a partner Digital Merchandising SDK (Jane DM SDK) for embedding MyHigh-powered personalization and sponsored-product widgets into a retailer's own menu. Both surfaces are partner-gated - access requires approval and credentials from a Jane account representative - so the endpoints listed here are modeled from Jane's public documentation rather than exercised against a live, open, unauthenticated API.

providers.name: JetZero
providers.description: JetZero is a Long Beach, California aerospace company founded in 2021 by Tom O'Leary and Mark Page to bring the blended wing body (all-wing) airframe to commercial aviation. Its flagship program is the Z4, a 250-seat, international-range jetliner the company says will burn up to 50% less fuel than comparable tube-and-wing airliners, and the Jet1 full-scale demonstrator being built with Scaled Composites in Mojave, California ahead of a first flight targeted for 2027. JetZero broke ground in 2026 on a manufacturing and final-assembly campus in Greensboro, North Carolina and is opening an engineering office in Wichita, Kansas at NIAR. It is backed by the U.S. Air Force, NASA, United Airlines, Alaska Star Ventures and a $175M Series B led by B Capital, with letters of intent from Gulf Air and Japan Airlines. JetZero is an aircraft manufacturer, not a software or data provider: as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, no API documentation, no SDKs, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its public technical surface is a supplier registration and supplier standards program.

providers.name: Jive
providers.description: Jive (marketed today as "Jive AI" and owned by IgniteTech, an ESW Capital company based in Austin, Texas) is an enterprise collaboration and communication platform — a digital workplace that unifies people, knowledge, and content across departments and locations for large, often regulated organizations. Capabilities include collaboration spaces and group discussions, knowledge management with search and co-editing, personalized role-based news feeds, mobile and desktop apps, and engagement analytics. Jive originated as a venture-backed (Kleiner Perkins) enterprise-social vendor that IPO'd in 2011 and shipped a REST API plus an official Node.js add-on SDK. It was later acquired into the Aurea / ESW Capital / IgniteTech family.

providers.name: Jobvetta
providers.description: Jobvetta is a jobs API for India — live openings gathered and checked against official employer sources, exposed as a REST API and a hosted MCP server that share one key. Search by keyword, Indian city or state, and posting age; fetch full structured detail for a single job. It is India-only by design: non-Indian locations return no results. The MCP server answers tools/list without credentials, so an agent can discover the two tools before signing up, and installation is a single documented `claude mcp add` command. Free during early access, with a shared limit of 50 tool calls per day and up to 20 jobs per search across both surfaces.

providers.name: Khatabook
providers.description: Khatabook is a Bengaluru, India-based fintech company building a mobile-first digital ledger ("bahi khata") and business management platform for India's 6.3 crore-strong MSME sector. Founded in 2018 by Ravish Naresh, Vaibhav Kalpe, Dhanesh Kumar, and Jaideep Poonia, its flagship Khatabook Android app lets shopkeepers and small merchants record credit transactions ("udhaar"), send free WhatsApp/SMS payment reminders, collect payments via UPI and QR codes, and generate ledger statements — replacing the paper notebook ("khata") historically used across Indian retail. The app has been downloaded over 50 million times and is offered in 13+ Indian languages. Khatabook's portfolio also includes Cashbook (cash-in/cash-out tracking), Pagarkhata/Pagarbook (staff attendance and salary management), Biz Analyst (Tally mobility for accountants, acquired in 2021 for ~$10M), and a suite of GST, EMI, income tax, payroll, and loan calculators. The company has raised roughly $190M across seed through Series C from Sequoia Capital, Tencent, DST Global, GGV Capital, Y Combinator, B Capital, Moore Strategic Ventures, and angels including MS Dhoni, valuing it around $600M. Khatabook monetizes via SMB lending tie-ups, premium business tools, and adjacent fintech distribution. The Khatabook GitHub organization (verified, owns khatabook.com) exists but has no public repositories, and the company does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI spec, or partner program — its surface is a consumer/SMB mobile app rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Koska
providers.description: KOSKA Corporation (株式会社KOSKA) is a Tokyo-based manufacturing technology company, founded in October 2018, that applies cost accounting and IoT to the Japanese factory floor. Its flagship product GenKan (原価管理自動化サービス) automates cost management for high-mix low-volume manufacturers: RFID and power sensors installed on existing equipment capture work progress and consumption without changing operator behavior, then make processing cost, material cost, and electricity cost visible line by line, feeding real actual-cost figures and KPI setting back to the shop floor and management. A second product, ながら記録 (Nagara Kiroku / "vScribe"), is an AI record-keeping app for manufacturing, construction, and logistics sites — photograph a paper form and AI generates the input form, then operators record hands-free by speaking, with the AI parsing natural speech into structured records, inspections, and reports. KOSKA is led by CEO Kenichiro Sone (Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia 2021) and advised by Hiroshi Obata, former chair of the Japan Cost Accounting Association. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal — it is a sensor-and-SaaS product company, not an API provider.

providers.name: LAMMA Toscana Open Data
providers.description: LAMMA Toscana Open Data is a government agency open-data portal for Italy running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 184 datasets from Tuscany's meteorological and environmental research agency.

providers.name: Level AI
providers.description: Level AI (legally Ujwal Inc.) is a Mountain View, California contact center AI company founded in 2019 by Ashish Nagar, a former member of Amazon's Alexa conversational AI team. The company builds LLM-native customer experience intelligence and service automation for enterprise contact centers, with a platform spanning two product surfaces: a CX Delivery suite (AI Virtual Agent, Agent Assist, AgentGPT, Coaching, Manager Assist, Knowledge Bot, Auto Summary, Agent Screen Recording) and a CX Strategy suite (Auto-QA on 100% of interactions, Voice of the Customer theme detection, omnichannel Analytics, iCSAT, AI Workers). The proprietary full-stack AI platform includes Level AI's own ASR/Voice AI and semantic-intelligence layer trained on customer-service data, and is positioned for financial services, insurance, healthcare, retail, banking, and collections operations. Level AI exposes a public REST API for bidirectional data exchange with BI tools and existing contact center stacks, and ships native integrations across telephony, CRM, customer support, workforce management, CX management, communication, learning management, and SSO categories. The company has raised $73.1M to date (Series A 2021, Series B 2022 led by Battery Ventures, Series C $39.4M 2024 led by Adams Street Partners with Cross Creek, Brightloop, Battery Ventures and Eniac Ventures), holds a 4.7/5 rating on G2, and reports customer outcomes including 25% CSAT lift, 45% agent satisfaction improvement, and 90% time savings on manual QA. The Level AI GitHub organization (github.com/Level-AI) exists but is currently empty — there is no public OpenAPI specification, public SDK, or open-source release; the API is documented and credentialed through the customer's tenant of the Level AI platform.

providers.name: Monto
providers.description: Monto is a B2B payments platform that automates supplier-side billing and collection across customer accounts-payable (AP) portals. It connects suppliers to 500+ AP platforms, using AI to deliver and format invoices per portal, verify data, match invoices to purchase orders, track invoice and payment status in real time, and retrieve remittance details end to end. Integrations include a NetSuite bundle (Send to Monto), generic ERP integration, and email or web upload. Monto reports $10B+ collected across 67 countries. The company is SOC 2 Type II audited. Monto is backed by Scale Venture Partners. This profile has no public developer API or documentation surface as of enrichment.

providers.name: NextSilicon
providers.description: NextSilicon is a deep-tech compute company building intelligent, software-defined acceleration hardware for high-performance computing, AI, and vector-database workloads. Its flagship Maverick-2 is a dataflow accelerator built on the Intelligent Compute Architecture (ICA) that reconfigures itself at runtime, and its Arbel product is a server-class RISC-V CPU core on TSMC process. A developer toolchain supports C/C++, FORTRAN, OpenMP, and Kokkos, with planned CUDA and HIP/ROCm paths, letting teams run existing code faster without rewrites or vendor lock-in. NextSilicon publishes no public web API, SDK registry package, or open developer portal; its documentation site is gated, so this profile captures company identity, its GitHub organization (largely upstream compiler/Kokkos forks), and domain-security posture.

providers.name: OVIA
providers.description: OVIA is listed via wepow.com, the domain of Wepow, a video-interviewing and candidate-assessment startup backed by 500 Global. Wepow is now part of Harver, a Talent Intelligence platform offering pre-employment assessments, automated interview scheduling, video interviewing, game-based assessments (pymetrics), and reference checking (Checkster). wepow.com 301-redirects to harver.com, and the served /.well-known documents and llms.txt are Harver's. This entry has no independent, self-service public API surface; enrichment captured the live security, well-known, and AI-governance signals published on the domain.

providers.name: PIN
providers.description: PIN (getpin.xyz) is a fintech platform that makes it easy to launch and operate an investment club or syndicate, handling the administrative, legal, and tax work for group startup investments so a community can pool capital and invest in VC-backed startups together. Members onboard in a few simple steps, commit to deals, vote, and PIN manages the tax filings and portfolio support for the lifecycle of the club. PIN is venture-backed by Initialized, NEA, Industry Ventures and others. As of this enrichment pass PIN publishes only a marketing site and a member web app (app.getpin.xyz); no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface was found.

providers.name: Pixis
providers.description: Pixis is an AI-powered advertising and marketing platform for consumer brands, built on proprietary codeless AI infrastructure that plans, creates, and optimizes digital advertising across channels. Its products include Prism (campaign performance optimization and cross-channel analytics), Adroom (generative AI creative production for ad assets), and Visibility (AI-search presence tracking and optimization). Pixis connects directly to marketing and ad platforms such as Google, Meta, and Salesforce to automate media buying, creative generation, and performance optimization from one place. The company is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, with engineering operations in India. Pixis does not publish a public developer API or documentation; it is an enterprise, demo-led SaaS platform.

providers.name: PlantShop.me
providers.description: PlantShop.me (operated by Lamento Trading LLC, Dubai) is the largest online plant store in the Middle East, selling indoor and outdoor plants, pots and planters, seeds, terrariums, fertilizers and plant-care accessories with UAE-wide delivery and localized shipping to Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and Kuwait. It offers cash on delivery, same-week delivery, and free plant-care support from a real team. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes no public developer API; its machine-readable surface is a first-party /llms.txt AI overview, an AI-crawler-friendly robots.txt, and schema.org structured data on product pages.

providers.name: Polycom
providers.description: Polycom, Inc. was a pioneer of unified communications and video conferencing, known for its RealPresence video collaboration platform, SoundStation conference phones, and Group Series and HDX room video endpoints. Polycom merged with Plantronics in 2018 to form Poly, which HP acquired in 2022; the polycom.com domain now redirects to HP's Poly product line. For developers, Polycom exposed the RealPresence Platform REST API (via the RealPresence Resource Manager and Distributed Media Application, later branded Clariti) along with device REST APIs on its VideoOS endpoints, enabling programmatic conference control, scheduling, provisioning, resource monitoring, and billing integration. Developer resources are now consolidated under HP's Poly developer portal.

providers.name: Povio
providers.description: Povio is a Y Combinator-backed product design and engineering agency headquartered in San Francisco that helps startups and established companies design, build, and launch scalable digital products. The team delivers end-to-end UI/UX and product design, frontend, backend, and mobile engineering, DevOps, QA, and AI, IT, and legal consulting across 38+ technology stacks including React, Node.js, Python, Swift, and the major cloud platforms. Povio positions itself around AI-accelerated delivery ("build in days what once took months") and engages through fixed-price projects, dedicated teams, staff augmentation, and startup MVP / CTO-as-a-Service models. Povio does not operate a public API or developer portal; it does maintain open-source GitHub organizations that publish first-party developer tooling such as deployment CLIs and the PovioKit Swift toolkit.

providers.name: Quintoandar
providers.description: QuintoAndar is a São Paulo-based proptech company operating Latin America's largest residential real-estate marketplace, matching tenants and buyers with property owners for long-term rentals and home purchases. Its platform digitizes leasing (no guarantor required, rent guarantee, digital contracts), financing, and property management across Brazil and, via its Grupo QuintoAndar brand, other Latin American markets. As of this enrichment pass QuintoAndar exposes no public developer or partner API and no developer portal; developer/api subdomains redirect to the consumer marketing site. It does publish an RFC 9116 security.txt and runs a Bugcrowd vulnerability-disclosure program, and maintains an active public GitHub organization of open-source engineering tooling.

providers.name: SATIM
providers.description: SATIM provides AI-powered analysis of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery for intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) operations. Its OREC analytics engine performs automated object detection and classification on satellite and airborne SAR data (accuracy up to 95%), deployable in cloud, edge, or air-gapped environments and integrable into C2 and C4ISR workflows. OREC-Intelligence adds persistent monitoring with real-time area-of-interest change alerts and activity pattern analysis. Headquartered in Krakow, Poland, with offices in Dover, Delaware and London. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company; no public API surface, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: SCANA Corporation
providers.description: SCANA Corporation was an American regulated electric and natural gas public utility headquartered in Cayce, South Carolina. Its primary subsidiaries included South Carolina Electric & Gas (SCE&G), which provided electric and natural gas service to approximately 660,000 electric customers in South Carolina, and PSNC Energy, which served over one million natural gas customers in North Carolina and Georgia. SCANA was acquired by Dominion Energy in January 2019, after which the SCANA, SCE&G, and PSNC names were retired and operations were integrated into Dominion Energy's Southeast Energy Group. SCANA Energy Natural Gas continues to operate as a retail natural gas marketer in Georgia.

providers.name: Sirius XM Holdings
providers.description: Sirius XM Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: SIRI) is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, operating a portfolio of subscription, ad-supported streaming, podcast, and advertising-technology businesses. Its flagship satellite radio service SiriusXM serves roughly 33 million paid subscribers, while Pandora delivers ad-supported and premium music streaming to approximately 40 million active users. The portfolio also includes podcast network Simplecast, programmatic audio adtech platform AdsWizz, audio sales arm SiriusXM Media, and Pandora AMP. SiriusXM Holdings was split off from Liberty Media in September 2024, becoming an independent publicly traded company. This holdings-level index points to the operating subsidiaries; the consolidated developer surface is profiled in the `sirius-xm` repository, with no separate corporate developer program at the holding-company level.

providers.name: Teap
providers.description: Teap is a collaboration and productivity platform providing APIs for workspace management, team coordination, real-time notifications, and analytics. The platform offers core REST APIs for managing users, workspaces, and tasks, along with webhook support for event-driven integrations and analytics endpoints for workspace insights.

providers.name: TPP GROUP INC.
providers.description: TPP Group is a media intelligence company that creates and scales Arabic content, helping brands make data-driven marketing investments across the Arabic-speaking world. It operates four integrated divisions - Network (Arabic intellectual property development, 40+ owned and operated IPs), Studio (production infrastructure with 1,400+ produced episodes), Agency (performance-driven distribution), and Intelligence (psychographic audience-behavior analytics and attention measurement). A 500 Global portfolio company; it publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Tugende
providers.description: Tugende is a for-profit social enterprise founded in 2012 in Uganda that uses asset finance, technology, and a customer-centric model to help informal-sector entrepreneurs (MSMEs) own income-generating assets through lease-to-own financing — motorcycles (boda bodas), taxis, matatus, boat engines, smartphones, and small-business equipment like salon kits, fridges, and sewing machines. Operating in Uganda and Kenya with 800+ full-time staff, Tugende has served over 52,000 clients. Backed by Partech. Tugende publishes no public API or developer program as of this profile.

providers.name: Ubiq (now NECTURE)
providers.description: Ubiq is a Vienna, Austria mobility-intelligence company (NECTURE GmbH) that rebranded from UBIQ to NECTURE in 2024. Its "distributed operations" SaaS platform turns fleet data into action for shared-mobility operators, business fleets transitioning to EVs, autonomous fleets, and last-mile delivery -- offering automated rebalancing, predictive charging (Charging as a Service), and airport peak services, alongside StreetCrowd, its decentralized community workforce for fleet operations. Founded in 2015 around city parking optimization, it pivoted to shared-mobility SaaS in 2020 and is backed by Speedinvest among other investors. No public developer portal, API documentation, or client packages were found.

providers.name: United Refining Company
providers.description: United Refining Company is an independent, integrated petroleum company headquartered in Warren, Pennsylvania. The company owns and operates a petroleum refinery and a network of retail gasoline stations and convenience stores under the Kwik Fill and Country Fair brands in the northeastern United States. United Refining does not offer publicly documented APIs or developer resources.

providers.name: VaultDragon
providers.description: VaultDragon (Vault Dragon Pte Ltd) is a Singapore-based digital healthcare company building end-to-end practice-management software for clinics and medical providers across Southeast Asia and China. Its product suite includes DragonHub, an end-to-end clinic-management platform covering appointment scheduling, patient tracking, electronic health records, inventory and invoicing; DragonCare, a patient-facing web app for self-booking, reminders and access to medical history; DragonInsights, an on-demand business- intelligence and analytics layer; and DragonLab, a laboratory information system automating the workflow from sample receipt to report delivery. VaultDragon serves 650+ healthcare providers across Singapore, China, Indonesia, Thailand and Cambodia. The platform is delivered as a hosted SaaS (hub.vaultdragon.com) backed by a private, authenticated internal API; the company currently publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or client SDKs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Vector Legal
providers.description: Vector Legal is an AI-native law firm and legal operating system for startups, combining senior startup attorneys (averaging 10+ years of Big Law experience) with proprietary software for formation, fundraising, commercial contracts, employment and equity, and M&A, priced around outcomes rather than billable hours. Legal services are provided by Vector Legal, P.C., a licensed California law firm; the platform is built by Vector Systems, PBC. A Y Combinator Winter 2026 company headquartered in San Francisco, also backed by Base10, Palm Drive Capital, and Amino Capital.

providers.name: Xtalic
providers.description: Xtalic Corporation is a materials technology company founded in 2005 out of MIT by professor Chris Schuh and Dr. Alan Lund, headquartered in Marlborough, Massachusetts, with technical support and sales teams in Shanghai, South China, and Singapore. Its patented computational materials design platform tailors nanostructured metal alloys - XTRONIC nickel, LUNA silver, XTALIUM aluminum, PALLEX palladium, XENERGY soft magnetic, and XEFORM nickel-gold - as high-performance, sustainable replacements for traditional metals and precious-metal plating in electronics connectors, EV powertrains and charging systems, wireless charging, and wearables. Xtalic publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: 280 Earth
providers.description: 280 Earth is a direct air capture (DAC) company that permanently removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. Originally launched in 2018 inside X, the Alphabet moonshot factory, and spun out as an independent company in 2022, it is backed by Sergey Brin, Builders VC and a $50M Series B. Its proprietary sorbent moves through a gravity-fed dual-chamber system that continuously cycles material between capturing and releasing CO2, running on low-grade industrial waste heat or clean electricity and producing fresh water as a byproduct. Its first pilot plant, in The Dalles, Oregon, captures 500 tons of CO2 per year on a site sized for more than 20,000 tons per year at full build-out, and underpins a $40M offtake agreement with the Frontier carbon removal buyer consortium (Google, Meta, Stripe, Shopify and others). 280 Earth is a hardware and carbon-removal operator; as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer surface, API, or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Agl Resources
providers.description: AGL Resources was an energy services holding company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, whose principal business was the distribution of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. In 2016, AGL Resources was acquired by Southern Company and renamed Southern Company Gas, becoming the nation's largest natural gas-only distribution company. The company distributes natural gas through subsidiaries including Atlanta Gas Light, Chattanooga Gas, Nicor Gas, and Virginia Natural Gas. AGL Resources / Southern Company Gas does not offer a public developer API; utility data access is available through third-party data aggregators and community-built integrations.

providers.name: Autositu
providers.description: Autositu (AutoSitu) is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) PropTech startup building an AI-native intelligence layer for real estate development plan review. Its multi-agent platform automatically analyzes site plans, building plans, and AEC drawings against municipal zoning and building codes to flag compliance issues before submission, cutting city comments and resubmittals so approvals move faster. The product serves cities, architecture and engineering firms, and real estate developers with human-in-the-loop review workflows. Autositu is an early-stage SaaS company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: BlueLayer
providers.description: BlueLayer is an operating-system platform for carbon-project developers, providing infrastructure to collect project data, run automated digital measurement, reporting and verification (dMRV), manage the carbon-credit lifecycle from estimation through retirement, and generate revenue by distributing and selling credits while reducing compliance burden. The product spans project operations, a revenue engine, credit management, a stakeholder DataHub, customizable dashboards, and integrations with registries, CRMs, accounting software, and ERPs. Backed by Point Nine, BlueLayer was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface was found — the platform is accessed via its hosted web application.

providers.name: Bluenote
providers.description: Bluenote is an AI platform for life sciences that automates regulatory and clinical documentation for pharmaceutical, medical device, diagnostic, and CDMO companies. Its AI agents, workflow builder, document generation, dataset search, and translation tooling accelerate regulatory submissions by 50-75% across the pre-clinical, clinical, CMC, regulatory, quality, and commercial stages of the product lifecycle. Bluenote is an enterprise, sales-led company with no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface published as of this profile; it maintains a Vanta-hosted trust center and a public privacy policy. Backed by Electric Capital and Lux Capital, tracked in the API Evangelist network as a healthcare / life-sciences AI company.

providers.name: Breathe Life
providers.description: Breathe Life is a Montreal, Quebec based life insurance technology company — an enterprise SaaS core-systems vendor rather than a carrier or a broker — founded in 2018 to sell life insurers a modern new-business origination and distribution platform. Its product was the Breathe Life Hybrid Origination (Hybrid Distribution) Platform, sold either end-to-end or as four separately licensable modules: Quoter, Hybrid e-App, Advisor Tools and Data Dashboards, supporting advisor-driven, consumer self-serve, or blended selling of individual life products with simple and complex underwriting paths. Its home market is Canada, and its named clients were Canadian and North American life carriers, fraternals and faith-based insurers including Teachers Life, FaithLife Financial, National Bank Insurance, National Catholic Society of Foresters and La Capitale. The company raised CAD $11.5M in August 2020 from Diagram Ventures, Real Ventures and Investissement Quebec plus angels from AXA, AIG and RGA, was named to the 2020 InsurTech 100, and held PCI DSS, SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3 attestations. SE2, an Eldridge business, announced its acquisition of Breathe Life on 2022-03-28; SE2 subsequently rebranded as Zinnia, and the Breathe Life site carried a "We are now part of Zinnia!" banner before being decommissioned. Its API posture is closed and now historical: as of the 2026-07-25 review Breathe Life never published a developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI or Swagger definition, Postman collection, GraphQL endpoint, webhook catalog or ACORD/AL3 conformance claim on breathelife.com, and the domain no longer serves a site at all — breathelife.com returns an nginx "Site Not Configured" 404 and www.breathelife.com returns a WP Engine "Site is not available" 404. Quote, bind, issue and FNOL existed only as capabilities inside a carrier-licensed, login-gated SaaS product, never as an addressable public API.

providers.name: BrightGo
providers.description: BrightGo is an all-in-one janitorial and commercial-cleaning ERP platform for building service contractors. It unifies field operations, workforce management, and back-office finance in one system: scheduling, GPS-verified time and attendance, inspections and quality assurance, real-time job costing, payroll, and accounting, plus operations business-intelligence dashboards and an in-app employee communication portal. Backed by Index Ventures and Costanoa Ventures, BrightGo serves janitorial companies across the U.S. and Canada. No public developer API or documentation surface has been identified; the product is delivered via web (app.brightgo.com) and iOS/Android mobile apps.

providers.name: Carahsoft
providers.description: Carahsoft Technology Corp. is a master government IT solutions aggregator and distributor that resells software, cloud, and cybersecurity products from hundreds of technology vendors to U.S. federal, state, local, defense, intelligence, healthcare, and education customers across 220+ government contract vehicles. Carahsoft operates a partner-facing Developer Center that exposes partner integrations for accounts, quotes, orders, invoices, price lists, purchase orders, and resources; the underlying API is gated behind a partner account and is not a public REST API.

providers.name: Celus
providers.description: CELUS GmbH is a Munich-based electronics design automation company building an AI-driven, cloud design platform that automates the early stages of printed circuit board (PCB) engineering. The CELUS Design Platform turns high-level product requirements into schematics, part selections and layout-ready outputs in minutes rather than days by combining AI-powered component search with its proprietary CUBO component knowledge base, then handing off EDA-compatible files to tools like Altium and KiCad. Founded by Alexander and Tobias Pohl and backed by Earlybird and Speedinvest, CELUS targets hardware engineers and manufacturers pursuing digital transformation of the electronics design workflow. The platform is a closed SaaS product accessed through app.celus.io; as of this enrichment pass CELUS publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Data Sutram
providers.description: Data Sutram is an enterprise AI trust platform for the financial services sector, using external and alternative data intelligence plus agentic workflows to power fraud detection, identity and address verification, credit assessment, and collections. Its products - Trust (fraud and trust scoring), Auth (authentication and verification), and Echo (collections intelligence) - are applied across the customer lifecycle from acquisition and onboarding through portfolio monitoring and debt recovery. Data Sutram serves leading Indian banks and fintechs including HDFC, Axis, ICICI, Kotak, IndusInd, Jupiter, Navi, and Fibe, and maintains ISO 27001, ISO 27018, and SOC 2 certifications along with DPDP compliance. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and is also backed by B Capital.

providers.name: EcoPlant
providers.description: EcoPlant provides an intelligent air compressor control and monitoring platform for industrial facilities. The Ecoplant 360 solution uses IoT sensors, AI-powered dynamic controls, and predictive analytics to optimize compressed-air systems in real time, preventing downtime, improving reliability, and reducing compressed-air energy costs by up to 50 percent. It installs in under a week with no installation fees and is compatible with most compressor brands and existing plant technology.

providers.name: Eon Pass
providers.description: Eon Pass (EonPass) is an AI-powered anti-counterfeiting and brand-protection software platform. It helps brand-protection and enforcement teams identify, investigate, and take down counterfeiters by analyzing more than 24 data sources — including marketplace activity, corporate records, logistics data, and investigation signals — to build comprehensive profiles of suspected bad actors. Teams track suspects, manage cases, and coordinate enforcement actions from a unified dashboard, with the platform reporting takedown-efficiency improvements of up to 20%. Eon Pass is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public API, SDK, or developer surface is currently published; this profile is maintained as an enrichment lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Evri
providers.description: Evri is the United Kingdom's largest dedicated parcel delivery company, formerly Hermes UK, headquartered in Leeds and majority owned by Apollo-managed funds. Following the CMA-cleared 2025 merger with DHL eCommerce UK, the combined group delivers more than a billion parcels a year across a courier network of 30,000+ couriers and van drivers, thousands of ParcelShops and lockers, and domestic, returns and international services for retailers and marketplace sellers. Evri sits at the last-mile end of the supply chain — the carrier a shipper, retailer or e-commerce platform hands a parcel to for final delivery in the UK. Its API posture is customer-contract portal only: Evri publishes no developer portal, no public API reference and no machine-readable specification. The host api.evri.com resolves to a live Tyk API Gateway (5.13.0) whose only publicly reachable path is an unauthenticated health check; every other probed path returns 404 and no listen path is discoverable without credentials. Shipment, label, ParcelShop, Print in Store and tracking credentials are issued by an Evri account manager or sales representative to contracted Corporate or Business accounts, with sandbox and production credentials handed over by email. In practice most integrators reach Evri indirectly through shipping-API aggregators such as EasyPost, ShipEngine / ShipStation, Sendcloud, AfterShip and Intersoft Sapient rather than directly.

providers.name: Five Jack
providers.description: Five Jack (PT. Five Jack) is the Indonesian company behind itemku, one of Southeast Asia's largest digital-goods marketplaces for gamers. Founded in 2014 as a game price-comparison and classifieds platform, itemku grew into a full marketplace where buyers and sellers trade in-game items, currency, account top-ups, game keys, and vouchers across 200+ game categories including Roblox, Genshin Impact, Mobile Legends, Dota 2, Steam, and Growtopia. The company reached one million orders in 2018, launched its Android app and gaming blog in 2020, and became part of Bukalapak (IDX: BUKA) in May 2021. Five Jack was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It operates a consumer-facing marketplace and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Fuse Energy
providers.description: Fuse Energy (originally launched as Tesseract) is a UK-based, vertically integrated energy supplier founded by former Revolut executives Alan Chang and Charles Orr. It buys power from generators and supplies gas and electricity directly to residential and business customers, positioning itself to beat the UK price cap with variable, fixed and multi-rate tariffs, 30-minute billing updates, EV charging, solar/battery export tracking and an in-app AI assistant called "Plugs." The company raised $78M led by Balderton Capital and Lakestar.
