Founded in 2025 by former Hims & Hers leaders Quentin Lacornerie and Jack Abraham, the company pairs science-backed "main" meals with taste-driven "drizzle" toppers, guided by a two-minute intake quiz that builds a personalized meal plan for each dog. It operates a Shopify Hydrogen storefront at mygoldenchild.com and has raised $37M from Redpoint Ventures, Atomic, and A*. Golden Child publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; this profile tracks it as a company in the API Evangelist network, surfaced from the Redpoint Ventures portfolio.

providers.name: Grain
providers.description: Grain is a Singapore-based online restaurant and catering company founded in 2013 that delivers freshly prepared, thoughtfully sourced meals across Singapore. Its products include Meals On Demand (same-day ready-to-eat delivery), wedding catering, event catering, gift cards, and the Grain Savers program, with MUIS Halal and ISO certifications. Grain was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio stub (500 Global among its early backers). As of this enrichment pass it publishes a consumer web storefront but no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or other machine-readable API artifacts, so this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Greentoe
providers.description: Greentoe is a name-your-price e-commerce marketplace where shoppers make an offer on brand-new electronics, cameras, TVs and home theater, appliances, baby gear, watches, and optics, and manufacturer-authorized retailers compete to fulfill the order at the buyer's price. Built to bring the negotiation model of big-ticket purchases online, Greentoe reports more than $100M saved by its customers, backs every order with manufacturer warranties and a 30-day return policy, and is backed by 500 Global and Y Combinator. Greentoe operates as a consumer-facing web application and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Guazi
providers.description: Guazi is a China-based used-car export, auction, and trading platform founded in 2015 and headquartered in Beijing. It connects international dealers and buyers with used vehicles sourced across China, offering sealed-bid online auctions, Buy It Now direct sales, a 200-plus-point vehicle inspection process, direct sourcing on request, and global logistics shipping to more than 50 countries via container and Ro-Ro. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, HongShan (Sequoia China), and Tencent, Guazi handles over 200,000 vehicles annually. This API Evangelist profile currently tracks the company's public web presence; no public developer program, API, or SDK has been found.

providers.name: Gym Class VR
providers.description: Gym Class VR (operating as "Gym Class" by IRL Studios) is a social virtual reality sports gaming platform for Meta Quest headsets and mobile devices, offering multiplayer basketball, baseball, football, boxing, paintball, and soccer experiences where players compete, socialize, and create and share their own games. The top-rated sports title on the Meta Quest Store with a 4.8-star average across 53,000+ ratings, the company holds licensing agreements with the NBA and Major League Baseball, expanded to mobile in 2026, and has raised over $8M from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Y Combinator, and NBA players. It is a consumer VR entertainment product with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Harley-Davidson
providers.description: Shop the Official Harley-Davidson site for new and used motorcycles, genuine parts and apparel. Locate a dealer or take a test ride. Harley-Davidson does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Haus Laboratories
providers.description: Haus Labs by Lady Gaga (formerly Haus Laboratories) is an American clean-beauty cosmetics brand founded by Lady Gaga. It first launched in September 2019 and relaunched in June 2022 with Sephora as its exclusive retail partner. The brand makes skincare-infused, high-performance color cosmetics and makeup — including its Triclone Skin Tech Foundation plus lip, eye, and complexion products — that are always vegan and cruelty-free. It sells direct-to-consumer through hauslabs.com and through Sephora. Haus Labs is a consumer packaged goods / beauty company with no public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record surfaced from the Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio.

providers.name: Hawaya
providers.description: Hawaya is a Muslim-focused online dating and matrimonial app that began as Harmonica, an Egyptian matchmaking startup backed by 500 Startups (500 Global), and was later acquired by Match Group and rebranded as Hawaya. The service emphasized serious, marriage-minded connections with privacy controls tailored to Muslim singles across the Middle East, North Africa, and international diaspora markets, offered as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps rather than a developer platform. Hawaya was discontinued in 2023 and no longer accepts new registrations; it exposes no public API, SDK, or developer program. This API Evangelist profile is retained as a company record with identity and legal links captured from the provider's own site.

providers.name: Hooked
providers.description: Hooked is a mobile entertainment company founded in 2015 by Prerna Gupta and Parag Chordia (Telepathic, Inc.) that pioneered the chat-fiction format: bite-sized, suspenseful stories read as simulated text-message conversations. Its flagship Hooked app reached #1 on the App Store and Google Play in more than 25 countries and over 100 million viewers, and the company later launched Hooked TV, a short-form mobile video streaming service. Hooked uses data and AI to predict and produce hit short-form content distributed across its own apps and social platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, and YouTube. It is backed by 500 Global, Cowboy Ventures, Sound Ventures, The Chernin Group, Founders Fund, and Greylock. Hooked does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK.

providers.name: Hotelogix
providers.description: Hotelogix is a cloud-based hotel property management system (PMS) headquartered in Noida, India, serving more than 12,000 independent hotels, groups, chains, and resorts across 100+ countries since 2008. The platform provides front desk management, reservations, point-of-sale, housekeeping, revenue management, multi-property and group management, a web booking engine, a guest service mobile app, and an integrated channel manager that distributes inventory to OTAs and GDS. Hotelogix exposes a partner Web API (HAPI) at developer.hotelogix.net that uses XML POST over HTTP rather than REST/JSON, enabling channel managers, payment gateways, accounting systems, CRMs, loyalty programs, door locks, ID scanners, and in-room devices to integrate with the PMS. Documentation is split into Web (booking engine), Admin, and Frontdesk surfaces. There is no public OpenAPI specification, no public SDK, and no public GitHub org content; partner access and credentials are granted on request through the Hotelogix support and partnership teams. Revenue model is SaaS subscriptions per hotel/room along with an integration marketplace ecosystem.

providers.name: Human Archive
providers.description: Human Archive is a Stanford- and Berkeley-founded, Y Combinator-funded data lab building foundational multimodal datasets for training AI and robotics systems to understand human movement and interaction. It collects and labels first-person video, RGB-D, audio, tactile, and motion-capture data from a network of 100,000+ contributors and 500+ industry partners, and provides dataset access to researchers and enterprise partners through a customer dashboard on request. The company is a B2B data infrastructure provider rather than a self-serve platform, and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: i2x
providers.description: i2x is a German real-time AI platform for contact centers, built by i2x GmbH in Mönchengladbach. It provides live agent assistance that surfaces contextual recommendations during calls in under 0.4 seconds, including automatic detection of purchase signals and faster agent onboarding; full-coverage call analysis with automatic transcription plus quality, compliance, and sales-opportunity scoring across 100% of conversations; and voicebots for automated inbound/outbound telephony and virtual agent-training scenarios. The platform emphasizes DSGVO/GDPR compliance with EU-only hosting in German data centers, prepared works-council documentation, and EU AI Act alignment, positioning itself as an alternative to US-cloud-dependent conversation-intelligence tools. No public API, developer portal, or SDKs are currently published; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of hv-capital.

providers.name: ICON
providers.description: ICON Technology, Inc. is an Austin, Texas construction-technology company building large-scale robotic 3D printing systems, materials, and software to make home building faster, more affordable, and more resilient. Its flagship Titan 3D construction printer, orchestrated by the proprietary BuildOS software that translates architectural designs into robotic tool paths and manages material flow, can print the wall system of a 2,500 sq. ft. home in under seven days. ICON operates a Design + Build division delivering 3D-printed homes and communities, a Technology division selling its printers and building systems to other builders, the CODEX digital home design catalog, and ICON Prime. The company is privately held and backed by investors including Bond Capital and Pantera Capital. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from a venture-portfolio lead; ICON publishes a marketing and product presence but no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Immersive Gamebox
providers.description: Immersive Gamebox is a London-founded (2018) location-based entertainment company operating indoor gaming venues across the UK, US, Germany, and the UAE. Each Gamebox combines projection mapping, touch screens, motion tracking, and surround sound to deliver fully immersive, interactive games for teams of two to six players in 30-60 minute sessions. Its catalog spans licensed titles built with partners such as Netflix (Squid Game), Aardman (Shaun the Sheep), Rovio (Angry Birds), and Tetris, alongside originals, and the business runs on bookings, party and corporate packages, Game Pass subscriptions, and a multi-unit franchise model. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of index-ventures. It exposes no public web/REST API today; developer collaboration is limited to a Unity-based SDK offered to game studios building titles for the Gamebox hardware platform.

providers.name: Insitu
providers.description: Insitu Inc. is a wholly owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company that designs, builds, and operates uncrewed aerial systems (UAS) and related intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance technologies for defense and government customers. Its product line includes the Integrator, ScanEagle, and RQ-21A air vehicles alongside imaging payloads, ground control stations, and mission software such as TacitView, the Media Management Suite, and the Tungsten SDK. Insitu delivers end-to-end capabilities for collecting, processing, and distributing information, with more than 1.6 million operational flight hours across 30-plus international customers. Insitu operates as a defense contractor and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Inyad
providers.description: Inyad is an all-in-one business management and payments platform for small and medium businesses across Morocco, the Middle East, and Africa. Its mobile-first apps let merchants sell, get paid, and run their operations from one place — including a smart point-of-sale (POS Mahaal), automatic invoicing, an online store builder, employee attendance and payroll (Staff), a digital credit book (Konnash), in-store card terminals and terminal-free digital collection (Collect), professional business accounts, and money-transfer services. The company reports 250,000+ professionals on the platform and is backed by investors including Partech, Al Mada Ventures, CDG Invest, and FJ Labs. Inyad exposes an internal application backend (api.inyad.com) but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Iterum Therapeutics
providers.description: Iterum Therapeutics plc is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, focused on developing novel anti-infective medications to treat multi-drug resistant (MDR) bacterial infections. Its lead product, ORLYNVAH (sulopenem), is described as the first oral and IV penem antibiotic targeting gram-negative resistant infections. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Iterum Therapeutics is a pharmaceutical/biotech company and does not operate a public developer API; as of March 2026 the company entered liquidation following a High Court order in Ireland.

providers.name: J&T Express
providers.description: J&T Express (J&T Global Express Ltd, HKEX: 1519) is a global logistics service operator whose core business is express parcel delivery and international logistics. Founded in Indonesia in 2015, it operates express delivery networks across 13 countries including Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, Cambodia, Singapore, China, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Mexico, Brazil, and Egypt, with international freight services reaching Asia, Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Oceania. The company serves e-commerce sellers and consumers with parcel pickup, sorting, line-haul, last-mile delivery, and track-and-trace. As of this profile J&T Express publishes a public track-and-trace web experience and regional merchant onboarding, but no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI definition was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain security.

providers.name: Joopiter
providers.description: Joopiter (stylized JOOPITER) is a digital-first auction house and marketplace founded by Pharrell Williams for rare objects and culturally significant collectibles. The platform hosts timed online auctions, a curated marketplace, and private sales spanning watches, sneakers, streetwear, art, jewelry, and memorabilia, pairing commerce with editorial storytelling about each object and its provenance. Joopiter offers consignment and "sell with Joopiter" services connecting collectors and creators globally. It is a consumer-facing luxury commerce brand; as of this writing it publishes no public developer program, API, or documentation surface, so this API Evangelist profile is an identity record rather than a technical/API catalog entry.

providers.name: Jumba
providers.description: Jumba is a Nairobi-based construction technology company founded in 2022 that digitizes the sourcing and financing of construction materials across Africa. Its B2B marketplace connects hardware retail stores and construction sites to manufacturers and suppliers of materials such as cement, steel, tiles, plumbing, electrical, paint and finishes, offering real-time price comparison and online ordering. Jumba OS is a management application for tracking sales, inventory and creditor accounts, while Jengwa provides buy-now-pay-later inventory financing. The company operates a consumer mobile app and reports processing over 12.6 million cement bags through more than 1,350 hardware stores, and is backed by Speedinvest. Jumba does not publish a public API; its developer presence is limited to open-source tooling on its GitHub organization.

providers.name: Kendra Scott
providers.description: Kendra Scott is an American jewelry and accessories retailer founded in 2002 in Austin, Texas, offering personalized jewelry, watches, home goods, and gifts through customization options such as initials, birthstones, and engraving. The brand operates a direct-to-consumer ecommerce storefront alongside a network of retail stores, and pairs its Color Bar customization experience with a philanthropic giving model tied to purchases. Surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes a consumer ecommerce site but no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. This profile captures its public identity and web-property surface pending any future developer program.

providers.name: Kennek
providers.description: Kennek (Kennek Solutions Ltd) is a UK-based fintech providing all-in-one loan management software built for specialist bridge and development lenders. The platform lets lenders originate, manage, and service loans while monitoring funding lines in one place, automating manual workflows, covenant and eligibility calculations, portfolio risk visibility, and investor reporting so lending teams can scale without adding headcount. Founded by former lenders and backed by HV Capital, Kennek is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio-company profile; it publishes a marketing site and legal pages but no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Kinlo
providers.description: KINLO is a consumer skincare and suncare brand formulating sun protection and skincare products specifically for melanin-rich skin. Co-founded with tennis champion Naomi Osaka, the line addresses a market gap in SPF for melanated skin tones, offering dermatologist-tested, tinted, reef-safe formulations with ingredients like niacinamide that blend without a white cast. Products are sold direct and exclusively through Amazon with Buy with Prime. KINLO is a direct-to-consumer commerce brand with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or programmatic surface; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of initialized-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer-brand profile.

providers.name: KUKA
providers.description: KUKA AG is a German industrial automation company headquartered in Augsburg, Bavaria, founded in 1898 and majority-owned by China's Midea Group since 2016. KUKA designs and manufactures industrial robots, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), production cells, controllers, and the software stack that drives them. Its product portfolio spans six-axis articulated robots (KR series), sensitive collaborative robots (LBR iiwa, LBR iisy), mobile platforms (KMR iiwa, KMP), and palletizing/welding/CNC cells, controlled by the KR C4 and KR C5 / KR C5 micro controller generations. The robot software stack centers on KUKA System Software (KSS/VSS) for KR C4-class hardware, the newer iiQKA.OS / iiQKA.OS2 operating system for KR C5, and the KUKA Robot Language (KRL) for motion programming, with extension surfaces including KUKA.RobotSensorInterface (RSI), KUKA.EthernetKRL, KUKA.PLC mxAutomation for external PLC control, KUKA.OPC UA, and KUKA.AppTech / iiQKA App Builder for option packages. Engineering and simulation are delivered through iiQWorks (iiQWorks.Sim, iiQWorks.App Builder, iiQWorks.Copilot) and KUKA.Sim, while operational software includes KUKA Xpert (documentation/cloud), KUKA iiQoT (condition monitoring), and KUKA Connect / my.KUKA customer portals. KUKA does not publish a first-party public REST/OpenAPI developer API or an official GitHub organization for its robot control stack; integration is performed through proprietary protocols (RSI, EthernetKRL, mxAutomation, OPC UA, PROFINET, EtherCAT) and SDKs distributed via the iiQKA Creator portal and KUKA Xpert. A meaningful body of open-source KUKA integration code lives in the community-maintained kroshu GitHub organization (ROS 2 drivers, external-control SDK, URDF robot descriptions) and the roboticsapi / openkuka projects. KUKA serves automotive, electronics, battery, metal, consumer goods, healthcare, aerospace, and e-commerce logistics customers, and through its Swisslog subsidiary extends into warehouse and intralogistics automation.

providers.name: Lucidum
providers.description: Lucidum is a cyber asset and security data platform (CAASM) that ingests, correlates, and enriches data from more than 500 sources to give security and IT teams a unified inventory of assets, identities, data, and their relationships. The Security Data Fabric platform eliminates blind spots by connecting to existing SIEM, cloud, endpoint, and identity systems without extra ingestion charges, and surfaces unseen systems and accounts for exposure and attack-surface management. Lucidum was acquired by Cyderes and its capabilities are now delivered as part of the Cyderes "Meridian" platform. This profile originated as a GGV Capital portfolio lead and was enriched from Lucidum public web surface; the company publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Lumos Helmet
providers.description: Lumos (Lumos Helmet) is a consumer hardware company that designs and manufactures smart bike helmets and connected bike lights with integrated safety features such as turn signals, brake lights, and high-visibility LED lighting. Its product line spans commuter, e-bike, and kids' helmets plus standalone smart bike lights, controlled through companion iOS and Android mobile apps. Backed by Techstars, Lumos sells direct-to-consumer through an online store; it does not currently publish a public API, developer platform, or SDK. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline, which confirmed no programmatic API surface and captured the company's identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: lunchlab Corp.
providers.description: lunchlab Corp. (런치랩) is a Seoul-based corporate lunch subscription and delivery service that brings daily meals to office teams across South Korea. It offers two rotating meal lines — a traditional home-style Korean lunch box and a "Fresh Meal" line of poke bowls and sandwiches — with delivery and pickup included for a flat per-meal price, employees choosing their meals through a mobile app while administrators manage orders and billing from a web dashboard. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, lunchlab operates in the food-service / corporate-catering space and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Maelyscosmetics
providers.description: MAELYS Cosmetics is a direct-to-consumer body care brand offering clinically proven body solutions focused on firming, toning, and addressing concerns such as cellulite, stretch marks, and loose skin. Surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. The company operates a consumer e-commerce storefront and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Magic Spoon
providers.description: Magic Spoon is a direct-to-consumer breakfast brand selling high-protein, low-sugar cereal, oatmeal, granola, treats, and toaster pastries through its Shopify-powered online store and major retailers including Whole Foods, Target, Costco, Walmart, Kroger, and Sprouts. The company reformulates childhood-classic cereals to be keto-friendly and gluten-free, offering a subscribe-and-save model. Magic Spoon is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) ecommerce company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners; it operates a retail storefront rather than a public developer platform, and this profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: MagicBus
providers.description: MagicBus is a vanpool management platform that helps employers, HR teams, fleet managers, and transit agencies rebuild and operate employee commuting programs. Through its MagicRide app, riders, drivers, and coordinators book seats, form dynamic on-demand vanpools, and crowdsource new routes, while reporting dashboards supply the data needed for program evaluation and transit-subsidy applications. Surfaced as a mobility portfolio lead of Version One Ventures and Y Combinator, MagicBus publishes no public API or developer program at this time; this profile captures its verified public web surface.

providers.name: Marriage Pact
providers.description: Marriage Pact is a matchmaking platform that pairs people using a research-backed compatibility questionnaire, originally built for college campuses and run as periodic matching events across universities. Participants answer a values-and-preferences survey and the service uses the responses to compute and deliver each person their most compatible match. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, the company operates as a consumer web product; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: MealPal
providers.description: MealPal is a consumer meal subscription service that lets members reserve lunch or dinner from a rotating selection of local restaurants at a discounted, fixed membership price, ordering ahead through its iOS and Android apps to skip the line at pickup. The service is organized around its MealPass lunch/dinner subscription and MealFix offering, alongside a partner program that restaurants join to reach members. MealPal operates as a business-to-consumer mobile application and website and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This record was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Menlo Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Metro Residences
providers.description: MetroResidences is a serviced apartments and furnished-rentals platform offering flexible temporary housing for business travelers, expatriates, and relocating professionals. Its portfolio spans thousands of listings across Singapore, Tokyo, and Australia, ranging from studios to six-plus bedroom units in both furnished and unfurnished configurations, alongside select hotel accommodations. The company also runs a property-management offering that lets owners list and monetize their units. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site exposes no developer program, API, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Mi Dulce Hogar
providers.description: Mi Dulce Hogar is a professional home and commercial cleaning services company operating in Mexico City (CDMX), connecting customers with vetted, background-screened cleaning professionals. Services include residential and office cleaning, upholstery and carpet washing, floor polishing, and pest control/fumigation. The company states it has delivered more than 100,000 services and screens candidates through a rigorous criminological vetting process. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; the public web presence is a consumer marketing and booking site with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Mission Barns
providers.description: Mission Barns is a Berkeley, California cultivated-meat company founded in 2018 that grows real animal fat from cells to make animal-friendly pork products — including meatballs, bacon, pepperoni, chorizo, and sausage — built on Mission Fat, its proprietary cultivated pork fat. It is the first company to receive both FDA and USDA clearance for cultivated fat and operates a dual B2C consumer-brand and B2B ingredient / co-development model across foodservice and CPG partners. This API Evangelist profile is a portfolio-company lead (backed by Point Nine); the company runs a consumer marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Mixhalo
providers.description: Mixhalo is an AI-enabled digital audio platform for live events that streams broadcast-quality speaker audio, real-time language interpretation, transcription, and summaries directly to attendees' smartphones, eliminating the need for silent-session headsets or dedicated receiver hardware. Its flagship product, Mixhalo Live, delivers low-latency multilingual audio into event apps, and it has partnered with Eventbase to offer an SDK for embedding the experience in client event applications. Mixhalo is now part of DeepL, extending DeepL's multilingual communication capabilities to in-person events. The company is backed by Cowboy Ventures. This profile currently exposes no public developer portal or API surface.

providers.name: Model N
providers.description: Model N is a revenue management software company that has served the pharmaceutical and medtech industries for more than 25 years. Its cloud commercial platform helps life sciences innovators grow market access, optimize revenue, and maintain regulatory compliance across provider and payer management, US Government Pricing and Medicaid, global pricing and tender management, 340B vigilance, state price transparency, deal management, and its Intelligence Cloud and Data nSights analytics. Model N is enterprise SaaS with a customer support portal and knowledge center but no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company identity plus its published security, trust, and compliance posture.

providers.name: Nanit
providers.description: Nanit is a consumer smart baby-monitoring company whose camera-based system tracks infant sleep patterns, monitors breathing motion through wearable Breathing Wear, and sends real-time safety notifications to parents. Its products pair 1080p HD video with computer-vision analytics, alongside a companion mobile app, sound machines, and sleep-guidance content, sold direct-to-consumer as hardware plus app subscriptions. As of this enrichment pass Nanit publishes no public developer API, SDK, CLI, or webhook surface for third-party integration.

providers.name: Nickelytics
providers.description: Nickelytics is a data-driven out-of-home (OOH) and digital-out-of-home (DOOH) advertising platform that turns moving assets into measurable media. It wraps gig-economy and rideshare vehicles, autonomous sidewalk delivery robots, and e-scooters with brand campaigns, then layers geo-targeting, programmatic DOOH buying, route verification, proof-of-play, and performance reporting into a single campaign dashboard. Nickelytics was acquired by Kiwibot for roughly $25M in September 2024 and now operates as the "r-ads" advertising product of Robot.com. It has no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface; campaign activation runs through an advertiser dashboard rather than an API.

providers.name: NinjaBlocks
providers.description: Ninja Blocks Inc was an Australian Internet-of-Things startup (founded 2012, backed by 500 Global / 500 Startups) behind the Ninja Block and Ninja Sphere home-automation hubs. It offered a cloud-connected platform with a RESTful API (base https://api.ninja.is/rest/v0/) for reading sensor data and controlling actuators, plus first-party client libraries for Node.js, PHP, Ruby, Lua and Arduino, a `ninja-toolbelt` CLI, and OAuth-based authentication. The company ceased operation and its web and API hosts are no longer online; this profile preserves the surviving first-party open-source client libraries and API tooling published to npm and GitHub. Added to the API Evangelist network from the 500 Global portfolio and enriched from public package registries and the github.com/ninjablocks organization.

providers.name: NNG
providers.description: NNG (NNG Software Developing and Commercial LLC), formerly Nav N Go, is a Budapest-based automotive navigation and location-based software company founded in 2004. Its flagship iGO platform delivers modular guidance, positioning, routing, map content management, and driver-assistance features such as Intelligent Speed Assistance, embedded in more than 60 million devices across 30+ vehicle brands and supplied to over 150 automotive and mobility partners in nearly 200 countries. NNG is backed by growth investment from Insight Partners. NNG sells embedded and OEM location-based software rather than a public developer API; no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or API documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Nodal Industries
providers.description: Nodal Industries, operating as Nodal Security, is a network security company and 500 Global portfolio startup that makes Numa, a plug-and-play network security appliance providing protective oversight of every connected device on a home or small-office network. Rather than per-device antivirus software, Numa works at the network layer, intercepting malicious traffic before it reaches devices using real-time threat intelligence powered by Suricata, with automatic updates and minimal setup. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing website only and exposes no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or event surface.

providers.name: Oncimmune
providers.description: Oncimmune is a biotechnology company specializing in antibody and autoantibody biomarker discovery for precision medicine. Its proprietary ImmunoINSIGHTS platform screens against 9,000+ human antigens using Luminex xMAP bead-based multiplexed immunoassay technology, minimal sample volumes, high-throughput automated robotic workflows, and proprietary machine-learning algorithms to identify immune-system signatures across immuno-oncology, autoimmune disease, and infectious disease. Products include the ImmunoINSIGHTS 2K targeted panels, custom biomarker discovery services, and bioinformatics/data-science multiomics integration. Oncimmune was acquired by Alden Scientific in July 2025. The company operates as a research and discovery services provider and does not publish a public developer or API platform.

providers.name: Open Bionics
providers.description: Open Bionics is a Bristol, UK-based medical technology company that designs and manufactures advanced multi-grip bionic arms for children and adults with upper-limb differences. Its Hero product family (Hero ARM, Hero PRO, Hero RGD, Hero FLEX and Hero GAUNTLET) pairs 3D-printed, lightweight myoelectric prosthetic hands with an ecosystem of MyoPods wireless electrodes and the Sidekick companion app, delivered through a network of specialist prosthetists and clinics in the US and UK. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; enrichment probing found no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or event surface.

providers.name: OpenDurian
providers.description: OpenDurian is a Bangkok, Thailand based educational technology company delivering hybrid (online plus offline) learning and test preparation. Its platform offers exam-prep courses for TOEIC, IELTS, TOEFL, TCAS and Thai civil-service exams, language instruction in English, Chinese and Japanese, secondary-school mathematics and science courses, an online bookstore, free English-proficiency assessment tools, and extensive practice-test question banks. The company reports reach in the millions of annual users across its learning ecosystem. It is a consumer-facing edtech product; as of this enrichment pass no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation was found.

providers.name: Openhouse
providers.description: Openhouse is a network of neighborhood children's learning centres in Bangalore and Kolkata, India, describing itself as a "Third Space" for children — neither home nor school, but a sanctuary for curiosity. It runs preschool programs for ages 1-6, a Parent-Toddler Club for ages 1-3, and Excel extracurriculars (robotics, public speaking, music, art and design) for ages 3-5+, built around a learning-by-doing philosophy. The consumer-facing website (openhouse.school, formerly openhouse.study) is a marketing and enrollment surface; the only network-visible technical surface is a private app backend health endpoint at api.openhouse.study. Openhouse was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Osmo
providers.description: Osmo (Tangible Play) makes hands-on, screen-interactive learning games for iPad and Fire tablet that pair a physical reflector base placed over the device camera with digital games spanning math, coding, spelling, drawing, and problem-solving for children. Backed by Accel and GV, Osmo is a consumer educational-technology brand that sells hardware kits and companion apps direct to families and schools. As of this enrichment pass it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Outdoor Voices
providers.description: Outdoor Voices is an Austin-founded direct-to-consumer activewear and athletic apparel brand designing clothing for everyday recreation — running, hiking, studio workouts, and rest days — for women and men. The company sells exclusively through its own Shopify-hosted e-commerce storefront and retail presence rather than a public developer platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network. An enrichment pass found no first-party public API, SDK, webhook, or developer surface: the site runs on Shopify commerce infrastructure with only consumer-facing help, privacy, and terms pages.

providers.name: Output
providers.description: Output is a Los Angeles-based music software company founded in 2013 by composer and CEO Gregg Lehrman that makes creative virtual instruments, audio effects, and a cloud-connected subscription platform for music producers, songwriters, composers, and beatmakers. Its flagship product is Arcade, a cloud-powered playable sampler and instruments plugin whose library of vocal chops, chords, melodies, basslines, loops, samples, and chromatic instruments (organized into product lines such as Hooked, Poolside, and Drip) refreshes daily. Output's catalog also includes Co-Producer, a sample-discovery plugin that finds samples that fit the current project, and the Output FX suite — Portal (granular synthesis engine), Thermal (interactive distortion engine), and Movement (rhythm engine) — alongside legacy Kontakt-based instruments such as Exhale, Analog Brass & Strings, REV, Signal, and Substance. Products are sold as one-time perpetual licenses and bundled in the Output One subscription ($14.99/month or $119.99/year) covering Arcade, Co-Producer, and the three FX plugins with all expansion packs included. Output raised a $45M Series A from Summit Partners in 2020. Products are delivered as VST3, AU, and AAX plugins (Arcade also runs as a standalone desktop app) installed via account.output.com and the Output Hub; there is no public REST API, SDK, or developer program — integration is through the industry-standard DAW plugin formats.

providers.name: Overtime
providers.description: Overtime is a sports media and entertainment company building disruptive, digital-first sports leagues and intellectual property aimed at the next generation of fans and athletes. It operates branded leagues including Overtime Elite (OTE) basketball, OT7 seven-on-seven football, and OT Select women's basketball, and reaches nearly 100 million followers across social platforms. Backed by a16z, Overtime generates revenue through sponsorships, merchandise, media rights, and brand partnerships, reimagining how Gen Z engages with sports through content-first entertainment.

providers.name: P.F. Chang's
providers.description: P.F. Chang's is an American casual-dining restaurant chain specializing in Asian-inspired cuisine, operating restaurants and a Home Menu retail line. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of trinity-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The enrichment pipeline found no public developer API surface: no developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or well-known discovery endpoints are published. The only live host, api.pfchangs.com, returns a default Azure Function App page (an internal app backend, not a public API). This profile captures the company's public web and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Pair
providers.description: Pair (formerly Inversity) is an enterprise AI adoption platform that helps organizations build workforce capability in artificial intelligence and measure the return on their AI investment. Pair delivers personalized, hands-on masterclasses grounded in each learner's role, industry, and day-to-day tasks — covering tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Claude, plus agentic AI — moving teams from basic AI awareness to measurable adoption. A multi-tier certification path (Fundamentals, Proficiency, Mastery), team adoption dashboards, ROI measurement that tracks time saved and business impact, an AI Showcase for sharing effective workflows, and manager oversight tools round out the platform. Pair is a Seedcamp portfolio company.

providers.name: Panera Bread
providers.description: Panera Bread is a chain of bakery-cafe fast casual restaurants offering sandwiches, soups, salads, pasta, and bakery items with a focus on clean food and convenience, anchored by the MyPanera loyalty program. Panera operates a private developer portal at developer.cloud.panerabread.com (built on Google Apigee X) that lists an APIs catalog and an OAuth-based authentication guide, but the API reference and OpenAPI specifications are gated behind authentication and are not publicly accessible. No openly documented, self-service public developer API is available at this time; access appears to be limited to partners and authenticated developers.

providers.name: Petual
providers.description: Petual is a direct-to-consumer pet wellness brand offering functional soft chews for dogs. The company sells six formulas — Thrive (daily longevity), Steady (calm & stress), Nourish (digestive & gut health), Soothe (skin & allergy), Spring (mobility & joint), and Lean (healthy weight & metabolism) — each an apothecary-style canister of 90 chews (9.5 oz) positioned as a daily ritual for a longer, healthier canine life. Backed by a16z and Cowboy Ventures. Petual publishes a consumer storefront only — no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, OpenAPI, well-known discovery, or agent surface was found. This profile tracks the company as a network lead and will be enriched if and when a developer program appears.

providers.name: Phoenix Labs
providers.description: Phoenix Labs is an independent video game developer with studios in Vancouver and Montreal, building immersive online worlds and community-driven games. Its titles include the free-to-play action RPG Dauntless and the cozy life-sim Fae Farm. The studio operates player-facing support and account services for its games but does not publish a public developer platform, API program, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Sapphire Ventures and enriched into the API Evangelist network; its API surface is currently none.

providers.name: Pilotly
providers.description: Pilotly is a media and content audience-testing research platform used by studios, streamers, and brands to test films, trailers, series, and advertising with targeted audiences before release. Its managed service pairs clients with expert research managers who handle survey design, audience targeting, and insights synthesis, while a Study Tracker guides each project through five stages (Requested, Setting up, Fielding, Analysis, Complete). Content is fielded through a secure, DRM-protected and watermarked video player across desktop, mobile, and smart TV. Pilotly is a managed-service SaaS with no public developer API surface; clients named on the site include Netflix, Amazon, Sony, Paramount, Warner Bros. Discovery, and Audible. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pingo AI
providers.description: Pingo AI, Inc. is a consumer language-learning application that uses conversational AI to help learners practice speaking across 15 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, and Arabic. Learners hold real-time voice conversations with an adaptive AI tutor and get a transcript and vocabulary list for every session, following personalized learning paths. Pingo is distributed as iOS and Android mobile apps and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform. Backed by Matrix Partners.

providers.name: PitPro Automation
providers.description: PitPro Automation is a fleet-maintenance technology company building automated tire-service systems that perform full tire changes and rotations on commercial fleet vehicles in under fifteen minutes. Targeting Class 2 and smaller vehicles, the company serves last-mile delivery, rideshare, utility, telecom, moving, and government fleets with in-bay automation, 24/7 monitoring, and field support. Backed by Bloomberg Beta, PitPro is a hardware-and-software provider focused on reducing fleet downtime; it currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK.

providers.name: PlayQ
providers.description: PlayQ is a Los Angeles-based mobile game developer and publisher creating free-to-play games for a global audience, including titles such as Charm King and Treasure Party. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass PlayQ operates a consumer-facing marketing and game-support website with no public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface; player support is routed through per-game Zendesk help centers.

providers.name: Pollen
providers.description: Pollen Technologies is a London-based, FCA-authorised white-label fintech platform that lets any business launch its own banking and payments product with no code and a fully managed back office. The platform delivers programmatic payment delivery, instant named IBAN account opening, third-party bank account linking for real-time balances and transaction data, multi-currency payments across 148 currencies into more than 160 countries, local payment schemes, and virtual and physical cards. A managed compliance layer covers KYC, AML, transaction monitoring, client fund safeguarding and help-desk support under SLAs. Pollen Technologies Ltd is authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority under the Payment Services Regulations 2017 (firm reference 768011), founded in 2015 and backed by Seedcamp, Level39 and Q-Advisers. Access to the underlying payments and banking APIs is delivered as a managed, partner-only service rather than a public self-serve developer program, so no public API specifications, SDKs or developer portal are currently published.

providers.name: Poppy
providers.description: Poppy (poppyflowers.com) is an online, full-service wedding florist that designs, delivers, and sets up personalized floral arrangements for weddings across multiple US locations. Couples receive a custom floral proposal based on their style preferences, with bridal and bridesmaid bouquets, boutonnieres, ceremony installations, arches, reception centerpieces, and table arrangements, all delivered and installed on-site by Poppy's team. The company publishes pricing guidance (a $1,750 order minimum, ~$3,400 average spend, a $249 deposit to secure dates) and offers interest-free monthly payment plans and flexible modifications up to 60 days before the event. Poppy was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Poppy operates a consumer-facing website only and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Pops
providers.description: Pops is a consumer mobile application, built by Undefined Software, Inc. and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026), that lets users create, remix, and share AI-powered mini games with friends. Every play instantly becomes a funny gameplay/reaction video you can send to friends. Pops is available on iOS and Android and is organized around game categories such as arcade, 3D, racing, sports, puzzles, party, and reaction games. It is an end-user social and gaming product with no public API, SDK, or developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Powerup Money
providers.description: PowerUp Money is an India-based mutual fund advisory app that helps retail investors select, monitor, and rebalance their mutual fund portfolios. It is operated by a SEBI-registered Investment Advisor (RIA No. INA000019798) and BSE member (IA-BSE Membership No. 2465), and describes itself as "India's trusted Mutual Fund Advisory App" serving 900,000+ investors. Consumer-facing features include portfolio performance analysis, fund recommendations (start/pause/exit SIP guidance), monthly portfolio reports, and Elite membership tools such as Power Rank fund selection, Rank Trends monitoring, and Power Rebalancing for tax-efficient quarterly adjustments. It is distributed as iOS and Android mobile apps; no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company.

providers.name: Preemadonna
providers.description: Preemadonna is a consumer hardware and software company best known for the Nailbot, a compact inkjet nail-art printer that prints custom designs onto fingernails, press-ons, gel, or bare nails in about five seconds. Backed by Version One Ventures, the company is building a creative-expression platform that pairs smart hardware with AI-powered design tools, consumables, and a creator marketplace, delivered through companion iOS and Android apps. The company holds 10+ utility patents. Preemadonna currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web, support, and policy footprint for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Prewitt Ridge
providers.description: Prewitt Ridge builds SysGit, "the collaboration layer for complex hardware" — an enterprise platform that applies software development practices to systems engineering. SysGit provides Git-based version control for requirements and system models, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) workflows, AI-assisted systems engineering automation, and SysMLv2 compliance for open-standards adherence. The platform targets defense and aerospace teams, with customers including the US Air Force, GTRI, Leidos, and Anduril. Prewitt Ridge is a Techstars-backed company added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or .well-known documents.

providers.name: Prophetic
providers.description: Prophetic is a San Francisco-based neurotechnology startup, incorporated in January 2023, building the world's first wearable device for stabilizing lucid dreams. Its "Halo" headband pairs EEG sensing with targeted transcranial focused ultrasound (tFUS) to noninvasively stimulate the prefrontal cortex, driven by an in-house AI model, Morpheus-1, that takes brain activity as its prompt and generates shaped ultrasonic waveforms as output. Backed by BoxGroup and a16z's Scout Fund, Prophetic sells its neuromodulation headbands direct-to-consumer. The company was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass Prophetic publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or programmatic integration surface — it is a consumer hardware and wellness company.

providers.name: Public Goods
providers.description: Public Goods is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce retailer selling household essentials, personal care, and home products under its own private label, with an emphasis on natural formulations, simplified ingredient lists, minimalist packaging, and sustainable sourcing. The company operates a membership model (an annual fee unlocking member pricing, free shipping, and store credit) and a wholesale channel. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail brand it publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: PUBLY
providers.description: PUBLY is a Korean career-development and content membership platform operated by NEWNEEK Co., Ltd. (뉴닉). It offers a subscription-based Career Membership giving working professionals access to curated career content, series, templates and job-transition guides, personalized daily recommendations by career stage, an AI feature (Perdy, beta), and a newsletter. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; PUBLY publishes a consumer web product and does not expose a public developer API, so this profile carries identity and security-posture signal only.

providers.name: Realty Mogul
providers.description: RealtyMogul is a real estate crowdfunding and investment platform that gives individual and institutional investors online access to commercial real estate opportunities, including private placements, 1031 Exchange properties, and Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs). The company performs due diligence on sponsors, business plans, and properties, and provides members with a secure website and online tools to evaluate and invest in professionally managed real estate. RealtyMogul publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Reliance Steel & Aluminum
providers.description: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co. is the largest metals service center in North America, providing value-added metals processing services and distributing a full line of metal products including aluminum, brass, bronze, carbon and alloy steel, copper, titanium, and stainless steel. Operating over 300 service center locations across 40 US states and 13 countries, Reliance serves more than 130,000 customers across aerospace, automotive, defense, energy, electronics, construction, and semiconductor end markets.

providers.name: Remedyskin
providers.description: Remedyskin (Remedy Science, operated by Doctorly Skin Inc.) is a dermatologist-developed skincare and beauty brand founded by Dr. Muneeb Shah. It sells a direct-to-consumer line of advanced skincare treatments organized by concern (dark spots, aging, pore size, body texture) and skin type, spanning cleansers, treatment serums, moisturizers, targeted solutions, and bundles, built around a "Do No Harm" formulation principle that excludes fragrances and common irritants. The storefront runs on Shopify with a Gorgias-powered help center and mobile apps on iOS and Android. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners. Enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface — this is a consumer e-commerce brand with no developer program.

providers.name: Replika
providers.description: Replika is a consumer AI companion chatbot created by Luka, Inc., launched November 2017 and now serving 40+ million users. The product personalizes a neural network through user conversations and offers free "friend" plus paid "partner / spouse / sibling / mentor" relationship modes via iOS, Android, Oculus Rift, and a legacy web app at my.replika.com. There is no public developer API or partner program.

providers.name: Resulticks
providers.description: Resulticks is a next-generation, data-driven omnichannel marketing automation and audience engagement platform built for real-time customer engagement. Operating under the RESUL brand, it combines a cookie-independent customer data platform (CDP) with omnichannel campaign orchestration across email, SMS, push, WhatsApp, web, and social channels, plus AI-assisted audience building and analytics. Resulticks targets enterprise marketers across industries and regions, and is backed by 500 Global. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public marketing site; Resulticks does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition, so no API-specification artifacts are catalogued here.

providers.name: Retailo
providers.description: Retailo (Retailo Technologies) operates a B2B marketplace that helps independent retailers across the MENAP region (Middle East, North Africa and Pakistan) restock their shops, offering thousands of products, instant price comparisons and next-day delivery through the Retailo App. Its ecosystem also includes the Hisaab App, a fintech and bookkeeping product for merchants, and HORECA supply services for the hospitality trade. Founded by Talha Ansari, Muhammad Nowkhaiz and Wahaj Ahmed and backed by 500 Global, the company is operational in markets including the UAE and Pakistan. Retailo distributes its products as native iOS and Android mobile applications and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: Royal
providers.description: Royal is a music-and-crypto company backed by a16z and Paradigm that originally let fans buy tokenized shares of songs (Limited Digital Assets, or LDAs) so they could earn streaming royalties alongside the artists they support. As of mid-2026 the public site at royal.io states the company is "reinventing itself" and is between products, keeping only its legal pages and LDA support live; it publishes no developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or public API surface at this time. This profile tracks Royal as an API Evangelist network company and will be enriched further if and when a public API or developer program appears.

providers.name: Rupeek
providers.description: Rupeek is an asset-backed online gold loan company operating across India, enabling customers to borrow money by pledging gold jewelry as collateral. Its products include gold loans (from around 30,000 up to 1.5 crore rupees), gold loan balance transfers, the Rupeek Gold Card, part/full gold release, and an online repayment portal. The company partners with banks such as Federal Bank, Indian Bank, and South Indian Bank, offers 100% insurance coverage via New India Assurance, and delivers its consumer experience primarily through its website and highly-rated mobile app. It is ISO 27001 certified. Rupeek is a consumer fintech surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and GGV Capital; it publishes no public developer API surface, so this profile is an identity-only company record.

providers.name: Savi Technology
providers.description: Savi Technology provides Internet of Things (IoT) and active RFID (aRFID) solutions for real-time supply chain visibility, asset tracking, and cargo security. Combining active RFID tags, environmental condition sensors, and machine intelligence, Savi delivers location, condition, and estimated-time- of-arrival data for cargo and high-value assets across government, military (including U.S. Department of Defense in-transit visibility), and commercial supply chains. The company is headquartered in Wilmington, North Carolina. As of this enrichment pass, Savi Technology exposes no public developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDKs, or documented web API; its only authenticated surface is the aRFID-VI customer catalog (savirfidcatalog.net).

providers.name: Scalera
providers.description: Scalera AG is a Swiss construction-technology company building an AI platform that automates the tender and quotation process for the construction industry across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland). Its product-matching engine extracts positions from tender documents (PDF, GAEB, Excel/CSV, XML, email) and matches them against supplier product catalogs, while its supplier-matching tools help contractors identify relevant manufacturers and send structured inquiries. Scalera integrates with ERP, CRM, and PIM systems and serves 200+ manufacturers, processors, and traders. Backed by Speedinvest, it positions itself as one of Europe's most funded construction-tech startups. This profile documents the company's public web surface; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Scondoo
providers.description: Scondoo is a German consumer cashback and coupon platform, operated by acardo group AG, that lets shoppers earn money back on everyday grocery and drugstore purchases. Users browse exclusive cashback deals in the scondoo iOS and Android apps, buy the qualifying products at any supermarket or drugstore (Kaufland, REWE, EDEKA, Netto, Aldi, Lidl, dm, Rossmann and many more), then snap a photo of the receipt to have the cashback credited to their balance and paid out via bank transfer or PayPal. The service is consumer-facing and mobile-only; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or partner integration surface.

providers.name: ScoreBig (TicketNetwork)
providers.description: ScoreBig is an online event-ticket resale marketplace owned by TicketNetwork, selling tickets to live sports, concert, and theater events with an emphasis on transparent, all-in pricing (no extra fees or hidden costs) and a money-back guarantee. Its parent, TicketNetwork, operates the Mercury Web Services API and Mercury Retail integration platform, an API-driven, real-time ticket-inventory feed offered to partners under contract. ScoreBig itself is a consumer storefront and does not publish a public developer API; Mercury is partner-gated behind a sales/onboarding contact form with a sandbox provided to approved integrators. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Senra Systems
providers.description: Senra Systems is an aerospace wire harness manufacturer based in Redondo Beach, California, that unites design, data, and production under one roof. The company builds complex electrical wire harnesses for aerospace and defense programs, spanning wire harness design and engineering support, prototype through full-rate production, component selection and supply chain optimization, and precision automation in a 15,000 square foot smart-manufacturing facility. Senra positions itself as delivering harnesses at roughly four times the speed of traditional vendors while maintaining aerospace-grade quality and certifications. Senra Systems is backed by Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 8VC, and General Catalyst. The company does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Set Scouter
providers.description: Set Scouter is a location-scouting marketplace, built by former producers, that connects film, television, commercial, and branded-content productions with residential and commercial filming locations across North America. Producers browse film-ready spaces — kitchens, lofts, warehouses, mansions and more — arrange in-person scouts, and book online with payments, deposits and overtime handled by the platform, while property owners list their spaces to earn income from productions. The company operates from offices in Toronto and Los Angeles, serving markets including Toronto, New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Chicago, Vancouver, Montreal and Atlanta.

providers.name: ShopLook
providers.description: ShopLook is a consumer fashion discovery and outfit-creation platform where a community of over two million creators design and share outfit ideas on a drag-and-drop styling canvas. Everyday shoppers browse the feed, follow designers, and shop expertly designed looks for any occasion, body type, and budget across the web (shoplook.io) and native iOS and Android apps, with an AI personal stylist and a rewards model that pays creators for outfits that inspire purchases. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Silo
providers.description: Silo is a cloud-based ERP platform built specifically for the fresh-produce supply chain, serving growers, packers, shippers, and distributors. The platform unifies produce operations across five modules - a diversified produce ERP, labor and asset management, payments and financial operations, EDI and traceability, and analytics and intelligence - to improve operational efficiency and financial visibility for small to midsize produce businesses. Silo is backed by a16z and Initialized Capital. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Silvur
providers.description: Silvur (Silvur Technology Services, Inc.) is a white-label financial-wellness platform that helps credit unions and financial institutions deliver personalized retirement education and planning tools to their members and customers. Its patent-pending Retirement Score answers "how long will their money last in retirement?" and its SmartDraw technology generates personalized recommendations across Social Security, Medicare, retirement savings, and state-specific planning. Institutions launch a fully branded retirement website in weeks and use it to educate members and market financial products such as loans, mortgages, and insurance against the multi-trillion-dollar retirement wallet. Silvur is a venture-backed fintech (Anthemis portfolio). As of this enrichment pass Silvur publishes only a marketing site with legal and support pages and exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or webhooks.

providers.name: Simplifyber
providers.description: Simplifyber is a sustainable footwear and materials technology company that manufactures shoe uppers and other components using a proprietary fiber-molding process. By casting products directly from a liquid, cellulose-based material it eliminates the spinning, weaving, and knitting steps and much of the cutting and sewing of traditional shoemaking, which it says lowers the CO2 emissions of a shoe upper by roughly 33x versus conventional methods. Its flagship Moon Shoe was developed with the fashion brand Ganni. Simplifyber is a Techstars-backed startup. It operates as a consumer and industrial manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Skylo
providers.description: Skylo Technologies is a satellite communications company based in Mountain View, California, operating a global Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN) that lets standard smartphones and IoT cellular devices connect directly to satellites over 3GPP Release 17 direct-to-device (D2D) standards for SMS, sensor telemetry, and other low-bandwidth messaging. Founded in 2017 and backed by DCM, SoftBank, Intel Capital, Innovation Endeavors, BMW i Ventures, Samsung Catalyst, Next47, Seraphim Space, and NGP Capital, Skylo has commercial service across the US, Brazil, Australia, New Zealand, and Europe. Skylo does not publish a public REST/HTTP API; developer integration is device-level (certified modules such as Quectel, Murata, Blues Notecard and Particle) with detailed procedures gated behind a partner Knowledge Base. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company and its developer surface.

providers.name: Smilobaby
providers.description: Smilo (Smilobaby) is a direct-to-consumer baby and toddler products brand founded in 2016 and based in Boston, backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Products are developed by doctors, scientists and engineers and sold direct via smilobaby.com, spanning bottle feeding, pacifiers and teethers, pregnancy and nursing, nursery, mealtime and bath. Its hero products are a pediatric-dentist-designed pacifier that supports a baby's developing palate and a patented-nipple bottle with an extra-sensitive vent that simulates breastfeeding. This is a consumer e-commerce retail brand: it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI, so the enrichment pass records identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: smol
providers.description: smol (smol.com, formerly reachable via smolproducts.com) is a UK-based Certified B Corporation direct-to-consumer home cleaning brand founded in 2018 by ex-Unilever product leaders. It sells concentrated, eco-conscious laundry capsules, dishwasher tablets, and household cleaning products on a letterbox subscription model designed to cut plastic, carbon, and chemical waste. smol runs a consumer e-commerce storefront and a Zendesk help centre only; enrichment found no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, webhooks, or agent/MCP surface.

providers.name: Snowman
providers.description: Snowman Logistics is an Indian integrated cold-chain and temperature-controlled logistics company headquartered in Bengaluru, providing refrigerated (frozen and chilled) warehousing, cold storage, and distribution services across India. It serves frozen and chilled foods, dairy, seafood, quick-service restaurants, pharmaceuticals, and other perishables through a national network of temperature-controlled warehouses and a refrigerated transportation fleet. The company is publicly listed on Indian exchanges and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the enrichment pass confirmed the company publishes a marketing/corporate website (snowman.in) but exposes no public developer, API, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Splitty
providers.description: Splitty (splittytravel.com) is a Techstars-backed online travel company that offered discounted hotel bookings by algorithmically splitting a single multi-night stay across separate reservations to surface lower nightly rates. The consumer service has since been wound down and now operates as "Splitty by trivago DEALS Ltd." - it no longer accepts new bookings and only lets existing customers manage their reservations, redirecting new hotel searches to trivago DEALS (trivago.DEALS). Splitty publishes no public developer program, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Stockeld Dreamery
providers.description: Stockeld Dreamery is a Swedish food-tech company founded in Stockholm in early 2019 by Sorosh Tavakoli (previously founder of the video-advertising company Videoplaza) to reinvent animal-based staples as plant-based alternatives, starting with cheese. The company develops and manufactures fermented, legume-based cultured cheese products — including a cream cheese and a melting cheese aimed at foodservice — as a sustainable substitute for dairy. Backed by venture investors including Creandum and Northzone, Stockeld Dreamery operates as a consumer packaged-goods brand and does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Sulekha
providers.description: Sulekha is an online local-services marketplace and classifieds platform serving Indian communities in the United States and Canada (us.sulekha.com) as well as its origin market in India (sulekha.com). It connects consumers with local service providers across housing and rentals, events and concert tickets, jobs, care services (nannies, eldercare, housekeeping), real estate, beauty, photography, immigration, astrology, travel and IT training. Sulekha operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace rather than an API producer; no public developer portal, API reference, or programmatic integration surface is published. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: Supersolid
providers.description: Supersolid is a London, UK based mobile game developer and publisher, backed by Index Ventures, that designs and operates free-to-play mobile titles across merge, cooking, simulation, and multiplayer arena genres. Its portfolio includes Cook & Merge, Snake Rivals, Home Street, Food Street, Adventure Town, Super Penguins, and RoPets. Supersolid is a consumer-facing games studio and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web properties (support, careers, terms, privacy) and domain-security posture. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures.

providers.name: Swish
providers.description: Swish (operated by Munchmart Technologies Private Limited) is a Bengaluru-based quick-commerce food delivery startup founded in 2024 that promises meals at your door in ten minutes. It runs a full-stack, vertically integrated model — owning its neighbourhood cloud kitchens ("delight centres"), sourcing and supply chain, proprietary ordering/routing technology, and its own last-mile delivery fleet — operating dense hyperlocal clusters of roughly 1.5–2 km. The company focuses on frequent, lower-ticket occasions such as breakfast, snacks, and late-night meals, and reports around 20,000 orders a day across Bengaluru micro-markets. Swish raised a $38M Series B led by Hara Global and Bain Capital Ventures with participation from Accel, valuing it at $139M post-money and bringing total funding to about $54M. Swish is a consumer mobile-app business and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: tagSpace
providers.description: tagSpace is a Spatial AI platform, part of the tagStorm group, that lets creators and brands publish interactive augmented-reality experiences and spatial content anchored to real-world places. Through its create, explore, and publish surfaces, tagSpace offers a creator-economy platform where makers showcase spatial "tags," and its tagAI layer applies AI to spatial content. It markets to brands and enterprises (B2B) with named partners including RTL, Telekom, Telstra, Warner Music Group and others. The public site is a Framer marketing presence; as of this enrichment pass tagSpace exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or well-known API metadata. This profile remains an identity-only company record.

providers.name: TaleMonster Games
providers.description: TaleMonster Games is a fully remote mobile game studio whose mission is to create games that surprise, challenge, and evolve with players. The team is united by a shared obsession for product craft and a deep love for games, and ships casual mobile titles to iOS and Android. Its debut title, Match Valley, is a casual match puzzle game published on the Apple App Store and Google Play. TaleMonster Games publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or technical documentation; this profile captures its public company and product identity.

providers.name: Talofa Games
providers.description: Talofa Games is a mobile game developer and publisher backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). The studio builds social fitness games that turn real-world physical activity into cooperative multiplayer play. Its flagship title, Run Legends, is a free-to-play running RPG available on iOS and Android in which players' real-world runs and walks power team battles against monsters, and its newer title Monster Walk is in closed beta. Talofa Games is a consumer mobile-gaming company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and public web presence rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Taxa
providers.description: Taxa Technologies is a San Francisco and Tokyo synthetic-biology startup engineering the human skin microbiome. Its debut consumer product is a shelf-stable probiotic deodorant cream: a single application of Taxa Probiotics (25.4 billion CFUs in a base of water, mango butter, and sunflower extract) lasts one week by swapping out the skin microbes responsible for body odor, with a line focused on Wakiga (severe underarm odor). The company frames the skin microbiome as a platform whose microbes drive body odor, UV absorption, and mosquito attraction. Backed by Matrix Partners, Taxa currently runs a product waitlist and publishes a consumer marketing site with People, Science, Terms, and Privacy pages, but no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: TEDI
providers.description: TEDI (Tecnologia y Educacion Innovadora) is a Latin American EdTech platform delivering professional training for the construction and engineering industries under the motto "Mejores profesionales, mejores paises." It runs 150+ live and recorded courses each month covering BIM, VDC, Lean management, and project management, plus Autodesk/PMI-aligned certifications, an exclusive construction job board, a professional community, the EDI AI learning assistant, and a TEDICOINS rewards system. TEDI reports 50,000+ certified students across 18+ countries with 150+ expert instructors, and is backed by 500 Global. The company operates a consumer-facing web platform (tedivirtual.com / tedicomunidad.com) and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Tennibot
providers.description: Tennibot builds AI-powered ball machines and autonomous ball collectors for tennis, pickleball, and padel. Its flagship Partner ball machine and Rover ball collector use computer vision and robotics to deliver realistic drills and eliminate manual ball pickup, controlled through the Tennibot mobile app for iOS and Android. The company, based in Auburn, Alabama and backed by Techstars, sells direct-to-consumer hardware; it ships a companion mobile app but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record; no external API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: TerraFirma
providers.description: TerraFirma, Inc. is a construction technology and physical-AI company building the robotic infrastructure stack for modern heavy-civil construction. Founded in 2024 by former SpaceX engineers and based in Austin, Texas, it combines AI-enabled pre-construction software (Mission Planner), a remote command-and-control center (Mission Control), and retrofitted semi-autonomous heavy machinery — excavators, bulldozers, loaders, graders and rollers operated autonomously, remotely, or traditionally. The company raised roughly $115M including a $100M Series A led by Kleiner Perkins with Bain Capital Ventures. TerraFirma publishes no public developer/API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Tessera Labs
providers.description: Tessera Labs is an AI-native enterprise software company building a governed, multi-agent AI platform that automates complex ERP and business-system transformations, compressing SAP ECC-to-S/4HANA migrations and broader modernization work from years to weeks. The platform orchestrates data, process, and code changes across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems (SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Oracle) with enterprise governance, full audit trails, and traceability, letting business teams describe requirements in natural language. Founded by AI researchers and enterprise-software veterans and backed by a $60M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz. Tessera Labs currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; it is a sales-led enterprise platform.

providers.name: Theretailequation
providers.description: The Retail Equation (TRE) is an Irvine, California software and analytics company that helps retailers detect and prevent fraudulent transactions and reduce return/exchange policy abuse.
