Its core Transaction Authorization service analyzes a shopper's linked purchase, return, and exchange history in real time and returns an approve, warn, or deny recommendation at the point of return — scoring transaction frequency, value, and receipt status while explicitly excluding demographic factors. TRE is part of Appriss Retail. The public web presence is a marketing and consumer-inquiry site plus an authenticated retailer Return Activity Report (RAR) portal; no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface is published.

providers.name: TheSkimm
providers.description: TheSkimm is a digital media company founded in 2012 that curates news, lifestyle, money, career, and wellness content for a primarily female audience, delivered through email newsletters (the flagship Daily Skimm, plus Well Played, Skimm Well + Good, and Skimm Shopping), a mobile app, podcasts, and shopping guides. It is now part of Everyday Health, Inc., a Ziff Davis company. TheSkimm operates as a consumer media and audience business rather than an API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a portfolio lead of GV (Google Ventures) and enriched with the company's public identity, link properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Timehop
providers.description: Timehop is a consumer mobile application that resurfaces a person's past photos, videos, and social media posts as daily "memories," letting people celebrate what they were doing on this day one, five, or more years ago. It aggregates content from a user's camera roll and connected social accounts and presents it back on a nostalgic timeline. Timehop is made by Sincere Corporation, a family of consumer brands that also includes Punchbowl, Lovebird, and Memento. Timehop ships as iOS and Android apps and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures the company's public web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Tinvio
providers.description: Tinvio is a Singapore-based B2B commerce and payments SaaS that helped merchants and their suppliers manage ordering, invoicing, and business payments across Southeast Asia. The company was backed by Partech. As of 2026 Tinvio has been integrated into Jaz (jaz.ai), an AI-powered accounting platform for modern businesses, and now operates as a feature within Jaz rather than as a standalone product; tinvio.com redirects to the Jaz landing page. Tinvio does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, SDK, CLI, or OpenAPI definition, so this profile captures the company identity and its live domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Triumph Arcade
providers.description: Triumph Labs (originally Triumph Arcade) is a consumer entertainment and commerce company that builds mobile apps for competitive, skill-based gaming and collectibles. Its flagship products are Triumph: Play for Cash, a real-money skill-gaming platform, and Rips by Triumph, a live collectibles and trading-card ripping experience. Backed by Multicoin Capital, the company operates consumer iOS apps and publishes no public developer API surface; this profile tracks the company identity, legal, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vannevar Labs
providers.description: Vannevar Labs is a defense technology company that builds agentic AI for national security missions. Its Agent Orchestration platform fuses defense-grade foundational data, mission requirements, and strategic reasoning into mission-focused AI agents — spanning course-of-action, force-protection, information-operations, and cross-border pattern-analysis agents — used from tactical kill-chain decisions to theater-level campaigns. The company collects hard-to-reach data from adversarial information environments to train models for national security, and works across mission areas including Indo-Pacific deterrence, homeland security, and intelligent statecraft. Backed by General Catalyst; no public developer portal or API surface is published.

providers.name: videogame.ai
providers.description: videogame.ai is an AI-native game development studio that uses fleets of autonomous AI coding agents to build, ship, and operate video games. The company offers full-service game development delivered in days at the cost of a single full-time employee, along with automated live-ops pipelines, a multiplayer engine optimized for AI coding agents, an AI-native asset and media management system, and autonomous generation of ads and creative from game builds. Featured titles include Zero Hour, a narrative game set on a frozen planet, and Imperfect World, an RPG built around time-loop mechanics. Backed by a16z (SR02) and Konvoy. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the studio publishes a marketing site and contact channel but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Villoid
providers.description: Villoid is a Norwegian online fashion retailer (villoid.no, redirected from villoid.com) operating a Shopify-hosted boutique that curates over 250 designer and contemporary womenswear brands such as Ganni, Isabel Marant, Stella McCartney and ROTATE Birger Christensen. The store sells dresses, shoes, bags, accessories, sportswear and home goods, offering same-day delivery in Norway, easy returns, gift cards and payment via Klarna, Vipps, Visa and Mastercard. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global, Villoid exposes a consumer storefront and publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Vioo
providers.description: Vioo is a Mexican professional visual-content platform that connects businesses with a national network of 1,500+ certified photographers and creators across Mexico, delivering photography, videography, drone footage, 3D renders, and Matterport virtual tours. It serves real estate, gastronomy, e-commerce, hospitality, events, and portrait use cases with AI-assisted editing and 48-hour delivery, and offers scheduling either through a personalized form or automatically via an integration API. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vir
providers.description: Vir Biotechnology, Inc. (NASDAQ: VIR) is a clinical-stage immunology company headquartered in San Francisco that combines immunologic insights with modern technology platforms to treat and prevent serious infectious diseases and, increasingly, cancer. Its pipeline spans chronic hepatitis B and D, respiratory infections, and dual-masked T-cell engagers for solid tumors, built on antibody, T-cell, innate-immunity, and small interfering RNA (siRNA) platforms. Vir is a research and corporate organization surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal — only its corporate and investor websites.

providers.name: Volterra
providers.description: Volterra was a Santa Clara-based distributed cloud company founded in 2017 by Ankur Singla, Harshad Nakil, and Ashish Ranjan, offering the VoltMesh (multi-cloud networking and security) and VoltStack (edge application deployment) SaaS platforms on a global application delivery network. Backed by roughly $50M from Khosla Ventures, Mayfield, M12, Samsung NEXT, and Itochu Technology Ventures, Volterra was acquired by F5 in January 2021 for approximately $500M and became the foundation of F5 Distributed Cloud Services. Its API surface (ves.io.schema, console.ves.volterra.io) is catalogued in the F5 Distributed Cloud Services profile, while the Volterra-branded Terraform provider and vesctl CLI remain published and maintained by F5.

providers.name: WebComics
providers.description: WebComics (webcomicsapp.com) is a digital comics reading platform for Asian serialized comics, offering a large free library of manhua, manhwa, and manga across genres such as fantasy, romance, action, drama, horror, and slice-of-life. Readers browse trending titles, daily picks, new arrivals, and recent updates on the web and through native iOS and Android apps, while creators publish work through a separate Contribution Studio. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass WebComics exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or webhook surface; it operates as a consumer content application, so this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture rather than an API integration surface.

providers.name: Webloyalty
providers.description: Webloyalty is a customer-engagement and loyalty-marketing company that helps ecommerce and retail businesses build stronger, more profitable customer relationships. Its market-leading rewards platform delivers savings, cashback, and shopping benefits to consumers, typically presented after an online transaction, while generating incremental secondary revenue for the retail partner. Founded in 1999 and historically part of the Affinion Group, the company operates localized programs across the United States, United Kingdom, France, Ireland, Spain, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Turkey, and Mexico. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. Webloyalty markets a consumer rewards/membership product and a partner engagement platform, but publishes no public developer program or API.

providers.name: Wollit
providers.description: Wollit is a UK-based credit-health subscription service (£9.99/month) that helps consumers build and strengthen their credit profile. Authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority for credit-broking activities, Wollit reports rent and subscription payments to Experian, Equifax and TransUnion, and bundles a suite of consumer tools: Rent Reporting, Payment Reporting, an AI credit assistant (Olli), Affordability Boost, Credit Smart lessons, and Credit Wins. It is a consumer-facing fintech app and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: X Zell
providers.description: X-ZELL is a Thailand-based medical technology company (Y Combinator W15) building a multiplex cytopathology product ecosystem that combines cryofixation, immunostaining, and digital imaging to turn limited cytology specimens into data-rich diagnostic workflows. Its Cryosuite platform pairs a Cryofixator and Cryostainer for specimen processing and automated staining, alongside Cryophore multiplex antibody panels for pleural fluid, ascitic fluid, and tumor-origin analysis, validated conjugated antibodies, and ISO 13485-certified reagent and OEM manufacturing. Founded by physician-scientist Sebastian Punyaratabandhu Bhakdi, the company originated in rare-cell detection (Circulating Endothelial Cells). It is a hardware, reagent, and laboratory-instrument business and publishes no public API, developer platform, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Zimmer Biomet
providers.description: Zimmer Biomet is a global medical technology company that designs, manufactures, and markets orthopedic reconstructive products, sports medicine, biologics, extremities, trauma products, dental implants, and related surgical products. The company is a Fortune 500 organization with operations in over 25 countries and a portfolio of digital and robotic technologies including ZBEdge Dynamic Intelligence, ROSA Robotics, the mymobility patient app, Persona Knee, and ZBEdge Analytics. Zimmer Biomet does not currently publish a public REST API developer portal; its digital platforms are surfaced through partner integrations, hospital systems, and proprietary devices.

providers.name: Zingroll
providers.description: Zingroll is a consumer AI entertainment platform that generates personalized episodic video shows starring the user. A person uploads a single selfie and Zingroll casts them as the lead in an AI-generated series spanning up to 200 episodes across genres including action, romance, horror, and comedy, which can then be watched and shared. Backed by Accel, Zingroll operates in the AI media and generative-video space. The company runs a public consumer web application at zingroll.com but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile tracks it in the API Evangelist network as an AI-sector lead.

providers.name: Zoox
providers.description: Zoox is an Amazon subsidiary developing a purpose-built, bidirectional, symmetrical robotaxi vehicle designed from the ground up for autonomous ride-hailing rather than retrofitted from a conventional car. The vehicle carries up to four riders in a carriage-style seating layout, has no steering wheel or pedals, and is engineered for dense urban operation. Zoox provides the autonomous driving stack, the vehicle hardware, and a consumer ride-hail app. Commercial robotaxi service has launched in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with expansion announced for Austin, Miami, Atlanta, and Los Angeles. Acquired by Amazon in 2020, Zoox does not publish a public developer API or open research dataset; its public surface is product, ride-experience, and safety content. This profile captures the company surface for API Evangelist reference.

providers.name: 8th Wall
providers.description: 8th Wall is a web-based augmented reality (WebAR) platform originally founded in 2016 and acquired by Niantic in March 2022. Following Niantic's 2025 sale of its gaming division to Scopely and the spin-off of Niantic Spatial, Inc. as an independent geospatial AI and XR company, 8th Wall's hosted cloud editor, login, and Niantic Studio services were retired on February 28, 2026 and the platform transitioned to a free, open-source distribution model. Existing published 8th Wall experiences continue to run through February 28, 2027. The 8th Wall stack centers on the XR Engine — a SLAM-based WebAR runtime providing World Tracking, Image Targets, Face Effects, Sky Segmentation, and World Effects — exposed to developers as a TypeScript/JavaScript SDK that integrates with A-Frame, three.js, PlayCanvas, and Babylon.js. The Distributed Engine Binary (released January 2026) ships SLAM under a binary-only license for commercial and noncommercial use, while the surrounding framework, utilities, and example projects are MIT-licensed on the 8thwall GitHub organization. 8th Wall Studio (formerly Niantic Studio) is a real-time visual editor and game engine for authoring 3D and XR experiences that can be deployed to any web host. 8th Wall does not publish a public REST or HTTP API; the developer surface is a client-side JavaScript SDK plus command-line and utility tooling distributed through GitHub.

providers.name: 99Bill
providers.description: 99Bill Corporation (快钱, Kuaiqian) is one of China's leading independent third-party electronic payment service providers, offering a comprehensive suite of online payment, mobile payment, and settlement solutions for merchants and enterprises. Its Kuaiqian Merchant Open Platform (open.99bill.com) exposes standardized payment interfaces over common internet protocols, covering protocol/agreement (card-free) payments, online banking (B2C and B2B) payments, and WeChat Official Account and Mini-Program payments, with SDKs and demo code published for Java, PHP, and .NET. Developers select a product in the Product Center, build against a sandbox using provided demos, then contact 99Bill business staff to activate a production merchant account (issued MerchantAcctID and product keys) before going live. 99Bill was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures and is profiled here in the API Evangelist network. No public OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or package-registry SDK was found during enrichment; developer resources are distributed through the authenticated open platform and help center.

providers.name: Alchemab Therapeutics
providers.description: Alchemab Therapeutics is a UK-based clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation antibody therapeutics for hard-to-treat diseases. Its "Adaptive Immunity" platform identifies naturally resilient individuals, such as long-term cancer survivors, and harnesses their protective antibodies, using artificial intelligence and deep learning to translate these natural immune responses into novel human-derived therapeutics across neurodegeneration, oncology, and other areas of high unmet need. Alchemab was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. As a research-stage therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API program, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Alexandria Real Estate Equities
providers.description: Alexandria Real Estate Equities is an urban office REIT and the leading owner, operator, and developer of life science, agtech, and technology campuses in AAA innovation cluster locations across the United States. The company partners with biotechnology, pharmaceutical, agtech, and technology firms to provide laboratory and office space, venture investments, and thought leadership. Alexandria Real Estate Equities does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: Atolls
providers.description: Atolls (formerly Global Savings Group) is a Munich-based consumer commerce-content company that operates the world's largest shopping engagement platform, running coupon, cashback, deals, and shopping-community destinations across more than 20 markets. Its brand portfolio includes Coupons.com, Cuponation, iGraal, Shoop, Pouch, mydealz, hotukdeals, and Deala, connecting millions of shoppers with offers from thousands of retailers and brands through affiliate marketing, cashback, and AI-enhanced shopping insights. Founded in 2012 as CupoNation with Rocket Internet and rebranded to Atolls in 2024, it is backed by investors including HV Capital, RTP Global, and Rocket Internet. Atolls does not expose a public developer API; this profile captures its public consumer, security, and legal surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Balerion
providers.description: Balerion (Balerion AI) is a San Francisco-based agentic AI platform for mortgage loan origination, underwriting, and processing. Its flagship product, Loan Intelligence, is an agentic reasoning engine embedded directly into the origination workflow that automates the loan manufacturing lifecycle — complex high-precision income calculation, guideline validation, document checks, and identifying derogatory conditions in bank and credit data through underwriting and closing. The company raised a $6M seed round in April 2026 led by Kleiner Perkins with participation from Formation and BoxGroup, and was co-founded by CEO Naren Krishna (previously a founding member of Snowflake-acquired Ponder) and CTO Vishal Satish. Early customers include residential lender FM Home Loans. As of this profile Balerion publishes a marketing website only — no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs are available.

providers.name: Centivax
providers.description: Centivax is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, California, developing broad-spectrum vaccines to prevent infectious diseases at scale. Its lead program is a universal, broadly protective influenza vaccine in Phase 1 clinical development designed to protect against all strains of the virus. The company's pandemic-prevention work received a Gates Foundation Grand Challenge award and was featured in Netflix's "Pandemic: How to Prevent an Outbreak." Centivax's mission is to accelerate the world's transition to a post-pathogen humanity. This is a life-sciences company profile in the API Evangelist network; Centivax does not currently publish a public developer or API platform.

providers.name: CLAUDE.md
providers.description: CLAUDE.md is the markdown-based project memory format used by Anthropic's Claude Code CLI to give the model persistent, session-spanning instructions about a codebase. CLAUDE.md files are plain markdown that Claude Code loads at the start of every session by walking up the directory tree from the working directory, picking up files at organization-managed, user (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md), project (./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md), and local (./CLAUDE.local.md) scopes. The format supports an @path import syntax for composing files together (up to five hops, relative or absolute), HTML block comments that are stripped before injection, an AGENTS.md import pattern for compatibility with other agents, and a complementary .claude/rules/ directory of path-scoped markdown rules with YAML frontmatter. CLAUDE.md is the human-authored counterpart to Claude Code's auto memory at ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/MEMORY.md, which Claude writes itself.

providers.name: Closure
providers.description: Closure (Closure Intelligence, Inc.) builds an AI-powered digital analyst platform for law enforcement agencies that securely transcribes, translates, searches, organizes, and analyzes case evidence — jail communications, warrant returns, and large multi-lingual case files — to help investigators overcome evidence overload and resolve homicides and cold cases. The platform runs under a zero-access security model with SOC 2 Type II, CJIS, and HIPAA compliance. Backed by CRV. No public API or developer program is currently published.

providers.name: Codoxo
providers.description: Codoxo is an AI-driven healthcare cost-containment and payment-integrity platform serving health plans, PBMs, and government agencies across more than 80 million lives. Its Forensic AI Platform powers Provider Scope (pre-claim provider education), Audit Scope, Fraud Scope, and Payment Scope, alongside the generative ClaimPilot suite for clinical record review, compliance validation, and concept data mining. Codoxo was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, portal, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures company identity and security posture only.

providers.name: Corvia Medical
providers.description: Corvia Medical, Inc. is a medical device company headquartered in Tewksbury, Massachusetts that develops interventional cardiology solutions for heart failure. Its lead product is the Corvia Atrial Shunt System (IASD), a transcatheter implant indicated for improving quality of life and reducing heart-failure symptoms in patients with elevated left atrial pressures who remain symptomatic despite guideline-directed medical therapy. The company has been backed by General Catalyst since 2009. Corvia Medical publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface; its web presence is clinical, patient, and regulatory information only.

providers.name: Crave Retail
providers.description: Crave Retail, Inc. builds in-store retail technology that connects shoppers, store associates, and product data across physical touchpoints. Its platform spans Crave Engage (customer-facing digital shopping assistants in fitting rooms, on the sales floor, and on mobile), Crave Assist (store-associate tools for floor visibility, service routing, and item lookup), and Smart Fitting Rooms, the RFID-based connected fitting-room product it started with. Crave reports 3,000+ live touchpoints, 27M+ shopper sessions, and operations across 10+ countries. The company is Techstars-backed. As of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing and legal web presence but no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: Custom Ink
providers.description: Custom Ink is a direct-to-consumer custom apparel and promotional products company that lets groups design and order custom t-shirts, hoodies, hats, drinkware, bags, and other branded merchandise through an online Design Lab, instant price quotes, and full-service order fulfillment. As of the review date Custom Ink does not publish a public or partner developer API - there is no documented, self-serve programmatic surface for products, designs, quotes, or orders. An internal API host (api.customink.com) backs Custom Ink's own web and mobile storefront but is private and undocumented, secured behind AWS API Gateway and Cognito. Partnerships are handled as commercial/business relationships rather than technical developer integrations. This entry is a gated stub - the logical APIs below are honestly MODELED from Custom Ink's public product surface, not sourced from published API documentation, and no endpoints are fabricated as if real.

providers.name: DeepSight Technology
providers.description: DeepSight Technology is a medical-imaging company reinventing diagnostic ultrasound. It is building a semiconductor-based ultrasound sensor and imaging platform (including its NeedleVue technology) to deliver a step-change in ultrasound performance, making this safe, non-invasive, radiation-free, low-cost imaging modality far more usable across clinical applications. The company is a hardware and medical-device business backed by Wing Venture Capital and Deerfield; it is added to the API Evangelist network as a Wing portfolio lead. It does not currently publish a public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Easypanel
providers.description: Easypanel is a modern, self-hosted server control panel powered by Docker and Docker Swarm that simplifies application deployment, database provisioning, and server management through an intuitive web interface. Operators can deploy applications from GitHub repositories using Heroku Buildpacks (Node.js, Ruby, Python, PHP, Go, Java), custom Dockerfiles, or Cloud Native Buildpacks; provision managed services for MySQL, MariaDB, Postgres, MongoDB, and Redis based on official Docker images; and launch 1-click templates from a community library of 100+ applications including WordPress, Ghost, Strapi, Directus, Appsmith, Appwrite, n8n, Activepieces, Anything-LLM, and AdGuard Home. The platform automates Let's Encrypt SSL certificate provisioning, supports zero-downtime deployments, exposes in-browser terminal, database CLI, and log inspection tools, and provides database backup automation. Easypanel is available as a one-click install on DigitalOcean, AWS, Vultr, Linode, Hostinger, and Kamatera marketplaces, or via manual Docker install on any Linux VPS. Commercial plans range from a generous Free tier through Hobby, Growth, and Business tiers with multi-user access control, white-labeling, and clustering. Easypanel exposes a web UI, a Hub for shared templates, and the Dockerizer tool, but does not currently publish a public REST API or first-party developer SDK for programmatic panel control.

providers.name: Enlitic
providers.description: Enlitic is a healthcare AI company building the Curie platform to standardize, anonymize, and manage medical imaging data across radiology and enterprise imaging workflows. Its products include ENDEX for real-time DICOM data standardization and enrichment, ENCOG for automated PHI/PII anonymization of imaging data, Migratek for large-scale imaging data migration, and Ensight for imaging data management and analytics. Enlitic serves radiologists, imaging IT teams, executives, and researchers to improve imaging data quality, interoperability, and operational efficiency. Enlitic does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; integration is delivered through its products and a customer support portal. Backed by Amplify Partners and DCVC.

providers.name: Fidu
providers.description: Fidu is an operating system and financial-services platform for private K-12 schools across Spanish-speaking Latin America. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina, Fidu digitizes the academic, administrative, financial, and communication processes of educational institutions in a single platform. School administrators send tuition statements and pay slips to families, who then pay tuition directly through the Fidu mobile app, and a "Parent Copilot" AI layer handles 24/7 automated responses, content generation, and academic-data synchronization with school information systems. Fidu raised a $5M seed round led by NFX and Lightspeed Venture Partners and reports more than 1,000 institutions across 10 countries and over 500,000 active users. Fidu does not currently publish a public developer program, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures the company's real public web properties only.

providers.name: GetInsured
providers.description: GetInsured (Vimo, Inc.) is a SaaS technology provider for public-sector healthcare that powers state-based health insurance marketplaces (SBMs). Its platform handles eligibility and enrollment, plan shopping and comparison, and consumer-assistance contact-center operations for state ACA exchanges. GetInsured powers ten state marketplaces (including Idaho, Illinois, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Virginia, and Oregon, with Oregon launching in 2027) and supported the migration of roughly 4.5 million people off Healthcare.gov. It sells to state governments, insurance carriers, agents/brokers, and enrollment assisters. GetInsured does not publish a public self-serve developer portal or API; integrations are delivered under contract. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: HavocAI
providers.description: HavocAI (Havoc) is a Providence, Rhode Island-based defense technology company building all-domain collaborative autonomy software and autonomous surface vessels for the U.S. Navy, U.S. Army and allied militaries. Its software suite pairs Havoc OS, an edge autonomy operating system for heterogeneous platforms, with Havoc C2 for one-to-many operator control, Havoc Insights for real-time sensor and telemetry analytics, and Havoc Connect, a resilient peer-to-peer overlay network for degraded or GPS-denied environments. The company builds the Rampage, Seahound, Kiakoa and Atlas autonomous surface vessels and is partnered with Hanwha on 200-foot ASVs. Enrichment probing in July 2026 found no public developer API, OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, no developer portal or documentation, no published SDKs or packages, no MCP server, and no A2A agent card - the platform is delivered under defense contract rather than as a self-serve developer product.

providers.name: Instabeat
providers.description: Instabeat is a San Francisco based swimming technology company that builds a heart-rate monitoring device integrated directly into swim goggles, giving swimmers real-time, color-coded effort feedback (heart-rate zones), automatic stroke detection, lap counting, pace, distance and rest-interval tracking without a chest strap or wrist watch. Paired with the Instabeat mobile app and myinstabeat.com, it delivers data-driven training insights so swimmers can adjust workouts in the water rather than after the session. The company sells the device through a Shopify storefront and has tested the product with 250+ swimmers across 56 countries. Added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company; no public developer or API surface has been identified.

providers.name: Jenkins Pipeline
providers.description: Jenkins Pipeline is a suite of plugins for the Jenkins automation server that supports implementing and integrating continuous delivery pipelines as code. It provides an extensible domain-specific language (DSL) with two syntax styles - Declarative and Scripted - and core building blocks (agents, stages, steps) for modeling simple-to-complex CI/CD workflows that are versioned with application source code via a Jenkinsfile.

providers.name: Media Chain
providers.description: Mediachain (Mediachain Labs) was a decentralized universal media library and attribution protocol built on IPFS and blockchain technology, designed to let creators and applications collaborate on open metadata about creative works and track the provenance and ownership of online images and other media. Founded in 2016 with seed funding from Andreessen Horowitz and Union Square Ventures, the company was acqui-hired by Spotify in April 2017 to help build fair, blockchain-based royalty attribution for rightsholders. The company is now defunct and its primary domain (mediachain.io) is a parked page, but its open-source protocol, design documentation, Protocol Buffer definitions, and first-party client libraries (the `aleph`/`mcclient` JavaScript client on npm and the `mediachain-client` Python reader on PyPI) remain public under the github.com/mediachain organization. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and enriched from its surviving open-source surface.

providers.name: MWI Veterinary Supply
providers.description: MWI Veterinary Supply, a subsidiary of AmerisourceBergen, is a leading distributor of animal health products to veterinarians across the United States and the United Kingdom, providing pharmaceuticals, vaccines, supplies, diagnostics, and practice management software to veterinary practices.

providers.name: Nexiu
providers.description: Nexiu (Nexiu AI LLC) is a Latin America-focused recruiting automation platform that uses AI agents to source, contact, screen, and schedule high-volume candidates over the official WhatsApp Business API, integrating with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Meet) and existing ATS systems and job boards. It offers a fully managed pay-per-hire service (Nexiu Managed) and a self-service SaaS platform (Nexiu Platform) for internal talent-acquisition teams, and is backed by 500 Global (500 Latam) and NVIDIA Inception. As of this pass Nexiu consumes third-party APIs (WhatsApp Business, Google, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) but does not publish a public developer API of its own.

providers.name: NovaSparks
providers.description: NovaSparks builds ultra-low-latency FPGA market data solutions for banks, trading firms, and electronic markets. Its NovaTick ticker plant, delivered as a hardware appliance or PCIe card, normalizes and distributes real-time feeds across global equities, options (OPRA), and other asset classes with deterministic nanosecond latency. Integration is via a proprietary ultra-low-latency C++ Software API and the NovaSparks Wire Format (NSWF), a normalized message protocol whose full specification is provided to banks and trading firms under NDA rather than published publicly. NovaSparks is now part of Exegy. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech.

providers.name: Nozomi
providers.description: Nozomi Networks is an operational technology (OT), IoT and cyber-physical systems security company providing asset visibility, vulnerability management and threat detection for industrial and critical infrastructure environments. Its platform pairs the Vantage cloud console and the on-premises Central Management Console (CMC) with the Guardian, Guardian Air (wireless) and Arc (endpoint) sensors, plus Threat Intelligence and Asset Intelligence modules, monitoring OT/IoT/IT devices across thousands of deployments in energy, manufacturing, healthcare, transportation, water, mining, maritime, retail and government sectors. A Vantage REST API and an N2OS / Universal SDK support programmatic integration; the full API reference is delivered inside the authenticated Vantage tenant and technical documentation portal rather than as a public OpenAPI description.

providers.name: Numbi
providers.description: Numbi is a tech-enabled accounting and payroll firm for Colombian companies — especially SAS entities, SMBs, and startups. It pairs expert accountants with automation and AI to run monthly bookkeeping, taxes, payroll, and DIAN electronic-invoicing compliance. Numbi is a service rather than software or an ERP: it operates on top of a company's existing accounting systems (Siigo and Alegra) instead of replacing them, ingesting documents (PDFs, XMLs, images) and keeping tax calendars and filings current. Founded in Bogotá and backed by Homebrew and Newtopia VC. No public developer API surface is published as of this pass.

providers.name: OpenSpace
providers.description: OpenSpace is a visual intelligence platform for the construction industry, headquartered at 333 Kearny Street, San Francisco, California. The company pairs an off-the-shelf 360-degree camera worn on a hardhat with computer-vision software that automatically maps captured imagery to construction floor plans and BIM models, producing a navigable, time-indexed visual record of every jobsite walk. The platform is built around five products: Capture (complete visual record), Field (image-based task management with AI Autolocation), Track (AI-driven progress tracking against schedule), Air (drone imagery management), and BIM+ (3D field tools). OpenSpace reports more than 69 billion square feet captured across projects in 131 countries, with regional presence in Australia, Canada, EU, Japan, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, and the United Kingdom. The company is led by CEO and co-founder Jeevan Kalanithi. OpenSpace integrates with the major construction software stacks, including Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud / Autodesk Build, Revizto, PlanGrid, and Bluebeam. A REST API exists for partner and enterprise integration but is not publicly self-serve; integration access is obtained via OpenSpace's support and partner channels.

providers.name: Pearl
providers.description: Pearl is a dental AI computer-vision company whose FDA-cleared products - Second Opinion (real-time pathology and restorative detection on 2D and 3D dental radiographs), Practice Intelligence (clinical and operational analytics over full practice-management-system data), and Precheck (AI insurance claim review) - are delivered by embedding Pearl's cloud AI into third-party imaging and practice management software rather than through a public, self-serve developer API. Pearl integrates natively with 40+ imaging/PMS platforms (DEXIS, Carestream, Planmeca Romexis, Dentsply Sirona Sidexis, Apteryx XVWeb, MiPACS, Open Dental, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Curve, Denticon, Software of Excellence EXACT) and is an authorized vendor in the Henry Schein One API Exchange. There is no publicly documented, self-signup Pearl developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI reference; API access is partner/OEM-gated and arranged through Pearl's integrations and sales teams. The API surfaces below are modeled from Pearl's public product descriptions and integration architecture, not from published Pearl API reference documentation.

providers.name: Quandela
providers.description: Quandela is a Paris-region (Massy, France) photonic quantum computing company building modular, scalable, and energy-efficient quantum systems driven by deterministic single-photon sources. Its hardware lineup includes Ascella (its first deployed cloud-accessible system), Belenos (a 12-qubit second-generation machine), Canopus (its latest state-of-the-art system), and Mosaiq (its flagship prototyping platform), alongside Prometheus single-photon sources and the Entropy quantum random number generator. Quandela develops Perceval, an open-source Python framework for programming photonic quantum computers, distributed via PyPI as perceval-quandela, and operates a cloud platform at cloud.quandela.com where users authenticate with a token and submit jobs to simulators and QPUs (e.g. "sim:altair", "qpu:altair") through Perceval's RemoteProcessor. The company also runs a Quantum Acceleration Program for enterprise pilots in cybersecurity, pharma, chemistry, logistics, finance, energy, and aerospace. There is no public REST/HTTP OpenAPI specification — the cloud surface is abstracted entirely behind the Perceval Python SDK and its companion perceval-interop bridges to Qiskit, QuTiP, cQASM, and myQLM.

providers.name: RedWing Aerospace Laboratories
providers.description: RedWing Aerospace Laboratories (RedWing Labs, operated by Kitemaps AMS Pvt Ltd) is a Bangalore, India based, Techstars-backed company that designs, develops and deploys fully autonomous drones to transform logistics supply chains. It offers a fleet of long-range, urban and medium-range delivery aircraft plus an operations software suite, and runs an autonomous four-step delivery flow (order, handoff to flight operations, proof of delivery, return to hub) used to move healthcare products, food and other goods within the hour. The company reports operational milestones including 145,930+ kilometers flown and thousands of deliveries completed. RedWing does not publish a first-party developer API; its public agent surface is the platform-provided Wix Site MCP endpoint advertised in its llms.txt.

providers.name: Saxbys Coffee
providers.description: Saxbys is a Philadelphia-headquartered hospitality company founded in 2005 by Nick Bayer that operates a small chain of cafes across the U.S. East Coast and Midwest. The brand is unique for its "Experiential Learning Platform" (E.L.P.) — 100% student-run cafes embedded inside college and university campuses. Each E.L.P. cafe is operated by a Student Cafe Executive Officer (SCEO) who takes full responsibility for running the location while earning paid, experiential learning credit. Saxbys describes itself as "a national education company and For Students, By Students" with a mission to "Make Life Better." Saxbys does not publish a public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or partner integration program. The only public digital surfaces are the marketing website (saxbyscoffee.com), location-specific online ordering powered by BentoBox, a "Saxbys Stories" blog, and a mobile ordering / rewards app. The Saxbys GitHub organization exists but currently holds a single internal inventory-analyzer repository. This apis.yml records the company as a non-API hospitality + education brand for the API Evangelist network catalog.

providers.name: Schrödinger
providers.description: Schrödinger is a New York-headquartered (NASDAQ: SDGR) computational science company that develops a physics-based and AI-driven molecular simulation platform used across drug discovery and materials science. Its flagship desktop modeling environment is Maestro (MS Maestro for materials science), which integrates a deep stack of computational tools — Glide (docking), FEP+ (free energy perturbation), Desmond (molecular dynamics), Jaguar (quantum chemistry), Prime (protein structure prediction), BioLuminate (biologics), LigPrep, QikProp, SiteMap, and WaterMap — together with the Schrödinger-maintained PyMOL visualization system. LiveDesign is the cloud-native enterprise design lab where chemists, biologists, and program teams collaborate on molecules, run computational workflows, and integrate experimental data; it exposes a snap-in API framework for connecting in-house and third-party tooling. The Schrödinger Python API (current release 2026-1) is the primary developer surface, providing programmatic access to molecular structures, Maestro automation, jobcontrol, Glide, FEP+, Desmond, Jaguar, MacroModel, Prime, BioLuminate, and LiveDesign integration (login, export, dataset and column management). Schrödinger also ships KNIME extensions, command-line drivers for every computational product, and maintains a meaningful open-source footprint on GitHub — including PyMOL, maeparser, coordgenlibs, sketcher, gpusimilarity, csmiles, and the fixed-data-table-2 React component. The business has two segments — software licensing to global pharma, biotech, and materials companies, and a co-developed and proprietary drug discovery pipeline. There is no public developer signup or self-serve REST API; access to the platform, Python API, and LiveDesign is gated through commercial licensing and the my.schrodinger.com customer portal.

providers.name: Theorem
providers.description: Theorem builds machine-learning-powered credit underwriting infrastructure for consumer debt markets. Since 2014 the company has priced and purchased billions of dollars in loan volume, powering one of the longest-running investment programs in the market. Its products deliver instant, API-driven credit assessments to lending originators (Custom Loan Integration Programs, or CLIP), score default risk down to individual loan cashflows (Theorem Loan Score, or TLS), and package loans into credit products for capital-market investors (Securitization as a Service). The API is a private, partner-onboarded B2B integration arranged through the partnerships team; there is no public developer portal, published OpenAPI specification, or self-service sign-up. Theorem is backed by Initialized Capital and operates from Silicon Valley, New York City, and Dallas.

providers.name: Verdex
providers.description: Verdex builds AI for the clinical workflow. Its first product rooms patients and takes their history by voice before the physician walks into the room: the agent gathers and organizes the patient's story, hands the physician a three-sentence summary, and lands a structured, signable history back in the electronic health record (EHR) the practice already runs. The agent never diagnoses or advises, escalates anything urgent to staff immediately, keeps every line of the note traceable to its source, and is built to be HIPAA compliant. Verdex is aimed at clinicians, practice owners, and health-system teams. The company is an early-stage Y Combinator startup; verdexai.com is a browser-rendered marketing site that publishes machine-readable llms.txt, robots.txt, and a security.txt but does not (yet) expose a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Westmag
providers.description: Western Magnetics (Westmag) designs and manufactures brushless DC (BLDC) drone motors and robot actuators in South San Francisco, California. Built and scaled in America and NDAA-compliant from day one, Westmag is a vertically integrated motor company spanning design, manufacturing, and supply chain — producing high-volume BLDC drone motors for Group 1, 2, and 3 UAS platforms (20-100mm stators, Kv 100-3,000, outrunner and inrunner) and integrated actuators for humanoid and mobile robots (torque 1-150Nm, 24-48V, gearing 6:1-12:1). Founded by David Hansen (CEO) and Jordan Sanders (COO) and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, Lux Capital, Menlo Ventures, and NFDG. This is a hardware company; it currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Witness AI
providers.description: WitnessAI is an AI security and governance platform that lets enterprises safely deploy and manage AI across their workforce. Its platform spans three pillars: Observe (visibility into all AI activity, shadow-AI discovery, and cataloging of applications and agents), Control (governance policies, audit trails, and compliance across human and AI workforces), and Protect (runtime security that blocks prompt injection and jailbreaks and filters harmful outputs). It addresses data leakage, prompt-injection attacks, unauthorized agent activity, and compliance gaps. The company is backed by GV. As of this profile no public API, developer portal, or SDKs are published; engagement is via sales/demo.

providers.name: Wonderful
providers.description: Wonderful is an applied-AI company building an enterprise AI platform for critical, high-volume workflows. It combines an AI platform (run any model, any modality, any use case, fully governed) with local deployment teams and a strategic partnership model to help large organizations accelerate AI adoption. Wonderful powers agentic automation for enterprises such as national telecom operators, energy providers, and financial-services firms, covering customer-service containment, collections across millions of clients, internal IT automation, and end-to-end billing resolution, with reported outcomes like a 91.5% containment rate across millions of customers. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and IVP. Wonderful sells an enterprise platform with deployment services rather than a self-serve public developer API; its developer documentation is login-gated.

providers.name: XFuel
providers.description: XFuel develops, patents, and deploys technologies that transform diverse waste into low-carbon drop-in transport fuels, using its Chemical Liquid Refining (CLR) and Mechanical Carbon Conversion (MECC) processes to produce marine (ISO 8217 DMA), road (EN590), and in-development sustainable aviation fuels. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with operations in Bunyola, Spain, and backed by Union Square Ventures. XFuel publishes no public API or developer program as of 2026-07-21.

providers.name: 01 Exchange
providers.description: 01 Exchange (01.xyz) was a full-suite decentralized derivatives exchange on Solana, offering cross-margined and cross-collateralized Perpetual Futures and Power Perpetuals (SQUOL) built on a fully on-chain Serum limit orderbook, with support for up to 100 markets and 50 collateral tokens and up to 20x leverage. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of multicoin-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The people and product behind 01 are now part of N1 (app.n1.xyz), where trading, points, and rewards have migrated. This profile captures 01 Exchange's historical developer surface: the TypeScript, Python, and Rust SDKs and on-chain program interface published by the Zero One Global Foundation (github.com/01protocol).

providers.name: Agro Club
providers.description: Agro.Club is a US-based agtech company operating a digital grain trading and crop marketing marketplace that connects farmers with grain buyers. The platform offers competitive bids for corn, wheat, soybeans and other grains, along with logistics (truck and rail transportation), quality control, financing, and market insights. Farmers can transact through cash, FOB or delivered, and basis contracts, plus a Firm Offer price-target monitoring service. Agro.Club serves tens of thousands of farmers and grain companies across the largest agricultural hubs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. Agro.Club does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation; its api.agro.club host is a private backend that serves the company's own applications.

providers.name: Ashvattha Therapeutics
providers.description: Ashvattha Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a new class of precision nanomedicines built on hydroxyl dendrimer therapeutics (HDTs), a platform exclusively licensed from Johns Hopkins University. Hydroxyl dendrimers traverse tissue barriers such as the blood-retinal and blood-brain barrier and are selectively taken up by activated cells in regions of inflammation, allowing known small-molecule drugs to be delivered intracellularly to diseased tissue with sustained effect and reduced off-target exposure. The company is advancing programs across ophthalmology, neurology, and inflammatory disease, led by migaldendranib (MGB), a first-in-class subcutaneously administered nanomedicine in Phase 2 development for diabetic macular edema and neovascular age-related macular degeneration, plus hydroxyl dendrimer PET imaging tracers such as [18F]OP-801. Founded by Jeffrey L. Cleland, Kannan Rangaramanujam, and Sujatha Kannan. Ashvattha publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Axalta Coating Systems
providers.description: Axalta Coating Systems is a global supplier of liquid and powder coatings for transportation and industrial end-markets, operating through Performance Coatings (refinish and industrial) and Mobility Coatings (light vehicle and commercial vehicle) segments. Brands include Cromax, Spies Hecker, Standox, Imron, and Voltatex. In July 2024 Axalta acquired The CoverFlexx Group from Transtar Holding for $285 million to expand its economy-tier aftermarket coverage in North America. In November 2025 Axalta announced a $17 billion all-stock merger of equals with AkzoNobel that is expected to close in late 2026 or early 2027, forming a coatings company with dual headquarters in Amsterdam and Philadelphia.

providers.name: Beijing Lanweitong Technology (蓝卫通 / BSC)
providers.description: Beijing Lanweitong Technology Co., Ltd. (北京蓝卫通科技有限公司), branded BSC, operates one of China's longest-running telemedicine networks — the 蓝卫通远程医学服务平台 (Lanweitong Remote Medical Service Platform). Founded in 1998 and headquartered in Beijing, the company connects thousands of member hospitals and clinics to specialist physicians at Grade-A tertiary hospitals for remote consultation (远程会诊), remote outpatient clinics, multidisciplinary MDT consultations, remote imaging and DICOM cloud reading, remote ECG, remote pathology, remote ultrasound, remote ward rounds, and continuing medical education. The platform is delivered as hospital-facing web applications (BSCTelmed, DicomCloud, BSCEcg, BSCUltrasound, BSCEdu) plus a mobile app, and is sold to health systems and medical alliances (医联体) rather than exposed as a public developer API. The company reports 19 patents and 199 software copyrights and has been recognized as a national-level "little giant" specialized enterprise. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company. Its original domain chinabsc.com is still registered but no longer resolves; the live platform runs on bsc1.cn / bscm.cn.

providers.name: Bleacher Report
providers.description: Bleacher Report is a digital sports media company headquartered in San Francisco and owned by Warner Bros. Discovery (Turner Sports). Founded in 2007, it delivers sports news, live scores, highlights, video, and community-driven commentary across the web and its iOS and Android applications, spanning the NFL, NBA, MLB, soccer, and other leagues. Bleacher Report maintains a public GitHub organization with open source engineering projects but does not publish a public developer API program; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bloomingdale's
providers.description: Bloomingdale's is an American luxury department store chain and a subsidiary of Macy's, Inc. Bloomingdale's does not publish a public developer portal; partner integration is delivered through the parent Macy's Inc. vendor and trade partner programs, drop-ship and EDI channels with suppliers, the Bloomingdale's affiliate program for marketing partners, and the shared Macy's Inc. technology platform powering Bloomingdale's commerce, loyalty, and fulfillment.

providers.name: Carnot Fleet
providers.description: Carnot Fleet (Carnotfleet) is a Seoul-based cold-chain technology company that converts non-refrigerated vehicles into temperature-controlled units in under 30 minutes using modular insulation panels and proprietary solid-state thermoelectric heat pumps, spanning frozen, chilled, and ambient ranges with humidity control. Its Adaptive Thermal Control System (ATCS) is an AI-based autonomous control platform delivering cloud-connected temperature monitoring at 10-second intervals. Carnot Fleet surfaces its capabilities through the CF Mobile Application, the CF Portal, and CF APIs that let customers integrate the ATCS into existing logistics solutions to detect, analyze, prevent, and discover cold-chain data points and reduce post-harvest to pre-retail loss across the supply chain.

providers.name: Celerion (H.I.G. Capital)
providers.description: Celerion is a global contract research organization (CRO) specializing in early-stage clinical research, Phase I clinical trials, clinical pharmacology, and bioanalytical services that accelerate drug development from first-in-human studies through proof-of-concept. Headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska with clinical and bioanalytical sites across North America and Europe, Celerion supports pharmaceutical and biotechnology sponsors with healthy-volunteer and special-population studies, bioanalysis, biomarker assays, ECG/cardiac safety, and its LabNotes bioanalytical data-management software. The company is a portfolio holding of H.I.G. Capital and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network via the bain-capital-ventures portfolio graph. As a corporate/marketing web presence with no public developer or API program, this profile carries only the artifacts that could be observed on the public web (llms.txt, domain-security posture).

providers.name: Chipotle Mexican Grill
providers.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill is a Fortune 500 fast-casual restaurant chain serving burritos, bowls, tacos, salads, and quesadillas made with responsibly sourced, classically-cooked, real ingredients. Founded in 1993 in Denver, Colorado and headquartered in Newport Beach, California, Chipotle operates more than 3,500 restaurants across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Kuwait, and the United Arab Emirates. The company is widely recognized as a digital ordering and loyalty leader in the restaurant industry through its Chipotle Rewards program, native iOS and Android apps, and digital ordering platforms (web ordering, group ordering, and catering). Chipotle does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API catalog; partner integrations such as third-party delivery (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub) are managed through bilateral agreements, and supplier and franchise integrations occur through internal portals.

providers.name: Cognitive Space
providers.description: Cognitive Space is an aerospace software company delivering AI-powered automated satellite operations for constellation and fleet management. Its CNTIENT.Optimize platform automates mission planning, tasking, and multi-ground-station pass scheduling for satellite operators and government agencies, reporting large per-operator time savings, while CNTIENT.Earth delivers satellite Data-as-a-Service. The company integrates with customer systems via APIs and serves clients including Terran Orbital, the Space Development Agency, the Air Force Research Lab, and NOAA. Backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Colgate-Palmolive
providers.description: Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer-products manufacturer operating in oral care, personal care, home care, and pet nutrition through brands such as Colgate, Palmolive, Hill's Pet Nutrition, Speed Stick, Ajax, and Softsoap. Colgate-Palmolive does not publish a general-purpose public developer REST API. Its B2B integration footprint is centered on EDI exchanges with retail trading partners (X12 messages, AS2, VAN), supplier integrations through SAP Ariba, and internal corporate systems. There is also a corporate sustainability and ESG reporting surface, but it is not exposed as a developer API.

providers.name: Corteva
providers.description: Corteva Agriscience is a publicly traded, Fortune 500 global pure-play agriculture company that provides farmers around the world with one of the most complete portfolios in the industry, including a balanced and diverse mix of seed, crop protection, and digital products. Corteva was formed as the spinoff of the agriculture division of DowDuPont in June 2019. The company markets seeds under the Pioneer, Brevant, and other brands and crop protection products including herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, and biologicals. Corteva also operates Granular, a farm management software platform with insights and analytics products. A public developer API is not currently published; growers access tools through the Granular Insights and Granular Link platforms.

providers.name: Covariant
providers.description: Covariant is an Emeryville, California warehouse-robotics AI company founded in 2017 (originally as Embodied Intelligence) by UC Berkeley professor Pieter Abbeel and his former students Peter Chen, Rocky Duan, and Tianhao Zhang. The company builds the Covariant Brain, a universal AI platform that enables industrial picking robots to handle virtually any SKU regardless of shape, size, or packaging, and in March 2024 it introduced RFM-1 (Robotics Foundation Model 1), an 8-billion-parameter multimodal transformer trained on text, images, video, robot actions, and numerical sensor readings to give robots human-like reasoning over the physical world. Covariant ships AI-powered solutions for order picking, sortation, item induction, kitting, depalletization, and goods-to-person workflows, delivered through long-running integration partnerships with KNAPP (Pick-it-Easy Robot, since 2020) and ABB (warehouse robotics, since 2020), as well as deployments with retailers and logistics providers worldwide. In August 2024, Amazon announced a non-exclusive license to Covariant's robotic foundation models and hired its three co-founders along with roughly a quarter of its workforce in a reverse-acquihire arrangement; Covariant continues to operate independently under COO-turned-CEO Ted Stinson and co-founder Tianhao Zhang. The Covariant Brain and RFM-1 are proprietary, deployed on-premise on partner robotics hardware, and the company has no public developer API, SDK, open-source release, or third-party developer program.

providers.name: Evox Therapeutics
providers.description: Evox Therapeutics is an Oxford, United Kingdom based biotechnology company developing genetic medicines that expand the reach of gene therapy into the brain to transform the treatment landscape for severe neurodegenerative diseases. Its proprietary ExoEdit platform combines the natural transport capabilities of exosomes with CRISPR-based gene editing to improve the delivery, potency, and safety of genetic treatments for central nervous system disorders such as Rett Syndrome. Evox is a venture backed life-sciences company (investors include GV) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes a corporate and scientific website but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Farmwise
providers.description: FarmWise Labs is an agricultural technology company building AI-powered robotics for specialty crop farming. Its flagship product, Vulcan, is an intra-row weeder and precision cultivator that uses computer vision and machine learning to identify and mechanically remove weeds without herbicides, covering up to three acres per hour and saving growers an estimated $250+ per acre. The self-calibrating machine operates in all field conditions and receives over-the-air software updates. Founded in San Francisco and backed by GV (Google Ventures), FarmWise is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or specification surface.

providers.name: FinancesOnline
providers.description: Read detailed online reviews of B2B & SaaS solutions prepared by industry experts. Compare popular tools and easily find a perfect software that will let your business grow. Write your own reviews and share your experience with a constantly growing community of SaaS users.

providers.name: Finless Foods
providers.description: Finless Foods is an Emeryville, California cellular-agriculture company founded in 2017 by Michael Selden and Brian Wyrwas to grow real seafood from fish cells instead of harvesting it from the ocean. Its scientists established proprietary marine cell lines and a culture-media and bioreactor process that cultivates bluefin tuna and other high-value species into three-dimensional tissue with comparable taste, texture and nutrition to wild-caught fish, and the company has also shipped a plant-based tuna alternative into foodservice while the cell-cultivated line moves toward regulatory clearance and commercial launch. Backed by SOSV/IndieBio and a USD 34 million Series B closed in March 2022, and now led by co-founder and CEO Brandon Chen with co-founder Brian Wyrwas as CSO, Finless Foods is a food-biotechnology and consumer-products business rather than a software vendor: it operates a single-page Squarespace marketing site with a Squarespace Commerce cart, publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its 2017-era GitHub organization holds one dormant static-HTML repository.

providers.name: FirstEnergy
providers.description: FirstEnergy is one of the largest investor-owned electric systems in the United States, with utilities serving customers in Ohio, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, West Virginia, Maryland, and New York. FirstEnergy does not publish a public developer portal or open API catalog. Customer energy data is shared with authorized Curtailment Service Providers and Conservation Service Providers under its Third-Party Data Access program in Pennsylvania, and bulk utility data is exchanged with state regulators and grid operators through Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) and other industry-standard interfaces.

providers.name: Forward Platform
providers.description: FORWARD Platform is a govtech SaaS company (a Techstars portfolio company) offering one secure platform for administering public-benefit programs. It serves governments, nonprofits, and foundations with tooling for program management, online form building, eligibility determination, case management, client communication, referrals, payment disbursement, reporting and analytics, and fraud prevention. FORWARD supports service-delivery programs such as guaranteed basic income, housing assistance, and emergency management, and is packaged in Direct, Pro, Enterprise, and Ally tiers. Enrichment found no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, MCP server, or developer portal — this is a product/marketing web presence only.

providers.name: Fox Corporation
providers.description: Fox Corporation (NASDAQ: FOXA, FOX) is a US media company spun out of 21st Century Fox in 2019 when the rest of the business was sold to Disney. Per the company website, "Fox Corporation produces and distributes compelling news, sports, and entertainment content through its primary iconic domestic brands" — Fox News Media (Fox News Channel, Fox Business Network, Fox News Digital, Fox News Audio, Fox Weather), Fox Sports (FS1, FS2, Big Ten Network, Fox Deportes, Fox Bet partnerships), Fox Entertainment, Fox Television Stations, and the Tubi Media Group (Tubi free ad-supported streaming, Credible). In May 2024 Fox acquired Mexican sports-betting and casino operator Caliente.mx, expanding its sports-and-wagering footprint into Latin America. Fox does not publish a public developer portal or REST API surface for the parent corporation — programmatic distribution is delivered via per-brand RSS / Atom feeds (Fox News, Fox Business, Fox Sports, Fox Weather), the Tubi Media Group open source projects on GitHub (github.com/Tubitv, 53 public repositories), and direct B2B advertising and content-syndication relationships rather than self-serve API signup. This apis.yml therefore catalogs the public RSS surface, Tubi engineering OSS, and the corporate/brand web properties.

providers.name: Hessian
providers.description: Hessian is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building a forward-deployed AI agent platform for automating business operations. Its engineers embed on-site to map real workflows, then build and operate custom AI agents on the Hessian platform to run those processes end-to-end — spanning sales proposals, financial reconciliation, data management, and internal-system synchronization. The platform surfaces workflows, task and agent orchestration, workers, queue groups, prompts, assets, artifacts, secrets, webhooks, and audit logging, with integrations for tools such as GitHub, Slack, Postgres, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenAI, and Claude. Hessian does not yet publish a public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its verifiable public identity and web properties while the developer surface is awaiting release.

providers.name: Ireland Open Data Catalogue
providers.description: Ireland Open Data Catalogue is a national government open-data portal for Ireland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 1,467 datasets.

providers.name: Kimberly-Clark
providers.description: Kimberly-Clark is a global personal care and consumer tissue company with brands including Huggies, Kleenex, Scott, Kotex, Cottonelle, Poise, Depend, and Pull-Ups. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified for Kimberly-Clark; this repository tracks corporate, supplier, and integration surfaces for ongoing API discovery.

providers.name: Knit Health
providers.description: Knit Health Technologies, Inc. is a healthcare AI company spun out of the University of California, Berkeley, building what it calls a Large Clinical Behavior Model (LCBM) — a healthcare-native intelligence layer trained on real clinical decision patterns rather than text alone. Where conventional clinical AI is built on large language models trained on medical literature, Knit learns from the actions of practicing clinicians captured in electronic medical records: referral decisions, scheduling behavior, patient routing, discharge timing, and care coordination. The model is trained on Truveta EMR data representing more than 130 million patients across 30 U.S. health systems, using deep reinforcement learning, causal inference, and behavioral cloning, then fine-tuned to an individual health system's own practice patterns. Knit sells to health systems as an enterprise intelligence platform spanning intelligent specialist routing, predictive patient flow, optimized care team allocation, clinical variation insight, and proactive care recommendations. The company launched from stealth in May 2026 with an $11.6M seed round co-led by Uncork Capital and Frist Cressey Ventures, following a pre-seed led by Moxxie Ventures with Coalition Operators. Knit states that its engineers work alongside customer teams to design and deploy APIs tailored to each health system; as of this profile there is no public developer portal, API documentation, or self-serve API surface.

providers.name: Kyverna Therapeutics
providers.description: Kyverna Therapeutics (Nasdaq: KYTX) is a patient-centered, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Emeryville, California, developing engineered T cell therapies for patients suffering from autoimmune diseases. Kyverna adapts CD19 CAR T-cell therapy — originally developed for B cell cancers — to deeply deplete the B cells that drive autoimmunity, with the goal of durable, drug-free remission. Its lead candidate, mivocabtagene autoleucel (miv-cel, KYV-101), is a fully human CD19 CAR T-cell therapy in Phase 2 development for stiff person syndrome, myasthenia gravis and multiple sclerosis, and in Phase 1/2 development for systemic sclerosis and lupus nephritis in the United States and Germany. The pipeline also includes next-generation autologous and allogeneic CAR T constructs, including KYV-201, built on the company's Ingenui-T rapid manufacturing platform. Kyverna is a biopharmaceutical operating company and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile tracks its public web, corporate and investor surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Lecce Open Data
providers.description: Lecce Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Italy running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 480 datasets.

providers.name: Leyden Labs
providers.description: Leyden Labs is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Leiden, The Netherlands, with a regional office in Singapore, developing intranasal antibody products that protect people against known and newly emerging respiratory viruses. Its approach pairs mucosal immunity — delivering antibodies directly into the nasal passages, the gateway respiratory viruses use to enter the body — with broad protection, by targeting conserved regions of viral proteins so a single product can cover circulating strains and future variants. Its lead program, PanFlu, is an intranasal antibody candidate in clinical trials derived from CR9114, among the most broadly neutralizing influenza antibodies identified to date. Founded in 2021 by Koenraad Wiedhaup and Ronald Brus with founding scientist Jaap Goudsmit, the company is backed by GV and the SoftBank Vision Fund alongside the European Innovation Council Fund, the European Investment Bank and Invest-NL. Leyden Labs publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK; this profile captures its public web, security and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: LifeMine Therapeutics
providers.description: LifeMine Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Watertown, Massachusetts, with sites in Gloucester, Massachusetts and Basel, Switzerland. It pioneers a Top-Down Drug Discovery approach that leverages evolutionary insights from fungi to find next-generation precision medicines. Its LifeBank collection of deep-sequenced wild-type fungi and its Avatar-Rx platform combine human genetics and genomics, bioinformatics, machine learning and synthetic biology to mine biosynthetic gene clusters for genetically encoded small molecules, using embedded target genes as avatars to predict therapeutic effect independent of chemical structure. Its lead program LIFE-001 is a precision-engineered calcineurin inhibitor in Phase 1 for immune-mediated disorders and organ transplant rejection, alongside a genomic drug discovery alliance with GSK. LifeMine publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Lucid Motors
providers.description: Lucid Motors is the consumer-vehicle brand of Lucid Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: LCID), a Newark, California–headquartered American luxury electric vehicle manufacturer. The company designs and manufactures high-performance battery-electric sedans and SUVs, with its flagship Lucid Air (Pure, Touring, Grand Touring, and Sapphire trims) and the Lucid Gravity SUV (Touring and Grand Touring), assembled at its AMP-1 factory in Casa Grande, Arizona. Lucid develops its own electric powertrain, battery, and software stack — including the Lucid UX in-vehicle experience, the Lucid mobile app, Lucid Assistant, and over-the-air updates — and operates a vertically integrated direct-to-consumer sales, financing, leasing, and service model across North America, Europe, and the Middle East, supported by a growing network of Lucid Studios, Service Centers, and DC fast charging partnerships. Lucid is majority-owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF). Beyond consumer vehicles, Lucid licenses its powertrain and battery technology to other OEMs (notably Aston Martin) and supplies battery systems through its Lucid energy storage initiatives. Lucid Motors does not publish a public developer API portal, SDK, or OpenAPI specification; the Lucid mobile app and vehicle telematics are powered by private backend services that are not documented for third-party use.

providers.name: Mangata Finance
providers.description: Mangata Finance (Mangata X, since rebranded GASP) is a decentralized exchange built as a Substrate parachain in the Polkadot and Kusama ecosystem. It is designed for algorithmic traders and DeFi frontends, offering gas-free swaps, an omnichain ZK-rollup architecture, and a Proof-of-Liquidity consensus model where liquidity providers help secure the network. There is no REST or OpenAPI surface; developers integrate through a TypeScript SDK (@mangata-finance/sdk) that communicates with the Mangata Substrate node over Polkadot.js JSON-RPC/WebSocket, with published type-definition packages and open-source node, bridge, and dev-kit repositories under the gasp-xyz GitHub organization.

providers.name: Montenegro Open Data (data.gov.me)
providers.description: Montenegro Open Data (data.gov.me) is a national government open-data portal for Montenegro running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 894 datasets.

providers.name: Neolaiacampus Open Data
providers.description: Neolaiacampus Open Data is a organization open-data portal running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 70 datasets.

providers.name: Netreveal
providers.description: Netreveal is BAE Systems Applied Intelligence's financial crime detection and prevention platform, providing analytics for anti-money laundering, fraud detection, sanctions screening, and regulatory compliance for banks and financial institutions. Netreveal does not currently publish public developer-facing APIs; integrations are typically delivered through customer engagements.

providers.name: Noon Academy
providers.description: Noon Academy (Noon) is a social learning platform where students study alongside their friends in live, teacher-led group classes. Operated by Noon Tech Limited and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, the company serves more than 12 million students and over 100,000 teachers across five countries, primarily in the Middle East and South Asia. Noon is a consumer education product delivered through student and teacher apps and a web experience; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal. This API Evangelist profile was created from a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched with the company's public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Paramount
providers.description: Paramount is a global media and entertainment company producing premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide, encompassing film, television, and streaming through brands such as Paramount Pictures, CBS, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV.

providers.name: Photobox
providers.description: Photobox is Europe's leading e-commerce retailer of personalised photo products and gifts, serving tens of millions of customers across the UK and continental Europe. Its consumer web and mobile apps let people upload photos and create photo books, wall art, canvas prints, calendars, cards, mugs and other personalised gifts for home delivery. Backed by Insight Partners. As of this enrichment pass Photobox publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or partner API surface; its verified GitHub organization contains only two forked operations utilities. This profile therefore captures company identity and public web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Schüttflix
providers.description: Schüttflix is a Gütersloh, Germany based digital logistics platform for the construction industry, describing itself as the first digital logistics hub to connect construction companies, building-material suppliers, disposal companies and carriers. The marketplace digitizes the full workflow from ordering bulk materials (sand, gravel, crushed stone) through transport dispatch to the delivery note, and adds construction-waste disposal and circular-economy recycling services. Schüttflix operates as a neutral marketplace ("we don't compete, we connect") spanning 4,000+ suppliers and disposers, 6,800+ partner carriers and 33,000+ vehicles, delivered primarily through native iOS and Android apps rather than a public API. It is a portfolio company of HV Capital, added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Serchen
