providers.description: Serchen is a cloud services marketplace and review platform that helps businesses discover, review, and connect with cloud and SaaS providers.

providers.name: Soria
providers.description: Soria is an AI-native financial terminal built for healthcare investors. The platform aggregates financial data from 125+ public and private sources into continuously updated financial models and delivers them through a terminal UI, an MCP server, an API, warehouse sync, and a research feed. Soria targets bulge-bracket banks, boutique research firms, and the largest hedge funds that specialize in the healthcare sector, turning fragmented healthcare and life sciences data into live, analyst-ready models. Backed by Y Combinator. Its public surface is a single-page marketing site; the API and MCP delivery channels are gated to customers and are not publicly documented.

providers.name: Steel Dynamics
providers.description: Steel Dynamics, Inc. is one of the largest domestic steel producers and metals recyclers in the United States, with operations spanning steel manufacturing, steel processing, and metals recycling. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Fort Wayne, Indiana, the company operates steel mills, fabrication operations, and metals recycling facilities. Steel Dynamics is a Fortune 500 company listed on NASDAQ (STLD) and does not offer public developer APIs; data access is available through financial data providers and investor relations communications.

providers.name: Symbotic
providers.description: Symbotic is an AI-powered warehouse automation company that designs, manufactures, and operates end-to-end robotic distribution and micro-fulfillment systems for food and beverage, retail grocery, healthcare, apparel, retail general merchandise, and consumer packaged goods customers. Its portfolio includes the Symbotic distribution solution for case handling, SymMicro for less-than-case micro-fulfillment, autonomous SymBots mobile robots, warehouse AI software, and Warehouse-as-a-Service offerings. Symbotic operates as a hardware-and-services vendor and does not publish a public developer portal or open APIs.

providers.name: Teller Finance
providers.description: Teller Finance (Teller Protocol) is a decentralized, multi-chain lending and borrowing protocol on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, and BNB Chain. Borrowers take fixed-APR, time-based loans from isolated lending pools using their tokens as collateral, with no oracle-driven margin-call liquidations, through an open order-book of markets governed by the TellerV2 smart contract. The developer surface is on-chain (Solidity smart contracts) plus a GraphQL subgraph for read-side data and an embeddable Cash Advance widget (npm) that any dapp can drop into its front end - there is no hosted REST API, OAuth server, or API-key program; authentication is wallet-based. Teller was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and enriched here from its public developer surface.

providers.name: Theker
providers.description: Theker (THEKER Robotics) is a Barcelona-based robotics and artificial intelligence company whose stated mission is "solving 100% of physical work" — building humanoid and physical-AI systems it frames as "a power beyond human" and "the next frontier of robotics and intelligence." The company is at a stealth stage: its public site is a landing page and careers portal with product details deliberately withheld ("Details remain secured"). Its public GitHub organization (THEKER Robotics, Spain) works in the physical-AI/ROS 2 stack — forks of the ZED ROS 2 wrapper, NVIDIA cuRobo CUDA motion planning, and Meta SAM 3 perception. Backed by CRV. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK is published yet; this profile captures its identity and public surface pending a developer platform.

providers.name: Treeline Biosciences
providers.description: Treeline Biosciences is a drug discovery and development company that aspires to make great medicines reliably and repeatedly, matching compelling disease targets with clinically proven drug approaches -- small-molecule inhibitors, protein degraders, and antibody drug conjugates -- enabled in-house at its U.S. and EU research facilities and integrated with in silico and machine learning models that help its scientists understand protein targets at an atomic level. The company pursues a target-centric preclinical pipeline serving patients with serious diseases across oncology, immunology, and neurology, and is a portfolio company of GV. Treeline publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: TrueBlue
providers.description: TrueBlue (NYSE: TBI) is a leading provider of workforce solutions and specialized talent services. TrueBlue connects people and work through three operating segments: PeopleReady (industrial staffing), PeopleScout (RPO and talent advisory), and Staff Management | SMX (managed staffing). TrueBlue's digital platforms include JobStack for on-demand industrial staffing and Affinix for recruitment process outsourcing.

providers.name: Umbria Region Open Data
providers.description: Umbria Region Open Data is a regional government open-data portal for Italy running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 457 datasets.

providers.name: Varda
providers.description: Varda Space Industries is a microgravity-enabled life sciences company that processes materials in orbit and returns them to Earth. Its in-house W-Series spacecraft are free-flying orbital production satellites with reentry capability, used for in-orbit pharmaceutical crystallization for biopharma partners and as a hypersonic reentry testbed for government flight testing. Backed by Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Khosla Ventures, and Lux Capital, Varda publishes no public API or developer surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Vivid Vision
providers.description: Vivid Vision is a digital vision care company that builds VR- and software-based tools for diagnosing and treating binocular vision disorders. Its products include a vision training system for amblyopia (lazy eye), strabismus, and convergence insufficiency; Vivid Vision Perimetry (VVP), a VR-based visual field test used as an endpoint in ophthalmology clinical trials for geographic atrophy, AMD, and glaucoma; and EYEBAB VT therapeutic exercises for clinical settings. Founded in 2014, the platform has been used by more than 100,000 patients across 50+ countries through eye-care practices and clinics. Vivid Vision is backed by Uncork Capital. The company is a patient- and clinician-facing vision-care provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface at this time.

providers.name: Watsco
providers.description: Watsco, Inc. is the world's largest distributor of air conditioning, heating, and refrigeration (HVAC/R) equipment and related products. Operating through subsidiaries including Carrier Enterprise, Baker Distributing, Gemaire Distributors, and East Coast Metal Distributors, Watsco serves contractors and dealers across more than 670 locations in the US, Canada, Mexico, and the Caribbean. The company has undergone significant digital transformation, running a unified B2B e-commerce platform powered by Magento Commerce and a centralized PIM system covering approximately 900,000 SKUs.

providers.name: Welltower
providers.description: Welltower Inc. (NYSE: WELL) is an S&P 500 healthcare REIT that invests in senior housing, post-acute care, and outpatient medical properties across the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada. The company operates an internal operator portal at portaldev.welltower.com for property operators and partners. Welltower uses the Welltower Business System (WBS) and has integrated AI and data science capabilities including OpenAI. No public developer API has been identified; Welltower primarily uses internal proprietary systems for property management and operator coordination.

providers.name: Wendys
providers.description: The Wendy's Company is a leading international quick-service restaurant chain operating over 7,000 restaurants worldwide. Wendy's operates digital commerce channels including the Wendy's mobile app, online ordering, and a loyalty rewards program. The company uses AI-powered drive-thru ordering (FreshAI) powered by Google Cloud, and integrates with third-party delivery platforms including DoorDash, Grubhub, and Uber Eats. Wendy's uses PAR Technology for loyalty program advancement and NCR Aloha for POS systems. No public developer API is available; digital ordering is powered through internal platforms and third-party integrations.

providers.name: Zurich Insurance
providers.description: A Swiss multinational insurance company and one of the world's largest insurers providing property, casualty, life, and specialty insurance products. Zurich operates a public API platform at exchange.zurich.com (Zurich Exchange / ConnectZ / Zurich Edge) that exposes 30+ internal and external APIs across policy, claims, quoting, partner analytics, procurement, and operations.

providers.name: Airforestry
providers.description: AirForestry is a Swedish climate-technology company developing autonomous electric drones that perform forest thinning from the air. Its system pairs AI and computer vision for tree identification and selection with a lightweight aerial harvesting tool, letting a fleet of drones fell and extract trees without ground machinery. The result is forestry with zero soil compaction, no root damage and no machine tracks, higher operational efficiency, and lower emissions than conventional harvesters, while increasing forest growth and carbon sequestration. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. It currently publishes a marketing and news presence but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Autonomic
providers.description: Autonomic is a connected-vehicle cloud company founded in 2016, acquired by Ford Motor Company in 2018 and fully integrated into Ford in 2023. Its flagship product, the Transportation Mobility Cloud (TMC), is one of the largest connected-vehicle cloud platforms in production, providing an API-driven platform for developers to build applications that interact with vehicles while abstracting the complexity of different vehicle models and connectivity devices. The public developer surface (the TMC Developer Portal) is gated behind partner authentication, so most technical artifacts are not publicly harvestable. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Craft Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Beesafe Ai
providers.description: Beesafe AI is a fraud-prevention and anti-scam platform whose tagline is "Stopping Scams Before They Reach Your Customers." Its AI-powered anti-scam agents proactively engage scammers to uncover the fraudulent accounts, money-mule networks, and criminal financial infrastructure behind trust-based scams such as romance scams, pig-butchering, and investment fraud, which bypass traditional detection by convincing victims to authorize transactions themselves. Beesafe serves financial-services firms, cryptocurrency companies, telecommunications providers, and government agencies. It was founded by AI and security PhDs from Carnegie Mellon and UC San Diego and is backed by Y Combinator, Obvious Ventures, and SBIR/STTR funding. The platform is currently in early access with no public self-service API, developer documentation, or pricing published.

providers.name: CoinTracker
providers.description: CoinTracker is a cryptocurrency portfolio tracker and crypto tax software that connects a user's exchange accounts and blockchain wallets to automatically track holdings, calculate cost basis and capital gains, and generate tax reports and IRS forms. It supports a large catalog of exchanges, wallets, and cryptocurrencies, and offers tax-loss harvesting, performance tracking, and integrations with consumer tax-filing products. For developers and partners, CoinTracker publishes a first-party JavaScript SDK (@cointracker/tax-kit) for supplying cost-basis data; its core HTTP API is offered through enterprise and partner integrations rather than a self-serve public developer program. This profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from publicly discoverable surfaces (npm, GitHub, status page, DNS/TLS).

providers.name: EverestLabs
providers.description: EverestLabs builds AI, computer vision, and robotics for the recycling industry. Its RecycleOS platform identifies, tracks, and sorts recoverable materials on the conveyor lines of Materials Recovery Facilities (MRFs), giving recyclers, reclaimers, and packaging manufacturers analytics, bale tracing, plant optimization, and compliance reporting to increase recovery rates, cut labor costs, and verify recycled content. Headquartered in Fremont, California and backed by Sierra Ventures. EverestLabs does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, GitHub, and discovery surface.

providers.name: Honorlock
providers.description: Honorlock is an online exam proctoring and academic integrity platform for higher education and professional certification. Its primary integration path is LTI 1.3, installed natively into LMS platforms - Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L Brightspace, Open LMS, Docebo, and Intellum - plus publisher platforms such as Pearson, McGraw Hill, and ALEKS via LMS workflows. For assessment platforms that need to embed proctoring outside an LMS, Honorlock offers a partner developer toolkit ("APIs and Elements") documented at docs.honorlock.com - a REST API for provisioning users, courses, exams, authentication tokens, and exam sessions, plus a browser-based Elements/Integration SDK that drives the exam-taker experience (extension verification, session setup, begin/end session). The developer program is sales-gated (contact-sales onboarding); Honorlock does not publish a self-service API key flow, an OpenAPI description, or a public base URL.

providers.name: Liberty Energy
providers.description: Liberty Energy is a North American oilfield services company providing hydraulic fracturing, wireline, sand logistics, and power generation services to onshore exploration and production operators. The company also develops technology solutions for energy completion, ESG reporting, and natural gas fueling. Liberty Energy does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Lyra Health
providers.description: Lyra Health is a Burlingame, California enterprise mental health benefits company founded in 2015 that provides employer-sponsored behavioral health care to more than 20 million members across a network of 30,000+ providers in over 200 countries and territories. The platform combines preventive self-care resources, coaching, evidence-based therapy, medication management, family and pediatric services, and specialized acute care delivered through a benefits-administration model sold to large employers and health plans rather than directly to consumers. Lyra's product surface includes the Lyra App for members, the Lyra Empower AI-powered care platform launched in 2025, Centers of Excellence for pediatric mental health and neurodiversity, a manager coaching program, and a clinical-grade AI guide. Customers include Salesforce, Lululemon, Morgan Stanley, Genentech, Starbucks, JE Dunn, VCA, and the School District of Philadelphia, and in March 2026 the company became Workday Wellness's preferred mental health partner. Lyra acquired pediatric and family mental health provider Bend Health in July 2025. Lyra is led by CEO Jennifer Schulz, with Jenny Gonsalves as Chief Product & Technology Officer, Alethea Varra as Chief Clinical Officer, and co-founder Bob Kocher, MD on the board. The company's revenue model is per-member-per- month employer contracts plus utilization-based clinical billing; Lyra does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or self-service API, and its only public GitHub repository is an internal fork of an unrelated infrastructure module. All employer, member, HRIS/eligibility, SSO, and EHR integrations are negotiated and delivered through the Lyra customer success and implementation teams rather than through a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: Meso
providers.description: Meso is payment infrastructure designed for crypto. Backed by Ribbit Capital, the company is positioned as a payments-rails provider for the cryptocurrency sector. As of this enrichment pass its public web presence is a single-page marketing site at meso.network with no publicly documented developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition surfaced yet. The one machine-readable artifact the company publishes is a PGP-signed RFC 9116 security.txt at /.well-known/security.txt declaring a security contact and disclosure policy. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Ribbit Capital portfolio lead and is tracked for future API surface as the product launches.

providers.name: Noetica
providers.description: Noetica AI is a New York-based legal and financial market-intelligence platform that uses natural language processing and a proprietary knowledge graph to extract, benchmark, and analyze deal terms from millions of public and private transactions. It serves transactional attorneys, capital-markets and M&A lawyers, credit and private-lending professionals, and legal-innovation teams at leading global law firms, delivering real-time quantitative and qualitative benchmarking across 60+ transaction types. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Thomson Reuters Ventures. As of this profiling Noetica exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface; it operates as an enterprise B2B SaaS platform.

providers.name: Noox
providers.description: Noox is a Web3 platform for creating and collecting achievement badges as soulbound NFTs, letting people build verifiable on-chain reputation. Users discover community-curated Web3 achievements, check eligibility, and mint them as identity-bound (non-transferable) NFTs, while creators build custom on-chain achievements from live blockchain data with a no-code, template-based designer. The protocol is deployed on Ethereum mainnet (badge, badgeMinter and feeCollector smart contracts) and is powered by Alchemy Web3 infrastructure. Noox is a portfolio company of Electric Capital in the crypto sector. Note: Noox exposes no public REST/HTTP developer API, OpenAPI, GraphQL/subgraph, or SDK; its developer surface is the on-chain smart contracts.

providers.name: Normative
providers.description: Normative is a Stockholm, Sweden-based carbon accounting and ESG reporting software company helping enterprises measure, report, and reduce their greenhouse gas emissions across scopes 1, 2, and 3. Its platform combines a library of more than 349,000 region- and sector-specific emission factors with workflows for product carbon footprint (PCF), supply chain engagement, Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) target setting, Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) disclosure, and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) reporting. Calculations are built to the GHG Protocol and independently verified by TÜV SÜD against ISO/IEC 25051. Customers include Vodafone, Hertz, Hitachi Rail, and Flying Tiger Copenhagen, and every account is paired with a named, GHG Protocol-certified Climate Strategy Advisor rather than a traditional support helpdesk. The company's revenue model is enterprise SaaS subscriptions plus advisory services; Normative does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and its GitHub organization (normative-io) currently exposes no public repositories.

providers.name: Nymbus
providers.description: Nymbus is a Jacksonville, Florida-based fintech software provider delivering cloud-based core banking, digital banking, and account onboarding technology to community banks and credit unions. Its Nymbus Connect product exposes a modern RESTful API layer alongside a client- and partner-facing developer portal, a secure sandbox environment, real-time Kafka event streaming (event-driven architecture), and an AWS-based data lake and Redshift data warehouse for reporting and analytics. Nymbus is backed by Insight Partners. The public developer portal and API reference are gated to authenticated clients and partners, so no public OpenAPI specification is available at this time.

providers.name: Parkhub
providers.description: Parkhub provided parking management and payment processing APIs for parking operators and venues. Parkhub has been acquired and the parkhub.com domain now redirects to JustPark Business. Public API documentation is no longer available.

providers.name: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts (PAFA)
providers.description: The Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts (PAFA) is the United States' first museum and school of fine arts, founded in 1805 in Philadelphia by painter and scientist Charles Willson Peale, sculptor William Rush, and other artists and business leaders. PAFA operates as a 501(c)(3) cultural nonprofit at 118-128 North Broad Street, Philadelphia, PA 19102 and occupies two connected historic buildings — the Frank Furness and George Hewitt-designed Furness-Hewitt Building (1876, designated a National Historic Landmark in 1975) and the Samuel M. V. Hamilton Building — joined by Lenfest Plaza. PAFA's permanent collection focuses on 19th- and 20th-century American art and includes works tied to alumni and faculty such as Mary Cassatt, Thomas Eakins, Henry Ossawa Tanner, William Glackens, Barkley L. Hendricks, Violet Oakley, Cecilia Beaux, Louis Kahn, David Lynch, and Njideka Akunyili Crosby, alongside the Linda Lee Alter Collection of Art by Women. Following a March 2025 announcement of a financial crisis driven by a reported roughly $3 million annual deficit and a sharp decline in enrollment, PAFA stopped granting its own BFA and MFA degrees beginning with the 2024-2025 academic year. As of 2026 the school's active educational pathways are the three-year Fine Arts Certificate Program ("designed to prepare students for entry-level professional roles within the visual arts and related creative industries"), Continuing Education classes ("an inclusive studio arts offering for artists of all ages and skill levels, from beginners to advanced creatives") delivered in-person and online, Youth & Teen programs including Summer Art Camp and Summer Academy, and PAFA Shop Memberships providing self-guided access to professional-grade printmaking, papermaking, and sculpture studios. The museum continues to operate, with admission $25 adults / $23 seniors / $10 students / $5 youth / free for children 12 and under and members, and is presenting the once-in-a-generation exhibition "A Nation of Artists" (April 2026 - September 2027) in partnership with the Philadelphia Museum of Art and the Middleton Family Collection. PAFA is a cultural nonprofit, not a technology company. It publishes no developer portal, no OpenAPI specifications, no SDKs, no public REST or GraphQL APIs, no webhooks, no status page, and no engineering blog. There is no `github.com/pafa` institutional organization — the user account `github.com/pafa` is an unrelated personal account focused on ERP and WeChat tooling. The institution's only programmatic third-party surface is its participation in the Bloomberg Connects free digital museum guide app, which presents PAFA's collection and tours through Bloomberg Philanthropies' shared mobile platform. Donations are routed through the third-party platform community.pafa.org/give and ticketing through standard museum e-commerce.

providers.name: Rebellion Defense
providers.description: Rebellion Defense (rebelliondefense.com) is a defense-technology company building an AI-driven "intelligence shield" for protecting critical infrastructure and military assets — combining multi-band AESA radar sensing (ARGUS/SPECTRUM), AI track-fusion and threat prediction (PRISM), operator alerting and situational awareness (IRIS/STATUS), and effector command-and-control (HADES) on an integrated RBLN-OS platform. Recent public activity includes U.S. Navy contracts and designation as an awardable vendor on the CDAO Tradewinds Solutions Marketplace. The company publishes a marketing site only: as of this enrichment pass no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable discovery surface is exposed. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Insight Partners portfolio lead.

providers.name: Regency Energy Partners
providers.description: Regency Energy Partners LP (NYSE: RGP) was a publicly traded master limited partnership focused on midstream natural gas services including gathering, processing, contract compression, treating, and transportation of natural gas, crude oil, and natural gas liquids. Regency operated in North Louisiana, West Texas, and the Mid-Continent region before being acquired by Energy Transfer Partners in a $11 billion transaction in 2015 and merged into Energy Transfer's broader midstream operations.

providers.name: Solfacil
providers.description: Solfacil is a Brazilian clean-energy fintech and photovoltaic distributor that operates the largest solar-energy ecosystem in Latin America. Through a B2B2C model it connects more than 20,000 partner solar integrators to 100% digital solar financing (approval in ~30 seconds, terms up to 120 months), distribution of homologated PV equipment (own branches in Jundiai-SP, Jaboatao dos Guararapes-PE and Tubarao-SC), the Solfacil Smart monitoring and asset-management platform, battery/BESS storage, insurance products, and the Solfacil Academy training programs. Financial products are regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil via Solfacil SCFI S.A. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and QED Investors; no public developer API was found - the customer surface is the partner Integrator Portal, storefront, and monitoring platform.

providers.name: Swile
providers.description: Swile is a French fintech that operates an all-in-one employee-benefits and engagement super-app built around a single Mastercard smartcard and mobile app. Founded in 2018 as Lunchr and rebranded Swile in 2020, it consolidates meal vouchers (titres-restaurant), gift and culture vouchers, mobility and work-from-home allowances, and team/recognition budgets that were historically spread across paper vouchers and multiple providers. The company merged with Bimpli in France, expanded into Brazil through Vee Benefícios, and is backed by investors including Index Ventures, SoftBank Vision Fund, and Bpifrance. Swile serves employers and their employees rather than external developers: as of this enrichment pass it publishes a security surface (RFC 9116 security.txt, a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy, and a researcher hall of fame) but no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or API reference.

providers.name: Terrascope
providers.description: Terrascope is a Singapore-headquartered climate-tech and sustainability software company building an enterprise carbon measurement, management, and decarbonization platform. Launched in 2022 after being incubated and spun out of Olam Group (a Temasek-linked Singapore agribusiness), and led by former Google and AWS executive Felipe Daguila, Terrascope serves large food, agriculture, retail, and manufacturing enterprises that need to quantify Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions across their operations, products, and supply chains. The platform centers on four core modules: Corporate Carbon Footprint (CCF) for organization-level inventories, Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) for product-level lifecycle emissions, Supplier Engagement for Scope 3 primary-data collection, and Climate Reporting for audit-ready disclosure. Terrascope's differentiator is its AI-assisted data ingestion layer (built on Amazon Bedrock) that reduces measurement cycles by roughly 80% versus manual baselines, intelligent emissions factor matching with FLAG (Forestry, Land, and Agriculture) breakdowns, data gap-filling claiming 92% accuracy versus supplier data, and a curated library of over 20,000 decarbonization best practices used to power what-if scenario modeling and ROI-ranked recommendations. The platform supports the GHG Protocol (including Land Sector and Removals guidance), SBTi FLAG, CDP (Terrascope is a CDP Gold Accredited software provider), TCFD, California SB253, and Australia's S2 climate disclosure regimes. Notable customers include Kellanova, Princes Group, iNova Pharmaceuticals, Mandai Wildlife Group, Olam Food Ingredients, Tetra Pak, Mitsubishi, Japan Tobacco, and Kagome. Investors include Olam Group and Plug and Play Tech Center. Terrascope is delivered as a closed enterprise SaaS — there is no publicly documented developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or open-source release. The github.com/terrascope organization exists but has no public repositories, and docs.terrascope.com is not publicly resolvable. Integration with customer ERP, procurement, and energy systems is handled through bespoke implementation engagements rather than self-serve developer onboarding.

providers.name: Texas Capital Bank
providers.description: Texas Capital Bank, National Association is the banking subsidiary of Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: TCBI), a Dallas-headquartered full-service financial services firm founded in 1998 with roughly $31.5 billion in assets (FYE 2025). As a nationally chartered commercial bank it serves businesses, entrepreneurs, and institutions across Texas and the United States with commercial and business banking, treasury management, mortgage/warehouse finance, and investment banking. On the open-finance dimension the bank is relationship-first rather than developer-first: it markets treasury and ERP API integrations (including its ConnectNow embedded banking for Sage and NetSuite, direct platform integrations, and SFTP/XChange file transfer) but exposes them through partner onboarding with dedicated bankers, not a public self-serve developer portal. There is no public first-party developer portal, no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger, and no self-serve API signup. Consumer account and transaction data is made available to permissioned third parties through the Finicity (Mastercard) aggregator rather than a first-party API, which is the honest posture for most US regional banks under the voluntary, fragmented US open-banking landscape (CFPB Section 1033 and the industry FDX standard).

providers.name: Touchten
providers.description: Touchten (Touchten Pte. Ltd.) is an award-winning mobile game studio headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia, and an early 500 Global (500 Startups) portfolio company. Its casual games - including Piper's Pet Cafe, Royal Garden Tales, Dessert Chain, Warung Chain Go Food Express, and the Teka-Teki Saku (TTS) crossword series - are published on the App Store and Google Play, are played by millions worldwide, and cater especially to the underserved women gamers market in the US and Europe. Touchten won the Google Play Indonesia Games Contest and received the Forbes Indonesia Rising Global Stars Award. The company publishes no developer portal or public API surface.

providers.name: Turbine
providers.description: Turbine (Turbine Ltd) is a Budapest-based AI biotechnology company that virtualizes biological experiments to accelerate and de-risk drug discovery. Its Simulated Cell platform trains virtual cells on genomic, transcriptomic, and perturbation-response data, then runs millions of in silico experiments per day to predict therapy response across cell lines, patient-derived organoids and xenografts, and patient samples. Turbine offers partner-facing products for target discovery and de-risking, combination design, and ADC (antibody-drug conjugate) intelligence, and works with pharmaceutical partners including AstraZeneca and MSD. The company publishes research code and benchmarks on GitHub but exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Weaveworks
providers.description: Weaveworks was the cloud-native company that coined the term "GitOps" and built the Weave family of open-source infrastructure tooling — Weave Net (multi-host container networking), Weave Scope (Docker/Kubernetes visualization and monitoring), Weave GitOps, and the widely used eksctl CLI for Amazon EKS. Backed by Accel and GV, the company ceased commercial operations in February 2024 after a planned acquisition fell through. It shipped no hosted REST API or client SDKs; its public surface was open-source Go tooling. Following the shutdown, Flux CD moved to the CNCF (graduated), eksctl transferred to the eksctl-io org jointly maintained with AWS, and the remaining Weave repositories became community-driven under the github.com/weaveworks organization. The former company website (weave.works) has lapsed and now redirects to a parked page.

providers.name: 1Balance
providers.description: 1Balance (1Balance Living) is a personalized herbal-wellness and tea brand offering curated caffeinated and caffeine-free tisane blends formulated for different times of day — spanning gut health, energy, metabolism, adaptogenic immune support, relaxation, and menopause support. The company blends traditional herbal science and personalization (drawing on Ayurveda and naturopathy) with modern subscription commerce, selling whole-herb capsule and loose-leaf tea blends directly to consumers through a Shopify-powered storefront with free shipping over $30 and a 30-day money-back guarantee. Backed by an Accel-led seed round, 1Balance operates as a US/India direct-to-consumer consumer-wellness company. This API Evangelist profile tracks 1Balance as a consumer brand; it runs a retail e-commerce experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Academic Partnerships
providers.description: Academic Partnerships (rebranded as Risepoint in 2024) is an education technology and online program management (OPM) company that partners with more than 100 regional public universities to launch, market, and scale affordable, workforce-focused online degree programs. The company provides operational support services including digital marketing, student enrollment and retention coaching, faculty support, and technology implementation, while curriculum, instruction, and degree conferral remain under university control. Its programs concentrate in high-ROI fields such as nursing, teaching, business, and public service. This profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Actio Biosciences
providers.description: Actio Biosciences is a San Diego-based clinical-stage biotechnology company developing precision medicines that translate insights from Mendelian (single-gene) genetics into treatments for both rare and common diseases. Its pipeline targets genetically defined conditions including KCNT1-related epilepsy and TRPV4-related Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2C (CMT2C), following a strategy of expanding from rare indications into more prevalent diseases that share the same underlying biology. The company is backed by Canaan Partners. Actio publishes no developer or API surface; this profile captures its public identity and corporate web properties.

providers.name: Air Space Intelligence
providers.description: Air Space Intelligence builds AI software for mission-critical aviation and defense operations. Its Prescience platform fuses live operational data, domain models, prediction, and optimization to give airlines, air-traffic managers, energy operators, and defense customers predictive situational awareness and decision support for complex, time-sensitive logistics. Product areas span airline operations, air traffic management, energy, global logistics, and defense (space, air mobility, land, and sea lift). The company was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass it publishes an enterprise marketing and hiring surface only — no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine discovery surface were found.

providers.name: Aizome
providers.description: Aizome is an enterprise AI agent security and governance platform that makes autonomous AI agents accountable through identity-led access control and intent validation. Its platform follows a three-step model: Discover (map every AI agent in the enterprise, including undocumented ones), Assess Risk (score agents by data access, functionality, and behavior), and Control and Govern (enforce policy through identity-led governance and intent interception before execution). Aizome inherits agent identity from users scoped to specific tasks and integrates with existing enterprise identity systems such as Okta, Microsoft Entra, and SailPoint rather than replacing them. It targets enterprise workflow automation use cases including billing, talent reviews, contract monitoring, and customer service. Aizome is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification is published at this time.

providers.name: Alterome Therapeutics
providers.description: Alterome Therapeutics is a clinical-stage precision oncology company founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Diego, California, backed by Canaan Partners. The company designs alteration-specific cancer therapies using deep biology and chemistry expertise paired with an in-house computational chemistry platform ("The Kraken"), a custom CPU/GPU compute array for physics-based molecular simulation and drug design. Its clinical pipeline includes ALTA2618, a mutation-selective inhibitor for AKT1 E17K-driven cancers, and ALTA3263, an oral pan-KRAS ON-state inhibitor targeting more than 90% of KRAS mutations in cancer. Alterome was surfaced through the Canaan Partners portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: ApartmentList
providers.description: ApartmentList is a U.S. rental marketplace that uses preference-based matching technology and a guided quiz to pair renters with apartments across all 50 states, covering the full journey from search and tours to applications and lease signing. Founded in 2011 and backed by Matrix Partners among other investors, the company operates a two-sided marketplace connecting renters with property managers and landlords, and publishes widely cited rental-market research through its Rentonomics research program. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector company profile; enrichment probing found a production website with SPF/DMARC email protection and TLS 1.3 but no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Aqtual
providers.description: Aqtual, Inc. is a Hayward, California precision-medicine company founded in 2019 by Diana Abdueva (Founder and CEO) and co-founder Rich Rava, developing blood-based diagnostics on a proprietary "active chromatin" cell-free DNA (cfDNA) platform. Rather than reading cfDNA for mutations alone, Aqtual captures the previously unexplored cfDNA fragments bound to active chromatin, so a single routine blood draw reports on DNA, epigenetic regulation and protein-DNA binding together — surveying on the order of 200,000 gene promoters, 400,000 enhancers, 50,000 insulators, 20,000 silencers and a million transcription-factor binding sites. Its lead product is a therapy-response prediction test for rheumatoid arthritis, evaluated in the prospective PRIMA-102 observational trial (NCT05936970), with oncology programs in leiomyosarcoma immunotherapy response and early colorectal cancer detection, and stated expansion into immunology, cardiovascular, metabolic and neurological disease. The company raised a USD 16 million Series A in October 2023 and over USD 31 million in Series B funding announced July 2025 from Bold Capital, the Bold Longevity Growth Fund, Genoa Ventures, Manta Ray Ventures and Yu Galaxy. Aqtual is a clinical-diagnostics and life-sciences business, not a software vendor: as of August 2026 it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract of any kind, and every /.well-known/ and contract-discovery path on aqtual.com returns 404.

providers.name: Arago
providers.description: Arago (Arago Computing SAS) is a Paris-based deeptech semiconductor startup, founded in 2024 by Nicolas Muller, Ambroise Muller, and Eliott Sarrey, building energy-efficient AI accelerators powered by light rather than electricity. Its photonic processor, codenamed JEF, uses a proprietary multi-physics computing core that encodes values with lasers instead of thousands of transistor switches, targeting 10x to 30x reductions in energy and cost overhead for AI workloads at equivalent performance to leading GPUs. Arago pairs the hardware with a full software stack called CARLOTA, which abstracts the complexities of photonic computing and exposes a programmable interface compatible with mainstream AI frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, while remaining fabbable using standard semiconductor processes. The company operates across France, North America, and Israel, and in July 2025 raised an oversubscribed $26 million seed round co-led by Earlybird, Protagonist, and Visionaries Tomorrow, with backing from executives and investors tied to Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon, Uber, PayPal, and Hugging Face. Arago was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Earlybird; as an early-stage hardware company it does not yet publish a public developer API or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Arcos Labs
providers.description: Arcos Labs is an early-stage, stealth-mode legal technology company focused on "rethinking the practice of law." Backed by 8VC as a portfolio company, the firm is building software aimed at modernizing legal work, and is currently operating in pre-launch / early-access mode with a public waitlist rather than a generally available product. As of this profile there is no public developer platform, API, documentation, or SDK surface — only a marketing site, a careers page, and an early-access intake form. This record was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched with the identity details the company publishes today; API artifacts will be captured if and when Arcos Labs ships a developer offering.

providers.name: Arena AI
providers.description: Arena AI (now operating as Arena Physica) is a New York-headquartered applied-research company building what it calls "electromagnetic superintelligence." Its flagship product, Atlas, is an AI-powered hardware-engineering platform that pairs general intelligence with deterministic physics models to accelerate the design, verification, and debugging of electronic and RF hardware. Atlas ingests telemetry, schematics, CAD files, and firmware, then connects via API or MCP (Model Context Protocol) to engineering toolchains such as Jira, GitHub, Altium, Cadence, and SPICE simulators, and to test equipment from vendors like Keysight and Tektronix. Atlas RF Studio, the company's RF design tool, is currently in beta. The company operates from New York City (HQ), San Francisco, and Los Angeles.

providers.name: Astrus
providers.description: Astrus is an AI-powered microchip design company automating the physical layout of analog circuits. Founded in 2022 by Brad Moon (CEO) and Zeyi Wang (CTO) and based in Toronto and Waterloo, Canada, Astrus applies deep reinforcement learning — inspired by AlphaGo-style self-play — to generate thousands of manufacturable analog chip layouts in seconds, targeting high-speed SERDES interconnects used in data-center GPUs. The platform lets circuit designers submit a schematic and receive optimized layouts in minutes rather than the weeks of manual transistor-by-transistor placement that analog EDA traditionally requires. Astrus raised $8M in seed funding led by Khosla Ventures with participation from Pradeep Sindhu, 1517 Fund, Drive Capital and Alumni Ventures. This profile was surfaced as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; Astrus publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Averna Therapeutics
providers.description: Averna Therapeutics is a genetic-medicine biotechnology company creating what it calls the last, great missing tool required to break through the most persistent barriers in genetic medicine. Backed by Insight Partners, the company was recognized as an Endpoints 11 Most Promising Biotech Company in 2025 and has presented at the 44th Annual J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference. As a therapeutics R&D company it does not currently publish any public developer program, API, SDK, or API documentation surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks it as a company identity record only.

providers.name: Axend
providers.description: Axend is an online investment marketplace that connects individual investors in Latin America with private company and project investment opportunities. Operating as an aggregator, it partners with allied investment platforms and earns commissions when users register or transact through them. The platform provides portfolio-building tools to analyze projects by industry, timeline, and expected return, personalized support for managing capital, and dynamic reconfiguration so investors can adjust their preferences to optimize financial performance. Axend is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It exposes no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Azra Games
providers.description: Azra Games is a mobile role-playing game studio founded in 2022 by Mark Otero and headquartered in Sacramento, California. The studio builds RPGs on its proprietary "RPG GameKit" technology, with its flagship title UnGodly, a dark sword-and-sorcery RPG. Azra Games is backed by a16z and Pantera Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As a game studio it publishes a public website, news, careers, terms, and privacy pages but does not expose a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Basking Biosciences
providers.description: Basking Biosciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in Research Triangle, North Carolina (with operations in Mitchelton, Queensland, Australia) developing novel therapies for life-threatening blood clots. Its lead program BB-031 is an investigational RNA aptamer that targets von Willebrand Factor (vWF) to deliver a rapid-onset, targeted, and reversible thrombolytic for acute ischemic stroke, paired with BB-025, a direct-acting reversal agent designed to rapidly neutralize BB-031. The company is running the RAISE Phase 2 clinical trial and is backed by Insight Partners. Surfaced as a VC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile carries company identity only.

providers.name: Beatdapp
providers.description: Beatdapp is a trust and safety operating system for digital platforms, providing AI-driven fraud detection and content integrity. Originally built to detect streaming fraud in the music industry, its platform now spans anomaly detection, customer due diligence, AI-generated music detection, account takeover detection, and recommendation systems across streaming, gaming, media, and marketplaces. The company reports analyzing 6T+ streams and 65T+ data points, with clients including Universal Music Group, iHeartRadio, Beatport, and SoundExchange. No public API, developer portal, or SDKs are published at this time.

providers.name: Better Origin
providers.description: Better Origin is a UK-based agritech company decarbonizing the food chain by converting food waste into sustainable, locally produced animal feed. Its core technology is a fully automated, AI-controlled containerized insect farm that breeds black soldier fly larvae to consume food waste and produce nutrient-rich insect-based ingredients for pet food, poultry feed, and aquaculture. The systems are remotely monitored and controlled by software and require no specialist knowledge from operators. Better Origin is a portfolio company of Balderton Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Beyond Meat
providers.description: Beyond Meat, Inc. is a Los Angeles-based producer of plant-based meat substitutes founded in 2009 and publicly traded on Nasdaq (BYND). The company makes plant-protein versions of beef, pork, and poultry products, including the Beyond Burger, Beyond Sausage, Beyond Beef, and Beyond Chicken, distributed across grocery retail and foodservice channels worldwide. Beyond Meat operates as a consumer packaged-goods brand rather than a technology or developer-platform company; it publishes a marketing and e-commerce website, product and recipe catalogs, a newsroom, and an investor-relations presence, but does not offer a public developer API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Kleiner Perkins and Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: bith.tv
providers.description: Bith.ai (bith.tv) is an all-in-one, AI-powered video editing and content creation platform for creators, letting users record, edit, resize, caption, and publish short-form video reformatted for the major social platforms from a single browser-based dashboard. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Amman, Jordan, the company is backed by 500 Global, BeyondCapital, Propeller, and Oasis500. Bith does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched with what the company publicly publishes (website, marketing tool pages, pricing, sign-up, and probed domain security posture).

providers.name: Blink Identity
providers.description: Blink Identity is an Austin, Texas company building a privacy-first facial-recognition identity platform for live entertainment venues, stadiums, and public spaces. Its "identify-in-motion" machine-vision system lets patrons enroll with a smartphone photo, then walk through touchless entry, pay-with-your-face concessions, and automatic loyalty recognition without stopping to scan a ticket. Facial images are converted into encrypted templates rather than stored as photos, and the company is a Techstars Music alumnus that has partnered with Live Nation / Ticketmaster on facial-recognition ticketing. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public website; Blink Identity does not currently publish a developer-facing API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: blueflite
providers.description: blueflite is a Techstars-backed unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) company that designs and manufactures autonomous cargo and delivery drones built on its SLATE platform for all-weather, time-sensitive logistics. Its aircraft target last-mile shipping and medical or life-saving delivery (such as defibrillators and emergency supplies), and the company complements the hardware with blueDelivery (a consumer ordering app), blueDigital (a cloud productivity tool), and blueControl, alongside drone consulting, engineering, and project services. blueflite is on the FAA Section 44807 approved UAS list and holds FCC conditional approval, and was founded by Frank Noppel and James McClearen. No public developer or API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Breadfast
providers.description: Breadfast is an Egyptian quick-commerce and online grocery platform, founded in 2017 in Cairo by Mostafa Amin, Muhammad Habib, and Abdallah Nofal. It delivers groceries, freshly baked bread, dairy, fresh produce, ready-to-eat meals, household essentials, pharmacy, and beauty products — more than 7,000 SKUs — to customers in roughly 60 minutes through a vertically integrated network of dark stores and company-owned bakeries, and also operates Breadfast Pay fintech services. The company serves 300,000+ active users across Cairo, Giza, Alexandria, and Mansoura and processes close to a million orders a month. Breadfast runs a consumer WordPress/WooCommerce marketing site and native iOS/Android apps and does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Brunswick Corporation
providers.description: Brunswick Corporation is a global leader in marine recreation and technology, headquartered in Mettawa, Illinois (NYSE: BC). Brunswick owns over 60 brands across marine propulsion (Mercury Marine, Mercury Racing, MerCruiser, Fliteboard), boat manufacturing (Boston Whaler, Sea Ray, Bayliner, Lund, Crestliner, Harris, Lowe, heyday), and marine parts and accessories (Navico Group: B&G, C-Map, Lowrance, Simrad). The company's ACES innovation strategy centers on Autonomy/Assistance, Connectivity, Electrification, and Shared Access.

providers.name: Buildcheck
providers.description: Buildcheck is a Sweden-based cloud software platform that simplifies self-inspections and quality checklists for construction and infrastructure projects. The service uses AI to automatically generate project-specific inspection and control plans from uploaded building documents, then lets field teams document work on a mobile app with photo capture and digital signatures, share progress with clients through shareable links, and export organized PDF reports. It offers company-branded templates, role-based access, SSO and other enterprise features. Buildcheck was founded by Anders Jacobson (previously Next One Technology) and Johnny Wulcan (founder of Byggplanen). It is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API or API documentation has been found on its site as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Career Karma
providers.description: Career Karma is a consumer edtech platform that helps people find and compare career training programs and get matched to the right one based on their goals, learning style, schedule, and budget. Its catalog spans technology paths (coding bootcamps, software engineering, data science, cybersecurity, AI, UX design), skilled trades (CDL truck driving, HVAC, electrical), healthcare, beauty, and sales, alongside rankings, school comparisons, financing guidance (scholarships, deferred tuition, GI Bill), and a resource center of career guides. Backed by GV, Career Karma runs a guided quiz-and-advisor matching experience rather than a public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and the security and link surface probed from its public web properties.

providers.name: CarSwitch
providers.description: CarSwitch is a tech-enabled used-car marketplace founded in Dubai in 2016 that facilitates buying and selling of pre-owned vehicles across the United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi and nationwide) and Saudi Arabia. Rather than a traditional classifieds site, CarSwitch operates as a fully managed service: every car undergoes a 200-point inspection before listing, sellers get an end-to-end managed selling service (professional photography, listing, negotiation and RTA transfer handling), and buyers get price transparency, a free online car-valuation tool and installment financing through banking partners such as Emirates NBD, FAB, ADCB, ADIB, DIB and Emirates Islamic. The company has inspected 130,000+ vehicles and facilitated over $500 million in sales. CarSwitch was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a consumer marketplace with no public developer API program.

providers.name: CarWale
providers.description: CarWale is an Indian automotive marketplace and part of CarTrade Tech Limited, connecting car buyers with new-car dealers and used-car sellers across 1,500+ cities in India. The consumer platform offers new and used vehicle listings, accurate on-road pricing sourced directly from dealers, car valuation and sell-car tools, side-by-side comparisons, expert reviews and first-drive reports, and automotive news and video content. CarWale reports over 34 million monthly unique visitors and operates alongside sister brands including BikeWale, CarTrade, CarWale abSure, Mobility Outlook, and Adroit Auto. CarWale does not currently publish a public developer portal or API; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Castelion
providers.description: Castelion is a vertically integrated defense technology company that designs, tests, and manufactures next-generation military systems, with a focus on affordable, mass-producible hypersonic strike weapons such as its Blackbeard system, built rapidly and at scale to deter future conflict. Founded by former SpaceX and defense-industry engineers, it operates manufacturing and test facilities in Torrance, CA; Rio Rancho, NM; Midland, TX; and Allen, TX. Castelion is privately held and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), General Catalyst, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. It publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation; this API Evangelist profile tracks it as a company in the network.

providers.name: Celebal Technologies
providers.description: Celebal Technologies is an enterprise data and AI consulting and engineering firm founded in 2016 and headquartered in Jaipur, India, with delivery across 13 countries and more than 3,000 certified professionals. It partners with organizations on digital transformation across Data Engineering, Generative AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, cloud and database migration, SAP Extend & Innovate, app modernization, and enterprise cloud integration, building on Microsoft Azure, Databricks, AWS, and SAP. Proprietary products include Konverto AI, CT VMS, CT Passport, CT Vision, Eagle Eye IQ, PuFF, and Chronify, serving manufacturing, retail & CPG, oil & gas, energy, BFSI, healthcare, media & entertainment, public sector, ITES, and education. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners; no public API or developer surface was found.

providers.name: Cheddar
providers.description: Cheddar is a business and technology news media company producing live and on-demand video, articles, and newsletters covering financial markets, technology, innovation, entrepreneurship, and culture for a modern digital audience. Founded as a millennial-focused financial news network and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Ribbit Capital, Comcast Ventures, and Altice USA, Cheddar streams programming such as Opening Bell, Big Business This Week, and NYSE TV Live across its website, connected-TV apps, and social platforms. It operates as a digital media and content publisher rather than an API or developer-platform company; this profile tracks Cheddar within the API Evangelist network and carries no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Chiquita Brands International
providers.description: Chiquita Brands International is a leading global producer, marketer, and distributor of bananas and other fresh produce, recognized worldwide by the iconic Blue Sticker on its bananas. Founded in 1899 as the United Fruit Company and rebranded as Chiquita in 1990, the company is headquartered in Etoy, Switzerland (with significant operations in Fort Lauderdale, Florida) and sources fruit from plantations across Latin America (Honduras, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, and Ecuador) for distribution in the United States, Europe, and other markets. Beyond core Cavendish bananas, Chiquita markets specialty banana varieties (organic, Reds, Manzanos, Minis), plantains, pineapples (including the Sunburst Gold variety), and partners with retailers worldwide. Chiquita does not currently publish a consumer-facing developer API; supplier, retailer, and grower integrations are managed through internal portals and bilateral EDI systems, and consumer-facing digital experiences focus on recipes, sticker collection campaigns, and retail merchandising.

providers.name: Cleveland-Cliffs
providers.description: Cleveland-Cliffs is North America's largest flat-rolled steel producer and supplier of iron ore pellets, operating an integrated business spanning mining, steelmaking, and downstream finishing for the automotive, infrastructure, and manufacturing markets. Cleveland-Cliffs does not publish a public developer portal or general-purpose REST API surface. Programmatic interaction with the company is limited to investor and customer touchpoints (corporate website, investor relations, customer service, EDI for trading partners).

providers.name: Convergys
providers.description: Convergys was a global leader in customer management services, providing customer care, technology services, and analytics across industries before being acquired by Concentrix in October 2018. The legacy convergys.com domain now redirects to Concentrix, and Convergys offerings such as contact center outsourcing, workforce management, analytics, and digital customer experience platforms have been folded into the Concentrix portfolio. Concentrix itself does not publish public REST APIs or developer programs in the way SaaS vendors do. Most platform integrations are delivered through enterprise contracts and private APIs.

providers.name: Copperlane
providers.description: Copperlane is an AI-native mortgage loan origination platform founded in 2025 by Brianna Lin and Athan Zhang and backed by Y Combinator (W26 batch). Its AI agent, Penny, behaves like a real loan officer: it guides borrowers through intake, pulls and reads borrower documents, verifies loan eligibility in real time, answers borrower questions live, and generates Letters of Explanation, delivering cleaner files to human loan officers so they can focus on closing loans instead of chasing paperwork. The San Francisco company raised a $4.1M seed round to modernize a mortgage origination process that remains largely manual. Copperlane is currently a demo-request business application and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Coru
providers.description: Coru is an enterprise-grade AI company transforming financial services across Latin America with conversational AI agents. Its "Adi" platform lets banks, fintechs, and insurers build and customize agentic workflows for digital loan origination, 24/7 customer service, collections management, insurance quoting, claims handling, and commission reconciliation across web, app, and WhatsApp channels in Spanish, Portuguese, and English, with multimodal input (text, voice, audio, documents) and OCR-based document capture. Coru serves financial institutions including Bradesco, Banorte, and Neon, and is backed by QED Investors. Coru markets a hosted, enterprise agent product and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Coty
providers.description: Coty Inc. is one of the world's largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin and body care. The company operates two divisions: Prestige (premium fragrance, cosmetics, and skincare brands such as Gucci, Burberry, Calvin Klein, Hugo Boss, Marc Jacobs, Tiffany, Chloe, Davidoff, Lancaster, philosophy, and Kylie Cosmetics) and Consumer Beauty (mass-market color cosmetics, hair care, and body care brands such as CoverGirl, Rimmel, Max Factor, Sally Hansen, Bourjois, and Adidas). Coty does not publish a public developer API; supplier and partner integrations occur through the Coty Supplier Portal and B2B / EDI channels.

providers.name: Covance (Fortrea)
providers.description: Covance was a contract research organization (CRO) acquired by Labcorp in 2015 and rebranded as Labcorp Drug Development in 2021. In 2023, the clinical development business was spun off as Fortrea, an independent CRO headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, operating in 90+ countries and serving the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries with clinical trial management, central laboratory, and bioanalytical services. No public API or developer portal is currently published; integrations are arranged through sponsor and partner agreements.

providers.name: Datasembly
providers.description: Datasembly is a real-time retail intelligence platform that collects hyperlocal pricing, promotion, and assortment data from physical and online retail locations. The company reports gathering 12+ billion weekly prices across 150K+ stores from 230+ retailers, building a dataset of more than 2 trillion observations that consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and retailers use to optimize pricing strategy, measure trade-spend effectiveness, monitor competitors, evaluate key value items, and plan seasonal launches. Datasembly delivers this competitive intelligence as fully shareable data and analytics rather than a public developer API. The company was acquired by SPINS. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public API, developer portal, or API documentation was found on the provider's surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: DayDayCook
providers.description: DayDayCook is a home-cooking content-to-commerce platform founded in Hong Kong that publishes recipes, cooking videos, and food storytelling (its "Taste & Tales" blog) alongside a direct-to-consumer shop selling its own branded sauces, ingredients, and prepared foods under the tagline "Easy Cooking, Festive Flavours." The business pairs a culinary media audience with a consumer-packaged-goods and e-commerce operation. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass DayDayCook publishes a consumer web presence and online shop but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Doccla
providers.description: Doccla is a UK-founded virtual care platform delivering remote patient monitoring and virtual wards across Europe. It combines pre-configured, Bluetooth-connected medical devices, a patient app, and a clinician dashboard to monitor patients at home, reducing hospital admissions and freeing bed capacity for health systems. The platform integrates bidirectionally with electronic health record (EHR) systems, including Oracle Cerner for the Northwest London Virtual Hospital, and is deployed with NHS trusts and European providers. Doccla holds ISO 27001 and ISO 13485 certifications, UKCA and CE medical-device marks, is GDPR compliant, and is registered with the UK Care Quality Commission (CQC). No public developer API or portal is published at this time; integration is delivered via managed EHR and medical-device connections.

providers.name: Eclipse GlassFish
providers.description: Eclipse GlassFish is the open-source reference implementation of the Jakarta EE platform, formerly owned by Sun/Oracle and now stewarded by the Eclipse Foundation. GlassFish is a lightweight Java application server that ships a full Jakarta EE runtime (Servlet, JAX-RS, CDI, JPA, EJB, WebSocket, JMS, Concurrency, etc.) and exposes a built-in REST management API on the DAS (Domain Administration Server) for administering domains, applications, resources, monitoring data, and configuration. The management API is part of the server itself rather than a public hosted service.

providers.name: Edukita
providers.description: Edukita (PT Edukita Budaya Cinta Belajar) is an Indonesian education company founded during the COVID-19 pandemic by Peter Gumulia and Sean Widjaja on the belief that high-quality education should be accessible to all. It teaches skills that matter through playful but powerful learning, delivering programs online, through six physical learning centers across Greater Jakarta (Bintaro, Bogor, BSD, Depok, Gading Serpong), and blended (Rumah Belajar Edukita). Programs span English with native speakers, early childhood development, Japanese mathematics, and professional upskilling for young students, families, adult learners, and corporate training. Edukita is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It exposes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: EMERGENCES AI, INC.
providers.description: EMERGENCES AI, INC. (Emergences Labs) builds human competency models, assessment, and training solutions for the AI era, focused on defining the transformative skills whose value compounds rather than erodes as AI advances. Its products include NeoWork, real-world task assessments for recruiting and identifying top performers in AI-native roles and for reskilling; NeoHuman, deliberate-practice training that teaches professionals and students effective human-AI collaboration through real enterprise work; and an expert-curated Data offering of annotated professional workflow trajectories for agent reinforcement learning and domain-specific benchmarks. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a public website with research, blog, careers, and legal pages, but does not currently expose a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Endless Studios LLC
providers.description: Endless Studios LLC is a game development learning platform where aspiring creators learn to build video games through real, pro-studio projects. Its Endstar game engine lets creators code and collaborate in real time, while structured programs (Launchpad for beginners, Capstone for advanced participants) pair learners with 30+ game-industry mentors, expert playtesting, and collaborator matching across design, art, and programming. Learners build portfolios of shipped games to show potential employers. The company runs university, government, and partner programs (including a UAE national game-making competition) and is a 500 Global portfolio company. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public developer/API surface was found during enrichment (consumer/creator-facing product on the studio.endlessstudios.com app).

providers.name: Enigmalabs
providers.description: Enigma Labs operates a crowdsourced platform for reporting, tracking, and analyzing unidentified aerial phenomena (UAP) and UFO sightings, positioning itself as a destination for UFO sighting alerts and aerial intelligence. Through a mobile app (iOS and Google Play) and a web platform with a map interface and sighting-submission flow, a global community of sky watchers contributes reports that the company enriches with data science, machine-learning analysis, real-time alerts, and historical context. Enigma Labs reports over 57,000 sightings, more than 570,000 sky watchers, and around 2,000 high-signal UAP events, and has been featured by NBC News, PBS Nova, Scientific American, The Guardian, and The New Yorker. It is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. No public API, developer portal, or developer documentation was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web presence as a consumer-facing product rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Ethic
providers.description: Ethic is an SEC-registered technology-driven asset manager that helps financial advisors and institutions build and manage highly customized, values-aligned, and tax-smart investment portfolios at scale. Its platform centralizes client portfolio management across direct indexing, model portfolios, and unified managed accounts (UMAs), letting advisors personalize holdings to individual values and tax situations. Ethic is a private, advisor- and institution-facing platform and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhooks as of this profiling.

providers.name: Eyva
providers.description: Eyva (operated by datazeit GmbH of Cologne, Germany) is an AI-powered portfolio-intelligence platform for the beauty and personal-care industry. It unifies consumer, market, and product data so product, marketing, and R&D teams can detect emerging consumer trends across Google search, TikTok, Instagram, and product reviews, benchmark their portfolio, run gap and competitive analysis, track ingredients and claims, and develop AI-assisted product concepts. The platform bundles an AI research assistant, automated AI reporting, and data-backed product recommendations, and is used by 700+ teams at brands including Beiersdorf, Nivea, dm, BASF, Babor, and Lavera. Eyva is a portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital. It is a B2B SaaS delivered through a demo-led sales motion and an authenticated web application; no public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: FabHotels
providers.description: FabHotels is an Indian branded-budget hotel chain and online booking platform, founded in 2014 by Vaibhav Aggarwal and Adarsh Manpuria and headquartered in Gurugram. It operates a network of 1500+ standardized economy hotels across 80+ cities under the FabHotel, FabHotel Prime, and Via brands, with quality-controlled amenities such as free WiFi, air conditioning, and 24/7 security. Consumers book stays through the FabHotels website and its iOS and Android apps; the company also runs a franchise program for property owners and corporate-stay offerings, and is backed by Accel and Goldman Sachs. No public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface is advertised — this remains a business-to-consumer travel brand rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Fabletics
providers.description: Fabletics is an American athleisure and activewear brand co-founded in 2013 by actress Kate Hudson with Adam Goldenberg and Don Ressler under the TechStyle Fashion Group in El Segundo, California. It sells women's and men's (FL2) activewear, leggings, sports bras, accessories, the Yitty shapewear line, and Fabletics Scrubs through a VIP membership subscription model that gives members monthly credits and member pricing, operating omnichannel across its e-commerce site and a growing footprint of brick-and-mortar retail stores. As a direct-to-consumer retailer, Fabletics does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: First Club
providers.description: FirstClub is a member-exclusive quick-commerce grocery platform operating in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, India, delivering curated, quality-inspected groceries in as little as 30 minutes from physical "ClubHouses" rather than traditional dark stores. The company targets India's top-tier consumers with only trusted, tasted, and tested products, screening out a published list of banned ingredients across categories including fruits and vegetables, dairy and eggs, bakery, staples, kids nutrition, packaged foods, snacks and beverages, health supplements, and cleaning essentials. FirstClub also offers a subscription model, "FirstClub Mornings." Founded by ex-Flipkart executive Ayyappan R, the company is backed by Accel and RTP Global. It surfaces here as an API Evangelist network profile; FirstClub is a consumer mobile-app business and currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Frankford Candy
providers.description: Frankford Candy & Chocolate Company is a privately held, family-owned confectionery manufacturer headquartered in the Frankford neighborhood of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1947 by Russian immigrant Sam Himmelstein, the company describes itself as the "#1 Marketer of Licensed Confectionary in the United States," producing licensed novelty candy, holiday plush, hot chocolate bombs, gummies, Valentine heart boxes, and seasonal collectibles under partnerships with M&M's, Hershey, Pez, Oreo, Sour Patch Kids, Peeps, Welch's, Jif, Kraft, Disney, Marvel, Netflix, Nickelodeon, Minecraft, Super Mario, SpongeBob, Stitch, Care Bears, Elf on the Shelf, Baskin-Robbins, Dunkin', KFC, and Smucker's. Frankford acquired the Cap Candy and Wonder Ball lines from Hasbro and Nestlé in the 2000s and is one of the largest producers of chocolate Easter rabbits in the United States. This repository captures the publicly observable web surface for Frankford Candy; the company exposes no public developer API, portal, SDK, status page, or machine-readable artifacts.

providers.name: FutureFit AI
providers.description: FutureFit AI is an AI-powered workforce technology company that connects people to careers, employers to talent, and workforce partners to tools for integrated and intelligent workforce systems. Its Pathways Platform powers workforce-system transformation while its Career Copilot delivers AI-driven career guidance across career navigation, labor exchange, employment services, virtual career centers, upskilling and reskilling, and industry talent pipelines. The company serves workforce development, economic development, and enterprise customers. As of this enrichment pass FutureFit AI publishes a marketing and product site but no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Gambit
providers.description: Gambit Security is an Israeli cyber-resilience company, founded in 2024 by Unit 8200 veterans Alon Gromakov (CEO), Sa'ar Elias (CPO) and May Kogan (CTO), that emerged from stealth in February 2026 with $61M in seed and Series A funding from Cyberstarts, Kleiner Perkins and Spark Capital. Its product, Balens, is an AI-native autonomous resilience platform that continuously maps every resource in an environment into end-to-end business applications, revealing dependencies, backup coverage and immutability, detecting infrastructure drift, scoring Cyber Resilience Posture Management (CRPM) and validating real-world recovery paths against ransomware and outages. It also automates compliance evidence for frameworks such as DORA, NIST CSF and SOX. Gambit does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Gandeeva
providers.description: Gandeeva Therapeutics is a Vancouver, Canada-based precision-medicine and drug-discovery company that combines cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) with artificial intelligence and machine learning to visualize druggable transient protein-protein interactions at atomic resolution and design first-in-class molecular glues and engineered antibodies. Its structure-guided platform spans target prediction and validation (SPOTLIGHT), hit identification across virtual and fragment libraries (HYPERFOCUS), and cryo-EM-driven lead optimization (CRYO-CADD), with an oncology-focused pipeline of proximity-inducing small molecules. The company raised a $40M Series A and has run cryo-EM research collaborations with partners including Moderna and Zymeworks. Gandeeva is a private biotechnology company and does not publish a public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio record.

providers.name: Gather AI
