providers.description: Gather AI is a Physical AI platform for logistics that gives warehouses dock-to-dock inventory visibility. Cameras mounted on autonomous drones and forklifts capture inventory, and computer vision extracts structured data (LPNs, UPCs, lot codes, and free text) from the imagery. Its Sage AI engine analyzes operations and surfaces prioritized actions before each shift, while automated Workflows route tasks to the right personnel across integrated systems. The plug-and-play solution deploys in hours alongside existing warehouse management systems, serving manufacturing, healthcare, food & beverage, retail, and 3PL operations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and bloomberg-beta.

providers.name: Get Lighthouse
providers.description: Get Lighthouse (Lighthouse Lessons) is a management-training and leadership-development company that helps managers run better one-on-ones and grow their teams. It offers bite-sized, actionable online management-training programs, including a 1-on-1 Master Class, Managing Up, and the Secret Habits of Senior Leaders, delivered as self-paced solo study and structured team training, alongside a widely-read management and leadership blog. Get Lighthouse is a content and training provider with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its web identity and domain-security posture. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Glass Imaging
providers.description: Glass Imaging is a Los Altos, California AI company that enhances image and video quality on smartphones and imaging devices. Its GlassAI technology uses machine learning to reverse lens aberrations and sensor imperfections, extracting the full image-quality potential of camera hardware by removing noise, blur, and artifacts. The company ships a Custom Neural ISP that boosts camera performance up to 10x on edge AI-enabled devices, and a Co-Designed AI + Optics approach for space-constrained (SWaP) cameras. Glass Imaging sells to smartphone and device manufacturers and is venture-backed by Google Ventures, LDV Capital, Future Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Ground Up, and Insight Partners. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Glass Imaging does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Glyph
providers.description: Glyph is a sustainable footwear brand that designs digitally knit, versatile everyday shoes engineered to be worn for every occasion. Backed by 500 Global, the company sells direct-to-consumer through its Shopify storefront at glyph.earth, emphasizing low-waste digital knitting, single-shoe versatility, and eco-conscious materials. Glyph is a physical consumer-products (DTC e-commerce) company and does not currently publish a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its web and policy surface for network completeness.

providers.name: Google Vids
providers.description: Google Vids is an AI-powered video creation and editing application in Google Workspace that enables business users to produce professional videos without design expertise by combining Gemini-assisted outlining, Veo 3 generative video clips, AI avatars, recording studio capabilities, and a royalty-free stock media library. Vids is available on Business and Enterprise Workspace plans as well as Google AI Pro and Ultra consumer plans, with collaboration handled through standard Workspace sharing controls. There is no public developer REST API for Google Vids at this time; this index tracks the product as a documentation-only reference.

providers.name: Grubmarket
providers.description: GrubMarket is a food technology company founded in 2014 that digitally transforms the American food supply chain across the U.S. and Canada. It operates a B2B wholesale eCommerce marketplace connecting buyers to thousands of food products, an AI-powered ERP and warehouse-management software suite (WholesaleWare) for food distributors and growers, and a direct-to-consumer farm-fresh food delivery service. Backed by Battery Ventures, GGV Capital, and Y Combinator, GrubMarket was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass GrubMarket publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Habito
providers.description: Habito is a UK-based digital mortgage broker that lets people research, compare, and apply for mortgages online across the whole of the market, pairing self-serve digital tools with human mortgage experts, alongside related home-buying services. Founded as a fintech in the consumer lending and real-estate space and backed by Ribbit Capital, Habito has since joined Monzo. The company operates a consumer web product (Webflow-hosted marketing site) and does not publish a public developer API program, developer portal, or OpenAPI at the time of this profile; this record is maintained by the API Evangelist network and reflects only publicly verifiable surfaces.

providers.name: Harmonix
providers.description: Harmonix Music Systems is one of the world's leading independent game development studios, best known for creating blockbuster music and rhythm franchises including Rock Band and Dance Central, alongside titles such as Amplitude, Fuser, DropMix, Audica, Super Beat Sports, and Harmonix Music VR. Founded in 1995 and based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, the studio was acquired by Epic Games in 2021 and continues to invent the future of music and motion gaming. Harmonix operates a consumer-facing web presence (games, music, community, blog, and press) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Humanising Autonomy
providers.description: Humanising Autonomy is a London-based behavioural AI company that builds ethical computer-vision software to understand and predict human behaviour, providing context between people and machines. Its "Behaviour AI" platform combines novel deep learning, behavioural psychology and statistical AI to analyse existing camera and video footage across automotive & ADAS, fleet telematics, city infrastructure & planning, and health & safety use cases -- improving road safety and reducing liability. The company connects to a customer's existing cameras, platform or video footage rather than exposing a public developer API. Backed by Anthemis. No public developer API, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment; this profile remains a company stub with a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Hustle Fund
providers.description: Hustle Fund is a pre-seed and seed-stage venture capital firm that invests in "hilariously early" software and technology startups, backing founders often within one or two meetings. Beyond writing early checks through its funds and angel investor network, Hustle Fund publishes tactical, BS-free educational content and newsletters for founders (The Founder Playbook) and investors (Small Bets), and runs programs that help operators learn to angel invest. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of foundry-group. Sector: venture-capital.

providers.name: HyperStrong
providers.description: HyperStrong (Beijing HyperStrong Technology Co., Ltd. / 北京海博思创科技股份有限公司, SSE: 688411) is a leading Chinese provider of battery energy storage systems (BESS) and integrated energy solutions. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Beijing, the company designs and manufactures modular liquid-cooled storage systems (HyperBlock and HyperCube series), integrated solar-plus-storage and charging-storage units, and the core control stack of battery management systems (BMS), energy management systems (EMS), and power conversion systems (PCS), alongside its HyperCloud AI cloud platform for fleet monitoring and optimization. HyperStrong serves generation-side, grid-side, and user-side (commercial, industrial, and residential) storage markets, ranking among the top domestic and global players by cumulative installed capacity with 60+ GWh deployed across 400+ projects. It is backed by IDG Capital and Qiming Venture Partners. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; HyperStrong is a hardware and energy-platform company and does not publish a public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: In Your Shoe
providers.description: In Your Shoe is an Egyptian streetwear and apparel brand, founded in 2018 and based in Cairo, Egypt, that designs and sells playful, statement-driven ready-to-wear pieces — oversized and boxy tees, shirts, jeans, jorts, loungewear, kids' lines, and accessories — letting Millennials and Gen-Z express themselves through high-quality, self-expressive fashion. The company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront and is backed by 500 Global and the Misk 500 MENA Accelerator. It publishes no first-party developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

The company is building a "superlearner" that discovers knowledge from its own experience using reinforcement learning, without relying on human data, with the goal of rediscovering and transcending human inventions such as language, science, mathematics and technology. Backed by Bond Capital and Index Ventures, Ineffable is an early-stage research lab: at this time it publishes a mission/beliefs site, a founder blog note, and open roles, but no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications. This profile captures the company's public identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

Backed by Partech, the company operates in the consumer end-of-life services sector. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; Inmemori publishes a consumer website and blog but no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: KAMI

Community-validated narratives are measured through read rates, micro-transactions, and engagement, then graduate into vertical-drama production and licensable intellectual property — a "story IP engine." KAMI is a consumer product (2.5M+ users) with no public developer API; it is part of the wearekami.com ecosystem and a 500 Global Creators Ventures portfolio company, added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Memora

providers.name: Merida Biosciences

providers.name: MKS Instruments

The platform integrates with existing camera and monitoring infrastructure and applies real-time training and analysis to detect security and safety threats across retail spaces, hospitality and lodging, educational institutions, fuel and service stations, and food-handling environments. mokSa AI states SOC 2 Type 2 certification and GDPR compliance for its data handling. providers.name: Newleos Therapeutics

Its pipeline, licensed from Roche, develops oral small-molecule therapeutics targeting GABAA-gamma1, V1a, TAAR1 and GABAA-alpha5 mechanisms, with first- or best-in-class potential for general anxiety, social anxiety, substance use disorders, and cognitive impairment. Newleos is a pharmaceutical R&D company with no public developer or API product surface; this profile captures its corporate web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: NEXT Academy

Its flagship Quantum Degrees cover full-stack web development, frontend, and backend engineering, pairing project-based challenges with personalized mentorship. Founded to help close the region's tech-talent gap, NEXT Academy has produced 2,800+ graduates from 50+ countries, with alumni placed at companies including Google, Uber, AirAsia, Fave, and Mindvalley. It is backed by 500 Global. NEXT Academy publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface as of this profile; its primary digital surfaces are a marketing website and a student learning-management portal at lms.nextacademy.com.

providers.name: Nikahsatu
providers.description: Nikahsatu is a Malaysian wedding-planning marketplace that helps couples plan and budget their weddings more easily and affordably. The consumer-facing platform curates venue packages across Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Johor, Melaka, Penang and other Malaysian states, along with wedding vendor services such as digital and printed invitations, photography and videography, traditional songket attire, and custom gift boxes, bundled into coordinated all-in-one wedding packages with promotional rebates. It is built on WordPress/WooCommerce and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Nikahsatu publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Northstar
providers.description: Northstar is an employer-sponsored financial wellness benefit that helps employees understand, manage, and get the most out of their total compensation and personal finances. Delivered as a workplace benefit (offered by employers to their workforce), Northstar pairs financial guidance with tools for budgeting, saving, equity/compensation planning, and overall money management. The company is a fintech provider backed by GGV Capital. It was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. providers.name: Novo Space
providers.description: Novo Space develops high-performance, radiation-tolerant, modular electronics for the most ambitious space missions. Founded by Rodrigo Diez (CEO) and Facundo Jorge (CTO), the company builds SpaceVPX single-board computers, mass memory and GPU boards, tailored subsystems, and radiation-tolerant FPGA IP cores (SpaceWire, SpaceFibre, Ethernet/TCP-IP, CCSDS, NAND controllers, floating-point units) that let satellite and spacecraft builders reuse qualified hardware instead of re-engineering every mission. Customers and partners include Maxar, MIT, Thales Alenia Space, BAE Systems, Leonardo DRS, Mitsubishi, the US Air Force, Nvidia, Ansys, and Microchip. Novo Space is a space-computing hardware provider and does not publish a public web API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Oak
providers.description: Oak is an AI-native identity operating system that governs human, machine, and AI-agent identities from a single platform. Its Identity Intelligence Layer unifies identity data into a graph that serves as a foundational security layer, paired with Agentic Identity governance for AI agents, a Connect Any connector layer spanning on-premises, SaaS, cloud, and custom systems, and White Glove enterprise onboarding services. Oak is an early-stage, enterprise/sales-led identity-security company backed by CRV; it currently exposes a customer login app but no public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: Once
providers.description: Once (getonce.com) is a consumer chat and connection platform positioned as an alternative to traditional dating apps, offering a pressure-free space for people seeking meaningful connections, improved social skills, and guidance in their personal lives. The mobile app surfaces a small number of daily matches based on shared interests and vibes, lets users join communities of like-minded people, and runs a rewards system called Sparks that members earn and spend on gifts and chat features. Once is a Consumer-sector portfolio company of the venture firm Partech. It ships as a consumer mobile application and does not currently expose a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: OpenStore
providers.description: OpenStore (Miami Labs, Inc. d/b/a OpenStore) is a Miami-based e-commerce holding company that buys direct-to-consumer Shopify businesses from their founders, offering data-driven valuations, offers in as little as 24 hours, and closings in about a week. After acquiring long-tail Shopify merchants, OpenStore uses its own software, marketing, and operations platform to run and grow the brands under one portfolio. Founded in 2021 by Keith Rabois and Atomic's Jack Abraham, OpenStore is backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, Atomic, Khosla Ventures, and others. It is a consumer/operator business and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its corporate and web-property surface.

providers.name: Oshkosh

providers.name: OUTFRONT Media
providers.description: OUTFRONT Media is a U.S. out-of-home (OOH) advertising company and real estate investment trust (NYSE: OUT) operating a national portfolio of billboards, digital displays, and transit advertising assets. The company runs the MTA Advertising Network across New York City's subways, buses, and commuter rail, along with roadside billboards, digital liveboards, Times Square spectaculars, and place-based displays in major U.S. markets. OUTFRONT's digital inventory is made available programmatically through DOOH supply-side partners such as Vistar Media and Place Exchange. OUTFRONT sold its Canadian operations to Bell Media in October 2022 to focus on the U.S. market. OUTFRONT does not publish a developer portal or public APIs; programmatic access to its inventory is mediated through third-party DOOH SSPs.

providers.name: Pacaso
providers.description: Pacaso is a proptech company that operates a luxury vacation-home co-ownership platform, letting individuals buy a fractional share of a professionally managed second home. It handles the LLC ownership structure, financing, scheduling, cleaning, maintenance, and full property management for co-owners across premium destinations in the US, Europe, Mexico, and other resort markets. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and the SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network. Pacaso publishes no public API or developer program at this time; this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: PayScale
providers.description: PayScale is a compensation intelligence and salary data company that helps organizations and individuals price jobs, benchmark pay, and manage compensation. Its platform combines a Peer Data Ecosystem of daily-refreshed, HRIS-sourced salary data across thousands of organizations and millions of employee records with survey-based and crowdsourced pay data spanning tens of thousands of jobs across many countries. Products include the Payscale Ascent compensation management platform, market pricing and benchmarking datasets (Peer Global, Peer Enhanced, Peer Industry, Peer Markets), pay equity analytics, and consumer-facing salary research tools. This profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; PayScale publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time, so this entry captures company identity, links, and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Pelikan Mobility
providers.description: Pelikan Mobility is a Paris-based smart-leasing and fleet-management company for electric commercial vehicles, founded in late 2022 by David Salfati and Vincent Schachter. It operates two products: Pelikan Lease, a very-long-term leasing offer (up to 10 years / 300,000 km) for electric utility vans that targets a 20% lower total cost of ownership, and Pelikan FleetPilot, a SaaS platform using digital twins, optimization algorithms and generative AI to plan fleet renewal, electrification and vehicle redeployment across large B2B fleets in utilities, maintenance, construction and logistics. The company is backed by Seedcamp, Frst and PaleBlueDot Ventures. It publishes a marketing and resources website but exposes no public API or developer surface at this time; this profile records its identity and web-domain security posture.

providers.name: Percolate
providers.description: Percolate was a New York-based content marketing and marketing-orchestration platform, backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Slow Ventures, that helped enterprise marketing teams plan, create, and distribute campaign content. providers.name: Port of Mokha

Known for record-setting Coffee Review scores and curated offerings such as the Timeless Mokha Blend and The Yemen Trilogy, it also runs a wholesale program and publishes brewing guides. Rather than shipping software, Proper delivers a trained accounting team supported by automation to handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, month-end close, and financial reporting, integrating with existing property-management systems such as AppFolio, Buildium, and RentManager. Founded in the property-management space in 2017, the company is backed by QED Investors, Redpoint Ventures, MetaProp, Expa, and Bling Capital. As of this enrichment pass Proper exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface; this profile is maintained as a company record.

providers.name: Pura Mente

providers.name: Pvx Partners

Its PvX Capital product offers a flexible credit line covering up to 80% of monthly marketing spend with no equity dilution, term sheets within 24 hours, and funds within 30 days, secured by and repaid from funded user cohorts. PvX Lambda is a cohort intelligence engine offering cohort-based ROAS projections, benchmarking, and funding-eligibility analysis across 650+ apps and 14,500+ cohorts, and PvX Delta rounds out the analytics suite.
