The enrichment pipeline found no developer or API surface; this is a clinical-stage therapeutics company, not a software or platform provider, so no API artifacts were produced (none is the correct, non-fabricated result).

providers.name: Crown Holdings
providers.description: Crown Holdings, Inc. is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and sale of rigid packaging products for consumer goods, including metal beverage cans and ends, food cans, aerosol cans, specialty closures and promotional tins, as well as transit and protective packaging products for industrial markets. The company operates in more than 40 countries and supports customers with design, decoration, reprographics, compound development, pilot facilities, and seaming training services. Crown Holdings does not publish a public developer API program; technical collaboration with customers happens through B2B and EDI channels.

providers.name: data.gov.mt (Open Data Malta)
providers.description: data.gov.mt is the national government open-data portal for Malta, operated by MITA (Malta Information Technology Agency) as a bespoke "Shared Data Governance and Data Management Platform" with a JavaScript single-page-app front end (served at portal.data.gov.mt / open.data.gov.mt). It is DCAT-AP-compliant for EU harvesting (~230+ datasets) but exposes no publicly documented JSON catalog API. Malta's geospatial APIs are available separately via the MSDI geoportal.

providers.name: DCG
providers.description: Digital Currency Group (DCG) is a crypto-industry venture and holding company that describes itself as the enduring investor and operator of the crypto industry. Investing in digital currencies and blockchain since 2012, DCG has built a portfolio of 200+ equity investments, 50+ fund investments, and 30+ token and digital-asset positions across 25+ countries. It owns and operates category-leading subsidiaries including Grayscale (crypto asset management), Foundry (mining and staking infrastructure), CoinDesk (media, data and events), Genesis (institutional financial services), Luno (consumer wallet), HQ, and TradeBlock. DCG is a corporate holding and investment company and does not publish a public developer API; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead.

providers.name: De-Ice
providers.description: De-Ice Technologies is a Somerville, Massachusetts deep-tech aviation startup building a chemical-free aircraft de-icing system that replaces conventional glycol spray with electrically heated strips applied to aircraft surfaces, removing snow and ice prior to takeoff. The technology eliminates weather-related departure delays, cuts glycol spraying costs, and reduces CO₂ emissions from idling fuel burn and chemical production. Named to Time's Best Inventions of 2024, De-Ice counts Air Canada as its launch customer and is backed by Techstars. This is a physical-hardware aviation company and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Detoure Inc
providers.description: Detoure Inc (DETOURE) is a sustainable fashion resale marketplace, backed by 500 Global, that sources highly curated clothing from influencers and tastemakers and offers it to shoppers at thrift prices. The platform lets customers buy current trends from the creators they follow while cutting down on excess fashion waste, and lets influencers and partners apply to consign and sell items from their own closets. Detoure operates as a consumer e-commerce brand on a hosted Shopify storefront and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Digg
providers.description: Digg is a technology news aggregation and community curation platform, relaunched under new ownership and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and True Ventures. It surfaces trending stories, discussions, and video signals drawn largely from X/Twitter, ranking them by community engagement and editorial signals. The platform tracks contributor rankings, rising stories, today's highlights, and GitHub repository activity, positioning itself as an AI-assisted discovery hub for technology, startups, and AI news. As surfaced here, Digg is a consumer web product with no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation; this profile captures its identity and web/domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Digital Iron
providers.description: Digital Iron is an AI platform delivering aftersales intelligence for heavy machinery. It helps equipment dealers and OEMs turn scattered service data — machine history, product documentation, customer records, bills of materials, work orders, and technician notes — into faster troubleshooting, accurate parts identification, and reliable job quoting. The platform surfaces recurring failure patterns across fleets (excavators, crushers, compaction rollers, and similar equipment) to improve first-time fix rates. Digital Iron is backed by Seedcamp and tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; the product is delivered as a hosted web application and no public API has been identified to date.

providers.name: Dream
providers.description: Dream (Dream Security / Dream Group) is an AI company for national cybersecurity and sovereign AI, founded in 2023 by Shalev Hulio, former Austrian Chancellor Sebastian Kurz, and Gil Dolev, with offices in Tel Aviv, Vienna, and Abu Dhabi. Dream builds a full sovereign AI stack that nations own, control, and operate with zero foreign reliance, delivered on-premises and air-gapped with no foreign telemetry. Its platform spans three products: Atlas, a national AI platform that turns government data into knowledge and decisions across intelligence, finance, health, and supply chain; Sphere, a unified cyber-defense system protecting government and critical infrastructure against nation-state threats; and Hero, an autonomous multi-agent solution for vulnerability discovery and patching. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures and others at a multibillion-dollar valuation, Dream has no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Dusk
providers.description: Dusk (dusk.app), tagline "Make the night," is a consumer mobile app backed by 500 Global. It publishes product documentation on a Notion-hosted docs site (docs.dusk.app) and maintains an RFC 9116 security.txt pointing to a public Responsible Disclosure Policy. Dusk was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface at this time, so this profile captures its verifiable web, documentation, and security posture.

providers.name: E-3 Tech
providers.description: E3Tech (E-3 Tech) is an investment firm that partners with entrepreneurs through programmatic M&A and technology amplification, providing private-equity-style investment in profitable service-industry platforms while letting founders retain control and preserve their entrepreneurial culture. It combines strategic acquisitions, operational enhancements, and technology to drive growth across multi-trade construction services, marketing agencies, managed service providers, wealth management, pharmaceutical services, and vegetation management. Surfaced as an a16z-associated portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as an investment/advisory firm it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Earli
providers.description: Earli is a biotech company using AI-designed genetic switches for early cancer detection and treatment. Its synthetic-biomarker technology forces cancer cells to reveal themselves for earlier, more accurate detection, and can program cancer cells to self-destruct while sparing healthy tissue. Founded by Cyriac Roeding and backed by a16z and Menlo Ventures, Earli is a research-stage company with no public developer platform, API, or SDK surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead awaiting further enrichment.

providers.name: Earth AI
providers.description: Earth AI is a vertically integrated, AI-powered mineral exploration company that discovers, develops, and owns critical mineral mines for the emerging hardware economy — data centers, humanoid robots, eVTOL aircraft, fusion energy, space, and defense. Its proprietary predictive model, MTP, is trained on roughly 400 million geological sites to identify the source rocks of new mineral deposits and dramatically compress traditional exploration timelines. The company vertically integrates the search for critical minerals: it predicts targets with AI, acquires mineral rights, and drills to prove and own the resource. Earth AI is backed by DCVC and has been profiled by TechCrunch, Business Insider, and The Generalist's Future 50. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Earth AI does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: ELKROOM CO., LTD.
providers.description: ELKROOM CO., LTD. is a consumer mobile-gaming studio and 500 Global portfolio company behind the OXO product family. Its flagship OXO Game Launcher is an Android game launcher and optimization tool that organizes a player's games and automatically tracks play history, journals, monthly reports, rankings, and community activity, and has surpassed five million downloads on Google Play. The company also builds OXO Gameplay, an AI-powered gaming content and social platform for Android and iOS, and Stricer, a cloud-based AI video analysis and highlight-editing tool on the web. ELKROOM operates consumer applications rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, product surface, and legal/policy pages. Tagline: "You Chase Glory. We Make It Legendary."

providers.name: Everyrealm
providers.description: Everyrealm Inc. is a Web3 and metaverse company building virtual communities inside in-game worlds, positioned at the intersection of gaming, entertainment, and blockchain technology. Under the banner "Connecting what matters," Everyrealm develops immersive, gamified virtual worlds and experiences, partners with gaming platforms, and invests across the broader metaverse and digital-real-estate ecosystem. The company has raised venture funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Coinbase Ventures, Brevan Howard, Hashed, and other prominent investors. Everyrealm is a consumer- and community-facing operator rather than an API-first developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI definitions, SDKs, or programmatic API surface. This entry was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile and has been enriched with public identity, legal, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Excelergy
providers.description: Excelergy is a global provider of high-performance retail energy billing and revenue management software, now part of Harris Computer. Its flagship product, RevenueManager, is a cloud-based, meter-to-cash billing platform used by competitive energy retailers across more than 200 jurisdictions in North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. RevenueManager handles residential, commercial, industrial, and wholesale billing across multiple commodities (electricity, natural gas, water, heat, and sewage), supporting complex tariff and pricing models, customer lifecycle management, smart-meter and time-of-use pricing, and built-in Salesforce CRM integration. The platform exposes APIs for connectivity with third-party systems and access to data held in the RevenueManager database. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company; Excelergy publishes a corporate marketing site and a customer support portal but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Fishbit
providers.description: Fishbit is a smart-aquarium management company whose platform pairs a mobile app (iOS/Android) with connected hardware — the Fishbit Monitor, which tracks water parameters such as pH, temperature, and salinity in real time, and the Fishbit Controller, which wirelessly automates aquarium equipment. Hobbyists and reef keepers use the system to remotely monitor tank conditions and automate lighting, pumps, and dosing. The company sells its monitoring and control hardware through an online store and ran a device-manufacturer partner program (e.g. RapidLED Corona integration). No public API, developer portal, or SDK is currently published; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a connected-hardware / IoT lead.

providers.name: Flavrs
providers.description: Flavrs is a consumer food and cooking platform "made for people who live to eat" that pairs short-form cooking videos from notable chefs and food creators (including Eric Ripert and Binging with Babish) with structured recipe data and integrated ingredient shopping, so viewers can watch a dish being made and buy everything they need to cook it in a single app. Backed by a16z and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile, Flavrs has since merged with the meal-delivery service CookUnity and now redirects its audience there. Flavrs operates as a mobile consumer application and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its real identity, legal, and social properties for network completeness.

providers.name: Flickplay
providers.description: Flickplay, Inc. is a Web3 social and gaming company that turns character intellectual property into portable, interactive, and monetizable experiences across user-generated content, social platforms, and real-world retail activations. Its consumer iOS app combines character-based gameplay (blind boxes, spin games, leveling), AR video and GIF creation tools, AI character chat, iOS home-screen widgets, a quest system tying gameplay to e-commerce, and a Fandom Intelligence dashboard tracking fan identity, behavior, and spend. Flickplay is a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of mid-2026 the company published a suspension notice, and it exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal — this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: Gen.G
providers.description: Gen.G is a global esports organization founded in 2017 (originally KSV eSports) that connects the United States and Asia, operating from Los Angeles, Seoul, and Shanghai. It fields professional teams across League of Legends, Valorant, PUBG, Counter-Strike 2, Rocket League, Fortnite, Brawl Stars, Honor of Kings, Mobile Legends, NBA 2K, Overwatch, Rainbow Six Siege, and EA FC, and runs a youth esports academy program alongside merchandise and fan-engagement businesses. Backed by Canaan Partners among other investors, Gen.G was valued at roughly $250 million as of 2022. It is a consumer esports brand and merchandise operator with a Shopify-based storefront; it publishes no public developer API, so this profile carries company identity only.

providers.name: Generate Biomedicines
providers.description: Generate Biomedicines is a Somerville, Massachusetts therapeutics company pioneering Generative Biology, a machine-learning-driven approach to de novo protein design across antibodies, peptides, enzymes, and gene therapies. Founded out of Flagship Pioneering and chaired by Noubar Afeyan, the company trains generative models on the full compendium of natural protein structures and sequences plus proprietary wet-lab data to design novel protein therapeutics computationally rather than by trial-and-error discovery. Its open-source flagship is Chroma, a programmable diffusion-based generative model for joint protein structure and sequence design published in Nature 2023 ("Illuminating protein space with a programmable generative model", doi:10.1038/s41586-023-06728-8) and released on GitHub under Apache 2.0 with pretrained weights available under a custom Chroma Parameters License (free for academic and nonprofit use). Chroma uses equivariant graph neural networks, diffusion modeling, and conditional random fields to sample all-atom protein structures with sub-quadratic complexity, supporting conditional generation via composable Conditioner modules for symmetry, substructure, shape, and secondary-structure constraints. The internal Generate Platform iterates on a "generate, build, measure, learn" loop that pairs in-silico design with high-throughput protein synthesis and characterization; the company reports having generated, built, and tested more than 42,000 proteins. Generate Biomedicines has platform collaborations with Amgen (six programs, January 2022) and Novartis (multiple programs, September 2024) and a CAR T collaboration with Roswell Park. Its clinical pipeline is led by GB-0895, a long-acting anti-TSLP antibody for severe asthma now in Phase 3 (SOLAIRIA study) with a parallel Phase 1 in COPD, plus preclinical programs GB-4362 (anti-free-MMAE for ADC oncology safety) and GB-5267 (MUC16 armored CAR T for ovarian cancer). The company priced its initial public offering in February 2026. Revenue derives from drug development, partner collaborations, and (for Chroma) commercial weights licensing; there is no public developer REST/HTTPS API or SDK for the Generate Platform itself — Chroma is consumed as a Python library installed via pip with model weights downloaded from chroma-weights.generatebiomedicines.com after registering for an API key.

providers.name: Good Job Games
providers.description: Good Job Games is a global mobile gaming company founded in 2017 that designs, develops, and operates puzzle and match-3 titles for iOS and Android, including Wonder Blast and Match Villains. The studio publishes its games through the Apple App Store and Google Play rather than a developer API program, and its public web surface is limited to its marketing site, games catalog, careers ("Life at Good Job Games") pages, and legal policies. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, SDK, documentation, or API reference was found during enrichment; the artifacts captured here reflect its domain security posture and public web properties.

providers.name: Grand Games
providers.description: Grand Games (Grand Games Oyun ve Yazılım) is an Istanbul-based hybrid-casual mobile game studio founded in early 2024 by Bekir Batuhan Çelebi, Mehmet Çalım, and Mustafa Fırtına, a team that previously built Zen Match at Moon Active. The studio develops genre-defining puzzle games for iOS and Android played by millions worldwide, including Magic Sort, Car Match, and Block Out, and has grown to six live titles with fivefold year-over-year revenue. It has raised roughly $103M across three rounds, most recently a $70M Series B led by Balderton Capital's Growth Fund in May 2026. Grand Games publishes consumer mobile games and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Graph Query Language (GQL)
providers.description: GQL is an international standard query language for property graph databases, developed by ISO/IEC JTC1 SC32 WG3 to provide a declarative way to query and manipulate graph data structures. Published as ISO/IEC 39075:2024 on April 17, 2024, the standard complements SQL for graph workloads and builds on prior art including openCypher, PGQL, GSQL, and G-CORE. Effective implementation supports data-driven strategies and helps maintain data integrity and portability across graph database systems.

providers.name: Gravy
providers.description: Gravy is a local-first, AI-powered personal finance workspace that runs on the Mac. It connects every bank, credit card, and investment account, automatically categorizes every transaction, and lets people ask plain-language questions about their money while keeping the data on their own device for privacy. Gravy focuses on optimizing spending, surfacing savings, tracking investments and recurring subscriptions, and automating tedious money tasks for both individuals and small businesses. It is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company. Gravy is a consumer application and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Green Eye Technology
providers.description: Greeneye Technology is an agricultural technology company that builds AI-powered precision spraying systems for weed management. Its retrofit hardware and computer-vision software integrate into existing farm sprayers to identify weeds in real time and apply herbicide only where it is needed, enabling Green-on-Green (weed-versus-crop) and Green-on-Brown (bare-soil) selective application that can reduce herbicide use by up to 90 percent while performing species-level analysis to help combat herbicide resistance. The company positions its dual-line system as a way for growers to cut chemical costs, reduce soil contamination, and address the roughly $100 billion in annual crop losses attributed to weeds. Greeneye is a Techstars-backed company and was added to the API Evangelist network from that portfolio; it currently publishes a marketing and product site but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: houmo
providers.description: HOUMO.AI (后摩智能) is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company founded in 2020 that develops compute-in-memory (CIM / storage-and-computation integrated) edge AI chips for running large language models and other AI workloads on endpoint devices. Its products include the MOMAGIC (H30) series processors, LIQING M.2 modules, and Limou (LM 5050 / LM 5070 / LM 30) AI acceleration cards, paired with the Houmo Avenue software toolchain (PyTorch / TensorFlow / ONNX, CUDA-style front end) for model quantization, compilation, and deployment. The company targets edge inference, autonomous driving, embodied robotics, and intelligent mobile devices, and runs a developer community with documentation and downloads. This profile is a hardware / AI-chip vendor with a developer toolchain rather than a public web API provider; no REST/OpenAPI, OAuth, or hosted API surface was found.

providers.name: Humeo, INC.
providers.description: Humeo, INC. is a San Francisco-based applied AI research lab focused on creative intelligence, blending design, social science, and frontier AI research. Its products include VideoClaw, a desktop creative production agent that transforms existing media and automates media creation, and Studio, a web application for producing high-impact short-form video content. Humeo's research spans creative attunement, taste modeling, universal media transformation, world models of attention, and creative efficiency. The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this profile Humeo publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation; VideoClaw is in private alpha with access granted by request.

providers.name: IAD
providers.description: IAD Group (I@D International) is a European real-estate network company that combines real estate, digital tools, and network marketing to digitalize the traditional agency model through a network of independent agents rather than brick-and-mortar offices. Founded in France, IAD operates across France, Portugal, Spain, Italy, Germany, Mexico, the United Kingdom, and the United States (Florida), with roughly 20,000 independent agents, around 500 employees, more than 96,000 online property listings, and 521 million euros in 2025 turnover. It is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. IAD publishes a consumer/agent web presence but no public developer platform or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Iambic Therapeutics
providers.description: Iambic Therapeutics is a clinical-stage AI drug discovery company headquartered in San Diego. Its proprietary AI platform pairs the NeuralPLexer 3D generative model for protein-ligand structure prediction with the Enchant multimodal transformer for clinical and preclinical endpoint prediction, integrated with automated wet-lab capabilities. Iambic's clinical pipeline includes IAM1363 (HER2), IAM-K1 (KIF18A), and IAM-C1 (CDK2/4) in oncology. Iambic is a therapeutics developer rather than an API provider and does not publish a public developer API or open-source platform.

providers.name: IKANO Communications
providers.description: IKANO Communications, Inc. is a diversified consumer and business Internet company founded in 1999 and headquartered in metropolitan Los Angeles, with additional offices in Salt Lake City and Toronto, Canada. IKANO provides hosted voice services and broadband Internet access through direct and wholesale/private-label channels. Its primary brands include Broadvoice, a provider of feature-rich broadband phone (VoIP) service to consumers and businesses across the continental US and Canada, and DSL Extreme, a provider of high-speed and traditional Internet access. IKANO is a wholly owned subsidiary of Teutonic Holdings, LLC. The company publishes a marketing and corporate site only; it exposes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface at this time.

providers.name: Ineffable Intelligence
providers.description: Ineffable Intelligence is a frontier artificial intelligence research lab working toward superintelligence. The company is building a "superlearner" - a system designed to discover all knowledge from its own experience, from elementary motor skills through to profound intellectual breakthroughs - driven by reinforcement learning algorithms rather than learning from human data. Its stated mission is "making first contact with superintelligence," which it believes can be built within years and must be built in a way that is beneficial to humanity. Ineffable Intelligence is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and was surfaced through that portfolio into the API Evangelist network. As a research lab it currently publishes a mission-and-beliefs website and a careers board, and does not expose a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or product APIs at this time.

providers.name: Inertia
providers.description: Inertia is a commercial fusion energy company pursuing laser-driven inertial confinement fusion to deliver safe, affordable, grid-scale clean power. Building on the December 2022 ignition milestone at the National Ignition Facility (NIF) in Livermore, Inertia is developing a modular laser system composed of roughly a thousand smaller, more efficient lasers, mass-manufacturing 4.5mm fusion fuel targets for under a dollar each, and firing them ten times per second to power a 1.5 gigawatt baseload, dispatchable power plant. The company is a deep-tech venture tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; it operates a corporate/marketing web presence and publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Inmarsat
providers.description: Inmarsat is a British satellite communications operator founded in 1979, originally as the International Maritime Satellite Organization, providing voice, data, broadband, and IoT services over a global L-band, Ka-band, and multi-band fleet of geostationary satellites. In May 2023 Viasat completed its acquisition of Inmarsat, and the combined company now operates Inmarsat's GX (Global Xpress), BGAN, IsatData Pro (IDP), and Fleet Xpress services alongside Viasat's ViaSat-3 constellation as a unified multi-orbit network. Inmarsat serves four core markets — Maritime (NexusWave, Fleet Xpress, Fleet One, FleetBroadband, Inmarsat C/GMDSS), Aviation (SwiftBroadband, GX Aviation, Jet ConneX, SB-S safety services), Government (L-TAC, GX, BGAN M2M), and Enterprise/IoT (BGAN M2M, IsatData Pro, IsatM2M, NB-NTN). Inmarsat operates a developer program at developer.inmarsat.com with documented APIs for BGAN network management, GSPS voice, Global Xpress, IsatData Pro messaging, Fleet Edge assurance, and Fleet Edge hardware replacement; access to interactive Swagger documentation is gated behind developer registration and approval, though the IsatData Pro Messaging API has an open-source Apache-2.0 Node.js client published on GitHub. Inmarsat is also one of the participating operators in the GSMA NB-NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) standards work for satellite-extended cellular IoT, with Viasat-led proof-of-concept code for NIDD (Non-IP Data Delivery) published under the inmarsat-enterprise GitHub organization.

providers.name: Instacoach
providers.description: Instacoach is an AI-powered baseball training app that generates personalized, on-demand workout programs for athletes across hitting, pitching, arm care, fielding, catching, lifting, and mental performance. Programs are built by college and pro athletes and adapt to the user's equipment and goals, with short guided drills, progress tracking, and stat logging. It is delivered as consumer iOS and Android apps plus a web experience, and also offers team training programs for coaches. Sector: consumer sports/fitness technology. Backed by GGV Capital. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment (no api./developer./docs. host, no /.well-known, llms.txt, or OpenAPI).

providers.name: jokr
providers.description: JOKR is an instant grocery and convenience delivery company headquartered in Luxembourg (JOKR S.a.r.L) that operates an online supermarket delivering fresh products and local brands to consumers within minutes or on a scheduled window through its mobile app. The service offers more than 10,000 products with AI-powered personalized recommendations and competitive supermarket pricing, and reports roughly 3 million app downloads and 5 million users. In Brazil it operates under the DAKI brand (soudaki.com), the leading online supermarket in cities including Sao Paulo and Belo Horizonte. JOKR is a consumer-facing quick-commerce business with no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain posture in the API Evangelist network. Backed by Balderton Capital, GGV Capital, and HV Capital.

providers.name: Jump
providers.description: Jump is a unified fan experience and ticketing platform built exclusively for professional sports teams. It combines primary and resale ticketing, team-branded mobile apps and websites, marketing and messaging, loyalty, fan identity and wallet, point-of-sale and scanning, dynamic pricing, and a unified fan-data foundation into a single system that teams own and control. Jump also embeds agentic AI agents to automate pricing, inventory, and revenue operations. It serves teams across the NBA, MLB, WNBA, NWSL, USL, and NCAA and is backed by Battery Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, Index Ventures, and Menlo Ventures. Jump connects to the tools teams already use through integration APIs, but publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-serve API documentation.

providers.name: Las Vegas Sands
providers.description: Las Vegas Sands Corp. is the world's leading developer and operator of integrated resorts, including The Venetian Resort in Las Vegas (divested in 2022) and Marina Bay Sands in Singapore. The company operates in the casino, hospitality, convention, and entertainment industries.

providers.name: Lattice Health
providers.description: Lattice Health is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) healthcare company building AI governance as a managed service for hospitals. The platform sits beside an existing clinical stack and taps the HL7 and DICOM signals that deployed imaging and clinical AI models already emit, with no rip-and-replace integration, then continuously measures population drift (PSI), subgroup fairness disparity under HHS Section 1557, latency against target, and silent vendor model-update detection across every vendor model running in production. Rather than another dashboard, Lattice delivers a per-role signed PDF report each morning to IT directors, CMIO/CIO, and compliance officers, cryptographically signed with the institution's own signing key so any recipient, including outside counsel or a regulator, can verify the artifact offline with standard open-source tooling and no Lattice account or infrastructure. Radiologist thumbs-up/thumbs-down feedback on AI results is aggregated at model level and folded into the next morning's findings. The company positions itself around standards alignment (IHE UPS-RS work-list status, AI-Results and ERA classification, ONC HTI-1, FDA Predetermined Change Control Plan envelopes with automatic breach detection) and HIPAA-safe egress with a strict-mode PHI redactor, deployed on-premise or in the customer's private cloud so PHI stays behind the hospital firewall. As of this profile Lattice Health publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API specification, SDKs, or pricing; it is a pre-public-API company tracked here as an AI governance and clinical AI oversight lead.

providers.name: Mad Realities
providers.description: Mad Realities is a creator-powered entertainment network that produces original episodic shows for internet-native audiences, bridging the gap between culture born online and television-level production by partnering with creators. Its Mad Labs arm is an R&D effort leveraging AI and technology to superpower creatives. Backed by Paradigm, the company operates as a consumer media brand and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Manicule
providers.description: Manicule is an AI-native technical documentation studio, backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026), that specializes in developer relations and technical content for developer-tool and AI-native companies. It builds documentation from scratch, revamps existing docs, and provides ongoing maintenance as products evolve, pairing AI agents for auditing, code verification, and scaling with human expertise in information architecture, writing, and creative direction. Its work spans documentation, blogs, cookbooks, videos, and SEO, optimized for discovery by both AI agents and human developers. Clients include Supermemory, Greptile, Reducto, Rootly, Promptlayer, and Skyvern. Manicule is a professional-services company, not an API provider — it publishes no public API, SDK, or MCP surface.

providers.name: Mindgard
providers.description: Mindgard is a UK-based offensive AI security company (London/Lancaster, spun out of Lancaster University) that provides an automated AI red-teaming and security testing platform for large language models, AI agents, and generative AI systems. Mindgard's platform combines AI Discovery and Recon (mapping the AI attack surface and shadow AI usage), continuous AI Red Teaming against evolving attacker techniques, AI Assessment, AI Runtime Protection, and Model Scanning, backed by a research-led attack library covering jailbreaks (ActorAttack, Crescendo, EvilConfidant, PersonGPT, DevModeV2, AsciiArtAttack, AntiGPT), prompt-injection techniques (Ascii85, AnsiEscaped, AnsiRaw and others), and policy/violation testing (MaliciousGeneration, PromptAlignment). Developers and security teams integrate Mindgard via a public REST API (projects, tests, multi-turn tests, datasets, findings, reconnaissance), a Python CLI (`pip install mindgard`), a Python SDK, a Burp Suite extension, and a GitHub Action for adding red-team checks to MLOps pipelines. The company also maintains and contributes to open-source security tooling including PyRIT integrations, an OpenAI-compatible LLM-Guard proxy, a chatbot API wrapper for testing web chatbots, and proof-of-concept vulnerability demonstrations (document RCE in LangChain agents, hidden audio jailbreaks, prompt-jailbreak demos). Mindgard's commercial model is enterprise SaaS with platform and services tiers; pricing is gated behind a sales conversation, and the platform is positioned for security, AppSec, and AI governance teams testing customer-facing or internally deployed AI systems.

providers.name: MindRhythm
providers.description: MindRhythm is a medical technology company focused on improving outcomes caused by neurological injury. Founded by scientific experts with prior commercialization success, the company builds a detection and monitoring platform — anchored by its Headpulse technology — that provides real-time visibility into life-threatening neurological events such as large-vessel-occlusion stroke and concussion, across the home, EMS, battlefield, and clinical settings. MindRhythm publishes clinical studies, news, and company/leadership information on its site; it does not expose a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: MindSumo
providers.description: MindSumo was a crowdsourcing and open-innovation platform that connected companies with a community of students and young professionals to solve time-boxed business challenges for monetary prizes, generating ideas, market insight, and hiring leads. A GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company later acquired by MBO Partners, the platform distributed over $1.3M in rewards across 1,300+ challenges in 200+ countries before being permanently shut down after 13 years of operation. MindSumo never published a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile records its identity and the residual public web properties (terms, privacy) that remain live.

providers.name: Mission Control Games
providers.description: Mission Control Games is a mobile game studio building casual puzzle games, co-founded by Kivanc Okutur (CEO) and Murat Gurel (CTO), veterans of the team behind Merge Dragons. Headquartered across London and Istanbul (legal entity Mission Control Games Yazilim Anonim Sirketi), the studio works in small teams to create new casual puzzle sub-genres through rapid iteration and AI-assisted development. It launched publicly in April 2026 alongside a $4M pre-seed round led by General Catalyst, with participation from Arcadia Gaming Partners and e2vc. The company operates a marketing website only and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable developer surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Mother Games
providers.description: Mother Games is a Brooklyn, New York consumer gaming studio backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of mid-2026 the company is pre-launch: it operates a public waitlist for its debut social title "Le Zoo" and runs a campus ambassador program from its Williamsburg mailbox address (223 Bedford Ave #200, Brooklyn, NY 11211). Mother Games does not currently expose any public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer platform surface — probes of the domain returned 404 for every /.well-known/, /llms.txt, /openapi.json, /api, /docs, and /developers path. This profile tracks the company identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead pending any future developer platform.

providers.name: Nature's Fynd
providers.description: Nature's Fynd is the consumer food brand of The Fynder Group, a fermentation biotechnology company that grows a complete protein (Fy Protein) from an extremophile fungus originally discovered in the geothermal springs of Yellowstone National Park. The Fynder Group operates as the central R&D, fermentation, and scaled-manufacturing hub behind Fynder Ingredients (specialty food and beverage ingredients), FynderBio (oral biopharmaceuticals), and Hydefy (bio-based performance materials). Nature's Fynd sells meat- and dairy-alternative consumer foods made from Fy Protein. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Newme
providers.description: Newme (newme.asia) is an Accel-backed fast-fashion women's apparel and accessories e-commerce brand operating under the tagline "Freshest Fashion Fastest." It sells trend-driven contemporary womenswear — denim, bottoms, tops, t-shirts, dresses, co-ords, jumpsuits, bodysuits and winterwear — through its website and iOS/Android shopping apps, backed by a growing footprint of physical retail stores across India and Asia. Newme is a consumer direct-to-consumer retailer and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Opalcamera
providers.description: Opal Electronics is an original hardware company based in California specializing in the design and engineering of premium webcams and creator-focused camera devices. Its products include the Opal C1, a professional-grade webcam built around a large image sensor and DSLR-style optics, and the Opal Tadpole, an ultra-compact clip-on webcam for laptops, paired with the Opal Composer desktop software that adds virtual-camera, scene, and streaming controls. The company is backed by Kindred Ventures. Opal runs a consumer hardware business and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner platform; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ordermark
providers.description: Ordermark is a restaurant technology company that consolidates online food delivery and takeout orders from third-party channels such as DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, and Postmates into a single dashboard and printer, with menu synchronization, order management, and analytics across delivery partners and 250+ POS systems. Ordermark was acquired by and now operates under UrbanPiper; the ordermark.com property is maintained by UrbanPiper. As of this enrichment pass Ordermark publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs on its own surface. It was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company lead.

providers.name: Oto Capital
providers.description: OTO (Oto Capital) is India's leading platform to discover, research, and buy two-wheelers online with embedded financing. It offers digital bike loans with eligibility checks in five minutes and loan approvals within thirty minutes, an EMI calculator, home delivery, and test rides across 22+ Indian cities, working with 10+ lending partners including Northern Arc, Western Capital, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, and Suryoday Small Finance Bank. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, portal, or documentation surface is currently published by the company.

providers.name: Outsmart College
providers.description: Outsmart (Outsmart Education, Inc.) is an education-technology company rebuilding higher education for the AI era, aiming to make learning smarter, faster, and more engaging than traditional lectures and student debt. The company is currently pre-launch, operating a public waitlist at joinoutsmart.com, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of this profile the company publishes only a marketing site with a legal Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions and does not expose a public developer or API surface. This record was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for ongoing enrichment as any API surface appears.

providers.name: Pano
providers.description: Pano AI provides enterprise-grade, AI-powered wildfire and bushfire detection. The platform combines ultra-high-definition 360-degree mountaintop cameras, satellite feeds, field sensor data, and machine learning to detect ignitions early, confirm and triangulate their location, and deliver real-time visual situational intelligence to utilities, fire agencies, first responders, and landowners. Operators access the Pano 360 platform at 360.pano.ai to monitor camera networks, review AI detections, and coordinate incident response. Backed by DCVC and Initialized Capital, Pano was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Pariti
providers.description: Pariti is an AI-powered talent acquisition platform that helps companies source, vet, and hire candidates through a community-driven referral network of thousands of leaders, technologists, and recruiters. It pairs recruiter-trained AI/ML candidate screening with salary benchmarking (Salary Insights) and a Talent Engine that aims to move roles from open to offer in about four weeks. Pariti is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, MCP server, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web presence and security posture as a lead awaiting a real API surface.

providers.name: Pashouses
providers.description: Pashouses (PT Pionir Alfa Sejahtera) is an Indonesian proptech company operating an end-to-end transactional marketplace for buying and selling ready-to-occupy residential homes across the Greater Jakarta (Jabodetabek) region — Jakarta, Tangerang, Tangerang Selatan, Bekasi, Bogor, and Depok. Founded in 2020 by Junghans Tasani and Bin Anindita, the platform combines an iBuyer model, brokerage, staging, and renovation with mortgage (KPR) origination through partnerships with major Indonesian banks (BCA, Mandiri, BSI, BRI). It offers consumer tools including a Smart Agent property assistant, a KPR mortgage calculator, and an affordability calculator. QED Investors led a $5M pre-Series B in November 2022 (its first Indonesian / Southeast Asian investment). The company exposes a consumer web marketplace only; no public developer, API, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Personify
providers.description: Personify (Personify Inc., part of Momentive Software as of January 2026) is a constituent and association management software provider for associations, nonprofits, and member-based organizations. Founded in 1996 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, Personify offers a family of products - the enterprise Personify360 / ThreeSixty AMS, MemberClicks (MC Professional) for mid-sized professional and trade associations, Wild Apricot for small associations and clubs, and A2Z Events for event management. Several products expose documented REST APIs secured with OAuth 2.0. Wild Apricot and MemberClicks publish public developer documentation, while Personify360's Novus APIs (Swagger-documented) are provisioned through a customer's account manager. API access generally requires being a paying customer of the respective product.

providers.name: Pivotal Commware
providers.description: Pivotal Commware develops millimeter wave (mmWave) infrastructure for 5G networks, built around its Holographic Beam Forming technology and what it calls the world's first smart repeater ecosystem. Its product line includes WaveScape network-planning software, the Pivot 5G outdoor network repeater, the Echo 5G subscriber repeater for indoor mmWave coverage, and IBMS, an Intelligent Beam Management System that pairs machine learning with smart repeaters for real-time network optimization. The company is venture-backed by Lux Capital. As of this enrichment pass Pivotal Commware publishes a corporate and marketing site (datasheets, white papers, videos, and a blog) but no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface was found.

providers.name: Plan0 Ai
providers.description: Plan0 AI is a real estate construction technology company that applies AI to preconstruction cost estimation and design analysis. Its platform turns architectural drawings into detailed cost estimates and 3D models in roughly 30 minutes rather than the traditional two-week cycle, and adds automated takeoff and pricing, value-engineering scenario simulation, and predictive analytics. Plan0 AI serves real estate developers underwriting and making preconstruction design decisions, general contractors producing business- development estimates and cost forecasts, and investors validating pro-formas and benchmarking. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and demo-booking website only, with no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: playhouse
providers.description: Playhouse is a consumer real estate application that combines homes-for-sale listings with community polls and reactions. Home searchers, neighbors, homebuyers, investors, and real estate professionals browse luxury and residential listings and react to them, turning property discovery into a social, opinion-driven experience. The product ships as native iOS and Android apps backed by a private api.playhouse.so service; there is no publicly documented developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or API reference surface. Playhouse is a 500 Global portfolio company. This profile was enriched from live probes of its Webflow marketing site, app-store listings, and DNS/TLS records.

providers.name: PLAYSTUDIOS
providers.description: PLAYSTUDIOS, Inc. (Nasdaq: MYPS) is a developer and publisher of free-to-play casual and casino-style mobile and social games, including myVEGAS Slots, POP! Slots, MGM Slots Live, myKONAMI, Tetris Block Puzzle, Solitaire, Bingo, and Mahjong titles. Its differentiating platform, playAWARDS, is a loyalty rewards engine that lets players earn real-world rewards from brand partners across gaming, hospitality, dining, and entertainment. The company is headquartered in Las Vegas and went public in 2021 via a business combination with Acies Acquisition Corp. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a dcm-ventures portfolio company; PLAYSTUDIOS publishes consumer-facing games and corporate/investor properties but no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Plus
providers.description: Plus (PlusAI) develops AI-based autonomous driving technology for commercial trucks. Its flagship SuperDrive is an AI-powered Level 4 autonomous driving system, and HyperFoundry is an integrated development platform for Physical AI. Plus works through partnerships with truck OEMs including TRATON GROUP, Hyundai, and IVECO rather than shipping a public developer API. Backed by GGV Capital, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; this enrichment pass confirmed it exposes no public API, SDK, or developer portal surface, and captured its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Poetic
providers.description: Poetic is an enterprise AI automation company whose platform learns an organization's rules and procedures and then executes end-to-end business processes with high precision and compliance. Marketed as "turn your business into software," Poetic ingests procedures, training materials, and expert feedback to build self-healing automations that adapt when underlying systems change, targeting long, multi-step workflows such as fraud detection, KYC, and dispute resolution. The company emphasizes enterprise-grade security with zero data retention (processing data in-transit only) and states SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance, and cites customers including AIG, SoFi, and Chime. Poetic is an early-stage, Kleiner Perkins-backed AI company; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Porotech
providers.description: Porotech (Poro Technologies Ltd) is a Cambridge University deep-tech spinout, founded in 2018 by Dr. Tongtong Zhu, Dr. Yingjun Liu, and Professor Rachel Oliver, that develops gallium nitride (GaN) semiconductor materials and MicroLED display technology. Its proprietary PoroGaN porous-InGaN epitaxy enables full-color MicroLED production on 4-to-12-inch wafers using a single material system, and its Dynamic Pixel Tuning (DPT) technology generates any visible color from a single LED chip. Porotech supplies epitaxy, micro displays, and light-engine products for AR/VR/MR applications, and has established mass-production partnerships with Foxconn, PSMC (Powerchip), and GIS. The company is backed by Speedinvest. Porotech is a hardware and semiconductor manufacturer and publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or event/streaming surface; this record is maintained for company-level discovery within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Porte Tech Ltd.
providers.description: Porte Tech Ltd. is a hotel technology company based in Astana, Kazakhstan that offers a digital concierge platform to streamline guest experiences and reduce front-desk workload for hotels. Its product covers digital check-in and check-out, mobile room keys delivered via app, access codes or QR codes, Bluetooth lock upgrades that reuse existing hardware, an in-app guest experience for bookings and amenity ordering, integrations with spa, restaurant and laundry services, and a centralized management dashboard for property staff. Porte is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public API, SDK, or developer surface is currently published.

providers.name: Post-Quantum
providers.description: Post-Quantum is a quantum-safe cybersecurity company founded in 2009 that protects critical infrastructure against both present-day threats and future quantum-computing attacks. Its platform spans Identity Protection, a hybrid post-quantum VPN standardized by the IETF as RFC 9370, and quantum-safe messaging, built on a crypto-agile modular architecture and NIST-round cryptography such as Classic McEliece. The company authored RFC 9370, delivered first-in-world quantum-safe drone communications, and its technology is deployed in NATO and active defense environments. The public web presence is a marketing and platform-overview site; no public developer API, SDK, documentation portal, or sign-up surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Proteinea
providers.description: Proteinea is an AI-driven biotechnology company engineering next-generation therapeutic antibodies. It integrates protein language models, computational biology and biological automation to design, optimize and validate biologics faster and more safely. Proteinea is the creator of Ankh, an optimized general-purpose protein language model, and operates a Protein Engineering Platform (PEP) for multi-parameter optimization and RaGene for AI-driven codon/gene optimization, with a focus on rational Fc-domain engineering for context-specific immune tuning, enhanced half-life and targeted biodistribution. Headquartered in Cairo, Egypt with offices in Cambridge/ Boston, MA and a presence at KAUST, Saudi Arabia. Backed by 500 Global, IndieBio/SOSV, Shorooq Partners, Sawari Ventures and others. The company exposes research software (open-source models and benchmarks) rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Prototyping.io
providers.description: Prototyping.io is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building AI-driven autonomous manufacturing for mechanical parts. The platform converts CAD designs into finished physical parts by automating design-for-manufacturability analysis, manufacturability evaluation, production planning, machine execution, and quality control across CNC machining, sheet metal, 3D printing, injection molding, extrusion, and die casting. Founded by Revanth Bodepudi (CEO) and Prerit Oberai (CTO) in the San Francisco Bay Area, it targets hardware teams in robotics, AI infrastructure, energy, automotive, and defense, aiming to cut hardware iteration cycles from weeks to days with no minimum order quantities and tight tolerances. The company is in early-access/waitlist stage and does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Rainmarket
providers.description: Rainmarket is the flagship intelligence platform of Digital Media Nusantara (DMN), built to map and illuminate cross-border trade flows between ASEAN and Hong Kong's Greater Bay Area. It combines three integrated engines — Supply Chain Intelligence, a Tariff Tracker, and a Trade Flows Mapping engine — to turn roughly USD100 billion in previously unmapped or mispriced regional trade activity into investible, financeable, and transparently governed flows. The platform is architected for sovereign-grade deployment, targeting the security, compliance, and resiliency thresholds required by central banks, financial regulators, and national-level intelligence environments, and serves institutional investors, financial institutions, market regulators, and enterprise treasury and supply-chain teams. Rainmarket was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As of this pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable service surface.

providers.name: Ray Therapeutics
providers.description: Ray Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing optogenetic, gene-based medicines to restore vision in people with blinding degenerative retinal diseases. Its approach reprograms surviving retinal neurons to detect light and transmit visual signals to the brain, independent of the underlying gene mutation. Lead programs include RTX-015 (retinitis pigmentosa and other inherited retinal diseases, Phase 1/2) and RTX-021 (Stargardt disease and geographic atrophy, IND-enabling). The company is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. Ray Therapeutics operates as a therapeutics developer and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Recursive Superintelligence
providers.description: Recursive (Recursive Superintelligence) is an AI research company based in San Francisco and London building recursive self-improving superintelligence to automate knowledge discovery. Its team of 25+ former OpenAI, DeepMind, Google Brain, and Meta researchers works on open-ended algorithms, quality-diversity methods, self-improving coding agents, automated red teaming, AI-generating algorithms, world models, vision transformers, and RAG systems, initially targeting the automation of AI research before expanding to other scientific disciplines. As of this pass Recursive publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile tracks the company's identity and web presence in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Reface
providers.description: Reface (NeoCortext, Inc.) is an AI-native consumer app studio best known for its flagship Reface face-swap and AI-avatar application, alongside a portfolio of generative media apps including Revive (photo animation), Restyle (AI photo and video filters), Ink AI (virtual tattoo try-on), BitePal (AI calorie tracking), Lightly (AI journaling), Letsy (virtual clothing try-on), and Memomet. Backed by a16z, Reface builds and distributes mobile-first generative AI experiences directly to consumers via the App Store and Google Play. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its surface is consumer applications rather than a programmable platform. This APIs.json profile is a company lead in the API Evangelist network awaiting any future developer surface.

providers.name: Remix 3
providers.description: Remix (YC W26, "remix-3" in the Y Combinator directory) is a San Francisco AI startup building a consumer social-media content platform under the tagline "Trends, remixed by you." Users connect their accounts and drop in photos, voice notes, or messages, and Remix uses hundreds of parallel AI agents to auto-generate posts in their style — articles, tweets, carousels, and short-form videos, including riffs on trending formats — without manual prompting. The company was founded in 2025 by Sam Kaplan (Harvard CS; early Brex employee). As of this enrichment pass Remix ships a consumer web/mobile product only and publishes no public developer API, SDK, docs, or webhook surface, so this remains an identity-only profile in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rexby
providers.description: Rexby is a consumer travel discovery and trip-planning platform where local creators publish interactive travel guides and maps of curated "spots," and travelers browse those guides, build personal itineraries, and follow creator recommendations. The product is delivered as iOS and Android mobile apps plus the rexby.com web experience, with a creator program that lets travel enthusiasts monetize their guides. Backed by Techstars. As of this profile Rexby publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this apis.yml captures its identity and a domain-security probe for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rigi
providers.description: Rigi (Rigi TV) is an instant-entertainment mobile app that streams quick, captivating, and scroll-worthy short-form video and micro-drama series across genres such as romance, drama, thriller, and suspense. Operated out of HSR Layout in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India and backed by Accel, it delivers on-demand vertical entertainment through its Android app. It is a consumer-facing streaming product; no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal surface is currently published.

providers.name: Rondo Therapeutics
providers.description: Rondo Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Hayward, California, developing immune-cell engaging bispecific antibodies designed to treat solid tumors by unleashing the immune system while maximizing efficacy and minimizing side effects. Founded in 2019 by Shelley Force Aldred and Nathan Trinklein, its pipeline includes RNDO-564 (Phase 1 for bladder cancer) plus programs targeting ovarian, endometrial, and renal cancers, backed by a Series A led by Canaan and Red Tree Venture Capital and a collaboration with Eli Lilly. Rondo publishes a corporate and pipeline website but exposes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API surface; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Santa Ana Bio
providers.description: Santa Ana Bio is a precision immunology company developing targeted therapies to stop autoimmune and inflammatory disease at the source. The company pairs a multi-omics discovery platform (integrating genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data) with a pipeline of bispecific and multi-specific antibody and antibody-drug-conjugate programs (SAB01, SAB05, SAB06) advancing toward IND submissions across 2026-2027. Backed by a16z and GV, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. It publishes a corporate and careers website but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Scout
providers.description: Scout (Scout Space) is a Techstars- and venture-backed space technology company founded in 2019 that builds next-generation orbital sensing and autonomy for Space Domain Awareness (SDA). Its in-space products, first launched in 2021, let spacecraft see and understand objects around them through electro-optical and infrared sensors (the Owl long-range SDA sensor line), edge processing hardware, mission autonomy software developed with the U.S. Space Force, and mission-design analysis. Scout supplies cross-orbit intelligence and dynamic space operations to government and commercial operators and has been awarded multiple AFWERX SBIR and USSF TACFI contracts. Scout does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Season Share
providers.description: Season Share (SeasonShare) is a ticketing technology platform for sports and entertainment venues. Its subscription-pass, last-minute, student, and credit-based products — Pass, Flow, Flex, and LivePass — help teams and venues reach younger fans, capture first-party data, and build recurring ticket revenue. It reports $100M+ in ticket inventory delivered and 1.5M tickets purchased, and is used by 30+ franchises including the Sacramento Kings, New Jersey Devils, Arizona Diamondbacks, and Nashville Predators. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company; no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Sectra
providers.description: Sectra is a Swedish medical technology company providing an enterprise imaging platform (PACS/VNA) for radiology, pathology, cardiology, orthopaedics, and other -ologies. Integration is delivered through established healthcare interoperability standards rather than a single open developer API - DICOM and DICOMweb for imaging, HL7 for orders/results messaging, IHE XDS for cross-enterprise document sharing, FHIR/FHIRcast for clinical context synchronization, and a Web Content API for embedding third-party content and applications into the diagnostic viewer. AI and third-party applications integrate through the Sectra Amplifier Marketplace / Amplifier Services ecosystem. Sectra's API and integration surface is partner- and customer-gated (deployed per-site, no public self-service developer portal); the API entries below are honestly modeled from Sectra's documented standards and interfaces, not scraped from an open OpenAPI catalog. Sectra also authored the first open-source FHIRcast sandbox and reference implementation.

providers.name: Seeqc
providers.description: Seeqc is developing the first digital quantum computing platform for businesses, integrating all core functions of a quantum computer - qubits together with classical control logic - onto a single superconducting chip operating at millikelvin temperatures. Founded in 2019 and holding over 115 patents, the company combines classical and quantum technologies to address the efficiency, stability, and cost challenges endemic to scalable quantum computing, and also offers superconducting chip foundry services. As a quantum-hardware and foundry company, Seeqc currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Sensemesh
providers.description: Sensemesh builds an AI-powered operating system that unifies cameras, sensors, and drones into a single intelligent network for real-time perception and autonomous response. The platform fuses visual, thermal, audio, and pressure sensor data so organizations can detect threats, investigate incidents, dispatch drones autonomously, and query sensor history in natural language across law enforcement, corrections and prisons, events and venues, homeowners associations, and schools and universities. Backed by DCVC, Sensemesh was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes a single marketing site (sensemesh.ai) with no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or well-known metadata.

providers.name: Showroomprive.com
providers.description: Showroomprive.com is a French online private-sales (flash-sales) e-commerce platform operated by Showroomprive.com SAS, a subsidiary of SRP Groupe SA, based in La Plaine Saint-Denis. It sells discounted apparel, beauty, home, sports, and travel products from major brands, and also runs a third-party seller marketplace. The company exposes a private marketplace / seller API reached through partner onboarding and surfaced by third-party integration platforms such as ChannelEngine and Commercium, but it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio lead.

providers.name: Solomon
providers.description: Solomon (Solomon AI, solomontax.ai) is an agentic AI platform for tax preparation aimed at accounting firms, automating the preparation of review-ready individual 1040 returns for high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients. The system interprets K-1/K-3 footnotes, applies multi-state SALT rules to K-1s, reconciles rental and real estate investments, analyzes brokerage statements for foreign income, and produces workpapers and audit trails, positioning itself to replace legacy tools such as SurePrep and K1x. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: Solu Therapeutics
providers.description: Solu Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, pioneering a novel class of antibody therapeutics that unlock cell-surface targets by combining small molecules with effector antibodies through proprietary linker technology. Its two platform technologies are CyTAC (Cytotoxicity Targeting Chimera), which links cell-surface targets to antibodies that kill pathogenic cells, and TicTAC (Therapeutic Index Control Targeting Chimera), which gives long-acting small-molecule agonists and antagonists antibody-like pharmacokinetics. Its lead program, STX-0712, is a CyTAC targeting the GPCR CCR2 in Phase 1 trials for chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, with additional oncology and immunology programs advancing. Solu is a portfolio company of the venture firm DCVC. The company operates as a drug-discovery and clinical-development organization and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Spotter
providers.description: Spotter is a creator-economy platform that invests in YouTube creators through capital, catalog licensing, and brand partnerships, and connects brands with top long-form YouTube creators for marketing and content opportunities. Its Spotter Studio product provides AI-assisted tooling that helps creators plan, ideate, and optimize their content and titles. The company reports more than $1 billion invested in creators and over 43 billion monthly views across a network that includes creators such as MrBeast, Critical Role, and Sam and Colby. Spotter is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. No public developer API surface has been found at this time.

providers.name: Subway
providers.description: One of the world's largest fast-food restaurant chains specializing in submarine sandwiches and salads. Operates over 36,000 locations in more than 100 countries through its franchise model. Subway has no public developer API or self-service developer portal; ordering, store locator, nutrition, and MyWay/MVP loyalty integrations are handled through internal systems and direct franchise/partner agreements.

providers.name: SunEdison
providers.description: SunEdison was a renewable energy company that developed, financed, installed, owned, and operated solar power plants and wind energy plants globally. Originally founded as MEMC Electronic Materials in 1959, SunEdison became the world's leading renewable energy developer before filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in April 2016 and emerging as a restructured private company in 2017. No public developer API was documented.

providers.name: SuperGaming
providers.description: SuperGaming is a Series B-funded game development studio building multiplayer games "for the next billion players" in emerging markets. Headquartered in Singapore with a studio in Pune, India, the company develops and operates titles including Indus (battle royale), Prime Rush, Prime Rush MENA, SHOWDOWN, MaskGun (110M+ installs), Tower Conquest, and Silly Royale. SuperGaming also runs SuperPlatform, a proprietary real-time multiplayer and live-ops engine that powers its own games and 15+ other titles, and offers publisher services such as co-development, LiveOps-as-a-service, localization, and user acquisition. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal for external developers; SuperPlatform is an internal engine offered through partnerships rather than a self-serve API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z.

providers.name: SuperQuickQuestion
providers.description: SuperQuickQuestion (SQQ) is a fan-engagement platform that hosts brief, 60-second one-on-one live video interactions between fans and celebrities, athletes, and musicians. It is web-based with no app download required, uses industry-standard encryption, and removes traditional event logistics (travel, hotels, agent back-and-forth) so talent only needs WiFi and a camera device while fans receive brand- or team-sponsored free access. Early clients include professional sports organizations such as the Washington Wizards, Cleveland Browns, Washington Mystics, Wrexham AFC, and talent like Ric Flair. No public API, developer portal, or SDK surface is currently published; this remains a consumer product profile.

providers.name: Surgery Partners
providers.description: Surgery Partners is a leading operator of surgical facilities and ancillary services in the United States, including ambulatory surgery centers, surgical hospitals, multi-specialty physician practices, and anesthesia services. The company partners with physicians to deliver high-quality, cost-effective surgical care across short-stay surgical procedures. Surgery Partners does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: SweetLabs
providers.description: SweetLabs is a San Diego-based software company that builds consumer applications and app-distribution, discovery, and personalization software for device manufacturers (OEMs), helping them differentiate their PCs and devices through preloaded and recommended app experiences. The company is backed by Google Ventures (GV). It operates as a corporate and consumer-software business: its public web presence is a marketing and careers site, and as of this enrichment pass SweetLabs does not publish a public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal, so no API artifacts were harvested. This profile captures the identity and domain-security posture that could be verified from its public surface.

providers.name: Tantalus
providers.description: Tantalus Systems (TSX: GRID; OTCQX: TGMPF) is a technology company that has served public power utilities and electric cooperatives for over 35 years, modernizing electrical distribution grids through data-centric solutions. Its Tantalus Grid Modernization Platform (TGMP) unifies intelligence across the distribution grid, connecting metering, load and DER management, grid automation, and data management across both legacy and modern infrastructure. Product lines include TRUConnect advanced metering infrastructure (AMI), TRUFlex load and DER management, TRUGrid automation analytics, TRUSync grid data management, and the TRUSense behind-the-meter gateway. Tantalus does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; integration with back-end utility software is delivered through standard data formats and handled via its technical support and integration teams.

providers.name: Telgani
providers.description: Telgani is an app-based car rental aggregator founded in 2018 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Its consumer iOS and Android apps let users compare prices and book cars from more than 50 partner rental companies with over 500 branches across the Kingdom, offering doorstep delivery, airport pickup, and daily, monthly, or yearly rentals. Backed by 500 Global, Impact46, and Elm, Telgani has raised roughly $8.5M across a seed round, a 2021 pre-Series A, and a 2023 Series A. Telgani operates as a consumer mobile marketplace and does not publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its public web properties (homepage, privacy policy, terms of service) and its domain security posture.

providers.name: The Bot Company
providers.description: The Bot Company is a San Francisco robotics startup founded in 2024 by Kyle Vogt, the co-founder and former CEO of Cruise, building a helpful general-purpose robot for every home to automate everyday household chores. Its team draws from Tesla, Cruise, OpenAI, Google, and Pixar, and the company has raised roughly $301M (reportedly valued near $2B) from investors including Spark Capital and SV Angel. As of this profile the company operates a marketing and careers site only and publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Thirdwave
providers.description: Thirdwave (Third Wave Automation) builds autonomous material-handling systems for warehouses and distribution centers, led by its shared-autonomy forklift platform where one human operator can supervise a fleet of self-driving forklifts that operate independently and hand control back to a person when needed. Its ArmadaFMS (Armada Fleet Management System) software coordinates the robotic fleet across facilities. The company is a venture-backed logistics-robotics provider (backed by Homebrew and Norwest Venture Partners). As of this enrichment pass Third Wave publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: TigerEye
providers.description: TigerEye is an AI company for the construction industry, helping builders get answers faster and spend less time searching for information across construction, business intelligence, and home planning and delivery workflows. Founded as an Initialized Capital-backed startup and acquired by homebuilder Lennar to scale its capabilities nationally, TigerEye operates a public marketing site with an About page, Terms of Use, and Privacy Policy. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, documentation, or well-known discovery surface, and its former Secureframe-hosted trust center now redirects to a 404.

providers.name: TNL Mediagene
providers.description: TNL Mediagene is a next-generation digital and technology media group serving millennial and Gen Z audiences across Asia. Formed from the 2023 merger of Taiwan's The News Lens and Japan's Mediagene, the group operates more than twenty media brands spanning news, business, technology, lifestyle, and sports — including The News Lens, INSIDE, Cool3c, Gizmodo Japan, Business Insider Japan, Lifehacker Japan, Roomie, and licensed titles such as Digiday Japan and Glossy Japan. Beyond publishing, the company runs advertising and marketing technology (the Ad2iction DSP), an AI-driven customer data and audience analytics platform, e-commerce properties, and market-research services. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer or API surface is published at this time.

providers.name: TrustAI
providers.description: TrustAI (trytrust.ai) is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator Summer 2026 company founded in 2026 by Hannah Chung and Medha Venkatapathy that provides continuous compliance, governance, and risk assessment for AI agents operating on sensitive enterprise systems, with an initial focus on ERP agents such as SAP Joule. It maps what every agent can reach, then runs evaluations across six domains - data privacy, hallucinations and grounding, permission compliance, robustness at scale, accountability, and security - including adversarial pentests and prompt-injection red-teaming, and maps every risk to controls like SOX, ITGC, ISO 27001, GxP, and the EU AI Act for audit-ready reporting. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, docs, or SDKs. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub.

providers.name: Veluga
providers.description: Veluga (Veluga Brewery Inc.) is a South Korean B2B alcohol wholesale distribution platform that connects hospitality business owners with liquor suppliers.
