Operating from Mapo, Seoul, the company runs a wholesale marketplace offering real-time wholesale pricing quotes for spirits and craft beverages, product recommendations for business owners, wholesale order facilitation, and partnership programs for distributors and catering services. Veluga positions itself as a transaction and information intermediary rather than a direct seller. The company began as a craft-beer and snack subscription service and is backed by 500 Global, Kakao Ventures, SparkLabs, HL Holdings, and Sema Investment. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vercept
providers.description: Vercept is an AI startup building AI that works directly on your computer rather than in a distant cloud — software that understands your screen, workflows, and intent and can act on your behalf safely and transparently. Its product, Vy, is a personal computer AI assistant offered as a paid subscription. Vercept was founded by Kiana Ehsani, Luca Weihs, and Ross Girshick, backed by Point Nine, Fifty Years, AI2 Incubator, and Madrona, and was acquired by Anthropic in early 2026. Vercept does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Verse Enterprises
providers.description: Verse, Inc. is a San Francisco-based clean energy software company, founded in 2022 and backed by GV (Google Ventures), that helps organizations understand, plan, procure, and operate clean energy portfolios. Its AI-powered platform, Aria, is modular and app-based, turning complex energy, market, and financial data into finance-ready energy intelligence so enterprises can connect to the grid faster, contain electricity costs and risk, and control assets across every market and hour. Verse raised a $20.5M Series A led by GV, with participation from Coatue, CIV, and MCJ Collective, to help organizations reduce electricity costs and emissions.

providers.name: Vetted (FKA Lustre)
providers.description: Vetted (legally Parli, Inc.; formerly Lustre) is a San Francisco-based consumer AI shopping agent founded in 2019. It analyzes product reviews and expert content across the web and compares prices across retailers such as Amazon, Walmart, and Best Buy to help shoppers find high-quality products at the best price. Vetted ships as an iOS app, Android app, macOS app, and Chrome extension, and reports more than 370,000 shoppers. The company rebranded from Lustre to Vetted alongside a $14M Series A led by Insight Partners in August 2022. Vetted is a consumer product and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal; its api.vetted.ai backend is a private, auth-gated app service.

providers.name: Visibl Semiconductors
providers.description: Visibl Semiconductors builds an AI-enabled coordination layer for custom chip design teams, positioning itself as "the first coordination layer for chip design." Its platform continuously monitors specifications against implementation to detect drift early, investigates issues by assembling evidence bundles, and proposes fixes through AI agents that require human approval before any change is deployed. The company frames this as a faster path to custom silicon and is backed by Y Combinator. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing website only and exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Visolis
providers.description: Visolis is a biomanufacturing company that combines synthetic biology with chemical catalysis to convert plant biomass into MEV (mevalonic acid), a proprietary platform molecule used to make sustainable, bio-based alternatives to petroleum-derived chemicals and fuels. Its products include bio-isoprene for synthetic rubber (a partnership with Zeon), AroSAF 100% bio-based sustainable aviation fuel, and non-toxic bio-based industrial solvents (piloted with the U.S. Department of Defense). Headquartered in San Leandro, California and led by CEO Deepak Dugar, Visolis is a climate-tech company surfaced as a DCVC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Visolis publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: WeRide
providers.description: WeRide (NASDAQ: WRD) is an autonomous driving technology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Guangzhou, China. It develops Level 4 self-driving technology across a portfolio of five core products — Robotaxi, Robobus, Robovan, Robosweeper (autonomous sanitation) and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) — and operates its fleets in more than 40 cities across 12 countries. WeRide does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web presence and domain-security posture as surfaced by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Western Alliance Bancorp.
providers.description: Western Alliance Bancorporation is a bank holding company headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, that provides commercial banking, treasury management, and specialty lending services through Western Alliance Bank. The company serves business clients across multiple regional and national specialty segments. Western Alliance Bancorp does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Wheelocity
providers.description: Wheelocity (Wheelocity Fresh Private Limited) is a Bangalore, India based logistics and supply-chain company building daily fresh-produce and grocery delivery networks for underserved rural markets across India, which it frames as "the access rails for Bharat commerce." Its phygital (online plus offline) model combines location intelligence, IoT hardware, cold-chain and predictive demand forecasting with an electric-vehicle first-mile and last-mile fleet and a consumer app branded WoW. The company reports serving more than one million households, running over 100,000 km of EV movement daily and avoiding tens of thousands of kilograms of produce waste each day. Wheelocity is a venture-backed operating company (Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio) and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Whiting Petroleum
providers.description: Whiting Petroleum was an independent oil and gas company engaged in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids primarily in the Williston Basin (Bakken Shale) in North Dakota and Montana. In July 2022, Whiting Petroleum merged with Oasis Petroleum to form Chord Energy Corporation, which trades on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol CHRD.

providers.name: Xinhe Technology
providers.description: Xinhe Technology (Shanghai Xinhe Box Technology Co., Ltd. / 上海心盒科技有限公司) operates 心愿盒 Match Box, a consumer experience co-creation platform. Brands distribute product samples to precisely targeted consumer segments matched on age, gender, occupation, and consumption-preference tags, collect structured questionnaire feedback and reviews for agile marketing iteration, and convert triallists into private-domain traffic on WeChat official accounts and mini programs. A DCM Ventures portfolio company; it publishes no public developer portal or API surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Yuga Labs
providers.description: Yuga Labs is a Web3 company and the creator of the Bored Ape Yacht Club (BAYC), Mutant Ape Yacht Club (MAYC), and the Otherside metaverse, along with related NFT collections and intellectual property. Backed by a16z, Bond Capital, GV, Lightspeed Venture Partners and SV Angel, the company operates in the crypto / NFT sector on the Ethereum blockchain. It does not publish a formal, documented public developer API program; its on-chain assets are accessed via Ethereum smart contracts and third-party marketplaces (OpenSea, Blur), and Otherside exposes the forthcoming Otherside Development Kit (ODK) for building within the metaverse. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched with the available public identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Zemanta
providers.description: Zemanta was a native advertising and content-recommendation technology company founded in 2007 (Ljubljana, Slovenia and New York), best known for Zemanta One, a self-serve programmatic demand-side platform (DSP) for native advertising. Zemanta was acquired by Outbrain in 2017 and its DSP has since been folded into the Outbrain / Teads advertising platform. The standalone one.zemanta.com console now redirects to dsp.outbrain.com and the former developers.zemanta.com API documentation is no longer resolvable, so there is no live first-party Zemanta public API surface today. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead with domain-level metadata.

providers.name: Zhihu
providers.description: Zhihu (知乎) is a Chinese online question-and-answer and knowledge-sharing community, often described as China's answer to Quora, where users post questions and answers, follow topics and creators, and consume long-form content, columns, live sessions, e-books and short video. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Beijing, Zhihu operates one of China's largest online content communities and is dual-listed (NYSE: ZH; HKEX: 2390). It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass Zhihu publishes no public developer platform, open API, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts on its primary domain; this profile therefore captures company identity plus a probed domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Zipline
providers.description: Zipline is a South San Francisco–headquartered autonomous logistics company operating the world's largest commercial drone delivery network, with more than two million customer deliveries flown across the United States, Rwanda, Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, Côte d'Ivoire, and Japan. Zipline designs, builds, and operates two end-to-end aircraft platforms: Platform 1 (P1, "Sparrow"), a long-range fixed-wing aircraft that launches from a catapult, parachutes payloads from altitude, and is used primarily for national-scale healthcare logistics — delivering blood products, vaccines, medicines, and lab samples to hospitals and clinics — and Platform 2 (P2), a short-range hybrid VTOL aircraft with an autonomous tethered "droid" delivery vehicle that lowers packages from a hovering aircraft directly to a designated point on the ground, enabling precision quick-commerce delivery from restaurants, retailers, pharmacies, and hospitals. Zipline's customer roster includes Walmart, OhioHealth, Michigan Medicine, Cleveland Clinic, Mayo Clinic Florida, MultiCare, Sweetgreen, GNC, Jet's Pizza, the governments of Rwanda, Ghana, Nigeria, and Kenya, and Japan's Toyota Tsusho, with the P2 platform actively scaling across the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex, Pea Ridge (AR), and expanding into Houston and Phoenix in 2026. The company also operates one of the largest civil autonomous aviation stacks in the world — proprietary detect-and-avoid, route planning, weather, fleet operations, and flight-control software — and in 2025 received the first-ever FAA Part 135 BVLOS (beyond-visual-line-of-sight) operational approval permitting drone package delivery without visual observers. Zipline is a privately held company; its revenue model is drone-as-a-service contracts with healthcare systems, retailers, restaurant brands, and governments. There is no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, GitHub organization, status page, changelog, or self-service developer portal — integrations with customer systems (order management, EHR, WMS, dispatch) are delivered as managed enterprise integrations rather than as a public programmable API.

providers.name: AdColony
providers.description: AdColony was a mobile advertising and app-monetization company known for its high-definition video and interactive (Aurora HD) mobile ad SDKs and its Publisher and Advertiser reporting APIs. AdColony was acquired by Digital Turbine in 2021; adcolony.com and its developer support/docs hosts now 308-redirect to digitalturbine.com, so the historical reporting-API and helpdesk documentation is no longer served. The first-party AdColony mobile ads SDKs for iOS (CocoaPods) and Android (Maven Central) remain published, and the iOS SDK source remains archived on GitHub.

providers.name: Advantage Solutions
providers.description: Advantage Solutions is a leading provider of outsourced sales, marketing, merchandising, and business intelligence services to consumer goods manufacturers and retailers across North America. The company supports brand growth through retail execution, in-store demos, digital commerce enablement, and shopper insights. Advantage Solutions does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Alan
providers.description: Alan is a French digital health insurance and healthcare company that combines health insurance (mutuelle / complementary health), preventive care, and daily health support in a single app. It serves businesses of every size (from independent contractors and very small companies to large enterprises) and individuals such as the self-employed, retirees, and civil servants across France. Alan offers fast reimbursements (90% processed within 24 hours), a 24/7 chat clinic (Clinique Alan) staffed by healthcare professionals, mental health support, eyewear coverage, and an HR-facing platform for administering employee health plans. It reports over one million members and 41,000+ companies. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from the Index Ventures portfolio; Alan does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Alinia Ai
providers.description: Alinia is an AI compliance and control platform that helps enterprises deploy large language models and AI agents safely and in compliance with regulations, making AI systems "compliant by design" through regulation-informed control layers. The platform is built around three products: an Evaluation Engine that tests AI systems against company policies and regulatory standards (compliance red teaming), Guardrails that enforce compliance in real time — including a proprietary multilingual RAG Guard model that blocks hallucinations and irrelevance — and Monitoring that provides automated auditing, full traceability, and compliance reporting of AI activity. Alinia is model-agnostic and multilingual, targeting financial services, healthcare, and other heavily regulated industries, with named customers including Banco Santander and Origin Financial. The company was co-founded by Ariadna (CEO, previously Head of ML Platform at Twitter and Director of Development at IBM Watson) and Carlos (COO, previously AI Counsel at Hugging Face), operates offices in Barcelona, Valencia, New York, and Pittsburgh, and is backed by Speedinvest. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: ANSR
providers.description: ANSR Global is a workforce and operations company that helps enterprises build, manage, and scale Global Capability Centers (GCCs) — captive technology and shared-services hubs, most often in India and other emerging markets. Its end-to-end offering spans four areas: Talent Solutions (AI-driven recruiting, sourcing, onboarding, and talent management), Workspace (managed, customized office space and workplace strategy), Business Operations (payroll, HR, employer-of-record, compliance, legal, and finance/tax), and Research & Advisory (organizational design, capability planning, and market intelligence). ANSR engages clients through Global Capability Center subscriptions, Build-Operate-Transfer arrangements, and Managed Teams, and operates a proprietary workforce platform, 1Wrk. The company reports 20+ years of operations, 210+ global centers established, 225,000+ professionals hired, and 14M+ square feet of managed workspace. ANSR is a portfolio company of Accel. It is a business-services provider and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web surface and web-domain security posture.

providers.name: Aruna
providers.description: Aruna is Indonesia's largest integrated fisheries commerce platform, on a mission to make the sea a better livelihood for all by building a fair and sustainable fisheries ecosystem. Aruna connects more than 40,000 small-scale fishermen to domestic and global markets using technology, a network of processing partners, and 177+ distribution hubs (Aruna Hubs) across the Indonesian archipelago, trading 23+ seafood commodity types into 31+ countries. The company pairs commerce with sustainability work, including fisherman education, fish-population tracking, and coastal-community empowerment. Aruna is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Atomo Coffee
providers.description: Atomo Coffee is a Seattle-based food-tech company that makes beanless "molecular" coffee: it reverse-engineers the coffee bean and reconstructs the taste, aroma, and caffeine of coffee from upcycled, naturally derived plant ingredients, producing cold brew, ground, and canned products with a lower carbon and water footprint than conventional bean-grown coffee. Backed by bessemer-venture-partners and other investors, it sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at atomocoffee.com. Atomo is a consumer packaged-goods brand and publishes no first-party developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record. Sector: deep-tech / food-tech.

providers.name: Auradine (Velaura AI)
providers.description: Auradine, Inc. is a Silicon Valley semiconductor and infrastructure company founded in 2022, in 2026 rebranded as Velaura AI, Inc. The company designs ultra-low-power compute solutions for data center, edge, and physical AI applications, anchored by its Titan Core silicon design and IP platform that reduces the power required for AI compute while maintaining performance. Its Teraflux product line delivers high-efficiency Bitcoin mining hardware (3nm ASICs, air- and hydro-cooled miners, containers, and fleet management software) deployed by leading Bitcoin data center operators. Auradine raised over $300 million across its funding rounds, including a $153M Series C, and is backed by investors including DCVC. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Auradine/Velaura AI publishes no public developer API or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Babbel
providers.description: Babbel is a Berlin, Germany-based language learning company founded in 2007 by Thomas Holl, Markus Witte, Lorenz Heine, and Toine Diepstraten. It operates one of the world's first online language-learning platforms, offering structured, conversation-focused courses in 14 languages including Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Dutch, Turkish, Indonesian, and English. The Babbel product suite includes the core subscription Babbel App with interactive bite-sized lessons, speech recognition, and AI conversation partners; Babbel Live for online classes with certified teachers; Babbel for Business for enterprise language training; Babbel Podcasts and Babbel Magazine for supplemental content; and Babbel Videos on YouTube. The company has sold over 25 million subscriptions and reports that 92% of users improved their proficiency in two months, with effectiveness studies conducted by Michigan State University, Yale University, and CUNY. Babbel maintains an additional office in New York City and is privately held. Babbel's revenue model is direct-to-consumer subscriptions (monthly, annual, lifetime tiers) plus enterprise B2B licensing through Babbel for Business; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source learner content. The Babbel GitHub organization publishes internal infrastructure tooling (Terraform AWS modules, Puma plugins, OkHttp AWS signing, GitHub Actions) but no consumer-facing API.

providers.name: Bastille Networks
providers.description: Bastille Networks is a wireless airspace cybersecurity company that detects, localizes, and continuously monitors radio-frequency emitting devices and threats across 50+ wireless protocols including Bluetooth, BLE, Wi-Fi, cellular, and IoT. Its platform delivers real-time inventory of wireless assets, rogue-device and insider-threat detection, and localization down to a 1-3 meter radius, integrating through an API-led architecture with SIEM, SOAR, XDR, and CAASM tooling such as Splunk, ArcSight, and QRadar. Bastille serves Fortune 100 enterprises, government agencies, classified facilities, and data center operators, and is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. It exposes integration APIs to enterprise customers but publishes no public developer portal or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Bold Metrics
providers.description: Bold Metrics is an AI body data platform for the apparel and fashion industry that uses digital-twin technology to power apparel fit and sizing. From just 4-6 simple body-data inputs it predicts 50+ individual body measurements with tailor-level accuracy, without photos, scanning, or measuring tapes. Its products - Smart Size Chart, Virtual Sizer, Virtual Tailor, Apparel Insights, and the Agentic Sizing Protocol - help brands reduce returns, lift conversion, and increase average order value with personalized size recommendations. The Agentic Sizing Protocol exposes this capability to AI shopping agents while keeping retailer API credentials off the agent and out of any LLM. Bold Metrics has processed 250M+ digital twins and 12B+ body-data points. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Techstars. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Bold Metrics publishes no public API documentation - integration is gated behind a demo/partner engagement.

providers.name: Burger King
providers.description: Burger King is one of the world's largest fast-food hamburger chains operating over 18,000 locations in more than 100 countries. Known for the flame-grilled Whopper, Burger King is a subsidiary of Restaurant Brands International (RBI) and operates the BK mobile app, Royal Perks loyalty program, and delivery partnerships with DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub.

providers.name: Calumet
providers.description: Calumet is a specialty hydrocarbon and renewable fuels company that produces a broad portfolio of branded and customer-formulated specialty products including lubricating oils, white mineral oils, solvents, waxes, and renewable diesel through its Montana Renewables subsidiary. The company serves customers across consumer, industrial, and energy markets globally. Calumet does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Camion
providers.description: Camion is an infrastructure-intelligence platform accelerating the electrification of real estate portfolios. Its AI-driven platform indexes properties by their readiness and potential for electrification, forecasts energy demand, and optimizes the placement of solar, storage, and EV-charging infrastructure so the largest real estate owners and infrastructure developers can underwrite and deploy energy upgrades at scale. Camion positions itself as an "always-on energy department" that delivers consultant-grade investment cases without manual dashboard monitoring. Founded in 2023 and based in London, Camion raised a EUR 2.7M pre-seed round led by EQT Ventures in April 2024. Sector: energy-and-environmental. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; Camion publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Claros
providers.description: Claros is a data center power delivery company reimagining how energy moves from chip to grid for AI and high-performance computing infrastructure. Based in Torrance, California with an office in McLean, Virginia, the company builds two hardware-and-software product lines: an Integrated Voltage Regulator (IVR) that targets the roughly 40 percent of chip power lost to heat at the point of delivery, and a Power Gateway that manages broader data center power distribution where 30 to 50 percent of power is lost to transmission, conversion, and cooling. Claros is an early-stage hardware company backed by General Catalyst and Red Cell Partners; its founding team collectively holds 286 patents and has brought more than 80 gigawatts of projects to market. As of 2026 it is pre-product (prototypes in development, engineering samples planned for 2026, low-volume production 2027, high-volume scale 2028) and publishes no developer API, SDK, or public documentation surface yet — this profile captures its public identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Code Metal
providers.description: Code Metal is a Boston-based AI company building a verifiable code translation and optimization platform for mission-critical, edge, and regulated industries including defense, automotive, semiconductor, robotics, and aerospace. The platform ingests high-level research and prototype code (Python, MATLAB, Julia) and produces optimized, edge-ready low-level code across C/C++, Rust, VHDL, Verilog, CUDA, HIP, and ONNX, using a divide-and-conquer pipeline that instruments and tests, translates and verifies functional equivalence, then optimizes and benchmarks against target CPU/GPU/FPGA runtimes. Code Metal was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer documentation, or specification surface; this profile carries verified company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Codec
providers.description: Codec (CODEC AI) is an AI-powered audience-intelligence consultancy that helps ambitious global brands identify, understand, and activate high-value cultural communities to accelerate growth. Its work spans marketing strategy, brand and creative, and activation and measurement, powered by an award-winning proprietary AI platform, with case studies for enterprise brands such as Stella Artois, Frank's RedHot, and Moncler. Codec is a B2B consultancy rather than a developer-facing API provider — it publishes no public API, SDKs, or developer documentation. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Commsignia
providers.description: Commsignia is a Budapest-based V2X (Vehicle-to-Everything) technology company building connected vehicle and smart infrastructure solutions for the automotive and transportation industries. Its portfolio spans roadside units (RSUs) and onboard units (OBUs), a V2X software stack, and cloud services grouped into product suites: Roadway Intelligence, Emergency Safety, Fleet, Automotive, Smart Infrastructure, and Connected Vehicle. The company turns isolated roadway and vehicle data silos into real-world operational intelligence for safer roads and improved traffic flow. As of this enrichment pass Commsignia publishes no public developer API, REST/OpenAPI reference, SDK, or developer portal; technical integration is handled through direct engagement. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech.

providers.name: Cyngn
providers.description: Cyngn (NASDAQ: CYN) is a Mountain View, California autonomous vehicle technology company that develops and deploys industrial autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) for material handling. Its flagship DriveMod stack is a vehicle-agnostic, AI-powered autonomy system that retrofits onto standard industrial vehicles such as tuggers and forklifts, paired with the Cyngn Insight fleet-management, teleoperation, and analytics platform and the Cyngn Evolve data toolkit — together marketed as the Enterprise Autonomy Suite. Cyngn targets warehousing, manufacturing, and logistics operators facing labor shortages and safety challenges, and integrates with major warehouse management systems (Manhattan, Blue Yonder, SAP EWM). The company traces its corporate lineage to Cyanogen Inc. (the CyanogenMod company), whose dormant GitHub organization still links to cyngn.com.

providers.name: domob
providers.description: Domob (多盟) is a Beijing-based mobile intelligent marketing and advertising technology company founded in September 2010, positioned as one of China's early smartphone advertising DSP and mobile ad-network platforms. It provides data-technology and content services spanning programmatic buying (DSP), the UGdesk user-growth platform, the BidMaster preferred buying platform, and the BlueNova traffic-monetization platform, alongside agency and short-video services partnered with ByteDance, Tencent, Kuaishou, Microsoft Advertising and Xiaohongshu. For developers and app publishers, Domob distributes first-party iOS and Android ad SDKs (banner, interstitial, splash, native and offerwall formats) plus Unity3D and Cocos2d-x game-engine plugins via its Domob-SDK GitHub organization; publishers obtain a Publisher ID and Placement ID from the Domob platform to monetize apps. In 2025 the Domob SDK passed CAICT dual-end (iOS/Android) security certification. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Dynamics
providers.description: Dynamics Inc designs and manufactures battery-powered interactive payment cards that work with existing point-of-sale and card infrastructure. Its "Computer-in-a-Card" technology embeds a microprocessor, buttons, and a rewritable magnetic stripe into a standard-size card, enabling programmable multi-account cards, hidden card numbers, and on-card loyalty for banks, merchants, and consumers. The company is a fintech hardware manufacturer backed by Bain Capital Ventures. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this repository tracks its identity and public security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Esper Satellite Imagery
providers.description: Esper Satellite Imagery is an Australian space-technology company building an 18-satellite hyperspectral Earth-observation constellation (the Over The Rainbow / OTR program) to deliver global chemical-composition data of the planet's surface from orbit. Its Esperesso hyperspectral imagers capture more than 100 contiguous spectral bands spanning roughly 400 to 1000 nm, which Esper turns into mineralisation maps that identify lithium, rare earths, gold, nickel, cobalt and alteration zones for critical-mineral exploration — faster, cheaper and greener than traditional ground surveys. Founded in 2021 in Melbourne, Victoria by Iqbal and Joey Lorenczak, Esper sells custom area-of-interest mineral maps and a pre-built Northern Territory mineral map. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's public web, security and code-repository surface.

providers.name: EY
providers.description: One of the Big Four professional services firms providing audit, tax, consulting, and advisory services. Operates in over 150 countries helping businesses navigate regulatory and strategic challenges, and runs proprietary technology platforms such as EY Helix (analytics), EY Atlas (research), and EY Canvas (audit) for internal and engagement use.

providers.name: FarMart
providers.description: FarMart is an AI-powered food sourcing and procurement platform that connects suppliers, food manufacturers, processors, and logistics providers across the global food and energy supply chain. It provides end-to-end procurement infrastructure including verified supplier discovery, five-minute AI-powered KYC verification, compliance management, market-to-factory batch traceability, automated invoicing and e-way bill generation, and real-time payment settlement in one to four hours. FarMart serves food companies, HoReCa (hospitality) buyers, and bio-fuel supply chains, with a network spanning 100+ premium buyers, 50+ food categories, and 10,000+ suppliers.

providers.name: Flatlooker
providers.description: Flatlooker (founded 2016) is a French digital real-estate agency for online rental search, tenant placement, and full rental property management (gestion locative). It now operates under the Manda brand (formerly Flatlooker and Hello Syndic); flatlooker.com redirects to manda.fr. Manda covers rental and property management, sales, condominium (syndic) management, and energy renovation for owners, tenants, investors, and co-ownerships across France, working primarily online — remote viewings, electronic dossiers and signatures, and mobile apps to track properties in real time — while relying on local agents in Paris, Lyon, and Marseille. Flatlooker was surfaced as a Partech portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its live llms.txt and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Flowcarbon
providers.description: Flowcarbon is a climate-finance company that provides project finance and bespoke capital solutions for companies working in infrastructure, decarbonization, and frontier climate industries. Its end-to-end services span project origination, screening and due diligence, deal structuring, and tax-credit solutions, with a focus on engineered carbon-removal technologies such as biochar and enhanced rock weathering. Founded with a web3 heritage in tokenized voluntary carbon credits and backed by a16z and General Catalyst, Flowcarbon today operates primarily as a climate project-finance firm rather than a developer platform, and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: HAAWK
providers.description: HAAWK is a Los Angeles-based music rights management and monetization company that administers digital rights across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok for record labels, music publishers, and independent artists. Its products include HAAWK (full-service YouTube Content ID and Meta Rights Manager administration), Identifyy (self-service UGC rights management for independent creators), Keyframe Audio (a micro sync-licensing catalog of 50,000+ production music tracks), and Diistro (digital music distribution to Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, and TikTok). HAAWK has administered 100B+ video views and manages 1.1M+ music copyrights for 2,000+ rights holders. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: High Alpha
providers.description: High Alpha is a venture firm and venture studio based in Indianapolis, Indiana that creates and funds early-stage B2B SaaS companies. Through its Capital arm it makes pre-seed to Series B investments across the United States, and through its Studio it co-founds companies with entrepreneurs, providing design, brand, marketing, recruiting, product design, and go-to-market services. Founded by ExactTarget co-founder and CEO Scott Dorsey along with Eric Tobias, Mike Fitzgerald, and Studio Science founder Kristian Andersen, High Alpha pioneered the venture studio model and publishes the annual SaaS Benchmarks Report. Studio and portfolio companies include Salesloft, Lessonly, Attentive, Logik.ai, LogicGate, Dwolla, Zylo, and project44.

providers.name: Hippo
providers.description: Hippo is a digital home insurance provider operating as Hippo Insurance Services, a subsidiary of Hippo Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HIPO). Headquartered in California and domiciled in Delaware, Hippo sells homeowners, Hippo+, auto, flood, pet, landlord, and fire insurance through a network of more than 70 carrier partners, including its in-house carrier Spinnaker Insurance Company. The company serves more than 500,000 homeowners across all 50 states and pairs policies with the Hippo Home app, which offers home maintenance checklists, seasonal guidance, and a home care score to encourage proactive home upkeep. Hippo Holdings also operates First Connect Insurance Services, an independent-agent platform, and Spinnaker Specialty Insurance Company and Mainsail Insurance Company. Hippo does not publish a public developer portal, partner API, or SDK; there is no documented public REST API, OpenAPI specification, or open-source GitHub presence (the `hippoinsurance` GitHub organization exists but is empty).

providers.name: HungryHub
providers.description: HungryHub is a restaurant reservation and dining-deals platform operating primarily in Bangkok, Thailand. It connects diners with fixed-price dining packages — all-you-can-eat buffets, omakase, fine dining, rooftop venues, hotel staycations and cruise dining — from luxury hotels and restaurants, often at significant savings. The consumer marketplace runs on the web and in mobile apps, while a separate business portal gives 2,000+ partner restaurants and hotel chains a booking and package-management dashboard. The company reports serving more than four million customers monthly and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. HungryHub publishes no public developer or partner API; this profile captures its public web, discovery and security surface.

providers.name: Isembard
providers.description: Isembard is a UK- and US-based advanced manufacturing company building a distributed network of software-powered precision factories for critical industries including aerospace, defence, space, satellites, drones, nuclear energy, and motorsport. Founded in 2024 by Alexander Fitzgerald and named after engineer Isambard Kingdom Brunel, the company runs its factories on MasonOS, a proprietary AI-powered operating system that manages quoting, scheduling, production, and quality control across its factory network. Its model reshores high-precision component manufacturing closer to home to address supply-chain vulnerabilities in the Western industrial base, scaling from prototypes to production and offering factory franchise opportunities. Isembard has raised a Series A led by Union Square Ventures and operates factories across the UK, US, France, and Germany. There is no public developer API; MasonOS is an internal software platform, so this profile captures the company's identity and web surface rather than an API.

providers.name: Juna.ai
providers.description: Juna.ai is a Berlin-based industrial AI company building an Agentic Factory OS — a platform of autonomous AI agents that plan, steer, and continuously improve complex industrial production processes. Its agents ingest live plant data through integrations with existing IT/OT systems (SAP, Siemens, AVEVA, PI Server, Snowflake), model assets and processes into a Factory Graph and Knowledge Graph, detect anomalies, run root-cause analysis, generate reports, and recommend or execute control actions 24/7 with human-in-the-loop oversight and full traceability. Juna targets heavy and process industries including chemicals, cement, pulp & paper, glass, food & beverage, pharma, consumer goods, and industrial manufacturing, focused on maximizing output, quality, energy efficiency, and sustainability. The company is backed by Kleiner Perkins, Norrsken VC, and John Doerr. Juna delivers integration through enterprise engagements and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal.

providers.name: Kontoor Brands
providers.description: Kontoor Brands, Inc. is a global lifestyle apparel company with a portfolio of iconic denim and casual apparel brands including Wrangler, Lee, and Rock & Republic. Headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, the company designs, manufactures, sources, markets, and distributes its apparel products worldwide through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. Kontoor Brands does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: Logixboard
providers.description: Logixboard provides a unified, white-labeled customer experience platform for freight forwarders and logistics service providers, letting their customers book, track, quote, and manage shipments across ocean, air, FTL/LTL, customs, and warehousing from a single branded portal. It ingests and normalizes shipment data from TMS and WMS systems (CargoWise, Descartes, homegrown systems) via private API, file drop (FTP/SFTP), and database sync, so providers can differentiate on digital visibility. Logixboard exposes no public developer API; integrations are delivered as bespoke, provider-scoped data connections. Added to the API Evangelist network from the venture portfolios of Insight Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and Techstars.

providers.name: MasterClass
providers.description: MasterClass is an online education streaming platform where members learn from a roster of 200+ world-renowned instructors across categories including Arts & Entertainment, Business, Design & Style, Sports & Gaming, Writing, Food, Music, Science & Tech, Home & Lifestyle, Community & Government, and Wellness. Content is delivered as video lessons with downloadable workbooks on web, iOS, Android, Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire TV under Standard, Plus, and Premium membership plans. Newer offerings include MasterClass at Work, MasterClass On Call, and the AI-native MasterClass Executive program. Founded by David Rogier; backed by Atomico, Bloomberg Beta, and IVP. MasterClass exposes no public developer API — it is a consumer edtech product, not an API provider.

providers.name: Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP
providers.description: Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP is a global Am Law 10 firm with approximately 2,200 lawyers and 39 offices across North America, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. The firm provides corporate, transactional, litigation, and regulatory services across energy, financial services, healthcare, life sciences, retail and ecommerce, sports, technology, and transportation, with widely recognized depth in employee benefits and executive compensation, fintech and financial services regulation, intellectual property, and M&A. Morgan Lewis does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI spec, or machine-readable data product; its public technology surface is limited to its corporate website, an email-alert subscription managed through a Real Magnet (REACTION) marketing platform, and a portfolio of LexBlog-style practice blogs covering specific subject areas.

providers.name: Nebu
providers.description: NEBU (legal entity NEBU LAH SDN. BHD., Malaysia) is an early-stage, AI-powered DevOps-as-a-Service platform positioned as "the missing brain for your cloud" — offering intelligent understanding of cloud infrastructure rather than scripted automation alone. Founded in 2024, the company markets AIOps/MLOps-style cloud management, cost optimization, and intelligent automation for enterprise cloud estates, and self-states a security posture of SOC 2 Type II readiness, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance. As of this profile the product is pre-launch ("we're building what comes next") with a single-page marketing site and no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs yet. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead; the only machine-readable surface found is a valid RFC 9116 /.well-known/security.txt.

providers.name: Netic
providers.description: Netic (legal entity Cybernetic Labs Inc.), headquartered in San Francisco, builds production-grade autonomous AI systems for America's essential service industries — home services, pest control, roofing, consumer health, and veterinary. Its AI Growth Engine spans speech, text, and data with products including Convert (autonomous multi-channel job booking into CRM/FSM systems), Cultivate (autonomous upsell and membership campaigns), Empower (analytics and data-driven decision support), and Evaluate (AI call-center scoring), with Expand announced as coming soon. Netic is backed by Founders Fund, Greylock, and SV Angel. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity, blog, privacy policy, domain-security posture, and its Secureframe-hosted trust center.

providers.name: Nomagic
providers.description: Nomagic builds Physical AI for end-to-end warehouse automation, using AI-powered robotic arms and computer vision to automate picking, packing, sorting and other fulfillment tasks across e-commerce, fashion, pharmaceutical and third-party logistics warehouses. Nomagic exposes a standard Station API for systems integrators, WCS/WMS providers and customers to control its robots, and a Grip AI API that adds an intelligence layer to third-party robot hardware; all robot actions are recorded to the Nomagic Cloud to continually improve its models. The company is backed by Khosla Ventures. Public developer documentation for these APIs is not published; integration is arranged directly with Nomagic.

providers.name: Pax
providers.description: Pax (Pax AI) is a San Francisco-based artificial intelligence company that automates U.S. duty drawback claims, letting importers, retailers, and manufacturers reclaim overpaid tariffs and import duties. Branding itself the "AI Broker for Tariff Refunds" and "TurboTax for import duty rebate," Pax uses proprietary AI to automate data extraction, validation, transaction matching, refund calculation, and electronic claim submission to U.S. Customs and Border Protection with minimal manual effort. Founded by former duty-drawback experts and engineers from Charter Brokerage, MIT, Amazon, Flexport, and Brex, Pax is backed by Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, General Catalyst, Flexport, Soma Capital, Basis Set Ventures, and others. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Pickle Robot
providers.description: Pickle Robot builds Physical AI systems for supply chain automation, best known for autonomous truck- and container-unloading robots that handle non-palletized, floor-loaded freight. Its Dill Autonomy Engine (DAE) pairs classical optimal control with generative AI and foundation models, driving an industrial arm with vision, LiDAR, and an air-suction gripper to unload 400-1,500 cases per hour. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in the Boston, Massachusetts area, the company deploys into existing warehouses in days with no WMS integration and counts UPS among its customers. Pickle Robot exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, domain-security posture, and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Porch
providers.description: Porch Group is a home services and home insurance platform operating across the full lifecycle of the home. Trading on Nasdaq as PRCH, the company combines a vertical software business for home inspectors, moving companies, title and mortgage providers, and contractors with a consumer-facing home insurance carrier (Porch Insurance Reciprocal Exchange), home warranty, and a moving-concierge app that helps homeowners set up utilities, security, and services. Porch reaches a large share of U.S. homebuyers each year through its inspection-software network, using that unique early-in-the-home-lifecycle data to power insurance, warranty, and moving offerings. This profile was seeded as a Battery Ventures portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Porch publishes no public developer API, but it does operate a responsible disclosure program and RFC 9116 security.txt.

providers.name: Sereact
providers.description: Sereact GmbH is a Stuttgart, Germany based physical-AI company building intelligent robotic systems for warehouse and fulfillment automation. Its "Cortex" platform pairs a Vision Language Action Model (VLAM) with robot control so robots can pick, place, sort, induct, and inspect diverse items in production without task-specific retraining, running across 50+ deployments in Europe and the US. Products include Pick-and-Place, Putwall, Induction, Bin Handling, Returns Handling, and the Lens perception system. Backed by Creandum and Point Nine; announced a $110M Series B. Sereact does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface — an internal api.sereact.ai host exists but is a placeholder. This profile captures the company identity and public web/GitHub surface.

providers.name: SilverRail
providers.description: SilverRail Technologies is a rail technology company that powers global rail ecommerce and distribution. Its platform spans journey planning, ticketing, and onboard information, aiming to transform the rail experience for travelers while making rail retail easier and more profitable for operators, travel agencies, and distributors. SilverRail connects rail carriers and sellers so rail inventory can be searched, booked, and ticketed across markets. The company was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Accel and Canaan Partners. As of this enrichment pass SilverRail runs a corporate marketing site (Next.js) but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery documents; its API and distribution capabilities appear to be delivered through partner/enterprise integration rather than a self-serve public API.

providers.name: Sleek EV
providers.description: Sleek EV (SLEEK EV) is a Thai-Singaporean electric motorcycle company founded in 2022, headquartered in Singapore with primary operations in Thailand. Under the mission "Sustainability must be affordable," it builds accessible electric two-wheelers — the TYPE-S, TYPE-E and TYPE-X motorcycles and the SLEEK Play 1.0 urban scooter — powered by its S-DRIVE powertrain and IP67-rated lithium-ion batteries (via Ampace/CATL). It runs the S-Charge fast-charging network (100+ stations across Bangkok) and a SLEEK App for vehicle monitoring, route planning and station finding, sold through a nationwide dealer network. BOI-certified and backed by ORZON Ventures (OR + 500 TukTuks), January Capital, A2D Ventures and Krungsri Finnovate. This is a consumer product company with no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Sourceful
providers.description: Sourceful is a Manchester, United Kingdom packaging technology company that began as a sustainable packaging marketplace connecting brands with vetted manufacturers and offering data-driven carbon footprint, life-cycle, and recyclability metrics for every packaging design. Founded in 2020 by Wing Chan and Charlie Bradshaw, the company raised roughly $32M from investors including Index Ventures, Coatue, and Eka Ventures, and grew to over 100 employees serving climate-conscious consumer brands. Since 2024–2025 Sourceful has pivoted toward AI-powered visual design for packaging, releasing Sourceful 3.0 and Riverflow 1, a proprietary image-editing foundation model marketed as state-of-the-art for design-grade, print-ready packaging artwork. The current product line covers AI logo design, packaging design, AI product photography, image editing, packaging ranges, flavor/variant ranges, brand moodboards, and (announced) product mockups and social ads. Sourceful is ISO 42001 certified for AI management. As of this profile the company does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or open-source GitHub organization for the packaging/design platform, and the original sustainable-packaging marketplace surface and supplier-facing carbon footprint API have been superseded by the AI design product; there is no Sourceful developer portal at this time. The unrelated github.com/sourceful organization belongs to Pony Foo, not this company, and sourceful.energy is a separate distributed-energy-resource platform unrelated to Sourceful Ltd.

providers.name: Splice
providers.description: Splice is a New York City-based music creation platform founded in 2013 by Steve Martocci and Matt Aimonetti that operates a royalty-free sample marketplace, a rent-to-own plugin store, and a growing suite of in-house instruments, AI tools, and DAW integrations for producers and beatmakers. Splice Sounds offers a credit-based subscription giving access to millions of cleared samples, loops, presets, and MIDI; Splice INSTRUMENT is the company's virtual instrument with free monthly preset drops; Astra is a Splice-built hybrid synthesizer covering virtual analog, wavetable, sampling, granular, and FM synthesis; Beatmaker is its drum-machine instrument; and Bridge is a free plugin that surfaces the Splice Sounds catalog directly inside Ableton Live, Studio One, Pro Tools, and Studio Pro with automatic key and tempo matching. Splice has also rolled out generative AI features including Create Mode (build "Stacks" from any loop), Variations (regenerate any Splice sample with creator compensation), Craft (turn catalog sounds into playable instruments inside INSTRUMENT), and an upcoming Magic Fit (harmonic/rhythmic auto-matching to a session), with an announced ElevenLabs partnership for next-gen AI music tools. The company acquired Superpowered and Audiaire in 2020 and Spitfire Audio in 2025, and operates a rent-to-own marketplace of 130+ third-party plugins (Serum 2, V Collection, Abbey Road, etc.). Splice does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface; the business is a consumer/prosumer SaaS for music creators, distributed via desktop app, mobile app, and DAW plugin integrations rather than a programmable platform.

providers.name: Sunday
providers.description: Sunday (Sunday Lawn Care, getsunday.com) is a direct-to-consumer, subscription lawn and yard care brand. It builds a personalized annual plan for each customer's exact lot from satellite imagery, soil data, and local climate patterns, then ships pesticide-free, phosphorus-free fertilizer, weed control, grass seed, and pest-control products on a seasonal cadence. Plans include Sunny AI guidance and Yard Advisor expert support, plus regional lawn-care guides for 1,700+ US cities. Sunday is a consumer commerce company rather than an API provider: it publishes a machine-readable llms.txt for agents and runs an internal application API (api.getsunday.com), but exposes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documented API surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bond Capital and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: TuneCore
providers.description: TuneCore is a Brooklyn, New York based independent music distribution and publishing administration company founded in 2006 (as YourTunes, Inc., rebranded TuneCore in 2008) and acquired by French music company Believe in 2015. TuneCore lets self-releasing artists and labels deliver recorded music to 150+ digital stores and streaming services — Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, TikTok, Tidal, Deezer, Beatport, and others — while retaining 100% of their rights and master ownership, in exchange for a flat annual distribution fee starting at $24.99/year for unlimited releases. TuneCore Publishing Administration registers compositions with performance rights organizations, mechanical rights societies, and digital service providers worldwide to collect songwriter royalties, sync, and neighboring rights income. Additional services include the TuneCore Accelerator artist development program, TuneCore Social (monetization on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts), TuneCore Direct Advance (royalty-backed capital, powered by RoyFi), mastering, and Splits for collaborator revenue sharing. TuneCore operates across 5 continents with local teams in 15+ countries through Believe's global network. There is no current public TuneCore developer API, SDK, or partner portal — an earlier white-label REST/XML "TuneCore Direct" partner API existed circa 2008-2012 (with a community Ruby gem `tunecore_direct`) but is no longer actively documented or promoted. TuneCore's public-facing surface is the artist web app at web.tunecore.com and the support/help center; any current B2B integrations run through Believe's enterprise partnerships.

providers.name: Turo
providers.description: Turo is a San Francisco-headquartered peer-to-peer car sharing marketplace operating in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France, and Australia. The platform lets vehicle owners (hosts) list their cars for rent and lets travelers (guests) book those vehicles directly through the Turo app or website, with Turo handling identity verification, insurance, protection plans, payments, and trust and safety on top of the host's inventory. The marketplace covers economy cars, SUVs, trucks, vans, exotic and classic vehicles, and EVs across more than 14,000 cities, and offers contactless Turo Go vehicles where supported. Turo's revenue model is a marketplace take-rate against each trip plus protection plan and ancillary fees, supported by an integrated host operations stack (calendar, pricing, messaging, and earnings) and a guest mobile and web booking experience. Turo does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or partner developer portal. The only third-party-facing surface was a now-deprecated ChatGPT plugin (chatgpt.turo.com) launched in 2023 and sunset alongside OpenAI's plugins program in 2024. Integrations with connected-car platforms such as Smartcar are negotiated directly rather than through self-serve developer onboarding, and Turo's public GitHub presence (github.com/turo, github.com/open-turo) is limited to internal engineering tooling, GitHub Actions, ESLint configs, and language-specific libraries rather than a public marketplace API.

providers.name: Warren
providers.description: Warren (Warren Investimentos e Gestao Patrimonial) is a Brazilian digital wealth-management and investment platform founded in 2017 and based in Porto Alegre. Regulated by Brazil's Central Bank, the CVM securities commission, and ANBIMA, Warren offers a goals-based, fee-only model spanning managed portfolios, ETFs, fixed income, global stocks, gold and crypto, private pension plans, life insurance, currency exchange, and business (PJ) accounts, plus a Warren for Business platform for investment professionals. It is backed by QED Investors, Ribbit Capital, and Citi Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Warren exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, or first-party SDK; its GitHub organization (warrenbrasil) contains internal engineering tooling and courseware rather than a consumer-facing API surface.

providers.name: Agomab Therapeutics
providers.description: Agomab Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company (Nasdaq: AGMB) developing novel disease-modifying therapies for fibro-inflammatory diseases, with an initial focus on chronic fibrotic indications of high unmet medical need such as Crohn's disease and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. Building on deep expertise in growth factor biology, Agomab advances a pipeline of small-molecule and antibody candidates targeting the pathways that drive tissue fibrosis and inflammation. Headquartered in Belgium with operations across Europe and the United States, the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a biopharmaceutical company it publishes a corporate and investor-relations web presence rather than a public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the network catalog.

providers.name: AKASA
providers.description: AKASA is a generative AI company for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), building AI-powered products that automate coding, clinical documentation integrity (CDI), prior authorization status, and claim status work for hospitals and health systems. Its platform includes the Prebill Optimization Suite (Coding Optimizer and CDI Optimizer), AI Advisor, Auth Status, and Claim Status, trained on millions of clinical and financial documents. AKASA reports serving 650+ hospitals and 6,500+ outpatient facilities across all 50 states, with customers citing reductions in A/R days and hundreds of monthly staff hours saved. The company was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Alterest
providers.description: Alterest is the operating platform for asset-based finance (ABF), giving credit funds, banks, specialty lenders, and loan originators verification-first workflows, a unified data model, and AI-assisted controls over capital deployment, SPV operations, and asset origination. The platform digitizes facility management, borrowing-base calculations, trigger and covenant monitoring, multi-party workflows, and automated investor reporting, while running daily verification, tape-to-collections matching, integrity checks, and double-pledge detection to prevent fraud. It replaces fragmented spreadsheets and email with a system of record, portfolio analytics, immutable audit trails, and SFTP plus API data feeds to lender systems. Founded in 2016 and based in London, Alterest oversees $15B+ in capital across 250+ transactions, 9+ asset classes, and 4+ regions (US, UK, EU, APAC), and is backed by Seedcamp.

providers.name: Amparo
providers.description: Amparo is a Brazilian fintech that supports bereaved families in the days after a funeral. Its Central de Cadastros uses automated document reading and data extraction to register a family once and share that data across partner systems, while a WhatsApp assistant delivers personalized financial guidance covering INSS pension advances, life-insurance payouts, credit, repatriation reimbursements, and debt and inventory organization. Amparo exposes integration APIs so its Central de Cadastros can connect with funeral-home and insurer client systems. Backed by QED Investors.

providers.name: Archimetis
providers.description: Archimetis builds an AI-powered Operational Reasoning System for refineries, chemicals, and heavy process industries. The platform unifies data from disparate operational sources — plant historians, linear programs, advanced process control models, and digital engineering documents — into a single intelligence layer, then continuously monitors operations, performs complex engineering analysis, and applies industry best practices to surface actionable insights for operators and engineers. Marketed as "See more. Solve smarter," it targets margin improvement, cost savings, and process safety across refining, chemicals, and other heavy industries. Founded in 2023, the company raised $11.5M led by Inspired Capital. Archimetis is an enterprise B2B platform engaged through guided working sessions and demos; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Autobahn Therapeutics
providers.description: Autobahn Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in San Diego, California, developing regenerative medicines for central nervous system (CNS) disorders. The company pairs a proprietary brain-targeting chemistry platform - which creates orally administered small-molecule prodrugs designed to cross the blood-brain barrier - with validated human biology and biomarker-driven development strategies. Its pipeline includes elunetirom (its lead clinical program, being developed for indications such as bipolar depression), ABX-101 (a next-generation CNS-active S1P molecule), and ABX-003. Autobahn is backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners and Insight Partners. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; the company does not currently publish a public developer API, so this record captures company identity and published web properties only.

providers.name: Aven
providers.description: Aven is a consumer fintech that issues a home-equity-backed Visa credit card, letting homeowners tap their home equity (a HELOC) through a card with credit-card convenience at lower, home-equity-secured rates. Its product line spans the Aven HELOC card, a Bitcoin-backed Visa card, and educational tooling such as a payment calculator, positioning itself as an AI-driven "machine bank." Founded in the fintech sector and backed by Electric Capital, Founders Fund, General Catalyst, GGV Capital, and Khosla Ventures, Aven operates a consumer marketing and account-servicing web presence at aven.com. As of this enrichment pass Aven publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP server; this profile captures its verifiable public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Binaris
providers.description: Binaris was a fast, low-latency Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) platform for running production Node.js workloads in the cloud. Founded in 2017 and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, its developer surface centered on the `bn` command-line tool and Node.js SDK (published to npm as `binaris` and to Docker Hub as `binaris/bn`), which let developers scaffold, deploy, invoke, and inspect serverless functions in seconds. Authentication was via a Binaris API key (`BINARIS_API_KEY`). The company later explored a "Shift" programming model (`@binaris/shift-fetch-runtime`). The hosted platform at binaris.io / binaris.com is no longer in service, but the first-party client packages and a 42-repository GitHub organization remain publicly available and are captured here.

providers.name: BreezeBio (formerly GenEdit)
providers.description: BreezeBio, Inc. (formerly GenEdit) is a clinical-stage genetic medicines company based in South San Francisco, California, solving the central delivery problem of gene editing and genetic medicine. Its proprietary NanoGalaxy platform is a library of thousands of non-viral, non-lipid polymer nanoparticles engineered to deliver genetic payloads (mRNA, DNA, and CRISPR ribonucleoprotein) to specific cell types and tissues without triggering an immune response. The company is advancing an internal pipeline of precision genetic medicines focused on autoimmune disease and oncology, led by BRZ-101, a tolerance-inducing candidate for Type 1 diabetes. GenEdit rebranded to BreezeBio in February 2026 alongside a $60M Series B, and has established platform partnerships with Roche's Genentech and Sarepta Therapeutics. This is a therapeutics company with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CNO Financial Group
providers.description: CNO Financial Group is an Indiana-based insurance holding company that develops, markets, and administers life and health insurance, annuities, and workforce benefits solutions through brands including Bankers Life, Colonial Penn, Washington National, Optavise, and PMA USA. CNO does not publish a public-facing developer portal or API; integrations are run via partner channels (CRM, Pega Cloud platform, and brand-specific producer portals).

providers.name: Comanche Biopharma
providers.description: Comanche Biopharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Concord, Massachusetts, developing investigational siRNA (small interfering RNA) medicines for maternal health. Its lead candidate, CBP-4888, is a subcutaneously administered siRNA therapy targeting sFlt1-mediated preterm preeclampsia, a leading and potentially life-threatening complication of pregnancy. The company's mission is to develop and make globally available the first therapy targeting a root cause of preeclampsia. In April 2025, CBP-4888 received Orphan Drug Designation from the European Medicines Agency. Comanche Biopharma is a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). As a therapeutics company it publishes a corporate and scientific web presence rather than a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Concord Systems
providers.description: Concord Systems was a Brooklyn, New York stream-processing company founded in December 2014 by Alexander Gallego and Emilio Del Tesoro, and backed by Bloomberg Beta. It built a high-performance distributed stream processing framework written in C++ on top of Apache Mesos, aimed at letting application developers and data scientists write real-time streaming computations ("operators") in the language of their choice — Python, Ruby, Go, Java/Scala, Node.js or Haskell — with Kafka and Amazon Kinesis connectors and a CLI for deploying topologies. Akamai Technologies acquired the company in an all-cash transaction in September 2016 and folded the technology into its IoT edge data platform for real-time messaging and log processing. The company is discontinued: concord.io is parked and the documentation site is gone. Its interface was a Thrift-based operator driver API rather than an HTTP/REST API, so there is no OpenAPI or event surface to catalog; the surviving first-party developer artifacts are the github.com/concord organization and the client libraries still published on PyPI, RubyGems and pkg.go.dev.

providers.name: Contraline
providers.description: Contraline is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing non-hormonal, long-acting, reversible contraceptive options for men and couples. Its lead product, ADAM, is an investigational implant designed to provide long-lasting reversible contraception, and NES/T is a daily topical gel intended to pause sperm production. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), Contraline runs clinical trials and participant programs from its Charlottesville, Virginia base. Its products are investigational and have not been approved by the FDA. The company operates a marketing and clinical-trial website with no public developer program or API; this API Evangelist profile captures its web presence, privacy posture, and domain security for the network catalog.

providers.name: Data Innovations
providers.description: Data Innovations LLC is a clinical laboratory informatics company that builds enterprise laboratory management and instrument-connectivity software for hospitals, health systems, and diagnostic labs. Its flagship Instrument Manager middleware connects analyzers, laboratory information systems (LIS), and EHR platforms such as Epic Beaker and Oracle Cerner, while EP Evaluator supports method validation and quality control, and Lab GPS delivers operational analytics. The company helps clinical labs optimize productivity, connectivity, and risk management across regional, community, and federal health systems. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: data.egov.bg (Open Data Portal of Bulgaria)
providers.description: data.egov.bg is the national government open-data portal for Bulgaria, operated by the Ministry of e-Government (Министерство на електронното управление). It is a custom Laravel application exposing a REST API with action-style endpoints (predominantly POST with JSON bodies) under the /api prefix. It is not CKAN. Public read endpoints require no key; write/admin endpoints require an api_key obtained via a free account.

providers.name: data.gov.hr
providers.description: data.gov.hr (Portal otvorenih podataka) is the national government open-data portal for Croatia, operated by the Ministry of Justice and Public Administration. It runs CKAN 2.9.9 and exposes the standard CKAN Action API over approximately 3,858 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access, plus DCAT-AP RDF/XML catalog feeds for EU harvesting. Note that the CKAN API is mounted under a non-default /ckan/ path prefix; root-level CKAN URLs return the Vue single-page-app HTML rather than JSON.

providers.name: data.gov.rs
providers.description: data.gov.rs is the national government open-data portal for the Republic of Serbia, operated by the Office for IT and eGovernment. It runs the uData platform and exposes the uData REST API over approximately 3,452 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, organization listings, and resource access. The API provides a consistent JSON-over-HTTP interface and is harvested into the EU data portal.

providers.name: dataset.gov.md (Portalul Datelor Deschise)
providers.description: dataset.gov.md is the national government open-data catalog for the Republic of Moldova (Portalul Datelor Deschise). The landing portal at date.gov.md links out to this catalog, which runs CKAN 2.10.4 and exposes the standard CKAN Action API over approximately 1,275 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. No API key is required for read endpoints.

providers.name: Democracy Earth
providers.description: Democracy Earth Foundation is a Y Combinator- and Fast Forward-backed 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source, blockchain-based software for incorruptible digital governance and voting. Its flagship Sovereign application is a liquid-democracy platform that lets communities vote directly on issues or delegate their voting power to trusted peers over a decentralized, censorship-resistant network. The Foundation also develops self-sovereign identity (a proof-of-humanity protocol), a universal basic income token, and a minimal quadratic-voting DAO, publishing all of its work as open-source repositories rather than as a commercial, hosted API. Democracy Earth is a protocol-first, decentralized project without a hosted REST API or developer program.

providers.name: DisplayLink
providers.description: DisplayLink, a brand of Synaptics Incorporated, develops USB-based virtual graphics technology that pairs host driver software with a device-side decoder SoC to act as a virtual graphics card. Its adaptive-compression technology powers universal docking stations, USB monitors, adapters, and multi-display setups over USB-C, USB, and Ethernet, spanning products from the entry-level DL-3000/4000 series to the quad-display DL-7000 professional series. DisplayLink is a hardware/semiconductor and driver-software product line rather than a public web-API provider; its developer surface consists of chip SDKs, firmware tooling, and host driver software.

providers.name: Eikon
providers.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company that integrates Nobel Prize-winning super-resolution single-molecule tracking (SMT) microscopy, advanced engineering, automation, and high-performance computing to visualize and measure the real-time movement of individual proteins in living cells. This proprietary live-cell imaging platform screens protein-ligand interactions across millions of cells per day, generating large, high-dimensional datasets that power the discovery and development of novel small-molecule medicines. Eikon advances a clinical- and preclinical-stage oncology and immunology pipeline, including EIK1001 (a TLR7/8 agonist) and IMP1734 (a selective PARP1 inhibitor). Backed by General Catalyst, the company is headquartered in Millbrae, California with offices in New York and Jersey City.

providers.name: Extra Space Storage
providers.description: Extra Space Storage Inc. is a fully integrated, self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust (REIT) and one of the largest operators of self-storage properties in the United States. The company owns, operates, and manages thousands of self-storage facilities across the country, offering storage units, vehicle storage, and business storage solutions. Extra Space Storage does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: Family Dollar Stores
providers.description: Family Dollar is a chain of discount variety stores in the United States offering a broad assortment of merchandise including consumables, home products, apparel, and seasonal goods at low prices. Owned by Dollar Tree, Inc., Family Dollar operates thousands of locations across the country and serves millions of customers seeking value-oriented shopping. The company does not currently publish public APIs or a developer portal.

providers.name: Flix
providers.description: Flix SE is a Munich-based global travel-tech company founded in 2013 that operates an asset-light, platform-based long-distance mobility network across more than 40 countries and 8,000+ destinations. Under the Flix umbrella it runs four consumer brands — FlixBus (green intercity coaches across Europe, North and South America, and Asia), FlixTrain (long-distance rail in Germany and Sweden), Greyhound (North America), and Kâmil Koç (Turkey) — having carried more than 500 million travelers. Flix pairs a technology and data-analytics platform with partner bus operators who run the physical fleet, selling and servicing trips through its consumer apps and website. Flix does not currently publish a public developer API or partner developer portal; its public technical surface is limited to a coordinated vulnerability-disclosure program (security.txt) and the flix-tech open-source GitHub organization. This profile was surfaced as an HV Capital portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Freespira
providers.description: Freespira is a digital therapeutics company that provides an FDA-cleared, at-home, medication-free treatment for panic disorder and PTSD symptoms. The program pairs a compact breathing sensor with a tablet app that gives patients real-time feedback while they retrain their breathing across two 17-minute daily sessions over a 28-day course, supported by weekly check-ins with Care Specialists. Freespira is sold through health plans, employers, provider organizations, and veterans programs rather than as a public developer platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Genesis Medtech
providers.description: Genesis MedTech is a global medical device company founded in Singapore in 2019, building and commercializing advanced clinical solutions across surgical, vascular intervention, and structural heart categories. It operates a vertically integrated platform that sources global medical technologies, develops them through in-house and partner R&D, manufactures at scale, and distributes across more than 30 countries. Its portfolio includes the J-Valve structural heart system, the iReach Omnia articulating powered surgical stapler, and neurovascular and peripheral vascular intervention product lines. Genesis MedTech is a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). It publishes a corporate and product marketing presence only; no public developer program, API, or technical documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Granata Bio
providers.description: Granata Bio is a reproductive-health biopharmaceutical company founded in 2018 and headquartered in the United States, focused on expanding access to fertility and IVF therapeutics across North America. The company identifies, licenses, and develops biopharmaceuticals spanning the in-vitro fertilization medication lifecycle from ovarian stimulation through luteal phase support, and is advancing a clinical pipeline that includes the Phase III GRACE Study. Granata Bio has raised over $30M, including a $14M Series A led by GV (Google Ventures) and a subsequent $15M Series A+.
