It operates a corporate and clinical web presence only and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or machine-readable interface; this profile captures its identity and web properties within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Graph AI
providers.description: Graph AI is an AI-native software company (founded 2024, CEO Raghavendra Parvataraju) building Graph Safety Suite, a unified platform for pharmacovigilance and drug safety in life sciences. Powered by its agentic graphx foundation and built on Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Kubernetes), the suite unifies source intake, case processing, aggregate reporting, signal detection, risk management and regulatory compliance into one connected ecosystem via modules including /intake, /nucleus, /report, /signal, /assure and /comply. Available on Google Cloud Marketplace, the company raised a $3M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners in October 2025. Graph AI is in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Hyperfine Research
providers.description: Hyperfine, Inc. (Nasdaq: HYPR) is a medical device company that created the Swoop Portable MR Imaging System, the first FDA-cleared, AI-powered, portable brain MRI. Swoop uses an ultra-low-field (0.064T) magnet — a fraction of the field strength of conventional MRI — to deliver diagnostic brain imaging at the point of care in hospitals, neurology clinics, ICUs, and pediatric settings without dedicated shielded infrastructure. Its Optive AI software applies deep-learning image reconstruction to reduce noise and blur. Hyperfine is headquartered in Guilford, Connecticut and is backed by GV (Google Ventures). Hyperfine publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Infosys
providers.description: Infosys is a global IT services, consulting, and outsourcing company headquartered in Bengaluru, India, providing digital transformation, cloud, AI, and business process services. Through its Finacle banking software product and Banking API Platform, Infosys exposes open banking APIs for deposits, loans, payments, trade finance, and data privacy, along with a configurable developer portal, API composer, and consent management. A public Finacle Open Bank Project sandbox is also available for developers to explore banking APIs.

providers.name: Insurdata
providers.description: Insurdata is a re/insurance technology company providing global, best-in-class geocoding and property exposure data. Its unique multi-sourced methodology delivers the highest-resolution, building-level geocoding available worldwide, together with building-perimeter and property-characteristic data that lets underwriters and catastrophe modelers assess risk at the individual-property level at the point of underwriting. Insurdata's augmented exposure data has been used in collaborative studies with carriers such as Canopius and flood modelers such as Fathom to sharpen exposure levels and average-annual-loss (AAL) forecasts. The company is a portfolio company of Anthemis and serves the global re/insurance market.

providers.name: InterVenn
providers.description: InterVenn Biosciences is a digital-biology company applying artificial intelligence and mass spectrometry to glycoproteomics, the large-scale study of glycosylated proteins, to discover novel biomarkers for precision medicine. Its proprietary platform integrates liquid chromatography and tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS) with AI-driven analysis (including the OpenPIP software) to identify and quantify glycopeptides and glycan structures across complex diseases such as cancer. Surfaced as a portfolio company of amplify-partners and softbank-vision-fund and added to the API Evangelist network. InterVenn publishes no public developer API, portal, or specifications as of this enrichment pass; this profile carries company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: INURU
providers.description: INURU (Inuru GmbH) is a Berlin-based printed-electronics company that manufactures ultra-thin, flexible printed OLED lighting for smart packaging, labels, apparel, and medical products. Its core product, the Elf (Embeddable Luminous Film), combines an inkjet-printed OLED, a power source, and a microchip into a paper-thin, waterproof film that can glow in any shape and respond to touch, motion, or sound. Founded in 2016, Inuru operates the automated "Dragon Factory" OLED production line in Wildau and works with brands such as Coca-Cola and Marvel on interactive, sustainable smart-packaging and medication-adherence labels. This is a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network; Inuru is a hardware and smart-packaging manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Irreducible
providers.description: Irreducible is a cryptography company accelerating the zero-knowledge (ZK) revolution by turning advanced proof systems into cost-efficient, production infrastructure. The company invented and leads Binius, a state-of-the-art zero-knowledge SNARK built on towers of binary fields that natively handles bitwise operations to deliver order-of-magnitude speedups over prime-field systems on ordinary CPUs, GPUs, mobile devices, and custom FPGA hardware. Irreducible operates its own FPGA-based proof-generation service and publishes Binius as open-source Rust crates. Target applications include self-sovereign identity, on-chain privacy, content provenance for AI-generated media, and verifiable supercomputing. Irreducible was backed by a Series A co-led by Paradigm and Bain Capital Crypto. This profile was seeded as a Paradigm portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company exposes an open-source developer surface (crates + docs) rather than a public REST API.

providers.name: Kanvas Biosciences
providers.description: Kanvas Biosciences is a spatial biology company building a microbiome drug screening, discovery, and manufacturing platform to accelerate development of next-generation live biotherapeutics. Its proprietary High-Phylogenetic-Resolution Spatial Mapping (HiPR-Map) platform uses oligonucleotide probes targeting ribosomal and messenger RNA to visualize microbial identity and cellular function within tissue across all kingdoms of life, illuminating host-microbiome interactions. The company advances a microbiome-based immuno-oncology pipeline (lead candidate KAN-001) and operates GMP manufacturing. Backed by DCVC. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile; the enrichment pass found no public developer API, SDK, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Kayum
providers.description: Kayum (KAYUM, S.A.P.I. de C.V.) is a Mexico City-based insurance data-analytics and software company serving the Mexican insurance market. It gives insurers exclusive, continuously updated market intelligence and actionable analysis: monthly price panels for GMM (major-medical), Life, and Auto lines backed by data from more than ten leading insurers, competitive pricing models, a quotation-processing tool (Claveteador) that compresses quote data preparation from days to minutes, customer-facing quoting platforms (Cotizadores) processing over 100,000 auto quotes a month, and compliance/document verification tooling (Suite 492 / ID Documental). Backed by 500 Global. The company publishes a marketing website but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Keploy
providers.description: Open-source, AI-native testing platform that captures real production API traffic with eBPF and replays it in CI as deterministic tests, auto-generated mocks, and production-like sandboxes with zero code changes. Offers a Cloud REST API, a hosted MCP server, llms.txt, and generated agent skills.

providers.name: Kinvey
providers.description: Kinvey was a mobile Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS / mBaaS) platform providing app developers with hosted data storage, user management and authentication, file storage, push notifications, caching/offline sync, and serverless business logic through its Flex (FlexData / FlexFunctions) services. It shipped first-party client SDKs for web, Node.js, iOS/macOS (Swift), Android/Java, Xamarin/.NET, NativeScript, Angular/Ionic, and Cordova/PhoneGap, plus a command-line utility for managing apps, environments, and Flex microservices. Kinvey was acquired by Progress Software; the standalone developer surface has since been retired (kinvey.com redirects into Progress and the GitHub organization was archived in February 2025), though the published SDKs and CLI remain available on their package registries.

providers.name: Knotch
providers.description: Knotch is a New York-based content intelligence company founded by Anda Gansca and Aron Tzimas. Its Knotch One platform measures and optimizes owned-content performance for enterprise marketing teams, and its newer product, Ace, is positioned as AI experience infrastructure for the conversational web: it ingests a brand's existing web properties, content hubs, video and feeds, atomizes them into modular content units tagged by topic, audience, funnel stage and intent, then composes adaptive page experiences for human visitors while emitting structured, citable content for AI agents and answer engines. Named enterprise customers include Google, Deloitte, Ally, Zillow, Cox Automotive, GEICO, Synchrony, Square, Dropbox, FOX and Chime. As of July 2026 Knotch publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification, SDK or package registry presence; access is sales-led.

providers.name: Kuaidian Reading
providers.description: Kuaidian Reading (快点阅读) is a Chinese mobile reading community operated by Beijing Tiantong Interactive Technology Co., Ltd. (Sky Platanus Interactive, 天桐互动), positioning itself as China's first dialogue-based reading app. Instead of long-form web fiction, the platform publishes chat-style novels rendered as character dialogue, which it argues gives clearer characterization, tighter pacing and stronger reader immersion. Content is user-generated at scale — the company claims over 20,000 new novels uploaded daily — and distributed through a decentralized recommendation algorithm rather than editorial merchandising. Social mechanics include barrage-style inline comments, author tipping, and a co-writing mode that lowers the barrier for first-time writers. Authors work in a separate creation console at editor.kuaidianyuedu.com. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Kuaidian Reading publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or /.well-known/ discovery surface; it is a consumer-app company with no developer-facing program.

providers.name: Loyal
providers.description: Loyal (Cellular Longevity, Inc.) is a clinical-stage veterinary biotechnology company developing drugs intended to extend the healthy lifespan of dogs. Its lead programs — including LOY-002 for metabolic dysfunction in senior dogs and LOY-001/LOY-003 for large- and giant-breed dogs — are advancing through the FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine approval process, with more than 1,300 dogs enrolled across clinical studies. Loyal also runs a veterinary Learning Hub for practitioner education. The company is backed by Bain Capital Ventures and First Round Capital. As of this enrichment pass Loyal publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its public web identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Matwings Technology
providers.description: Matwings Technology (天鹜科技) is a global, AI-driven full-stack protein research and development platform. Centered on its self-developed MatwingsVenus general large model for protein design, the company integrates an in-house AI biological design agent (MatwingsVenus Agent), a ten-billion-scale protein sequence dataset (MatwingsVenus Pod), and an automated experimental platform (MatwingsVenus Auto) to deliver an end-to-end paradigm that spans AI design through AI validation. Capabilities include AI-directed evolution, AI enzyme mining, and de novo protein design, applied across affinity fillers and consumables, holistic health, and innovative drug discovery. Matwings is a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company headquartered in Shanghai, with peer-reviewed work at ICLR, NeurIPS, and PNAS. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK is currently published.

providers.name: Mestag Therapeutics
providers.description: Mestag Therapeutics is a clinical-stage immunotherapy company based in Cambridge, UK, developing new treatments for cancer and inflammatory diseases by targeting the understudied role of activated fibroblasts in immune responses. Its lead cancer program, MST-0312, is a targeted LTBR-agonist bispecific antibody designed to drive tertiary lymphoid structure (TLS) formation in solid tumors and is now in the Phase I STARLYS trial. Its inflammatory-disease program, M402, uses agonist antibodies against stromal inhibitory receptors for conditions including rheumatoid arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease, and lupus. Backed by GV, Mestag is a privately held biotech and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Moonwalk Biosciences
providers.description: Moonwalk Biosciences is a biotechnology company pioneering therapeutics in adipose (fat) biology, driven by deep genetic and epigenetic insights. Co-founded by Alex Aravanis (CEO), Arash Jamshidi (President & CTO), Justin Valley (Chief Platform Officer), and CRISPR pioneer Feng Zhang, the company develops epigenetic and siRNA-based programs — including obesity therapies — and is backed by Khosla Ventures, ARCH Venture Partners, Google Ventures, Future Ventures, Alpha Wave Global, and YK Bioventures. Moonwalk does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or API documentation; this profile captures its corporate identity and web presence in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Nchroma Bio
providers.description: nChroma Bio is a genetic medicines company developing durable in vivo therapies by pairing best-in-class genetic cargoes, including epigenetic editing approaches, with targeted delivery technologies for diseases of significant unmet need. Headquartered at 201 Brookline Avenue in Boston, Massachusetts, the company is backed by DCVC and GV. This is a corporate research and therapeutics organization; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Octant Bio
providers.description: Octant (Octant Bio) is a precision-medicine and therapeutics company based in Emeryville, California, founded by Sri Kosuri and Ramsey Homsany. Octant engineers small-molecule drugs that modulate cellular mechanisms behind serious disease, with a focus on protein misfolding and mistrafficking disorders. Its Navigator platform merges synthetic biology, massively parallel experimentation in human cells, high-throughput chemistry, and AI/ML to understand and modulate how target proteins actually behave inside cells. Programs span rare genetic diseases (including autosomal dominant retinitis pigmentosa and Fabry disease), oncology, metabolism, and immunology. Octant is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Catalio Capital Management. As of this profile Octant publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this record captures the company's public web identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: One Assist
providers.description: OneAssist is an Indian consumer protection and services company that provides device and appliance protection, extended warranty, and financial-fraud assistance to retail customers. Its offerings span gadget protection for mobile phones, laptops, wearables, and tablets (accidental damage and extended warranty coverage), home appliance repair and maintenance for air conditioners, televisions, washing machines, refrigerators, water purifiers, and geysers, wallet and card fraud protection, credit-card bill-payment assistance, and furniture, motor, and jewelry insurance plans. The company reports serving over 1.8 crore active customers across 19,000+ pincodes and resolving more than 25 lakh issues. OneAssist is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of this profile, OneAssist publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; it operates a consumer-facing web and mobile experience only.

providers.name: Panta
providers.description: Panta is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage that automates the operations layer of insurance placement. Rather than selling software to brokers, Panta operates as a licensed broker (all 50 states) whose AI operators handle submissions, follow-ups, service, and renewals across file systems, carrier portals, email, phone, and PDFs. It focuses on hard-to-place Excess & Surplus (E&S) and heavy-industry risk — construction and trades, transportation and logistics (trucking fleets, owner-operators, cargo), manufacturing, and hospitality — placing coverage across General Liability, Workers Compensation, Commercial Auto, Property, Cyber, Professional Liability, Umbrella/Excess, and Employment Practices Liability through an A-rated carrier panel. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company. Panta publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: PhaseV
providers.description: PhaseV is a biopharma software company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts that builds AI and machine-learning solutions for clinical-trial optimization. Its platform helps pharmaceutical sponsors and CROs improve trial design, reduce enrollment and cost, shorten timelines, and increase probability of success through simulation and Bayesian adaptive design (Trial Optimizer), biomarker and patient-subgroup identification (Response Optimizer), disease-progression causal analysis (Portfolio Optimizer), site selection and operational analytics (ClinOps Optimizer), and ML-based early-derived endpoint identification. PhaseV publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture. Backed by Accel and Insight Partners.

providers.name: Pheon Therapeutics
providers.description: Pheon Therapeutics is a preclinical-stage oncology biotechnology company developing next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for a wide range of hard-to-treat solid tumors. Leveraging two decades of ADC experience, Pheon arms monoclonal antibodies against both novel and clinically validated targets with warheads from its proprietary payload platform, which offers a novel mechanism of action, or with off-the-shelf linker-payload combinations, balancing safety and efficacy for each target. The company is privately held and backed by specialist healthcare investors. Pheon publishes a corporate and scientific web presence only; it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, documentation, or well-known API discovery surface.

providers.name: Postfix
providers.description: Postfix is a free, open source mail transfer agent (MTA) originally written by Wietse Venema at IBM Research as a fast, secure, and easy-to-administer alternative to Sendmail. It runs on UNIX-like systems including Linux, BSD, and macOS, routing and delivering email over SMTP with extensive support for TLS, SASL, DKIM/SPF/DMARC integration, content filtering, and policy delegation. Postfix is administered via configuration files (main.cf, master.cf) and command-line tools rather than a public HTTP API, and is one of the most widely deployed mail servers on the internet.

providers.name: Preveta
providers.description: Preveta is a healthcare software company that builds an AI-driven care navigation platform and "command center" for specialty clinics. Built on clinical pathways, its software transforms EMR data into actionable insights, giving oncology, urology and gastroenterology practices an entirely new way to view, navigate and manage their patient populations across the cancer care continuum. Preveta is backed by Bullpen Capital and Techstars. As of this profile the company markets a closed clinical SaaS product and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Qualified Health
providers.description: Qualified Health is an enterprise, healthcare-native generative AI platform for health systems. It provides a single integration point into clinical, operational, and financial systems, a library of pre-built and validated AI solutions, an agent and workflow builder, unified real-time governance with audit trails and safety checks, and outcomes tracking across clinical, operational, and financial impact. The company is backed by Menlo Ventures and serves health systems including the University of Texas System, Emory Healthcare, Jefferson Health, University of Rochester Medical Center, and Mercy. No public developer API, SDK, or API reference is published; integration is delivered through enterprise engagements.

providers.name: Randolph-Brooks FCU
providers.description: Randolph-Brooks Federal Credit Union (RBFCU) is a member-owned, not-for-profit federal credit union headquartered in Live Oak, Texas, federally insured by the NCUA and serving more than one million members across Texas and beyond. Chartered as a federal credit union rather than a state or national bank, RBFCU is one of the largest credit unions in the United States by membership and assets, offering retail banking, mortgages, auto loans, credit cards, and deposit products through branches and digital channels. As a member-focused retail institution, RBFCU publishes no first-party public developer program, API documentation, or downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications; consumer-permissioned account data is reached through third-party aggregators (such as Plaid, MX, Finicity, or Akoya) rather than a directly documented open-finance API, and it publishes no stated CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture or documented FDX participation.

providers.name: Reify Health
providers.description: Reify Health is a clinical research technology company whose mission is to remove clinical trial operations as the bottleneck to delivering new therapies to patients. It is the parent organization behind OneStudyTeam, whose StudyTeam platform is a cloud-based patient enrollment and recruitment management system connecting research sites, sponsors, patients, and vendors on a unified workspace, and Care Access, a business unit expanding trial access to underserved communities. StudyTeam is used by roughly 70% of the sponsors running the most clinical trials (including Amgen, AstraZeneca, and Eli Lilly), across 10,000+ research sites in 100+ countries. Reify Health is backed by Altimeter Capital, Battery Ventures, ICONIQ Capital, and Sierra Ventures. No public developer API, developer portal, or API specification was found during enrichment; this profile captures company identity, links, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: sanegenebio
providers.description: SanegeneBio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing RNAi (RNA interference) genetic medicines for metabolic, cardiovascular, and complement-mediated autoimmune diseases, including obesity. Its proprietary LEAD (Ligand and Enhancer Assisted Delivery) platform enables receptor-mediated, targeted delivery of siRNA therapeutics to adipocytes, skeletal myocytes, and other tissues beyond the liver. The company operates as a fully integrated global biotech and has raised over $150 million to advance its pipeline. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a corporate website (about, technology, pipeline, news, contact) but no public developer, API, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Scribe Therapeutics
providers.description: Scribe Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Alameda, California, engineering CRISPR-based genetic medicines through its proprietary "CRISPR by Design" platform. Co-founded by molecular engineers Benjamin Oakes, Brett Staahl, and David Savage alongside CRISPR co-inventor Jennifer Doudna, the company builds highly engineered CasX-derived enzymes — including its X-Editing (XE) molecules for precise gene editing and ELXR epigenetic long-term X-repressor technology for durable gene silencing without altering the underlying DNA sequence. Scribe focuses initially on cardiometabolic disease, the leading cause of death globally, and expands into areas such as sickle cell disease and neurological conditions through strategic pharmaceutical partnerships. The company is backed by a16z and Menlo Ventures and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a venture portfolio company. Scribe Therapeutics is a therapeutics and drug-discovery company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documented API surface.

providers.name: Sequence Bio
providers.description: Sequence Bio is a life sciences and population genomics company based in St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada, focused on discovering the genetic causes of disease to power the development of new medicines. The company leverages the founder-effect genetics of the Newfoundland and Labrador population, running a large-scale Study of the Genetic Causes of Inherited Disease to identify novel drug targets and predictors of treatment response for pharmaceutical partners. Surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company publishes a corporate and research website but does not currently expose a public developer program, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: SigTuple
providers.description: SigTuple Technologies is a medical-technology company that combines artificial intelligence, robotics, microfluidics and high-resolution digital microscopy to automate the microscopic analysis of biological samples across human and veterinary diagnostics. Its product portfolio includes AS76, a CE-IVDR compliant automated digital cell morphology analyzer for peripheral blood smears with true 100X oil immersion; AI100, an FDA- and CE-cleared multi-purpose analyzer for blood smear and urine sediment analysis; and SigVet, an AI point-of-care platform for veterinary clinics. Backed by Accel, the company reports 10+ years of R&D, 27 patents and 350+ deployments globally. As of this enrichment pass SigTuple publishes no public developer/API surface (no docs portal, OpenAPI, /.well-known discovery, or llms.txt were found); this profile captures identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Synaptic
providers.description: Synaptic is a vertical AI solutions company that extends Salesforce and Agentforce environments with pre-built, industry-specific AI agents and applications. Its AQ Platform ships purpose-built agents for healthcare payers and providers (Provider AQ), government citizen services (Citizen AQ), and high-tech customer service (Service AQ), using a value-first methodology that promises measurable results within 30 days and full implementation within 90 days. Synaptic is a managed-delivery solutions and consulting firm rather than a self-service developer platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or technical documentation. Backed by Bloomberg Beta and Ribbit Capital.

providers.name: Tera-ai
providers.description: Tera AI is a San Francisco-based robotics AI company (founded 2023, out of stealth March 2025 with $7.8M seed co-led by Felicis and Inovia) that builds the first unified, software-only spatial reasoning stack for camera-based mapping and navigation across air, onroad, offroad, and sea platforms. Its foundation-model approach delivers GPS-denied, manufacturer-interoperable autonomy that runs on a robot's existing camera and onboard GPU. Tera publishes research (TARDIS/STRIDE) and technical field results but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; this profile captures its public web, research, and GitHub surface.

providers.name: Vegrow
providers.description: Vegrow is a Bengaluru-based B2B fruits marketplace founded in 2020 by IIT alumni that connects Indian fruit farmers with demand outlets across retail channels, using technology to match produce such as apples, bananas, pomegranates, and grapes with buyers, handling grading, sorting, quality assurance, and delivery, and paying farmers digitally. Backed by GIC, Prosus Ventures, Matrix Partners India, Elevation Capital, Lightspeed, and Ankur Capital, it raised a $46M round led by GIC in December 2023. Vegrow publishes no public API or developer program today.

providers.name: Vivodyne
providers.description: Vivodyne is a bio-AI company working to make human biology computable through large-scale human tissue engineering. Its TissueDisk platform cultivates hundreds of self-assembling, vascularized human tissues on a single microfluidic disk, and its autonomous HIVE robotic labs cultivate, perturb, and analyze thousands of tissues to generate multi-modal phenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data at single-cell resolution for pharmaceutical drug discovery and AI model training. The company operates as a B2B partner to pharma and does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Xiudan (Showball)
providers.description: Shenzhen Xiudan Technology Co., Ltd. (深圳秀蛋科技有限公司) is the Chinese company behind Showball (秀蛋), a virtual social "meta" mobile app where users create avatars and socialize in virtual spaces, distributed through the iOS App Store and an Android download on xiudan.net. A Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company, Xiudan publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts as of July 2026 - this profile records the company identity and probe results for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Zalos
providers.description: Zalos is a Y Combinator-backed (F25) company building AI "computer agents" for finance operations. Rather than integrating through APIs, its agents log into a company's existing systems — ERPs, accounting platforms, banks, invoicing and CFO tools such as NetSuite and SAP — and operate the user interface the way a human would, learned from screen recordings. Zalos automates repetitive, multi-step finance workflows including reconciliation, transaction categorization, billing, form filling, month-end close and cross-system KPI reporting, while building a living process graph of an organization's finance operations for documentation and compliance. Founded in 2025 by William Fairbairn (CEO) and Hung Hoang (CTO, previously Apple Pay), the company is based in London and San Francisco and raised a $3.6M seed round led by 14 Peaks. Because Zalos operates entirely through computer-use automation of third-party interfaces, it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs or developer portal.

providers.name: Zauber
providers.description: Zauber is an AI agent platform purpose-built for sea and air freight forwarding operations. Freight forwarders describe their processes in plain language and Zauber's AI agents execute them consistently across global operations, automating rate and booking workflows with exception handling, deploying global workflows with local execution, and giving operators real-time operational visibility into conversion rates, response times, and exception patterns. The platform integrates with existing systems including Office 365, CargoWise One, carrier portals, and proprietary tooling. Zauber is a portfolio company of Point Nine. No public API, developer portal, or developer documentation is currently published; this profile captures the company's identity and security posture.

providers.name: ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.md
providers.description: ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.md is a standardized file convention used in open source repositories to credit third-party software, libraries, inspirations, and other works that a project builds upon or is indebted to. It is a common practice for documenting attribution and provenance, complementing LICENSE, README, CONTRIBUTING, and CODE_OF_CONDUCT files as part of a healthy open source project structure. The file typically lists dependencies, their copyright holders, and the licenses under which they are distributed.

providers.name: AgroMatch
providers.description: AgroMatch is a Chilean agricultural technology (AgTech) platform, founded in 2018 and backed by 500 Global, that connects farmers, agricultural contractors, and machinery owners in a single collaborative marketplace. Often described as the "Airbnb of agricultural machinery," it lets machinery owners lease idle equipment (tractors, implements, portable bins) during low-use periods to farmers in regions whose seasons do not coincide, and lets farmers contract or offer agricultural services such as harvesting, soil preparation, and crop applications. The platform also supports buying and selling new and used machinery, operative leasing, and supplier networking, using artificial intelligence and IoT to match demand for machinery with available supply. AgroMatch reports more than 400 B2B customers across Chile and Perú with operations extending to the US, Colombia, and Mexico. The company operates as a web and mobile application at app.agromatch.cl; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Antigen
providers.description: Antigen is an AI-powered continuous offensive security platform for the enterprise. It deploys autonomous AI penetration-testing agents against production systems every night, maps and exploits the full attack surface, and pairs the automated testing with a monthly human red-team assessment. Findings ship with reproduction steps and remediation guidance delivered directly into engineering tools such as GitHub and Linear. Antigen serves financial services, healthcare, retail, and government sectors, and is a Y Combinator (Fall 2025) company backed by Lightspeed, DST Global, and Susa Ventures.

providers.name: Apptronik
providers.description: Apptronik is an Austin, Texas-based humanoid robotics company founded in 2016 as a spinout from the Human Centered Robotics Lab at the University of Texas at Austin. Co-founded by Jeff Cardenas (CEO), Dr. Nick Paine (CTO), and Dr. Luis Sentis (scientific advisor), the company designs and manufactures Apollo, a general-purpose humanoid robot standing 5'8", weighing 160 lbs, capable of lifting 55 lbs, and running for roughly 4 hours on a swappable battery. Apollo targets warehouse, manufacturing, and logistics applications including trailer unloading, case picking, palletization, machine tending, and workcell delivery. Apptronik has commercial pilot programs and partnerships with Mercedes-Benz (automotive manufacturing logistics), GXO Logistics (multi-phase R&D in U.S. distribution centers), Jabil (supply-chain partner helping scale production and an internal Apollo deployment), and Google DeepMind (Apollo integrates Gemini Robotics vision-language-action models). The company previously built NASA's Valkyrie humanoid and ten-plus other research robots. As of February 2026 Apptronik had raised more than $935M (including a $520M Series A-X extension) at a reported $5B valuation, with investors including B Capital, Google, and Mercedes-Benz. The company sells/leases Apollo to enterprise customers via a direct contact-sales motion and ships a proprietary "point-and-click" control suite for deploying solutions; there is no public developer portal, no published REST/AsyncAPI/gRPC API, no public SDK, no open-source release, and no public GitHub repositories under the `apptronik` org.

providers.name: APX
providers.description: APX (APX Logistics Solutions) is a Southeast Asian less-than-truckload (LTL) digital logistics platform headquartered in Bangkok, with operations in Thailand, Malaysia, and Singapore. It positions itself as the region's first LTL digital logistics provider, offering domestic and cross-border shipping, international sea and air freight, customs brokerage, warehousing and distribution, project logistics, and heavy-lift/breakbulk services. Its proprietary technology platform provides online shipment booking, real-time tracking with ETA notifications, digital proof-of-delivery, AI-assisted route optimization, a driver app, and analytics dashboards including CO2/ESG reporting. APX is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass APX publishes no first-party public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; shipment tracking is currently integrable only via third-party aggregators.

providers.name: Barnes & Noble Education
providers.description: Barnes & Noble Education, Inc. (NYSE: BNED) is one of the largest operators of college bookstores in the United States, operating physical and virtual campus stores alongside digital course-materials and educational services. BNED reaches more than 5.7 million students through 1,125+ physical and virtual stores across higher education and K-12 institutions, primarily through its Barnes & Noble College Booksellers subsidiary and the MBS Textbook Exchange wholesale business. Flagship offerings include the First Day and First Day Complete affordable-access course-materials programs, BNC OER+ digital courseware, faculty adoption tools, campus retail and ecommerce services, and BNC AI Tools. BNED separated from Barnes & Noble, Inc. in August 2015 and is not affiliated with the Barnes & Noble retail bookstore chain. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with BNED. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time; integrations with campus systems and learning-management systems are delivered through institutional partnerships rather than a public API surface.

providers.name: Canary
providers.description: Canary is an AI QA engineer that reads your source code to understand developer intent. Push a pull request and Canary reads the diff, understands the intent, and runs feature and regression tests against your preview app across real browsers, catching broken auth flows, slow page loads, and failing checkouts before they reach production. Built by ex-Google, Windsurf, and Cognition engineers, Canary is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company positioned as the validation layer for AI-generated code.

providers.name: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets)
providers.description: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) is a W3C web standard for describing the presentation of documents written in HTML and XML, including layout, colors, typography, and animations. CSS is a foundational web technology defined by the W3C CSS Working Group and is implemented natively by every major web browser. The CSS Object Model (CSSOM) and CSS Houdini extensibility APIs expose CSS to JavaScript at runtime.

providers.name: Depay
providers.description: Depay (Depayments S.A.) is a Latin American cross-border payment infrastructure company that connects banks, wallets, and fintechs to the region's instant payment rails through a single API integration, enabling real-time international payments with settlement in local currency. Depay bridges interoperability across PIX (Brazil), Transferencias 3.0 (Argentina), Bre-B (Colombia), QR BCR (Peru), and QR BCB (Bolivia), and offers QR-code collection products for online and in-person checkout. Founded in Buenos Aires and backed by Techstars (Payments Powered by Stellar and MoneyGram), the company raised a $4M round to expand its real-time payment network across LATAM.

providers.name: Ethonai
providers.description: EthonAI AG is an ETH Zurich spin-off (founded 2021, Zurich, Switzerland) that builds an Industrial AI Platform — the Manufacturing Analytics System (MAS). It applies Causal AI through a no-code platform so manufacturing engineers can move from reactive dashboards to prescriptive quality and process analytics, deploying models to production in hours. The platform ships as Analyst, Inspector, and Operator modules, is cloud-agnostic (AWS, GCP, Azure), and is API-first: data flows in and out via a REST API, MQTT streaming, and a Python SDK for notebooks and custom applications. EthonAI is used by manufacturers including Siemens, Bosch, Roche, and Lindt & Sprüngli, is part of the Siemens Xcelerator ecosystem, and is backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Earlybird, and Founderful. It does not publish a public API reference or developer portal; its API and SDK are documented inside the authenticated product.

providers.name: FilSekka
providers.description: FilSekka (also styled Felsekka, Android package com.felsekka) is the company behind MammyApp (Mammy.app), an Arabic-language pregnancy calculator and week-by-week pregnancy tracking mobile app for Arab mothers. The app computes a due date and current pregnancy week from a start date, then serves daily, weekly-updated medical content covering fetal development, symptoms, nutrition, exercise, and childbirth, plus an integrated e-commerce shop (shop.mammy.app) selling maternity and baby products with delivery. FilSekka is a consumer B2C mobile product surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface, so this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: Formation Bio
providers.description: Formation Bio (formerly TrialSpark, founded 2016 in New York City) is a tech-driven, AI-native pharmaceutical company that aims to bring new treatments to patients faster and more efficiently. Rather than discovering drugs, Formation Bio in-licenses and acquires clinical-stage drug assets from pharma companies, universities, and biotech firms, then develops them using proprietary technology platforms, process automation, and large language models applied across the drug development lifecycle — patient recruitment, e-consent, data management, monitoring, and biostatistics. The company rebranded from TrialSpark to Formation Bio in 2023 as it moved from a pure clinical-trial software platform to combined platform-plus-asset ownership. It raised a $372M Series D in 2024 and announced a first-in-class AI collaboration with Sanofi and OpenAI. Formation Bio operates hybrid teams across New York City, Boston, the San Francisco Bay Area, and North Carolina's Research Triangle. It is a private company with no public developer API program; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Incite Interactive
providers.description: Incite Interactive is an AI-native gaming studio founded in 2023 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz's Speedrun program, building AI-powered emergent narrative games where the stories players tell matter more than the ones they are told. Its "Everything Story Engine" is an agentic game engine that lets anyone create AI characters and living-world scenarios, powering products such as Embark and Incite Worlds — a roleplaying sandbox of human and AI-driven characters. The founding team are veterans of Zynga, Roblox, and Manticore Games with deep expertise in language models, user-generated content, and live-game operations. There is no public developer API or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures the company's public identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Innovatrix Tech, Corp.
providers.description: Innovatrix Tech, Corp. operates Sahl (getsahl.io), an AI-powered Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform built in the MENA region for MENA organizations. Sahl automates policy generation, control mapping, risk assessment, evidence tracking, vulnerability scanning, and audit preparation across 20+ regulatory frameworks including PDPL, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NCA ECC, and SAMA CSF, aiming to reduce compliance work from months to weeks with an AI DPO assistant and compliance copilot. The company was part of the Sanabil Investments x 500 Global Accelerator (Batch 8). It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company; as of this pass it publishes a marketing site and a customer application login but no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Kakehashi
providers.description: Kakehashi is a Japanese healthcare technology company digitally transforming the country's roughly 60,000 community pharmacies, a traditionally paper-based sector. Its flagship cloud platform Musubi provides electronic medication history, automated dispensing records, and personalized patient guidance, and is used by more than 14,000 pharmacies across Japan. The product suite extends to Musubi Insight (pharmacy management analytics), Pocket Musubi (patient follow-up app), Musubi AI Stock Management (machine-learning demand forecasting and inventory optimization), and Pharmarket. Kakehashi is backed by investors including 500 Global and Goldman Sachs. No public developer API or platform is currently published.

providers.name: Legora
providers.description: Legora is a Stockholm- and London-based legal AI company (formerly Leya) building a collaborative AI workspace for lawyers. The platform is centered on Legora aOS, an agentic operating system that connects information, communication, and the execution of legal work across Agent, Monitors, Lists, Legal Research, Tabular Review, Workflows, and the client-facing Portal, with Word and Outlook add-ins, an Editor, and a mobile app. Legora is sold to elite law firms and in-house legal teams via enterprise contracts; customers include Mannheimer Swartling, Goodwin Procter, Cleary Gottlieb, Linklaters, Bird & Bird, and HWL Ebsworth, with 400+ firms across 40+ countries. There is no public, self-serve developer API, SDK, or open-source release; integrations are arranged through enterprise sales and partnership engagements, and the platform runs on Azure OpenAI Service with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, GDPR, and HIPAA controls.

providers.name: Lithos
providers.description: Lithos Carbon is a deep-tech carbon-removal company that spreads crushed basalt on croplands to accelerate enhanced rock weathering, converting atmospheric CO2 into dissolved bicarbonate that is permanently stored as ocean carbonates. The company pairs soil models and machine learning with agronomic partnerships to maximize durable carbon dioxide removal while improving soil health and crop productivity for farmers, and sells the resulting high-permanence carbon credits to corporate buyers. Surfaced as a Greylock portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; an enrichment pass confirmed the company publishes no public API, SDK, or developer surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Lizee
providers.description: Lizee is a Paris-based Retail-as-a-Service platform that helps brands and retailers launch and operate circular commerce programs — rental, resale, and second-hand — end to end. Its stack pairs a rental platform, a resale/e-commerce platform, and a logistics platform (returns, refurbishment, reverse logistics) behind an operations API so a brand can offer rent or buy-back experiences on top of its existing catalog. Lizee runs a production API (api.lizee.io) and publishes a public Atlassian Statuspage, though it does not expose a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs — the API surface is partner and integration facing. Lizee was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Speedinvest.

providers.name: Moove
providers.description: Moove is a mobility fintech providing revenue-based vehicle financing and ownership programs that let drivers acquire cars, motorcycles, and trucks and build businesses on ride-sharing and delivery partner platforms. Applicants apply to Moove, get verified, and start driving toward owning their vehicle, typically within days. Moove partners with major manufacturers including Hyundai, Toyota, Tesla, Volkswagen, and Bajaj, and centers its model on financial inclusion, gender equality, and a hybrid/EV fleet transition. Backed by DCM Ventures and Speedinvest. Moove publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time; this profile captures the company's public identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Neocis
providers.description: Neocis is a medical robotics company and the maker of Yomi, described as the first and only FDA-cleared robot-assisted dental surgery system. Yomi combines preoperative implant planning software with intraoperative haptic robotic guidance to assist dentists during dental implant placement procedures. The company sells hardware, planning software, and practitioner training to dental practices rather than operating a public developer platform. Neocis is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. As of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Noetik
providers.description: Noetik is an AI-native biotechnology company headquartered in South San Francisco, California, focused on discovering and developing cancer therapies with machine learning. The company has assembled one of the largest multimodal tumor datasets and trained foundation models (including its OCTO world model for cancer biology) to represent tumor microenvironments and simulate spatial biology with virtual cells. Its platform spans human data generation, foundation models, and therapeutic applications aimed at enriching clinical trials, repositioning drugs to the right patient populations, and discovering novel oncology targets. Noetik is backed by DCVC. As of this profile the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; this record captures its public web and organizational surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Path Robotics
providers.description: Path Robotics is a Columbus, Ohio autonomous welding robotics company founded in 2018 by brothers Andy and Alex Lonsberry (CEO and CTO) out of Case Western Reserve University. The company builds AI-powered intelligent welding cells that automate metal fabrication for defense shipyards, utility and energy infrastructure, data centers, and heavy industry. Its core technology is Obsidian, a physical-AI reinforcement-learning agent trained inside Path's proprietary Weld World Model on tens of millions of welded inches; Obsidian runs at the edge of each cell and makes real-time, seam-by-seam welding decisions using a sensor stack of two cameras plus four lasers that deliver sub-millimeter 360-degree awareness around the torch. Path markets the cells with a CapEx-free consumption model and reports 97%+ first-pass yield, 4x productivity, and 30% lower welding costs across customers including HII (America's largest military shipbuilder), Saronic, LAD Services, Tycrop, Mine Rite Technologies, and Millerbernd. In April 2026 Path announced Rove, a mobile welding system mounted on a quadruped platform, extending its addressable geometry beyond fixed-cell applications. The company has raised approximately $271M across Seed through Series D from Drive Capital, Matter Venture Partners, Tiger Global, Addition, and Yamaha Motor Ventures, with the most recent $100M Series D closing in October 2024. Path Robotics has no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface; its GitHub organization contains roughly 50 repositories that are almost entirely upstream open-source forks (ROS, protobuf, abseil, ceres-solver, pytorch3d, etc.) used as internal build dependencies rather than published developer artifacts. Revenue is earned through welding-cell deployments, services, and the consumable weld-output model — not API monetization.

providers.name: Per Vices
providers.description: Per Vices Corporation is a Toronto-based company that designs and manufactures high-performance software defined radio (SDR) platforms, where signal tuning is handled in hardware while the remaining radio functionality runs in software so a single application-agnostic platform can serve many markets. Its product line includes Cyan (up to 16 independent radio chains, near-DC to 18 GHz), Crimson TNG (4 Rx / 4 Tx, near-DC to 6 GHz), Chestnut (near-DC to 9 GHz on an Intel Stratix 10 FPGA), and Calamine (receive-only, near-DC to 40 GHz). Per Vices ships open-source host software and firmware built on the UHD (USRP Hardware Driver) framework rather than a public web API; developers program the radios through the UHD C++ driver, GNU Radio integration, and example applications published on its GitHub org, with full integration support provided directly to customers. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched with company identity and a security probe; it publishes no public REST/OpenAPI web API surface.

providers.name: Personal Capital
providers.description: Personal Capital is a digital wealth management and personal finance company, now operating as an Empower company, that pairs free online money-management tools with paid registered-investment-adviser services. Its Personal Capital / Empower Personal Dashboard app lets individuals link bank, brokerage, retirement, and loan accounts to track net worth, analyze investment fees, plan for retirement, and manage cash flow, while Personal Capital Advisors Corporation (an SEC-registered investment adviser) offers human financial advisors and managed portfolios for clients who link at least $100,000 in investable assets. Personal Capital was acquired by Empower Retirement (Great-West Lifeco / Power Corporation) in 2020. The company is consumer-facing and, as of this enrichment pass, does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Piris Labs
providers.description: Piris Labs is a Y Combinator (W2026) deep-tech startup building the networking layer for AI. The company develops proprietary photonic interconnect technology paired with a vertically optimized software stack that moves data between AI accelerators at ultra-low latency, targeting the bottleneck where up to 80% of advanced AI compute sits idle waiting on slow networking. Piris Labs couples this optical fabric with a full-stack, low-latency inference offering and has reported some of the fastest inference speeds for large frontier models. Founded in San Francisco by Ali Khalatpour (CEO) and Keyvan Moghadam (President), the company currently exposes no public, documented developer API or SDK — its product is delivered as hardware plus a hosted inference stack behind an early-access waitlist. This profile tracks Piris Labs' identity in the API Evangelist network and any future API surface it publishes.

providers.name: Propagate Ventures
providers.description: Propagate (formerly Propagate Ventures) is a regenerative-agriculture company founded in 2017 that helps farmland owners, farmers, and investors design, plant, finance, and manage agroforestry and tree-crop systems. Its flagship SaaS product, Overyield, lets farmers, developers, and investors model tree-crop economics, choose crops, and design tree-crop systems that work alongside existing farm operations. Propagate pairs the software with technical assessments, site prep and planting services, improved tree genetics, and ongoing project monitoring, and is a partner in the USDA Partnerships for Climate-Smart Commodities. The company advises 30,000+ acres of agroforestry supporting over 760,000 trees and shrubs. Propagate publishes no public API or developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Proprio
providers.description: Proprio is a Seattle-based surgical technology company modernizing how surgery is predicted, performed, and perfected by combining physician expertise with immersive, intelligent technology. Its FDA-cleared Paradigm platform fuses proprietary light-field imaging, an array of advanced sensors (the Prism sensor array), and artificial intelligence to build a continuous, real-time 3D model of anatomy during spine and orthopedic procedures. Paradigm delivers radiation-free intraoperative measurement, per-vertebra registration, and structured surgical data capture, reducing radiation exposure while streamlining surgical workflows. Founded in 2016 and backed by DCVC, Proprio is commercializing surgical navigation, real-time surgical intelligence, and a growing surgical data registry. Proprio is a hardware- and software-based medical device company; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: QMC
providers.description: QMC Telecom is a provider of shared telecommunications infrastructure for mobile networks, operating across Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Peru, and Chile. The company develops, owns, operates, and leases indoor connectivity solutions, street-level solutions (SLS), and towers, rooftops, and special sites, positioning itself as a partner in 5G network densification. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub, this is a hardware and telecommunications-infrastructure company that publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Rally Network
providers.description: Rally Network (RLY Protocol, stewarded by the RLY Network Association) is a permissionless, open-source, multi-chain web3 mobile toolkit for developers. It provides natively embedded, self-custodial wallets and gasless (gas station / ERC-2771 relayer) transactions so mobile apps can let users create wallets, transfer tokens, claim NFTs, and deploy or call smart contracts without handling gas or seed phrases. The toolkit ships as first-party SDKs for React Native/Expo, Flutter, and Unity plus TypeScript libraries and a hosted dashboard for API keys and configuration. Rally Network is the successor to the original rally.io social-token platform (creator coins), which decentralized in 2021 and wound down its consumer sidechain in early 2023; the RLY Network Association now maintains the open protocol and developer tooling.

providers.name: Regal Beloit
providers.description: Regal Beloit was a global manufacturer of electric motors, electrical motion controls, power generation, and power transmission products before merging with Rexnord's Process & Motion Control segment in October 2021 to form Regal Rexnord Corporation. Major brands included Marathon, Leeson, Genteq (HVAC brushless DC motors), and Browning (power transmission). Regal Rexnord continues these product lines and is developing the Perceptiv IIoT platform for motor condition monitoring and predictive maintenance.

providers.name: Sainapse
providers.description: Sainapse, built by Bayestree Intelligence, is a unified, explainable AI engine for customer support, outreach, and operations that is embedded directly in an enterprise's environment. It connects to existing integrations to source real-time data for autonomous resolution, grounds every response in verified sources of data, and can act as an agent copilot (next best actions, suggested responses) or as an autonomous agent. Sainapse learns from human-in-the-loop corrections and evolving business rules, supports 220+ integrations, and is offered as a hosted service or deployed on-premises. It publishes SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance. Sainapse is an enterprise, demo-led product with no public self-serve API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: Shenandoah Telecommunications
providers.description: Shenandoah Telecommunications Company (SHEN), doing business as Shentel, is a publicly traded telecommunications company headquartered in Edinburg, Virginia. For over 100 years, Shentel has provided internet, TV, and phone services to residential and business customers across Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Delaware, Ohio, and Indiana. The company operates a digital wireless and wireline network delivering broadband internet, video, and voice services. Through its Glo Fiber and Glo Fiber Business brands, Shentel provides high-speed fiber optic internet, Ethernet, wavelength services, managed network services, and dark fiber leasing to enterprise and wholesale customers. Shentel operates approximately 15,400 route miles of fiber on a MEF-certified network, with connectivity including the Washington D.C. market via CoreSite.

providers.name: SiamSquared
providers.description: SiamSquared Technologies (Thailand) Co., Ltd. is the Bangkok-based company behind StockRadars (stockradars.co), a retail stock-investment analysis platform branded "investing made simple." StockRadars offers mobile apps (iOS and Android, including a paid StockRadars PLUS tier) and a web app for the Thai stock market, with features such as customizable screening "radars," Top100 rankings, income-statement views, shareholder tracking, volume analysis, real-time price alerts, and an in-house news feed (stockradars.news). The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass StockRadars publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation — it is a consumer-facing application, so most machine-readable API artifacts are not applicable and this profile captures identity plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Surglasses Inc.
providers.description: Surglasses Inc. (SURGLASSES) is a medical technology manufacturer of augmented reality surgical guidance systems and medical education products. Its portfolio includes AR-guided surgical navigation for orthopedic, spine, and neurosurgery procedures (the Foresee-X AR surgical glasses), 3D computer surgical navigation and planning software, and the Asclepius AI Table and Virtual Dissection Table for anatomy, radiology, and histopathology education. Backed by 500 Global. The company operates as a B2B medical-device manufacturer and publishes no public developer, API, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Synphony
providers.description: Synphony builds and deploys robots that work in the real world, combining AI, robotics, and human-in-the-loop systems so machines can perform practical physical tasks across agriculture, assembly, and inspection. Its platform trains AI models on real-world data, tests robot performance in realistic scenarios, and deploys systems into production. The company's first application is autonomous strawberry-harvesting robots plus farm software services (bed-level analytics, data-pipeline integration, and agentic solutions), targeting California's roughly $3B strawberry industry where labor is about 60% of costs. Founded in 2025 and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026), Synphony runs a customer-facing platform at app.synphony.co but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: TD Bank Group
providers.description: TD Bank Group (The Toronto-Dominion Bank) is one of Canada's Big Six chartered banks — a federally regulated Schedule I bank headquartered in Toronto and listed on the TSX and NYSE under the ticker TD. It is among North America's largest banks by assets, serving roughly 27 million customers worldwide across Canadian Personal & Commercial Banking (TD Canada Trust), U.S. Retail (TD Bank, N.A. — America's Most Convenient Bank, a separately profiled entity), and Wholesale Banking (TD Securities). Like the rest of Canada's banking sector, TD's open-finance posture is voluntary: Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking framework was legislated in 2024 (Consumer-Driven Banking Act) but is not yet operational, so the Canadian parent exposes no first-party public developer API. Consumer financial-data access today is aggregator-based — TD signed a North American data-access agreement with Plaid in December 2023 — while payments run over the shared Canadian rails (Interac e-Transfer and Payments Canada's Real-Time Rail, with Interac as the RTR exchange solution provider). The FDX-aligned, Akoya-based open-banking API suite published at developer.td.com belongs to the U.S. subsidiary TD Bank, N.A., not this Canadian entity.

providers.name: Tomo Guides
providers.description: Tomo Guides is the home-buying guide and educational content produced by Tomo Mortgage (tomo.com), a consumer digital mortgage lender backed by a16z. Tomo offers home purchase mortgages and refinancing with $0 lender fees and rates advertised at roughly 0.25% below the market median, alongside its TrueRate tool that shows a fair rate before applying and state-by-state interest-rate pages. The "Guides" surface is Tomo's home-buying-guide blog content aimed at first-time and repeat buyers, not a developer product. As of this enrichment pass Tomo publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, documentation site, or .well-known metadata; the company's web presence is entirely consumer-facing. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and is retained as a company record with no API artifacts.

providers.name: Transfix
providers.description: Transfix is a New York-based freight technology company that, since divesting its brokerage operation to NFI Industries in June 2024, operates as a SaaS and data company providing AI-powered Transportation Management System (TMS) software to freight brokers, third-party logistics providers (3PLs), shippers, and carriers across the United States. The Transfix TMS unifies pricing, planning, execution, and billing in a single platform, with feature areas covering Smart Pricing and Quoting, RFP Management and Collaboration, Coverage and Carrier Management, Streamlined Scheduling, Operations and Automation, Invoicing and Payments, and Reporting and Insights. Core AI capabilities include the Custom Rate Prediction Suite for spot and contract pricing across Dry Van, Reefer, and Flatbed equipment, and the RFP Workflow with a Smart Upload feature that structures bid data from heterogeneous file formats. Transfix markets integrations with existing TMS, carrier networks, and data sources, and references freight API integrations in marketing material, but does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or open-source repositories. NFI Industries is the platform's anchor third-party customer following the brokerage divestiture.

providers.name: Warby Parker
providers.description: Warby Parker (NYSE: WRBY) is a direct-to-consumer eyewear and vision care company founded in 2010, selling prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, contact lenses, and eye exams online and across 900+ retail stores. It operates a headless, modular commerce architecture and a proprietary point-of-sale system (Point of Everything), plus consumer-facing tools like Virtual Vision Test and PD measurement. Warby Parker does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its API surface (api.warbyparker.com) is internal. The company does publish a public llms.txt for AI agents and an RFC 9116 security.txt with a bug-bounty contact. This API Evangelist profile captures that agent-facing and security posture; there is no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI or SDK surface to harvest.

providers.name: Werner Enterprises
providers.description: Werner Enterprises is a leading transportation and logistics company providing truckload transportation services, logistics solutions, and supply chain management throughout North America. Founded in 1956 and headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, Werner operates one of the largest fleets in the United States and offers freight brokerage, dedicated carriage, intermodal, and final-mile delivery services through its Werner Bridge℠ digital freight platform.

providers.name: Whole Surplus
providers.description: Whole Surplus (now operating as Fazla) is a Turkish technology-based waste management and circular-economy company backed by Techstars. It prevents waste at its source and recovers surplus products back into the circular economy with maximum environmental, social, and economic benefit across the entire supply chain from producers to consumers. Its platform combines an AI-powered analysis tool that identifies the optimal recovery path for each product with services including Fazla Market (discounted resale), donations to food banks, animal-feed conversion, recycling, a smart-scale detection system, and sustainability consultancy. Fazla is the first B Corp certified waste-management company in Turkey and is supported by the UN Development Programme (UNDP). The company operates a customer web application (app.fazla.com) but publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: Wildcard
providers.description: Wildcard is a PvP collectible-card-based MOBA (multiplayer online battle arena) developed by Playful Studios and currently in Early Access on Steam. Players pick Champions, assemble decks of Summon creature cards, and compete in real-time strategic arena battles where deck-building matters as much as mechanical skill. The game ships collectible cosmetics (Wildpass, Flair, Wildfile) with a web3 angle — the Wildpass is a Polygon NFT collection tradeable on Magic Eden — and is backed as a portfolio company of the crypto venture firm Paradigm. Its backend gaming services are built on Beamable and Unreal Engine. No first-party public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal is published; this profile is a company/lead record in the API Evangelist network. Sector: gaming.

providers.name: AssetWorks
providers.description: AssetWorks is an enterprise fleet and asset management software company with more than 40 years of history and over 1,000 customers across commercial and private fleets, government and public works, and higher education. Its products include FleetFocus fleet and enterprise asset management (EAM), Active Assets fixed-asset tracking, Recoup Ops surplus management, and Scan and Validate mobile inventory management. AssetWorks sells on-premise and hosted enterprise software to large fleet and facility operators; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or self-serve API program. This repo is a company profile in the API Evangelist network, backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Aurorin CAD
providers.description: Aurorin CAD is a San Francisco company building a modern mechanical CAD application for engineers and hardware teams, founded in 2026 by Michael Baron and backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2026 batch). Rather than layering on top of the geometry kernels that underpin incumbent tools such as SolidWorks, NX, Creo, CATIA, Fusion 360 and Onshape, Aurorin has written its own parametric, B-Rep driven CAD kernel designed to exploit modern multi-core CPUs and GPUs and to be AI-native from the foundation rather than as a bolted-on assistant. The product ships as a native desktop application for macOS and Windows, pairing conventional direct and parametric editing with an integrated AI agent driven through a chat interface, with the stated goal of collapsing modeling work that traditionally takes twenty minutes into seconds and avoiding the slow rebuilds and cascading feature breakage common to older parametric systems. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or API documentation; its public surface is a marketing site, a blog, an about/contact page, and careers listings.

providers.name: Beisen
providers.description: Beisen (北森) is a China-based enterprise software company and the country's largest cloud-native Human Capital Management (HCM) and talent-management SaaS provider, delivered through its iTalent platform. Its integrated suite spans recruiting and applicant tracking, talent assessment and psychometric testing, performance and goals (OKR), core HR and personnel records, compensation, learning and development, and succession planning for large enterprises. Beisen operates an Open Platform (open.italent.cn) that lets partners and customers integrate HR data and workflows into the iTalent ecosystem via web APIs. The company is publicly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (9669) and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company.

providers.name: Bug Labs
providers.description: Bug Labs is a New York City enterprise software company founded in 2006, first as one of the earliest open-source modular hardware makers and later as an enterprise IoT platform provider serving Fortune 500 customers including Verizon, Comcast, VMware, Ford, Charter and Orange. Its current flagship product, Signalpattern, targets workflow fragmentation by mapping and connecting dispersed enterprise systems, automating cross-system tasks, and letting users interact with APIs directly without writing code. Bug Labs previously operated the well-known public IoT APIs dweet.io, dweetpro.io and freeboard.io; all three are decommissioned and the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation or public API today. Backed by Union Square Ventures, Spark Capital and Court Square Ventures.

providers.name: BuyBuddy
providers.description: BuyBuddy is an AI-powered retail merchandising platform positioned as an "AI Merchandiser that tracks, thinks & acts for you." It automates in-store operations for retailers and brands, including planogram compliance and shelf monitoring via computer vision, stockout prevention, product placement optimization, dynamic pricing and promotions, demand forecasting, store transfers, and shopper-behavior analysis through smart tags. BuyBuddy is a portfolio company of 500 Global. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; at time of enrichment BuyBuddy publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDK, or specification surface, so this remains a company-level profile.

providers.name: CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog)
providers.description: CHANGELOG.md is a community convention for a human-readable, Markdown- formatted file at the root of a project that records notable changes between versions. The leading specification is "Keep a Changelog" by Olivier Lacan, which defines a stable, opinionated set of section headings (Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security) and recommends pairing with Semantic Versioning (SemVer). The format is widely adopted across open source and enterprise projects as the de facto way to document API and software releases in a way that is readable by humans and parseable by tooling.

providers.name: Clinc
providers.description: Clinc is a conversational AI platform for banking and financial services, founded in 2015 in Ann Arbor, Michigan. It provides the Natural Language Understanding (NLU), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Natural Language Generation (NLG) engine behind virtual assistants and chatbots, and is ASR/TTS-agnostic so it can be connected to phone, mobile, web, or smart-speaker devices. Once a user utterance is converted to text, Clinc's AI engine interprets intent and calls the appropriate third-party systems (such as an external database) to answer or carry out an action. Clinc has been deployed with customers including USAA, Ford, Barclays, and İşbank, and is backed by Insight Partners, Drive Capital, and eLab Ventures. NOTE — Clinc's public developer surface (clinc.com and api.clinc.com) is offline as of 2026-07-18: the clinc.com AWS Route53 delegation is dangling and its authoritative nameservers return REFUSED, so the domain resolves SERVFAIL everywhere. The documentation and API URLs recorded here are the genuine published locations, recoverable via the Internet Archive.

providers.name: Council on Environmental Quality
providers.description: The Council on Environmental Quality (CEQ) is an office within the Executive Office of the President of the United States that coordinates federal environmental policy, advises the President on environmental and natural resource policies, and oversees the implementation of the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA). CEQ does not publish a public developer API. Federal NEPA documents and related environmental data are surfaced through partner federal agencies and platforms (NEPAtool, the Federal Permitting Dashboard, regulations.gov, EPA EJScreen, and the Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool).

providers.name: CruxOCM
providers.description: CruxOCM is a midstream automation software company that delivers closed-loop, real-time process control for oil and gas pipeline operations. Its Industrial Automation Hub (IAH) runs on top of existing SCADA and DCS infrastructure to automate control-room procedures, unlock asset throughput, reduce operating expenses, and improve safety without adding headcount. Product families include pipeBOT, gatherBOT and draBOT for pipeline, gathering and drag-reduction automation, and maxOPT, leanOPT and powerOPT for throughput, cost and power optimization, alongside a Deployment Manager, Log Analyser and Status Dashboard. CruxOCM is headquartered in Houston, Texas and closed a $17M Series A in 2024 led by Microsoft's M12 venture fund. This company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Electio
providers.description: Electio (Electio Technologies) is a San Francisco-based, General Catalyst-backed software company building modern control-system software for energy production and transportation infrastructure. The company modernizes the legacy industrial control layers behind power generation, oil and gas, and transportation networks with next-generation software for monitoring, automation, and operational reliability. Electio is an early-stage, largely stealth company: it publishes a company website, a careers page, a contact page, and a privacy policy, but has not released a public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation as of this profile. This entry was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and enriched as an identity-only lead.

providers.name: Firefly Aerospace
providers.description: Firefly Aerospace is an end-to-end space transportation company building the Alpha small-lift rocket, the Eclipse (formerly MLV) medium-lift vehicle, the Blue Ghost lunar lander, and the Elytra orbital vehicle (with the Ocula lunar imaging service). Firefly sells launch, lunar delivery, and on-orbit services through sales and payload-user-guide channels; it does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Getaround
providers.description: Getaround was a peer-to-peer and connected car-sharing marketplace (merged with France's Drivy in 2019) that let owners list personal or fleet vehicles fitted with Getaround Connect - a BLE/telematics smart-lock kit - for keyless, app-based rental. Getaround historically ran a documented Owner API and webhook program for fleet-management partners (CarSync, FleetWire, Invers Fleet Hawk) plus a native Connect Blueforce BLE SDK for lock/unlock. OPERATING STATUS (as of 2026-07-03) - the company is winding down - it shut down U.S. operations (including its HyreCar subsidiary) in February 2025, sold its European car-sharing business to Denmark's GoMore ApS effective April 30, 2026, and Getaround Inc.'s board voted June 5, 2026 to pursue formal Delaware dissolution and liquidation (stockholder vote July 29, 2026, no distribution expected).
