The api.getaround.com API host no longer resolves and its owner API documentation page is now empty, so the API described here is historical/discontinued rather than currently operable.

providers.name: Glint
providers.description: Glint is an employee-engagement and organizational-health platform built on people-science pulse surveys, manager dashboards, and action-planning analytics. Founded in 2013 and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Shasta Ventures, Glint was acquired by LinkedIn in 2018 and subsequently folded into Microsoft, where it now ships as Microsoft Viva Glint within the Microsoft Viva employee-experience suite. The original glintinc.com domain now redirects to Microsoft, and the product is administered through the Microsoft 365 tenant and Microsoft Entra ID rather than a standalone public developer API; Glint does not publish an independent OpenAPI, REST API reference, or developer portal.

providers.name: Govport
providers.description: GovPort is a Software-as-a-Service platform built specifically for government contractors (GovCons) to manage subcontractor performance, compliance, and collaboration. It centralizes critical contract records, sends primes and subs automated requirements to keep every party compliant, and lets GovCons securely share and manage deliverables with one another across teams. Positioned as subcontractor management software for the federal contracting ecosystem, GovPort emphasizes high levels of data privacy and security. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors and added to the API Evangelist network; the company references APIs in its terms of service but does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: HomeLight
providers.description: HomeLight is a San Francisco–based real-estate technology company that matches home buyers and sellers with top-performing local real-estate agents and operates a stack of consumer-facing products that span the entire residential transaction: agent matching, Simple Sale cash-offer marketplace, Buy Before You Sell (BBYS) bridge financing, HomeLight Home Loans (NMLS #1529229), the HomeLight HELOC Card, and HomeLight Closing Services for title and escrow. The company ranks agents using historical performance data on home sales (price, speed, volume, geography, property type) and routes consumer leads to a curated network of agents, lenders, and cash-buyer investors. HomeLight exposes a private Partner API to lenders, brokerages, CRMs, and marketing partners (NerdWallet is its largest partner) for submitting leads (`/api/partner_lead/v2`), Simple Sale seller leads (`/leads/partner_simple_sale_lead`), and duplicate-lead checks (`/api/partner_dupe_lead_check`); credentials are issued on a per-partner basis via support@homelight.com. Beyond the Partner API, HomeLight has direct integrations with most major real-estate agent CRMs (Follow Up Boss, BoomTown, Sierra Interactive, Firepoint, Real Geeks, Brivity, Chime, LionDesk, KW Command). HomeLight has no public, self-service developer portal — the Partner API is gated by a commercial relationship, and there is no public OpenAPI spec, SDK, or open-source client published by the company.

providers.name: Infleqtion
providers.description: Infleqtion is a Louisville/Boulder, Colorado quantum-technology company — formerly ColdQuanta — that builds neutral-atom quantum computers, precision atomic clocks, and quantum sensors for governments, corporations, and research institutions. Its computing portfolio spans Sqale (a full-stack, fault-tolerant neutral-atom quantum computer), Quantum Cores (ready-to-use neutral-atom systems for laboratories), and Superstaq, an open-source quantum software platform with proprietary cross-layer optimization that compiles Qiskit, Cirq, and OpenQASM circuits down to hardware-native operations and routes them across heterogeneous quantum backends. Infleqtion's sensing portfolio includes the Tiqker optical atomic clock, Quantum Spectrum (Rydberg atomic spectrum sensing), and inertial sensors for GPS-denied positioning. The company was founded in 2007 as ColdQuanta, rebranded to Infleqtion in November 2022 after absorbing the Super.tech quantum-software acquisition, and became Infleqtion, Inc. (NASDAQ: INFQ) in January 2026. Superstaq (qiskit-superstaq, cirq-superstaq, general-superstaq) is the only developer-facing public surface; the hardware and sensing businesses are sold via direct engagement and government contracts rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Jumia
providers.description: Jumia is a pan-African e-commerce company often described as the "Amazon of Africa." Headquartered in Berlin and listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker JMIA since its 2019 IPO, Jumia Technologies AG operates a third-party marketplace, a logistics network (Jumia Logistics), and a digital payments arm (JumiaPay) across eight African markets as of 2026: Egypt, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Morocco, Nigeria, Senegal, and Uganda. The company exited Algeria in February 2026 and previously wound down Cameroon, Gabon, Rwanda, and Tunisia as part of a multi-year restructuring program targeting full-year profitability in 2027. Jumia's commerce platform connects more than 100,000 sellers with consumers across diverse categories including phones and electronics, fashion, home and living, beauty, FMCG, and groceries. Its developer surface is non-trivial: the Jumia Vendor API (vendor center, OAuth 2.0) supports order, inventory, product, and shipment integration for marketplace sellers, while the legacy SellerCenter API (a SellerCenter / Rocket Internet lineage shared with Lazada and Daraz) remains documented with PHP, Python, Ruby, and Node SDKs. JumiaPay exposes a Merchant API for payment creation, verification, refund, recurring-payment agreements, and callback-based webhooks, plus official WooCommerce and Magento payment-gateway plugins. The Jumia GitHub organization is sparse (an open-source playbook, Jumia Tech Blog, and Tech in Porto event site) while the JumiaPay AIG GitHub org hosts the WooCommerce and Magento gateway plugins under Apache 2.0.

providers.name: Kaiser Permanente
providers.description: One of the largest nonprofit health plans in the United States integrating health insurance with healthcare delivery. Serves over 12 million members through its network of hospitals, medical offices, and health plan services. Publishes a patient access FHIR API at kp.org/fhir in compliance with the CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Final Rule.

providers.name: Locusrobotics
providers.description: Locus Robotics is a warehouse automation company that builds autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and the LocusONE platform, a data-science-driven system for enterprise-wide AMR deployments and warehouse performance management. Its fleet (Locus Array, Origin, and Vector robots) plus integrated software supports robots-to-goods and autonomous fulfillment across 3PL, retail, healthcare, and industrial operations. LocusONE integrates with leading WMS platforms through the LocusConnect middleware, a REST API secured with OAuth 2.0 and documented as OpenAPI 2.0 via SwaggerUI; API access is provisioned per customer rather than published as an open developer program. Locus Robotics is backed by Bond Capital and maintains an active open-source presence in the ROS (Robot Operating System) ecosystem on GitHub.

providers.name: Mitchell & Ness
providers.description: Vintage and throwback sports apparel brand founded in Philadelphia in 1904. Holds league-licensed agreements with the NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, and MLS to produce authentic reproduction jerseys, snapback hats, varsity jackets, hoodies, and shorts. Acquired in February 2022 by Fanatics, Inc. alongside investors Jay-Z (Marcy Venture Partners), LeBron James / Maverick Carter (SpringHill Co), and Kevin Hart.

providers.name: MXML
providers.description: MXML (Magic XML) is a declarative XML-based markup language used in Adobe Flex for creating user interfaces and applications, allowing developers to define UI components and layouts in an XML format. It is a UI markup language, not a network API.

providers.name: NEO TECH MOBILITY HOLDINGS LIMITED
providers.description: NEO TECH MOBILITY HOLDINGS LIMITED (Neo Mobility) is a UAE-based B2B electric-mobility startup driving sustainable transportation across the MENA region. Neo bundles electric-vehicle fleets, charging infrastructure, an integrated fleet/driver/operations/energy management platform, driver-safety programs, and human-capital support into a single subscription-based ecosystem — delivering EV Delivery-as-a-Service for e-commerce, food delivery, and last-mile logistics, alongside e-taxi mobility. The company publishes no public developer or API program; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network discovery.

providers.name: Pipelinedb
providers.description: PipelineDB was a high-performance PostgreSQL extension for continuous, incremental aggregation of time-series data using continuous SQL views, avoiding the need to store raw event data. It also offered Stride, a hosted streaming-analytics API with first-party Python, JavaScript, and Go client SDKs, plus extensions for Apache Kafka and Amazon Kinesis ingestion. The company joined Confluent in 2019; the open-source extension reached a final 1.0.0 release (Apache-2.0) and is now archived, while the pipelinedb.com website and the hosted Stride service have been retired. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of DCVC.

providers.name: Properly
providers.description: Properly was a Toronto-based Canadian digital real estate brokerage founded in 2018 that began as one of the country's only iBuyers — making algorithmic cash offers on Calgary homes — before pivoting to Sale Assurance, a guaranteed-purchase backstop that let a seller buy their next home before selling the current one, wrapped around an online listing search and a machine-generated home valuation. It sat in the challenger layer of the Canadian value chain alongside HouseSigma, Wahi, and Zolo, competing on visibility into listing data controlled by CREA, the national cooperative that operates REALTOR.ca and the Data Distribution Facility (DDF) syndicating member boards' listings, in a market where land registration is provincially privatised and the public record is itself a commercial product. Properly was acquired by Pine Canada Financial Corporation in October 2023 and the brand has since been absorbed: properly.ca and www.properly.ca now answer HTTP 301 from an Amazon S3 and CloudFront redirect bucket to www.pine.ca, and the word "Properly" no longer appears anywhere on the surviving Pine real estate pages. Its API posture is closed and, as of this profile, non-existent. No developer portal, no API program page, no partner or data licensing page, and no published terms of API use were found. The developer., developers., api., docs., app., and blog. subdomains of properly.ca do not resolve in DNS, and every contract path probed — /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs, /$metadata, /odata — redirects into a Pine 404. The successor host api.pine.ca resolves to an AWS API Gateway that answers every path with HTTP 403 MissingAuthenticationTokenException: a private first-party backend, not a developer product. RESO is absent, which is the honest Canadian answer — Properly and Pine appear nowhere on RESO's own Canadian membership roster, and no Web API or Data Dictionary certification, OData $metadata document, or Universal Property Identifier usage was observed. No open, unlicensed dataset is published. The underlying listings reach the platform through licensed channels — CREA MLS trademark attribution appears in the site footer and listing media is served from cdn.repliers.io, the CDN of the licensed MLS data vendor Repliers, whose own developer guide names "Pine (formerly Properly)" as a customer — which is a brokerage and vendor licensing posture, not anything a third-party developer can sign up for.

providers.name: QuidelOrtho
providers.description: QuidelOrtho is a diagnostics company that transforms diagnostic data into action across the entire healthcare spectrum, from home testing to hospital laboratories. The company offers over 550 assays in more than 140 countries and territories. QuidelOrtho maintains technical documentation libraries, customer portals (MyQuidel and Ortho Plus), and a comprehensive Instructions for Use library for healthcare professionals.

providers.name: Sea Group (Sea Limited)
providers.description: Sea Limited is a Singapore-headquartered consumer internet holding company that operates three core businesses across Southeast Asia, Taiwan, and Latin America: Shopee (e-commerce), Garena (digital entertainment and game publishing), and SeaMoney / Monee (digital financial services including SeaBank, ShopeePay, and SPayLater). Sea Limited is publicly listed on the NYSE (ticker: SE). Sea does not publish a unified group-level developer API — each operating subsidiary maintains its own developer platform: Shopee Open Platform (open.shopee.com) for marketplace integrations, Garena for game-platform partners, and SeaMoney / ShopeePay for in-region payment integrations.

providers.name: Sec3
providers.description: Sec3 (formerly Soteria) is a Solana-native security firm, founded in 2021, providing smart-contract security audits, formal verification, and post-deployment on-chain monitoring for high-stakes protocols and institutions building on Solana. The team combines manual security review by experienced researchers with automated tooling and formal methods, and maintains open-source tools including the X-Ray static analysis scanner and IDL Guesser. Sec3 has secured protocols such as the Solana Foundation, Wormhole, Kamino Finance, Helium Network, Jupiter, Orca, Metaplex, and Solana Mobile, publishes an annual Solana Security Ecosystem Report, and offers free nonce and multisig monitoring tooling. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Multicoin Capital and enriched from Sec3's public surface; it is a security-services firm with no self-serve public API.

providers.name: SST
providers.description: SST is an open source TypeScript framework for building full-stack applications on your own infrastructure. Originally known as Serverless Stack, it now ships as a single `sst.config.ts` file that uses Pulumi and Terraform providers under the hood to deploy components across AWS, Cloudflare, and 150+ other providers. SST covers Lambda functions, containers, queues, buckets, databases, cron jobs, and front-end frameworks like Next.js, Remix, Astro, and SvelteKit, with resource linking that wires components together without hardcoded ARNs. SST Console adds a hosted dashboard for logs, issues, deployments, and autodeploy from Git.

providers.name: Tahoe
providers.description: Tahoe (Tahoe Therapeutics) is a San Francisco AI-biotech company building "the ground truth for biological superintelligence." It generates gigascale perturbative single-cell datasets and trains foundation models of the human cell to design therapeutics, starting with cancer. Flagship open assets include Tahoe-100M — the largest interventional single-cell dataset to date (100M+ transcriptomes across ~1,100 chemical perturbations and 50 cancer cell lines) — and Tahoe-x1, a family of perturbation-trained single-cell foundation models with up to 3 billion parameters, released fully open-source with open weights plus training and evaluation code. Tahoe's Mosaic platform makes in vivo, single-cell-resolution data generation scalable. Backed by General Catalyst and Wing Venture Capital, Tahoe publishes no commercial REST API; its programmatic surface is open-source models, datasets, and the first-party tahoe-x1 Python library.

providers.name: Tahoe Therapeutics
providers.description: Tahoe Therapeutics (formerly Vevo Therapeutics) is a South San Francisco digital-biology company building the "ground truth for biological superintelligence." Its Mosaic platform generates perturbative single-cell data in vivo at gigascale, and it trains AI models — including the Tahoe-x1 single-cell foundation model (up to 3 billion parameters) and the Rhaister family of perturbation-response models — on the resulting data to discover novel drug targets and predict how patient cells respond to drugs. Tahoe openly publishes datasets (including the 100-million-cell Tahoe-100M atlas) and model weights on Hugging Face, ships the tahoe-x1 Python package on PyPI, and operates Tara, an autonomous research agent. The company does not run a public REST API. Backed by Amplify Partners; raised $30M in 2025.

providers.name: Transform
providers.description: Transform (Transform Data) was a metrics-store and semantic-layer company backed by Redpoint Ventures that offered a metrics framework, a metrics catalog, and the MQL (Metrics Query Language) API, and open-sourced the MetricFlow metrics framework. Transform was acquired by dbt Labs (announced February 2023), and its technology lives on as MetricFlow and the dbt Semantic Layer. transform.co now returns a 308 Permanent Redirect to getdbt.com on every path, and the company no longer operates an independent API or developer surface — see the dbt provider profile in this network for the successor APIs.

providers.name: Urban Machine
providers.description: Urban Machine is a GV-backed robotics company building AI and computer-vision powered machines that remove metal fasteners (nails, staples, and screws) from construction and demolition lumber waste, reclaiming it for premium wood products and circular-economy reuse. The company publishes no public API, but maintains an open-source ROS/Python robotics tooling footprint on GitHub, including the colcon-poetry-ros package on PyPI.

providers.name: Visual Studio Code
providers.description: Visual Studio Code is a free, open-source, cross-platform code editor developed by Microsoft for Windows, Linux, macOS, and the web, built on the MIT-licensed Code - OSS project and distinguished by features such as IntelliSense, debugging, integrated Git, and a marketplace with tens of thousands of extensions. VS Code is not a SaaS REST API; instead, developers extend the editor through the Extension API, a TypeScript / JavaScript programmatic interface that exposes nearly every aspect of the editor for customization. This index points to the Extension API documentation and surrounding developer resources.

providers.name: Voxeet
providers.description: Voxeet was a San Francisco-based startup that built spatial-audio voice and video conferencing APIs and SDKs for web and mobile applications, backed by 500 Global. Dolby Laboratories acquired Voxeet in 2019 and rebranded its technology as the Dolby.io Communications APIs and SDKs. That surface has since been retired -- the voxeet GitHub org archived all 88 repositories on 2024-08-30 and the Dolby.io Communications documentation now redirects to Dolby OptiView. This profile preserves the historical record; see the dolby and dolby-io profiles for the successor platform.

providers.name: Yipitdata
providers.description: YipitData is a market-intelligence and alternative-data company that delivers daily insights on consumer behavior, market share, pricing, and company performance to the world's largest hedge funds, investors, brands, and retailers. Its Proprietary Data Network combines owned-and-operated B2C and B2B panels with 40+ always-on sources (consumer receipts, card transactions, B2B and cloud spend, web-scraped signals), analyzed on a Databricks/Delta Lake lakehouse and delivered through data-sharing, hosted apps, and its AI-powered Insight Agent rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Alluva
providers.description: Alluva operates a global analyst marketplace centered on cryptocurrency and digital-asset price predictions. Users forecast the future price of assets such as Bitcoin and Ethereum across timeframes from 24 hours to six months, follow leading analysts, and earn redeemable rewards for accurate forecasts with no upfront investment. Asset pages surface detailed analysis and Buy/Hold/Sell recommendations. Alluva also packages its predictive market data for B2B customers - data providers, media houses, and financial institutions - with named clients including 500 Global, Refinitiv, Thomson Reuters, Economic Times, and Times of India. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is published at this time.

providers.name: American Water Works
providers.description: American Water Works Company is the largest publicly traded U.S. water and wastewater utility company, providing drinking water, wastewater, and other related services to approximately 14 million people in more than 1,700 communities across 14 states. The company operates through regulated utility subsidiaries and offers customer self-service through its MyWater online portal and mobile app.

providers.name: Anywhere 2 Go
providers.description: Anywhere 2 Go Co., Ltd. is a Bangkok, Thailand insurtech company and the maker of Claim Di, a mobile application ecosystem that streamlines motor insurance claims and vehicle inspection between drivers, independent surveyors, and insurance companies. Its flagship "Shake and Go" (K4K) feature lets two Claim Di users resolve minor accidents on the spot, while Emergency Alert, self-service Car Inspection, photo-based Non-Accident Claims, and the Claim Di Bike surveyor-dispatch program cut claim processing time and help insurers reduce fraud. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. Claim Di is a consumer/B2B mobile product (iOS and Android); no public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Atmosplay
providers.description: Atmosplay was a mobile advertising technology company, founded in 2014 in Budapest, Hungary, that built interactive 3D "playable" ads and an ad-monetization platform for mobile game publishers. Its ATMIQ cloud gameplay engine let users try a game inside an ad without installing it, and its self-serve builder produced playable creatives for 3D and action games. Atmosplay shipped first-party mobile SDKs (Unity, iOS, Android) plus AdMob and MoPub mediation adapters for publishers to integrate interstitial, banner, and rewarded-video formats. Speedinvest led its Series A in 2016; the company was acquired by ZPLAY Information Technology on 2018-01-01. Its websites (atmosplay.com / atmosplay.net) are no longer operational; the surviving public developer surface is its GitHub organization of SDK and adapter repositories. This profile is maintained for network completeness as an acquired/inactive portfolio lead.

providers.name: AVI Networks
providers.description: AVI Networks builds a software-defined application delivery platform - the Avi Vantage Platform / Avi Load Balancer - providing multi-cloud load balancing, web application firewall (WAF), GSLB, container ingress, and analytics driven by a central Avi Controller with a fully programmable REST API. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, AVI Networks was acquired by VMware in 2019 and the product is now offered by Broadcom as the VMware Avi Load Balancer. The controller exposes a comprehensive REST API with first-party Python, Go, and Java SDKs, a Terraform provider, and Ansible automation for intent-based, self-service application services across VMware, AWS, Azure, GCP, OpenStack, and bare-metal environments.

providers.name: Ayannah
providers.description: Ayannah (Ayannah Information Systems, Inc.) is a Philippines-based fintech company providing digital finance and digital commerce services to the emerging middle class across emerging markets, many of whom are migrants and/or unbanked. It operates a market-proven stack of digital financial services spanning payments, commerce, and analytics, reporting 10K+ touchpoints and 50M+ transactions processed. Marquee products include Sendah Direct (a B2B SaaS payment platform for retailers offering mobile top-ups, game credits, and domestic remittance, adopted in 7,000+ outlets), Sendah Remit (bank-grade interoperable international and domestic remittance), Sendah (a B2C gift-remittance service for Overseas Filipinos), and Asira (Indonesian B2B2C/B2C lending, insurance, and investment apps). Ayannah is backed by 500 Global. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; the company publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification at this time.

providers.name: Biostack Platforms
providers.description: BioStack Platforms is a San Francisco healthcare-data company (Y Combinator Spring 2026, backed by Afore Capital, Verdict, Heroic VC, and angels from Meta and Google DeepMind) building the data engine for healthcare and drug-discovery AI. It sources and structures ML-ready biomedical datasets — longitudinal, multimodal data across EHR, medical imaging, ECGs, labs, clinical notes, audio, and outcomes — and turns real clinical and preclinical workflows into training environments, evals, reward functions, and verifiable tasks for reinforcement learning and post-training. It serves biotech startups, frontier AI labs, and healthcare data companies. At profiling time BioStack publishes a marketing site and blog only; it exposes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or other machine-readable developer surface, so this remains an identity-only profile in the API Evangelist network pending a public developer offering.

providers.name: Campus Apartments
providers.description: Campus Apartments is a privately held student housing developer, owner, and operator headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1958, the company originally served students of the University of Pennsylvania and has grown into one of the largest privately held student housing companies based in the United States, operating over 145 properties across more than 25 states with a portfolio of roughly 70,000 beds. The firm is led by CEO David J. Adelman and operates alongside affiliated brand presence historically associated with the Campus Crest student housing portfolio. Campus Apartments does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI documentation, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Clinflash
providers.description: Clinflash (易迪希医药科技 / Clinflash Healthcare Technology) is a Chinese clinical-research technology company founded in 2014 that provides a cloud-based clinical trial information platform for pharmaceutical sponsors, CROs, and research sites. Its self-developed suite spans more than ten systems, including Clinflash EDC (electronic data capture), IRT/IWRS (randomization and trial supply management), eCOA/ePRO (electronic clinical outcome and patient-reported outcomes), Safety/PV (pharmacovigilance and drug-safety alerting), CTMS (clinical trial management), eTMF (electronic trial master file), eCTD, eConsent, eSign, Coder (medical coding), and ePAY (subject payment). Clinflash has supported thousands of clinical trial projects for over a thousand pharmaceutical, generic, medical-device, and IVD organizations, including pivotal Phase III and international multi-center studies. The platform is delivered as a login-gated SaaS at cloud.clinflash.com and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer/API program, OpenAPI, SDKs, or GitHub organization.

providers.name: Cloudistics (Fungible)
providers.description: Cloudistics was a composable, hyperconverged cloud infrastructure software company whose platform managed applications, virtual machines, storage, and networking across on-premises datacenters via a REST API and an official Python client (with the ccli command-line tool). Fungible acquired the Cloudistics software team and assets in September 2020 to build DPU-powered hyperdisaggregated infrastructure, and Microsoft acquired Fungible in January 2023 to bolster Azure datacenter networking and storage. As independent companies both are now defunct: the primary product domains are parked, the public GitHub organization has been emptied, and the PyPI package has been removed. The one surviving public developer surface is the read-only Cloudistics API Python Client documentation hosted on Read the Docs. This profile is retained as a historical API Evangelist network record.

providers.name: commandbar
providers.description: CommandBar is a product-adoption and in-app user-assistance platform that helps SaaS teams onboard, guide, and support users directly inside their web applications. Its embeddable widget bundles a command palette / universal search (Spotlight), an AI copilot, contextual help (HelpHub), nudges and product tours, checklists, and in-app surveys, all driven by a JavaScript SDK (npm `commandbar`) that boots against an organization ID. CommandBar was founded in 2020, backed by Insight Partners among others, and acquired by Amplitude in 2024; the product is now delivered as Amplitude Guides & Surveys. The standalone commandbar.com developer surface (SDK reference, REST API, changelog) has been retired and redirects to Amplitude, though the npm SDK remains published.

providers.name: contentbox
providers.description: ContentBox is a blockchain infrastructure company for the digital content industry, built by the team behind Castbox, a global podcast platform serving millions of users across 135 countries. ContentBox aims to give the industry three things: a shared content pool, a shared user pool, and a unified, token-based payout system. Its products include BOX Payout (a blockchain multi-party payment system), BOX Passport (blockchain identity and attribution across applications), and BOX Unpack (a turn-key platform for content creators). The foundation publishes open-source blockchain infrastructure (boxd) and first-party developer SDKs in JavaScript, Python, and Java through its BOXFoundation GitHub organization. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: convergence
providers.description: Convergence AI was a London-based artificial-intelligence startup founded in 2024 by Marvin Purtorab (CEO) and Andy Toulis (CTO) building Proxy, a personal AI agent designed to complete open-ended administrative and web-browsing tasks across domains. Its approach centered on long-term memory and continual learning via a new class of models it called Large Meta Learning Models (LMLM). Convergence raised a $12M pre-seed led by Balderton Capital with participation from Salesforce Ventures and Shopify Ventures, and was acquired by Salesforce in May 2025 to strengthen Agentforce. Its lasting public surface is the convergence-ai GitHub organization, which open-sourced proxy-lite (a mini open-weights web-browsing agent), the proxy-lite-3b vision-language model on Hugging Face, the LM2 memory-model paper repo, and the WebGames agent benchmark.

providers.name: Deben
providers.description: Deben is an AI-powered treasury and cash management platform for CFOs and finance teams, positioned as a cloud-native alternative to spreadsheets and legacy treasury management systems. The product covers cash management with centralized bank connectivity and multi-currency support, liquidity planning and forecasting, automated bank and payment reconciliation, payments, banking and ERP connectivity, multi-entity consolidation, and debt management, with an emphasis on real-time cash control and AI-driven forecasting. Deben targets finance teams in Saudi Arabia and the wider region, referencing Open Banking, and is backed by 500 Global. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; Deben does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface, so this record captures company identity and probed domain security only.

providers.name: eBPF
providers.description: eBPF (extended Berkeley Packet Filter) is a technology that allows programs to run in a sandboxed virtual machine within the Linux kernel without changing kernel source code or loading kernel modules. It enables high-performance networking, security monitoring, observability, and tracing capabilities at the operating system level with minimal overhead. eBPF is governed as a standard by the eBPF Foundation under the Linux Foundation.

providers.name: Eden Network
providers.description: Eden Network is an Ethereum MEV, block-building, and orderflow infrastructure project (EDEN token, launched 2021, evolving from the earlier Archer DAO relay). It operated a gRPC mempool streaming service, an Eden block builder and reverse proxy (eden-geth / eden-proxy), subgraph-backed data tooling, and a DEX API for the Ethereum ecosystem. The original edennetwork.io web property has since lapsed; the canonical, still-live developer surface is the eden-network GitHub organization and the published npm and Go packages. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Multicoin Capital and enriched from those public sources.

providers.name: Edge Markets
providers.description: EDGE Markets builds financial infrastructure for high-throughput gaming and trading environments, positioning itself as the "financial backbone for a new asset class." Its product line spans EDGE Boost, a high-limit debit platform (up to a $1,000,000 daily limit) with built-in responsible-gaming controls and activity tracking; EDGE Connect, a private payment rail and closed-loop settlement layer that replaces traditional consumer card networks to cut transaction costs and chargebacks; and EDGE Pro, a banking platform (in development) for market makers and institutional investors. The company has raised a $29.2M Series A and partners with gaming and betting operators. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing and newsroom presence only — no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface has been found.

providers.name: ether.fi
providers.description: ether.fi is a non-custodial, decentralized Ethereum liquid restaking protocol where stakers retain control of their validator keys. Users deposit ETH to mint eETH, a rebasing liquid restaking token (LRT), or wrap it into weETH, the non-rebasing ERC-20 used across DeFi and bridged cross-chain via LayerZero to networks including Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Linea, Mode, Scroll, BNB Chain, Blast, Mantle, and Solana. Beyond ETH liquid restaking, ether.fi has expanded into eBTC (Bitcoin restaking) and eUSD (stablecoin restaking), Liquid auto- balancing strategy vaults, the ether.fi Cash non-custodial credit card with cashback, "The Club" membership tier program, and an AVS operator stack that runs services on EigenLayer, Symbiotic, and Karak. The protocol is governed by the ETHFI token via governance.ether.fi. ether.fi has no public REST API or developer SDK — its public surface is on-chain: open-source Solidity smart contracts on Ethereum mainnet (eETH, weETH, LiquidityPool, EtherFiNodesManager, EtherFiOracle, MembershipManager, ETHFI), cross-chain bridge contracts (weETH-cross-chain via LayerZero, ETHFI via Wormhole NTT), AVS operator contracts, plus operator tooling (etherfi-avs-operator, eigenpod-proofs-generation) and a public subgraph indexing protocol events. ether.fi is one of the largest LRT protocols by TVL with deep integrations across Aave, Pendle, Gearbox, Morpho, and other DeFi venues.

providers.name: EvolutionIQ
providers.description: EvolutionIQ is an AI-native insurance technology company providing claims guidance software for the insurance industry. Its platform surfaces claim-specific, actionable guidance to help claims professionals resolve complex cases, spanning Auto Casualty, Group & Individual Disability, Workers' Compensation, and Income Protection lines of business, plus Medhub, which converts unstructured medical records into claim-specific insights. Backed by First Round Capital and ICONIQ Capital, the company reports outcomes such as a 5-10 point reduction in combined ratio and 20%+ improvement in handling capacity. EvolutionIQ operates as a B2B enterprise vendor and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and public-surface security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Finaccess
providers.description: Finaccess Mexico, S.A. de C.V., Sociedad Operadora de Fondos de Inversion, is an independent Mexican investment-fund operator (asset manager) authorized by the CNBV and the SHCP and regulated by Banco de Mexico. Founded in 2000 and headquartered in Mexico City, it is part of Grupo Finaccess and operates under the tagline "Acceso financiero para todos" (financial access for everyone). Finaccess manages the AXES family of mutual funds spanning short/medium/long-term local debt (AXES CP, MP, LP), domestic and international equity (AXES BMV, GLO, GSP, USA), dollar-denominated debt (AXES COB), and ESG equity (AXES ESG), and it distributes third-party funds from Franklin Templeton, Santander, and Scotiabank. It provides model portfolios, published rate-of-return tracking, and Morningstar-rated fund evaluation for retail and institutional clients. Finaccess publishes no public developer API; this profile carries company identity and domain-security enrichment only.

providers.name: Fortera
providers.description: Fortera is a Silicon Valley materials-technology company advancing zero-CO2 cement. Its ReCarb process economically converts captured CO2 into ReAct green cement that meets regulatory standards and can be blended with or used in place of Ordinary Portland Cement inside existing production infrastructure. Fortera operates its first commercial ReCarb plant in Redding, California, holds 100+ patents, and is backed by Khosla Ventures and Temasek. The company is a climate-tech materials producer rather than a software/API provider; it publishes a public marketing website and an llms.txt but no developer API surface.

providers.name: Gannett
providers.description: Gannett Co., Inc. is a diversified media and digital marketing solutions company and the publisher of USA TODAY and a network of more than 200 local daily newspapers across the United States. Through its USA TODAY Network and LocaliQ digital marketing services, Gannett delivers news, information, and digital marketing technology to consumers and small-to-medium-sized businesses. Gannett does not currently publish a publicly accessible developer API portal with open documentation.

providers.name: Granulate
providers.description: Granulate is a real-time continuous optimization company acquired by Intel in 2022 and now offered as Intel Tiber App-Level Optimization. Its platform autonomously tunes OS-level and runtime behavior (scheduling, memory, networking) for compute, Kubernetes, and big-data workloads to cut CPU cost and latency without code changes. Granulate also maintains gProfiler, an open-source, low-overhead, system-wide continuous profiler that combines multiple sampling profilers (perf, py-spy, async-profiler, rbspy, PHP/.NET/Node.js) into a single flamegraph and optionally uploads results to the Granulate Performance Studio. gProfiler ships as an Apache-2.0 agent (github.com/intel/gprofiler), a self-hosted backend/UI (github.com/intel/gprofiler-performance-studio), a Docker image, and cloud-marketplace images. The former granulate.io developer surface now redirects to intel.com.

providers.name: iChase Co., Ltd.
providers.description: iChase Co., Ltd. (iCHASE) builds AI-powered biosecurity and precision-farming systems for modern agriculture. Its integrated computer-vision monitoring platform protects livestock and optimizes growth for dairy, poultry, warehouse/industrial, and utility operations. Flagship products include the AI Bird Repeller, which detects birds in real time and deploys automated, chemical-free laser deterrence to reduce avian-flu and contamination risk, and InsightScale, which uses 3D scanning and AI weight prediction to track poultry Average Daily Gain and uniformity without stressful manual weighing. iCHASE is a member of the NVIDIA Inception program, a 2024 THRIVE Top 100 Global Innovator, and a 500 Global portfolio company. The site markets an "Open API" capability, but no public developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs were discoverable at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Infermedica
providers.description: NLP based symptom checker and patient triage API for health diagnosis from text

providers.name: Istante
providers.description: Istante is an Italian technology company (VAT IT03635230547, based in the Perugia area) that develops and operates Athena, a business-process-automation platform built around a team of specialized AI assistants. Athena covers assistants for communication routing and email classification, credit management and collections, a 24/7 voice/phone assistant, quote and order processing, automated tender monitoring and scoring, outbound lead engagement, contract and legal analysis, and HR and onboarding. It is positioned to collaborate with staff rather than replace them, keeping critical decisions under human oversight, and is offered on a fixed-cost "Digital Working Units" (DWU) pricing model rather than variable token pricing. The platform integrates across email, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, SMS, and phone, and is presented as GDPR and EU AI Act compliant. Istante was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Kinro
providers.description: Kinro is an AI-powered commercial insurance brokerage for small businesses, founded in the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch and based in San Francisco. Its autonomous AI agents run the full broker workflow around the clock, from prospect identification and quote preparation through comparison, binding, and ongoing certificate and renewal servicing. Kinro targets the roughly 77% of the 36 million U.S. small businesses that are underinsured because traditional brokers cannot profitably serve low-premium accounts. It is licensed across 30 states, appointed by 15+ carriers with access to 50+ markets, and offers general liability, business owner's policies, workers' compensation, commercial auto and trucking, professional liability, cyber, and more. Kinro was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched in the API Evangelist network; it currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Kiva Systems (Amazon Robotics since 2012)
providers.description: Kiva Systems was a warehouse robotics company founded in 2003 that pioneered the goods-to-person mobile fulfillment model, in which fleets of low-profile drive units lift and carry mobile storage pods to human pick stations instead of moving workers to static shelving. Amazon acquired Kiva Systems in March 2012 for approximately US$775 million and renamed it Amazon Robotics in 2015. Since the acquisition the technology has been developed exclusively for Amazon's own fulfillment and sortation network and is no longer sold to third parties. Amazon Robotics publishes no public API, developer portal or SDKs; amazonrobotics.com now redirects to Amazon's internal identity provider and kivasystems.com no longer resolves. This profile is retained as a historical and acquisition record in the physical-AI and warehouse-robotics space rather than as an integratable API provider. Not to be confused with AWS RoboMaker or AWS IoT RoboRunner, which are AWS product APIs.

providers.name: KK直播 (KK Live)
providers.description: KK直播 (KK Live) is a Chinese mobile-first video livestreaming and social entertainment platform operated by 杭州米络文化传播有限公司 (Hangzhou Melot Culture Communication Co., Ltd.), part of 米络星集团 (Melot Group), headquartered in Hangzhou with offices in Beijing, Changsha, Xi'an, Shenyang, Los Angeles and Mumbai. Founded in 2012 to fill the gap in mobile livestreaming variety shows, the platform pairs talent and performance streaming with interactive social features — virtual gifting, bullet comments (弹幕), multi-person live connections, PK mini-games, karaoke rooms, outdoor streaming and paid companionship. The company reports more than 100,000 independent streamers, over 600 partner talent agencies and 150 million registered users. Melot Group runs three business lines — entertainment livestreaming, online education and video service solutions — under the KK, 棒直播 and 米乐 brands. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners (启明创投), Sequoia China (红杉资本), CMC Capital (华人文化基金) and Shanda Capital (盛大资本). KK Live is a business-to-consumer product: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Lightspeed Photonics
providers.description: LightSpeed Photonics is a silicon-photonics and optoelectronics hardware company whose public site is built around optical interconnect for computing, with the tagline "Bringing Light to the Computing World." It publishes a LightKonnect product line (LightKonnect and LightKonnect Fiber), a LightSIP technology page, and patents and publications sections, alongside company pages for its team, investors, memberships and careers, plus an Insights area carrying blog, news, events and technology posts. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of the 2026-07-19 enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind - it is a semiconductor and optical hardware vendor rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Maven Clinic
providers.description: Maven Clinic is a virtual clinic for women's and family health serving 2,300+ employers and 28 million covered lives globally. Programs span fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, menopause and midlife health, GLP-1 and hormone care, and a 30+ specialty virtual clinic. Maven sells primarily B2B through employer benefits and health plan partnerships, with go-to-market surfaces for employers, health plans, and benefits consultants. Maven's care model is validated by 40+ peer-reviewed studies and Milliman-audited outcomes. No public developer API has been identified - partner integrations are handled via gated employer and health plan onboarding. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: MoveitPro
providers.description: MoveitPro (MoveitPro+) is web-based moving company management software built by professional movers, covering the full operation of a moving and storage company - CRM and lead capture, estimating and quoting, a smart dispatch board with drag-and-drop scheduling and crew assignment, fleet and maintenance management, digital bills of lading and e-signatures, itemized inventory, storage and warehouse tracking, invoicing and credit-card payments, commission tracking, and AI call transcription and QA. MoveitPro advertises "Open API & Custom Integrations" and ships native integrations (QuickBooks, Twilio, Mailchimp, Google Maps/Calendar), but does not publish a self-serve public developer API, reference documentation, or OpenAPI. Its only publicly documented programmatic surface is a Zapier integration exposing Clients, Leads, Jobs, and Estimates. The APIs listed below are logical resources modeled from that documented Zapier integration; MoveitPro does not publish HTTP endpoints, base URLs, or authentication details.

providers.name: Mtailor
providers.description: MTailor is a Y Combinator-backed custom-clothing company that measures your body with your phone's camera and manufactures made-to-order apparel on demand. Its mobile apps capture a short video or 360-degree turn and use machine-learning models to compute roughly 60 body measurements, which the company claims are about 20 percent more accurate than a professional tailor. MTailor produces custom shirts, polos, tees, pants, jeans, blazers and suits for men and jeans for women, each cut to the customer's unique measurement pattern. The business is a direct-to-consumer mobile app and e-commerce brand; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or first-party SDK. This APIs.json profile captures the company's identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: NeuralMagic
providers.description: Neural Magic was an AI software company that spun out of MIT in 2018 to build high-performance deep learning inference software. Its flagship open-source products were DeepSparse, a sparsity-aware inference runtime delivering GPU-class performance on commodity CPUs, together with SparseML, SparseZoo, and Sparsify for model compression, sparsification recipes, and a curated model repository, plus nm-vllm, an enterprise LLM inference server for GPUs. Neural Magic was a prolific contributor to the community vLLM project. The company was acquired by Red Hat (agreement announced November 2024, completed January 2025) and its engineering now advances vLLM and Red Hat AI. The community versions of DeepSparse, SparseML, SparseZoo, and Sparsify were deprecated on 2026-06-02. Neural Magic exposed no commercial REST API; its developer surface was a set of first-party Python libraries published to PyPI and open source on GitHub.

providers.name: Officebanao
providers.description: Officebanao is a technology-enabled office interior design and build company headquartered in Gurugram and Bengaluru, India, and founded in 2021. It delivers turnkey commercial workspace solutions — space planning, interior design, furniture procurement, office renovation, and end-to-end project execution — for startups, enterprises, and coworking spaces across 40+ Indian cities. Its "Tech plus Touch" delivery model pairs real-time 3D visualization and online progress tracking with an in-house team of designers and project managers. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Officebanao publishes a public marketing website and an llms.txt discovery file but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer platform surface as of this profiling.

providers.name: Orchestra Bio
providers.description: Orchestra (orchestra.bio) is an agentic operations platform for drug development and life sciences R&D organizations, helping teams unify planning across leadership, programs, and scientific groups, automate R&D workflows, and reduce the operational risks that derail breakthrough science. The San Francisco company pairs unified program roadmaps with intelligent operations and decision support, and is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), 8VC, Haystack, and other investors. It was added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Orchestra publishes a product marketing site, a company blog, and a hosted web application, but no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Pavoot
providers.description: Pavoot is a Y Combinator-backed AI event-management platform that operates as an autonomous AI agent for running events end-to-end. It sources and matches the right attendees, personalizes invitations, captures and checks in guests on-site, automatically follows up with context from each interaction, tags event media (photos, faces, and logos) with AI, and attributes the resulting pipeline and ROI. The product targets field marketers, GTM leaders, sales teams, CMO/VP Marketing roles, and founders who want to turn events into pipeline. Pavoot exposes no public developer API surface at this time; its api.pavoot.com host is an authenticated internal application backend rather than a documented public API, and the company publishes no OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and has been through one enrichment pass.

providers.name: Perl
providers.description: Perl is a highly capable, feature-rich programming language with over 37 years of development. It is best known for text processing, system administration, web development, and rapid scripting, supported by the Comprehensive Perl Archive Network (CPAN) with more than 25,000 open source extension modules and a global community of developers, blogs, and local user groups. The Perl Foundation supports ongoing development of Perl and its sister language Raku.

providers.name: Philips
providers.description: A Dutch multinational health technology company focused on diagnostic imaging, patient monitoring, image-guided therapy, ultrasound, sleep and respiratory care, and connected care solutions. Philips transitioned from a diversified electronics conglomerate to a dedicated healthcare technology leader and operates the HealthSuite Digital Platform (HSDP) as its cloud-based platform for connected health applications. HSDP exposes Identity & Access Management, Provisioning, IoT/Connect, Foundation, Cognitive, Clinical Data, and Notification building blocks to enable consumer health and professional healthcare applications, but access is gated behind a customer portal at www.hsdp.io with developer documentation distributed to authenticated customers and partners rather than the open public web. Philips also operates vertical Connected Care offerings (Patient Monitoring, eICU/Capsule, Sleep & Respiratory Care/SimplyGo, IntelliSpace) layered on HSDP. The legacy Philips Hue lighting API is no longer a Philips offering - Hue has been spun off into Signify and is published at developers.meethue.com.

providers.name: PolyXLabs
providers.description: PolyXLabs is a Techstars-backed biotechnology and sustainable-materials company developing biodegradable plastic alternatives from lignocellulose-based biomass, including food waste such as spent coffee grounds. The company produces customized, toxin-free, microplastic-free polymers designed to be lightweight and durable as drop-in replacements for conventional plastics in consumer goods and packaging, with operations across the United States and Europe and headquarters in Martonvasar, Hungary. PolyXLabs currently publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Prospera Credit Union
providers.description: Prospera Credit Union is a member-owned cooperative financial institution headquartered in British Columbia, Canada, formed on January 1, 2020 through the merger of the original Prospera Credit Union and Westminster Savings Credit Union — the largest credit-union merger in Canadian history. With roughly CA$9 billion in assets under management, about 120,000 members, and some 900 employees across branches in Metro Vancouver, the Fraser Valley, and the Okanagan, it is the third largest credit union in British Columbia and among the six largest in Canada. As a provincially regulated cooperative (credit unions in BC are overseen by BC Financial Services Authority and deposits are protected by the Credit Union Deposit Insurance Corporation of BC), Prospera serves personal and business members with chequing and savings accounts, credit cards, mortgages, loans, and Interac e-Transfer. On the open-finance side, Prospera runs NO public first-party developer portal or documented API — none of developer/api/developers.prospera.ca resolve — and Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open-banking) framework, legislated in Budget 2024 and overseen by the FCAC, is not yet operational. Like most Canadian credit unions, Prospera reaches national payment rails and consumer data-sharing through shared credit-union-system infrastructure rather than a proprietary API, and third-party data access today is aggregator/screen-scraping based (e.g. Flinks, Plaid). This is an honest identity-only profile with no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Rette
providers.description: Rette AI is a revenue cycle management (RCM) platform for small specialty medical practices, with an initial focus on orthopedic and other specialty clinics. It uses AI to convert clinical notes into structured, specialty-specific ICD-10 and CPT claim data, run payer-specific claims validation and eligibility checks, and manage denial appeals by analyzing root causes and generating payer-specific appeal letters. Rette integrates read-only with existing EHRs such as Athena, Epic, and eClinicalWorks without requiring data migration or workflow changes, and is HIPAA-compliant with Business Associate Agreements. Backed by 500 Global and a participant in StartX and Mayo Clinic Platform Accelerate. No public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: Salus
providers.description: Salus provides runtime validation and governance for AI agents. It sits between an agent and its tools as a policy-aware proxy that intercepts each action before it executes, then clarifies, rewrites, escalates for human review, or blocks it against organizational policies — managing commit-time risk on financial transfers, appointment changes, and data modifications before they alter customer data, finances, or records. Integration requires only an endpoint URL change (no agent rewrite), and Salus works across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Retell, Vapi, and custom tools. Capabilities include evidence-based validation, PII detection, budget and loop protection, idempotency checks, human-in-the-loop escalation, self-repair of blocked actions, and integrated evals and observability. Salus is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company based in San Francisco.

providers.name: Smallhold
providers.description: Smallhold is a specialty organic mushroom company founded in 2017 by Andrew Carter and Adam DeMartino and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York. A Certified B Corporation, Smallhold grows gourmet mushroom varieties — including blue oyster, lion's mane, maitake, royal trumpet, and shiitake — using modular, automated "minifarm" growing environments designed for distributed, locally grown supply to grocery retailers and restaurants. Its public presence is a direct-to-consumer and retail-partner storefront built on Shopify; the company publishes no first-party developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead and run through the enrichment pipeline, which confirmed no bespoke API surface — only Shopify's platform OAuth discovery documents are exposed on the shop domain.

providers.name: Sound.xyz
providers.description: Sound.xyz was a web3 music platform and suite of on-chain tools that let artists release music as digital collectibles and host listening parties for new releases, building direct economic relationships with their communities. The consumer platform went offline on 2026-01-16 (with a successor project, Vault.fm), but Sound.xyz's first-party developer surface remains publicly published: the open-source Sound protocol (a permissionless Solidity smart-contract framework for music collectibles) and the official @soundxyz npm SDK ecosystem (@soundxyz/sdk, sdk-viem, legacy-sdk) for on-chain development, alongside GraphQL and caching infrastructure libraries. Added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company; this profile now reflects the enrichment pipeline's findings.

providers.name: TakeCareOS
providers.description: TakeCareOS is an AI-powered operating system for home care and disability-services agencies. It consolidates fragmented back-office operations — shift rostering and scheduling, GPS-enabled clock-in/out, participant/client CRM, shift notes and incident reporting, timesheet management with variance detection, invoice generation synced to accounting tools (Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks), team messaging, and compliance and credential tracking — into a single platform. An AI assistant called Atlas drafts documentation, converts PDF forms to digital, and automates administrative work while requiring human approval. Founded by Ragav Sachdeva and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026), the company is based in San Francisco and serves NDIS and Medicaid HCBS providers. As of this profile the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: Universal Corporation
providers.description: Universal Corporation is a global leaf tobacco merchant and processor that selects, buys, processes, packs, stores, ships, and finances leaf tobacco for sale to manufacturers of consumer tobacco products. Operating in approximately 30 countries, Universal Corporation is the world's leading supplier of leaf tobacco, providing supply chain management, processing, and blending services. The company has developed digital platforms including MobiLeaf, a tablet-based grower management system for tobacco farmer support and crop tracking.

providers.name: xiaoyi
providers.description: Xiaoyi Technology (小蚁科技), operated by Shanghai Yunyi Zhilian Technology (上海云蚁智联) and best known for its YI-brand cameras, is a Shanghai-based smart-imaging company that emerged from the Xiaomi ecosystem. It builds action cameras, the M1 mirrorless camera, smart home/security cameras, dash cams and in-car rearview systems, VR cameras, and handheld gimbals, and now positions itself around computer vision, edge intelligence, and edge computing solutions for smart mobility, smart home, smart retail, smart parks, and smart communities, selling through JD and Tmall storefronts. Surfaced as a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment - the developer subdomain (dev.xiaoyi.com) returns 502, api.xiaoyi.com serves only a placeholder page, and no API documentation, OpenAPI specs, official GitHub organization, or first-party registry packages were located.

providers.name: ALICE Technologies
providers.description: ALICE Technologies is a Menlo Park, California construction technology company that builds an AI-driven generative scheduling and construction optioneering platform. The product simulates millions of possible construction sequences for a project — varying crews, equipment, methods, and constraints — to find optimal schedules, accelerate timelines, recover delayed projects, and de-risk capital project delivery. ALICE's suite includes ALICE Optimize (generative scheduling from imported Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project schedules), ALICE Plan (a 2D visual planning canvas overlaid on drawings), ALICE Model (BIM-driven schedule generation from 3D models), and the Schedule Insights Agent (an LLM-powered conversational interface for analysing and recommending schedule changes, including automated DCMA 14-point schedule quality scoring). The platform is sold as SaaS to general contractors, owners and developers, and consultants working on industrial (data centres, energy, semiconductors), infrastructure (rail, highway, tunnels), and commercial projects, with reported impacts including up to 17% reduction in project duration and 14% labor cost savings. ALICE was founded in 2015 by René Morkos (Stanford PhD) and is backed by Merus Capital, Foundamental, Future Ventures, Lightspeed, Blackhorn Ventures, and Brick and Mortar; in 2026 it announced a formal alliance with McKinsey to deploy generative scheduling on capital projects. ALICE integrates by importing from Primavera P6, Primavera Cloud, Microsoft Project, and BIM/drawing formats, but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source repository — integration is delivered via the product's import/export surface and customer-success engagements.

providers.name: Apoha
providers.description: Apoha is a deep-tech molecular-science company teaching machines to understand matter at the molecular level. Its Liquid State sensory-intelligence platform captures dynamic molecular fingerprints, measuring the biophysical behavior of molecules under stress from minimal sample amounts, to unlock a new fundamental data class for AI. Its first commercial product, VIBE (Variations in Inter-facial Behaviour Under Excitation), predicts how drugs, foods, and materials will behave in the real world, serving pharmaceutical, biotech, food-and-beverage, and materials-science R&D. Based in San Francisco and London, Apoha emerged from stealth in 2026 with $36M in funding led by Singular, alongside Draper Associates, Redalpine, Seedcamp, Wilbe, and Nucleus.

providers.name: Artemis Security
providers.description: Artemis Security is an AI-native security operations platform that detects and responds to threats faster than traditional SIEMs, cutting mean time to detection and response with claims of up to 96% reduction in resolution times. The platform performs environment-specific threat detection, multi-source correlation across identity, cloud, endpoint, network, and SaaS signals, natural-language AI threat hunting, and autonomous investigation with automatic case generation and detection-gap closure. It integrates with enterprise tools such as Okta, AWS, Salesforce, Snowflake, and Databricks. The company emerged from stealth with $70M in funding from Felicis Ventures, First Round Capital, and Brightmind Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public surface; no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Assurely
providers.description: Assurely is a United States insurtech and managing general agent (MGA) founded by David Carpentier and Ty Sagalow that builds and distributes commercial property-and-casualty insurance for companies with unconventional funding models, most notably TigerMark, a directors-and-officers (D&O) product written for Regulation CF / Regulation A crowdfunding issuers and early-stage startups that incumbent carriers decline. Assurely positioned itself as an "Insurance-as-a-Service" (IaaS) provider embedding industry-specific products plus a multi-carrier marketplace into vertical SaaS operating systems in fintech and capital raising, proptech and construction, property management, blockchain and digital assets, and SMB marketplaces (named partners include Wefunder, Silicon Prairie, Fairmint, Dalmore Group, Buildertrend and CoConstruct), and stated licensing in all 50 states and Bermuda. Its API posture is the honest floor of this sector — no public, self-serve developer portal, no API reference, and no downloadable OpenAPI was ever published. "Embedded" here meant a commercial partnership with white-labeled quote-and-bind web flows on client.assurely.com and tigermark.assurely.com plus human advisory and administration, not a documented partner API. Assurely was acquired by Equal Parts on 2025-06-26, and as of the 2026-07-25 review its entire public surface is offline — www.assurely.com returns HTTP 404 as an expired Squarespace site, and api./client./tigermark.assurely.com are dangling CNAMEs to a deleted AWS load balancer. Home market is the United States.

providers.name: Audi Connect / myAudi
providers.description: Audi Connect is the connected-vehicle services platform from Audi AG, the Ingolstadt, Germany-based luxury automaker and member of the Volkswagen Group. Delivered to drivers through the embedded MMI infotainment system and the myAudi companion app for iOS and Android, Audi Connect spans remote vehicle control (lock/unlock, remote start, climate pre-conditioning, EV charge management), safety and security (Emergency Call/eCall, Audi Service Request, stolen-vehicle locator, geofencing, speed alerts), and in-car infotainment (real-time traffic, satellite map imagery, parking and fuel information, weather, news, natural voice recognition, Amazon Alexa, Amazon Music, Wi-Fi hotspot, and an in-vehicle app store with Disney+ and passenger gaming on supported models). Services are packaged as Audi connect CARE (included for ten years on new U.S. Audis), Audi connect NAV (navigation and live traffic), and Audi connect PLUS (premium streaming and Wi-Fi). For EVs and PHEVs, Audi Connect adds charging-station search, remote charge monitoring, and cabin pre-conditioning. Audi does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, OAuth program, or partner SDK for myAudi/Audi Connect; programmatic access today is brokered by third-party connected-car aggregators (Smartcar, High Mobility, Enode, Mojio) under Audi's commercial agreements, and community projects reverse-engineer the mobile-app endpoints. Audi has publicly discussed an internal OpenAPI-driven API management strategy (with Nagarro) but the surface remains private to Audi, VW Group brands, and authorized partners.

providers.name: biolink
providers.description: BioLink (百林科医药科技（上海）有限公司) is a Shanghai-based bioprocessing company that manufactures core equipment and single-use consumable solutions for biopharmaceutical manufacturing. Its product lines span cell culture and bioreactors, fluid management, chromatography purification, process filtration, and pre-formulated aqueous products (buffers, water for injection, defoamers), serving antibody therapeutics and ADCs, vaccines, cell and gene therapy, and recombinant protein production. BioLink is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: CAPS
providers.description: CAPS Inc. (CAPS株式会社) is a Tokyo-based Healthcare x IT company founded in December 2014 whose mission is to maximize the total amount of happiness through health management (健康経営). CAPS operates a chain of primary-care clinics plus its Doctor365 telemedicine and urgent-care service, provides corporate health-support and wellness programs for employers, runs 24-hour IT-enabled fitness gyms, and delivers health-education programs including a Sesame Street partnership. Headquartered in Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, the company was seed-funded by 500 Startups Japan (500 Global) in 2018. This API Evangelist profile tracks CAPS as a company; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: CareBridge *
providers.description: CareBridge is a home and community-based healthcare company that delivers 24/7 virtual and in-home care coordination to high-risk, largely Medicaid populations on behalf of health plans. Its interdisciplinary care teams address members' physical, behavioral, and social health needs, and the company operates three core service lines: 24/7 member support, decision support (durable medical equipment and technology provisioning), and Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) technology used by state Medicaid programs and managed-care organizations. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, CareBridge was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile therefore captures its public identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Centric Brands
providers.description: Centric Brands LLC is a New York-headquartered global lifestyle brand management and product-development platform formed in October 2018 when Differential Brands Group (NASDAQ: DFBG) acquired Global Brands Group's $1.2B North American licensing business. The company designs, sources, markets, and distributes apparel, accessories, footwear, beauty, and entertainment-licensed products across men's, women's, kids', accessories, and entertainment segments. Its mission is "to be a leading global apparel & accessories company with a portfolio of iconic licensed and owned brands that delight retailers and consumers of all ages." Centric filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on May 18, 2020 and emerged in October 2020 under control of secured creditors led by Blackstone's GSO Capital Partners, Ares Management, and HPS Investment Partners. The company is led by CEO Jason Rabin (since 2018) and operates ~20 global offices across New York (HQ), Los Angeles, Greensboro, Montreal, London, Amsterdam, Hong Kong, and multiple cities in China, Bangladesh, Cambodia, India, and Vietnam. Owned brands include Hudson Jeans, Buffalo Jeans, Robert Graham, Joe's Jeans, Hervé Léger, Favorite Daughter, and AllSaints; licensed apparel brands include Calvin Klein, Tommy Hilfiger, Nautica, Spyder, IZOD, Van Heusen, Kate Spade New York, Coach, Michael Kors, Frye, Timberland, Lucky Brand, Juicy Couture, Under Armour, and Off-White; the entertainment licensing portfolio spans 70+ properties including Disney, Marvel, Warner Bros., DC, Nintendo, Hasbro, Mattel, Nickelodeon, Netflix, Pokémon, Sanrio, Paw Patrol, and the NFL/MLB/NBA/NHL via Sports & Entertainment Licensing. Centric Brands operates "11 end-to-end Ecommerce sites," a 3D design and art studio in Greensboro, and a New York City photo/video studio. The company has no public developer program, no documented public APIs, and no public source code repositories; its two namesake GitHub organizations (centric-brands, Centricbrands) are private placeholders with zero public repos.

providers.name: Citi
providers.description: Citi is the consumer-facing brand of Citigroup, the global diversified financial services holding company. The Citi developer surface is cataloged under the canonical Citigroup profile, which covers the Citi Developer Hub, retail Accounts and Transactions, Money Movement, Authorization, Customer Onboarding, Pay with Points, Utilities, and CitiConnect for corporate treasury. This entry exists as an alias so the citi short name resolves to the same catalog as citigroup.

providers.name: Django
providers.description: A high-level Python web framework that encourages rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. Django follows the model-template-views architectural pattern and includes an ORM, automatic admin interface, robust template system, and quick internationalization support. The current release line is Django 6.0, supported by the non-profit Django Software Foundation, and it powers some of the busiest websites globally.

providers.name: dMed Global (Caidya)
providers.description: dMed Global, now operating as Caidya, is a global, full-service clinical research organization (CRO) headquartered in Shanghai, China and backed by Qiming Venture Partners. The company provides flexible, patient-centric clinical trial solutions to biopharmaceutical innovators, running studies across more than 40 countries and regions. Its capabilities span clinical operations, regulatory services, data management, biostatistics, and complex trial execution across core therapeutic areas. Caidya operates an English-language corporate site at caidya.com and a Chinese-language site at caidya.cn. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record; the company publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Doctorly
providers.description: Doctorly (doctorly GmbH, Berlin) builds a modern cloud-based practice management system (Praxisverwaltungssystem / PVS) for medical practices in Germany, positioned as a replacement for legacy systems such as Medistar, Turbomed and ALBIS. The platform covers KV quarterly billing, e-prescription (eRezept), electronic sick leave (eAU), real-time collaborative patient records, GDT device integration and cross-platform access on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, and it is KBV-, gematik- and GDPR-compliant. Doctorly is a Seedcamp portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/FHIR specification, SDKs or GitHub organization; this entry is maintained as a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ensurance
providers.description: Ensurance Limited (ASX:ENA) was an Australian ASX-listed insurance underwriting agency headquartered in Perth, Western Australia, marketing itself as "innovating the online insurance sector." Its Australian arm, Ensurance Underwriting Australia, operated as a wholesale underwriting agency under an Australian Financial Services Licence, assembling a consortium of local and international capacity — including Lloyd's, Swiss Re and XL Catlin — behind construction-specific products sold exclusively through intermediaries: Licensed Builder Annual Construction, Plant and Liability, Project-Specific Construction, Trades Liability, Owner Builder, and Home and Contents insurance, distributed to a broker network the company described as 340-plus intermediaries. A sister company, Ensurance UK Limited, ran as a Managing General Agent authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority and a coverholder at Lloyd's. The group's API posture is nil and always was. Ensurance never published a public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI or Swagger definition, Postman collection, GraphQL endpoint, webhook or event catalogue. What the company called its "customised online platform" for intermediaries was BOB (bob.ensurance.com.au), a form-based, session-login ASP.NET MVC quote-and-proposal wizard keyed to per-agent codes — an agent login wall, not a programmable interface. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference appears anywhere in the company's live or archived web estate. As of this review the ensurance.com.au TLS certificate has expired and every path on the domain, along with the ensurance.ltd domain family, blanket 301-redirects to Chase Underwriting Solutions Pty Ltd, an Australian professional-lines underwriting agency that likewise publishes no API. Ensurance is recorded here as a partner-gated, no-public-API insurance provider in the Australian market — a faithful data point for a sector where the Consumer Data Right was designated for general insurance and then deferred, leaving carriers and underwriting agencies with no forcing function to expose anything.

providers.name: Eos AI
providers.description: Eos AI is a San Francisco healthcare technology company building an autonomous operating system for healthcare that helps clinics and hospitals identify eligible patients and enable early care interventions. The platform connects to fragmented clinical systems (EHRs, imaging archives, labs, scheduling, and billing), resolves patient identities across sites and encounters, and links records into a continuous longitudinal history that can be searched and analyzed as one distributed database. Two harmonization products anchor the stack: VERA standardizes medical imaging across scanners, sites, and protocols to improve model performance and shorten deployment, and LUCIA structures EHR free text, ICD, SNOMED, and clinical signals into a unified representation for downstream analytics. On top of the harmonized data, Eos runs predictive models over full patient trajectories and drives automations into hospital workflows, reporting roughly 3x administrative productivity and 37% revenue recovery in early deployments. Founded in 2025 by Arya Khokhar and backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2026 batch). Its application is gated at my.helloeos.ai; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal has been published to date, so this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: Flowbird
providers.description: Flowbird is a global urban mobility and parking technology company that builds pay stations, mobile parking apps, digital permits, EV charging, and transit ticketing systems for cities and transport authorities worldwide. Flowbird was acquired by EasyPark Group in an acquisition that closed in January 2025.
