Its integration surface is the Flowbird HUB, an open platform that exposes documented but partner/agency-gated APIs (OAuth2 and client-certificate secured, with role-based access control and ownership filters) for tariffs, rights/permits, parking sessions, pay stations, and transactions. There is no self-service public sign-up; access is granted to cities, transport agencies, and integration partners under contract.

providers.name: Forus Health
providers.description: Forus Health Pvt Ltd is a Bengaluru, India based medical device manufacturer specializing in advanced eye-care and retinal-imaging technology. Its 3nethra family of devices covers adult and neonatal retinal imaging, refraction and myopia management, and anterior-segment imaging, complemented by the FH-POISE AI diagnostic platform that screens for diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, cataract, hypertensive retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration, and dry eye. Forus also operates connected telemedicine platforms (FH TeleCare, FH TeleEye, FH TeleOpticals) for remote eye screening. The company reports more than 5,000 installations across 85+ countries. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Hedge
providers.description: Hedge is a decentralized, non-custodial lending protocol built on the Solana blockchain that lets users mint USH, a stablecoin soft-pegged to the US dollar. Users deposit collateral into vaults to take out 0% interest loans for a one-time fee, maintaining a collateral-to-debt ratio above 110% to avoid liquidation. A stability pool absorbs liquidations and rewards depositors with discounted collateral, while a Peg Stability Module and a multi-source oracle (Pyth Network primary, Switchboard fallback) keep USH near its peg. Hedge is an on-chain protocol rather than a hosted REST API; its documentation, whitepaper, and audited Solana program are its public surface. Backed by Pantera Capital and Y Combinator; smart contracts audited by Kudelski, OtterSec, and Sec3.

providers.name: Hims
providers.description: Hims is the men's brand of Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (NYSE: HIMS), a U.S.-based direct-to-consumer telehealth platform. Through forhims.com it connects patients with licensed medical providers and affiliated pharmacies to offer treatment for sexual health, hair loss, dermatology and skincare, mental health, and weight loss, including provider consultations, personalized prescriptions, and recurring subscription fulfillment shipped to the customer. Hims & Hers operates the sibling Hers brand for women and runs its own pharmacy and fulfillment operations. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, security, and trust surface; Hims does not currently publish a public developer API, so this record is identity- and security-focused rather than spec-bearing.

providers.name: Hims & Hers Health
providers.description: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (NYSE: HIMS) is a direct-to-consumer telehealth platform headquartered in San Francisco that connects consumers with licensed providers and ships personalized treatments across men's and women's health categories. Hims serves men with offerings spanning sexual health, hair loss, mental health, dermatology, and weight loss; Hers serves women with birth control, hair, skin, mental health, and weight management; both brands include compounded GLP-1 weight-loss programs. International expansion has been driven by the acquisitions of ZAVA (Europe, 2025) and Eucalyptus Health (Australia, 2026). Hims & Hers is primarily a consumer D2C product; no public developer API has been identified, and B2B and partner integrations are gated. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: Integral Ad Science
providers.description: Integral Ad Science (NASDAQ: IAS) is a New York-based global ad verification and digital media measurement company. IAS provides technology and data that measures the quality, viewability, ad fraud, brand safety and suitability, contextual targeting, and attention performance of digital advertising across CTV and video, the open web, social platforms, mobile and in-app, and digital audio. Its products serve advertisers and agencies, publishers, and ad-tech platforms with proprietary capabilities including Quality Impressions, Total Visibility, Total Media Quality, Context Control, and the IAS Agent platform for generative-AI-era brand safety. IAS does not publish a general-purpose public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or self-serve SDK portal; customer access to IAS data and measurement is delivered through enterprise integrations with DSPs, SSPs, ad servers, social platforms, and walled gardens, plus the IAS Signal reporting platform, header-bidding modules (Prebid IAS RTD provider and bidder adapter), and partner connectors such as the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) IAS connector. The company's GitHub organization (github.com/integralads) is primarily internal tooling, forks, and ad-tech ecosystem contributions rather than a documented developer SDK surface.

providers.name: island.is (Digital Iceland)
providers.description: island.is (Stafrænt Ísland / Digital Iceland) is Iceland's national digital-services and government API platform, operated by the Ministry of Finance and Economic Affairs / Digital Iceland. It provides a GraphQL gateway at api.island.is (authentication-gated) that fronts internal REST microservices, with business/government-to-government REST services described using OpenAPI 3.0 and registered in the X-Road "Straumurinn" API Catalogue. The developer handbook is published at docs.devland.is. Iceland's former CKAN open-data portal (opingogn.is) has been decommissioned and now redirects to island.is.

providers.name: Lydia
providers.description: Lydia is a French fintech, founded in 2013, that built one of Europe's most popular mobile peer-to-peer payments apps, letting users send money, split bills, and pay merchants from their phone. Backed by Accel, Tencent and others, the company evolved into a full mobile banking and financial services provider. In 2024 it split its consumer banking product into a new brand, Sumeria (sumeria.eu), while the Lydia name continues for the P2P payments experience. Lydia publishes a security.txt bug-bounty contact but no longer exposes a public developer API or portal.

providers.name: Microlink.io
providers.description: Extract structured data from any website

providers.name: Omate
providers.description: Omate designs and manufactures Wearable-as-a-Service (WaaS) safety solutions built around cellular-connected smartwatches for people who need protection — seniors, children, and lone workers. Its devices (such as the O6L Pro line, marketed under the Omahome brand) combine GPS location tracking, SOS calling, fall detection, and two-way voice into a managed hardware-plus-service offering sold direct to consumers and through partners. Omate is a hardware and connected-device company; as of this profile it exposes no public developer program, API, or SDK. This entry was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched with an identity and domain-security pass.

providers.name: Ossus
providers.description: Ossus builds AI-native intelligence for cultural institutions, starting with libraries. Its flagship product is Ossus ILS, a modern integrated library system that unifies cataloguing, circulation, acquisitions, analytics, and patron discovery in one interface, with an AI copilot that drafts MARC records, subjects, and classifications for librarian approval. A lighter product, Librar, targets school libraries with fast mobile setup. AI add-ons cover camera-based shelf inventory, vendor comparison for purchasing, and grant finding. Ossus emphasizes privacy-first design: it does not train on or sell customer data and works only with catalogue metadata rather than borrower records. Ossus is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company based in San Francisco.

providers.name: PraxiPal
providers.description: PraxiPal GmbH (Berlin, Germany) builds Luna, an AI voice receptionist for medical, dental, therapeutic, and veterinary practices. Luna answers incoming phone calls 24/7, handles patient questions, books and reschedules appointments, and processes prescription requests autonomously, integrating directly with 40+ German practice-management systems (PVS) such as CGM MEDISTAR, tomedo, charly by solutio, DAMPSOFT, and DENSoffice. It operates in a GDPR-compliant manner on European servers with medical-confidentiality safeguards under German law. PraxiPal is backed by HV Capital. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is currently published; this profile tracks the company as an API Evangelist network lead.

providers.name: pulseData
providers.description: PulseData, Inc. is a healthcare artificial-intelligence company that applies machine learning and predictive analytics to chronic disease management, with a focus on chronic kidney disease. Its platform helps payers, providers, ACOs, and value-based care organizations identify at-risk patient populations, predict disease progression, and act by directing patients to targeted interventions and care programs. Named customers include Quest Diagnostics, US Renal Care, Vytalize, and HealthEdge. The company is SOC 2 Type II certified and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. No public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable documentation were found during enrichment.

providers.name: Reliv
providers.description: Reliv is a digital medical ecosystem operating in Ecuador and Mexico that aims to simplify healthcare management for clinics, hospitals, doctors, and patients. Its platform combines a Hospital Information System (HIS) for hospital and clinic operations, an Electronic Health Record (EHR) offering digital clinical histories with online scheduling and electronic prescriptions, and a patient-facing Pacientes mobile app for appointments, digital prescriptions, and offers. Reliv positions itself as the first integrated digital medical ecosystem of Ecuador and runs a Reliv Academy training platform. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Satellite Bio
providers.description: Satellite Bio is a biotechnology company developing off-the-shelf liver cell therapies to treat severe and life-threatening liver diseases. Its tissue therapeutics platform engineers functional hepatocytes designed to engraft and restore liver function, combining the biological power of liver cells with scalable manufacturing and distribution. The company is headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Satellite Bio is a life-sciences company and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Second Spectrum (Genius Sports)
providers.description: Second Spectrum is a Los Angeles–based computer vision and AI sports tracking company, acquired by Genius Sports in 2021 for roughly $200M. It supplies skeletal and optical tracking, machine-learning analytics, and augmented broadcast products to major leagues, clubs, and broadcasters — most notably the NBA (official tracking partner from 2017 to 2023), the Premier League (official tracking partner via Football DataCo), and MLS. The customer-facing offering is the Performance Studio platform, used by club analysts and coaching staff to access tracking data, visualizations, and tagged clips. There is no public developer portal, no published OpenAPI, and no self-serve API keys; data and integration access are delivered exclusively under enterprise agreement with Genius Sports. The product surface is effectively a sales-led, league/club-tier offering rather than a developer API.

providers.name: Sensee
providers.description: Sensee is a French direct-to-consumer online optician and contact-lens retailer, operating since 2005 and run by licensed opticians. It sells contact lenses, lens-care solutions, eye-health products and eyewear across six European markets (France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Switzerland and Austria) under localized storefronts, and supports third-party insurance payment (tiers payant) via networks such as Kalixia, Santeclair, Almerys and Optilys. Sensee is a subsidiary of Vision Group Holding AG. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the enrichment pass found no public API, SDK or developer program, only a corporate security.txt / responsible-disclosure surface.

providers.name: Snowball *
providers.description: Snowball * is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Sonus
providers.description: Sonus is the API Evangelist network profile for the company that began as Sonus Networks, an early pioneer of VoIP softswitches and session border controllers (SBCs), and which today operates as Ribbon Communications (NASDAQ: RBBN) following its 2017 merger with GENBAND. Ribbon builds real-time communications, IP optical networking, session border control, cloud and edge, and network security and analytics software for service providers and enterprises. This profile originated as a Matrix Partners portfolio lead. Ribbon publishes enterprise product, support, and responsible-disclosure resources but no public developer API or open API specification was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Storytree
providers.description: Storytree Inc. is a Palo Alto consumer photo company, backed by 500 Global, that operates SimplePrints (simpleprints.com, formerly getsimpleprints.com) — a mobile-first service that turns the photos on your phone into physical products: layflat and mini photo books, canvas prints, metal prints and metal desk prints, photo cards, and wall calendars. The app pulls images directly from the phone with no exporting or reformatting, and the business adds a referral program, promotional discounts, and a schools program. SimplePrints is a business-to-consumer mobile app and does NOT publish a developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or a developer portal. The one machine-consumable surface it exposes is a Wix-hosted llms.txt and a generic Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic access to public site content (business details, site search, and a bridge to Wix business-solution APIs).

providers.name: Talofa
providers.description: Talofa Games is a consumer mobile game studio, backed by Insight Partners, that builds location-based and fitness-driven games where real-world movement powers play. Its titles include Run Legends, a cooperative running RPG for iOS and Android in which players' real-world runs and steps fuel monster battles, and Monster Walk, a walking game currently in closed beta. The company distributes through the Apple App Store and Google Play and runs its community on Discord. As a consumer game publisher it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks it as a company with no API footprint.

providers.name: Tenzai
providers.description: Tenzai is an AI-native cybersecurity company building an autonomous, agentic AI "hacker" for the enterprise. Its AI agents continuously discover, chain, and exploit hard-to-find vulnerabilities across enterprise software and validate them in production the way a human red team would, aiming to bring nation-grade offensive security to every engineering organization. Founded in 2025 by Guardicore founders Pavel Gurvich and Ariel Zeitlin together with Ofri Ziv, Itamar Tal, and Aner Mazur, the Tel Aviv-based company launched out of stealth in November 2025 with a $75M seed round (one of the largest in cybersecurity) led by Greylock Partners, Battery Ventures, and Lux Capital at a reported $330M valuation. Tenzai targets the penetration-testing market with continuous, AI-driven offensive validation. As of this profile the company exposes a marketing site, a research blog, careers, and a SOC 2 Type 1 trust center, but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Tidal Vision
providers.description: Tidal Vision Products, Inc. is a Bellingham, Washington biotechnology and specialty-chemicals manufacturer, and the only commercial-scale US producer of chitosan — a non-toxic, non-hazmat, biodegradable industrial biopolymer upcycled from crab and shrimp shell waste. Its zero-waste Chitofining process extracts, modifies and formulates chitosan chemistries that displace PFAS, halogenated chemicals, toxic antimicrobials and persistent plastics across three business lines: Tidal Clear water and wastewater treatment, Tidal Grow AgriScience crop and soil inputs, and Tidal-Tec Biomaterial Science performance materials. The company closed an oversubscribed $140M+ Series B in 2025 and acquired Clear Water Services. It is a materials-science manufacturer and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: TokyoOtakuMode
providers.description: Tokyo Otaku Mode (TOM) is a Japan-based e-commerce company and online destination for fans of Japanese pop culture, selling official anime figures, manga merchandise, apparel, and collectibles worldwide through its otakumode.com shop. Grown out of a large social-media following, TOM curates and ships Japanese otaku goods internationally. It runs a private, API-key-gated backend (api.otakumode.com) that powers its storefront, but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specifications, or first-party client SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from live public probes.

providers.name: Torchdental
providers.description: Torchdental (Torch Dental) is a B2B dental-supply procurement platform for independent dental practices and dental groups. It runs a web application at app.torchdental.com that lets practices order dental supplies and equipment from multiple vendors in one place, compare prices, manage recurring ordering and budgets, and streamline back-office purchasing. The company is venture backed and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis. As of this enrichment pass Torchdental exposes no public developer/API surface: no api/docs/developer subdomains resolve, and the application host publishes no /.well-known/ discovery documents. This profile therefore captures company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Tractive
providers.description: Tractive is an Austrian pet-technology company, founded in October 2012 in Pasching, Austria and led by CEO Michael Hurnaus, that builds GPS location and health-monitoring trackers for dogs and cats. Its collar-attached devices (such as the DOG and CAT GPS trackers) pair with a subscription mobile app to deliver real-time worldwide location, virtual fences, activity, sleep and, more recently, resting heart-rate and respiratory-rate health intelligence to more than 1.4 million active subscribers. Tractive was acquired by Italy's Bending Spoons in 2026. Tractive does NOT publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal — its backend HTTP API (api.tractive.com) is private to its own apps; the only clients are unofficial, community reverse-engineered libraries. This profile enriches the company's identity for the API Evangelist network; there is no official API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Vend
providers.description: Vend was a cloud-based retail point-of-sale and inventory management software company founded in Auckland, New Zealand, backed by investors including Point Nine. Lightspeed announced its acquisition of Vend in March 2021 for approximately US$350 million, and the product lives on as Lightspeed Retail (X-Series). vendhq.com redirects to lightspeedhq.com/vend/, and the former Vend API is documented today at x-series-api.lightspeedhq.com. The X-Series API surface is profiled in the API Evangelist network under the Lightspeed provider, so this profile records the acquired Vend brand rather than duplicating that API.

providers.name: Western & Southern Financial Group
providers.description: Western & Southern Financial Group is a Fortune 500 diversified family of financial services companies headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. Founded in 1888, the group offers life insurance, annuities, mutual funds, asset management, retirement planning, and investment management through a family of subsidiaries including Western & Southern Life, Columbus Life, Gerber Life, Integrity Life, Lafayette Life, Fort Washington Investment Advisors, Touchstone Investments, and W&S Financial Group Distributors, with over $112 billion in assets under management.

providers.name: Xairos
providers.description: Xairos Systems is a Techstars-backed company building quantum time transfer (QTT) technology - a space-based, quantum-resilient global timing and synchronization system positioned as a secure alternative to GPS for positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT). The company targets sub-nanosecond accuracy while mitigating GPS jamming and spoofing, serving critical infrastructure sectors such as transportation, finance, data centers, and power grids. Xairos publishes no first-party developer API, but its site ships an llms.txt and a live Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic access to public site content.

providers.name: Altos Labs
providers.description: Altos Labs is a biotechnology company pursuing cellular rejuvenation programming to restore cell health and resilience, with the goal of reversing disease, injury, and the disabilities that can occur throughout life. Launched publicly in January 2022 with roughly $3 billion in initial funding from investors including Jeff Bezos and Yuri Milner, the company operates geographically distributed Institutes of Science in the San Francisco Bay Area, Cambridge (UK), and San Diego, alongside an Institute of Medicine and an Institute of Computation. Altos combines experimental biologists with computational scientists to translate laboratory discoveries in cell biology into transformative medicines. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network; as a research-stage life-sciences company it currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: AutoGen Studio
providers.description: AutoGen Studio is a low-code / no-code developer GUI from Microsoft Research for rapidly prototyping, composing, and debugging multi-agent AI workflows built on the AutoGen framework. Shipped as the `autogenstudio` Python package and launched with `autogenstudio ui`, it serves a FastAPI + React (Gatsby) web app on localhost that exposes four primary interfaces — Team Builder, Playground, Gallery, and Deployment — backed by a SQLModel persistence layer (SQLite by default; any SQLAlchemy-compatible backend such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL via `--database-uri`). The Team Builder offers drag-and-drop and JSON authoring of teams, agents, models, tools, and termination conditions fully aligned with AutoGen AgentChat's declarative component spec; the Playground streams live inter-agent messages and renders the control transition graph; the Gallery imports community components; and the Deployment view exports a team to Python, exposes it as an endpoint, and packages it for Docker. AutoGen Studio is built on AutoGen AgentChat / Core / Extensions and supports any OpenAI-compatible model endpoint (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, local vLLM/Ollama, etc.) via declarative `model_client` configuration, plus MCP tool integration. Authentication is experimental (GitHub OAuth + JWT only). Microsoft explicitly positions AutoGen Studio as a research prototype — not production-ready — and encourages teams that need authn/z, multi-tenancy, sandboxing rigor, or hardened deployment to build directly on the AutoGen framework instead. Companion to the broader AutoGen multi-agent framework, distributed under the Microsoft microsoft/autogen monorepo (CC-BY-4.0 docs, MIT code).

providers.name: Bbot
providers.description: Bbot is an order-and-pay solution for the hospitality industry, letting guests scan a QR code to view menus, order, and pay from their phones, including placing orders with a server on the same tab. Bbot was acquired by DoorDash and is now offered as Tableside Order & Pay by DoorDash, serving restaurants, bars, breweries, and hotels with on-premise digital ordering and payment, plus POS integrations such as Toast. Bbot operates owner and admin web portals but does not publish a standalone public or partner-facing developer API or documentation portal, so no API products are listed here.

providers.name: BeConfident
providers.description: BeConfident (Beconfident Inteligencia Artificial em Idiomas Ltda.) is an AI-powered English language-learning platform that lets learners practice through real-time conversations with AI tutors via text, voice, and video, plus guided 24/7 lessons, grammar and pronunciation feedback, and study plans tailored to proficiency level, with access across web, WhatsApp, and smartwatch. It is a consumer EdTech application backed by Prosus Ventures and operating primarily in the Brazilian (Portuguese) market. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface, so this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: BentoBox
providers.description: BentoBox is a restaurant marketing and commerce platform, part of Fiserv, that powers restaurant websites, online ordering, takeout and delivery, events, reservations, and digital presence for thousands of hospitality brands. While BentoBox runs a Technology Partners program and connects to 50+ third-party services across POS, reservations, delivery, payments, marketing, and shipping, it does not publish a public self-service developer API or API reference. Integrations are built through partnership rather than open documentation, and prospective technology partners are directed to contact the BentoBox partnerships team to integrate with the platform. As a Fiserv company, payments and commerce flows connect through Clover and Fiserv rails.

providers.name: Biren Technology
providers.description: Biren Technology (Shanghai Biren Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company that designs general-purpose GPUs (GPGPUs) for AI training, inference, and high-performance computing. Its flagship BR100-series accelerators are programmed through BIRENSUPA, a CUDA-like software platform that bundles the BRCC compiler, a hardware abstraction layer, deep-learning and general-compute acceleration libraries, and a developer toolchain with support for PyTorch, TensorFlow, and PaddlePaddle. Biren distributes its drivers, SDK, and documentation through its developer.birentech.com developer community rather than a public web/REST API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Captain's Eye
providers.description: Captain's Eye is a Haifa, Israel-based maritime AI company (founded 2020 by Uri Ben Dor and Doron Oizerovich, backed by Techstars) that delivers real-time video analytics software for maritime and industrial safety. Its SaaS platform connects to existing CCTV cameras, radar, and thermal sensors aboard merchant vessels, yachts, cruise ships, ports, and on-land petrochemical and energy sites, applying custom neural networks and commercial AI models to detect fires, smoke, leaks, sea pollution, missing protective gear, unauthorized access, and equipment failures. It provides real-time alerts, remote monitoring, incident documentation, and operational data collection, monitoring 5,000+ cameras and having detected 100,000+ events. Access is delivered through a private web application and mobile apps rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Chingona Ventures
providers.description: Chingona Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm that writes first institutional checks into pre-seed companies, typically investing $250,000 to $2 million into founders building in industries that are massively changing. The firm concentrates on financial technology, the future of work, the future of learning, and health technology, backing founders with unique market positioning in large, often overlooked growth markets. Its portfolio spans 40+ companies including Finix, Hologram, Suma Wealth, Honey Homes, Connect Care Hero, and Boom Pay. This API Evangelist profile was originally surfaced as a venture-capital lead and has been enriched with firm identity and domain-security signals; the firm publishes no public API, so API-specific artifacts are not applicable.

providers.name: Conifer
providers.description: Conifer (YC S26) builds Sage, a local-first AI runtime and workspace that runs models entirely on your own machine. Its inference engine is written from scratch in Rust, reaching up to 60% faster decode than llama.cpp on Apple Silicon, and pairs an editor, integrated terminal, file viewers, and an agent runtime inside a kernel-level sandbox so tool calls only touch what you allow. Conifer routes each request to the cheapest capable model, starting with free on-device inference and falling back to cloud only when needed, cutting AI spend by up to 80%. The desktop app ships as Juniper for macOS, Windows, and Linux with no accounts, no telemetry, and no cloud dependency. Conifer is proprietary and distributed as compiled binaries; it currently exposes no public web API.

providers.name: Creator Stack
providers.description: CreatorStack is a consumer creator-economy platform that helps independent creators own their audience instead of renting it from social networks. Its core product, the "Superclub," lets a creator build a membership community of paying super-fans, capture first-party audience data, and deepen engagement and loyalty that translates into stronger brand sponsorships. A forthcoming Royalty product will let creators share and sell royalties in their future content directly to the top fans who invest early, in exchange for perks and exclusive benefits. Backed by Accel, CreatorStack positions a creator's brand and audience as a true, ownable asset on the internet rather than a rented one.

providers.name: CrowdTwist
providers.description: CrowdTwist is a customer loyalty and engagement platform founded in New York City in 2009 and accelerated through Techstars. It lets consumer brands build multi-channel loyalty programs that reward customers for purchases, social sharing, referrals, and other engagement across web, mobile, email, and social channels, with points redeemable for rewards. CrowdTwist exposed a REST API for managing members, tracking earning and redemption activities, and administering points, tiers, and campaigns. Oracle acquired CrowdTwist in March 2019 and folded it into Oracle CX Marketing as Oracle CrowdTwist Loyalty and Engagement; the standalone crowdtwist.com site now redirects to Oracle and the developer documentation is hosted on Oracle Help Center.

providers.name: Ctrip
providers.description: Ctrip (Ctrip.com International / Trip.com Group, NASDAQ: TCOM) is one of the world's largest online travel agencies, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Shanghai, China. Its consumer platform sells hotels, flights, train tickets, car rentals, tours, cruises, and travel packages across China and internationally, and the broader Trip.com Group also operates the Trip.com, Qunar, and Skyscanner brands. Ctrip exposes partner and B2B travel-distribution capabilities through the Ctrip Open Platform (openapi.ctrip.com), the Trip.com Group open platform (connect.trip.com), and a corporate-travel developer platform (ctripbiz). These developer surfaces are partner-gated and largely account-restricted; no public OpenAPI or first-party SDK has been discovered for this profile.

providers.name: E-Pal
providers.description: E-Pal is a gaming social platform with the tagline "Never Battle Alone" that connects gamers to find teammates, compete, and socialize around competitive and casual gaming experiences. Its mobile apps (iOS and Android) let users discover gaming companions ("ePals"), form squads, use voice chat, play minigames, and hang out in social spaces. Product surfaces include Games (finding great teammates for titles like League of Legends and Valorant), Chilling (social hangout spaces), and Custom personalized experiences, plus a tiered community of eStars, Legend ePals (professional-rank players), and E-Chat. E-Pal is a consumer application and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts at this time; this profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and enriched as an identity-only lead.

providers.name: Eagle
providers.description: Eagle is a next-generation engineering firm founded in 2025 and based in New York City that builds AI-powered software for civil, structural, and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) engineers designing critical infrastructure. Rather than selling its technology, Eagle acquires and transforms engineering firms directly, pairing frontier design-automation, knowledge-infrastructure, and quality-control tooling with world-class engineers to deliver faster, higher-quality infrastructure design. It is a seed-stage portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. Eagle publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK today; this profile captures verified company identity only.

providers.name: Elemental
providers.description: Elemental (Elemental Technologies) was a Portland, Oregon video encoding and multiscreen delivery company founded in 2006 and backed by General Catalyst. Its software powered large over-the-top and broadcast video providers before Amazon Web Services acquired the company in 2015. The business now operates as the AWS Elemental brand within AWS Media Services, spanning cloud services (MediaConvert, MediaLive, MediaPackage, MediaConnect, MediaStore, MediaTailor) and on-premises appliances and software (Elemental Live, Elemental Server, Elemental Conductor, Elemental Statmux, Elemental Link). Elemental no longer operates an independent developer portal; its API surface is delivered through AWS SDKs and the AWS Elemental documentation. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; the investment exited via acquisition.

providers.name: Fourier Intelligence
providers.description: Fourier (Fourier Intelligence, founded 2015 and headquartered in Shanghai, China) is a full-stack robotics company that develops core robot technology and finished robot products. It began in rehabilitation robotics — exoskeletons and upper/lower-limb rehab devices such as the ArmMotus and ExoMotus lines and the RehabHub intelligent rehabilitation ecosystem — and has expanded into general-purpose humanoid robots (the GRx series, including GR-1 and GR-2), smart actuators (FSA), and dexterous hands. Fourier publishes first-party developer SDKs for robot control through its FFTAI GitHub organization: the RoCS (Robot Control System / General Robotics OS) client libraries for Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, and the fourier-grx control stack for the GRx humanoid series. Fourier is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. These are device/robot-control developer libraries rather than a hosted web API; the company publishes no public REST/OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Geneva
providers.description: Geneva is an all-in-one communication app for groups, clubs, and communities — "the online place to find your offline people." It bundles full-featured group chat (threaded replies, reactions, GIFs, attachments, polls, pins), audio/video rooms and livestreaming for hundreds of viewers, event planning, and wallet-connect with token-gated rooms for tokenized communities. Geneva ships as free iOS, Android, and web apps and was acquired by Bumble Inc. This API Evangelist profile entered the network as a VC-portfolio-sourced stub; the company publishes a consumer app with no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: GetSetup
providers.description: GetSetUp is a consumer education platform delivering live, interactive online classes designed specifically for older adults. Learners join expert-led sessions to build digital skills, stay physically and mentally active, pursue hobbies, and connect with a global community of peers. The catalog spans technology how-tos, health and wellness, finance, creativity, and social classes, offered in multiple languages across regions. GetSetUp partners with health plans, employers, libraries, and government programs to make classes accessible. Backed by Cowboy Ventures, it operates a business-to-consumer learning experience rather than a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Gherkin
providers.description: Gherkin is a business-readable, domain-specific language created to support Behavior-Driven Development (BDD). It lets teams describe software behavior in plain text using a structured Given-When-Then syntax that is human-readable and machine-parsable. Gherkin is the language used by Cucumber and many other BDD tools to define executable specifications and acceptance tests.

providers.name: INF Tech
providers.description: INF Tech (无限光年, "Infinite Light Year") is an AI-native technology company headquartered in Shanghai, with a global entity in Singapore (inf.sg), building safe and trustworthy agentic AI for mission-critical industries. Its flagship is an enterprise "Agentic OS" — an intelligent-agent operating system with unified governance, a private AI code-execution engine that supports custom LLMs and skills, and full-stack application security spanning model training through deployment. INF also develops and open-sources multimodal foundation models, including the Infinity-Parser document-parsing family, the INF-Retriever bilingual dense-retrieval models, OpenCoder code LLMs, and VL-Rethinker vision-language reasoning models, all published on Hugging Face and GitHub. Vertical "industry agents" target finance (AI index customization, compliance intelligence, investment research, and SME credit rating) alongside science and education. The company exposes API, CLI, and SDK access and supports MCP integration.

providers.name: ISO
providers.description: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) develops and publishes international standards covering technology, manufacturing, food safety, and many other industries. ISO standards provide globally recognized frameworks that help organizations ensure quality, safety, interoperability, and consistency in their products and processes.

providers.name: Jamba Juice
providers.description: Jamba (formerly Jamba Juice) is an American quick-service restaurant chain that blends fruit-and-vegetable smoothies, fresh juices, bowls, and boosts. Founded in 1990 in San Luis Obispo, California, it operates hundreds of locations and is owned by GoTo Foods (formerly Focus Brands). The brand runs a consumer website, mobile ordering apps, and a rewards program; it publishes no public developer API. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a trinity-ventures portfolio company.

providers.name: Jeh Aerospace
providers.description: Jeh Aerospace is a precision aerospace manufacturing company building "future factories" across the US-India corridor to supply aerostructures and aero-engine components for the commercial aerospace supply chain. From certified facilities in India spanning more than 160,000 square feet, Jeh delivers machining, sheet metal, tubes and pipes, surface treatment, structural assembly, and engineering services on time and at scale. The company is fully compliant with AS9100, ISO 9001, OEM requirements, and export regulations, and weaves a digital thread across its supplier networks for radical transparency. Jeh operates from both the US and India and is backed by General Catalyst and IndiGo Ventures.

providers.name: Meta4
providers.description: Meta4 is a human capital management (HCM) software provider founded in Madrid, Spain, delivering cloud-based payroll, talent, and time-management applications widely used across the Spanish-speaking world and Europe. Backed by Insight Partners, Meta4 was acquired by Cegid in 2019 and its PeopleNet HCM platform is now delivered as part of the Cegid HR product family. The developer surface — Core HR, payroll, and talent APIs — is published through the Cegid HR developer portal rather than a standalone Meta4 developer program.

providers.name: Mirana Toys
providers.description: Mirana Toys (Mirana Innovations Pvt Ltd) is an India-based smart-toy company and OEM/ODM manufacturer of electronic toys — RC cars, monster trucks, drones, educational toys, and AI/AR toys. It pairs its consumer products with the Mirana smart app (iOS and Android), a mobile gaming platform that lets kids and adults control and play with Mirana toys over Bluetooth. As an OEM partner it offers in-house PCB/PCBA design and SMT assembly, tooling and mold design, mobile app development, compliance support (ASTM, EN-71, RoHS, ISO, SMETA), and global logistics for toy brands and retailers. Backed by Accel. The company publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront and support center but no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: morewis
providers.description: Morewis (摩尔元数) is a Chinese industrial software company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Xiamen, Fujian, that develops cloud-based Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) software for the manufacturing sector. Its Morewis Cloud industrial internet platform, MoreDEV low-code development platform (including the WisIDE cloud IDE), and MoreAgent / N³ industrial AI large model let manufacturers build and run smart-factory applications with reduced hand coding. Reference clients include Haier, Hisense, Aisino, Inspur, and 3Trees Group. The company raised a ~100M yuan Series B led by Qiming Venture Partners. No public English-language REST API, OpenAPI, SDK, or GitHub organization was found; the developer surface is a China-hosted low-code industrial application platform.

providers.name: mth Sense
providers.description: mth Sense (Mth Sense Inc.), operating as RevSense, is a mobile ad-technology company founded in 2011 by Mandar Agte and Mohan Balachandran and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2012). It began as a mobile on-device profiling and ad-serving platform that inferred demographic and psychographic audience profiles from app-usage data, and has evolved into a programmatic yield and revenue-optimization platform for digital publishers. The RevSense product suite provides machine-learning yield optimization (real-time price floors, frequency caps, geo controls), automated header-bidding tag management, a unified reporting and data platform aggregating ad-server and demand-partner data, and one-click demand/buyer integration. mth Sense markets to publishers, agencies, SSPs, ad networks, and advertisers, and will build private exchanges with an RTB engine and common reporting dashboards. As of this profile the company publishes a static marketing website with no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: MyCrypto
providers.description: MyCrypto is a free, open-source, client-side interface for managing Ethereum accounts and interacting with the Ethereum blockchain. Founded in 2015, it is a non-custodial wallet — private keys never leave the user's device — supporting hardware wallets, Web3 and browser wallets, and offline transaction signing. In February 2022 MyCrypto was acquired by ConsenSys to consolidate with MetaMask and unify the Web3 wallet experience. MyCrypto ships no public REST API; its developer surface is the open-source application codebase and the JavaScript/TypeScript libraries (eth-scan, ethereum-blockies-base64, asset mappings) published under the MyCryptoHQ GitHub organization.

providers.name: OctoAI
providers.description: OctoAI (formerly OctoML) was a Seattle-based AI inference platform founded in 2019 as a University of Washington Allen School spin-out of the Apache TVM project. The company originally focused on machine-learning model optimization and compilation across CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators, and in June 2023 launched a generative-AI SaaS inference platform that served open-source foundation models (Llama 2, Mixtral, SDXL, Stable Diffusion, Whisper) behind OpenAI-style REST APIs with Python and TypeScript SDKs. In January 2024 OctoML formally rebranded to OctoAI and in April 2024 unveiled OctoStack, a self-contained generative-AI production stack for deploying models inside customer VPC and on-premises environments across NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and AWS Inferentia. NVIDIA acquired OctoAI in September 2024 for a reported $165M (down from a 2021 peak valuation of ~$900M), with CEO Luis Ceze and key staff joining NVIDIA. OctoAI sent customers a "Wind down of OctoAI Services" notice and terminated all hosted endpoints, accounts, and SDK access on 31 October 2024. The octo.ai domain now 301-redirects to nvidia.com and no public OctoAI product, API, dashboard, or developer portal remains; the technology has been absorbed into NVIDIA's internal AI inference stack and is not separately purchasable. This catalog entry is a historical record of the former OctoAI developer surface and the GitHub artifacts that remain.

providers.name: OpenID Connect
providers.description: OpenID Connect (OIDC) is an identity authentication protocol that is an extension of OAuth 2.0. It enables clients to verify the identity of end-users and obtain basic profile information in a secure, standardized way using JSON Web Tokens (JWT).

providers.name: Osmaura
providers.description: Osmaura is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an AI-powered business development platform for corporate law firm partners. Its agents monitor the web, news, social media, and a firm's internal context to surface targeted new-matter opportunities, then recommend tailored outreach strategies. The platform works in three stages: building partner profiles from practice areas and networks, identifying prospective clients and their legal needs from external data sources, and suggesting engagement approaches for each opportunity. Founded by MIT graduates Kali Abeje and Jity Woldemichael. As of this profile the company publishes only a marketing landing page and a booking link — no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs exist yet. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead awaiting an API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Payitoff
providers.description: Payitoff is an embedded-fintech platform that helps banks, lenders, credit unions, and fintech apps guide their customers through debt management and student-loan optimization. Its embeddable widgets and partner API let institutions surface personalized debt-payoff plans, federal student-loan repayment and forgiveness enrollment (IDR/PSLF), refinancing guidance, and consolidation workflows directly inside their own digital experiences. Payitoff was acquired by Array, the embeddable finance and consumer-credit platform, where it now powers the Student Loan Aid and broader debt product suite delivered through Array's embed layer. The developer surface is a partner-gated platform (sandbox, embed SDK, and partner portal) rather than a fully public, self-serve API. Payitoff is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Protectt AI
providers.description: Protectt.ai (Protectt.ai Labs Pvt Ltd) is an AI-native, full-stack mobile application security and fraud-control platform for Android and iOS. Its products — AppProtectt (RASP with 100+ runtime protections against hooking, spoofing, reverse engineering, tampering, MITM and SMS exploitation), SDKProtectt (SDK hardening/obfuscation), and ApiProtectt (API security) — embed as a lightweight SDK with zero performance overhead and no disruption to release cycles. The company targets banking, financial services and regulated enterprises (RBL Bank, Yes Bank, BSE, Bajaj Finserv, LIC), is ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 / ISO 22301 and PCI DSS certified, and aligns to RBI, SEBI and NPCI security mandates. It is headquartered in Mumbai with offices in Dover (Delaware, US) and Dubai (UAE). Protectt.ai ships enterprise SDKs to customers rather than a public developer portal or open API — no OpenAPI, SDK registry package, or public API reference is published.

providers.name: Ring Radar
providers.description: Ring Radar is horse show management software for the equestrian industry, operating at ringradar.com. The web-based platform helps horse show organizers, managers, and exhibitors run competitions end to end - handling show entries, class scheduling, ring coordination, results, and exhibitor information. Ring Radar is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this profile the company runs a consumer web application (login and signup) but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer documentation surface that could be discovered.

providers.name: Ritual
providers.description: Ritual is a Toronto-based restaurant order-ahead and "social ordering" platform (ritual.co, founded 2014) that lets consumers pre-order, pay, and skip the line at local restaurants and coffee shops, and lets colleagues pile onto a shared order for group pickup. For restaurants it offers Ritual ONE (online ordering, company/building perk programs, and Ritual for Coffee). Ritual does NOT publish a public or self-serve developer API - there is no developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or authentication documentation. Restaurant order injection into point-of-sale systems is handled through partner/POS integrations (documented on partnersupport.ritual.co) and third-party ordering aggregators such as Deliverect, not through a Ritual-published API. Operating status - Ritual continues to operate the consumer app and online-ordering platform, but the business is distressed and in transition - revenue fell from ~US$11M (2021) to ~US$3.9M (H1 2024) with repeated layoffs, and in January 2025 Shopify "acqui-hired" the co-founders (CEO Ray Reddy became Shopify's VP of Retail/POS) and much of the R&D team while a separate process to sell the standalone Ritual business was underway. This entry is a documentation stub with no APIs modeled because none are publicly documented.

providers.name: RoomRaccoon
providers.description: RoomRaccoon is an all-in-one hotel management software platform for independent hotels, B&Bs, guesthouses, hostels, and small chains, founded in 2017 by Tymen van Dyl and Nadja Buckenberger and headquartered in Breda, Netherlands with major operations in Cape Town, South Africa, plus offices in Valencia, Spain and Lisbon, Portugal. The platform bundles a cloud Property Management System (PMS), a Channel Manager that synchronises rates, availability, and restrictions across 200+ OTAs, metasearch engines, GDSs, and bedbanks, a commission-free Booking Engine for direct website bookings with bookable add-ons, RaccoonPay for integrated, multi-currency guest payments, and RaccoonRev for competitor insights and revenue management. RoomRaccoon advertises 400+ integrations with partners such as Booking.com, Expedia, Lightspeed, and Sage, and was named World's Best Hotel Channel Manager at the 2023 World Travel Tech Awards. A connectivity / partner API exists at api.roomraccoon.com (e.g. POS endpoint at /api/?type=POS&version=2) but is access-controlled: prospective integrators must request an API key and Hotel ID by emailing connectivity@roomraccoon.com, and no public OpenAPI specification, public SDKs, or public GitHub organisation are published.

providers.name: Securly
providers.description: Securly is a K-12 student safety company whose platform spans web filtering, device management (MDM), classroom management, and student wellness/self-harm and threat monitoring across the web, email, and cloud drives. Securly is deployed by school districts and integrates with the school technology stack - Google Workspace, Microsoft 365/Entra, Apple School Manager, and Student Information Systems via the OneRoster and rostering standards. Securly's public developer surface is limited and access-gated - it primarily CONSUMES rostering and identity APIs from external systems rather than exposing a documented public developer API. The one provider-exposed API is a credential-gated Securly MDM API used by third-party device/asset systems to pull device inventory and assign or unassign students to devices; its endpoints and base URL are provisioned per tenant and are not publicly documented as a reference.

providers.name: Spiral
providers.description: Spiral (SpiralDB) is a multimodal data platform built for the "machine consumer" — frontier AI systems and agents. It unifies video, images, audio, embeddings, point clouds, sensor streams, tables, and text under one query language and coordinate-frame system, serving everything from raw bytes to model-ready tensors at machine-scale throughput for pretraining pipelines and agentic access. Spiral is the creator of Vortex, a high-performance extensible columnar data format (100x faster random access and 10-20x faster scans vs. Apache Parquet) now incubating under the Linux Foundation, along with the FastLanes, FSST, and ALP compression libraries. The hosted Spiral warehouse is currently invite-only (Request Access); the public developer surface today is the open-source Vortex ecosystem (Python and Rust bindings). Backed by Amplify Partners and General Catalyst.

providers.name: Stader
providers.description: Stader Labs is a non-custodial, smart-contract-driven liquid-staking protocol that lets users stake crypto assets and earn rewards while retaining liquidity through liquid-staking tokens (ETHx, MaticX, BNBX, HBARX, NEARx) usable across 40+ DeFi protocols. Stader operates across multiple chains — Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Hedera and NEAR — with open-source smart contracts and node tooling. Its developer surface is on-chain contracts, a Go node client (stader-node) and permissioned CLI, and public GitHub source rather than a hosted REST/OpenAPI API. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; probes confirm no public HTTP API, well-known discovery, or llms.txt surface at this time.

providers.name: United Continental Holdings
providers.description: United Continental Holdings, now known as United Airlines Holdings, Inc., is the parent holding company of United Airlines. It was formed through the merger of United Airlines and Continental Airlines in 2010. As the parent company, it oversees United Airlines' operations, which include one of the world's largest airline route networks. The company's APIs and digital services are delivered through United Airlines.

providers.name: United States Africa Command
providers.description: United States Africa Command (AFRICOM) is a unified combatant command of the United States Department of Defense responsible for military operations and coordination in Africa. AFRICOM's primary mission is to advance U.S. national security interests and promote regional stability through security cooperation, military assistance, and joint training exercises with African partner nations. AFRICOM is headquartered at Kelley Barracks in Stuttgart, Germany and maintains relationships with 53 African nations. The command is led by a four-star general and conducts operations spanning humanitarian assistance, counter-terrorism, peacekeeping support, and capacity-building activities across the continent.

providers.name: VideoPoint
providers.description: VideoPoint is a Shopify app from TouchPoints Inc. (a 500 Global portfolio company) that turns a merchant's existing product photos and videos into shoppable, on-site experiences on product-detail and collection pages, with the company reporting an 11-35% conversion uplift and 60-120x ROI from existing content. It is part of the broader TouchPoints suite of AI-powered Shopify apps (alongside TryPoint virtual try-on, plus A/B testing and AI-powered chat) built to engage shoppers, boost conversions, and drive more sales. VideoPoint ships as an embedded Shopify app installed from the Shopify App Store; it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile and enrichment lead.

providers.name: Virool
providers.description: Virool is a native video advertising platform that distributes branded video content ("advertainment") across the web to help brands reach and grow targeted audiences. It pairs a proprietary data-management platform of roughly 450 million unique profiles for granular audience targeting with native video placement technology designed to minimize disruption to the user experience, and a real-time performance analytics dashboard that includes emotional insight tracking (eIQ). Virool serves advertisers and publishers through self-service campaign and monetization dashboards rather than a public developer API. The company was backed by 500 Global and a16z and has run campaigns for brands including Turkish Airlines, Under Armour, and WestJet.

providers.name: Windward
providers.description: Windward is a Maritime AI company headquartered in London and Washington D.C. delivering mission-grade, multi-source maritime intelligence for defense agencies, law enforcement, customs, energy and commodity traders, marine insurers, shippers, and financial institutions. Founded by CEO Ami Daniel, Windward fuses AIS data, remote sensing (EO, SAR, RF GEOINT), proprietary behavioral analytics, and generative AI into a single Maritime AI platform covering vessel screening, ownership and entity resolution, sanctions exposure, deceptive shipping detection, ship-to-ship transfer analysis, IUU fishing detection, smuggling detection, container tracking, and maritime infrastructure protection. Windward exposes its intelligence through the API Insights Lab, a unified GraphQL API at developer.windward.ai providing programmatic access to vessel risk scores, Organization Defined Risk (ODR), ultimate beneficial ownership, early detection signals, tracked shipments, carriers, and detention & demurrage data, along with webhooks and workflow automation. The company has no public REST/OpenAPI surface, no public SDKs, and no public GitHub org — its API is GraphQL-only with managed onboarding and expert-led implementation support.

providers.name: 2X
providers.description: 2X is the global leader in B2B Marketing-as-a-Service (MaaS), a subscription-based alternative to traditional B2B marketing delivery models. Founded in 2017 by three former B2B CMOs and led by CEO Domenic Colasante, 2X provides AI-enabled marketing talent and strategic consulting spanning marketing operations, MarTech management, campaign build and demand generation, content and creative production, GTM engineering, and revenue strategy consulting. With more than 1,000 team members across five continents, 2X serves over 150 enterprise clients including SAP, Ricoh, Docker, Seismic, Qlik, and GoTo, and is backed by private-equity firms Recognize and Insight Partners.

providers.name: Acerta Analytics
providers.description: Acerta (Acerta Analytics Solutions Inc.) is an industrial AI company whose LinePulse platform applies machine learning to real-time discrete-manufacturing production data to detect and resolve quality defects early. It helps automotive and manufacturing teams reduce scrap, rework, and end-of-line testing while protecting throughput, ingesting data from MES, PLC, and QMS systems and deploying in under 30 days. Surfaced as an EQT Ventures portfolio company; no public developer API or documentation is exposed today (data connectivity is via a private ingestion API and prebuilt integrations such as ETQ and Microsoft).

providers.name: Aclarity Water
providers.description: Aclarity, Inc. (Aclarity Water) is a Medway, Massachusetts cleantech company that designs and manufactures on-site PFAS destruction technology. Its flagship Aclarity Octa system uses electrochemical oxidation to break the carbon-fluorine bond in per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), destroying these "forever chemicals" at landfills, centralized waste-treatment facilities, industrial sites (laundry, pulp and paper, automotive), municipal and industrial wastewater, drinking-water treatment, and AFFF-contaminated aviation sites. Aclarity is a portfolio company of DCVC. It is a physical water-treatment hardware and services business with no public developer API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence.

providers.name: AI Fleet
providers.description: Aifleet (aifleet.com) is a technology-driven, full-stack trucking carrier founded in 2020 and headquartered in Austin, Texas. The company describes itself as the first full-stack, AI-driven carrier, pairing company drivers with proprietary AI algorithms and its own Transportation Management System (TMS) to optimize truck utilization, routing, load matching, fuel usage, and scheduling across the roughly $400B U.S. freight sector. Aifleet emphasizes a driver-centric model — better pay, predictable schedules, and reduced wait times — alongside shipper-facing services with proactive tracking updates and predictive ETAs. It has raised roughly $50M since founding (Series A 2021, venture round 2023, Series B 2024) from investors including Obvious Ventures, Ibex Investors, Volvo Group Venture Capital, Compound, and Heron Rock. Aifleet is a logistics service provider rather than a developer-facing API platform; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: Aiperia
providers.description: Aiperia (formerly PlanerAI) is a German AI company whose SaaS platform automates demand forecasting and fresh-food supply-chain planning from production through to the end consumer. Its machine-learning models predict fresh-food demand up to 21 days ahead using around 150 external factors, then generate automated order and production suggestions for bakeries and self-service stations, food manufacturers, and supermarkets to reduce food waste and overproduction. Aiperia is a portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital.

providers.name: Allen Control Systems
providers.description: Allen Control Systems is a defense technology company building autonomous precision weapon stations that detect, track, and neutralize unmanned aerial systems (drones) for military and partner forces. Its Bullfrog family of robotic gun mounts (M240C, M2, M230, M134) pairs passive machine-vision drone detection with autonomous fire-control targeting, synthetic training-data generation, and low-collateral engagement options such as laser dazzlers and composite rounds. The systems use an open architecture to integrate with command-and-control platforms. Backed by Craft Ventures, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a defense-sector provider; it publishes no public developer API, portal, or specification at this time.

providers.name: Andco
providers.description: Andco is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an AI-agent platform that automates the pre-litigation case workup process for personal injury law firms. Its agents retrieve and synthesize case documents across fax, phone, email, mail, web portal, and SMS channels, including police and accident reports, insurance coverage verification, medical records, and medical bills, then draft demand letters and calculate damages. Andco covers auto accident, premises liability, medical malpractice, workplace injury, and mass tort practice areas, offering same-day go-live and a free trial on the first case. This profile was surfaced from Andco's Y Combinator portfolio listing and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Andco publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: Arondite
providers.description: Arondite is a defence technology company building Cobalt, a defence software platform for accelerated decision making that orchestrates missions and manages operational intelligence. Cobalt brings together sighting reports, real-time notifications and alerts, mapping and visualisation, task management and kanban workflows, and observation and monitoring tools to support complex military and defence operations across use cases including Hybrid Navy, C-UAS, Recce-Strike, and Site Security. Arondite combines operational and technical expertise to deliver technology with immediate, real-world impact on a global scale. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures. Arondite does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Aurelius Systems
providers.description: Aurelius Systems is a defense technology company building autonomous directed-energy laser defense platforms for counter-unmanned-aerial-system (C-UAS) missions. Its flagship product, Archimedes, fuses high-power lasers, advanced optical sensing, and AI-guided autonomous tracking into a compact, field-deployable platform that detects, tracks, and neutralizes Group 1 and Group 2 drone threats at the speed of light and a fraction of the cost of traditional interceptors. The system runs on grid, generator, or commercial off-the-shelf batteries, is designed to operate without human operators, and can be networked into modular defensive grids to protect troops, bases, and critical infrastructure. Founded in 2025 by Michael LaFramboise and John Marmaduke, the company raised a $10M seed round co-led by General Catalyst and Draper Associates and is partnered with American Rheinmetall. Aurelius currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or software developer surface — it is a directed-energy hardware company.

providers.name: AutoChilango
providers.description: AutoChilango (Auto Chilango) is a Mexico City-based mobile application that consolidates the everyday services drivers in CDMX and the State of Mexico need into a single app. It covers the "Hoy No Circula" driving-restriction calendar, vehicular verification schedules, traffic fines (multas) lookup and payment, annual registration (tenencia), insurance, parking, gas stations, and mechanical services for private cars, motorcycles, taxis, and special plates. Backed by 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer/API surface has been found, so this profile captures the provider's identity, information surface (blog, FAQs, privacy), and probed domain security.

providers.name: Ayr Energy
providers.description: Ayr Energy is a power grid equipment manufacturer founded in 2024 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, backed by General Catalyst. The company designs and builds custom-engineered electrical infrastructure - power, distribution, and special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear - for renewable energy, data center, utility, industrial, and oil & gas customers. Ayr operates six manufacturing facilities across India (Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Tamil Nadu) and emphasizes accelerated delivery of grid hardware in months rather than years. Ayr Energy does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: B&L Information Systems
providers.description: B&L Information Systems, LLC is a metalcasting-focused enterprise resource planning (ERP) software company founded more than 50 years ago and headquartered in Bridgman, Michigan. Its flagship product, Odyssey ERP, is a cloud-based ERP purpose-built for foundries, die casters, and investment casters, spanning manufacturing, sales, inventory, quality, finance, and data analytics. B&L pairs the software with implementation, consulting, data-conversion, training, and support services tailored to the metalcasting industry. The company is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. As of this enrichment pass, B&L does not publish a public developer portal, REST API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI definition, so this profile captures company identity and public web properties rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Bizongo
providers.description: Bizongo is a Mumbai-based B2B commerce and supply-chain platform founded in 2015 that digitizes procurement, vendor management, and supply-chain financing for enterprises across India, with a focus on packaging, raw materials, and made-to-order goods. It operates a SaaS-led vendor digitization stack plus an embedded-finance offering, connecting large buyers with a network of manufacturing partners. Bizongo is backed by Accel, Chiratae Ventures, B Capital, and others. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass Bizongo publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, or /.well-known discovery surface — third-party logistics integration is offered only through carrier aggregators such as ClickPost, so most API-artifact scoring dimensions are not applicable.

providers.name: Bondai
providers.description: Bondai is a group-travel planning and booking platform, delivered primarily as a mobile app, that helps friends organize trips together in one place. It targets millennials and tackles the friction of collaborative travel by combining itinerary coordination, deal discovery, destination inspiration, group communication, expense splitting, and booking of experiences into a single social workflow. The company frames its mission around "travel dreams made real" and lasting friendships formed through travel. Bondai also curates and sells local experiences and stays (villas, tours, and guided outings), with early activity concentrated around Saudi Arabian destinations such as AlUla, Makkah, Madina, Jazan, and Tabuk. It is a consumer travel product with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time. Bondai is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Brumby
providers.description: Brumby (formerly GrazeMate) is a Y Combinator-backed (W2026) precision-grazing company based in Sydney, Australia, building an autonomous drone toolkit for cattle ranchers. Brumby drones plan routes and move herds with gentle, AI-guided pressure, fly scheduled monitoring missions that locate and count every animal, measure standing dry-matter pasture biomass from the air, and inspect water troughs, tanks and fences on every flight — all managed from a single phone app that works online or in a local base-station mode without connectivity. The company is running pilot programs and does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or documentation; this profile is a company lead maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Calamu Technologies
providers.description: Calamu Technologies is a data-first cybersecurity company founded in 2019 and headquartered in Clinton, New Jersey. Its flagship product, Calamu Protect (Data Harbor), is a cyber vault for backup and recovery data that uses a patented process to fragment and scatter data across multiple storage locations, rendering it valueless ("Digital Sludge") to attackers even if breached and instantly reassembling it for authorized applications and users. Calamu integrates with enterprise backup platforms including Veeam, Veritas NetBackup, Dell EMC, Nutanix, Wasabi, and StarWind, and exposes an S3-compatible storage interface for data protection. The company is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Candela
providers.description: Candela is a Swedish manufacturer of electric hydrofoiling boats and ferries, on a mission to decarbonize waterborne transportation. Its proprietary computer-controlled hydrofoil system, C-Pod electric propulsion, and C-Foil technology lift the hull clear of the water to cut energy consumption by roughly 80% versus conventional planing hulls, enabling silent, long-range, zero-emission travel. Products span leisure craft (the C-8 and C-7 dayboats) and professional vessels (the P-12 electric ferry and shuttle for public and commercial transport). Backed by EQT Ventures, Candela is a hardware and mobility company; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. This record captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: Chefs for Seniors
providers.description: Chefs for Seniors is an in-home personal chef service for older adults, founded in 2013 by Barrett and Nathan Allman. Locally-owned franchise chefs come to a senior's home to plan menus, grocery shop, and cook 10-15 servings of fresh, customized meals each visit for about the cost of meal delivery. Menus rotate across 175+ options and accommodate diabetic, low-sodium, kidney-friendly, vegetarian, and other dietary needs, reviewed by a Registered Dietitian. The company operates across roughly 99 US locations, serves about 15,000 clients, and has prepared over 2.5 million meals. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Chefs for Seniors publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Chemix
providers.description: Chemix is an artificial-intelligence company building an end-to-end, AI-enabled power system for batteries, organized around the themes of power safety, observability, and predictability. Based in Sunnyvale, California, the company applies generative and machine-learning techniques to make battery behavior more transparent and predictable across the battery lifecycle. Chemix is a Mayfield-backed portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this profile the company is pre-launch ("more product details coming soon") and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications; this record captures verifiable company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: CHINT
providers.description: CHINT (Chint Group) is a global smart-energy and intelligent-electrical solutions provider founded in 1984 and headquartered in Wenzhou, China, with operations across more than 140 countries. Its portfolio spans low-voltage electrical equipment (IEC and UL), power transmission and distribution systems, switchgear, instruments and meters, EV charging, and clean-energy systems including solar PV and battery storage, serving power utilities, buildings, telecom and data centers, industrial, and OEM sectors. CHINT does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and its public web properties. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan / former Sequoia China).

providers.name: Cholamandalam
providers.description: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company (Chola) is an Indian non-banking financial company (NBFC) headquartered in Chennai and part of the Murugappa Group (CIN L65993TN1978PLC007576). It provides lending across vehicle finance (commercial vehicles, cars, two-wheelers, three-wheelers, tractors and construction equipment), home loans and loan against property, SME/MSME and business loans, supply chain finance, gold loans, and consumer and personal loans through a branch network across India. No public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs were found during enrichment; the company operates consumer/branch and mobile-app (Chola One) channels rather than a published developer program. Group affiliates include Chola Securities and the Gaadi Bazaar vehicle marketplace.

providers.name: Clicktivated
providers.description: Clicktivated is a video technology platform that turns existing video content into interactive, shoppable experiences without re-shooting or re-editing. Its "Activate, Distribute, Optimize" workflow makes any video clickable the same day, deploys it programmatically across DSPs, SSPs, publishers, and direct site embeds, and captures first-party intent signals - item-level and place-level - to improve targeting, measure lift, and drive better performance. The company serves retail brands closing the gap between inspiration and purchase, and tourism brands converting inspiration into itineraries. Founded as Clicktivated Video, Inc. and backed by Techstars, with offices in Detroit, New York, Dubai, and Sydney.

providers.name: CloudAStructure Inc
providers.description: Cloudastructure Inc. is a cloud-based AI video surveillance and remote guarding company that combines cloud infrastructure, computer-vision machine learning, and live human monitoring to detect and deter crime in real time. Its platform offers license plate recognition, facial recognition, motion-zone detection, and cloud storage with instant playback across multifamily, commercial, construction, storage, logistics, and campus properties. As of this profile the company operates a marketing and product website with no public developer API, documentation portal, or OpenAPI surface; the company has stated an intent to offer an open API platform for integrations in the future. This API Evangelist profile is a portfolio-lead stub enriched with domain-security probe data and verified public link properties.

providers.name: Cloudwell
providers.description: Cloudwell (cloudwell.io) is a Microsoft 365 and Azure-focused software partner founded in 2012, offering a suite of SharePoint and Teams apps: Calendar Overlay, Org Chart, Staff Directory, Team Members, and Viva Announcements - all distributed via Microsoft AppSource. Cloudwell does not publish a public REST API; their products are consumed inside SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, and Viva Connections via SharePoint Framework (SPFx) web parts and the Microsoft Graph API. The "opal" suffix in this repository name is preserved for index continuity but Cloudwell does not currently ship a product named Opal.

providers.name: Cognuse
providers.description: Cognuse is a digital health company offering a comprehensive rehabilitation platform for the continuum of care. Its CoNurse product is a guidelines adherence and management system that empowers clinicians, caregivers, and family members across the ICU, inpatient rehabilitation, and outpatient / chronic-disease-management settings. Capabilities include patient and family ICU dashboards, interactive diagnostic and procedural content, therapy and virtual exercises, actionable clinical-guideline creation and management, continuous patient education, automated discharge documentation, an interactive day planner, and progress visualization and analytics. Based in San Diego, California, and backed by 500 Global. This profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Cognuse publishes a company/marketing site but no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Collegepulse
