providers.description: College Pulse is an American market research and data analytics firm that specializes in survey-based insights from college students. Through an online student panel of 800,000+ verified undergraduates across 1,500+ campuses in all 50 states, it has collected 130+ million survey responses and offers custom research, brand trackers, and syndicated reports to brands, media, and nonprofit organizations. Its work is used by outlets and institutions including The New York Times, the Knight Foundation, FiveThirtyEight, Forbes, Dell, GE, and Chegg. College Pulse is a research services company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web surface and domain security posture.

providers.name: Connected Robotics
providers.description: Connected Robotics Inc. is a Japanese foodtech startup, founded in 2014 by Tetsuya Sawanobori and headquartered in Koganei, Tokyo, that develops specialized robotics and AI systems to automate labor-intensive work across food factories and restaurants. Its product line pairs AI image-processing and robot-control technology with purpose-built machines including the Delibot S plating robot, Delibot X filling robot, AI inspection software, a soft-serve ice-cream robot, and a french-fry cooking robot, targeting labor shortages, productivity, and food safety. The company has raised multiple rounds (including a July 2019 Series A led by Global Brain and a Series B closed in 2023 with strategic investors such as Yaskawa Electric, Hoshizaki, and Mitsubishi HC Capital) and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. As a hardware and robotics manufacturer, Connected Robotics publishes no public web API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: ConverzAI
providers.description: ConverzAI is a Seattle-based artificial intelligence company (founded 2019) that builds an agentic, voice-first AI platform for the recruitment and staffing industry. Its flagship Virtual Recruiter deploys autonomous AI agents that source, engage, screen, and match candidates through natural conversations over voice, text, and email, then update the customer's applicant tracking system automatically. The platform integrates with major ATS products used by staffing firms (Avionte, Bullhorn, Ceipal, JobDiva, Salesforce, TempWorks and others) and lets a single recruiter engage hundreds of thousands of candidates in parallel. ConverzAI raised a $16M Series A led by Menlo Ventures in February 2025 and reports processing over 100,000 jobs while engaging millions of candidates. This is a product/application company profile; ConverzAI does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store
providers.description: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. is an American chain of restaurants and gift shops with a Southern country theme, offering home-style meals and retail merchandise. Founded in 1969 and headquartered in Lebanon, Tennessee, Cracker Barrel operates roughly 656 restaurant and retail locations across 44 U.S. states. No public API or developer portal is published; the company offers a consumer website, iOS and Android mobile ordering apps, To-Go and catering ordering, gift cards, and the Cracker Barrel Rewards loyalty program for guests.

providers.name: Craon
providers.description: Craon (craon.ai) is an AI-native video editing platform where users edit through natural-language chat instead of a traditional timeline. Creators describe their intent in plain language — "make this more cinematic", "build tension before the reveal", "warm golden-hour grade" — and Craon's AI performs the cuts, color grading, pacing, silence removal, scene detection, subtitle generation, and emotional storytelling automatically. It targets content creators, YouTubers, social and short-form creators, filmmakers, and marketing teams who want professional results without timeline experience or color-theory skills, positioning itself as an AI-native alternative to CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, iMovie, Filmora, Runway, and Descript. Craon is an early-stage company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. The product is a consumer web application with no public developer API; its only machine-facing surface today is a published /llms.txt for AI discovery.

providers.name: Crewline
providers.description: Crewline is an autonomous heavy-equipment company that retrofits existing construction machinery to operate self-driving. Its hardware retrofit kit installs on-site in about an hour and adds autonomy to drum rollers today (compatible with Caterpillar, Bomag, Hamm, Volvo, and CASE), with dozers on the 2027 roadmap and rock trucks, excavators, motor graders, and wheel loaders in development. It is offered on a subscription model with zero upfront cost, a fixed monthly rate per machine, and 24/7 technical support, targeting earthworks and grading crews. Crewline is backed by Initialized Capital and headquartered in San Francisco. It publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Cron Systems
providers.description: Cron Systems (now operating as Cron AI) builds deep-learning perception software for 3D sensor and LiDAR data. Its flagship platform, senseEDGE, performs real-time 3D object detection, classification, and tracking from point-cloud data at the edge, with multi-sensor fusion and adverse-weather resilience. The technology serves intelligent transportation systems, smart infrastructure, autonomous mobility, smart cities, and security and surveillance — powering use cases such as traffic management, autonomous tolling, crowd and queue management, smart parking, vehicle counting, and airport and aircraft-movement monitoring. Object output is emitted as JSON and Flatbuffers binary over WebSocket, with a web-based configuration and visualizer utility, VPN and PTP time-synchronization support, and a privacy-preserving, GDPR-compliant design. Cron AI was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company currently publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Cubenergy
providers.description: Cubenergy (ShenZhen Cubenergy Co., Ltd. / 库博能源) is a BloombergNEF Tier 1 manufacturer of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) for commercial, industrial, and utility-scale deployments. The company integrates self-developed Battery Systems, BMS, and EMS with grid, PV, wind, and diesel generation into standardized, all-in-one, transportable, EPC-free energy storage products (FlexCombo, PowerCombo E5, FlexCombo D2, FlexCube C1). Its products are certified to UL9540, UL9540A, and NFPA855, and it offers an O&M platform plus bankability (DNV certified, AIG insured) for funded and insured projects. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. Cubenergy publishes a corporate marketing site with no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: Cx2
providers.description: CX2 is a defense technology company building AI-enabled electromagnetic spectrum (electronic warfare) systems for the tactical edge. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in El Segundo, California, CX2 develops attritable, machine-learning-powered hardware and software that detect, disrupt, and geolocate RF threats across land, air, sea, and space. Its flagship products are Wraith, a roughly 32-pound autonomous airborne EW platform that geolocates and identifies hostile emitters such as jammers and radars in GPS-denied environments, and Vadris, an RF-seeking payload for FPV drones that hunts ground control stations and other emitters of interest. CX2 is backed by 8VC, Point72 Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, and others, and sells directly to military and government customers. It does not currently publish a public API or developer portal.

providers.name: Cylake
providers.description: Cylake is an AI-native cybersecurity company founded in 2026 by Nir Zuk, Wilson Xu, and Ehud (Udi) Shamir — veterans of Palo Alto Networks — to deliver complete, data-driven security for the world's largest and most regulated organizations that require total data sovereignty. Its platform combines hardware and software with agentic workflows on a single, sovereign data foundation, running on-premises or in a private cloud with no dependence on public cloud or external AI services. Cylake launched publicly in March 2026 with a $45M seed round led by Greylock Partners (with IQT participating), is being built alongside several design partners, and plans general availability in early 2027. As of this writing Cylake does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs — this profile tracks the company's identity and public surface pending an API program.

providers.name: DailyDeal.de
providers.description: DailyDeal.de is a German consumer deals, coupons, and discounts platform ("Deals, Gutscheine & Schnäppchen") that aggregates daily deals across categories including electronics, fashion, home and garden, beauty, kids, sports, and free-to-try product samples ("gratis testen"). Shoppers browse discounted products, brand vouchers, and shop-specific coupon codes, and read shopping guides in the site's Magazin. Originally founded in Berlin in 2009 and briefly owned by Google, DailyDeal today operates as a WordPress-based consumer commerce and content site and publishes no public developer API program. It was added to the API Evangelist network as an Insight Partners portfolio lead.

providers.name: DailyMealz
providers.description: DailyMealz is a Saudi Arabia-based meal subscription service that delivers fresh daily lunches and full-day meal plans sourced from a network of more than sixty partner restaurants. Subscribers choose a package (healthy, keto, diet, and similar options), select meals from a rotating menu, and control delivery timing through the DailyMealz mobile app. The company also operates a DailyMealz for Business offering for corporate meal programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; DailyMealz is an app-first consumer brand and publishes no public developer API surface, documentation portal, or API specifications as of this profiling round.

providers.name: DayOne
providers.description: DayOne is a hyperscale data center company delivering next-generation digital infrastructure for cloud, AI, and edge computing workloads. Spun out of the GDS International business and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, DayOne develops and operates strategically located, interconnected data center campuses across Asia-Pacific — Singapore, Johor (Malaysia), Batam (Indonesia), Hong Kong, Tokyo, and Bangkok — and is expanding into Europe with a launch market in Finland. The company positions itself as a build-to-suit and hyperscale partner focused on power availability, connectivity, and sustainable operations rather than as a public API or developer-platform provider; there is no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Deepnight
providers.description: Deepnight is a San Francisco defense-technology company building AI-powered digital night vision. It embeds edge AI models into commoditized digital (CMOS) image sensors, using a deep neural network that aggregates photons temporally to recover true information in near-total darkness — down to overcast moonless starlight (0.1 millilux) — exceeding the performance of conventional Gen 3 analog image-intensifier tubes at a fraction of the cost. By using mass-manufactured consumer-electronics sensors, Deepnight aims to turn night vision from a scarce defense capability into a scalable digital product for people, robots, drones, and autonomous vehicles. Founded by former Google engineers Lucas Young and Thomas Li, the company is backed by Initialized Capital and has won U.S. Army and Air Force contracts. Deepnight publishes no public developer API; this profile tracks its web and security surface.

providers.name: DEFCON AI
providers.description: DEFCON AI is a modeling, simulation, and analysis (MS&A) company based in McLean, Virginia, building AI-driven optimization for contested logistics and mobility across defense and commercial operations. Founded in 2022, it develops mission-tailored optimization and intelligent-agent simulation products - including ARTIV (delivered to U.S. Air Force Air Mobility Command) and R-ALIGN for resilient multimodal logistics - that let planners rapidly generate and evaluate mission scenarios in dynamic, disrupted environments. The company was awarded a five-year, $115M prototype agreement supporting U.S. Marine Corps logistics modernization. DEFCON AI publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Denki
providers.description: Denki is a full-stack AI financial audit firm that automates internal audit work — planning, control testing, evidence collection, walkthrough interviews, and documentation — so teams can comply with financial regulations such as SOX 404 and BSA/AML. Its Tracer agent links general ledger, sub-ledgers, ERP, and payments data into a single audit trail, detecting anomalies early and producing ready-to-share audit packs. Denki works alongside existing systems such as AuditBoard, Workiva, and ERPs, and is built for audit teams at pre-IPO and publicly listed companies. Founded in 2025 by brothers Felipe and David Jin Li, Denki is a Y Combinator (F25) company that raised $4.1M led by Base10 Partners and Shine Capital.

providers.name: designstripe
providers.description: designstripe (rebranded in 2026 as Visual, visual.app) is an AI-powered design platform for go-to-market teams that automates the creation of presentations, proposals, QBRs, and marketing assets through conversational AI agents, with brand-lock consistency across generated materials. It serves sales, marketing, and customer success teams. Backed by Insight Partners. As of July 2026 the product is under active development / waitlist and references API integrations ("every agent is an endpoint"), but publishes no public developer documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Diamond Foundry
providers.description: Diamond Foundry is a deep-tech materials company that manufactures semiconductor-grade single-crystal diamond wafers and diamond transistors to overcome the thermal limits of silicon in AI chips, datacenters, and electric vehicles. The company operates its own foundries and has built a full technology stack for producing diamond at scale as a sustainable substrate for high-performance and power electronics. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a planetary-health portfolio company of Obvious Ventures; it publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Disrupt
providers.description: Disrupt Technology Venture is a Bangkok, Thailand-based organization focused on building the country's startup ecosystem and developing future-ready business leaders through education, executive training, and venture investment. Its offerings include the House of Talents (HOT) executive leadership curriculum, the Advanced Executive Program (AXP), corporate in-house training, and the Disrupt MBA online course platform, alongside investment vehicles such as the Disrupt Health Impact Fund (deep-tech healthcare) and the Stormbreaker edtech startup accelerator. Disrupt reports 1,500+ program alumni, 20+ corporate clients (including KBank, PTT, Unilever, and Central Group), and that 7 of the top 10 Thai startups count Disrupt alumni among their founders. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Disrupt publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: DocuTAP
providers.description: DocuTAP was an urgent care EHR and practice-management software company based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. In 2019 DocuTAP merged with Practice Velocity to form Experity, the on-demand and urgent-care healthcare technology vendor. The DocuTAP EMR/PM product continues under the Experity portfolio, with customer sign-in at dtlogin.experityhealth.com; the legacy docutap.com domain is no longer actively maintained (its TLS certificate has expired). No public developer portal or API is currently published for DocuTAP.

providers.name: Dorado Software Inc
providers.description: Dorado Software, Inc. is a Roseville, California infrastructure management software company whose Cruz and Redcell product families deliver resource management, orchestration, monitoring, and automation for data centers, AI infrastructure, enterprise campuses, and service-provider networks. The Cruz suite spans DCIM, network performance management, fabric and compute orchestration, compliance, and agentic-AI operations, discovering and controlling multi-vendor devices over SNMP, CLI, NETCONF, and REST/HTTPS. Dorado Software is backed by Insight Partners. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, portal, or SDK surface was found.

providers.name: Dryft
providers.description: Dryft, Inc. is a Palo Alto, California startup building an AI operating system for manufacturing operations. The platform pairs context-aware, agent-based intelligence with mathematical optimization to mimic, optimize, and automate complex human decisions across the shop floor and supply chain. Dryft reads operational data from existing ERPs and inventory systems, identifies issues such as late items or stockouts, and autonomously recommends and executes actions like adjusting order quantities and safety stocks or following up with suppliers. The company frames this as a shift from static Enterprise Resource Planning to Enterprise Resource Automation, freeing planners to focus on strategy over administrative work. Founded in 2024 by CEO Anna-Julia Storch and CTO Leonie Freisinger, Dryft raised a $5M round led by General Catalyst with participation from Neo and Sandberg Bernthal Venture Partners. Dryft does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation; this profile captures its company identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ECO2GROW
providers.description: ECO2GROW is a German renewable-energy procurement company serving mid-sized businesses. It builds an individually optimized electricity procurement mix that combines Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) sourced directly from German solar and wind farms with spot-market and forward contracts, giving companies enterprise-level pricing, long-term fixed rates, and traceable green power. The service automates the optimization of a company's procurement strategy and reduces the complexity and transaction costs of closing a PPA, helping industrial and mid-market buyers lower CO2 emissions through verifiable renewable sourcing. ECO2GROW is a Techstars portfolio company. As a B2B energy procurement and advisory business it operates a marketing/consulting web presence and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Ecolectro
providers.description: Ecolectro is an Ithaca, New York materials-science company developing alkaline exchange membrane (AEM) technology for green hydrogen production. Its patented ionomers and membranes combine the low-cost, non-precious-metal chemistry of traditional alkaline electrolysis with the performance and efficiency of PEM electrolyzers, targeting roughly a 78% reduction in electrolyzer stack cost and a 33% reduction in the overall levelized cost of green hydrogen. A Cornell University spin-out backed by Techstars, Ecolectro partners with industrial gas and energy companies to manufacture and deploy its membrane materials at scale. Ecolectro publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Elementary
providers.description: Elementary is an AI-powered machine-vision inspection company for manufacturing, founded in 2017 in South Pasadena, California (originally Elementary Robotics). Its VisionStream self-training edge AI detects production defects in seconds without rules, labeling, or tuning, while the QualityOS cloud platform delivers traceability, analytics, and MES/ERP integration across production lines. Elementary inspects over one billion parts annually for Fortune 500 manufacturers across food & beverage, automotive, consumer packaged goods, electronics, and life sciences, and is backed by Rockwell Automation, Tiger Global, Toyota Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Fika Ventures, and Idealab. The company exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties.

providers.name: Eleqtron
providers.description: eleQtron GmbH is a German quantum computing hardware company founded in 2020 as a spin-off from the Quantum Optics Department at the University of Siegen by Prof. Dr. Christof Wunderlich, Dr. Michael Johanning (CTO), and Jan Leisse (CEO). Based in Siegen, Germany, eleQtron develops freely programmable, scalable trapped-ion quantum computers built on its proprietary MAGIC (Magnetic Gradient Induced Coupling) technology, which controls qubits with microwaves rather than lasers for higher precision and a clearer path to scaling. The company aims to become a leading provider of quantum computing time for industrial applications across chemicals, pharmaceuticals, automotive, logistics, finance, and machine learning. eleQtron's systems are made accessible to developers through cloud platforms and standard quantum frameworks (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane) rather than a first-party public REST API. Backed by Earlybird Venture Capital.

providers.name: Ematic Solutions
providers.description: Ematic Solutions is a digital marketing and marketing-technology consultancy headquartered in Singapore that helps B2C brands across Asia Pacific build integrated, high-ROI digital ecosystems. It combines strategy, implementation, and ongoing optimization across SEO, performance marketing, social media, CRM, conversion-rate optimization, analytics, and e-commerce (Shopify), and it implements and manages enterprise marketing clouds including Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Experience Cloud, and Braze. The firm also runs social-CRM channels such as WhatsApp, LINE, and Zalo and partners with 100+ martech platforms (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Iterable, Segment, Mixpanel, and others). Backed by 500 Global, Ematic operates across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, the Philippines, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and beyond. It is a services and consulting company rather than an API producer, and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Encentive
providers.description: encentive GmbH is a German industrial energy-technology company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Neumuenster. Its AI-driven smart energy management platform, flexOn, automatically optimizes and controls electricity consumption for industrial and commercial operations, orchestrating assets such as PV/solar systems, battery storage, heat pumps, cooling and thermal storage, CHP, wind, and EV charging infrastructure alongside existing energy management systems. flexOn combines plant data, weather forecasts, and real-time market prices to shift loads to periods when energy is cheapest and greenest, cutting energy costs by up to 20% and CO2 emissions by up to 30%. It integrates with industrial assets over REST API, SFTP, OPC UA, and Modbus TCP. encentive publishes no public developer API, portal, or specification; integration is delivered as part of its managed platform, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Energy Vault
providers.description: Energy Vault Holdings (NYSE: NRGV) is a Swiss-founded, US-headquartered energy storage company delivering grid-scale storage hardware, software, and services worldwide. Its portfolio spans battery energy storage (B-VAULT), gravity-based storage (G-VAULT / EVx), and green-hydrogen storage (H-VAULT), unified by VaultOS, an energy management software platform providing real-time monitoring, operational control, and optimized dispatch across storage and generation assets, alongside Vault Bidder and Vault Manager for market bidding and asset management. The company serves utilities, independent power producers, and large energy users, with more than 1.4 GWh deployed since 2023. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Energy Vault is a frontier-tech company in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API reference; VaultOS is delivered as a proprietary, deployment-integrated platform rather than a public API product.

providers.name: Entalpic
providers.description: Entalpic is an AI-driven materials science company that designs molecules and materials for industrial processes by combining machine learning, atomistic simulations, and experimental feedback loops to engineer surfaces and materials at the atomic scale. Its work spans a Discovery Engine for high-throughput screening of chemical spaces, process modeling with ML-plus-CFD digital twins, and quantum/atomistic simulation for surface chemistry, applied to semiconductors and thin-film coatings, battery cathode and interface chemistry, catalysis and active-site design, and advanced specialty materials. Founded in 2024 with research roots at the Mila AI lab, the company is based at Station F in Paris and Mila in Montreal and raised an 8.5M euro seed round. Entalpic does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile tracks its public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Enveil
providers.description: Enveil is a privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs) company whose ZeroReveal platform lets organizations securely use, search, and analyze data while it is being processed, without moving, replicating, or exposing it. Built on homomorphic encryption, secure multiparty computation, and trusted execution environments, ZeroReveal Search delivers encrypted search, analytics, and watchlisting as a point-to-point proxy layer, while ZeroReveal Machine Learning provides encrypted training (SMPC-based federated learning) and encrypted model evaluation. Enveil serves financial services, healthcare and insurance, government and public sector, and secure-AI use cases spanning cross-silo data collaboration, fraud detection, secure data monetization, and privacy-preserving AI. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta.

providers.name: Every.tv
providers.description: Every, Inc. (株式会社エブリー, corp.every.tv) is a Tokyo-based Japanese video-media and advertising company that runs consumer lifestyle products including DELISH KITCHEN (recipe video media), retailHUB (a retail promotion and data platform connecting physical stores with digital channels), トモニテ / Tomonite (parenting video media and community), and MOMENTH (a professional video production and social team). Led by CEO Taissei Yoshida and headquartered in Roppongi, Minato, Tokyo, the company approached an IPO on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Every, Inc. publishes an engineering blog and owned media but exposes no public developer API program.

providers.name: Evreka
providers.description: Evreka is a smart waste and recycling management technology company offering an end-to-end "Sustainability as a Service" platform that digitizes the entire waste management lifecycle. Its software suite spans operations, fleet, asset, MRF, and workforce management, route optimization, citizen engagement, and EPR/PRO management, complemented by IoT hardware such as fill-level sensors, vehicle and container trackers, and RFID readers. Evreka serves dumpster rental, recycling centers, medical, hazardous and liquid waste, construction and demolition, local authorities, and cross-border waste operators. Backed by 500 Global, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Eyebot
providers.description: Eyebot is a health-technology company building automated, self-serve vision testing kiosks that generate precise eyeglass prescriptions in minutes without a traditional eye-doctor appointment. The company deploys robotic screening kiosks into retail environments — partnering with large retailers such as Walmart and Sam's Club — to make refractive vision care faster, cheaper, and more accessible. Founded by Matthias Hofmann (CEO) and Jack Moldave (CTO) with Chief Medical Officer Alex Martin OD FAAO, Eyebot raised a $20M Series A and is backed by General Catalyst, Ubiquity Ventures, Village Global, and the National Science Foundation. Eyebot is currently a hardware-and-retail company with no public developer program, API, or SDK surface; this profile tracks its identity in the API Evangelist network pending any future developer offering.

providers.name: Famous
providers.description: Famous (famous.co) now redirects to Amaze (amaze.co), the creator-commerce platform operated by Amaze Holdings, Inc. Amaze describes itself as building the operating system for creator-led businesses, bringing commerce, content, media, and live shopping into one connected ecosystem. Its products include Amaze Commerce (creator storefronts and AI-powered product creation), Amaze Live (shoppable livestreams), and Amaze Media (performance marketing and audience targeting for brands). The company reports 190K+ creators, 1.7B+ lifetime fan reach, and operations across 183 countries. Surfaced originally as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment (identity and domain-security artifacts only).

providers.name: Fernride
providers.description: FERNRIDE (FERNRIDE GmbH) is a Munich, Germany based ground-autonomy company delivering human-assisted autonomous driving for logistics. Its platform automates electric and diesel trucks and terminal tractors across container terminals, yard operations, manufacturing supply, defence logistics, and open-road trucking, pairing on-vehicle autonomy with remote human oversight (teleoperation) for reliability at scale. A centralized Management Suite lets fleet managers monitor and control the autonomous fleet and integrates with existing terminal operating systems (TOS) and yard management systems (YMS). Customers and partners have included DB Schenker, Volkswagen, HHLA, and NVIDIA. FERNRIDE was acquired by Quantum Systems in December 2025. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest; the company exposes no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: FilmTrack
providers.description: FilmTrack is a cloud-based content and rights management platform for the media and entertainment industry, streamlining the intellectual property lifecycle from project inception through distribution. Its software gives distributors and studios a holistic view of the data behind rights, availabilities, contracts, invoicing, licensing, revenue recognition, royalties, and workflow management. Founded in 1996 by Jason Kassin and headquartered in Studio City, California, FilmTrack was acquired by City National Bank in 2019 and now operates alongside Rightsline. Its API-first architecture enables integration with ERP and financial systems such as SAP and NetSuite, and an event bus for change-driven automation. Customers include Lionsgate, Miramax, Focus Features, Starz, and Screen Australia.

providers.name: Fivestargroup
providers.description: Five Star Group (Five Star Business Finance) is an India-based non-banking financial company (NBFC) that provides small-business and mortgage loans to self-employed and underserved borrowers, primarily across southern India. Its public web presence is an investor-relations and customer-service portal covering board and management disclosures, financials, annual reports, NCD and SEBI (LODR) compliances, RBI policies, credit ratings, and investor grievance redressal, alongside customer tools such as a loan mobile app, online EMI payments, and NACH mandate cancellation. It is listed in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer program, API, or SDK was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Flexkeeping
providers.description: Flexkeeping is a hotel operations automation platform (owned by Mews) that streamlines housekeeping, maintenance, front-office collaboration, and quality assurance for hotels and resorts. It centralizes staff task management, automated room cleaning schedules, checklists, lost-and-found, and guest service requests, and connects to major property management systems so operational teams can reduce manual work, coordinate across departments, and improve the guest experience across thousands of properties worldwide. Flexkeeping is an integration consumer rather than an API producer: it does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or API keys. Instead it ships pre-built connectors into PMS platforms including Mews, Apaleo, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Cloudbeds, RMS Cloud, Guesty, Shiji, Protel, SiHot, and Beds24.

providers.name: Freemodel
providers.description: Freemodel is a presale home renovation platform that helps real estate agents and homeowners prepare properties for sale by coordinating design, renovation, and project management through local project directors. It offers pay-at-close financing so clients can defer renovation costs until the home sells, and provides transparent online project tracking. Freemodel operates across Northern California (Bay Area, Sonoma, Santa Cruz/Monterey) and Southwest Florida. This profile was surfaced as a QED Investors portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Freemodel publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Frore Systems
providers.description: Frore Systems is a Silicon Valley thermal-management company that develops solid-state active cooling technology for high-performance computing in space-constrained devices. Its flagship AirJet solid-state cooling chips (AirJet Mini and AirJet PAK families) and LiquidJet direct-to-chip liquid cooling for data centers enable higher power density, quieter operation, and thinner designs across consumer devices, mini PCs, industrial embedded systems, and data-center compute trays. The company partners with Intel, Qualcomm, NVIDIA, AMD, Phison, and Zotac, is headquartered in Silicon Valley with manufacturing in Taiwan, and reached unicorn status following a Series D round. Frore is a hardware/semiconductor company with no public developer API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company identity and market coverage.

providers.name: Future Trash
providers.description: Future Trash is a Los Angeles-based independent, multidisciplinary creative game studio and the developer behind FOAD, a user-generated-content (UGC) native video game franchise. Founded around 2022, the team first built a vertical-slice MVP of FOAD in Unreal Engine 5 and released it in early access on Steam. After Epic Games launched Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN) in 2023, the studio pivoted to building FOAD experiences natively inside Fortnite's UGC ecosystem, spanning MOBA, tycoon, and combat modes, while planning to resume the standalone UE5 core game. Future Trash raised a $5M seed round in September 2024 led by TIRTA Ventures with participation from General Catalyst. This profile was surfaced from General Catalyst's portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network; Future Trash is a game studio and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Generative Engineering
providers.description: Generative Engineering (Generative Vision Ltd) is a London-based deep-tech startup, founded in 2021, building a platform that generates, tests, and simulates thousands of engineering designs in parallel, in a fraction of the time traditional processes take. A code-first integration framework lets engineers plug in their existing tools alongside out-of-the-box integrations, spanning concept engineering, systems integration, and cost engineering. Parallel engineering aims to radically cut product development time for real-world products across energy, decarbonization, agriculture, and mobility. The company is backed by a pre-seed round led by EQT Ventures with participation from Join Capital. It publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Graphite Innovation and Technologies
providers.description: Graphite Innovation and Technologies Inc, operating as GIT Coatings, is a Canadian materials-science company that develops sustainable, graphene-based marine coatings for commercial ships. Its biocide-free hard foul-release hull and propeller coatings, including XGIT-FORCE, XGIT-VORTEX, and XGIT-PROP, cut fuel consumption, reduce drag, and eliminate leaching to protect the marine environment. The company is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. It is a physical-products manufacturer and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company-level discovery and coverage.

providers.name: Greenlyte
providers.description: Greenlyte Carbon Technologies is an Essen, Germany based climate-tech company building its LiquidSolar platform, which liquefies air, sun, and water into 99% pure carbon and hydrogen feedstocks to produce synthetic e-fuels (sustainable aviation fuel, synthetic methanol, and synthetic natural gas) for hard-to-decarbonize industries. Founded as a direct air capture and power-to-liquid venture, Greenlyte has raised more than 55M EUR from Carbon Removal Partners, Earlybird, Partech, AENU, and Green Generation Fund. It was surfaced through VC portfolio mining and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Greenlyte publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface; this profile captures its verifiable web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Grey Wolf Therapeutics
providers.description: Grey Wolf Therapeutics (Greywolf Therapeutics) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a new therapeutic class of immunotherapies through antigen modulation, aimed at treating people living with cancers and autoimmune disorders. Its approach modulates antigen presentation on cell surfaces so T cells can correctly recognize and target diseased cells, and it is pioneering modulation of Signal 1 in the T cell activation cascade. Lead assets include GRWD5769, a first-in-class oral ERAP1 inhibitor for oncology in Phase 1/2 trials, and GRWD0715, an autoimmunity-focused asset also in Phase 1/2. Backed by Canaan Partners, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company profile. It is a corporate/scientific organization and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: hallo theo
providers.description: Hallo theo (rebranding to "Theo") is a German residential property management company (Hausverwaltung) that manages homeowners' associations (WEG/HOA), rental apartment buildings, and commercial properties across Germany. With 150+ experts and local teams in Berlin, Frankfurt am Main, Munich, Stuttgart, and Wildeshausen, the company manages over 20,000 units and is Section 26a HOA-certified, combining on-the-ground regional teams with central specialists in law, technology, and finance. Backed by Insight Partners, it offers HOA management, property management, commercial property management, succession, and sale-and-stay-on services to co-owners and building owners. This is a services company with a marketing/lead website (built on Framer + HubSpot); it publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: HelioRec
providers.description: HelioRec is a floating photovoltaic (FPV) engineering and manufacturing company that designs and builds floating solar power plants for lakes, reservoirs, and nearshore waters. It uses an engineering-led, load-based methodology focused on structural behavior, mooring integrity, installation practicality, and long-term operability on water, delivering grid-connected, utility-scale systems engineered for real water conditions. HelioRec serves independent power producers and utilities, hydropower and reservoir owners, industrial and infrastructure operators, and water and agriculture stakeholders, supporting projects from site-specific concept through execution. The company is backed by Techstars.

providers.name: HONESS (Shanghai Hongji Environmental Protection)
providers.description: HONESS (泓济环保 / Shanghai Hongji Environmental Protection, honess.cn) is a Chinese environmental services provider founded in 2006, specializing in industrial wastewater treatment and the broader treatment of the "three wastes" (wastewater, waste gas, and hazardous waste). It offers customized environmental solutions, environmental equipment manufacturing and integration, EPC delivery for energy and chemical full-water systems, fine-chemical waste treatment, process packages for new and upgraded wastewater plants, and technology-enabled ("smart") digital operations and maintenance. The company holds top-grade design and contracting qualifications, has delivered 500+ design/build/operation projects for 300+ clients across China and abroad, and operates manufacturing and R&D bases in Shanghai and Anhui. It is not a developer/API company; the public surface is a WordPress corporate site with no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or OAuth. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Icardio.AI
providers.description: Icardio.AI (iCardio.ai) builds artificial-intelligence software that automates the interpretation of cardiac ultrasound (echocardiography). Its FDA 510(k)-cleared products include EchoMeasure, which identifies cardiac phases and automatically measures anatomical structures to produce comprehensive echo reports, and CardioVision, which automatically detects aortic stenosis and structural heart disease from ultrasound clips (also granted FDA Breakthrough Device Designation). Additional tooling includes EchoCheck image-quality and view classification, quantitative linear and volumetric measurements, qualitative structural-disease analysis, and EchoGPT image-to-text description. The company trains on a database of 200M+ echocardiography images and partners with ultrasound manufacturers, PACS vendors, and healthcare systems, offering API integration into enterprise PACS workflows. Icardio.AI is a Techstars portfolio company.

providers.name: Ideon Technologies
providers.description: Ideon Technologies (ideon.ai) develops REVEAL, a subsurface intelligence platform that uses muon tomography and geophysical inversion to image, map, and monitor mineral deposits and geological structures deep underground. It helps mining companies reduce geologic uncertainty across exploration, resource evaluation, geotechnical analysis, and cave monitoring, with customers including Rio Tinto, Vale, Glencore, and BHP. The company is backed by Playground Global. Ideon publishes a marketing and content web presence (solutions, case studies, papers, blog, careers) but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile tracks the company as a network lead.

providers.name: ilovewoof
providers.description: ilovewoof (ilovewoof.com) is a UK-focused pet-care and lifestyle content publication covering companion animals and wildlife. It publishes pet-care guides, behavioral insights, health articles, rescue stories, and animal-world news across four sections — Cats, Dogs, News, and Other pets (small and exotic animals) — with health and medical content reviewed by licensed veterinary professionals, and offers a weekly email newsletter. It is an editorial content site, not an API provider; no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable interface was found during enrichment. Surfaced as a qiming portfolio lead and profiled in the API Evangelist network for completeness.

providers.name: Impulse Space
providers.description: Impulse Space is an American aerospace company founded in 2021 by Tom Mueller, building in-space transportation and mobility infrastructure. The company designs and operates orbital transfer vehicles (OTVs) that host, maneuver, and deliver payloads across and between orbits for commercial, civil, and government customers. Its product line includes Mira, an agile spacecraft for precise payload hosting and deployment across any orbit; Helios, a high-energy kick stage capable of moving up to 4,000 kg of payload from Low Earth Orbit to Geostationary Orbit in under 24 hours; and a GEO Rideshare program offering economical access to geostationary orbit. Impulse Space is a hardware and launch-services company rather than a software API provider, and does not publish a public developer portal, API, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and Founders Fund and enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Infinitopes
providers.description: Infinitopes is an Oxford University spinout biotech company (founded 2021, based at the BioEscalator in Oxford, UK) developing off-the-shelf precision cancer vaccines aimed at preventing deaths from cancer metastases. Its proprietary Precision Immunomics platform identifies tumor-specific antigens by integrating immunopeptidomics, advanced laboratory methods, machine learning, and validated biological testing across cancer types, paired with engineered viral vectors that elicit protective CD8 T-cell responses. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Amplify Partners (also supported by Cancer Research UK). This is a digital-biology company profile; Infinitopes publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or technical integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Insempra
providers.description: Insempra is a biotechnology company that produces sustainable, bio-based ingredients using precision fermentation. It develops alternatives to petrochemical and naturally-extracted ingredients for the beauty and personal care, food and nutrition, and fibers and performance materials industries. Products include a bio-based Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol fragrance ingredient, an Omega-7 biolipid, and Biomelanin (in development), produced from agricultural and forestry waste streams through circular manufacturing. Insempra is a portfolio company of EQT Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Involve Space
providers.description: Involve Space is an Italian stratospheric aerospace company building real-time Earth intelligence. It operates autonomous high-altitude balloon platforms (Stratostats) that loiter around 20 kilometers for hours, days, or weeks to deliver continuous, high-resolution Earth observation, bridging the gap between satellites, drones, and ground sensors. Its Neurostar AI flight software autonomously controls individual balloons and networks of them (LoonHive), while the CLEAR GeoAI platform turns captured imagery into geospatial insights for disaster response, infrastructure and environmental monitoring, security, and in-orbit-demonstration / payload validation. A certified B Corporation headquartered in Italy with U.S. operations at the Houston Spaceport, Involve Space is backed by Earlybird Venture Capital, CDP Venture Capital, and an EIC Accelerator grant.

providers.name: IONA
providers.description: IONA (IONA Drones) is a UK-based autonomous drone delivery company building the full technology stack for logistics operators. Its tilt-rotor Sonnet aircraft performs VTOL from compact sites and carries up to 20 parcels up to 200 km per autonomous flight. IONA pairs the aircraft with an onboard autonomy operating system, GPS/LiDAR sensor-fusion precision landing, a SORA-aligned BVLOS compliance engine, an operations centre for real-time fleet monitoring and analytics, and a digital twin for simulation and predictive maintenance. The platform integrates with existing TMS/WMS logistics systems and targets healthcare, rural/remote, express e-commerce, industrial, and maritime delivery. Backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Iwarranty
providers.description: iWarranty is a London-based, AI and machine-learning powered warranty management software platform that digitizes the entire warranty lifecycle for manufacturers, retailers, warrantors, and consumers. The platform covers QR-code product registration, automated claims processing and verification, repair and replacement coordination, fraud detection, and real-time product performance analytics, and integrates with existing ERP and CRM systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, and NetSuite. iWarranty emphasizes sustainability by reducing paper waste and e-waste through digitized processes. The company is backed by Anthemis and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network enrichment lead.

providers.name: Key
providers.description: Key AI is a professional networking platform that rebuilds business connection-making around AI and consent-based introductions. Its Kai AI agent surfaces the right people through warm paths in your existing network, while Handshake handles consent-first introductions (launching summer 2026). The platform also offers matched Opportunities (jobs, deals, and partnerships), branded Communities and directories for alumni groups and associations, event and calendar pre-matching, a searchable knowledge Library, and Connectors for Slack, WhatsApp, and LinkedIn. Founded by Google alumni behind the 35,000-member Xoogler community and backed by Felicis, Key AI is an end-user and community-operator product; as of July 2026 it publishes no public API, developer platform, or API documentation.

providers.name: Knowify
providers.description: Knowify is a New York-based construction management SaaS for trade contractors (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, painting, remodeling, concrete, excavation), covering the full job lifecycle from bidding through payment on a single platform. The product spans project execution (estimating, proposals and contracts, change orders, RFIs and submittals, scheduling, daily logs, document and photo management), service work (dispatch, invoicing, payments, field operations, asset and inventory management), and financial management (AIA billing, job costing, prevailing wage, purchase orders, expenses, WIP and reporting). Knowify is positioned as the official construction software partner of QuickBooks Online and offers deep two-way sync with QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Intuit Enterprise Suite, QuickBooks Payroll, QuickBooks Payments, and QuickBooks Time, alongside native integrations with CompanyCam, Billd, Lumber, eBacon, and AIA Contract Documents. Third-party automation is available via Zapier. Pricing starts at $99/month (Core), $249/month (Advanced), and custom Enterprise, with paid add-ons for Service Pro, Live Equipment Tracking (FleetSharp), AI Dashcams, and Tool Tracking. Knowify does not publish a public REST API, webhooks specification, SDK, CLI, or developer portal; programmatic access for third parties is limited to Zapier and the QuickBooks ecosystem.

providers.name: Legora
providers.description: Legora is a Stockholm, Sweden-based collaborative AI workspace for lawyers, founded in 2023 as Leya by Max Junestrand (CEO), Sigge Labor (CTO), and August Erséus, and rebranded to Legora in 2025. The platform delivers an agentic operating system, Legora aOS, that helps law firms and in-house legal teams execute document review, legal research, drafting, advisory work, and regulatory monitoring at scale. Core product surfaces include Agent (end-to-end execution of complex legal work), Monitors (regulatory change tracking), Lists (workflow organization), Tabular Review, Workflows, Legal Research, Portal, Editor, a Word Add-in, an Outlook Add-in, and a mobile app, with practice-area solutions spanning M&A, litigation, banking, tax, and insurance. Legora is built on Azure OpenAI Service, holds ISO 42001, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 Type II certifications, operates under GDPR with EU and US data residency options, supports BYOK encryption, and commits not to train AI models on customer data. The company closed a $550M Series D led by Accel in March 2026 at a $5.55B valuation. Legora's commercial model is enterprise SaaS sold to law firms and in-house teams; there is no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, GitHub organization, or open-source release for the Legora platform.

providers.name: Lowercarbon Capital
providers.description: Lowercarbon Capital is a climate-focused venture capital firm that backs companies making real money by slashing CO2 emissions, removing carbon from the atmosphere, and buying the planet more time. The firm invests across energy, transportation, materials, agriculture, carbon removal, and planetary-cooling technologies, on the thesis that markets — not shame or guilt — will fix the climate. It was surfaced as a portfolio-linked company and added to the API Evangelist network. Lowercarbon Capital publishes no public API or developer program; this profile captures the firm's identity and web properties.

providers.name: Lydia AI
providers.description: Lydia AI is an enterprise AI company whose flagship platform, ORCA, reasons through complex operational problems and delivers structured work product rather than chat replies. ORCA spans three domains: Content & Commerce (generating product content, campaign assets, and structured search data), Evidence & Analysis (analyzing large document sets for legal discovery), and Operations & Logistics (optimizing routing, dispatch, and disruption response). The company is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Lydia AI exposes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API surface; engagement is via a book-a-demo/contact sales motion.

providers.name: Mach Industries
providers.description: Mach Industries develops and manufactures asymmetric aerospace and defense systems and components at scale, with a product portfolio that includes the Viper vertical-takeoff attack drone, the Glide precision strike munition, the Stratos high-altitude pseudo-satellite, the Pike long-range munition, the Dart counter-drone kinetic interceptor, and energetics testing services. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Ribbit Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. The company is a defense hardware manufacturer and publishes no public developer or API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Maman
providers.description: Maman is a French-inspired bakery and cafe chain founded in New York City, with locations across the United States and Canada. Maman serves seasonal pastries, coffee, salads, sandwiches and its signature nutty chocolate chip cookie in design-forward spaces, and operates online ordering for pickup and delivery, a nationwide cookie and gift shop, full-service event and corporate catering, private event venues, a loyalty mobile app, and a published cookbook. This API Evangelist profile tracks Maman's public web and commerce properties; the company exposes no first-party developer API surface.

providers.name: Market IQ
providers.description: Market IQ is a predictive analytics platform for financial institutions, serving retail banking, investment banking, and capital markets. It ingests both structured and unstructured data, applies natural language processing and AI to generate insights, and delivers bespoke dashboards such as its Social Net Promoter Score and incident-monitoring tools. The company operates from Toronto, New York, and London and reaches customers through login-gated applications rather than a public developer API. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Marley Medical
providers.description: Marley Medical is a venture-backed (Andreessen Horowitz / a16z) digital health company that delivers virtual, membership-based medical care to patients directly through a consumer web and mobile experience. Its patient-facing product runs as a web application (member portal at my.marleymedical.com) backed by Google Firebase, fronted by a Webflow marketing site and signup funnel, with member support delivered through Zendesk and transactional email via Mailgun on Google Workspace. As of this enrichment pass Marley Medical operates as a direct-to-consumer telehealth service and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its verified public web and email infrastructure and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Material Evolution
providers.description: Material Evolution is a UK-based cleantech manufacturer of ultra-low carbon cement for the construction industry. Its MevoCem and MevoXL products use a proprietary "Alkali Fusion" process to transform industrial byproducts into cement feedstocks, achieving a 52.5N strength rating at roughly 144-196 kg CO2e per tonne versus ordinary Portland cement. The company operates compact, automated factories (including its Wrexham facility) and applies AI to material development and feedstock optimization. It is a B2B cement supplier and does not currently publish any public developer-facing API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Matterway
providers.description: Matterway is an enterprise-grade, AI-native intelligent assistance platform built for operations teams at large organizations and BPOs. Its screen-aware digital Assistant sits on top of the systems employees already use, guiding people through complex workflows while automating document data extraction, data verification, form pre-fill, and cross-application navigation. Processing stays client-side inside the corporate network, and the Assistant acts with the same rights as the logged-in user, which is aimed at regulated industries such as banking, insurance, and healthcare. Skills are authored in a no-code Designer, exported to a low-code SDK, and monitored from a management console. Matterway was acquired by Cognizant in October 2025. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HV Capital and enriched by the local pipeline; Matterway publishes no public developer API, SDK registry package, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Mediacao Online
providers.description: MOL (Mediacao Online) is Brazil's first online dispute resolution (ODR) platform, founded in 2014 in Sao Paulo. It is a 100% digital, automated platform for negotiation, conciliation, and mediation that lets individuals, companies, and institutions resolve conflicts extrajudicially without going to court. The CNJ-compliant platform covers the full flow, from capturing cases in the courts, building agreement policies, sanitizing and enriching data, through to agreement approval and payment. MOL has facilitated tens of thousands of agreements and counts Magazine Luiza, Itau, and Caixa Economica among its clients. It is backed by 500 Global, Wayra, Canary, and Redpoint eventures. MOL exposes no public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: MeetFuture Technology
providers.description: MeetFuture Technology (弥费科技) is a Shanghai-based, global-leading supplier of semiconductor Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) and core components, founded in 2014. It designs and manufactures overhead hoist transport (OHT), stocker/storage, purge, and AMHS control-software solutions for semiconductor wafer fabrication plants, integrating with fab MES systems over SEMI equipment communication standards (E37/HSMS, E30/GEM, E82, E84, E10). MeetFuture holds 300+ intellectual-property items, operates China's largest AMHS cleanroom test center, authored China's first semiconductor OHT standard (T/SICA 006—2024), and won the 2025 SEMI Product Innovation Award. It is a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company. MeetFuture is an industrial semiconductor-equipment maker and does not publish a public web API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained for network identity and discovery.

providers.name: MemeChat
providers.description: MemeChat is an Indian consumer social and creator-economy mobile app from MemeChat Private Limited (Memetech), where users make, share, and compete with memes — including a Face Swap AI feature and a MemeChat keyboard — and earn money when their content goes viral. Marketed as a self-reliant ("Atmanirbhar") Indian app that has crossed five million users, it is backed by 500 Global. This API Evangelist profile is a network stub: MemeChat is a consumer application with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface discovered at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: merama
providers.description: Merama is a Latin American e-commerce company that invests in and scales established online brands selling on marketplaces such as Amazon and MercadoLibre. It acquires a substantial stake while founders retain operational control, then provides working capital, business intelligence, digital marketing, cross-border expansion across Latin America and the US, and proprietary operating technology to accelerate growth. Merama operates as a brand aggregator / roll-up rather than a developer platform and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: MicroBenefits
providers.description: MicroBenefits is a workforce-engagement and HR technology company, backed by 500 Global, that created CompanyIQ — a scalable mobile platform for improving engagement, learning, and communication for factory and manufacturing workers, particularly across Asia. CompanyIQ bundles Worker Voice (employee feedback and dialogue), Digital Learning (safety, rights, and professional-development training), an Employee Portal (wage, hours, and benefits transparency), and Business Intelligence workforce analytics, alongside professional and learning services. The company operates a marketing and support presence but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface at this time.

providers.name: Mombak
providers.description: Mombak is a Brazilian nature-based carbon removal company that acquires degraded and deforested land in the Amazon and restores it through large-scale, biodiverse reforestation with native species, generating high-integrity, high-quality carbon removal credits for corporate buyers. Founded by former Nubank executives and backed by investors including Union Square Ventures, the company combines science, technology, forestry, and carbon-market expertise to remove carbon at scale while restoring native ecosystems. Mombak operates as a corporate and carbon-markets business and publishes a public marketing and news presence; it does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: MyCash
providers.description: MyCash (operated by IN REMIT PTE LTD, Singapore) is a mobile-only cross-border remittance service built for migrant workers. Through the MyCash Money mobile app, users send money home instantly, reload / top up mobile airtime, and pay bills across supported corridors without needing a traditional bank account. The service targets the unbanked and underbanked migrant population with low-cost digital money transfer and mobile financial services. As of this profile MyCash publishes a consumer mobile application and marketing site (inremit.co) but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile records the company's public web and security posture.

providers.name: Nazar
providers.description: Nazar (nazar.ai) is an AI-powered database performance and cost optimization platform that helps engineering and DBA teams monitor, analyze, and tune their databases. It supports Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, MariaDB, Amazon Aurora, Oracle, and SAP HANA across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Capabilities include SQL.AI, an LLM-based tuning assistant, offensive SQL monitoring for slow-query detection, real-time lock visibility, and anomaly detection. Founded in Recife, Brazil and backed by 500 Global, Nazar counts financial-services and travel companies among its customers.

providers.name: New Story
providers.description: New Story is a US 501(c)(3) nonprofit building a housing market that helps vulnerable families in Latin America become homeowners. It develops underused land into affordable communities, enables families to own land, and connects them to credit and home financing. Founded in 2014 (Y Combinator W15), New Story has housed thousands of people across Haiti, Bolivia, Mexico, and El Salvador, partnered with ICON to build the first community of 3D-printed homes, and reports outcomes like 60% of land titles going to women and a 100% portfolio repayment rate. Its impact-investing arm operates as New Story Capital. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; New Story publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Ofbusiness
providers.description: OfBusiness is one of India's largest B2B raw-materials procurement and credit platforms, serving more than two million SMEs and corporates. It operates as an aggregator, manufacturer, and importer/exporter across supply chains including steel, aluminium, chemicals, polymers, and agriculture, pairing live commodity pricing, quotations, and order tracking with working-capital credit through its NBFC arm Oxyzo. Related brands include BidAssist (government tender and procurement intelligence), SMEAssist, and Ved AI. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and the SoftBank Vision Fund. OfBusiness reaches customers primarily through its website and iOS/Android mobile apps; no public developer API or API documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: OpenLDAP
providers.description: OpenLDAP is an open source implementation of the Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) that provides directory server daemons, client libraries, and utilities for managing distributed directory services. The suite includes slapd (the standalone LDAP daemon), lloadd (a load balancer), protocol libraries, and command-line tools for searching, modifying, and administering directory data. OpenLDAP does not expose a REST API; access is via the LDAP protocol over TCP using SASL, simple bind, or TLS-secured authentication.

providers.name: Orqa
providers.description: Orqa is an aerial robotics company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Osijek, Croatia, that designs and manufactures mission-ready FPV (first-person view) drone systems for the defense and enterprise markets. With full vertical integration, Orqa builds every component in-house — tactical drones such as the MRM1-5 and MRM2-10, FPV goggles (FPV.One Pilot), controllers, simulators, and detection equipment — to keep its supply chain secure and its systems high-performance. The company is ISO 9001 certified and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners (Seed round, 2024, partners Antoine Moyroud and Alexander Schmitt). As of this profile Orqa is a hardware manufacturer and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a programmatic developer surface; this repository tracks it for identity and network completeness.

providers.name: Ostra Security
providers.description: Ostra Security is a managed security services provider (MSSP) that delivers enterprise-grade cybersecurity as an outcome-focused, fully managed service under the tagline "Your Trusted Cybersecurity Team." Its Pulse platform consolidates managed detection and response (MDR), managed SIEM, endpoint security, penetration testing, and risk and cyber maturity assessments, and integrates with 90-plus third-party security and enterprise tools including CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Sentinel/Defender, Palo Alto Networks, Tenable, Okta, and the major cloud platforms. Ostra serves finance, education, healthcare, legal, manufacturing, retail, and trades customers, emphasizing measurable risk reduction, board-ready reporting, and partnership over raw alerting. It is backed by General Catalyst. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API reference; this entry captures its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Overland AI
providers.description: Overland AI is a Seattle- and Washington, DC-based defense technology company building autonomous ground vehicle systems for military and national-security applications. Its product line spans ULTRA (a fully autonomous tactical vehicle with modular payloads), OverDrive (an off-road autonomy stack for tactical maneuver in GPS- and comms-denied environments), OverWatch (a command-and-control platform for single-operator control of multiple ground vehicles, which the company describes as offering an open API for integration with existing C2 systems), and SPARK (modular hardware that adds autonomous mobility to existing platforms). Overland AI is a portfolio company of 8VC. The company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI specification; its "open API" is referenced only in marketing material and integration is handled through direct contact.

providers.name: Oxford Ionics
providers.description: Oxford Ionics is a quantum computing hardware company founded in Oxford, UK that designs and builds trapped-ion quantum computers powered by its proprietary Electronic Qubit Control (EQC) technology, which uses integrated semiconductor chips rather than lasers to control qubits. The company holds published records across single-qubit gate fidelity, two-qubit gate fidelity, and state preparation/measurement, and builds compact, field-upgradeable, data-center-ready QPUs that fit standard server racks and integrate with AWS and NVIDIA stacks. Its roadmap targets 16-64 qubits (2025), 256+ qubits (2026), and 10,000+ qubits (2027). Oxford Ionics was acquired by IonQ in 2025. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDKs, MCP server, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Parting
providers.description: Parting operates parting.com, a consumer-facing funeral-home and cremation price-comparison platform that indexes more than 15,000 funeral homes and mortuaries across all 50 U.S. states, letting families research locations, photos, reviews, and pricing and contact providers directly. Founded in 2015 and based in Los Angeles, the company also publishes Parting Pro (partingpro.com), funeral-home arrangement and cremation software with third-party integrations to Passare, Keeper, and QuickBooks. As of this enrichment pass Parting exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI/spec surface, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web presence and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Peoplise
providers.description: Peoplise (now Logo Peoplise) is a Turkish human-resources technology SaaS that digitalizes recruitment and hiring workflows for enterprises. The platform covers the full talent-acquisition funnel: candidate sourcing and application tracking, automated pre-screening and assessments, one-way and live video interviews, reference checking, and digital onboarding. Originally a 500 Global (500 Startups) portfolio company, Peoplise was acquired by Logo (Logo Yazilim), one of Turkey's largest enterprise-software vendors, and is marketed as "Logo Peoplise" at logo.com.tr. Public probing found a marketing/product site only; no developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger specification, /.well-known/ discovery surface, or documented public API was found at this time.

providers.name: PitchMe
providers.description: PitchMe is a recruitment data intelligence platform that enriches, verifies, and deduplicates candidate records to turn an existing ATS or CRM database into an activated talent pool. It cleans and appends verified contact details, employment history, and skills data, then surfaces career-intelligence signals that power AI-driven sourcing and outreach. PitchMe connects to applicant tracking systems such as Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Salesforce, Lever, JobDiva, Vincere, Avionte, Jobvite, and Ashby via native and certified integrations, plus a custom API for connecting any ATS or recruitment platform. Backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Plant Prefab
providers.description: Plant Prefab is a Southern California offsite construction technology company that custom-fabricates panelized and modular building components to deliver housing and hospitality projects in roughly half the time of traditional site-built construction. Its panel-based building system spans open-cavity panels to fully finished modules, and its LivingHomes product line and in-house Plant Design Studio offer customized, sustainable designs recognized with LEED Platinum, NAHB Energy Value Housing, and AIA Top Ten Green Projects awards. The company is backed by Obvious Ventures and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Podqi
providers.description: Podqi is an AI-native intellectual property and brand protection platform that automatically detects and removes brand infringements across digital platforms. It scans major marketplaces, storefronts, and domains for counterfeit listings, stolen imagery, fake products, and copycat sites, then packages evidence and files takedowns at scale with minimal human intervention. The company reports roughly 95% AI automation with same-day detection and an average resolution time of about 1.2 days, and also operates Brandsweep.ai, a free public brand-protection scanning tool. Podqi serves brand owners, entertainment and creative companies, e-commerce sellers, and law firms. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Podqi publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: PopCom
providers.description: PopCom is an AI-powered automated retail technology company founded by e-commerce entrepreneur Dawn Dickson. Its flagship product, the PopShop, is a robotic self-service kiosk that dispenses physical and digital products while capturing customer data through computer vision, facial recognition, and real-time analytics. The platform gives brands and entrepreneurs the kind of sales metrics, inventory monitoring, targeted advertising, and customer-sentiment insight that online retailers enjoy, but for physical, unattended retail. PopCom sells its hardware on an annual lease with a monthly software subscription. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass PopCom publishes no public developer platform, API, or specification.

providers.name: Presence
providers.description: Presence is a student engagement and co-curricular involvement platform for higher education, now part of Modern Campus. It helps colleges and universities manage student organizations, campus events, involvement and attendance tracking, co-curricular records, forms, and engagement analytics so institutions can attract, engage, and retain learners. Modern Campus serves more than 1,700 colleges, universities, and education providers. Presence is delivered as a closed SaaS product with support and reference code available through the Modern Campus customer support portal; there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-service API surface published at this time, so this profile captures company identity and probed domain security rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Profitero
providers.description: Profitero is an eCommerce data and technology platform (Profitero+) that helps consumer brands optimize their digital shelf presence across major retailers such as Amazon and Walmart. It combines digital shelf analytics, retail media management, content optimization, and managed services to help brands measure and grow online sales, monitoring more than 1,400 retailer sites across 15 commerce hubs for over 9,000 global brands. Profitero was surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: PropTiger
providers.description: PropTiger.com is one of India's leading online real estate advisory and transaction platforms, founded in 2011 and now part of the REA India group (alongside Housing.com). It helps home buyers discover, evaluate, and purchase residential property across major Indian cities, combining property search and locality research with on-ground advisory, legal paperwork guidance, and home-loan assistance. The public surface is a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace; as of this enrichment pass PropTiger publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP server. This profile captures verifiable company identity, published consumer pages, and live domain-security posture. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Quris
providers.description: Quris-AI is a Bio-AI company building what it describes as pharma's first AI safety-prediction platform, aiming to predict which drug candidates will be safe in humans before they reach clinical trials. Its approach couples machine learning with "Patients-on-a-Chip" technology — miniaturized, organ-representative human tissue models that generate automatically-tagged biological data used to train classification algorithms for drug-safety prediction. The company targets the roughly 89% of drugs that fail in clinical trials, seeking to de-risk and accelerate pharmaceutical development. Based in Boston and Tel Aviv, Quris was co-founded with pioneers including Moderna co-founder Robert Langer and Nobel Laureate Aaron Ciechanover. Quris is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and is profiled in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: Radia
providers.description: Radia is a dual-use aerospace company founded in 2016 by MIT-trained aerospace engineer Mark Lundstrom, headquartered in Boulder, Colorado with a second operating base in Italy led by Giuseppe Giordo. After roughly seven years in stealth the company emerged in March 2024 with WindRunner, an aircraft it describes as the largest ever built: roughly ten times the cargo volume of a Boeing 777, sized to carry onshore wind turbine blades of up to about 105 metres, and designed to land on semi-prepared packed-dirt or gravel strips so that oversized cargo can be flown directly to a wind farm, a forward operating site or a disaster zone rather than trucked over highways it cannot fit on.
