This profile records the honest no-API-surface result plus a live domain-security probe of the flowly.world host.

providers.name: The Fit Body Co
providers.description: The Fit Body Co (Fitbody) is a Mexican direct-to-consumer sports nutrition and dietary supplements brand selling isolated and hydrolyzed protein powders, creatine, vitamins, and wellness products, along with digital recipe guides, through a Shopify-based online storefront at fitbody.mx. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As an e-commerce retail brand it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API documentation; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Trial Library
providers.description: Trial Library is an AI-native oncology clinical trials technology company that integrates clinical trials into routine cancer care. Its provider-facing decision-support platform helps community oncology practices and health systems identify eligible patients and match them to open trials at the point of care, while a navigation layer supports patients through enrollment and completion by proactively addressing transportation, food, language, and scheduling barriers. Trial Library works across health systems, biopharma sponsors, and research sites to expand equitable access to cancer clinical trials. The company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of lux-capital.

providers.name: TrueFort
providers.description: TrueFort was a zero-trust lateral-movement protection platform for enterprise workloads, providing real-time microsegmentation, service account protection, file integrity monitoring, and workload hardening driven by continuous application behavior analysis, with integrations for CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, and Armis. Backed by Canaan Partners and other investors through a $30M Series B, the company ceased operations on May 21, 2025. TrueFort never published a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Umoja Biopharma
providers.description: Umoja Biopharma is a Seattle-based clinical-stage immuno-oncology company developing in vivo CAR T cell therapies for cancer. Its VivoVec lentiviral platform generates CAR T cells directly in a patient's body, removing the ex vivo manufacturing step of traditional cell therapy, and the company operates its own manufacturing facility in Louisville, Colorado. Its pipeline includes UB-VV111 (CD19), UB-VV400 (the industry's first known CD22-directed in vivo CAR T candidate, FDA IND clearance July 2026), and UB-VV500. Umoja is backed by investors including DCVC (DCVC Bio) and SoftBank Vision Fund 2. The company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: wefox
providers.description: wefox is a Berlin-headquartered digital insurance distribution platform that connects insurance carriers, brokers, and end customers through a single technology stack. Founded in 2014 and originally known as FinanceFox, the company operates across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, and France, selling personal-lines products such as motor, home, liability, life, and commercial insurance via its in-house carrier (wefox Insurance) and a network of independent brokers. wefox positions itself as an "indirect" insurtech — meaning it distributes through human advisors augmented by software rather than selling direct-to-consumer — and has historically been one of Europe's most highly funded insurtech companies, with backing from Mubadala, Target Global, Salesforce Ventures, OMERS Ventures, Eurazeo, Mountain Partners, and others. The platform itself is a multi-tenant SaaS used by brokers and agents to manage customer relationships, quote and bind policies across multiple carriers, handle claims, and trigger commissions. wefox does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or a github.com/wefox organization; integration with the wefox platform is carrier-, broker-, and partner-mediated rather than self-service, and there is no Tier-1 developer surface to document. This repo profiles wefox as an insurance distribution business and tracks any future move toward a public API program.

providers.name: XellSmart Biomedical
providers.description: XellSmart Biomedical (士泽生物医药) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Suzhou and Shanghai, China, founded in 2021 by Dr. Xiang Li. The company develops clinical-grade, allogeneic, off-the-shelf iPSC-derived cell therapies for central nervous system diseases, with NMPA- and U.S. FDA-cleared registrational clinical trials in Parkinson's disease, spinal cord injury, and ALS. XellSmart is a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company and publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Acadia Healthcare
providers.description: Acadia Healthcare is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Acadia Healthcare API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Agile Loop L.L.C.
providers.description: Agile Loop L.L.C. is a London-founded enterprise AI company (founded 2023, backed by 500 Global) building Large Action Models — action-first foundation models trained on thousands of software interfaces so AI agents can operate any user interface and execute multi-step workflows end-to-end from natural-language instructions. Its product suite spans Sector Fusion (telecom network analytics), an Intelligent Evaluation Platform (AI scoring and fraud detection), LLM Ops (governance for LLM applications), an Aviation Ops Suite, and SAM-X (natural-language Excel automation), alongside the open-source Synapse Copilot toolkit for connecting LLMs to APIs and an embeddable Copilot widget for SaaS products. Agile Loop publishes no public OpenAPI, developer portal, or versioned client SDKs at the time of this profile.

providers.name: Alba Robot
providers.description: ALBA Robot is a Turin, Italy based autonomous micro-mobility company building a fleet of self-driving robots for indoor and pedestrian spaces such as airports, hospitals, and large facilities. Its product line includes ALBA One, ALBA Ride, ALBA Ride +, and the ALBA Caddie autonomous baggage transport robot, and it layers digital services such as Digital Twins and Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) advertising on top of the mobility platform. ALBA Robot runs pilots and deployments with airports including Cagliari, London Gatwick, Dallas, Milan, Turin, and Dubai (with dnata), and operates from Turin with a US presence in Detroit, Michigan. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or GitHub organization; it is a hardware/robotics fleet operator rather than an API provider.

providers.name: AltexSoft
providers.description: AltexSoft is a technology and solution consulting company that provides software development and IT consulting services to businesses across various industries. Specializing in travel and hospitality, healthcare, and finance sectors, AltexSoft helps companies design, build, and implement innovative technology solutions to improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experience, and drive business growth.

providers.name: Amblea
providers.description: Amblea is a French mission-driven ("entreprise à mission") healthcare-logistics platform that centralizes and optimizes patient (medical / sanitary) transport across the French health system. Formed in 2023 from the merger of Ambler (founded 2018) and Sanilea (2013), it operates a marketplace connecting healthcare establishments (hospitals, clinics, EHPADs, day-care centers) with licensed transport providers (ambulance companies and medical taxi services). The platform handles centralized booking and digital prescription management, shared-transport optimization (grouping patients per trip), real-time tracking, budget and contract management, and automated billing between facilities and transporters. Amblea reports 800+ healthcare establishments, 6,300 transport partner companies, and roughly 8,000 daily trips, making it one of France's largest healthcare-transport coordination platforms. It exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; access is via its web application and direct business arrangements.

providers.name: Apex.AI
providers.description: Apex.AI is an embedded and autonomous software company whose tagline is "software that moves," focused on safe, real-time, software-defined systems (SDx) for automotive, robotics, and other safety-critical embedded platforms. Its product line includes Apex.Grace (deterministic embedded execution framework, an automotive-grade evolution of ROS 2), Apex.Ida (high-speed fault-tolerant middleware for sensor, compute, and cloud connectivity), Apex.OS for V&V (data recording and replay for validating autonomous systems), and Apex.Alan (automated tooling and CI/CD workflows for safe software development at scale). Apex.AI also provides technical assessment, architecture, embedded and cloud software development, CI/CD pipeline, and ROS 1 to ROS 2 migration services. The company is a maintainer of substantial ROS 2 and embedded middleware open source. It is backed by Canaan Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Apex.AI publishes no public developer REST API at this time.

providers.name: Arca
providers.description: Arca (Arca Financial, Inc.) is an AI-native wealth management company founded by former Plaid product leader Rron Rexha and headquartered in New York. It pairs human financial advisors with a fully integrated, agentic platform in which AI agents are the primary operational users: monitoring emails, calls, documents, market data, and news, coordinating with one another, generating dynamic user interfaces, and executing multi-step advisory workflows so advisors can focus on client relationships. Arca is an SEC-registered investment adviser managing over $1 billion in client assets, and raised $64M across a seed round (led by Venrock) and a Series A (led by General Catalyst, with Index Ventures and Venrock). It has no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Authorea
providers.description: Authorea is a collaborative online platform for writing, editing, reviewing, and publishing scholarly and scientific documents. Founded in 2012 by Alberto Pepe and Nathan Jenkins, it lets researchers co-author articles in rich text or LaTeX, manage citations and references, embed data, figures, and code, run version-controlled review, and export to journal-specific styles. Authorea was acquired by Atypon in 2018 and is now operated as part of John Wiley & Sons, hosted on Atypon's Literatum publishing platform, where it supports preprints, journal submission, and open collaboration for the research community. It has no public developer API today; its earlier REST API was retired after the Wiley/Atypon acquisition, and the GitHub organization now publishes only document-processing tooling (LaTeXML, Pandoc, TeX styling) rather than API client SDKs.

providers.name: Barnes & Noble
providers.description: Barnes & Noble is the largest retail bookseller in the United States, operating physical bookstores and an e-commerce site selling books, magazines, gifts, and educational products. Barnes & Noble also operates the Nook e-reader platform and offers affiliate and publisher partner programs. No public developer API is currently offered; the company operates primarily through retail channels and affiliate marketing programs.

providers.name: Bindbridge
providers.description: Bindbridge is an AI-driven molecular discovery company founded in 2025 and based in Cambridge, UK, developing next-generation crop protection through targeted protein degradation. Its BRIDGE platform uses AI to discover and design molecular glues and targeted protein degraders with novel modes of action against weeds and crop diseases, combining AI candidate generation, computational docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and free-energy binding calculations to accelerate agricultural R&D across herbicides, insecticides, and fungicides. The company raised $3.8M to help reduce billion-dollar crop losses and is backed by Speedinvest. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; it publishes no public API or developer surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: BitDAO
providers.description: BitDAO is a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) launched in 2021 to fund and govern the growth of decentralized finance and the broader on-chain economy, with decisions made by holders of the BIT governance token. BitDAO incubated Mantle Network, an Ethereum Layer 2 scaling solution, and in 2023 the BIT token merged into MNT as the project rebranded to Mantle; bitdao.io now redirects to mantle.xyz. BitDAO publishes governance, tokenomics, and litepaper documentation rather than a developer REST API. Sector: crypto.

providers.name: Bond
providers.description: Bond Financial Technologies was an embedded-finance platform that offered APIs for card issuing (Bond Issuing), money movement (Bond Pay), deposit accounts (Bond Banking), and credit underwriting (Bond Credit) to brands and fintechs. Bond was acquired by FIS (Fidelity National Information Services) in 2023 and its product surface has been folded into Atelio by FIS at atelio.com. The original Bond developer portal and API surface at bond.tech is no longer the primary access path; new partners are routed to the Atelio platform. This is an honest historical record.

providers.description: Brazil Central Bank Open Data

providers.name: Caba
providers.description: CABA Design Co. is a direct-to-consumer home-furnishings company building the next generation of furniture brands powered by community and technology. It develops sustainable, high-quality furniture and gives customers choice through customization and modularity, selling directly through its Shopify-hosted storefront at cabadesign.co under the tagline "Your Home. Your Way." Caba was surfaced as a portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network as a company stub; it publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront and does not currently expose a first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile captures the identity, storefront, and domain/security posture verified during enrichment.

providers.name: Cameron International
providers.description: Cameron International (formerly Cooper Cameron Corporation) was a leading provider of flow equipment products, systems, and services to the worldwide oil, gas, and process industries. In 2016 the business was acquired by Schlumberger (now SLB) and its pressure-control, drilling, subsea, valves, measurement, and compression product lines were integrated into SLB's digital oilfield portfolio. Cameron-branded capabilities are now delivered and integrated through the SLB DELFI digital platform and its developer APIs rather than through a standalone Cameron developer program.

providers.name: Canadian National Railway
providers.description: Canadian National Railway (CN) is the largest railway network in Canada and one of the largest in North America spanning over 20,000 route miles. CN transports goods across an integrated network linking the Atlantic and Pacific coasts with the Gulf of Mexico. CN offers shipper APIs, EDI integration, the eBusiness portal, and the CN ONE mobile app for shipment tracking, ordering, billing, and rate management.

providers.name: Color Health
providers.description: Color Health (founded as Color Genomics in 2015) is a population health technology company that operates a nationwide, oncologist-led Virtual Cancer Clinic and delivers population-scale precision health programs - hereditary cancer and cardiovascular genetic testing, pharmacogenomics, cancer early detection and screening, and clinical care management - for employers, unions, health plans, governments, and public health institutions. Color does NOT publish a public, self-service developer API. Access to its platform is enterprise/partner-gated and contracted directly with organizations; data exchange with health systems and EHRs is handled through interoperability partners (e.g. Redox) using FHIR/HL7 rather than an open developer portal. The APIs listed here are logical, honestly-modeled surfaces (endpointsModeled) that describe how such a program is typically integrated - they are not confirmed public endpoints.

providers.name: Compass
providers.description: Compass is a New York City headquartered, tech-enabled residential real estate brokerage founded in 2012 by Robert Reffkin and Ori Allon. The company operates the largest residential real estate brokerage in the United States by sales volume, supporting roughly 36,890 agents and $267 billion in gross transaction value across approximately 250,360 transactions in fiscal year 2025, on $6.96 billion in revenue. Compass builds and operates a proprietary, end-to-end agent platform — an integrated cloud-based suite spanning CRM, marketing center, transaction management, listings, market analytics, the Compass One client dashboard, Compass Lens, AI-powered comparative market analysis, AI-generated video, virtual agent services, and a voice-activated AI assistant — custom-built for residential brokerage workflows. The company has invested over $100 million per year in technology and runs a 500+ person Product and Engineering organization, with engineering hubs that have included Seattle. Compass completed its merger with Anywhere Real Estate on January 9, 2026, combining two of the largest residential brokerage operators in the United States. The Compass platform is internal-facing: it is offered as the operating system for Compass agents and their clients, not as a developer product. There is no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or third-party developer portal for the Compass real estate platform; the company's GitHub presence at github.com/urbancompass publishes a handful of internal-tooling open source projects (e.g. Snail, Mussel, hnvm, bazel-toolchain) rather than product APIs.

providers.name: Country Style Cooking
providers.description: Country Style Cooking Restaurant Chain (乡村基, Xiangcunji) is a large Chinese quick-service restaurant group founded on 23 November 1996 in Chongqing by Li Hong and Zhang Xingqiang. The group operates two directly-managed chain brands — Xiangcunji (乡村基) and Mr. Rice (大米先生) — serving Sichuan-style fast food cooked to order in restaurant kitchens under a long-standing "good taste at affordable prices" operating philosophy. The company formerly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CCSC and was, at the time, the only Asia-headquartered restaurant chain listed on the NYSE. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan. Country Style Cooking publishes a Chinese-language corporate website (csc100.com) covering its restaurants, brands, group news, recruiting, and procurement bidding, but it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable API artifacts — this profile records that verified absence of an API surface.

providers.name: Createra
providers.description: Createra is a user-generated-content (UGC) gaming metaverse platform backed by Andreessen Horowitz, built by the Code Infinity team associated with the youth-coding company Codemao. The platform lets creators build and publish infinitely engaging 3D worlds and games directly in the browser, founded on the belief that creativity is a talent that everyone possesses. Its Box3 creation platform published a first-party JavaScript web SDK to npm as @box3/web-sdk. As of a July 2026 probe the createra.fun website returns no response over HTTP or HTTPS, no developer portal, documentation, API reference, OpenAPI definition, or /.well-known discovery surface could be located, and the npm SDK has not been republished since January 2023 — this profile therefore records Createra as a dormant company with no active public API surface.

providers.name: DealerSocket
providers.description: DealerSocket is an automotive dealership CRM and Dealer Management System (DMS) software platform for franchise and independent auto dealers, covering customer relationship management, inventory management, websites, digital marketing, and desking/deals. DealerSocket is a Solera company (acquired 2021; part of Solera's Vehicle Solutions line of business). DealerSocket exposes a set of inbound and outbound integration APIs - lead forwarding, deal push to the DMS, customer updates, activity and CTI/call logging - but access is not self-serve. It is delivered through DealerSocket's Certified Partners program (launched 2013, 500-plus integration points) and is application-, contract-, and certification-gated. There is no public developer portal, no published authentication reference, and no public endpoint or base-URL documentation; the logical APIs below are modeled from DealerSocket's public integrations page rather than a self-serve API reference.

providers.name: Distributional
providers.description: Distributional is an a16z-backed company (security contact Scott Clark) tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of July 2026 distributional.com serves a pre-launch holding page ("Something new is coming") with no public API, backend, or authentication surface. The site does publish machine-readable discovery surfaces, however: an RFC 9116 security.txt at /.well-known/security.txt and an llms.txt with plain-markdown page twins for direct LLM ingestion. This profile captures those published surfaces and probed domain-security posture, and will be enriched further once the company launches a developer or API offering.

providers.name: Ekomoditi
providers.description: eKomoditi (PT Ekomoditi Solutions Indonesia) is a Southeast Asian agriculture-technology company, founded in 2015 and based in Jakarta, that builds digital plantation-management software for oil palm, rubber, sugar, and durian estates. Its flagship Electronic Plantation Control System (ePCS) replaces paper-based field recording with a mobile in-field Android app, an eGIS geographic mapping application, mills automation, and business-intelligence analytics — capturing harvesting, fertilization, pest-management, worker, and transport data for same-day reporting, labor-fraud monitoring, quality control, and traceability. eKomoditi also offers aerial-mapping drone services, a plantation marketplace, and due-diligence consulting. The company is backed by 500 Global and ZB Capital. It does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.description: Broadest collection of public data

providers.name: Entocycle
providers.description: Entocycle is a London-based insect farming technology company building industrial-scale, controlled-environment facilities that use black soldier fly bioconversion to turn organic waste streams into insect protein for animal feed and organic fertilizer (frass). Its platform combines modular climate-controlled farm infrastructure, real-time AI-driven insect monitoring that counts and tracks insects across their lifecycle, and fully automated production systems to standardize output across deployments worldwide. Entocycle partners with waste management companies, agricultural producers, insect companies, and offtake buyers to develop and operate circular-economy insect farms. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.description: The Daily Journal of the United States Government

providers.name: GATE Space
providers.description: GATE Space is an Austrian aerospace company redefining in-space mobility with high-thrust chemical propulsion systems for satellites, capsules, and landing vehicles. A TU Wien spinout founded in 2022 and backed by Techstars, the company builds the GATE Jetpack — a plug-and-play, refuelable propulsion module running on green propellants that lets satellites perform rapid orbit and attitude maneuvers with no integration effort. Its patented engines have been validated across 8,000+ hot-fire tests in atmospheric and vacuum conditions, manufactured in a European facility with a 98% local supply chain. GATE Space raised €6.3M via the EIC Accelerator and its propulsion system will fly on BeaconSat, Austria's first military satellite. This is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer/API surface; the profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity record.

providers.name: Heska
providers.description: Heska is a veterinary diagnostics company that makes in-clinic point-of-care lab analyzers and imaging for veterinary practices - chemistry (Element DC/DCX/RC/RCX), hematology (Element HT5), blood gas and electrolytes (Element POC), immunodiagnostics (Element i), coagulation (Element COAG), and AI-guided urine/fecal/blood-morphology testing (Element AIM) - plus the HeskaView Connect lab data and workflow software. Heska was acquired by Antech Diagnostics, a subsidiary of Mars, Incorporated (Mars Petcare / Mars Science & Diagnostics), in 2023, and now operates as an Antech company. Heska exposes a partner-gated integration API that bidirectionally connects its analyzers to veterinary practice information management systems (PIMS/EMR) - orders flow out to the analyzers and results flow back into the patient record - but there is no public, self-service developer portal, published API reference, OpenAPI, or public pricing. Access is provisioned to approved integration partners (ezyVet, Instinct, Vetspire, NectarVet, Digitail, and others) via API Partner credentials.

providers.name: Hireguide
providers.description: Hireguide is a structured-interviewing and hiring-intelligence platform, originally a Techstars-backed startup, that helped talent teams run consistent, evidence-based interviews with guided question banks, scorecards, interview recording and AI-assisted candidate evaluation grounded in industrial-organizational hiring science. Hireguide's team and technology were acquired by HireVue in 2026; the primary domain now redirects to HireVue's AI Interviewer platform, while trust.hireguide.com remains live and Hireguide-branded, publishing the company's compliance posture (SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead; no independent public developer/API surface was found for Hireguide.

providers.name: Iman
providers.description: IMAN (mobile app IMANUM, operated by IMAN CAPITAL LTD) is a halal fintech and Islamic-finance super-app serving Muslim-majority, largely unbanked markets in Central Asia. Headquartered in Uzbekistan and expanding into Kazakhstan, Pakistan, South Asia and MENA, IMAN bundles Sharia-compliant financial products into a single consumer app: IMAN Invest, a faith-based investing platform where users and IMAN enter Mudarabah contracts to finance real trade in goods, and IMAN Pay, an interest-free buy-now-pay-later / point-of-sale installment product for the previously unbanked. All services are certified compliant with Islamic finance principles by scholars including the Muslim Board of Uzbekistan. IMAN was the first Central Asian startup backed by 500 Global and has raised over $6M from strategic and institutional investors.

providers.name: InAuth (American Express)
providers.description: InAuth is a mobile-first digital device intelligence and authentication company acquired by American Express in 2018 and now operated within American Express's fraud-management portfolio; its technology also powers Accertify Device Intelligence. The InAuth Security Platform provides persistent device identification (device fingerprinting), malware and criminal-tool detection, rooted/jailbroken-device detection, location and behavioral risk analysis, and transaction risk scoring, delivered primarily through native iOS and Android SDKs embedded in merchant and financial-institution apps. Access is enterprise-gated through the Amex for Developers portal; there is no public self-serve REST API, OpenAPI specification, public package-registry distribution, or InAuth-specific public code repository for the product line.

providers.name: ING
providers.description: A Dutch multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Amsterdam. Provides retail banking, direct banking, commercial banking, and wholesale banking services to millions of customers across Europe and globally. Operates a public Developer Portal exposing Open Banking, PSD2, and payment-related APIs for third-party developers and fintech partners.

providers.name: InstaAgent
providers.description: InstaAgent is a Y Combinator-backed AI marketing platform that turns a single campaign brief into hundreds of audience-specific creatives. It generates persona-, trend-, and format-grounded ad variants, distributes them across Meta, TikTok, and niche social accounts built for specific audiences, then tests which personas, hooks, formats, and channels drive performance and scales the winners into the next campaign. The company reports serving 500+ clients across 10+ countries with 10x ad variants and 30%+ ROI improvement. InstaAgent operates a marketing product surface only and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: ISAAC Instruments
providers.description: ISAAC Instruments is a Canadian provider of in-cab technology and fleet management for the trucking industry - electronic logging devices (ELD), telematics, hours-of-service (HOS) compliance, driver workflow, messaging, and fuel/performance analytics, delivered as a fully managed hardware-plus-software platform. ISAAC runs an "Open Platform" with a documented API that lets fleets and 80+ integration partners (TMS/dispatch, maintenance, fuel tax, visibility, safety/compliance) share ISAAC data with their chosen vendors. API access is partner-gated - vendors apply through the ISAAC partner program and the full API Guide and reference live behind the ISAAC InRealTime portal and Client Center rather than on a public developer site. The API surface documented here is modeled from ISAAC's public platform and partner materials; exact endpoints, base URLs, and authentication are provisioned to approved partners.

providers.name: Jifflenow
providers.description: Jifflenow is a B2B meeting automation and scheduling platform for trade shows, conferences, and corporate events, now part of Cvent (acquired 2021) as Cvent Jifflenow. It lets sales and event teams request, approve, and confirm meetings before attendees arrive on the show floor, with automated routing and notifications, a unified calendar that combines customer meetings and internal staff activities, on-site mobile check-in and no-show tracking, and reporting dashboards that tie meeting volume and outcomes back to pipeline. It integrates with Salesforce (native CRM sync of accounts, opportunities, campaigns, and leads), Outlook, and iCapture badge scanning. The standalone jifflenow.com now redirects to Cvent; there is no public first-party developer API, SDK, or documentation surface for Jifflenow as a distinct product.

providers.name: Kobalt Music
providers.description: Kobalt Music Group is a music services company providing publishing administration, neighbouring rights and recordings services for songwriters, artists, publishers and rights holders. It collects, matches and accounts for royalties across streaming and digital platforms, reporting to clients through its own portals rather than a public developer program. Kobalt's rights and content management platform is operated by KTech, its technology arm, which processes the micro-transaction royalty data behind Kobalt Music Publishing and AMRA, the global digital collection society. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass Kobalt publishes no public API, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification; the only public machine-readable surface found was an RFC 9116 security.txt.

providers.name: Lean Six Sigma
providers.description: Lean Six Sigma is a methodology that combines Lean manufacturing principles and Six Sigma quality management techniques to improve business processes by eliminating waste and reducing variation, focusing on data-driven decision making and continuous improvement.

providers.name: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
providers.description: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt is an advanced certification in Lean Six Sigma methodology focused on leading complex improvement projects, statistical analysis, and change management to reduce defects and variability in business processes.

providers.name: Letel
providers.description: Shanghai Letel Communication Equipment (Group) Co., Ltd. (上海乐通通信设备（集团）股份有限公司) is a Chinese manufacturer of information and communication network infrastructure, founded in March 1992 and headquartered in Shanghai with over 1,500 employees and 20+ service locations nationwide. Letel builds data center physical infrastructure — cabinet micromodules, cold aisle micromodules, containerized micromodules, pallet IT cabins, and cabinets — alongside communication cabling equipment, optical communication devices, data communication equipment, broadband access equipment, and structural components for notebooks and servers. It operates through subsidiaries including Zhongle Communication Technology Co., Ltd. Letel publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation; this is a company profile in the API Evangelist network, surfaced as a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company.

providers.name: Markerly
providers.description: Markerly is a full-service influencer marketing agency, running creator campaigns since 2012 across strategy, vetted-creator sourcing, content, activation, and real-time measurement. Two specialties set the Austin, Texas agency apart: influencer campaigns for government agencies, public health, and nonprofits (advocacy), and bilingual/multicultural creator campaigns. Markerly operates managed campaigns and a creator network rather than a public developer API; it was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network. This enrichment pass confirmed a marketing/agency surface (site, llms.txt, robots.txt) with no public API, OpenAPI, MCP, or developer portal.

providers.name: Muon Space
providers.description: Muon Space is a Mountain View, California-based end-to-end space systems company that designs, builds, and operates mission-optimized satellite constellations to deliver Earth Intelligence and enable real-time compute and decision-making in space. Founded in 2021 by veterans of Skybox, NASA, and SpaceX, the company's core product is Muon Halo, an integrated technology stack composed of MuSim (constellation simulation and digital twin), MuOS (IP-based software-defined network middleware connecting space, ground, and cloud), MuCore (software-configurable instrument core), Condor (modular Condor-M and Condor-XL spacecraft platforms), and MuDash (cloud-based tasking, scheduling, and operations dashboard). Muon Space's flagship public mission is FireSat, a purpose-built wildfire detection and monitoring constellation developed with the Earth Fire Alliance, Google Research, and the Gordon & Betty Moore Foundation; FireSat carries a high-dynamic-range multispectral IR instrument capable of detecting 5x5 meter fires across a 1,500 km swath with a 50 m nadir ground sample distance, with revisit times targeted to twenty minutes once the full constellation is operational. The Protoflight satellite produced its first-light imagery in June 2025, with the first block of three additional satellites launching in 2026 and full operational capacity targeted for 2030. Other Muon Space missions support the U.S. Air Force and U.S. Space Force for next-generation weather monitoring, Hydrosat for thermal geospatial intelligence in climate and agriculture, and global security applications including missile-defense architecture. Muon Space's revenue model is mission contracting, spacecraft and constellation delivery, and hosted data services; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release of the Halo platform or FireSat data feed.

providers.name: Noodle Partners
providers.description: Noodle Partners (Noodle) is a higher education solutions company providing full-funnel services and AI-powered products spanning student recruitment through graduation and workforce development. Its product suite includes the Noodle Learning Platform (a customizable LMS for lifelong learning and continuing education), Noodle Companion (an in-platform AI assistant), Noodle Engage (conversational AI for recruitment and enrollment), Noodle Dialogue (AI-assisted faculty content and curriculum design), and Noodle Manage (data integration and analytics). Noodle also delivers marketing, enrollment, learning design, retention, and strategic consulting services to universities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment; the company publishes a SOC 2 trust center.

providers.name: One More Game
providers.description: One More Game is a fully remote game development studio founded by veterans behind titles such as Warcraft, Diablo, StarCraft, and Guild Wars. The team builds delightful, social online games designed to be played with friends, emphasizing fast iteration and a mission to help players have more fun. One More Game was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. The studio publishes a consumer gaming website, a company blog, careers listings, and a GitHub organization (PlayOneMoreGame) of game-development tooling and forks, but does not currently operate a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: OpenEyes Insurance
providers.description: OpenEyes Insurance (OpenEyes Insurance Agency, Inc.) is an Austin, Texas-based insurtech startup, with an additional New York office, that provides commercial auto insurance for truck and bus fleet operators bundled with proprietary risk-prevention technology. Its offering pairs fleet coverage with real-time driver monitoring, AI dashcams, safety analytics, customized driver training, and 24/7 claims management, serving both insurance agents (For Agents) and fleet operators directly (For Fleets). Founded by Yoav Oron (CEO), Dr. Omry Sendik (CTO), and Dan Charash (Chairman), OpenEyes emerged from stealth in February 2023 with a $23M Series A led by Insight Partners with Pitango First. The company operates a customer-facing fleet dashboard but does not publish a public developer API, portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: ProFrac Holding
providers.description: ProFrac Holding Corp. is a vertically integrated, innovation-driven energy services company providing hydraulic fracturing, completion services, and complementary products and services to upstream oil and gas companies engaged in the exploration and production of North American unconventional oil and natural gas resources. The company operates through portfolio brands including ProFrac, Best Pump & Flow, Alpine Silica, IO-TEQ, and Livewire Power. ProFrac Holding does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: Rangers Protocol
providers.description: Rangers Protocol is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain (Chain ID 2025) built for Web3 games and metaverse applications, using a VRF+BLS consensus mechanism to handle high-frequency transactions and a heterogeneous relay chain for true cross-chain interoperability. It features a virtual-machine ("blockchain virtualization") design, an NFT protocol emphasizing data inheritance and reuse, an on-chain oracle, and the Grand Guard Safe security tooling. Its native gas token, RPG (Rangers Protocol Gas), is also issued as ERC20 on Ethereum and BEP20 on BNB Smart Chain. The developer surface is standard Ethereum JSON-RPC plus verification-node operations; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of Pantera Capital and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Reporting Templates
providers.description: Pre-built document templates for generating standardized reports, dashboards, and data presentations with consistent formatting and structure. Organizations use reporting templates to track key metrics, identify trends, optimize business outcomes, and communicate data insights to stakeholders. This collection catalogs APIs and tools for working with report templates across business intelligence, analytics, document generation, and data visualization platforms.

providers.name: Republic
providers.description: Republic is a New York-based fintech and private investing platform (republic.com) that lets retail and accredited investors access early-stage startups, private companies, real estate, crypto, and other alternative assets through regulated investment crowdfunding offerings. Backed by prosus-ventures, Republic operates a consumer investing marketplace rather than a public developer platform: it publishes a security and compliance posture (SOC 2, ISO 27001) at republic.com/security but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface at the time of this enrichment pass. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched with the provider-security signals that could be probed directly.

providers.name: ResWare
providers.description: ResWare is customizable title and escrow production software for real estate closings, originally built by Adeptive Software Corporation and acquired by Qualia Labs in December 2020 (now shipping as ResWare 10 within the Qualia ecosystem). It is an on-premises, workflow-driven platform covering title and escrow production, document management and auto-generation, secure communications, and escrow accounting. ResWare exposes an integration API to partners and customers that is historically a SOAP/XML web-service API (built on Windows Communication Foundation / WCF, Microsoft binary protocol by default with Basic Authentication available on request), complemented by newer REST APIs for document handling. There is no public, self-serve developer portal - API access is gated behind a partner/integration program and an "API assistance" package (developer support hours, REST/WCF code samples, and documentation), with pricing on request via sales@adeptivesw.com. The logical service areas below are modeled from partner-integration behavior; ResWare publishes no public API reference or OpenAPI, so no REST surface is fabricated here.

providers.name: Rubric Labs
providers.description: Rubric Labs is an applied AI lab based in Canada that helps companies build and ship intelligent, agent-powered applications. Rather than selling a public API product, Rubric Labs operates as an engineering partner and maintains open-source tooling for AI-first development, including create-rubric-app (a full-stack AI project scaffold inspired by create-next-app), maige (open-source infrastructure for running natural-language workflows on your codebase), and tokenmaxx (a local proxy that aggregates LLM token usage across Codex and Claude Code accounts). The team partners with companies such as Cal.com and Trigger.dev, works with Neon, Vercel, and LangChain, and publishes engineering writing on its blog. As of this profile there is no self-service developer API, hosted API reference, SDK, or pricing surface to score — this is a services and open-source lab, not an API provider.

providers.name: Schuettflix
providers.description: Schuettflix is a German digital logistics platform for the construction industry, founded in 2018 in Guetersloh. It operates a neutral B2B marketplace that connects construction companies, bulk-material suppliers, freight forwarders and waste-disposal firms in a single fully digital workflow. Through its iOS and Android apps, customers order sand, gravel and crushed stone with transparent real-time pricing, coordinate dispatch and transport, capture delivery documentation, manage routes, and handle mineral-waste disposal and circular-economy recycling of construction materials. The company digitizes the traditionally analog and fragmented process of procuring and delivering bulk goods, earning a commission on the transactions facilitated through its platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest. No public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Seamflow
providers.description: Seamflow builds AI-native software for the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry, automating end-to-end regulatory certification workflows for notified bodies and certification organizations while preserving human oversight and accreditation compliance. Its platform spans four core products: the Notified Body Suite (intake-to-certificate workflow management), Scheduling Agents (automated auditor assignment and travel optimization), Tech File Review (structured technical-documentation assessment against regulatory requirements), and Report Writing (AI-assisted drafting of compliance reports). Seamflow is an early-stage enterprise-SaaS company ($4.5M seed) backed by Initialized Capital and Northzone. As of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI specification; this record captures its verified public company surface.

providers.name: ShelterLogic Group
providers.description: ShelterLogic Group is the world leader in shade, shelter, storage, and outdoor lifestyle products with over 70 years of industry experience. Launched in 1991, ShelterLogic develops tough, affordable shelter solutions for everyday consumers and commercial customers. The company operates three manufacturing facilities in the US and China and maintains worldwide distribution. The ShelterLogic brand portfolio includes ShelterLogic, SOJAG, Arrow Storage Products, Quik Shade, CAMP&GO, RIO Beach, and licensed brands including Tommy Bahama, Margaritaville, Life is Good, and Scotts Miracle-Gro. As a B2C manufacturer and retailer, ShelterLogic does not expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Silgan Holdings
providers.description: Silgan Holdings Inc. is a leading global sustainable packaging provider for consumer goods products. The company partners with customers to deliver essential products to the world in efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective packaging formats. Silgan operates through three primary business segments: Dispensing and Specialty Closures, Metal Containers, and Custom Containers. With 123 manufacturing facilities on four continents, over 17,200 employees, and approximately $6 billion in annual sales, Silgan serves the food, beverage, healthcare, home and garden, personal care, fragrance, and beauty end markets.

providers.name: Simple HealthKit
providers.description: Simple HealthKit is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of initialized-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Smartness
providers.description: Smartness (formerly Smartpricing) is an Italian hospitality-technology company that helps hotels, B&Bs, and vacation-rental operators automate online operations and grow direct revenue. Its product suite spans AI dynamic pricing (Smartpricing), a property management system (Smartpms), 24/7 guest messaging (Smartchat), email marketing and segmentation (Smartconnect), a website builder (Smartsite), reputation, ads, and payments (Smartpay), serving 4,000+ accommodation providers across Europe. Smartness connects to 80+ PMS and channel-manager platforms through partner integrations, but publishes no public developer API or portal; integrations are arranged via a partnership request. Backed by Partech.

providers.name: SoLo Funds
providers.description: SoLo Funds is a Techstars-backed, Los Angeles fintech that operates a community-driven peer-to-peer lending marketplace delivered as a consumer mobile app for iOS and Android. Members request small, short-term loans that other members choose to fund, with borrowers offering an optional tip and donation rather than mandated interest, positioning the platform as a member-to-member alternative to payday and overdraft borrowing. SoLo Funds is a consumer financial-services product and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its only publicly reachable operational surface is a hosted status page.

providers.name: Swiftlane
providers.description: Swiftlane is a San Francisco-based physical security company providing cloud-based access control and video intercom systems for multifamily residential and commercial buildings. Its touchless, mobile-first platform combines face recognition, mobile and key-card credentials, visitor PIN access, vehicle readers, smart locks, and a centralized cloud management dashboard with access logs, user management, and remote unlock. Swiftlane publishes a customer product site, a large blog, and an Intercom-hosted help center, but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or webhooks; integrations are delivered through partners such as Okta, Azure, Google Workspace, and Eagle Eye.

providers.name: The Coterie
providers.description: The Coterie is a financial technology company founded in 2022 by Ethan Agarwal, Jeson Patel, and Chris Boies to give startup founders access to venture capital investments, estate-planning strategies (including its ATOM Trust product), and lending. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, the company has since rebranded and now operates as Allocate (allocate.co), positioning itself as "an operating system for private markets" serving wealth advisors and asset managers with deal sourcing, white-labeled fund creation, AI-powered portfolio management, and unified reporting. The company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Thermondo
providers.description: Thermondo is Germany's largest residential heating installer, focused on heat pumps, photovoltaic (solar) systems, home energy management (thermondo smart), dynamic electricity tariffs, financing and subsidy assistance, and maintenance and repair services for homeowners. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Berlin, the company employs over 1,200 staff and has completed installations for more than 55,000 customers. Thermondo is a consumer-facing climate-energy provider and a portfolio company of HV Capital. It publishes no public developer API or documentation surface; it does operate a security.txt vulnerability-disclosure program and a GitHub organization. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from HV Capital's portfolio and enriched with the public security surface that could be verified.

providers.name: Thor Industries
providers.description: Thor Industries is the world's largest manufacturer of recreational vehicles, owning subsidiary brands including Airstream, Jayco, Heartland RV, Keystone RV, and others. Thor Industries operates primarily as a manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer API. Dealer integrations and connected vehicle features are managed through subsidiary brands and OEM partnerships.

providers.description: Open data of the city Umeå in northen Sweden

providers.name: United States Capitol Police
providers.description: The United States Capitol Police (USCP) is a federal law enforcement agency responsible for protecting the U.S. Capitol Building, members of Congress, and visitors to the Capitol complex. The agency is tasked with maintaining security and order within the Capitol grounds, conducting background checks on individuals entering the buildings, and responding to emergencies and threats. Capitol Police officers also provide security for large events and demonstrations taking place on Capitol Hill. As a legislative branch entity, the USCP operates under unique legal frameworks. In 2024, the agency adopted a FOIA-like request process making certain records publicly available upon request.

providers.name: University of Oslo
providers.description: Courses, lecture videos, detailed information for courses etc. for the University of Oslo (Norway)

providers.name: WhiteWave Foods
providers.description: The WhiteWave Foods Company was a consumer packaged food and beverage company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It offered plant-based foods and beverages, coffee creamers, dairy, and organic produce under brands including Silk, So Delicious, Horizon Organic, International Delight, LAND O LAKES, Vega, Wallaby Organic, and Earthbound Farm. WhiteWave was acquired by Danone in April 2017 and is now part of Danone North America.

providers.name: Xiaopangxiong
providers.description: Xiaopangxiong (小胖熊, "small fat bear") is a Chinese B2B e-commerce platform for home and office renovation materials, operated by Shanghai Miju Network Technology Co., Ltd. (上海米居网络科技有限公司). The platform connects building-material suppliers with renovation contractors, crew foremen, and decoration companies, selling the full range of auxiliary materials (辅材) — sand, cement, paint and coatings, electrical wiring, pipes, tiles, and leveling supplies — through a self-operated model that spans factory-direct procurement, warehousing, logistics, delivery, installation, and after-sales service. Headquartered in Shanghai with service stations and warehouses in Suzhou, Hangzhou, Hefei, Ningbo, Wuxi, and Jiaxing, Xiaopangxiong is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and distributes primarily through its 小胖熊 mobile app; the company publishes no public developer portal or API surface.

providers.name: YOURIKA
providers.description: YOURIKA (YOURIKA Labs) is a Kitchener-Waterloo, Canada AI platform and venture studio that creates and scales purpose-built, verticalized AI ventures in partnership with industry experts, prioritizing accuracy, trust, and measurable outcomes over technology-first approaches. Its ventures include smart'n, a nurse-first intelligence and learning platform that helps nurses learn, grow, and make more informed decisions throughout their careers, and Retain / Workforce Intelligence for senior and long-term care, which helps operators identify, hire, and retain caregivers while reducing turnover. yourikaLABS also offers AI advisory services connecting businesses with experts to build data-driven strategies and roadmaps. YOURIKA is backed by Amazon, Techstars (Amazon Alexa Accelerator), and the University of Waterloo. The company exposes no bespoke public developer API; its marketing site is built on Wix and advertises a Wix Site MCP endpoint plus an llms.txt for agentic access.

providers.name: Aerialoop
providers.description: Aerialoop is a drone technology and urban logistics company that designs, builds, and operates intelligent aerial networks for cargo delivery, surveillance, and infrastructure inspection. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Miami with operations rooted in Quito, Ecuador, it is one of the fastest-growing drone delivery operations in Latin America. Its ALT 6-8 delivery drone carries a 5kg payload for urban logistics, while the ALT 6-ISR line adds HD, infrared, and night-vision cameras with AI-powered intrusion detection; extended-range variants operate up to 120km using LEO satellite connectivity for beyond-visual-line-of-sight flights. The company has completed over 50,000 flights across six countries. Aerialoop is a Techstars Miami (powered by J.P. Morgan) portfolio company. It currently publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Atomic Finance
providers.description: Atomic.Finance was a non-custodial, Bitcoin-native financial platform based in Toronto, Canada (founded 2018) that built options-trading and hedging products directly on Bitcoin using Discreet Log Contracts (DLCs) — with no custody, no wrapping, and no swapping. Rather than a hosted REST API, the company's public developer surface is a body of open-source Bitcoin and DLC tooling published to GitHub (the atomicfinance organization, 34 repositories) and to npm under two first-party scopes: @atomicfinance/* (the Bitcoin Abstraction Layer SDK) and @node-dlc/* (a Node.js implementation of the DLC and Lightning wire protocols). The company is reported out of business, but the libraries remain published and implement DLC, BIP-340 Schnorr/adaptor signatures, and BOLT Lightning standards.

providers.name: BAYCON
providers.description: BAYCON Inc. is a Seoul, South Korea-based mobile connectivity company, founded in 2018 and backed by 500 Global and Shorooq Partners (seed round, 2024). BAYCON operates a global data eSIM platform and a family of international communication apps: eSIM Easy (이심이지), which delivers multi-country data eSIM plans as a QR code within minutes of purchase; ModuCall (모두의 국제전화), affordable VoIP international calling that lets users place overseas calls using their domestic mobile plans; and BayTalk. The company partners with local network operators and global carrier infrastructure so international travelers and businesses can access local mobile networks without physical SIM cards, cut roaming costs, and stay connected across borders, and is expanding into travel content such as attraction tickets and transportation passes. BAYCON publishes consumer mobile apps rather than a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Bloomsbury
providers.description: Bloomsbury AI was a London-based natural-language-processing startup, backed by Seedcamp, that built Cape — an API making it easy to build software that answers questions about the contents of documents (machine reading / document question answering). Bloomsbury AI was acquired by Facebook in 2018; the hosted Cape API is terminated and bloomsbury.ai now serves only a farewell page. The team open sourced the Cape stack (web services, document QA, machine reader, and clients) under the bloomsburyai GitHub organization, which remains publicly available as archival source. This API Evangelist profile preserves that identity and the open-source footprint.

providers.name: BrightSource Energy
providers.description: BrightSource Energy is a renewable energy technology company founded in 2006, historically known as a pioneer of utility-scale Concentrated Solar Power (CSP) — it designed, developed and built the 377 MW Ivanpah Solar Electric Generating System in California along with CSP projects in Israel, Dubai and South Africa. In 2022 the company transformed into a software business and now commercializes OASES, a cloud-based, AI-powered Energy Management System (EMS) that forecasts, optimizes and dispatches portfolios of photovoltaics, battery energy storage (BESS), wind, microgrids and EV charging. OASES combines physics-based digital twins, big-data analytics and sensor fusion with an on-site SCADA edge controller ("OASES Gateway + IoT") to run asset management, energy-market bidding and arbitrage, PPA management, grid services and frequency regulation. Engineering is based in Jerusalem, Israel, with a UK office in London. BrightSource does not publish a public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract as of August 2026.

providers.name: Buckeye Partners
providers.description: Buckeye Partners, LP is a master limited partnership that owns and operates one of the largest independent liquid petroleum product pipeline and terminal systems in the United States. Buckeye transports and stores refined petroleum products including gasoline, jet fuel, diesel, and heating oil, connecting refineries and import terminals to local distribution markets across the Eastern US, Midwest, and internationally. Buckeye was taken private by IFM Investors in 2019.

providers.name: Clearwave
providers.description: Clearwave is a patient revenue-cycle and self-service engagement platform for healthcare practices, covering online scheduling, self-service registration and intake, multi-factor insurance eligibility verification, and patient payments. Rather than publishing an open developer API, Clearwave connects to more than 50 electronic health record (EHR) and practice management (PM) systems - including athenahealth, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, Modernizing Medicine, Veradigm, Nextech, Greenway, and Unlimited Systems - through formal, partner-gated API license and integration agreements. Data such as appointments, patient demographics, eligibility results, and payments flows bidirectionally between Clearwave and the practice's EHR/PM in real time. There is no public, self-service developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or documented public WebSocket API; the API surfaces below are logical capability areas modeled from Clearwave's product documentation, not publicly documented endpoints.

providers.name: Climavision
providers.description: Climavision is a Louisville, Kentucky weather intelligence company that combines a proprietary nationwide supplemental network of low-altitude X-band, dual-polarization gap-filling weather radars with AI-driven numerical weather prediction (NWP) to deliver enterprise-grade forecasts and observational data. Its Horizon AI product line includes Horizon Point for site-specific forecasts, Horizon Global for ground-to-high- altitude global models, Horizon HI-RES for custom high-resolution local forecasting, and Horizon S2S for subseasonal-to-seasonal prediction. Climavision exposes a Weather API hosted at point-forecast-api.climavision.com with 1,800+ parameters, 15-day forecasts, and bearer-token authentication, plus a separate Radar Status API and Radar-as-a-Service offering that supplies Level II files, NetCDF, and GeoTIFF radar data products (reflectivity, velocity, dual-pol-derived QPE at 1km, precipitation type, tornado debris detection) for coverage below 4,000 feet where NEXRAD cannot see due to Earth curvature. The company integrates its radar feed into MRMS and has provided supplemental data into the National Weather Service's AWIPS software. Climavision processes 1.5+ billion datasets daily, serves customers across agriculture, aviation, commodity trading, drones and Advanced Air Mobility, energy and utilities, government, insurance and reinsurance, media, and transportation and logistics, and raised a $100 million strategic investment from TPG's Rise Fund. API access is gated through a sales-led contact process; no public sandbox or open-source SDKs are published, and the Climavision GitHub organization (github.com/Climavision) currently has only two minor public repositories (an archived Azure Table Storage helper and a GeoServer Helm chart fork).

providers.name: EQUIPTAL HOLDING LTD
providers.description: EQUIPTAL HOLDING LTD operates Moedatech (معداتك), Saudi Arabia's first digital procurement and rental marketplace for heavy construction equipment, connecting contractors with verified suppliers of excavators, cranes, and trucks through RFQs, real-time bidding, and audit-ready digital contracts. Founded in Riyadh in 2020 by Ali Merie and Mansour Hmaid, the company pairs the marketplace with a telematics/fleet layer (built on Traccar GPS tracking) so equipment owners can monitor real-time asset performance. The product ships as iOS and Android apps plus a web app; there is no publicly documented developer API at this time. The company is backed by 500 Global and Plug and Play Middle East. This profile was surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio and enriched from the company's public web, brand (moedatech.net), and GitHub presence.

providers.name: Free Agency
providers.description: Free Agency is a careers company and talent marketplace that pairs technology professionals with an AI-powered Talent Agent which proactively surfaces relevant work — full-time roles and short project engagements with defined deliverables, duration, and compensation. Founded by Sherveen Mashayekhi and backed by Bloomberg Beta, the company has raised a $10M Series A and counts talent placed at companies such as OpenAI, Stripe, and Figma. It also publishes Intent, a newsletter for careerists. Free Agency is a consumer, waitlist-stage product and does not currently expose a public API, SDK, or developer platform; this profile tracks it in the API Evangelist network as a company stub.

providers.name: Fullcourt
providers.description: Fullcourt is an ecommerce helpdesk built for direct-to-consumer (DTC) Shopify brands, consolidating email, Shopify, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok into a single fast support inbox with live chat, a self-service knowledge base, AI-assisted agent and customer replies, keyboard-driven navigation (command-K search), and automation and triage rules. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network under the stub slug "japan"; enrichment found a Webflow marketing site plus a hosted web app but no public developer API, docs, SDKs, or MCP surface.

providers.name: Fwb
providers.description: Friends With Benefits (FWB) is a Web3 cultural community and member-owned organization that blends online culture, IRL events, and token-gated membership. It operates the $FWB token, publishes an editorial arm, runs member governance, and produces gatherings such as FWB FEST (its annual festival in Idyllwild, CA) alongside builder programs like World Build Labs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. At the time of enrichment FWB publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface — this profile captures its public identity and member-facing web properties.

providers.name: Givecampus
providers.description: GiveCampus is a digital-first fundraising and alumni-engagement platform built for educational institutions - K-12 schools, colleges, universities, and their affiliated foundations, alumni associations, and nonprofits. The platform provides online giving pages, Giving Days, crowdfunding and peer-to-peer (advocacy) fundraising, matching and challenge gifts, event and volunteer management, donor management and advancement CRM tooling, payment processing, and stewardship and engagement features that help advancement teams raise more money at a lower cost. Founded in 2015 and backed by Y Combinator, GiveCampus is used by thousands of schools and institutions across the United States and internationally. This API Evangelist profile tracks GiveCampus as a company in the network; the company operates a closed SaaS product and does not publish a public developer API, so this record is identity- and infrastructure-focused.

providers.name: H2O Hospitality
providers.description: H2O Hospitality is a South Korea-based hospitality digital-transformation company that connects existing hotel and leisure systems rather than replacing them, streamlining operations from booking to checkout. Its products span three areas: Connect (cloud property-management tooling including Smart CRS, Smart RMS, and Smart FMS), Maximize (revenue and guest-engagement tools such as Smart D2C and AI-based CRM), and Transform (managed operations). It offers smart mobile check-in and automated inventory management, operates across nine countries in Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, and is ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Hades
providers.description: Hades Mining GmbH is a Munich-based deep-tech extraction company building technology-first methods for accessing critical minerals and geothermal energy from ultra-deep rock formations. Its flagship system, Cerberus, uses high-power continuous-wave fiber lasers delivered through proprietary fiber optics to fracture rock without mechanical bit wear, paired with in-situ recovery (ISR) fluid circulation to extract minerals without open-pit excavation. The company positions itself at the intersection of geology, engineering, and geopolitics under the tagline "Sovereignty begins subsurface," aiming to reduce Western dependence on imported critical minerals. Hades is backed by HV Capital and Headline via a EUR 15M seed round. As a physical deep-tech extraction company, Hades publishes no public developer API, SDK, or MCP surface at this time.

providers.name: Helix
providers.description: Helix is a population genomics company operating an end-to-end precision health platform - a proprietary Exome+ next-generation sequencing assay, a CLIA/CAP-certified clinical lab, and bioinformatics tooling - that enables health systems, life sciences companies, and payers to integrate genomic data into clinical care and research at population scale. Through its DNA Product Studio, Helix exposes a partner-gated developer surface - a Genomics API (direct programmatic access to 100M+ base pairs including SNPs, indels, and copy number variants with panel-grade coverage of actionable genes), an Ancestry API (continental ancestry for 6 global populations or regional ancestry for 26+ populations), and an Insight API (user-specific results for hundreds of traits and conditions, from single-marker traits to machine-learning polygenic risk scores) - alongside Embedded Apps and an App Acceleration Framework for building white-label DNA products. API access is enterprise/partner-gated and provisioned through Helix partnerships; there is no public self-serve developer portal or openly published API specification, so the API surface below is modeled from Helix's public product documentation.

providers.name: Homethrive
providers.description: Homethrive is a technology-enabled caregiving-support benefit sold to employers, health plans, financial institutions, ancillary insurers, brokers, and platform partners. It pairs a digital assistant (Homethrive Dari) with human Care Guides to help family caregivers navigate backup care, aging, complex health, estate planning, and loss for their loved ones. Homethrive is a B2B2C member platform - it is delivered to covered members through their employer or health plan, not as a self-serve product. There is no public or partner developer API, API reference, or developer portal. Customer integration is handled during enterprise onboarding via an eligibility-file specification (typically SFTP/CSV batch files) and Single Sign-On (SSO), with utilization and engagement data returned to the sponsor - all arranged through implementation, not a documented self-service API.

providers.name: Hyundai Bluelink
providers.description: Hyundai Bluelink is Hyundai Motor America's connected vehicle service for Hyundai owners, providing remote vehicle control, vehicle status and diagnostics, navigation and route services, safety and security features, and EV-specific charging and climate management. Bluelink is delivered to owners through the MyHyundai with Bluelink mobile app (iOS and Android), the in-vehicle infotainment head unit, the owner web portal at owners.hyundaiusa.com, and connected smart-home and voice integrations (Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, smartwatch apps). Feature sets vary by model year and subscription tier — typically Bluelink, Bluelink+, and Bluelink Connected Care / Remote / Guidance bundles — and include remote start with climate, remote door lock/unlock, remote horn and lights, vehicle finder, stolen vehicle recovery and SVI, automatic collision notification, SOS emergency assistance, monthly vehicle health reports, destination search (powered by Google), in-vehicle Wi-Fi hotspot (via AT&T on supported models), and EV-specific remote charge start/stop, charge schedule, charge-level monitoring, and pre-conditioning. Bluelink is a consumer-facing, owner-authenticated service. Hyundai does not publish a public developer portal, public OpenAPI specification, or self-serve API keys for third-party integration with Bluelink vehicle endpoints; access is limited to authenticated owners through Hyundai's first-party apps and to enterprise partners under contract (fleet, insurance telematics, charging networks, smart-home platforms). A community ecosystem of reverse-engineered, unofficial Python and Node.js clients (Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api, Home Assistant integrations, Bluelinky) is used by enthusiasts and home automation users, but these are not endorsed, supported, or governed by Hyundai and may break at any time.

providers.name: Kano Computing
providers.description: Kano Computing is a London-based technology company founded in 2013 by Alex Klein, Saul Klein and Yonatan Raz-Fridman that began by shipping build-it-yourself computer and coding kits designed to teach STEM and creative computing to children on top of Raspberry Pi hardware. Its catalog spanned the Kano Computer Kit, motion-sensor and Harry Potter / Star Wars coding wands, the Windows-based Kano PC built with Microsoft, and the Stem Player and Stem Video Projector consumer devices. Kano paired the hardware with Kano Code, a block-to-text creative-coding platform, and Kano World, an online making and sharing community. The company entered administration in 2023 and its assets now trade under the Stem brand; its developer footprint survives as open-source tooling in the KanoComputing GitHub organization and the npm @kano scope rather than a hosted API.

providers.name: L'Oréal
providers.description: L'Oréal is the world's largest cosmetics and beauty company, producing skincare, makeup, haircare, and fragrance products. The group operates a portfolio of over 35 brands, including Lancôme, Maybelline, Garnier, NYX Professional Makeup, Kérastase, La Roche-Posay, and Kiehl's, sold in over 150 countries. L'Oréal's primary developer surface is the ModiFace platform (a wholly owned subsidiary), which exposes an AR virtual try-on SDK and API for partner brands and retailers. L'Oréal Group itself does not operate a general-purpose corporate developer portal.

providers.name: Occamnetworks
providers.description: Occam Networks was a broadband access equipment vendor that developed and marketed systems enabling telecommunications carriers to profitably deliver emerging voice, video, and high-speed data (triple-play) services over copper and fiber, including its BLC 6000 access platform and ONT/ONU customer-premises hardware. The company was acquired by Calix in early 2011 and no longer operates independently. The occamnetworks.com domain currently serves an archived circa-2010 marketing site (products, solutions, support, news, whitepapers) with no developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface. Enrichment found no API artifacts to harvest.

providers.name: Patent Watch
providers.description: Patent Watch (PatentWatch.ai) is a Toronto-based, Y Combinator-backed (F25) legal-tech startup building AI for patent intelligence and infringement detection. Its platform interprets patents, maps them to competing products, and generates claim charts that show who is infringing and how, so IP teams can find licensing and litigation targets, send cease-and-desist letters, pursue counter-litigation, sell IP in wind-downs, and accelerate M&A diligence. It also runs AI invalidity and prior-art searches to help patents hold up in court. Founded in 2024 by Alexander and Andreas Stroe, the company raised a $2.8M seed round in April 2026. As of this profile Patent Watch is an early-stage product with a marketing site and login only, and no public developer, API, or documentation surface; this repo tracks it as an enrichment lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Persado
providers.description: Persado is an enterprise AI platform that generates and optimizes marketing and customer-communication language, built for regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, healthcare, and retail. Its Motivation AI models produce compliant, on-brand message variants, score them for predicted performance, and personalize every send automatically, integrating with marketing platforms including Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, and Braze. Persado is delivered through enterprise contracts and platform integrations; it does not currently publish a public self-service developer API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Point
providers.description: Point (Point Digital Finance, Inc.) is a San Francisco fintech founded in 2015 by Eddie Lim, Eoin Matthews, and Alex Rampell that gives homeowners access to their home equity without monthly payments or income requirements. Its flagship Home Equity Investment (HEI) provides lump sums up to $600,000 in exchange for a share of a home's future appreciation over a 30-year term, alongside a HELOC product offering lines up to $750,000. Point has served more than 25,000 homeowners and facilitated over $2 billion in home equity investments, and is backed by a16z, Bloomberg Beta, and Ribbit Capital. Point is a consumer-facing platform with no public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched with the API Evangelist pipeline (identity + domain-security probe only — no API surface found).

providers.name: proximafusion
providers.description: Proxima Fusion is a European fusion energy company headquartered in Munich, Germany, developing commercial fusion power plants based on quasi-isodynamic (QI) stellarator technology. Spun out of the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics, the company combines stellarator optimization, high-performance computational design, and high-temperature superconducting (HTS) magnet technology to build its Stellaris power plant concept. Proxima Fusion aims to deliver clean, safe, continuous baseload fusion energy, and is backed by investors including Balderton Capital. It currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Sandbar
providers.description: Sandbar is a consumer hardware and AI company behind Stream, a private voice ring and conversational notes app. Worn on the finger, Stream pairs a discreet private microphone, a glass touchpad, and silent haptics with an on-device "Inner Voice" assistant so people can capture notes, reminders, and todos, dictate speech-to-text across any iOS or Mac app, and think aloud without reaching for a phone. Backed by Kindred Ventures and True Ventures, Sandbar is a preorder-stage consumer product; it publishes a marketing site, an About/Us page, and a Careers page, but no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: SheetRocks
providers.description: SheetRocks is a spreadsheet engine embedded directly into the business platforms teams already use. Branded "The Spreadsheet for Everywhere," it brings keyboard-driven data entry, formula-based analytics, and spreadsheet-in-the-loop workflows inside host applications such as Salesforce (live), WooCommerce and Gravity Forms (beta), and Shopify, HubSpot, and ServiceNow (announced).
