The product targets operators, analysts, and builders who want a familiar grid plus instant workflow invocation without leaving their platform of record. SheetRocks is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public REST/GraphQL API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook surface; it does publish product documentation, a free sandbox, and a responsible security-disclosure policy.

providers.name: Standardkernel
providers.description: Standard Kernel Co. is an AI infrastructure company that automatically generates high-performance compute kernels for GPUs and TPUs. It targets the traditionally manual, expertise-intensive process of writing optimized low-level accelerator code, operating at the CUDA and PTX level to fully exploit new hardware features rather than relying on higher-level abstractions, delivering better performance on compute-bound machine-learning workloads and newer accelerator architectures. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis and added to the API Evangelist network; the company is early-stage and publishes no public API, developer portal, or specification at this time.

providers.name: Surescripts
providers.description: Surescripts operates the largest health information network in the United States, connecting prescribers, pharmacies, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), health plans, and health systems for e-prescribing, medication history, benefit and eligibility verification, electronic prior authorization, and clinical interoperability. Surescripts is a network operator rather than a public API provider - its transaction services run over NCPDP SCRIPT (NewRx, RxRenewal, RxChange, RxTransfer, RxFill, CancelRx), NCPDP Telecommunication, and X12 (270/271 eligibility, 278 prior authorization) standards. There is no self-serve developer portal, no published OpenAPI, and no free API keys; access is gated behind a Surescripts certification process (conformance testing against current NCPDP standards, plus DEA third-party audit for EPCS) or through a certified middleware/EHR partner. The service surfaces below are honestly modeled from Surescripts' published solution descriptions and the underlying NCPDP/X12 transaction standards - endpoints are not publicly documented.

providers.name: Tingsn
providers.description: Jiangsu Tingsn Technology (霆升科技) is a Nanjing, China medical-device company focused on ultrasound for cardiac electrophysiology and structural heart disease. It develops intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) products, including the TINGSN Sonic Eyes line of disposable 2D ICE diagnostic catheters — among the first domestically developed ICE catheters approved by China's NMPA (registration 2023) — and TINGSN FINDERS portable color ultrasound systems, with 4D ICE, ultrasound 3D mapping, and ultrasound ablation platforms in development. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners with R&D centers in Nanjing and Massachusetts, Tingsn is a clinical hardware company and publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: toksta
providers.description: Toksta is a B2B influencer marketing intelligence platform that uses AI agents to research, filter, and match creators at scale for enterprise brands. It provides a vetted B2B creator database with LinkedIn and YouTube influencer search, automated relevance scoring (AI Match), granular vetting benchmarks (Deep Metrics), campaign management, brand monitoring, and reporting. Toksta is a portfolio company of Seedcamp. As of this enrichment pass the product is a web application (hub.toksta.com) with a marketing site and blog; no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface was found.

providers.name: Trucks Venture Fund I
providers.description: Trucks Venture Capital (Trucks VC) is an early-stage venture firm headquartered in San Francisco investing in companies building the future of transportation — making mobility decarbonized, safer, and more accessible. Its focus spans autonomous vehicles, electric aviation, agricultural robotics, fleet management, and mobility infrastructure. Trucks Venture Fund I is the firm's first fund; notable portfolio outcomes include Joby Aviation (NYSE: JOBY), Bear Flag Robotics (acquired by John Deere), nuTonomy (acquired by Delphi), Roadster (acquired by CDK Global), and Zendrive (acquired by Intuit). Surfaced as a portfolio relation of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network as a venture-capital firm; it publishes a marketing/portfolio website but no developer API surface.

providers.name: Universal American
providers.description: Universal American was a health insurance holding company that focused on providing Medicare Advantage and Medicare prescription drug benefit plans to seniors. The company operated Medicare managed care plans in partnership with Accountable Care Organizations and primary care physicians before being acquired by WellCare Health Plans in 2017 for approximately $800 million.

providers.name: UPMC
providers.description: A world-renowned health care provider and insurer headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. One of the largest nonprofit health systems in the United States, operating hospitals, physician practices, and a health insurance division (UPMC Health Plan) serving millions of members. UPMC Health Plan exposes an ONC 21st Century Cures Act Developer API for patient-authorized access to clinical and claims data over HL7 FHIR.

providers.name: Visage Imaging
providers.description: Visage Imaging is a global enterprise imaging vendor and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Pro Medicus Limited (ASX PME). Its flagship Visage 7 Enterprise Imaging Platform delivers server-side rendered images adaptively streamed to an intelligent zero-footprint thin-client viewer for diagnostic radiology, cardiology, and mobile reading, alongside Visage 7 Open Archive and the Visage AI Accelerator research platform. Interoperability is built on healthcare imaging standards - DICOM / DICOMweb, HL7, FHIR, and IHE profiles - and Visage exposes REST and open-API surfaces for AI algorithm integration and QA workflows. There is no public self-service developer portal; API access is partner- and customer-gated (Client Portal login, product documentation login, and an invitation-only AI Accelerator Program), so the API entries below are logically modeled from public product and release-note material rather than a published API reference.

providers.name: Warehousing1
providers.description: Warehousing1 is a Berlin-based LogTech company, founded in 2018 by Nico Szeli, Nils Aschmann and Fabian Sedlmayr, that operates a digital fulfillment and warehousing marketplace connecting brands and e-commerce merchants to an independent network of more than 1,000 logistics locations across Germany, Europe and the US. Its cloud platform and customer portal centralize warehousing, order picking, packing and shipping, and integrate with common ERP systems, online shops and marketplaces so companies can scale contract logistics, distribution and e-commerce fulfillment. The company has served 500+ customers and is backed by HV Capital, Schenker Ventures, Aster Capital and Wille Finance. Warehousing1 does not publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through managed ERP/shop connectors and its customer portal.

providers.name: Aday
providers.description: Aday is a direct-to-consumer sustainable fashion brand founded in 2015 in New York City by Nina Faulhaber and Meg He. It designs technical, long-lasting capsule wardrobes built for outfit repetition, using custom recycled fabrics (including post-consumer recycled plastic) and plant-based, beechwood-derived materials produced in closed-loop processes. Aday has raised more than $10 million in venture capital, is backed by Cowboy Ventures, and has been named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, with coverage in Vogue, Refinery29, and Conde Nast Traveler. The company sells globally through its Shopify-powered storefront at thisisaday.com and does not publish a public developer API. This profile was created as an API Evangelist network stub from Cowboy Ventures' portfolio and enriched with company identity and domain-security signals; the storefront returned a Shopify "store is unavailable" lock at the time of the enrichment probe.

providers.name: Addus HomeCare
providers.description: Addus HomeCare is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Addus HomeCare API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Aiva
providers.description: AIVA (Artificial Intelligence Virtual Artist) is an AI music generation platform that composes original music across more than 250 styles in seconds. Musicians, content creators, and studios generate tracks from prompts or from uploaded audio and MIDI influences, build custom style models, edit the resulting compositions, and export to MP3, MIDI, and WAV. Paid plans add higher download limits, longer tracks, social monetization rights, and full copyright ownership. AIVA is a consumer- and creator-facing product; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery documents.

providers.name: Ambience Healthcare
providers.description: Ambience Healthcare is a San Francisco-based artificial intelligence company building an AI clinical operating system for hospitals and health systems. The platform is organized as a suite of Pre-Visit, In-Visit, and Post-Visit applications anchored by Ambient Scribe — an ambient AI medical scribe that generates complete, coding-ready medical notes from clinician-patient conversations across 200+ specialties — alongside Chart Chat, Medication Order Assist, Patient Instructions Generator, Referral Letters, Discharge Note Generator, HPI Generator, Assessment & Plan Generator, ED MDM Generator, and a Coding & Revenue Compliance toolset (ICD-10 Code Assist, E/M Code Advisor, HCC Compliance Validator, Modifier 25 Advisor, Add-On Code Assist, Inpatient Level of Service Advisor, ED Critical Care Assist). Ambience embeds inside Epic via the Epic Ambient Module, Hyperdrive, Haiku, Epic Toolbox, and native FHIR APIs (including SMART on FHIR), and also connects to Oracle Cerner and athenahealth for schedule, problem-list, and patient-list sync. Customer enterprises include Cleveland Clinic, UCSF, John Muir Health, Houston Methodist, MultiCare Health System, Ardent Health, Memorial Hermann, The Oncology Institute, GI Alliance, and St. Luke's Health System, with deployments reporting 39–45% reductions in charting time and ~90% clinician utilization. Ambience is OpenAI-backed and valued at roughly $1B; its revenue model is enterprise SaaS sold to health systems and there is no public developer API, SDK, open-source release, or self-serve developer portal — integrations are delivered as a HIPAA-gated managed offering through Epic, Cerner, and athenahealth ecosystems.

providers.name: Amyris
providers.description: Amyris, Inc. is a synthetic-biology and precision-fermentation company that engineers microbes to convert plant-derived sugars into high-performance renewable molecules — including farnesene, squalene, squalane, and bisabolol — at industrial scale. The company offers strain development, process development, piloting, scale-up, and manufacturing services for custom renewable chemistry used across personal care, cosmetics, flavors and fragrances, and other industries, emphasizing resilient supply chains, product consistency, and reduced ecological impact. Amyris is a private company that emerged from a 2023 Chapter 11 restructuring; it does not currently publish a public developer API or technology platform.

providers.name: Being
providers.description: Being (Being Juice, operated by Being Global Sdn Bhd) is a Malaysian smoothie and cold-pressed juice brand founded by Sayantan Das, the former CEO of foodpanda Malaysia and Brunei, on the promise that "you are what you drink." The company sources ingredients from local farmers and handcrafts fresh, feel-good smoothies and juices daily, sold through physical outlets across the Klang Valley and through a mobile rewards app. Being is backed by 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company profile awaiting enrichment. It publishes a consumer web presence but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Bland Company
providers.description: The Bland Company is a London-based food-technology and biotechnology startup building functional plant proteins that replace eggs in food manufacturing. Its feedstock-agnostic process upcycles underused agricultural side streams into flavor-neutral, cost-stable proteins engineered to match animal-protein functionality — solubility, foaming, gelling, and emulsifying — for bakery, sauces, beverages, and snacks. The company raised a ~$2.7M pre-seed round led by Initialized Capital. It publishes no public developer API surface (no docs, SDKs, or GitHub); this profile is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio lead.

providers.name: Blendid
providers.description: Blendid operates fully autonomous robotic smoothie kiosks that prepare chef-created blended beverages from real whole fruits, vegetables, seeds, nuts, and juice with no artificial flavors or added sugar. Each kiosk uses AI and robotics to run without on-site staff, taking mobile-app orders with customization and payment, producing up to eight simultaneous drinks and roughly thirty per hour. Blendid deploys its Blendid M2 platform into retail, colleges and universities, health clubs, and hospitals as a low-labor, low-capex, 24/7 automated food-service offering. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Partech in the Food & Agritech sector; the company publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: BlocPower
providers.description: BlocPower is a Brooklyn-based climate technology and building decarbonization company, founded in 2014 as a Public Benefit Corporation, that makes urban buildings smarter, greener, and healthier with a focus on historically underserved communities. It combines deep building-science expertise with accessible financing to deliver energy-efficiency retrofits and electrification measures such as heat pumps, pairing construction management with clean-energy upgrades. As of late 2023 BlocPower reported more than 1,200 completed measures across 1,100+ buildings nationwide, thousands of metric tons of CO2e reduced, and hundreds of local job placements, earning recognition from the White House, EPA, and TIME. BlocPower is a portfolio company of a16z and is tracked in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or GitHub organization at this time.

providers.name: Carpenter Technology
providers.description: Carpenter Technology Corporation is a U.S.-based producer and distributor of premium specialty alloys — including titanium alloys, powder metals, high-temperature stainless steels, tool steels, and soft magnetic alloys — serving the aerospace, defense, medical, transportation, energy, and industrial end markets. The company supports customers through technical product resources such as its Alloy Finder, alloy technical data sheets, conversion tables, and a member-only Customer Portal for order and account self-service, but does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Clearbos (clearorthod)
providers.description: Clearbos (clearorthod / 可丽尔博士) is a Chinese clear-aligner orthodontics company that designs and manufactures invisible teeth-alignment systems for adults and children, delivered through a network of partner dental clinics and orthodontists. Its digital treatment platform pairs the C4 adult-correction system with the C3 pediatric full-cycle system, and is supported by a doctor-facing web portal for case submission, treatment planning, and aligner ordering. The company reports more than 11,900 registered doctors and 9,200 partner clinics across 321 cities. Clearbos was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
providers.description: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is the de-facto repository file used by open-source projects on GitHub, GitLab, and similar platforms to declare community standards, acceptable behavior, and enforcement procedures for project participants. The most widely adopted text dropped into this file is the Contributor Covenant, currently at version 2.1, maintained by the Organization for Ethical Source. GitHub surfaces a CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md located in the repo root, .github/, or docs/ directory in its Community Standards checklist and links to it from issue templates. The file is plain Markdown and has no machine-readable schema, but it is structurally consistent across the dominant template (Contributor Covenant) and a small number of alternatives (Citizen Code of Conduct, Django Code of Conduct, Mozilla Community Participation Guidelines).

providers.name: Coded
providers.description: CODED is a Kuwait-based coding education and technology skills company offering hands-on bootcamps and programs for adults, youth, and kids. Its adult bootcamps cover Cybersecurity, Agentic AI, AI & Data Science, and AI App Development, while youth tracks (ages 14-24) and kids programs (ages 6-13) build foundational and career-oriented tech skills through projects, coaching, and real-world standards. CODED also delivers custom enterprise training for corporate teams. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; CODED is an education provider and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or specifications.

providers.name: CODEOWNERS
providers.description: CODEOWNERS is the file format originally introduced by GitHub and later adopted by GitLab, Bitbucket Cloud, Gitea, and Azure Repos that lets a repository declare which individuals or teams are responsible for a path or pattern within the codebase. Platforms use it to auto-request reviews on pull/merge requests, enforce required approvals via branch protection or push rules, and route pings on issues. The file is plain text with one rule per line - a glob pattern followed by one or more owner handles (`@username` or `@org/team`) or email addresses. Comments start with `#` and the last matching pattern wins.

providers.name: Cork City Open Data
providers.description: Cork City Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Ireland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 32 datasets.

providers.name: CQuotient
providers.description: CQuotient is the artificial intelligence and shopper-data technology that powers personalization and predictive commerce for Salesforce B2C Commerce (Commerce Cloud) Einstein. Originally an independent commerce-personalization startup, CQuotient was acquired by Demandware in 2013, and Demandware was in turn acquired by Salesforce in 2016. Today the CQuotient engine underpins Einstein product recommendations, predictive sort, Einstein search dictionaries, and shopper activity capture. Its developer surface is the Salesforce B2C Commerce Einstein API (also referred to as the CQuotient API), documented within the Salesforce Developers documentation rather than on a standalone CQuotient portal.

providers.name: Diffusion
providers.description: Diffusion Software is a small independent software vendor that develops audio-encoding and RDS (Radio Data System) tooling for FM radio broadcasters. Its flagship product, Airomate, is a software-based RDS/RBDS encoder that generates a high-quality RDS signal using a 192 kHz-capable soundcard, letting stations broadcast professional-looking RDS information (station name, RadioText, program service data) at low cost without dedicated hardware. The company also ships complementary broadcast utilities: StereoCoder (an FM stereo/MPX encoder), Little SineGen (a sine-wave generator that runs at any sample rate the soundcard supports), and Chronos (a free scheduler that sequences Programme Service name and RadioText messages for Airomate). The products are Windows desktop applications distributed as low-cost licensed downloads. Diffusion Software is a seed-stage Canaan Partners portfolio company and does not publish a public API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained as a network identity record.

providers.name: Dotterel
providers.description: Dotterel Technologies is an Auckland, New Zealand acoustics and audio-hardware company founded in 2015 out of the Callaghan Innovation C-Prize. It began by solving drone noise, building acoustic shrouds, low-noise propellers, and onboard active audio-recording systems for UAVs used in film, security, and noise mapping. That work led to Konos (now marketed as Konos Digital), an 80-element directional MEMS microphone array with a continuously variable 60-300 degree beam width that streams four channels of AES67 / SMPTE ST 2110 audio over a single Power-over-Ethernet cable, targeting film, broadcast, and live-sports production. The microphone exposes a firmware-updatable on-device HTTP control interface (a web page plus a POST control endpoint for beam steering) rather than a public developer web API. Dotterel is backed by Techstars (Adelaide 2017 cohort) and is tracked here as a hardware company; it publishes no public API specification, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Draig Therapeutics
providers.description: Draig Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing transformative, best-in-class therapies for major neuropsychiatric disorders, including Major Depressive Disorder. A Cardiff University spinout co-founded with SV Health Investors, Draig ("dragon" in Welsh) leverages its founders' expertise in modulating the core glutamate/GABA pathways that underlie synaptic excitation and inhibition imbalance in the brain. Its pipeline is led by DT-101, a next-generation AMPA receptor positive allosteric modulator (PAM) advancing toward Phase 2 in MDD, alongside DT-201 and DT-301, subtype-selective GABAA receptor modulators. The company launched from stealth in June 2025 with a $140 million (£107 million) oversubscribed Series A led by Access Biotechnology, with participation from Canaan Partners, SR One, Sanofi Ventures, Schroders Capital, SV Health Investors, and ICG. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Edra
providers.description: Edra is an AI automation platform that analyzes an organization's existing business data - tickets, logs, messages, and system records - to automatically discover and document how operational processes actually run, then turns that knowledge into workflows that AI agents can execute reliably. The company targets knowledge-intensive functions such as IT service management and technical support, and integrates with common enterprise systems including ServiceNow, JIRA, Zendesk, Salesforce, and Outlook. Edra was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Edra publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Ephemeral Solutions
providers.description: Ephemeral Solutions is the company entity behind Ephemeral Tattoo, the direct-to-consumer brand at ephemeraltattoos.com (ephemeral.tattoo) known for "made-to-fade" semi-permanent tattoos applied with a vegan ink formulated to fade naturally over roughly one to three years, removing the need for laser removal. The company operates two sides of a marketplace: a consumer service that connects people with approved partner tattoo artists, and a business line that sells its proprietary fading ink to professional tattoo artists and studios. It runs an editorial blog, a lookbook of tattoo examples, a How It Works explainer, and an FAQ. It was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or agent surface, so this profile carries only verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Ergo
providers.description: Ergo (ergo Offers, Inc.) is a New York-based e-commerce pricing company that lets online shoppers name their own price. Its flagship product is a Shopify app that adds a "Make an Offer with ergo" button to product pages: a customer submits the price they are willing to pay and how long they are willing to wait, and the merchant accepts or rejects the offer from a backend dashboard. Beyond bartering, Ergo captures true willingness-to-pay data and turns it into pricing analytics and a price-discovery and optimization tool, helping retailers clear excess inventory and reduce blanket discounting. Founded and led by CEO Claire Stepanek (previously supply chain at Apple), Ergo raised a $1.5M pre-seed round in October 2023 led by Anthemis with Wischoff Ventures. Ergo does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity.

providers.name: Eversource Energy
providers.description: Eversource Energy is the largest energy delivery company in New England, providing electric, natural gas, and water service to millions of customers in Connecticut, Massachusetts, and New Hampshire.

providers.name: Fairbanc
providers.description: Fairbanc (PT Fairbanc Technologies Indonesia) is a Jakarta-based digital finance platform that uses AI/ML-powered credit scoring to deliver embedded, revolving supply-chain financing and buy-now-pay-later "terms of payment" to micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) across Indonesia. Working with trusted financial institutions and distributor/supply-chain ecosystems, Fairbanc provides merchants with an instant digital facility limit and short-term working-capital liquidity at the point of purchase — with no formal loan application, smartphone, or app required — plus data intelligence and consulting that help distributors reduce bad-debt risk and grow transaction value. The company reports its terms-of-payment product drove roughly 35% distributor sales growth. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Fairbanc publishes a consumer-facing marketing and onboarding site but no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: Flycrates
providers.description: Flycrates is an international shipping service, founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, that lets shoppers outside the United States buy US Amazon.com Prime items and have them delivered worldwide. Instead of filling an Amazon cart, customers fill a fixed-size crate (small, medium, or large); Flycrates then purchases the items, consolidates them, clears customs, and pays import duty and tax on the buyer's behalf before shipping via DHL, FedEx, or UPS to more than 117 countries. It also offers a Chrome browser extension that adds "Add to Flycrates" buttons directly onto Amazon product pages. Flycrates raised a seed round led by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a consumer web application only and exposes no public API, developer portal, or partner integration program.

providers.name: FTN Network
providers.description: FTN Network is a New York-based sports data, analytics, and content company founded in 2020 that helps fans, fantasy players, and sports bettors make smarter decisions. FTN operates the FTN Fantasy platform (ftnfantasy.com), publishing proprietary NFL charting data, projections, DFS ownership, and betting analytics through articles, livestreams, videos, and podcasts. FTN also sells a REST/JSON sports-data API covering NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, PGA, CFB, and CBB across CSV, mid-tier API, and enterprise white-label plans. The company went through the Techstars Sports Tech Accelerator (2022) and is backed by 11 Tribes Ventures.

providers.name: Impossible Foods
providers.description: Impossible Foods is a Redwood City, California food-technology company that develops plant-based substitutes for meat, including Impossible Beef, Sausage, Chicken, Meatballs, and Pork. Founded in 2011 by Patrick O. Brown, the company engineers its products around heme (soy leghemoglobin) to replicate the taste and texture of animal meat while reducing the environmental footprint of food production. Its products are distributed through grocery retail and tens of thousands of restaurants across the United States and international markets including Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates and the United Kingdom. Impossible Foods is a private, venture-backed company surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: INDOS
providers.description: INDOS (Garment IO) is an AI-powered manufacturing operations platform built for labor-intensive garment and apparel production facilities. Its cloud-based system unifies Manufacturing Execution (MES), Quality Management (QMS), Maintenance Management (MMS), and Warehouse Management (WMS) into a single real-time view of the factory floor. A shop-floor hardware device captures operator and production-line data, and the platform surfaces operator efficiency, AI anomaly detection, performance scorecards, and end-to-end control from cutting through packing. Founded by Ahmed Nounou and Mahmoud Sabae and backed by 500 Global, it serves garment manufacturers across the Middle East, North Africa, and South Asia. INDOS does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: KEENON Robotics
providers.description: KEENON Robotics is a global commercial service-robotics company founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, designing and manufacturing autonomous service robots deployed across more than 70 countries and 600+ cities. Its product lines span catering and delivery robots (the T-series and W3), the KLEENBOT commercial floor-cleaning range (C20/C30/C40/C55), heavy-load delivery robots (S100/S300), humanoid service robots (XMAN-R1/XMAN-F1), hospital and hotel logistics solutions (including the WITMED medical line), and the Keenmow K1 domestic robot. KEENON is a hardware-and-solutions company; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI. This record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: MediSage
providers.description: MediSage is an India-based digital health company that operates one of Asia's largest online medical communities, connecting doctors and healthcare practitioners with first-hand, peer-reviewed medical information, live CME webinars, clinical discussion forums, medical news, and professional networking. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, MediSage delivers its knowledge platform primarily through consumer-facing web and mobile applications for physicians; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or partner integration surface has been identified at this time.

providers.name: MokN
providers.description: MokN is a cybersecurity company that helps organizations detect external threats before attackers can weaponize them. Founded by SOC practitioners after a major cyber crisis, MokN builds the detection layer around two products: Baits, defensive deception pages that lure attackers into revealing stolen credentials and validate compromise in real time, and Lantern, an external attack surface management tool that maps and remediates perimeter exposures. The platform reports processing over one billion login attempts and protecting hundreds of thousands of users across organizations. MokN publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation as of this pass; this profile captures the company's public web presence and domain-security posture.

providers.name: MoonFrost
providers.description: MoonFrost is a cozy life-sim RPG developed by Oxalis Games Ltd., set in a world ravaged by constant meteor storms where players farm, fish, craft, and build their dream home. Positioned as a Web3 game, it is backed by crypto investor Pantera Capital and is available to wishlist on Steam and the Epic Games Store, with a community on Discord. As of this profile, MoonFrost publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or developer portal — it is a consumer game rather than an API provider, so this record is identity-only pending any future developer surface.

providers.name: Nothing
providers.description: Nothing is a London-based consumer technology company designing smartphones (Phone series), wireless earbuds (Ear series), and other consumer hardware under the Nothing and CMF by Nothing brands, backed by EQT Ventures and GV. Surfaced as a portfolio-company lead in the API Evangelist network. An enrichment pass confirmed Nothing publishes a consumer web presence (support centre, community, careers, playground) but no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, SDK, or webhook surface as of this pass.

providers.name: NYDIG
providers.description: NYDIG is a vertically-integrated bitcoin and power company founded in 2017, operating at the intersection of power, compute, and sound money. It develops power infrastructure supporting bitcoin's proof-of-work security and low-cost energy, and provides institutional-grade financial infrastructure including regulated bitcoin custody, spot and derivatives trading, structuring, and financing. NYDIG was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; access is through the authenticated institutional platform at app.nydig.com.

providers.name: Popmeals
providers.description: Popmeals (Pop Meals, operated by Farm To Fork Sdn Bhd) is a Malaysian food-delivery and cloud-kitchen brand offering popular meals at affordable prices through a central-kitchen model and a network of outlets across Malaysia and Southeast Asia. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. This is a consumer brand with a public ordering and support surface but no published developer/API program: domain-security posture was probed live, and no OpenAPI, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal was found.

providers.name: PrimaryIO
providers.description: PrimaryIO is a Silicon Valley cloud workload management and data mobility company based in Los Altos, California, that helps enterprises safely leverage the public cloud. Its portfolio includes ProtectIO, a Disaster-Recovery-as-a-Service offering; RecoverIO, a Ransomware-Recovery-as-a-Service offering; ConvertIO, which migrates VMware VMs into cloud-native virtual server instances; and a tech-enabled Migration-as-a-Service. The platform uses changed-block replication to cloud object storage with data encryption in transit and at rest for non-disruptive migrations and on-demand VMware infrastructure. PrimaryIO is backed by Accel and Partech. It currently publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Procuri
providers.description: Procuri (procuri.ai) presents itself as an AI-powered procurement automation platform that uses specialized AI agents to discover and vet suppliers, optimize contract negotiation and pricing, monitor policy and regulatory compliance, and assess supplier and market risk for enterprise procurement teams. It was surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass the public site publishes no developer/API surface (no docs, developer, API-reference, or OpenAPI pages resolve).

providers.name: Propmatic
providers.description: PropMatic (PropMatic Inc.) is an AI-powered residential leasing platform that helps property managers and multifamily operators lower cost-per-lease across both traditional and AI-driven discovery channels. Its three products are AI Smart Sites (dynamic, search-optimized landing pages), an AI Concierge chatbot that engages, nurtures, and converts prospects into residents, and an AI-to-AI hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) service that structures a client's listings, data, and APIs so AI assistants such as ChatGPT can find, recommend, and act on inventory and even schedule tours. The platform integrates with existing property-management, CMS, and CRM tools. PropMatic is a proptech portfolio company backed by Fifth Wall.

providers.name: Protocol Labs
providers.description: Protocol Labs is an open-source research and development company founded in 2014 by Juan Benet, best known for creating foundational decentralized web protocols including IPFS (the InterPlanetary File System), Filecoin (a decentralized storage network), libp2p (a modular peer-to-peer networking stack), and IPLD (a data model for content-addressed systems). Since its founding it has grown into an innovation network connecting more than 750 startups, funds, accelerators, foundations, and open-source projects working across web3, AI, robotics, cryptography, and neurotechnology. Protocol Labs itself (protocol.ai) is a research and venture organization rather than a commercial API provider — it publishes no first-party REST API; its developer surfaces (IPFS HTTP APIs, Filecoin JSON-RPC, libp2p) live in their own separate open-source projects and GitHub organizations.

providers.name: Remora
providers.description: Remora is a carbon-capture startup (legally Echeneidae Inc.) founded in 2020 and based in Wixom, Michigan, that retrofits semi-trucks and locomotives with zero-backpressure devices which extract and purify up to 90 percent of the CO2 from vehicle exhaust while cutting other pollutants. The company then sells the captured, purified carbon dioxide and shares the resulting revenue with the transportation operators it partners with. Remora is a hardware and climate-technology business with no public API or developer platform; this profile tracks it as an API Evangelist network company for portfolio and discovery purposes.

providers.name: Resolute Ventures
providers.description: Resolute Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm that typically writes a founder's first VC check, backing pre-seed and seed-stage companies. Co-founded by Mike Hirshland and Raanan Bar-Cohen, the firm invests in people rather than ideas, backing mission-driven founders with the grit, energy and conviction to bring their ideas to life and offering community, mentorship, health & wellness, and team-building support. Portfolio companies include Vercel, Opendoor, Greenhouse, Hello Heart and Signifyd. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Foundry Group.

providers.name: Sadbhav Engineering Limited
providers.description: Sadbhav Engineering Limited (SEL), operating at sadbhaveng.com, is an Indian infrastructure and civil-engineering contractor founded in 1988 by Vishnubhai M. Patel and headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The company builds and operates large-scale roads and highways, mining, and irrigation projects, including Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) concessions of national significance, and is publicly listed on the NSE and BSE. This is a traditional infrastructure/construction firm: it publishes an investor-relations and corporate website but exposes no developer API, SDK, documentation, or other machine-readable API surface. Surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a stub via vc-portfolio harvesting; an enrichment pass confirmed there is no API product to catalog.

providers.name: sento
providers.description: sento is a Munich-based B2B software company (sento GmbH) building a cloud-based EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) platform that automates complex business-partner processes, letting companies replace slow, manual partner-integration workflows with automated document and data exchange. Founded by Nimar Blume and Felix Krauth and backed by Insight Partners, sento raised a EUR 9 million seed round to expand its partner-onboarding and document-automation product. As of this profile sento does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation - only its corporate marketing site and legal pages are publicly available.

providers.name: Shippio
providers.description: Shippio is a Japanese logistics-technology company positioning itself as "Japan's first digital forwarder." It provides cloud-based SaaS for visualizing and streamlining international trade and freight-forwarding operations, combining domain expertise with AI-era digital technology. Its product line includes Shippio Forwarding (a digital forwarding service), Shippio Cargo (trade-management SaaS for shippers/importers-exporters), and Shippio Works (trade-management SaaS for logistics operators), delivered through a multi-sided platform that connects shippers and operators. The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Shippio publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or pricing; its APIs are internal platform APIs referenced only in engineering job postings, so this profile is identity-only with no public API surface.

providers.name: SmartDublin Open Data
providers.description: SmartDublin Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Ireland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 929 datasets.

providers.name: SoundBetter
providers.description: SoundBetter is an online marketplace that connects musicians and artists with professional audio talent for hire — mixing and mastering engineers, music producers, singers, songwriters, beat makers, and studio session musicians. Clients post jobs or browse curated professional profiles, audition portfolio tracks, and hire and pay through the platform, which handles escrow, milestones, and delivery. The company also operates a storefront (my.soundbetter.com) and a plugins shop (shop.soundbetter.com / Imagine Plugins). SoundBetter was acquired by Spotify in 2019. As of this enrichment pass, SoundBetter publishes a consumer/creator web marketplace but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile therefore captures company identity and a live domain-security probe rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Spark Therapeutics
providers.description: Spark Therapeutics is a Philadelphia-based gene therapy company founded in 2013 with roots at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP). Spark developed Luxturna (voretigene neparvovec-rzyl), the first FDA-approved gene therapy for a genetic disease in the United States, approved in December 2017 for the treatment of inherited retinal disease caused by biallelic RPE65 mutations. Roche acquired Spark Therapeutics in December 2019 for approximately $4.3 billion, and Spark has since been integrated into the Roche Group, operating as a Genentech subsidiary. The original sparktx.com domain now redirects to gene.com/spark. Spark does not publish any public developer APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or GitHub organization. As a pharmaceutical/biotech operating under Roche, Spark's public technical surface is limited to patient and prescriber information for Luxturna and adverse event reporting channels (FDA MedWatch and 1-855-SPARKTX).

providers.name: Spring Global
providers.description: Spring Global is an AI field intelligence platform for the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry, marketed as an AI operating system for the CPG field workforce. Its Field Intelligence Platform provides real-time AI coaching for field representatives, drivers, and merchandisers, compliance validation and break-adherence monitoring, automated communication with personalized recommendations, image recognition, and custom workflow automation. The platform is built on modern enterprise infrastructure (Node.js, React, AWS) and integrates with existing mobile workforce management, ERP, and retail systems rather than replacing them. Spring Global is backed by Sapphire Ventures. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition is currently published.

providers.name: Stealth Worker
providers.description: Stealth Worker is a cybersecurity staffing marketplace (Y Combinator W2016) that connects companies with vetted, contract-based information security, cloud security, privacy, and compliance professionals at competitive hourly rates. Engagements range from a few hours a week to full-time, covering InfoSec staffing, GDPR / data protection officer services, penetration testing, security architecture, SOC 2 / SOX / HIPAA / PCI audit and compliance, and CISO-as-a-service. Roughly 80% of consultants are US-based, with coverage across Europe, Asia, and Australia in 15+ countries. It is a professional-services company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: TRIC Robotics
providers.description: TRIC Robotics builds autonomous agricultural robots that replace chemical pesticides with ultraviolet light. Its flagship platform, Luna, is a tractor-scale robot that roams California strawberry fields after dark, using UV-C light to kill fungal pathogens such as powdery mildew and botrytis while a mechanical "Bug Vac" removes pests like Lygus bugs, spotted wing drosophila, and spider mites — without a single drop of pesticide. Founded in 2017 by Dr. Adam Stager and Vishnu Somasundaram out of the University of Delaware and now based in California, TRIC operates a robotics-as-a-service model that requires no upfront investment from growers, and reports pesticide reductions of up to 70% across the farms it serves. The company raised a $5.5M seed round led by Version One Ventures to expand its fleet across Santa Maria, Oxnard, and Watsonville. TRIC Robotics is an agricultural robotics operator and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its company identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Twig
providers.description: Twig (twig.bio) is a UK biotechnology company using artificial intelligence and machine learning to design sustainable bioengineered ingredients — "AI defined ingredients that don't cost the earth." Its proprietary twig:tech platform pairs bio:drive, an AI/ML design engine that generates and scores novel microbe designs across pathway and enzyme selection, gene edits, and expression levels, with grow:bot, an automated high-throughput lab that builds and tests those designs and feeds every result back into the next design cycle. Twig aims to cultivate clean ingredients from bacteria via fermentation rather than extracting them from the ground or sea or producing them with fossil fuels. Twig is a Seedcamp portfolio company and is backed by additional early-stage investors. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio lead; Twig currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface — its api./app. subdomains resolve to internal infrastructure — so this pass captures company identity and a domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Unconventional
providers.description: Unconventional (Unconventional, Inc.) is an AI-hardware research company rethinking the foundations of the computer to optimize energy efficiency for AI. Founded by experts in AI systems, analog circuits, computing theory, and neuroscience, and backed by Playground Global, the company researches dynamical-systems computing substrates — coupled-oscillator (Kuramoto) hardware, an instruction set architecture for dynamical-system hardware, and hardware/software neural co-evolution — targeting biology-scale energy efficiency. Its open-source Un-0 model generates images with simulated coupled oscillators. Unconventional does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or hosted product.

providers.name: Unconventional AI
providers.description: Unconventional AI (unconv.ai) is rethinking the foundations of the computer to optimize energy efficiency for AI, working to bring biology-scale efficiency to artificial intelligence through analog, dynamical-system hardware co-evolved with neural software. Founded by experts in AI systems, analog circuits, computing theory, and neuroscience, and backed by Felicis, the company publishes research including the Un-0 image-generation model built on coupled Kuramoto oscillators and an instruction set architecture for dynamical-system hardware, but does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Unconventional AI
providers.description: Unconventional AI is rethinking the foundations of compute to bring biology-scale energy efficiency to AI. The company researches dynamical systems such as coupled Kuramoto oscillators as a computing substrate that maps onto analog and physical hardware, pointing toward on the order of 1000x lower energy for AI than today's digital accelerators. Its open-source Un-0 reference implementation generates images by integrating the phase dynamics of coupled oscillators. Backed by DCVC, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Lux Capital, and Wing Venture Capital. The company does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Westbound Equity Partners
providers.description: Westbound Equity Partners is a venture capital firm that invests financial and social capital into values-aligned founding teams, aiming to build a virtuous cycle of wealth and opportunity. The firm backs ventures across workplace equity and wealth-building, climate tech and decarbonization, AI and advanced technology, and social impact, and supports founders through the Westbound Network of entrepreneurs, operators, and investors plus culture coaching and talent services. Portfolio companies include Esusu, Planet FWD, Syndio, Sierra, Mon Ami, The Browser Company, Conduit Tech, Manas AI, and Laborup. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group. Westbound publishes a marketing and careers website but no public developer or API program.

providers.name: Windfall Bio
providers.description: Windfall Bio transforms methane emissions into organic fertilizer and carbon credits using proprietary non-GMO methane-eating microbes (methanotrophs). The company operates across agriculture, coal mining, oil & gas, and waste management, capturing methane at the source and converting it into a soil amendment while generating verifiable carbon credits. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the latest enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Wisear
providers.description: Wisear is a Paris-based neurotechnology company building an AI-powered neural interface that lets people control devices through voiceless and touchless commands. Its technology reads biosignals captured by everyday wearables such as wireless earphones, AR/VR headsets and smartglasses, turning subtle facial and neural gestures into hands-free device controls. Wisear targets use cases across consumer audio, industrial augmented reality, walkie-talkie and emergency communications, gaming headsets, the metaverse and accessibility. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Wisear publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal — this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: YesGraph
providers.description: YesGraph was a San Francisco startup (YC W13) that provided a referral and contact-recommendation API. Its HTTP API and SDKs let mobile and web apps upload a user's address book and receive a machine-learning ranked list of which contacts a user should invite, powering smarter invite and referral flows. Founded by Ivan Kirigin (ex-Dropbox, ex-Facebook), YesGraph worked with companies including Airbnb, Atlassian, Gusto and Hired. In 2017 the team and its social-graph technology joined Lyft to strengthen Lyft's in-house referral program, and the public YesGraph API was deactivated on August 31, 2017. This profile documents the historical developer surface; the API is retired and no longer accepting traffic.

providers.name: yesmro
providers.description: YESMRO (易买工品), operated by Shanghai Sheti Information Technology Co., Ltd. and founded in April 2016, is a self-operated Chinese B2B e-commerce platform for MRO (maintenance, repair and operations) and factory-automation parts. It carries millions of SKUs across mechanical components, industrial control (PLCs, HMIs, servos, drives), sensors, low-voltage electrical, pneumatics, tools, safety and factory consumables from 800+ brands, targeting the small and medium-sized end factories that make up the long tail of industrial demand. The company runs automated (AGV) warehouses in Shanghai, Hefei and Dongguan and 10+ regional offices, and in 2020 launched an open platform for upstream suppliers. It is backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Matrix Partners China and Sequoia Capital China. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming; no public developer API, open-platform docs, or specification surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Zeromatter
providers.description: Zeromatter is a deep-tech simulation platform that lets teams build, test, and train autonomous systems in one environment. It provides high-performance sensor simulation, automatic environment generation, and multi-agent co-simulation frameworks used to accelerate development across autonomy, aerospace, automotive, agriculture, drones, and green energy. Backed by Spark Capital, Zeromatter currently exposes a marketing and company site only; no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs were found during enrichment. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a lead pending any future public API surface.

providers.name: Ajar Online
providers.description: Ajar Online is a cloud-based property management and rent-collection platform headquartered in Kuwait and founded in 2015. It lets landlords, real-estate agencies, and property managers digitize rent collection and property administration, sending payment requests to tenants over SMS and email and accepting payment via credit and debit cards, KNET, and Sadad so tenants can pay in under a minute from anywhere. The platform adds portfolio dashboards, tenant and contract management, and analytics for data-driven property decisions, and has expanded across the GCC into the UAE and Saudi Arabia. The company operates a live, authenticated API backend at api.joinajar.com; there is no public API documentation, OpenAPI definition, or SDK published at this time, so this profile captures verifiable identity and domain-security signals pending a public developer surface.

providers.name: Alan
providers.description: Alan is a Paris-based digital health insurance and wellness company founded in 2016 by Jean-Charles Samuelian-Werve and Charles Gorintin. It was the first independent health insurance provider licensed in France in over fifty years and offers an integrated product combining complementary health insurance ("mutuelle"), prevention, and care delivery through a single mobile and web experience. Alan's product surface includes group and individual health plans (Alan Santé), retirement plans (Alan Dolce Vita), public-sector and self-employed offerings, an HR/benefits admin dashboard for employers, an in-house telehealth and chat-care service (Clinique Alan) staffed by salaried clinicians, a gamified prevention and step-tracking program (Alan Play / Alan Mind), and vision/optical benefits with zero out-of-pocket pricing. The company reports over one million members and roughly 33,000 client businesses, operates in France, Belgium, and Spain, and reached a reported €5B valuation in its 2026 Series F round. Engineering and product practice is documented publicly on the Alan Product and Technical Blog at medium.com/alan, and a small portfolio of internal-tools and design assets (most notably react-native-fast-shadow and the Alan Sans typeface) is open-sourced on github.com/alan-eu. Alan does not publish a public-facing developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK; all member and employer interactions happen through Alan's first-party apps and the HR/benefits dashboard.

providers.name: Alkemics
providers.description: Alkemics was a French SaaS company founded in 2011 in Paris that operated a collaborative commerce platform connecting consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and retailers to share, enrich, and distribute product content and data across the FMCG/grocery supply chain. Backed by investors including Partech, Cathay Innovation, and Serena, Alkemics was acquired by Salsify (a US product experience management company) in October 2020. The product now lives on as "SupplierXM by Salsify"; alkemics.com and docs.alkemics.com redirect to Salsify, and the successor developer documentation is hosted at docs.supplierxm.salsify.com. This company profile is preserved in the API Evangelist network with an honest acquisition/successor record. No independent Alkemics-owned API surface remains.

providers.name: Alpha Finance
providers.description: Alpha Finance Lab, now operating as Alpha Venture DAO, is a Web3 builders' DAO and DeFi studio backed by Multicoin Capital. It builds and incubates on-chain financial applications, most notably Homora, a leveraged yield-farming protocol on Ethereum, BNB Chain and Avalanche, along with an on-chain lending protocol and Alpha X derivatives work. Its stack is delivered as audited Solidity smart contracts (with Python/JavaScript/TypeScript tooling and integration docs) published on GitHub rather than as a hosted REST API; developer integration is contract- and subgraph-oriented. This API Evangelist profile tracks the organization's public developer surface — documentation, GitHub organization, and blog. The legacy alphafinance.io domain has been retired in favor of alphaventuredao.io.

providers.name: Apreohealth
providers.description: Apreo Health is a clinical-stage medical device company based in Menlo Park, California, developing a novel, tissue-sparing bronchoscopic treatment for severe emphysema. Its investigational Apreo BREATHE Airway Scaffold uses a self-expanding nitinol scaffold to tent open targeted airways, releasing trapped air and reducing lung hyperinflation without removing healthy tissue. The device received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2024 and is being evaluated in the BREATHE clinical trial program. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, F-Prime Capital, and OSF Ventures, Apreo Health is a physical medical device company with no public developer API, SDK, or software platform; this profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bioagelabs
providers.description: BioAge Labs is a clinical-stage biotechnology company (NASDAQ: BIOA) based in Emeryville, California, that harnesses the biology of human aging to develop new therapies for metabolic and cardiometabolic disease. Its AI-driven discovery platform mines proprietary multi-omics data from large, longitudinal human aging cohorts to identify the molecular pathways that drive age-related disease, then advances small-molecule and biologic drug candidates against those targets. The clinical pipeline centers on BGE-102, an oral NLRP3 inflammasome inhibitor aimed at cardiovascular inflammation, and next-generation APJ (apelin receptor) agonists developed as exercise mimetics for obesity and cardiometabolic conditions. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis and enriched into the API Evangelist network; BioAge is a therapeutics developer and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Bioyond Robotics
providers.description: Bioyond Robotics (奔曜科技) is a life-sciences intelligent-automation company founded in 2021 and headquartered in Shanghai's Zhangjiang Science City. It combines robotics, machine vision, and artificial intelligence to build autonomous laboratory solutions for scientific research, drug discovery, applied chemistry, synthetic biology, multiomics, and clinical diagnostics. Its product line spans the LabGenius robot platform (liquid-handling and transport robots), the LabMate automation platform (material/liquid handling, stackers, and intelligent scheduling), the LabMind laboratory software platform for integrating external instruments and modules, and the BIOYOND AutoSeq genetic-analysis system. Bioyond is backed by Qiming Venture Partners. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal — this record captures its identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Cellino Bio
providers.description: Cellino Bio is a Boston-area biotechnology company developing AI-driven optical bioprocessing to manufacture personalized, autologous regenerative medicines from a patient's own induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSC). Its proprietary Nebula platform combines deep learning, laser-based cell management, and closed-loop optical bioprocesses to produce living therapeutics targeting degenerative conditions such as kidney disease, lung disease, spinal cord injury, Alzheimer's, diabetes, and obesity. The company also operates Cellinoverse, a digital simulation environment for its manufacturing workflows. Backed by 8vc. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Cellino Bio publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Cellinobio
providers.description: Cellino Bio develops AI-driven optical bioprocessing technology for personalized regenerative medicine. Its proprietary Nebula platform combines deep learning, laser-based cell management, and closed-loop optical bioprocesses to manufacture patient-specific, induced-pluripotent-stem-cell-derived cell and tissue replacements at scale. The company targets degenerative and chronic conditions including kidney disease, lung disease, spinal cord injury, Alzheimer's, and diabetes. Cellino is a life-sciences/biotech company with no public developer API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence and is backed by Felicis and Khosla Ventures.

providers.name: Complete Omics
providers.description: Complete Omics is a Baltimore, Maryland based, CLIA- and CAP-accredited molecular diagnostics company building ultra-deep, clinically reproducible proteomics and multi-omics testing. Its Complete360 liquid- and tissue-biopsy platform and Valid-NEO companion-diagnostics platform apply AI-assisted analysis of high-dimensional biological data across oncology, neurology, cardiovascular, and immunology testing. The company holds 40+ global patents and 20+ top-tier journal publications. Complete Omics is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface exists at this time; this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Downjoy (当乐网)
providers.description: Downjoy (当乐网, d.cn) is a Chinese mobile game distribution and community platform operated by Beijing Downjoy Information Technology Co., Ltd (北京当乐信息技术有限公司). The site offers mobile game downloads, gaming news and original editorial content, game-related video, community features, and game rankings and recommendations. Downjoy also runs an open platform at open.d.cn where game publishers and developers register, create and submit games, integrate the Downjoy SDK, and manage launch and updates. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; enriched with verified public identity and infrastructure probes.

providers.name: Eikon Therapeutics
providers.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company (Nasdaq: EIKN) founded in 2019 and headquartered in Millbrae, California, with additional offices in New York and Jersey City. Eikon built a proprietary drug-discovery platform around single-molecule live-cell imaging, applying super-resolution fluorescence microscopy and high-throughput single-molecule tracking to observe how proteins and drug targets move and interact inside living cells in real time. The technology descends from co-founder Eric Betzig's Nobel Prize-winning work in super-resolution microscopy, and the company is led by former Merck R&D chief Roger Perlmutter. Eikon uses these measurements to discover and develop novel therapeutics across oncology and other disease areas. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lux Capital and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Eikon publishes a corporate and investor web presence but no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Forter
providers.description: Forter is a New York City-headquartered ecommerce fraud prevention and digital identity platform founded in 2013 by Michael Reitblat and Alon Shemesh. The company operates an AI-powered decision platform for digital commerce that helps merchants approve more legitimate transactions while blocking fraud, account takeover, payment abuse, policy abuse, and return/refund abuse. Forter's products include Fraud Management, Payment Optimization (3DS, card vaulting, network uplift, payment orchestration, predictive routing), Dispute / Chargeback Recovery, Account Protection (sign-up, login, session), Abuse Prevention (checkout and post-purchase), Element for Payment Service Providers, and an Agentic Commerce suite for AI-agent-initiated transactions. The platform is built on what Forter describes as the world's largest first-party identity network, derived from real consumer interactions across hundreds of leading retailers, marketplaces, and food-delivery brands such as Adidas, eBay, Instacart, Nordstrom, Priceline, Sephora, and Wayfair. Forter exposes a public Core API (orders, 3DS, disputes, accounts, merchants, compensation, data privacy) and an Evidence API documented at docs.forter.com, alongside prebuilt integrations for Magento/Adobe Commerce, Salesforce B2C Commerce, commercetools, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Paysafe, Worldline, Worldpay, and others. Forter is also the sponsor of the open-source Trusted Agentic Commerce Protocol, a secure authentication and data-encryption protocol for AI agents, merchants, and merchant vendors. The company has raised approximately $525M in venture funding from Sequoia Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, NEA, and others, and has been valued at roughly $3B at last public reporting.

providers.name: Fox Rothschild LLP
providers.description: Fox Rothschild LLP is a national US law firm with approximately 1,000 attorneys across 30+ offices. The firm has no public developer APIs. Its programmatic surface is limited to publication and content distribution: subscription-based email alerts and 21+ topical attorney-authored blogs hosted on the LexBlog (WordPress) platform, each of which exposes a standard WordPress RSS 2.0 feed at /feed/. This index catalogs the firm and the RSS-able LexBlog network as the consumable surface.

providers.name: HealthSouth (Encompass Health)
providers.description: HealthSouth, rebranded as Encompass Health in 2018, is one of the largest providers of post-acute healthcare services in the United States, operating inpatient rehabilitation hospitals across the country. The company focuses on rehabilitation services for stroke, neurological conditions, spinal cord injuries, and orthopedic conditions. No public developer APIs have been identified.

providers.name: Heineken
providers.description: A Dutch multinational brewing company and one of the world's largest beer producers. Operates over 165 breweries across 70 countries producing iconic brands including Heineken, Amstel, Tecate, and Dos Equis. Maintains an internal HEIWAY API portal (api-portal.production.az.heiway.com) used for partner, distributor, and on-trade B2B integrations; access is gated and not openly published.

providers.name: HomeGP
providers.description: HomeGP is a Malaysian on-demand house-call healthcare platform, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, that connects patients with a network of over 300 vetted healthcare practitioners who visit them at home. Services include general practitioner consultations, homecare nursing, licensed physiotherapy, blood and urine testing, medical concierge, wound dressing, and private and live-in caregivers. Bookings are placed through WhatsApp with confirmation typically within ten minutes, operating Monday to Saturday 8am-10pm. HomeGP positions itself as a marketplace connecting individuals to independent professionals rather than a healthcare provider itself, and is backed by 500 Global (500 Southeast Asia), 8capita, and IncuVest.

providers.name: Imperson
providers.description: Imperson is an enterprise conversational-AI company and creative studio that builds turnkey, premium chatbots to automate the customer journey through natural, two-way dialogue. Its platform spans lead generation, customer support, sales and e-commerce, and engagement/entertainment, with a conversation engine, dashboard analytics, and a knowledgebase, activating across channels including Facebook Messenger, Amazon Alexa, websites, SMS, Google Assistant, native apps, and phone. Imperson operates an enterprise-sales model (no public self-serve developer API is published) and has produced chatbot experiences for brands such as Disney, Microsoft, Amazon, National Geographic, and Universal. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Knowmia.com
providers.description: Knowmia was an education-focused video platform used by instructors to create, share, and assign instructional video and lessons. The brand was operated by TechSmith alongside Camtasia and Snagit, and was marketed as Knowmia and Knowmia Pro for classroom and campus video. TechSmith retired Knowmia Pro in early 2025 and now directs former Knowmia customers to TechSmith Screencast, which offers comparable asynchronous video sharing, commenting, and review and integrates with Snagit and Camtasia. As of July 2026 knowmia.com issues an HTTP 301 redirect to the TechSmith Screencast product page. Knowmia publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, CLI, or machine-readable specifications; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a retired/absorbed entry for historical and lineage purposes.

providers.name: Luminate
providers.description: Luminate Medical is a healthcare company delivering cancer care at home. Its Lotus Home Infusion platform enables nurse-led, at-home chemotherapy infusion, partnering with oncology clinics, health plans, and patients while keeping drug dispensing oversight with the originating cancer center. Luminate is a portfolio company of 8vc and GV. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer, API, documentation, or integration surface.

providers.name: Mana.bio
providers.description: Mana.bio is an AI-driven drug-delivery biotechnology company specializing in programmable lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) for nucleic-acid therapeutics and vaccines, including mRNA, DNA, and CRISPR-based gene therapy. The company runs a closed-loop design-build-test-learn platform that uses machine-learning models to design novel LNP candidates, synthesizes dozens of formulations weekly via high-throughput automation, screens them with comprehensive assays, and feeds results back to continuously improve its models — targeting precise, optimized extrahepatic delivery. Mana.bio also operates Mina (ChatLNP), an AI agent that helps scientists explore curated literature, predict LNP properties, and optimize formulations, plus an LNP patents / freedom-to-operate map. The company is backed by a16z. Mana.bio publishes no first-party developer or product API; its only public agent surface is a Wix Site MCP endpoint and an llms.txt on its site.

providers.name: Mips
providers.description: MIPS is a processor IP and compute company building embedded and edge AI silicon for automotive, robotics, and mission-critical systems. Its portfolio spans the MIPS RISC-V CPU families (M8500, I8500, P8700, S8200), the ARC processor and NPX/VPX accelerator lines, and development tooling such as MIPS Atlas Explorer virtual platforms and the ASIP Designer / ASIP Programmer toolchains. MIPS frames its offering around a "Sense, Think, Act, Communicate" signal chain for real-time autonomy — what it calls Physical AI at the edge. MIPS is a semiconductor IP licensor rather than a public web-API provider; this profile was surfaced as a Mayfield portfolio company and enriched with identity and probed security posture.

providers.name: Model Medicines
providers.description: Model Medicines is an AI-first biotechnology company based in San Diego, California, discovering and developing first-in-class small-molecule drugs by targeting fundamental disease mechanisms it calls biological choke points. Its end-to-end GALILEO AI engine spans drug design, target discovery, and preclinical development, supported by specialized models including AmesNet for regulatory-grade toxicology prediction and ChemPrint for chemical property prediction. Lead programs target RdRp Thumb-1 (a conserved allosteric pocket on viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase) and BRD4, with lead assets MDL-001, a broad-spectrum oral antiviral candidate, and MDL-4102. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Model Medicines publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface; its AI platform is used internally for drug discovery.

providers.name: Noise
providers.description: Noise is a consumer "attention markets" / trend-prediction platform built on Base where curators propose trend pages and communities trade markets on how relevant a topic, brand, or movement becomes over time. Market price reflects a central "relevance" number, with funding and liquidation mechanics familiar from perpetual markets. Noise raised a $7.1M seed round led by Paradigm and launched an invite-only testnet beta. It is a mobile-first consumer app rather than a developer platform; its public surface is product documentation (Mintlify) at docs.noise.xyz — no first-party developer API, SDKs, or authentication scheme is currently published.

providers.name: Nook
providers.description: Nook is an accounts payable (AP) automation platform for businesses, combining invoice management with automated payment workflows to reduce manual data entry, cut errors, and give finance teams clearer visibility over outgoings. Founded in the UK and backed by Speedinvest as an early investor, Nook was acquired by payments infrastructure provider Modulr; its product now operates as "Modulr AP" and its former standalone site at nook.io presents the combined Modulr AP offering. Nook does not publish an independent public developer platform, API reference, or SDKs — the payment rails are provided through Modulr's platform — so this profile is maintained as a company record rather than an API-bearing provider.

providers.name: Numerion Labs
providers.description: Numerion Labs is an AI-driven drug discovery company building an "AI superplatform" that explores chemical space to uncover novel, drug-like molecules using machine learning. The company pairs computational drug-hunting with its own development programs, applying generative and predictive models to surface previously unseen chemical matter and advance therapeutic candidates. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, Numerion Labs currently publishes a marketing and corporate web presence (platform overview, pipeline programs, team, news/blog, and contact) but does not expose a public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Onit
providers.description: Onit is a Kenyan digital bank operated by Onit Microfinance Bank Inc. and regulated by the Central Bank of Kenya (CBK), with deposits protected by the Kenya Deposit Insurance Corporation (KDIC). Formerly known as Shara, Onit provides a free peer-to-peer transaction network linking consumers, businesses, and suppliers: users can send and receive money instantly and at no cost between Onit accounts, run separate personal and business accounts, and access loans and checkout/BNPL finance from a single mobile app. The company positions open APIs as part of its offering to let partners and merchants integrate consumer payments, though it does not currently publish a public developer portal or API documentation. Onit is a portfolio company of Speedinvest and operates in the emerging-markets fintech space.

providers.name: Optain
providers.description: Optain (Optain Health) is a healthcare technology company delivering AI-powered retinal imaging and oculomics for early, non-invasive detection of chronic disease at the point of care. Its platform pairs the FDA 510(k)-cleared Resolve robotic fundus camera and Eyetelligence Assure Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) with teleophthalmology grading to screen for diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, age-related macular degeneration, hypertensive retinopathy and cardiovascular risk in seconds, without dilation. Rooted in Australian-founded Eyetelligence (2019) and research from the Centre for Eye Research Australia, Optain integrates with major EHR systems and returns ICD-10-coded reports, typically same day. Backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Pluralis
providers.description: Pluralis Research is a decentralized AI lab pioneering Protocol Learning, a third path between closed proprietary models and open-weight models in which large transformer models are collaboratively pre-trained across many low-bandwidth, geographically distributed consumer GPUs without any single participant holding the full model weights. Its work spans communication-efficient model parallelism, asynchronous pipeline-parallel optimization, and community-owned training runs (Agora, node0), published as research papers at NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR and as open-source libraries. Pluralis is backed by Union Square Ventures. It exposes research libraries, a participation CLI, and live run dashboards rather than a conventional REST/GraphQL developer API.

providers.name: Protect AI
providers.description: Protect AI is an AI/ML security company building defensive tooling and open-source security research for the model supply chain, large language model (LLM) applications, and runtime AI workloads. The commercial platform is anchored by three products — Guardian (AI model security and third-party model scanning across PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, Keras, Pickle, GGUF, Safetensors, and 35+ formats with Hugging Face, SageMaker, MLflow, S3, Git, and Artifactory integrations), Recon (scalable AI red teaming with an attack library of 450+ known attacks against LLM applications mapped to OWASP LLM Top 10), and Layer (runtime AI security with 27 turnkey policies, eBPF and SDK collection, and DataDog/Splunk/Elastic/PagerDuty integration).
