This profile tracks the firm in the API Evangelist network; as a venture firm it has no public developer or API surface of its own.

providers.name: Infinimmune
providers.description: Infinimmune is a biotechnology company that discovers and engineers human-derived antibody therapeutics. Its Complete Human Sequencing and Anthrobody library-on-B-cell platform surface rare antibodies that evolution has already proven in people, and its GLIMPSE antibody language model characterizes and optimizes candidates in silico for clinical development. Its lead program, IFX-101, is an IL-22 inhibitor for moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with additional pipeline programs targeting IL-13, APRIL, and IL-17F. Backed by Playground Global. Infinimmune publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications; this API Evangelist profile captures the company identity and its public web, security, and legal surface.

providers.name: Integrated Development Environment
providers.description: Integrated Development Environment (IDE) is a software application that consolidates the core developer workflow into a single interface, typically combining a source code editor, build automation tools, debugger, version control integration, intelligent code completion, refactoring, and language server protocol (LSP) support. Modern IDEs increasingly integrate AI coding assistants, agentic tooling, remote development containers, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients to extend the surface area beyond local file editing.

providers.name: Inventa
providers.description: Inventa is a Brazilian B2B commerce platform — a "B2B commerce cloud" — that integrates technology, credit, and logistics on a single platform so brands and distributors can scale wholesale sales in Brazil. Its products include a sales platform that syncs catalogs, orders, inventory, and prices across B2B e-commerce sites and marketplaces via ERP integrations; a field-sales mobile app for sellers; automated credit analysis and approval; shared distribution-center logistics (OMS/WMS/TMS) with fulfillment and 72-hour delivery in the São Paulo region; multichannel customer support; and business-intelligence dashboards. Solution packages span Fulfillment, Response, FullService, and a pay-per-use OnDemand model. The company is headquartered in São Paulo. Inventa configures the API and connector integrations for its customers rather than publishing a public developer portal, so it has no public API artifacts as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Irregular
providers.description: Irregular (formerly Pattern Labs) is a frontier AI security lab founded in 2023 by Dan Lahav and Eli David with the mission of protecting the world as AI systems become increasingly capable and sophisticated. The company runs security assessments and red-team evaluations against advanced frontier AI models, works to set security standards for the frontier AI industry, and is trusted by major AI labs to evaluate model risk. Irregular raised $80M co-led by Sequoia Capital and Redpoint Ventures at a $450M valuation. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Redpoint Ventures portfolio company; Irregular publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal at this time, so this record captures company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Isengard Industries Inc
providers.description: Isengard Industries builds sovereign production capability for defense: the means for allied nations to manufacture precision-strike and counter-drone (counter-UAS) systems by the thousand, on their own soil, at a fraction of what traditional prime contractors charge. The company describes its approach as "Weapons of Mass Production." Founded in 2026 and part of Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch, it is led by Francisco Serra-Martins (previously co-founder/CEO of Terminal Autonomy) and James Tennant (former Australian Army officer), and is headquartered in San Francisco. As a hardware and defense-manufacturing company it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: iTAC Software
providers.description: iTAC Software AG is an independent company of the Duerr Group and a leading provider of Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) software for discrete manufacturing. Its iTAC.MOM.Suite delivers production control, end-to-end traceability, quality management, and AI-supported analytics that help automotive, electronics, and medical-technology manufacturers implement Industry 4.0 and smart-factory operations. iTAC does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; system integration is delivered through the MOM platform's IoT and connectivity layers as part of a project engagement.

providers.name: Jenesis Software
providers.description: Jenesis Software is a web-based insurance agency management system (AMS) for independent property and casualty agencies, offering client and policy management, ACORD forms, carrier downloads (IVANS/Ebix), comparative rating, two-way email and texting, commission tracking, receipts and payments, e-signature, and reporting. Jenesis does NOT publish a public, self-serve developer API. Integration with outside systems is delivered through vendor-built connectors and partner platforms - Zapier (via JenesisLink), IVANS/Ebix ACORD carrier downloads, comparative raters (Zywave/TurboRater), DocuSign, QuickBooks, RingCentral, Twilio, and payment processors - each arranged and provisioned through Jenesis rather than exposed as documented REST endpoints. The API areas listed here are modeled from Jenesis's published product capabilities and integration surface; they do not reflect a documented public API and their endpoints are not published.

providers.name: JOBDOH
providers.description: JOBDOH is a Hong Kong-based on-demand hiring and staffing platform that connects employers with temporary, part-time, and short-term workers, letting businesses staff up within 24 hours and job seekers find flexible work in one minute. The bilingual (English/Chinese) service spans market research, sales and promotion, exhibitions and events, hospitality, personal assistance, logistics, creative, and beauty roles. Hiring and job applications run through a mobile-app and web experience; there is no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: K2 Integrity
providers.description: K2 Integrity is a global risk, compliance, and investigations advisory firm specializing in financial crimes risk management, regulatory compliance, fraud detection, asset tracing and recovery, cybersecurity and AI resilience, crypto and digital-asset solutions, internal audit, and independent monitoring. It serves financial institutions, corporations, governments, and law firms worldwide. K2 Integrity was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; this profile has been enriched but the firm publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Khmer Home
providers.description: Khmerhome (khmerhome.com) is Cambodia's real estate marketplace, based in Phnom Penh, connecting buyers, renters, and property owners across houses, apartments, condos, villas, boreys, land, warehouses, and commercial spaces. The platform offers property search and browsing, sales and rental listings with photos and agent details, property valuation and appraisal tools, an articles section covering Cambodian economic and property developments, and community events for real estate professionals and expats. Khmerhome ships native iOS and Android mobile apps and operates alongside sister sites khmerload.com and khmercars.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer/API surface, OpenAPI specification, or documentation portal has been found at this time.

providers.name: Knowable
providers.description: Knowable was a mobile audio-learning company that united world-class experts, thinkers, and storytellers to produce structured audio courses for curious minds — an "audio courses" take on online learning delivered as serialized lessons rather than one-off podcasts. Founded by the Bit Kitchen team and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z led its round in May 2019), Knowable published expert-led course series across business, creativity, and personal development. The company is no longer operational: knowable.fyi now serves a tombstone notice stating that Knowable has been acquired by Medium and directing former listeners to Medium.com. Knowable never published a public developer program, API, SDKs, or developer documentation, and its GitHub organization (bitkitchen) exposes no public repositories. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical company record from the a16z portfolio; there is no live API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Kovr.ai
providers.description: Kovr.ai is a security and compliance automation company surfaced through the Battery Ventures portfolio and profiled in the API Evangelist network. Its verified public engineering presence is the GitHub organization github.com/kovr-ai, whose open-source kovr-aws-nist-compliance project validates AWS environments against NIST 800-53 Rev 5 and NIST 800-171 Rev 2 and maps findings across the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark, MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP Cloud Security, the AWS Well-Architected Framework, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, the CSA Cloud Controls Matrix, the SANS Critical Security Controls, and NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture, running roughly 160 checks across 50+ AWS services. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification has been located for this company; the corporate website is served behind a bot-protection interstitial that blocks automated retrieval, so link properties beyond the homepage and the GitHub organization remain unverified.

providers.name: Latent Space
providers.description: Latent Space is an artificial intelligence company building generative models for businesses and creatives, described by General Catalyst as creating "AI technology for predictive analytics and data-driven insights." The company raised a Series A from Greylock and General Catalyst and is listed in the General Catalyst portfolio under the Artificial Intelligence industry in North America. As of a July 2026 probe, Latent Space publishes no developer surface: the company domain latentspace.co returns an HTTP 302 redirect to its X/Twitter profile for every path probed, no docs/api/developer/app/status subdomains resolve in DNS, there are no /.well-known/ discovery documents, no llms.txt, and no public repositories under its GitHub organization. This profile therefore records verified company identity and domain posture only — no API, SDK, or documentation artifacts exist to harvest.

providers.name: Lendtable
providers.description: Lendtable was a US consumer fintech that extended a line of credit so individuals could afford to max out employer-sponsored benefits they would otherwise leave on the table — primarily the employer 401(k) match and Employee Stock Purchase Plans (ESPP). In its own words: "Lendtable gives a line of credit to help individuals get their employer 401(k) match and ESPP." The product advanced cash against a user's paycheck contributions and took a share of the resulting gains, and was distributed direct-to-consumer and through employers via a Lendtable for Business offering, alongside an iOS app and a Zendesk help center. Lendtable was backed by Partech among others. The company now appears defunct: lendtable.com, the blog, and all product paths return HTTP 402 DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED (probed 2026-07-19), the iOS App Store listing is delisted, and the last successful Internet Archive capture of the live site is 2024-12-06. DNS, Google Workspace mail (MX/SPF/DMARC) and the GitHub organization remain registered. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts were ever published by this company.

providers.name: Lettuce
providers.description: Lettuce (Lettuce Inc.) is a venture-backed startup headquartered in Venice, California, surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass the company operates no live public surface: lettuceapps.com and every probed subdomain (www, api, docs, developer, app) return the same wildcard domain-parking page rather than first-party content, and no developer portal, documentation, API reference, OpenAPI or AsyncAPI specification, SDK, package-registry release, or .well-known discovery document could be located. The company's remaining public footprint is a GitHub account holding one internal Node.js proxy project and one empty repository. This profile therefore records verified identity and live probe results only; it is retained as a dormant portfolio lead rather than an active API provider, and carries no fabricated API artifacts.

providers.name: lovecrafts
providers.description: LoveCrafts (LoveCrafts Group Limited) is a UK-based crafting commerce and community platform — "your home to shop, share and dream in crafts" — selling yarns and fibers, knitting, crochet, sewing, quilting and embroidery patterns, supplies, tools, kits and fabrics, alongside free and paid patterns, tutorials and inspiration content. It operates localized storefronts for North America, the UK, Germany, Australia and France on a Nuxt-based e-commerce stack. LoveCrafts was surfaced as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. It exposes no public developer portal or API surface; the only machine-discoverable public artifact is an RFC 9116 security.txt with a responsible- disclosure policy (no bug bounty programme).

providers.name: Lynq
providers.description: Lynq Networks develops infrastructure-free, long-range wireless connectivity for enterprise and OEM devices, bridging the gap between short-range Bluetooth and infrastructure-dependent cellular/5G. Its technology lets original equipment manufacturers build large-area device networks without deploying traditional network infrastructure, targeting construction, agriculture, military, and public-safety use cases. Lynq is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API documentation; this profile captures its identity and a domain-security probe for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Machindustries
providers.description: Mach Industries develops and manufactures asymmetric aerospace and defense systems and components, aiming to produce them by the millions to deter conflict and advance prosperity. Its product line includes Viper (a turbojet vertical-takeoff attack drone), Glide and Pike precision strike munitions, Stratos high-altitude platforms, Dart counter-drone interceptors, and an Energetics propulsion and explosives testing practice. The company is a Khosla Ventures portfolio company. It is a hardware and manufacturing business with no public developer API surface at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company identity and monitoring.

providers.name: Macromedia
providers.description: Macromedia was a developer-tools and interactive-media software company (Flash, Dreamweaver, ColdFusion, Shockwave, Director, Fireworks) surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and kleiner-perkins. Adobe acquired Macromedia in 2005; www.macromedia.com now 301-redirects to www.adobe.com and the domain serves Adobe's canonical security.txt / PSIRT disclosure surface. This profile is a legacy company lead in the API Evangelist network with no independent live API surface of its own.

providers.name: Magoosh
providers.description: Magoosh is an online test-preparation company serving over 10 million students across 185 countries with affordable, self-paced courses for the GRE, GMAT, SAT, ACT, TOEFL, IELTS, MCAT, and LSAT. Its platform pairs expert-crafted practice questions, video lessons, and detailed explanations with progress tracking, flashcard tools, AI-assisted tutoring, and iOS/Android apps, plus school and district plans. Magoosh publishes a marketing website and a company blog but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its public web footprint and domain security posture.

providers.name: Mathem
providers.description: Mathem is Sweden's largest pure-play online grocery retailer, delivering fresh food, household goods and pantry staples directly to consumers' homes across Sweden. Customers browse and order the full assortment of a physical supermarket through the mathem.se website and native iOS/Android apps, and receive scheduled home delivery. Mathem merged with the Norwegian online grocer Oda to form one of the Nordics' largest online grocery groups, and its security and careers functions are now operated under the shared Oda organization. Payments are handled through Klarna and the major card networks. Mathem operates a consumer e-commerce storefront and mobile apps; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal. This API Evangelist profile was created as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio lead and enriched via the enrichment pipeline; the substantive public technical surface found is an RFC 9116 security.txt and an invite-only YesWeHack bug-bounty program run through Oda.

providers.name: Meituan
providers.description: Meituan (美团) is a Chinese technology-retail company operating one of the world's largest on-demand local-services and food-delivery super-apps. Its platform spans restaurant food delivery, in-store dining and group buying (Dianping), grocery and instant retail, hotel and travel booking, bike and moped sharing, and payments. Meituan runs a partner/developer cooperation center exposing merchant, delivery/logistics, and local-services integration APIs to business partners; these are partner-gated and documented in Chinese, with no public OpenAPI specification, SDK registry, or self-serve developer signup surfaced at this time.

providers.name: Metafy
providers.description: Metafy is a consumer marketplace for gaming coaching and mentorship, connecting players with expert coaches and professional gamers for personalized one-on-one lessons, VOD reviews, and guides across popular competitive titles. Metafy operates a consumer web platform at metafy.gg and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; the only machine-discoverable surface found was an RFC 9116 /.well-known/security.txt security contact. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures.

providers.name: Miniso
providers.description: MINISO is a global value retailer of lifestyle and consumer products — home goods, accessories, cosmetics, stationery, toys and seasonal items — known for its IP-collaboration merchandise (Harry Potter, PEANUTS, Sanrio, BT21 and others). Founded in Guangzhou, China and publicly listed (NYSE/HKEX), the company operates 7,700+ stores across 112 markets worldwide. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hillhouse; the public web presence is consumer- and investor-facing and exposes no developer API, developer portal, or partner integration platform at this time.

providers.name: MoonActive
providers.description: MoonActive is a mobile game developer and publisher best known for the casual titles Coin Master and Pet Master. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As a consumer gaming company MoonActive publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; the enrichment pass captured its security and domain posture only (a published RFC 9116 security.txt with a security contact and disclosure page, plus probed TLS/SPF/DMARC).

providers.name: MotorMia
providers.description: MotorMia is an AI-powered automotive platform for car enthusiasts, built around Mia, an AI modding partner, build advisor, and performance analyst. Users add their vehicles, set build and performance goals, and Mia returns personalized upgrade recommendations across engine, transmission, brakes, suspension, cooling, and exhaust systems, tuned to the user's level of mechanical experience. The platform is backed by a proprietary automotive intelligence dataset combining over 5 million aftermarket parts, more than 50 million fitment records, and real-world enthusiast build behavior from 1M+ community projects, and ships as iOS and Android mobile apps plus a web store. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, MotorMia raised $8M led by investors including Lerer Hippeau and Seedcamp. As of this profile MotorMia is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface.

providers.name: NaroIQ
providers.description: NaroIQ is a European ETF issuance and infrastructure platform that lets capital management companies and ETF initiators launch and operate their own exchange-traded funds while retaining control over their value chain. It acts as a single coordination layer across the full ETF lifecycle — fund setup, basket and portfolio composition file (PCF) management, intraday indicative net asset value (iNAV) calculation, an in-house indexing engine, optional portfolio management, and end-to-end regulatory compliance under Germany's BaFin and the EU's ESMA regimes. The company is a General Catalyst portfolio company based in Europe. As of this enrichment pass NaroIQ publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine discovery surface (no /.well-known/*, no llms.txt); this profile captures the company identity and published web properties.

providers.name: Neuralink
providers.description: Neuralink is a neurotechnology company pioneering implantable brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) intended to restore autonomy to people with unmet medical needs and, longer term, to expand human capability. Its flagship device, the N1 Implant, is a surgically embedded array of thin, flexible threads placed by a purpose-built surgical robot to record and stimulate neural activity, paired with an app that lets users control external devices. Neuralink is a frontier-tech company backed by Craft Ventures, Founders Fund, GV and Lightspeed Venture Partners. It publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its only public machine-readable surfaces are a security.txt vulnerability-disclosure record and standard web/DNS security posture. This profile was surfaced from VC portfolio data and enriched with real probed security artifacts.

providers.name: newmo
providers.description: newmo (newmo株式会社, "ニューモ") is a Japanese mobility company with the mission "移動で地域をカラフルに" — coloring regions through movement. It modernizes regional transportation through a consumer ride-hailing app and taxi service (newmo-taxi.jp), driver recruitment and dispatch, and its newmo Autonomy initiative (newmo.ai), which since 2025 has run Level 4 autonomous-driving taxi trials spanning safety, remote monitoring, operations design, and vehicle integration. newmo is a consumer transportation service rather than a developer/API platform; probing found no public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface. Backed by DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Nimble Robotics
providers.description: Nimble Robotics (Nimble) is an autonomous robotic third-party logistics (3PL) company building AI-powered robots that pick, pack, and fulfill ecommerce orders with minimal human intervention. Founded by Simon Kalouche, the company operates fully autonomous robotic fulfillment centers and is training general-purpose robot AI to power fast, economical commerce. Backed by Accel and partnered with FedEx, Nimble raised a $106M Series C at a $1B valuation, with board member Marc Raibert (Boston Dynamics founder). Nimble is a physical robotics and logistics operator and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Nitricity
providers.description: Nitricity is a climate-tech and agricultural-technology company that produces nitrogen fertilizer on-farm from only air, water, and renewable electricity. Founded in 2018 by Stanford graduate researchers Nicolas Pinkowski and Joshua McEnaney, the company uses a solar-powered plasma / electrochemical process to fix atmospheric nitrogen and produce nitric acid and calcium nitrate fertilizers on-site and on-demand, eliminating the fossil-fuel-intensive Haber-Bosch process and long-distance transportation that make conventional fertilizer responsible for roughly 5% of global greenhouse gas emissions. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Fine Structure Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, and strategic investor Chipotle, Nitricity is a hardware and physical-product company; it publishes a corporate website, blog, and field-trial program but exposes no public API, developer portal, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Northwood Space
providers.description: Northwood Space is an El Segundo, California ground-infrastructure company for the space industry, founded in 2022 by Bridgit Mendler (CEO), Griffin Cleverly (CTO), and Shaurya Luthra. It designs and delivers rapidly deployable satellite ground stations built on electronically steerable phased-array antennas that track many satellites at once with no moving parts, paired with software ("Portal") that orchestrates every contact, automates scheduling, and moves data from spacecraft to customer. Northwood aims to turn ground infrastructure into cloud-like, on-demand global capacity for defense and commercial operators. The company's software stack is described as developer-oriented with modern APIs and integration hooks, but it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs at this time. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Founders Fund, Washington Harbour Partners, and Alpine Space Ventures; raised a $100M Series B and won a $50M Space Force contract in early 2026.

providers.name: Octavewealth
providers.description: Octave Wealth (octavewealth.com) is a Y Combinator-backed company that, based on its name and branding, operates in the wealth and personal-finance space. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the company's public web presence sits behind Cloudflare and exposes no public developer API, documentation, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface; the only machine-discoverable artifact found was a published RFC 9116 security.txt with a security contact. This profile records that verifiable state rather than a developer program.

providers.name: opendata.gov.al (Open Data Albania)
providers.description: opendata.gov.al is the national government open-data portal for Albania (Open Data Albania). It is a custom, DCAT-AP-compliant platform (an Angular single-page-app front end over a bespoke REST API) with a dedicated SPARQL query endpoint, and it is harvested into the EU data portal (data.europa.eu). It is not CKAN or DKAN. Read endpoints live under the /api prefix using PascalCase, action-style routes.

providers.name: opendata.rks-gov.net (Kosovo Open Data) [offline]
providers.description: opendata.rks-gov.net (RKS Open Data) was the national government open-data portal for the Republic of Kosovo, historically running CKAN (~v2.7). As of mid-2025 the hostname no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN) and the portal is offline; the last Internet Archive snapshots are from June 2025. It is cataloged here as historical pending restoration. Sectoral government open-data services remain available (e.g. Kosovo Customs at dogana.rks-gov.net/OpenData and the national geoportal at geoportal.rks-gov.net).

providers.name: Openlight
providers.description: OpenLight Photonics is a silicon photonics company that designs and manufactures custom Photonic Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (PASICs) using a heterogeneously integrated, open silicon photonics platform that builds active components such as lasers and modulators onto the same chip as passive waveguides. Operating an open foundry model out of Goleta, California, OpenLight offers three services: design enablement through its Process Design Kit (PDK) with component libraries, evaluation kits, and a PDK Sampler; in-house custom PASIC design; and production manufacturing. Its technology targets datacom, telecom, AI data-center interconnect, lidar, HPC, healthcare, quantum, and IoT sensing. Spun out of Synopsys as an independent, venture-backed company in 2025, OpenLight has raised roughly $84M (a $34M Series A in 2025 and a $50M Series A-1 in 2026) from investors including Mayfield. This is a hardware/semiconductor company; it publishes no public web API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time — its developer surface is the chip-design PDK.

providers.name: Pioneer Square Labs
providers.description: Pioneer Square Labs (PSL) is a Seattle-based startup studio and venture capital firm that partners with founders to build and fund early-stage technology companies. It operates two programs: PSL Studio, which co-creates companies from scratch alongside founders, and PSL Ventures, which invests seed capital in early-stage startups. PSL has spun out and backed companies including Arrived, Boundless, Recurrent, Dropzone, and SingleFile, and is currently focused on AI and agent-driven ventures (including its own "Lev" AI co-founder). This is a company/investor profile in the API Evangelist network; PSL publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Pramaana Labs
providers.description: Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI research lab building the verification layer for high-stakes, mission-critical AI. The company turns complex human knowledge - tax codes, clinical guidelines, legal rules, and safety constraints - into machine-checkable logic, so that every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved rather than merely sounding plausible. Its stack compiles domain rules into formal systems that return proofs, counterexamples, and traceable explanations. Pramaana Labs raised $27M to build a compiler for mission-critical AI and is backed by Accel. At this time the company operates as a research lab with published work (RuleArena, arXiv) and no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Pretred
providers.description: Pretred is a Techstars-backed manufacturer of sustainable rubber safety barriers made from recycled waste tires, serving the infrastructure, traffic control, and construction sectors with a circular-economy model. Its product line spans the Standard Rubber Barrier, TL-2 and TL-3 crash-tested barriers, a Load-Rated Barrier rated for heavy machinery, and Paceline bike-lane barriers, each engineered for energy absorption, durability, and modularity. Every Pretred facility can divert over 100 million pounds of waste tires from landfills or incineration annually. As a physical-goods manufacturer, Pretred publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface; this profile captures the company identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Rcom
providers.description: Rcom (Reliance Communications, RCOM) is an Indian telecommunications and digital infrastructure company providing enterprise connectivity, voice, and data-center services. Its portfolio spans dedicated internet access and DDoS protection, IP transit, MPLS VPN, Ethernet and leased lines, cloud networking (Cloud X Fusion / Cloud X WAN), enterprise voice (E1 PRI, SIP trunk, IP Centrex), cloud telephony and hosted contact centers, toll-free and global access numbers, audio/web conferencing, colocation and managed data-center services, and global subsea cable networks via its Global Cloud Xchange subsidiary. The company surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; enrichment confirms an enterprise service business with customer and billing portals but no public developer program, API surface, or well-known discovery documents.

providers.name: RefineRE
providers.description: RefineRE is a commercial real estate (CRE) SaaS platform that unifies benchmarking, data analysis, and portfolio usage tools into a single product suite for corporate real estate teams. Its eight modules span data foundations, portfolio management, market analysis, ESG tracking, and workplace analytics, helping occupiers and CRE managers optimize their real estate portfolios. A Techstars-backed company, RefineRE is added to the API Evangelist network as a provider profile; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: RIVR
providers.description: RIVR (RIVR Technologies AG, formerly Swiss-Mile) is a Swiss robotics and AI company spun out of ETH Zurich that develops autonomous legged-wheeled robots for doorstep delivery across parcel, grocery, and instant food/convenience segments. RIVR pursues "General Physical AI" by combining large-scale reinforcement learning in simulation with real-world self-supervised learning from live delivery operations, owning the full stack from software to hardware for reliability, safety, and cost efficiency. The company operates commercial deployments with partners including Just Eat Takeaway.com, Swiss Post, Migros Online, Evri, and Veho, and is backed by investors including Hongshan and Bezos Expeditions. This profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network company record; RIVR publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Seedsight
providers.description: Seedsight is a Porto, Portugal and Delaware, USA based agri-food technology company applying artificial intelligence and optical sensing to the cereal and grain value chain. Its platform helps farmers, traders, millers, and food processors make smarter, faster, and safer decisions through contaminant and safety screening, biological-fingerprinting traceability for origin and variety identification, Flour Extraction Rate yield prediction, and Flour Rheology quality prediction. Backed by Techstars, Seedsight raised roughly EUR 1.78M to reduce agri-food waste. At present the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile tracks its identity and domain security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sidecar
providers.description: Sidecar (side.cr) was added to the API Evangelist network as a Union Square Ventures portfolio lead. The side.cr domain today hosts a transportation news and information content platform (self-described as "building the largest transportation news source powered by everyday people"), covering ridesharing, driving, delivery, safety, and automotive topics for riders and drivers. It is a reader-facing editorial site, not a developer platform: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, OpenAPI, or any /.well-known discovery surface. The name echoes the pioneering peer-to-peer Sidecar ridesharing company that Union Square Ventures backed and that wound down in 2015, but the current content site states no operational or corporate ties to that defunct service. This profile is retained as a company/lead record with no active API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Sila Nanotechnologies
providers.description: Sila Nanotechnologies is a next-generation battery materials company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Alameda, California, with a commercial-scale manufacturing plant in Moses Lake, Washington. Sila develops silicon-based anode materials — marketed as Titan Silicon — that replace conventional graphite anodes to increase the energy density of lithium-ion batteries used in consumer electronics, electric vehicles, and other applications. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8VC and Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Sila is a physical materials and manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web and security posture only.

providers.name: Sizable Energy
providers.description: Sizable Energy is a Milan, Italy based clean-energy company developing offshore pumped hydro energy storage. Its patented system pairs subsea and floating reservoirs connected by pipes with reversible pump-turbines that move saturated sea-salt brine between them to deliver long-duration, grid-scale energy storage. The modular, scalable design leverages proven pumped-hydro technology with zero land use and integrates with floating wind and solar installations. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Playground Global; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Slip Robotics
providers.description: Slip Robotics is an Atlanta, Georgia-based robotics company that builds SlipBots, autonomous omnidirectional Automated Loading Robots (ALRs) that load and unload any truck trailer in about five minutes without a forklift ever entering the trailer. Each SlipBot carries up to eight pallets and roughly six tons, cutting driver dwell time from around ninety minutes to five while reducing material-handling damage and loading-dock accidents. The company also offers SlipLift, a platform that extends autonomous trailer loading and unloading to heavier freight and regional and last-mile routes. Slip Robotics markets its robots-as-a-service offering as requiring no IT integration, is backed by DCVC, and won Best New Innovation in supply chain technology at MODEX 2024. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Smartsign
providers.description: Smartsign (SmartSign) is a Brooklyn, New York-based e-commerce retailer of customizable signs, labels, and tags for regulatory, compliance, and safety applications, founded in 1999. It sells pre-designed and custom signage - safety, parking, traffic, property, and facility signs, plus banners and labels - online to businesses of all sizes, including a large share of the Fortune 1000 across education, healthcare, and industrial verticals. Norwest Venture Partners acquired the company in 2019 and Sentinel Capital Partners acquired it in September 2022. SmartSign operates as a business-to-business and business-to-consumer e-commerce storefront and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Substrate
providers.description: Substrate is a semiconductor manufacturing company building America's next-generation chip foundry, with the stated mission of returning the United States to dominance in advanced semiconductor fabrication. Rather than designing chips, the company is inventing manufacturing technology intended to extend Moore's Law while lowering the cost of building state-of-the-art fabs and the wafers they produce. Substrate is a hard-tech / advanced-manufacturing venture backed by General Catalyst; it is a physical-infrastructure company and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from the General Catalyst portfolio and enriched with the provider's public identity and security surface.

providers.name: Swiss Education Group
providers.description: Swiss Education Group (SEG) is a Montreux-based alliance of internationally celebrated hospitality, business, and culinary arts schools in Switzerland, comprising Cesar Ritz Colleges, Culinary Arts Academy Switzerland, Swiss Hotel Management School, and HIM Business School. Across five campuses it educates more than 6,000 students from over 110 nationalities in hospitality management, culinary arts, and business. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass SEG publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; this profile is maintained as a company/identity record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Synquote
providers.description: Synquote is a decentralized crypto options trading platform that lets traders obtain options quotes directly from market makers using a request-for-quote (RFQ) model. Founded in 2021 by former Google engineer Ahmed Attia and based in San Francisco, the platform offers European-style options across ETH, BTC, AVAX, LINK and MATIC with liquidity spanning 500+ instruments. It pairs a centralized-exchange-like experience (social/Google logins, two-click trading, zero-gas trading, maker rebates and low taker fees) with DeFi self-custody, and supports undercollateralized margin trading for liquidity providers to improve capital efficiency. Backed by Initialized Capital and Polygon, Synquote raised $2.8M and launched publicly in June 2023 after a beta exceeding $25M in notional volume. Added to the API Evangelist network as a crypto/DeFi portfolio profile.

providers.name: Synthekine
providers.description: Synthekine is a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering, developing, and commercializing the next generation of selective cytokine therapeutics. The company believes cytokine therapeutics engineered to be selective can fundamentally change the treatment paradigm for cancer and inflammatory disease. Synthekine's engineering platforms (including its surrogate/partial agonist and orthogonal cytokine-receptor approaches) are used to design cytokines and cytokine-based cell therapies with improved selectivity and tolerability. Backed by Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; Synthekine is a therapeutics developer and publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Tema
providers.description: Tema is a thematic, active ETF issuer founded in 2022 by CEO Maurits Pot (formerly of Goldman Sachs, Vitol and Kingsway Capital) and backed by Index Ventures, Accel and Zinal Growth in what the firm described as the largest venture round in ETFs to date. Tema builds institutional-grade, expert-led thematic exchange-traded funds spanning growth themes (space, oncology, electrification, reshoring, luxury) and core strategies, and is underpinned by an end-to-end ETF issuance infrastructure that also enables turnkey launches for external fund managers. The company is a consumer-facing asset manager; it publishes investor resources, fund pages, insights and educational content but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Temple
providers.description: Temple Capital is a cryptocurrency trading firm founded in 2018 that specializes in the algorithmic trading of liquid digital assets using machine learning technology. The firm has a seven-year live fund track record and manages over $75 million in assets on behalf of a diversified investor base, supported by a team of roughly 25 investment professionals across quantitative research, engineering, and operations. Backed by investors including Pantera Capital and Bain Capital, Temple Capital operates as a quantitative crypto hedge fund and does not currently publish a first-party developer API; its temple.capital marketing site is Wix-hosted and exposes a generic Wix Site MCP endpoint for AI agents.

providers.name: The Icon League
providers.description: The Icon League is a five-a-side (small-sided) football entertainment league co-founded by former Real Madrid and Germany midfielder Toni Kroos and German streamer Elias Nerlich (Eliasn97), operated by The Icon League GmbH of Cologne, Germany (Amtsgericht Köln, HRB 117138). Played indoors in a US-style 14-team franchise format with two 12-minute halves and "Rulebreaker" mechanics designed to maximize attacking play, the league blends professional and amateur players and is distributed primarily through livestreams and social platforms to a young German-speaking audience. Season one generated more than 1.3 billion social-media impressions, and the league raised a €15M Series A (backed by HV Capital) to professionalize operations and expand across Europe. This is a consumer sports-and-media property; it publishes a public content website (teams, players, standings, matchdays, news, tickets, shop) but exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: THG
providers.description: THG plc (formerly The Hut Group) is a UK-based consumer brands group founded in 2004 in Manchester and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Following the 2025 demerger of its Ingenuity technology and fulfilment division, THG is a pure-play consumer brands business operating two divisions: THG Beauty (home to Lookfantastic, Cult Beauty, Dermstore and prestige brand partners) and THG Nutrition (led by Myprotein, one of the world's largest online sports-nutrition brands). THG designs, manufactures and sells beauty and nutrition products direct-to-consumer across global markets. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital, an early investor. THG operates corporate, investor-relations and careers web properties but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Third Dimension AI
providers.description: Third Dimension AI is a spatial-generation company building high-fidelity 3D worlds and simulation for embodied AI, autonomy, robotics, gaming, and entertainment. Its core product, SuperSim, models the world across the full fidelity spectrum - from real-world reconstruction of scenes captured from sensor data to open-ended generative simulation - so autonomy teams can validate, train, and deploy AI systems and close the simulation-to-reality domain gap without hand-built 3D art. Founded by Tolga Kart (CEO) and Piotr Sokolski (CTO), with Oxford professor Christian Rupprecht as Chief Researcher, the team draws on experience from Wayve, Tesla, Google, Luma AI, Nvidia, Niantic, Amazon, and Unity. The company raised $7 million and is backed by Felicis. As of this profile it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; enrichment captured its identity and probed its domain security posture.

providers.name: Those Beyond
providers.description: Those Beyond is a fandom entertainment company that merges gaming and community into immersive, location-based and online experiences for fans, gamers, and creators. Built by the Cauldron Co studio and backed by Seedcamp, it runs interactive worlds and events tied to major fandoms (including Invincible- and SCP-branded experiences) alongside a Discord community. Its public surface is a consumer marketing site on Squarespace; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or /.well-known/ discovery documents.

providers.name: ThriveHive
providers.description: ThriveHive was a Boston-based guided marketing platform for small businesses (10 or fewer employees), founded in 2011 by Max Faingezicht and Adam Blake and part of the Techstars Boston 2015 class. It was acquired by Propel Marketing (GateHouse Media) in 2016 for $11.8M and the brand was folded into Gannett's LocaliQ after the 2019 GateHouse-Gannett merger. The company published no public API or developer portal; thrivehive.com now serves LocaliQ content behind an expired TLS certificate.

providers.name: Thundra
providers.description: Thundra was an application observability and security platform for serverless, container, and VM workloads, best known for AWS Lambda monitoring and debugging. Its products included Thundra APM (distributed tracing), Sidekick (remote debugging), and Foresight (CI pipeline test observability). Founded in 2018 out of OpsGenie and backed by Battery Ventures, its assets were acquired by Catchpoint in April 2023 and the service has been discontinued — thundra.io now redirects to Catchpoint's acquisition announcement and the GitHub organization states "Thundra is no longer in service." Its open-source agents and plugins remain published on npm, PyPI, Maven Central, NuGet, and pkg.go.dev.

providers.name: Tile
providers.description: Tile is a consumer-electronics company known for its Bluetooth tracker devices, used to locate everyday items such as keys, wallets, bags, and phones through a companion mobile app and a crowd-sourced Find network. Tile was acquired by Life360 in 2021; its former site thetileapp.com now 301-redirects to life360.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Tile publishes no public developer API — this profile captures its security posture (security.txt, a HackerOne responsible-disclosure program, and probed domain security).

providers.name: Timetric
providers.description: Timetric was a London-based data platform founded in 2008 for publishing, analysing, and performing calculations on large quantities of time-varying statistical data, later providing online market data, analysis, and advisory services to the insurance, construction, and infrastructure sectors. The Timetric Platform exposed an API with OAuth and API-token authentication for creating and updating time series. Timetric was acquired by GlobalData in March 2018 and timetric.com now redirects to globaldata.com; the company no longer operates independently.

providers.name: Titan Invest
providers.description: Titan (titan.com), operating the brand Titan Invest, is a wealth management firm founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City that serves high-performing technology professionals. Titan combines AI-assisted technology with dedicated human wealth teams to deliver actively managed portfolios, direct indexing and equity-diversification strategies, tax planning, and financial advisory for pre- and post-IPO tech employees, charging a 0.4% annual advisory fee. The company reports managing roughly $1.2B in assets for more than 10,000 clients and is backed by General Catalyst. Titan delivers its service through consumer web and mobile applications and advisor relationships; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal, so this profile captures the company identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Treecard
providers.description: Treecard was a Seedcamp-backed "walk to plant" climate consumer company that funded reforestation from everyday activity, originally through a wooden debit card and later a step-tracking mobile app. The company has shut down, and treecard.org now serves a closing notice thanking members and reporting 10,037,912 trees funded and 2,931,070 lifetime tons of carbon, pointing former users to Ecosia and Treekly while its planting projects live on at impact.veritree.com/treecard. Treecard published no public API, developer program, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Twirl
providers.description: Twirl is a data platform and orchestrator that lets teams build data products faster by combining BigQuery, dbt, Python, and Google Cloud services (GCS, Dataflow) in a single git-backed project. Backed by Creandum. As of July 2026 the twirldata.com website and docs.twirldata.com both return 404 (GitHub Pages) and no public API surface is available; the remaining public artifacts are the twirldata GitHub org (twirl-examples) and a placeholder PyPI package (twirldata 0.0.0, "Client SDK for the Twirl data platform").

providers.name: Twyla
providers.description: Twyla is an online marketplace for limited-edition art prints from contemporary artists, backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of July 2026 the twyla.com site is a landing page under redevelopment ("pardon our dust as we work on creating an even better online art marketplace and community") pointing visitors to its social channels, and the company publishes no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface — api.twyla.com and docs.twyla.com do not resolve.

providers.name: Tydo
providers.description: Tydo delivers autonomous audits for Shopify stores inside Claude. A single integration runs hundreds of audits - retention, shipping, email and SMS, and more - scoring a store against similar brands in its network, re-running on a cadence in the background, and routing every finding to a next step: fix it yourself, turn on an agent, or get matched to a vetted partner via dtcmvp. A Greylock portfolio company, currently waitlist-only with no public developer portal, API documentation, or published MCP endpoint.

providers.name: uberVU
providers.description: uberVU was a social media analytics and monitoring company, backed by Seedcamp, that offered brand-insight dashboards and a metrics API before being acquired by Hootsuite in 2014. The company no longer operates independently - ubervu.com now 301-redirects to blog.hootsuite.com/social-media-analytics/, its former metrics API is retired, and its GitHub organization is dormant. This profile is kept as a historical record of a VC-portfolio company with no current public API surface.

providers.name: Unikrn
providers.description: Unikrn was an esports betting and entertainment company founded in November 2014 by Rahul Sood and Karl Flores, headquartered in Seattle and backed by investors including Mark Cuban, Ashton Kutcher, 500 Global, and Pantera Capital. The platform offered real-money and token-based wagering on competitive video game tournaments (CS:GO, League of Legends, Dota 2, and more) and ran a $30M ICO for its UnikoinGold (UKG) cryptocurrency in 2017, which it later disabled as part of a 2021 SEC settlement. Unikrn was acquired by Entain in August 2021, and the unikrn.com betting site was permanently closed on October 20, 2023. The domain now serves only a farewell notice; the company publishes no APIs, developer portal, or public technical artifacts.

providers.name: uNow (UniversityNow)
providers.description: UniversityNow, Inc. (uNow) was a San Francisco-based higher-education startup founded in 2011 and backed by 500 Startups (500 Global) that built competency-based, self-paced online degree programs for working adults. It operated New Charter University, acquired Patten University in 2012, and its learning platform was sold to Penn Foster Education Group in 2016 and National University System in 2018. The company is defunct and unow.com now redirects to a dead page; it published no public API.

providers.name: Upverter
providers.description: Upverter is a browser-based, collaborative electronic design automation (EDA) platform for schematic capture and PCB layout, founded in Toronto in 2010 (Y Combinator W11) and acquired by Altium in 2017. Surfaced as a Version One Ventures portfolio company. As of the July 2026 enrichment probe the upverter.com platform returns HTTP 502 on every path, its docs/blog/status subdomains no longer resolve, and no public API surface remains; the GitHub organization is dormant since 2019.

providers.name: UrbanHire
providers.description: UrbanHire was an Indonesian all-in-one hiring and assessment platform (applicant tracking system) backed by 500 Global, designed to streamline recruitment and help employers hire the right talent. The company appears defunct - urbanhire.com has been offline behind Cloudflare (HTTP 530) with the last archived homepage from January 2021 - and it never published a public API or developer documentation. Its GitHub organization and first-party npm engineering packages remain the surviving technical footprint.

providers.name: Utopia
providers.description: Utopia was an online platform for designing, coding, and shipping React applications, pairing a visual design tool with a code editor over one source of truth. A 2020 Seedcamp portfolio company, it was built in the open as the MIT-licensed concrete-utopia/utopia monorepo (3.8k stars) with a first-party utopia-api npm library. The project has been dormant since mid-2025, utopia.app now serves a parked placeholder page, and no network API was ever published.

providers.name: Vaire Computing
providers.description: Vaire Computing is a deep-tech semiconductor startup building reversible computing chips for near-zero energy computing. Its reversible logic gates recover and recycle the energy of computation instead of dissipating it as heat, aiming to decouple energy consumption from growth in computing power. The company was co-founded by Rodolfo Rosini (CEO) and Dr Hannah Earley (CTO), is backed by Seedcamp, 7percent Ventures, and Lifeline Ventures, and publishes technology and software whitepapers. Vaire currently publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Valence
providers.description: Valence (Valence OS) is an early-stage mental-healthcare company backed by 500 Global, building continuous care that bridges the gap between therapy sessions. Its site describes an evidence-based system grounded in peer-reviewed research on mental-health trends, attrition factors, between-session care, and AI-augmented clinical support. Valence publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts as of July 2026.

providers.name: Vanti Analytics
providers.description: Vanti Analytics was an Israeli adaptive-AI-for-manufacturing company backed by Insight Partners, offering AI-based defect detection, early fault prediction, predictive quality, and process tuning across production lines via a hosted application (app.vanti-analytics.com). The company published no public API, OpenAPI spec, SDKs, or developer program, and as of 2026-07-21 it has no live web presence - vanti-analytics.com has lapsed and is parked by a third party, vanti.ai is for sale, and the former app/support/docs subdomains no longer resolve.

providers.name: Variant Bio
providers.description: Variant Bio is a biotechnology company developing life-saving therapies by studying the genes of people with exceptional health-related traits. Working with partner communities around the world under an ethical, benefit-sharing approach, the company pairs large-scale genomic discovery with data science to turn genetic diversity into novel drug targets across metabolic, cardiovascular and other disease areas. Surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst, Lux Capital and SoftBank Vision Fund and profiled in the API Evangelist network; Variant Bio publishes no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: Vertical Semiconductor
providers.description: Vertical Semiconductor is an MIT spinout developing next-generation vertical Gallium Nitride (GaN) power devices for AI data centers and grid infrastructure. Built on a decade of research from MIT's Palacios Group, its vertical GaN transistors push energy conversion closer to the chip with less power loss and heat, targeting high-voltage applications from 100V to over 2kV. The company claims up to 30% higher efficiency, a 50% smaller power footprint, and 10% lower total cost of ownership versus silicon, and has demonstrated its platform on 8-inch wafers using standard silicon CMOS manufacturing. It is a hardware/deep-tech power-electronics company with no public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI surface. Backed by Playground Global.

providers.name: Viajanet
providers.description: Viajanet is a Brazilian online travel agency (OTA) operated within the Despegar group, selling flights, hotels, vacation packages, car rentals and travel insurance to consumers in Brazil through www.viajanet.com.br. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Viajanet publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the enrichment pass captured its live security surface (a published security.txt with a Bugcrowd private bug bounty program run by the Despegar application-security team) and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Waabi
providers.description: Waabi is a Toronto-based artificial intelligence company founded in 2021 by Raquel Urtasun, pioneering Physical AI for autonomous driving and starting with self-driving trucks. Its flagship product, the Waabi Driver, pairs a generative-AI, end-to-end interpretable and verifiable autonomy stack with sensors and compute, trained and validated in Waabi World, a high-fidelity neural closed-loop simulator, and designed for factory-level OEM integration and large-scale commercialization. Waabi is a product/technology company: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signal rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Wildtype
providers.description: Wildtype is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of crv, spark-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: food. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Wishbird Experiences
providers.description: Wishbird Experiences is Mexico's largest online marketplace for gift experiences, offering more than 450 original activities across the country, from adrenaline adventures like skydiving and bungee jumping to spa treatments, gourmet dining, hot-air-balloon and helicopter flights, and weekend getaways. Experiences are sold as gift cards (Wishcards and Wishbox products) redeemable within a twelve-month window, with checkout via credit card, PayPal, and Mercado Pago. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce business and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Wivity
providers.description: Wivity Inc. is a Web3 governance consultancy that helps organizations form blockchain consortia and infrastructure DAOs, design Web3 infrastructure, and optimize decentralized governance through its Wivity Governance framework, drawing on experience running standards working groups for organizations like the SunSpec Alliance and OMA3. A 500 Global portfolio company, Wivity does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or client libraries.

providers.name: Workbounce
providers.description: Workbounce was an AI-powered revenue and sales enablement platform that gave sales reps instant answers to deal-blocking questions by connecting company documents and knowledge to AI-powered search, delivered through a Slack bot and Chrome extension. Co-founded by Adam Smith and Rowan Bailey and backed by Index Ventures. As of July 2026 workbounce.com returns HTTP 402 (Vercel DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED) and the company appears defunct; no public API, developer docs, SDKs, or packages were ever published.

providers.name: XING Mobility
providers.description: XING Mobility (行競科技) is a Taiwan-based battery technology company building immersion-cooled lithium battery systems under the IMMERSIO brand, including cell-to-pack (CTP) battery platforms, battery backup units (BBU) for AI data centers, and the automotive-grade XBE energy storage series, serving electric mobility, energy storage (ESS), marine, and data center markets from its Taoyuan City headquarters. A 500 Global portfolio company, XING Mobility publishes no public developer API or API documentation as of July 2026.

providers.name: Xscape Photonics
providers.description: Xscape Photonics is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of addition and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ai-infrastructure. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: YoloRekt
providers.description: YOLOrekt is a social, hyper-gamified DeFi prediction-markets dApp where users bid on the short-term future price of crypto assets such as ETH, BTC, and MATIC, or provide in-game liquidity to earn game fees and YOLO rewards. Built on the Polygon network for high transaction speed, negligible fees, and full EVM support, YOLOrekt is delivered as Ethereum and Polygon smart contracts (including a first-of-its-kind synced dual-token issuance across both chains) rather than a traditional REST/GraphQL API. Backed by Pantera Capital and surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a crypto portfolio company; the yolorekt.finance domain no longer resolves and the project appears dormant, with its surviving public surface being the YOLOrekt GitHub organization, community bug-bounty programs, and the YOLOrekt Medium publication.

providers.name: Zest AI
providers.description: Zest AI is an AI-powered lending technology company that provides credit underwriting, fraud detection, and lending intelligence software to credit unions, banks, and specialty lenders. Its machine-learning models automate credit decisioning and risk assessment, and the company reports operating over 600 active lending models in production. Zest AI operates as a B2B SaaS platform delivered to financial institutions rather than as a public developer API; no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or self-service developer surface were found during enrichment.

providers.name: Akara
providers.description: Akara is a healthcare automation company building AI-powered systems for the operating room and clinical environments. Its platform combines the Akara AI Sensor, a thermal-only computer-vision system that passively tracks surgical and procedure events without capturing identifiable patient data (named to TIME's Best Inventions list); the Akara AI Platform, which delivers real-time OR monitoring, automated alerts, interactive dashboards, analytics, and Clara, an AI chat assistant for exploring surgical data and optimizing scheduling; and the Akara UV Robot (Violet), a fully autonomous UV-C disinfection robot that generates 3D UV dose maps and disinfects occupied clinical spaces up to six times faster than manual cleaning. Akara is trusted by hospitals across Europe and the US. The company does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile tracks its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: AND Global
providers.description: AND Global is a fintech-as-a-service company operating across the Asia-Pacific region, with offices in Mongolia, Singapore, Japan, the Philippines, and Thailand. It builds software that lets banks and lenders launch digital lending and financial products, integrating with banking and payment systems through APIs and other means. Its solutions span automated lending lifecycle management (Looms), custom and AI/ML credit scoring (Scorecard Builder, Custom AI Scoring, Niko AutoML), intelligent document processing (Mindox), omnichannel customer data, document management (DMS), and a collaborative investment platform (Oasis). Consumer-facing brands include the LendMN and Lend Pinoy digital lending platforms. AND Global was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; no public developer portal or API documentation was found at profiling time.

providers.name: Arcion Labs
providers.description: Arcion Labs, Inc. built a distributed, in-memory change data capture (CDC) platform for real-time enterprise database replication. Its agentless, zero-code pipelines replicated data with low latency and high availability across 20+ enterprise databases and data warehouses (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks Delta Lake and more), driven by a YAML CLI, a workflow UI, and an API, with built-in schema conversion and evolution. Founded by CTO Rajkumar Sen and later led by CEO Gary Hagmueller, and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Databricks Ventures, Arcion was acquired by Databricks in November 2023 (deal valued at over $100M) and its technology now underpins Databricks Lakeflow Connect. This profile is retained for network history; the standalone product is no longer independently marketed.

providers.name: Arrakis
providers.description: Arrakis Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company pioneering RNA-targeted small molecules (rSMs) as a new class of genetic medicines. Its rSM platform enables orally available small molecules to bind RNA and modulate previously undruggable biological pathways, with an industrialized discovery toolkit spanning multiple modalities. The lead proprietary program targets Type 1 Myotonic Dystrophy (DM1) at the root cause of the disease, alongside a pipeline of proprietary and partnered programs. A GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company in the life-sciences sector, Arrakis was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes a corporate and scientific website but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: AutoStore
providers.description: AutoStore is a global warehouse robotics and technology company headquartered in Nedre Vats, Norway, that pioneered the cube storage automated storage and retrieval system (AS/RS). Its goods-to-person solution combines autonomous robots, an aluminum storage grid of stacked bins, workstation ports, and controlling software (marketed as CubeVerse, spanning design, simulation, operations, and predictive diagnostics) to fulfill orders in a fraction of the floor space of conventional warehouses. With more than 1,950 systems deployed across nearly 65 countries, AutoStore serves retail, grocery, 3PL, healthcare, and industrial customers. Systems are distributed, designed, installed, and serviced through a global network of qualified system integrators rather than a public developer/API program. AutoStore was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: B/E Aerospace
providers.description: B/E Aerospace was a manufacturer of aircraft cabin interior products and a provider of aerospace services for commercial aircraft and business jets. The company was acquired by Rockwell Collins in 2017 and subsequently merged into Collins Aerospace (a Raytheon Technologies subsidiary) in 2020. B/E Aerospace products included seating, food and beverage preparation equipment, lighting systems, and oxygen systems for commercial and business aviation.

providers.name: Barefoot Networks
providers.description: Barefoot Networks was a computer-networking company founded in 2013 in Santa Clara, California, that designed and produced programmable network-switch silicon, systems, and software. Its flagship Tofino Intelligent Fabric Processor was the first end-user-programmable Ethernet switch ASIC, built on the Protocol Independent Switch Architecture (PISA) and programmed with the P4 language at line rates up to 12.8 Tbit/s. Developer tooling spanned the P4 Studio SDK, the Barefoot Runtime Interface (BRI) control-plane API, and the Tofino Native Architecture (TNA). Intel acquired Barefoot Networks in June 2019, folding the technology into Intel Tofino / Intel Intelligent Fabric Processors; the barefootnetworks.com corporate site now redirects into Intel, and the surviving open documentation lives in the barefootnetworks GitHub organization (notably the Open-Tofino repository publishing the public TNA and P4 architecture docs).

providers.name: Berry Global
providers.description: Berry Global is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products, nonwoven specialty materials, and engineered materials for consumer and industrial end markets. In 2024, Berry Global merged with Amcor to form one of the world's largest packaging companies. Berry's products include rigid open top packaging, closures and dispensing systems, flexible packaging, tapes, and engineered materials.

providers.name: Bio-Rad Laboratories
providers.description: Bio-Rad Laboratories is a global leader in developing and manufacturing a wide range of products for the life science research and clinical diagnostic markets, including instruments, reagents, consumables, software, and services. Founded in 1952, Bio-Rad serves scientists in genomics, proteomics, cell biology, quality control, and clinical diagnostics with products like real-time PCR systems, western blotting instruments, flow cytometers, and digital PCR.

providers.name: Buddy
providers.description: The fastest continuous integration and continuous delivery platform

providers.name: Catalyx Space
providers.description: Catalyx Space Inc. is a San Francisco based space infrastructure company building an integrated platform for deploying payloads to low Earth orbit and returning them safely to the ground. The company develops autonomous orbital labs and reusable reentry vehicles (ReX) that use origami-inspired hypersonic decelerator technology to deliver heavy-mass downmass from orbit to ocean recovery zones, positioning itself as the fastest and most affordable way to deploy experiments and manufacture in orbit. Catalyx handles end-to-end space operations including spacecraft development, payload integration, launch logistics, mission control, and recovery. Surfaced as a Techstars (and Outlander) portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company currently publishes a marketing and careers presence but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Clue (BioWink)
providers.description: Clue, operated by BioWink GmbH in Berlin, Germany, is a science-driven menstrual, ovulation, pregnancy, and reproductive health tracking app with 100M+ downloads across 190+ countries. The product portfolio spans Clue (free tier), Clue Plus (subscription), Clue Conceive, Clue Pregnancy, Clue Perimenopause, and a "Clue (No Period)" mode for non-bleeding hormonal cycles. Clue Connect provides partner sharing. The company contributes anonymized real-world data to academic research partnerships with Stanford, University of Oxford, UC Berkeley, MIT, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Clue is a consumer mobile product; no public developer API or partner API portal has been identified. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: CODEX.md
providers.description: CODEX.md is a project-level Markdown memory file that the OpenAI Codex CLI loads to bootstrap an AI coding agent with persistent project instructions, coding conventions, build and test commands, and team conventions. The OpenAI Codex CLI now standardizes on AGENTS.md as the canonical filename, with CODEX.md and codex.md historically used and still recognized as fallback configuration filenames. Files are discovered through a three-tier hierarchy spanning the user's home directory, the Git repository root, and the current working directory, with closer files overriding earlier guidance when concatenated into the model prompt.

providers.name: Cumulus Networks
providers.description: Cumulus Networks was a computer networking company founded in 2010 that developed Cumulus Linux, an open Linux-based network operating system for bare-metal and white-box data-center switches, along with NetQ, a network operations and telemetry platform. It was a pioneer of open, disaggregated networking, letting operators run a standard Linux distribution on commodity switching hardware. NVIDIA acquired Cumulus Networks in May 2020, and the products are now part of NVIDIA's Ethernet switching and networking software line. The former cumulusnetworks.com and docs.cumulusnetworks.com domains now redirect to NVIDIA's networking documentation. Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, Battery Ventures, and Wing Venture Capital.

providers.name: CYBAVO
providers.description: CYBAVO was a digital asset security company (founded 2018, Taipei/Singapore) providing institutional-grade cryptocurrency custody and wallet infrastructure. Its flagship CYBAVO Vault delivered MPC-based (Multi-Party Computation) custody with a policy/workflow engine, REST API, and client SDKs, alongside the CYBAVO Wallet App SDK for embedding secure private-key storage into mobile apps. Circle Internet Financial acquired CYBAVO in June 2022; the team and technology became the foundation of Circle Web3 Services and Circle Programmable Wallets. The cybavo.com developer surface has since been wound down (redirects to circle.com), but the first-party @cybavo Wallet/Auth SDKs remain published on npm and are maintained under Circle's circlefin GitHub organization.

providers.name: Cyrus Biotechnology
providers.description: Cyrus Biotechnology is a Seattle-based protein-design and drug-discovery company building novel biologics for serious unmet medical needs by re-engineering existing proteins with a tight loop between computational modeling and lab testing. Its flagship product, Cyrus Bench, is a cloud-based protein modeling and structure-prediction platform that packages the Rosetta software suite (alongside deep-learning tools such as AlphaFold, OpenFold, RoseTTAFold and ProteinMPNN) behind a browser-based interface for homology modeling, protein/protein and enzyme/ligand interface design, protein stabilization, protein/ligand and protein/protein docking, and X-ray molecular replacement. Cyrus Bench is delivered as a hosted web application with user documentation rather than a public developer REST API; the company is backed by Trinity Ventures.

providers.name: Defer
providers.description: Defer was a Paris-based, Y Combinator-backed (W23) zero-infrastructure background jobs platform for Node.js and TypeScript developers, founded in 2022 by Bryan Frimin and Charly Poly. The product converted regular JavaScript/TypeScript async functions into managed background jobs with configurable retries, throttling, concurrency controls, scheduled crons, multi-environment support, alerting, and a hosted dashboard — removing the need for developers to operate their own queues, workers, and Redis-style infrastructure. Defer shipped client SDKs and framework integrations (Next.js, RedwoodJS) and a CLI/build pipeline that uploaded function bundles to the Defer cloud for execution. The company appears to have wound down its hosted service in 2024 — the defer.run domain now 301-redirects to digger.tools, no end-of-service post-mortem is publicly linked from the homepage, and the GitHub organization (github.com/defer-run) last saw meaningful activity in July 2024 with the final defer.client release v2.3.0 cut on 2024-03-06. The open source client libraries remain available but are effectively unmaintained and the hosted backend they depended on is no longer operational. This catalog entry preserves the historical footprint of Defer as part of the 2022-2024 wave of "zero-infrastructure" background-job and durable- execution startups (Inngest, Trigger.dev, Hatchet, Temporal Cloud, Restate) so the design pattern and the players who pursued it remain discoverable in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Flo Health
providers.description: Flo Health operates the Flo app, a leading consumer period, ovulation, pregnancy, and reproductive health tracker with hundreds of millions of downloads worldwide. The product surface includes cycle tracking, ovulation and pregnancy predictions, an AI-assisted symptom checker, Secret Chats, Flo for Partners (partner-shared mode), Anonymous Mode, and a Premium subscription tier. Flo's Medical Affairs team partners with clinicians and researchers on women's health science. Flo is a consumer mobile product; no public developer API or partner API portal has been identified at this time. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: Fritz.ai
