providers.description: Fritz.ai was a Boston-based mobile, on-device machine learning platform, backed by Uncork Capital, that gave iOS and Android developers SDKs plus a hosted service for training, deploying, and managing ML models directly on devices. That original developer platform has since wound down, and the fritz.ai domain now hosts an unrelated AI-tools review and ranking content site (guides, glossary, interviews, and tool comparisons) with no public API, SDK, or developer program. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from the Uncork Capital portfolio graph and is retained as a historical company record; no live API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Gas POS
providers.description: Gas Pos is a North Little Rock, Arkansas technology company (founded 2015) that builds cloud-based point-of-sale systems and EMV-certified fuel dispensers for gas stations and truck stops across the United States. Delivered as equipment-as-a-service with no upfront hardware cost, the platform pairs touchscreen POS terminals, barcode scanners, and back-office inventory and pricing tools with PCI-compliant, EMV-certified payment processing at both the register and the pump. It accepts major fleet cards including Comdata, Comchek, EFS, T-Chek, Voyager, and Fleetone, and lets operators manage item pricing and inventory remotely from a phone. Backed by 500 Global and Pioneer Fund. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface has been located to date.

providers.name: GEMINI.md
providers.description: GEMINI.md is the project context file convention used by the Google Gemini CLI to provide project-specific instructions, coding standards, architectural notes, and development workflows to the Gemini AI agent. The format follows a hierarchical, plain Markdown structure that the Gemini CLI loads automatically from the working directory and parent directories, layering global, project, and subproject context. It mirrors similar agent context conventions like CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md.

providers.name: Habana Labs
providers.description: Habana Labs is an artificial-intelligence processor company, now part of Intel, that designs deep-learning accelerators for AI training and inference. Its Gaudi (training) and Goya (inference) processors — sold today as the Intel Gaudi 2 and Gaudi 3 AI accelerators — are programmed through the SynapseAI software suite, which integrates with PyTorch and DeepSpeed and ships reference models, containers, and installation tooling. Habana was founded in 2016 in Israel and acquired by Intel in 2019. Its public developer surface is not a hosted web API but an open-source SDK and toolchain: the HabanaAI GitHub organization (reference models, PyTorch bridge, setup/install, plus vLLM and Megatron forks) and the Intel Gaudi documentation at docs.habana.ai. This profile catalogs that developer footprint for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hapag-Lloyd
providers.description: A German multinational container shipping company and one of the world's largest liner shipping companies. Operates a fleet of over 250 vessels serving approximately 600 ports across 130 countries with a focus on quality and reliability. Provides a public API portal (api-portal.hlag.com) exposing container tracking, schedule, and booking APIs to customers, partners, and logistics platforms.

providers.name: Hinge
providers.description: Hinge is a relationship-oriented dating app owned by Match Group, marketed as "designed to be deleted" with a product focus on prompt-driven profiles and compatibility matching intended to drive actual dates rather than prolonged in-app engagement. Hinge Labs is the company's in-house research arm publishing data on dating behavior and outcomes. Hinge is a consumer mobile product; no public developer or partner API has been identified. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: Interlink
providers.description: interLink is an abstraction layer that extends the Kubernetes Virtual Kubelet interface, enabling pods to execute on remote resources such as HPC batch systems (SLURM, HTCondor), virtual machines, remote Kubernetes clusters, and serverless platforms. It comprises a Virtual Kubelet that converts pod execution requests into remote API calls and a modular interLink API Server with provider-specific sidecar plugins, with built-in OpenTelemetry observability, TLS/mTLS, and OAuth2 authentication.

providers.name: Joes Future Food (Zhouzi Future)
providers.description: Joes Future Food (周子未来 / Nanjing Zhouzi Future Food Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Nanjing-based cellular agriculture and food-technology company pioneering cultivated (cell-cultured) meat in China. The founding team produced what it describes as China's first piece of cultivated meat, and the company develops cell-cultured pork products (pork belly, fatback, skin, meatballs, and a mixed family pack) alongside serum-free culture media and a catalog of primary and gene-edited animal cell lines (porcine adipose and muscle stem cells, bovine muscle and adipose cells, chicken embryo fibroblasts, and more) used across cultivated-meat research and biomanufacturing. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners. The company runs a corporate marketing website and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Moonwalk Biosciences
providers.description: Moonwalk Biosciences is a preclinical biotechnology company pioneering therapeutics in adipose biology driven by deep genetic and epigenetic insights. Co-founded by Feng Zhang, Alex Aravanis, Arash Jamshidi and Justin Valley, the company developed a multiplex epigenetic engineering platform and has publicly shifted its focus toward siRNA-based obesity and cardiometabolic therapies. It is a private, research-stage drug-discovery organization backed by GV; its public surface is a corporate/marketing website covering its science, pipeline, team, careers and news, with no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable discovery documents.

providers.name: National Gallery of Art
providers.description: The National Gallery of Art is a national art museum in Washington, D.C., located on the National Mall. The Gallery provides open access to images and data about its art collection through its Open Access program. While the Gallery does not publish a documented public REST API, it releases a comprehensive open dataset of more than 130,000 artworks and associated creators in CSV format under Creative Commons Zero licensing through its GitHub repository, with reconciled Wikidata Q-item identifiers for research interoperability.

providers.name: Neuroware.io
providers.description: Neuroware is a Malaysia-based blockchain infrastructure provider that has been building distributed-ledger applications since 2010, working with government agencies and regulated fintech operators. Its flagship Cortex platform offers a unified interface for managing multiple blockchains and protocols, powered by private, use-case-customized APIs delivering identity, authentication and role management, distributed data and document storage, custom token generation and analytics, and cryptographic keyless e-wallets. Related products include COKEEPS (regulated digital-asset custody), OVIATO (PassKey-native self-custody wallet infrastructure), and R1 (training and consultancy). Neuroware also created the earlier Blockstrap blockchain application stack and API. No current public, documented API or OpenAPI surface is published; APIs are delivered privately per engagement.

providers.name: Nofence
providers.description: Nofence is a Norwegian agritech company (founded 2011, headquartered in Batnfjordsøra, Norway) that produces the world's first commercial virtual fencing system for livestock. Solar-powered GPS collars worn by cattle, sheep and goats keep animals inside virtual pastures that farmers draw on a map, with the collar teaching animals boundaries through audio cues before a mild electric pulse. The system is operated entirely from a mobile app (iOS and Android) and a web portal, communicating over GPS and the cellular network with no base stations or buried wire. Farmers get real-time animal location, boundary/escape push notifications, herd replay, grazing-history and multi-species management. Nofence is a consumer/farmer-facing product: as of this profile it publishes a mobile app and web portal but no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface. It is a portfolio company of Speedinvest, added to the API Evangelist network for tracking.

providers.name: Notco
providers.description: NotCo (The Not Company) is a food-technology company founded in 2015 in Santiago, Chile that uses artificial intelligence — its proprietary "Giuseppe" platform — to reverse-engineer animal-based foods from plant ingredients. Its consumer brand at notco.com sells plant-based products including NotMilk, NotMayo, NotBurger and NotIceCream across the Americas, while NotCo AI (notco.ai) licenses the Giuseppe AI R&D platform to global CPG manufacturers such as PepsiCo, Magnum and Barry Callebaut to accelerate food-product innovation. The company is backed by General Catalyst and other investors. NotCo publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its corporate, product, AI-platform and trust/compliance web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ocean Network Express
providers.description: Ocean Network Express (ONE) is a Singapore-headquartered global container liner shipping company formed in 2017 through the integration of the container shipping businesses of three Japanese carriers — Nippon Yusen Kaisha (NYK), Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL), and Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (K-Line) — with commercial operations launching on 1 April 2018. Operating under the magenta "ONE" brand and the Standard Carrier Alpha Code ONEY, the company runs a fleet exceeding 2,200,000 TEU across 165+ weekly service loops calling at 244+ ports worldwide, making it one of the largest ocean container carriers globally. ONE participates in THE Alliance vessel sharing agreement and offers reefer, dangerous goods, out-of-gauge, and project cargo services alongside standard dry container moves. Its customer-facing digital surface centers on the ONE eCommerce platform (ecomm.one-line.com), which provides cargo tracking, instant quotation via ONE QUOTE (powered by Descartes Kontainers), spot booking, shipping instructions, electronic bill of lading, ePayment, and demurrage/detention inquiry. A partner-facing developer portal exists at developers.one-line.com alongside EDI integration channels, but ONE does not publish a fully open, self-service OpenAPI specification, public SDK, or open-source code at either the github.com/ocean-network-express or github.com/OceanNetworkExpress organizations (both exist with zero public repositories). Tracking, booking, and schedule integrations are most commonly accessed by shippers and BCOs through third-party aggregators (Vizion, Portcast, JSONCargo, Terminal49, Tradlinx) or via DCSA-conformant carrier APIs delivered under commercial agreement.

providers.name: OSGi
providers.description: OSGi is a set of specifications that define a dynamic component system for Java. It enables modular, service-oriented Java applications by managing the life cycle, dependencies, and services of bundles at runtime. OSGi is a Java/JVM technology and does not expose REST APIs of its own.

providers.name: Picasso
providers.description: Picasso is an image downloading and caching library for Android, focused on simplicity and minimal disk space usage. It is an open-source project by Square. Picasso is a client-side library, not a hosted HTTP API.

providers.name: Pokkt
providers.description: Pokkt is a mobile-first advertising and app monetization platform, part of AnyMind Group, serving app publishers and game developers with SDK-based ad monetization (rewarded video, interstitial, and video advertising) and serving advertisers with performance campaigns, remarketing, and connected-TV (CTV) inventory across India, Southeast Asia, and MENA. The platform operates through a web console for campaign management, targeting, exchange-log tracking, pixel-based post-click engagement, and reporting. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and is being enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public OpenAPI, SDK registry package, or machine-readable API surface has been confirmed.

providers.name: AlixPartners
providers.description: AlixPartners is a global consulting firm founded in 1981 in Detroit, with over 3,500 people across more than 40 countries, specializing in turnaround and restructuring, corporate performance improvement, M&A, investigations, and digital/AI transformation. AlixPartners does not publish a public developer portal or REST API surface; technology value is delivered through client-specific engagements, proprietary tools such as the AI Profit Engine for retail and the Rapid G&A Diagnostic, and a flagship public thought leadership surface anchored by the annual AlixPartners Disruption Index (3,200+ executives across 11 countries and 10 industries) and the AlixTalks podcast (RSS via Podbean). Public consumption is via the alixpartners.com website, downloadable PDF reports, an email subscription preference center, and the AlixTalks Podbean RSS feed.

providers.name: Alpha Biopharma
providers.description: Alpha Biopharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, with an additional office in Beijing. The company focuses on the clinical development and commercialization of global innovative drugs across oncology and immunotherapy, spanning medical affairs, clinical operations, regulatory affairs and commercialization. Its lead product is Zorifertinib (formerly AZD-3759, marketed as Zorifer), a next-generation EGFR TKI designed for EGFR mutation positive advanced NSCLC patients with central nervous system metastases, which received NMPA approval in November 2024 as the first EGFR-TKI indicated for lung cancer with brain metastases. Alpha Biopharma also partners with Wugen Inc. on universal off-the-shelf memory NK and CAR-T cell therapies. The company raised a Series A led by Qiming Venture Partners. Alpha Biopharma publishes a corporate marketing website only and operates no public API, developer portal, or software platform.

providers.name: Axolotl
providers.description: Collection of axolotl pictures and facts

providers.name: Basis Set Ventures
providers.description: Basis Set Ventures is an AI-native, early-stage venture capital firm founded in 2017 by Dr. Lan Xuezhao and headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. The firm invests at the seed and early stages in founders building artificial intelligence across AI infrastructure, autonomous systems, molecular and materials discovery, agentic development tooling, intelligent collaboration, and automated workflows. Basis Set announced a $250M Fund IV and describes itself as "the first capital when it's just you and your vision," pairing capital with an operator-led founder concierge team. Portfolio companies include Path Robotics, Quince, Sakana AI, Tigris Data, Mem0, OpenArt, Cusp, Simular, Vizcom, and Entire. This is an API Evangelist network profile of the firm; Basis Set Ventures does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs, so this record captures firm identity, web properties, and derived security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Beyond Imagination
providers.description: Beyond Imagination, Inc. is a Los Angeles based robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in January 2018 by Dr. Harry Kloor and Dr. Ray Kurzweil, building general-purpose humanoid robots and the AI software stack that runs them. Its flagship platform is Beomni, a wheeled humanoid robot with an articulated upper body and dexterous hands that can be teleoperated through VR headsets and haptic gloves or run autonomously. The software side is marketed as four products: AURA (Adaptive Unified Robotic/Human Administrator), a universal operating system for coordinating robots, humans and infrastructure across manufacturing ecosystems; ARCANA, an LLM-free synthetic brain architecture for real-time perception, decision making and coordination; Expert Minds, modular AI job modules trained for specialized roles such as chemical handling, bio-reactor operation, surgical prep and warehouse logistics; and Hive Mind Intelligence, a fleet learning layer where robots upload new skills to a shared cloud memory. The company has run pilot programs in commercial kitchens, laboratory work, healthcare and pharmaceutical manufacturing, and announced a manufacturing partnership with Korean electronics manufacturer Dreamtech. As of this profiling pass Beyond Imagination publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, SDKs or MCP/agent surface; its public web presence is a marketing site only.

providers.name: BioTheryX
providers.description: BioTheryX is a private, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, discovering and developing first-in-class targeted protein degraders — both bifunctional degraders and molecular glues — for cancer and inflammatory disease. Its proprietary PRODEGY platform is built on Cereblon-binding expertise carried over from founders who worked on FDA-approved Cereblon modulators. The lead program BTX-9341, a dual CDK4/CDK6 degrader, is in Phase 1 for HR+/HER2- breast cancer, alongside BTX-10908 targeting SOS1 for pan-KRAS mutant cancers and PDE4 degraders for inflammatory conditions; the company also partners with Incyte on molecular glue degrader discovery. BioTheryX is a therapeutics developer with no public developer program: probes on 2026-08-02 returned 404 for /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs, /llms.txt and every /.well-known/ discovery path on biotheryx.com, and there is no api./developer./docs./portal. subdomain, GitHub organization, or published SDK.

providers.name: Bluevoyant
providers.description: BlueVoyant is a cyber defense company that combines managed detection and response (MDR), digital risk protection, and supply-chain (third-party) cyber risk management into a cloud-native platform backed by a global security operations capability. It continuously monitors customers' internal networks, endpoints, and cloud along with their external attack surface and vendor ecosystem, using threat intelligence to detect, investigate, and remediate threats. BlueVoyant serves enterprises and governments across sectors and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead (8vc); this profile is maintained by the enrichment pipeline against public sources.

providers.name: Bowery Capital
providers.description: Bowery Capital is a B2B-focused venture capital firm that leads Pre-Seed and Seed rounds in founders "modernizing business through technology." It concentrates on SaaS and marketplace companies, with particular interest in vertical AI and back-office software, and takes lead-investor positions that it supports hands-on through four pillars: Growth (go-to-market and sales enablement), Talent (hiring, culture, and benefits), Business Development (pipeline and customer introductions), and a Revenue Council advisory network of operators. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Foundry Group. Bowery Capital is an investor rather than an API provider and publishes no developer API surface.

Its product line spans standard ready-mix batches and higher-performance "Super Concrete" variants used for mass-concrete pours. At the time of enrichment Brik publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook surface; this record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Horizon Media
providers.description: Horizon Media is the largest independent media agency in the United States, founded in 1989 by Bill Koenigsberg and headquartered at 75 Varick Street in New York with offices in Los Angeles and Toronto. The agency employs roughly 2,300+ people, is ranked the third largest US media agency by COMvergence, and manages an estimated $8.7 billion in billings. Horizon operates a portfolio of specialty units (Horizon Next for performance, Blue Hour Studios for social/creator, Night Market for retail media, Scout Sports for sponsorship via Horizon Sports & Experiences, and the WHY Group for cultural insights) and runs a proprietary data and AI stack anchored by the Blu platform. In 2025 Horizon formed Horizon Global, a 50/50 US joint venture with Havas positioned at roughly $20 billion in combined billings, merging Blu with Havas Converged into a shared platform branded BluConverged, and is also building Horizon OS (Open Sphere) as an orchestration layer over the programmatic ad-tech stack. providers.name: Knotel
providers.description: Knotel is a flexible workspace and managed office provider that designs, builds, and operates tailored office space for companies across a global network of locations including Amsterdam, Austin, Berlin, London, Miami, and Paris (through its Deskeo partner). Its business is organized around managed office experiences, member work clubs such as Wyncatcher and Old Sessions House, and a services arm covering design and delivery, fit-out, furniture, amenity and hospitality, workplace strategy, technology and AV, catering, and day-to-day workplace operations. Knotel also works directly with brokers and with building owners who want space leased and operated on their behalf. Knotel is a real estate services business and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; its member-facing mobile app is a white-labeled deployment of the Spacebring coworking platform. The one machine-readable surface it does publish is an llms.txt describing its site for AI agents, alongside a robots.txt that explicitly permits the major AI crawlers.

providers.name: LemonBox
providers.description: LemonBox (来檬) is a health-technology brand working in AI-generative personalized nutrition. Founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley, incubated at the University of Chicago Polsky Center in 2017, and accepted into Y Combinator in 2018, it entered the Chinese market that year and is now headquartered in Shanghai. LemonBox builds individualized daily vitamin and supplement packs from a three-minute FFQ (food frequency questionnaire) nutrition assessment scored by its LemonAlgo adaptive engine, then fulfills them one pack at a time (MOQ=1) through its Personalization Fulfillment Center in Hong Kong. The company reports serving more than 10 million cumulative users as of 2026 and sells both direct-to-consumer and B2B. Investors include Y Combinator and Partech. LemonBox operates a consumer web and WeChat mini-program experience and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its agent-facing surface is limited to a published /llms.txt and a robots.txt that explicitly allow-lists generative-AI crawlers.

providers.name: LINSOL Co.,Ltd.
providers.description: LINSOL Co.,Ltd. (린솔) is a safety-technology company headquartered in Daejeon, South Korea, founded as an in-house venture spun out of Hanwha Aerospace. LINSOL adapts acoustic detection techniques originally developed for defense landmine applications into commercial real-time hazard, accident, and environmental detection. Its product line includes Karang F (driving-environment detection), Karang S (precision acoustic signal transmission), SkyShield (fall detection), BR, Acoustic Eye (aerial security), and Safety Nova (smart integrated safety platform), sold into industrial safety, ESG, and defense security use cases. The company operates a Daejeon headquarters and research center plus a Goheung branch. LINSOL ships hardware and integrated platforms; as of a 2026-07-19 probe it publishes no public developer API, portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: MisMar
providers.description: MisMar (مسمار) is a Saudi Arabian automotive maintenance and repair platform that connects vehicle owners with certified service centers. It runs a consumer mobile app (B2C) alongside a Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) platform and Workshop Management System (WMS) that digitize fleet management, order processing, and workshop operations for business (B2B), government (B2G), and insurance partners. Services span fault diagnostics, accident restoration, oil and battery and tire changes, periodic maintenance, car wash, and protective treatments across 45+ Saudi cities, with at-home or center-based delivery and warranty coverage. MisMar is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is currently published.

providers.name: Rollup AI
providers.description: Rollup is a browser-based, real-time collaboration platform for engineering teams building complex hardware. It supports the full hardware development lifecycle across modular tools for systems engineering, systems modeling, requirements management, technical documentation, CAD viewing, and design reviews, with modules that interlink so changes propagate across a project. Rollup markets first-class APIs and developer-friendly features so teams can integrate it into new and existing systems; the platform exposes a REST API (authenticated with API keys or OAuth tokens) with pagination and websockets. Rollup serves early-stage hardware companies from small satellite builders to robotics firms, and offers Self-hosted and GovCloud options for ITAR/EAR export-controlled data. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Thiel Capital ($5.6M seed) and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company.

The firm invests across eight sectors — Health and PharmaTech, Enterprise AI, Cybersecurity, Fintech, Consumer, Applied AI/ML and Vertical SaaS, AI/ML Infrastructure and Developer Tools, and Enterprise Infrastructure and Developer Tools — and supports portfolio founders with a team of engineers, data scientists, operators, recruiters, and advisors. SignalFire's differentiator is Beacon AI, a proprietary data platform the firm spent roughly a decade building that tracks more than 80 million companies and 650 million employees across hundreds of billions of data points to power sourcing, talent, and go-to-market intelligence for both the firm and its portfolio. SignalFire does not publish any public developer APIs — Beacon AI is an internal platform offered as a service to portfolio companies, not a third-party product.

providers.name: Twine Ventures
providers.description: Twine Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm "transforming human and planetary health," writing first checks into interdisciplinary, data-obsessed founders who use data and AI to transform legacy industries across healthcare, industrials, and fintech/data. It was founded by Leshika Samarasinghe — early Google product team, founding member of ARPA-E, and former Managing Partner at The Production Board — who raised a $25M debut fund in 2022 (WSJ); Ethan Yeh, PhD, former Head of Data Science at Stripe, joined as Managing Partner. Its ~33-company portfolio includes Apella, Alaffia, Rupa Health (acq), Waltz Health (acq), Waymark, Teiko Bio, CloudCruise, and Rowspace. Surfaced as a Foundry Group partner-fund lead in the API Evangelist network; the firm runs a Webflow marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface.

providers.name: UpsideHoM
providers.description: Upside (joinupside.com, originally UpsideHoM) is a housing-stability company for health plans and employers. It finds, houses, and stabilizes members whose housing instability disrupts health, care, and outcomes at scale - accepting referrals, assessing housing needs, executing stabilization or transitions, coordinating with community partners, and documenting outcomes for Medicaid and Medicare plans, health systems, and employer programs. A Techstars portfolio company, Upside publishes no public developer program or API surface as of 2026-07-21.

providers.name: ValCtrl
providers.description: ValCtrl is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026 batch) startup building an intelligent prediction market platform, where users can input any public, resolvable belief about the future and the platform structures, prices, and enables trading on that claim. Its world model maps typed beliefs to relevant market signals, evaluates basis risk, and provides model-priced liquidity. Founded by Gaurav Paliwal and Sarth Garg in New York City, the company is pre-launch with a stealth landing page and no public API, documentation, or developer surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Valthos
providers.description: Valthos is a New York City-based biodefense company developing frontier AI systems that identify biological threats and design medical countermeasures in real time. The company emerged from stealth in October 2025 with $30 million in backing from the OpenAI Startup Fund, Lux Capital, and Founders Fund, with a founding team drawn from Palantir, DeepMind, the Broad Institute, and the Arc Institute. Valthos is building AI-powered biodefense infrastructure to rapidly analyze biological sequences and update medicines at scale for experts in government and the life sciences. The company does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or open-source surface.

providers.name: VaynerMedia
providers.description: VaynerMedia is an integrated strategy, creative, and media agency founded by Gary Vaynerchuk, positioning itself as "The Modern Agency of Record" with social media at the center of its practice. Headquartered in New York with roughly 2,000 employees across offices in Los Angeles, Chattanooga, Chicago, Miami, Toronto, Amsterdam, London, Mexico City, Sydney, Mumbai, Tokyo, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, and Bangkok, the agency serves clients including Bose, Coach, Diageo, Duracell, Indeed, Jimmy John's, Meta, Mondelez, NatWest, PepsiCo, Tinder, and Wingstop. VaynerMedia is the flagship brand of holding company VaynerX, whose portfolio also includes Gallery Media Group, ChukMedia, Tamara Group, Eva Nosidam Productions, VaynerSpeakers, Tingley Lane, and the Marketing for the Now podcast. VaynerMedia is a services agency, not an API or platform company — it does not publish a developer API, SDK, or public technology product, and its public GitHub presence (github.com/vaynermedia and github.com/vaynerx) consists primarily of forked open source libraries and internal build tooling rather than maintained API products.

providers.name: Xona Space Systems
providers.description: Xona Space Systems builds Pulsar, a commercial low-Earth-orbit (LEO) positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) satellite service designed to complement and harden GPS with centimeter-level accuracy and encrypted, jam-resistant signals usable by existing GNSS devices via software updates. The planned constellation is 258 small satellites at roughly 1,080 km altitude, with the Pulsar Verified ecosystem (receivers, simulators, test platforms) delivered through partners including Trimble, Septentrio, Topcon, Furuno, and Murata. A Craft Ventures portfolio company serving defense, agriculture, telecom, transportation, maritime, aviation, and autonomous systems. No public developer API surface was found as of July 2026.

providers.name: A Capital
providers.description: A.Capital Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm founded by Ronny Conway, a former partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and one of the first employees at Google Ventures. The firm provides funding, talent, and strategic counsel to founders building at the frontier of technology, with a portfolio spanning AI and machine learning (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Character.ai), developer tools (Notion, Replit, Databricks), and crypto and consumer platforms (Coinbase, Uniswap, Reddit, Airbnb). A.Capital differs from standard venture models by customizing investment amounts rather than enforcing ownership thresholds, advising without mandatory board seats, and staffing full-time Talent Partners to help early-stage teams hire and build their organizational foundation. This profile was surfaced via the a16z network (through founder Ronny Conway's a16z tenure) and enriched from the firm's public website. A.Capital is a venture capital firm and does not publish a developer-facing API surface, developer portal, or API artifacts.

providers.name: Acesion Pharma
providers.description: Acesion Pharma is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company based in Frederiksberg, Denmark, developing novel therapies for atrial fibrillation (AF), the most common cardiac arrhythmia. The company pioneers small-molecule SK ion channel inhibition as a differentiated mechanism to treat AF safely and effectively. Its lead program AP31969 entered Phase 2 clinical trials in January 2026, building on earlier work on the cardioversion candidate AP30663. Acesion Pharma is backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners. As a pharmaceutical R&D company it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation; this profile captures its corporate identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: APT Medical
providers.description: APT Medical (Suzhou APT Medical Inc., Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market 688617.SH) is a Chinese interventional medical-device manufacturer specializing in electrophysiology and cardiovascular intervention. Its product portfolio spans electrophysiology navigation systems, navigated, mapping and ablation catheters, transseptal needles and steerable sheaths, interventional cardiology access, diagnostic and therapeutic products (guiding catheters, PTCA balloon catheters, guidewires), peripheral intervention devices, and OEM/ODM catheter and nitinol components. The company sells globally and publishes clinical cases, expert education, and investor relations material. It is a hardware medical-device manufacturer and does not currently expose a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and enriched from public company properties.

providers.name: ARKO Corp
providers.description: ARKO Corp (Nasdaq: ARKO) is a Fortune 500 company and one of the largest operators of convenience stores and wholesalers of fuel in the United States. Through its subsidiary GPM Investments, ARKO operates approximately 1,400 company-operated stores under 25+ regional brands across 30+ states, as well as proprietary cardlock locations and a fleet fueling network. In 2026, ARKO completed the IPO of ARKO Petroleum Corp., which operates its wholesale, fleet fueling, and petroleum distribution segments.

providers.name: Avea Robotics
providers.description: Avea Robotics is a San Francisco-based robotics software company (Y Combinator Spring 2026) building teleoperation software that lets operators control robots from anywhere in the world with ultra-low latency. Its product, Sentinel, provides real-time remote control, immersive viewing, haptic feedback, and multi-stream video so operators can remotely intervene and keep robots running continuously. The platform supports industrial robotic arms, humanoid robots, and custom systems, and targets use cases such as data collection for Physical AI training, remote real-world robot deployment, and supervised autonomy with human oversight. Integration is handled during onboarding by sharing a robot's URDF and joint control API rather than through a public developer API. As an early-stage startup, Avea Robotics publishes a website, Notion-hosted documentation, and a Substack blog, but does not yet expose a public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a self-serve developer platform.

providers.name: Bento
providers.description: Bento (Bento Technologies, Inc., dba Bento for Business) was a Chicago- and San Francisco-based small-business fintech that provided card-based payment and expense management for small and mid-size businesses: virtual and physical employee and utility cards, per-card spend controls and category restrictions, real-time spend tracking, and accounting integrations. Bento published a public REST API at api.bentoforbusiness.com (documented at apidocs.bentoforbusiness.com) for issuing employee and utility virtual cards, retrieving card numbers, activating and customizing billing addresses, and reading card transactions, plus outbound webhooks for card transaction completed and declined events; API access was granted per account via an Access Key and Secret Key issued by api-support@bentoforbusiness.com. Bento raised a $2.5M seed round led by Anthemis Group in 2015, with Blumberg Capital, LionBird, Pivot Investment Partners, Edison Partners and Espresso Capital also investing. U.S. Bank agreed to acquire Bento Technologies on August 11, 2021 and closed the acquisition on August 31, 2021, folding the product into U.S. Bank's small-business spend management offering. The Bento card program was then wound down: card reloads stopped April 30, 2024 and all card program services were discontinued June 25, 2024, with customers directed to alternative providers. The developer surface is retired — apidocs.bentoforbusiness.com and api.bentoforbusiness.com no longer resolve in DNS, and bentoforbusiness.com now redirects to U.S. Bank. This profile is retained as a historical record of a former API provider; there is no live API to consume.

providers.name: Byanat
providers.description: Byanat is an Oman-based, award-winning AI company offering a unified platform for optimizing digital infrastructure across telecommunications networks and data centers. The platform pairs system-wide visibility with custom-tailored automation to scale operations, ensure compliance, and promote sustainability, an approach the company frames as "Infrastructure 4.0." Its product families span mobile network solutions (site management, degradation detection, auto-discovery, performance analytics), data centre solutions (predictive analytics, capacity forecasting, energy management, infrastructure monitoring), and an API and integration layer for cross-platform connectivity and AI-powered workflow automation. Byanat is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The company does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or API reference; its API and integration capability is delivered as a managed product.

providers.name: Carnot Innovations
providers.description: Carnot Innovations is a Hong Kong-based building energy management company that applies AI, machine learning, and advanced data analytics to optimize HVAC systems and reduce energy consumption across commercial buildings, data centers, hospitals, railways, and sewage treatment facilities in the Asia-Pacific region. Its platform delivers AI-driven energy optimization, predictive maintenance and fault detection for chillers, pumps, cooling towers, and air handling units, analytics dashboards for facility managers, and continuous commissioning insights, reporting outcomes such as 15% energy cost reductions, 90% hidden-fault detection, and 15 million kWh per year of energy savings across its deployment portfolio. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Carnot Innovations does not currently publish a public developer program or API; this profile exists in the API Evangelist network for discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: Eneryield
providers.description: Eneryield is a Gothenburg, Sweden based company (a Techstars portfolio company) building AI-powered fault prediction and analytics for electric power systems. Its flagship product, Eneryield IntelliView, uses explainable AI to forecast power outages before they occur by analyzing voltage and current signals from digital relays and merging units on overhead lines, underground cables, and underwater cables. The cloud-based platform integrates directly into existing utility monitoring systems without additional hardware, giving grid operators transparent root-cause analysis so they can move to proactive maintenance and reduce operational cost and downtime. As of this profile, Eneryield publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this record captures its identity and infrastructure posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: firsthand
providers.description: firsthand is a healthcare company delivering peer-based support to individuals living with serious mental illness and substance use disorders, helping them access care, benefits, and community resources. Its guides and specialists have lived experience of mental illness, and its HITRUST r2-certified helpinghand platform coordinates care across states including Florida, Ohio, Michigan, Virginia, and Washington. firsthand is a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; firsthand publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Fond
providers.description: Fond (formerly AnyPerk) is a U.S. employee rewards and recognition platform that lets companies run customizable recognition programs combining monetary and non-monetary rewards, perks, and a global rewards catalog. Fond offers a gated public/provider API that allows authenticated partners to programmatically manage a Fond account — provisioning, employee roster management, giving recognition to one or more employees, and rewards redemption — alongside integrations for Workday, ADP, Namely, Salesforce, Slack, and other HR systems. There is no open developer portal or published OpenAPI; API access is arranged directly via integration@fond.co. Fond was acquired by Reward Gateway in March 2023 and fond.co now redirects to rewardgateway.com. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Google NotebookLM
providers.description: Google NotebookLM is an AI-powered research and thinking partner that helps users analyze, summarize, and explore sources such as documents, PDFs, web pages, and notes. It leverages Google's Gemini models to ground responses in user-provided source material, generating summaries, study guides, FAQs, and Audio Overviews. NotebookLM does not currently expose a public API; integration with the service is limited to the web interface and supported Google Workspace contexts.

providers.name: Gyre Energy
providers.description: Gyre Energy is a UK-based climate-tech company that reduces cooling costs for operators of cold storage facilities, data centers, and building portfolios by combining artificial intelligence with thermal energy storage. Its platform pairs Gyre AI, a digital twin that learns a facility's thermal behavior and shifts cooling cycles to run when grid energy is cheapest and greenest, with an integrated thermal energy storage "cold battery" and a real-time monitoring and controls layer that tracks temperature, energy use, and door-open events. The company reports up to 50% lower cooling expenses, 38% verified energy cost savings at its first commercial cold storage deployment, a 91% reduction in temperature excursions, and a payback period of under 1.5 years. Gyre Energy is a portfolio company of Speedinvest and, as of July 2026, secured $1.3m in funding to support a major blue-chip deployment and global scaling. It currently exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hexcel
providers.description: Hexcel Corporation (NYSE: HXL) is a global leader in advanced composite materials for the aerospace, defense and space, and industrial markets. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut and operating roughly 18 manufacturing facilities worldwide with about 5,800 employees, Hexcel produces HexTow carbon fiber, HexPly prepregs, HexWeb honeycomb, HexForce reinforcements, HexBond adhesives, HexFlow infusion resins, and HexTool tooling materials supplied into commercial aircraft, military platforms, space launch vehicles, wind energy blades, and industrial structures. Hexcel is a critical materials supplier to Boeing and Airbus and supports more than 100 defense programs; it has no public developer portal, REST APIs, SDKs, or machine-readable product catalog. Customer interaction with technical resources is PDF-based (datasheets, technology manuals, brochures), and the company's GitHub organization (github.com/Hexcel) is registered but empty.

providers.name: Hyro
providers.description: Hyro is a responsible AI-powered conversational and agentic communications platform, best known for deploying AI assistants and voice/chat agents for large healthcare systems as well as other regulated enterprises. Its platform automates patient and customer engagement across web, SMS, and voice channels — handling tasks such as appointment management, IT help-desk requests, call routing, and answering high-volume repetitive questions — using a knowledge-graph-driven natural language engine positioned around explainability and control. Hyro is headquartered in New York and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. At enrichment time Hyro exposes no public developer API or OpenAPI specification; its public technical surface consists of a customer product dashboard (docs.hyro.ai) and a live operational status page (status.hyro.ai). This profile was surfaced from the Norwest portfolio and enriched from verifiable public signals only.

providers.name: Kik (Kin)
providers.description: Kik (Kin) refers to the Kin cryptocurrency created by Kik Interactive, the messaging company, as a blockchain-based digital currency for use inside consumer applications. Kin originally launched on a fork of the Stellar network and later migrated to Solana, shipping first-party developer SDKs (JavaScript/Node and Python) under the kinecosystem GitHub organization and a developer program at developer.kin.org. The Kin project is now defunct: the developer surface no longer resolves, every kinecosystem repository is archived, the published SDKs are deprecated, and Kik itself was acquired by MediaLab AI Inc. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Pantera Capital and is retained as a historical record of a wound-down crypto developer surface.

providers.name: Leaky
providers.description: Leaky was a US auto-insurance comparison service that operated from 2011 until 31 August 2013. It let consumers compare prices and plans across the nation's top insurers, model "what if" coverage scenarios, and keep all of their policy information in one place with alerts when they could save money. The comparison engine was built by reverse-engineering the pricing models of more than 100 insurers from publicly-available government filings rather than by selling user information to carriers. Leaky reported providing over $300 million of auto-insurance quotes and saving its users more than $40 million before it wound down the consumer business; its commercial-insurance business was acquired by Navion Insurance. The company was backed by 500 Global (500 Startups). Leaky is defunct — leaky.com now serves only a static shutdown notice, all user data was deleted at closure, and there is no developer portal, public API, SDK, or discovery surface to catalog.

providers.name: Linen App
providers.description: Linen Wallet, operated by Linen Mobile, Inc., was a mobile self-custody cryptocurrency wallet that used multi-signature protection built on Safe (formerly Gnosis Safe) smart-contract accounts instead of the single seed phrase used by most wallets. It began as a DeFi savings wallet earning yield on stablecoins through Compound, later adding Ethereum staking and Polygon support, and grew out of Bloqboard, a non-custodial digital-asset lending platform built on the Dharma, Compound and MakerDAO protocols. Linen was backed by Polychain, Coinbase Ventures, HashKey and Wyre, and won Aave and Polygon grants. The product is discontinued — since late 2023 every path on linen.app has returned a site-wide redirect to a single X post, and no documentation, developer portal, API or specification was ever published publicly. See lifecycle/linen-app-lifecycle.yml for the probed wind-down evidence.

providers.name: mcp.json
providers.description: mcp.json is a Model Context Protocol configuration file format that defines MCP server connections for AI coding assistants and agents. It enables tool integration and enhanced AI capabilities through a standardized configuration schema.

providers.name: Nicolette
providers.description: Nicolette, Inc. is a digital health company that empowers patients and families fighting acute health battles by democratizing electronic health record (EHR) data, curated education, and participation tools. Its flagship product, NicoBoard, is a hospital-provided bedside platform for parents of babies in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU): it visualizes a baby's plan of care and clinical data, surfaces curated research and education, provides a care-team directory, and offers engagement, insights, and diary tools so parents can partner competently and confidently in their child's care. NicoBoard ships as iOS and Android apps distributed to families by hospitals. Founded in 2016 and backed by Techstars among others, Nicolette exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Pax Historia
providers.description: Pax Historia is an alternate-history sandbox game backed by Y Combinator, where players explore branching "what if" scenarios and reshape the course of history through open-ended, simulation-driven play. It is a consumer-facing game product reached at paxhistoria.co with a single "Get Started" entry point; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer platform, API, SDKs, documentation, pricing page, or other machine-readable API surface. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead surfaced from the Y Combinator portfolio and enriched here with verified identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Petra Power
providers.description: Petra Power is an on-site power generation company based in Solon, Ohio, and backed by Techstars, building rapidly deployable, high-efficiency generation systems positioned as "the next 100GW of on-site power." Its technology runs on natural gas, diesel, or hydrogen, claims up to 3x fuel savings versus conventional generators and turbines, and operates silently and odorlessly for use in populated areas. Target applications include data centers, critical backup power, heavy industry, and utility-scale deployment. Petra Power is a hardware/energy company with no public developer or API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Pivot Bio
providers.description: Pivot Bio is an agricultural biotechnology company headquartered in Berkeley, California with additional operations in St. Louis, Missouri. The company engineers naturally occurring soil microbes to fix atmospheric nitrogen on crop root systems, providing a biological alternative to synthetic nitrogen fertilizer that reduces nitrous-oxide emissions, nitrate runoff, and exposure to volatile fertilizer prices. Pivot Bio's product line includes PROVEN 40 and PROVEN G3 (corn and corn silage), RETURN (wheat and small grains), CERT-N (cotton), and RETAIN (sorghum). The company also operates N-OVATOR, an outcomes-based program that pays farmers for verified emissions reductions; the program reports having paid out more than $6M to growers since 2022 and contributing to over 1,050,000 metric tons of CO2e avoided. Pivot Bio was founded by Karsten Temme (CEO) and Alvin Tamsir. Investors include Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Temasek, DCVC, Generation Investment Management, Pavilion Capital, G2 Venture Partners, Bond, and others. Pivot Bio's product is the microbe, not an API; the company operates a farmer-facing Salesforce-based portal but does not publish a public developer API or SDK.

providers.name: Printique
providers.description: Printique (An Adorama Company, formerly AdoramaPix) is a professional online photo lab based in Brooklyn, NYC that produces photo prints, fine-art giclee prints, photo books, albums, wall decor (metal, acrylic, canvas, glass, framed, wood), cards, calendars, and photo gifts. Printique does NOT publish a documented public developer or fulfillment API. There is no developer portal, no published REST reference, no API keys, and no OpenAPI definition on the open web. Programmatic and automated ordering is instead delivered through prebuilt partner-platform integrations - a Squarespace integration that syncs products and automates order fulfillment, a PhotoShelter wholesale print-and-product integration for professional photographers, Fundy Designer album integration, and desktop plugins for Adobe Lightroom and Capture One that publish images directly to Printique. A Pro membership tier ($14.95/month or $159.95/year) unlocks tiered wholesale savings, white-label blind shipping, and dedicated support for photography businesses. The logical API surfaces below (catalog, orders, order status) are honestly modeled from Printique's public product, Pro, and integration pages to describe how ordering works conceptually; they are NOT transcribed from any released or documented Printique API. No public endpoints, paths, or request/response schemas are published, so endpointsModeled is true and no endpoint surface has been fabricated beyond these named, integration-delivered capabilities.

providers.name: Regeneron
providers.description: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals is a leading biotechnology company that invents, develops, and commercializes life-transforming medicines, including EYLEA and EYLEA HD for ophthalmology, Dupixent in immunology (co-developed with Sanofi), Libtayo and Lynozyfic in oncology and hematology, and Praluent for cardiovascular disease. Regeneron does not publish a public developer API; its Regeneron Genetics Center collaborates on large-scale genomic research via the UK Biobank, DiscovEHR, and partner platforms rather than a self-hosted API.

providers.name: Respondus
providers.description: Respondus builds assessment-integrity tools for online exams - most notably LockDown Browser, a custom browser that locks down the testing environment, and Respondus Monitor, an automated webcam-based online proctoring service that adds AI-assisted review on top of LockDown Browser. Over 2,000 institutions across 50+ countries use Respondus to deliver hundreds of millions of online exams a year. Respondus does not publish a self-service public developer API. Its products reach learning platforms through LMS integration rather than an open REST surface - native plugins/building blocks plus the IMS Global LTI (Learning Tools Interoperability) standard for Blackboard, Brightspace, Canvas, Moodle, Sakai, and Schoology, and a privately-licensed LockDown Browser SDK for third-party assessment platforms that must be arranged through Respondus sales. No public OpenAPI, developer keys, or documented endpoints are offered.

providers.name: Sanofi
providers.description: Sanofi is a French multinational pharmaceutical and healthcare company focused on immunology, oncology, rare diseases, and vaccines, and a leading vaccines manufacturer. Sanofi does not publish a public developer API. Its GitHub organization exists but has no public repositories. The company operates patient assistance and HCP portals as well as clinical trial information services that require authenticated access.

providers.name: Sonic Automotive
providers.description: Sonic Automotive is one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, operating 100+ franchise dealerships across 13 states representing 25+ automotive brands, and operating EchoPark Automotive used-vehicle stores. The company invests in digital retail, inventory management technology, and automotive data platforms to enhance customer experience across vehicle sales, service, finance, and insurance. Technology partners include Stripe, NETSOL, and CDK Global.

providers.name: ToyTalk
providers.description: ToyTalk was a San Francisco conversational AI company founded in 2011 that built voice and chat characters for entertainment, rebranded as PullString in 2016, and was acquired by Apple in early 2019. Its developer platform - the PullString Web API plus Converse and Author tooling for authoring conversational experiences - was shut down after the acquisition. Today pullstring.com and toytalk.com no longer resolve and both domains are parked on Apple nameservers, the github.com/pullstring organization has been deleted, and the only surviving first-party developer artifact is the orphaned pullstring JavaScript SDK on npm. This profile records that historical developer surface; there is no live API.

providers.name: Transparent Systems
providers.description: Transparent Systems (Transparent Financial Systems) was a Seattle-based fintech startup advancing financial infrastructure through on-demand, 24/7 cryptographic settlement solutions built on cryptographically-secured distributed networks, backed by Pantera Capital and Vulcan Capital and active in US regulatory engagement (OCC comments, 2020). The company appears defunct: its website redirected away from 2021 onward and as of July 2026 transparentsystems.com is a parked GoDaddy domain listed for sale, with no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface.

providers.name: Uni Cards
providers.description: Uni Cards (Uniorbit Technologies) is a Bangalore-based Indian consumer fintech backed by Accel that builds credit-card and pay-later products, best known for its Uni Pay 1/3rd Card and co-branded credit cards delivered through its consumer mobile app. Uni Cards publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; its api.uni.cards and docs.uni.cards hosts resolve but are closed behind a Cloudflare challenge, so its API surface is internal-only today.

providers.name: Utopia Labs
providers.description: Utopia Labs was a stablecoin payments and finance-operations platform for crypto-native teams and DAOs, covering payments, payroll, invoicing, and approval workflows, backed by Paradigm. Coinbase acquired Utopia Labs Corp. on November 13, 2024, and the team joined Base to build onchain payments into Coinbase Wallet. The company no longer operates independently and publishes no public API surface — utopialabs.com returns 404 and its former docs, api, and app subdomains no longer resolve.

providers.name: Vetstoria
providers.description: Vetstoria provides real-time online appointment booking, veterinary websites, and online payments for veterinary practices, integrating in real time with 40+ practice management systems (PIMS) - including ezyVet, IDEXX Neo, IDEXX Cornerstone, IDEXX Animana, Covetrus Ascend, AVImark, RxWorks, visionVPM, Provet Cloud, OpenVPMS, and others - to sync availability, prevent double-bookings, and match clients and pets back into the PIMS. Founded in 2015 and used by more than 5,000 practices worldwide (operating as PetDesk Direct Booking in the United States), Vetstoria does NOT publish a public, self-service developer API. Its integration surface is partner-gated - software vendors connect through a contact-based Integrations Partner program, and each PIMS integration is typically driven from the PIMS side (for example, ezyVet exposes Vetstoria as an "API Partner" and IDEXX Neo auto-generates an API key when the Vetstoria connection is enabled). No public API reference, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or documented WebSocket exists as of this cataloging.

providers.name: VF Corporation
providers.description: VF Corporation is a global apparel and footwear company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. VF owns major brands including Vans, The North Face, Timberland, Altra, Eastpak, Icebreaker, JanSport, Kipling, Napapijri, and Smartwool. The company does not offer a public developer API program; its technology integrations are handled through third-party e-commerce platforms and enterprise supply chain systems. VF Corporation operates more than 1,500 stores globally and integrates with platforms such as Shopify, Amazon, Magento, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce via third-party integration services.

providers.name: Viatris
providers.description: Viatris Inc. is a global healthcare company formed in November 2020 through the combination of Mylan and Pfizer's Upjohn division. Viatris is one of the world's largest producers of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and generic medicines, serving patients in more than 165 countries. The company has undergone significant strategic restructuring, divesting its India API business and women's healthcare business. Viatris focuses on branded generics, complex generics, biosimilars, and branded specialty medicines. No public developer API program or developer portal has been identified; the company operates in B2B pharmaceutical supply chain contexts without a public technology integration API offering.

providers.name: Williams Companies
providers.description: The Williams Companies is an American Fortune 500 energy company focused on natural gas infrastructure, processing, and transportation. Williams owns and operates midstream energy assets including the Transco pipeline (the largest natural gas pipeline in the United States), gathering and processing systems, and storage facilities. Williams serves natural gas producers, local distribution companies, and large-volume end users. The company provides customer portal access for operational data and FERC-regulated electronic bulletin boards for capacity transactions, but does not offer public developer REST APIs.

providers.name: 51Talk
providers.description: 51Talk is an online English-language education platform that connects learners with certified teachers through one-on-one live video lessons. Founded in 2011 and listed on the NYSE, the company operates across 90+ countries with a large base of accredited teachers, delivering a structured curriculum and ready-made teaching materials for both children and adult learners. Following a strategic shift, 51Talk focuses on international markets outside mainland China, including the Philippines and the broader Southeast Asia region, and recruits teachers globally. It is a consumer education company backed by DCM Ventures; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this repo carries only identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: A-Frame
providers.description: A-Frame Brands is a Los Angeles-based consumer brand incubator and product-development company founded in 2019 by entrepreneur Ari Bloom and actor Hill Harper. It partners with celebrities and cultural figures to build purpose-driven personal-care, beauty, fragrance, home-care, and pet-care brands, taking each from opportunity identification through product development, design, sourcing, production, and retail go-to-market. Brands in its portfolio include LOVED01 (John Legend), Kinlo (Naomi Osaka), Proudly (Gabrielle Union and Dwyane Wade), and Purrfect Paws, sold through retailers such as Target, Walmart, Amazon, CVS, JCPenney, QVC, and Bath & Body Works. Backed by Initialized Capital. This is a consumer company profile in the API Evangelist network; A-Frame publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: A-Frame Brands
providers.description: A-Frame Brands is a Venice, California based consumer brand incubator and product development platform founded in 2019 by Ari Bloom and Hill Harper. It builds and grows purpose-driven personal care, beauty, suncare, baby care, home care, and pet care brands, frequently in partnership with celebrity and talent founders such as John Legend, Naomi Osaka, Gabrielle Union, and Dwyane Wade, with a focus on products formulated for historically underserved and melanin-rich consumers. Its portfolio includes Loved01, Kinlo, Proudly, and Purrfect Paws, distributed direct-to-consumer and across more than 10,000 national retail locations including Walmart, Target, CVS, and Amazon. Backed by Forerunner Ventures. This is a consumer company profile in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: aardaia
providers.description: Aardaia is a Wageningen (Netherlands) agri-biotech startup that turns wild plant species into new commercial crops through accelerated domestication, combining classical plant breeding with modern genomics and AI rather than genetic modification. Its flagship is the aardaker, a nitrogen-fixing legume-tuber that yields a naturally protein-rich crop (roughly 10g protein per 100g of fresh tuber) without synthetic fertilizer. The company raised a EUR 5M seed round led by Point Nine in 2026. Aardaia does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a Point Nine portfolio lead.

providers.name: agavegames
providers.description: Agave Games is a mobile game publisher based in Istanbul, Turkey, founded in 2021 by Alper Oner, Burak Kar, and Ali Baran Terzioglu. The company specializes in casual puzzle games played by millions, with titles including Find the Cat, Wonder Link, What The Hex, Soda Match, and Art Block Puzzle across iOS and Android. Backed by Balderton Capital and Felix Capital (Series A, December 2024), Agave Games is a consumer-facing gaming company; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a Balderton Capital portfolio company and enriched with a live domain-security probe and identity hygiene.

providers.name: AI Medical Service
providers.description: AI Medical Service Inc. (AIM) is a Tokyo-based med-tech company founded in September 2017 with the mission to save lives worldwide by eliminating gastrointestinal cancers through earlier detection. AIM develops endoscopic AI (artificial intelligence) that assists physicians in real-time diagnostic imaging of the digestive tract, drawing on joint research with more than 100 medical institutions. Its flagship gastroAI family of endoscopic image diagnosis support software has secured regulatory approval in Japan, Singapore, and Thailand, and an earlier FDA approval in the United States. The company distributes its AI on-premise today and is building an in-house cloud platform to broaden access; it currently publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a health-tech lead backed by SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: Alexion Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Alexion Pharmaceuticals was a global biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, focused on developing life-transforming therapies for rare diseases. Founded in 1992, the company pioneered complement inhibition therapy and developed leading treatments for rare hematological and neurological conditions including Soliris (eculizumab) and Ultomiris (ravulizumab). AstraZeneca acquired Alexion in July 2021 for $39 billion, and the company now operates as Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease. The combined entity maintains research programs in complement biology, hematology, nephrology, neurology, metabolic disorders, cardiology, and ophthalmology. Alexion's GitHub organization (alxndgb) hosts research tools including genomic data analysis platforms, precision medicine knowledge graphs, and rare disease target discovery systems.

providers.name: Alphora Holdings
providers.description: Alphora (Alphora GmbH / Alphora Holdings) is a Berlin-based, AI-native managed IT services company founded in 2025 and backed by Northzone at the seed stage. Its agentic platform runs IT operations end-to-end for businesses and managed service providers (MSPs) — an integrated IT service desk, managed compliance and documentation, managed AI delivered by forward-deployed engineers, endpoint cybersecurity, user and hardware provisioning, and 24/7 network and cloud monitoring — pairing centralized intelligence with local execution across a shared data lake. The company operates alphora-it.com with a marketing site and active careers portal but does not yet expose a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: American Family Insurance
providers.description: American Family Insurance is a private mutual company that offers auto, homeowners, life, renters, umbrella, business, and farm/ranch insurance throughout the United States. The company serves customers through a network of exclusive agents, digital tools including the MyAmFam mobile app, and online self-service capabilities. American Family is headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin, and is one of the largest property-casualty insurers in the country.

providers.name: Ampaire
providers.description: Ampaire is a Long Beach, California electric aviation company that develops hybrid-electric propulsion systems for aircraft. Its AmpDrive powertrain retrofits and powers regional aircraft, and the company reports more than 30,000 flight miles with a stated goal of cutting fuel consumption, maintenance costs, and noise. Ampaire is backed by Techstars and has worked with partners including NASA and ARPA-E. The company currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record awaiting any future developer program.

providers.name: Ask
providers.description: Ask (Ask.com), formerly Ask Jeeves, was a consumer web search engine that operated for roughly 30 years before officially closing on May 1, 2026. The domain now serves a static closure/farewell notice and a Privacy Policy page. It was surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub in the API Evangelist network; enrichment confirms there is no public developer API, SDK, documentation, well-known discovery surface, or event/webhook surface to harvest — the site is defunct. Retained as a historical company record.

providers.name: Axio Biosolutions
providers.description: Axio Biosolutions Private Limited is a medical technology manufacturer headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, focused on advanced chitosan-based solutions for bleeding control, trauma care, surgical care, and advanced wound care. Its Axiostat hemostatic dressings deliver rapid hemostasis for emergency, military, and surgical bleeding, while its MaxioCel microfiber gelling wound dressings support wound healing, exudate management, and infection risk reduction across chronic and acute wounds. Axio operates its own manufacturing and quality systems and holds FDA and CE regulatory certifications. The company publishes no public API or developer platform; this profile captures its public web and discovery surface.

providers.name: Bayshore
providers.description: Bayshore (bayshore AI GmbH) is a Munich-based legal and compliance technology company building an agentic AI platform that turns any ruleset — from sector regulations to internal corporate policies — into deterministic, machine-readable guardrails for AI agents. Positioned as a "Legal & Compliance Front Door," the platform handles incoming requests from business teams, auto-clears low-risk cases with instant responses, escalates complex matters to human reviewers, and maintains audit-ready documentation for every decision. Founded in 2024 by Paul F. Welter, Philipp Wiegand, and Erik Krauter, the company focuses on highly regulated industries including finance (MaRisk, DORA, NIS2), pharma, defense (export controls, sanctions), and cross-industry programs (GDPR, anti-bribery, antitrust, third-party due diligence). Bayshore raised an $8M seed round led by Earlybird Venture Capital in 2026. This profile currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or specifications.

providers.name: Behja
providers.description: Behja (Behja Holdings Limited Inc) is a licensed real estate platform in Saudi Arabia (License 120022677) that offers flexible rental-to-own housing. Its model lets residents select a property, apply, sign a three-year lease, and then buy with a full year's rent credited back toward the purchase. The integrated platform handles leases, purchases, and utility payments in one place. Behja is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer program, API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Beike
providers.description: Beike (KE Holdings Inc.) is China's largest integrated online-and-offline platform for housing transactions and services, connecting home buyers, sellers, renters, and real estate agents. It operates the Beike (贝壳) platform and the Lianjia (链家) brokerage brand, along with businesses spanning existing-home and new-home transactions, home rentals, and home renovation and furnishing. Its Agent Cooperation Network (ACN) lets brokerages and agents share listings and commissions across a standardized workflow. KE Holdings is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: BEKE) and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX: 2423) and is headquartered in Beijing. This API Evangelist profile was created from venture-portfolio sourcing and enriched via the pipeline; Beike operates consumer-facing housing web and mobile properties and does not currently publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Bitauto
providers.description: Bitauto (易车, Yiche) is one of China's largest automotive internet companies, founded in 2000 with the mission of making car ownership simpler. It operates consumer-facing platforms that provide car buyers with pricing, reviews, specifications, and automotive news across new and used vehicles, alongside an enterprise EP (dealer) platform offering web-based digital marketing and CRM applications to Chinese automobile dealers. Bitauto runs regional informational portals across 20+ countries cataloging Chinese car brands. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures; as of enrichment Bitauto publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: BLAST
providers.description: BLAST is a Danish esports and gaming entertainment company headquartered in Copenhagen, founded in 2016. It produces and operates premier competitive gaming tournaments and leagues (notably Counter-Strike BLAST Premier) and runs the blast.tv streaming and fan-engagement platform, delivering live events, broadcasts, and interactive esports content to a global audience. Backed by Creandum, Heartcore, Maki.vc, and Vaekstfonden, BLAST was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company. No public developer API, portal, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures verifiable identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Bluestem Brands
providers.description: Bluestem Brands, Inc. is an American multi-brand direct-to-consumer retailer headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota. It is best known for Fingerhut, a credit-based catalog and online retailer that extends revolving credit (via partner WebBank) to underserved consumers so they can purchase brand-name merchandise across home, electronics, apparel, and general merchandise categories. Bluestem historically operated a broader portfolio of catalog and e-commerce brands and reaches shoppers through its websites, mobile apps, and printed catalogs. No public developer program, API, or documentation surface was found for Bluestem Brands or Fingerhut at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Brain Jar Games
providers.description: Brain Jar Games is a fully-remote independent video game studio founded by AAA industry veterans who have shipped franchises including Mass Effect, Dragon Age, RIFT, and Call of Duty. The studio builds bold, vibrant, music-driven action games designed to be shared; its debut title, Dead as Disco, blends kinetic gunplay with rhythm-synced choreography. Brain Jar Games is backed by Menlo Ventures and Transcend, having raised $12.2M across seed funding, and operates a four-day, 32-hour work week with team members across North America, Europe, and Turkey. The company publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform; this profile tracks it as a venture-portfolio lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bunkerhill Health
providers.description: Bunkerhill Health is a healthcare AI company building Carebricks, a platform that lets clinical and operational teams at health systems build, deploy, and scale AI agents that reason across large volumes of patient and operational data and take real action across patient access, pharmacy, revenue cycle, care coordination, imaging, population health, and administrative workflows. The company also develops FDA-cleared imaging algorithms, such as opportunistic bone-mineral-density screening on routine abdominal CT. Backed by Felicis, Bunkerhill Health raised $55M to put AI agents to work inside hospitals. This API Evangelist profile currently tracks the company's public web presence; no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface has been published yet.

providers.name: BYD
providers.description: BYD Company Ltd. is a Chinese multinational manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in Shenzhen, founded in 1995 by Wang Chuanfu and publicly listed in Hong Kong (1211) and Shenzhen (002594). Originally a rechargeable-battery maker, BYD has grown into one of the world's largest producers of new-energy vehicles (battery-electric and plug-in hybrid cars, buses, and trucks), power batteries (including the Blade Battery), consumer and automotive electronics, rail transit systems (SkyRail/SkyShuttle), forklifts, and solar and energy-storage products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; BYD is a hardware and manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer or API program.

providers.name: CatalYm
providers.description: CatalYm GmbH is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Planegg-Martinsried near Munich, Germany, developing next-generation cancer immunotherapies. Its lead approach neutralizes GDF-15 (Growth Differentiation Factor 15) to reverse a key immune-resistance mechanism in solid tumors, aiming to reinstate anti-tumor immune activity and overcome resistance to checkpoint-inhibitor and other cancer therapies. The company is a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. This is a biotech/pharmaceutical organization with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: CityMall
providers.description: CityMall is an Indian social-commerce and e-commerce platform operated by Rashanbox Retail Private Limited (CIN U52190HR2020PTC086114), serving Tier-2 and Tier-3 towns through a community-group-buying model. Customers shop across groceries, staples, fashion, electronics, home and kitchen, beauty and health, kids and toys, and books and stationery, with cash-on-delivery and free-delivery options via web and native Android/iOS apps. The company runs on modern web infrastructure (CloudFront CDN, next-gen image optimization) and is backed by Accel, General Catalyst, and Norwest Venture Partners.
