It issues permissionless, fully-backed tokenized products — including tokenized US Treasury bills (mTBILL), yield and basis strategies (mBASIS) and other onchain investment products — that offer full transparency, instant liquidity and native composability across DeFi. Investors mint and redeem Midas tokens directly against the underlying assets, and the resulting ERC-20 tokens can be used as collateral and as building blocks throughout the onchain economy. Positioned as "the standard for onchain investment products," Midas surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio company for enrichment.

providers.name: MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company
providers.description: MSC (Mediterranean Shipping Company) is a privately-held, family-owned global container shipping and logistics group headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, founded in 1970 by Gianluigi Aponte and now led by CEO Soren Toft under the Aponte-Diamant family. MSC is the world's largest container shipping line by fleet size and capacity, operating roughly 900 cargo vessels with a combined intake of about 7 million TEU and controlling more than a fifth of global container capacity as of late 2025. The carrier offers a portfolio of digital shipment-management products through its myMSC e-business platform — including Instant Quote for online rate generation, online booking, electronic Bill of Lading and Sea Waybill issuance via eDocs, container Track & Trace, and the myMSC mobile app — and exposes a Direct Integrations program for shippers, freight forwarders, and NVOCCs that combines REST APIs and EDI message exchange. The MSC Developer Portal (developerportal.msc.com), hosted on Microsoft Azure API Management, publishes documentation and EDI message implementation guides for products such as the DCSA-aligned Track & Trace API (v1.2 and v2.2), Booking, Booking Confirmation (X12 301 / EDIFACT IFTMIN), and Shipping Instructions, alongside ANSI X12 and EDIFACT IFTMIN / IFTMBC / COPRAR reference documents. MSC also runs direct-integration partnerships with INTTRA, Infor Nexus, and CargoSmart. API and EDI access is not self-service: prospective integrators must submit a Direct Integration request, and fees may apply.

providers.name: Oculus VR
providers.description: Oculus VR is the pioneering virtual reality company founded in 2012 and acquired by Facebook (now Meta) in 2014. Its Rift, Go, and Quest headsets defined consumer VR, and the Oculus brand has since been folded into Meta Quest and Meta Horizon OS. The former developer.oculus.com and oculus.com properties now redirect to Meta's developer platform. There is no distinct public REST/OpenAPI surface; developers build against SDK-based tooling (Unity, Unreal Engine, native OpenXR, and the Meta Spatial SDK) rather than a hosted web API. Backed originally by a16z; consumer VR/AR hardware and platform.

providers.name: Osmos
providers.description: Osmos is an AI-powered data ingestion and data onboarding platform that helps companies import, clean, transform, and validate data arriving from customers, partners, and third-party sources. Its core products include the Osmos Uploader, an embeddable data-import experience that lets end users upload spreadsheets and CSV files that are automatically mapped, validated, and cleaned; AI Data Wrangler capabilities that use AI agents to reshape messy inbound data into a target schema; and data pipelines for recurring ingestion from files, APIs, and other systems. Osmos is aimed at product and data teams that need to reliably onboard external data without building and maintaining bespoke import tooling. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched through the enrichment pipeline; public API surface details are gated behind the Osmos application and documentation.

providers.name: Pace Revenue
providers.description: Pace Revenue was a London-based revenue management and dynamic pricing platform for hotels and hospitality operators that used machine learning to recommend optimal room rates from real-time demand, market, and booking-pace signals. Founded in 2016 and backed by Speedinvest, Pace was acquired by FLYR in 2023, and its revenue-optimization technology has since been folded into FLYR's hospitality commercial platform. Pace Revenue does not currently publish a public developer portal or an openly documented API specification; developer resources for the combined offering now live behind FLYR's gated developer knowledge base. This profile was surfaced as a Speedinvest portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public machine-readable API surface was found at enrichment time.

providers.name: PerkinElmer
providers.description: PerkinElmer is a global leader in scientific instrumentation, lab services, and informatics for life sciences, diagnostics, food, environmental, and industrial markets. The company provides analytical instruments, reagents, software, and software downloads to support laboratory operations and scientific research.

providers.name: Purpose Green
providers.description: Purpose Green is a Berlin-based sustainability consulting firm and 360-degree provider for sustainable real estate development, serving property owners and investors who manage multi-unit residential and commercial buildings. The company combines energy auditing (its Energy Light Report tool), ESG reporting, subsidy and grant consultation, renovation project management, and a web-based portfolio management portal (Green+ Portal) to help reduce a building's final energy demand by up to 80%. It is backed by Speedinvest and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; the company publishes web tools and a customer portal but no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Raft
providers.description: Raft is a consensus algorithm for distributed systems designed to be understandable and provide the same guarantees as Paxos, used for distributed log replication and leader election in fault-tolerant systems.

providers.name: Realogy Holdings
providers.description: Realogy Holdings (now Anywhere Real Estate) is a global provider of residential real estate services with brands including Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate, Century 21, Coldwell Banker, Corcoran, ERA, and Sotheby's International Realty. Realogy Holdings does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are managed through brand-specific technology platforms and partner programs.

providers.name: RedNote (Xiaohongshu)
providers.description: RedNote, known in China as Xiaohongshu (小红书, "Little Red Book"), is a Shanghai-based social and e-commerce platform operated by Xingyin Information Technology (行吟信息科技). It blends user-generated lifestyle content, community discovery, and in-app shopping, and is one of China's largest content-commerce platforms. Beyond the consumer app, RedNote runs an open platform (open.xiaohongshu.com) plus the Qianfan (千帆) merchant commerce workbench (ark.xiaohongshu.com) and a mini-program surface (miniapp.xiaohongshu.com) that let brands, merchants, and marketing partners integrate storefronts, content, and campaigns. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of HongShan (Sequoia China) and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Rfmd
providers.description: RFMD (RF Micro Devices) was a semiconductor manufacturer of radio-frequency (RF) components for mobile, infrastructure, defense, and aerospace markets. In January 2015 RFMD merged with TriQuint Semiconductor to form Qorvo, and the rfmd.com domain now redirects to qorvo.com. Qorvo designs and manufactures RF and power solutions — amplifiers, filters, integrated circuits, wireless connectivity, and power management devices — spanning mobile, defense/aerospace, network infrastructure, IoT, automotive, and consumer electronics. As a hardware semiconductor company, RFMD/Qorvo publishes no public developer web API; its developer-facing resources are simulation models, QSPICE circuit-simulation software, datasheets, evaluation boards, and a technical support forum. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio lead of norwest-venture-partners and enriched to reflect the RFMD-to-Qorvo identity; there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Riverse
providers.description: Riverse (linked property rainbowstandard.io / Rainbow Standard) is a carbon credit certification platform and registry that issues high-integrity carbon credits from carbon removal and greenhouse-gas reduction projects. Its methodologies span biogas, biomass, battery recycling, and other engineered decarbonization pathways, with credits approved under ICVCM Core Carbon Principles and endorsed by ICROA. The public surface is a policy, methodology, and procedure documentation site for project developers; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or webhook surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Shape Security
providers.description: Shape Security was an enterprise application-security company (backed by gv and wing-venture-capital) specializing in bot mitigation, credential-stuffing defense, and online-fraud prevention for login, checkout, and account-recovery flows. It was acquired by F5 in 2020 and its technology now ships as F5 Distributed Cloud Bot Defense; the shapesecurity.com domain 301-redirects wholesale into f5.com. Shape Security no longer operates an independent developer portal, public API, OpenAPI spec, or SDK surface of its own — its capabilities are delivered through the F5 Distributed Cloud platform. This profile is retained as an acquisition/lineage record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Shape Security
providers.description: Shape Security was a bot-mitigation and anti-fraud company whose behavioral and telemetry-based defenses protected web and mobile applications from automated attacks such as credential stuffing, account takeover, and fake account creation. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners and other investors, the company was acquired by F5 Networks in early 2020 and its technology now ships as F5 Distributed Cloud Bot Defense. Shape Security does not operate a standalone public developer API; its original shapesecurity.com domain now redirects (HTTP 301) to the F5 product page, and integration and API documentation are served from F5 developer properties (clouddocs.f5.com, my.f5.com). This profile is retained as an acquired-company record within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Shepherd 3
providers.description: Shepherd is a Y Combinator-backed (W21) insurtech modernizing commercial insurance for the construction and renewable energy sectors. Using technology and data-driven underwriting, it delivers faster decisions and clearer risk insights across Primary Casualty, Excess Casualty, and Builder's Risk coverage for middle-market to enterprise builders and operators. As of this enrichment pass Shepherd does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, MCP server, or a developer portal — this profile captures the company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Smashfly
providers.description: SmashFly Technologies was a recruitment-marketing software company whose Total Recruitment Marketing Platform combined a career-site CMS, a candidate CRM, programmatic job advertising, and recruiting analytics for enterprise talent-acquisition teams. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, SmashFly was acquired by Symphony Talent in 2019 and its product folded into the Symphony Talent (SFX / SmashFlyX) suite. SmashFly historically exposed RESTful integration APIs — a Job Import API, a Contact Import API, a Contact Export API, and a List Lookup API — secured with per-organization API keys generated by an administrator in the SmashFly Console. The standalone developer documentation at recruit.smashfly.com has since been retired (the host now returns an empty 302), smashfly.com redirects to symphonytalent.com, and the remaining SmashFly developer resources are hosted in the Symphony Talent support center.

providers.name: Sonoco Products
providers.description: Sonoco Products Company is a global leader in sustainable metal and fiber consumer and industrial packaging, operating 285 facilities across 40 countries with 23,000+ employees. Products include metal packaging (aerosol cans, steel food cans, closures), rigid paper packaging (paper containers, fiber cartridges), industrial paper packaging (tubes, cores, recycled paperboard), and industrial specialty packaging (plastic components, reels, spools). Serves food and beverage, pet care, household products, beauty, automotive, and industrial markets. A Fortune 500 company (NYSE: SON).

providers.name: SpringSource
providers.description: SpringSource was the software company behind the open-source Spring Framework for Java. Founded in 2004 as Interface21 by Rod Johnson and colleagues, it was venture-backed (Accel, Benchmark) and acquired by VMware in 2009. The Spring portfolio subsequently moved through Pivotal and VMware Tanzu and is maintained today by Broadcom. The springsource.com domain now 301-redirects to spring.io, the current home of the Spring ecosystem. SpringSource exposed no standalone public API of its own; this profile documents the historical company and its lineage into today's Spring projects.

providers.name: The Andersons
providers.description: The Andersons, Inc. is a diversified agribusiness company headquartered in Maumee, Ohio, with operations in grain, plant nutrients, and renewables. Founded in 1947, the company operates grain elevators, fertilizer and nutrient businesses, and ethanol facilities across the United States and Canada. The Andersons does not publish a public developer API or developer portal. Business integrations are handled through EDI and direct partner arrangements.

providers.name: Tsumobi
providers.description: Tsumobi was a Y Combinator (Winter 2007) mobile messaging startup founded in Boston by Joshua Wilson and Adam Bouhenguel, and later backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). It built a programming language that sat on top of J2ME so feature-phone applications could be downloaded and updated on the fly via URLs, aiming to fix the painful install and upgrade cycle of late-2000s mobile apps. The company is inactive (YC lists it as Inactive; reporting describes the startup as shut down after raising roughly $2M), the tsumobi.com domain no longer serves a website, and no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or specifications were found. This profile is retained as a historical a16z portfolio record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: VonBox
providers.description: VonBox operated as Vonjour (vonjour.com), a Santa Monica, CA cloud communications startup offering phone, text messaging, and contact center services for small businesses, backed by 500 Global (then 500 Startups) and Kima Ventures circa 2014-2015, including a Vonjour for 500 Startups perk program. The vonjour.com website is no longer live (DNS resolves but HTTP does not respond), and no public API, developer documentation, or client packages are published. The founding team (Daniel Tawfik, Aman Fahimullah) went on to build ZenPatient (zenpatient.com), a digital health platform, and the company GitHub organization github.com/Vonjour is now branded ZenPatient.

providers.name: Western Refining
providers.description: Western Refining was an independent crude oil refiner and marketer of refined petroleum products headquartered in El Paso, Texas. The company operated refineries in El Paso, Texas; Gallup, New Mexico; and St. Paul Park, Minnesota before being acquired by Tesoro Corporation in 2017 for approximately $6.4 billion. Western Refining's assets are now part of Andeavor (formerly Tesoro), subsequently acquired by Marathon Petroleum in 2018.

providers.name: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services
providers.description: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd. (NYSE: ZIM) is a global container liner shipping company founded in 1945 and headquartered in Haifa, Israel. ZIM operates in more than 90 countries, serving over 30,000 customers across more than 300 ports worldwide with a differentiated global-niche strategy focused on agile fleet management and select trade lanes. The company is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange and, as of 2026, is the subject of a pending acquisition by Hapag-Lloyd at approximately $35.00 per share. ZIM's digital surface includes the myZIM customer area, ZIMonitor cargo visibility, an electronic Bill of Lading (eB/L) service, a Draft B/L tool, EDI integrations for booking and shipping instructions, a mobile application, and a developer API portal at api.zim.com hosted on Microsoft Azure API Management. Access to the ZIM API requires registering through ZIM API Support and obtaining a security token; rate limits are set per organization at registration. No public OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or GitHub organization are published, so ZIM is profiled here as a Tier-3 catalog entry pending spec disclosure or partner access.

providers.name: Zumba Fitness
providers.description: Zumba Fitness is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: AltoTech Global
providers.description: AltoTech Global is a Bangkok-based energy-management technology company building an AI and IoT (AIoT) platform that optimizes energy consumption and reduces carbon emissions across smart buildings. Its Alto CERO air-side and water-side products autonomously tune HVAC, VRF, and chiller-plant systems based on real-time occupancy and conditions, while Alto Digital Twin, Alto Multi-Property, and AltoACE deliver spatial building intelligence, centralized multi-site energy tracking, and AI-assisted facility engineering. Backed by 500 Global, AltoTech serves offices, malls, hotels, banks, and government facilities across Southeast Asia to help accelerate the net-zero economy.

providers.name: Alva Energy
providers.description: Alva Energy is a nuclear technology company rewriting the economics of nuclear deployment to deliver gigawatts of clean power in years, not decades. Rather than building new reactors, Alva productizes capacity upgrades ("uprates") for the existing U.S. reactor fleet: the Alva Uprate combines advanced steam generators with improved heat transfer, a second turbine plant (2TGP) sited outside the protected area, and the DUO-SYNC digital control system, adding roughly 250-300 MWe per reactor as a fixed-price, turnkey project deployable in under two years and targeting 10 GWe across the fleet. The company launched in February 2026 with $33 million in funding led by Playground Global to meet surging power demand from AI and industrial load. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of playground-global and added to the API Evangelist network; Alva Energy publishes a marketing and news presence but no public developer, API, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Astral Systems
providers.description: Astral Systems is a fusion-technology company based in Bristol, United Kingdom, developing Multi-State Fusion (MSF) reactors that produce high-flux neutron sources on demand. Co-founded by Talmon Firestone (CEO) and Dr. Tom Wallace-Smith (CTO), the company applies compact, modular fusion to near-term problems: large-scale medical isotope production to address the global isotope shortage affecting cancer diagnosis and treatment, spent fission fuel analysis, neutronics research, industrial neutron irradiation and accelerated lifetime testing, materials-damage testing, nuclear-waste burnup, and hybrid fission/fusion power. It is a Speedinvest deep-tech portfolio company. Astral Systems is a hardware/deep-tech provider and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Attotude
providers.description: AttoTude is a semiconductor and data-center infrastructure company building the first wired terahertz (THz) interconnect for AI and hyperscale networking. Its platform pairs the AttoEngine, an ASIC-based THz radio built on standard CMOS manufacturing, with AttoWire, a low-loss dielectric waveguide that carries 200/400/800 Gbit/s per lane over reaches up to roughly 40 meters, delivering the bandwidth density of optics without the cost, power, and complexity of photonics. Founded to relieve the interconnect bottleneck in everything-to-everything AI clusters, the company has raised roughly $143M across seed, Series A, Series B, and Series C rounds. This is a hardware company with no public API, developer portal, or SDK; the profile below is enriched only with the identity and domain-security facts the pipeline could verify.

providers.name: Blubblub
providers.description: Blub Blub Inc. is the company behind Speech Blubs, a speech-therapy and language-development app for children aged 1 to 8. Created by speech-language pathologists and child-development experts, the app uses video modeling, speech exercises, face filters, and play-based activities to help kids with speech delays, autism, Down syndrome, and apraxia learn to talk. Speech Blubs is available on iOS and Android, supports English, Spanish, and German, and has been downloaded by over 10 million families worldwide. Blub Blub is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. This is a consumer mobile-app company; it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal, so the entry is limited to verified company identity and published web properties.

providers.name: Boxbot
providers.description: Boxbot builds next-generation supply chain automation, making logistics operations more productive, intelligent, and resilient through automated, high-density dynamic storage that unlocks new AI-driven capabilities. Its platform is designed for mission-control fulfillment facilities: real-time space allocation packs variable-sized items densely, hands-free load/unload moves items onto and off proprietary storage trays linked to standard conveyors with no pick or load stations, and a modular, gantry-based architecture delivers a robust, fault-tolerant design with no single point of failure. Boxbot is a hardware/robotics company backed by Playground Global; it publishes a marketing presence but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Conundrum
providers.description: Conundrum (Conundrum Industrial Ltd, Cambridge, UK) is an industrial AI company building AI-driven, closed-loop advanced process control (APC) and model predictive control (MPC) software for the metals, mining, and cement industries. Its platform combines physics-informed and machine-learning models with real-time controllers, optimizers, data-quality tooling, interactive process-flow diagrams, drag-and-drop dashboards, and a Python SDK for building configurable runtime applications. Conundrum optimizes crushing, grinding, flotation, and cement processes to raise throughput and metal recovery while reducing energy consumption, deployed on-premises or in the cloud across plants running 24/7. The company is backed by Speedinvest and reports deployments across multiple plants in several countries.

providers.name: Crater Studios
providers.description: Crater Studios is an AI-native game studio that builds core AI systems for game design, decision making, and live operations, trained on real player behavior in production environments. The company uses its own live game launches as production laboratories, shipping titles such as Dwarven Realms, Gravebound, and Doomspire on Steam while building agentic tooling around them - a GDD Maker that turns raw concepts into production-ready game design documents, a conversational decision engine wired to live telemetry, automated playtesting agents, content moderation, and localization. Crater publishes a set of playable browser prototypes on craterstudios.ai subdomains as proof that its design agents can produce working core loops. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Crater Studios publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable specification - its AI systems are internal platform infrastructure rather than a developer product.

providers.name: CrowdForce
providers.description: CrowdForce was a Nigerian fintech that operated the PayForce agent-banking network, deploying point-of-sale and digital financial-services agents to extend cash-in/cash-out, bill payments, and banking access to underbanked communities across Nigeria. Backed by 500 Global, its PayForce merchant/agent business merged with FairMoney's Fusion in 2023. As of this enrichment pass the crowdforce.io domain no longer serves an active product or developer surface. The homepage renders an empty Cloudflare-fronted shell and the /payforce path returns unrelated third-party (gambling) spam content, so no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation could be verified.

providers.name: Docker Swarm
providers.description: Native clustering and orchestration solution for Docker containers that turns a pool of Docker hosts into a single virtual host. Docker Swarm enables deploying applications across multiple machines and provides high availability and load balancing for containerized workloads.

providers.name: Dockerfile
providers.description: A text file that contains instructions for building Docker container images, defining the application environment, dependencies, and configuration in a reproducible way. Dockerfiles accelerate software delivery cycles and improve collaboration between development and operations teams.

providers.name: Drop
providers.description: Drop (formerly Massdrop) is a consumer e-commerce brand operated by Corsair that sells limited-edition, community-driven products across mechanical keyboards, audiophile gear, and licensed gaming collaborations (Fallout, Cyberpunk 2077, The Witcher, Call of Duty and others). Founded in San Francisco and backed by Cowboy Ventures and other investors before its acquisition by Corsair, Drop runs a direct-to-consumer storefront at drop.com with a Zendesk-based support helpdesk. It is a retail brand with no public developer API program; this API Evangelist profile tracks it as a company in the network.

providers.name: Enable Midstream Partners
providers.description: Enable Midstream Partners was a midstream energy company engaged in the gathering, processing, transportation, and storage of natural gas, natural gas liquids, and crude oil. Enable Midstream Partners was acquired by Energy Transfer LP in December 2021 and operations have been integrated into Energy Transfer's midstream business. No public developer APIs are published for this entity.

providers.name: Georgiamune
providers.description: Georgiamune Inc. is a Gaithersburg, Maryland based biopharmaceutical company developing first-in-class immunotherapies that reprogram immune signaling pathways to rebalance the immune system and restore health across cancer and autoimmune diseases. Built on a target-discovery platform, its pipeline of immunomodulators spans clinical, preclinical, and discovery stages, including the clinical-stage dual-functioning antibody GIM-122, the regulatory T-cell (Treg) inhibitor GIM-531, and the Treg activator GIM-407, alongside additional antibody and small-molecule programs. The company was surfaced as a venture-backed portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or programmatic interface.

providers.name: GodHands
providers.description: GodHands is a Y Combinator-backed startup (2026, San Francisco) building deterministic computer-use infrastructure for AI agents. It provides a high-fidelity execution layer that acts as a translation interface between any model or agent runtime and the operating system, letting agents reliably operate across desktop and browser applications - including legacy software and API-less systems, on the premise that "if a human can see it, GodHands can interact with it." Instead of fragile, probabilistic vision-based UI automation, every action is designed to be repeatable and predictable, removing hallucination risk from the execution layer, and every action is captured in comprehensive, immutable audit logs for debugging, accountability, and regulatory compliance. The platform is organized around a Control Plane plus Iceberg and Vector surfaces, and is built as the execution engine for any LLM or agent framework. Positioned for regulated teams, claims-approval workflows, and moving records from legacy terminals into browser-based systems.

providers.name: Govenda
providers.description: Govenda (formerly BoardBookit, acquired by OnBoard in 2024) is board management and governance software - a secure board portal for scheduling and running board and committee meetings, distributing board books and documents, managing directors and members, capturing votes and minutes, and reporting to administrators. Access is delivered through web and mobile applications for board professionals, administrators, directors, and executives. As of this cataloging, Govenda does NOT publish a public or partner developer API, an API reference, or developer documentation. Integration is limited to identity and productivity connectors - single sign-on (for example Okta), Microsoft 365 in-browser collaboration, calendar connectivity, two-factor authentication, and biometric login. Any programmatic or SCIM/provisioning access would need to be arranged directly with Govenda/OnBoard sales; there is no self-serve, documented API surface to model. This entry is therefore a stub - no API endpoints are claimed or modeled.

providers.name: Haaven
providers.description: Haaven is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline. The company's primary web presence is haaven.com, which sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge; a published RFC 9116 security.txt (security@haaven.com, languages en,nl) and an api.haaven.com host were confirmed during enrichment, but no public OpenAPI, docs, or developer portal could be read.

providers.name: Hang Ten
providers.description: Hang Ten Systems is an enterprise AI services company founded in 2026 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. Led by co-founder and CEO Dr. Vishal Sikka (formerly CEO of Infosys and a member of SAP's executive board), the company helps large enterprises adopt AI to build, change, and run the software that runs their business at a fraction of the cost and time. Its AI-native delivery model combines agentic code generation, a reusable skills library, and deep domain expertise across SAP migrations, finance, HR, and new product development. Hang Ten raised a $32 million seed round led by Mayfield with strategic investment from Aramco Ventures, and counts Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy and Fresenius among its early customers.

providers.name: Hill-Rom Holdings
providers.description: Hill-Rom Holdings was a global medical technology company best known for its hospital beds, patient support systems, Welch Allyn vital signs monitors, and Bardy Diagnostics cardiac monitoring devices. Hill-Rom was acquired by Baxter International (NYSE: BAX) in December 2021 for $12.4 billion and now operates as Baxter's Hillrom and Front Line Care segment, continuing to deliver connected care, smart beds, vital signs monitoring, and clinical workflow solutions to hospitals and health systems worldwide.

providers.name: HUB Group
providers.description: HUB is a global leader in multifunction pole design and street infrastructure, supplying over 1,000 pieces of urban infrastructure worldwide. With 20+ years of experience, HUB excels in integrating digital devices and data analytics into innovative urban solutions. Partnered with Valmont Industries, HUB delivers high-quality infrastructure for public spaces, including telecommunications poles, monopoles, steel jackets, and head frames.

providers.name: InRisk
providers.description: InRisk Labs is a climate insurtech company building parametric insurance products for climate and disaster risk financing. Its platform pairs an AI-driven pricing engine, real-time geospatial and weather monitoring, and blockchain smart contracts to deliver rapid, data-triggered payouts across 15+ parametric products spanning agriculture (crop, livestock, agri-input), renewable energy (solar, wind), logistics, tourism, energy demand, infrastructure protection, and wage and business-interruption cover. Risk models incorporate global climate drivers such as ENSO and IOD and range from India to global coverage. InRisk exposes an "API on-demand" so insurance partners can integrate customized products, dynamic pricing, and real-time analytics into their own infrastructure. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Interface Fluidics
providers.description: Interface Fluidics is a Calgary-based microfluidics company serving the energy industry with high-pressure, high-temperature (HPHT) laboratory testing systems and reservoir fluid analysis services. Its SapphireLab Pro+ platform and standard and custom microfluidic chips deliver direct visual insights for PVT and phase-behavior characterization, enhanced oil recovery (EOR) evaluation, flow assurance studies, and fracturing fluid testing, using small sample volumes at high throughput. Customers include Equinor, ExxonMobil, Chevron, TotalEnergies, and Shell, along with research institutions such as Rice University and PUC-Rio. The company operates customer-facing software (a SapphireLab LIMS portal and desktop apps) but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Knife River
providers.description: Knife River Corporation is one of the leading aggregates-led construction materials and contracting companies in the United States. The company mines, processes, and sells construction aggregates, ready-mix concrete, asphalt, and related products, and also performs heavy-civil construction services. Knife River operates across multiple western and central U.S. states.

providers.name: Mainspring Energy
providers.description: Mainspring Energy is a power generation company that designs and manufactures the Linear Generator, a fuel-flexible, dispatchable distributed power system that converts natural gas, biogas, propane, or hydrogen directly into electricity through a low-temperature, flameless reaction. The modular, factory-built systems deliver firm, flexible onsite power with near-zero NOx emissions and roughly 46% electrical efficiency across deployment scales, targeting data centers, utilities, enterprises, and industrial operations. Mainspring is a venture-backed hardware and energy-infrastructure company (backed by DCVC and General Catalyst) and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: ManoMano
providers.description: ManoMano is Europe's leading online marketplace dedicated to DIY, home improvement and gardening, operating consumer storefronts across France, Germany, Italy, Spain and the United Kingdom plus a ManoManoPro offering for construction professionals and craftsmen. Founded in France and backed by Partech, it connects millions of DIY, tools, heating, electrical, kitchen, bathroom, flooring and garden products from thousands of third-party sellers and brands to individuals and trade buyers. This API Evangelist profile was added as a portfolio-company stub; enrichment found a consumer marketplace with a published llms.txt and help center, but no public developer, seller or partner API surface (no developer portal, OpenAPI, or API subdomain resolves).

providers.name: Methodical Games
providers.description: Methodical Games is an independent AAA game development studio building award-winning multiplayer games, describing itself as "built by developers, for developers." Founded by veterans of Infinity Ward, Respawn Entertainment, Epic Games and Santa Monica Studio, its lean team has shipped and shaped franchises including Call of Duty, Titanfall, Apex Legends, Fortnite, Gears of War and God of War Ragnarok. The studio emphasizes a developer-driven process of fundamentals, quick iteration and collaboration to craft immersive, long-lived multiplayer experiences. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a game studio it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web presence.

providers.name: Monumental
providers.description: Monumental builds autonomous construction robots and the software that runs them. Its robots lay bricks and blockwork on real building sites, coordinated by Monumental's software platform (Atrium) and fleet operations (Fleet). The venture-backed company operates across the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and the United States, and has raised multiple funding rounds (including a reported $32M raise and Series B rounds in the US and UK). Monumental was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation - this record captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: National Institute of Mental Health
providers.description: The National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) is the lead federal agency for research on mental disorders. NIMH conducts and supports research that seeks to understand, treat, and prevent mental illness, working to transform the understanding and treatment of mental illness.

providers.name: NeueHealth
providers.description: NeueHealth operates a healthcare platform that aligns interests across consumers, payors, and providers to enable value-driven, consumer-centric care. The company serves more than 600,000 health consumers and manages approximately $2.5 billion in medical expenses through partnerships with 21 payors and over 3,000 affiliated providers. NeueHealth operates two segments: NeueCare for direct clinical delivery and NeueSolutions for supporting independent providers in performance-based care arrangements.

providers.name: Ninjacart
providers.description: Ninjacart is India's largest agritech B2B fresh-produce supply-chain company, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Bengaluru. It connects farmers and producers directly with retailers, kirana stores, and businesses, removing layers of middlemen from the fruit-and-vegetable supply chain. Its product portfolio spans Ninja Mandi (wholesale produce marketplace), Ninja Kisan (farmer sourcing), Ninja Kirana (retailer supply), and Ninja Global, alongside a technology-licensing model, Ninja Tech Ventures, and a Startup Program that gives FoodTech/AgTech startups access to its supply-chain tooling (demand forecasting, pricing intelligence, procurement, inventory, logistics, and catalog management). Ninjacart is backed by investors including Accel, Tiger Global, and Walmart/Flipkart. As of this profile it exposes no public self-serve developer API or documentation; technology access is handled through partnerships (partnerships@ninjacart.com).

providers.name: Occupational Safety and Health Administration
providers.description: The Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) is a US federal agency that sets and enforces standards for safe and healthful working conditions. OSHA provides data APIs for accessing workplace injury and illness data, establishment inspection records, and compliance information.

providers.name: Potion Labs
providers.description: Potion Labs (which rebranded its engineering org to Ntropika Labs) is a decentralized finance team behind Potion Finance / Potion Protocol, an on-chain risk-management and options platform on Ethereum. Potion is a "perfectly priced put AMM" — a decentralized put-option / DeFi insurance marketplace where liquidity providers earn yield by selling downside protection through a proprietary bonding curve based on the Kelly Criterion, while buyers get automated routing to the best price across independent liquidity providers. The protocol is delivered as Solidity smart contracts with TypeScript/Vue frontends rather than a hosted REST API. Backed by Polychain Capital. This profile was surfaced from Polychain's portfolio and enriched from the team's public GitHub org and website; the project appears largely dormant (contracts deployed to the deprecated Ropsten testnet, and potion.fi now serves a DeFi blog).

providers.name: Ravio
providers.description: Ravio is a real-time compensation benchmarking and total-rewards platform for people and reward teams. Companies connect their HRIS to contribute anonymized headcount and pay data and, in return, access live salary, equity and benefits benchmarks segmented by role, level, location and sector, replacing static annual salary surveys. Backed by Northzone. No public developer API, docs portal or SDK surface was discovered during enrichment; security posture (Vanta trust center, domain security) was probed.

providers.name: ReadSoft
providers.description: ReadSoft was a provider of intelligent automation and business process management solutions for accounts payable and other document-intensive processes. Acquired by Lexmark in 2014, the technology was rolled into Kofax and is now part of Tungsten Automation. ReadSoft no longer publishes a public developer-facing REST API; its capture and AP automation products are delivered as installed enterprise software with partner-only integration resources.

providers.name: Reflect Orbital
providers.description: Reflect Orbital is a space-technology company developing satellite-based infrastructure to redirect natural sunlight to precise locations on Earth. It offers a Lighting service (adjustable illumination from moonlight to full-daylight intensity, controllable via app or website with no ground infrastructure) and an Energy service (augmenting solar-farm output by directing concentrated sunlight onto photovoltaic arrays). The company plans to expand its constellation from 2 satellites in 2026 toward 50,000+ by 2035. Reflect Orbital is backed by Lux Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-sourced company profile. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, pricing, or sign-up surface.

providers.name: Samooha
providers.description: Samooha is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of altimeter-capital, cowboy-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: data-infrastructure. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Slice Labs
providers.description: Slice Labs is a New York-based insurtech company that operates as an insurance-as-a-service cloud platform provider. Founded in 2015 and publicly launched in 2016, Slice originally offered on-demand insurance products for the sharing economy (homeshare, rideshare, cyber) and then pivoted to offering its underlying digital insurer stack — branded Insurance Cloud Services (ICS) — to other carriers, MGAs, and brands. The ICS platform packages pricing, rating, licensing, real-time and automated underwriting, policy servicing, claims, and capacity into a cloud-hosted, API-embeddable subscription. The company's modern product surface focuses on 100% digital small-business insurance distributed through agents and partners (currently Contractors General Liability, with Commercial Real Estate and Excess Casualty announced as coming soon) on top of Slice Mind, an AI/ML, behavioral-science, and LLM-driven intelligence layer. Slice Labs publicly markets its platform as "fully embeddable via API," but the developer portal, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, and endpoint reference are not exposed on the open web — integration is gated behind a B2B carrier/partner relationship. The official GitHub organization (github.com/slicelabs) exists but is archived with zero public repositories, and there is no public developer.slice domain serving documentation. As a result this profile captures the company, product, and platform surface only; no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, JSON Schema, Naftiko capability, plan, rate-limit, or FinOps artifact is generated here because none of the underlying contracts are publicly observable.

providers.name: Solestial
providers.description: Solestial is a space solar energy company developing space-stable silicon photovoltaics — radiation-hardened, ultrathin flexible silicon heterojunction solar cells and modules for spacecraft. Its products are the only solar products on the market that self-cure radiation damage at operating temperatures, offering competitive performance at lower cost than III-V multijunction solar. Solestial has flight heritage across multiple spacecraft and works with customers including NASA, Boeing, and the U.S. Space Force. This is a hardware and manufacturing company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: TenOneTen
providers.description: TenOneTen Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm based in Los Angeles, founded in 2011 by repeat software founders David Waxman and Gil Elbaz (later joined by managing partner Minnie Ingersoll). The firm backs engineers-turned- entrepreneurs building B2B software, data infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and technical products that reimagine essential industries such as healthcare, logistics, real estate, and manufacturing. TenOneTen typically leads pre-seed, seed, and Series A rounds with checks from roughly $500K to $5M, invests about ten times a year with a ~90% B2B focus, and has backed companies including Procore, Pluto TV, Scopely, and Crexi. The firm also produces the LA Venture podcast covering the Los Angeles startup and investor community. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a venture-capital company record.

providers.name: Tibo Energy
providers.description: Tibo Energy is an Eindhoven-based energy software company building an AI-driven Energy Management System (EMS) for commercial and industrial customers. Its SaaS platform simulates, monitors, and autonomously controls on-site energy hubs and smart grids, coordinating distributed assets such as heat pumps, EV charging stations, and battery storage to cut energy costs and emissions and to unlock additional capacity from existing infrastructure without waiting for grid upgrades. Tibo connects hardware through standard protocols such as MODBUS and OCPP via the Tibo Gateway and exchanges data with BMS, SCADA, and ERP systems through open APIs. Since launching in late 2023 it has deployed its EMS across more than 30 industrial sites and is backed by KOMPAS VC, Hitachi Ventures, SET Ventures, WEPA Ventures, and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Vouch
providers.description: Vouch is a San Francisco-based business insurance brokerage built for startups and high-growth companies, headquartered at 250 Montgomery Street, Suite 650. Co-founded by Sam Hodges and Travis Hedge, Vouch positions itself as the insurance broker for leaders building what's next, with the tagline "Ambition Insured." The company has raised $225M+ from Ribbit Capital, Redpoint, Y Combinator, Index Ventures, and other investors, and serves more than 6,000 insured companies across four industry verticals: Technology (AI, SaaS, Fintech, Cybersecurity, Hardware, DevTools, eCommerce, Crypto), Healthcare & Life Sciences (HealthTech), Financial Services (Venture Capital, Hedge Funds, Asset Management), and Professional Services (Architecture/Engineering, Management Consulting, Accounting, IT Consulting, Creative). Vouch's offering combines a tech-enabled brokerage workflow — including same-day quoting for 81% of submissions — with programs covering founder and investor protection, contract requirements review, workforce compliance, comprehensive coverage review, and claims advocacy. Vouch operates as an insurance broker rather than a developer platform and does not publish a public API, SDK, or developer portal; its only public GitHub artifact is Quadipy, a small Python utility for transforming structured data into RDF graph format, indicating an internal knowledge-graph practice but no externally consumable API surface.

providers.name: Wikifarmer
providers.description: Wikifarmer is a global agricultural platform that connects producers with buyers through a B2B marketplace for agricultural products and educates farmers through expert-reviewed content. It provides practical agricultural knowledge, market access, and price insights for farmers, agribusinesses, traders, and food companies worldwide, with a multilingual educational library covering crop cultivation, livestock, sustainability, soil management, irrigation, pest control, and post-harvest handling, alongside a global marketplace connecting suppliers and buyers and a price-insights service for agricultural commodities.

providers.name: AcreLens
providers.description: Land suitability scoring API for any US property: off-grid, rural, recreational, investment

providers.name: Agamon Health
providers.description: Agamon Health is a healthcare AI company that improves imaging patient workflow management through automation across the continuum of care. Its Coordinate platform uses proprietary deep-learning natural language processing (NLP) models, trained on tens of millions of radiology reports, to automatically extract actionable findings from signed radiology reports, determine whether follow-up is needed, and capture modality, body part, and timeframe so radiology teams can automate patient communications, personalize outreach, and track follow-up adherence. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York City, Agamon has helped radiology teams increase productivity by up to 30 percent. The company was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it does not currently publish a public developer API, so this profile captures company identity and domain security rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Akara Robotics
providers.description: Akara Robotics (akara.ai) is a healthcare automation company building an integrated hardware-plus-AI platform for hospitals across Europe and the United States. Its AI Room Sensor passively captures surgical event data in the operating room as a hospital data layer, an AI platform turns that operational data into real-time staff coordination and actionable insights, and Violet, its clinically validated autonomous robot, uses high-intensity UV light to disinfect surfaces up to six times faster than manual cleaning. The company emphasizes hardware-level data deidentification for privacy compliance, single-provider delivery of the full system, no upfront capital cost, and installation in under an hour. Akara publishes a marketing and careers site but no public developer API, documentation, or OpenAPI surface at this time.

providers.name: Arrakis Therapeutics
providers.description: Arrakis Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering RNA-targeted small molecules (rSMs) — orally available small-molecule medicines designed to bind directly to RNA and reach targets long considered undruggable. Its rSM Platform and rSM Toolkit industrialize the discovery and development of these medicines across proprietary and partnered programs, with a lead candidate addressing the root cause of Type 1 Myotonic Dystrophy (DM1). Based in Waltham, Massachusetts, the company is backed by Canaan Partners. This profile is part of the API Evangelist network; Arrakis Therapeutics does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Aspen Neuroscience
providers.description: Aspen Neuroscience is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing personalized regenerative cell therapies for Parkinson's disease. Its lead candidate, ANPD001, is an autologous induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived neuron replacement therapy that uses a patient's own cells to restore dopamine function without requiring immunosuppression, with manufacturing designed for scalable, reproducible production. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network. It operates a corporate website only and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface at this time; artifact coverage here is limited to domain/identity signals.

providers.name: Asymchem
providers.description: Asymchem (Asymchem Laboratories (Tianjin) Co., Ltd.) is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) with more than 25 years of experience delivering integrated, cGMP-compliant services across the pharmaceutical value chain. Its single-source model spans route scouting, process research and development, scale-up, and commercial manufacturing for small molecules, peptides, oligonucleotides, chemical macromolecules, biologics, and synthetic biology, and is known for green chemistry and continuous flow chemistry. Headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina with major R&D and manufacturing operations in China, the U.S., and the U.K., Asymchem employs roughly 9,000 people and is publicly listed (002821.SZ / 6821.HK). Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network. Note: "API" in Asymchem's context refers to Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient manufacturing, not a public web/developer API — the company publishes no developer API surface.

providers.name: Avaya
providers.description: Avaya delivers smarter customer experiences, greater business efficiency, and lower costs through AI-powered communication and collaboration tools.

providers.name: Avery Dennison
providers.description: Avery Dennison is a global materials science and manufacturing company specializing in the design and manufacture of labeling and functional materials, packaging, and intelligent labels.

providers.name: Avis Budget
providers.description: Avis Budget Group is a leading global provider of vehicle rental and mobility solutions with brands including Avis, Budget, Budget Truck, Payless, and Zipcar.

providers.name: Avnet
providers.description: Avnet is a global technology distributor and solutions provider that delivers electronic components, embedded solutions, and design and supply chain services to industrial and commercial customers.

providers.name: Avon Products
providers.description: Avon Products is a global manufacturer and marketer of beauty and related products, primarily distributed through a network of independent sales representatives.

providers.name: BCLaws
providers.description: Access to the laws of British Columbia

providers.name: Bexorg
providers.description: Bexorg, Inc. is a New Haven, Connecticut and San Francisco based digital-biology company building AI-powered drug-discovery infrastructure for central nervous system (CNS) therapies. Its BrainEx platform restores and sustains whole donated human brains to test drug candidates directly in human tissue, generating clinically predictive data on blood-brain-barrier delivery, target engagement, and brain exposure across small molecules, biologics, viral vectors, and lipid nanoparticles before human trials. Backed by Amplify Partners, Bexorg aims to reduce the high failure rate of CNS clinical trials. The company markets a scientific platform and does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Biotree
providers.description: Biotree (Shanghai Biotree Biomedical Technology, 百趣生物) is a Shanghai-based life-sciences company founded in 2012 that provides mass-spectrometry-driven metabolomics, proteomics, transcriptomics, and multi-omics products and services. It operates non-targeted and high-throughput targeted metabolomics platforms, single-cell and spatial omics, pharmaceutical protein characterization, clinical diagnostic test kits, and CDMO services, backed by a proprietary compound spectral library of 20,000+ standards, automated sample-preparation systems (Starlid), a LIMS, and the MAPS cloud analysis portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or specification is published at this time.

providers.name: Bitacora.io
providers.description: Bitacora.io is a Mexican field-data and operations platform (a 500 Global / 500 LatAm Batch 14 startup) that helps deskless teams in construction, maintenance, and field services capture reports, photos, tasks, and events from the field. Its mobile and web apps work offline and sync to the cloud when connectivity returns, turning field activity into searchable records, PDF and Excel exports, map and gallery views, and real-time analytics dashboards for managers. Bitacora is a SaaS product rather than a developer-API company - it offers custom development, integrations, and KPI dashboards as professional services, but does not publish a public self-serve API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK.

providers.name: Black History Facts
providers.description: Contribute or search one of the largest black history fact databases on the web

providers.name: Bondent (博恩登特)
providers.description: Bondent (博恩登特, Bondent Group / 博恩集团) is a Chinese oral-healthcare technology company that provides an integrated, digitalized platform and hardware for dental clinics. It develops and manufactures its own clinical equipment — oral CBCT / CT imaging (Bojue series), dental microscopes (Semorr), dental chairs (Bomesin), dental lasers (Doctor Smile), UDG endodontic/root-canal systems, intraoral digital impression scanners, and periodontal/implant and digital-orthodontics solutions — alongside the Edent clinic-management software and the "Bondent Cloud" (博恩云) app for dentists. The company pairs manufacturing with training academies (Bondent Academy / 博恩学苑, Star EMBA), operating eight factories, four solution families across ten product series, over a thousand employees, and serving more than 200,000 dentists. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a qiming portfolio lead; no public developer or API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bookend AI
providers.description: Bookend AI is a healthcare automation company building a Gastroenterology Practice Automation Platform that combines Payer Policy Intelligence with intelligent workflow automation. Its Universal Policy Library aggregates and interprets prior authorization, eligibility, benefits, and reimbursement requirements from hundreds of medical and pharmacy payers, and its Benefits, Coverage, and Authorization Assistants automate eligibility verification, coverage triage, and prior-authorization creation, submission, and tracking to reduce claim denials, accelerate care, and improve practice margins across specialty pharmacy, infusion, procedures, and imaging service lines. Bookend AI is a Seedcamp portfolio company; this API Evangelist profile was enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Care.com
providers.description: Care.com is a two-sided online marketplace that connects families with caregivers across childcare, senior care, pet care, housekeeping, tutoring, and special-needs care, plus a "Care for Business" employer benefit used by companies such as Google, Starbucks, and Best Buy. Founded in 2007 by Sheila Lirio Marcelo, the company went public on the NYSE (CRCM) in 2014 and was acquired by IAC (IAC Inc.) in February 2020 for approximately $500 million, taking it private. Care.com is consumer- and enterprise-facing and does NOT publish a documented public developer API - there is no developer portal, no public API reference, and no self-service API keys. Its GitHub organization (github.com/caredotcom) contains only internal DevOps/infra tooling, not customer-facing API libraries. The only partner-facing programmatic surface is a private job-import integration inside Care.com Recruiting Solutions / Care for Business, used to sync job postings from an employer ATS; it is provisioned through a partnership agreement rather than openly documented. Note - Care.com is frequently confused with Caring.com (a separate senior-care directory owned by Caring, Inc. that DOES publish a JSON API at docs.caring.com); this entry is about care.com only. Access to the marketplace itself is via paid Basic and Premium memberships; there is no published API pricing.

providers.name: Carevision Inc.
providers.description: Carevision Inc. is an AI-powered digital health company whose platform turns any camera into a 60-second contactless cardiometabolic wellness scanner. Using remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) and deep learning models trained on 12M+ patient records, it extracts 30+ physiological parameters — including heart rate, blood pressure indicators, stress index, respiratory rate, and oxygen saturation — and produces a comprehensive digital health persona covering 15+ cardiometabolic conditions. Carevision operates under the FDA General Wellness Policy (it is not a medical device or diagnostic tool) and is delivered as a kiosk, an embedded/white-label SDK for iOS and Android, or a web integration to hospitals and clinics, health insurers, pharmacy chains, diagnostic laboratories, wellness apps, and teleconsultation platforms, integrating with EMR/HIS systems.

Acquired by Entegris in 2022, CMC's materials portfolio is now part of the Entegris specialty chemicals and CMP solutions business, serving semiconductor manufacturers through advanced materials and process technologies.

providers.name: Cozen O'Connor
providers.description: Cozen O'Connor is a full-service U.S. law firm founded in 1970 and headquartered in Philadelphia, with more than 1,000 attorneys across 33+ offices in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. The firm is ranked among the top 100 law firms in America and is best known for its nationally recognized subrogation, insurance, labor and employment, global corporate, intellectual property, and government relations practices. Cozen O'Connor Public Strategies, the firm's bipartisan federal, state, and local government affairs and lobbying arm, operates from Washington, D.C. and major state capitals. The firm operates an unusually broad thought-leadership network of LexBlog/WordPress-powered blogs and podcasts (subrogation, cyber law, health law, state AGs, transformative AI, OSHA, employment law, family law, property insurance, casualty coverage, real estate / land use, professional responsibility, and a Public Strategies feed), each of which exposes a standard `/feed/` RSS endpoint. Cozen O'Connor does not operate a public developer program, REST/GraphQL API, SDK ecosystem, or GitHub organization. This profile catalogs the firm's public-facing knowledge surface — practice and industry pages, attorney directory, ancillary businesses, lobbying arm, and the blog/podcast RSS network — rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Cure Genetics
providers.description: Cure Genetics (克睿基因) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2016 and based in Suzhou, Jiangsu, China, developing cell and gene therapies for solid tumors and genetic diseases. Its differentiated pipeline is built on two proprietary platforms: AIMS CAR-NKT, a cell-therapy approach engineered to improve solid-tumor infiltration and modulate the tumor microenvironment, and VELP, an AAV (adeno-associated viral) vector technology targeting the nervous system, heart, and kidneys. Lead programs include CGC729, an anti-CD70 CAR-NKT therapy in Phase I trials for renal cell carcinoma, and CGC-602, a PD-1-IL-2v bispecific molecule for cancer immunotherapy. The company is backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Advantech Capital, and Oriza Holdings. It publishes no public API, developer platform, or technical documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record surfaced from the Qiming portfolio.

providers.name: CytomX Therapeutics
providers.description: CytomX Therapeutics is a clinical-stage, oncology-focused biopharmaceutical company based in South San Francisco, California, pioneering a novel class of masked, conditionally activated biologic therapeutics built on its proprietary Probody platform. The Probody technology is engineered to remain inactive in healthy tissue and to become selectively unmasked and activated within the tumor microenvironment, with the goal of producing more potent, less toxic cancer medicines. The company's pipeline spans antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), T-cell engaging bispecific antibodies, and immunotherapies, advanced both internally and through partnerships with major pharmaceutical companies. CytomX is a publicly traded company (Nasdaq CTMX). providers.name: Ericsson
providers.description: Ericsson (Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson) is a Swedish multinational networking and telecommunications equipment vendor headquartered in Kista, Stockholm. Founded in 1876, the company supplies mobile and fixed network infrastructure to communication service providers worldwide and operates across three product areas: Networks (5G RAN, 5G Core, Cloud RAN, transport), Cloud Software & Services (OSS/BSS, orchestration, billing, charging, analytics), and Enterprise Wireless Solutions (private 5G via Cradlepoint). Ericsson holds more than 60,000 granted patents and operates 21 R&D centers, with networks that carry roughly 40 percent of the world's mobile data traffic. In 2024 Ericsson and twelve major operators — AT&T, Bharti Airtel, Deutsche Telekom, KDDI, Orange, Reliance Jio, Singtel, Telefonica, Telstra, T-Mobile, Verizon, and Vodafone — closed Aduna, a 50:50 joint venture that aggregates CAMARA-aligned network APIs (SIM Swap, Number Verification, Quality on Demand, Device Location, Device Reachability, Scam Signal, Call Forwarding Signal, Connectivity Insights, OTP SMS) and exposes them through hyperscaler and CPaaS channel partners (Microsoft Azure Marketplace, Google Cloud, Vonage, Sinch, Infobip). Ericsson also owns Vonage (acquired 2022), which operates the public-facing developer portal for many of these network capabilities, and runs the Ericsson Intelligent Automation Platform (EIAP) for ORAN-aligned rApp development. Ericsson does not publish a single consolidated developer portal or canonical OpenAPI catalog at ericsson.com — its programmable surface is delivered indirectly through Aduna, Vonage, and channel partners, and most of its public GitHub presence is research tooling and infrastructure software (CodeChecker, CodeCompass, ecchronos) rather than developer-facing APIs.

Examity's programmatic surface is a partner/LMS integration - single sign-on via IMS LTI (consumer key plus shared secret) and a partner integration REST API that platform vendors use to register exams, schedule proctoring appointments, launch sessions, and retrieve completion status and integrity flags. Access is gated - there is no public self-service developer portal, and integration keys plus the integration manual are provided on request via developers@examity.com. Because no endpoints are publicly documented, the APIs below are modeled from the known integration model rather than a published reference.

providers.name: Incandor
providers.description: Incandor is a San Francisco based Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building behavioral intelligence infrastructure for fraud and abuse detection. Rather than relying on identity verification at account creation, Incandor constructs a behavioral map of every user on a platform from how they physically interact with an app or website — mouse dynamics, keystroke timing, scroll patterns, and on mobile how a device is held. It requires no fraud labels and no enrollment period, working from the first session. At the individual level it identifies account takeovers with greater than 99 percent accuracy; at the population level it separates out coordinated fraud rings, mule operators, shared operators, bots and agents, and coerced or duress sessions. Incandor is delivered as a programmable API and a client-side telemetry SDK rather than a black-box risk score, letting fraud teams combine behavioral signals with their own transaction history, customer records, and business rules. It collects only behavioral signals — not what users type, read, or view — keeping user data private by design. The company was founded by Matthew Yekell (CEO) and Luc Rosenzweig (CTO), both Stanford CS graduates. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; the developer platform is currently early access.

This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a health-tech portfolio lead; Tessera is a therapeutics developer and does not currently publish a public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Tia
providers.description: Tia is a modern women's healthcare provider offering a hybrid in-person and virtual care model. Services span primary care, sexual and gynecological health, mental health, dermatology, acupuncture, perimenopause and menopause care, and weight management and metabolic health. Tia operates in-person clinics in Los Angeles (Culver City, Pasadena, Playa Vista, Silver Lake, Studio City, West Hollywood), Scottsdale (AZ), San Francisco (CA), and New York (Soho, Williamsburg), and supports virtual visits across served states. Pricing combines a Tia Membership ($25/mo or $240/yr) with a pay-as-you-go Tia Essential option; most major PPOs are accepted. Tia is primarily a consumer healthcare service; no public developer or partner API has been identified. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: Until
providers.description: Until (Until Labs) is a biotechnology company building the medical infrastructure to pause biological time. It is developing reversible cryopreservation systems for human organs, starting with organ-scale reversible cryopreservation to solve the donor-organ procurement and matching problem, and methodically scaling toward whole-body preservation. The lab translates the fundamentals of cryobiology into engineered workflows across five dimensions — perfusion, cryoprotectants, cooling, rewarming, and organ health assessment — using vitrification (glass, not ice) to prevent ice formation during preservation and safe rewarming. Founded by Laura Deming and Hunter Davis, Until has raised $100M+ to date and is backed by Founders Fund. Until is a research-and-development company with no public API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.description: The largest set of publicly available real time urban data in the UK

providers.description: Basic candidate data and live electoral vote counts for top two parties in US presidential election

providers.description: Authoritative information on U.S. programs, events, services and more

providers.description: US federal spending data

providers.name: Venostent
providers.description: VenoStent is a clinical-stage medical device company based in Houston, Texas, developing SelfWrap, a bioabsorbable perivascular wrap designed to reduce arteriovenous (AV) access-site failures in chronic kidney disease patients requiring hemodialysis. The company combines biomedical engineering, materials science, and medical 3D printing to improve the maturation and durability of dialysis access, where an estimated 50-60% of access sites fail within the first year. SelfWrap holds FDA Breakthrough Device Designation (2022) and is being evaluated in a 200-subject US clinical trial. VenoStent is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, IAG Capital, and Y Combinator, with additional support from the NSF and NIH. This is a medical device / healthcare company with no public API or developer surface; profiled in the API Evangelist network for portfolio and market context.

providers.name: Verso Corporation
providers.description: Verso Corporation (NYSE: VRS) was a North American producer of coated papers including coated groundwood, coated freesheet, and specialty products used in magazines, catalogs, commercial print, books, and packaging. Headquartered in Miamisburg, Ohio, Verso operated mills in Wisconsin Rapids (Wisconsin), Escanaba (Michigan), Duluth (Minnesota), and historically Luke (Maryland). In March 2022, Swedish pulp and paper group BillerudKorsnäs (now Billerud) completed its acquisition of Verso for $825 million in cash, taking the company private and rebranding it as Billerud Americas Corporation. The Verso standalone brand, ticker, and corporate web presence have been retired; ongoing North American operations, paper grades, and customer relationships now sit inside Billerud's global business.

providers.name: Vista
providers.description: Vista AI is a Redwood City, California medical technology company building AI-powered software that automates cardiac and general MRI acquisition. Its FDA-cleared Vista AI Scan product lets technologists of varying skill levels perform high-quality, standardized MRI exams across multiple hospital sites without on-site specialists, claiming faster scan times, more available scan slots, and reduced imaging backlogs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a product/marketing website only — there is no public API, developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer surface to catalog.

providers.name: Zypl
providers.description: Zypl (zypl.ai) is an AI company building synthetic-data and machine-learning technology for financial services and government. Its core is proprietary zGAN generative synthetic-data technology, delivered through Lucid, a no-code platform for developing and deploying robust scoring models. Products include zScore for credit decisioning, plus fraud detection, collection scoring, and IFRS-9/GAAP-compliant provisioning for credit-loss estimation. Zypl serves banks, financial institutions, and public-sector entities, and operates an R&D lab (zehnlab.ai). It is backed by Prosus Ventures. Zypl publishes no public developer/API surface at this time; this profile carries verified identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Alien Labs
providers.description: Alien Labs, Inc. was a San Francisco software startup founded by Cristian Strat, Mircea Pasoi and Liana Dumitru, and a seed-stage portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. Under the Alien Labs banner the team shipped Summify, a social news digest acquired by Twitter in January 2012, and later Memo — "the wiki that's always up-to-date" — a Slack-native team knowledge base that let 8,000+ teams star a Slack message to save it as a searchable note, edit rich-text and code-block documents in context, and retrieve them with a /memo-find slash command. Memo stopped accepting new signups on January 16, 2018 and shut down on March 16, 2018; most of the engineering team joined Coinbase. The company operates no live developer portal, documentation, or public API today, and this profile is retained as a historical network record rather than an active API provider.

providers.name: Ankyra Therapeutics
providers.description: Ankyra Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing "anchored" immunotherapies for cancer and immune-mediated diseases. Its proprietary platform tethers immune-modulating drugs to aluminum hydroxide so that treatment concentrates locally at the disease site, broadening the therapeutic window while reducing systemic toxicity and dosing frequency. The lead candidate, ANK-101, is an anchored IL-12 therapy in clinical evaluation for patients with advanced solid tumors. Ankyra is backed by investors including Google Ventures (GV), Mithril, Polaris Partners, Sands Capital, and Fidelity. The company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical platform; this profile exists in the API Evangelist network for discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: Aptera
providers.description: Aptera (Aptera Software, Inc.) was a custom software development consultancy based in Fort Wayne, Indiana, founded in 2003 and specializing in the Microsoft stack — .NET, SharePoint, Azure, business intelligence, and web and mobile application development, plus legacy application modernization, DevOps, UI/UX design, quality assurance, and security and compliance services for enterprise clients. It employed more than 100 people and was the largest web development firm in northeast Indiana before being acquired by IT services provider Core BTS on June 30, 2021, after which it ceased to operate as an independent brand. Battery Ventures lists "Aptera, Inc." on its all-companies page as an exited investment, which is how this record entered the API Evangelist network. Aptera was a services firm rather than an API producer: enrichment found no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, SDK, webhook surface, or MCP server. Its only surviving public technical footprint is a GitHub organization of engineering-practice repositories (coding katas and workshop material).

providers.name: ARI
providers.description: ARI (shopARI) is a New York City based artificial intelligence company building a personal shopping and styling assistant for fashion. The product is positioned as an AI stylist that produces custom style recommendations across a curated marketplace of both major and independent brands, interpreting the intent and sentiment behind a shopper request rather than matching product tags alone. The company was founded by Lior Cole and has raised pre-seed capital from investors including Bloomberg Beta, 1517 Fund, Correlation Ventures, Daybreak Ventures and Z Fellows. As of this enrichment pass ARI operates as a consumer application and publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, SDKs or machine-readable specification; the shopari.com domain is registered and carries mail records but resolves no web address record.

providers.name: Automatic
providers.description: Automatic (Automatic Labs, Inc.) was a San Francisco connected-car company founded in 2011 by Thejo Kote and Jerry Jariyasunant. Its OBD-II adapter and companion mobile app turned almost any car built since 1996 into a connected car, adding trip logging, fuel and MPG tracking, engine-light diagnostics, parking recall, and automatic crash alerts. Automatic ran a public developer platform at developer.automatic.com built around three surfaces: a REST API exposing trip, user, and vehicle data; an Events API delivering real-time driving events such as ignition on/off, hard braking, acceleration, speeding, and location changes over webhooks and websockets; and a private-beta Streaming SDK that read raw OBD-II data from the second-generation adapter over Bluetooth. SiriusXM acquired the company on 2017-04-27 for approximately $115 million, and all operations were shut down on 2020-05-28. THIS COMPANY IS DEFUNCT — no API, developer portal, or documentation remains online, and the automatic.com domain now belongs to the unrelated company Automattic. This profile is retained as a historical record of a notable connected-car API platform.

providers.name: Bedrock Systems
providers.description: BedRock Systems (now operating as BlueRock Security, Inc) is a United States based cybersecurity company building formally verified systems software for critical infrastructure.
