The company distributes its technology as embedded SDKs and reference designs through hardware partnerships (e.g. Arm, Cadence Tensilica, Knowles) rather than a public cloud API. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: GE HealthCare Technologies
providers.description: GE HealthCare Technologies (NASDAQ: GEHC) is a global medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and digital solutions innovator providing imaging, ultrasound, patient care solutions, and pharmaceutical diagnostics. Spun off from General Electric in January 2023 and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.

providers.name: Generalist
providers.description: Generalist (Generalist AI) is a frontier AI research and product company building general intelligence for the physical world — embodied foundation models that train general-purpose robots to perform real-world physical tasks with human-level dexterity. Founded in 2024 by researchers drawn from OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and Boston Dynamics (contributors to PaLM-E, RT-2, Gemini Robotics, Atlas, Spot, and the scaling of ChatGPT and GPT-4), the company has released GEN-0 and GEN-1 — large multimodal embodied models that emit robot actions in real time across factories, warehouses, laboratories, restaurants, farms, homes, and space applications. GEN-1 is positioned as the first general physical AI model to cross a commercial-viability threshold. Generalist raised $400M in 2026 at roughly a $2B valuation ($500M+ total). It operates from the San Francisco Bay Area and Boston and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: GeoGrid
providers.description: Geogrid Co., Ltd. is a South Korean smart-building water technology company behind BLOS ("Building Oasis"), an integrated building-level water purification and monitoring system. BLOS delivers drinkable water from every tap using chemical-free ionization to eliminate rust, scale, and biofilm, and pairs it with real-time monitoring of water quality, usage, carbon emissions, and consumption plus predictive analytics for pipe condition, contamination risk, and filter replacement. Geogrid targets schools, hotels and resorts, public institutions, and healthcare facilities, and offers a BLOS Care membership service. The company is based at Seoul Startup Hub Seongsu, holds 21 registered patents, and has been recognized with venture certification, ESG awards, and selection as a Korean representative for WSA 2026. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Gokin
providers.description: Gokin Solar Co., Ltd. (高景太阳能股份有限公司) is a Chinese photovoltaic manufacturer founded in 2019 and headquartered in Jiangsu, China. The company produces monocrystalline silicon ingots and wafers (N-type and P-type) and high-efficiency solar modules (GOKIN BC and FLAMINGO series), operating four major production bases with roughly 100 GW of wafer and 16 GW of module annual capacity. Ranked among the top three global silicon-wafer shippers, Gokin employs 6,000+ people, holds 500+ patents, and serves utility, commercial, and residential solar projects across 30+ countries. Backed by IDG Capital, Gokin is a solar-hardware manufacturer with a corporate marketing website and no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Governata
providers.description: Governata is a Saudi Arabia-based data governance and management platform that helps government entities and enterprises turn complex data into business value through comprehensive, PDPL-aligned data management. Its product suite spans Data Governance (business glossary, data catalog, data classification, data lineage, metadata store, data quality), Master Data Management (domains, golden record, matching and survivorship), Data Privacy (personal-data discovery and protection under Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law, access management, and a service catalog), and Governata Core, an administrative backbone covering license management, audit trail, and workflows. Governata packages role-based solutions for chief data officers, compliance officers, data protection officers, and data stewards, and sector solutions for government, healthcare, financial services, insurance, telecom, retail, energy, and large enterprises. It is backed by 500 Global and is being profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification was found at the time of enrichment; this profile captures the company's identity and web presence.

providers.name: Green Canopy NODE
providers.description: Green Canopy NODE is a Seattle- and Portland-based sustainable real estate development and construction technology company that designs and builds all-electric, low-carbon homes. The business operates across three lines: prefabricated "Building Kits" (including mass-timber panelized systems), full development services for multi-unit and infill housing projects, and impact investment funds that finance green housing. The company reports 300+ all-electric homes built, five real estate investment funds, and roughly 35K metric tons of greenhouse-gas emissions mitigated since inception. Green Canopy NODE was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a marketing and investor website but no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: GreenQ
providers.description: GreenQ is an Israeli smart waste-management technology company (founded 2015, Jerusalem) promoting the "Internet of Garbage" — turning ordinary garbage trucks into smart trucks. Its GreenTrack device installs on any collection vehicle to weigh incoming waste and track route, mileage, capacity, time and per-bin (single-can-level) pickup data without requiring sensors on the bins, using a patent-pending visual-recognition algorithm. A recommendations engine then suggests route-optimization and scheduling improvements, surfaced through the GreenQ dashboard of reports and analytics. Collected data can be integrated with a municipality's local-authority systems through a private integration API; the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or specification. GreenQ was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global (also backed by URBAN-X) and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GrowthHackers
providers.description: A private community for top growth leaders - where marketing, product, and growth experts come to learn, connect, and tackle challenges together.

providers.name: Hammoq
providers.description: HAMMOQ is an AI-powered resale and recommerce platform that streamlines the processing and listing of secondhand goods for resellers, liquidators, thrift and retail organizations. Its Listing Solution turns photographs into marketplace-ready listings: machine vision identifies each item's attributes and category, generative AI writes SEO-optimized titles and descriptions, and virtual assistants quality-check each listing before it is published across resale marketplaces such as eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Amazon and Etsy. HAMMOQ also offers Sorting and Photography solutions and an Infinity AI Chrome extension that autofills item specifications during listing. The company raised a $24M round to tackle the growing retail-returns and used-goods market. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Sierra Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; HAMMOQ publishes no public API, developer portal, or specification at this time.

providers.name: Heart Aerospace
providers.description: Heart Aerospace is a hybrid-electric aircraft manufacturer founded in 2019 and headquartered in Torrance / Los Angeles, California, working to decarbonize and lower the cost of regional air travel. The company is developing the X1, a full-scale hybrid-electric technology demonstrator, and the ES-30, a 30-seat regional production aircraft, backed by strategic airline partners including United Airlines and Air Canada and investors such as Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, EQT Ventures, and Y Combinator. Heart Aerospace publishes no public developer or API surface; this profile tracks the company as an API Evangelist network entry in the sustainable-transport sector.

providers.name: Heartbeat Medical
providers.description: Heartbeat Medical is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of hv-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Holo
providers.description: Holo (Holo AM, operating under Greene Group Industries) is an advanced metal additive manufacturing company founded in 2017 and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Its PureForm metal 3D printing platform uses digital light processing (DLP) with metal powder-filled photopolymer resins to produce high-resolution, complex metal components with features as small as 50 microns, in pure copper, stainless steels (17-4PH, 316), and in-development cobalt alloy, titanium, nickel superalloys, tool steels, and alumina. Customers submit CAD files and receive prototyped-to-production parts with roughly two-week turnaround, serving medical technology, precision micro-robotics, and general advanced manufacturing. Holo is a hardware manufacturer and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Houseparty
providers.description: Houseparty was a face-to-face social networking and group video chat mobile app developed by Life on Air, Inc. Launched in 2016, it let up to eight friends video chat together in shared rooms and play built-in games such as Heads Up! and trivia. Epic Games acquired Houseparty in June 2019, and the service was discontinued in October 2021 with its team folded into Epic. Surfaced as a Greylock portfolio company, it is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical consumer-social profile; the product is defunct and publishes no developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: HTML
providers.description: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard markup language for creating web pages and web applications. Maintained as a Living Standard by WHATWG and developed in close coordination with the W3C, HTML defines the structure and semantics of web content alongside CSS for presentation and JavaScript for behavior. The current specification covers semantic elements, multimedia (audio, video, picture, track), the canvas API, forms with rich input types and validation, web storage, custom elements, the dialog and popover patterns, and a broad set of DOM and document conformance rules. This index covers HTML-related standards, specifications, references, and resources relevant to API designers and web developers building on top of HTTP.

providers.name: HTML5
providers.description: HTML5 is the fifth major version of the HyperText Markup Language used for structuring and presenting content on the web. Standardized by the W3C in 2014 and now maintained by WHATWG as the HTML Living Standard, HTML5 introduced semantic elements (article, section, nav, header, footer, aside), native multimedia via the audio and video elements, the canvas drawing surface, web storage (localStorage and sessionStorage), geolocation, drag-and-drop, offline application support, Web Workers for background processing, and richer form input types with built-in validation. HTML5 remains the foundation for modern web applications and the substrate that HTTP-based APIs ultimately render and consume on the client.

providers.name: Hydroleap
providers.description: Hydroleap is a Singapore-based greentech company revolutionizing industrial water and wastewater treatment through proprietary electrochemical technology. Its chemical-free, modularized systems - electro-coagulation (HL-EC), electro-oxidation (HL-EO), and electro-oxidation for cooling towers (HL-EO-CT) - replace conventional chemical-intensive processes with automated, energy-efficient alternatives. Hydroleap serves data centers, palm oil mills, food and beverage production, pharmaceuticals manufacturing, and municipal wastewater operators, helping businesses cut operating costs, improve regulatory compliance, and reduce environmental impact. Backed by 500 Global, the company is profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a product and marketing website but no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: InsightEra
providers.description: InsightEra Co., Ltd. is a Bangkok-based marketing technology and data intelligence company that builds ready-to-use online marketing tools from social network data. Its platform spans social research (social listening and competitor analytics), social management (omni-channel management and chatbots), social data and analytics (Customer Data Platform and CRM), and social campaigns (campaign targeting and analytics), alongside a Thai NLP service and a generative enterprise AI platform. InsightEra positions its "Intelligence Model" as an ecosystem that connects external intelligence (market, customers, competitors, society) with internal organizational data so brands can turn insight into interaction and action. The company was surfaced as a portfolio lead of lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, documentation, or specification surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public identity only.

providers.name: INTL FCStone
providers.description: INTL FCStone Inc. (rebranded as StoneX Group in 2020) is a Fortune 100 financial services organization providing execution, risk management, advisory services, market intelligence, and post-trade services across asset classes and global markets including commodities, equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, and securities.

providers.name: InventisBio
providers.description: InventisBio Co., Ltd. (Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market: 688382) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, China, with operations in New Jersey, United States. Built on independent R&D capabilities, InventisBio discovers and develops innovative small-molecule and targeted therapies for oncology, autoimmune, and metabolic diseases to address unmet medical needs. The company has advanced multiple drug candidates into clinical trials, including late-stage Phase III programs in non-small cell lung cancer and breast cancer, alongside earlier-stage assets targeting KRAS G12C, synthetic-lethal pathways, hyperuricemia/gout, and plaque psoriasis. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. InventisBio is a research-driven pharmaceutical company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Isomorphic Labs
providers.description: Isomorphic Labs is a London-based AI-first drug discovery company spun out of Google DeepMind in 2021 and operating as an Alphabet subsidiary. Founded and led by Sir Demis Hassabis, the company applies frontier AI — including derivatives of the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system and its proprietary Unified Drug Design Engine — to accelerate the design of small-molecule and biologic therapeutics across oncology, immunology, and other therapeutic areas. The Drug Design Engine is positioned as a target- and disease-agnostic, multi-modality platform that combines predictive and generative models with a curated proprietary life-science "Dataverse" and large-scale GPU infrastructure. Isomorphic Labs monetises through strategic pharmaceutical research collaborations — disclosed deals include Novartis (January 2024, expanded February 2025), Eli Lilly, and Johnson & Johnson (January 2026) — and through its own internal therapeutic pipeline. The company closed a $600M external Series B investment round in March 2025. Isomorphic Labs does not operate a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release of its Drug Design Engine; external researcher access to AlphaFold-family models is provided separately by Google DeepMind via the free AlphaFold Server (alphafoldserver.com) for non-commercial use, and via the open-source AlphaFold 3 inference code released by DeepMind. The Isomorphic Labs GitHub organisation hosts only a small number of forks of internal Kubernetes and configuration-management tooling.

providers.name: Janney Montgomery Scott
providers.description: Janney Montgomery Scott LLC is a full-service wealth management, financial services, and investment banking firm headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and continuously operating since 1832. A wholly owned subsidiary of The Penn Mutual Life Insurance Company, Janney serves individual investors, corporations, and municipalities through more than 100 branch offices across the United States, with over 900 financial advisors managing in excess of $167 billion in client assets under advisement. The firm provides client account access through the MyJanney online portal and iOS/Android mobile apps, but does not publish a general-purpose public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or external developer portal.

providers.name: Já Entendi
providers.description: Já Entendi is a Brazilian corporate-education (EdTech) company based in Curitiba that converts traditional corporate training materials into short, video-based online courses designed for workforces with lower levels of formal education. Its learning platform combines andragogy, heutagogy, storytelling, neurolinguistics, instructional design, and mind mapping to deliver more effective learning, offering both custom-built training solutions for large employee bases with sensitive or confidential content and a catalog of ready-made courses, all with integrated video lessons, assessments, and exercises. The company reports 1.2M+ students, 100+ courses, and 1,600+ videos delivered. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer portal, API, or SDK is published.

providers.name: Kadeya
providers.description: Kadeya is a Chicago-based, female-founded climate technology company operating a closed-loop, waste-free beverage vending system for workplaces. Its autonomous stations dispense filtered water and flavored, carbonated, and branded drinks into reusable stainless steel "Infinite Bottles," filling a cold beverage on demand in under seven seconds. Used bottles are returned to any station where they are autonomously cleaned, sanitized, and refilled for reuse, eliminating single-use plastic on site. Kadeya owns and operates the stations and sells hydration-as-a-service, charging workplaces per drink so beverages are free for employees. It serves industrial and manufacturing sites, fulfillment centers, offices, universities, and fitness centers, and reports up to a 75% carbon reduction versus PET plastic bottles. Kadeya was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI has been found.

providers.name: Kinnser Software
providers.description: Kinnser Software was an Austin, Texas-based provider of cloud, web-based software for the post-acute care industry, serving home health, hospice, private duty / personal care, and outpatient therapy agencies. Its flagship product, Kinnser Agency Manager, handled clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, OASIS assessments, and regulatory compliance for home-based care providers. Founded in 2003 by Chris Hester, the company took growth investment from Insight Partners (Insight Venture Partners) in 2012, was acquired by Mediware Information Systems in December 2016, and its products were folded into WellSky after Mediware rebranded as WellSky in 2017. The kinnser.com domain now redirects to wellsky.com; there is no independent Kinnser public developer portal or API surface. This record is a portfolio-lead stub retained in the API Evangelist network for lineage and enrichment.

providers.name: Kronos Bio *
providers.description: Kronos Bio was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in the life-sciences sector, backed by GV, working on cancer therapeutics. It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a GV portfolio lead. The company operates no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation surface. A live probe on 2026-07-19 found that kronosbio.com no longer hosts a corporate website: the apex and www hosts both return a GoDaddy domain-parking lander that answers HTTP 200 for every path, and the ir, docs, api, and developer subdomains do not resolve at all. No GitHub organization or public repositories were found. This profile is retained as a network record of a company with no API surface rather than as an active API provider.

providers.name: L-3 Communications
providers.description: L-3 Communications was a U.S. defense prime contractor specializing in command, control, communications, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (C3ISR) systems, aircraft modernization and maintenance, and government services. In 2019 L-3 merged with Harris Corporation to form L3Harris Technologies, which continues the legacy product lines and is now ranked among the top U.S. defense contractors. No public developer API has been documented.

providers.name: Le Collectionist
providers.description: Le Collectionist is a French luxury travel and villa-rental marketplace that curates high-end vacation homes and provides concierge services for guests, alongside a revenue-management offering for property owners and a commission-based referral program for travel agencies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network, the company operates a consumer booking website, an owner portal, and a travel magazine, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or programmatic partner integration at this time. Sector: Marketplace / Travel & Hospitality.

providers.name: LICENSE.md
providers.description: File specifying the legal license under which a project is distributed, defining permissions, conditions, and limitations for use and redistribution. Standard reference for SPDX-identified open source licenses including MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0, BSD, and Creative Commons variants.

providers.name: LiquidLight
providers.description: LiquidLight, Inc. (Liquid Light) was an electrochemistry company based in Monmouth Junction, New Jersey that developed and licensed process technology for converting carbon dioxide into industrial chemicals. Founded in 2009 by Kyle Teamey, Emily Cole, Andrew Bocarsly, Fouad Elnaggar and Nety Krishna around technology licensed from Princeton University, the company built a portfolio of more than 100 patents covering the electrochemical production of chemicals including monoethylene glycol (MEG), propylene and acetic acid, with MEG as its lead target market. It raised seed funding from Redpoint Ventures and a $15 million Series B in September 2014 from investors including VantagePoint Capital Partners and BP Ventures, and was also a Battery Ventures portfolio investment. Avantium acquired Liquid Light on January 10, 2017 and the company ceased operating independently. LiquidLight was a materials and process-technology company: it never published a public API, developer portal, SDKs or any machine-readable developer surface, and no company web property survives the acquisition. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as an accurate, non-API portfolio record.

providers.name: Listrunner
providers.description: Listrunner was a HIPAA-compliant clinical collaboration platform that let hospital care teams build and share living patient lists. Marketed as "a collaboration platform for clinicians," it targeted specialty practices, residency programs, hospital departments, and outpatient teams with shared sign-out/handoff lists, faster rounding, coordinated discharge tracking, task assignment, real-time lab and clinical data access, EHR integration, printable rounding lists, fully customizable per-team list fields, administrator-controlled user permissions and data access, audit logs and reporting, and a robust offline mode across web plus native iOS and Android apps. Listrunner no longer operates as an independent product: its brand domains listrunner.health and listrunnerapp.com are now served from Cloudflare and redirect (301 then 307) to commure.com, the healthcare-infrastructure company that merged with Athelas. The last archived standalone Listrunner homepage is from 2021-06-04. Listrunner never published a public API, developer portal, SDK, or package; it is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical health-tech identity record and a pointer to its successor surface at Commure/Athelas, not as an API provider.

providers.name: Market Vibe
providers.description: MarketVibe (marketvibe.com) is a finance and technology news blog that publishes ongoing coverage under the tagline "The Financial Status of the World" — market trends, startup funding, and developer-focused technology news (for example, recurring roundups of Replit funding talks, feature releases, and AI developments). It is a WordPress.com / Newspack-hosted publication organized into Tech, Finance, and Lifestyle categories, offering articles and an RSS feed rather than a developer API product. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found a content/media site with no product API surface (only the default WordPress REST API at /wp-json/).

providers.name: Matrimony Com
providers.description: Matrimony.com Ltd is India's largest wed-tech company and a pioneer in online matchmaking since 2000. Headquartered in Chennai, it operates BharatMatrimony, EliteMatrimony, CommunityMatrimony, Jodii, MeraLuv and 300+ community and regional matrimony portals, alongside wedding-services brands WeddingBazaar, Mandap.com, ManyJobs and WeddingGiftBox. Publicly listed on the NSE and BSE, the company serves roughly 7.5 million customers monthly and is backed by investors including Mayfield. It is a consumer-facing platform and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface at this time.

providers.name: MBA Polymers
providers.description: MBA Polymers is a global plastics recycling company founded in 1997 that transforms waste plastics recovered from end-of-life durable goods such as computers, electronics, appliances, and automobiles into high-quality post-consumer recycled polymer granulates. Grades include ABS, impact-modified PS, PC/ABS, PP copolymer, and HDPE, produced through a three-step separate, clean, and finish process across operations in several countries. The company publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical developer surface; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile of balderton-capital.

providers.name: Mendel AI
providers.description: Mendel AI is a San Jose, California clinical AI company founded in 2017 by Dr. Karim Galil to streamline oncology research by organizing real-world data and accelerating clinical-trial workflows. Its flagship platform, Mendel Hypercube, pairs large language models with a clinician-built clinical knowledge hypergraph to add physician-like reasoning to LLMs operating over electronic health records, pathology reports, genomic data, clinician notes, claims, diagnostic data, and EDC submissions. Hypercube is offered as three productized experiences — Hypercube Cohort for patient cohort discovery (with funnel-style criteria analysis and direct integration to clinicaltrials.gov), Hypercube Analyst for AI-driven analysis of structured and unstructured real-world data, and Build Your Own Hypercube for custom clinical-data queries. The platform integrates with enterprise data warehouses (Databricks, Snowflake) and BI tools (Tableau, Qlik), and is available through the AWS Marketplace, Microsoft Azure Marketplace, and natively on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. Mendel serves pharma, providers, payers, and research organizations including Quest Diagnostics, Boston Scientific, Gatehouse Bio, and the University of Pennsylvania, with published evidence in oncology trial prescreening. Mendel has no public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source GitHub repositories; integration is delivered through enterprise contracts and cloud-marketplace deployments.

providers.name: Micro-Service Architecture Patterns
providers.description: Design patterns and best practices for building distributed systems using microservices architecture, including service decomposition, communication patterns, data management, and deployment strategies.

providers.name: Mockups
providers.description: Mockups are visual representations or prototypes of user interfaces and designs used to demonstrate the look and feel of a product before development. They are used across software, mobile, web, and product design to align stakeholders, validate ideas, and improve outcomes by surfacing feedback before code is written. This index tracks tools, services, and resources in the mockup and prototyping space.

providers.name: Modeling Language
providers.description: A modeling language is a formal language used for specifying, visualizing, constructing, and documenting the artifacts of a system. Modeling languages are used in software engineering, systems design, enterprise architecture, and data modeling to capture structure and behavior in a way that can be shared, reasoned about, and turned into running systems. This index tracks modeling languages and notations relevant to the API and software design space.

providers.name: Movopack
providers.description: Movopack is a Milan-based sustainability startup, founded in 2021 and backed by Techstars, 360 Capital, and Greiner Innoventures, that provides reusable, customizable packaging for e-commerce, retail, and B2B logistics. Its circular system pairs branded reusable mailers with pre-paid return labels and QR-code drop-off points, then handles quality checks, cleaning, and redistribution — cutting packaging waste by up to 98% and CO2 emissions by 84% after repeated reuse cycles. Movopack is a physical-product and reverse-logistics company and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: National Telecommunications and Information Administration
providers.description: The National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) is an agency of the U.S. Department of Commerce that serves as the executive branch principal advisor on telecommunications and information policy issues.

providers.name: NephroPlus
providers.description: NephroPlus is India's largest dialysis network, operating 500+ dialysis centers across the country and delivering kidney care through in-clinic hemodialysis, home hemodialysis, and peritoneal dialysis, alongside allied nephrology services and a training academy for dialysis technicians. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, the company reaches patients through its consumer website and mobile apps (iOS and Android). It was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass NephroPlus publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable discovery surface.

providers.name: Network Protocols
providers.description: Network protocols are the standardized rules and conventions for communication between network devices. They include foundational protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, BGP, SMTP, FTP, SSH and many others that enable data exchange across networks. Network protocols are fundamental to modern network architectures and underpin reliable communication between systems.

providers.name: Nlight
providers.description: nLIGHT, Inc. (NASDAQ: LASR) is a US-based designer and manufacturer of high-power semiconductor and fiber lasers, optical fibers, and beam-control systems. For more than 25 years the company has served mission-critical directed-energy and defense, sensing, and advanced-manufacturing markets (cutting, welding, additive, medical, and battery production) from a vertically integrated stack spanning semiconductor chips to complete laser systems, with a portfolio of over 450 patents and design and manufacturing based in Camas, Washington. nLIGHT is a hardware and photonics company and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Nubity
providers.description: Nubity is an AWS Premier Tier cloud consulting and managed services provider serving enterprises across Latin America, with operations in Mexico and Argentina. It helps organizations modernize legacy systems, migrate to and build cloud-native applications on AWS, deploy cloud contact centers and GenAI and business-intelligence solutions, run managed services and DevOps practices, apply Well-Architected cost optimization, and strengthen cloud security and business continuity. Nubity is a professional-services firm and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Numa
providers.description: Numa is the AI Operating System for car dealerships. Its voice AI and messaging platform answers dealership calls and texts, connects directly to the DMS (CDK, Tekion, Reynolds & Reynolds) with roughly 90% DMS coverage, books service appointments, and coordinates the service lane and fixed operations. Used by over 1,300 dealerships, Numa reports cutting average customer response time from 23 hours to under 10 minutes and lifting repair-order dollars per advisor. Numa publishes no public API or developer portal; integrations are delivered through native DMS, CRM, and scheduler connectors.

providers.name: NXTP
providers.description: NXTP is an early-stage B2B technology venture capital firm investing across Latin America and globally, with more than 15 years of investing experience. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as "NXTPLabs" — a portfolio lead of 500 Global — enrichment revealed nxtplabs.com now redirects to nxtp.vc, the firm's current home. NXTP runs Fund III ($100M), has made 122 investments with 32 exits, and its portfolio companies have raised more than $2.3B in capital. The firm backs category-defining B2B founders from offices in Buenos Aires, São Paulo, and Mexico City. As an investment firm it publishes no public API, developer platform, SDK, or technical documentation, so this profile carries identity and firm facts rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Obvio
providers.description: Obvio is an AI-powered traffic-safety platform that helps cities and police departments detect and enforce reckless driving. Its context-aware computer-vision cameras identify stop-sign violations, crosswalk failures, school-zone speeding, and distracted driving, then support law enforcement in reducing infractions and improving road safety. Obvio is a physical-AI company deployed with police departments in Maryland and expanding into new states; it is backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Homebrew, and Khosla Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio lead; no public API or developer surface is currently published.

providers.name: Open
providers.description: Open (Open Financial Technologies) operates at open.money as an India-based fintech offering a connected digital business banking platform for SMEs and startups. It pairs a business current account with invoicing, payments, automated accounting, expense management and payroll, letting founders run their banking and finance operations from a single dashboard. Open is a Speedinvest portfolio company. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; the company website is protected by Cloudflare and no public OpenAPI could be harvested during enrichment.

providers.name: Orbital Arc
providers.description: Orbital Arc is a Houston-based deep-tech spacecraft propulsion startup founded in 2023 by Jonathan Huffman, building Gas-Phase Field Effect Electric Propulsion (Gas FEEP) thrusters and the RIOT Drive (Relativistic Ion Thrust Drive) for satellites and in-space transportation. Its ultra-lightweight electric thrusters use solid naphthalene fuel that sublimates at room temperature instead of noble gases, targeting high specific impulse for satellite constellations. Backed by Techstars and Capital Factory, the company completed a sub-scale physics demonstration at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (TRL 3). This is a hardware company with no public API, SDK, or developer surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Orchard Robotics
providers.description: Orchard Robotics (Orchard AI, "The AI Farming Company") is an agricultural technology startup founded in 2022 that builds AI-powered camera systems and farm-management software for precision fruit and vine growing. Its FruitScope platform mounts AI-enabled cameras on any farm vehicle to collect precise per-tree and per-vine data — fruit count, size, color, and growth rate — which is stored in FruitScope Vault and surfaced through FruitScope OS for crop decision-making, with a Vineyard Robotics division serving grape growers. Backed by General Catalyst, the company has raised roughly $22M. As of this profile Orchard Robotics publishes a marketing and careers website but no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Paisley Consulting
providers.description: Paisley Consulting was a governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) software company best known for its AutoAudit internal audit management product. The Paisley Consulting brand and its paisleyconsulting.com domain now redirect to Empowered Systems, a GRC software vendor whose Connected Risk platform delivers internal audit, internal controls, enterprise risk, operational risk, third-party risk, model risk, and policy & compliance management, along with the AutoAudit audit solution. The company supports frameworks including SOX/ICFR, COSO, Basel III, NIST, ISO 27001, and DORA. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public API, SDK, or developer surface is currently published.

providers.name: PECO Energy
providers.description: PECO Energy Company is the largest electric and natural gas utility in Pennsylvania, serving roughly 1.7 million electric and 553,000 natural gas customers across a 2,100-square-mile service territory in southeastern Pennsylvania. Headquartered in Philadelphia and a wholly owned subsidiary of Exelon Corporation, PECO operates a regulated transmission and distribution business that includes a fully deployed smart-meter network, an LNG storage facility in West Conshohocken, and a portfolio of energy-efficiency, demand response, and assistance programs marketed under the Smart Ideas brand. PECO does not publish a public developer portal or general-purpose API: its digital surface is delivered through the PECO web portal (peco.com / secure.peco.com), iOS and Android mobile apps, and an internal Exelon Utilities content / configuration API (eudapi.peco.com) that is not documented for third-party use. Customer-authorized programmatic access to interval energy usage is available through the customer-facing My Data / Energy Usage tools and, where supported via the Pennsylvania PUC EDI / data access framework, through third-party data aggregators (UtilityAPI, Arcadia, etc.) using customer credentials.

providers.name: PicoJool
providers.description: PicoJool is an optical connectivity company building Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Lasers (VCSELs) and optical engines for AI and cloud data-center infrastructure. Its 50G NRZ, 100G PAM4, and 200G PAM4 VCSEL arrays target 800G and 1.6T transceivers for PCIe, Ethernet, and InfiniBand, aiming to raise bandwidth density and cut the power cost of moving data across hyperscale AI clusters. Founded in 2024 and based in Palo Alto, California, PicoJool emerged from stealth in November 2025 with $12M led by Playground Global. It is a semiconductor/photonics hardware company with no public API or developer platform; this profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network for portfolio and market tracking.

providers.name: PillPack
providers.description: PillPack is a full-service mail-order pharmacy that sorts each customer's medications by date and time, packages them into clearly labeled dose packets, and delivers them monthly with automatic refill management. The service coordinates directly with prescribing doctors and insurance providers, charges no service fee (customers pay only for their medications), and holds URAC Mail Service Pharmacy accreditation with NCPDP E-Scribe capabilities out of Manchester, NH. Founded in 2013 and acquired by Amazon in 2018, PillPack is now operated by the same team of licensed pharmacists behind Amazon Pharmacy, which the site increasingly directs customers toward for same-day delivery and additional savings. PillPack is a consumer-facing pharmacy service with no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Plant Cartridge
providers.description: Plant Cartridge is a Malaysian ag-tech company modernizing sustainable agriculture with modular growing systems for indoor and vertical farming. It designs and builds growing environments, supplies growing systems, and offers managed services to cultivate leafy vegetables, herbs, and fruiting vegetables with a faster growth rate while saving water, nutrients, and growing media. Headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Selangor with operations at Technology Park Malaysia in Kuala Lumpur, the company empowers farmers in the ag-tech transformation to help secure the food future. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global, Plant Cartridge publishes a marketing and news website but no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Presto Automation
providers.description: Presto Automation (now operating as Presto Phoenix, Inc.) is a Silicon Valley-based voice AI and automation provider for restaurant drive-thrus and quick-service restaurant (QSR) chains. Its flagship product, Presto Voice, is an AI-driven drive-thru ordering assistant that automates order taking using in-house Natural Language Understanding (NLU) and large language models combined with automated speech recognition (ASR) and text-to-speech (TTS), with optional human-in-the-loop supervision. Presto offers a full spectrum of operating modes (supervised AI, pure AI, agent-led, and unsupervised AI) and has expanded into AI-native phone ordering for QSRs. Presto Voice integrates into existing drive-thru hardware, confirmation boards, headsets, and POS platforms through partnerships with vendors such as Oracle, PAR, and Qu, and draws on AI partnerships with OpenAI and ElevenLabs. Presto does not publish a public or partner-facing developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; integrations are arranged directly with the company through vendor and POS partnerships, so no API products are listed here.

providers.name: Punch Software
providers.description: Punch! Software is a consumer and professional home, interior, and landscape design software company, describing itself as the number-one global brand in home design with over twenty years of market innovation. Its Punch! Home & Landscape Design product line lets homeowners, remodelers, and designers plan and visualize renovation projects in 3D across Windows and Mac, with tools for paint, flooring, stone, decks, patios, and blinds. The company was recapitalized by Insight Partners (formerly Insight Venture Partners) and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. It sells packaged desktop design software directly to retail and professional customers and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Qarbotech
providers.description: Qarbotech (Qarbotech Sdn Bhd) is a Malaysian agritech and nanotechnology company that develops biocompatible organic compounds to optimize plant photosynthesis and raise agricultural productivity. Its flagship product, QarboGrow, is a photosynthesis-enhancing treatment marketed to boost photosynthetic efficiency and lift crop yields by roughly 20-30% while improving plant health, disease resistance, and crop quality, alongside the Harvast and Harvast+ product lines. Headquartered in Puchong, Selangor with additional offices in Bukit Mertajam, Penang and Jakarta, Indonesia, the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Qarbotech is a physical-product agritech business and publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Quantumdiamonds
providers.description: QuantumDiamonds (QD) is a Munich-based German deep-tech company that develops diamond-based quantum sensing systems for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. The company markets what it describes as the world's first commercially available quantum sensing system for semiconductor inspection, using nitrogen-vacancy (NV) diamond quantum microscopy to detect defects and current-flow anomalies that traditional inspection methods miss. QuantumDiamonds is a portfolio company of the venture firm Earlybird and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As a quantum hardware and instrumentation company, it does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web presence and company identity.

providers.name: Quintessent
providers.description: Quintessent is a Goleta, California deep-tech photonics company developing quantum dot laser and optical interconnect technology to scale computing and AI infrastructure. The company builds quantum dot epitaxial wafer supply chains (in partnership with IQE) and optical connectivity solutions for AI optical interconnects, targeting the bandwidth and energy-efficiency bottlenecks of next-generation data centers. Backed by Sierra Ventures, Quintessent is a hardware and semiconductor company; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API documentation.

providers.name: Rebaja Tus Cuentas
providers.description: Rebaja Tus Cuentas is a Latin American consumer fintech, backed by 500 Global, that helps individuals lower their debt and monthly loan payments. Through its website (rebajatuscuentas.com, redirecting to rtc.pe in Peru) it lets people compare refinancing and debt-consolidation offers from banks and lenders to reduce the cost of their existing loans, credit cards, and other obligations. It operates as a business-to-consumer marketing and lead-generation platform built on WordPress and fronted by Cloudflare, with a public blog and help center but no publicly documented developer program, API, or integration surface at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: RecommerceX
providers.description: RecommerceX is an engineering-driven manufacturing company applying circular-economy practices to transform industrial waste into advanced engineering materials. It operates three flagship brands: RexSteel (seamless and ERW stainless steel pipes, tubes, forgings, flanges and heat-exchanger tubes), RexPol (HDPE and DWC polymer pipes, polymer compounds and engineering plastics), and RexTherm (critical infrastructure including liquid cooling, heat exchangers, power components and acoustics). It serves oil & gas, chemical, pharmaceutical, infrastructure, automotive, water, power and industrial manufacturing sectors. Surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site publishes no API, SDK, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Rhoda Ai
providers.description: Rhoda AI develops robotic intelligence for real-world industrial and commercial environments, building general-purpose foundation models that adapt to the variability of physical work through its Direct Video Action model. Its robots handle tasks across automotive, manufacturing, logistics, and ecommerce, including returns processing, component handling, and material breakdown. The company is a venture-backed portfolio company of Mayfield and currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Rubedo Life Sciences
providers.description: Rubedo Life Sciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering and developing precision medicines that target the biological drivers of aging and age-related diseases. Its proprietary ALEMBIC drug-discovery platform identifies and validates senescent ("zombie") cells that accumulate with age and drive chronic disease, enabling the design of selective senolytic therapeutics. The company's lead candidate, RLS-1496, is a first-in-class selective GPX4 modulator that has produced positive Phase 1 dermatology results (plaque psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, skin aging) and Phase 1b/2a data in actinic keratosis. Rubedo is backed by Khosla Ventures and operates as a therapeutics company rather than a software/API provider — this profile carries no developer or API surface.

providers.name: Ruedata
providers.description: Ruedata (RueData AI) is an AI predictive tire-management software platform for commercial fleet operators. It combines a smart digital inspection app, the TLGX precision tire-measurement device (tread depth to +/-1/32nd and pressure to +/-0.25 percent), and a centralized web platform to help fleets prevent tire blowouts, cut maintenance costs, extend tire lifecycle, and improve road safety. Its business-intelligence layer applies predictive analytics for tire wear and route optimization, and it integrates with major telematics providers such as Samsara, Geotab, Netfleet, and Traffilog plus ERP systems via direct API connections. Ruedata is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing and product site but no public developer API, API reference, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Safe Superintelligence
providers.description: Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI) is an AI research lab founded in 2024 by Ilya Sutskever, Daniel Gross, and Daniel Levy, with offices in Palo Alto and Tel Aviv. The company describes safe superintelligence as its single mission, sole focus, and "entire product roadmap," and is assembling a lean team of engineers and researchers dedicated to it and nothing else. SSI raised $1B in a Series A from NFDG, a16z, Sequoia, DST Global, and SV Angel; Ilya Sutskever serves as CEO and Daniel Levy as President. The company publishes no public API, developer platform, or technical documentation as of this enrichment pass — this profile captures its identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Sagence AI
providers.description: Sagence AI is a semiconductor company building analog in-memory computing hardware for AI inference. Its "analog inference machine" combines deep subthreshold computing with multi-level flash memory cells to run large AI models at a fraction of the power and cost of conventional digital GPUs, targeting datacenter and edge workloads such as generative AI, recommendation systems, real-time defect detection, and video security. Backed by Khosla Ventures, the company positions its technology against offerings like Nvidia's B200, claiming large gains in performance-per-watt and cost efficiency for AI inference. Sagence AI is a hardware/silicon company and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or public developer portal.

providers.name: Sailo
providers.description: Sailo is a global peer-to-peer boat rental and yacht charter marketplace, founded in 2014, that connects private boat owners and captains with renters across more than 3 continents, 50 countries, and 500 locations including New York, Miami, the Caribbean, Athens, and Phuket. The platform lists over 30,000 boats ranging from powerboats to luxury mega yachts for hourly, daily, and weekly charters with optional captain services, and provides verified listings, reviews, booking, and customer support to both sides of the transaction. Sailo is a Techstars-backed consumer marketplace and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Scodix
providers.description: Scodix is a digital print enhancement (embellishment) technology company founded in 2007 and headquartered in Rosh HaAyin, Israel. It manufactures the Scodix Ultra series of digital embellishment presses and the Scodix Studio web-to-print software, enabling decorative effects across 17 applications including Spot UV, foil, glitter, metallic, cast-and-cure, braille and variable data. Scodix serves commercial print, folding-carton packaging, publishing and web-to-print markets with over 400 installations worldwide, and went public on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE) in 2021. Scodix Studio exposes integration APIs for connecting embellishment workflows to MIS and web-to-print storefronts, but Scodix does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or self-serve API documentation.

providers.name: Seppure
providers.description: SepPure Technologies (Seppure) is a deep-tech company building advanced organic solvent nanofiltration (OSN) membrane systems that make industrial chemical separation dramatically more sustainable, claiming processes up to 580x less energy intensive than conventional thermal separation. Its product line includes GreenMem organic solvent nanofiltration membranes, RE(SOLV) solvent recovery systems, and DE(SOLV) oil-refinery equipment, serving edible-oil refining, pharmaceutical filtration, semiconductor processing, and specialty chemicals across offices in Singapore and Calgary, Canada. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. Seppure sells membranes online at seppure.shop and publishes no public API, developer documentation, or GitHub organization at this time.

providers.name: Singularity6
providers.description: Singularity 6 is a Los Angeles-based video game development studio founded in 2018 by a team of experienced developers, several of them Riot Games alumni, with the mission of forging alternate worlds that deepen players' lives. The studio is the developer and publisher of Palia, a free-to-play community simulation MMO where players build a cozy life, craft, farm, fish, and explore a shared social world with friends. Palia launched into open beta on PC and Nintendo Switch and has grown to millions of registered players. Singularity 6 was acquired by Daybreak Game Company in 2024. The company operates a consumer gaming business and does not publish a public developer API program; this profile documents the company's public web presence rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Smacktechnologies
providers.description: Smack Technologies is a frontier AI lab dedicated to national security, building domain-specific multimodal models trained via deep reinforcement learning in synthetic warfare environments to deliver decision dominance to the U.S. Department of War, its allies and partners. The company ships two product suites — Omega, a command-level AI stack pairing frontier models with customer-specific applications for strategic decision-making, and Alpha, an edge-level stack of lightweight models on proprietary hardware for tactical platforms and autonomous systems. Founded by MARSOC veterans Andrew Markoff and Clint Alanis and headquartered in El Segundo, California, Smack has raised $32M across Seed and Series A rounds led by Felicis. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs — a defense-domain vendor with no external developer surface.

providers.name: Sophont
providers.description: Sophont is a frontier medical AI lab (est. 2025) building open, universal, multimodal foundation models for medicine, working toward open medical superintelligence for clinicians. Its open-weight models are evaluated publicly and built with the research community (in collaboration with MedARC), spanning computational pathology (OpenMidnight and the nanopath challenge), functional MRI (CortexMAE), fMRI vision decoding (Brainmarks), and clinical-text benchmarks (Medmarks). Sophont aims to unify every modality of patient data (clinical notes, labs, imaging, pathology, physiological signals, genomics, medications, and demographics) into a single model of patient state to model disease trajectory, predict intervention response, and accelerate biomedical research. Backed by Kindred Ventures. Enrichment note (2026-07-21) — Sophont is a research lab that publishes open model weights, benchmarks, and papers; it does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or docs portal.

The company is also developing Storm, a high-thrust reusable rocket engine (up to 180 tons of thrust) built through European partnerships toward a globally competitive launcher. Backed by Balderton Capital and a certified B Corp, it markets itself as one of the fastest-growing space startups in the world. Its mission is to build a "pause button for biology" by safely vitrifying organs at ultra-low temperatures without ice formation, then rewarming them for transplant — extending the viability window for donor organs and improving transplant outcomes. The company builds perfusion hardware, cryoprotective agents, cooling and rewarming infrastructure, and organ-health assessment methods, working toward whole-body medical hibernation. Co-founded by Laura Deming and Hunter Davis, Until has raised over $100M including a $58M Series A (September 2025) led by Founders Fund with Lux Capital participating. As a wet-lab hardware and life-sciences company, Until publishes no public developer API, SDK, or software platform. This profile was surfaced as a Lux Capital portfolio company and enriched from public sources.

providers.description: Applied Cognition is a clinical-stage neuroscience company unlocking the therapeutic power of the brain's glymphatic system, the waste-clearance mechanism implicated in neurodegeneration. The company pairs a first-in-human, non-invasive platform for continuous, real-time measurement of glymphatic function (validated against contrast-enhanced MRI) with a small-molecule drug pipeline targeting Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and post-traumatic headache, supported by issued platform patents and datasets positioned for AI integration. providers.name: Arc Institute
providers.description: Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit biomedical research organization headquartered in Palo Alto, California, co-founded in 2021 by Silvana Konermann (Executive Director), Patrick Hsu (Core Investigator), and Stripe co-founder Patrick Collison. With 300+ staff ("Arconauts") across 9 core laboratories and 5 technology centers, Arc develops AI foundation models for biology that span DNA, RNA, proteins, and single cells. Its flagship releases include Evo (Science, 2024) and Evo 2 (Nature, 2026) — DNA foundation models trained on trillions of nucleotides at single-nucleotide resolution with up to a 1-megabase context; STATE and Stack single-cell foundation models for cellular perturbation and in-context learning; the Arc Virtual Cell Atlas; the SRAgent LLM agents for bioinformatics; and the BINSEQ binary sequencing format. Models are released under Apache 2.0 on GitHub and Hugging Face, with hosted inference for Evo 2 available through NVIDIA BioNeMo and the NVIDIA build.nvidia.com API. Arc is funded by philanthropic donations from Patrick and John Collison, Vitalik Buterin, the Ron Conway family, Dustin Moskovitz, Daniel Gross, Elad Gil, and other technology benefactors; it does not sell APIs, SaaS, or models commercially.

Its data-center and high-performance-computing business delivers direct-to-chip liquid cooling for servers and racks, and its Asetek SimSports division makes premium sim-racing hardware such as force-feedback wheelbases and load-cell pedals. providers.name: Auransa
providers.description: Auransa Inc. is a clinical-stage, AI-native biopharmaceutical company based in Palo Alto, California, founded in 2014 by Pek Lum. Auransa uses its proprietary SMarTR Engine — a hypothesis-free machine learning platform that mines human disease data such as RNA transcriptome and gene-expression profiles — to discover novel small-molecule therapeutics without starting from a predefined drug target. The company has analyzed more than 500,000 gene-expression profiles across roughly 70 diseases to identify molecular disease subtypes and match them to candidate compounds. Its lead program, AU-409, is a first-in-human Phase 1 candidate for liver cancer (hepatocellular carcinoma), with additional pipeline work in heart-safe chemotherapy and other oncology indications. Auransa is a DCVC / DCVC Bio portfolio company, also backed by Lux Capital, 11.2 Capital, and Harmonix Fund. Auransa is a private drug-discovery company and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its identity and web presence in the API Evangelist network.

Founded in Budapest, Hungary, Avatao is backed by 500 Global and Speedinvest. providers.description: BetaStore (legal entity SimpleMarket Inc., trading as BetaStore.co) is a B2B retail marketplace founded in 2020 by Steve Dakayi-Kamga and Leo-Armel Tchoudjang that serves informal neighborhood retailers in West and Central Africa, operating across Nigeria, Senegal and Ivory Coast from offices in Lagos and a Wilmington, Delaware registration. The platform lets small shopkeepers restock fast-moving consumer goods directly from manufacturers and distributors at wholesale prices, ordering through SMS, chat, WhatsApp and a mobile app, with logistics partners delivering to the store within 24 hours, and it layers embedded working-capital financing on top of observed retailer sales. BetaStore raised a 2.5 million dollar pre-Series A in May 2022 led by 500 Global with VestedWorld and Loyal VC. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass BetaStore publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK or machine-readable artifact of any kind, and its betastore.co domain serves no content -- both the apex and www hosts answer every path with a blanket Cloudflare 301 to unrelated third-party domains, and no api/app/docs subdomain resolves.

providers.name: Bidgely
providers.description: Bidgely is a Mountain View, California energy analytics company that builds AI software for electric and gas utilities. Its flagship platform, UtilityAI, applies patented non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) and disaggregation techniques to smart meter interval data to infer appliance-level energy usage — air conditioning, heat pumps, electric vehicles, pool pumps, water heaters and more — from the whole-home meter signal alone, without surveys, sub-meters, or smart plugs. The platform layers GenAI natural-language interfaces and Agentic AI workflows on top of disaggregation to support utility programs across demand-side management, customer engagement and high-bill alerts, load flexibility and time-of-use, electrification (EV and heat pump targeting), grid resiliency and DER planning, affordability and income-qualified outreach, gas efficiency, small and mid-sized business programs, and energy theft detection. Bidgely is sold to utilities as SaaS or deployable into customer AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, and Oracle environments, and exposes embeddable customer-facing widgets to utility digital channels. Bidgely has been deployed by more than 50 utilities across four continents — including FortisBC, Arizona Public Service, PacifiCorp, Avista, NV Energy, Nova Scotia Power, and SoCalGas — covering tens of millions of meters. Bidgely operates an internal REST API surface across regional endpoints (naapi.bidgely.com, api.eu.bidgely.com) for its own pilot deployments and embeddable widgets, but does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or self-service API key program; integration is conducted under utility contracts.

providers.description: Bright Horizons Family Solutions Inc. The company operates more than 1,000 early-education and child-care centers across the US, UK, Netherlands, and India, serving roughly 1,450 employer clients through three core lines: Full Service Center-Based Child Care (on-site and near-site centers for employer-sponsored families), Back-Up Care (last-minute child, adult/elder, and pet care via in-home and in-center networks), and Educational Advisory Services. The Educational Advisory segment is anchored by EdAssist by Bright Horizons (tuition assistance, student loan repayment, and workforce education administration covering 257 employer clients, 4.7 million eligible learners, and more than $1 billion in education and loan payments administered annually), College Coach (college admissions coaching delivered as an employee benefit), and Sittercity (consumer caregiver marketplace acquired in 2020 and offered through corporate benefits). Bright Horizons sells exclusively to enterprise HR and benefits buyers — 72 of the Fortune 1000's top 100 companies use EdAssist — and does not publish public APIs, SDKs, a developer portal, status page, or a public GitHub organization. The brighthorizons GitHub org exists but contains zero public repositories. This profile documents the corporate structure, segment portfolio, and employer-benefit positioning of a child-care and family-benefits operator that runs a closed B2B technology stack with no third-party developer surface.

providers.description: Bzaar is a cross-border business-to-business wholesale marketplace founded in 2020-2021 by Nishant Verman (previously head of corporate development at Flipkart) and Prasanth Nair (previously engineering and product at Amazon, Flipkart, and Lazada), headquartered in Palo Alto / San Francisco, California with operations in India. The platform connected small and medium retailers in the United States and other markets with curated suppliers and manufacturers in India and Southeast Asia, listing thousands of products across home, lifestyle, accessories, apparel, jewelry, cookware, and bakeware verticals, and layering sourcing services such as vendor management, quality control, consolidated logistics, and cross-border payments on top of the catalog. Bzaar raised a $4 million seed round led by Canaan Partners with participation from Binny Bansal, Sameer Nigam, Rahul Chari, Lee Fixel, and Ashish Gupta. As of this enrichment pass Bzaar publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface, and its bzaar.com domain resolves to a registrar parking page rather than a live product site.

providers.name: Caper
providers.description: Caper (caper.ai) is a New York-founded computer-vision company that builds AI-powered smart shopping carts and cashierless checkout technology for grocery and retail. Its Caper Cart uses a set of onboard cameras and deep-learning object recognition, running on NVIDIA Jetson edge AI, to auto-detect items as shoppers add them and let customers skip the checkout line. Founded in 2016 (Y Combinator) by Lindon Gao and team, Caper was acquired by Instacart in 2021 for roughly $350M and now operates as part of the Instacart Enterprise Platform (Connected Stores), deployed with retailers including ALDI and Coles. Caper ships retail hardware and an internal edge/vision platform; it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or a developer portal.

providers.name: Cassie
providers.description: Cassie (Aircassie) develops advanced air filtration technology for healthcare and indoor environments. Its flagship CASSIE system uses patented filtration to eliminate mold, viruses, and bacteria with zero harmful emissions, contrasting with UV and ionizer systems that emit ozone. The company markets 99.9% effectiveness against viruses and bacteria, a 59-second disinfection cycle, and 24-hour air quality monitoring with real-time data. Cassie is a hardware and environmental-technology company backed by Techstars; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. As of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing website (Wix) with no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or other machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Caterwings
providers.description: Caterwings was a European online catering marketplace connecting businesses with local caterers for office and event food ordering, surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HV Capital. As of the July 2026 enrichment probe the brand appears to be retired: caterwings.com no longer serves a site (AWS S3 responds 403 AllAccessDisabled) and caterwings.de redirects to www.eatfirst.com, the corporate-catering platform operated by B2B Food Group of Berlin, which also runs the EatFirst and Feedr brands. No developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDK package, or GitHub organization could be found for Caterwings; this repo is retained as a historical network record with no live API surface.

providers.name: Cazoo
providers.description: Cazoo was a UK online used-car retailer founded in 2018 by Alex Chesterman, offering a direct-to-consumer platform to buy, sell, and finance used cars fully online with home delivery. The company listed on the New York Stock Exchange via a SPAC merger in 2021 before restructuring and entering administration in 2024; its consumer marketplace brand was subsequently sold. Cazoo was surfaced as a portfolio company of D1 Capital, General Catalyst, and Sapphire Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. No public developer portal or API surface was found during enrichment: the site is behind bot protection (HTTP 429) and no /.well-known/ discovery documents are published. Sector: ecommerce / automotive retail.

providers.name: Cellanome
providers.description: Cellanome is a life-sciences technology company building multimodal single-cell analysis instrumentation. Its R3200 Platform combines live-cell imaging with single-cell transcriptomics using proprietary CellCage technology to isolate, observe, and perturb individual cells and track their dynamics over time, with applications across neurobiology, immunology, cancer research, aging, and CRISPR screening. Cellanome is venture-backed (8vc, DCVC, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Wing Venture Capital) and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and scientific-resources website but no public developer, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Citymapper
providers.description: Citymapper is a London-based urban transit and journey-planning company, founded in 2011, that operates a consumer mobile app for iOS and Android covering more than 80 cities worldwide. The app combines public transit (bus, rail, metro, tram, ferry), micromobility (bike share, scooter, e-bike), ride-hail, walking, and driving into multi-modal routes with real-time arrivals, disruption alerts, step-by-step navigation, fare comparisons, and journey-saving features such as Get Me Somewhere, Go, and Citymapper CLUB (its paid premium subscription). In March 2023 Citymapper was acquired by Via Transportation, the New York-based TransitTech company that supplies on-demand transit, paratransit, and network-planning software to cities and transit agencies; Via integrates Citymapper as the rider-facing layer of its end-to-end transit platform alongside Remix (network planning) and Via's own on-demand operations software. Citymapper additionally offers a B2B advertising platform (ads.citymapper.com) targeting urban commuters. Citymapper previously published a self-service Directions API, a Navigation SDK (iOS, Android, Web), and Travel Time / Routing endpoints, but discontinued all self-serve developer products on 23 June 2023; remaining transit-data and routing integrations are now delivered under enterprise contracts through Via Transportation rather than via a public developer portal. There is no current public OpenAPI specification, self-serve API key, or open-access developer documentation for Citymapper.

providers.name: CleanCo
providers.description: CleanCo is a United Kingdom-based beverage company, founded in 2019 by Spencer Matthews, that produces premium low- and no-alcohol alternative spirits. Its product line replicates the flavour profiles of traditional spirits across key categories, including CleanGin, CleanRum, CleanVodka and CleanTequila, aimed at consumers who want to reduce alcohol consumption without sacrificing taste. The company sells direct-to-consumer through cleanliquor.com and through grocery and hospitality retail channels across the UK and international markets. CleanCo raised venture funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners in 2020. It is a consumer packaged-goods brand and does not publish a developer API, developer portal, or any machine-readable API surface; it is retained in the API Evangelist network only as an identified Lightspeed portfolio company, not as an API provider.

providers.name: Clicky
providers.description: Clicky (ClickyPass) was an Argentine fitness-membership startup founded in 2015 in Cordoba by Ezequiel Bucai. It offered a single all-access monthly pass ($15-60/mo) that let members build their own fitness schedule across a network of gyms, studios and sports centers in Latin America - crossfit, zumba, yoga, running and more - on the same aggregator model as ClassPass and Gympass. It was backed by 500 Global, Start-Up Chile and Parallel18 (about $125K raised) and was acquired by ClassPass on March 2, 2020; founder Ezequiel Bucai joined ClassPass as Head of Partner Development for Chile and Argentina. The company no longer operates independently - the clickypass.com domain now 301-redirects to classpass.com - and it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal of its own. Retained in the API Evangelist network as an acquired 500 Global portfolio lead.

providers.name: Collegevine
providers.description: CollegeVine is a Cambridge, Massachusetts company, backed by Menlo Ventures, that has repositioned itself as "the AI operating system for universities." Its platform pairs automated ingestion of data from campus systems (a Data layer) with a unified Ontology of institutional operations and an AI Operations layer of agents, applications, and ML models that connect directly to a university's CRM and admissions workflows. CollegeVine also operates a large consumer-facing college-admissions guidance property (chancing engine, essay guidance, and an AI counselor) at collegevine.com and blog.collegevine.com. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, or published SDK for its product; engagement is enterprise sales and demo driven. It does maintain an active public GitHub organization of open-source PureScript, Haskell, and TypeScript libraries.

providers.name: Conagra Brands
providers.description: Conagra Brands is a leading North American branded consumer packaged goods (CPG) food company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. Its portfolio of iconic frozen, refrigerated, and shelf-stable brands includes Marie Callender's, Healthy Choice, Slim Jim, Reddi-wip, Hunt's, Banquet, Birds Eye, Duncan Hines, and Orville Redenbacher's. Conagra internally describes itself as API-first across its digital estate, but does not publish any public developer APIs at this time. Partner integrations such as foodservice, retail, and supplier portals are managed via direct B2B agreements rather than a public developer surface.

providers.name: Confluence Labs
providers.description: Confluence Labs is a San Francisco AI research company (Y Combinator Winter 2026, backed by Paul Graham) focused on learning efficiency — building machine learning systems that learn from limited data and few experiments. Founded by Brent Burdick and Niranjan Baskaran, the lab works on hypothesis generation (using AI to design maximally informative experiments) and data-efficient modeling (combining large language models with discrete program search) to accelerate breakthroughs in data-sparse domains such as drug design, materials engineering, hardware, and physics discovery. The team reported state-of-the-art performance on the ARC-AGI-2 reasoning benchmark using LLM-driven program synthesis and open-sourced their solver on GitHub. Confluence Labs currently publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI surface; this profile captures verified company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Continental Resources
providers.description: Continental Resources is a privately held independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Oklahoma City with operations focused on the Bakken play of North Dakota and Montana and the SCOOP and STACK plays of Oklahoma. The company was taken private in November 2022 in a $4.3B transaction with the Hamm family and is no longer publicly traded. Continental Resources does not publish public developer APIs; this profile catalogs its corporate, investor, sustainability, and operational web properties.

providers.name: Cova
providers.description: Cova is an AI-native home care agency licensed in Michigan and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026). The company serves Medicaid, long-term care insurance (LTCI), and private-pay patients, pays caregivers the highest base rate in the state, and helps unpaid family caregivers get paid through programs they may not know they qualify for. Cova operates a home care platform that connects caregivers with families needing in-home assistance, using an AI-driven operational model to reduce traditional agency overhead while maximizing caregiver compensation. Founded in 2026 by Jordan Ibe and Ansh Tandon, the team is based in Detroit, Michigan. Cova also runs MichiganHomeHelp.com as a Medicaid Home Help information resource. As a consumer home-care service, Cova does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: cutt
providers.description: cutt (cutt.com) is a Chinese technology company surfaced from the published portfolio of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. As of the 2026-07-20 enrichment pass the company has no reachable public web presence: the cutt.com apex does not complete an HTTPS connection, www.cutt.com returns HTTP 404 for the site root and every probed path, and no developer, documentation, or API subdomain (api./developer./docs./ dev./open.) resolves. One surviving subdomain, zhiyue.cutt.com, issues a 301 redirect to api.zhiyueapp.cn — a live JSON API host fronted by an APISIX 3.4.1 gateway that returns an empty 200 body and publishes no documentation. The zhiyueapp.cn domain is registered to 北京简网生活圈科技有限公司 (Beijing Jianwang Life Circle Technology Co., Ltd.), which appears to be the operating entity behind the cutt.com property. The cutt.com domain itself was created in 2003 and remains registered through Alibaba Cloud Computing Ltd. (HiChina) with an April 2027 expiry, so the registration is maintained even though the public site is not being served. No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, SDK, portal, changelog, status page, or /.well-known/ discovery document could be found on any reachable host. This profile therefore records probed infrastructure evidence only; it carries no fabricated API surface and should be revisited if the company restores a public developer presence.

providers.name: Datacurve
