providers.name: Magellan Health
providers.description: Magellan Health is a healthcare company focused on managing the fastest-growing, most complex areas of health, including special populations, complete pharmacy benefits, and other specialty areas of healthcare. Magellan Health was acquired by Centene Corporation in January 2022 and operates as a Centene subsidiary. This repository tracks any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts made publicly available by Magellan Health.

providers.name: Makeup
providers.description: Makeup Information

providers.name: Mount
providers.description: Mount is a Y Combinator-backed (P26) AI-native insurance carrier built specifically for companies deploying autonomous AI agents in real business processes. Its first product, an AI liability policy marketed as ActiveCover, pairs continuous vulnerability scanning and red-teaming of AI deployments with purpose-built liability coverage across AI-specific risk categories. Mount secures the agent workflow, quantifies the residual operational risk, helps fix vulnerabilities, and transfers the remaining risk through insurance, advertising fast activation and dynamic, usage-based pricing. Founded in 2026 by Fabian Amherd and John Bachmann and based in San Francisco, Mount aims to rebuild the commercial-insurance carrier stack from the ground up with AI at its core. As of this profile Mount publishes a marketing site and blog but no public developer, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Nationwide
providers.description: Nationwide Mutual Insurance Company is a Fortune 100 American mutual insurance and financial services company providing auto, home, life, business, and retirement products. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts for Nationwide.

providers.name: Novartis
providers.description: Novartis AG is a Swiss multinational pharmaceutical corporation headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, and one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in the world by revenue. The company focuses on innovative medicines across oncology, immunology, neuroscience, cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic disease areas. Novartis does not publish a public external developer API. The company does maintain an Open Source Science programme that releases scientific computing libraries, Drupal modules, and informatics tooling on GitHub for use by the research community.

providers.name: Novo Nordisk
providers.description: Novo Nordisk A/S is a Danish multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Bagsværd, Denmark, and the world leader in diabetes care. The company also develops treatments for obesity, rare blood disorders, and growth-hormone therapy, including its widely known GLP-1 medicines Ozempic, Wegovy, and Rybelsus. Novo Nordisk does not publish a public commercial developer API. The company maintains a research GitHub organization (novonordisk-research) that releases open-source scientific computing libraries and an SDK for the Waters Empower Web API (OptiHPLCHandler) used in pharmaceutical analytical chemistry workflows.

providers.name: NPPES
providers.description: National Plan & Provider Enumeration System, info on healthcare providers registered in US

providers.name: Old Republic International
providers.description: Old Republic International is one of the nation's largest publicly held insurance organizations, providing general insurance, title insurance, and life and accident insurance through its subsidiaries. No public developer APIs have been documented at the parent company level at this time.

providers.name: Open Data NHS Scotland
providers.description: Medical reference data and statistics by Public Health Scotland

providers.name: Open Disease
providers.description: API for Current cases and more stuff about COVID-19 and Influenza

providers.name: PeopleFund, Perfect Technologies
providers.description: PFC Technologies (formerly PeopleFund) is a Seoul, South Korea fintech company operating at the intersection of direct online lending and AI lending infrastructure. It runs two platforms: CPLE (Crople), an online investment-linked finance (온라인투자연계금융) service that matches retail investors with consumer and small-business loans, and AIRPACK, an AI-powered, no-code underwriting and loan operations infrastructure (AIRPACK-Lab for data analysis, model development and approval-rule tuning, and AIRPACK-Studio for model deployment, rule-set operation and performance monitoring) sold to savings banks and other lending institutions. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or partner API surface; AIRPACK integrations are handled through a direct sales/contact process. This record was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched as an API Evangelist network company profile.

providers.name: PNC Financial Services Group
providers.description: PNC Financial Services Group is one of the largest diversified financial services institutions in the United States, organized around customers, communities, and employees offering retail and corporate banking, asset management, and residential mortgage services. This repository tracks APIs, SDKs, and other developer resources associated with PNC Financial Services Group.

providers.name: Quintiles Transnational Holdings
providers.description: Quintiles Transnational Holdings was a Fortune 500 contract research organization (CRO) that provided biopharmaceutical development and commercial outsourcing services to the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries. In October 2016, Quintiles merged with IMS Health to form IQVIA, a leading provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions, and contract research services to the life sciences industry. The legacy Quintiles entity no longer operates as an independent company and does not maintain a public API program; all developer-facing capabilities are now part of IQVIA.

providers.name: Radian Group
providers.description: Radian Group Inc. (NYSE: RDN) is a global, multi-line specialty insurer providing private mortgage insurance through Radian Guaranty and specialty insurance through its Inigo subsidiary at Lloyd's of London. Additional subsidiaries include Radian Mortgage Capital and Radian Settlement Services. Radian sold its homegenius media business in 2024. The company does not publish a public developer portal or API documentation; lender integrations occur through partner loan-origination, pricing, and servicing systems. This repository captures what little machine-readable surface exists for Radian Group.

providers.name: Rio Tinto
providers.description: Rio Tinto is a British-Australian multinational mining and metals corporation and one of the world's largest producers of iron ore, aluminum, copper, and diamonds. Rio Tinto does not publish a public developer API, but operates supplier portals (Supplier Master Data Management and a transactional platform) and a START traceability program. Its GitHub presence is limited to a small number of internal forks (ai-sentry, xpano).

providers.name: Royal Caribbean Group
providers.description: Royal Caribbean Group is a global cruise vacation company operating Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises, and Silversea Cruises. Royal Caribbean does not publish a public developer API. Travel partner and agent integration is operated through the CruisingPower B2B portal (cruisingpower.com), which requires authenticated agent access. The company also operates loyalty (Crown & Anchor Society) and consumer booking platforms with no public API surface.

providers.name: Sephora
providers.description: Sephora is a French multinational chain of personal care and beauty stores and a subsidiary of LVMH, operating 2,700+ locations worldwide and a large ecommerce footprint. Sephora does not publish a public developer API and does not maintain a public GitHub organization. The Sephora storefront and Beauty Insider loyalty program are accessed only through consumer apps and the website; affiliate marketing partnerships are brokered through third-party networks such as Rakuten Advertising and Skimlinks rather than a Sephora-owned API.

providers.name: Tractable
providers.description: Tractable is a London-headquartered artificial intelligence company founded in 2014 by Alexandre Dalyac, Razvan Ranca, and Adrien Cohen that applies computer vision and deep learning to automate visual damage assessment for auto and property insurance claims. The platform analyzes photos of vehicles and buildings down to the pixel to produce accident first-notice- of-loss (FNOL) triage decisions, AI-generated preliminary repair estimates, automated claim review for fraud and consistency, subrogation packet analysis, and property repair-cost estimation and underwriting condition assessment. Tractable's flagship offerings include Auto Estimator, Auto Damage Appraiser, Auto Salvage, Property Estimator, Property Underwriter, and the LumaScanner fixed-operations vehicle scanning product. The company serves insurers, dealerships, repair networks, recyclers, and fleet and rental operators including GEICO, Aviva, Mitchell, Tokio Marine, Admiral, Sompo, Aioi Nissay Dowa, and LKQ. Tractable reached unicorn status in June 2021 and secured a $65M investment from SoftBank Vision Fund 2 in July 2023, scaling to over 300 employees across offices in London, Warsaw, Paris, Milan, Spain, Romania, New York, Toronto, Tokyo, and Bangkok. The product is delivered through flexible desktop and API integrations with FNOL, estimatics, and claim review systems, but the developer surface is gated to enterprise partners — there is no public developer portal, self-service API key, OpenAPI specification, SDK release, or open-source repository, and no publicly published authentication, endpoint, pricing, or rate-limit documentation.

providers.name: Tri Pointe Homes
providers.description: Tri Pointe Homes (NYSE: TPH) is a US homebuilder headquartered in Orange County, California. Founded in 2009, it builds single-family and multifamily new homes across 13 states plus the District of Columbia under a unified Tri Pointe Homes brand that consolidated legacy regional brands including Pardee Homes, Maracay, Quadrant Homes, Winchester Homes, and Trendmaker Homes. The company also offers ancillary services through Tri Pointe Connect (mortgage), Tri Pointe Assurance (title and escrow), and Tri Pointe Advantage (insurance). Tri Pointe operates no public developer program, no documented API, and no GitHub presence; its digital surface is limited to a marketing site (tripointehomes.com), an investor portal, a blog, and a careers portal.

providers.name: Ualá
providers.description: Ualá is an Argentine financial technology company and neobank founded in 2017 by Pierpaolo Barbieri, headquartered in Buenos Aires. The company delivers a mobile-first financial ecosystem anchored by a Mastercard prepaid/debit card linked to an in-app account, with a layered product suite that includes credit cards, personal loans, savings accounts with yield, fixed-term deposits, mutual funds (FCIs), stocks, bonds, CEDEARs, insurance, bill payments, recharges, and international transfers. Its merchant arm, Ualá Bis, provides payment links, online checkout, and POS hardware (POS Mini and POS Pro) for SMBs and online stores, exposing a public Cobros Online v2 API plus SDKs and pre-built integrations for WooCommerce, Tienda Nube, Magento, and Empretienda. Ualá operates as a regulated bank in Argentina (under BCRA oversight), has acquired ABC Capital in Mexico to operate as a chartered Mexican bank, and is the first technology-based company licensed as a financing entity by Colombia's Financial Superintendence. The company reached a $3.2B valuation following $195M in new equity in 2024, and reports more than eight million users across Argentina, Mexico, and Colombia. UaláScore, the company's AI-driven credit evaluation system, powers personalized lending across markets. Public developer surface is limited to the Ualá Bis merchant payments API; the consumer banking, lending, and investing capabilities are not exposed as third-party developer APIs.

providers.name: uncommonbio
providers.description: Uncommon (uncommonbio.co, formerly Higher Steaks) is a Cambridge, UK biotechnology company backed by Balderton Capital. The company sold its cultivated meat platform to Vow and has pivoted to launch SymphoRNA, a new venture developing nucleic acid delivery technology for multi-RNA combination medicines that target complex diseases such as fibrosis, heart failure, and neurodegeneration. As a life-sciences research and platform company, Uncommon publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API specification. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Balderton Capital and enriched via the local enrichment pipeline, which confirmed the absence of an API surface while capturing live domain-security posture.

providers.name: VR Medical
providers.description: VR Medical (Kunshan Weirui Medical Technology Co., Ltd.) is a medical device company founded in 2009 that designs, develops, and manufactures devices for respiratory care, critical care, and wound care, operating an FDA-registered, ISO 13485 certified plant in Kunshan, China. Qiming Venture Partners led its Series A in February 2016. The company publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: VyStar Credit Union
providers.description: VyStar Credit Union is a member-owned, not-for-profit financial cooperative headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida. Founded in 1952 as Jax Navy Federal Credit Union to serve military members at Naval Air Station Jacksonville and renamed VyStar in 2002, it is one of the largest credit unions in the United States, with roughly $14 billion in assets, more than 950,000 members, and approximately 80 branches across Florida and Georgia. It is state-chartered and federally insured by the NCUA. Like most US credit unions, VyStar publishes no public, first-party developer API program: there is no live developer portal, no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger definition, and no documented first-party data-access API. Consumer-permissioned account data is shared with third parties through financial-data aggregators rather than a documented open API, and the United States has no single mandated open-banking contract. VyStar's open-finance posture is therefore aggregator-mediated, with the emerging CFPB Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule as the relevant regulatory horizon.

providers.name: XtalPi
providers.description: XtalPi is an AI-and-quantum-physics drug discovery and materials research platform company with headquarters in Cambridge, Massachusetts and major operations in Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen, publicly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under stock code 2228.HK. The company combines a hybrid AI plus quantum mechanics (QM) discovery engine with large-scale robotic laboratory automation to accelerate molecular research and development for pharmaceutical, agrochemical, and materials customers, including engagements with Pfizer, Eli Lilly, and Novartis. XtalPi's offering spans proprietary software platforms — PatSight for patent extraction, XFEP for free-energy perturbation binding-affinity prediction, XMolGen for generative chemistry, and XtalGazer for solid-state research — and intelligent automation hardware including the XmartChem intelligent synthesis workstation and ChemPlus desktop solid dispenser. Its drug discovery services cover hit discovery, hit/lead optimization, biology capabilities, focused library synthesis, and the PepiX peptide platform, complemented by sister brands Ailux (biology) and AiFChem (chemistry). XtalPi's products are delivered as enterprise collaborations, licensed software, and CRO-style services; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release.

providers.name: 451 Degrees
providers.description: 451 Degrees is a marketing-technology and ad-tech company founded in 2006 that builds Graffiti, a patented AI content ecosystem for digital content and ad-tech businesses. Graffiti uses machine learning, artificial intelligence, and natural language processing to analyze user-generated comments and digital content in real time, converting comment "noise" into structured data that powers brand safety, contextual relevancy, content recommendation, and first-party data strategies. It is designed as a platform-agnostic tool that complements existing comment platforms, ad delivery networks, and content systems rather than replacing them, and markets itself as privacy-compliant with GDPR and CCPA while using no cookies, mobile IDs, or IDFA for targeting.

providers.name: Airbrite
providers.description: Airbrite was an early commerce-infrastructure startup (a16z portfolio) that offered a hosted order-management and payments/commerce backend API for merchants and developers, with JavaScript and Python client SDKs and an embeddable checkout. The product was later rebranded and pivoted to "Celery" (pre-order / crowdfunding commerce). Airbrite is now defunct: its primary developer domains (airbrite.io, getairbrite.com) no longer resolve and airbrite.com is a parked domain, so there is no live developer portal, API reference, or hosted API to enrich. What remains verifiable is the public github.com/airbrite organization and the client libraries still published on npm and PyPI. This profile records that residual, evidence-backed surface; most enrichment artifact types are legitimately empty because the provider no longer operates.

providers.name: Amazon Scraper API
providers.description: REST/JSON API for extracting structured Amazon product, search, and batch data across 20 marketplaces, with key-based authentication, official SDKs, a CLI, and a local MCP server. Operated independently under the ChocoData namespace; not affiliated with Amazon.com, Inc.

providers.name: Amca
providers.description: Amca (Advanced Manufacturing Company of America) is an El Segundo, California aerospace and defense manufacturer rebuilding America's industrial base by acquiring specialized component suppliers and expanding competition and capacity for critical parts — actuators, switches, hydraulics, pressure sensors, power electronics, and flight-control electronics. Founded in 2024 by Eli Giovanetti and Jai Malik, Amca combines design, testing, and production into a single RAPID platform across a network of AS9100D-certified factories (Electro-Mech Components, Electrocube, Aerospace Control Products, Payne Magnetics, Cal-Draulics, BC Power Systems), and serves nearly every major aerospace and defense prime and Tier 1 supplier — Boeing, Lockheed Martin, Airbus, GE Aerospace, Honeywell, Textron, BAE Systems, and the Defense Logistics Agency. It is a hardware manufacturing company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Anda
providers.description: Anda (andaafrica.com) is an Angolan mobility and delivery company that operates ride-hailing and courier services using motorcycles, electric motorcycles, and tuk-tuks, integrating technology, finance, and sustainability to serve people and businesses across Angola. Anda runs a drive-to-own model that empowers drivers to own their vehicles through training (ANDA Academia), insurance, maintenance support, and safe operating hubs, turning informal transport work into stable livelihoods. Moto-taxi rides are fulfilled through the Yango app, alongside green electric-motorcycle options, tuk-tuk transport, and express delivery. The company is based in Talatona, Angola, and is a portfolio company of Speedinvest (invested 2025). Anda does not currently publish any public API or developer documentation; this profile captures the verified company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Apstal
providers.description: AI-first website analytics and visitor tracking platform that replaces traditional dashboards with a natural-language chatbot interface, offering conversational analytics, cookieless tracking, session replays, and heatmaps. Programmatic access is provided through a hosted MCP server exposing analytics tools.

providers.name: Aqrose Technology
providers.description: Aqrose Technology (阿丘科技) is an industrial AI machine-vision platform provider founded in Beijing in 2017 out of the Tsinghua University AI Lab, now dual-headquartered in Beijing and Singapore with offices in Suzhou, Shenzhen, Hsinchu, Berlin, Tokyo, and Seoul. The company builds AI tools, models, and turnkey systems for manufacturing quality control, safety inspection, and process optimization, with 20,000+ AI deployments across 1,200+ clients in 50+ industrial sectors. Its product line spans the AIDI defect-inspection platform, the AQVision low-code AI vision development toolkit, the AIDG toolkit, the SV2000 smart vision hardware, an AI Review System (ARS), a robot inspection system, and the AQ-VLM industrial vision-language model, serving EV batteries, automotive, semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, electronics, photovoltaics, food and beverage, and packaging. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Arctus Aerospace
providers.description: Arctus Aerospace is a Bengaluru, India based deep-tech startup building high-altitude, long-endurance autonomous unmanned aircraft (MALE/HALE UAVs) for real-time Earth observation and geospatial intelligence. Its platforms are designed to operate near 45,000 feet for over 24 hours while carrying payloads up to 250 kg, delivering centimeter-level multispectral imagery as a "zero-infrastructure" alternative to satellites. The company positions itself as a data-as-a-service provider, selling subscription-based aerial coverage for energy, infrastructure, climate, defense, and agriculture use cases. Founded in 2024 by Shreepoorna S. Rao, Arctus raised a $2.6M pre-seed round led by Version One Ventures (with South Park Commons, gradCapital, and angels). As of this writing the company is pre-product from an API standpoint and publishes no public developer surface, API, or documentation; this profile was surfaced as a Version One Ventures portfolio lead.

providers.name: Assist
providers.description: Assist (assi.st) was a San Francisco conversational-commerce platform founded in 2015 by Shane Mac, Giovanni Vatieri, and Geek Squad founder Robert Stephens, and backed by Slow Ventures. Assist built branded chatbot and voice assistant experiences that let consumers order, book, and pay inside messaging channels, running deployments for brands including Fandango, 1-800-Flowers, and Hyatt across Facebook Messenger, Telegram, Twitter, Apple Business Chat, Amazon Alexa, and Google Assistant, where it shipped one of the first Google Actions at launch in 2016. Conversocial acquired Assist in March 2019 and Shane Mac became Conversocial's Chief Automation Officer. The assi.st domain is now parked with no web host, and Assist never published a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification, so there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Atlas Motion Systems
providers.description: Atlas Motion Systems (atlasmotion.com) designs and builds brushless DC (BLDC) motors and actuators for defense and robotics applications, engineered around a customer's specific program and manufactured at scale. The public web presence is a single-page marketing site (hero plus a contact page); it is a hardware company that does not publish a developer portal, public API, SDKs, documentation, or well-known discovery surface. This profile was seeded as a Homebrew-portfolio lead and enriched with verifiable identity and live domain-security probe data only. Enrichment found no API surface to harvest.

providers.name: Autobia
providers.description: Autobia is a B2B e-commerce marketplace for the automotive aftermarket in Saudi Arabia, connecting auto-parts retailers, workshops, and service centers with wholesalers and dealers. The platform offers real-time pricing and instant ordering across more than 20,000 spare parts from multiple brands, centralizing sourcing to streamline procurement and improve supply-chain efficiency for the automotive sector. Backed by Techstars, Autobia operates via a web platform and native iOS and Android apps. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK is currently published.

providers.name: BBN Technologies
providers.description: BBN Technologies is a research and development organization founded in 1948 (originally Bolt Beranek and Newman) and now operating as RTX BBN Technologies, a division of RTX (Raytheon). BBN is historically notable for pioneering the ARPANET, early network email, and packet-switched networking, and today conducts advanced defense and intelligence R&D across AI/machine learning, command and control, cyber operations, signal processing and spectrum, networking, quantum and photonics, and voice and language technologies. BBN serves government and defense customers and does not publish a public developer portal, API, or SDK surface; this profile is maintained for network identity and discovery only.

providers.name: Beacon (Software)
providers.description: Beacon Software is a permanent software holding company, founded in 2024 and led by CEO Nilam Ganenthiran, that acquires and operates essential vertical software businesses serving Main Street industries. Rather than flipping acquisitions, Beacon holds companies indefinitely, keeping each founder's team and brand intact while providing a centralized operating platform — engineering support, AI integration, sales, finance, and a network of portfolio operators — to help them better serve their customers. Backed by General Catalyst, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and D1 Capital. Beacon is an acquisition and operating company, not a developer-facing platform: it publishes no public API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Blank Rome LLP
providers.description: Blank Rome LLP is an Am Law 100 U.S. law firm founded in 1946 and headquartered in Philadelphia, with approximately 600+ attorneys across roughly 14 U.S. offices plus an international presence (Shanghai). The firm provides comprehensive legal and government-advocacy services across commercial and corporate litigation, corporate / M&A and finance, restructuring and bankruptcy, government contracts, intellectual property, labor and employment, real estate, tax, white-collar defense, matrimonial and family law, and a nationally recognized maritime and international trade practice. Blank Rome Government Relations LLC, the firm's affiliated lobbying arm, operates from Washington, D.C. The firm publishes practice-area client alerts, the Mainbrace maritime newsletter, and industry insights through its website's News & Events and Publications sections. Blank Rome does not operate a public developer program, REST/GraphQL API, SDK ecosystem, or GitHub organization; this profile catalogs the firm's public-facing knowledge surface (practice pages, newsletters, alerts) rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Blue Studios
providers.description: Blue Studios Labs is a family-focused technology company operating under the tagline "Where Families Flourish." It builds consumer digital products that help couples and families explore, learn, and grow together. Its portfolio includes Wallio, a shared financial-management app for couples and families; Blue Studios EDU, an entertainment-based educational streaming service; and Blue Studios Entertainment, a media-production studio creating family-oriented narratives and content. The company reports more than 400 million digital views, 350,000 game plays, and 4,000+ classes delivered. Blue Studios is a Techstars portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Broadvision
providers.description: BroadVision spans two chapters of Dr. Pehong Chen's technology work. BroadVision, Inc. (NASDAQ: BVSN), founded in 1993 and backed by Mayfield, was a pioneer of e-commerce and enterprise self-service portal software and later the Vmoso enterprise collaboration platform; the operating company was acquired by ESW Capital in 2020. The broadvision.com domain is now home to BroadVision Group (BVG), a US-based private asset management firm formed in 2006 that funds, incubates, and operates ventures across artificial intelligence, cleantech, fintech, healthtech, biotech, medtech, semiconductors, and cloud/big-data. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Brodo
providers.description: Brodo (PT Brodo Ganesha Indonesia) is an Indonesian direct-to-consumer footwear and menswear brand founded in Bandung, selling shoes, apparel, and accessories through its official webstore at bro.do. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Brodo runs a consumer e-commerce storefront on a third-party commerce platform (Plugo) with local Indonesian payment rails (NicePay); it publishes no first-party developer API, OpenAPI, developer portal, SDK, or public integration surface at this time, so there are no API artifacts to enrich beyond this company profile.

providers.name: Bunge
providers.description: Bunge Global SA is a multinational agribusiness and food company connecting farmers to consumers by sourcing, processing, and supplying oilseed and grain products. Operates across grain origination, oilseed processing, refined and specialty oils, milling, sugarcane and biofuel production, and fertilizer sales. In 2025 Bunge completed its merger with Viterra to create a major global agricultural trading and processing platform.

providers.name: Captain Fresh
providers.description: Captain Fresh is a Bangalore, India based B2B technology company building sustainable seafood and animal-protein supply chains worldwide, connecting fishermen, farmers, processors and retailers through a technology-enabled sourcing, cold-chain and distribution marketplace. Backed by Accel and Prosus Ventures, the company operates across India and international markets. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a consumer / supply-chain company profile; no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal was found during enrichment (a marketing website only).

providers.name: Cerrion
providers.description: Cerrion builds enterprise-grade video AI agents for manufacturing. Its platform connects to existing or provided factory cameras to monitor production lines in real time, using pre-trained visual triggers to automatically detect and respond to quality defects, safety hazards, process deviations, and equipment issues. The closed-loop system can slow or stop machines, raise alarms, and escalate alerts while giving operators root-cause insight, helping manufacturers resolve problems up to 50% faster and cut downtime and scrap. Cerrion is deployed in live production across glass, food & beverage, tableware, sawmilling/timber, and CPG environments (customers include Unilever, Riedel, Schott Zwiesel, Stölzle Lausitz, Sisecam, and Verallia). Zurich-based and backed by Creandum, Y Combinator, Goat Capital, 10x Founders, and Session VC. No public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: CH2M Hill
providers.description: CH2M Hill was a global engineering, consulting, design, construction and operations firm providing services for corporations and federal, state, and local governments. Headquartered in Englewood, Colorado, the firm delivered work in water, transportation, environment, energy, industrial, and facilities markets. In December 2017 CH2M was acquired by Jacobs Engineering (now Jacobs Solutions) and its operations have been integrated into Jacobs. As of the acquisition, CH2M Hill no longer publishes a standalone public API program; relevant digital engineering, project delivery, and data services are now offered under the Jacobs brand.

providers.name: Chocodata
providers.description: Web-scraping REST API that returns structured JSON from a large catalog of target sites (e-commerce, search engines, social, real estate, finance, and more), with proxies, CAPTCHA, and anti-bot handling managed server-side. Offers an npm-distributed MCP server, a live llms.txt docs manifest, and published Claude agent skills.

providers.name: Clausematch
providers.description: Clausematch is a London-founded regulatory technology (RegTech) company providing a cloud platform for policy and procedure management, regulatory change management, and structured document authoring and collaboration for banks, insurers, and other regulated financial institutions. Its tooling helps compliance teams draft, review, version, and attest to policies while mapping regulatory obligations to internal controls. Clausematch was acquired by Corlytics in 2024; the clausematch.com domain now 301-redirects to corlytics.com. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. No public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment (the web surface is WAF-protected and returns HTTP 403 to automated probes).

providers.name: Clutch Wallet
providers.description: Clutch Wallet was a Los Angeles-based web3 startup building a non-custodial "social wallet" and web3 toolkit — a seedless browser extension and mobile wallet (leaning on account abstraction and seamless sign-in) paired with a dApp offering token search, three-click DeFi, a web3 social profile, a personalized crypto media feed, aggregated multi-wallet balances in a single dashboard, integrated crypto education, and community tools. Founded by Bec Jones (CEO), James Kouzinas (CFO/COO), and Sheela Vats (CTO), it raised ~$800K backed by Anthemis (Female Innovators Lab Fund), Emmeline Ventures, Everywhere Ventures, and Rogue Women. The company is now permanently closed: its clutchwallet.xyz domain is parked and it exposed no public production API. It remains in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead profile; its clutch-wallet GitHub organization (mostly forks of Zerion, Argent, and MetaMask projects) and one first-party npm library survive as artifacts.

providers.name: Cooper Tire & Rubber
providers.description: Cooper Tire & Rubber Company is an American manufacturer of replacement tires for passenger cars, light trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles, founded in 1914 and headquartered in Findlay, Ohio. Cooper was acquired by The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company in June 2021 and now operates as a subsidiary, retaining the Cooper brand alongside Goodyear. The Cooper brand portfolio covers all-season, winter, all-terrain, and sport performance tires distributed through retailers and dealers worldwide. Cooper Tire does not publish a public developer program or REST APIs. Its digital presence is consumer-facing tire selection, retailer locators, and post-purchase tire registration.

providers.name: Cord *
providers.description: Cord * (Cord Project Inc.) was a consumer communication startup building simple, fast voice messaging that let people send short audio clips to one friend or broadcast to a whole group, delivered through iOS and Android mobile apps. Backed by GV and Index Ventures, the New York based team was acquired by Spotify in 2015, where the product formed the foundation of a group exploring new ways people interact with audio; the standalone apps and service were subsequently wound down. The company never published a public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this API Evangelist profile is retained as a historical portfolio-lead record with no active API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: CreatorDAO
providers.description: CreatorDAO supports content creators through funding, bespoke tooling, and training, backing a roster of YouTube and social channels ranging from tens of thousands to millions of subscribers. It operates a decentralized autonomous organization model with an on-chain creator token, promoting its creator app (district.xyz) and community channels rather than a developer platform. Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and Initialized Capital, CreatorDAO publishes no public API, developer documentation, or API specifications as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Dispatch Goods
providers.description: Dispatch Goods is a reusable-packaging and reverse-logistics company that offers returnable containers and insulated bags as an alternative to single-use and compostable packaging for direct-to-consumer meal kits, grocery delivery, and food-service operations. The company handles the full circular loop — packaging, collection, washing, and redistribution — and markets its reusable system as a cheaper and lower-impact substitute for cardboard, gel packs, and insulation, citing reductions in water use and CO2 equivalent emissions. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: DivX, Inc. (NasdaqGS:DIVX)
providers.description: DivX is a San Diego-based digital video technology company best known for the DivX video codec and format. Under the former public company DivX, Inc. (NasdaqGS:DIVX), and today as DivX, LLC, it offers free and premium consumer software — DivX Software and DivX Pro for Windows and macOS — for playing, converting, and casting video, alongside a technology-licensing business that certifies DivX and HEVC playback in consumer electronics devices (the "DivX Certified" program). The company distributes desktop applications to end users and licenses codecs and playback technology to device manufacturers rather than operating a public developer API platform. Customer support is handled through a Zendesk help center, and enterprise/device partners are served via a Salesforce-based partner portal.

providers.name: Dresser-Rand Group
providers.description: Dresser-Rand Group was a global supplier of rotating equipment solutions to the worldwide oil, gas, petrochemical, and process industries. It was acquired by Siemens in 2015 and now operates as part of Siemens Energy.

providers.name: EasyAR CRS API
providers.description: EasyAR CRS (Cloud Recognition Service) is a cloud image-recognition solution that lets developers manage up to 100K image-targets online and recognize them from camera key-frames. It provides HTTP web-service APIs for target management and recognition, with request-signing/token authentication on per-instance regional base URLs.

providers.name: EPAL INC.
providers.description: EPAL INC. operates E-Pal (epal.gg), a consumer gaming-companion and social marketplace platform that connects players who want teammates, coaches, or company for online play. Through its web and mobile apps, users book vetted "ePals" across titles such as League of Legends, Valorant, and Fortnite for co-play, chilling (social hangout) sessions, and custom experiences, with a tiered recognition system (eStars and Legend ePals) surfacing top community members. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; no public developer platform, API, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Esar
providers.description: Esar (ايسار) is a Saudi Arabia and UAE based car rental marketplace that connects vehicle owners with renters through a mobile app, offering luxury, sports, family, and 4x4 vehicles across Riyadh, Jeddah, Mecca, and Dubai. The platform lets car owners list vehicles to earn recurring returns while giving travelers on-demand access to a curated fleet at competitive daily rates. Headquartered in Jeddah, Esar is an early-stage startup backed by 500 Global and the Taqadam accelerator. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead; no public developer API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: Fabrion
providers.description: Fabrion builds an AI Operating System for industrial manufacturers, applying artificial intelligence to manufacturing operations and the industrial sector. The company is a venture-backed portfolio company of 8vc and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As of this enrichment pass Fabrion publishes a marketing website with AI Lab, Careers, and Contact pages, but exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, packages, MCP server, or other machine-readable developer artifacts. No developer, docs, or api subdomains resolve and no /.well-known/, llms.txt, pricing, or blog surfaces were found. This remains a lead awaiting a real API surface to enrich against.

providers.name: Famebit
providers.description: Famebit was an influencer-marketing marketplace, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Los Angeles, that connected YouTube, Instagram, and Vine creators with brands for sponsored branded-content campaigns. Backed by 500 Startups (500 Global), it was acquired by Google in October 2016, rebranded as "FameBit by YouTube," and later folded into YouTube BrandConnect. The standalone platform has been shut down and famebit.com now redirects to a Google/YouTube Help support page, so there is no live public API, developer portal, or documentation to enrich.

providers.name: FIMI Technology
providers.description: FIMI Technology Ltd. (Beijing FIMI Technology Co., Ltd. / Shenzhen FIMI Robot Technology Co., Ltd.) is a consumer aerial-imaging hardware manufacturer founded in May 2014 as a member of the Xiaomi ecosystem. FIMI designs and sells affordable camera drones, handheld gimbal cameras, and smartphone gimbals, with a product lineup that includes the X8 series (X8 SE, X8 Pro, X8 Tele, X8T enterprise), the compact Mini 3, the Manta VTOL fixed-wing drone, and the PALM series gimbal cameras. The company holds hundreds of patents across flight control, wireless transmission links, mechatronic design, gimbal image-stabilization, and computer vision. FIMI is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. This is a consumer-electronics company with no public developer program, API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: FloSports
providers.description: FloSports is an Austin, Texas-based direct-to-consumer sports media and live-streaming company founded in 2006 by brothers Martin and Mark Floreani. It operates a network of vertical properties (FloWrestling, FloTrack, FloGrappling, FloRacing, FloHockey, FloRugby, FloFootball and more) that deliver live and on-demand event streaming, original programming, news, rankings, and results for underserved and passionate sports communities through a subscription model. FloSports surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures; enrichment probing found a consumer streaming site with no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, well-known discovery documents, or SDK program at this time.

providers.name: forgame
providers.description: Forgame Holdings Limited (HKEX 00484) is a Hong Kong-listed technology holding company founded in 2009 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China. It operates across cloud/light gaming, fintech, electronic trade, and cloud storage. Its web and mobile game publishing platform 91wan, run by PRC entity Guangzhou Weidong Internet Technology Co., Ltd., has distributed over 100 web games and attracted more than 200 million registered players. In 2016 the group obtained an internet micro-lending (fintech) license in the PRC, and since 2019 has explored e-sports and virtual-reality games. Forgame is tracked by API Evangelist as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners; no public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Gaspack
providers.description: Gaspack is a Web3 NFT launchpad that helps brands, creators, and artists turn their intellectual property into NFT projects and bridge them with their fans. The platform provides a full technology stack, community management, and creative consultancy that supports projects from ideation through minting, launching, scaling, and long-term maintenance as sustainable digital-collectible businesses. Gaspack operates a consumer application (app.gaspack.xyz) for collecting digital assets and has incubated branded NFT collections such as JPG People, Easy Demons Club, and Jukiverse, alongside Kometh, a Web3 comic publishing and discovery platform. Gaspack is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Gaspack publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile captures its verified public identity only.

providers.name: GOTCHA Technology Inc.
providers.description: GOTCHA Technology Inc. is an emotion-AI company that uses computer vision to detect human micro-emotions through the analysis of facial behavior, grounded in behavioral science research. GOTCHA offers two models: an evaluative model that measures customer satisfaction and service quality, and an investigatory model aimed at fraud and deception detection. The technology is applied across customer service, HR, legal services, mental health, and pharma. Founded and led by CEO Anna Gevorgyan, GOTCHA graduated from the 500 Global and SAP Startup Factory accelerator programs and won the Cannes Neurons Award (retail) at WAICF 2025. This profile currently exposes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface.

providers.name: Haseel
providers.description: Haseel (حصيل) is a Riyadh-based technology startup, founded in 2018, that delivers fresh fruits and vegetables to consumers across Saudi Arabia through its iOS and Android mobile apps. The company sources high-quality produce and fulfills each order from the nearest of its branches inside Riyadh, pairing a curated selection with fast, reliable last-mile delivery. Haseel reports more than 400,000 app downloads, three branches inside Riyadh, and over 1,000 orders per day, and is backed by 500 Global. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Haseel is a consumer produce-delivery app and does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Heaviside Industries
providers.description: Heaviside Industries is a defense-technology company founded in 2024 in Los Angeles, California, building autonomous precision munitions for U.S. and allied special operations and conventional forces. Its products — MOTH (land electromagnetic signal intelligence and spectrum awareness), TYR (autonomous aerial munition), and HYDRA (autonomous underwater munition) — are designed to deliver hyper-precise strike capabilities across air, land, and sea in GPS-denied and contested environments. Named after physicist Oliver Heaviside, whose electromagnetic theory enabled miniaturized electronics, the company emerged from stealth in May 2026 with a $28M Series A. It does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: International Game Technology
providers.description: International Game Technology (IGT) is a global gaming company that delivers entertaining and responsible gaming experiences across all gaming channels and regulated segments, including lottery, gaming machines, sports betting, and digital gaming. IGT does not currently offer a public developer API program; its technical resources are delivered through licensed B2B partner channels.

providers.name: Istra Research
providers.description: Istra Research (Istra LLC) is a quantitative proprietary trading firm that develops data-centric algorithms and low-latency technology to participate in global financial markets. The firm employs researchers and engineers who build automated trading strategies grounded in advanced mathematics, statistics, and large-scale data analysis, spanning quantitative research, algorithm development, and custom hardware/VLSI and software engineering. Istra is a proprietary trading operation rather than an API-first technology vendor: it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDKs, or developer documentation, and its technology is used internally. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Jetapult
providers.description: Jetapult is a capital and support firm focused on scaling mobile game studios, combining operator-first funding with hands-on systems for monetization, user acquisition, market expansion, and operational efficiency. Its GamePac AI toolset helps indie studios create, grow, and monetize their games. Jetapult is backed by Accel and operates as a partner-and-capital platform for gaming studios such as Holy Cow Studio and UMX Studio. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Jetapult does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Kintep (Jiangsu Kintep Environmental Protection Co., Ltd.)
providers.description: Jiangsu Kintep Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. (江苏康泰环保股份有限公司), founded in 2011 and headquartered in Taizhou, Jiangsu, China, is a national high-tech enterprise that designs, manufactures, sells, and services new-type environmental-protection equipment and complete turnkey solutions. Kintep focuses on solid-liquid separation and intelligent sludge / pollutant collection and treatment. Its KINTEP product line includes multi-disc (stacked-screw) sludge dewatering machines, integrated automatic chemical dosing units, dense-phase belt sludge deep-dewatering machines, high-efficiency fully-automatic filter-press systems, Lamella sedimentation tanks, and screw presses. The company operates seven national customer-service centers (Shenzhen, Wuhan, Chongqing, Xi'an, Tianjin, Shanghai, Yixing) and exports to customers worldwide. Kintep is a physical industrial-equipment manufacturer and does not publish a public web API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Kira Systems
providers.description: Kira Systems is a machine-learning contract analysis and review platform for law firms and corporate legal teams, automatically extracting clauses, concepts, and data points from contracts during M&A due diligence, real estate, banking, and other transactional work. Founded in Toronto and backed by Insight Partners, Kira was acquired by Litera in 2021 and is now offered as Litera Kira. It integrates with HighQ and Intralinks data rooms and Litera Transact, and exposes an Open API for additional customer integration needs; no public developer portal or OpenAPI specification is currently published.

providers.name: Lumific
providers.description: Lumific is a client reactivation platform for med spas that reconnects dormant clients with a practice to recover revenue from high-value treatments. Its proprietary system identifies inactive clients in an existing CRM (such as Mindbody or Zenoti) and launches automated, multi-channel outreach campaigns combining personalized text messaging, professional phone calls, and instant gift-card offers to drive bookings. Campaigns launch within 24 hours, pricing is performance-based (commission only on completed treatments), and the service is TCPA and HIPAA compliant with market exclusivity limited to a few clinics per area. Lumific was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. This provider currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Matrimony.com
providers.description: Matrimony.com Limited is an India-based online matchmaking and wedding services company, publicly listed on the NSE and BSE and headquartered in Chennai. Founded by Murugavel Janakiraman, it operates the flagship BharatMatrimony brand alongside a large portfolio of regional and community matrimony sites (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, and religion- and community-based platforms), the premium EliteMatrimony service, and wedding-services properties including WeddingBazaar and Mandap.com. The company serves millions of customers each month across its matchmaking and marriage marketplace. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Matrimony.com publishes a corporate/investor and consumer-brand web presence but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Mauna Kea Semiconductors
providers.description: Mauna Kea Semiconductors (mk-semi.com) is a Silicon Valley-based fabless semiconductor company founded by industry veterans to develop what it describes as the world's lowest-power Ultra-Wideband (UWB) solution for high precision location and direction-finding applications. Its UWB chips, modules, and integrated System-on-Chip solutions target smartphones, wearables, IoT devices, and automotive use cases, combining digital and analog/mixed-signal design expertise. Headquartered in Cupertino, California, with engineering operations in Shanghai, Beijing, and Shenzhen, the company is led by CEO Dr. Yifeng Zhang and is backed by Qiming. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming; it is a hardware/silicon vendor with no public API or developer surface at this time (documentation, blog, and careers pages are marked "Coming Soon").

providers.name: Metatheory
providers.description: Metatheory, Inc. is an independent studio of builders that makes games and, through an AI-led software division, tools built for makers. The team describes itself as builders, dreamers and doers applying what they have learned making games to software, building in public and sharing what they learn. Metatheory has been surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and Pantera Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the public site (metatheory.gg) is a single-page marketing site with no developer portal, documentation, API, OpenAPI, SDK, or public developer surface; the only public contact is support@metatheory.gg.

providers.name: Miruvor AI Inc.
providers.description: Miruvor AI Inc. is an early-stage deep-tech AI research lab building brain-inspired continual learning models. Rather than scaling frozen, pre-trained models, Miruvor uses spiking neural networks as its representational substrate together with local learning rules to build systems that learn from experience in real time, with persistent memory and low-energy, neuromorphic efficiency. Founded out of The Residency and backed by 500 Global, the company is pre-product and publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Misfit
providers.description: Misfit is a consumer wearables brand — fitness trackers and smartwatches such as the Misfit Shine, Flash, Ray and Vapor — founded in 2011 by Sonny Vu, John Sculley and Sridhar Iyengar and backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Founders Fund, GGV Capital and Xiaomi before being acquired by Fossil Group in 2015. Misfit ran a developer program (the Misfit Cloud API, Device SDK and Scientific Library) at build.misfit.com with 30+ launch partners. Fossil discontinued the Misfit backend, Cloud API and companion app in spring 2023, so the hosted API and all misfit.com domains are now unreachable. The only surviving developer surface is the official Misfit-Developers GitHub organization and its unmaintained iOS SDKs on CocoaPods.

providers.name: MOLG
providers.description: MOLG (molg.ai) is a circular manufacturing company tackling electronic waste. It operates autonomous robotic microfactories that disassemble complex devices like laptops and servers to recover components and materials for reuse, remanufacturing, and recycling. MOLG also partners with manufacturers on design-for-circularity (modular snap/press-fit/latch assembly instead of screws and adhesives) and offers OriginMark, a traceability platform for tracking devices, components, and materials across their lifecycle to calculate embodied carbon and supply-chain transparency. As of this enrichment pass MOLG publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Occipital
providers.description: Occipital is a computer-vision and 3D-scanning company known for the Structure Sensor depth camera and the Canvas home-scanning app, built on more than fifteen years of spatial-computing expertise. The Canvas product line (formerly canvas.io) now operates as Twindo, a spatial intelligence platform that turns iPhone/iPad LiDAR scans, floor plans, and point clouds into accurate, editable CAD and BIM files for architecture, interior design, construction, remodeling, multifamily residential, retail, hospitality, and fire-safety professionals. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes end-user scanning apps, a web viewer, and a support center, but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: OHouse
providers.description: OHouse is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bond-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ecommerce. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: omio
providers.description: Omio (formerly GoEuro) is a Berlin-based travel booking platform that lets travelers search, compare, and book trains, buses, ferries, and flights across thousands of transport providers throughout Europe and beyond from a single website and mobile app. Founded in 2013 as GoEuro and rebranded to Omio in 2019, the company aggregates schedules, fares, and seat availability from hundreds of carriers into one checkout. Omio does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its carrier and distribution integrations are handled through private B2B partnerships. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from VC-portfolio discovery and enriched by probing Omio's public domain, DNS, and security surface.

providers.name: One Robot
providers.description: One Robot is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building world-model-based simulation environments for robotics teams. Its core product learns physics and visual appearance directly from real robot data, producing simulation environments that are both visually and physically realistic so teams can train and evaluate robot manipulation policies without excessive reliance on physical robot time and real-world data collection. One Robot specializes in contact-rich manipulation, deformable objects (such as textile and box folding), and precise assembly tasks. As an early-stage two-person company it currently offers task-specific simulation collaboration rather than a public developer platform or API; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network for future enrichment as any developer surface emerges.

providers.name: Otrafy
providers.description: Otrafy is an AI-powered supplier management platform that automates regulatory compliance, supplier data collection, and supply chain risk assessment for QA, R&D, Regulatory, and Procurement teams at enterprise clients. The platform uses natural language processing to automate supplier data collection (citing high supplier response rates), monitors suppliers in real time against regulatory standards such as FDA, EU MRLs, California Prop 65, and PFAS, and applies AI-driven risk scoring to suppliers and facilities to streamline buyer-supplier collaboration. Otrafy is a Techstars portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing website and product/contact pages but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Periodic
providers.description: Periodic (Periodic Labs) is an AI research company building "AI scientists" paired with autonomous laboratories to accelerate discovery in the physical sciences, with an early focus on materials science and higher-temperature superconductors. Their systems hypothesize, run physical experiments, and learn from the results, and they partner with industry to optimize experimental processes. Surfaced as a portfolio company of CRV and Felicis, the company is at an early stage and does not currently publish a public API, developer documentation, or developer platform. This profile records that honest result; it is not penalized for having no API surface.

providers.name: Pixcel
providers.description: PIXCEL Inc. is an early-stage deep-tech startup developing cutting-edge silicon photonics solutions and photonic integrated circuits (PICs) for optical communications and related systems. Based in Matawan, NJ, and co-founded by silicon photonics veteran Long Chen (previously at Cisco Systems and Acacia Communications), the company designs passive and active photonic components and collaborates with foundry partners to optimize process design kits (PDKs). PIXCEL is a hardware and semiconductor company with no public API, developer portal, or software product surface at this time; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. This profile reflects an enrichment pass that confirmed there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Pluribus Networks
providers.description: Pluribus Networks was a software-defined networking (SDN) and open-networking vendor known for its NetVisor ONE network operating system (NVOS), the Adaptive Cloud Fabric controllerless SDN fabric, the UNUM management/analytics platform, and the Freedom 9000 series switches. The company was acquired by Arista Networks in 2022; the pluribusnetworks.com domain now redirects to Arista's Pluribus support resources, and the core Pluribus product line (NVOS, UNUM, Freedom 9000) has since been moved to End-of-Sale / End-of-Life. No independent Pluribus developer portal, public REST API, OpenAPI definition, or SDK is published; support and technical documentation are provided through the Arista customer portal. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and Menlo Ventures.

providers.name: PopChill
providers.description: PopChill is Taiwan's largest secondhand luxury fashion trading platform, operating as a mobile marketplace app for buying and selling authenticated pre-owned designer goods including handbags, watches, jewelry, apparel, and footwear from Chanel, Hermes, Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Prada, and 40+ other brands. The company provides item authentication, secure transactions, and seller support to a consumer audience. PopChill is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or technical integration surface; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network pending any future API program.

providers.name: Poth Labs
providers.description: Poth Labs is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an AI-native customer research platform that positions itself as "the customer brain for your company." It aggregates scattered customer feedback from sources such as Fireflies, Slack, support tickets, CRM notes, surveys, in-app chat, docs, and product analytics into a unified, searchable system, then extracts patterns, runs thematic and root-cause analysis, generates hypotheses about user issues like churn or checkout abandonment, and validates them through adaptive user interviews and targeted follow-up surveys. Founded by Matthew Wong (CEO, ex-Palantir, Stanford) and Mojmir Horvath (CTO, ex-Tietoevry) and based between San Francisco and New York, the company targets product, growth, customer research, and analytics teams. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass Poth Labs publishes a marketing site but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Quantierra
providers.description: Quantierra (Quantierra Advisors LLC) is a quantitative real estate advisory firm that uses proprietary software to source, analyze, and execute real estate transactions on behalf of institutional investors, family offices, nonprofits, and everyone in between. The firm blends data-driven deal sourcing and quantitative underwriting with traditional brokerage and advisory services. Quantierra keeps a deliberately low public profile at the preference of its clients and does not publish a public developer program, API, or self-service platform; its technology is used internally to support client engagements rather than exposed as a product.

providers.name: Quest Software Inc.
providers.description: Quest Software Inc. is a privately held IT management and cybersecurity software company headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California. Its portfolio spans database management and development (Toad), database and infrastructure performance monitoring (Foglight, Spotlight), unified endpoint management (KACE), Microsoft platform management and security (On Demand, Change Auditor, Recovery Manager, Migration Manager), data protection and backup (NetVault, QoreStor, Rapid Recovery), data replication (SharePlex), and data governance and modeling (erwin). Its products are distributed and supported through the Quest Support portal. Surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and processed by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline; no public, first-party developer API portal or OpenAPI surface was discoverable at enrichment time.

providers.name: Qumu
providers.description: Qumu is an enterprise video management platform for creating, managing, and securely distributing live and on-demand video across large organizations, with features spanning live broadcasting, video content management, analytics, enterprise content delivery/eCDN, and AI-powered enhancements such as auto-generated summaries and video chapters. Qumu was acquired by Enghouse Systems in 2023 and is now operated as part of Enghouse Video; the qumu.com domain redirects to the Enghouse Video product page. No public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface is published.

providers.name: Rovio
providers.description: Rovio Entertainment is a Finnish mobile games company best known for the Angry Birds franchise. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Espoo, Finland, Rovio operates multiple game studios and became part of Sega in 2023. It is a consumer entertainment company; its public web presence covers games, careers, press, and support, and it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub for enrichment.

providers.name: Saul Ewing LLP
providers.description: Saul Ewing LLP is a U.S.-based law firm founded in 1921 as Saul, Ewing, Remick & Saul, with more than 450 attorneys across 17 U.S. offices spanning the Mid-Atlantic, Northeast, Midwest, Florida, and California. The firm serves clients across 40+ industries with practice strengths in litigation, corporate and M&A, bankruptcy and restructuring, real estate, public finance, life sciences, financial services, intellectual property, labor and employment, and cybersecurity and privacy. Saul Ewing does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or machine-readable data product; its public technology surface is limited to its corporate website, a HighQ-powered client portal, the SEquel Alumni Portal at alumni.saul.com, employee remote-access tooling, and a small set of practice-specific blogs (Construction Industry Counselor, OZ and EB-5 Investments, Legacy Matters, The Friday Five). Two empty GitHub organizations (Saul-Ewing and saulewing) exist with zero public repositories.

providers.name: ScaleArc (IgniteTech)
providers.description: ScaleArc is database load balancing software that delivers continuous availability and high performance for SQL Server and MySQL databases. It sits transparently between applications and databases to automate failover, split and balance read/write traffic, pool connections, and cache queries with no application code changes, supporting on-premise, cloud, and database-as-a-service deployments such as Amazon RDS and Azure SQL. Originally an independent product, ScaleArc is now owned and supported by IgniteTech (part of ESW Capital Group) and offered through its enterprise software library. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures. There is no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or downloadable spec surface for ScaleArc today; access, licensing, and support are handled directly through IgniteTech.

providers.name: scytl
providers.description: scytl is an electoral technology company entered into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of balderton-capital and sapphire-ventures. The scytl.com domain today presents an electoral-technology offering (secure, scalable and auditable digital voting and election-management platforms serving governments and electoral bodies internationally). Enrichment probing found a live HTTPS site (TLS 1.3, SPF and DMARC with a reject policy) but no public API surface — no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/SDKs, or well-known API artifacts are published, so this profile remains an identity-and-security record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Secure-By-Design
providers.description: A software development approach that prioritizes security from the initial design phase through implementation, ensuring security considerations are built into the foundation of systems rather than added as an afterthought. It is widely adopted across industries to safeguard digital assets and reduce security risks.

providers.name: Seeing Systems
providers.description: Seeing Systems is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) defense technology company building autonomous, modular strike drones and AI-powered swarm coordination software at the intersection of artificial intelligence and robotics. Its product line includes Bandit, a cost-effective FPV drone for training and expendable missions with 30+ km of range; Banshee, an autonomous modular platform built for contested, jamming-resistant environments with 40+ km of range; and Aerie AI, swarm coordination software for multi-platform operations that lowers operator cognitive load. The company works directly with military and defense partners — including UK Royal Marine Commandos and NATO forces — rather than publishing a public developer platform. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; as of the latest enrichment pass Seeing Systems exposes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Shpock
providers.description: Shpock is a mobile-first second-hand marketplace and classifieds platform that brings millions of private buyers and sellers together, primarily across the United Kingdom, Austria, and Germany. Users list, discover, and negotiate on pre-owned goods across categories including electronics, fashion, home and garden, vehicles, and property, alongside a Shpock+ for Professionals program for business sellers. Founded in Vienna and backed by Speedinvest, Shpock operates consumer iOS/Android apps and a web experience. As of this enrichment pass Shpock publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; the api.shpock.com host exists but is private (returns 401 to unauthenticated requests). This profile therefore captures company identity and probed domain security rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Spotangels
providers.description: SpotAngels is a consumer parking application that helps drivers find free and cheap parking, understand and avoid confusing street-parking rules, get reminders before street cleaning and permit-zone changes, and book discounted garage and lot parking in major cities. The company also runs business programs for cities, universities, and parking operators/owners to surface availability and deals. SpotAngels is a Y Combinator-backed company. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; its integrations are business partnerships rather than developer-facing APIs.

providers.name: SwiftStack
providers.description: SwiftStack was a software-defined object and cloud storage company whose data platform managed unstructured data at scale across private data centers and public clouds using a distributed, shared-nothing architecture built on OpenStack Swift, targeting AI, deep learning, and large-dataset workloads. NVIDIA acquired SwiftStack in 2020; the data platform is no longer available for sale and only existing-customer support and portal resources remain. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Mayfield and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline, which confirmed there is no active public API, developer portal, or SDK surface for the discontinued product.

providers.name: Taiyaki Studios
providers.description: Taiyaki Studios is a Tokyo-based startup working to redefine how anime is consumed, delivering stories that are immediate, engaging, and satisfying. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Polychain Capital in the DeFi/NFT (web3) sector, the studio pairs anime content production with web3 and AI technology and creator-community building. The company is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Tammwel publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and infrastructure security posture.

It blends guided sessions, generative visuals, spatial audio and gamified "trips" to help people manage stress, focus, mood and sleep. Tripp is backed by Mayfield. As of this enrichment pass Tripp operates a consumer-facing application and an Intercom-powered help center but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; its web properties sit behind a bot-mitigation (captcha) wall, so no OpenAPI, llms.txt, or /.well-known discovery documents were retrievable.

providers.name: VICTUS Technologies
providers.description: VICTUS Technologies builds contested-autonomy software for autonomous systems operating in GPS-denied and jamming-heavy environments. VICTUS is backed by Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes a marketing and platform site but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Viki
providers.description: Viki (Rakuten Viki) is a global video streaming service specializing in Korean dramas, Chinese dramas, and other Asian television shows and movies, subtitled into more than 200 languages by a community of volunteer contributors (the name is a portmanteau of "video" and "wiki"). Founded as a startup backed by 500 Global, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), and CRV, Viki was acquired by Rakuten in 2013 and now operates as part of Rakuten's media portfolio. The consumer product streams licensed content on web, mobile, and connected-TV apps, funded by advertising and a Viki Pass subscription. Viki does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; it exposes an internal application API (api.viki.io) that powers its own clients and requires app credentials, and a community contribution platform for volunteer subtitlers and segmenters. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched with the honest finding that there is no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: vivino
providers.description: Vivino is the world's largest online wine marketplace and wine-discovery mobile app, founded in 2010 in Copenhagen, Denmark by Heini Zachariassen and Theis Sondergaard. Users scan a wine label to get community ratings, reviews, and tasting notes drawn from a database of more than 15 million wines and tens of millions of members, and can buy wine directly through the integrated marketplace. As of an enrichment pass on 2026-07-21, Vivino does not publish an official public API or developer portal (the former developer.vivino.com subdomain 301-redirects to the main site), so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Volta
providers.description: Volta is an experiential technology company that turns passive audiences into active participants in live events, retail spaces, and out-of-home advertising. Its Dynamic Experience Engine, powered by the VoltaConnect backend, lets attendees control stage visuals, brand content, and public displays directly from their smartphones, creating audio-reactive, audience-driven activations for concerts, brand experiences, museum exhibitions, and retail environments. Volta is a Techstars-backed company; as of this profile it publishes a marketing site (hosted on Squarespace) with no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface, so this entry is limited to verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Wolverine World Wide
providers.description: Wolverine World Wide is a leading designer, manufacturer, and marketer of branded footwear, apparel, and accessories. Wolverine World Wide does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.description: Yieldify is a website personalization and conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform for ecommerce brands, founded in 2013 in London by Jay Radia and backed by investors including GV (Google Ventures). Its SaaS platform delivers targeted on-site messaging, customer-journey personalization, and A/B testing to lift conversion and revenue. Yieldify was acquired by Publicis Groupe in January 2023 and folded into Epsilon, where it is now offered as the "Accelerate" (Yieldify) platform; yieldify.com now redirects to Epsilon. The product is delivered as a hosted, managed marketing service with a customer help center rather than a public developer API — no public REST/OpenAPI surface, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment.
