providers.description: Alliant Credit Union is a federally chartered, member-owned credit union headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, regulated by the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA). Founded in 1935 as the United Airlines Employees' Credit Union and rebranded Alliant in 2003, it is one of the largest credit unions in the United States, with more than 800,000 members and over $19 billion in assets. Alliant operates as a digital-first, branchless institution offering consumer and commercial deposit accounts, high-yield savings and checking, credit cards, auto and home loans, and business banking. Like nearly all U.S. credit unions, Alliant publishes no public first-party developer API or developer portal; consumer-permissioned data access is available to members only through third-party aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) rather than a directly documented open-finance API.

providers.name: Alsym Energy
providers.description: Alsym Energy is a Malden, Massachusetts battery technology company founded in 2015 by Mukesh Chatter, Rahul Mukherjee, and Kripa Varanasi to develop low-cost, high-performance rechargeable batteries that are free of lithium and cobalt. Its Na-Series is a line of non-flammable, non-toxic sodium-ion batteries aimed at grid and utility-scale energy storage, data-center backup, and industrial applications where safety and supply-chain resilience matter. The company uses a proprietary AI/computational-materials platform to accelerate battery chemistry development, and has raised roughly $111M+ including a $78M round in 2024 led by Tata Limited and General Catalyst. Alsym is a hardware/energy-infrastructure manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Altair Semiconductor
providers.description: Altair Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company that designs low-power, highly integrated cellular IoT chipsets. Its core products are the ALT1250 (a dual-mode LTE-M / NB-IoT modem and SoC with integrated iSIM, MCU and GNSS) and the ALT1350 (a next-generation 5G LPWA SoC that combines LTE-M/NB-IoT, unlicensed-spectrum and satellite NTN connectivity), used in smart meters, asset trackers, wearables, sensors and vehicle telematics. Altair was acquired by Sony in 2016, operated as Sony's cellular IoT unit, and in 2026 was spun back out as an independent company with $50M in funding led by Pitango. This is a hardware/semiconductor provider: it ships chipsets, evaluation kits and datasheets rather than a public developer API, so it carries no OpenAPI, SDK, MCP or developer-portal surface to enrich.

providers.name: AMI Labs
providers.description: AMI Labs is a frontier AI research lab building intelligent systems that understand the real world. The lab develops world models trained with self-supervised learning on continuous, high-dimensional sensor data (cameras and other sensors), aiming for AI with persistent memory, reasoning and planning, and controllable, safety-oriented behavior. Targeted applications span industrial process control, automation, wearable devices, robotics, and healthcare. AMI Labs launched officially in March 2026 with a $1.03B funding round and operates from Paris, New York, Montreal, and Singapore. It is backed by HV Capital, Obvious Ventures, and Wing Venture Capital. The lab operates as a research organization and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: AMPLY Discovery
providers.description: AMPLY Discovery is a UK (Belfast, Northern Ireland) biotechnology company turning the roughly 98% of the genome largely ignored by drug developers — the "dark genome" — into a pipeline of first-in-class therapeutics. The company pairs six AI/computational discovery engines with two wet labs in a closed loop between silicon and bench to find novel antimicrobial and therapeutic candidates targeting drug-resistant pathogens and complex diseases. AMPLY is a Techstars portfolio company and has been backed by Innovate UK, Invest NI, QUBIS and other UK/NI innovation programmes. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; AMPLY Discovery publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Amprius Technologies
providers.description: Amprius Technologies is a Fremont, California-based developer and manufacturer of high-energy density lithium-ion batteries built on a proprietary 100% silicon anode platform. Its flagship SiCore and SiMaxx cell families are marketed as among the industry's highest gravimetric and volumetric energy density rechargeable cells, enabling longer endurance, faster charging, and higher payload capacity than conventional graphite-anode chemistries. Amprius targets aviation and aerospace (high-altitude pseudo-satellites, unmanned aerial systems, electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft), defense (US Army soldier-worn power, BAE Systems), light electric vehicles, robotics, and AI hardware. Public references include AALTO's Airbus-derived Zephyr HAPS programs, Prismatic's PHASA-35 stratospheric aircraft, Nokia Drone Networks, and Matternet drone delivery. The company runs pilot manufacturing and R&D in Fremont and is scaling a GWh-scale Brighton, Colorado plant alongside contract manufacturing partnerships in Asia. Amprius is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker AMPX. It is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100:2016. Amprius sells cells, modules, and engineering services to OEMs and defense primes; it does not publish a developer API, SDK, or open-source battery telemetry interface, and has no public GitHub organization.

providers.name: Anar
providers.description: Anar was a B2B marketplace and business networking mobile app for small businesses, sellers, and buyers in India, operating from 2020 to 2023 before shutting down. At its peak it reported 1.6M+ registered businesses, 450k+ sellers, 1.1M+ buyers, and 7M+ business enquiries processed across 6.6M+ listed products. It raised roughly $6.5M from Accel and Elevation Capital plus angel investors. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company; no public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation was ever published, and the service is now defunct.

providers.name: Apixio (Centene)
providers.description: Apixio is a healthcare artificial intelligence company that applies machine learning and natural language processing to unstructured clinical and claims data for value-based care, risk adjustment, HCC coding, payment integrity, and healthcare analytics. Founded in 2009 and an early Bain Capital Ventures portfolio company, Apixio was acquired by Centene Corporation in 2020; its connected-care and coding products are delivered as enterprise B2B SaaS to health plans and providers. Apixio does not currently publish a public developer portal or open API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Architect Labs
providers.description: Architect Labs is an AI lab building an AI system that explores, designs, and provably verifies custom silicon for the world's most demanding AI and compute workloads. The company is developing a platform that automates the chip-design and verification workflow, aiming to let AI model developers, robotics startups, and neocloud operators generate and verify custom chips without deep hardware-engineering expertise. Architect Labs raised a $24M seed round led by Kindred Ventures, with participation from investors including Aravind Srinivas and Lukasz Kaiser, and is scheduled to appear at DAC 2026. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing site (about, blog, careers) but no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Arcstone
providers.description: Arcstone is a Singapore-based digital manufacturing technology company (founded 2013) that helps enterprises digitalize and gain real-time transparency across their shop floors and supply chains. Its product family spans arc.essentials (a lightweight Manufacturing Execution System for SMEs), arc.ops (a modular, next-generation MES for large enterprises), arc.net (multi-tier supply chain visibility), arc.studio (a low-code enterprise app and integration platform), arc.green (sustainability tracking), and arc.ai (an AI control tower for managed AI workforce deployment). Arcstone serves precision engineering, FMCG, mining, semiconductor, plastics, and biomedical manufacturers, and was named a Gartner Cool Vendor in Manufacturing Operations in 2022. The company is backed by 500 Global. No public API, developer portal, or SDKs are published at this time; this profile carries the identity and infrastructure signals harvested by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Arda Therapeutics
providers.description: Arda Therapeutics is a San Carlos, California biotech company founded in 2021 that develops targeted cell depletion therapies for chronic disease. Rather than modulating the proteins that pathogenic cells produce, Arda uses a single-cell sequencing and computational discovery engine to map disease-specific cell states, identify surface markers on harmful cells, and design targeted biologics that selectively deplete them across fibrotic, autoimmune, and metabolic conditions. Backed by a $43M Series A led by a16z Bio + Health with GV, Two Sigma Ventures, Eli Lilly and others. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer and web surface; Arda currently publishes a corporate marketing site with no public developer API.

providers.name: Areteia Therapeutics
providers.description: Areteia Therapeutics was a clinical-stage biotechnology company, formerly based in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, operating in the life-sciences sector. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass the company is no longer operating: areteiatx.com serves only a closure notice directing asset and general inquiries to contact addresses, and the company publishes no developer portal, API, documentation, SDKs, or other technical developer surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; retained for network completeness with no API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: Aria Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Aria Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to drug discovery, using a computational platform to identify and advance small-molecule therapeutic candidates for complex, inflammatory, and immunological diseases. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Aria operates as a therapeutics developer rather than a software or API provider. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile; an enrichment pass found no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or other programmatic developer surface for the company at this time.

providers.name: Arlo Industries
providers.description: Arlo Industries is a San Francisco defense hardware company (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) building a passive sensing network for detecting and tracking drones and aerial threats without traditional radar. Its product, Mentat, uses a distributed mesh architecture of low-cost sensors that cooperatively detect and track targets in 3D while remaining invisible to the threats they monitor. The company frames its approach around "asymmetric economics" — sensor deployment cost grows linearly while tracking accuracy grows exponentially — making the system more scalable than conventional radar installations. Arlo has demonstrated its technology with Ukrainian military operators on active frontlines and maintains partnerships across the US, Ukraine, and Northern Europe. As an early-stage hardware startup it publishes no public API, developer program, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Arpelos Biosciences
providers.description: Arpelos Biosciences is a seed-stage biotechnology company based in Kendall Square, Cambridge, developing multivalent medicines — therapeutics engineered for high potency and selectivity by engaging multiple targets or sites simultaneously. The founding team comprises scientists from UCSF, Penn, Stanford, and MIT spanning computational biology, immunology, and protein engineering, and the company is backed by prominent biotech investors including Wing Venture Capital. Arpelos currently operates as a stealth-stage research company with a single-page web presence and does not publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity record awaiting any future developer surface.

providers.name: Arrail Group
providers.description: Arrail Group (瑞尔集团) is one of the largest privately owned dental service providers in China, operating premium Arrail Dental clinics and the Rytime Dental (瑞泰口腔) network across major Chinese cities. The company delivers general dentistry, orthodontics, implants, and pediatric dental care through directly operated clinics and hospitals. It is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and counts Qiming Venture Partners among its investors. Arrail Group was added to the API Evangelist network as a Qiming portfolio company; it is a consumer healthcare provider and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: ArriVent Biopharma
providers.description: ArriVent BioPharma (NASDAQ: AVBP) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the identification, development, and commercialization of differentiated medicines for the treatment of cancer. Its lead candidate is firmonertinib, an EGFR inhibitor being studied across non-small cell lung cancer indications, and its pipeline includes next-generation antibody drug conjugates such as ARR-002. The company operates by identifying novel oncology programs, in-licensing drug candidates through partnerships, and designing regulatory-compliant clinical development strategies. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of HongShan and added to the API Evangelist network; as a traditional pharmaceutical developer it publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: ArsenalBio
providers.description: ArsenalBio is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company in South San Francisco developing programmable, integrated cell therapies for solid tumors. Its platform engineers autonomous CAR-T cells using large-scale genome engineering and computational biology to create multi-functional therapies. Backed by Kleiner Perkins and SoftBank Vision Fund, the company operates in the healthcare and biotechnology sector. It publishes no public developer API, portal, or documentation; this profile is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company/provider record.

providers.name: Aspinity
providers.description: Aspinity is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania semiconductor company that develops analog machine learning (AnalogML) technology combining ultra-low-power analog signal processing with machine learning for always-on, battery-operated edge AI event detection and classification. Its analogML processors the AML100 and next-generation AML200 deliver TOPS-level inference in a microwatt power footprint, targeting automotive vehicle-security monitoring, smart-home sensing such as glass-break and water-leak detection, and IoT applications including voice and keyword detection and vibration monitoring. Aspinity is a hardware and semiconductor provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile tracks its public web and security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Aspire Health *
providers.description: Aspire Health was a community-based palliative care provider surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences stub. The company delivered home- and clinic-based palliative and serious-illness care and was acquired by Anthem (now Elevance Health) in 2018; its aspirehealthcare.com domain today redirects into the Carelon Health / CareMore Health palliative-care service line. Aspire Health is a healthcare services organization, not a technology or API provider: enrichment found no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known/ discovery surface. This profile is retained as a network lead with only the identity and domain-security posture that could be verified from public probes.

providers.name: atantares
providers.description: Atantares (芯宿科技) is a Chinese synthetic-biology company based in Suzhou Industrial Park that builds "silicon-based biology" — semiconductor-driven biotechnology. Its chip-based, high-throughput platform (the EcoSyn synthesizer and ECHOS MicroArray, using electrochemical oligonucleotide synthesis on CMOS/MEMS microelectrode arrays) drives low-cost, high-fidelity DNA synthesis and is expanding into RNA and protein synthesis and detection. Research-service offerings include primer/oligo synthesis, gene synthesis, gene sequencing, cloning and mutagenesis, strain-library preparation, and gene editing, built on an in-house full-workflow automation, sequence-analysis, and order-management platform. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners. The company operates a marketing website only and publishes no public developer program, API, or documentation at the time of this profile.

providers.name: Atara Bio
providers.description: Atara Biotherapeutics is a clinical-stage allogeneic (off-the-shelf) T-cell immunotherapy company developing transformative therapies that harness T cells to fight cancer and autoimmune conditions, and is the first company to receive regulatory approval for an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Kleiner Perkins and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes a corporate website but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation was found; this profile carries identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Atomionics
providers.description: Atomionics is a Singapore-based deep-technology company, founded in 2018, that builds quantum sensors for mineral resource exploration and GPS-free navigation. Its Gravio quantum-grade gravity-sensing platform uses cold-atom interferometry to measure tiny gravitational changes and map the Earth's subsurface at high resolution, and its ORE-O AI geologist visualizes complex geologies and mineral deposits in 3D to accelerate exploration for energy-transition resources such as copper, lithium, nickel, graphite and rare earth elements. The company does not currently publish a public API or developer platform; this profile tracks its identity and public web surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Aurora Innovation
providers.description: Aurora Innovation is a Pittsburgh-headquartered autonomous-vehicle company publicly traded on NASDAQ as AUR. Its core product is the Aurora Driver, a self-driving system designed as a single platform deployable across vehicle classes - first commercialized in long-haul Class 8 trucking through Aurora Horizon, with Aurora Connect intended for ride-hailing applications. The Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous and PACCAR Peterbilt 579/Kenworth T680 trucks, uses Aurora's proprietary FirstLight FMCW lidar with 450+ metre range, and benefits from a NVIDIA-powered compute platform and Continental hardware partnership. Aurora launched commercial driverless freight operations in Texas in 2025 between Fort Worth, El Paso, Dallas, and Houston, with freight customers including Werner, Hirschbach, Uber Freight, FedEx, Schneider, Ryder, and Toyota Motor North America. Aurora does not publish a public developer API; the public surface is product, safety, and investor material.

providers.name: Autoscience
providers.description: Autoscience (Autoscience Institute) builds AI systems that train state-of-the-art models for frontier and applied AI labs. The company automates AI research itself, developing agents and infrastructure that design, run, and evaluate machine-learning experiments to accelerate model development and automated scientific discovery. Autoscience is an early-stage AI research company backed by General Catalyst and is hiring engineers, researchers, and designers. It currently publishes a marketing site, a research blog, and a careers page; no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications have been located at this time.

providers.name: Avid Ventures
providers.description: Avid Ventures is a boutique early-stage venture capital firm founded in 2021 by Addie Lerner Katz, backing founders from pre-incorporation through growth across fintech, consumer, software, and emerging AI. The firm emphasizes hands-on, vertically integrated support — recruiting, go-to-market and customer introductions, and fundraising help — investing across the U.S., Europe, and Israel. It launched with a $68M debut fund in February 2021 and raised an $87M Fund II in September 2024 (roughly $165M in total capital under management). Surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent firm of Foundry Group and profiled in the API Evangelist network as a venture-capital company record.

providers.name: avimedical
providers.description: Avi Medical is a technology-enabled primary care provider headquartered in Munich, Germany, operating a network of modern general-practice (Hausarzt) medical practices paired with a patient-facing mobile app for booking appointments, video consultations, prescriptions, and digital access to medical records. The company combines physical clinics with digital health tooling to modernize German primary care, and is backed by Balderton Capital among other investors. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company; no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal has been found on its public surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Awork
providers.description: Awork (awork.ge) is a Georgian online job marketplace that connects job seekers with employers across Georgia. The platform lets people search and apply for vacancies directly, while companies post openings and manage their hiring and HR processes digitally. It features an AI assistant named "Argo" that helps users find relevant positions or publish vacancies, and offers native iOS and Android mobile apps alongside the web experience. Awork is backed by 500 Global. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. Not to be confused with the unrelated German work-management SaaS awork.com, which does operate a developer API.

providers.name: Banksight
providers.description: BankSight Systems is a cloud banking software company founded in 2015 (San Francisco / Mumbai) that built an intelligent banking CRM and customer engagement platform for community banks, regional banks, and credit unions. The platform consolidated and analyzed customer data on top of Microsoft Azure and the Microsoft Power Platform, running a banking-specific data model with an open integration framework of pre-built connectors to core, LOS, and legacy banking systems, and delivered AI-driven "Next Best Conversation" recommendations to bankers and wealth managers. BankSight was acquired by Bottomline Technologies; its product now lives inside Bottomline's Commercial Digital Banking platform, and banksight.com 301-redirects to bottomline.com. This profile was surfaced as a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company (since exited) and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: bayomics
providers.description: Bayomics (贝普奥生物) is a Shenzhen-based biotechnology company specializing in spatial proteomics and trace (micro) proteomics solutions for pharmaceutical research and drug development. Its product lines include the SISPROT protein sample-preparation kits built on proprietary Spintip centrifuge-pipette technology that process nanogram-level samples in roughly two hours, VistaProX spatial visualization proteomics combining immunofluorescence staining with high-depth mass-spectrometry detection on a single slice, and high-throughput automation systems capable of processing up to 400 proteomics samples per day. Bayomics operates as a B2B reagent supplier and research-services provider and does not currently publish any public developer API, SDKs, or programmatic developer resources. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: BeiGene
providers.description: BeiGene (rebranded as BeOne Medicines in 2025) is a global oncology biopharmaceutical company founded in 2010, developing and commercializing cancer therapies worldwide. Its portfolio spans blood cancers and solid tumors, led by BRUKINSA (zanubrutinib), a BTK inhibitor, alongside programs in protein degradation (CDACs) and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). The company is listed on NASDAQ (BGNE), HKEX, and the Shanghai STAR Market, with a global footprint across 30+ countries (beonemedicines.com). Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hillhouse; no public developer portal, API, or SDK program is currently published.

providers.name: Bellabeat
providers.description: Bellabeat is a femtech and women's wellness technology company founded in 2014 by Urska Srsen and Sandro Mur, headquartered in San Francisco, California. It designs health-tracking wearables and connected devices aimed at women, including the Leaf and Ivy wellness jewelry trackers, the Time hybrid smartwatch, and the Spring smart water bottle, paired with the Bellabeat mobile app that tracks activity, sleep, stress, meditation, menstrual cycle, and overall wellness. Bellabeat operates as a direct-to-consumer wellness brand; it does not currently publish a public developer API, so this profile captures company identity and network provenance rather than API artifacts. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched here.

providers.name: Benchmark Electronics
providers.description: Benchmark Electronics, Inc. is an advanced electronics engineering and manufacturing services (EMS) company headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. The company provides integrated design, engineering, and manufacturing services from prototypes to high-volume production, including procurement, logistics, and repair. Benchmark serves original equipment manufacturers in defense, medical technologies, commercial aerospace, industrial, next-gen communications, advanced computing, and semiconductor capital equipment markets. The company operates approximately 22 locations in 8 countries with around 13,000 employees.

providers.name: besunyen
providers.description: Besunyen is a Chinese consumer-health company known for herbal weight-management, functional and detox teas plus related wellness and nutrition products, surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment on 2026-07-18 found no public developer, API, or documentation surface — besunyen.com serves only an nginx 404 and its TLS certificate is issued for besunyen.co (hostname mismatch); the only real artifact captured is a domain-security probe.

providers.name: BioOrbit
providers.description: BioOrbit is a London-based in-space manufacturing company, founded in 2023, that uses microgravity to crystallise protein-based biologic drugs at scale. Its autonomous BOX hardware — a compact, microwave-sized manufacturing unit designed to operate in low-Earth orbit — grows highly ordered crystalline forms of therapeutic proteins that reduce viscosity, enabling treatments normally given intravenously (including cancer therapies) to be reformulated as subcutaneous, self-injectable products. Co-founded by Dr Katie King and Dr Leonor Teles, BioOrbit raised the world's largest seed round for in-space manufacturing (~£9.8M / $13.2M) co-led by LocalGlobe and Breega with Seedcamp, Auxxo, Type One, 7percent and angels, and is supported by the UK Space Agency, ESA BIC and ESA BSGN. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Seedcamp portfolio company; it publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: BlackSky
providers.description: BlackSky Technology (NYSE: BKSY) is a Herndon, Virginia headquartered real-time space-based intelligence company that operates a high-revisit Earth observation constellation and delivers AI-enhanced tactical ISR (intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance) imagery and analytics to defense, intelligence, and global security customers. BlackSky's flagship product is the Spectra platform — a cloud-based intelligence hub that provides on-demand satellite tasking, sub-90-minute imagery delivery, automated AI-driven object detection and change monitoring, archived imagery access, and a secure tasking and delivery API. The company operates Gen-2 satellites at 83 cm resolution and a newer Gen-3 constellation delivering 35 cm class very-high-resolution imagery with infrared sensors, inter-satellite links, and on-board AI processing, manufactured at BlackSky's facility in Tukwila, Washington. Commercial offerings include BlackSky ON-DEMAND (flexible global tasking) and BlackSky ASSURED (dedicated, contracted persistent monitoring capacity). BlackSky's Spectra tasking and imagery API is integrated into partner platforms including Esri ArcGIS, UP42, and the STAT (Satellite Tasking API) community spec, however the API is access-controlled for vetted defense, intelligence, and enterprise customers and is not exposed as a public self-service developer portal — there is no public Spectra developer documentation site, OpenAPI specification, or open SDKs at the time of this entry. The customer revenue model is subscription-based Spectra ON-DEMAND and ASSURED contracts, Mission Solutions custom engagements, and through marketplace partners.

providers.name: BlackThorn Therapeutics *
providers.description: BlackThorn Therapeutics was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2015 and headquartered in South San Francisco, focused on discovering and developing targeted therapeutics for brain diseases and central nervous system (CNS) disorders such as major depressive disorder and schizophrenia, using a precision-medicine platform. It was backed by gv (Google Ventures) and later combined into Neumora Therapeutics, whose corporate site now resolves at neumoratx.com. This is a life-sciences company profile: it operates no public developer API, SDK, or agent surface, so API-oriented artifacts are not applicable beyond a domain-security probe of the corporate host.

providers.name: Blue Cloud Pediatric Surgery Centers
providers.description: Blue Cloud Pediatric Surgery Centers operates accredited ambulatory surgery centers specializing in pediatric and special-needs dental and oral surgery care delivered under general anesthesia. Positioning itself as the largest pediatric surgery center company in the United States, Blue Cloud partners with dentists and payors across multiple U.S. locations with a mission to expand access to care, exemplify safety and quality, and reduce costs to patients and payors. Headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas, the company is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. Blue Cloud is a healthcare services provider and does not publish any public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained for network identity and demand-side coverage.

providers.name: Blue River Technology
providers.description: Blue River Technology is a Santa Clara, California agricultural robotics company and John Deere subsidiary that builds intelligent farm machinery using computer vision, machine learning, and robotics. Its flagship product, See & Spray, uses onboard cameras and deep-learning models to distinguish crops from weeds in real time and target herbicide only where it is needed, cutting chemical use while improving field health. The company combines Silicon Valley software engineering with deep agricultural-equipment expertise across computer vision, full-stack software, robotics and mechatronics, product management, and field testing. Blue River Technology does not currently publish a public developer portal, API, or SDK; this profile tracks the company as a Khosla Ventures portfolio lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: BlueYard
providers.description: BlueYard Capital is a venture capital firm founded in 2016, operating as a small, equal partnership with offices in Europe and the United States. Managing roughly $500M in AUM, it invests $500K-$5M at pre-seed to Series A as lead or co-lead investor, backing two kinds of technologies: those that move us toward utopia and those that hold the line against oblivion. Its focus areas span computation & intelligence, engineering/aerospace & defense, biology & chemistry, and crypto. Notable portfolio companies and exits include Privy (acquired by Stripe), Groq, IonQ, Filecoin, Castelion, and Marvel Fusion. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio relationship of foundry-group and enriched from BlueYard's public website; it exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Boise Cascade
providers.description: Boise Cascade is a leading North American manufacturer and distributor of building materials for the residential and commercial construction industry. The company produces engineered wood products (EWP) including I-joists, LVL beams, and glulam, as well as structural panels and lumber, and distributes a broad range of building materials through its wholesale distribution network.

providers.name: Boohee
providers.description: Boohee (薄荷健康) is a Chinese consumer health-technology company focused on scientific weight management, serving a cumulative 180 million users over its ~17-year history. Its portfolio spans the Boohee Health mobile app (calorie and food tracking, diet and exercise logging, AI weight-management coaching, meal plans, smart body scales, community), Boohee Life nutritional foods and subscription services, the Boohee Life Internet Hospital (Tianjin-based telemedicine for internal and traditional Chinese medicine), and a Boohee weight-loss SaaS platform that helps hospitals stand up weight-management clinics. The company operates as a consumer mobile and content platform and does not publish a public developer API or open platform; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Boosters
providers.description: Boosters is a Seoul-based global commerce company and brand aggregator, founded in 2019, that acquires and accelerates the growth of emerging Korean direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, with a particular focus on K-Beauty. Boosters takes over small and medium-sized Korean brands that have strong product potential but struggle with marketing, distribution, and inventory management, then scales them across domestic and international commerce channels. Portfolio brands include Eqqualberry and Branden. The company raised a USD 10 million Series A round in 2022 with participation from Partech and other investors. Boosters is a consumer commerce operator rather than a developer platform, and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: BorgWarner
providers.description: BorgWarner is a global automotive supplier designing and manufacturing propulsion systems, thermal management, battery systems, charging solutions, and power electronics for combustion, hybrid, and electric vehicles. The company accelerates the world's transition to clean, efficient mobility across passenger and commercial vehicle markets.

providers.name: Breathe Well-being
providers.description: Breathe Well-being is an India-based digital therapeutics and chronic-care company focused on Type 2 diabetes reversal and management. Through a mobile app (Android/iOS) it pairs continuous health coaching, personalized nutrition and lifestyle plans, medical supervision, and progress tracking to help members reduce blood sugar, lose weight, and lower medication dependence. Founded by Aditya Kaicker and Rohan Verma, the company is backed by Accel and Y Combinator (Series A, 2021). It operates as a direct-to-consumer health program rather than an API provider: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface (paths return the SPA lander fallback). This profile captures the company identity and its probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Brosmed
providers.description: BrosMed Medical (Guangdong Brosmed Medical Technology Co., Ltd.) is a medical device manufacturer founded in 2012 and headquartered in Dongguan, Guangdong, China, specializing in the research, manufacturing, and global sale of high-performance vascular intervention medical devices. Its product families span cardiovascular intervention, peripheral vascular intervention, hemodialysis access, neurointervention, and intervention accessories. The company employs over 1,000 staff, holds 650+ product registrations, and sells across 100+ countries. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; as a physical medical-device manufacturer it publishes no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Cabinet Health
providers.description: Cabinet Health is an end-to-end supply chain platform for private-label over-the-counter (OTC) medicines. The company develops, sources, manufactures, and delivers OTC products across 70+ active ingredients in tablet, softgel, capsule, liquid, powder, gummy, and chewable formats to retailers, wholesalers, and online marketplaces, emphasizing sustainable, refillable packaging and quality assurance at scale. Cabinet also produces its own certified B Corp consumer brand sold on Amazon and Target. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer or API surface has been found for this provider.

providers.name: Calibrate Ventures
providers.description: Calibrate Ventures is a Pasadena, California venture capital firm backing visionary technical founders scaling deep tech to transform industries such as transportation and logistics, food and agriculture, healthcare, manufacturing, security, and warehousing. The firm invests in AI, computer vision, machine learning, robotics, and automation startups, partnering with founders to turn a technical breakthrough into scalable commercial advantage and drawing on decades of combined investment and company-building experience. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent company in the API Evangelist network and enriched from the firm's public web presence.

providers.name: Calumet Specialty Products Partners
providers.description: Calumet, Inc. (NASDAQ: CLMT) is a publicly traded U.S. manufacturing company established in 1919, headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. The firm specializes in the manufacture of lubricating oils, solvents, waxes, packaged and synthetic specialty products, fuels, renewable diesel, and fuel-related products. It operates 12 production facilities across North America and serves approximately 2,700 global customers in over 90 countries through brands including Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, Penreco, Orchex, and TruFuel. Calumet does not publish a public developer API program; commercial integrations are handled via B2B portals and EDI.

providers.name: Cambrio
providers.description: Cambrio is a manufacturing software company, now a Sandvik-owned brand, that develops CAD/CAM software for CNC programming and digital manufacturing. Its portfolio spans GibbsCAM for CNC milling and turning, SigmaNEST for nesting and material optimization, and Cimatron for integrated tooling and mold design. Cambrio serves the automotive, aerospace, medical, electronics, and general manufacturing industries. It was a Battery Ventures portfolio company before being acquired by Sandvik AB in 2021. Cambrio is desktop/on-premises manufacturing software and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: cansinotech
providers.description: CanSino Biologics (康希诺生物, cansinotech.com.cn / cansinotech.com) is a Tianjin-based Chinese biopharmaceutical company founded in 2009 and dual-listed on the Hong Kong and Shanghai (STAR) exchanges. It researches, manufactures, and commercializes human vaccines across five proprietary technology platforms, with a portfolio covering COVID-19, meningococcal, pneumococcal, tuberculosis, Ebola, and DTcP indications. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation; only its corporate web presence was found.

providers.name: Caraway Health *
providers.description: Caraway Health is a digital health company that provides virtual mental and physical healthcare designed for college and university students, delivered through a mobile app with support offered around the clock. The company partners with higher-education institutions and is backed by GV (Google Ventures). It operates as a direct-to-consumer / campus telehealth provider rather than an API platform; at the time of this enrichment pass no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification was found on its public web surface. Sector: life-sciences / digital health.

providers.name: Cardiogram
providers.description: Cardiogram is a digital-health company whose consumer app analyzes heart-rate and activity data from wearables such as the Apple Watch, Wear OS, Garmin, and Fitbit to help people understand their cardiovascular health. Its DeepHeart deep-neural-network technology was developed to screen heart-rate patterns for signs of conditions including atrial fibrillation, sleep apnea, diabetes, and hypertension, work studied in collaboration with academic health researchers. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; as of this pass Cardiogram exposes no public developer or API surface and its primary website (cardiogram.com) does not complete an HTTPS/TLS handshake.

providers.name: Cardiologs
providers.description: Cardiologs is a cloud-based ECG analysis platform that uses clinically validated artificial intelligence to streamline cardiac diagnostics, helping clinicians and healthcare providers reduce the burden of manual ECG interpretation while improving diagnostic scalability and accessibility. Founded in Paris in 2014, Cardiologs was acquired by Philips in 2021 and is now offered as part of Philips ambulatory monitoring and diagnostics (ECG monitoring) portfolio. The company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its primary domain redirects to the Philips healthcare product page.

providers.name: Catalog
providers.description: Catalog was a music distribution and direct-to-fan platform that let independent musicians sell digital downloads while keeping 100% of earnings, collect fan emails directly, split revenue with collaborators, run referral rewards, and control private, public, or scheduled releases with zero marketplace fees. The company has ceased operations - its homepage now shows a closure announcement - and it never published a public developer API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Celltype
providers.description: CellType is an AI-driven drug discovery company building what it calls "The Biological World Model" — foundation models and autonomous agents that simulate human biology to predict drug responses in human systems before clinical trials, reducing reliance on traditional preclinical models such as mice and cell lines. Its core technology, Cell2Sentence (C2S), teaches large language models to understand cellular biology by converting single-cell gene expression data into a text-like format that models can interpret, and the company reports using it to discover and validate a novel cancer treatment signal targeting tumor immunogenicity. A Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company based in New York City, CellType works with large pharmaceutical partners and currently operates as a B2B research and drug-discovery platform rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Cencora
providers.description: Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen, renamed August 2023) is a leading global pharmaceutical solutions organization that connects manufacturers, providers, pharmacies, and patients across the healthcare supply chain. Cencora operates an Axway-based central EDI platform exchanging over 800,000 EDI messages daily with more than 23,000 trading partners and a Cell and Gene Therapy (CGT) Integration Hub for real-time data exchange with biopharma and provider platforms. No public developer API portal has been identified.

providers.name: Centreherbs (Beijing Shengtaier Biotechnology)
providers.description: Centreherbs is the brand of Beijing Shengtaier Biotechnology Co., Ltd., a veterinary pharmaceutical company founded in 1999 and headquartered in the Daxing Biopharmaceutical Industrial Park, Beijing, China. An integrated research, development, production, and distribution organization for animal health, it specializes in veterinary traditional Chinese medicine preparations, animal vaccines for poultry and livestock, plant-based premixed feed additives, and pet health products, backed by four wholly-owned subsidiaries and an internal biotech research institute. It is a healthcare portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. The company operates a corporate marketing website and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Ch4 Global
providers.description: CH4 Global is a climate-technology company working to reduce methane emissions from livestock at gigatonne scale. Its flagship product, Methane Tamer, is a feed supplement made from Asparagopsis red seaweed that has been shown to cut enteric methane emissions in cattle by up to 90 percent. In January 2025 the company began production at what it describes as the world's first commercial-scale Asparagopsis growing facility, its EcoPark in Louth Bay, South Australia, using a proprietary pond-based cultivation system to lower production costs. CH4 Global is a deep-tech and agriculture-focused company backed by DCVC; it operates as a physical-product and climate-impact business rather than a software or API provider. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched with the identity and domain-security signals that are publicly available.

providers.name: Chimerix
providers.description: Chimerix, Inc. was a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, focused on developing medicines for serious and life-threatening diseases. It is best known for brincidofovir (TEMBEXA), an antiviral approved by the U.S. FDA in 2021 as a smallpox medical countermeasure, and for dordaviprone (ONC201), an investigational small-molecule therapy for H3 K27M-mutant diffuse glioma, a form of brain cancer. Chimerix was a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: CMRX) and was acquired by Jazz Pharmaceuticals in 2025, primarily for dordaviprone; the chimerix.com domain now redirects to jazzpharma.com. As a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, Chimerix does not operate a public developer program or API surface — this profile tracks it as a company entity within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ChronicleBio
providers.description: ChronicleBio is a biotechnology company working at the intersection of human data and drug discovery, with the stated mission of translating human data into disease-defining medicines. It operates in the healthcare and life-sciences sector and was surfaced through the electric-capital portfolio. As of this profile, ChronicleBio publishes a corporate marketing website but no public developer surface: enrichment found no API documentation, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, MCP server, or changelog. Domain security was probed live (TLS 1.3, HSTS, SPF, and a DMARC quarantine policy present; DNSSEC and CAA absent).

providers.name: Ciitizen
providers.description: Ciitizen is a digital health company that helps patients collect, organize, and control their own medical records. Founded by Anil Sethi and backed by a16z, Ciitizen built patient-directed tools for aggregating records across providers under HIPAA right-of-access, originally with a focus on cancer patients. The team and technology now operate as Citizen Health (citizen.health), which turns a patient's medical records into instant answers through an AI Advocate built for rare disease patients and caregivers and used by 100+ patient advocacy groups. Ciitizen exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its live web presence.

providers.name: Circle Health Group
providers.description: Circle Health Group is the largest independent operator of private hospitals in the United Kingdom, running a nationwide network of hospitals and clinics that provide diagnostics, surgery, physiotherapy, and consultant-led private medical care to self-pay patients, insured patients, and the NHS. Originally backed by Balderton Capital as Circle Holdings, the group offers services spanning orthopaedics, cardiology, gynaecology, general surgery, and imaging. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; the organization operates a consumer-facing patient website and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface.

providers.name: Clairity
providers.description: Clairity Technology Inc. is a Los Angeles based climate-tech company building gigaton-scale carbon dioxide removal using Direct Air Capture (DAC) paired with ex-situ mineralization. Their approach removes CO2 from the atmosphere with readily available, inexpensive chemicals and standard construction materials to produce concentrated CO2 streams for permanent removal and storage. Clairity operates Project Juniper, a live carbon-removal facility in Southern Nevada, and raised a $6.75M seed round in 2024. As a hardware and carbon-removal operator the company publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ClearCare
providers.description: ClearCare (originally ClearCare Online) is a web-based home care agency management platform founded in 2011 and headquartered in San Francisco. It provides non-medical home care agencies with back-office and point-of-care tooling: caregiver scheduling, telephony-based clock-in/clock-out and electronic visit verification (EVV), billing and payroll, client and caregiver management, care planning, a family room portal, and business analytics. ClearCare was backed by Battery Ventures and Cendana Capital and was acquired by WellSky (formerly Mediware) in 2019; the product is now marketed as WellSky Personal Care, and the clearcareonline.com domain redirects to WellSky. This profile was surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company and enriched as a historical company record — ClearCare no longer operates a standalone public developer or API program.

providers.name: cmlabs
providers.description: CMLabs (千麦医疗 / Qianmai Medical) is an independent third-party clinical laboratory group headquartered in China. It operates a network of medical testing laboratories that provide clinical laboratory diagnostics, pathology diagnosis, routine and specialty blood testing, clinical trial and research testing, and laboratory information system (LIS) services to hospitals, clinics, and other medical institutions. The company is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: CNX Resources
providers.description: CNX Resources Corporation is one of the largest independent natural gas exploration, development, and production companies in the Appalachian Basin. The company focuses on responsibly developing natural gas, NGL, and condensate resources from the Marcellus and Utica shales. CNX Resources does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: colandpharma
providers.description: colandpharma was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Enrichment probing on 2026-07-20 found no public surface to profile: colandpharma.com is registered (created 2007-09-21, renewed through 2027-09-21, Gname.com registrar) and delegates to share-dns nameservers, but the zone publishes no A/AAAA, MX, TXT, SPF, DMARC or CAA records. The apex and the www, api, docs and developer subdomains do not resolve, and the authoritative nameserver itself returns no host records, confirming a dormant or parked domain rather than a transient outage. There is consequently no website, developer portal, documentation, or API surface to catalog. This record is retained as a lead; re-run enrichment if the domain is ever brought online.

providers.name: Collaborative Robotics
providers.description: Collaborative Robotics (Cobot) is a Physical AI company founded by Brad Porter building AI-powered collaborative robots that work safely alongside people. Its flagship robot, Proxie, is a human-capable mobile manipulator designed to address labor shortages across warehousing, manufacturing, logistics, and healthcare. The company uses ScoutMap to analyze facility operations and identify automation opportunities, then deploys robots that learn real-world workflow patterns. Backed by General Catalyst, Collaborative Robotics is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it is a hardware / Physical AI provider with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Colony Capital (DigitalBridge Group)
providers.description: Colony Capital was a diversified real estate and hospitality investment firm founded by Tom Barrack in 1991. In June 2021 the company rebranded as DigitalBridge Group, Inc. (NYSE: DBRG) — completing a multi-year pivot from traditional real estate to pure-play digital infrastructure investing. The Boca Raton, FL-based alternative asset manager now operates exclusively across five digital infrastructure categories: data centers, macro cell towers, fiber networks, small cells, and edge infrastructure. DigitalBridge manages approximately $119B in assets across 45+ portfolio companies including Vantage Data Centers, DataBank, Switch, Vertical Bridge, Zayo Group, GD Towers, Boingo Wireless, AtlasEdge, Scala Data Centers, Yondr Group, and ExteNet Systems. In December 2025 SoftBank Group announced a definitive agreement to acquire DigitalBridge for approximately $4 billion, with the deal expected to close in the second half of 2026. DigitalBridge itself publishes no developer API, SDK, or public OpenAPI surface — it is a holding company whose programmable surface lives inside its individual portfolio companies (e.g., Zayo, DataBank, Switch), each of which is profiled separately in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Community Transit
providers.description: Transitland API

providers.name: Constelli
providers.description: Constelli (Constelli Signals Private Limited) is a Hyderabad, India based defence and aerospace signal-processing company founded in 2017 by Satya Gopal Panigrahi and Avinash Chenreddy. It designs and manufactures radar systems, radar target and echo simulators, deployable drone-based radar payloads, high-performance radar processors, and IRIG-standard digital telemetry receivers for ground, onboard, and satellite telemetry. Its products serve electronic warfare and defence R&D programs globally, including India's Ministry of Defence and DRDO. Constelli raised a $20M Series A led by General Catalyst (with Pravega Ventures and 360 One). It is a hardware/systems company and does not currently publish a public developer API, portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Coolant
providers.description: Coolant (Coolant Climate, Inc.) is a climate-technology startup building AI-powered forest monitoring and carbon measurement from consumer-grade drone imagery. Its "3D spatial intelligence" platform reconstructs high-resolution 3D forest models from ordinary drone footage (DJI Mini, Mavic) and applies computer vision to measure biomass, tree height, diameter at breast height (DBH), tree counts, species, and growth rates — delivering LiDAR-grade accuracy at a fraction of the cost. The company positions this as the measurement, reporting, and verification (MRV) layer for scalable, verifiable carbon removal, reforestation success tracking, and conservation planning. Coolant raised a $4.3M seed round from General Catalyst and Floodgate in October 2025. As of this profile the company operates a marketing site, a demo web application, and a technical blog, but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: CourseGuide
providers.description: CourseGuide is a portfolio-lead company in the API Evangelist network, surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio and mapped to coursereport.com. Course Report is a consumer-facing education platform that helps prospective students discover, compare, and review coding bootcamps, certification courses, and professional training programs, aggregating 900+ programs and tens of thousands of alumni reviews alongside rankings, career-matching tools, and guidance content. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment; this profile remains a lead with only domain-security posture and public web properties captured.

providers.name: Cove
providers.description: Cove is a visual workspace for thinking with AI — an AI collaborator that works alongside you on projects big and small in a spatial, canvas-style interface rather than a linear chat. The product pairs an on-screen agent that can search the web, write and run code, and cite sources with a flexible visual surface for organizing ideas, and it ships an accompanying Chrome browser extension. Cove is a consumer/prosumer application backed by the venture firm Homebrew; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer documentation. This entry tracks Cove in the API Evangelist network, with domain-security posture captured by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Crosby
providers.description: Crosby is an agentic law firm that combines AI legal agents with barred attorneys to review commercial contracts in about an hour. Built for sales teams, it accelerates contract negotiation and time-to-signature with fixed, upfront per-document pricing, and integrates into existing workflows via Slack, email, and CLM/CRM triggers. Beyond contract review it offers business-specific knowledge agents and aggregated market data to improve negotiation outcomes. NYC-based, founded by Ryan Daniels and John Sarihan, and backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Index Ventures, and Lux Capital. Crosby publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface as of this profiling.

providers.name: CSR Biotech
providers.description: CSR Biotech (超视计 / Chaoshiji) is a Chinese life-sciences instrumentation company that develops super-resolution optical microscopy systems for advanced biological research. Its product line includes the HIS-SIM and MI-SIM structured-illumination microscopes and the SIM-Ultimate platform, delivering live-cell imaging down to roughly 60nm resolution across many imaging modes. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As a scientific-instruments maker, CSR Biotech publishes no public developer portal, documentation, or API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CTRL Therapeutics
providers.description: CTRL Therapeutics (cTRL Tx) is a Chicago-based preclinical biotechnology company developing next-generation cell therapies for solid tumors. The company harnesses circulating tumor-reactive lymphocytes (cTRLs) - a rare, potent T cell population found in the blood and naturally equipped to fight cancer - to engineer polyclonal cell therapies that avoid invasive tumor-tissue surgery. From a single blood draw, CTRL's proprietary IsoQore cell-sorting platform isolates millions of migratory, tumor-reactive cTRLs via novel markers, aiming to simplify the discovery, manufacturing and administration of solid-tumor cell therapy. CTRL launched in 2023 with a $10M seed financing led by General Catalyst, with participation from Intermountain Health and FACIT. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company operates a corporate website and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: D2G Oncology
providers.description: D2G Oncology is a precision-oncology company based in Mountain View, California, reported to have been founded in 2018 by Ian Winters. Public company descriptions characterize its work as applying quantitative and multiplexed functional cancer genomics to relate drugs to genotypes in order to advance precision cancer therapeutics. The company operates INSITE, a login-gated internal research portal at www.d2g-insite.com supporting preclinical study management and result exploration. D2G Oncology publishes no public developer API program, no developer portal, no API documentation, and no client SDKs, and third-party company trackers list the company as inactive as of 2026. It was surfaced through the Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio and is retained here as an identity-only profile.

providers.name: Daivin
providers.description: DAIVIN! is a deep-tech hardware company (Y Combinator Winter 2026, based in San Francisco and Finland) building tankless diving technology. Its core product, SPRING, is marketed as the "world's first tankless diving technology": instead of carrying heavy pressurized oxygen tanks, a diver wears a lightweight vest of electrolyzers and a battery belt that use electricity to split water on demand into breathable oxygen (O2) and hydrogen (H2), targeting depths up to 200 meters / 650 ft. Founder Leo Kankkunen frames breathing as "fundamentally an energy problem," and the company envisions applications beyond recreational and professional diving across space exploration, high-altitude rescue, hospitals, and aircraft. Added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-capital portfolio lead surfaced via y-combinator. Daivin runs a conceptual marketing website (Wix) and a news blog; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or other machine-readable developer surface, so no API artifacts apply to this provider.

providers.name: Damae Medical
providers.description: Damae Medical is a Paris-based medical device company developing non-invasive imaging technology for dermatology and skin cancer diagnostics. Its flagship deepLive system is built on proprietary LC-OCT (Line-field Confocal Optical Coherence Tomography), which pairs deep tissue penetration with cellular resolution to produce histology-like vertical and confocal-like horizontal 3D views of the skin in vivo. deepLive received CE Mark Class IIa certification in 2023 and FDA 510(k) clearance in March 2025, and integrates quantitative analysis tools such as 3D surface segmentation, cellular network visualization, melanin distribution mapping, and dermal fiber segmentation. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Danaher
providers.description: Danaher Corporation is a global life sciences and diagnostics conglomerate whose operating companies include Beckman Coulter, Leica Microsystems, Cepheid, SCIEX, IDT, Cytiva, Abcam, Aldevron, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, Radiometer, and others. Danaher itself does not publish a corporate-level developer API; product and service APIs are provided by individual operating companies under the Danaher portfolio.

providers.name: Darling Ingredients
providers.description: Darling Ingredients is a global developer and producer of sustainable natural ingredients from edible and inedible bio-nutrients, creating products for the food, pet food, feed, fuel, bioenergy, and fertilizer industries. Darling operates Diamond Green Diesel as a renewable diesel joint venture with Valero, and brands such as Rousselot (gelatin and collagen), Sonac, CTH, and EnviroFlight. Darling does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Data Driven Bioscience
providers.description: Data Driven Bioscience (now operating as Duoseq, a ddb.bio service) is a cancer genomics testing company that performs comprehensive molecular profiling of both DNA and RNA from a single sample in an on-site workflow, delivering results from sample to report in roughly two days. Its platform detects mutations, expression levels, gene fusions, and clonotype information, and integrates directly with Epic and other leading EHR systems so results flow into the patient chart. The company is a portfolio company of initialized-capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; as of this pass it publishes a marketing/clinical website but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Dechert
providers.description: Dechert LLP is a global law firm founded in 1875 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, with "more than 900 lawyers" across 22 offices in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia (Wikipedia cites roughly 1,000 attorneys in 20 offices; the firm itself emphasizes a global footprint spanning the U.S., Europe, Asia, and the Middle East). The firm is known for market-leading practices in financial services and investment management, private equity, private credit, mergers and acquisitions, international arbitration, intellectual property, life sciences, white collar enforcement, and antitrust. Dechert publishes deep thought-leadership through its OnPoint series, Crypto Bytes, FSR Radar, THE CRED, and ReTorts; produces multiple podcasts (Dechert 4 Real, Committed Capital, Dechert On Reg); and operates proprietary information platforms including DAMITT (Dechert Antitrust Merger Investigation Timing Tracker), World Compass, World Passport, Dechert Direct, and a Box Portal. Despite these data-driven products, Dechert does not expose any public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, GraphQL endpoint, webhook surface, status page, changelog, or developer portal, and does not publish an RSS feed for OnPoint or any blog series — its only public-facing subscription mechanism is an email preference form.

providers.name: Decibel Therapeutics *
providers.description: Decibel Therapeutics was a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on gene therapies for hearing loss and balance disorders. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass its primary domain, decibeltx.com, 301-redirects to regeneron.com, consistent with the company having been acquired/absorbed by Regeneron; Decibel maintains no independent public developer portal, API, documentation, or other developer surface. This profile is retained as a network lead and carries only infrastructure-level (domain security) probe data.

providers.name: Deep 6 AI
providers.description: Deep 6 AI was a clinical-trial acceleration company that used artificial intelligence and natural language processing to mine structured and unstructured clinical data in electronic health records, matching eligible patients to clinical trials in minutes rather than months. The Techstars-backed precision-research platform was acquired by Tempus AI in early 2024, after which its standalone deep6.ai web presence was retired (the domain no longer serves a site, though its email/DNS records remain active). No public developer program, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or package registry entries could be found for Deep 6 AI during enrichment.

providers.name: dezhentech
providers.description: Dezhen Technology (德臻) is a Shanghai-based healthcare information technology company providing informatization solutions for public hospitals and medical institutions across China. Its portfolio spans hospital operations management centers, integrated electronic medical record (EMR) systems, information integration platforms, hospital data centers and big-data analytics, refined operations management dashboards, EMR interoperability testing, and domestic (localized) technology transformation of core hospital systems. Dezhen is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As of this profile the company publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: digitalsurgery
providers.description: Digital Surgery (originally Touch Surgery / Kinosis) is a London-based surgical artificial intelligence company backed by Balderton Capital and acquired by Medtronic in 2020, where it now operates as part of Medtronic's Covidien surgical business. It builds the Touch Surgery ecosystem of surgical simulation and training tools and Touch Surgery Enterprise, an AI-powered platform for recording, analyzing, and reviewing surgical video in the operating room. The company does not publish a public developer program or API; digitalsurgery.com now redirects to Medtronic's Digital Surgery product page. This profile remains a network stub awaiting a real developer surface.

providers.name: dkmedtech
providers.description: dkmedtech (Suzhou Dingke Medical Technology Co., Ltd.) is a medical device manufacturer founded in 2010 in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China, developing interventional vascular devices across three areas: peripheral vascular intervention, cardiovascular intervention, and neurovascular intervention. With a team of 100+ and a global manufacturing center launched in December 2025, its products carry NMPA (China), CE (Europe), and FDA (United States) regulatory clearances. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; it publishes a corporate website but no developer API, documentation, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: DocDoc
providers.description: DocDoc is Asia's leading patient empowerment company, positioning itself as the patients' trusted medical advisor. With a network of more than 23,000 doctors under contract and extensive proprietary data on outcome, price, and experience, DocDoc helps patients find the highest quality care for their unique medical needs. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by 500 Global, the company operates across Asia connecting patients with doctors, clinics, and hospitals through a data-driven medical advisory platform. DocDoc is profiled in the API Evangelist network as a healthcare technology company; no public developer/API surface was discoverable during enrichment.

providers.name: Dots
providers.description: Dots is a mobile games studio founded in 2013 by Paul Murphy and Patrick Moberg, known for minimalist, calming puzzle games including Dots, Two Dots, and Dots & Co. The studio focused on well-designed, easy-to-approach games and player-friendly monetization, measuring success by how players feel rather than aggressive in-app spending. Backed by Northzone, Slow Ventures, Tencent, Greycroft, and CrunchFund, Dots was acquired by Take-Two Interactive in August 2020. This is a consumer gaming company with no public developer API surface; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio stub and this enrichment pass confirmed it exposes no API, SDK, or documentation.

providers.name: DSL
providers.description: A Domain-Specific Language (DSL) is a programming language or specification language dedicated to a particular problem domain, a particular problem representation technique, or a particular solution technique. DSLs allow domain experts to express solutions in terms of the problem domain rather than the implementation domain.

providers.name: EdgeQ
providers.description: EdgeQ is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, building a converged "Base Station-on-a-Chip" that integrates 5G, 6G, non-terrestrial network (NTN), custom waveform, CPU, and antenna-controller functions into a single software-defined silicon platform. Its programmable baseband targets small cells, private enterprise 5G, open RAN, satellite (LEO/MEO) communications, and AI-enabled physical devices. EdgeQ is a hardware and silicon provider surfaced as a portfolio company of Threshold Ventures; it publishes a corporate site, a 5G engineering blog, newsroom, and careers, but exposes no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: effx
providers.description: effx was a San Francisco developer-tools startup, founded in 2018 by Joey Parsons, that built a modern microservice catalog to help engineering teams navigate and operate microservices architectures — tracking service ownership, cataloging services, enforcing service standards, tracking migrations, and supporting incident response. The company raised a $3.9M seed round led by Kleiner Perkins alongside Cowboy Ventures. effx was acquired by Figma in 2021; the product was shut down and the team joined Figma's engineering organization. effx.com is now an acquisition/farewell notice and there is no live API, developer documentation, SDK, or public source surface to enrich.

providers.name: Elemy
providers.description: Elemy (formerly Sprout Therapy) was a US pediatric behavioral-health startup providing in-home Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy for children with autism, reaching unicorn valuation on backing from SoftBank Vision Fund, General Catalyst, and 8VC. In late 2022 it wound down its direct-care therapy division and pivoted to software; in 2023 it rebranded to Tilly (tillytherapy.com), a HIPAA-compliant ABA practice-management and AI platform covering intake, scheduling, authorizations, billing, payroll, and family engagement for autism-care providers. The original elemy.com domain no longer resolves. Tilly is a closed SaaS product with no public developer API, developer portal, or published API documentation as of this profile.

providers.name: Ellis Coffee Company
providers.description: Ellis Coffee Company is a Philadelphia-based wholesale coffee roaster founded in 1854 and now in its fourth generation of family ownership. Ellis supplies coffee, tea, hot chocolate, brewing equipment, and POS materials to restaurants, hotels, resorts, office coffee service (OCS) programs, convenience stores, universities, distributors, and vending operators. Customers place and manage orders through deliver.elliscoffee.com and request brewing equipment service through the OnUpkeep portal. Ellis Coffee Company does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, webhook program, SDK, or status page.

providers.name: Elodie
providers.description: Elodie Games is an independent video game studio founded in 2019 and headquartered in Venice, California, building endlessly-playable cross-play PvE cooperative games for PC, console, and mobile. Co-founded by Christina Norman (design leadership on Mass Effect 1-3, League of Legends, and League of Legends: Wild Rift) and David Banks (former executive producer of League of Legends at Riot Games), the studio is focused on deeply social, cross-platform gameplay so friends and family can play together regardless of device or skill level. Elodie's Series A was co-led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Galaxy Interactive. Elodie publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; its backend stack (AWS, Kotlin, gRPC/Protobuf, DynamoDB, MySQL) is internal-only, so there is no API artifact surface to enrich for this provider.

providers.name: Enfabrica
providers.description: Enfabrica is a semiconductor company building networking silicon and systems for large-scale AI and accelerated-computing infrastructure. Its ACF-S ("Accelerated Compute Fabric") SuperNIC targets maximum throughput with fault-tolerant, multipath connectivity across AI clusters, and its EMFASYS elastic memory fabric system provides memory offload for AI inference workloads. Enfabrica is backed by Spark Capital. The company publishes a technical blog and company news, but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile carries company identity and domain-security signals rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Epiodyne
providers.description: Epiodyne is a San Francisco-based pharmaceutical company using structure-based drug discovery to develop small-molecule opioid medicines precisely calibrated for minimal side effects and minimal addiction potential. Its pipeline targets pain management and opioid use disorder (OUD), engineering compounds with specifically tuned receptor functions to address the opioid crisis. The company is a venture-backed biotech portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or technology platform.

providers.name: Epizyme
providers.description: Epizyme, Inc. was a Cambridge, Massachusetts biopharmaceutical company developing epigenetic therapies for cancer and other diseases. Its lead product, TAZVERIK (tazemetostat), is an oral EZH2 inhibitor approved by the FDA for epithelioid sarcoma and relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma. Epizyme was acquired by Ipsen in 2022. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub via the kleiner-perkins venture portfolio; the company operates no public developer program, API, or documentation surface, and its former corporate website (epizyme.com) is no longer serving a web presence though the domain remains registered and mail-active.

providers.name: EQRx
providers.description: EQRx was a biopharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 2020 by Alexis Borisy with a mission to develop and deliver innovative, patent-protected medicines at radically lower prices. The company went public in 2021 through a SPAC merger with CM Life Sciences III and built an oncology and immunology pipeline anchored by in-licensed candidates such as aumolertinib and sugemalimab. In 2023 EQRx wound down its drug-development programs and was acquired by Revolution Medicines in an all-stock transaction. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead (backed by a16z and GV); it never operated a public developer platform or API, and its web presence is no longer live.

providers.name: Erebor Bank
providers.description: Erebor is a nationally chartered U.S. bank built for the next century of American innovation.
