Its digital banking platform serves businesses with FDIC-insured deposit accounts, ACH and wire transfer rails, batch payments, multi-party approval workflows, account statements, and identity verification delivered through a modern web application. Erebor was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; as of this pass it does not publish a public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or other machine-readable artifacts, so the profile is limited to verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Etched
providers.description: Etched is an AI hardware company building Sohu, a transformer-only ASIC designed to accelerate inference for large language models by hard-wiring the transformer architecture directly into silicon. Etched markets Sohu as an alternative to general-purpose GPUs for transformer inference, claiming order-of-magnitude throughput improvements on models such as Llama 70B when deployed in eight-chip server configurations. The chip is fabricated on TSMC's 4nm process with 144 GB of HBM3E per package. As of mid-2026 Etched has raised more than 625 million dollars at a 5 billion dollar valuation but has not yet shipped Sohu to customers in volume, and there is no public Etched API or developer surface. This profile is company-and-product-only and intentionally has an empty apis list.

providers.name: Etherealize
providers.description: Etherealize builds institutional-grade infrastructure to bring Wall Street and financial institutions onto the Ethereum blockchain, focused on asset tokenization, Ethereum-native settlement, and institutional privacy for multi-trillion-dollar markets. Founded to connect institutions to the Ethereum ecosystem, the company pairs research and market education with products for programmable, private, and global finance. Backed by Electric Capital and Paradigm, Etherealize raised $40M in September 2025. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing site, a research/blog content hub, and careers and newsroom pages, but exposes no public developer or API surface, no documentation portal, and no client SDKs.

providers.name: Evelo Biosciences *
providers.description: Evelo Biosciences was a Flagship Pioneering-founded, GV-backed microbiome biotechnology company in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing orally delivered investigational medicines acting on the small intestinal axis. Following clinical failures of its lead candidates EDP1815 and EDP2939, the company announced dissolution in November 2023 and has been wound down. It is retained in the API Evangelist network as a dissolved life-sciences portfolio record: the evelobio.com domain now serves only a parked catch-all error page and the company publishes no developer portal, documentation, or API surface of any kind.

providers.name: Event-Driven Architecture
providers.description: Event-driven architecture (EDA) is a software architecture pattern promoting the production, detection, consumption of, and reaction to events. In this pattern, systems are designed to respond to state changes asynchronously through event messages. EDA enables loose coupling between services and is widely used in microservices, real-time data processing, and distributed systems. Foundational specifications include AsyncAPI for describing event-driven APIs and CNCF CloudEvents for a common event format.

providers.name: EveryONE Medicines
providers.description: EveryONE Medicines is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: life-sciences. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Evonetix
providers.description: Evonetix is a Cambridge, UK deep-technology company developing a benchtop DNA synthesis platform built on semiconductor technology. Its core innovation is a silicon chip carrying thousands of independently thermally-controlled reaction sites, allowing many DNA strands to be synthesised in parallel with per-site temperature control, in-process error detection and correction, and assembly of high-fidelity genes at the desktop. The company's goal is to give synthetic biology, life-science, and drug-discovery researchers accurate, on-demand access to synthetic DNA without relying on centralised outsourced gene foundries. Evonetix was surfaced as a portfolio company of the deep-tech venture firm DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK, and its primary web domain (evonetix.com) resolves to a suspended-account placeholder page.

providers.name: Excision
providers.description: Excision BioTherapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing CRISPR-based in vivo gene-editing therapies aimed at curing serious viral infectious diseases. Its programs apply multiplexed CRISPR editing delivered via AAV vectors to excise viral DNA from the host genome, led by EBT-101, an investigational one-time therapy for HIV. Excision is a therapeutics company with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company record rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Excision BioTherapeutics
providers.description: Excision BioTherapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing CRISPR-based gene-editing therapies intended to functionally cure serious viral infectious diseases. Its programs use multiplexed CRISPR/Cas approaches delivered via adeno-associated virus (AAV) to excise latent viral DNA from infected cells, with a lead candidate (EBT-101) targeting HIV and additional research directed at herpesviruses and hepatitis B. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As a therapeutics company it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile therefore carries company identity and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Exo Therapeutics
providers.description: Exo Therapeutics is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of crv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: biotech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Faception
providers.description: Faception is an Israeli facial personality analytics company that applies proprietary computer vision and machine learning to analyze facial images from photos, video streams, and cameras, scoring individuals against personality and behavioral classifiers. The company markets its technology to public-safety and smart-city security, fintech, retail, insurance, recruiting, and personal-robotics use cases, and states that it analyzes faces anonymously by storing mathematical classifiers rather than personal identity data. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; at this time it publishes a marketing site and blog but no public API, developer documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: FDA Regulations
providers.description: Federal regulations governing the safety, efficacy, and security of food, drugs, medical devices, and other products under FDA jurisdiction. Organizations adopt it to address specific technical or business challenges in their environments.

providers.name: Feedbin
providers.description: RSS reader

providers.name: Fenrock AI
providers.description: Fenrock AI is a Y Combinator (W26) company building specialized AI agents for the banking back office. Founded in 2026 and based in San Francisco by Charu Sharma and Michael M., Fenrock overlays on a bank's existing systems and ingests internal policies and standard operating procedures to automate compliance, financial-crime, and loan-operations workflows without requiring data migration. Its agents assist analysts with alert triage, case investigation, suspicious-activity-report (SAR) drafting, quality assurance, enhanced due diligence, KYC/KYB reviews, and sanctions/PEP monitoring, while preserving bullet-proof audit logs designed to pass regulatory examinations. Fenrock positions itself as an AI workspace that lets a single analyst process many times the volume of financial-crime and money-laundering cases. This profile is an API Evangelist network company record; Fenrock is an enterprise product company with no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Financial Regulation
providers.description: Financial regulation is the body of laws, rules, and supervisory frameworks governing financial markets, banks, broker-dealers, asset managers, payment providers, and crypto firms. Major regulators include the U.S. SEC, FINRA, CFTC, OCC, FRB, FDIC, FinCEN, CFPB; the UK FCA and PRA; the EU ESMA, EBA, and EIOPA; and global bodies like IOSCO and the Basel Committee. Core frameworks include MiFID II / MiFIR, Basel III, Dodd-Frank, Sarbanes-Oxley, EMIR, PSD2, GDPR, AML / KYC (FATF), and FATCA / CRS reporting.

providers.name: Firnas Aero
providers.description: Firnas Aero is a Saudi Arabian deep-tech startup building autonomous Drone-in-a-Box (DiaB) systems for aerial surveillance, industrial inspection, and environmental assessment. Its turnkey platform pairs self-charging, robotic battery-swapping drone stations with cloud-based remote management over 5G, Ethernet, or Wi-Fi, and applies machine-learning and deep-learning models for anomaly detection, Foreign Object Debris (FOD) detection, hazard identification, and geo-location. Based at KRTP HQ in Thuwal, Saudi Arabia, the company serves infrastructure, energy, and security clients including Red Sea Global, NEOM, and the Saudi Electricity Company, and is backed by 500 Global. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: firstgrid
providers.description: The domain firstgrid.cn resolves to Shanghai Shouige Network Technology Co., Ltd. (上海首格网络科技有限公司 / "Shouige Network"), a Chinese software and logistics-services provider focused on the medical-device industry. Its products include the Medical Jiecloud Platform (医捷云), a bidirectional logistics intelligence and supply-chain management system, a public database platform, and third-party warehousing/distribution services for medical-device producers, distributors, and 3PLs, with offices in Shanghai and an R&D center in Hangzhou. The company was surfaced as a portfolio lead of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As of this enrichment pass the public site is a Chinese-language corporate marketing site and exposes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documentation surface, so no API artifacts could be harvested. Note: the recorded English name "firstgrid" is the pinyin of 首格 (Shǒugé) and the domain/company identity should be verified against the intended qiming portfolio company.

providers.name: Fitocracy
providers.description: Fitocracy is a fitness gamification platform and social network that turns exercise into an RPG-style game, awarding points and levels for logged workouts and letting members join groups, take on challenges, and cheer each other on. Founded in 2011 and later acquired, it popularized applying game mechanics to habit-building and health tracking. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site currently returns HTTP 503 and exposes no documented API surface.

providers.name: Fla
providers.description: FLA Orthopedics (FLA Holdings) is a United States-based manufacturer of orthopedic, sports medicine, and bracing products, including supports, braces, splints, and soft-goods for the medical, clinical, and consumer health markets. Canaan Partners invested in FLA Holdings at the Series D stage; the company was surfaced through that portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. FLA Orthopedics is a physical medical-device maker and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile is identity-only and carries no API artifacts.

providers.name: FMC Corporation
providers.description: FMC Corporation is a Philadelphia-headquartered global agricultural sciences company that develops and supplies crop protection products including herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and biological solutions, alongside precision agriculture technology. Originally founded as the Food Machinery Corporation, the modern FMC focuses on productivity and resilience for growers worldwide. This repository tracks the FMC Corporation entity and any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published. Note that "FMC" is also commonly used as an abbreviation for the legacy FMC Technologies brand (now TechnipFMC), which is tracked separately under the fmc-technologies repository.

providers.name: Foaster
providers.description: Foaster is an AI transformation consultancy that bills itself as "the AI-native McKinsey." Founded in 2026 by Raphael Dabadie and Alexandre Combes and backed by Y Combinator, it deploys AI agents that interview a company's employees at scale, map how work actually gets done, identify bottlenecks and AI opportunities, and draft a transformation roadmap in about two weeks, with expert consultants reviewing the outputs and feeding their corrections back into the system. Its offerings span an AI Transformation Assessment, Continuous AI Transformation with monthly adoption tracking, and Enterprise Deployment backed by forward-deployed engineers. Foaster is a managed professional-services company and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or other developer-facing technical surface.

providers.name: Form Energy
providers.description: Form Energy is a long-duration energy storage company headquartered in Somerville, Massachusetts and Weirton, West Virginia. Its flagship product is an iron-air battery designed to store electricity for up to 100 hours, intended to enable utilities and grid operators to firm renewable generation across multi-day weather events, replace aging fossil-fueled peakers, and defer transmission and distribution upgrades. The company manufactures its battery at Form Factory 1, a 550,000-square-foot facility built on the former Weirton Steel mill site that employs roughly 400 people. Form Energy also publishes Formware, a grid-modeling software suite used by utilities to plan resource portfolios that include multi-day storage. Notable customers and partners include Georgia Power, Xcel Energy, Great River Energy, Dominion Energy, PG&E, New York Power Authority, and Crusoe Energy (a 12 GWh agreement to firm power for AI data centers). Form Energy does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK; engagement is through utility sales, partnership, and policy channels.

providers.name: Fortastra
providers.description: Fortastra is a spacecraft manufacturer building low-cost, maneuverable orbital defense systems designed for scalability and autonomous operation. Its spacecraft protect space-based infrastructure with autonomous navigation that detects, analyzes, and responds to orbital anomalies without relying on distant ground-based sensors. The company's open software architecture spans sensing, maneuvering, coordination, and response functions, and its hardware is validated through component testing, simulation, and orbital deployment. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta.

providers.name: Forty Seven *
providers.description: Forty Seven, Inc. was an immuno-oncology biotechnology company founded in 2015 to commercialize CD47 immune-evasion research licensed from Stanford University (Irv Weissman and colleagues). Its lead program was magrolimab, a monoclonal antibody targeting CD47 — the "do not eat me" signal tumor cells use to evade macrophage-mediated killing — studied in myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS), acute myeloid leukemia (AML), and diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL). Backed by GV, the company was acquired by Gilead Sciences in 2020 for roughly $4.9 billion; the fortyseveninc.com domain now redirects to gilead.com. As a clinical-stage therapeutics company it exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Founder Collective
providers.description: Founder Collective is a seed and pre-seed stage venture capital firm that describes itself as stage-focused, sector agnostic, and proudly anti-thematic. Founded more than fifteen years ago and operating from Cambridge, MA (Harvard Square) and New York, NY (SoHo), the firm positions itself as founder-aligned, backing capital-efficient companies from idea through IPO. General partners include Micah Rosenbloom, David Frankel, and Amanda Herson, with Eric Paley as partner emeritus. Notable portfolio companies include Uber, SeatGeek, WHOOP, The Trade Desk, Airtable, Cruise, Coupang, Verkada, Shield AI, and Suno. Added to the API Evangelist network via the venture-capital portfolio graph.

providers.name: Fox-Tech
providers.description: FOX-TECH CO. is a New Taipei City, Taiwan IoT company (founded 2016, backed by 500 Global and SparkLabs Taipei) that digitally transforms farming, logistics, cold-chain, and manufacturing operations. Its TempHawk platform pairs wireless temperature, humidity, CO2, light-intensity and soil-EC sensors over Sigfox LPWAN with web and mobile apps and cloud data analytics, helping the perishable-goods value chain monitor conditions, manage risk, and meet policy compliance. Recognized on the Forward Fooding FoodTech 500. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is currently published.

providers.name: Frontrow
providers.description: FrontRow was an India-based edtech company that operated an online learning platform teaching extracurricular skills and hobbies — such as music, singing, guitar, drawing, chess and other creative pursuits — to learners through recorded video courses and community-driven classes. The company was backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of the last enrichment pass the product has shut down: its primary domain frontrow.co.in 301-redirects to a Medium shutdown announcement confirming "FrontRow shut down a few months ago," and no developer portal, public API, documentation, or SDK surface exists. This entry is retained as a defunct portfolio-lead record; there are no live API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: Fyto
providers.description: Fyto is a Bay Area agricultural cleantech and robotics company, founded in 2019 by Jason Prapas with MIT origins, that builds automated cultivation systems for lemna — fast-growing aquatic "superplants" in the duckweed family. Its ReCover process, GrowGrid raised growbeds, and autonomous Harvester machine capture excess nutrients from dairy and livestock operations and convert them into high-protein animal feed, cutting nitrate pollution and greenhouse-gas emissions without arable land, synthetic fertilizer, or manual labor. Backed by GV, Fyto is scaling regenerative farming from California's San Joaquin Valley. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation is currently published.

providers.name: GazeHawk
providers.description: GazeHawk was a webcam-based eye-tracking startup founded in December 2009 by Brian Krausz and Joe Gershenson, offering affordable eye-tracking usability and ad-testing services that ran on ordinary consumer webcams instead of expensive dedicated hardware. Backed by Y Combinator (S10) and 500 Startups, the company was acqui-hired by Facebook in March 2012 — Facebook hired the engineering team but explicitly did not acquire the product or technology, and the founders moved on to unrelated backend and product engineering. GazeHawk operated no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; the domain today serves only a legacy static marketing and blog site for the defunct product.

providers.name: Gem
providers.description: Gem Security was a cloud detection and response (CDR) company, founded in 2022 in Tel Aviv, that built a real-time cloud threat detection, investigation, and response platform to shorten the time to investigate and contain cloud-native attacks. It raised roughly $34M from Team8, GGV/Notable Capital, IBM Ventures, Cisco Investments, and Silicon Valley CISO Investments, and was acquired by Wiz for about $350M in April 2024 to expand Wiz's CDR offering. Gem no longer operates as an independent product: the gem.security domain permanently redirects to Wiz and there is no standalone Gem developer portal, public API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface to enrich. This record is retained as an acquired-company / portfolio lead.

providers.name: Generalist AI
providers.description: Generalist AI is a frontier AI research and product company founded in 2024 that is building general intelligence for the physical world. Rather than manufacturing robots, Generalist builds the embodied foundation models — the "brain" — that run across many robot types and hardware configurations, with an emphasis on dexterity and autonomy. Its founding team of researchers, roboticists, and operators comes from Google DeepMind, Boston Dynamics, and OpenAI, with prior work on PaLM-E, RT-2, Gemini Robotics, Atlas, Spot, and the scaling of large language models. The company's GEN-1 model (April 2026) is described as the first general-purpose model to reach mastery of simple physical tasks, running with full autonomy. Generalist operates from the Bay Area (San Mateo / San Francisco) and Boston, and has raised more than $500M — including a $400M round at a roughly $2B valuation backed by Nvidia, Bezos Expeditions, Radical Ventures, 8VC, Union Square Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, Hanabi Capital, and boldstart ventures. Generalist AI currently publishes no public API or developer program; this profile captures its company identity and web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Genesis Therapeutics
providers.description: Genesis Therapeutics (Genesis Molecular AI) is an AI-focused biotechnology company building GEMS (Genesis Exploration of Molecular Space), a generative and predictive AI operating system for small-molecule drug discovery. GEMS combines structure-based deep learning, language and diffusion models, and physics-based simulation (molecular dynamics and quantum chemistry) to generate and optimize molecules for complex targets, accelerating hit identification through lead optimization and candidate selection. In 2025 the company introduced Pearl, a next-generation foundation model for drug discovery. Headquartered in Burlingame, California with a laboratory in San Diego, Genesis has raised over $300M and partners with Eli Lilly, Gilead, Genentech, and Incyte while advancing its own therapeutic pipeline. It is not a public API provider: GEMS is a proprietary internal platform with no published developer portal, documentation, or API.

providers.name: Genomics Medicine Ireland
providers.description: Genomics Medicine Ireland (GMI) is a Dublin-based life-sciences company founded in 2015 to build a large-scale Irish genomic and clinical research programme, sequencing volunteer participant DNA and pairing it with longitudinal phenotypic data to study the genetic basis of common and rare diseases such as Alzheimer's, heart failure, inflammatory bowel disease and multiple sclerosis. GMI was absorbed into WuXi NextCODE and subsequently rebranded as Genuity Science (genuitysci.com), a precision-medicine business offering disease-enriched genomic cohorts, whole-genome and next-generation sequencing through a clinically accredited lab, and population-scale data-analysis services to pharmaceutical and biotech partners for target discovery and biomarker identification. As a genomics research and data-services organization it exposes no public developer API, portal, SDKs or OpenAPI; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio lead and carries only the artifacts that can be honestly derived or probed for it.

providers.name: Gentem
providers.description: Gentem is a healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) technology company that helps medical practices automate insurance billing and get paid faster. Its platform streamlines eligibility verification, claims submission, denial and payment management, and patient billing for independent and specialty providers, with the goal of reducing administrative burden and accelerating provider cash flow. Gentem was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; its public developer surface is not currently reachable for artifact harvesting (the primary domain is protected behind a bot challenge and no developer, docs, or API subdomains resolve), so this profile carries verified domain-security probe data plus company identity.

providers.name: GigaCrop
providers.description: GigaCrop is an agricultural biotechnology company engineering the photosynthesis pathway to dramatically increase crop productivity. Founded by Chris Eiben, PhD, the company combines enzyme engineering and machine learning to optimize the RuBisCo enzyme, aiming to roughly double yields in staple crops such as corn and soy and to break past the limits that have held annual yield gains near one percent for a century. Backed by Playground Global, GigaCrop is working to make agriculture both more sustainable and more abundant.

providers.name: Ginger
providers.description: Ginger (formerly Ginger.io) was a behavioral and emotional health company offering on-demand mental health support — coaching, therapy, and psychiatry — delivered through a mobile app and an employer/health-plan benefits model. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead, Ginger merged with Headspace in 2021 to form Headspace Health; the ginger.com domain now redirects to Headspace for Organizations (organizations.headspace.com). Enrichment probing on 2026-07-19 found no independent public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface — every /.well-known path resolves to a soft-404 Headspace marketing page. This profile is retained as an acquired-company record; the only genuine machine-derivable artifact is the live domain-security posture of ginger.com.

providers.name: GITAI
providers.description: GITAI is a space robotics company building safe and affordable robotic labor for space. It develops robotic arms, spacecraft platforms, autonomous "Inchworm" robots, and lunar rovers for on-orbit servicing, satellite assembly and maintenance, and lunar and orbital infrastructure construction, working with customers and agencies such as NASA and JAXA. GITAI operates as a B2B and government contractor and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, SDK, or developer documentation; this profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with the publicly observable web, blog, and domain-security surface only.

providers.name: GLASS
providers.description: Glass Imaging (GlassAI) is a Los Altos, California AI imaging company that extracts the full image-quality potential from camera hardware by using neural networks to reverse lens aberrations and sensor imperfections. Its GlassAI Neural ISP is a software image-signal-processing pipeline that boosts camera performance up to 10x on edge AI-enabled devices such as smartphones, and its co-designed AI-plus-optics approach delivers DSLR-quality imaging from size-constrained camera systems. The company is venture-backed by GV, LDV Capital, Future Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Ground Up, and Insight Partners. Glass Imaging is an on-device computer-vision technology provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Golden 1 Credit Union
providers.description: Golden 1 Credit Union is a state-chartered, member-owned not-for-profit financial cooperative headquartered in Sacramento, California, and is one of the largest credit unions in the United States, serving roughly 1.1 million members across California with approximately 20 billion dollars in assets. Founded in 1933 and open to all Californians, it offers consumer checking, savings, credit cards, auto and home loans, and digital banking, and holds the naming rights to Golden 1 Center in Sacramento. Like most US credit unions, Golden 1 publishes NO public developer portal and NO first-party public API; its digital banking runs on a core-provider platform, and consumer-permissioned account data is reachable only indirectly through third-party data aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) rather than a documented first-party open-finance API. US open finance is voluntary and fragmented, and this institution's public API surface is honestly empty as of this record.

providers.name: Golden Ventures
providers.description: Golden Ventures is a seed-stage venture capital firm based in Toronto, Canada, founded in 2011 by former founders and operators who back bold, early-stage entrepreneurial teams across North America. The firm is sector agnostic and invests at the pre-seed, seed, and seed+ stages with typical initial checks of roughly $500K to $3M, having made over 100 investments including Wattpad, BenchSci, Float, ResQ, and Neo Financial. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Foundry Group. As a venture-capital firm rather than an API provider, it publishes no developer or API surface; this profile captures firm identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Graham Holdings
providers.description: Graham Holdings (NYSE: GHC) is a diversified holding company with operations in education, television broadcasting, digital media, manufacturing, healthcare, automotive, restaurants, and custom framing. Principal subsidiaries include Kaplan (educational services), Graham Media Group and Social News Desk (broadcasting and social media tools), The Slate Group and Foreign Policy (digital publishing), Code3 and City Cast (digital marketing and local news), Hoover Treated Wood Products, Joyce/Dayton, Group Dekko, and Forney (manufacturing), Graham Healthcare Group (home health and hospice), Graham Automotive (dealerships), Clyde's Restaurant Group (including Old Ebbitt Grill), and Framebridge (online custom framing). No public developer APIs have been identified across the portfolio.

providers.name: Granite Construction
providers.description: Granite Construction is one of the largest diversified heavy civil contractors and construction materials producers in the United States, with operations spanning transportation infrastructure, water infrastructure, mineral exploration, and aggregate materials.

providers.name: Graphic Packaging
providers.description: Graphic Packaging International is a Fortune 500 global manufacturer of sustainable, paperboard-based consumer packaging. Products include folding cartons, multipack cartons, foodservice packaging (cups, lids, to-go containers), microwave and ovenable packaging, paperboard canisters, and packaging machinery. Markets served include food, beverage, foodservice, household, personal care, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, pet care, beauty, and e-commerce. No public developer APIs are documented at this time.

providers.name: Greenbrier Companies
providers.description: The Greenbrier Companies is a leading international supplier of equipment and services to global freight transportation markets, designing, building, and marketing freight railcars in North America, Europe, and South America. Greenbrier also offers railcar leasing, repair, and digital fleet management services such as RailPulse.

providers.name: Gritstone Oncology
providers.description: Gritstone Oncology is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: life-sciences. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: guahao
providers.description: guahao.com is the flagship consumer domain of WeDoctor (微医), the Chinese digital-health platform that began as Guahao.com (挂号网) — literally the "appointment-registration network" — connecting patients to hospitals and physicians for online appointment booking, telemedicine consultations, e-prescriptions, and chronic-disease management. Founded in Hangzhou around 2010 and among the early investments of Qiming Venture Partners, the company operates a large internet-hospital and clinic network across China. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from a venture-portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; the public site sits behind a bot-challenge WAF (Tencent EdgeOne infrastructure), so no public developer/API surface was discoverable in this pass — the captured artifact is a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: guokang
providers.description: Guokang (国康私人医生 / Guokang Private Doctor, 深圳市国康健康管理服务有限公司) is a Shenzhen-based corporate and personal health-management service provider founded in 2005. It positions itself as one of China's leading health-management companies, integrating more than 1,000 domestic and international medical resources — private physicians, specialist experts, tertiary hospitals, and health-examination centers — to deliver private doctor services, family medical-care programs, and corporate health services such as medical screening, employee assistance programs (EAP), group insurance, and on-site corporate health centers. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture network; no public developer portal or API surface was found during enrichment (the site is served behind a Huawei Cloud WAF).

providers.name: Happs
providers.description: Happs was a live-streaming platform for creators and citizen journalists that let broadcasters produce real-time news and multicast a single live stream simultaneously to Facebook, YouTube, Twitter/X, Twitch and other destinations, with built-in studio tools and viewer monetization through tips and monthly sponsorships. Originally launched as a home for independent journalists, it expanded into a general creator social network and ran its live video on Amazon Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS). The company raised roughly $4.7M in a post-seed round led by Bullpen Capital and Crosslink Capital, and wound down operations around 2022. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead record; no public developer program, API, or live web surface remains.

providers.name: healthgenetech
providers.description: HealthGeneTech (HGT) is a genomics company focused on gene fragment analysis and the development of applications for genetic testing and diagnostics. It is a healthcare portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. The public website healthgenetech.com redirects to www.hgt.cn. As of enrichment, no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification could be located, and the primary web host did not serve content to automated probes; this profile remains a lead awaiting a discoverable API surface.

providers.name: Healthy Labs
providers.description: Healthy Labs is a healthcare and insurance technology company that powers a portfolio of digital health brands driving membership growth for Medicare and ACA (Affordable Care Act) insurance providers. Its offerings center on consumer lead generation, compliance and operational analytics, and member acquisition and retention optimization for the health-insurance market. The company has since rebranded as MPA (mpa.com), positioning itself as an AI-powered platform for licensed insurance professionals and agencies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub, this profile is enriched from public sources; no public developer program, OpenAPI specification, or API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Helion Energy
providers.description: Helion Energy is a fusion energy company headquartered in Everett, Washington pursuing a pulsed, magneto-inertial field-reversed-configuration (FRC) approach that uses a deuterium-helium-3 fuel cycle and direct electricity recovery rather than steam turbines. The company is on its seventh-generation prototype, Polaris, which achieved first plasma in 2024 and is targeted to demonstrate net electricity production from fusion. Helion's prior machines include Trenta, the sixth-generation prototype that reached fusion-relevant plasma temperatures, and Hercules, an earlier device. Orion is Helion's planned first commercial fusion power plant, with a publicly announced 2028 target for delivering electricity to Microsoft under what the companies describe as the world's first commercial fusion power purchase agreement; a second customer agreement is in place with steelmaker Nucor. Helion is led by co-founder and CEO David Kirtley, CTO Chris Pihl, Chief Scientist George Votroubek, and co-founder Anthony Pancotti. Investors include Sam Altman (chair), Dustin Moskovitz, Reid Hoffman, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Mithril Capital, Capricorn Investment Group, Peter Thiel, and others. Helion does not publish a public developer API or SDK.

providers.name: Helix Nano
providers.description: Helix Nano (HelixNano) is a Boston-based biotechnology company developing new ways to manipulate messenger RNA (mRNA) — the molecule that carries instructions from genes to the cell's protein-making machinery. Backed by DCVC since 2017, the company has developed techniques to improve the effectiveness and specificity of mRNA vaccines, including a next-generation COVID-19 vaccine engineered to resist viral mutation. HelixNano is now pursuing a broader vision of self-designing, adaptive therapeutics — drugs that could improve with every patient and, ideally, require only a single dose. The company operates out of 5 Channel Center Street in Boston, Massachusetts, and remains at an early, largely stealth stage with no public developer program or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Hero Journey Club
providers.description: Hero Journey Club is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of northzone and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Hexagon Bio
providers.description: Hexagon Bio is a Menlo Park, California biotechnology company developing novel payloads for antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) in oncology. The company designs next-generation ADC payloads intended to overcome resistance to current payloads and to expand the range of cancer indications ADCs can treat. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Hexagon Bio operates a therapeutics pipeline and research platform rather than a public developer program: it publishes no API, SDK, or developer documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched from Hexagon Bio's own public website (company, pipeline, science/platform, and news pages).

providers.name: High5health
providers.description: High5health (HighFive Healthcare) is a dental support organization that partners with endodontists and oral surgeons to run the business side of their specialty practices so the doctors can focus on patient care. Its managed services span human resources, accounting and legal, payroll, payor negotiations and credentialing, marketing, recruiting, revenue cycle management, IT and cybersecurity, procurement, insurance and risk management, and tax preparation. The company is a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio company. It operates as a healthcare business-services provider and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK.

providers.name: Hill International
providers.description: Hill International is a global construction consulting firm founded in 1976 in Mt. Laurel, New Jersey, providing program, project, and construction management, project management oversight, claims and dispute resolution, estimating and cost management, facilities management, project monitoring, troubled project turnaround, commissioning, and project labor agreement consulting to public and private sector owners across more than 100 offices in 42 countries. In December 2022 Hill agreed to be acquired by Global Infrastructure Solutions, Inc. (GISI), the parent of STV, with the take-private transaction closing in May 2023 — Hill now operates as a GISI Consulting Group company alongside STV, GEI Consultants, LiRo-Hill, Layton Construction, and the broader GISI portfolio. Hill International is a professional services firm and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or any developer portal.

providers.name: Hong Kong Asia Medical Group
providers.description: Hong Kong Asia Medical Group (HK Asia Medical Group) is a cardiovascular-focused healthcare group established in 1999, beginning with Wuhan Asia Heart Hospital. It operates across Mainland China, Hong Kong SAR, Japan and Indonesia, running hospitals and cardiac centres including Wuhan Asia Heart Hospital, Wuhan Asia General Hospital, Xinjiang Cardio-cerebrovascular Hospital, Sapporo Heart Center, Hong Kong Asia Heart Centre, Bali International Hospital and Shantou Cardiac Surgery Centre. Its work spans clinical medical practice, medical education and cardiovascular research, serving over 8.5 million patients with more than 5,200 medical staff across seven-plus service cities. It is a portfolio company of HongShan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). No public developer or API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Hormel Foods
providers.description: Hormel Foods Corporation is a global branded food company with over $12 billion in annual revenue. Known for brands like SPAM, Skippy, Jennie-O, Hormel, and Planters. The company produces and markets a wide range of meat, nut, and food products. No public APIs were identified.

providers.name: huimei
providers.description: Huimei Technology (惠每科技) is a Chinese medical artificial intelligence company whose core hospital-facing platform, Dr.Mayson, delivers clinical decision support systems (CDSS) built on a curated medical knowledge base. Its product suite spans specialty CDSS, single-disease quality management and reporting, medical-record quality control, DRG/DIP insurance cost control, and VTE intelligent prevention, helping hospitals raise clinical quality and safety. Huimei is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced through the VC portfolio graph and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes no public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: Human DX
providers.description: The Human Diagnosis Project (Human Dx) is a nonprofit initiative building an open, global medical intelligence system that combines the collective insight of physicians with machine learning to help make high-quality, affordable healthcare accessible to everyone. Its programs pair clinical microlearning and training tools for medical trainees with a specialist eConsult network that connects safety-net and underserved patients and their primary-care providers to volunteer specialists. The organization operates under the tagline "Rise together." Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Humane Genomics
providers.description: Humane Genomics Inc is a New York City biotechnology company engineering oncolytic RNA viruses to selectively target and destroy cancer cells. Using a first-principle, computer-aided design approach built on Vesicular Stomatitis Virus (VSV) with aptazyme-controlled selective replication, the company develops precision viral therapies; its lead candidate targets pediatric liver cancer (hepatoblastoma). Backed by Union Square Ventures, Humane Genomics operates from Alexandria LaunchLabs and partners with Genezen for cGMP manufacturing. The company publishes no public API or developer surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks it as a portfolio-company lead.

providers.name: Humansand
providers.description: humans& (Humansand) is a human-centric frontier AI lab publicly introduced on January 20, 2026. It aims to reimagine AI around people and their relationships, positioning models as connective tissue that strengthens organizations and communities rather than autonomous replacements. Its stated research agenda centers on long-horizon and multi-agent reinforcement learning, memory, and user understanding, tightly integrating scientific research with product development. The founding team has led work in reasoning, behavioral training, agents, and alignment across frontier industry and academic labs including xAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Meta, Reflection, AI2, Stanford, and MIT. Its seed round is led by SV Angel and co-founder Georges Harik. As of this profile the company is pre-product with no publicly documented API, SDK, or developer platform.

providers.name: Humedica (UnitedHealth Group)
providers.description: Humedica (UnitedHealth Group) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ai-apps. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Huntsman Corporation
providers.description: Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global chemical manufacturer of differentiated and specialty chemicals serving a diverse range of consumer and industrial end markets, with operating segments in polyurethanes, performance products, and advanced materials. Huntsman maintains a Technology Portal for partner collaborations, but no public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Hyalex Orthopaedics
providers.description: Hyalex Orthopaedics is a medical device company developing synthetic cartilage technology to repair and restore damaged joint surfaces. Its lead product, the HYALEX Knee System, uses a hydrogel-based material engineered to mimic the properties of natural cartilage and is intended to resurface damaged joints during surgery as an alternative to traditional implants. The company has received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation and is conducting clinical studies. Hyalex Orthopaedics is a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. As a physical medical-device manufacturer it does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its verified public identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hyde
providers.description: Hyde is an enterprise AI platform that partners with organizations to turn their proprietary data and institutional expertise into specialized reasoning models. Its integrated workbench spans environment and data preparation, a synthetic data engine for building simulation training environments, GPU-optimized training pipelines, trajectory engineering, and a tightly coupled inference-training loop for continuous improvement. Hyde positions custom, domain-specific models that keep enterprise data private while claiming superior agent accuracy and up to 10x lower inference cost and latency versus frontier models. It is a sales-led enterprise engagement (portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and general-catalyst) that does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Iconic
providers.description: Iconic (Iconic Interactive) is an AI gaming studio building real-time AI systems for video games and interactive storytelling — "Digital Actor" technology that lets game characters listen, react, and evolve alongside the player by combining speech recognition, large language models, and text-to-speech into low-latency conversational performances. Founded by veterans of GTA, Forza, Just Cause, and Sleeping Dogs with AI researchers from Cambridge and Imperial College, the company is backed by Northzone. Its flagship title, The Oversight Bureau, ships a demo on Steam. Iconic operates a marketing site, a Labs surface, and a technical blog; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a Northzone portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Iconicgames
providers.description: Iconic Interactive (iconicgames.io) is a game development studio building real-time AI systems for gameplay and interactive storytelling. The team combines game developers and AI scientists with credits on major franchises including GTA, Forza, and Just Cause, and is developing a game demo, "The Oversight Bureau," available on Steam. The company is backed by Kindred Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the studio publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public identity and the security posture of its web domain. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: IconOVir Bio
providers.description: IconOVir Bio is a New York City-based, clinical-stage life sciences company whose stated mission is to cure cancer and restore life to patients. Backed by GV (Google Ventures) as a portfolio company, IconOVir Bio operates in the oncology and cancer immunotherapy space, developing therapeutics aimed at treating patients across a range of cancers. The company maintains a corporate presence at 689 Fifth Avenue in Manhattan and presents a single-page corporate website with no public developer program, API, SDKs, or technical documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences portfolio lead; the enrichment pass confirmed there is no public API or developer surface to catalog beyond basic web-domain security posture.

providers.name: Illume Labs
providers.description: Illume Labs is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building a 24/7 AI personal health and longevity companion. Its platform is designed to connect a user's wearables, blood panels, and genomic data, then text them personalized, actionable insights — detecting patterns across data sources, answering health questions conversationally, and offering an interactive surface for deeper exploration of longevity signals. As of mid-2026 the company is pre-launch and operates a single marketing landing page ("A new lens on longevity") on Vercel with no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface yet published. This profile remains a network lead pending a public developer surface to enrich.

providers.name: Immunos Therapeutics
providers.description: Immunos Therapeutics is a privately held biotechnology company focused on harnessing the immune system to treat cancer and inflammatory diseases. The company develops immuno-oncology and immunomodulatory therapeutic candidates, advancing a preclinical and clinical pipeline supported by scientific and clinical advisory boards. Immunos Therapeutics is a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. As a therapeutics/drug-development company it operates in the life sciences rather than as a software API provider, and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer documentation at this time. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company and portfolio discovery.

providers.name: IncreBio
providers.description: IncreBio (formerly JuiceInnov8) is a Thai food-biotech company founded in 2017 that uses biology to create the next generation of healthier food and drinks. Its flagship product, INCREDIBLE Juice, is a 100% juice with roughly 70% less sugar than standard juice, about 30 calories and 5g of fiber per serving, under the tagline "Make Juice and War on Sugar." IncreBio is backed by 500 Global. It is a consumer food-and-beverage brand with no public API, developer platform, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Indodax
providers.description: Trade your Bitcoin and other assets with rupiah

providers.name: Industrial Microbes
providers.description: Industrial Microbes (iMicrobes) is a synthetic-biology company in Alameda, California that engineers microorganisms to convert renewable, low-carbon feedstocks such as ethanol and methane into commercial-grade industrial chemicals and bio-based materials. Founded in 2014 (Y Combinator W15) by Liz Clarke, Derek Greenfield, and Noah Helman, the company has produced 100% bio-based acrylic acid and targets net-zero or negative-emission building-block chemicals for coatings, paints, carbon-fiber precursors, biopolymers, and biodegradable plastics. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Industrial Microbes publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal, so the enrichment pipeline captured only verified company identity and website link properties.

providers.name: innostic
providers.description: Innostic is a China-based medical-device distribution and healthcare supply-chain company, established in 2015 and originally profiled as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Its public web presence at www.innostic.com now resolves to the Shanghai Jianfa Zhixin Medical Technology group, which operates across medical-device distribution, in-vitro diagnostics (IVD), hospital supply-chain management (SPD and centralized distribution), and consumer healthcare supply-chain services for manufacturers, distributors, and hospitals. The company is a B2B healthcare logistics and distribution firm; its only online systems are internal, login-gated operational platforms (Zhixin, U9, OA). As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile records verified company identity and a domain-security probe; there is no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Innovent
providers.description: Innovent Biologics (信达生物制药) is a biopharmaceutical company founded in 2011 and headquartered in the Suzhou Industrial Park, China, that discovers, develops, manufactures, and commercializes high-quality biologic medicines for the treatment of oncology, autoimmune, cardiovascular and metabolic, and ophthalmology diseases. Its portfolio includes the PD-1 inhibitor Tyvyt (sintilimab), developed in partnership with Eli Lilly, alongside a broad pipeline of monoclonal antibodies and other biologics. Innovent is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (01801.HK) and was surfaced through the Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China) portfolio. Innovent is a therapeutics company and does not publish a public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate and domain-security identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Instaplay
providers.description: Instaplay is an AI-native social gaming platform that turns plain-text prompts into playable multiplayer games with no coding required. Users describe a game idea in natural language ("a two-player pong game where paddles shrink after every point") and the platform generates a playable prototype that can be tested, remixed, and shared via link within seconds. It supports party, co-op, competitive, local, online, and solo formats. Founded in San Francisco and part of Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch, Instaplay frames games as a training ground for world models and embodied agents on the path to AGI.

providers.name: Intuitive Surgical
providers.description: Intuitive Surgical is the global leader in robotic-assisted minimally invasive surgery, developing and marketing the da Vinci surgical system, Ion endoluminal system, and the Intuitive Hub for case management, streaming, and integration in operating rooms worldwide.

providers.name: Inversion
providers.description: Inversion is a Los Angeles-based aerospace and defense company founded in 2021 by Austin Briggs and Justin Fiaschetti, building a new class of highly maneuverable reentry vehicles. Its flagship Arc is an autonomous, reusable, low-cost space-based delivery vehicle designed to store cargo in orbit and deliver it with precision to anywhere on Earth in under an hour, descending under parachutes using non-toxic propellants so crews can approach it immediately on landing. The company also develops hypersonics and space-based interceptor technology and flew its first reentry capsule, Ray, as an early technical demonstrator. Inversion has raised roughly $54M to date, including a $44M Series A led by Spark Capital and Adjacent with participation from Lockheed Martin Ventures, Kindred Ventures, and Y Combinator. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Inversion Space
providers.description: Inversion Space is a Los Angeles-based aerospace and defense company founded in 2021 by Justin Fiaschetti and Austin Briggs, building autonomous, reusable, and low-cost reentry vehicles that turn space into a global logistics network. Its Arc vehicle is designed to store cargo in orbit and deliver a 500-pound payload to anywhere on Earth in under an hour, while its first spacecraft, Ray, validated key reentry subsystems. The company also develops hypersonic test capabilities and space-based interceptor technology, partnering with Anduril on the Golden Dome program and Kratos on the MACH-TB 2.0 hypersonic test program, backed by a $71M U.S. Space Force contract. It is in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Invetx *
providers.description: Invetx was a Boston-based veterinary biotechnology company developing protein-based therapeutics — species-specific, half-life-extended monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) — for chronic conditions in companion animals (dogs and cats). Its integrated platform spanned antibody discovery, optimization, Fc-variant half-life extension, development and manufacturing, with lead program IVX-01. Backed by GV, F-Prime Capital, Novo Holdings, Eight Roads, Anterra Capital, Casdin Capital and Tekla, Invetx was acquired by Dechra Pharmaceuticals in July 2024 for up to $520M. It exposes no public API, developer, or documentation surface, and its standalone website (invetx.com) has been decommissioned since the acquisition; this profile is retained as a network lead / portfolio record.

providers.name: Jacobio Pharma
providers.description: Jacobio Pharma (Jacobio Pharmaceutica) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing novel small-molecule cancer therapies against historically "undruggable" oncology targets. Its pipeline spans 10+ clinical programs across six major tumor signaling pathways (including p53, RAS, RB, MYC, immune checkpoints, and tumor metabolism), advanced through proprietary allosteric drug-discovery and iADC platforms, more than 300 global patent applications, and 100+ clinical centers worldwide. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a corporate website but no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Jefferies Financial Group
providers.description: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. is a diversified financial services company engaged in investment banking and capital markets, asset management, and direct investing. Operating through its principal subsidiary Jefferies LLC, the firm serves institutional investors, corporations, and governments worldwide with research, trading, advisory, and underwriting services.

providers.name: jfkbio
providers.description: jfkbio (今复康生物科技 / JFK Bio) is a biotechnology and life-sciences company in China, surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Its public presence at jfkbio.com is a JavaScript single-page marketing site; no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, or other machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment, so most API artifact types are not applicable to this provider. This profile records what is genuinely observable today (identity and live domain-security posture) and remains a lead pending any future developer or API surface.

providers.name: jsDelivr
providers.description: Package info and download stats on jsDelivr CDN

providers.name: Jumbo
providers.description: Jumbo (Jumbo Privacy) was a consumer privacy and security assistant for iOS and Android, founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, that helped people manage the privacy settings across their social media and online accounts, clean up old posts, and monitor for data breaches. By design the app processed everything on-device and did not rely on server-side APIs to control user accounts, so it never exposed a public developer platform, OpenAPI specification, or SDK. Jumbo was acquired by Coalition, the B2B cyber insurer, in July 2023 and the consumer app has since been shut down. This API Evangelist profile is retained as a portfolio-company record for index-ventures; no API surface exists to enrich.

providers.name: KaliSpot
providers.description: KaliSpot is a fintech network operated by Outsource Monetic Group Inc. (OMG), an Atlanta-headquartered startup with legal presence in Senegal and Morocco. KaliSpots are Financial Inclusive Service Points (FISP) — ATM and interactive teller machine (ITM) locations running a brand-agnostic, "phygital" infrastructure that bridges physical cash and digital financial services. From a single access point, customers reach banks, mobile money operators, and fintechs for 24/7 cash-in/cash-out (CICO), positioning KaliSpot as an independent omnichannel ATM operator across Francophone West and Central Africa, with pilots launched in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire. Founded 2021; pre-seed funding from 500 Global and Grenfell Holdings. No public developer API or documentation surface has been published to date.

providers.name: KAR Auction Services (Historical)
providers.description: KAR Auction Services was a leading provider of vehicle auction, vehicle remarketing, and salvage auction services in North America. The company divested its salvage business IAA in 2023 (now part of RB Global) and rebranded its remaining wholesale business as OPENLANE. This repository is retained for historical reference. For current activity see the OPENLANE repository.

providers.name: Kavak
providers.description: Kavak is a Mexico-founded digital marketplace for buying, selling, and financing pre-owned cars across Latin America, the Middle East, and Turkey. Founded in 2016 in Mexico City by Carlos Garcia Ottati, Loreanne Garcia Ottati, and Roger Laughlin, Kavak became Mexico's first unicorn in 2020 and reached an $8.7B valuation in 2021 with backing from SoftBank, Sea Ltd, and Founders Fund. The company operates an end-to-end consumer platform that combines an e-commerce site and mobile app, physical hubs, in-house vehicle reconditioning, and a financial-services arm (Kavak Capital, Kuna, and Kavak Credito). Internally, Kavak uses machine learning and proprietary pricing models to value, inspect, and route inventory across markets including Mexico, Argentina, Brazil, Chile, the United Arab Emirates, and Turkey, while sponsoring high-profile partners such as the NFL. Kavak's revenue comes from vehicle sales, financing margins, and after-sales services, and the company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or open-source GitHub organization. Customer-facing integrations are limited to the consumer web and mobile apps and partner financing channels.

providers.name: Kets
providers.description: KETS Quantum Security is a Bristol, UK deep-tech company (incorporated 2016) building chip-based quantum-safe encryption and networking hardware. Its product line spans Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), Quantum Random Number Generators (QRNG), and the KETS KORE sub-system, delivering security grounded in the laws of physics rather than computational complexity. KETS technology hardens telecommunications networks, satellite and aerospace communications (including Airbus collaborations), data-center backups, and critical infrastructure control systems against the emerging threat of quantum computing. Backed by European quantum-specialist venture investors including Speedinvest and supported by multiple UK government funding awards, KETS is a hardware and photonics company; it does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Speedinvest portfolio lead and enriched with identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Labrys Biologics
providers.description: Labrys Biologics was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2012 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, developing monoclonal antibody therapeutics targeting calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) for the prevention of chronic and episodic migraine. The company was venture-backed, with Canaan Partners among its investors, and was acquired by Teva Pharmaceutical Industries in 2014, after which its lead anti-CGRP antibody program continued under Teva. Labrys Biologics no longer operates as an independent company and maintains no developer or API surface: enrichment probes on 2026-07-19 found the registrant domain labrysbiologics.com resolving but serving nothing (TCP 80 and 443 closed), delegated to Teva nameservers, with a no-mail SPF/DMARC lockdown and no GitHub organization. This profile is retained as a historical portfolio-company record rather than an API listing.

providers.name: Lear
providers.description: Lear Corporation is a Fortune 500 global automotive technology leader in Seating and E-Systems, delivering complete seat systems, electrical distribution and connection systems, and intelligent in-vehicle technology to vehicles from major automakers worldwide. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Leya
providers.description: Leya was a Stockholm-based legal AI startup founded in 2023 by Max Junestrand (CEO) and Sigge Labor, building an AI-powered workspace for law firms and legal professionals that automated repetitive document review, drafting, and legal research tasks across public sources and a firm's own private data. The company went through Y Combinator (Winter 2024 batch), partnered with leading Nordic firms such as Mannheimer Swartling beginning May 2023, raised a $10.5M seed (May 2024) and a $25M Series A (July 2024), and was named one of Stockholm's hottest startups by WIRED in 2024. Leya offered a collaborative legal AI workspace with tabular review (large-scale parallel document analysis) and was rolled out to 200+ law firms across 15+ countries under the Leya brand. On 19 February 2025 the company fully rebranded to Legora, retaining the same founders, Stockholm headquarters, and product, while expanding with agentic research tools and a Microsoft Word add-in. The Leya brand and product line have been entirely absorbed into Legora; there is no separate ongoing Leya product, no public developer API, no SDK, and no GitHub presence under the Leya name. This entry preserves the Leya identity for historical reference; see the legora entry for the ongoing company profile.

providers.name: Liberty Interactive
providers.description: Liberty Interactive Corporation owned and operated a broad range of video and online commerce companies, including QVC, HSN, and zulily, before being reorganized into Qurate Retail Group in 2018. The corporation tracked separate operating units through Liberty Interactive Group and Liberty Ventures Group tracking stocks.

providers.name: Liberty Media
providers.description: Liberty Media Corporation is a media and entertainment holding company headquartered in Englewood, Colorado, owning interests in a portfolio of assets across media, entertainment, and sports. Its primary holding is the Formula One Group, which encompasses Formula 1 racing operations and MotoGP motorcycle racing, alongside investments in companies such as Liberty Broadband, QVC Group, Atlanta Braves Holdings, and Liberty Live Holdings.

providers.name: Life Time Group Holdings
providers.description: Life Time Group Holdings is an American health and wellness company operating large-format athletic resort destinations across the United States and Canada. The company offers fitness facilities, personal training, group classes, aquatics, indoor and outdoor sports, spa services, and healthy living programs in premium resort-style facilities, plus the Life Time app for members. Life Time does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: LifePoint Health
providers.description: LifePoint Health is a leading healthcare provider operating community hospitals, regional health systems, physician practices, outpatient centers, and post-acute facilities across the United States. This index tracks any APIs, SDKs, and developer resources published by LifePoint Health.

providers.name: Lightmatter
providers.description: Lightmatter is a Mountain View, California photonic supercomputer company building optical interconnect and compute products for AI infrastructure. Its flagship Passage line of 3D-stacked photonic interposers and co-packaged optics, including the Passage M1000 superchip and the Passage L20 and L200 pluggables, deliver up to 114 Tbps of optical bandwidth and target frontier-scale AI training and inference fabrics. Lightmatter also ships the Envise general-purpose photonic AI accelerator and the Guide VLSP Light Engine universal light source, and provides reference systems and evaluation kits. The company holds a 4.4 billion dollar valuation on roughly 850 million dollars raised as of late 2024 and partners with TSMC, GlobalFoundries, OIF, IEEE, and OCP. Lightmatter does not expose a public developer API, so this profile is hardware-, research-, and press-focused with an intentionally empty apis list.

providers.name: LIH Healthcare (长和医疗)
providers.description: Beijing Changhe International Medical Investment Management Co., Ltd. — operating as LIH Healthcare (长和医疗) — is a Chinese rehabilitation-medicine group that invests in, manages, and operates rehabilitation hospitals and outpatient clinics. The company imports international rehabilitation techniques, service models, and management practices and adapts them to the Chinese market across pediatric developmental and behavioral rehabilitation, cardiopulmonary and critical-care rehabilitation, pain rehabilitation, neurological rehabilitation, and bone and joint rehabilitation. Its three business models are building and investing in high-standard rehabilitation hospitals and clinics, co-operating rehabilitation-medicine departments inside existing general hospitals, and selling systematized rehabilitation service solutions (planning, clinical pathways, operations, equipment, IT consulting, and staff training) to hospitals. Facilities include Beijing Changhe Dayun Pediatric Clinic, Shanghai and Shenzhen pediatric rehabilitation outpatient centers, and Kunming Changhe Tiancheng Rehabilitation Hospital. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. LIH Healthcare publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK — this profile carries identity and domain-security data only.

providers.name: Lithos Carbon
providers.description: Lithos Carbon delivers permanent carbon dioxide removal through enhanced rock weathering on agricultural land. The company applies crushed basalt to farm fields, where it captures atmospheric CO2 while raising soil pH, replenishing nutrients (iron, magnesium, phosphorus, calcium), improving crop yields, and building resilience to drought and pests. Lithos uses machine-learning soil models to optimize basalt application rates and provides measurement, reporting, and verification of the resulting carbon removal, managing delivery, sampling, and installation end to end for farmers and carbon-credit buyers. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Livongo
providers.description: Livongo Health is a digital chronic-condition management platform for diabetes, hypertension, weight, and prehypertension prevention, pairing connected devices (blood-glucose meters, blood-pressure cuffs, connected scales) with a mobile app, real-time monitoring, and certified health coaching delivered at no cost through employers and health plans. Founded in 2008 and taken public in 2019, Livongo was acquired by Teladoc Health in 2020; the standalone www.livongo.com site now 301-redirects to teladochealth.com/livongo, where Livongo operates as a consumer-facing product line. It is a patient/member health product, not a developer platform: no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation surface exists. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Sapphire Ventures, and Threshold Ventures.

providers.name: LKQ Corporation
providers.description: LKQ Corporation is a Fortune 500 company and a leading provider of alternative and specialty parts to repair and accessorize automobiles and other vehicles, with operations across North America, Europe, and Taiwan. LKQ does not currently expose a public developer portal or REST API; this repository captures publicly available company and partner-program references.

providers.name: longwill
providers.description: Longwill (Zhejiang Kangjiu Health Technology Group, 浙江康久康养科技集团有限公司) is a Chinese digital elderly-care and community-health group building what it calls a "China digital elder-care ecosystem" (数字康养). Operating from Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou, it runs 40-plus medical and senior-care institutions across Zhejiang (Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Ningbo, Quzhou, Jinhua, Zhoushan), Chengdu (Sichuan) and Shizuishan (Ningxia), organized around a "five-in-one" care model spanning a digital care cloud, CCRC senior-living complexes, institutional medical-and-elder care, community care and home care. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass Longwill publishes a corporate marketing website (www.longwill.com.cn) but exposes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Lonza
providers.description: Lonza Group is a Swiss multinational contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) serving the pharmaceutical, biotech, and nutrition industries. Headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, Lonza develops and manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), biologics, cell and gene therapies, and drug products for customers worldwide. Note: within Lonza's domain, "API" refers to Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (a chemical/biologic substance), not a software/web API. Lonza publishes no public developer portal, REST/GraphQL API, OpenAPI specification, or machine-readable API surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent lead and enriched; the honest result of the enrichment pass is that Lonza has no software API surface to catalog. The only machine-derived artifact is a domain-security probe of lonza.com.

providers.name: Loyalfordogs
providers.description: Loyal (Cellular Longevity, Inc., loyalfordogs.com redirects to loyal.com) is a San Francisco biotech developing longevity drugs for dogs that target the underlying processes of aging to extend healthy lifespan in senior dogs. Its lead candidate, LOY-002, targets metabolic dysfunction in dogs aged ten and older and is progressing through FDA approval. The company serves veterinary professionals and dog owners with clinical and care resources and runs clinical trials; it publishes no developer API, documentation, SDKs, or public code repositories. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: LucidAct
providers.description: LucidAct (Lucidact Health) is an AI-powered care management platform operating in the healthcare technology and digital health vertical. The company builds software that streamlines patient care coordination and clinical workflows, using artificial intelligence to automate administrative tasks, support clinical decision-making, and improve patient engagement and population-health outcomes for healthcare organizations. LucidAct was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface could be found — the marketing site (www.lucidact.com) returns 403 on developer and well-known paths — so this profile currently carries only the provider's probed domain security posture alongside its identity.

providers.name: Lucira Health
providers.description: Lucira Health (formerly Diassess Inc.) was a molecular diagnostics company based in Emeryville, California that developed single-use, disposable RT-LAMP test kits designed for at-home use. Its Lucira COVID-19 All-In-One Test Kit received the first FDA Emergency Use Authorization for an over-the-counter at-home molecular COVID-19 test, and the company later introduced the first at-home combination COVID-19 and influenza (flu) test. Lucira Health filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in February 2023 and its assets were subsequently acquired by Pfizer. The company is a consumer medical-device and diagnostics business; it published no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record; the legacy lucirahealth.com domain is now managed under Pfizer's email/DNS infrastructure and no longer serves a working web presence.

providers.name: Lumere
providers.description: Lumere was a Chicago-based healthcare technology company providing evidence-based analytics on medical devices, drugs, and clinical supplies to help hospitals and health systems reduce cost and variation in supply and utilization decisions. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Lumere was acquired by GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) in 2019 and its capabilities now ship as part of the GHX Clinical Integration / Value Analysis product line; lumere.com redirects to ghx.com. No independent Lumere developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface exists — this profile is retained as a network lead.

providers.name: M&T Bank
providers.description: M&T Bank is a regional bank holding company that provides commercial and retail banking services to consumers and businesses across the eastern United States. As of the latest review, M&T Bank does not publish a public developer portal or open banking API; integrations are arranged through Treasury Management and commercial banking relationships.

providers.name: Magna
providers.description: Magna is a direct-to-consumer beverage brand (drinkmagna.com) making a magnesium-based electrolyte hydration drink mix. The product pairs a triple-magnesium formulation (malate, gluconate, glycinate) with electrolytes and is marketed to athletes and fitness enthusiasts for hydration, energy, and recovery. Backed by Forerunner Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector company profile. The brand operates as a retail/e-commerce storefront and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Mango Medical Inc
providers.description: Mango Medical Inc is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of y-combinator and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Mantis
