providers.description: Mantis (Mantis Biotech) builds predictive digital twins of individual people, aggregating personal data streams — wearables, digital activity, and clinical records — into high-fidelity models by combining large language models with physics-based simulation. The company positions itself as a neutral intermediary for personal predictive models — an "OAuth for identity" or "Plaid for banking" layer — letting individuals grant scoped, revocable access to their twin to healthcare providers and third-party builders. Applications include pre-symptomatic infection detection, cognitive baseline monitoring, heart-failure decompensation forecasting, medication-adherence prediction, post-operative recovery trajectories, psychiatric relapse early warning, and running trials on twins. Mantis is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company; as of this profile it publishes a marketing site and manifesto but no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Manulife Bank
providers.description: Manulife Bank of Canada is a Schedule I federally chartered bank and a wholly-owned subsidiary of The Manufacturers Life Insurance Company, part of Manulife Financial Corporation. Launched in 1993 as Canada's first branchless (direct) bank — and the first federally regulated bank opened by an insurance company in Canada — it operates entirely through online banking, a mobile app, and telephone banking, with no physical branches. It is best known for the Manulife One all-in-one account, the Advantage Account, GICs, mortgages, and lines of credit that connect everyday banking and borrowing with long-term financial planning. Manulife Bank publishes no first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specifications; no developer.manulifebank.ca host resolves, and the public site is bot-protected. Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking (open-banking) framework — legislated in Budget 2024 and the Fall Economic Statement 2024, with the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada (FCAC) as overseer — is legislated but not yet operational, so consumer financial data access today is voluntary and occurs through financial-data aggregators (Plaid, Flinks, MX) rather than a first-party bank API. Interac e-Transfer is offered as a consumer feature but is not exposed as a documented public API.

providers.name: Maple VC
providers.description: Maple VC is an early-stage ("believing first") venture capital firm that writes first checks into founders at the seed stage, before their companies achieve mainstream recognition. The firm invests globally across four operator communities — San Francisco, Canada, Cambridge, and Korea — and is run by operators drawn from early teams at Uber, DigitalOcean, and Shopify. Notable portfolio companies include Clay, Neo Financial, AutoLeap, Playbook, BenchIQ, Finny, and Blacklake. Maple VC is a venture capital firm and does not operate a developer platform, public API, or API documentation.

providers.name: Maqsad
providers.description: Maqsad is Pakistan's leading online entry-test preparation platform, helping students prepare for standardized university entrance exams including MDCAT, ECAT, BCAT and O-Level. The platform delivers daily live classes, recorded video lectures, 15,000+ practice MCQs per exam, weekly mock tests, real-time doubt-solving and academic counseling through student-facing mobile apps and web access. Founded in 2021 and backed by Speedinvest, Maqsad reports 4M+ downloads and tens of thousands of enrolled students placed into universities such as NUST, IBA and DUHS. It operates as a business-to-consumer education company and does not currently publish a developer API, documentation or developer portal.

providers.name: Maribel Health
providers.description: Maribel Health provides AI-native operational intelligence for healthcare organizations delivering out-of-facility care, including home health, hospice, hospital-at-home, and community paramedicine programs. Its platform acts as a real-time operational layer that connects clinical workflows, patient records, and financial systems to help provider organizations monitor, coordinate, and control care delivery across settings. Maribel Health is backed by General Catalyst. As of this enrichment pass, no public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface was found on the company's website.

providers.name: Marinus Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Marinus Pharmaceuticals is a pharmaceutical company known for developing ganaxolone (brand name ZTALMY), a neuroactive steroid and GABA-A receptor modulator approved for the treatment of seizures associated with CDKL5 deficiency disorder (CDD). The company operated in the rare-disease and epilepsy space of the life-sciences industry. As of 2026 its corporate domain (marinuspharma.com) redirects to Immedica Pharma (immedicaus.com), reflecting the acquisition of Marinus and its ganaxolone franchise. Marinus was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. As a clinical- and commercial-stage pharmaceutical company it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; this profile therefore captures corporate identity and domain security signals only.

providers.name: Martin Marietta Materials
providers.description: Martin Marietta Materials is a leading supplier of building materials, including aggregates, cement, ready-mixed concrete, asphalt, and paving products, used in construction, infrastructure, and residential projects across the United States.

providers.name: Massive Science
providers.description: Massive Science is a science communication platform and media company that publishes stories, explainers, lab notes, and reports about current research, written and edited by working scientists. It runs the Massive Science Consortium, a training network of scientist-writers, alongside editorial content, newsletters, a community discussion forum, and a shop. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment finds no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface beyond a public RSS feed.

providers.name: Matchstick Ventures
providers.description: Matchstick Ventures is an early-stage venture capital fund investing across the North and Rockies (the Upper Midwest and Mountain West). The firm backs seed and pre-seed founders where innovative ideas, large markets, and diverse "underdog" founders intersect, describing itself as a catalyst for its founders, partners, and regional startup communities. Its portfolio spans consumer, commerce, developer, and B2B software companies including Soona, StackHawk, Spekit, Branch, Inspectorio, Airspace Link, Fiveable, Parallax, River, Tilt, Base, Ordermark, and Upsie.

providers.name: Maze Therapeutics
providers.description: Maze Therapeutics is a clinical-stage precision medicine company developing small-molecule and other treatments for common diseases with significant unmet medical need, with a focus on kidney disease. Its Compass platform pairs human genetics with variant functionalization to connect specific genetic drivers to disease biology and design targeted medicines, including programs for APOL1-mediated kidney disease and SLC6A19-related conditions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and gv, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; enrichment confirmed it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or discovery surface.

providers.name: MBX Biosciences
providers.description: MBX Biosciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel precision peptide therapies for people living with endocrine and metabolic disorders. Its proprietary Precision Endocrine Peptide (PEP) platform engineers long-acting peptide prodrugs, and its pipeline includes canvuparatide (MBX 2109) for chronic hypoparathyroidism, MBX 4291 for obesity, and MBX 5765 for post-bariatric hypoglycemia. The company is publicly traded on Nasdaq under the ticker MBX. As a clinical-stage biotech it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation surface; this profile is maintained for network completeness.

providers.name: Medico.com
providers.description: Medico.com was a Spanish-language online health portal and question-and-answer community, offering health reference articles, health news, and topic-focused Q&A around conditions such as diabetes, heart disease, and depression, initially targeting Hispanic markets. Backed by 500 Global, FJ Labs, First Round Capital, and FirstMark Capital, it was acquired by Everyday Health. The medico.com domain now 301-redirects to everydayhealth.com and exposes no independent developer portal, API, or documentation. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead; enrichment found no live API surface.

providers.name: medmotion
providers.description: MedMotion (复动肌骨 / 复动医疗, Shanghai Fudong Medical Management Co.) is a China-based musculoskeletal medical company founded in 2018 in Shanghai, building an integrated orthopedic, rehabilitation, orthotics, and physical-conditioning care model for conservative treatment and pre-/post-surgical recovery of sports and skeletal injuries. It operates three product lines: offline musculoskeletal rehabilitation medical centers, the PhysioCloud cloud service platform, and the NMPA-approved TELEREHAB (悦行) musculoskeletal digital-therapeutics device. It is backed by Qiming Venture Partners (Pre-A lead), TF Capital, and SunMed Capital. As of this enrichment pass MedMotion publishes a patient/clinic-facing marketing site and app backend but no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal, so no API artifacts were harvested.

providers.name: MedSci
providers.description: MedSci (梅斯医学 / MedSci Healthcare Holdings Limited, HKEX 2415) is a leading online professional physician platform in China, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Shanghai. It connects roughly 2.9 million registered physician users with pharmaceutical and medical device companies through big data and AI, offering physician platform solutions (medical knowledge, clinical study assistance), precision omni-channel marketing, real-world study (RWS) solutions, and the MedSci xAI medical AI agent. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public third-party developer API program, OpenAPI/SDK, or developer portal was found; the primary web host is geo-restricted and unreachable for HTTP probing.

providers.name: medxtmc
providers.description: MEDx Translational Medicine Co., Ltd (MEDx TMC) is a Suzhou, China based precision medicine company founded in 2013, formerly QIAGEN (Suzhou) Translational Medicine. It is a leading provider of companion diagnostics (CDx) and total precision-medicine solutions, offering pharma services (biomarker discovery, target validation, patient stratification, IVD/CDx R&D and commercialization), clinical testing panels for solid tumors, blood cancers and infectious diseases, and diagnostic products built on IHC, PCR and NGS platforms. MEDx has collaborated with 400+ pharmaceutical and technology partners and holds ISO 13485, ISO 17025, CAP and CNAS accreditations. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. MEDx TMC publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: MetaStable Capital
providers.description: MetaStable Capital is one of the oldest cryptocurrency hedge funds, co-founded in 2014 by Naval Ravikant and among the longest-running funds in crypto history, with early investments in major networks and protocols including Ethereum, Avalanche, Cosmos, and Starkware. The firm was acquired by crypto investment fund Dragonfly and now operates as a Dragonfly entity alongside Dragonfly Ventures and Dragonfly Liquid; its former domain metastablecapital.com redirects to dragonfly.xyz. As an investment/fund manager it exposes no public developer or API surface, so this API Evangelist profile carries identity and network metadata rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: MetLife
providers.description: MetLife is a Fortune 500 insurance and financial services company offering life, auto, home, dental, vision, and other employee benefits. This entry captures publicly available APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts for MetLife.

providers.name: Metsera *
providers.description: Metsera is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing injectable and oral therapies for obesity and metabolic diseases, backed by GV and the SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this enrichment pass its corporate domain (metsera.com) issues a 301 redirect to pfizer.com, consistent with Metsera's acquisition by Pfizer. As a life-sciences drug-development company it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or other machine-readable developer surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio record rather than an API producer.

providers.name: MightyFly
providers.description: MightyFly is an autonomous air-logistics company building hybrid-electric eVTOL cargo aircraft for expedited, long-range, same-day deliveries. Its autonomous aircraft carry up to 500 pounds, travel up to 1,000 miles at roughly 150 MPH, and cut delivery emissions by around 64% versus traditional ground and air freight. MightyFly targets B2B logistics and defense delivery partnerships rather than offering a public developer platform. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, developer portal, or public specifications; this profile captures its public web presence and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Mindstate Design Labs
providers.description: Mindstate Design Labs is a clinical-stage AI neuroengineering platform and drug development company addressing the mental health crisis. Its Osmanthus discovery platform maps the biological basis of emotion, perception, and cognition by analyzing psychoactive drug effects and biochemical data to understand how neurotransmitter combinations produce different emotional and cognitive states, driving a pipeline of novel mental-health therapeutics. Backed by Initialized Capital. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes an informational corporate site only and exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, or specification surface.

providers.name: Minute Media
providers.description: Minute Media is a global technology, media, and advertising company that builds and operates digital sports and entertainment content brands while licensing publishing and monetization technology to third parties. Its owned-and-operated properties include Sports Illustrated, The Players' Tribune, 90min, Mental Floss, FanSided, The Big Lead, and DBLTAP, reaching a reported 200+ million monthly users. On the technology side it offers the STN Online Video Platform (OVP) for video publishing and monetization, a Minute Media SSP for programmatic advertising, and ad-management solutions for publishers. Minute Media was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API definitions on its primary web properties.

providers.name: MITO Material Solutions
providers.description: MITO Material Solutions (MITO Materials) is a specialty chemical company that develops patented hybrid additive technology to strengthen composite and thermoplastic materials. Its platform functionalizes graphene and biomaterials to improve strength, durability, flexibility, and sustainability without requiring changes to a manufacturer's existing process. Core products include the MITO hybrid additive platform, MITO E-GO, MITO E-GO Res-1, and MITO ACRE, serving the sports and recreation, transportation, automotive, and infrastructure industries. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass, MITO publishes no developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: MNT-Halan
providers.description: MNT-Halan is a Cairo, Egypt-headquartered fintech holding company and Egypt's first private fintech unicorn, founded in 2017 by Mounir Nakhla (CEO) and Ahmed Mohsen (CTO). MNT-Halan operates a financial super app ("Halan") and a vertically integrated digital ecosystem covering micro-finance and SME lending, consumer credit, e-payments and money transfers, an e-wallet, prepaid and installment cards, payroll advances, investment and gold-installment products, and e-commerce (electronics, appliances, FMCG, e-grocer). Lending products span nano loans up to EGP 2,000, microloans, consumer loans up to EGP 500,000 over 36 installments, SME loans from EGP 200,000 up to EGP 15 million, education and home financing up to EGP 4 million, light-vehicle financing, and buy-now-pay-later. The Halan app and its supporting agent network reportedly serve 5–7 million customers, have disbursed in excess of USD 4 billion in loans across 3 million borrowers, and process 100+ million USD in monthly payments and 50+ million USD in monthly e-commerce sales. After raising USD 400 million in 2023 to cross unicorn status and an additional USD 157.5 million in 2024 (including an IFC investment), MNT-Halan expanded beyond Egypt into Turkey (via the August 2024 acquisition of Tam Finans), the UAE (December 2024 launch), and Pakistan. MNT-Halan's revenue model is interest and fees on lending, merchant and payment fees, e-commerce gross margin, and card interchange; the company markets directly to consumers and SMEs through its Halan app and physical outlets, and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, partner sandbox, or open-source code repository.

providers.name: Mobileye
providers.description: Mobileye is an Israel-headquartered ADAS and autonomous-driving technology company, majority-owned by Intel and publicly traded on NASDAQ as MBLY. Its flagship platform is the EyeQ family of purpose-built automotive systems-on-chip (EyeQ4, EyeQ5, EyeQ6L, EyeQ6H, EyeQ Ultra), shipped in over 175 million vehicles worldwide through partnerships with most major OEMs. Mobileye's solution portfolio spans entry-level ADAS, Mobileye SuperVision (eyes-on, hands-off highway and urban driving), Mobileye Chauffeur (eyes-off conditional autonomy), and Mobileye Drive (Level 4 full autonomy in robotaxi and goods-delivery applications). The company pioneered Responsibility- Sensitive Safety (RSS), a mathematical framework for AV decision safety contributed to IEEE standards work, and operates Road Experience Management (REM), a crowdsourced HD-mapping system that harvests anonymized road data from millions of consumer vehicles to build and update the Mobileye Roadbook. Mobileye does not publish a traditional public developer API; OEM and integration relationships are private B2B engagements.

providers.name: Modular Monolith
providers.description: An architectural pattern that structures a monolithic application into loosely coupled, well-defined modules with clear boundaries and dependencies, combining the operational simplicity of a monolith with the organizational benefits of modular design. Organizations adopt it to address specific technical or business challenges in their environments.

providers.name: Modulo
providers.description: Modulo Bio is a San Diego, California biotechnology company reprogramming the neuroimmune system to overcome the world's toughest neurological diseases. The company develops therapeutics that target microglia, the brain's resident immune cells, by combining stem cell engineering, neurobiology, multiomics (CRISPR and single-cell techniques), and machine learning to understand and manipulate microglial behavior, identify biomarkers, and discover new drug candidates. Modulo Bio is a therapeutics research company and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or technical documentation; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Mogassam
providers.description: Mogassam is a digital dentistry company building all-in-one dental 3D printing hardware and software for chairside, single-visit treatment. Its products include the DentCase automated all-in-one 3D printer with integrated CAM, automatic washing, and post-curing, the Microdent 1 Pro printer, and the DentPrint dental 3D printing software, used to produce dentures, dental models, surgical guides, and provisional and permanent restorations. The company was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, SDK, or developer documentation was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Momentus
providers.description: Momentus is a U.S.-based commercial space company providing in-space transportation and infrastructure services. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Jose, California, the publicly traded company (NASDAQ: MNTS) designs, manufactures, and operates Orbital Service Vehicles such as its Vigoride platform, using water plasma propulsion technology to move satellites and payloads between orbits, host payloads, and deliver last-mile satellite deployment. Momentus serves private satellite operators, government agencies, and research institutions. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or technical integration surface; it was surfaced as a Y Combinator (S18) portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Monak E-Services
providers.description: Monak E-Services (Monak) is a fintech and lifestyle super-app serving working expats, travelers, and locals across the Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Oman). The consumer app bundles banking (local accounts, debit cards, remittance, and forex), health (medical visa, pharmacy, and insurance), and daily essentials (groceries, food, taxi, bill payments, and mobile/TV recharge), while a B2B side offers recruiters workforce onboarding and tracking software plus flight bookings, PRO services, and airport transfers. A 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Monogramhealth
providers.description: Monogram Health is a value-based, in-home specialty care provider for people living with chronic kidney disease, end-stage renal disease, and other complex chronic conditions. Multidisciplinary teams of physicians, nurse practitioners, nurses, dietitians, pharmacists, and social workers deliver coordinated care in patients' homes with 24/7 access, addressing both medical needs and social determinants of health to reduce hospitalizations and emergency visits. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, the company partners with health plans (payer partners) and provider groups and serves over 200,000 patients annually. This is a healthcare services company with no public developer, API, or platform surface; the enrichment pass probed domain security and found no API.

providers.name: Monolith AI
providers.description: Monolith AI develops artificial-intelligence software for engineering product development, helping R&D and test-lab teams validate physical products faster. Its cloud SaaS platform pairs a notebook-style workspace with proprietary self-learning models built for engineers: a Test Data Validation module whose anomaly detector flags errors across hundreds of data channels, a Test Plan Optimisation module whose next-test recommender can cut test plans by up to 70%, and a System Calibration module that tunes performance across operating conditions. It serves battery, automotive, aerospace and defense, and industrial and medical engineering teams. Monolith AI is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. No public developer API, portal, or SDKs are published at this time.

providers.name: Morph Systems
providers.description: Morph Systems is a Palo Alto, California based artificial intelligence consultancy that accelerates enterprise adoption of Palantir Foundry and AIP by building LLM-powered operating systems on top of an organization's data and ontology. Founded by forward-deployed engineers who began by supporting military aviation with an LLM-based kneeboard system that generates mission briefs from integrated airport and flight data, the company now delivers AI-driven operating systems for trading firms, LLM-powered supply-chain visibility for large-scale factory construction, and patient-experience and operations solutions built on the Palantir platform. Morph Systems is an early-stage, venture-backed team (backed by 500 Global, Seoul National University, Mashup Ventures, Orange Planet Foundation, and the Tech Incubator Program for Startup / TIPS) that operates as a services and solutions provider rather than a public API platform; it does not currently publish a developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or a public API surface.

providers.name: Mosanna
providers.description: Mosanna Therapeutics is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company developing a nighttime nasal spray therapy for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). Headquartered in Redwood City, California with an office in Basel, Switzerland, the company is pursuing a pharmacological alternative to mechanical CPAP devices by reactivating the upper-airway muscles that keep the airway open during sleep. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners, Mosanna operates a corporate marketing website and publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Mountain America Credit Union
providers.description: Mountain America Credit Union (MACU) is a federally chartered, member-owned not-for-profit financial cooperative headquartered in Sandy, Utah, founded in 1936 and regulated and insured by the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA). It is one of the largest credit unions in the United States, with roughly $21.9 billion in assets, more than 1.4 million members, and over 100 branches serving Utah, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, and Arizona, offering consumer and business checking, savings, mortgages, auto loans, credit cards, and wealth services. Like the vast majority of US credit unions, Mountain America exposes no public first-party developer API or developer portal: there is no developer.macu.com or api.macu.com host, and every path under macu.com returns the same client-rendered application shell. Consumer-permissioned data access is intermediated through its core banking provider and data aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) rather than a directly published API. US open finance is voluntary and fragmented, and no public FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is documented for this institution at the time of review.

providers.name: Movel AI
providers.description: Movel AI is a Singapore-based robotics deployment software company, founded in 2016, that makes it faster and cheaper to get autonomous mobile robots up and running in real-world environments. Its platform pairs deep learning, sensor fusion, and probabilistic planning so robots can perceive their surroundings and plan tasks on their own. Core products are the Movel Fleet Management System (FMS) for real-time monitoring and control of multi-robot fleets and Movel RNS (Robotic Navigation System) for precise single-robot navigation of complex spaces, applied across logistics, manufacturing, construction, and healthcare. The company is backed by Silicon Solution Ventures, 500 Global, AviTech, SGInnovate, Seeds Capital, and Enterprise Singapore. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Movel AI publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: My China Roots
providers.description: My China Roots is a Chinese heritage genealogy platform that helps people of Chinese descent trace their ancestry, find records of their ancestors, connect with long-lost relatives, and organize roots trips to China. The platform offers a searchable database of roughly 200 million ancestors drawn from digitized clan books (zupu), overseas immigration records, tombstones, obituaries, and clan association member lists, alongside family-tree building and a Library Edition for institutions. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company exposes a consumer web application only, with no discoverable public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Mycotech
providers.description: MYCL (Mycotech Lab) is an Indonesian biomaterials company, founded in 2015 and based in Bandung, that cultivates mushroom mycelium on agricultural waste to produce sustainable, carbon-sequestering alternatives to animal leather, plastics, and construction materials. Its flagship product is Mylea, a mycelium-based leather-like material, alongside Biobo binder board, MYCL Composite for architecture and interior design, and Mylea Sea, a seaweed-based biopolymer. A certified B Corp and Good Design Award winner backed by 500 Global and the Unreasonable Group, MYCL sells physical materials and finished goods rather than software; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: MyHealthTeam
providers.description: MyHealthTeam operates condition-specific patient social networks that connect roughly 4 million members across 80+ chronic-condition communities (from multiple sclerosis and rheumatoid arthritis to autism and cancer) with peer support, practical advice, and trusted health information to help them better manage life with a chronic condition. It is a consumer-facing web and mobile platform rather than a developer-oriented API provider; as of January 2025 MyHealthTeam is a Swoop company. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. Enrichment found no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface on myhealthteam.com — only the consumer marketing site (which now redirects its blog to swoop.com), so this entry carries identity and domain-security signal only.

providers.name: Mythic
providers.description: Mythic is a high-performance analog computing company building Analog Processing Units (APUs) for energy-efficient AI inference. Its compute-in-memory architecture stores AI model parameters directly in the processor to eliminate the memory bottleneck of traditional digital designs, targeting data center, automotive, robotics, edge, and defense workloads with claims of dramatically lower energy use and cost versus GPUs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and Threshold Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Mythic publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Nabhdrishti Aerospace
providers.description: Nabhdrishti Aerospace is a Bangalore-based deep-tech startup building India's first fuel-flex micro gas turbine for aviation and power generation. Its ND 400 engine is a 400 N single-core micro gas turbine designed for UAVs, hybrid-electric aircraft, and small aircraft as well as oil & gas, manufacturing, and vehicle range-extender power generation, running on conventional fuels, biofuels, and hydrogen with an innovative recuperator design that targets greater than 15% efficiency at under half the cost of competing turbines. Backed by Accel, the company raised USD 3M and operates from the IISc Bangalore IHUB. As a hardware manufacturer it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform; this profile tracks its public web presence.

providers.name: navabi
providers.description: navabi is an online retailer specializing in plus-size designer fashion for women, founded and headquartered in Aachen, Germany. As of July 2026 only the Canadian storefront (navabi.ca) is live: navabi.com now redirects to an unrelated parked domain (gitinama.site) and navabi.de returns a maintenance page, indicating the brand has largely wound down its international operations. The shop curates dresses, tops, jackets, jeans, coats, swimwear and accessories from luxury and contemporary labels such as Anna Scholz, Basler, Bogner, Lacoste, Roberto Cavalli and Zizzi, alongside styling advice, a fashion magazine and an affiliate program. navabi was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It is a consumer e-commerce brand with no public developer portal, API, well-known discovery surface, or published security program; enrichment probes captured only its web/domain security posture (navabi.ca).

providers.name: NEO Success
providers.description: NEO Success (operating as NEO Money) was a Bangkok, Thailand personal-finance and money-management fintech founded in 2019 by Punnamas Vichitkulwongsa and backed by 500 Global. It built a consumer platform aimed at helping users reach financial freedom and manage their money. As of this enrichment pass the company is out of business (per PitchBook) and its domain neomoney.com resolves to a parked domain-for-sale page (Afternic/GoDaddy) — there is no live developer portal, documentation, or public API surface to enrich. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

providers.name: Neoplants
providers.description: Neoplants is a French climate-biotechnology company building genetically and microbially engineered houseplants that capture and metabolize indoor air pollutants. Its consumer product line pairs bioengineered pothos plants with an enhanced root microbiome ("Power Drops") to remove volatile organic compounds such as formaldehyde, benzene, toluene and xylene from indoor air. Backed by Partech and other climate investors, Neoplants operates as a direct-to-consumer brand rather than an API provider. This API Evangelist profile was created from a venture-portfolio lead; an enrichment pass confirmed the company publishes no developer API, OpenAPI, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: NeoTract
providers.description: NeoTract was a privately-held medical device company founded in 2004 that developed and commercialized the FDA-cleared UroLift System, a minimally invasive transurethral treatment for lower urinary tract symptoms caused by benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). Teleflex Incorporated acquired NeoTract for up to $1.1 billion in October 2017; the UroLift product line now lives under Teleflex at urolift.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of NEA. This is a physical medical-device business with no public developer, API, or SDK surface; the neotract.com domain no longer resolves.

providers.name: Netwerken
providers.description: Netwerken (Dutch for "networks") is an index entry covering the broad domain of computer networks, network management, and network connectivity services. This serves as a placeholder index for grouping APIs related to network management, monitoring, and infrastructure connectivity.

providers.name: Nia Health
providers.description: Nia Health GmbH is a Berlin-based digital health company and spin-off of Charité Universitätsmedizin Berlin that develops Nia, a mobile medical application supporting people living with atopic dermatitis (neurodermatitis) and other chronic skin conditions. Nia was the first atopic dermatitis app approved as a medical device, helping patients document flare-ups, identify triggers such as stress or fragrances, and manage their therapy day to day. The company builds a patient-engagement platform that turns real-world behavioral and symptom data into insights for patients, physicians, and research partners including pharmaceutical companies such as Sanofi. Nia Health is a consumer- and clinician-facing mobile product; it exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Version One Ventures and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Nilo Therapeutics
providers.description: Nilo Therapeutics is a New York-based, preclinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering a differentiated approach to immunomodulation by targeting the neural circuits that regulate systemic inflammation. Building on seminal discoveries from the laboratories of Charles Zuker (Columbia University / HHMI), Ruslan Medzhitov (Yale), and Stephen Liberles (Harvard) that identified vagal neurons regulating systemic immune activation, and led by CEO Kim Seth, the company harnesses the body-brain axis to restore immune homeostasis centrally, moving beyond conventional immunosuppression to treat autoimmune and inflammatory disease. Nilo launched in 2025 with a $101M Series A co-led by DCVC Bio, Lux Capital, and The Column Group, with participation from Alexandria Venture Investments and the Gates Foundation. As a therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface.

providers.name: Nimbus Therapeutics
providers.description: Nimbus Therapeutics is a Boston-based biotechnology company, founded in 2009, that designs and develops small molecule medicines with exquisite selectivity across oncology, immunology, and metabolic indications. Its approach integrates structure-based and computational drug design (including cloud-based molecular simulation) with target selection, translational medicine, and clinical development. Nimbus is a private, VC-backed drug-discovery company and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Nocion Therapeutics
providers.description: Nocion Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company discovering and developing a novel class of biologically selective charged sodium channel (NaV) blockers designed to selectively silence overactive sensory neurons to relieve chronic cough, pain, itch, and inflammation. Its lead candidate, inhaled taplucainium, is a first-in-class therapy in a Phase 2b (ASPIRE) trial for refractory and unexplained chronic cough, with topline results expected in 2026. Founded on foundational intellectual property licensed from Harvard University and Boston Children's Hospital and backed by Canaan Partners, F-Prime Capital, and other life-sciences investors, Nocion is a therapeutics R&D company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Noodle Labs
providers.description: Noodle Labs is an operational consulting firm founded by Jennifer Dennard and Jean Hsu that embeds experienced startup operators with early-stage teams to extend their leadership. Positioned as "operators, not advisors," the firm offers Strategic Operations and Engineering Leadership engagements that give founders senior leadership impact without the overhead of a full-time VP hire. It is a services business rather than a software or API provider; no developer portal, SDK, API, or technical documentation is published. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network; the enrichment pass confirmed no API surface exists.

providers.name: NorthOne
providers.description: NorthOne was a mobile-first, API-enabled business banking platform for small businesses, freelancers, and startups, founded in 2016 by Eytan Bensoussan and Justin Adler with banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. It offered the Connected Bank Account (a digital business checking account) with envelope budgeting, savings goals, bookkeeping and accounting integrations, cash deposits, and small-business lending, serving 320,000+ businesses and backed by Battery Ventures, Redpoint Ventures, and Tencent. As of 2026 the northone.com domain redirects to Relay (relayfi.com); NorthOne publishes no public developer API, developer portal, documentation, or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Noteable
providers.description: Noteable was a collaborative, cloud-based data notebook platform that combined code (SQL, Python, and R), natural language, and interactive no-code visualizations so data teams could explore, visualize, and act on data together in a single browser-based workspace. It offered real-time collaboration and commenting down to individual data points, scheduled/automated notebook runs, and connectors to databases and warehouses including Trino, Snowflake, CockroachDB, PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, and Databricks. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Wing Venture Capital. Noteable was acquired by Confluent on December 1, 2023, and the platform, operations, and services were terminated effective immediately, with users given until January 5, 2024 to export their data. As of this enrichment pass the noteable.io domain no longer serves the product and redirects to an Afternic domain-for-sale parking page; app.noteable.io, docs.noteable.io, and api.noteable.io are offline. There is no live public API surface to enrich.

providers.name: novoprotein
providers.description: Novoprotein (Suzhou Novoprotein Scientific / 苏州近岸蛋白质科技股份有限公司) is a Chinese biotechnology company specializing in recombinant protein preparation and related life-science reagents and contract research services. Its catalog spans mRNA vaccine raw materials, cytokines and growth factors, Matrigel and culture media, reference and bispecific antibodies, cell lines, target proteins, and viral research products serving drug discovery, cell therapy, and diagnostics customers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a B2B reagent supplier it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Novotech
providers.description: Novotech is a global full-service Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotech and pharmaceutical companies across every phase of clinical drug development. Its services span clinical operations and project management, patient recruitment and site selection, early-phase trials (notably in Australia), regulatory and medical consulting, biometrics and data management, site management organization (SMO), and laboratory services. Novotech reports 4,450+ trials conducted across 7,260+ trial sites in 50+ countries, supporting 60+ drugs to market. Added to the API Evangelist network as a healthcare portfolio company of Hongshan; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical integration surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Nuro
providers.description: Nuro is a Mountain View-based autonomy company that has pivoted from its original autonomous-goods-delivery vehicle program (R1, R2, R3) to a licensable, vehicle-agnostic autonomous driving stack. The Nuro Driver is an AI-first Level 4 self-driving system, validated through 5+ years of driverless deployments and more than 1.7 million autonomous miles with zero at-fault incidents, paired with the Nuro Toolkit suite of supporting technology. Partners and customers include Uber and Lucid (premium robotaxi program with production-intent vehicles announced for CES 2026), Mercedes- Benz, Toyota, Kroger, Domino's, and Walmart, with NVIDIA participation in recent funding rounds. Nuro has offices in Mountain View, San Francisco, Santa Clara, Las Vegas, Houston, Toronto, Washington DC, Shenzhen, Tokyo, and an upcoming Munich expansion. Nuro does not publish a public developer API; the Driver and Toolkit are commercialized through B2B licensing rather than a self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Nurx
providers.description: Nurx is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of union-square-ventures, y-combinator and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: health. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: NVision Imaging Technologies
providers.description: NVision Imaging Technologies (now operating as NVision Quantum Technologies) is a deep-tech healthcare company that engineers quantum technology at the molecular level. Its flagship POLARIS platform delivers quantum-enhanced MRI, boosting the magnetic signal of engineered sugar molecules by over 10,000x to image disease metabolism in real time, and its PIQC platform is a quantum-computing architecture built on molecular quantum nodes native to photonic chips. The company is backed by Playground Global. It publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface; this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Nym Health
providers.description: Nym Health provides autonomous medical coding for health systems and physician groups. Its Clinical Language Understanding (CLU) engine reads patient charts and assigns medical codes automatically with a transparent audit trail for every code, keeping current as coding guidelines change and supporting multispecialty environments. Nym is used by 30+ health systems including Ochsner Health, Inova, Henry Ford and Geisinger, and is backed by GV and Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass Nym publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; integrations are handled directly with health systems via sales/demo engagement.

providers.name: Oasis Health Partners
providers.description: Oasis Health Partners is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: life-sciences. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Oblenio Bio
providers.description: Oblenio Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing tri-specific antibody immunotherapies for refractory autoimmune diseases. Its lead candidate, LBL-051, is a tri-specific T-cell engager targeting BCMA, CD19, and CD3 to deplete B-cells and pursue long-term, drug-free remission and immune reset for patients. Founded with support from Aditum Bio and surfaced through the GV portfolio, Oblenio Bio operates in the life-sciences sector and does not currently publish a public developer or API program.

providers.name: OCRA
providers.description: OCRA (OATH Challenge-Response Algorithm) is a standard for generating one-time passwords based on challenge-response authentication as defined in RFC 6287. It extends HOTP and TOTP with challenge-response capabilities for stronger authentication scenarios.

providers.name: Odyssey Ai
providers.description: Odyssey is an AI research lab building general-purpose world models — causal, multimodal systems that understand and simulate physical environments, generating long-form interactive video simulations from text or image prompts rather than text. Its research includes Odyssey-2 (a flagship world model producing multi-minute interactive simulations), Starchild-1 (a real-time multimodal world model), Agora-1 (a multi-agent world simulator), and PROWL-1 (a reinforcement-learning framework for adversarial environment exploration). Odyssey positions world models as foundational AI for robotics, gaming, healthcare, education, and 3D visual asset generation, and raised a $310M Series B. The company is a portfolio company of DCVC. At the time of this profile Odyssey publishes research, writing, and interactive demos but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Ogilvy
providers.description: Ogilvy is a global advertising, marketing, and communications agency network founded by David Ogilvy in 1948 and headquartered in New York City. It is a WPP company (NASDAQ: WPPGY) operating across roughly 132 offices in 83 countries (per ogilvy.com/about; WPP cites 128 offices in 88 countries) with approximately 17,500 employees (per Wikipedia, as of 2022). The network positions itself around "Borderless Creativity," innovating at the intersections of five core capabilities: Advertising, Public Relations & Influence, Consulting, Relationship Design (OgilvyOne), and Health. Ogilvy was named Cannes Lions Network of the Year in 2022 and 2024, D&AD Network of the Year in 2020, and took Network of the Year at The One Show 2026. Long-standing client work includes Coca-Cola, Dove (Campaign for Real Beauty), IBM, American Express, IKEA, Hellmann's, Unilever, KFC, and Cadbury. Ogilvy does not publish a developer portal, public REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, status page, changelog, or pricing — its product is creative work delivered to brand clients, not software offered to developers. There is no `github.com/Ogilvy` organization. This repository indexes the public properties (homepage, capabilities, work, ideas/blog, parent company, regional sites, and notable sub-brands) so the API Evangelist network can track the absence of a developer surface and link Ogilvy to its parent WPP and to its practice-area brands (Ogilvy Health, OgilvyOne, Ogilvy PR, Ogilvy Consulting).

providers.name: Olema
providers.description: Olema Oncology is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Francisco with operations in Cambridge, Massachusetts, focused on developing targeted therapies for cancer. Founded in 2006, the company works in endocrine-driven cancers, nuclear receptors, and mechanisms of tumor drug resistance, with a stated goal of transforming the metastatic breast cancer treatment paradigm. Its investigational pipeline includes palazestrant (OP-1250), an oral complete estrogen receptor antagonist and selective estrogen receptor degrader advancing through the Phase 3 OPERA program, and OP-3136, a KAT6 inhibitor in Phase 1 clinical trials. Olema trades publicly on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker OLMA. As a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, Olema does not currently publish a developer-facing API, developer portal, SDKs, or public API documentation; this profile captures its corporate identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: OMsignal
providers.description: OMsignal was a Montreal-based biometric smart-apparel startup, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, that built compression shirts and the OMbra sports bra with embedded textile sensors streaming heart-rate, breathing, and activity data to a companion mobile app. The brand no longer operates independently: the omsignal.com domain now 301-redirects to hexoskin.com (Carre Technologies / Hexoskin), the biometric smart-clothing company that absorbed the product line. As of this enrichment pass OMsignal publishes no independent developer portal, API, or documentation of its own, and omsignal.com itself serves no API artifacts or well-known metadata.

providers.name: OnlineTyari
providers.description: OnlineTyari is one of India's largest online exam-preparation platforms, built by Next Door Learning Solutions Private Limited (Jaipur, Rajasthan) and acquired by Embibe in February 2020. Through its website and Android/iOS apps it helps students and job aspirants prepare for competitive government examinations such as SSC CGL, IBPS PO/Clerk, RRB, Railways NTPC, and various State PSC exams, offering mock tests, question banks, current-affairs updates, e-books, and study material in Hindi and English produced with independent tutors, coaching institutes, and subject authors. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass, OnlineTyari operates as a consumer-facing exam-prep product and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Opencare
providers.description: Opencare is a dental care marketplace that helps patients across the United States and Canada discover, review, and book appointments with vetted local dentists. The platform curates a network of dental providers, surfaces verified patient reviews, handles online booking and appointment reminders, and gives participating practices a patient-acquisition and practice-management channel. Opencare operates as a consumer-facing web platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or documentation surface. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 8vc.

providers.name: Oraliva
providers.description: OraLiva, Inc. is a dental diagnostics company developing an AI-powered oral cancer and dysplasia detection system for use during routine dental visits. Its ONC In-Cyt platform pairs a minimally-invasive brush biopsy with deep-learning cytology trained on more than 13 million cell images to score early malignancy risk. The company emerged from NIH-funded research at NYU by Dr. John T. McDevitt and is a portfolio company of DCVC. It is a medical-diagnostics (medtech/healthtech) company with no public developer, API, or technical surface at this time.

providers.name: Orapharma
providers.description: Orapharma is a specialty pharmaceutical company and a division of Bausch Health focused on oral healthcare, developing and commercializing products that help dental professionals improve and maintain periodontal and oral health. Its portfolio includes Arestin (minocycline HCl microspheres for the treatment of periodontitis) and the OSSIX bone-grafting and regeneration products. Headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey, Orapharma partners with dental professionals across the continuum of care. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API or portal at this time.

providers.name: Orbital Operations
providers.description: Orbital Operations is a space-defense technology company founded in 2024 and based in Huntington Beach, California, developing high-thrust, cryogenic-powered orbital vehicles for rapid-response satellite defense, interception, and in-orbit repositioning. Its flagship Astraeus vehicle uses liquid-hydrogen propulsion with a proprietary zero-boil-off (ZBO) cryogenic storage system enabling in-space refueling and efficient payload transport between LEO, MEO, GEO, and lunar orbits. Backed by Initialized Capital, the company builds spaceflight hardware and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Orca Bio
providers.description: Orca Bio is a late-stage biotechnology company developing high-precision allogeneic cell therapies for the treatment of cancer and autoimmune diseases. Its approach engineers purified cell populations, including regulatory T cells, to improve patient outcomes while reducing the risks associated with traditional allogeneic transplant. Its flagship product, TREGZI, is described as the first FDA-approved precision-engineered cell therapy for allogeneic transplant in adults with hematological malignancies. Orca Bio is backed by 8vc, DCVC and Lightspeed Venture Partners. The company publishes no public API or developer platform; this profile captures its identity within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Origin Bio
providers.description: Origin Bio is a cancer-biology research company that generates spatial, molecular, and functional maps from patient tumor samples to study cancer in its native tissue context. Its platform combines a spatial genomics pipeline that maps gene expression while preserving tissue architecture, tissue phenotyping that grounds molecular findings in histology and protein measurements, and functional response testing that runs ex vivo drug and perturbation experiments on precision-cut tumor slices. On top of this proprietary sequencing and spatial-transcriptomics data the company trains multimodal AI models for therapeutic target discovery, treatment-response prediction, and patient stratification. Origin Bio is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company. As of this profile the company publishes no public-facing API, developer documentation, or SDKs; this record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Orthocon
providers.description: Orthocon, now operating as Abyrx, is a surgical-therapeutics medical device company that has built a materials-science platform focused on therapeutic devices used during surgical procedures. Its portfolio centers on resorbable and hemostatic bone putties for orthopedic, trauma, spine, sports medicine, cranial, maxillofacial, and cardiothoracic applications, including AHBP (water-soluble hemostatic bone putty), the HemaSorb family (HemaSorb, HemaSorb Apply, HemaSorb Plus with HA/beta-TCP), and MONTAGE settable resorbable bone putty. The company sells directly to surgeons, hospitals, and distributors and does not operate a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or programmatic developer surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and enriched via the API Evangelist pipeline; the honest result is that there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Oscar Health
providers.description: Oscar Health is a technology-driven health insurance company offering individual, small group, and Medicare Advantage plans. It uses software, member-facing apps, and data to make health insurance simpler and more consumer friendly.

providers.name: Oula
providers.description: Oula is a modern maternity and women's healthcare provider offering collaborative pregnancy, gynecology, preconception, and miscarriage care across New York and Connecticut, with expansion into North Carolina. Its model pairs board-certified OBGYNs with expert midwives and care navigators to deliver compassionate, evidence-based, patient-centered care, and it accepts 30+ insurance plans. Oula reports over 3,000 babies delivered, c-section rates roughly 25% below the national average, and an 85% VBAC success rate. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc, Oula is a direct-to-consumer clinical care business with no public developer or API program; enrichment probing found no published OpenAPI, docs portal, or /.well-known discovery surface. An internal api.oulahealth.com host exists behind an AWS load balancer but publishes no public specification or documentation.

providers.name: Overture
providers.description: Overture (Overture Life) is a privately held life-sciences company backed by GV and Khosla Ventures, operating in the reproductive-health and fertility technology space. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile via the VC-portfolio pipeline. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-20 found no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or machine-readable developer surface; the profile is maintained here for network discovery and market context, with infrastructure signals captured from live domain probes.

providers.name: Owens-Illinois (O-I Glass)
providers.description: Owens-Illinois (now O-I Glass) is one of the world's leading manufacturers of glass containers, supplying glass packaging to the food, beverage, beer, wine, spirits, and pharmaceutical industries. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Oxygen
providers.description: Oxygen was a US fintech neobank founded in 2018 and a Y Combinator graduate, offering banking, debit-card, and financial products aimed at gig-economy workers, freelancers, small businesses, and entrepreneurs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, the company's consumer services are currently unavailable ("we are working on new and exciting initiatives") and no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface could be found during enrichment. This profile is retained as a company lead with a live web presence but no active API program.

providers.name: PaceMaker
providers.description: PaceMaker is the consumer DJ application from Pacemaker Music AB, a Swedish startup and 500 Global portfolio company, that lets anyone mix and mash millions of tracks on iPhone and iPad. It connects to streaming catalogs such as Spotify, includes an AI DJ that suggests matching tracks and beat-matched transitions, and lets users crop and blend songs at phrase, bar, and beat precision to record and share their own mixtapes. Pacemaker is a mobile end-user product; as of this pass it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal, and its domain (pacemaker.net) currently serves a WordPress marketing blog.

providers.name: Packaging Corporation of America
providers.description: Packaging Corporation of America (PCA) is the third largest producer of containerboard and corrugated packaging products in the United States, supplying packaging to food, beverage, and industrial customers. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Packaging Corporation of America
providers.description: Packaging Corporation of America (PCA) is the third largest producer of containerboard and corrugated packaging products in the United States, supplying packaging to food, beverage, and industrial customers. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Packworks
providers.description: Packworks is a Philippine business-to-business technology company empowering micro-entrepreneurs through connected commerce. Its Sari IQ platform gives sari-sari store owners and other micro-retailers an integrated mobile, web, and chat-based toolkit for inventory management, bookkeeping, sales analytics, credit (utang) tracking, deliveries and collections, loyalty programs, and financial literacy. Backed by Techstars, Packworks operates as an end-user SaaS platform for neighborhood retail and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, well-known discovery surface, or integration program.

providers.name: PACT Pharma
providers.description: PACT Pharma is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: life-sciences. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Pandorum Technologies
providers.description: Pandorum Technologies is a biotechnology company based in Bangalore, India, working in tissue engineering and regenerative medicine under the theme "building blocks of life." Its research and product pipeline spans a bioengineered cornea for corneal disorders, 3D human liver organoids ("mini liver") for drug discovery and disease modeling, and cell-free exosomal therapy for lung regeneration after trauma. The underlying platform combines bio-materials, cellular engineering (mesenchymal stem cell culture), exosome and nanotherapy, and bio-fabrication. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company; as a therapeutics and research organization it publishes no developer API, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Parasma
providers.description: Parasma is a San Francisco based biological compute startup building algorithms and hardware that train living human brain cells (cortical neurons on a chip) to perform computation for AI workloads. Founded in 2026 by Sean Cole and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026 batch), the company grew out of research that taught a clump of lab-grown human neurons to play Doom, coverage of which appeared in Nature, The Economist, Scientific American, The Guardian and elsewhere. Parasma currently operates as an early-stage research company with a marketing and news website; it does not yet publish a public API, SDK, developer portal, or other machine-readable developer surface. This profile is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company lead so any future developer platform can be captured when it ships.

providers.name: Parima
providers.description: PARIMA is a protein-innovation company that develops high-quality cultivated foods directly from animal cells, formed from the combination of Gourmey and Vital Meat. It combines expertise in cell cultivation, bioprocessing, and culinary development to produce cultivated meat at scale, and in October 2025 became the first European company granted regulatory approval for cultivated protein. Its culinary brand, Gourmey, focuses on premium cultivated meats co-developed with Michelin-starred chefs. Surfaced as an Earlybird portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API, developer platform, or software product surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Patina
providers.description: Patina was a technology-enabled primary care provider for adults 65 and older, delivering human, personalized, on-demand care through a mobile app that let patients chat or speak with their care team, view medical information, share photos and videos, ask questions, and schedule visits. Headquartered in Philadelphia, the venture-backed company (a16z, GV) has closed its clinical practice; patinahealth.com now serves as a records resource, with patient medical records maintained by custodian Morgan Records Management. Patina publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Paytm Payments Bank
providers.description: Paytm Payments Bank Limited is an Indian payments bank headquartered in Noida, offering digital savings and current accounts, the Paytm Wallet, FASTag, debit cards, UPI and other retail banking services to consumers and merchants. It operates as a distinct entity from Paytm's merchant payment-gateway developer platform (One97 Communications), and does not publish its own public developer API surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: PCV
providers.description: Precision Cardiovascular (PCV) is a UK-based digital-health company advancing cardiovascular care through continuous, AI-powered heart-failure monitoring. Its flagship PULSENSE system pairs an implantable pulmonary-artery-pressure (PAP) sensor insert and a wearable smart chest patch with an AI-powered clinical app that surfaces real-time pressure trends and analytics for clinicians and patients. The platform is designed to catch PAP fluctuations that traditional spot-check measurements miss, including overnight and during activity. PCV PULSENSE is an investigational device under regulatory review (FDA, MHRA, EMA) and is not yet approved for commercial sale. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Pennsylvania Real Estate Investment Trust (PREIT)
providers.description: Pennsylvania Real Estate Investment Trust (PREIT) is a Philadelphia-based mall REIT founded in 1960 by Sylvan M. Cohen. The trust developed, owned, and managed mixed-use retail destinations — including Cherry Hill Mall, Woodland Mall, Mall at Prince George's, and Springfield Town Center — across roughly nine states in the eastern and midwestern United States. PREIT filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection twice in four years. The first filing, on November 1, 2020, was a pre-packaged restructuring resolved by December 11, 2020. The second filing, on December 10, 2023, was a more consequential restructuring that wiped out public shareholders. PREIT emerged from its second Chapter 11 in early 2024 as a private company owned by its former lenders (reported to include Redwood Capital Management and Nut Tree Capital Management). Common shares were delisted from the New York Stock Exchange, and Jared Chupaila was appointed CEO of the reorganized, privately held entity. The post-emergence PREIT continues to operate its mall portfolio as a private operator. It exposes no public APIs, no developer portal, no documented machine-readable surfaces, and maintains no GitHub organization. This profile is preserved primarily to document the company's Chapter 11 history and its absence from the API economy.

providers.name: Perceive Bio
providers.description: Perceive Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, California, that translates protective biology into therapies for retinal degeneration and vision loss. Its pipeline targets dry age-related macular degeneration (AMD) and neuroprotection with differentiated targets grounded in deep genetic insights, aiming to prevent irreversible blindness. Backed by GV (Google Ventures). Perceive Bio is a therapeutics company with no public API, developer portal, or programmatic surface; this profile was run through the enrichment pipeline and no API artifacts were found to harvest. Contact: info@perceivebio.com.

providers.name: Permian Resources
providers.description: Permian Resources Corporation is an independent oil and natural gas company focused on the development of crude oil and related liquids-rich natural gas reserves in the Permian Basin. The company operates assets in the Delaware Basin in West Texas and southeastern New Mexico and is publicly traded. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Personalis
providers.description: Personalis, Inc. (NASDAQ PSNL) is a clinical genomics and cancer diagnostics company based in Fremont, California. It develops advanced tumor and immune profiling tests built on next-generation sequencing, including its NeXT Personal ultra-sensitive tumor-informed molecular residual disease (MRD) and recurrence-monitoring assay and the ImmunoID NeXT whole-exome and transcriptome platform used for translational cancer research, biopharma partnerships, and population sequencing programs. Personalis operates as a diagnostics laboratory and research-services provider; its offerings are delivered as clinical tests, sequencing services, and analytical reports rather than as a public developer API. No public developer portal, API reference, or SDK is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Petcube
providers.description: Petcube is a pet-technology company (a Y Combinator alum) that makes interactive Wi-Fi pet cameras and a companion mobile app for remote pet care. Its consumer hardware line includes the Petcube Cam, Bites treat-dispensing camera, and Play laser camera, offering HD video, night vision, two-way audio, motion and sound alerts, and app-controlled treat tossing and play. Petcube also sells the Care subscription (cloud video history, extended alerts) and Online Vet / Emergency Fund telehealth services. As of this enrichment pass Petcube exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or documented integration surface — the primary interface is the consumer iOS/Android app tied to its private cloud backend. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Pharos
providers.description: Pharos is a healthcare technology company whose stated mission is to improve hospital quality and patient safety. Backed by Felicis, it operates a gated product application (app.pharos.health) and access-restricted documentation (docs.pharos.health requires an access code), indicating an enterprise offering sold to hospitals and health systems rather than a public, self-serve developer platform. As of this enrichment pass Pharos publishes a marketing site but no public API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, developer portal, or other machine-readable developer surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead, this profile is retained for monitoring should a public API program emerge.

providers.name: Phishin
providers.description: A web-based archive of legal live audio recordings of the improvisational rock band Phish

providers.name: PhishMe
providers.description: PhishMe is a phishing defense and security awareness company founded in 2011 by Rohyt Belani and Aaron Higbee, and rebranded as Cofense in 2018 following its acquisition by a private-equity consortium. The company pioneered simulated-phishing training and crowd-sourced phishing detection, and today operates the Cofense phishing-defense platform spanning Phishing Detection and Response (PDR), security awareness training, managed phishing defense, and threat intelligence. Originally backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead. The company markets a connected, AI-assisted platform for post-perimeter phishing remediation rather than a public developer API; product, integration, and threat-intelligence capabilities are surfaced through customer and partner channels.

providers.name: Pig Latin
providers.description: Pig Latin is a language game in which English words are altered according to a simple set of rules (typically moving the first consonant cluster to the end of the word and appending "ay"). This repository indexes Pig Latin as a topic; no authoritative public REST API or OpenAPI specification has been identified, so no machine-readable contract is published here.

providers.name: Planby Technologies, Inc.
providers.description: Planby Technologies, Inc. (PLANBY) is a Seoul-based AI transformation partner for architecture and construction organizations, helping construction firms, architectural offices, and interior studios adopt AI-powered workflows. Its products include PLANA (interior and concept CG rendering automation) and PLAD (apartment exterior design visualization), which cut visualization timeframes from days to hours, alongside its AX Program for organizational AI transformation (diagnosis, training, and workflow integration) and Knowledge System Building that structures construction data such as blueprints, specifications, and defect records into domain-specific data frameworks. Clients include Samsung E&A, POSCO E&C, Hyundai, Daewoo E&C, and Samsung C&T. Backed by 500 Global. PLANBY publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Planet Fitness
providers.description: The largest fitness franchise in the United States by number of members and locations, operating over 2,500 clubs in the US, Canada, Panama, Mexico, and Australia. Planet Fitness is known for its affordable membership model (Classic and Black Card tiers), the non-intimidating Judgement Free Zone philosophy targeting casual and first-time gym-goers, and the PF App for workout content, club check-in, and member benefits. Planet Fitness does not publish a public developer API, integration portal, or third-party platform program; integrations with workout content providers and biometric/check-in vendors are handled via private commercial partnerships, not public APIs.

providers.name: PlateJoy
providers.description: PlateJoy is a personalized digital meal-planning and nutrition subscription service that generates customized weekly meal plans, recipes, and auto-built grocery lists from a detailed dietary and lifestyle questionnaire, with grocery-delivery hand-off. Founded in 2012 and later acquired into the Health.com / Dotdash Meredith consumer-health portfolio, it operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile app. As of this enrichment pass PlateJoy exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface. The apex domain has no live web host and the www endpoint resolves to a dangling AWS load balancer, so only domain-level DNS/email security could be probed.

providers.name: Playgroundpediatrics
providers.description: Playground Pediatrics is a pediatric medical group and practice-support (management services) organization that partners with independent, community-based pediatric practices across North Carolina, Georgia, Tennessee, and Pennsylvania. It provides partner practices with operational support (billing, payer contracting, HR, payroll, technology, compliance, and marketing), talent recruiting/development/retention, and infrastructure for long-term stability and value-based care participation, while letting each practice keep its local identity. Partner practices include Cobb Pediatrics, Cornerstone Medical Associates, and Rainbow Pediatrics. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. No public API, developer portal, documentation, or event surface was found as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Plena Health
providers.description: Plena Health is an AI operating system for specialty medical practices, founded in 2025 and part of Y Combinator's Spring 2026 batch. Plena automates the complex administrative workflows a clinic's staff shouldn't have to do — referrals, fax intake, patient calls, scheduling, prior authorization, procedure compliance, and collections — end to end, running in the background across the EHRs, clearinghouses, and other systems a practice already uses, rather than requiring the practice to adopt new software. Founded by Eyad Abdalla (CEO) and Ahmed Al Mudarris (CTO) and based in San Francisco, the company reports operating across six specialties in eight states. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Plena publishes only a marketing site (a single-page React application) with no public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Pliant Therapeutics
providers.description: Pliant Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of integrin-based therapies for underserved areas of medical need. Leveraging a proprietary integrin drug discovery and delivery platform, its lead program PLN-101095 is a dual-selective avb8/avb1 integrin inhibitor being evaluated in the FORTIFY clinical trial for patients with advanced or metastatic solid tumors, alongside additional pipeline programs in fibrosis and oncology. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, Pliant Therapeutics publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface; this profile captures corporate identity and web presence only.

providers.name: Podfund
providers.description: Podfund provides startup and growth capital to podcast creators and audio-driven media companies, typically investing $25,000 to $150,000 based on stage, track record, traction, and revenue. Operated by TechNexus Venture Collaborative, which has backed 600+ startups since 2007, Podfund pairs funding with business planning, a peer community, mentor matching, a growth toolkit, and partner offers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and added to the API Evangelist network. Podfund publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and web presence for network discovery.

providers.name: Prana Health
providers.description: Prana (prana.health) is a research-driven body-enhancement company building a system to engineer more muscle and less fat through three integrated steps: performance testing to measure a user's biology, predictive body-composition models that adapt training and nutrition protocols in real time, and personalized enhancement medicine to accelerate results safely. The platform centers on proprietary body-modeling technology, including its MUSCLE-1 hypertrophy prediction model, and is currently offered to users through a beta program. As of this profile Prana publishes a consumer marketing and research site only and exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: prcxi
providers.description: prcxi (Suzhou Zhongxi Bioinformation Co., Ltd.) is a life-science automation company founded in 2014 and based in Suzhou, China. It builds liquid-handling systems (manual, semi-automatic, and fully automatic pipetting workstations such as the SC9000/SC9100/SC9200/SC9320 PRO series), custom laboratory automation solutions, and general lab equipment including shaking incubators.
