Its systems serve biopharmaceuticals, clinical diagnostics, public health, food safety, and agricultural breeding. Surfaced as a portfolio company of qiming; the company publishes no public developer/API surface, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Predictive Oncology  (Precision Therapeutics)
providers.description: Predictive Oncology (Precision Therapeutics) is an AI-driven drug-discovery and precision-oncology company. It combines a proprietary biobank of 150,000+ tumor samples with machine-learning models to predict patient and drug responses, develops 3D in vitro tumor models that simulate human tissue environments for drug testing, and offers tumor drug-response testing and genomic profiling to support personalized cancer treatment and improve the probability of success in clinical trials. The company engages partners through direct B2B collaboration and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Prime Life Science
providers.description: Prime Life Science (璞睿生命科技) is a Chinese life-science technology company focused on digital and intelligent (数智化) clinical research. Its business spans the full lifecycle from clinical research to commercial decision-making, offering digital innovation solutions built on big data and artificial intelligence. The company positions itself as a "digital intelligent clinical research accelerator" aimed at driving innovative drug and device development, health management, and improved clinical-research decision-making and operational efficiency in China. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture fund and added to the API Evangelist network; the public presence is a WordPress marketing site with no developer or API surface discovered during enrichment.

providers.name: Proxima
providers.description: Proxima (Proxima Bio) is a preclinical biotechnology company making protein interactions programmable through an integrated discovery platform that combines artificial intelligence, machine learning, and structural proteomics. Building on a proprietary atlas of protein cross-linking data, Proxima trains models that design proximity modulators - Inducers, Modulators, and Blockers - small-molecule therapeutics that induce or block protein-protein complexes to address cancer, autoimmune disorders, and other hard-to-treat diseases. The company is backed by DCVC and collaborates with major pharmaceutical firms. It is listed in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; as of this pass Proxima publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Public Storage
providers.description: Public Storage is an American real estate investment trust (REIT) that acquires, develops, owns, and operates self-storage facilities throughout the United States and Europe. Headquartered in Glendale, California, it is one of the largest self-storage operators in the world, serving customers via its online reservation system (eRental), mobile apps, and physical facilities. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Purmeo
providers.description: PURMEO GmbH is a German ("Made in Germany") manufacturer and direct-to-consumer retailer of high-quality nutritional supplements, vitamins, and minerals, with a focus on digestive health (including H. pylori support), energy, immunity, cognitive function, vision, bone and joint support, and cardiovascular health. Products are formulated without artificial additives, GMOs, or magnesium stearate and are distributed via the company's own online shop as well as Amazon, DocMorris, Medpex, and Shop-Apotheke. Surfaced as a portfolio company of point-nine and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the enrichment pass this is a B2C e-commerce business with no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Quanterix
providers.description: Quanterix is a life-sciences company that develops ultra-sensitive protein detection technology for the research and clinical diagnostics markets. Its Simoa (Single Molecule Array) digital biomarker platform, delivered through instruments such as the HD-X and Simoa ONE analyzers and consumable assay kits, measures proteins at concentrations far below conventional immunoassays, enabling early-detection research in neurology (including Alzheimer's blood-based biomarkers), oncology, cardiology, inflammation, and infectious disease. Quanterix was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Quantum Systems
providers.description: Quantum-Systems GmbH is a Gilching/Munich, Germany-based dual-use drone manufacturer founded in 2015 by former Bundeswehr helicopter pilot Florian Seibel. The company designs, builds, and operates small electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) fixed-wing unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) for reconnaissance, intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition (RSTA), surveying, and mapping. Its flagship platforms include the Trinity Pro (mapping/surveying VTOL with up to 90-minute endurance), the Vector tactical reconnaissance drone (the de facto main small UAS supplier to the German Bundeswehr and, with 619+ systems delivered as of April 2025, one of the most-used Western reconnaissance drones in Ukraine), the Reliant long-range Group 2 ISR/RSTA platform built for the U.S. market with 10+ hours endurance and hot-swappable MOD-compliant payload bays (EO/IR, SIGINT, EW, CRPA), and the Ukraine-manufactured Sparta drone carrier that delivers two FPV drones to a 200 km combat radius. All platforms are operated through QBase 3D, Quantum-Systems' proprietary Windows-based mission planning, control, and post-processing software with integrated ESRI terrain data and direct export to Pix4D, Agisoft, Propeller, and Trimble Business Center. The Vector tactical line is built on Auterion's flight stack. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, Thiel Capital, Project A, Airbus Ventures, and Omnes Capital, the company reached unicorn status in May 2025 as "Europe's first dual-use unicorn." Quantum-Systems supplies the militaries of Germany, the United States, Ukraine, Australia, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Romania, and Spain. There is no public developer API, REST endpoint, SDK, or open-source release for QBase 3D or any Quantum-Systems platform; integration with Pix4D/Agisoft/Propeller/Trimble is via standard photogrammetry file exchange (GeoTIFF, RAW imagery, flight logs), not a programmable API.

providers.name: Quantumscape
providers.description: QuantumScape is a battery technology company developing next-generation solid-state lithium-metal batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage. Its anode-free cell design aims to deliver greater energy density, faster charging, longer life, and improved safety versus conventional lithium-ion cells, while simplifying manufacturing and lowering cost. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a corporate website, blog, and investor relations resources but no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Quick Ride
providers.description: Quick Ride is an Indian mobility platform offering carpooling, bikepool, and taxi services across major cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Kochi, NCR, and Chandigarh. Riders book airport, outstation, rental, and local trips across vehicle classes from hatchbacks to luxury SUVs, or share commutes via car and bike pooling to cut cost and congestion. The service is delivered through consumer iOS and Android apps. No public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, MCP, SDKs) is published; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of prosus-ventures and enriched via live web and DNS/TLS probes.

providers.name: Quintessent Communications
providers.description: Quintessent is a deep-tech photonics startup based in Goleta, California, developing optical connectivity solutions that address the communication bottlenecks in large-scale computing and AI infrastructure. The company builds chip-to-chip optical interconnect technology grounded in quantum-dot laser epitaxy, and has established supply chains for quantum-dot epitaxial wafers used in AI optical interconnects. Quintessent is a hardware and semiconductor photonics company rather than a software/API provider; it exposes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface. Backed by Battery Ventures, Entrada Ventures, Foothill Ventures, and Sierra Ventures, with research funding from DARPA, ARPA-E, and the NSF, the company was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead and profiled here for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Radical Numerics
providers.description: Radical Numerics is an AI research lab building what it calls "general biological intelligence" — next-generation AI architectures aimed at biology and science rather than language. It was founded by machine-learning researchers Michael Poli, Stefano Massaroli, Eric Nguyen, and Armin W. Thomas (associated with the Hyena and Evo / Evo 2 genomics model families), with an advisory board including Eric Horvitz, Chris Ré, George Church, and Andrew Weber. The lab focuses on the science of scaling, architecture, and systems: massive context windows scaling toward one billion tokens, generative genomics, biological threat detection, and multimodal biological intelligence. Its first product, Omnii, is an early-access health research preview. The company announced a $50M seed round in June 2026, with backing including Obvious Ventures. As of this profile Radical Numerics publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Radiology Partners
providers.description: Radiology Partners is a national radiology practice based in Austin, Texas that partners with radiologists, radiology practices, hospitals, and health systems to deliver diagnostic imaging services across the United States. Backed by New Enterprise Associates (NEA), the company focuses on transforming radiology through clinical operations, technology, and scale rather than a public developer platform. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specifications, SDKs, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface on its public websites (www.radiologypartners.com, which redirects to radpartners.com); only live domain-security posture was probeable. This profile remains a company/lead record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: RAPT Therapeutics
providers.description: RAPT Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing oral small-molecule and antibody therapies for patients with inflammatory, immunologic, and oncologic diseases. Its pipeline centers on ozureprubart, a long-acting anti-IgE antibody candidate in Phase 2 trials for food allergies, alongside programs targeting key drivers of immune response. The company was acquired by GSK in January 2026. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network; as a life-sciences therapeutics company it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: rdbio (仁度生物 / Rendo Biotech)
providers.description: Rendo Biotech (仁度生物) is a Shanghai-based molecular diagnostics company founded in 2007 and listed on China's STAR Market (Science and Technology Innovation Board, stock code 688193). It specializes in pathogen RNA clinical detection, developing diagnostic reagents and fully automated nucleic-acid analysis instruments across five clinical areas — reproductive-health screening, bloodborne pathogen detection, respiratory infections, enterovirus identification, and food safety. The company serves 700+ medical institutions and holds 74+ invention patents. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming Venture Partners network and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Rendo Biotech publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or documentation surface — it is a diagnostics-instrument and reagents manufacturer, not an API provider.

providers.name: Reach Labs
providers.description: Reach Labs (operating as Reach Power Inc.) is a wireless power transmission company that delivers electrical energy through the air without physical connections, describing its mission as "doing for power what Wi-Fi did for data." Its patented approach combines energy-transmission hardware, a custom delivery algorithm, and adaptive software controls to beam power to devices across varying distances and conditions. The company targets three primary sectors: defense and intelligence (powering sensors, autonomous vehicles, and drones in remote environments), manufacturing and logistics (energizing robotics and IoT devices in industrial settings), and public safety (enabling continuous drone operations for first responders). Reach was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable metadata surface.

providers.name: Recursion
providers.description: Recursion (Recursion Pharmaceuticals, NASDAQ RXRX) is a clinical-stage TechBio company that industrializes drug discovery by combining wet-lab automation, proprietary biological and chemical datasets (over 50 petabytes), and machine learning in its Recursion Operating System. Its Valence Labs unit runs machine-learning research, and the company has published open datasets (RxRx) for the ML community. Recursion was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC, Obvious Ventures, and the SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile records its identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Regency Healthcare
providers.description: Regency Healthcare is a multi-specialty tertiary and super-speciality hospital network in northern India, operating five centres across Kanpur, Lucknow and Gorakhpur with 240+ doctors and physicians covering 20+ medical specialties including cardiology, oncology (cancer care), nephrology, orthopedics and gastroenterology. Patient-facing services include appointment booking, emergency and ambulance care, diagnostic imaging (PET-CT), and an online lab-report portal. Surfaced as a portfolio lead of norwest-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network; the enrichment pipeline found no public developer/API surface for this provider.

providers.name: Related Companies
providers.description: Related Companies is a privately held, fully integrated real estate firm founded by Stephen Ross in 1972 as an affordable-housing developer and now active across luxury residential, affordable housing, retail, office, hospitality, data centers, and city-scale mixed-use development. Related is the developer of Hudson Yards in New York City, The Grand LA, Time Warner Center (now Deutsche Bank Center), The 78 in Chicago, and operates regional platforms including Related Beal, Related Midwest, Related California, Related Ross, and Related Argent in the UK. The firm owns and manages roughly 55,000 affordable and workforce housing units and has stated it has never converted a single affordable unit to market rate. Stephen Ross also owns a majority stake in Equinox Holdings (Equinox fitness clubs, Equinox Hotels, SoulCycle, Blink Fitness) and the Miami Dolphins / Hard Rock Stadium.

providers.name: Relievant Medsystems
providers.description: Relievant Medsystems is a medical device company that developed the Intracept Procedure, a minimally invasive treatment that uses radiofrequency ablation of the basivertebral nerve to relieve chronic vertebrogenic low back pain. Originally venture-backed (including by Canaan Partners), Relievant was acquired by Boston Scientific in 2023, and the Intracept system is now marketed under the Boston Scientific portfolio. The company is a clinical medical-device business focused on physicians, hospitals, and patients rather than a software or API platform, and it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Remedy Robotics
providers.description: Remedy Robotics is a medical robotics company developing what it describes as the world's first endovascular robot capable of performing entire cardiovascular and stroke procedures under onsite, remote, or autonomous control. Its stated mission is to expand timely access to life-saving vascular interventions for patients who cannot reach specialized stroke and cardiac care in time. Remedy Robotics is a portfolio company of DCVC. As a clinical-stage medical device developer, the company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Resilience
providers.description: Resilience is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc, crv, general-catalyst, gv, lightspeed-venture-partners, lux-capital, obvious-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: biotech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Reverie
providers.description: Reverie is an early-stage venture capital firm based in New York that invests at the pre-seed and seed stages in crypto and web3 companies and protocols, describing its work as crafting generational companies and protocols. Its portfolio spans blockchain infrastructure, wallets and key management, DeFi, on-chain security, and trading, and includes companies such as Blockaid, Keplr, Squads, Stride, Tensor, Geodnet, and Agora. Reverie was surfaced through the Multicoin Capital portfolio and also produces The Archive podcast. It is an investment firm rather than an API producer, so it publishes no public API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Rippl
providers.description: Rippl (Rippl Care, now part of Harbor Health) is a value-based, technology-enabled dementia and senior behavioral-health care provider backed by General Catalyst. It delivers specialized dementia care including medication assessments, personalized care plans, counseling, community-resource connections, care-navigation check-ins, safety guidance, and caregiver support, partnering with health systems and payors to lower total cost of care and improve outcomes for older adults. Rippl operates as a clinical care-delivery organization rather than an API-first software vendor: it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, and its patient portal is provided through an athenahealth integration.

providers.name: Ritivel
providers.description: Ritivel is an AI-native regulatory and medical-writing platform for life sciences organizations, backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2026 batch). Its AI agents automate the drafting of regulatory submission documents such as Common Technical Documents (CTD), Clinical Study Reports (CSR), INDs, and BLAs, turning work that typically takes weeks into minutes. The platform generates comprehensive first drafts in Microsoft Word format that follow FDA and ICH requirements, with word-level traceability of every statement back to source documents, integrations with SharePoint, Veeva, and Outlook for document retrieval and follow-ups, a regulatory search over FDA and ICH guidelines, and a privacy posture built around local deployment with no cloud storage. It serves pharma, biotech, medtech, CROs, and CDMOs. Ritivel is an end-user application and does not currently publish a public API or developer portal.

providers.name: Rize
providers.description: Rize (Rize Money, Inc. / RizeFS) was a Banking-as-a-Service and embedded-finance platform that offered unified banking, brokerage, and payments APIs, letting companies embed savings, checking, and investment accounts directly into their own products. Rize was acquired by Fifth Third Bancorp in 2023; the standalone rizefs.com developer and API surface has since been decommissioned, with no live documentation, OpenAPI, or reachable endpoints found during this enrichment pass. The registered domain still publishes SPF and DMARC (reject) email records but serves no web or API hosts.

providers.name: Rodin Therapeutics *
providers.description: Rodin Therapeutics * is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: life-sciences. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Roll
providers.description: Roll was a social token infrastructure platform for the creator economy, letting creators and communities mint and manage their own branded ERC-20 tokens on the Ethereum blockchain. Founded in 2017 in New York City and backed by Techstars, IOSG Ventures, and Fabric Ventures (a $10M Series A), Roll offered developer APIs and OAuth-based integrations so third-party apps could query tokens and balances. The custodial Roll app and its developer API (docs.tryroll.com / api.tryroll.com) were sunset in April 2025 and permanently shut down on 2025-05-26; the company web surface no longer resolves. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; this pass confirms the company is defunct with no live API surface remaining.

providers.name: Rubicon
providers.description: Rubicon (formerly NYSE: RBT) is a waste, recycling, and sustainability technology company founded in 2008. It went public in 2022 via a SPAC merger with Founder SPAC at a pro forma valuation of roughly $1.7 billion, branding itself a "digital challenger" to the traditional waste-hauling industry with a marketplace connecting waste generators to independent haulers plus the RUBICONSmartCity fleet-and-routing platform used by more than 70 municipalities. Operating Status: the company subsequently faced severe financial distress - layoffs and debt restructuring in 2023, a June 2024 NYSE delisting, and a May 2024 divestiture of its entire fleet technology and smart-city business unit (RUBICONSmartCity, RUBICONPro, RUBICONPremier) to Rodina Capital for roughly $68 million plus a possible $12 million earnout; those assets were subsequently absorbed by Routeware. In early 2025 Rubicon deregistered its securities and became a privately held company, majority-owned by Jose Miguel Enrich through MBI Holdings, and remains the subject of shareholder litigation over the change-of-control terms. The surviving company operates as a smaller enterprise waste brokerage and sustainability-data business built around the RUBICONConnect platform (service, equipment, pickup, and cost visibility for enterprise customers such as Chipotle and FedEx), alongside RUBICONRegWatch compliance tooling, sustainability reporting, technical advisory services, and the Rubicon Now on-demand dumpster-rental service in a handful of cities. rubicon.com publishes no developer portal, no public API reference, and no OpenAPI specification. The only discoverable API artifact tied to the rubicon.com domain is a "Routeware Smartcity Public Api" Swagger UI hosted at a dev subdomain (haulerpublic-api.dev.aws.rubicon.com) - leftover infrastructure from the divested fleet/smart-city business - which returned a 503 Service Unavailable on every check during this review and is not publicly documented or reachable. Any hauler or municipal system integration Rubicon references (for example, connecting to city 311 systems) is negotiated per partner and gated behind sales and onboarding rather than exposed through self-serve developer documentation. Pricing across RUBICONConnect and Rubicon's enterprise services is entirely quote-based and negotiated per contract; no public pricing, tiers, or rate limits are published. This entry is maintained as an honest stub pending any future public API surface.

providers.name: Rumarocket
providers.description: Rumarocket is an AI-powered talent management and HR analytics platform whose tagline is "Hire Talent, Not Employees." It integrates with existing HR systems to synthesize workforce data from hiring through employment, applying machine learning to predict employee attrition and performance, evaluate talent fit for specific roles, and deliver predictive insights for retention and workforce wellness. Backed by 500 Global, the platform exposes user-facing recruitment-algorithm and predictive-insights dashboards but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Sai De Yang Guang Oral Care
providers.description: Sai De Yang Guang Oral Care (赛德阳光口腔) is a dental healthcare chain operating across China, founded in 2007 by orthodontist Zhou Yanheng, formerly a director at Peking University School of Stomatology. It runs roughly 30 clinics across major cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Xiamen, Xi'an, Tianjin, Shenyang and Changsha, with nearly 340 treatment chairs, and provides orthodontics (including Invisalign), dental implants, pediatric dentistry, cosmetic dentistry and periodontal treatment. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. The company operates a patient-facing website (appointment booking, clinic locations, expert profiles) and publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: SalioGen Therapeutics
providers.description: SalioGen Therapeutics was a next-generation genetic medicine company, formerly based in Lexington, Massachusetts, developing gene therapies. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of d1-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a biotech stub. As of the 2026-07-21 enrichment pass its website (saliogen.com) serves only a minimal holding page indicating the company is no longer operating; no developer portal, API, documentation, blog, or other public technical surface was found.

providers.name: Sapiens Medicus
providers.description: Sapiens Medicus operates Esculap.io, a consumer digital-health platform offering AI-powered doctor consultations delivered instantly through a web application. Marketed as "Your AI Doctor - Instant Medical Care Anytime," the service promises AI doctor consultations with medical specialist-level accuracy and high diagnostic confidence, with no appointments and no waiting times. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company, it is a consumer-facing React single-page application; as of this enrichment pass no public API, developer portal, SDK, machine-readable OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface is published on the esculap.io domain.

providers.name: Savedo
providers.description: Savedo was a German fintech operating a consumer deposit marketplace that let savers in Germany open fixed-term and savings accounts across multiple European partner banks from a single portal. Backed by Point Nine, it was acquired by Deposit Solutions in 2017 and is now a subsidiary brand of Raisin SE (WeltSparen). The Savedo customer portal was deactivated on 31 March 2022 and the brand no longer accepts new customers; existing balances are administered via flatexDEGIRO Bank AG. Savedo published no public API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile is retained as a network lead surfaced from the Point Nine portfolio.

providers.name: Sayre Therapeutics
providers.description: Sayre Therapeutics is a healthcare company founded in 2015 that brings innovative treatments for rare, orphan, and life-threatening diseases to India and the broader SAARC region. It works across clinical research, regulatory strategy, and commercialization and market access, partnering with global licensors to bring US-, EU-, and Japan-approved drugs, drug-delivery devices, and diagnostics to South Asian markets under local regulatory standards. Its portfolio spans special-access and commercially approved products, diagnostics, biosimilars, and niche generics. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes no public developer portal, API, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC)
providers.description: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) is a Reston, Virginia based technology integrator that delivers mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services to U.S. federal civilian, defense, intelligence community, and space customers. With approximately 24,000 employees and roughly $7.3 billion in annual revenue, SAIC focuses on direct technical support and integration for government organizations, spanning CJADC2, data and AI, digital transformation, quantum technologies, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, digital engineering, and systems integration. SAIC has expanded its capabilities through acquisitions including Engility (2018), Unisys Federal (2020), Halfaker (2021, DoD healthcare), Koverse (2021, secure data lake for classified environments), and Forfeiture Support Associates (2023). No public REST APIs, developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or open source GitHub organization have been identified for SAIC — its software and platforms are delivered under federal contract to government customers rather than as externally-consumable developer products.

providers.name: SCIWIND
providers.description: Sciwind Biosciences (Hangzhou Sciwind Biosciences Co., Ltd.) is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Hangzhou, China, with a US office in San Ramon, California, focused on discovering, developing, and delivering innovative therapeutics for weight management and metabolic disease. Its pipeline spans obesity, type 2 diabetes, and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), led by the GLP-1 receptor agonist Ecnoglutide (advancing through Phase III trials). The company operates proprietary drug-discovery platforms including BiasVantage (biased agonist discovery), OralVantage (oral peptide delivery), and HaleVantage (half-life extension), with 14+ pipeline programs, 120+ researchers, and 110+ patents. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API or developer platform surface.

providers.name: Seed Club
providers.description: Seed Club is a web3 accelerator and early-stage venture organization in hot pursuit of a dramatically more interesting internet, backing founders building consumer crypto applications, tokenized communities, and creator networks. Through its accelerator, ventures arm, and portfolio programs (currently running the SC07: Consumer Crypto cohort), Seed Club helps teams design token models, grow onchain communities, and go to market. It operates primarily as a community and funding organization rather than an API provider: there is no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of multicoin-capital and tracked in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Senti Biosciences
providers.description: Senti Biosciences (Nasdaq: SNTI) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, California that engineers programmable "Gene Circuits" into cell and gene therapies to treat cancer with greater precision and control. Its lead candidate, SENTI-202, is an off-the-shelf logic-gated CAR NK cell therapy in clinical trials for acute myeloid leukemia and other hematologic malignancies. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of lux-capital and menlo-ventures. As a therapeutics company it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: sh-eco
providers.description: SH-ECO (翊科聚合物 / Yike Polymer) is a Chinese medical-device materials manufacturer specializing in the research, production, and customized fabrication of medical catheters and membrane materials. Its product range spans single-lumen tubing, multi-lumen tubing, composite/multi-layer tubing, and injection-molded components serving healthcare and multiple industrial applications. The company is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. It publishes a corporate marketing website but exposes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Shape Shapescale
providers.description: Shapescale is a consumer body-scanning company that builds ShapeScale, a home 3D body scanner and companion mobile app. The device slowly rotates around a standing user, captures a photorealistic 3D model of the body, and measures body composition, weight, and circumference metrics so users can track fitness and body changes over time. Shapescale is a Y Combinator portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer product website but no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Shasqi
providers.description: Shasqi is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing cancer treatment through click chemistry. Its CAPAC (Click Activated Protodrugs Against Cancer) platform uses a pre-targeting approach that captures therapeutic payloads at the tumor via in-vivo click chemistry, separating tumor-targeting molecules from their drug payloads and reuniting them at the cancer site to maximize drug delivery while reducing systemic toxicity. The company builds on the 2022 Nobel Prize-winning click chemistry work and operates as a therapeutics developer rather than a technology or API platform. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio company; enrichment found no public developer API, SDK, or technical platform surface.

providers.name: Shezlong
providers.description: Shezlong is an online mental health and therapy platform serving Egypt and the wider MENA region, connecting users with licensed psychologists and therapists through confidential video, voice, and text sessions delivered from any device. Founded in 2015 and Arabic-first, the consumer service offers subscription-based access to counseling, self-assessment tools, and educational content. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Shezlong operates a client-side (Angular) web application behind Cloudflare and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface; the profile is maintained as a lead for discovery and future enrichment.

providers.name: Shift5
providers.description: Shift5 is an operational technology (OT) cyber and observability company that instruments the onboard serial data buses of planes, trains, and military weapons systems to deliver real-time intrusion detection, predictive maintenance, and compliance intelligence for defense and transportation fleets. Founded by former US Army Cyber Command engineers, it collects and analyzes data directly from vehicle bus networks (MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 429, CAN) to give operators actionable insight into the health and security of their platforms. Backed by Insight Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; enrichment confirms Shift5 publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: shsongli
providers.description: shsongli (Shanghai Pine & Power / Songli Biotech Co., Ltd.) is a Shanghai-based biotechnology and medical-device maker specializing in the R&D, manufacture and sale of biological hemostatic products, most notably animal-derived quick-dissolving fibrin glue with independent IP, used in surgery and expanding into tissue engineering. The company operates a Class III medical-device line and is ISO 13485 and GMP certified. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network. The enrichment pass found no public developer or API surface: the shsongli.com domain returns 404 on every path (EIMS web server) with an expired TLS certificate, and no docs, portal, packages, MCP, llms.txt, /.well-known/ endpoints, or security program were published.

providers.name: shukun
providers.description: Shukun Technology (数坤科技) is a Beijing-based, globally operating AI medical-imaging company founded in 2017. It builds an AI-powered "Digital Doctor" portfolio (CoronaryDoc, NeuroDoc and related Digital Heart / Digital Brain products) that analyzes CT and other medical images to assist clinicians in screening, diagnosing, and planning treatment for cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, chest, abdominal and musculoskeletal disease. Shukun holds NMPA Class III certificates, EU MDR CE markings, and US FDA clearance across several therapeutic areas, and its products are deployed in nearly 3,000 healthcare institutions. The company is a clinical/enterprise AI vendor with no public developer or API surface at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Signify Group
providers.description: Signify Group is a London, United Kingdom-based ethical data science firm founded in 2017 by co-founder and CEO Jonathan Hirshler, applying machine learning, natural language understanding, and open-source intelligence (OSINT) to social and digital media data. Its flagship service, Threat Matrix, is widely regarded as the leading platform for detecting, analysing, evidencing, and actioning online abuse and fixated threats directed at athletes, clubs, leagues, player unions, federations, brands, and other public figures. Threat Matrix scans incoming public messages across X (Twitter), Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok in 39+ languages, uses "augmented intelligence" (AI speed combined with trained human analyst nuance) to triage racist, sexist, homophobic, anti-semitic, islamophobic, gambling-driven, and personally targeted abuse, and produces evidence-grade reports with network mapping that can be used by platforms, police, sponsors, and protection teams. Customers and partners include the Professional Footballers' Association (PFA), Kick It Out, the International Tennis Federation (ITF) and WTA Tour covering c.8,300 players, the International Ski and Snowboard Federation (FIS) protecting 1,000+ athletes and officials, the Badminton World Federation (BWF), the NCAA, and Japan's 2026 World Baseball Classic squad. Signify also operates ShareScore (media coverage and social buzz analytics), Sports Insights (fan engagement and athlete insight analytics), and Online Forensics (brand reputation, OSINT investigations, and risk assurance). Signify is a private services firm with no public developer API, no public SDKs, and no public GitHub organization; engagement is via direct sales and managed service contracts with rights-holders, leagues, federations, and enterprise clients.

providers.name: silversheet
providers.description: silversheet was a healthcare credentialing and provider-workforce technology company added to the API Evangelist network as a stub from venture-portfolio sourcing. As of this enrichment pass its domain silversheet.com no longer serves an independent product or developer surface — it redirects to AMN Healthcare's workforce technology platform (amnhealthcare.com/technology/workforce/), indicating the Silversheet brand has been absorbed into AMN Healthcare. No api/developer/docs subdomains resolve, no OpenAPI or developer portal was found, and no first-party API surface exists to enrich. The domain is still administratively live (SPF and DMARC configured, Proofpoint MX), so a domain-security probe was recorded, but there is no independent API to profile.

providers.name: Simple Love Yogurt
providers.description: Simple Love (简爱酸奶) is a Chinese natural yogurt brand operated by Pucheng Dairy (Group) Co., Ltd. (朴诚乳业), founded in 2016. Known for zero-additive, low-temperature fresh yogurts with short ingredient lists — including its no-sugar, probiotic, high-protein, and coconut lines — the brand is distributed across supermarket shelves in every Chinese province and operates its own manufacturing capacity in Hebei. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As a consumer packaged-goods (CPG) dairy company it publishes a corporate/consumer website but no public developer, API, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: SimplifiMed
providers.description: SimplifiMed is a healthcare technology company that provides an AI-powered virtual assistant for medical and physician practices, automating patient communication and front-office administrative workflows such as messaging, appointment scheduling, and intake in order to reduce staff workload and streamline clinic operations. It is an early-stage company backed by 500 Global. During enrichment no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or GitHub organization were discoverable; the marketing site is served behind a bot-challenge wall, so only infrastructure-level security signals could be probed.

providers.name: SINAI Technologies
providers.description: SINAI Technologies is a San Francisco–headquartered enterprise SaaS company providing a Decarbonization Intelligence platform for carbon management, sustainability planning, and ESG compliance. The platform unifies organization-wide emissions accounting, climate transition planning, climate financial planning, and execution management so industrial enterprises can measure, report, and reduce Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions using science-based methodologies. Core modules include Carbon Accounting & Reporting, the Climate Transition Planner (with marginal abatement cost curves and scenario modeling), the Climate Financial Planner, and Execution & Management for tracking decarbonization projects. SINAI's Decarbonization Intelligence Portal layers Tableau-based dashboards, AI-powered bulk data ingestion, and AI Emissions Match (which maps unstructured emissions data to emission factors) on top of the underlying carbon ledger. The platform is designed around major reporting frameworks including CDP, TCFD, SEC climate disclosure, CSRD, CBAM, California SB 253 / SB 261, Brazil SBCE, and Brazil CVM resolutions 217 and 218, and is SOC 2 compliant with TÜV SÜD ISO 14064 verification. Customers include Siemens Energy, ArcelorMittal, Harley-Davidson, Emirates, Natura &Co, Minerva Foods, Wilson Sons, BRK Ambiental, and Japan's largest bank MUFG. SINAI states publicly that it can connect to enterprise customer systems through APIs to automate roughly 70% of emissions data ingestion, but it does not publish a developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, public API reference, or a GitHub organization — its API surface is delivered as a private integration capability negotiated with enterprise customers rather than a self-serve developer product.

providers.name: Sino Biological
providers.description: Sino Biological is a global life-science reagent supplier and contract research organization founded in 2007, headquartered in Beijing, China, with a US subsidiary in Wayne, Pennsylvania and offices across Europe. The company manufactures and sells recombinant proteins, antibodies, ELISA kits, cDNA clones, and other research reagents in-house, and provides contract biologics services (protein production, antibody development, gene synthesis) for academic, biopharmaceutical, and diagnostic customers worldwide. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company stub of Qiming Venture Partners, this profile was run through the enrichment pipeline; no public developer API, developer portal, or programmatic-access surface was discoverable (the corporate site is bot-protected and returns HTTP 403 to automated clients).

providers.name: SinoMDT
providers.description: Sino Medical-Device Technology Co., Ltd. (SinoMDT), founded in 2007 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, is a high-tech medical equipment manufacturer that researches, designs, and produces accurate injection and infusion devices along with radiographic imaging diagnosis systems. Its product line spans the SN-50 series syringe pumps, SN-1500 series infusion pumps, SinoPower high-pressure contrast injectors used for CT/MRI/DSA enhanced scans, and molybdenum-anode film and full-digital mammography systems for breast radiographic diagnosis. SinoMDT is a portfolio company backed by Qiming Venture Partners. It manufactures physical medical hardware and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform.

providers.name: Sinotau
providers.description: Sinotau (先通医药) is a Chinese pharmaceutical innovator specializing in the research, development, production, clinical application, and academic promotion of radiopharmaceuticals (nuclear medicine). Formally established in 2014, the company focuses on three therapeutic areas — oncology, neurology, and cardiology — and has brought its first innovative product, 欧韦宁 (Florbetaben Fluorine-18 injection for PET brain imaging), to market alongside a pipeline of 10+ products in development. Sinotau operates multiple R&D and production facilities, employs 400+ staff, and holds 80+ authorized patents. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As a corporate radiopharmaceutical manufacturer, Sinotau publishes a corporate marketing website but no public developer platform, API, or technical documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: SinoUnited Health
providers.description: SinoUnited Health (曜影医疗) is a premium private healthcare provider headquartered in Shanghai, China, operating a group of international-standard medical and dental clinics offering family medicine, specialty care, and dental services. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a private, in-person healthcare services provider, it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface at this time.

providers.name: sinovision-tech
providers.description: Sinovision (Sinovision Weisheng, 赛诺威盛) is a Beijing-based medical imaging technology company that designs and manufactures computed tomography (CT) systems and related clinical solutions. Its portfolio spans the Insitum 16-128-slice scanners, the Alpha series up to 512 slices, veterinary Petcare CT, mobile and vehicle-mounted units, image-guided navigation robotics, AI-assisted diagnostics, and the Sinoplatform cloud imaging platform, with 700+ installations across 150+ international partners. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners; as of this enrichment pass the public website publishes no developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Sisu Clinic
providers.description: Sisu Clinic is a doctor-led medical aesthetics and cosmetic medicine provider that operates a network of clinics offering treatments such as anti-wrinkle injections, dermal fillers, and skin and skincare services delivered by qualified medical practitioners. It is a consumer healthcare brand rather than an API provider - no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface was found on its website or in developer registries during this enrichment pass. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: SK Ventures
providers.description: SK Ventures is a seed-stage venture capital firm run by general partners Paul Kedrosky and Eric Norlin that backs science-driven founders who are deep domain experts in their startup's field. The firm invests around themes surfaced through the founders' technology conferences (Defrag, Glue) — identity, software infrastructure, security, and emerging technologies — providing early capital, practical guidance, connections, and pathways to later funding rounds. Its portfolio spans 50+ companies including Blockstream, Wealthfront, Rachio, Sphero, Premise, FullContact, and Klue, with notable exits including FanDuel, Remitly, Cloudability, and Kinvey. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group and profiled in the API Evangelist network; SK Ventures publishes a marketing website but no public API surface.

providers.name: Skild AI
providers.description: Skild AI is a Pittsburgh-founded robotics AI company developing the Skild Brain, a general-purpose, omni-bodied physical AI system intended to control many different robot embodiments across many tasks without being tied to a specific hardware design. The company is initially targeting three application platforms: security and inspection robots that can navigate dangerous environments, mobile manipulation systems combining grasping and navigation, and autonomous packing with dexterous skills. Skild publishes a research blog discussing topics such as learning from humans and video data. The company is backed by Sequoia, General Catalyst, Felicis, SoftBank, Bezos Expeditions, and other investors. Skild AI does not currently publish a public API, SDK, model weights, or developer documentation; commercial engagement appears to run through direct partnerships and pilots.

providers.name: Slingshot AI
providers.description: Slingshot AI is a mental-health research lab building foundation models for psychology. Its flagship product, Ash, is a free consumer application for iOS and Android designed specifically for therapy, trained on a large behavioral-health dataset using reinforcement-learning techniques. Founded by Daniel Cahn and Neil Parikh and backed by Felicis, Forerunner Ventures, Radical Ventures and Andreessen Horowitz, the company raised a $93M Series A in 2025 after an 18-month beta with roughly 50,000 users. Slingshot AI is a consumer product company and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: SMTP Technology
providers.description: SMTP Technology Co., Ltd. (Beijing Shuimu Tianpeng Medical Technology, tpmedical.com) is a Beijing Zhongguancun-based medical device company founded in 2010 that develops, manufactures, and sells ultrasonic surgical equipment - including the ultrasonic osteotome (bone scalpel), Ultrasonic Osteotomy Surgical System, ultrasonic aspirator, and ultrasonic hemostatic surgical systems - with market authorization in China, the EU, and the USA, and is a drafter of the YY/T 1601-2018 industry standard for ultrasonic bone-tissue surgical devices. A Qiming Venture Partners healthcare portfolio company. Enrichment probing found a brochure-only website (HTTP-only, unreachable outside China; profiled via its September 2025 Wayback snapshot) with no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or event surface.

providers.name: Smule
providers.description: Smule is an American consumer music technology company whose flagship social singing and karaoke app lets people perform solos, duets, and group songs and collaborate with other singers around the world in real time. Launched on iOS in 2012 and on Android in 2013 under the name "Sing! Karaoke," the app grew to tens of millions of monthly active users. Smule Inc. is headquartered in San Francisco and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Shasta Ventures. Smule publishes no official public developer API; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: snssurgical
providers.description: snssurgical is a surgical / medical-device company (domain snssurgical.com.cn, based in China) surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the company website presents no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface (its host serves a self-signed localhost certificate and redirects to a non-responsive HTTP endpoint), so there is no API to profile yet. This profile is a lead retained for future re-enrichment should an API surface appear.

providers.name: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings
providers.description: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings is one of the world's largest manufacturers of aerostructures for commercial airplanes, defense platforms, and business and regional jets. Spirit designs and builds fuselages, pylons, nacelles, and wing components for major aircraft programs including Boeing 737 MAX, 787, and Airbus A350. The company does not publicly expose developer APIs; its digital operations are focused on internal supply chain, manufacturing execution, and enterprise systems.

providers.name: Springbank Collective
providers.description: Springbank Collective (Springbank) is an early-stage venture capital firm investing in mission-critical infrastructure technology across three core sectors — work, live, and care. The firm backs pre-seed through Series A companies building AI-driven productivity tools for frontline workers and small businesses, innovation responding to demographic change and the multi-trillion-dollar generational wealth transfer, and healthcare and caregiving delivery infrastructure. Springbank emphasizes backing world-class founding teams of all genders and backgrounds. It was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent company of foundry-group and tracked within the API Evangelist network; the firm itself publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Sprout Wellness Solutions
providers.description: Sprout Wellness Solutions is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of techstars and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: SQZ Biotech
providers.description: SQZ Biotech is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: life-sciences. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Standard Kernel
providers.description: Standard Kernel Co. is an AI infrastructure company building a system that automatically generates optimized low-level kernel code — the programs that execute computations on GPUs and TPUs. It aims to eliminate the kernel-engineering bottleneck across the AI stack by combining LLMs with program analysis to produce hardware kernels (matmul, attention, fused feed-forward networks) that match or exceed hand-tuned libraries such as cuBLAS and FlashAttention3, including reported results at 99–116% of cuBLAS on H100 BF16 matmul. Backed by a $20M seed round with participation from General Catalyst, the company is early-stage and does not yet publish a public API, SDK, or developer platform.

providers.name: Starcloud
providers.description: Starcloud is developing orbital data centers that run AI and high-performance compute in space. The company aims to deploy hyperscale, gigawatt-scale infrastructure in orbit, using continuous solar energy without batteries and radiative cooling into the vacuum to lower cost, scale beyond terrestrial siting and permitting limits, and deploy rapidly. Backed by Nvidia, Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, NFX and others, Starcloud is building a roadmap of Starcloud-1 through Starcloud-4 satellite compute platforms. As of this profile the company exposes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or technical documentation surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a space-compute infrastructure company and lead for future enrichment.

providers.name: Stilla Technologies
providers.description: Stilla Technologies is a life-sciences instrumentation company that develops digital PCR (dPCR) systems, consumables, and assays, best known for its Naica system for Crystal Digital PCR and the Nio product line. With operations in France and the United States, its technology serves oncology diagnostics, cell and gene therapy, and infectious-disease testing. Stilla was acquired by Bio-Rad Laboratories (announced February 2025, ~$225M plus up to $50M in milestones, closed 2025); its web properties now redirect to Bio-Rad. The company operates laboratory hardware and consumables rather than a public developer platform — no OpenAPI, developer portal, SDKs, CLI, or MCP surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Stipple Bio
providers.description: Stipple Bio is a preclinical precision-oncology biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 2022 by cancer-biology researchers Aaron Ring (Fred Hutch) and Aashish Manglik (UCSF). Its Pointillist Platform performs cellular profiling and tumor-specific epitope discovery to design antibody binders and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) that target tumor-specific cell-surface epitopes while avoiding on-target, off-tumor toxicity. Its lead asset, STP-100, is an ADC advancing toward early clinical studies. The company emerged from stealth in April 2026 with an oversubscribed $100M Series A co-led by RA Capital, a16z Bio+Health and Nextech Invest, with participation from Google Ventures (gv). As a therapeutics company, Stipple Bio publishes no public API, developer portal, or software developer surface.

providers.name: Stonks
providers.description: Stonks (now operating as Sandhill Markets) is a San Francisco investment platform, founded circa 2019-2020 by serial entrepreneur Ali Moiz, that lets accredited investors buy and sell shares of top pre-IPO companies on the private secondary market - often described as "Robinhood for private markets." The business is run through the SEC-registered adviser Sandhill Markets Advisors LLC and also publishes Sandhill Report, a venture-focused newsletter covering startups, funding, and the broader VC market. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Sandhill Markets publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public identity and a live domain-security probe of its primary domain.

providers.name: Stori
providers.description: Stori is a Mexico City–headquartered fintech (operating as a regulated Sociedad Financiera Popular under CNBV and CONDUSEF oversight) on a mission to democratize credit access for the roughly 400 million underbanked consumers in Latin America. Founded in 2019, the company achieved unicorn status in 2022 and has raised over $400M from investors including GGV Capital, General Catalyst, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Goodwater Capital, Source Code Capital, Vision Plus Capital, BAI Capital, Tresalia, and GIC. Stori's flagship product is the Stori Card, an inclusive Visa credit card marketed to first-time borrowers with little or no formal credit history, alongside Stori Black (premium tier), co-branded cards (SHEIN, Farmacias Similares, sports teams), Cuenta+ (a commission-free deposit account advertising up to 15% annual returns), personal loans up to roughly $3,000 MXN-equivalent, and payment services covering bill pay, mobile recharges, and phone-based merchant collection. The platform is delivered exclusively through its iOS and Android mobile apps and serves more than five million Mexican users. Stori has no public developer API, SDK, CLI, webhook surface, or open-source release; its revenue model is interest, interchange, and fee income from consumer credit and deposit products, with operations in Mexico, Colombia, and a U.S. corporate presence in Arlington, Virginia.

providers.name: StreamLoan
providers.description: StreamLoan was a digital mortgage software company offering a point-of-sale (POS) and loan-origination platform that connected loan officers, borrowers, and real-estate agents to convert leads into funded home loans faster. Its toolkit spanned lead management, borrower communication and collaboration, workflow automation, document collection, security/privacy controls, and a branded borrower experience aimed at cutting the 40+ day mortgage close cycle. Backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company appears defunct - streamloan.io is parked on a registrar IP and every developer/app/api/docs/portal subdomain is unreachable (DNS records remain but no host responds), and no public API or developer program was ever documented.

providers.name: Stylus Medicine
providers.description: Stylus Medicine is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotechnology company developing in vivo genetic medicines built on engineered recombinases. Its platform aims to generate precise, durable CAR-T cells directly inside the body using cell-targeted lipid nanoparticle delivery to immune cells, with therapeutic programs spanning oncology, autoimmune disease, and genetic disorders. The company is a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures. It operates as a research-stage therapeutics company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Subtle Medical
providers.description: Subtle Medical is a healthcare AI company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, that develops FDA-cleared deep-learning software to enhance medical imaging. Its products — SubtleMR, SubtlePET, SubtleGAD and SubtleSYNTH — denoise, accelerate and improve MRI and PET scans, integrating into existing radiology and PACS workflows via DICOM rather than through a public developer API or REST platform. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and DCVC. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal was discoverable during enrichment; DNS/TLS domain-security posture was probed.

providers.name: Suitable
providers.description: Suitable (Suitable AI) is a talent-acquisition platform that combines AI agents with human expertise to source, screen, and vet engineering and STEM talent for GCCs, AI labs, and innovation centres. Its offering spans a database of technically screened candidates, AI resume screening, and AMPO AI, a conversational AI interviewing agent delivered as AIaaS, across engagement models including contract talent, permanent hires, and executive hiring. As of this enrichment pass Suitable publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Sumutasu
providers.description: Sumutasu Inc. (株式会社すむたす) is a Japanese property-technology (proptech) company operating under the mission "a society where people can make ideal housing choices" (住まいの理想的な選択ができる社会に). It runs an instant real-estate buying and selling service for used condominiums in Japan, using data and technology to give homeowners a fast, transparent alternative to the traditional brokerage process, alongside an agent-assisted sales offering. The company is backed by 500 Global. Its public presence is a corporate marketing website (About, Services, Members, News, and Careers) built on the Studio.Design no-code platform; no public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation surface has been found.

providers.name: Suncoast Credit Union
providers.description: Suncoast Credit Union is a state-chartered, federally insured (NCUA), member-owned not-for-profit financial cooperative headquartered in Tampa, Florida. Founded in 1934 as Hillsborough County Teachers Credit Union, it is the largest credit union in Florida and one of the largest in the United States, serving well over a million members across Florida counties with more than $17 billion in assets. It offers consumer and small-business deposit accounts, lending, cards, and digital banking through a web presence (the brand's canonical domain is now suncoast.com, with the legacy suncoastcreditunion.com 301-redirecting to it) and an online/mobile banking platform hosted on banking.suncoastcreditunion.com. As is typical for a U.S. credit union, Suncoast publishes NO first-party public developer API and operates no developer portal: no developer or api subdomain resolves for either suncoastcreditunion.com or suncoast.com. Consumer-permissioned data access is available only through third-party aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) and its digital-banking core provider rather than a direct API. There is no publicly documented Financial Data Exchange (FDX) participation and no published CFPB Section 1033 open-banking posture. This is an identity-only API Evangelist record reflecting an honest "no public API, aggregator-only" reality.

providers.name: Supercritical
providers.description: Supercritical is a London-based carbon removal marketplace founded in 2021 by Michelle You and Aaron Randall, the team behind Songkick. The company builds the market infrastructure that turns carbon dioxide removal (CDR) commitments into delivered tonnes, connecting corporate buyers with vetted suppliers of durable, engineered, and nature-engineered carbon removal. Supercritical's marketplace covers the major durable CDR pathways — biochar, BECCS, enhanced weathering, direct air capture (DAC), DAC with ocean storage, woody biomass sinking, and bio-oil — with published per-tonne pricing and live availability data. The platform layers a proprietary 118-point vetting protocol on top of supplier listings, spanning climate science, environmental impact, delivery risk, and social benefits, and reports that 84% of assessed projects fail to meet its standards. Supercritical also provides supply sourcing and creation services to originate new CDR projects, buffer-pool-based delivery-risk mitigation, and policy and science advisory work (its team advises SBTi on CDR guidance). Customers include Virgin Atlantic, The Economist Group, Rothschild & Co, XTX Markets, and Tide, with reported coverage of roughly 80% of the global durable CDR market and 1.3M tonnes contracted across 200+ corporate buyers and 600+ tracked suppliers. The business is funded by Lightspeed Venture Partners, MMC Ventures, and GreenCode Ventures. Supercritical does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source repository; transactions, supplier discovery, and pricing data are delivered through its hosted marketplace, advisor relationships, and contracted buyer accounts.

providers.name: Superluminal Medicines
providers.description: Superluminal Medicines is a drug discovery company that combines structure-based drug discovery with AI-powered computational methods and experimental validation to identify and develop small molecule therapeutics. Its pipeline targets G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) for cardiometabolic disease and obesity, including a collaboration with Eli Lilly worth up to $1.3 billion. Backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: SureWaves
providers.description: SureWaves is a broadcast-television advertising technology company that integrates linear TV with digital advertising infrastructure. It provides AI-powered spot and yield management for broadcasters and real-time, pay-for-performance campaign tooling for advertisers, and operates India's largest spot TV network — more than 20 million spots monthly across 550+ local channels reaching 490+ million households. Holder of 50+ patents, backed by Accel, with offices in Bangalore, New York, McLean, Mumbai and New Delhi. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface as of 2026-07.

providers.name: Switch
providers.description: Switch (operating as Livekick at livekick.com) is a 500 Global-backed company running a virtual fitness and yoga SaaS platform. The Livekick Serve product lets movement teachers and wellness creators deliver live and on-demand classes, videos, courses, and programs to students and communities, with subscription billing and creator tooling to grow an online audience. The public surface is a consumer/creator web and mobile application backed by an internal Django REST API; as of this enrichment pass Livekick publishes no public developer program — no developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, MCP server, or security.txt (all /.well-known and /llms.txt paths return the single-page-app shell). This profile is therefore identity-only, enriched with a probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Syremis Therapeutics
providers.description: Syremis Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Tel Aviv, Israel and Boston, Massachusetts, developing best-in-class oral small-molecule medicines for serious mental health conditions. Its neuropsychiatric pipeline is rooted in clinically validated mechanisms including muscarinic M1/M4 agonism and next-generation NMDA antagonism; lead program ST-905 is a dual M1/M4 agonist in Phase 1 for schizophrenia, with ST-901 also spun out from Clexio Biosciences. The company launched publicly in December 2025 with a $165M Series A co-led by Dexcel Pharma and Third Rock Ventures, with participation from Bain Capital Life Sciences, GV (Google Ventures), QVT, and Pictet. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV. This company publishes no public API, developer, or event surface at this time.

providers.name: Systemax
providers.description: Systemax Inc. (now operating as Global Industrial Company, NYSE: SYX) is a B2B direct marketer of industrial, maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) products in North America. The company sells storage and shelving, material handling equipment, safety products, tools, HVAC, office supplies, and thousands of other industrial products to businesses, educational organizations, and government entities through its Global Industrial brand. Systemax was founded in 1949 and rebranded its primary segment to Global Industrial in 2021.

providers.name: T. Rowe Price
providers.description: T. Rowe Price is a global asset management firm (NYSE: TROW) offering a broad range of investment management strategies and retirement solutions to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. Founded in 1937, the firm manages mutual funds, ETFs, separate accounts, and retirement plans including 401(k) services. T. Rowe Price does not offer a public REST API but provides institutional client portals, data feeds, and integrations with retirement recordkeeping platforms and open banking aggregators such as Plaid and Finicity.

providers.name: TAE Technologies
providers.description: TAE Technologies (formerly Tri Alpha Energy) is a Foothill Ranch, California fusion energy company founded in 1998, pursuing commercial fusion power using aneutronic hydrogen-boron (p-B11) fuel in an advanced beam-driven field-reversed configuration (FRC). Because the p-B11 reaction is aneutronic, TAE's approach produces virtually no neutron flux or on-site radioactive waste compared with conventional deuterium-tritium concepts. The company has built a progression of plasma machines — Sewer Pipe, CBFR-SPS, C-2, C-2U, and C-2W ("Norman") — and is constructing Copernicus in Irvine, California to demonstrate net energy gain, with Da Vinci planned as the grid-connected power-plant demonstration. TAE has raised more than USD 1.2 billion from investors including Google, Chevron, NEA, Goldman Sachs, Vulcan, Venrock, Wellcome Trust, and the Kuwait Investment Authority, and runs research collaborations with Japan's National Institute for Fusion Science (NIFS). Two operating subsidiaries commercialize spin-off technology: TAE Life Sciences develops accelerator-based Boron Neutron Capture Therapy (BNCT) systems for cancer treatment, and TAE Power Solutions builds modular, software-controlled power-management systems for e-mobility and battery applications. TAE is a private hardware and deep-science company; it does not publish a developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or public open-source code repository.

providers.name: Tally Labs
providers.description: Tally Labs is a Web3 media and entertainment company founded in 2021 and headquartered in the United States. It is best known for creating and operating Jenkins the Valet, a fictional character and NFT project built around Bored Ape Yacht Club #1798, and for the community-generative NFT novel "Bored & Dangerous," set in the fictional world of Azurbala and written with New York Times bestselling author Neil Strauss. The company builds characters, narratives, and interactive storytelling tools intended to let creators turn their imaginations into content. Tally Labs raised a $12M seed round in May 2022 led by a16z crypto. As a Web3 media/IP company it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: TapAd
providers.description: Tapad is a digital identity and cross-device graph technology company, founded in 2010 and headquartered in New York City. Its flagship product, the Tapad Graph, is a probabilistic device graph that lets marketers, agencies, and platforms recognize a brand's customer or related household across the many devices they use, powering programmatic targeting, media measurement, attribution, and personalization. Tapad was acquired by the Norwegian telecom Telenor in 2016 and then by the credit-and-data company Experian in 2020, where its cross-device graph is offered as part of Experian's marketing and identity resolution portfolio. Tapad's technology is delivered primarily as a data partnership and graph-integration offering rather than a self-service public developer API; the company does not publish an open developer portal, API reference, or SDKs. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Taysha Gene Therapies *
providers.description: Taysha Gene Therapies is a clinical-stage biotechnology company (Dallas, TX with a laboratory in Morrisville, NC) developing AAV-based gene therapies for rare monogenic diseases of the central nervous system. Its lead program, TSHA-102, targets Rett syndrome and has completed dosing in the REVEAL pivotal trial. The company operates as a therapeutics developer and publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or technical integration surface; it was surfaced as a GV portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: Team Health Holdings
providers.description: TeamHealth Holdings is one of the largest physician practice organizations in the United States, providing outsourced healthcare professional staffing and administrative services to hospitals and other healthcare providers. Through more than 15,000 affiliated healthcare professionals and advanced practice clinicians, TeamHealth offers emergency medicine, hospital medicine, critical care, anesthesiology, orthopedic surgery, general surgery, obstetrics, ambulatory care, post-acute care, and medical call center solutions to approximately 3,000 acute and post-acute facilities and physician groups nationwide. TeamHealth does not maintain a public-facing developer API.

providers.name: Teamshares
providers.description: Teamshares is a tech-enabled acquiror that buys profitable small businesses (roughly $0.5-5 million EBITDA) from retiring owners and transitions them into broad-based employee ownership, granting workers company stock over time. The company pairs acquisition capital with an operating platform, financial products, and leadership programs to keep these businesses running and growing after the founder exits. It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Teamshares publishes a marketing site, a resources/blog, and investor and careers pages, but exposes no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: TechieMatter
providers.description: TechieMatter is a tech recruitment platform that provides an all-in-one solution to source, filter, assess, interview, and onboard technical talent from around the globe. The platform spans candidate sourcing and resume screening, technical skills assessment and coding evaluations, expert-led technical interviews, and remote-worker onboarding (payroll, compliance, and legal). It serves 900+ companies across 13+ countries, sourcing candidates from 9+ countries across 60+ technical roles including software engineers, data scientists, DevOps, security, product, and hardware roles. No public API or developer platform is documented at this time; this profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network company record.

providers.name: Tekever
providers.description: Tekever is a multinational defence technology company headquartered in Lisbon, Portugal, with operations in the United Kingdom (Bath and a planned large-scale drone production facility in Swindon), France (Toulouse and Cahors), and the United States (Fayetteville, North Carolina). Founded in 2001, the company specialises in AI-driven autonomy for civil and defence missions, with its core business centred on long-endurance Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) used for Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), maritime surveillance, and electronic warfare. Its flagship platforms include the AR3, a configurable medium-range tactical UAS (designated StormShroud in service with the UK Royal Air Force), the AR5, a SATCOM-enabled long-endurance maritime and land ISR aircraft, and the ARX, a next-generation system positioned as the company's game changer. These platforms are paired with ATLAS, Tekever's real-time intelligence-as-a-service platform that fuses sensor and satellite data into actionable mission intelligence. Tekever drones are operated by the UK Ministry of Defence, the British Army, the Armed Forces of Ukraine (with the UK having committed approximately £270 million in Tekever UAVs for Ukraine since the start of the Russian invasion), the European Maritime Safety Agency under a €30 million contract, the French Ministry of Armed Forces (CNES/DGA), Portugal, and NATO. The company also develops satellite technology and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) capabilities to extend its intelligence services beyond the airborne domain. Tekever's revenue model is built on government and defence contracts, platform sales, and managed ISR-as-a-service offerings; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and engagement with the company is conducted through direct sales, government procurement, and partnership channels.

providers.name: TenSixteen Bio
providers.description: TenSixteen Bio is a San Francisco-based clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the study of somatic mosaicism and clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) to discover and develop novel therapeutics for age-related diseases including cancer and cardiovascular disease. Founded by CEO Mark Chao and launched in 2022 with a $40M Series A from Foresite Capital and GV (formerly Google Ventures), the company combines human genetics, functional genomics and next-generation-sequencing (NGS) based assays to identify CHIP-linked mutations and translate them into companion diagnostics and precision-medicine treatments. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; as a therapeutics and diagnostics company it publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: TenSixty Bio
providers.description: TenSixty Bio is an oncology-focused biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, working to revolutionize the treatment of cancer.
