The company combines biology, machine learning, and high-throughput technologies to build an atlas of antibody targets on the surface of cancer cells, discover novel cancer targets, and develop improved therapeutics from bench to bedside. TenSixty Bio is a privately held research-stage company backed by General Catalyst and Wing Venture Capital, and it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced through the API Evangelist venture-capital portfolio pipeline and enriched with verified public company identity.

providers.name: TensorFeed
providers.description: Real-time AI news, model pricing, service status, and agent activity feeds

providers.name: Thalamed
providers.description: Thalamed is a Berlin-based medical device procurement marketplace, founded in 2014, that connects healthcare providers such as clinics, private practices, and outpatient care facilities with suppliers of medical equipment including ultrasound and x-ray devices, sterilization and disinfection systems, and medical lasers. Customers describe the device they need and Thalamed's team evaluates the request and contacts the most suitable providers to deliver matching quotes, simplifying comparison and purchasing. The company is a Point Nine and RTAventures portfolio company. No public developer API, documentation, or integration surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: The Data Guild
providers.description: The Data Guild is a San Francisco-based venture studio, founded in 2013, that builds data-driven companies addressing challenges in healthcare, life sciences, renewable energy, and climate change. Steeped in machine learning, data science, and artificial intelligence, the Guild pioneers a co-creation model that converts LP capital into equity across a portfolio of new ventures while applying its own team's efforts directly rather than simply allocating capital. It brings products to market through spinouts, alongside portfolio-company teams, and with strategic partners. Investors include Bloomberg Beta, David Gutelius, and Silicon Valley Data Capital. The Data Guild operates a marketing/company website and publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or MCP surface; this profile captures its identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: The Nuclear Company
providers.description: The Nuclear Company (TNC) is a U.S.-based nuclear energy infrastructure firm deploying nuclear power at fleet scale with a "design once, build many" standardized construction approach. Through its Powerhouse Resources arm it provides maintenance, outage execution, turbine, electrical, and instrumentation services to nuclear plants nationwide, and its proprietary AI-driven Nuclear Operating System (NOS) manages deployment and operations across the nuclear lifecycle. The company publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface; this profile tracks it as an API Evangelist network company and portfolio company of True Ventures.

providers.name: Theranica
providers.description: Theranica Bio-Electronics is a digital therapeutics company developing prescription-grade wearable neuromodulation devices for prevalent neurological pain conditions. Its flagship product, Nerivio, is an FDA-authorized wireless Remote Electrical Neuromodulation (REM) device worn on the upper arm for the acute and preventive treatment of migraine, with or without aura, in patients ages 12 and up. Nerivio is controlled by a companion iOS and Android smartphone app that lets patients start treatments, adjust stimulation intensity, monitor session duration, and keep a shareable migraine diary. Theranica is a venture-backed medical device company; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Thrive Agritech
providers.description: Thrive Agritech is a horticultural lighting company that designs and manufactures high-efficiency LED grow lights and related power systems for commercial indoor farming, greenhouses, and vertical farming operations. Its product line includes fixtures such as Strata, Boost XE, and a 1050W LED grow light, along with a Remote Power System, backed by lighting design services, rebate assistance, and multi-year warranties. The company positions itself around energy efficiency, ROI, and long-term grower partnerships rather than a developer or API offering. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, this profile was enriched by probing the public web surface; no public API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: tisenc
providers.description: tisenc (天深医疗 / Tianshen Medical) is a Chinese in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) medical-device manufacturer based in Guangdong, backed by Qiming Venture Partners. The company develops chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzers and point-of-care testing (POCT) systems — its ACCRE 8, ACCRE 90, and ACCRE 120 single-sample chemiluminescence platforms and an accompanying reagent menu — together with a digital POCT management platform. It is a nationally recognized high-tech enterprise. tisenc operates a corporate marketing website only (WordPress/Qifeiye, hosted in China); as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Toll Brothers
providers.description: Toll Brothers is the nation's leading builder of luxury homes, designing, building, marketing, and arranging financing for luxury residential communities across the United States. As a Fortune 500 company and #1 Most Admired Home Builder in Fortune magazine's 2026 list, Toll Brothers operates across 60+ markets. The company does not publicly expose developer APIs. Website integrations and home search functionality are provided through the tollbrothers.com consumer platform.

providers.name: Torch Dental
providers.description: Torch Dental is a New York-based vertical-software company that builds a procurement and practice-management platform for dental practices and dental service organizations (DSOs). The platform lets dental offices order supplies across multiple vendors from a single catalog, compare prices, manage budgets and approvals, track orders and invoices, and streamline back-office purchasing. Torch Dental is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and was surfaced through that portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs; its web presence sits behind a bot-challenge wall and there is no reachable api./developers./docs. subdomain, so this profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Tradewind Markets
providers.description: Tradewind Markets is a fintech company that operates a digital platform for precious metals, using blockchain and distributed-ledger technology to enable the trading, settlement, supply-chain management, and custody of physical commodities. Its VaultChain Gold and VaultChain Silver products represent investment-grade bullion held physically at the Royal Canadian Mint, with ownership tracked on a secure distributed ledger for real-time tracking and transparent auditability. Founded in 2016 and adopted by institutions including the Royal Canadian Mint and Kitco, Tradewind was acquired by Wellfield Technologies in 2023. No public developer/API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: TRIANA Biomedicines
providers.description: TRIANA Biomedicines is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners, lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: biotech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: tripaneer
providers.description: tripaneer is an Amsterdam-based online travel company that operates a family of themed wellness and activity travel marketplaces, connecting travelers with the organizers of retreats, courses, and holidays around the world. Its brands include BookYogaRetreats.com, BookSurfCamps.com, BookMeditationRetreats.com, BookAdventureRetreats.com, BookFitnessHolidays.com, BookMartialArtsHolidays.com, and BookSailingHolidays.com, among others. Each site lets travelers discover, compare, and book multi-day experiences by theme, destination, price, and date, while giving retreat and course organizers a channel to list and sell their offerings. tripaneer was surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer travel marketplace (sitemaps for listings, organizers, and a blog) but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, OAuth/OIDC discovery, or developer-portal surface that could be found or probed.

providers.name: tripod-glp
providers.description: tripod-glp resolves to TriApex Laboratories, a next-generation pharmaceutical and biomedical contract research organization (CRO) headquartered in Nanjing, China with facilities in Shanghai, Kunming, Wenchang and Pennsylvania. TriApex provides integrated nonclinical services (safety assessment, efficacy, DMPK and research models) and clinical trial services across phases I-III, with disease expertise spanning cardiometabolic, CNS, ophthalmology, autoimmune and oncology. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, it publishes a corporate website (www.tri-apex.com) but no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Trishula Therapeutics
providers.description: Trishula Therapeutics is a privately held, clinical-stage immuno-oncology company developing cancer immunotherapies that target immune-evasion mechanisms in the tumor microenvironment. Its lead candidate, TTX-030, is a first-in-class monoclonal antibody that inhibits CD39, an enzyme in the adenosine pathway that tumors exploit to suppress anti-tumor immunity; TTX-030 has advanced into Phase 2 clinical trials, including studies in metastatic pancreatic cancer. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. It is a therapeutics company with a corporate web presence and no public API, developer, or software product surface.

providers.name: Trisk Bio
providers.description: Trisk Bio is a preclinical AAV (adeno-associated virus) manufacturing partner / CDMO that develops bespoke, scalable processes for AAV gene therapies to enable affordable preclinical manufacturing. It supplies research-grade and non-human primate (NHP) study-grade vectors across capsid serotypes and transgenes, offering custom process development, high-throughput optimisation of a single transgene against multiple capsids, and purification and supply of partials as reference material. Backed by Matrix Partners, Trisk Bio is a healthtech / biomanufacturing company; at the time of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing website but no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Truvian
providers.description: Truvian Sciences is a San Diego-based diagnostics company founded in 2015 that develops an automated, benchtop blood-testing system combining clinical chemistries, immunoassays, and hematology assays within a single instrument to deliver lab-accurate results in under 30 minutes at the point of care. The company has raised roughly $208M across multiple rounds (including a Series C) and counts General Catalyst among its backers. Truvian is a diagnostics hardware and instrument business rather than a software/API provider: its public surface centers on the analyzer device, clinical assays, and FDA clearance for its testing platform. As of this profiling it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications. This record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; there is no API surface to enrich until Truvian ships a developer program.

providers.name: TScan Therapeutics
providers.description: TScan Therapeutics (Nasdaq: TCRX) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Waltham, Massachusetts developing T-cell receptor engineered T-cell (TCR-T) therapies for the treatment of patients with cancer. The company uses a high-throughput, genome-wide target-discovery platform to identify the TCRs and antigen targets that drive T-cell recognition of tumors, building a multiplexed library of TCR-T candidates (ImmunoBank) for both hematologic malignancies and solid tumors. Lead programs TSC-100 and TSC-101 target minor histocompatibility antigens to prevent disease relapse after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant. As a therapeutics company it exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and GV.

providers.name: Uniform Teeth
providers.description: Uniform Teeth was a San Francisco clear-aligner orthodontics startup founded by Meghan Jewitt and orthodontist Dr. Kjeld Aamodt, launched in 2018, pairing licensed in-clinic orthodontists with a patient app — positioned between traditional orthodontics and direct-to-consumer aligners. Canaan Partners led its $10M Series A. On August 5, 2022 it was acquired by (merged with) Barcelona-based Impress (smile2impress.com) to build a worldwide network of invisible-orthodontic clinics. The company published no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, and uniformteeth.com no longer serves a site (stale Netlify deployment returning 404); this API Evangelist profile records its identity and domain posture.

providers.name: Urantia Papers
providers.description: Full-text + semantic search across the Urantia Papers, with audio narration, entities, translations

providers.name: Verge Labs
providers.description: Verge Labs (formerly Verge Genomics) is a frontier AI company applying machine learning to human biology, building an AI system designed to reason about neurological disease at the patient level. Its stated goal is a "virtual biopsy of the brain" — a reconstructed picture of what is happening inside a patient's brain generated from a routine blood draw. The company built proprietary genomic datasets from human brain tissue for neurodegenerative diseases such as ALS and Parkinson's, and after an early ALS clinical program refocused on AI methods for matching brain therapeutics to the patients most likely to benefit. Verge is a research-stage biotech/AI company backed by Threshold Ventures and other venture investors; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal.

providers.name: Verobioscience
providers.description: Vero Bioscience measures biological age at the organ level using advanced proteomics and machine learning. Its OrganAge test analyzes thousands of proteins from a single blood draw to detect the earliest molecular signs of organ-specific aging, enabling targeted interventions to slow or reverse the aging process. The company is a Khosla Ventures-backed longevity and diagnostics startup whose work has been published in Nature and Nature Medicine. As of this enrichment pass Vero Bioscience operates a consumer waitlist and partnership program and exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Verra
providers.description: Verra is a Washington, D.C.-based nonprofit standards body that develops and manages the world's leading certification programs for climate action and sustainable development. Its flagship program, the Verified Carbon Standard (VCS), is the most widely used voluntary greenhouse gas crediting program globally, with more than 2,579 registered projects across 132+ countries and over 1.3 billion Verified Carbon Units (VCUs) issued. Verra also operates the Climate, Community & Biodiversity Standards (CCB), the Sustainable Development Verified Impact Standard (SD VISta), the Plastic Waste Reduction Standard (PWRP), the Scope 3 Standard Program, and the Jurisdictional and Nested REDD+ (JNR) framework. The Verra Registry at registry.verra.org is the system of record for projects, methodologies, issuances, retirements, and the AFOLU pooled buffer account across these programs; project documentation, public comment periods, and credit-lifecycle records are all surfaced through that registry. Verra recently launched VCS Version 5, modernizing program operations, strengthening safeguards, and clarifying credit rights. Verra does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or GitHub organization; programmatic data access is limited to the registry's web interface and filtered report exports, and there is no open-source code or machine-readable spec catalog associated with the organization.

providers.name: Vertosmed
providers.description: Vertos Medical (vertosmed.com) is a medical device company founded in 2005 and based in Aliso Viejo, California, focused on minimally invasive treatments for lumbar spinal stenosis (LSS). Its proprietary Mild (Minimally Invasive Lumbar Decompression) procedure is an image-guided outpatient treatment that removes a major root cause of LSS through an incision smaller than a baby aspirin, without implants, general anesthesia, or stitches. Vertos Medical was acquired by Stryker Corporation in 2024 and is now part of Stryker's Interventional Spine business; vertosmed.com now redirects to stryker.com. As a clinical medical-device manufacturer, Vertos Medical publishes no public developer, API, SDK, or integration surface.

providers.name: Verve Therapeutics
providers.description: Verve Therapeutics is a Boston-based clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a pipeline of in vivo gene editing medicines designed to treat cardiovascular disease with a single, one-time treatment. Its programs use base editing and CRISPR technology to durably switch off disease-driving genes, led by VERVE-102 (targeting PCSK9 to lower LDL cholesterol), alongside VERVE-201 (ANGPTL3) and VERVE-301 (LPA). Verve was acquired by Eli Lilly in July 2025 in a deal worth up to $1.3 billion. As a therapeutics/research company it publishes no public developer API; this profile is maintained as a company identity record in the API Evangelist network. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of GV.

providers.name: Vicinitas Therapeutics
providers.description: Vicinitas Therapeutics is a biotechnology company surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. It operates in the therapeutics and drug-discovery space (vicinitastx.com) and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface. This profile records what is verifiable about the company and remains a lead awaiting any future API footprint.

providers.name: VideaHealth
providers.description: VideaHealth (VideaAI) is an FDA-cleared dental artificial intelligence platform that analyzes dental radiographs to detect clinical findings such as caries, bone loss, calculus, and periapical lesions, and to surface aligner and implant treatment opportunities. VideaAI runs as ambient, chairside AI embedded directly inside dental practice-management and imaging systems (Dentrix, Denticon, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, Carestream, Dexis, Apteryx XVWeb, and others) - as soon as an X-ray is captured, the platform analyzes it and returns findings in the tools clinicians already use. Its detection, findings, study, and integration capabilities are delivered through partner-gated, embedded integrations rather than a public, self-serve developer API; there is no publicly documented REST API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI definition as of this writing.

providers.name: VINNO
providers.description: VINNO Corporation (飞依诺科技股份有限公司) is a Chinese medical device manufacturer, headquartered in Suzhou, that develops and produces digital color ultrasound (Doppler) imaging systems — cart-based, portable, and handheld/pocket devices — for clinical diagnostics and research. Product lines include the ULTIMUS and VINNO R-series ultrasound platforms plus Stream-series CPAP respiratory devices, built on proprietary soft beamforming and ultra-high-resolution micro-vascular imaging technology, with remote-diagnostic center and support services across 50+ countries. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As of enrichment the company publishes no public API, SDK, or developer surface (medical-device hardware manufacturer).

providers.name: Vir Biotechnology
providers.description: Vir Biotechnology is a clinical-stage immunology company that engineers antibodies into medicines targeting serious infectious diseases and cancer. Its programs span chronic hepatitis delta, hepatitis B, oncology, and prior work on COVID-19 and Ebola, built on a next-generation antibody platform and the licensed PRO-XTEN protease-releasable masking technology. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network. This is a corporate/investor-facing life-sciences company; enrichment probes found no public developer, API, or partner-integration surface.

providers.name: Visterra
providers.description: Visterra is a Waltham, Massachusetts biologics research company developing antibody-based therapeutics for patients with immune-mediated and other difficult-to-treat diseases. It combines computational design, artificial intelligence, and experimental research with agile preclinical development and manufacturing. Visterra publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company tracking and enrichment.

providers.name: Vitara Biomedical
providers.description: Vitara Biomedical is a medical technology company developing EXTEND, a fluid-filled extra-uterine environment designed to protect the fragile lungs and vital organs of extremely premature newborns born before 24 weeks of gestation, delaying the stress of early air exposure for up to 28 days while their lungs and other organs continue to develop. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV in the life-sciences sector. The company is pre-market (no FDA clearance) and does not currently publish any public API, SDK, developer portal, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Volt14
providers.description: Volt14 Solutions Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based deep-tech startup developing silicon-majority anode materials for lithium-ion batteries. Its fully integrated, tunable, and ready-to-use anodes replace conventional graphite to deliver large gains in energy density and lower normalized cell cost, while remaining compatible with existing battery cell manufacturing infrastructure. Target application markets include electric vehicles, consumer electronics, appliances, and power tools. The company is a materials-science and battery-technology producer; it publishes a corporate and careers website but exposes no public developer or API product surface. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Vyne
providers.description: Vyne was a London-based account-to-account (A2A) open banking payments platform, founded in 2019. It offered merchants real-time pay-by-bank payments, instant refunds, no-code payment links and verified payouts, built on open banking rails and real-time ACH networks with in-app biometric SCA across the UK and Europe. Vyne served retail, financial services and automotive merchants and won Best Open Banking Payments Project at the Open Banking Expo Awards 2023. In September 2024 Vyne was acquired by Dubai-based open banking platform Tarabut, and it wound down its UK operations effective 22 April 2025. The payvyne.com domain has since been repurposed to an unrelated site, and Vyne no longer operates a public developer portal, API reference or OpenAPI surface. This profile is retained as a historical record; there is no live API to enrich.

providers.name: Waltz Health
providers.description: Waltz Health is a Chicago-based digital health company founded in 2021 by Mark Thierer (former CEO of OptumRx and Catamaran) and Jonathon Thierer, building AI-driven prescription drug pricing marketplaces that help consumers, payers, pharmacy benefit managers, pharmacies, and self-insured employers make better-informed, lower-cost decisions on prescription care. Its Marketplace Search product is a multi-card search engine that compares medication prices across every major discount and savings program, and Waltz Connect is an end-to-end solution that lowers the cost of specialty medications through a network of national and regional specialty pharmacies that compete on price and clinical outcomes. The company raised a $35M Series A led by GV and, in August 2025, merged with EVERSANA to form a combined pharmaceutical commercialization and drug-access platform, with Mark Thierer appointed CEO of EVERSANA. Waltz Health has no public developer API program; this profile captures company identity and live domain-security posture.

providers.name: Wave Therapeutics
providers.description: Wave Therapeutics is a healthtech medical-device company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Nashville, Indiana, and backed by Techstars (Future of Longevity). It develops active therapeutic cushioning that helps prevent pressure injuries (bedsores) and reduce blood-clot risk, led by a microprocessor-controlled peristaltic-pump wheelchair cushion paired with monitoring analytics, with a planned fleet of products spanning mattress toppers and consumer seating. Wave Therapeutics is a hardware and clinical-device business and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline, which confirmed no API surface exists.

providers.name: Wayve
providers.description: Wayve is a London-based embodied AI company pioneering AV2.0, an end-to-end, mapless, vehicle-agnostic approach to autonomous driving built on large-scale self-supervised learning rather than hand-engineered HD maps and rule stacks. Wayve's core technology stack includes the Wayve AI Driver (the production driving stack licensed to automakers), GAIA generative world models that synthesize realistic driving video from text and serve as simulators for policy training, and LINGO, a vision-language-action research line that uses natural language to train and explain driving decisions. Backed by SoftBank, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Uber with a 1.5 billion USD funding round, Wayve is partnering with Nissan, Mercedes-Benz, and Stellantis on production programmes, and with Uber and Nissan on a Tokyo robotaxi launch. Wayve does not publish a public developer API; its public surface is research, press, and product positioning material.

providers.name: Welltok
providers.description: Welltok is a data-driven, enterprise SaaS company that delivers a healthcare consumer activation platform for health plans, employers, providers, and public entities, using data, analytics, and personalized outreach to guide individuals to health actions. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and emergence-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Welltok publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; its public web presence is a marketing and consumer-notice site.

providers.name: Western Midstream Partners
providers.description: Western Midstream Partners (WES) is a midstream energy company that owns and operates oil, natural gas, and water gathering systems, natural gas processing plants, oil treating facilities, and crude oil, natural gas, and NGLs pipelines. The company operates primarily in the Delaware Basin and DJ Basin, handling the transportation and processing of hydrocarbons and produced water.

providers.name: X-energy
providers.description: X-energy is an advanced nuclear reactor and fuel company headquartered in Rockville, Maryland, founded in 2009 by Dr. Kam Ghaffarian. The company's flagship product is the Xe-100, an 80 MWe (320 MWe four-pack) high-temperature gas-cooled small modular reactor (SMR) using helium coolant and TRISO-X pebble fuel, designed to deliver both electricity and high-temperature process steam to industrial customers. X-energy's fuel subsidiary, TRISO-X, is building a commercial TRISO fuel fabrication facility in Oak Ridge, Tennessee. Project pipeline includes a four-unit Xe-100 plant for Dow Chemical at Seadrift, Texas (NRC environmental assessment completed May 2026, the first US advanced reactor environmental review to be completed), a 12-unit Xe-100 deployment with Energy Northwest at the Tri-Cities, Washington site, a collaboration with Amazon Web Services for data-center power, a feasibility study with LG&E and KU in Kentucky, work with Ontario Power Generation in Canada, and selection under the US Department of Energy's Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program (ARDP). X-energy is led by CEO J. Clay Sell and Chairman/founder Dr. Kam Ghaffarian. Investors include Amazon (Climate Pledge Fund), Ares Management, Citadel, Segra Capital Management, Jane Street, Ken Griffin, the University of Michigan, and others. X-energy completed an upsized IPO on Nasdaq in April 2026. The company does not publish a public developer API or SDK.

providers.name: xiaoniaokuaiyan
providers.description: Xiaoniaokuaiyan (小鸟快验) is an in-home health-checkup and blood-testing service brand operated by Beijing Cloud Artery Health Management Co., Ltd (北京云动脉健康管理有限公司), a Qiming-backed internet-healthcare startup based in Chaoyang, Beijing. It offers on-demand at-home sample collection by licensed nurses with results processed by nationally accredited laboratories, spanning routine checkups, tumor screening, infection testing, chronic-disease monitoring, and custom corporate and family panels. The company operates via its consumer website, WeChat official account, and mobile apps; it publishes no public developer portal, documentation, or API surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Qiming portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; the honest result is that no public API artifacts exist to harvest.

providers.name: Xilis
providers.description: Xilis is a life-sciences / precision-oncology company developing patient-derived MicroOrganoSphere (MOS) technology to model a patient's tumor outside the body for functional drug testing and drug discovery. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment probes found a marketing website only (SiteGround-hosted, bot-protection returns HTTP 403) with no public developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or API surface of any kind.

providers.name: YOU-app
providers.description: YOU-app was a mobile wellbeing application built by Fifth Corner (Helsinki, Finland) that delivered daily "micro-actions" across food, mindfulness, movement, and mental wellbeing, blending social-media style photo sharing with habit-building and originally aligned to the UN Sustainable Development Goals. The company was acquired and is no longer operated as an independent product; the you-app.com domain now 302-redirects to Hintsa Performance (hintsa.com). No public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable specification was found during enrichment — this remains a consumer-app profile with no developer surface to catalog.

providers.name: Zarminali Health
providers.description: Zarminali Health (Zarminali Pediatrics) is a pediatric healthcare provider building a new standard for children's care through purpose-built clinics that support families from newborn care through young adulthood. Its services span primary care, urgent care, telehealth, and specialty pediatric care, with clinics expanding across Michigan, Minnesota, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Wisconsin, and Tennessee. Patient access is delivered through an AthenaHealth patient portal rather than a public developer platform. As a clinical care delivery organization, Zarminali Health publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or machine-readable developer surface at this time. It was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; this enrichment pass confirmed there is currently no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: zeenhealth
providers.description: zeenhealth is a health company surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Its public web and API surface (zeenhealth.com, zeenhealth.cn, api.zeenhealth.com) is hosted on Chinese cloud infrastructure (Tencent Cloud, with Feishu/Lark email) and was not reachable from the enrichment environment, so no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documentation could be harvested this pass. This profile remains a lead awaiting a reachable developer surface.

providers.name: Zenasbio
providers.description: Zenas BioPharma is a global clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and delivering transformative treatments for patients with autoimmune and rare diseases. Its lead candidates are obexelimab, a bifunctional monoclonal antibody that inhibits B-cell activity without depleting B cells, and orelabrutinib, an oral central-nervous-system-penetrant BTK inhibitor. The company serves patients, caregivers, investors, and job seekers through its corporate website; it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDKs, or technical integration surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: Zepto
providers.description: Zepto (Zepto Marketplace Private Limited) is an Indian quick-commerce grocery delivery company founded in 2021 that delivers groceries, fresh fruits and vegetables, meat, pet care, beauty and household products "in minutes" from a network of dark stores across major Indian cities. It operates a consumer-facing mobile app and website (zepto.com, formerly zeptonow.com) and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its partner-facing surfaces are limited to merchant onboarding (Sell on Zepto / brands.zepto.co.in), delivery-partner and franchise programs. Backed by General Catalyst, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Zetwerk
providers.description: Zetwerk is a global contract-manufacturing and B2B supply-chain company that connects original equipment manufacturers with a vetted network of manufacturing partners across processes including CNC machining, die casting, forging, injection molding, and sheet-metal stamping. It serves industries such as aerospace and defense, automotive, consumer electronics, renewable energy, and industrial equipment, offering production sourcing, quoting, and program management. Backed by Accel, D1 Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Lightspeed Venture Partners, Zetwerk operates as a manufacturing services marketplace rather than a developer platform: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: zhaohu365
providers.description: zhaohu365 (福寿康 / Fushou Kang) is a professional home-based elderly-care brand in China providing in-home nursing, rehabilitation, and long-term care services for aging populations through a network of community care stations and home-care teams. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer healthcare-services provider, it does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or documentation surface; this profile carries the identity and domain-security posture captured by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: AdaptHealth
providers.description: AdaptHealth is a national provider of home medical equipment, supplies, and related services in the United States. The company supports patients with sleep therapy, respiratory care, diabetes care, mobility, and other home medical needs through a network of locations and partnerships with healthcare providers and insurers. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Atkore
providers.description: Atkore is a manufacturer of electrical conduit, cable management systems, metal framing, and other safety and infrastructure products used in commercial, industrial, and residential construction. The company offers several end-user technical tools, including the Atkore BIM Toolbar (a Revit plugin), Atkore Virtual 3D, and an online Hanger Configurator, but does not expose a public REST API or self-service developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Cano Health
providers.description: Cano Health is a primary care provider focused on delivering value-based care to seniors and underserved communities, primarily through Medicare Advantage. The company operates medical centers offering primary care, wellness, pediatrics, and other services with an emphasis on preventive care and chronic disease management. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Genesis Energy
providers.description: Genesis Energy is a diversified midstream energy master limited partnership with a focus on providing services to refineries, crude oil and natural gas producers, and industrial and commercial enterprises.

providers.name: Halliburton
providers.description: Halliburton delivers advanced products and services to meet the evolving needs of the global energy industry, driving innovation, reliability, and performance. Halliburton operates enterprise software platforms such as DecisionSpace 365, Landmark, and iEnergy, but does not currently publish a public, openly accessible REST API for general developer use.

providers.name: ISO Standard
providers.description: ISO Standards are internationally agreed-upon standards developed by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) to ensure quality, safety, and efficiency across products, services, and systems worldwide. ISO standards cover a wide range of domains including technology, healthcare, manufacturing, and environmental management.

providers.name: MRC Global
providers.description: MRC Global is the largest global distributor of pipe, valve, and fitting products and services to the energy and industrial markets.

providers.name: NOV
providers.description: NOV is a Fortune 500 company providing equipment and components used in oil and gas drilling and production operations, oilfield services, and industrial and renewable energy sectors. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for NOV.

providers.name: PACS Group
providers.description: PACS Group, Inc. is a leading post-acute care company that operates skilled nursing and senior living facilities across the United States. The company provides short-term post-acute, rehabilitation, supportive care, and long-term care services through its network of facilities. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: PennyMac Financial Services
providers.description: PennyMac Financial Services, Inc. is a specialty financial services firm focused on the production and servicing of U.S. residential mortgage loans. The company is one of the largest mortgage lenders and servicers in the United States, providing financing to homebuyers and refinancing to existing homeowners. PennyMac operates through correspondent, consumer direct, and broker channels.

providers.name: Webster Financial
providers.description: Webster Financial Corporation (NYSE:WBS) is a regional financial services company that delivers banking and financial solutions to businesses and individuals. The organization operates three business divisions - Commercial Banking, Consumer Banking, and Healthcare Financial Services - and manages over $75 billion in assets. Webster Financial does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Clara
providers.description: Clara is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global, general-catalyst, ggv-capital, iconiq-capital, techstars and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Genworth Financial
providers.description: Genworth Financial is a Fortune 500 insurance holding company providing long-term care insurance, life insurance, annuities, and mortgage insurance products primarily in the United States.

providers.name: Henkel
providers.description: A German multinational company operating in adhesives, beauty care, and laundry and home care markets. Produces well-known consumer brands alongside industrial adhesive technologies used worldwide. No public developer API or developer portal was located; Henkel operates a Safety Data Sheets product portal at mysds.henkel.com but does not publish open developer APIs.

providers.name: Lockheed Martin
providers.description: Lockheed Martin is a leading global security, defense, and aerospace contractor. This repository captures the public APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts where they exist for Lockheed Martin.

providers.name: Merck
providers.description: At Merck, we're following the science to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. Get a glimpse of how we work to improve lives. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified for Merck.

providers.name: National Football League
providers.description: The National Football League (NFL) is the premier professional American football league, comprised of 32 franchises divided between the AFC and NFC conferences. The NFL produces the Super Bowl and is the most-watched sports league in the United States. The league does not operate a public developer portal; statistical and play-by-play data feeds are licensed to partners (notably AWS, Amazon Web Services Next Gen Stats, Sportradar, and Genius Sports) and are not offered as a self-serve developer API.

providers.name: NewLimit
providers.description: NewLimit is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of kleiner-perkins and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Parexel International
providers.description: Parexel International is one of the largest global biopharmaceutical services companies in the world, providing services that help clients accelerate the discovery and development of new therapies. No public developer API has been documented at this time.

providers.name: Pulse Charter Connect
providers.description: Pulse Charter Connect is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of techstars and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: quickpic
providers.description: quickpic is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Scrum
providers.description: Scrum is an agile project management framework that organizes work into fixed-length iterations called sprints, typically lasting two to four weeks. It defines clear roles (Product Owner, Scrum Master, Developers) and ceremonies (sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives) to enable teams to deliver value incrementally and continuously improve.

providers.name: SecOps
providers.description: Security Operations - the practice of integrating security practices into IT operations to identify, manage, and respond to security threats and vulnerabilities in real-time while maintaining system performance and availability. It plays a critical role in protecting organizational assets and maintaining a strong security posture.

providers.name: Secure Software Development Life Cycle
providers.description: A framework that integrates security practices and considerations into every phase of the software development process, from initial design through deployment and maintenance, to minimize vulnerabilities and ensure secure applications. It is used across a range of industries and technical contexts to improve efficiency and outcomes.

providers.name: Secure Software Development Lifecycle
providers.description: A framework that integrates security practices into every phase of the software development process, from design and development through testing and deployment, to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities early. It is widely adopted across industries to safeguard digital assets and reduce security risks.

providers.name: Secure-By-Default
providers.description: A security design principle where systems and software are configured with the most secure settings from the initial deployment, requiring users to explicitly opt-in to less secure options rather than having to manually enable security features. It plays a critical role in protecting organizational assets and maintaining a strong security posture.

providers.name: Service Oriented Architecture
providers.description: An architectural pattern where software components provide services to other components through a communication protocol over a network. Services are loosely coupled, reusable, and can be independently deployed and maintained.

providers.name: Entegris
providers.description: Entegris is a global supplier of advanced materials and process solutions for the semiconductor and other high-technology industries. The company develops and manufactures specialty chemicals, gases, filtration and purification systems, advanced materials handling, and process control products. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified at the corporate level; technical integration is typically supported through sales engineering, the supplier portal, and product documentation.

providers.name: Grainger
providers.description: W.W. Grainger, Inc. is a Fortune 500 industrial supply company headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois. Grainger distributes maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) products and services to businesses, government agencies, and institutions across North America, Japan, and the United Kingdom. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Grainger. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Office of Inspector General
providers.description: The Office of Inspector General (OIG) conducts audits, investigations, inspections, and other reviews to promote economy and efficiency in government programs and operations, and to prevent and detect fraud, waste, and abuse.

providers.name: Olea
providers.description: Olea is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: government. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Warner Brothers
providers.description: A major American film and entertainment studio producing movies, television shows, and interactive entertainment. Part of Warner Bros. Discovery operating across theatrical, streaming, and gaming platforms.

providers.name: &Volume
providers.description: &Volume is an AI-powered risk management platform for digital assets, built for institutional investors such as family offices, asset managers, and corporate treasuries. The platform normalizes data across exchanges, custodians, protocols, and strategies, then monitors risk in real time, compares uncorrelated yield and arbitrage opportunities, and rebalances capital among them with varying levels of AI-assisted automation. It connects to major exchanges (Binance, Coinbase), custody providers (Fireblocks, BitGo, Copper), protocols (Aave, Lido, Uniswap), and wallets (MetaMask, Ledger, Safe). Founded by a team drawn from Deutsche Bank, BNP Paribas, Jane Street, and EPAM, &Volume partners with the University of Edinburgh AI Laboratory and the LUMI supercomputer to build explainable, testable AI for capital orchestration as global assets move on-chain. Backed by 500 Global. No public API or developer program is published at this time.

providers.name: .cursorrules
providers.description: .cursorrules is a project-level configuration file used by the Cursor AI code editor to define custom rules, coding conventions, and behavioral instructions that shape how the editor's AI assistant generates and edits code. The file is placed in the root of a repository and is read automatically by Cursor when the project is opened, giving teams a way to enforce architectural patterns, style guides, framework conventions, and tooling preferences across all AI-generated code. The format is intentionally flexible - rules are typically written in plain Markdown or natural language and may include sections describing project structure, technology stack, naming conventions, testing requirements, and out-of-scope behaviors. Cursor has since extended the concept with .cursor/rules/ directories of multiple scoped rule files, but the original .cursorrules file remains widely used and supported.

providers.name: .Prompt.md
providers.description: Reusable prompt template files for AI coding assistants, defining task-specific instructions that can be executed from chat interfaces. Used for standardizing common development tasks like code review, refactoring, and test generation.

providers.name: /dev/agents
providers.description: /dev/agents (homepage sdsa.ai) is building a next-generation operating system for AI agents - a cloud platform, developer tools, and new UI primitives meant to let autonomous agents coordinate work across a user's apps and devices instead of people navigating individual applications. It was founded in 2024 by David Singleton (former Stripe CTO and Google Android VP of Engineering), Hugo Barra, Ficus Kirkpatrick, and Nicholas Jitkoff, and raised a $56M seed round at a $500M valuation led by Index Ventures with CapitalG and Conviction. As of this profile the company is pre-launch: it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation yet, so this API Evangelist entry captures verified company identity and domain posture only.

providers.name: 01 Advisors
providers.description: 01 Advisors (01A) is an early-growth venture capital and advisory firm founded in 2018 by former Twitter CEO Dick Costolo and former Twitter COO Adam Bain, with former Facebook Chief Revenue Officer David Fischer as a third general partner. Headquartered in San Francisco with a New York office, the firm positions itself as "venture coaches" that deliberately avoid taking board seats, focusing on Series B companies with product-market fit that need help building professional sales organizations and revenue operations. It manages roughly $920M across multiple funds. Added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-capital portfolio lead surfaced via foundry-group; the firm runs a corporate marketing website (Squarespace) and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface.

providers.name: 1 Mainstream
providers.description: 1 Mainstream was a cloud-based OTT (over-the-top) video streaming platform for content owners and distributors, enabling operators to launch live and on-demand video services across connected devices including iOS, Android, Roku, Amazon Fire TV, Chromecast, game consoles, smart TVs, and Apple TV, with DRM (Widevine, PlayReady), multi-CDN control, subscriber management, entitlements, and a CMS-based analytics engine. Backed by Sky and DCM Ventures, the company was acquired by Cisco in October 2015 and folded into Cisco's Infinite Video suite of cloud-powered video entertainment solutions. The standalone 1mainstream.com domain no longer resolves; this profile is retained as a historical portfolio-lead record.

providers.name: 10 Percent
providers.description: 10 Percent is a two-sided agricultural marketplace with embedded financial services, a Speedinvest portfolio company (invested ~2020) operating in the agri-fintech and marketplaces space. Public sources describe it combining agricultural supply-chain e-commerce, grain procurement, and business-intelligence services with embedded financing such as factoring and credit offered inside transactions to help agricultural partners manage cash flow and access capital. It was surfaced as a Speedinvest portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment searched the public web and found no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface, so no API artifacts could be harvested. This profile remains an identity-only lead pending a discoverable API.

providers.name: 12 Gigs
providers.description: 12 Gigs, Inc. — later operating as Super Lucky Casino Inc. and renamed Super Free Games, Inc. — was a San Francisco-based mobile game developer founded in 2011. The studio began in social casino games (Super Lucky Casino) before pivoting to casual and word titles such as Word Collect, Word Nut and Trivia Star. It was acquired by Stillfront Group in December 2020 for approximately USD 150 million upfront and now operates as a Stillfront studio; its former superluckycasino.com domain now redirects to stillfront.com. The company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK.

providers.name: 13th Lab
providers.description: 13th Lab was a Stockholm-based computer vision startup founded in 2012 that built SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) technology for mobile devices, letting phones detect and track 2D and 3D objects through the camera in real time. Its products included the PointCloud iOS SDK, the PointCloud library, and the Minecraft Reality app. Backed by Creandum, GP Bullhound, and angel investor Gustav Soderstrom, the company was acquired by Oculus VR (Facebook) in December 2014 for a reported SEK 195M (~$25M), where its team went on to develop standalone inside-out tracking for VR headsets (Oculus Insight). 13th Lab no longer operates as an independent company and publishes no live website, developer portal, or API surface; this profile is retained as a historical identity record.

providers.description: A simple URL shortener

providers.name: 24/7 Real Media
providers.description: 24/7 Real Media was a New York digital advertising technology and media company formed when 24/7 Media merged with Real Media in 2001, acquiring the Open AdStream publisher ad server. Venture-backed (Trinity Ventures, Zero Stage Capital) before its NASDAQ listing, it was acquired by WPP Group in July 2007 for approximately $649 million ($11.75 per share) and run inside WPP Digital. The business was renamed 24/7 Media, then merged into WPP's programmatic arm Xaxis in January 2014, retiring the 24/7 brand; Open AdStream was rebranded Xaxis for Publishers and sold to AppNexus later that year. Xaxis itself was sunset into GroupM Nexus in January 2024. The company is defunct: it operates no website, developer portal, or public API surface today.

providers.name: 2duche
providers.description: 2Duche was a Chinese used-car marketing and trading service platform, backed by Qiming Venture Partners and recognized on the Red Herring Asia 100 in 2009. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass the company appears defunct — the apex domain 2duche.com does not resolve and www.2duche.com is unreachable, with no discoverable developer portal, API, documentation, SDKs, or public code repositories. No API artifacts could be produced without fabrication.

providers.name: 2nd Address
providers.description: 2nd Address (formerly Homesuite) was a Palo Alto, California online marketplace for monthly furnished rentals and corporate housing aimed at business travelers, relocating professionals, and corporate clients. Founded in 2014 and launched in 2015 as Homesuite, it rebranded to 2nd Address in November 2017. Operating as a licensed real estate broker, it listed thousands of furnished homes for extended, month-to-month stays across major U.S. cities, positioning itself against vacation- rental platforms by focusing on longer corporate stays. It raised venture funding from Battery Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, Foundation Capital, and Google Ventures. The company never published a public API or developer program, and its website (2ndaddress.com) is no longer operational, so this profile is an identity record with no API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: 3com
providers.description: 3Com Corporation was a networking-technology pioneer founded in 1979 by Robert Metcalfe, the co-inventor of Ethernet, and colleagues; its name derived from "Computer, Communication, and Compatibility." 3Com built Ethernet network interface cards, switches, routers, and enterprise networking and security hardware, and at one point owned the Palm handheld computing business. An early Mayfield Fund portfolio investment (seed participation in 1981, alongside NEA, Venrock, and Sequoia), 3Com later operated the 3Com, H3C, and TippingPoint brands before being acquired by Hewlett-Packard in 2010 for roughly $2.7 billion, after which the standalone brand was wound down. This record is a historical company profile; 3Com no longer operates an independent developer portal, public API, or live product surface (the 3com.com domain now serves a placeholder page).

providers.name: 3VR
providers.description: 3VR, Inc. was a San Francisco-based video intelligence and video surveillance analytics company founded in 2005 and backed by Kleiner Perkins among others. Its VisionPoint VMS and Video Intelligence Platform combined video management with search-driven analytics including facial recognition, license plate recognition, object tracking, dwell/loitering detection, people counting, queue management, and forensic video search across IP, analog, and megapixel cameras, with an open architecture for third-party integration into POS, access control, and alarm systems. 3VR was acquired by Identiv in 2018 (approximately $6.9M) and folded into Identiv's Hirsch physical access control platform; Identiv's physical security business, including the 3VR line, was subsequently divested to Vitaprotech in 2024. The 3vr.com domain now redirects to Hirsch/Identiv support and no public developer API is documented.

providers.name: 41st Parameter
providers.description: The 41st Parameter, Inc. was a device-identification and web-fraud-detection company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Silicon Valley, with offices in Arizona, the UK, and Tokyo. Its device intelligence technology reduced fraud detection false positives for use cases such as new-account fraud, card-not-present (CNP) online transaction risk scoring, and account-takeover protection. Experian acquired the company in October 2013 and folded its device-recognition technology into Experian's global web-fraud and risk-based identity-authentication portfolio (FraudNet). 41st Parameter no longer operates as a standalone entity and publishes no independent developer portal, API, or documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of kleiner-perkins and retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical record.

providers.name: 42Floors
providers.description: 42Floors was a commercial real estate (CRE) search engine that made it easy to search for office space, coworking, and commercial listings across major U.S. markets. Founded in 2011 and part of Y Combinator's Winter 2012 batch, it was backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and other investors and grew a nationwide catalog of hundreds of thousands of listings. The company was acquired by flexible-office provider Knotel in July 2018, and later by real estate software company Yardi in 2021, which folded the 42Floors listing service into its CommercialEdge network of marketplaces (CommercialCafe, CommercialSearch, Point2, PropertyShark). 42Floors no longer operates as an independent brand: its 42floors.com domain now redirects to commercialcafe.com, and it exposes no public developer program, API, or documentation. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio-company lead with no active API surface to enrich.

providers.name: 555 Comic
providers.description: 555 Comic is an interactive storytelling and virtual-influencer studio founded by Ben Watanabe. It runs casts of anime-styled virtual characters — such as @CRC_Luna — who publish real-time alternate-reality-game (ARG) stories across TikTok, Twitter/X and Instagram, letting fans create original characters (OCs) and interact with official storylines across four interconnected fictional worlds: Conspiracy Research Club, All Night Arcade, The Convenience Store, and a Paranormal Research Club. Stories unfold in real time on "Poppy-valley Standard Time," with fans participating through social comments. 555 Comic is a Techstars Music portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and a domain-security probe of its web host.

providers.name: 5Nine Software
providers.description: 5nine Software, Inc. was a US-based cybersecurity and cloud-management company that built the leading management and security platform for Microsoft Hyper-V and Microsoft Azure environments, letting managed service providers monitor and manage on-premises Hyper-V clusters and Azure instances from a single console. The company was backed by Insight Partners and was acquired by Acronis in December 2019, after which its technology was folded into the Acronis Cyber Platform and is now offered as Acronis Cloud Manager. 5nine no longer operates as an independent vendor: its domain (5nine.com) permanently redirects to the Acronis Cloud Manager product page and it publishes no standalone developer portal, API, or SDKs.

providers.name: 6 River Systems
providers.description: 6 River Systems is a warehouse fulfillment robotics company founded in 2015 in Waltham, Massachusetts by former Kiva Systems leaders Rylan Hamilton, Jerome Dubois, and CTO Chris Cacioppo. Its flagship product is "Chuck," a collaborative autonomous mobile robot (AMR) that works alongside human associates to guide and accelerate order picking, replenishment, and sortation in ecommerce and retail warehouses. The 6RS platform is a cloud-based execution layer that sits on top of a customer's WMS/ERP and exposes a RESTful JSON/HTTPS integration API for order, task, and operational-data exchange rather than a public self-serve developer portal. Shopify acquired 6 River Systems in 2019 for roughly $450M; Ocado Group acquired it from Shopify in May 2023, and the technology now sits within Ocado Intelligent Automation (Ocado Mobile Robot System / OMRS). Chuck has been deployed across 100-plus warehouses for 70-plus customers. Added to the API Evangelist network as a menlo-ventures portfolio lead.

providers.name: 6 Wunderkinder
providers.description: 6 Wunderkinder (6Wunderkinder GmbH) was a Berlin-based software startup founded in 2010 that built Wunderlist, a popular cross-platform to-do list and task management application. The company shipped a public REST API for Wunderlist in 2013, along with webhooks and integrations such as Slack and Sunrise, and rebuilt its backend into roughly 60 microservices behind a single unified API. Backed by Earlybird and Sequoia Capital, 6 Wunderkinder was acquired by Microsoft in June 2015 for a reported US$100-200M. Microsoft folded the product into Microsoft To Do and discontinued Wunderlist on 6 May 2020. This profile is retained as a historical record; the company is defunct and publishes no live API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: 60dB
providers.description: 60dB was a personalized short-form audio and podcast application built by Tiny Garage Labs, founded in 2016 by John Ciancutti, Steve Henn, and Steve McLendon. The app curated and recommended short radio-style audio stories tailored to a listener's habits, and was available on iOS, Android, and the web as well as through Alexa, Android Auto, and CarPlay. It was backed by Bloomberg Beta, Khosla Ventures, and Rivet Ventures. Google acqui-hired the founding team in October 2017 and the 60dB service was shut down on November 10, 2017. The company is defunct and publishes no developer program, API, or machine-readable interface today; the 60db.com domain now resolves to a parked placeholder page. This profile is retained as a historical portfolio-company record for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: 61draw
providers.description: 61draw (广东省六一线上非学科培训学校有限公司, Guangdong Liuyi Online Non-Academic Training School Co., Ltd.) is a China-based online children's art and non-academic education platform delivering live-broadcast art lessons to children roughly aged five to nine. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and Matrix Partners China, which co-led its Series B round, and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead. The company runs a consumer web and mobile presence at 61draw.com; no public developer, API, or documentation surface has been found during enrichment.

providers.name: 6thSense
providers.description: 6thSense is a physical-AI hardware company building the touch layer for dexterous robots. It designs and manufactures wearable tactile-sensing data gloves that capture how human hands interact with the world — pressure, contact, grip, and 3D hand pose — alongside custom tactile skin molded to robot hands. Its capture stack synchronizes eight aligned modalities (tactile and pressure proxies, egocentric video, depth/RGB-D, hand pose, motion and IMU dynamics, wrist and scene cameras, dense labels and commentary, and success/failure outcomes) into model-ready demonstration datasets used to train the next generation of dexterous, manipulation-capable robots. Founded in 2026 in San Francisco and backed by Y Combinator (S26).

providers.name: 7k7k
providers.description: 7k7k (7k7k.com) is a Chinese online casual gaming portal operating a consumer-facing website that aggregates hundreds of free browser-based mini games across action, role-playing, strategy, puzzle, and two-player categories. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. The 7k7k property is a consumer web destination and publishes no public developer platform, API, SDK, or developer documentation; enrichment probes confirmed no OpenAPI, no .well-known discovery documents, and no security-disclosure or trust-center program at this time.

providers.name: 8sec
providers.description: 8SEC is a hybrid-casual and hyper-casual mobile game studio based in Lyon, France, founded in 2015 by serial entrepreneur and investor Jeremie Berrebi. The studio rapidly prototypes and ships engaging free-to-play mobile games for iOS and Android, with titles such as Jump Race!, Turbo Taxi, Trivia.io, Untie!, and Human Puzzle that have collectively driven over 50 million downloads. 8SEC positions itself as a full-stack studio spanning game design, development, and publishing. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global, surfaced into the API Evangelist network via VC portfolio mapping. The company operates as a game producer and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: 9 Mothers Corporation
providers.description: 9 Mothers Corporation is a defense technology company founded in 2024 and based in Austin, Texas, building AI-powered counter-drone (C-sUAS) point defense systems for the FPV drone era. Its flagship product, EDDA, is a small, low-power, autonomous-capable point-defense turret that engages Group 1 suicide drones at 10-100+ meter range to protect soldiers, vehicles, and critical assets. A Y Combinator Spring 2026 company with reported sales to the U.S. Department of War, its roadmap includes Vor (passive acoustic sensor), Atla (belt-fed shotgun system), and Gleipnir (counter-drone for larger platforms). This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: 99Dresses
providers.description: 99Dresses was a fashion resale and clothing-swap marketplace ("infinite closet") founded by Nikki Durkin, which went through Y Combinator and operated from roughly 2011 to June 2014 before shutting down. It offered a consumer web and mobile app for trading second-hand designer clothing; it never exposed a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. As of 2026 the 99dresses.com domain resolves to a "Launching Soon" parked placeholder with no live product or developer content. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no real API artifacts exist to harvest because the company is defunct.

providers.name: 9Slides
providers.description: 9Slides was a cloud-based presentation platform, founded by Ruchit Garg in 2011, that let users combine slide decks (PowerPoint, PDF, Keynote, Prezi, Excel) with synchronized video and deliver them through an HTML5 player viewable on desktop, tablet, and mobile. It operated on a freemium model, charging for premium features such as an ad-free player, password-protected presentations, and viewer analytics, and later pivoted toward learning and training. Backed by 500 Global, the company was acquired by employee-engagement platform Limeade. The 9slides.com domain no longer serves the product and now resolves to a parked/redirect landing page; no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation is currently published.

providers.name: @Home Network
providers.description: @Home Network (Excite@Home) was a pioneering residential broadband internet service provider founded in 1995, backed by venture firm Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers and cable operator TCI. It delivered high-speed cable internet access to consumers and merged with the Excite web portal in 1999 to form Excite@Home. The company filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on October 1, 2001 and ceased operations by February 2002; it is defunct and operates no website, developer portal, or API today. This record is retained as a historical portfolio-company profile and has no live surface to enrich.

providers.name: AA Audience
providers.description: AA Audience is an adtech and data company that estimates a mobile user's credit score from their online activity using proprietary machine learning models. It collects data from partner mobile apps and ad networks, analyzes it, and connects with popular DSPs and DMPs so its clients - banks, credit card companies, and financial services firms - can target audiences interested in credit cards, loans, and financial services with guaranteed ROI. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, or documentation surface was found during enrichment (the site is a single static marketing page).

providers.name: Aavenir
providers.description: Aavenir is an AI-powered contract lifecycle management (CLM) and source-to-pay software company that delivers procurement, legal, and finance workflow automation applications built natively on the ServiceNow platform. Its product suite includes Contractflow (contract lifecycle management), Obligationflow (contract obligation and compliance management), Sourcingflow (RFx and strategic sourcing), and Invoiceflow (accounts-payable invoice automation), using natural language processing and machine learning to digitize contracts, invoices, and procurement processes. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: abillion
providers.description: abillion was a Singapore-based social platform and mobile app for discovering and reviewing vegan, sustainable, and cruelty-free products across food, beauty, and fashion, pairing a large consumer review community with a rewards model that converted member reviews into donations to non-profits and animal sanctuaries. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. NOTE: as of July 2026 the abillion platform has officially shut down ("abillion is closing its doors"); the public site serves only a farewell notice and states member data is archived for six months before permanent deletion. No public developer program, API, or discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Abinitio Bio
providers.description: Abinitio Bio builds AI foundation models for biopharmaceutical manufacturing, positioning itself as the intelligence layer for drug manufacturing. Its first model, Echo, predicts manufacturing outcomes to assess manufacturability from day one through process scale-up — evaluating molecules early to reduce aggregation and regulatory liabilities, recommending optimal cell lines, media formulations, and bioprocess parameters, predicting process behavior across scales and operating conditions, and delivering lab-validated candidate molecules, processes, and characterization data ready for commercial scale-up. Founded in 2026 in Boston and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026), MIT's Researcher-to-Entrepreneur Accelerator, and Fifty Years' 5050 Program. The company operates a B2B model with pharmaceutical companies and CDMOs and does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Absci
providers.description: Absci is a Vancouver, Washington-based generative AI drug creation company (NASDAQ: ABSI) using AI and synthetic biology to design de novo antibodies in silico against specified epitopes. Its Integrated Drug Creation platform couples generative AI models — including the Origin-1 antibody foundation model — with a 77,000+ sq ft wet lab running proprietary SoluPro and ACE Assay technologies, screening millions of antibody sequence variants per cycle. The data flywheel between in silico design and high-throughput wet lab validation completes in as little as six weeks and can advance from target identification to development candidate in roughly 14 months. Absci's internal pipeline includes ABS-101, an anti-TL1A antibody for inflammatory bowel disease now in Phase 1; ABS-201, a novel anti-PRLR antibody for androgenetic alopecia in the Phase 1/2a HEADLINE trial; and ABS-301, a first-in-class AI-discovered oncology antibody. Strategic partnerships span AstraZeneca, Merck, Almirall, Twist Bioscience, NVIDIA, Owkin, Caltech, and the Gates Foundation. Absci's commercial model is therapeutic development (internal pipeline plus partnered programs and royalties); there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release of the Origin-1 model or its drug creation platform.

providers.name: Absurd
providers.description: Absurd is an AI video creation platform positioning itself as "the Creative OS for AI video." It uses autonomous AI agents to handle scripting, scene planning, and video generation, letting companies produce brand and performance advertisements at scale in roughly 72 hours instead of weeks. Based in Los Angeles and part of Y Combinator's Fall 2025 batch, Absurd works with brands such as Hims, Kalshi, Replit, and Brex, with some of its generated videos reaching over a million organic views. As of this profile the company markets a product surface only (portfolio, careers, and contact pages) and does not publish a public API, developer documentation, or SDKs; this entry was enriched from public web sources and will be upgraded if a developer surface appears.

providers.name: Accelerator Sciences
providers.description: Accelerator Sciences is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of battery-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Accompany
providers.description: Accompany was a relationship-intelligence startup that built people-and-company intelligence for executives, backed by Cowboy Ventures and CRV. It was acquired by Cisco (announced May 2018) and folded into Cisco's collaboration products; www.accompany.com is now a static acquisition-announcement page. Enrichment pass 2026-07-17 verified there is no live product, developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or any /.well-known/ or /llms.txt surface (the host is an nginx catch-all returning the same parked HTML for every path). No API artifacts exist to harvest; retained as a defunct/acquired VC-portfolio lead.

providers.name: Achieve3000
providers.description: Achieve3000 is a supplemental digital literacy solution for grades 3-12 that uses adaptive technology to personalize reading instruction, delivering differentiated nonfiction texts matched to each student's Lexile reading level to build vocabulary and comprehension. Originally an independent education-technology company backed by Insight Partners, Achieve3000 was acquired by McGraw Hill and is now offered as "Achieve3000 Literacy" within McGraw Hill's PreK-12 portfolio. Students and educators access the platform through their district's approved single sign-on (SSO); the product publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for discovery and demand tracking.

providers.name: Acne Studios
providers.description: Acne Studios is a Stockholm-based fashion house founded in 1996 as part of the creative collective ACNE (Ambition to Create Novel Expressions). The company designs and sells ready-to-wear womenswear and menswear, footwear, leather goods, denim, and accessories through its global network of retail stores and its official e-commerce site at acnestudios.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Acne Studios publishes no public developer API program or developer portal; this profile captures its public web identity and live domain-security posture. Sector: consumer / fashion retail.

providers.name: Acompli
providers.description: Acompli was a mobile email application for iOS and Android, first released in April 2014, that unified email, calendar, contacts, and file management across Microsoft Exchange, Office 365, Google Apps, Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo, and Outlook.com/Hotmail accounts. The San Francisco startup was backed by Redpoint Ventures and acquired by Microsoft on December 1, 2014 for a reported $200M+, after which its 21-person team and product were rebranded as Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android. Acompli no longer operates as an independent company and never published a public developer API; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical, acquired-company lead.

providers.name: acorn systems
providers.description: Acorn is a Time-Driven Activity-Based Costing (TD-ABC) and profitability-management platform for multi-dimensional cost-to-serve analysis, precisely attributing direct and indirect costs against products, customers, regions, business units and facilities. It offers what-if scenario modeling, shared-services optimization, custom business-process modeling, and OLAP/analytics for pricing, supplier negotiation and supply-chain decisions.
