providers.description: Cambridge Cancer Genomics (CCG.ai) was a Cambridge, UK precision-oncology company founded in 2015 out of the University of Cambridge, building OncOS, an AI/machine-learning platform that analyzed genomic data from liquid biopsies (circulating tumor DNA) to help oncologists track tumor evolution and personalize cancer treatment. The company was a Y Combinator alumnus in the digital-biology sector and was acquired by Dante Labs in June 2021, after which OncOS was folded into Dante Labs' genomics platform. As of this enrichment pass the CCG.ai domain redirects to a domain-sale marketplace and the company operates no independent public developer or API surface; its historical first-party code lives only in the ccgenomics GitHub organization (research repositories, not published API SDKs).

providers.name: Capital.xyz
providers.description: Capital.xyz (the company behind the former Party Round) is a startup banking and fundraising platform that helps founders raise, hold, spend, and send money in one place. Companies sign up to run fundraising rounds, receive a virtual Visa debit card once capital is raised, hold and move funds, and connect the account to fintech services such as Gusto. The product is built on embedded-finance rails (Unit, Plaid, Visa) and is a consumer/SMB-facing application; as of this enrichment pass Capital.xyz publishes no public developer program, API reference, OpenAPI, or docs portal. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of a16z.

providers.name: DGIT
providers.description: DGIT Systems is a Melbourne, Australia telecommunications software vendor best known for Telflow, an order-management and service-orchestration (BSS/OSS) platform used by communications service providers to design, quote, order and fulfil connectivity products. DGIT was surfaced as a portfolio company of Sierra Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company has no independent public web presence: its product domains dgitsystems.com and telflow.com both 308-redirect to csgi.com, indicating DGIT has been absorbed into CSG Systems International, and the domain listed by the Sierra Ventures portfolio page (dgit.us) is an Afternic/GoDaddy for-sale parking page rather than a company site. No developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDK or package surface could be located.

providers.name: Dick's Sporting Goods
providers.description: Dick's Sporting Goods is a leading omni-channel sporting goods retailer offering an extensive assortment of authentic, high-quality sports equipment, apparel, footwear, and accessories. As a Fortune 500 retailer, Dick's Sporting Goods does not currently publish a public developer portal or APIs; this repository is maintained as a placeholder for any APIs, developer tools, or machine-readable artifacts that may emerge.

providers.name: Dimensional Modeling
providers.description: A data modeling technique used in data warehousing that structures data into fact tables containing measurable metrics and dimension tables containing descriptive attributes, optimized for query performance and business intelligence reporting. Organizations use it to track key metrics, identify trends, and optimize business outcomes.

providers.name: Dow
providers.description: Dow Inc. is a global materials science company headquartered in Midland, Michigan. Dow combines science and technology to develop innovative products and solutions for packaging, infrastructure, mobility, and consumer applications. This entry is an alias of dow-chemical and covers the same parent company.

providers.name: Empathy Maps
providers.description: An empathy map is a collaborative visualization tool used to articulate what is known about a particular type of user. It externalizes knowledge about users in order to create a shared understanding of user needs, and aids in decision making. Empathy maps are used in design thinking and UX design to build empathy with target users.

providers.name: Erie Insurance
providers.description: Erie Insurance Group (NASDAQ: ERIE) is a Fortune 500 property and casualty insurance company headquartered in Erie, Pennsylvania. The company offers auto, home, business, and life insurance products through a network of independent agents across multiple U.S. states.

providers.name: Event Sourcing
providers.description: Event sourcing is an architectural pattern where state changes are stored as a sequence of immutable events rather than just the current state. Instead of storing only the current state of data, event sourcing stores all changes as a log of events, enabling complete audit trails, temporal queries, and event-driven projections.

providers.name: Extreme Programming
providers.description: Extreme Programming (XP) is an agile software development methodology that aims to produce higher quality software and improve quality of life for the development team. XP emphasizes customer satisfaction through frequent releases, continuous integration, test-driven development, pair programming, and collective code ownership.

providers.name: Farmers Insurance Exchange
providers.description: Farmers Insurance Exchange is a Fortune 500 inter-insurance exchange and the largest member of the Farmers Insurance Group of Companies. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Farmers Insurance Exchange. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Gap
providers.description: Gap Inc. is a Fortune 500 American clothing and accessories retailer operating brands including Gap, Old Navy, Banana Republic, and Athleta. Gap does not publish a public developer API; this repository tracks the company, its public web presence, and any partner or technical artifacts that surface over time.

providers.name: Hanesbrands
providers.description: Hanesbrands is a global consumer apparel company designing, manufacturing, and selling everyday basic apparel under brands including Hanes, Champion, Bali, Maidenform, and Bonds. In 2025 Hanesbrands was acquired by Gildan, with both companies continuing to operate as a combined apparel leader.

providers.name: Hatch Loyalty
providers.description: Hatch Loyalty (formerly Belly) was a Chicago-based customer activation, loyalty, and engagement platform for enterprise retailers, with a strong focus on the fuel and convenience-store vertical. It aggregated customer data across a retailer's business systems to build customer profiles and ran a rules engine over submitted transactions to trigger offers and redemptions. Hatch exposed a RESTful developer platform (the "Hatch HUB" API) that conformed to the JSON:API specification, with a public developer portal, API reference, and transaction-processing tutorials. The company was backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Lightbank, NEA, and DAG Ventures, and was acquired by Stuzo around 2019-2020 (the earlier Belly product line was sold to Mobivity). As of this profile the hatchloyalty.com domain and all of its subdomains (www, developer, api) are parked and listed for sale, so no live API or developer surface remains to enrich.

providers.name: Hyatt
providers.description: A global hospitality company managing and franchising luxury and upscale hotels, resorts, and vacation properties. Operates brands including Park Hyatt, Grand Hyatt, Andaz, and Hyatt Regency across more than 70 countries. No public developer portal or open API catalogue was located; Hyatt distributes inventory through GDS and travel-industry channels rather than a public REST API surface.

providers.name: IMS Health Holdings
providers.description: IMS Health Holdings was a leading global information and technology services company providing clients in the healthcare industry with end-to-end solutions before merging with Quintiles in 2016 to form IQVIA. No standalone public API is offered under the IMS Health Holdings brand; current API and data products are available through IQVIA.

providers.name: Inditex
providers.description: A Spanish multinational fashion group and the world's largest apparel retailer operating brands including Zara, Massimo Dutti, and Pull&Bear. Known for its fast-fashion model with rapid design-to-store turnaround times. No public developer portal or open API catalogue was located on inditex.com.

providers.name: Jabil
providers.description: Jabil is a global manufacturing services company that provides engineering, supply chain, and manufactured product solutions for the world's leading brands across industries including automotive, healthcare, industrial, consumer electronics, networking, and cloud infrastructure.

providers.name: Jabil Circuit
providers.description: Jabil (formerly Jabil Circuit) is a global manufacturing services and solutions company providing comprehensive electronics design, production, and product management services to electronics and technology companies in a broad range of industries.

providers.name: Lendsquare
providers.description: Lendsquare was a community-lending / peer-to-peer lending startup surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. The company is defunct. As of the 2026-07-19 enrichment pass lendsquare.com no longer hosts a product - the domain is parked on GoDaddy/Afternic nameservers (NS1.AFTERNIC.COM) and every path redirects to a "/lander" for-sale page, so there is no website, developer portal, documentation, or API surface to catalog. The only surviving first-party artifact is the dormant GitHub organization github.com/lendsquare, created 2013-07-09 and last updated 2015-04-24, holding two Ruby repositories that are third-party libraries the team consumed rather than APIs it published - "area" (place / area-code / zip conversion) and "dwolla-ruby" (Dwolla's official Ruby API wrapper), the latter indicating Lendsquare moved money via the Dwolla API. This profile is retained as a historical, defunct record; no API artifacts were generated because none exist to capture.

providers.name: Macy's
providers.description: Macy's, Inc. is one of the nation's premier omnichannel retailers, operating department stores, websites, and apps under the Macy's, Bloomingdale's, and Bluemercury brands. This repository tracks any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts that are made publicly available by Macy's.

providers.name: Markel
providers.description: Markel provides specialty insurance coverage and creates seamless solutions across multiple types of insurance risks for the US market and around the globe. Markel is a Fortune 500 insurance company with operations spanning property, casualty, and specialty lines for businesses and individuals.

providers.name: Medical Mutual of Ohio
providers.description: Medical Mutual of Ohio is the oldest and one of the largest health insurance companies based in Ohio, providing health insurance plans to individuals, families, and employer groups. No public developer portal or API specifications are currently documented; CMS-mandated Patient Access and Provider Directory FHIR endpoints, where they exist, are typically reached via member or provider account workflows rather than an open developer site.

providers.name: MVC
providers.description: Model-View-Controller (MVC) is a software architectural pattern that separates an application into three interconnected components - the Model (data), View (user interface), and Controller (logic) - to promote organized, maintainable code.

providers.name: Nanogrid
providers.description: Nanogrid was an Oakland, California software startup founded in 2017 by Patrick Sheehan (CEO), Jon McKay (Co-Founder & CPO), and Dan Lopuch (Co-Founder & CTO) that built software to determine the value of residential solar, battery storage, and electric vehicles for homeowners. Its platform simulated, estimated, and optimized these distributed energy resources and captured the operational synergies between the devices. A 500 Startups (500 Global) Batch 25 company, Nanogrid raised roughly $150K from 500 Global and Plug and Play Tech Center before being acquired by clean-energy company Arcadia on April 22, 2021. The company no longer operates independently and its nanogrid.tech domain no longer resolves; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical portfolio-lead record. (Not to be confused with the separate nanoGrid energy-data platform at nanogrid.com.)

providers.name: National Basketball Association
providers.description: The National Basketball Association (NBA) is the premier men's professional basketball league in North America, comprised of 30 franchises (29 in the United States and 1 in Canada). The NBA does not operate a public developer portal; statistical, scoring, and play-by-play data feeds are licensed through official partners (notably Sportradar and Genius Sports). The stats.nba.com endpoints are not officially documented as a public API.

providers.name: National Cemetery Administration
providers.description: The National Cemetery Administration (NCA) is an agency of the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs that provides burial and memorial benefits to veterans and their eligible family members. NCA does not currently expose a documented public REST API; access is via web tools such as the Nationwide Gravesite Locator and Cemetery Finder, with broader data available through VA Open Data.

providers.name: Navy
providers.description: The U.S. Navy plays a crucial role in defending national security and protecting the country's interests at sea. It operates a fleet of ships and submarines, as well as aircraft and personnel, to conduct a range of missions, including maritime patrol, reconnaissance, and combat operations. The Navy also performs humanitarian missions, such as disaster relief and search and rescue efforts. No public APIs have been identified at this time. The previously listed CNATRA "API" reference is an Aviation Preflight Indoctrination training video library, not a programmatic API.

providers.name: Neiman Marcus Group
providers.description: Neiman Marcus Group is an American chain of luxury department stores selling designer apparel, accessories, jewelry, beauty, home, and gifts under the Neiman Marcus, Bergdorf Goodman, and Last Call banners.

providers.name: Newell Brands
providers.description: Newell Brands is a Fortune 500 global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, Parker, Elmer's, Oster, NUK, and Mr. Coffee.

providers.name: Newell Rubbermaid
providers.description: Newell Rubbermaid was a global marketer of consumer and commercial products with brands including Sharpie, Paper Mate, Rubbermaid, and Calphalon before merging with Jarden in 2016 to form Newell Brands.

providers.name: OCI
providers.description: OCI (Open Container Initiative) is an open governance structure for creating open industry standards around container formats and runtimes. OCI defines standards for container images, distribution, and runtime specifications used by Docker, Kubernetes, and other container technologies.

providers.name: openCypher
providers.description: openCypher is an open-source project that provides a standardized graph query language originally developed by Neo4j for querying property graphs. It enables developers to write expressive pattern-matching queries against graph databases, and its specification has been adopted by multiple graph database vendors.

providers.name: PACCAR
providers.description: PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture, and customer support of premium light, medium, and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF nameplates. PACCAR also designs and manufactures advanced diesel engines, provides financial services and information technology, and distributes truck parts related to its principal business.

providers.name: Parker Hannifin
providers.description: Parker Hannifin is a global leader in motion and control technologies, providing precision-engineered solutions for a wide variety of mobile, industrial, and aerospace markets. No public developer API has been documented at this time.

providers.name: PRA Health Sciences
providers.description: PRA Health Sciences was a global contract research organization (CRO) headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, providing outsourced clinical development services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. On July 1, 2021 ICON plc completed its acquisition of PRA Health Sciences in a cash-and-stock transaction valued at approximately $12 billion, forming one of the world's largest healthcare research organizations. Following the acquisition the PRA Health Sciences brand has been fully retired and operations were merged into ICON. The legacy prahs.com domain redirects to iconplc.com / icongroup.com and no PRA-branded developer programs, public APIs, SDKs, or technical documentation remain.

providers.name: Prudential Backstop
providers.description: API collections for Prudential Backstop financial services and retirement solutions.

providers.name: QVC
providers.description: QVC is a multinational corporation specializing in televised home shopping owned by Qurate Retail Group, broadcasting to millions of households worldwide and offering products through television, mobile apps, and websites.

providers.name: Tilray Brands
providers.description: A global lifestyle and consumer packaged goods company operating across cannabis, beverage alcohol, and wellness segments. One of the largest cannabis companies worldwide with cultivation, processing, and distribution operations spanning North America, Europe, and beyond.

providers.name: Write Ahead Log
providers.description: A Write-Ahead Log (WAL) is a standard technique in database systems where changes are first recorded to a sequential log file before being applied to the actual data files. It ensures durability and crash recovery by guaranteeing that committed transactions can be reconstructed from the log even if the system fails during a write operation.

providers.name: Xplenty (Xenon)
providers.description: Xplenty (Xenon) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ai-infrastructure. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Cbeyond Com.
providers.description: Cbeyond Com. is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of battery-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Diamondback Energy
providers.description: Diamondback Energy is an independent oil and natural gas company focused on the acquisition, development, exploration, and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil and natural gas reserves in the Permian Basin of West Texas. As a Fortune 500 company in the upstream energy sector, Diamondback does not currently publish a public developer portal or APIs; this repository is maintained as a placeholder for any APIs, developer tools, or machine-readable artifacts that may emerge.

providers.name: Ferrellgas Partners
providers.description: Ferrellgas Partners is one of the largest propane distributors in the United States, providing propane to residential, industrial, commercial, portable tank exchange (Blue Rhino), agricultural, wholesale, and other customers.

providers.name: Great Plains Energy
providers.description: Great Plains Energy was the holding company of Kansas City Power & Light, an electric utility serving customers in Missouri and Kansas, before merging with Westar Energy in 2018 to form Evergy. No public APIs are documented.

providers.name: Green Plains
providers.description: Green Plains is a vertically integrated ethanol producer that operates ethanol plants, grain handling and storage facilities, and a cattle-feeding operation. No public APIs are documented.

providers.name: IMAP
providers.description: IMAP (Internet Message Access Protocol) is a standard email protocol that allows email clients to access and manage email messages stored on a mail server. IMAP enables users to view and manage email from multiple devices while keeping messages synchronized on the server.

providers.name: Integrys Energy Group
providers.description: Integrys Energy Group was a holding company with regulated natural gas and electric utility operations and a non-regulated retail energy business before being acquired by Wisconsin Energy Corporation in 2015 to form WEC Energy Group. There is no public developer API or documentation.

providers.name: MasTec
providers.description: MasTec is a Fortune 500 infrastructure construction company operating across clean energy, data centers, EV infrastructure, pipelines, power generation and delivery, civil infrastructure, technology deployment, water and wastewater, and communications. No public developer portal or APIs have been identified.

providers.name: National Fuel Gas Company
providers.description: National Fuel Gas Company is a diversified energy company engaged in natural gas distribution, gas pipeline and storage, gas exploration and production, and energy marketing across the northeastern United States. National Fuel Gas does not currently publish a documented public REST API or developer portal; customer information and operational disclosures are made available through its corporate website, investor relations channels, and FERC regulatory filings.

providers.name: NRG Energy
providers.description: NRG Energy is a Fortune 500 American energy company. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for NRG Energy. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: ONEOK
providers.description: ONEOK is a Fortune 500 energy company providing midstream services to natural gas and natural gas liquids producers, processors, and customers. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with ONEOK.

providers.name: Ovintiv
providers.description: Ovintiv is a Fortune 500 oil and natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. The company operates across North America with a focus on multi-basin development. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Ovintiv.

providers.name: Patterson-UTI Energy
providers.description: Patterson-UTI Energy is a leading provider of onshore contract drilling services to exploration and production companies in North America, with land-based drilling rigs and pressure pumping services. No public developer API has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Peabody Energy
providers.description: Peabody Energy is the world's largest private-sector coal company, mining and supplying coal to electricity generators and steel producers in the United States and around the world. No public developer APIs are currently documented for this organization.

providers.name: Puget Energy
providers.description: Puget Energy is the parent company of Puget Sound Energy (PSE), a regulated electric and natural gas utility serving customers across Washington state. Headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, the company provides electricity and natural gas service, energy efficiency programs, outage management, and customer billing services. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Services Patterns
providers.description: Design patterns and architectural approaches for building microservices and service-oriented applications. Modern distributed architectures rely on it to coordinate workloads across multiple nodes and regions.

providers.name: Texaco
providers.description: An American petroleum brand owned by Chevron marketing fuels, lubricants, and petrochemical products. Operates a network of service stations across the United States and internationally with a long history in the oil industry.

providers.name: Alphina Therapeutics
providers.description: Alphina Therapeutics is a New Haven, Connecticut precision-oncology biotechnology company founded by experts in DNA repair and metabolic lethality. It develops next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) that deliver potent NAMPT inhibitor payloads directly to tumors, designed to kill both dividing and non-dividing cancer cells, and pairs them with a proprietary companion diagnostic that identifies the patients most likely to respond. The company is venture-backed by Canaan Partners. It was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation, so no API artifacts apply at this time.

providers.name: Bank of New York
providers.description: The Bank of New York was one of the oldest banks in the United States, founded in 1784. In 2007, it merged with Mellon Financial Corporation to form BNY Mellon (Bank of New York Mellon Corporation), which now operates as a global investments company providing asset servicing, treasury services, and wealth management. See the bank-of-new-york-mellon repository for current API documentation.

providers.name: Envision Healthcare Holdings
providers.description: Envision Healthcare is a leading provider of physician-led services and ambulatory surgery services in the United States, supporting healthcare professionals across emergency, anesthesiology, radiology, women's and children's, and surgery. No public developer APIs have been identified for Envision Healthcare Holdings at this time.

providers.name: Fervo Energy
providers.description: Fervo Energy is a next-generation geothermal power company headquartered in Houston, Texas, that generates carbon-free, always-on electricity through enhanced geothermal systems (EGS). Founded in 2017 by Tim Latimer and Jack Norbeck, Fervo adapts horizontal drilling, distributed fiber-optic sensing, and advanced subsurface data analytics from the oil and gas industry to make geothermal energy viable in previously uneconomic locations. Its projects include the Project Red pilot in Nevada and the flagship 500 MW Cape Station development in Beaver County, Utah. Fervo trades on Nasdaq under the ticker FRVO and is backed by investors including DCVC. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network surfaced from the DCVC portfolio; Fervo Energy is a physical energy-infrastructure company and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Fourier
providers.description: Fourier is an energy technology company building on-site, on-demand hydrogen production systems. Its core product is a modular, scalable device that generates hydrogen where it is needed, removing the transport and storage barriers of conventional hydrogen supply. Fourier targets three application areas: long-duration distributed storage for renewable energy, alternative fuels for heavy transportation, and cleaner feedstock for chemical and manufacturing industries. The company commercially launched its onsite hydrogen system in late 2025 and raised an $18.5M Series A led by Paramark Ventures and General Catalyst. Fourier is a hardware and infrastructure company and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or other software developer surface.

providers.name: General Proximity
providers.description: General Proximity is a biotechnology company pioneering next-generation "proximity medicines" that control biological processes by inducing proximity between molecular targets. Its multi-target OMNITAC platform is used to discover and advance novel therapeutics, including an oncology collaboration with Daiichi Sankyo. The company is backed by investors including Felicis and Y Combinator, and has drawn investment from Freemind and Daewoong Pharmaceutical. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; General Proximity is a drug-discovery company and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts at this time.

providers.name: Gilead Sciences
providers.description: Gilead Sciences is a research-based biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, and commercializes innovative therapeutics in areas of unmet medical need including HIV, viral hepatitis, oncology, and inflammatory diseases.

providers.name: Grove Biopharma
providers.description: Grove Biopharma is a Chicago-based biopharmaceutical company developing therapeutics that target intracellular protein-protein interactions implicated in cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, and rare disorders. The company pioneered Bionic Biologics, hybrid biomolecules that integrate principles of biologic and synthetic design to achieve cell permeability with customizable, modular construction that can disrupt or degrade disease-causing proteins. Grove has demonstrated proof-of-concept against targets including AR/AR-V7, SHOC2, MYC, TAU, and KEAP1/NRF2. Founded in 2025 and led by CEO Geoffrey Duyk, the company raised a $30M Series A in April 2025 and is backed by DCVC. Grove is a therapeutics company with no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Health Co (Stealth)
providers.description: Health Co (Stealth) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Hospira
providers.description: Hospira was a global specialty pharmaceutical and medication delivery company providing injectable drugs and infusion technologies before being acquired by Pfizer in 2015. No public APIs are offered under the Hospira brand.

providers.name: IASIS Healthcare
providers.description: IASIS Healthcare was a leading owner and operator of acute care hospitals in growing urban markets in the United States before being acquired by Steward Health Care in 2017. Operations and any legacy developer resources have since been consolidated under Steward Health Care.

providers.name: Janssen Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Janssen Pharmaceuticals was a Belgian pharmaceutical company founded in 1953 by Paul Janssen and acquired by Johnson & Johnson in 1961. The company specialized in psychiatry, neurology, oncology, immunology, and infectious disease medicines, developing approximately 70 new active pharmaceutical substances over its history. In 2024 the Janssen brand was retired and the pharmaceutical operations were rebranded as Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine. As such, Janssen no longer operates as a standalone brand and does not maintain its own public APIs.

providers.name: Light Anchor
providers.description: Light Anchor is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of y-combinator and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: MommaZoo
providers.description: MommaZoo was a mobile web application for parent-teacher and school-community communication, surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Built as an HTML5 cross-platform app, it let parents and teachers centralize class posts, homework, sign-ups, reminders, documents, and multi-channel messaging across devices and languages. The company is defunct - public activity ends around 2013 and the mommazoo.com domain is now parked - and an enrichment pass found no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface.

providers.name: Neuroharmonics
providers.description: NeuroHarmonics is a London-based neurotechnology company and UCL spin-out developing non-invasive brain-health hardware based on focused ultrasound neuromodulation. Its wearable headset uses precisely focused sound waves to safely modulate deep brain circuits without surgery, an MRI, or head shaving, aiming to turn expensive, invasive neuromodulation into scalable, continuous at-home therapy for neurological and psychiatric conditions. Founded in 2016 by Antonio Stanziola, Tim Den Boer, Bradley Treeby and Michael Brown, the company is backed by Speedinvest, UCL Technology Fund, Fusion Fund and Jumpspace Ventures. As an early-stage medical-device company it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: NiSource
providers.description: NiSource is one of the largest fully-regulated utility companies in the United States, serving approximately 3.5 million natural gas and electric customers across six states through its operating subsidiaries Columbia Gas and NIPSCO.

providers.name: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
providers.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) is a federal agency responsible for regulating and supervising national banks and federal savings associations. The OCC ensures that these financial institutions operate in a safe and sound manner, comply with applicable laws and regulations, and treat customers fairly.

providers.name: Omnicare
providers.description: Omnicare is a long-term care pharmacy services company providing pharmacy services to long-term care facilities, senior living communities, and other healthcare providers. Customer-facing portals (Omniview, MyOmniview) exist for clients but no public developer APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Orbis Education
providers.description: Orbis Education is a healthcare education services company founded in 2003 that partners with universities and healthcare systems to create, market, and manage collaborative, accelerated healthcare degree programs — including Accelerated Bachelor of Science in Nursing (ABSN), Medical Laboratory Sciences (MLS), and Occupational Therapy Assistant (OTA) programs — to help address workforce shortages in nursing and allied health. Operating across more than 26 states, the company connects students with universities and clinical placement sites to graduate practice-ready professionals, and was acquired by Grand Canyon Education in 2018. Orbis Education is a services provider and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Passports
providers.description: Index for tracking APIs, SDKs, and developer resources related to passports (travel documents, identity verification, and government issuance). No authoritative public passport API has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Playtika Holding
providers.description: Playtika Holding is an Israel-based mobile gaming company and Fortune 1000 firm that develops and publishes free-to-play casual and casino-themed games such as Slotomania, Bingo Blitz, and Caesars Slots. The company operates a portfolio of social and casual mobile gaming titles distributed through major app stores and uses data-driven engagement and live operations to monetize its global player base. Playtika does not publish a public developer portal or external API.

providers.name: ReCharge
providers.description: Recharge (formerly ReCharge Payments) is a subscription and recurring-billing platform for e-commerce, most widely deployed on Shopify. DUPLICATE RECORD: this stub was created from the secondary-market harvest backlog (Forge Global listing) and profiles the same company already held in the API Evangelist network as all/recharge-payments, which carries the deep profile (10 registered APIs, refined OpenAPI, plans, rate limits, FinOps, authentication, security and blog artifacts). No API surface has been registered here and no artifacts have been generated, so this record does not split the company across two Kin Scores. It is queued for the duplicate-retirement procedure (survivor: recharge-payments).

providers.name: Stagwell
providers.description: Stagwell is a digital-first global marketing services and technology company and a Fortune 1000 firm. The company operates a network of agencies and technology brands and offers the Stagwell Marketing Cloud (SMC), a suite of proprietary marketing technology products built by its in-house engineering teams. Stagwell does not publish a single unified public developer portal at the holding-company level; product APIs are exposed through individual SMC products.

providers.name: Terragia
providers.description: Terragia is a cellulosic biofuel company developing technology to convert cellulosic biomass such as agricultural crop residues into ethanol and other low-carbon fuels at a cost competitive with petroleum. The company uses consolidated bioprocessing (CBP) with co-treatment, employing engineered thermophilic bacteria to reduce the capital expense and number of steps in bioprocessing, targeting difficult-to-electrify transportation sectors like aviation and maritime shipping. Founded on decades of research led by Dr. Lee Lynd and supported by the US Department of Energy's Center for Bioenergy Innovation, Terragia spun out of Enchi in 2022 and is based in Lebanon, New Hampshire. It is backed by General Catalyst. Terragia is a biotech and energy company and publishes no public developer, API, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Truelli
providers.description: Truelli is a health-technology company (a 500 Global portfolio company) behind a non-invasive menstrual health-screening product: a menstrual pad that also functions as a diagnostic device. A user wears the pad, scans a barcode with the Truelli mobile app, and receives instant screening results across general, hormonal, sexual, and metabolic health — spanning indicators such as anemia and fatigue, fertility and perimenopause, STIs and cancer risk, and diabetes and cardiovascular markers. The company emphasizes UKAS lab accreditation, HIPAA compliance, and clinical-trial validation. Truelli is a consumer product with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Vaccitech *
providers.description: Vaccitech * is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: life-sciences. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: VectorY
providers.description: VectorY Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel genetic medicines for neurodegenerative diseases using its proprietary Vectorized Antibody Platform, which combines AAV-based gene delivery with antibody engineering to express therapeutic antibodies directly in the central nervous system. Its pipeline targets amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) with VTx-002 and VTx-001 and Huntington's disease with VTx-003. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a therapeutics research organization, VectorY publishes a corporate website, pipeline, scientific publications, news, and careers, but operates no public developer API, documentation portal, or programmatic interface surface.

providers.name: Vitalgen
providers.description: Shanghai Vitalgen BioPharma Co., Ltd. (Vitalgen), founded in March 2020 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, translates cutting-edge gene delivery and gene editing techniques into clinically effective treatments for patients with unmet medical needs. Vitalgen operates a GMP-compliant commercial production platform built on its proprietary ViCas CRISPR/Cas editing tools, ViLNP lipid nanoparticles, and ViVec AAV capsids, developing gene therapies for hereditary diseases and neurodegenerative disorders across a pipeline that includes Bietti Crystalline Dystrophy (VGR-R01), AADC Deficiency, Parkinson's Disease, Gaucher Disease, and Glutaric Acidemia Type I. Several candidates have entered clinical trials and secured U.S. FDA Orphan Drug Designations and an EMA PRIME designation. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes a corporate marketing website only and exposes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface.

providers.name: Zeno Power
providers.description: Zeno Power is a deep-tech energy company developing radioisotope power systems (nuclear batteries) that convert the heat of radioisotope decay into reliable, long-duration electricity for extreme environments where conventional power sources fail. Its compact radioisotope Stirling generators target 1-100+ watts for use cases spanning NASA lunar surface missions (americium-241 fueled), seabed and maritime sensor infrastructure, and Department of Defense / U.S. Space Force applications (strontium-90 fueled). The company works with partners including NASA, the Pentagon, Westinghouse, and Orano, with commercial market delivery targeted for 2027. Backed by DCVC, Zeno Power was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; enrichment found no public API, developer platform, SDKs, or technical documentation surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Zepz
providers.description: Zepz (formerly WorldRemit Group) is a London-headquartered cross-border payments and remittance fintech that operates the consumer money-transfer brands WorldRemit and Sendwave. Through its mobile apps and website, Zepz lets migrants and their families send money from ~50 sending countries to 130+ receiving countries via bank deposit, mobile money, cash pickup, and airtime top-up, processing tens of millions of transactions and roughly $10B in annual customer transfers. Zepz is a direct-to-consumer app business: it publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or partner integration API. This profile was added as an Accel portfolio-company lead; enrichment confirms there is no public API surface to catalog at this time.

providers.name: Zumutor
providers.description: Zumutor is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Apache Spark
providers.description: Open-source unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing with built-in modules for streaming, SQL, machine learning and graph processing.

providers.name: Builders FirstSource
providers.description: Builders FirstSource (NYSE: BLDR) is the nation's largest supplier and manufacturer of structural building products, value-added components, and construction services to the professional market for single-family and multi-family construction. The company operates approximately 570 locations across 43 states with 28,000 team members, headquartered in Irving, Texas. Its product portfolio includes lumber, manufactured components, doors, windows, millwork, cabinets, and roofing, complemented by digital procurement and project management tools through the myBLDR platform.

providers.name: Exact Sciences
providers.description: Exact Sciences is a molecular diagnostics company and a Fortune 1000 firm best known for the Cologuard colorectal cancer screening test and the Oncotype DX family of cancer tests. The company develops, manufactures, and markets laboratory-based screening and precision oncology tests delivered to patients and providers through its Exact Labs operations. Exact Sciences does not publish a public developer portal or external API.

providers.name: Federal Accounting Standards Advisory Board
providers.description: The Federal Accounting Standards Advisory Board (FASAB) is an independent organization responsible for establishing accounting standards for the federal government. FASAB strives to improve the quality and consistency of financial reporting within federal agencies, ultimately ensuring transparency and accountability in government financial operations.

providers.name: Federal Maritime Commission
providers.description: The Federal Maritime Commission (FMC) is an independent agency of the United States government responsible for the regulation of international ocean transportation. The FMC oversees the practices of ocean common carriers, marine terminal operators, and other regulated entities.

providers.name: Genuine Parts Company
providers.description: Genuine Parts Company is a Fortune 500 service organization engaged in the distribution of automotive replacement parts (the parent of NAPA Auto Parts), industrial replacement parts, and electrical materials and electronic components.

providers.name: H&M
providers.description: A Swedish multinational fast-fashion retailer offering affordable clothing, accessories, and home goods. Operates thousands of stores globally and is one of the world's largest fashion companies. No public developer portal or open API catalogue was located on hm.com or hmgroup.com.

providers.name: Huntington Ingalls Industries
providers.description: Huntington Ingalls Industries is the largest military shipbuilding company in the United States, designing, building, overhauling, and repairing ships primarily for the U.S. Navy and Coast Guard, while also providing professional services including unmanned systems, defense solutions, and cybersecurity. No public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Keurig Dr Pepper (formerly Dr Pepper Snapple Group)
providers.description: Dr Pepper Snapple Group was an integrated brand owner, manufacturer, and distributor of nonalcoholic beverages in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and the Caribbean. In 2018 the company merged with Keurig Green Mountain to form Keurig Dr Pepper, a leading beverage company in North America with a portfolio of more than 150 brands including Dr Pepper, 7UP, Snapple, Canada Dry, Keurig, and Peet's Coffee.

providers.name: Landstar System
providers.description: Landstar System is a worldwide, asset-light provider of integrated transportation management solutions delivering safe, specialized transportation services to a broad range of customers.

providers.name: National Capital Planning Commission
providers.description: The National Capital Planning Commission is the federal government's planning agency for the National Capital Region. The Commission works with federal agencies to preserve and enhance the historical, cultural, and natural resources and federal assets of the National Capital Region. No public developer API has been identified at this time; available access is through the public website, project search, and FOIA.

providers.name: National Endowment for the Arts
providers.description: The National Endowment for the Arts is an independent federal agency that funds, promotes, and strengthens the creative capacity of our communities by providing all Americans with diverse opportunities for arts participation. NEA does not currently expose a documented public REST API; arts and culture data is available through partner programs such as the Arts and Cultural Production Satellite Account (with BEA) and the Survey of Public Participation in the Arts (with the U.S. Census Bureau).

providers.name: National Laboratories
providers.description: The U.S. Department of Energy's national laboratories are a network of federally funded research and development centers conducting cutting-edge research in energy, science, and national security.

providers.name: NewMarket Corporation
providers.description: NewMarket Corporation (NYSE: NEU) is a publicly traded specialty chemicals holding company headquartered in Richmond, Virginia. Through subsidiaries Afton Chemical and Ethyl Corporation, NewMarket develops petroleum additives for fuels and lubricants used worldwide.

providers.name: NIO
providers.description: NIO is a Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer and technology company that develops smart electric vehicles, battery swap technology, and related autonomous driving and connectivity services. NIO provides developer APIs for vehicle data, energy services, and connected car features.

providers.name: Pepco Holdings
providers.description: Pepco Holdings was a holding company providing electric and natural gas service to customers in Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey, and the District of Columbia before being acquired by Exelon.

providers.name: Post Holdings
providers.description: Post Holdings is a consumer packaged goods holding company with businesses in center-of-the-store, refrigerated, foodservice, food ingredient, and convenient nutrition product categories, with a brand portfolio that includes Post Consumer Brands, Bob Evans, Weetabix, and Michael Foods.

providers.name: Tailored Brands
providers.description: Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear operating the Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, K&G Superstores, Moores Clothing for Men, and Joseph Abboud brands. The company operates over 1,000 retail locations across North America and e-commerce platforms at menswearhouse.com, josbank.com, and kgstores.com. Tailored Brands is preparing for an IPO in 2026 following its 2020 restructuring. No public developer API is currently available.

providers.name: Trumark Financial
providers.description: A Philadelphia-area credit union providing a full range of personal and business banking products and financial services to members across the region.

providers.name: Academy Sports and Outdoors
providers.description: Academy Sports + Outdoors is a Fortune 500 sporting goods and outdoor recreation retailer headquartered in Katy, Texas. The company operates retail stores across the United States and an e-commerce platform offering sporting equipment, apparel, footwear, hunting and fishing gear, camping supplies, and outdoor recreation products. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Academy Sports + Outdoors. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Aleris
providers.description: Aleris was a global producer of rolled aluminum products serving the aerospace, automotive, building and construction, and other industrial end-use markets. Founded as IMCO Recycling and later renamed Aleris International, the company operated manufacturing plants across North America, Europe, and Asia. Aleris was acquired by Novelis Inc. (a subsidiary of Hindalco Industries) on April 14, 2020 for approximately $2.8 billion. The company's primary product lines included aluminum sheet, plate, and engineered products for demanding applications such as aerospace structures and automotive body panels. As a manufacturing-focused business, Aleris did not maintain a public developer API program, but engaged in B2B EDI integrations with major customers and suppliers across its supply chain.

providers.name: Alight
providers.description: Alight is a leading cloud-based human capital and technology services provider that powers confident health, wealth, and wellbeing decisions for millions of employees and family members. The company delivers integrated benefits administration, payroll, and total wellbeing solutions through its Alight Worklife platform. Alight does not publish a public, self-service developer portal; integrations are typically delivered through enterprise client engagements.

providers.name: Allegheny Technologies
providers.description: Allegheny Technologies Incorporated (ATI) is an American producer of specialty materials headquartered in Dallas, Texas. ATI produces metals including titanium and titanium alloys, nickel-based alloys and superalloys, stainless and specialty steels, zirconium, hafnium, niobium, tungsten materials, forgings, and castings. The company serves aerospace and defense (over 50% of sales), oil and gas, chemical process industry, electrical energy, and medical markets. ATI generates approximately $4.6 billion in annual revenue and is listed on the NYSE (ticker: ATI). As a specialty materials manufacturer focused on advanced metals production, ATI does not maintain a public developer API program, but engages in EDI-based supply chain integrations with aerospace OEM customers including Boeing and Airbus.

providers.name: Alliance One International
providers.description: Alliance One International was a global leaf tobacco merchant that purchased, processed, and sold leaf tobacco to manufacturers of cigarettes and other consumer tobacco products. Founded in 2005 through the merger of Dimon Incorporated and Standard Commercial Corporation, Alliance One International became one of the world's two largest leaf tobacco dealers. The company sourced tobacco from major growing regions including the United States, Brazil, Zimbabwe, Malawi, Turkey, and other countries. In 2018, Alliance One International changed its name to Pyxus International, reflecting a broader diversification strategy beyond tobacco into hemp, cannabis, and e-liquids. As an agricultural commodity trading business, Alliance One International did not maintain a public developer API program.

providers.name: APi Group
providers.description: APi Group Corporation is a Fortune 500 global, market-leading business services provider of safety, specialty, and industrial services. The company delivers life safety, security, specialty trades, and industrial contracting services through a network of operating companies across North America, Europe, the Asia-Pacific region, and beyond. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with APi Group. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: ATI
providers.description: ATI Inc. is a specialty materials and components manufacturer that produces high-performance alloys, titanium products, nickel-based superalloys, and engineered components. The company primarily serves the aerospace, defense, energy, electronics, and medical industries. ATI focuses on direct B2B customer relationships and does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Cal-Maine Foods
providers.description: Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. is the largest producer and distributor of fresh shell eggs in the United States. The company sells most of its shell eggs to grocery store chains, club stores, foodservice distributors, and egg product consumers across the country and produces specialty eggs including organic, cage-free, free-range, and nutritionally enhanced varieties. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Coherent
providers.description: Coherent Corp. is a Fortune 500 global leader in materials, networking, and laser technologies. The company designs and manufactures engineered materials, optoelectronic components, optical transceivers, laser systems, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment for AI infrastructure, datacommunications, industrial, aerospace and defense, life sciences, and consumer electronics markets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Coherent. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Crocs
providers.description: Crocs, Inc. is a global designer, manufacturer, and retailer of casual footwear known for its iconic molded clog. The company sells through e-commerce, owned retail, and wholesale channels worldwide and also owns the HEYDUDE casual footwear brand. Crocs does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Dream Finders Homes
providers.description: Dream Finders Homes is a national homebuilder that constructs new residential properties across markets in the Southeast and Southwest United States. The company emphasizes customization and affordability for homebuyers and offers mortgage, title, and insurance services through affiliated entities. Dream Finders Homes does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: FirstCash Holdings
providers.description: FirstCash Holdings is a leading international operator of pawn stores and a major provider of retail point-of-sale payment solutions. The company operates pawn store locations across the United States and Latin America, offering pawn loans, retail merchandise sales, and lease-to-own financing through its American First Finance subsidiary. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Gaming and Leisure Properties
providers.description: Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc. (NASDAQ: GLPI) is "the nation's first real estate investment trust focused on acquiring real property assets leased to gaming operators." Headquartered in Wyomissing, Pennsylvania, GLPI's portfolio comprises 71 premier gaming and related facilities across 21 states, totaling more than 29.3 million square feet and over 15,100 hotel rooms, leased on a triple-net basis to operators including Penn Entertainment, Caesars Entertainment, Bally's Corporation, Boyd Gaming, the Cordish Companies, and Hard Rock. No public developer API, data feed, or GitHub organization has been identified; GLPI engages investors, tenants, and partners through corporate and investor relations channels only.

providers.name: Gen Digital
providers.description: Gen Digital is a global leader in consumer cybersecurity, powering Digital Freedom through a family of trusted brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, Avira, AVG, ReputationDefender, and CCleaner. The company provides cyber safety, identity protection, and privacy solutions to over 500 million users worldwide. Gen Digital does not publish a unified corporate-level public developer portal; product integrations are managed at the individual brand level.

providers.name: GTM Release
providers.description: A network index of companies, organizations, and platforms relevant to the Naftiko Framework go-to-market release strategy, covering press, developer communities, directories, review platforms, podcasts, business directories, and events.

providers.name: Herman Miller
providers.description: Herman Miller is an American furniture company founded in 1905 and headquartered in Zeeland, Michigan, known for iconic office and residential designs including the Aeron chair and the Eames lounge chair. On July 19, 2021, Herman Miller closed its acquisition of Knoll Inc. in a $1.8 billion cash-and-stock deal and rebranded the combined company as MillerKnoll (NASDAQ: MLKN). Herman Miller continues as a consumer-facing brand within the MillerKnoll collective alongside Knoll, Design Within Reach, HAY, Muuto, Geiger, Holly Hunt, Maharam, Naughtone, DatesWeiser, Edelman Leather, and Colebrook Bosson Saunders. Herman Miller sells through retail, contract, and dealer channels and does not publish a public developer API portal — partner ordering, dealer pricing, and supply-chain integrations are private B2B channels run through MillerKnoll.

providers.name: Installed Building Products
providers.description: Installed Building Products, Inc. is one of the largest installers of insulation, garage doors, rain gutters, shower doors, mirrors, closet shelving, and other building products to the residential and commercial construction industry in the United States. The company operates a network of branch locations across the country and partners with major homebuilders and contractors. IBP combines product distribution with installation services for new construction and remodeling.

providers.name: Match Group
providers.description: Match Group is a leading provider of digital technologies designed to help people make meaningful connections. The company operates a portfolio of dating apps and brands including Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, OkCupid, Pairs, Plenty Of Fish, Azar, Hakuna, and others. Match Group does not publish a unified public developer portal at the corporate level; individual brands manage their own integrations.

providers.name: MillerKnoll
providers.description: MillerKnoll is a global collective of design brands including Herman Miller, Knoll, and other heritage furniture and design companies. The company designs and manufactures office, residential, and contract furniture, lighting, and accessories sold through retail, contract, and dealer channels. MillerKnoll does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: PEI-Genesis
providers.description: PEI-Genesis is a privately held, Philadelphia-headquartered global authorized distributor and value-added assembler of interconnect components (cable and circular connectors), founded in 1946. The company self-describes on LinkedIn as providing "Engineered Solutions for Connectors and Cables" in the Appliances, Electrical, and Electronics Manufacturing industry, with 501-1,000 employees. The public-facing peigenesis.com web property is a product catalog and quote-request portal protected by an interstitial JavaScript challenge; no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, EDI integration documentation, PunchOut catalog, or GitHub organization could be located. Public API documentation has not yet been catalogued in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Peloton Interactive
providers.description: Peloton Interactive is a connected fitness company that produces interactive exercise equipment and a streaming subscription service. The company sells connected stationary bikes, treadmills, rowers, and a digital app offering live and on-demand fitness classes. Peloton has built a large community of members who participate in instructor-led workouts and track performance metrics through its platform.

providers.name: Rocket Companies
providers.description: Rocket Companies is a Detroit-based financial services firm that provides digital solutions for homeownership and personal finance. Its portfolio includes Rocket Mortgage for home loans, Rocket Homes for real estate search, and Rocket Money for personal finance management. Rocket Companies does not publish a public corporate developer API portal at the holding-company level.

providers.name: RXO
providers.description: RXO is a freight and logistics platform that connects shippers and carriers across truckload, less-than-truckload, managed transportation, and last-mile delivery. The company operates RXO Connect, a digital freight platform that uses machine learning and AI across a network of approximately 150,000 independent carriers. RXO does not currently publish a public developer API portal on its corporate website.

providers.name: Scientific Games
providers.description: Scientific Games is the global lottery company serving government-sponsored lotteries on six continents in 50+ countries with instant scratch games, draw-based and terminal-generated games, iLottery and mobile platforms, Central Gaming Systems (CGS), retail point-of-sale technology, sports betting solutions, loyalty/CRM, analytics, and managed/partner services. The company traces to Scientific Games Holdings (founded 1973) and was merged into Scientific Games Corporation in 2001 alongside the WMS, Bally and NYX/OpenBet acquisitions. In April 2022 the lottery business was carved out and sold to Brookfield Business Partners for $6.05 billion, taking Scientific Games private; the residual gaming and digital businesses were renamed Light & Wonder (NASDAQ/ASX: LNW), and the social casino subsidiary SciPlay (spun off via IPO in 2019) was reabsorbed and later sits within Light & Wonder. Today Scientific Games operates as an independent, Brookfield-owned, pure-play lottery technology and services company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with instant ticket manufacturing in Alpharetta and Montreal. Scientific Games does not publish a developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, or public SDKs; customer integrations are delivered under direct contract with government lottery operators.

providers.name: Semantic Kernel
providers.description: An open-source SDK that lets you easily build agents that can call your existing code, enabling AI orchestration with LLMs like GPT-4, plugins, and memory capabilities. It forms a core part of modern AI/ML pipelines and intelligent automation systems.

providers.name: Sun Communities
providers.description: Sun Communities, Inc. is a real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns, operates, and develops manufactured home communities, recreational vehicle resorts, and marinas across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. The company is one of the largest operators in its sector and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Tinfoil Security
providers.description: Tinfoil Security was a web application and API security scanning company that provided automated dynamic (DAST) vulnerability testing for web apps and REST APIs. It was acquired by Synopsys in 2016 and folded into the Synopsys Software Integrity Group, which later became Black Duck. As of this enrichment pass its domain tinfoilsecurity.com no longer serves an independent site — every path returns an HTTP 302 redirect to blackduck.com — and there is no standalone Tinfoil Security developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, package registry presence, or /.well-known discovery surface remaining. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and is retained as an acquired/defunct lead with no live API surface to harvest.

providers.name: Titan Machinery
providers.description: Titan Machinery Inc. owns and operates one of the largest networks of full-service agricultural and construction equipment dealer stores in North America and Europe. The company sells, services, and rents new and used Case IH, New Holland, Case Construction, and other branded equipment, along with parts and precision farming technology. Titan Machinery serves farmers, ranchers, and construction contractors across multiple states and countries.

providers.name: Tri Pointe Homes
providers.description: Tri Pointe Homes is one of the largest homebuilders in the United States, designing and constructing premium single-family detached and attached homes across multiple regional markets. The company also offers in-house mortgage, title, and insurance services through its Tri Pointe Connect affiliates. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified; the company engages homebuyers and broker partners through its consumer website and broker program.

providers.name: V2X
providers.description: V2X is a defense and national security contractor providing mission-critical solutions including AI integration, cybersecurity, advanced engineering, operations support, training, and modernization services. The company serves U.S. government, allied defense, and aerospace customers globally. V2X does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Abata Therapeutics
providers.description: Abata Therapeutics was a biotechnology company developing engineered regulatory T cell (Treg) therapies aimed at restoring immune tolerance in tissue-specific autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, with lead programs directed at progressive multiple sclerosis and type 1 diabetes. Founded in 2021 and based in the Boston/Cambridge area (Watertown, Massachusetts), the company was launched by Third Rock Ventures and counted Lightspeed Venture Partners among its backers. As a therapeutics developer it operated no public developer program, API, or documentation surface. As of this enrichment pass its corporate domains (abatatx.com and abatatherapeutics.com) resolve to a WP Engine host but serve an unconfigured "Site Not Configured" 404, indicating the public website has been deprovisioned and the company appears to have wound down.

providers.name: Abyrx
providers.description: Abyrx is a medical device company that develops a materials-science platform for therapeutic devices used during surgical procedures, with an initial focus on hemostatic bone putties. Its flagship product, MONTAGE, is a cohesive, settable, and resorbable hemostatic bone putty that adheres to bleeding bone surfaces, used in orthopedic, trauma, spine, sports medicine, cranial, maxillofacial, and cardiothoracic surgeries. Abyrx is a B2B medical device manufacturer serving healthcare providers and surgeons; it is not a technology platform and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Adialante
providers.description: Adialante is a medical imaging startup redesigning MRI from the ground up with new physics, algorithms, and hardware to make cancer screening accessible and affordable. Rather than selling multi-million-dollar equipment, Adialante deploys compact, mobile, diagnostic-grade MRI units to clinics on a flat per-scan fee, letting clinics collect insurance reimbursement and keep the margin. Its full-body scanner is roughly 80% lighter and uses about 60% less power than a traditional MRI. The company is starting with pre-biopsy prostate imaging for urology practices, with breast, orthopedic, brain, and whole-body screening on the roadmap. Founded in 2023 and part of Y Combinator's Spring 2026 batch, Adialante is backed by more than $3M in grants including NSF SBIR Phase II funding.

providers.name: Advanced Biohealing
providers.description: Advanced BioHealing, Inc. was a regenerative medicine company best known for Dermagraft, a cryopreserved human fibroblast-derived dermal substitute used to treat diabetic foot ulcers. The company acquired the Dermagraft assets from Smith & Nephew in 2006, was backed by Canaan Partners and other venture investors, and was acquired by Shire plc for $750 million in cash in June 2011 to seed Shire's regenerative medicine business unit. Dermagraft was later sold to Organogenesis in 2014. Advanced BioHealing no longer operates as an independent entity and publishes no public developer portal, API, or programmatic surface; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company record.

providers.name: Advanced Computer Communications
providers.description: Advanced Computer Communications (ACC), founded as Associated Computer Consultants, was a data networking equipment vendor based in Santa Barbara, California. The company began by building IMP interfaces for the ARPANET — initially for IBM 360 mainframes and later for DEC PDP-11 minicomputers — and grew into a maker of wide-area internetworking products for the interconnection and management of distributed computer networks, including carrier-class routers and integrated remote-access gear. In 1990 it sold its ACCES/MVS native TCP/IP stack for MVS to Interlink Computer Sciences. Ericsson agreed to acquire ACC in 1998 for approximately USD 285 million in cash and completed the acquisition that same year, after which ACC ceased to exist as an independent company. ACC predates the public web API era and never operated a developer program, public API, or developer portal; no successor developer surface exists under the ACC name today.

providers.name: Aeroscout
providers.description: AeroScout was an Israeli real-time location systems (RTLS) company that built Wi-Fi-based RFID tags, exciters, and location receivers together with the MobileView software platform to track the location, condition, and status of mobile assets and people, primarily for hospitals and healthcare providers. Menlo Ventures led its Series C round in 2007. AeroScout was acquired by Stanley Black & Decker in 2012 (~$240M) and folded into Stanley Healthcare; the product line and brand now live under Securitas Healthcare / Securitas Technology. AeroScout no longer operates as an independent company and publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs — integration with the on-premise AeroScout Engine has historically been via a SOAP API for enterprise/HIS systems rather than a public web API.

providers.name: Agenovir
providers.description: Agenovir Corporation was a biotechnology company founded in 2014 to develop a novel class of human therapeutics targeting diseases caused by latent or persistent viral reservoirs. Built on CRISPR/Cas9 and other nuclease technology from the Stephen Quake lab at Stanford, it designed and simulated nucleases in silico at scale to disrupt intracellular viral DNA. It raised a $10.6M Series A led by DCVC (Data Collective) with Celgene and Lightspeed Venture Partners, and was acquired by Vir Biotechnology in 2018. It is a therapeutics company with no public developer, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Agito Networks
providers.description: Agito Networks was an enterprise mobility and mobile unified communications (UC) company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with a European presence in Reading, England. Its flagship product, the RoamAnywhere Mobility Router, was a network appliance that fused enterprise wireless LANs, carrier cellular networks, IP telephony, and location technology to extend PBX, deskphone, and unified communications features to mobile phones, providing handover between WiFi, 3G, and cellular networks while remaining agnostic to carrier and equipment vendor. The company was venture-backed by Battery Ventures, Castile Ventures, and ITX International. Agito Networks was acquired by IP telephony provider ShoreTel in 2010 for approximately $11.4 million, adding fixed-mobile convergence to ShoreTel's UC portfolio; ShoreTel was later acquired by Mitel, and the agitonetworks.com domain now redirects to Mitel. The company no longer operates as a standalone entity and publishes no public API, developer portal, or specifications.

providers.name: Ai Vivo
providers.description: AI VIVO (AIVIVO LTD) is a Cambridge, England based drug-discovery company that combines systems pharmacology with artificial intelligence to accelerate the identification and de-risking of therapeutic candidates. Its "Organome" platform simulates biological processes at the target, cell, organ, and organism levels and ranks drug candidates by their phenotypic effects at the tissue level, without relying on prior knowledge of the disease or compounds. The approach gained recognition in 2020 when the platform ranked roughly 90,000 compounds for COVID-19 and surfaced dexamethasone as a top candidate weeks before its clinical benefit was widely reported. AI VIVO is backed by DCVC and other life-science and applied-AI investors. As of this profile the company publishes a minimal public web presence (a home and contact page) and exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK.

providers.name: AirBand Communications
providers.description: AirBand Communications, Inc. was a fixed-wireless broadband provider for business customers, founded in 2000 by Andy Lombard and headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It delivered high-speed data, Voice over IP, security and managed services over a last-mile fixed-wireless network, bypassing incumbent local phone companies, and operated in metropolitan markets including Baltimore, Dallas, Fort Worth, Houston, Philadelphia and Phoenix. The company was venture-backed, raising roughly $119M across sixteen rounds from investors including Battery Ventures, M/C Partners and Crescendo Ventures, and grew by acquiring the fixed-wireless business of WindChannel Communications (2006) and Sparkplug (2010). Airband was acquired by United Network Services (UNSi) on 2013-05-15 and no longer operates independently. As of the 2026-07-19 enrichment pass its former domains (airband.com, www.airband.com, airbandcommunications.com) do not resolve (DNS NXDOMAIN), and no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts of any kind could be found. This company is retained in the network as a historical/defunct record only. Not to be confused with Airband Community Internet, an unrelated UK rural broadband operator.

providers.name: Airvana
providers.description: Airvana was a Chelmsford, Massachusetts wireless infrastructure company founded in 2000 by former Motorola engineers Sanjeev Verma and Vedat Eyuboglu, building femtocells and small cells for 3G CDMA2000 EV-DO and 4G LTE mobile broadband networks. Its access points extended operator coverage inside buildings over consumer broadband connections, and the company was a founding member of the Femto Forum and an active contributor to femtocell standards. Airvana went public on NASDAQ (AIRV) in July 2007, was taken private in 2010, and was acquired by CommScope in 2015. It no longer operates as an independent company: the airvana.com apex serves no site, www.airvana.com now points into CommScope infrastructure, and there is no Airvana developer portal, public API, or SDK. Its femtocell and device management products were TR-069 based operator systems rather than public web APIs.

providers.name: Allegiance Telecom
providers.description: Allegiance Telecom was a competitive local exchange carrier (CLEC) founded in 1997 and backed by Battery Ventures, providing local and long-distance voice, data, and internet services to business customers across major U.S. metropolitan markets. The company went public in 1998, expanded rapidly during the telecom boom, then filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2003; its network assets were acquired by XO Communications. Allegiance Telecom is defunct and operates no website, developer program, or public API surface today. This profile was surfaced from the Battery Ventures portfolio graph and is retained as an historical company record in the API Evangelist network. Enrichment found no live API artifacts to harvest.

providers.name: Alsius
providers.description: Alsius Corporation was a medical-device company that developed catheter-based intravascular temperature-management (IVTM) systems for precise regulation of core body temperature. Its heat-exchange catheters and control consoles induced or reversed therapeutic hypothermia to treat cardiac arrest, brain ischemia, and traumatic brain injury. Backed by Canaan Partners (Canaan Equity), Alsius went public via a 2006 reverse merger with Ithaka Acquisition Corp and sold its temperature-management assets to ZOLL Medical Corporation for roughly USD 12 million in 2009, after which it ceased to operate as an independent company. It has no public developer program, API, or specifications; this profile is a Canaan-partners portfolio identity record with no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Altonomy
providers.description: Altonomy is a digital-asset trading, market-making, and OTC firm founded in 2018 and headquartered in Singapore, with additional offices in New York City and Shenzhen. The firm provides 24/7 over-the-counter transaction services for crypto-to-fiat and crypto-to-crypto trades, deep liquidity coverage for illiquid tokens, and institutional-grade advisory and asset-management solutions across proprietary trading, mining, and venture capital. Its proprietary Hybrid IQ methodology pairs discretionary crypto-market experience with market-making algorithms to deliver order-book depth and tight spreads. Altonomy is also a data provider to the Pyth Network. In 2022, Blockchain.com acquired Altonomy's OTC trading desk; Altonomy continues to operate its other lines of business. Altonomy publishes no public developer API or documentation surface; this profile is a company/provider identity record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Altra Energy Technologies
providers.description: Altra Energy Technologies was a Houston, Texas software company founded in 1996 by Williams and PanEnergy (later Duke Energy) that built neutral online trading platforms for the energy sector.
